text:
Very disappointing experience.
The location is nice and the staff is friendly but the hotel is  very far to be even close to a 4star 
For €600/night you would expect much better experience
The rooms are very small
The breakfast is sub standard 
The bathroom is small and needs a refresh

name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: UNRESTFUL!
text:
Dropped off luggage for storage and returned to hotel in afternoon.  Check- in smooth and friendly

Another Paris hotel with small rooms but I hoped for more in a more modern brand.  Two bags of luggage a problem and had to put in entryway area along wall.  No luggage rack.

Bathroom nice although counter space minimal.

Windows open which provided some fresh air.

Sleep quality very poor.  The bed has a nice soft diver but the bed itself is hard.  Not at all comfortable and my back pointed that out to me.  The previous  2 nights at another hotel put this bed to shame.

And then in early morning around 6 a sound started me co to use about every 5 or 6 minutes.  A cross between a drill or impact sound that would last about 2 seconds.  Especially noticed in the bathroom.

Breakfast continental was OK.

Would not stay here again and I have stayed in many Hotels in the Marriott family.  Certainly not worth the cost and this was called a deluxe room with view of courtyard.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Amazing stay in Paris.
text:
Great hotel. Well located. Fantastic service. From Osna in front desk, Breakfast Team, Lea at concierge and finally Ahmed the fantastic porter. 
A little story. I forgot my bag at the hotel leaving in a taxi. While driving I see a car approaching with Ahmed in it. He took a cab and brought me my bag. That was unique top notch service. I am still amazed of his entrepreneurial action. Thanks a lot for the amazing stay
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Exceptional Concierge Service
text: I stayed here with my mother in May 2022 to celebrate her milestone birthday. I’ve been thinking about the trip over the last few months and was compelled to write a review. The service from Gaël at the concierge desk was absolutely exceptional and truly made the trip better than I imagined. I emailed ahead of time for help booking a restaurant I wasn’t able to get a reservation for and within the hour, he emailed me back with a reservation with the exact date and time I needed. He asked if he could help with anything else, so he helped us book a tour of Versailles, which picked us up from the hotel and dropped us off again. Just what I had been searching for but couldn’t find online. In my email, I mentioned it was a trip for a milestone birthday, so when we arrived there was a bottle of champagne and a small cake with “happy birthday” written on it. When the concierge staff made us a reservation, they would call our room with a friendly reminder or mention is to us in the lobby (amazing how they could personally know guests by name). I really cannot say enough good things about the service. We stayed in a garden view room, which I found a bit small, but it was what I expect in a major European city. The location is wonderful on a quiet street, but easy to walk or take a short Uber anywhere you need to get. Thank you again to Gaël and his concierge team for the memorable trip and exceptional service.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Perfectly nice stay in Paris
text: We had a nice stay here for 1 night in a Garden View King room. The room and bathroom were plenty spacious. The bath/shower were tucked oddly into the corner of the bathroom, so it was a bit awkward to get in/out. The hotel is in a good location, within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, but not in the middle of all the hustle and bustle of the area. The staff were very pleasant and the hotel was clean. While not my favorite place I've stayed in Paris, overall we had a nice stay and would recommend for a mid-range hotel in this neighborhood.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Lovely hotel, great location
text:
Hotel is modern, staff friendly and accommodating. We booked a suite for our family and the room was actually 2 levels - not ideal for small children. The pull out couch was surprisingly comfortable and the pack-n-play provided by the hotel was great. 

There is a bathtub which is wonderful for children and relaxing. The glass door only partitioned off half the tub which allowed too much water on the floor when bathing. 

If you love a very firm mattress, these beds are ideal for you. I did request a mattress topper to provide some soft comfort but one was not available. 

The bar staff are lovely and the areas is recently remodeled. Great for an aperitif. 

One interesting bit is the beautiful courtyard. Breakfast buffet seating is in the courtyard however it is a separate restaurant in the evening at which you cannot get reservations.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Average stay
text:
Came to the hotel in the early morning and was told that the check in time was at 3pm. It looked more like a boutique hotel than a  chain Marriott property. No problem, we dropped off the luggage and headed out to explore the city. The location is very convenient as it’s within the walking distance to the great Eiffel Tower, Arc d’Triomphe and the bridge where Inception was filmed at. 

As a platinum elite, I wasn’t much recognized as my suite upgrade certificates were denied and I was asked to pay €200/night in order to upgrade to a family room. In fact, unless I was staying at Courtyard or other more economical tier Marriott properties, this was the first time an upgrade wasn’t granted neither through the platinum status nor the upgrade certificates but it’s okay as I know they are running a business. 

Breakfast was okay as it included continental breakfast, croissants, juices, and some cold cuts. Omelets could also be orders through staffs. Friendly staff handed a piece of paper for us to tip should we feel the service was good. Staff was definitely friendly and helpful.

All and all, the hotel is at a good location, close to restaurants but with small space.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Fabulous in Paris
text: Just had another fabulous stay at this hotel. Thank you to management, especially Erica, for making my stay amazing from start to finish… as well as all of the other front desk people who helped along the way. The excellent customer was much appreciated! Finally, the concierge, Olivier, is truly amazing! He is always so helpful and accommodating. He really is the best of the best! A big thank you to the entire staff for another excellent stay!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Family visit to Paris
text:
Our family of 4 with 2 young children stayed in a Loft Suite for 4 nights in July. The hotel is well-situated down the street from the Eiffel Tower but far enough away that you are out of the crowds.
The loft was a good size for the family, such that we could spend time there during the day and feel relaxed.
Admittedly, the hotel is a bit tired but they do a good job with cleanliness and upkeep. The staff is friendly and especially Lea at concierge went above and beyond to help our family with transportation.
The breakfast is nice. The afternoon/eve bar service was hit or miss. One young woman was a great bartender but others left a bit to be desired. They tried their best though.
Relatively speaking for a city hotel, this was a good experience. We had no issues with sound or poor service or anything negative. This hotel is a good option for visiting Paris.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Our Stay
text: My wife and I immensely loved our time at the Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel for her surprise birthday trip. Prior to our arrival, I emailed the hotel to order 12 roses for my wife to be delivered on her birthday. Olivier and others were responsive to my emails and ordered the flowers for me. Upon our arrival, Fiona checked us in and escorted us to our building. The day prior to my wife's birthday, Lea provided me with a blank card to write sweet words, told me that a vase will be available to use, and asked me what time I would like the flowers delivered. On my wife's birthday, the 12 roses were delivered at the exact time requested. A bottle of champagne on ice and two danishes from Maison Russe were also delivered to my surprise! In addition, I would be remiss if I did not say kudos to the restaurant and kitchen staff for breakfast!  Thank you!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Wonderful and Centrally Located Hotel
text: My wife and I really enjoyed our time at the Renaissance hotel near the Eiffel Tower. The staff is super welcoming, especially Asma, Ahmed, and Stephan. The hotel and rooms are clean. The best part is the location. It is near the Eiffel Tower so we got to see it at day and night with a short walk. It is also near two metros and the area is full of restaurants, cafes, and bakeries. We had a wonderful time in Paris because of it.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: There are better hotels in Paris than this!
text: Beautiful hotel with so many possibilities. However, the room was hilariously small even for Paris hotel standards- the Moxy rooms have more space. We couldn’t open the window to our room because the sewer smell in the courtyard was too strong. Another super frustrating thing is the clear identity crisis between the restaurant Maison Russe and the Renaissance. Multiple times the restaurant staff made it clear that they were separate from the hotel. It seems both are fighting for their own identities and coexistence is not possible. The restaurant hostesses couldn’t greet us or acknowledge us hotel guests and at check in with hotel staff we were told we could get a reservation with no issues. Well there were issues. We never got a reservation for the 3 nights we were there. To make it worse, towards the end of (not so great-powered egg) breakfast we were kicked out to make room for the restaurant. There are so many better Hilton and Marriott properties in Paris, I would avoid this hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Hotel with loud music - no sleep
text:
Decent hotel close to lots. However, if you have a courtyard room you will not get any sleep as the restaurant plays music until 2 AM very loud. Overpriced. Let the front desk know and MAYBE they will help you. 
Nice walk to view the Eiffel Tower and Victor Hugo square.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Second stay, disappointing
text: I was using suite rewards as a Bonvoy Titanium member and was given an “upgrade” to a very small room with a cramped bathroom for a 6 night stay. I requested to move to a different room type that I had originally booked as I didn’t think this room was worth using my suite rewards. They told me that they would refund the rewards instead of moving to a different room. I was never refunded and honestly was miserable in that tiny room which had a poor layout and design. I’ve stayed there before and know that even standard rooms were more spacious. I have emailed the property now 5 times since my stay for a receipt and never received a reply. Disappointing.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Top notch service in Paris.
text:
First of all, I am one of those people that only take the time to write a review when the experience has been horrible or great. This hotel is the latter one. 
Having visited Paris for the last 20 years, I can tell you that this hotel has the best customer service I have ever experienced.
Anyone who has visited Paris, knows that the customer service in this city is not the best. However; this place has nicest and most accommodating people I have ever seen in this city. From the concierge to the people working at the reception, everyone makes you feel welcomed. There was a guy that kept giving my kid a high five every time he saw him.
My wife, 6 year old kid and I stayed at the Junior Suite on the third floor of one of the buildings, and the room was great. The view of the garden was great, and the windows were really sound-proof.
The gardens by the way are now finished. The only I would say we didn’t like that much is that the garden belongs to a restaurant, not the hotel, so we were only able to enjoy our breakfast in the garden the second day we were there. 
The breakfast is a buffet and the quality is only ok especially considering we are in France but the service there was also great. Maybe that is something they can work on and improve.
I heard a lady complain the coffee was not hot but I actually prefer it that way. 
We had a minor incident on the day we arrived but there was this young lady who had just started her shift,  that took care of us right away when I complained. I wish I had asked her for her name but I’m sure management can figure out who she is. 
Overall this hotel is amazing and the people that work there are really trying their best, which is always something I really value. 
Of course there is always going to be issues here and there but my experience was outstanding. I will definitely be coming back.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: The place to be
text:
I had the most wonderful time in this unique hotel. What a better place to stay in Paris than next to the Eiffel Tour ?
The staff made me feel really welcome and they always make themselves available.
The hotel in itself is modern yet welcoming and cosy and the new terrasse is amazing.
On top of that they commit to improve their environmental impact which is what makes this hotel outstand the other ones for me.
I would totally recommend !
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great concierge staff!
text: First time staying at this hotel, but third time in Paris and the location was great.  Just steps from Trocadero and Eiffel Tower.  Lots of great restaurants near by and metro station was close as well.  Olivier, the concierge at the hotel, was amazing!  He helped with dinner reservations before we even got there and was always happy to provide directions for our various outings.  He was especially helpful when we realized that the pharmacy where we got our mandatory return covid test for our next day flight transposed my husband's DOB.  We realized this at 6pm on a Sunday evening and Olivier helped us find a nearby pharmacy where my husband could go get re-tested so we could travel the next day without issue.  Overall a good experience at this hotel.  The only drawback was the lack of the overhead shower.  I kept flooding the bathroom everytime  I tried showering with the handheld shower device.  There was a bracket that should have held the device overhead but it appeared to be broken.  We asked the front desk if maintenance could look at it but didn't seem like they ever did.  We were only there 4 nights though.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Lovely stay
text: Very centrally located. Rooms good size for Paris and very clean. Breakfast very good, lovely staff, especially the Indian waiter at the breakfast was great - he was super kind and helpful. It was a shame that we were there during the terrace works
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Charming quiet street, intimate hotel with a garden
text:
I chose to stay at a quieter street to get more of a Paris feel away from the hustle and bustle.

Its a smaller hotel (6 floors I believe) with a small lobby. Its got all that you would expect from an original building and then one upgraded by a major hotel brand

1. Welcoming interior.
2. A fully equipped fitness center and disproportionately large compared to what I expected for this hotel size. 
3. Get the breakfast package: its plentiful and will make sure you are caloried up to skip lunch and enjoy dinner. I was.
4. Rooms and bathrooms are modern with plenty of power outlets.
5. The staff is amazingly friendly and polite. Everybody. I specially want to call out Sameer, the waiter at breakfast. He was always running around (even on busy days) making sure , despite the full house, everybody got what they needed. And he did this with the smiley cheerful attitude.
6. Location is in the middle of two different subway lines a quarter mile in either direction. And don't be misled by the name Eiffel. You have to walk 0.5 miles to see the tower across the river and the street gets busy. 
7. Lots of cafes that are not as big and busy as the popular ones facing eiffel.
8. Extreme attention to detail: the headphones for guest use in the fitness center are high quality. I didn't use them but not the cheap disposable kind (see picture)

Somethings to look out for:
1. Fitness center doesn't have wipes to use to clean prior person's use (or after your use)
2. There is a garden in the middle courtyard. I could see it and was one of the reasons I booked it. Unfortunately , its under repair and wasn't usable. They should state that in the reservation confirmation or let  you know at check-in and do something to make up for it. I don't know know how long the construction is for
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Wedding Anniversary and Birthday Celebration
text:
The reservations were easy and the communications with the hotel staff were excellent.  Veronica was so personal and responsive from beginning to the end of our stay.  We had some questions after booking our reservations and then reading some of the reviews.  The gardens were not open (will be next week) but we can say from our experience that it was the best choice for our stay in Paris!  There are so many reasons  why we enjoyed our stay at this hotel: great room on the 2nd floor, quiet, safe neighborhood location; proximity to the Eiffel Tower; short walk to metro train station; neighborhood restaurants; availability of virus testing locations; close to the Arc de Triumph; short, reasonable Uber and or taxi rides to all the attractions Paris has to offer.  The hotel staff led by Kumar was there for us giving directions, arranging transportation, providing  eating suggestions and answering all of our questions.  And the hotel breakfast was very good.  We could not have been more pleased with our choice of our hotel accommodations and we will return one day in the future.

Thank you Veronica, Kumar and Staff,
Rich and Norma
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Perfect stay
text: We had a great experience in Renaissance Nobel Tour Eiffel. The staff were very polite and helpful. Our room was ready for our late check-in at 11.30 pm.  I was just sorry to see the garden was closed for renovation. The family suite was exclusive. Definitely will come back!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Disappointing at best
text:
Several issues occurred.   We booked 2 rooms, arriving with small children after long international flights.    Our rooms were not ready until nearly an hour after the advertised checkin time.   We decided to wait in the garden courtyard that was beautifully depicted on the website.    It was ripped up and replaced with a construction site.  Bulldozers, etc.  this construction was not mentioned in our reservation  confirmation nor on the Marriott website.     
A smoke alarm went off repeatedly in the night in our room.   Maintenance fixed it, temporarily.    This all outweighed staying in the Trocadero neighborhood.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great stay at the Renaissance Nobel Tour Eiffel !
text: Great stay at the Renaissance Nobel Tour Eiffel. Very attentive staff, we ordered room service, it was fast and very good ! We also slept well our bed was very comfortable. Thank you very much for this night.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Don’t trust the pictures on the website
text: We just checked in and were told we received a suite upgrade with my Titanium Elite status. Our room isn’t even in the main building but is also a standard room, which they admitted at check in. They said they upgraded us to a garden view. We were very excited until we were escorted to the room, only to discover that there isn’t a garden but a full construction zone. I will be calling Marriott International to discuss with them - the rooms are shabby - broken curtains, hot water doesn’t work if someone in a room next to you is using it, a dirty wine glass left for us that had wine in the bottom and lipstick on the glass, broken bathroom accessories and filthy carpets.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: What a great place to stay !
text: Gael took care of all our needs! It was a wonderful place to stay and made our visit to France even more amazing. Cannot say enough about Gael  for he was truly amazing as well as the renaissance . Very centrally located . We will return
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Wonderful experience and stay
text: I've arrived for a discovery night at the hotel on saturday 11 september. We received a warm welcome from Miguel Naranjo Montero and he offered us a 5 star welcoming. Miguel has shown us the room where we were going to stay and we really enjoyed it. Then we went eating at the relais and we had a wonderful meal, my grandmother and myself congratulated the chef Xavier Pistol for his wonderful cooking. We can describe our stay at the Renaissance memorable and we thanks again all the person who took care of us during this stay Miguel for the front office, Simon, Ambre, Paolo for our dinner at the Relais and Marine who took care of us during breakfast. I really recommand the hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Wonderful experience
text:
Rarely is a chain hotel this charming and his garden make it one of the most unique hotels I've had the pleasure to visit in Paris. Staff is welcoming and friendly too!
You must have a dinner in the garden, best experience.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Horrible Treatment as a Platinum Elite Bonvoy Member
text: So I booked a reservation here on points (50,000 to be exact) due to an emergency. A friend of mine missed her flight, and had one rescheduled for the following day at 6:30 pm. As a Platinum Elite member, I get complimentary check-out of 4 pm. I booked her here, due to the benefits of a late check-out. BOY WAS I WRONG. The hotel staff member informed me that because I PERSONALLY WAS NOT STAYING HERE, that my friend could not get the 4 pm late check-out. They claimed that it is a benefit solely for the member, not for any accompanying guests. FALSE, this is not true. As a front desk agent, I extend 4 pm late check-outs to Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador members, even if they book the reservation for a family or friend. THIS HOTEL ENDED UP CHARGING ME OVER $100 for a 4 pm late check-out, when It should have done so free of charge. I guess this hotel is in need of a buck. Safe to say, I would not recommend this establishment to anyone. HORRIBLE. They stole from me. Charging me over $100 for a perk that I am given due to my Bonvoy status. If you are a Bonvoy member, stay away from this hotel. Far, far, far away.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Amazing stay
text: What an amazing experience staying in this hotel this week. Miguel, Amelia, and Viktoria from the front desk made me feel at home and were there anticipating everything we needed. Our room was perfect and had a view of the Eiffel Tower. The coffee maker worked well. Everything was within walking distance and the sceneries were panoramic all over. The best thing is that it didn't''t matter to this hotel staff that we are still in the middle of the pandemic -- they made no excuses to providing world class hospitality. I can't wait to return.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: This property has gone downhill.
text:
We stayed here a few years ago and had a fabulous experience. So, returning to Paris for another visit, we decided to stay here again. It was a poor decision. 

The property itself seems to have depreciated over the last few years. We have had multiple issues with the bathroom - continually losing hot water completely and having to call the front desk to get it fixed. When the hot water does work, it bounces between scalding hot to freezing cold giving you a short period of nice warm shower water before you have to step out for a few seconds. Additionally, the shower head falls constantly - again, having to call the front desk to tighten the shower head just for it to fall again the next day. 

It seems the property has suspended mini bar service, which is fine given COVID. However, our mini fridge had not been cleaned out when we arrived. The coffee has also gone majorly downhill and we noticed that the entire hotel is only serving instant coffee - even in the breakfast area! This is a crime!!! To pay €30 per person for breakfast with instant coffee is a disappointment for anyone that needs caffeine in the AM…. Especially at this price. 

Finally, the walls are just incredibly thin. We can hear the baby and toddler wailing to our left (no one’s fault, but still no fun) and the folks cursing about a business deal upstairs. Thank the lord for ear plugs. 

Anyway, for the price, pick another hotel. There are so many great places to stay in Paris and it would be a waste for anyone to spend their time and money here.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Fantastic boutique hotel in an ideal location with great service
text: I just completed my solo trip to Paris and could not speak more highly of this hotel. I’ve been to Paris many times, and this time just came for a long weekend from NYC to enjoy the City (past pandemic) and avoid any typical touristy stuff. The Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel is located in a great neighborhood, on a pretty tree-lined street. Unparalleled view of the Eiffel Tower from the riverbank and the Trocadore is simply steps away form the hotel. Arc de Triomphe/Champs Elysee is a 20 min walk. If you want to enjoy a long leisurely walk along the bank of the Seine and spot most of the major landmarks, this location is ideal for that too. If you want to stay away from the crowd, and want to enjoy high end shopping and restaurants at Avenue Montaigne, it’s a 20-25 min walk in that direction from the hotel. The hotel is small but property is beautiful, clean, very well maintained and the service of the front desk, room service and concierge are top notch. The restaurant is not just beautiful with a great garden seating, but the food was also really great, and they offer room service until 10pm. The gym is small but they seem to allow only 2 people at a time (requires advanced booking) - so it serves the purpose for a stress-free workout. Overall, for a non-touristy solo trip I could not have picked a better hotel. While the hotel doesn’t have the grandeur of many Category 7 Marriott properties, the quality of service and amenities probably make up for it. Room was definitely spacious by pros standards. Hotel also had a super cute lobby and bar at the entrance be.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Pleasant
text: Spent one night at this hotel and my stay here was wonderful. The hotel’s location is perfect, easy walk to many local attractions ( the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and many more). I would recommend this lovely hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: A hidden gem in the heart of Paris
text:
This hotel was everything we were hoping for.
The staff is kind and very professional. The rooms are elegantly furnished very clean and the bedding is extremely comfortable. Breakfast is excellent with fresh fruit and amazing croissants! We had breakfast in the lovely hotel garden, a haven of peace and quiet. 
Only a few blocks away from the Eiffel Tower and the Trocadéro, this hotel is the perfect place to stay if you want to visit the city or relax at the hotel. We will definitely come back
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great service, but rooms not as advertised
text: Great service , but room not as advertised and need renovation. Reserved a king they gave me 2 twin beds and said they dont have king, so they put two twins together. Not comfortable for a high end hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Plesant stay
text:
I stayed in hotel Renaissance Paris Trocadero for 4 nights. In general, staffs are very kind with excellent service-oriented mind set. Really appreciated for their kindness during my stay.

Internet speed was ok,
Breakfast : good
Location : very good
Cleanness : good
Water pressure (shower) : should be improved. 
Screen mirroring (mobile-hotel room tv) : ok
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Perfect choice
text: Choosing a hotel in Paris can be overwhelming.  We selected this one due to its location and Marriott affiliation.  Could not have been happier.  We visited some of the huge hotels in other areas of the city, and we’re glad to be able to return to this small, peaceful hotel in a wonderful building (or buildings?).  A short distance to Eiffel Tower, the Arc and other attractions.  Plenty of restaurants within easy walking distance, and even a few supermarkets to stock up on supplies.  Staff was great...friendly and helpful.  No complaints here.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Decent location, easy to navigate to and from, nice dining nearby
text: So many properties to choose from in Paris. This one fit a few of my criteria:  1). Close to the Arc. 2).  Decent dining nearby.  3).  Easy to navigate to and from.  4).  Nice property.  The facility was well kept and nice on property breakfast.  The location was good to get to and from and the staff was friendly enough.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: lovely boutique hotel
text: I will only stay at Marriott, but I like their smaller properties, so this was a lovely boutique hotel. Staff was so kind - thank you Miguel, Viktoria, and Clemence for being so welcoming.  We had a long journey, so being so warm upon our arrival made a great first impression for our Paris visit. Restaurant was very good too but service could have been more attentive and friendly. Rooms and lobby are lovely.  I highly recommend.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Good hotel, great location, outstanding staff!
text:
While I’ll start by saying that my room was a bit worn, my recent stay here was wonderful. My younger son is in a study abroad program, and my wife and older son recently spent a week at this property. 

Even before check-in, we benefited from the great service of the staff. Our taxi driver from CDG couldn’t make his credit card reader work—and without being asked, our bellman paid him. I just wish I had the bellman’s name! Julie at the front desk was equally kind and welcoming, and the housekeeping staff was warm and friendly. The bartender was a nice young man, and the staff at the hotel’s restaurant was quite accommodating.

The hotel’s location in the 16th is great for tourists—we walked to the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and many, many other places. Easy walk to both the Trocadero and Victor Hugo metro stations. Le Scossa near the Victor Hugo station was my favorite nearby restaurant, though the Italian place Ozio was pretty good too. 

The hotel itself consists of four buildings and a central courtyard. It’s not a huge property—one could almost call it a boutique hotel with a straight face, though hints of being part of a chain abound. We were in an older building—but I’m unsure if any of the others are newer. The bathroom was a but small, and the step getting out of the tub feels like a leap. We did have a towel warmer, but the bathroom ventilation was not great. Recommend springing for the breakfast package if you’re a morning eater—it’s quite the spread.

Several little markets nearby where one can procure a beer or bottle of wine.

If you’re Bonvoy loyal, Le Dokhan’s is very close, and appeared to be a cut above...but I didn’t have the nearly 200K additional points needed t stay there!

I would be more than willing to stay here again—largely because of the first-rate staff.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Not worth its stars!
text:
Spent a Sunday night at this hotel... It was my 3rd time there... Very disappointed ! 
Apparently the type of room I was assigned was an upgrade to what I had booked. 
Furniture seemed a bit tired. No heating or towel heater in the bathroom. Very unpleasant when outside temperatures are low as they were that week. As the air conditioning was not working properly either and I felt a bit cold, I called housekeeping to ask for a blanket. The person who answered the phone said that her colleagues had left 5 minutes earlier (it was 22.35) and she could not satisfy my request. I was very tired and was not in a mood to fight for what I think should not happen in a 5-star hotel so I did not complain... Useless to say I did not have a good night. I will not return to this hotel fo sure.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great hotel and location
text: The hotel was very nice and the staff was extremely helpful. It is in a very nice, safe area with lots of restaurants too choose from. It’s also close to multiple train stations and the BigBus tour stop which makes getting around Paris easy.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Nice hotel
text:
My last 2 stays were in this hotel. The hotel lobby although is small but the staff are very friendly. The rooms although not as big as the previous one that I stayed but I could say all is well contained and nice. The down side was the shower head where it keeps on sliding to face the floor, which always the floor wet after bath.
Is located in a very convenient location where they have 2 metro near the hotel. One is Victor Hugo and the other is Trocadero. Very accessible. There are lots of cafes nearby. I tried Le Poincare as well as Le Petit Retro, both recommended by the hotel staff, and is nice. I have posted the review of both restaurant in Trip advisor as well.
There is also a nice Patisserie shop near the hotel called Sabrina. The display makes the cake all looks so delicious, but I chance upon it on my last day and is too early to have the cakes for my breakfast. Thus I missed it.
Hotel is also near the Eiffel Tower (about 8 to 10minutes walk). Take a night stroll to see the light up of it. Simply stunning and beautiful.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Easy to get around with a short walk to an amazing view.
text: I probably would have given a 5 star review but our first room was so hot and the shower head was uncontrollable. You could not adjust it to keep it from spraying from all over the floor. We moved to a different room and everything was much better. They probably need more than 1 concierge because the hotel was full and waiting in line to ask the concierge anything was not something we wanted to do.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Paris Treasure
text: This hotel is a little off the main tourist areas, thus the reason it is such a treasure!   King beds in European hotels are not the norm, but they do.   The rooms are very nicely appointed.   The breakfast buffet is very high quality and has something for everyone.   I cannot say enough about the staff and how they cater to their guests.    You are a short walk to the metro and not too far from the Eiffel Tower.    We will be back!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Highly recommended!
text:
Stayed for the first time at this hotel recently and would highly recommend it. The rooms are well appointed and staff are very welcoming and helpful. We were in Paris for a short stay, and were happy with the hotel’s great location -very convenient location to the Eiffel Tower , plus a wonderful chance to see a Parisian neighbourhood. We enjoyed the visit to a street market nearby as well as a wonderful meal at a perfect bistro recommended by the helpful and knowledgeable Concierge. All within walking distance to the hotel.
Leave some time to sit and enjoy the outdoor garden of the hotel which comes complete with outdoor heating . It is a lovely respite from the busyness of Paris. We will be back!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Parisian experience!
text: Thanks to Jeffrey,Vince (Guest services) and Ommaund (Breakfast Staff) for making our stay special. Loved the location with easy access to the Metro system. Trocadero, Bossiere and Victor Hugo close by.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Excellent staff member
text: I stayed here recently on a business trip, the location is perfect for business and pleasure. There were one or two shortfalls on arrival however the excellence of Clemence really won me over, he is professional, helpful, efficient, polite and went above and beyond to ensure that i ended up with a satisfactory stay and because of him i will most definitely return. All others team members wee good also.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great location in Paris!  Highly recommend!
text: The staff at this hotel is absolutely lovely and welcoming.  Our room had a little view of the Eiffel Tower and was very spacious.  Breakfast had many options and everything was delicious.  The hotel's location is so convenient to exploring Paris.  A short walk to the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe.  The front desk staff, bellman and conceirge are all top notch.  Highly recommend this hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Excellent Location, Superb Staff
text: This hotel is in a great location, a short walk to the Eiffel Tower, or the Arc de Triomphe.  Many excellent bistros within easy walking distance:  Ozio Italian, prompt service, great food, reasonable prices; La Coincidence, just around the corner; XVI Avenue, great lamb shank, prompt servce, reasonable prices, small grocery just down the street where you can get a bottle of wine for your room.  Easy walk to the RER that takes you to Versailles.  Our room was in the front of the hotel, on the small side, but it had a queen bed, fridge,and was clean and comfortable, very quiet.  Breakfast was included for us, and I would rate it as excellent, wide variety of breads, pastries, cheeses, hot entrees; they'll make an omlette or eggs benedict.  Staff was perfect, very helpful, especially Ameilia at the front desk, and Michael, the consierge.  We needed a taxi a few times, and Michael had one there within minutes.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Good stay
text:
We’ve spent three nights there and I must say that the hotel rooms are comfortable, clean and the set of amenities rendered the stay enjoyable.
The reception team along with the concierge are very helpful. The concierge tried his best to accommodate our last minute requests.
One small note that I hope to be taken constructively! We wanted to have lunch on Sunday at the brunch; I admit we did not have any reservations but I would have appreciated accommodating us. We were told to sit alone inside since all tables were booked!!! An hour after, three tables were still dressed without being occupied so not to mention that more than ten tables were without any table cloths or cushions! We ended up having a sandwich in the room and the hotel lost the opportunity of accommodating us and earning definitely more revenues. I am sure it was feasible if the person in charge had the will to do so!!!! 
Overall, it is a nice stay.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Absolutely marvellous
text: Can’t praise this hotel enough, the staff were amazing very conscientious professional and can’t wait to return. Really looked after my wife and I during our time there making us feel as if we were the only visitors at the hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Superbly located
text: I was lucky enough to be treated to a weekend here so I don’t know how much the room cost...however the hotel is superbly located between the Eiffel Tower and the arc de triomphe about ten minutes walk from each. It’s on a nice street with plenty of shops bars and cafes all around. Breakfast was fresh and delicious and a huge variety of foods. Room was clean and comfortable. Staff all extremely helpful and spoke perfect English. The only thing I found was that the service was a little slow in the evenings, we had to wait a long time after ordering drinks in the bar. The restaurant is terribly expensive and has a very limited menu so we preferred to eat at the cafe XVI eme which is almost next door and much more what I wanted for an evening in Paris. Highly recommended
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Just great
text:
The hotel has great service. The rooms are super comfortable, well lit, and perfectly equipped. The decoration is very nice and since it's october it was themed with photographs in relation to Breast Cancer Awareness. They are also environmentally friendly because they do not change your towels unless you put a sign outside that you prefer to change them. 
The location is great, not far from the eiffel tower or the arc de triomphe. 
The breakfast buffet options are wide and delicious. 
Highly recommend.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Perfect Stay
text:
My favorite hotel in Paris! We absolutely loved it! The room and bathroom are nicely designed, fresh and very clean. The pillows are super comfy as well. It is 10 minutes walking distance to the Eiffel Tower.

Breakfast was very nice with freshly squeezed orange juice, which you don’t see at many places nowadays.

The staff were WONDERFUL!! Everyone from the front desk, bell captain to the concierge were absolutely amazing with great energy!

We will definitely be back next time we visit Paris!  Just one suggestion if the hotel is ready for renovation in the future to install double or triple pane windows to reduce outside traffic noice. Otherwise, AMAZING!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great Location for Many Reasons
text:
We spent 5 nights at the hotel and found the hotel staff to be exceptionally friendly and helpful.  The hotel is very clean, our room was comfortable, we had a view of the top of the Eiffel Tower, and the morning breakfast was very filling. The only downside was the smaller bathroom...it was a bit tight.  

The great news is the location!  A quick walk to the Trocadero plaza where you won't get a better picture of the Eiffel Tower.  The restaurants in this area are also very good and the metro line is right there.  Walk in the opposite direction from the hotel and you're at Victor Hugo circle, where there are more great restaurants and the metro.

We were extremely pleased with this Marriott property and plan to stay here again on our next trip.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Can’t believe I’ve never stayed at a Renaissance before.
text:
Platinum Elite and never stayed at a Renaissance before. This was the first time for me and it was a great stay!

Check-in was swift, benefits were explained in detail. Front desk was very prompt and offered to fix any issues that came up. 

I had an upgraded Garden View room which it didn’t really matter since I never look out — but the gesture was appreciated. Upon entry, I was presented with a bottle of wine, a personalized welcome note and some French chocolate. 

I denied housekeeping for a couple of days as I usually don’t need it cleaned that often. However upon the 4th day I’ve asked for house keeping to come in and it was done promptly before I returned. Very impressed.

My only very minor complaint was the free buffet offered to elite guests; at times the restaurant seemed quite chaotic and it’s hard to catch the waiters/waitresses. I even had one of the waitresses take away my coffee and plates while I stepped to get some more food (thinking that I left).

Would return, recommended.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Fantastic stay/ neighborhood location
text:
About a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and steps away from other attractions. My friend and I loved this stay. As a titanium elite member, I loved the perk of breakfast. We spent 3 nights and made this our Paris home. The room was not giant, but the stay was on points and it was completely worth it. The staff were friendly and willing to help. The check in area can get crowded if it’s busy, but other than that it’s easy to move around. 

The location is great! The street feels like an authentic Parisian experience. 

Breakfast was fantastic. Some mornings we ordered omelettes and others we indulged in the wide selections. 

The room was clean and comfortable for Paris size standards. The shower was interesting and the tile was a little slick, but I should have asked for a bathmat or extra towel. I do not think all rooms had our shower style (step in). 

I have recommended it to several friends. It was an easy taxi or Uber pick up location.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great service, sleepy location
text:
Pros: great service (everyone very nice), free B+ buffet for titanium marriott. They also provided Champaign and sweets for my anniversary 

Mixed: location. It’s in a more sleepy area but it’s short walkable to the  Trocadéro, Champs-Elysées, Victor Hugo circle... plus some metros. That works for me but know what you want 

The rooms were okay, nothing special 

Cons: no lounge, the gym was pretty bad 

Basically the great service gets it near a 5*, but otherwise a fairly average Renaissance 

Id stay again
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great Boutique Hotel on a Slightly Quieter Parisian St.
text:
We had 3 nights in Paris during 25th Anniv trip to France. Chose this hotel b/c it’s halfway between Eiffel Tower and Arch de Triumph and its on a less busy street but easy to get everywhere. We walked to many sights and restaurants and took the bus to others but Uber was super cheap and easy, too. Great location! Beautiful part of the city!

Check in was fast and painless, very friendly staff welcomed us after a long flight and 6 hour delay in NYC. 

Upgraded to an executive 1 bdrm with a living/TV room & desk area downstairs and king bed w/bth upstairs overlooking a lovely garden. We slept w/the windows open and it was peaceful and very quiet. I read a few reviews about the bathtub and it’s the step out that’s a bit difficult. If you swing the shower door in and use the towel rod as a grab bar you’ll have a surer footing because it is a long step down compared to U.S. standards. But this is Paris, I wasn’t expecting large spacious bathrooms but this one was nice sized and well appointed, the products were of the highest quality. We had everything we could possibly want or need refreshed daily.

Enjoyed breakfast as part of our room deal every morning and they had it all, pastries, French butter (YUM), meats, fresh fruits including these little French plums the size of large grapes, oatmeal, waffles, etc, etc... You won’t go away hungry!!

We had cocktails at the bar one afternoon and it was quite nice. The glassware was some of the finest we were served from on this trip and they don’t skimp on the ice... they know their clientele. Some other guests shared that the hotel puts out a punchbowl every evening :) We never were able to partake but love the idea that people get to mingle and meet. We did meet a few couples that afternoon and it was a charming and inviting atmosphere they’ve created if you wish to indulge. I enjoyed another soda after walking from the bus that brought us back from Sacre Coure.

Over all it was a delightful stay!!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: We Loved It!
text: We selected this hotel because of its location.  We knew it was convenient to what we wanted to see and do during our brief time in Paris.  I think we were both surprised by the charms of this hotel.  We had the sense that we were in a lovely little boutique; the decor was lovely and the hotel's staff was welcoming and helpful.  We loved this hotel and hope to return again!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: No way to contact Hotel ???
text: We are celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary and there is no way to contact the hotel online and let them know how special this is for us. We have planning this event for many years and wanted to reach out to the hotel but after spending many hours could not find any email. We booked the hotel because we love the GM Benno Busscher however there is no way to reach out to him to tell him how special this trip is to us. Oh well wish the communication was better and fear all our planning and selection may not have worked out for us.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Love everything about this charming hotel!
text: I booked this stay using Bonvoy points after reading the reviews and was thrilled to find everything even better than expected. The hotel is on a quiet street but I was delighted to find an amazing flower shop, grocery store, pharmacy and nail spa all within 1.5 blocks.  The hotel is stylishly appointed and is a nice blend of traditional architecture with modern and fun furnishings. The standard king room was roomy and so nicely decorated in whites greys and a touch of green.  Very zen and with excellent lighting. Windows opened for fresh air. Comfy bed, crisp linens and great pillows. Excellent lighting in the bathroom. The only misses with the room were the tub shower combo which had a small glass panel that did not keep the water out of the room and outlet that did not accommodate a hair dryer. The hotel has a very pretty garden in the courtyard with lounge and cafe seating that made the place feel like an oasis. It was too chilly to sit outside  when we had breakfast so we ate in the restaurant space which was lovely as well. Terrific hot and cold breakfast buffet was included and the food was excellent. The gym is small and lacks an elliptical but did had a nice rowing machine. The service was great. Julie who checked us in even walked us to our room in the adjacent building across the courtyard. When we asked for ice and luggage service, the item showed up immediately.  Could not have asked for a better stay!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Good location, but that's about all
text:
I stayed here while on holiday.  The hotel is in more of a neighborhood hotel, but close to a view of the Eiffel Tower, but not much else.  It's really far from the Louvre, gardens, shopping areas, gardens, etc.  The staff is friendly and the breakfast is pretty good, plenty of food. The bar closes early.  

The hotel has had better days.  for the prices and 5 star rating by Marriott, it's pretty run down.   The carpet was worn around the room, lots of dings in the walls and Knicks in the paint everywhere.  Rooms are small, which is not uncommon.  While the bath amenities are good quality, the rooms have weird bathtub showers that are awkward to get in.  Also, the towels are very low quality and thin.  The bed is hard and sheets mediocre quality.  All these things would be okay if the hotel didn't position itself as a 5 star property.  

For us, this. made for an average stay.  Staff very nice, but didn't overcome the mediocre property for the price.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Nice Hotel close to attractions
text: Nice rooms with  garden as well as views of the Eiffel Tower. The rooms were nice size but we were there during the record heat wave and the airconditioning was not able to adequately cool the rooms. The staff was excellent  and did a wonderful job of getting us booked in. Breakfast  buffet had a lot of offerings but I cannot comment on the cost since it was complimentary because of my status with Marriott. We never got to use the bar(it was small) as it closed before we got back to the hotel after exploring for the day. Hotel is easy walking distance to Eiffel Tower, Arc De Triomphe and Champs Elysees. There are numerous restaurants in easy walking distance of the hotel. We found using Uber to be the easiest way to get to places we wanted to explore.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Good location and friendly staff
text:
We stayed in this hotel as part of a Delta Vacations trip. The location is great; walking distance from Eiffel Tower and Arc du triumph--25 min. Within a block from a grocery store, there is also a bakery that sells sandwiches as well as bread and pastries near the grocery store. There are a couple of restaurants in the hotel and for those who prefer to get away from the hotel for food, there are several cafes within a block or two.
The staff is very friendly. speak English and French and are accommodating for reasonable requests.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great hotel right in the heart of Paris
text:
I stayed at this hotel during my family vacations. It is very well located, a few steps away from Trocadero and Eiffel Tower, as well as from Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysée.
Something that really gives a plus to this hotel is the garden, very nice terrace and restaurant.
Breakfast buffet is pretty well served. It also has a nice bar.
All personnel were really kind and helpful, doing their best to contribute in making an excellent experience.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Paris perfection
text: My family and I just returned from a family vacation in France and Switzerland. We all agree that our stay in Paris was the best part of our adventure, and the Renaissance Le Parc Trocadero contributed greatly to our experience there. The hotel is beautiful and in the BEST area of Paris. There are fabulous patisseries and cafes right down the street, not to mention how close it is to the Trocadero/ Eiffel Tower views. We were warmly greeted by staff, and they were very helpful in helping us plan outings. The courtyard area is adorable and truly Parisian, and the breakfast buffet was delicious. I will choose this hotel every time we travel to Paris. It can’t be beat.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great Visit
text: My mom, daughter and I stopped in Paris for a couple of nights and decided to stay at this Renaissance property. The hotel staff was excellent, very friendly, and helpful. The hotel was very clean and has a beautiful garden which is nice to sit and relax with a glass of rose'. It is not a far walk from the Eiffel Tower or the Arc d' Triumph. I would highly recommend staying.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Right where we wanted to be!!
text: This quaint hotel was in a great location, room was perfect and loved the daily breakfast.  We were able to start our days off with the wonderful selections for breakfast and get around to all the amazing sites from it's location.  Loved ending the day with a cocktail in the lovely courtyard garden.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great Property centrally located with great service
text:
We stayed here for a few days prior to our Seine River cruise.  The property is centrally located to many great restaurants, the Metro, and shopping.  In addition, you are within walking distance to the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tower.  As part of our package we were treated to a buffet breakfast that had an amazing selection of pastries, hot foods, and meats and cheeses.  There is a unique garden in the middle of the property, which hosted several parties while we were there.  The bar is very small, but well stocked. The garden was wonderful just sit and enjoy some peace and quiet after a long day of touring.

The rooms were surprisingly large and well appointed.

The staff was very friendly and attended to our every request in a timely manner.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great location, great service
text:
Stayed recently at Renaissance Le Parc Trocadero for a couple of days while on a business trip to Paris. The hotel is in a great location with minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower in one direction and the Arc de Triopmhe on the other direction with many cafes and shops in between.  

The hotel itself is made of several building with a pretty courtyard in the middle used as part of the restaurant.  The room was roomy and clean (spotless) and very quiet even though I was next to the elevator.  The staff was awesome and their English was far better than my French.  Lucas at the Front Desk was extremely helpful and friendly and the Navigator staff were equally helpful with restaurant suggestions.  The  hotel restaurant was great for breakfast and lunch - casual settings and welcoming.  All in all, I liked the place and will be staying here in future trips.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Quaint Property with a fanastic courtyard/restaurant
text: Spacious room with average sized bathroom and comfy bed/linens.  Breakfast was excellent with a varied selection of fresh bread, pastries, cheeses, fresh fruit, meats and hot buffet.  Wonderful central location between the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Very good hotel in an excellent location
text:
I have stayed at the Renaissance Paris Le Parc Trocadero four times in the last 6-7 years.  Three times on business, and most recently for personal travel (vacation/holiday).
This hotel is situated on Avenue Raymond Poincare, walking distance from the Eiffel tower (about 18 minutes on foot),   Other locations within Paris are a longer walk, but you're never too far from a subway entrance/exit.
Cab or uber fare from CDG is about 55 euros or so.
Hotel rooms are stylish, if a bit worn (chipped paint and veneer).  A bit tight (without a room upgrade), but normal by European standards.
Excellent breakfast selection and quality.  We also ate dinner one night in the hotel and everything was top notch - though that's true for a lot of Paris.
The staff were very friendly and helpful.  And the majority spoke fluent English (or at least more fluent English than our French).
Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.  Highly recommend.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Good Marriott property
text: Not sure if I am platinum or titanium these days, but we paid a small fortune in cash for the room to avoid the Paris heat wave. We got into the room only to find out there had been a water break and the ac was off!  Luckily the hotel fixed it immediately - I was impressed with how quickly their maintenance team fixed what could have been a disaster.  I got breakfast for free, usually would have been 62 Euros- and it was absolutely outstanding. We had a room with two beds that were next to each other (see photo), but worked fine for two friends traveling.  The other pictures are a view out our window and the bathroom. All towels and sheets were luxurious and the staff was super aimed to please.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Lovely hotel
text: This hotel has it all, especially a great location. The Eiffel Tower is a 15 minute walk in one direction, the Arc de Triomphe is a 15 minute walk in the other direction. There are many restaurants nearby and shops as well. The hotel has a lovely courtyard, where one could eat or drink. The room was very nice. The only negative, to me, was the bathtub/shower combo. The tub was high, so not easy to get in and use the shower. But this hotel is definitely worth a stay.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great Hotel
text: Loved the location as it is within walking distance of both the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. Room was large enough for a family of 4 and the beds were very comfortable. Breakfast was included with our rate and we thought the food was great. Staff was friendly and helpful. Will definitely stay there again and will recommend to others.
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Lovely Hotel in Paris
text:
My 21 Girlfriends and I had a fabulous stay at Rennaissance Trocadero celebrating my birthday.  I spent 4 months working with Olivier and Michel to ensure phenomenal and unique experiences for my birthday celebration. We spent 5 nights at the hotel and every request was handled with the utmost sophistication.   Pauline was so detailed in how she facilitated the number of people traveling with me and making last minute tweaks due to a few illnesses.  I appreciate all the staff having copies of my my detailed itinerary and spreadsheets, because it made the check-in and out seamless.  

The exceptional level of service at the restaurant, front desk and bellmen are to be commended. I appreciated the warm front door welcome by all of the staff to greet us upon arrival and for our departure.  We all felt like royalty.  Every restaurant had a special room for us and acknowledged the celebratory occasion.  The labor of love to curate these experiences were definitely reflective in the satisfaction of my friends and I. 

Because our departure was so early for the Champagne Region, the hotel provided very nice breakfast “to go” packages with someone to provide us tea and coffee for our journey to Reims.  

I give this hotel 5 Stars in every category (the bathrooms could be updated) and I hope that each staff person is recognized at the highest level for exceeding expectations.  Thank you Rennaissance Trocadero for making my Birthday trip magical.  We will be back soon!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: The best of the best!
text: Marriot brand never ceases to amaze us!  It is the only brand we stay in and this hotel exceeded our expectations in every way!  The superbly updated and clean room had an exceptional view of the park/cafe.  The service provided us from checkin to leaving was amazing.  Just can't give it enough praises!  A big thanks to all the staff for making our time so incredibly enjoyable!
name: Renaissance Paris Nobel Tour Eiffel Hotel

title: Great location and wonderful staff.
text:
the hotel is a short metro or a walk from most of the attractions in Paris.
if staying on the left bank, can't do much better
the breakfast is simple but good - coffee is great
the hotel staff is very helpful and makes you feel welcomed.

The private hotel offers guests peace and quiet away from the busy street outside with an outdoor patio shaded by trees and overlooked by the elegant rooms above, the most famous of which is decorated with a ceiling fresco from L'Ecole de Versailles. title: Disappointing - I wouldn't stay again.
text:
I was really looking forward to exploring Paris from this charming hotel for 5 nights with my family due to all the wonderful reviews.   However, the rooms and service were a big disappointment.  
I had booked 2 rooms directly with the hotel staff well in advance but added my son (25) to the reservation a few weeks ahead of arrival after being assured the classic room already booked for my daughter (20) would accomodate twin beds and be ready on arrival.  
Upon arrival, however, we were told the hotel was full;  no twin beds had been set up and the classic room could not accomodate twin beds.  We were then shown 2 double-bedded rooms both with extremely low ceilings and told that some people enjoy the low ceilings.  Maybe that is the case but a small room with a low ceiling is not where I prefer to pay to sleep on holiday.  Given the time of night and feeling a bit powerless as the hotel was "full," I  agreed to put the kids in the deluxe room and to have the bed separated the next day while somehow another classic room magically was made available for my husband & I although we were told we would need to vacate it after 4 nights.  Who would have thought certain rooms could be reserved while such desirable low-ceilinged rooms were on offer?
Given we were informed we would move rooms again after 4 days, my husband & I told the hotel we would leave instead of changing rooms.  At that point, we were  informed things had changed although noone had deigned to tell us despite my speaking to yet another person ealier about changing rooms  if something came available.  
After noting we would leave early, the woman at the desk was then berated by her male colleague for her acquiescence (in French of course as I guess they didn't realize we understood).  
On the last day, we asked the man at the desk to book a cab for us to the train station and, upon hearing our daughter was ill, he kindly arranged for the room to be cleaned immediately so that she could rest in the room.  Needless to say, the room was not attended to until hours later and the cab was not pre-ordered so had to be done while we nervously waited.

title: Loveliest Hotel in Paris
text:
I have stayed in many Parisian hotels over the years thanks to my daughter living in Paris.  I stay on both the Right & Left Bank, comparing locations, proximity to the Metro, shopping, restaurants, museums, etc, always looking for the, "best of all worlds."  I believe the Hôtel des Saints-Pères has ticked all the boxes as my latest favorite hotel for a number of reasons.  The location on the Left Bank is perfect for any shopping or dining needs being in the Saint Germain neighborhood but tucked on a side street so close to everything but on a quieter side street.  But it is the hotel itself & the staff they employ that make the hotel an outstanding one.  The front desk manager Damien is delightful; warm & welcoming, he immediately looks up as you approach the desk even when you are simply walking by, just to make sure you are not in need of him.  Housna, another delightful employee was quick to answer my inquiring emails about accommodations, arranged a taxi for transport to the hotel for my family of 5 (83 Euro) & was even more lovely in person when we finally met.  Inna, the GM introduced herself to us shortly upon our arrival & reached out to us throughout our stay. Customer service appears to be paramount to this hotel.  Not only are the staff approachable they are friendly, speak excellent English, & act as a team to consistently focus on guest satisfaction. This goes for the delicious breakfast served each morning in the charming breakfast room.  A small yet bountiful buffet of high quality patisserie, fresh, ripe, cut up fruits, scrambled eggs, meats/cheeses, yoghurts, fresh squeezed fruit juices, cereals, & hot beverages were served by an attentive masked gentleman every morning.  This feast carried us through most of the day before hunger struck.
Our room categories were "cozy" & "classic."  Both styles of rooms accommodated everything one could need during our stay in Paris & decorated with beautiful fabrics & wallpaper, antiques, high quality bed linens, lots of pillows, who could ask for more?  High quality Codage body products were appreciated in the bathroom along with slippers & thick bathrobes.  The rooms were also very quiet which was much appreciated after an overnight flight from the States.  Cleanliness in all guest areas & Covid awareness were highly appreciated as well, especially since my traveling sisters & I are nurses.  This hotel warrants your patronage.  You will not be disappointed. We were delighted!

title: A consistently comfortable stay whenever I’m there
text: I have now stayed several times in this four star hotel in the heart of St. Germain, just off the boulevard.  I have had several categories of rooms - Club (the smallest), Superior and Deluxe - and while the size of the rooms  has varied, I could always rely on a very comfortable bed and great service from the front desk.  The air conditioning works well and if you get a room overlooking the little courtyard, you will sleep well with no street noise.  The hotel has done a great job of preserving this building which was built by a royal architect.  No two rooms have exactly the same decoration and you feel you are staying in a place with history and character. This is no cookie-cutter chain hotel.

title: Great Experience
text:
This property was perfect for our Paris vacation.  First, and most importantly, the staff was kind and helpful.  They were happy to indulge our very limited French and quickly switched to English if we were confused.  They had good recommendations for restaurants and transportation options as well.

The hotel location is also first-rate.  There are tons of good restaurants, bakeries and cheese/wine shops, and boutiques within 15 minutes on foot.  It is also within walking distance of many prime attractions (<20 minutes to the Louvre, d'Orsay, Notre Dame; <45 minutes to Eiffel Tower, Champs Elyses, and Pompidou) shopping.

The room was nice, if not extravagant.  My only critiques would be typical differences between American and European hotels (the bed was a double, the shower was small, the wifi was a bit too slow to stream video, etc.) rather than criticism specific to this property.  That said, the room was very clean and included a mini bar and coffee maker.  Moreover, it was a charming space that had the sort of character typically absent from modern American properties.  

Overall, the hotel considerably exceeded our expectations, and when you thrown in the relatively low cost, it's an amazing deal.  We would definitely stay there again.

title: Very average experience, which is a shame for such a lovely and quaint hotel
text:
The room was tiny and very hot (we could not control the heating).  We struggled to get around the room without either bumping in to each other or tripping over things.  The TV had no English speaking channels and the subtitles did not work so we could not even watch TV when we went back to our room for a rest, although it was so small we didn't really have the comfort to do that.  The fire alarm went off in the early hours and while I think most people vacated their rooms, there were no checks done by the hotel staff to make sure that everyone had been accounted for. Had this been a real fire it would have been very concerning not knowing if everyone was out of their rooms.  The hotel has a policy to leave your key with them when you go out so this should have been something quite simple to do.  There were no fire wardens or anyone directing the residents so everyone just stood in reception as it was very cold outside (it was the middle of December) while the alarm continued to sound. Eventually we were told to go back to our rooms and later found out that someone had been smoking in their room which had set the alarms off!

That said, the location was good, and the hotel was very quaint and nicely decorated.  The staff were pleasant too.

title: Great Location
text:
Just finished a five-night stay.  Location was outstanding with most of the major sights within 10-20 minutes walking distance (40 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower). Many lovely cafes, restaurants and shops nearby.  Staff was helpful and friendly.  Our room was clean with a comfortable bed and decent linens.

If you will need an elevator, be sure to inform them when you book.  We booked a superior room and it was 2 flights of stairs up to the room.  Once in the room, another flight to the bedroom plus a flight up to the bathroom.  This was not a problem for us but might be for others.  We booked online and while we realized there was a flight up to the bathroom, did not realize there would be three flights to get to the bedroom.

Breakfast was fine, nothing special. It included scrambled eggs, meats, cheeses, yogurts, fruit and pastries.  

Minor complaint, the cleaning staff did not do a good job refreshing items that were used, such as tea cups, wine glasses and tissue paper. Front desk staff was always available to replenish what we needed.

text: We have just spent 4 nights at this hotel which is located in a quiet side street off the Boulevard Saint Germain. Merci & A la prochaine
Colleen  & Gary Bruckner

title: The room I booked was given to someone else and they still made me pay full price
text:
I'll start off with saying that I never write reviews, as I consider myself pretty easy going. But, with that said I had to write about my experience here. I booked this hotel through Booking.com several months ago. Actually, I booked this hotel as soon as bought my plane ticket. The room that I had booked was a Double Deluxe Room that was Very spacious and had a beautiful view. Throughout several months of me arriving to the hotel I was in constant communication with the customer relations manager. I made sure to let them know what time I would be arriving and making sure that my room was confirmed and would not be released. I also special requested that they help me with a taxi to the airport upon my departure. Both of which were confirmed by the hotel. 
To my surprise, when I arrived to the hotel after a very long day of travel. The nice young lady checked me in and gave me a key to "my" room. Well, it would have been great if it was the room I actually booked. This room was on ground level / street level. Where I could literally see men outside my window smoking. May I add that it looked NOTHING like what I had booked. Of course, I went back to the front desk assuming there was a mistake and it would be easily rectified. Well, that would have been to easy. 
After she looked into her system she said there was a little mistake that she needed to speak to her manager and they would find a solution. Well, after a back and forth. We come to find out that they gave my room to a family right before me. So, the only solution they had was to put me in a different room with a "view". The nice young lady said that her manager would also throw in breakfast because of the inconvenience (mind that this breakfast is 16euros). Also,  the room that they would be putting me in is not so different than what I had initially booked. She asked if I would like to see it before moving all my luggage again. I said sure! Did not sound bad at all. Well, again if the room was actually anything like what I had booked we wouldn't have  a problem. But this room was literally 1/3 in size of what I booked. Obviously ALOT less expensive and the view consisted of 1 very small window. So no, not at all similar to what I had booked. At this point she could see how very upset I was, especially after a long journey. Her only explanation, was what her manager told her to tell me. Which was, that when you book through another website, that they as a hotel don't necessarily see what room you booked. Does that make sense? Because it didn't make sense to me. It actually sounds like they dropped the ball somewhere because they definitely charged me for the room that I booked which was a lot more expensive that what I stayed in. I told the young lady that this was unacceptable and they need to figure out a better solution. By the way at this point management thought that they would still be able to hang on to the full rate of what I paid for. It almost felt like they thought throwing in breakfast would makeup the difference for the amount of the room that I paid . 
Well, the hotel was booked of all the rooms that were similar to mine. So I had no choice but to stay in that small tiny room. But, they would be able to move me to the room that I actually booked the following afternoon. I asked about a refund for one night and she said her manager would only refund 90euros and that was it because it was the difference of the room that I was staying in. I asked, why am I being charged for a room that I never booked, this was not my fault at all. She then proceeded to have a united front with her manager saying that the first room that they initially gave me was still under the same "category" of room that I booked, it just was street level with no view. So, NO not at all in the category of what I booked.
 For me, being in the hospitality business for many years, I have never or would ever handle this situation the way this manager and this establishment did. 
If were putting things into perspective / money language, I was not able to unpack and unwind and relax because I knew I would be moving the following afternoon into a room that at this point was not enjoyed. My flight is scheduled  for the following morning meaning I have to leave early. So this whole stay was absolutely stressful and not at all relaxing. The staff at the front desk  tried but the reality is that the manager and the establishment / Hotel could have been a lot more professional and do right by there customer. There should have been a full credit for a night, especially because I didn't get into the room that I booked until after 1pm. Meaning that more that half of the day that I paid for is also gone. I have yet to hear from the staff in regards to how they are going to handle my credit of only 90euros. 
This whole experience is very unfortunate. I was really looking forward to staying at this hotel because of its location and because of its beautiful room. But instead it turned out to be the worst experience I've had not only in travel but seeing how this business conducts itself professionally. 
Therefore, my tip to you fellow traveler considering staying at this hotel. Buy yourself a calling card and make sure to talk to someone on the phone NOT via Email and confirm you reservation details / room. Because I thought I was doing my due diligence by communicating via email but that didn't mean anything at the end of the day.

name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great location and excellent service!
text: Great location, close to metro station and restaurants. We had a great view of the Arc de Triomphe. Staff was friendly and helpful. Room was spacious and very clean. We got a family room because we were traveling with our two kids. The room was big enough to accommodate all of our luggage and had multiple small closets.  There are various pharmacies near by. Overall a great experience.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Lovely hotel, lovely staff
text: Great location with lovely, helpful staff. We had a connective room on the first floor which was only. Only issue was it was very noisy which has nothing to do with the hotel itself. Although our booking included breakfast but we didn’t chose not to have it there as we wanted to explore.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Amazing hotel with a beautiful view
text: Went there with my family while on our vacation to Paris during this winter.  Overall, I can describe this hotel as really pleasing and appealing. Our room was well cleaned and taken care of. The food is also pretty good. The staff was really nice and welcoming. I would recommend this hotel to those who want a closer look at Paris since it's placed near Arc de Triomphe and also quite close to the Eiffel Tower. Our room also allowed us to see the Eiffel Tower. The price is quite affordable which took me by surprise. I'm sure that next year I'll choose Hotel Plaza Etoile once again!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Xmas holiday
text: Very comfortable stay, staff us very friendly, and the rooms are very clean and tidy. The location is excellent, close to the main high street, and great view. The food was good. The only thing I can suggest is to have more TV channels and options.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Cute Hotel with a view to the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe
text:
