Couldn't imagine a better hotel for my stay in Paris for the weekend! The Hotel-Room is very small but had anything i need, it was very clean and also very quiet, you didnt hear the street-noise or the other guests! The breakfast is also very delicious. And the staff is really friendly.
I will definetly come back :)
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Poor
text:
We were asked to provide a survey after the first night and listed a number of issues with our room, namely: bloodstains; no deadlock on the door and incredibly loud plumbing sounds.

Nobody ever responded to our complaints or addressed the issue.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Rude Staff atrocious service.
text: Atrocious customer service upon checking out was charged for water which is normally complementary. I was not informed by any stuff or did nit see any notices indicating this. Staff member was being rude and at the same time ignoring anyhting I had to say.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Perfect for a short stay
text: A good hotel close to Arc de Thriomphe and Metro station. Perfect for a weekend. We had a renovated familiy room with 3 adults. The room had a bathroom with seperate WC with an extra sink. Fresh prepard breakfast and very nice staff.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Comfortable stay
text: We enjoyed our stay and the room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The location is perfect and close to the metro. The only disappointment was the bathroom, it was very small but we managed. The lift is small for 2 people with luggage. Overall we enjoyed our stay at this hotel.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Very satisfied
text: Our group of 14 people was very satisfied with the rooms, the service and the breakfast. Everything is nice and clean, good beds, windows close well and keep the traffic noise out very well. Only the room for breakfast is a little bit too small, so not all the guests oft the hotel can have breakfast at the same time.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Unfair
text:
In all fairness, I did not stay here.  I just wanted to share what I thought was an unfair business practice.   I booked this hotel with a booking site in July 2021 and took the " pay at the hotel" option.  My reservation was for April 2022.  Yesterday (August 2021) there was a transaction from the hotel on my credit card for the amount of the stay - which is 8 months from now!  I contacted the hotel.  They said it's not a charge, it's a hold that will be released when I complete my stay.  In 8 months!  A charge would have been better because now there's a large hold on my card that I can't pay off and can't use for eight months.  This seemed unfair so I just wanted to warn others booking here. 

I've now canceled my reservation and am hoping there is no charge here because it was free cancellation.   We'll see..
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Perfect stay for a short trip to Paris
text: The Room was clean, but very small. But that's okay, because you know, it's Paris. The staff was very friendly, the breakfast was okay. Hotel Plaza Etoile is 4Min away to l'Arc de Triomph and 3Min to the Metrostation. Perfect Spot.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Convenient location but small rooms
text:
Very convenient location With less than 5min walk from cdg-etoile station. If u are travelling with big luggage, do note that most part of the station has no lifts.
A lot of restaurants and fast food near the hotel. The hotel offer complimentary coffee/tea and croissants every evening. 
Rooms are small. Can’t open 2 big luggage at the same time. Showers are really tight.
Have to leave the room key at the concierge each time we go out. Didn’t encounter any issue with that though.
Overall it was a comfortable stay and the location is great.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Hidden gem is excellent location
text: This hotel is over the road from my office so perfect location for me. Very close to the metro and epic shopping district. The hotel is clean, modern and the staff are wonderful. I stayed in room 602 which was utterly beautiful - the best nights sleep I’ve had in Paris. Will return for sure
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: lovely city break hotel
text: I stayed here for 4 nights last week and we were very impressed with the hotel. From the moment we entered the reception we were greeted by lovely mannerly staff and a the difuser is a lovely touch makes the reception so relaxing. Our room was small but very comfortable and the shower was brilliant. We had breakfast included in our bundle for a discount but i wouldn't advise future guests to spend the 16 Euro on it as its only alright.The staff were so happy to help with any of our tourist questions which was so helpful. The only criticism i have is that when we ran out of milk for tea in our room the reception couldn't give us any as the housekeeping were the only ones who had them and they were gone home which was disappointing as us irish love our tea. Overall its a great hotel with lovely staff,a brilliant location right next to the metro and loads of bars/restaurants.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Excellent Hotel and Friendly Staff
text: The hotel is in a great location, very close to the metro lines. The hotel room was the perfect size for one person and the room was very clean and comfortable. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Nice hotel and worth to stay
text: I stayed here for 4D3N with my spouse at room no:502. It’s location is superb, nearby to Bus stop and Tube station. Also nearby to the famous high end road ie champ elysees. My room facing 2 famous Paris icon ie Eiffel Tower and Arc de triomphe. You may get your breakfast at nearby McDonald, starbuck and a few cafe. Their staff are attentive and friendly. No airport transfer provided but you may ask for the airport transfer with payment of €18 per person. I came to this hotel from Gare Du Nord via uber and it cost me around €15. We have wonderful moments here. Would definitely recommend this hotel to others.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Good location, bad smell
text: The location close to the Arc du Triomphe is nice and the room ok from its size and amenities. But it did not seem very clean and the bathroom had a distinct sewage smell, for which I had to keep the room windows open often.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great location, clean, great service
text: If you went to Europe before you know by now how difficult it is to find a decent hotel at a reasonable price. Well, this is it. The location of this hotel is unbeatable, walking distance to Champs-Élysées. It is a clean hotel with clean sheets, clean room and CLEAN BATHROOM! Very difficult combination to find. The service was great, very polite manager and helpful to book the taxis for all the days we needed. Highly recommend this hotel for your stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: It's the place to stay
text: This hotel has an awesome location, with restaurants that are open as late as 4am and as early as 7am within steps, so jet lag wasn't a problem.  The lobby is small but very chic and makes a perfect spot to meet.  They stored our luggage.  It's a 3 minute stroll to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees.  Superb location.  For Paris, a big room and bathroom with a bath tub was great for us.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Location, location, location
text: Very nice boutique hotel steps away from the Arc do Triomphe and Les Champs Elysees.  Metro station is a 2 minute walk. Our room had a view of the Eiffel Tower, it was nice, clean and comfortable. A bit small, but you may expect that in Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Very cosy hotel and nice room. Good situated in the heart of Paris
text:
Hotel looks very good and very friendly staff.
Breakfast was also very well. the room was cleaned properly every day and also the lobby was homely. Also the staff does everything to make you feel at home in Paris with very good tips
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Plaza Etoile-Our place in Paris!
text: Excellent hotel!  Great and friendly staff.  We were automatically upgraded to a suite on the top (5th) floor with a partial view of Eiffel and the Arc.  We are a family of three (mom, dad, teenage daughter) and were very pleased with the room, price, sleeping arrangement, and staff.  We arrived on a morning flight and the hotel allowed us to leave our baggage there for a few hours prior to check-in, which gave us time for a great meal at a cafe across the street and to explore the Arc which is within close walking distance a few minutes up Wagram.  Excellent location!  It was very quiet and very cozy--a great European experience with a tiny elevator, small hallways, and great layout.  The hotel has modern features and was remodeled recently.  They have exceptionally great usage of their space which is not wasted on corridors but maximized for comfort in rooms.  Bathroom size is very good and we had a split room with shower on one side and toilet on the other which made it very comfortable.  It was the perfect place to crash!  A colleague recommended this hotel so we went with it and we were so happy with the decision!  The price was great for our budget as we were able to enjoy a quiet and smaller place in a perfect location.  The metro stop is within 3 minutes and there are a lot of good food options close by.  It is close to the Champs Elysees. Staff were so nice, especially Oceane!  Thank you Plaza Etoile for a perfect Paris visit!  We will be back!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Perfect Location
text: Perfectly located next to restaurants, shops, and the Arc de Triomphe. Staff was always very helpful and friendly. Bed was very comfortable and rooms were clean. I would highly recommend this hotel to everyone.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Recent Stay
text:
The location is fantastic and the staff are very nice and helpful. 
My first room was 204 which was extremely too small so I changed to room 302 which was great.
I recommend that house keeping change the glasses when they are used and replace them with new ones. But overall the stay was very good,.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Good room and great location
text:
Our stay at the Hotel Plaza L’Etolie on Av de Wagram was a pleasant one. The hotel is very close to the Arc de Triomphe and our room had a view of the Eiffel Tower, a bonus which enhanced our stay. There were also a number of restaurants in our immediate vicinity which was also advantage.

The hotel is compact, especially the corridors and the lift is tiny, barely fitting the four of us. There are some quirky old fashioned features. The room key, for example, is an actual key and they like you to leave it with the front desk when you go out. The staff are also very helpful.

The room was spacious enough for us. Our bed was comfortable and we slept well and there was a sofa bed for the two children. It is worth noting that the website does not confirm that there can be four in a room but we found that the sofa bed was fine for the purpose.

The location, the comfort of the room and the friendliness of the staff made for a very pleasant stay.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Perfect location
text: Perfect location - few steps from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysse but not on an extremely busy street.  Staff was friendly and helpful and accommodated is for early checkin.  Breakfast was good for a quick grab and go.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Two traveling girls
text: Great location to restaurants, stores and the metro.  The staff was very helpful with directions and suggestions speaking in English too!  Rooms are small breakfast was good.  This was a perfect location to enjoy the sites I would recommend
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Parisian Hotel Close to Arc de Triomphe!
text:
This hotel was the last hotel on our trip to France. The Hotel Plaza Etoile is close to almost everything you want to see and do plus its close to incredible stores for shopping and great cafes to eat at. 

The hotel staff was excellent in setting up the car service we needed from the airport since we flew from Nice back to Paris. There was some issues I had trying to connect with the driver but the lady at the desk was nice enough to be the go-between by phone to get us connected for our pick up.

Overall the hotel was very nice, clean but be aware the rooms here are the typical small hotel rooms associated with staying in Paris. The bathroom was the smallest bathroom I think I've ever been in. Not much room for luggage and there is street noise since you are in the hustle of Paris at this location.

Overall it was nice stay however the only negative, and it was the only thing from me giving it a 5-star review was the bed. The mattress was so hard and firm that I would wake up at least a couple of times during the night because my back hurt from it. Just to some Aleve each morning before heading out to see the sights.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: EXCELLENT
text: Excellent customer service. Very Helpful. Clean rooms. Comfortable, restful stay. Walking distance to shopping area and Arc De Triomphe. Manager was very accommodating to our needs. Excellent, friendly, respectful customer service.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Excellent location for landmarks and transport
text: 1st time visitors to Paris, this hotel is well located with the Arc de Triumph is 1 min walk! Hotel is clean, reception is very friendly speaks good english. Room is a double, small with privater bathroom with a shower. Small mini bar and tea/coffee facilities. Loads of restaurants in at the door step. We recommend the open tours or big bus hop on hop off bus tour..€ worth spent. Overall good value for $$ and only down fall windows aren't double glazed to sound proof local and subway noises, but don't let it put you off. It wasn't a deal breaker for us.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Marvelous
text: I had a Great stay at this hotel. Very Convenient and plenty of restaurants and shops to choose from. Close to Arch de Triump and walking blocks to Champs de Elesee! I would certainly return. I have already recommended to a friend.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Pleasant Stay
text: Exceptionally clean room, extraordinarily helpful staff and great location to stay near the Arc D Triomphe.  Our room for 3 people was very small as was the bathroom.  The reception area was very pleasant.  Staff could not have been more helpful in getting us transportation to the airport during a congested time in Paris due to Jacque Chirac’s funeral.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Avoid the Hotel Plaza Etoile
text:
Breakfast 3/10
Cleanliness 8/10
Location 9/10
Bed 3/10
Noise Levels 2/10
Comfort 3/10

Whilst this hotel has a great location and in general appears clean, overall this is a very poor hotel and I would not stay again.

Room 501 which I stayed in for 4 nights was very cramped and very tired looking. The fixtures were of very poor quality.  The room in no way matches the hotel’s representative photos of their rooms.

The hotel sits above the Metro line which can be heard and felt on top of lots of external noise from the main road and internal noise from corridors and neighbouring rooms.

The bathroom was clean but the shower very cramped.  Towels were of very poor quality.

The bed was two small singles pushed together to form a double but the mattress was not at all comfortable.

Breakfast (located in the slightly grim basement) was also very average and certainly not worth the €16 per day charge.

I would recommend the Hotel Lord Byron instead for similar location, value & star rating but of a much higher standard.

Overall I would rate this a 2 star hotel.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Really small room - Not worth the price
text: We were forced to take a so-called 'Superior Room' because the hotel didnt have a classic twin. The superior room given didn't have the beds separated adn it was very small. I believe it was not worth the price we paid.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great hotel, the friendliest of staff
text: The hotel is beautiful and situated in the best location ever. A walking distance from the Arc de Triumph, Avenue des Champs Elysees, even the Eiffel Tower. The rooms are clean and cleaned every day. The rooms are small but not too small. Remember that this hotel is situated in an old French tenement house. The staff was super friendly and helpful. For me it was one of the best stays in Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: I enjoined my stay
text: Hotel location in perfect place.Room and bath were clean but very tight. Close to alot of attraction.  Close to metro and RER lines. Recommended if you planning not to stay at hotel just for sleeping..
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great service!
text: Great location in the heart of it all 3 minute walk from Arc de Triomphe. The highlight of our stay however was how the staff was so intent on making our stay pleasant. On an early am when we had to catch a very early tour Michael had breakfast ready for us an hour earlier than usual. Wonderful people! Thank you
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Hotel Review
text:
Great staffs and good quality hotel as well. The location is outstanding; there are so many restaurants, cafe and mini-mart. Metro stations are nearby and it is walking distance to the main attraction like Arc de Triumph and shopping center.
We will definitely come back to this hotel chain whenever come to Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Very good hotel, perfect location
text:
Excellent location just few meters from the metro , 2-3 minutes walk to arc de triomphe and 3 mins to Champs Elysee.

The hotel located near to many Resturants.
The Room is clean.
Staffs are so helpful and friendly specially Mr. Rachid .
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: One night stay in Paris
text:
Upon my arrival and check-in I was a given my room which was undone, though my arrival time had been announced: between 14:00 and 15:00 pm!
It was a real shock: display of beverages on the table, shuffled bed, I expected someone would turn up out of the bathroom to welcome me. It was a very disagreeable impression...
However the receptionist was very quick at giving me another, even better room with an even more beautiful view on the Tour Eiffel. 
But, you have only one opportunity to make a first good impression...
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Stay at Plaza Etoile
text:
The hotel has an excellent location.  The rooms were expensensive and are very small. The rooms were not very clean.  Breakfast was adequate. Stickly counters and lots of hair in the bathroom. Probably would not stay at this hotel again.  Staff were helpful.
.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: PERFECT STAY
text: We stayed at the Hotel Plaza Etoile for 1 week and we had the most perfect stay! The staff was amazing, catering to our every need. Location could not be more perfect - it's one block away from the Arc de Triomphe & a minute walk from 2 metro stations. Will definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: very good
text:
everything was good, the hotel offers good service and meets all requirements..
But for one night it was expensive in my opinion
But i enjoyed my night there and it was wonderful.. there is nothing gone wrong.. 
Looking to come back again though!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Fun location and friendly staff
text: Very friendly and helpful staff.  It was no problem getting a couple extra things such as an ironing board and umbrella.  The hotel is just a couple minute walk to the arc de triomphe.  We enjoyed our stay at this hotel
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great Location
text:
Your hotel has an excellent location and is stpes distance from the Arc.
Close to the hotel are: Wine shop, sports and mini market.
Room was fine, with a great view! And staff was super!
We sincearly hope to come back in january.
Many Thanks!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Worst customer service, staff !
text:
First of all, it says kids are welcome, but they weren't unless we paid 240€  Extra to our booking. One is 1 yr old and the other is three, which three other hotels 
allowed them in for free in the same trip ! Then two lights where not working in the room, the same lady who checked us in, took a while and held us back from our outing because she will come and replace them. And they had no butler, nor doormen to open the door every time we came, they asked for the room keys every time we went out ! No one helped us with our luggage neither checking in nor out ! No complementary welcome water bottle nor coffee capsules and thts when we booked the most expensive room in the hotel ! Lobby is ridiculously small, and elevators too, an elevator does not fit a small sized baby stroller !
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great rooms and location, dirty breakfast area in basement, poor quality food offeringsz
text: Well styled and comfortable room!  Breakfast was such a disappointment in a dirty basement room with fruit flies.  And luggage storage was not secure, they only put it in the lobby where people can see it from the street.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Vacation
text: The staff at the hotel are great, rooms are very nice. We had an early your and they prepared breakfast for us before schedule so that we wouldn't start the day hungry. Excellent!!! Staff. Great place.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Clean and modern, a bit small in some rooms
text: Lovely location right near Arc de Triomphe.  Room was quite cozy, but you get that in paris.  Nice cafes nearby - I had breakfast out, so not sure what their service is like for that.  I'd certainly come back.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: visit June 12-14
text: I have only positive remarks for this hotel. I keep returning to the hotel for several reasons, one of them its locations close to Champs Elysees. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room was nice and clean, and quiet since it was heading towards a small street.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: THE VIEW OF FROM OUR ROOM WAS BREATHTAKING
text: We decided to go to Paris and it was def an excellent experience. We chose this hotel and it was GREAT. It was few blocks from the arch, and not too far from the Eiffel tower. Restaurants every where around it. It was just super convenient. I celebrated my 30th Birthday there and It was def a life time experience. They decorated the room really nice. The hotel was super clean. It was a bit small but for my partner and I it was just perfect. I would come back to this hotel since is just close to everything.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Nice Hotel, Well Located
text: It's a nice, boutique, hotel, I think is how to describe  Some of the rooms are a little small so just check this before you book. The hotel is in a nice area, very close to The Arc Dr Triomphe and also to another Metro station, Ternes. This other station is much less busy. And a nice Thai restaurant two doors away. Very welcoming and helpful reception staff. Thank you!
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great hotel! Friendly staff!!
text: This boutique hotel was nice, clean and affordable. The staff was helpful, friendly and very pleasant. We had a problem in our room that was attended to without  hesitation. Accessible to public transportation, restaurants for all budgets and the Arch. P.S there’s a Starbucks  next door.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great Experience
text: Great hotel with great team.  Nice room. We spent 9 nights in Paris and profit the location a lot.  Highly recommended for both Couples and Business. Ask for a room at 5th or 6th floor with a view to Tour Eiffel....
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: PCR Convention
text:
Very nice little Hotel close to the convention center. Small rooms but clean and comfortable. Next year I come back to stay here for the PCR convention!
Walking distance to Arc de triumph and Champ Elysee. Nice shopping. Friendly stuff.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great location, nice breakfast
text:
We spent only 3 days at the Plaza Etoile and overall had a great experience: it is impressively well located (only a few meters from the metro station and the Triomphe Arch, and a pleasant walk away from the Eiffel tower). Breakfast is well served, room is just as expected.

The staff is very friendly and helpful, but we find it a little confusing when asking the receptionist one night about the room service (the menu was given to us when we checked in) and we were told that there wasn't such service at all in the hotel except for the mini bar. We were oriented to order food from Uber Eats, which was ok, but I think there was some kind of misinformation among the team. It didn't bother us that much but I think it's worth the commentary.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: The perfect location
text: Well situated near place de l’etoile and les Champs-Elysée, this hotel is Cosy. Rooms have excellent view and very clean.The reception staff are very helpful. For the breakfast the choice of food is there.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Paris Value
text: Stayed here during a quick family trip. The staff was awesome. Our flight arrived early in the morning and they allowed us room access well before check in time. We also had a handicapped traveler. The hotel is accessible, however some of the corridors are narrow with tight turns. You can’t beat the location. There is quite a bit to see and places to eat within a short walk. We are very happy we stayed here and look forward to returning soon.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Long weekend in Paris
text:
Together with my 12 year old son, we stayed in hotel Plaza Etoile. Great location and very friendly staff!
Room was comfortable and what you would expect in the center of Paris (not very big, but of good quality)
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Perfect for a Paris stay
text: A perfect hotel with a lovely ambience. Room was cosy, comfortable and stylish. Breakfast was a nice small selection of foods. Hotel Location was excellent and although transport was close I chose to walk to most venues.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Jeniuous Hotel Location
text: Location was super, hotel was clean convenient and value for money paid, Very close to nice restaurants and carers as well to various means of transportation, the hotel was clean with quality bathing stuff.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Paris Trip
text: The staff at the hotel were very nice and helpful.  The room and bathroom were clean although a little on the small side, but we sort of expected that being from the US.  The location was also great and there was a metro stop just a few blocks away, plus lots of places to eat.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Great location but small hotel
text: Maybe this is the norm in this area of Paris but the hotel while in a great location was very small. The hallways, the elevator and the rooms are small. We stayed in the triple room but did not have enough space for the three of us. The staff was very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Very comfortable stay.
text:
The staff were always helpful and friendly.
Everywhere was very clean and beds were  comfortable . Facilities in the room just as expected and replenished when required.
A most comfortable hotel and close to the Metro and shops.
name: Hotel Plaza Etoile

title: Excellent
text:
The hotel is excellent. It is in the perfect location and great staff, great accommodations. Very pleased. I'm not sure why this website is requiring 200 words as a minimum button the hotel was great I'm happy I stayed here
.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great hotel and superb location!
text:
We had two rooms, a classic room and the Junior Suite.

The Location of the hotel couldn’t be better! Perfect and 2 min walk to the Arc De Triomphe.

Room and Junior suite were perfect.

Great breakfast

Also great staff at the reception, nightshift and breakfast.
Only the housekeeping could be much better.

In the classic room there was no replacement for the water bottles the second and thirth day.

In the Junior Suite, the second day, they disconnected the refrigerator, so we had no cold drinks after a warm day out!

There was no conditioner in the bathroom of the suite and they never replaced the cardboard cups after the first day.
In the suite there was no refill of the Nespresso cups the second and thirth day (so only 2 coffee capsules for 3 days in a suite?)

If housekeeping would have been better, we would have been perfectly satisfied and would have given 5 stars, now only 4*. 
We defenetely wil come back for the same Junior Suite, so they can make up for the mistakes.  ;-)
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Central, Clean and Comfy
text: Lovely hotel with great apartments for families. Very central and hotel staff really friendly. There is a small bar where the reception staff will serve you and a pool table that our kids enjoyed! Overall great place
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good location, good service
text: We definitely recommend the hotel. Large apartments with everything you need. Good service both when you arrive and at breakfast. close to champ elysee It was the second time and we will definitely be back next year
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Family trip to Paris
text: We stayed in a good sized two bedroom apartment for a week in the hotel. Great neighborhood with lots of good restaurants nearby. Shopping and sightseeing within walking distance. Very friendly staff, good breakfast and overall a very nice stay.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: a hotel without a heart, is like an empty condominium
text:
I have seen only 2 reception people, the rest of the hotel was empty.
the location is good.
it is with exemption of the location  a 2 stars hotel
there is no service, there is nobody present in this hotel
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great
text: Great location. Nice service. Friendly staff. Clean room. Hafsa at front desk helped us a lot. The staff worked hard to make our stay convenient. Walkable location to champs Elysee. Many nearby shops and restaurants. Would stay there again next visit.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: NEVER AGAIN
text:
Staff was not helpful at all.
No one picks up the front office phone after 8 pm, we had to go down stairs several time during our stay to ask for what we need.

The Air Condition was utter rubbish, the staff tricked us by saying it was fixed but it wasn’t really.

The taxi we ordered from the front dest to take us to the airport, didn’t speak any English and had a terrible attitude.

Overall,will go back and will never recommend to any one.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Amazing friendly Hotel
text:
I've stayed for (9 nights-Ecxicutive Room - 6th floor)...I've enjoyed my stay.
The staff was amazingly friendly even the guests of the hotel...besides its only 10 minutes walk 
to the "Champs Elysees".
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Warm, welcoming staff and a great location!
text:
My positive experience with the Royal Garden Champs Elysees began with a telephone call from Roxane Bouch'e in response to my query for an early check in on Sept 15.  My Air France arrival was early, of course, and published hotel policy identifies check in as 3:00 pm.  Miss Bouch'e, in perfect English, spoke to me with positive news of my ability to check in early at the Royal Garden.  My first fear of having to find something to do between landing, hotel arrival and hotel check in was alleviated.

I seamlessly arrived at Charles D'Gaule International Airport, collected my luggage and stepped into a fixed rate official taxi cab and, off I went to the Royal Garden.  Upon arrival at the Royal, Mr.Pierre Emmanuel welcomed me, processed my check in and escorted me to my apartment.  Mr. Emmanuel also took charge of my larger luggage, an obvious sign of wanting to provide an initial good impression.  He ensured I was introduced to the quaint, comfortable apartment, to include the wonderful balcony, safe, refrigerator, pots, pans, table wear and cooking utensils.  I found the apartment appropriate for my 24 day stay.

I'm a gregarious man and recognize I was a long stay guest, so I quickly became friendly with the front desk staff.  Several days into the stay, I was delighted when Miss Bouch'e approached me with a recommendation for an event in Paris.  She spoke to me about a private jazz/theater company providing a special event and she and a colleague thought it appropriate to mention it to me.  Further, as I struggled to speak French with her, actually everyone, she volunteered to act as a concierge and via hotel email provided detailed information regarding the performance in English.

I'm not functional in French these days, did not want to attend the event alone, and used Miss Bouch'e's  email and a copy of the event to solicit work colleagues to attend the event with me.  She also recommended two dynamic neighborhood restaurants to me, both of which were very satisfactory, almost excellent.  

The staff are customer oriented.  The facility, with Covid restrictions, is warm and welcoming.  The fact I am renting an apartment, competitively priced, adds to the satisfaction this Trip Advisor member is experiencing in Paris.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: €700 for 2 nights. Simply not worth €100.
text:
€700 for 2 nights.
(2 adults & 2 children &a small dog) 
Simply not worth it in apartment 223. 
Very Disappointed.  WC was tiny, mould and discoloured tiles and flooring.  No extractor fan or window.  Bathroom was the same with mould and discoloured tiles.  It looked like it had been cleaned but the discoloured grout made it look very unclean. Extractor fan didn't work, or did not have one, and the bathroom door had swollen with condensation and therefore did not shut let alone lock. 
Apartment room was dated and old, some other reviews refer it to being shabby. Nespresso coffee capsules available, but no Nespresso machine to use it with. No milk capsules.  Balcony looks onto a wall and garage alley, so noisy in the early hours. 
Breakfast on Sunday morning was unprepared and lots of continental breakfast was missing, you also have to order your breakfast drinks the night before.  Monday breakfast was a huge improvement, staff service and continental breakfast freshly prepared and made.  The waitress was very lovely, accommodating and friendly, nothing was too much for her.  If i could I'd give her 5 stars.  
The garage is extremely small and tight to get too, our Range Rover Evoque just cleared the turning down. It also drips of a lot water into the garage so don't wear your best clothes when getting to your car. 
After explaining the problems and issues to the hotel reception as well as the helpful waitress at breakfast, they merely refunded the dog fee of €24, and also explained that it is the waitresses job to be nice..... which i feel is very rude and obnoxious for them to say.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Perfect stay
text: Thank you all the staff at this wonderful hotel where I spent 6 days while in Paris with my wife!!! Spacious, clean rooms, fantastic petite dejouner, in a quite neighborhood, though within minutes from Arc de Triumph and champs Elysees Avenue. The staff is excellent ! Special thanks to Raul from the restaurant and the reception officers !
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Dirty Hotel
text:
I used to spend my time here for business several times during the year. 
Unfortunately this time I found the hotel I very bad condition!!! The cleaner didn’t clean the room for 2 days and when I complained to the reception the was only able to say sorry!
The floor was always dirty, with old drop of something and washbowls in the toilet was always dirty!!! I cleaned up by my self!! And it is possible in 4stars hotel?!?!

Please don’t stay in this dirty place, stay safe!!!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Love this hotel
text:
Very good experience in this hotel
We were 4 adults
We booked an app for 4 pers( 1 bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room) but when arrived they upgrade our stay for a bigger app with 2 bedrooms,a living room and a kitchenette
The location is very good 5 min walking to the champs elysees and to metro stations and near many restaurants
The rooms are clean, the staff were so helpful, very kind 
I recommend it highly and will come back
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: not exaggerating when I say best value for money I've ever had
text: The hotel is extremely well located and has really excellent extras that you don't get in every 4 star hotel around the world including slippers, plush bathrobes, nice toiletries and refreshments. The beds are comfy, the receptionists and all the staff are EXTREMELY friendly and helpful and overall its a wonderful find. Will definitely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone travelling for business or pleasure.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: A Mouse in our room
text: We stayed in one of the family apartments. First of all, we were waiting 90 minutes for the appartment at check in. We arrived at 3 in the afternoon. The room was clean, but furniture and clossets was old and used. The first night, we saw a mouse in our room. Then we informed the hotel about it, we were told that there was nothing they could do about it, and we should give it a name, because but was going to stay. Untop of that, there were also lots of ants in the apartment.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Fantastic comfortable hotel just 3 min walk from Arc de Triomphe!
text: It's not easy to find a right place to stay in the big cities! But Hotel Royal Garden Champs Elysees is the right choice for Paris! It's very good location, 3 min literary walking distance to Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees or shopping on rue du Faubourg Saint Honore! The breakfast is rich and high quality! Rooms are clean, big enough and quiet. The stuff is so helpfull and friendly! Don't miss it!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: BAD customer service
text: AC not working, & not being informed prior 2 my short visit. Receptionist checkin me in without saying AC not working. I checked out nxt mornin STAT. No discount 4 z horrible night, no free breakfast!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Grubby, smokey and tired
text: Very tired and run down hotel. We first arrived after a tiring drive from the Nurburgring direct to Paris. We were greeted by an extremely nice gentleman who wanted to get us sorted. We walked into our superior room to be greeted with the stench of cigarettes. I spoke to the staff and they apologised and immediately gave us another key to a different room. Sadly greeted with a standard room with no balcony and even worse stench of stale smoke! I was pulling my hair out at this point. After some under the breath French being spoken by the hotel staff they offered us an apartment due to the fact we were ready to leave the hotel. One positive, there was no smoke smell! However, all three rooms looked extremely tired and lack of care from the cleaners. Cracked mouldy ceiling in the bathroom, mucky grout all over, dust all over the walls, broken aircon and ceilings looking like a leak had happened. (Pictures attached) At this point we were too exhausted to even go back down to the foyer. Would not stay here again and I think the 7.7 rating is extremely generous. Only positives I can say are cheap parking at €20 a day and very polite front of house staff. Needs some serious investment to correct this hotel.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Location, Location, Location
text: If it wasn’t for the way too low toilet in it’s small water closet, I’d be giving this hotel a full 5 stars. The staff were super friendly and helpful; the breakfasts were great; the accommodations comfortable and roomy : we had an “apartment” with kitchen, bedroom, sitting room (couch/pull out bed), 2-sink bathroom with tub/shower, a balcony with table and chairs, and the ever inconvenient small water closet. But the top feature is the location. Restaurants everywhere; a couple of blocks to Champs E’lysees, the Arc d’Triumph, and a Hop on/Hop off stop.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good 4 star hotel just a short distance from the Arc de Triomphe
text:
When we arrived at the hotel we were given macaroons and drinks in the room which was a very pleasant surprise. I think 4 stars fit well in this hotel. We were greeted by a pleasant receptionist and the staff otherwise was also good.
One room had something wrong with the air conditioner, but we were switched to a room with working air conditioner right away and it was very good since it was very high temperatures in Paris
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great service and staff friendliness
text: Perfect small hotel in Paris for short trip business or private. Central for shopping and next to Parc Monceau. We travelled with our dog and they gave us a room with a balcony. Great breakfast. Rooms are freshly renovated.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Excellent
text: We stayed here for three nights and everything was perfect. Staff in the hotel were the only friendly staff we experienced in France! The hotel was absolutely spotless and in a great location. There was building work going on at the time which was unfortunate as we were woken early but I guess there never is a good time to do it :)
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Family trip
text:
larger rooms to accomodate the family in a single room, great hospitality and helpful staffs.
location is in the heart of Paris and they offer parking space for those who loves to drive but be aware the parking access is quite tight, so large vehicles might be a tight squeeze.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good
text: The location is excellent and the service, despite some construction and inconvenience was quite friendly.  We had a small family apartment which turned out to be very good-  beds are comfortable and rooms nice though not superb
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Always excellent, even more than ever
text:
I was once more in my favorite Paris Hotel 4 stars, stars well deserved, from the welcoming to the quality of all services. Very good breakfast, very nice and clean rooms, in the right center of Paris. More over I can tell you that I tested so many 3 and 4 stars hotel in Paris and this is for me the best. People are nice, all is very cleaned, staffs are nice, etc. A nice huge car parking.
And to end up, a very very fair price. Enjoy it...
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Perfect family trip
text:
We planned a family trip and following some friends recommendation we booked Royal Garden. Since the booking, the arrival and during our visit the treatment was outstanding.

I must add that we travel with an extremely allergic kid and we had the full collaboration of the hotel personnel and he enjoy the breakfast and the biscuits they replace every day in the room (thank you once again).

The neighborhood is quiet, so it’s perfect for rest time and is very well connected.

We will definitely go back!!!!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Lives up to its 4Star Status
text: Well serviced 4 star hotel for a change one that exceeds standards, immaculately clean, good breakfast and with an excellent team looking after their guests. Good place to stay with great restaurants nearby especially Le Lorraine
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Paris marathon trip
text:
We booked this hotel as it was convenient for the start of the race my husband was competing in for one night. Although we couldn’t check in early, the reception team were very helpful and kept our luggage securely locked away. 

Once we were allowed to check in, our room was adequate for the trip. View wasn’t so great & the bathroom decor was a bit dated although it didn’t affect its use.

Breakfast was lovely & plentiful and lots of choice. We were also offered to come back after check out to use the showers and to look after our cases again.

Would certainly stay again if in the area.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Early check in
text: I arrived at the hotel around 9 o’clock in the morning after long flight from Jakarta. I didn’t expect can get early check in, but lucky me there was a room available and they allow me to early check in. Room also comfort and clean and I had comfort sleep. Champs Elysees was walking away and the from Metro Charles de Gaulle Etoille was around 10 minutes walk.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Nice place and very good location
text:
Nice place and very good location with very nice and delicious breakfast. 
We had two rooms apartament with tarace so a lot of space. Very good idea for family and bigger groups. I think there is modern and renew part of building and some older part, however everything is really nice! 
Thank You for our stay!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Lovely stay during holidays with family
text: We enjoyed the helpful service of hotel employees, convenient and quiet location and nice extra touches in the comfortable, spacious rooms. It was beautifully decorated for the holidays.The breakfast buffet was quite tasty and generous. Easy to walk to shopping, major sites and cafes, and also easy to catch Metro or taxis.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: A charming hotel
text: Located in a quiet area yet very close to a lot of the sights and shops in Paris.  Metro stations are nearby to get around Paris. Reception staff and everyone we dealt with were highly professional and all contributed to make our stay very enjoyable and special.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Comfortable and convenient
text: Good size room, well located right new the Champs-Elysees with tons of shops and restaurants.View on the Eiffel tower from some rooms. Nice staff.I would definitely stay there again, as my office is just nearby.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good location as base to explore Paris
text:
We arrived at Beauvais Airport and a shuttle bus brought us to Porte Maillot, Paris with 15 euros/ person and from there a short ride by taxi, which costs 11 euros brought us fast to hotel.
We recommend this hotel as it is cosy, acceptable close to metro stations of Etoile and Courcelle.
Service was excellent and because we celebrated something they did a touch gesture, which I really appreciated.
A supermarket is very near, 2 boulanger ies as well and nice restaurants not far, not to mention Champs Elysee is just few streets away.
Room was clean, big enough and bathroom separate from toilet.
You can have buffet breakfast for 17 euros / person but we decided to enjoy France boulangeries instead.
Price was reasonable as well.
Most probably we'll come back on day again.
Enjoy
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Bine située
text: The hotel was good enough but pretty much old, even with the visible efforts to modernize.Communication between front desk staff shall be improved as there wes some changes non communicated between them. No pb for me, but unnecessary work for staff.  The couch was old and uncomfortable.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel, great location, dedicated service
text: I've spent one night at the hotel during a business trip and have chosen the hotel because of the location and - for Paris - reasonable prices. Location was perfect, team very friendly, breakfast great. Room was nice and quiet with all you need.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Royal Garden Champs Elysees
text: We stayed at Royal Garden Champs Elysees from 20th November 2018 to 25th November 2018 and here our feedbackPros:- Great location- Excellent servicesCons:- Small room- Limited breakfast menu- Small lift- old decorations
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Perfection location
text: I recently spent two nights at this hotel for a conference my company had at the Rothschild hotel just opposite. The hotel only does have the one lift so morning time is a bit hectic to get down. Some views are lovely but since my room wasn’t ready when I got there I didn’t have much of a view. The superior room however was spacious and clean.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Very reasonable and well located
text: The hotel is only a 5 -10 minute walk from the Arc de Triumph.  It is easy to find.  The rooms are large and the hotel is very clean.  The staff could not be nicer.  Breakfast was quite nice as well.  Would certainly stay again
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good location, tired hotel
text: We had 2 nights in a double room, the check in was quick and easy! the rooms are pretty tired and probably a few years overdue a re-furb! Because they are so tired they look pretty dirty but they were not! comfortable bed and quiet!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great hotel
text:
I stayed here for one night whilst working in Paris. The hotel is in a great location, staff are all friendly and the rooms are a good size. Breakfast is good with plenty to chose from. Main asset for me was the hotel had a car park.
I will be staying here next time I'm in Paris.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: endeavour
text: location is little bit far away 600-700 m one way to metro and the same back to the hotel (+all day activities) but staff really endeavours a lot.a view of Eifel tower on the horizon. on the map everything seems close but only on map)
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Definitely a hotel to stay
text: Nice hotel and very close to the center. I stayed in a standart room.The staff were very nice and friendly. The breakfast was enough.  The size of the room was enough. The room was cleaned every day. The bathroom was clean. The welcome refreshments were nice.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good value in Paris!
text: This is a good hotel.  The people that work there are excellent - friendly and very helpful.  I believe you get good value for your money here.  The rooms are average, but the common spaces are very nice and the breakfast is a great value.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Decent
text: It took over half an hour to check in and I was not very pleased with that because people who came after me were being served before me. They really didn’t take interest in welcoming me. The staff on general was decent, but there was this one older man at the front desk who seemed very irritable every time I went down... The room was bigger than I expected. They have a lot and a wide range of toiletries (including bathrobes, nail filer, ear swabs, bath salts, etc), which made my stay more enjoyable. The little complentary chocolates were a nice touch also. The breakfast was okay. From the hot foods provided, the only things that could be eaten were the eggs and hash browns if you don’t eat pork. There’s a decent variety of pasteries, yogurts, and cereals.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Friendly staff, spacious hotel
text:
I was a little worried having read some of these reviews but I must say, I am really confused as to what people had to complain about. We were in a 'superior room', which was spacious (especially for Paris) with a large bathroom. We had a bottle of wine included in our stay, which was lovely. 

The staff were great, really friendly and happy to answer any questions. Breakfast was good - the coffee was great. Cooked breakfast wasn't incredible but still good and tasty but the selection of yoghurts, juices, pancakes and pastries, was amazing. 

The only reason that I can't give it five stars is that I found the room quite hot. However, it was a particularly hot few days in Paris and we were told the buildings air con broke on one night and I think I run on a higher temperature than most! 

I would really recommend this hotel and will hopefully be back again!

Thanks.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Perfect location for a city exploration
text: Nice staff and perfect location to visit the city. It looks a bit out dated but overall fine. Very happy to receive free parking at the hotel. The location is nearby Champs de Elysee but very quiet and safe.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Little gem
text: Just returned from the Royal Garden hotel, we had a fabulous time the hotel is in an excellent location and everyone working there are so friendly and helpful.The breakfast was very good with plenty of fresh food and good variety.We will definitely be returning.We found everyone in Paris warm and friendly we really had a lovely time.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Fantastic
text: A great location, situated a stone's throw from the Champs-Elysee. We arrived late and a little disheartened by a poor Eurostar experience, but Antonio on reception was funny, chipper and immediately improved our mood. The room was excellent - everything you need and more, with a comfortable bed, fantastic air-con, regularly cleaned and complimentary water/coffee/tea etc. The shower was fantastic, the hotel was quiet, and we'll definitely stay here again when we come back to Paris.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great location but broken air conditionong
text: We had two rooms both were spacious. The suite had a beautiful terrace .we could not sleep well as it was too hot since the aircondioning was broken. The location was great. The bed mattress and pillows were not the most comfortable.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great Location
text:
We stayed for 4 nights with a balcony.  It was always clean, comfortable and the service was very good.
It is close to everything we wanted to visit and conveniently next to restaurants and shops like 7/11’s or milk bars which added to the location.
Good value hotel.  Would stay again.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Excellent hotel in great location
text:
We cannot fault this hotel, great location, incredibly friendly staff in all areas.
Spacious, clean, well equipped bedrooms.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would not hesitate to book this hotel again.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Low quality, high prices
text: Low quality, even the room was double superior. A lot of dust, the room and the bathroom were not clean. The floor of the room was in a very bad shape; also the switch on-off buttons - not in  good conditions. The bad was not confortable. In the second day I had to ask for the room cleaning. I already miss a meeting because of the lack of interest from the reception desk ( they
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: A comfy stay
text: it was a nice quite hotel, not crowded and in the area of all shopping centers, cafes and restaurants.the Breakfast is varied and delicious and its display is eye catching. the rooms are tidy, could be cleaner.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Ideal for short business visit
text: Comfortable hotel; generous room sizes by Parish standards; professional and very friendly multilingual front of house staff; outstanding location; excellent value for money and never to be underestimated - aircon/climate control!!!  Did not dine during my stay so cannot comment on same.  Will stay again...
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Fantastic location. Hotel is a little tired - needs minor renovation.
text:
Firstly location. This hotel was in a fantastic location. A 5 min walk to the right of the hotel and you reach the Arc De Triomphe, 5 mins to the left the Champs Elysee. It is near 2 major metro stops which get you almost anywhere in Paris. If you like walking then this hotel is for you, you can walk to the Eiffel Tower in 20 mins the Louvre in 30 mins and the River Seine in 15 mins. It is also near a number of good restaurants and bakeries (boulangeries) 

In terms of room size for a Paris hotel I found the rooms quite spacious. They feel more like mini apartments. Our room on the first floor had a small separate sitting room, bathroom, bedroom and toilet. So it felt more like an apartment than a standard hotel room with the bedroom and sitting room all in one.

Staff are very helpful. 

Now for the negative side. There hotel is in need of some work. It is a little tired in some areas. For example the lobby and elevator both need some major touch ups, it looks quite worn. The signs near the entrance are old and peeling apart which doesn’t look nice when you first arrive. The rooms also are a little tired (but not as much as the lobby and other common areas). The bathroom needed some touch ups especially the sink, however the shower pressure is very good. Also the toilet is about 5 meters around the corner from the bathroom so after you use the toilet you then need to walk down the small corridor to get to the bathroom to wash your hands - quite annoying if you need to visit the toilet at night in the dark. 

Overall I would definitely stay here again. The location is fantastic and the room was much bigger than any I’ve stayed at before in Paris. If you can look past the minor tired details then it is great.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Good location, good staff, small rooms
text:
We stayed in the two bedroom apartment. The apartment is nice with a kitchenette which is very handy. There are two bedrooms and one sofa bed. We were 4 adults and two kids and were reasonably comfortable except for two issues. The toilet is separate from the washroom and is extremely small. I mean it's really tiny and it isn't lockable from the inside. It's not more than 4 feet x 3 feet. It's really really small. 

I used to use the toilet in the basement which is great. The other issue is that the washroom has a tub instead of a bathing closet. It's very inconvenient to stand in the tub and take a shower. 

The staff is polite and helpful. Antonio is very jovial and helpful. There location is about 200-300 mtrs from the Champs Elysees and Arc De Triomphe.

There is a nice franprix nearby for getting stuff.

The breakfast is simple but really nice.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Lovely Hotel Great Location
text: We stayed here for a very special wedding anniversary. Really nice hotel, very clean and staff are very friendly. The location is excellent and the restaurant provides a great breakfast. Couldn’t fault it and would definitely recommend it.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: business
text: The NESPRESSO machine is  extremely dusty and unappealling to be used at all. In addition, the table was also very dusty. Otherwise, the room is of decent size and the close proximity to shops and cafes is a bonus point for the hotel.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Weekend in Paris
text: We asked for early check in and room was ready when we arrived. The reception staff was very friendly and they even upgraded our room. Excellent location, in a very quite and cozy neighborhood, only ten minutes walk from Etoille. Highly recommended!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Chalee Thailand
text:
I like this hotel. It's great Hotel, Nice location! Happy to stay here 4 nights.
Reception staffs are helpful and warm welcome.
Good services and very good English.
The room is very nice with amenities ,good environment!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Relaxed and calm
text: The main criteria for us was private parking for a reasonable price which the hotel offers (20 eur per day). After check out they allowed us to leave the car there until the evening. The hotel decoration is a bit worn-out compared to the pictures but the essential things, like the bed etc are very comfortable and new. The little balcony in our room had a view to the Eiffel tower. Breakfast was worth the money but if not very hungry you can also skip it and have your coffee in the room before heading to the museums. All in all it was a good experience.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: With good location, clean hotel
text: It is located in 10 minutes walk away from Triumph Gate. It also has a metro station nearby. The standard room is wide enough and bath is clean and useful. Because I didn't eat breakfast, I have no idea about it.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Disappointed
text: Hotel location is far from champselysee I thought it was near , they told us we will have early check in but when we arrived at the hotel they told us to back at 2 pm , while it was approved and we got a confirmation on booking
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: good jorney
text: attentive personnel on reception desk, good restaurant for breakfast, shampagne with macaroons in the room - all of this can make you happy, thanks to this hotel!!!! and from our room we could see Tour Eiffel!!!
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Will Stay Again
text: Excellent, awesome location, 10 min walk from all major sites and stores.  Highly recommend.  Great Hotel with good room.  Good restaurants around the area, 10-15 walk to the arc, 40 min walk to all major stores.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: One night in Paris
text: We very much enjoyed our stay at the hotel and, in retrospect, I wish that I had scheduled more time there.  The staff was very attentive and helpful.  The room was very clean and the amenities were more than expected.  We were very satisfied with our stay at the Royal Garden Champs Elysées
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great hotel with big spacious rooms and lovely breakfast. Top location
text: Aftee reading all negatives about how out dated is the hotel. I was pleasantly surprised. The staff were extrimely helpful. Offerred is a drinks on arrival. Room was very spacious clean and all the all of the beds were super comfy. Bathroom had hundreds of shampoos, gels etc. Bathrobes and slippers complimentary as well as Nespresso coffe. Location was spot on 20 min walking distance to Eiffel tower and 5 min to Arce Triumph.highly recommend this hotel for family stay.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great staff, good breakfast, good location,poor atmosphere
text: The location of the hotel is near many bus lines and place de l’etoile. The lobby and its decorations are old and run down, and most of the time there was a smell of old furniture and curtains, same way n the corridors in the floors. The breakfast is enjoyable and service is great with helping staff. The room was small and no place to lay the luggage
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Three days in Paris
text: Very good location in the center, easy to take trains, metro, buses from close by and go to shopping by foot. Nice, clean old room, very,very friendly staff, bar open and EXCELLENT, delicious breakfast.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Old hotel needs basic renovation
text: Beds are good and clean. Apart from that you can see the years of this hotel, e.g. furniture and water taps are broken, windows not really sealed. Service people try their best. Breakfast acceptable. However, price not worth it if you want to have it nice.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Average room
text: Average room , the bathroom needs renewing as it looks like it was built in the 1950’s , windows are so dirty you can’t even see out of them also they aren’t double glazed so you can hear the traffic outside all night , not much lighting in the room , breakfast is awful and very over priced ! would recommend you walk down the road to the bakery for breakfast ! Also there’s only 1 lift in the whole hotel and that only fits 2 people so really annoying waiting for a lift ! Good points are the Bed is comfy and the heating works well that’s about it !
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: A pleasant stay
text: The location is amazing,at the center of Paris, 5 minutes walk to Champs Elysees. Rooms are clean and more spacious comparing to other hotels at Paris. The parking is tight, not ideal for big cars.Over all I think it is one of the best options for staying at Paris.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: doesnt look like their pictures in internet
text: hotel is very close to champ elysee by walking 10 minutes maksimum,around the hotel there were nothing,only a small market you can see.during the check in time there was a helpfull clerk at the reception and gave us an upgraded room,room was not refurbished very old designed and not dirty.at the entrance to the hotel was very quite and there was no body in the lobby also did not see in following days.we did not take breakfast because for two people they were going to harge us 18 euro per person and it did not worth.we checked out very early in the morning and the gentleman was also helpfull.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: bad
text: i called the reception to clean up the room because my 5 years old nephew was vometing because of the bad smell of the hotel and he said there is no one to clean, i called again to ask for a doctor and no one respond
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Very disappointed
text: The pictures shown on the hotel website and booking.com were clearly taken several years ago as the rooms are very run down in comparison with the photographs. The air conditioning also doesn't work, after leaving it on all day we would still come back to a warm room. The bed also was on wheels, which mean it moved around when in bed and made a horrible noise. The website specifies that the rooms are sound proof which is untrue as when trying to sleep we could hear staff and other guests in the corridor. Finally, although the hotel does offer parking they didn't tell us until check out that it would be €20 a night which is not acceptable , would not stay here again or recommend to anyone
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great location, friendly staff yet old hotel
text: The hotel is located in a great location few minutes away from the Arc De Triomphe, the Champs Elysee and two metro stations. The rooms (we had) are very roomy and spacious, however they are very old and need renovation. The Hotel staff are friendly and helpful, and breakfast is excellent (taste wise and variety wise). However cleanliness is a major concern. The room was not cleaned well at all a few days and then cleaned better on the other days. It all depends on the cleaning team.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Nicely located at the centre of Paris but rooms feels too old.
text: This hotel is well located at the centre of Paris. Walking distance to two Metro stations ( M1 Line). However hotel need refreshment as getting old. Close to supermarket. Free Wifi bit slow. If you wanna explore (by walking) Champ Ellysee, Arc De Triomph then you should consider this hotel.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel
text: Hotel room was small, the service was good, everything is nearby. Champs Elysees is 5 minutes walking and they have a nice parking area for the customers. If you give the priority to location and price instead of comfortable expensive luxe room then this hotel is perfect.
name: Royal Garden Champs Elysees

title: Great, cosy and homely.
text:
I was very well welcomed, the staff is genuinely kind and caring ! I really felt at home which is not something that I usually feel when I stay in hotels. 
The hotel has a homy size which makes your stay even more intimate and cosy.
Thank you Hotel Saint Marc staff, see you soon 🙌
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Nicest staff in Paris!!
text: Great stay at Hotel Saint Marc. Excellent location within walking distance of the metro the Louvre. Amazing breakfast and the room was great, very chic and clean. Incredibly nice staff on site and helped us with everything, definitely will stay here next time we’re in Paris!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Chic & Boutique
text: Chic and boutique, this hotel delivers. The rooms are spacious and well-appointed (although a bit dark); the lobby offers ample areas to lounge around, including an outside atrium; the attention to customer needs are addressed; and the breakfast and afternoon snacks keep the belly happy.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Charming Hotel
text: First time visitor and there were several things I enjoyed about this hotel. The staff was friendly and very accommodating, meaning the few requests we made were handled in a timely manner with a positive attitude. The twin/double bed was literally a twin, but comfortable. The location was great (downtown), with the metro within a very short walking distance. The picture of the room I received with my third party confirmation was exactly as it appeared in person.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Our favourite hotel in Paris
text: It is hard to be confident of hotels in Paris - many expensive ones have poor-quality rooms. But a number of years ago we discovered Hotel Saint-Marc and it is now the hotel to which we always return. Even the least expensive rooms (not the cheap, to be honest) are small but comfortable and beautifully equipped. The decor is splendid art deco throughout. The staff are always immensely friendly and helpful. Add the fact that it is in an excellent location in the 2eme arrondissement, and I can say that it is always a pleasure to stay here.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Excellent hotel
text:
We love to stay in this beautiful hotel, right in the town center,12min to walk to the Louvre. The receptionists are super friendly, the hotel rooms are beautiful, really comfortable and very clean. Breakfast is delicious, with snacks in the afternoon too.
We loved it and would come anytime again.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Solitude in the city
text:
I can't say enough good things about this hotel and its staff.  Everyone was kind and so helpful.  This hotel was an oasis for us after long days of sight seeing.  
Pros: 
- quiet location close to many restaurants and cafes. I'm not sure if all rooms overlook the courtyard like ours did.  
- quiet room (only noise we heard was when someone had to close their door to leave their room)
- big bathroom with strong water pressure and hot water 
- any issues were addressed promptly
- very helpful staff (we loved all of them) 

The only con is the bathroom lighting is a little dark for people who love to do their makeup in the morning.  

Highly recommend this hotel!!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect getaway hotel
text: Great hotel. Beautiful design details. Friendly staff, concierge was very knowledgeable about good local restaurants. A nice garden to enjoy breakfast. Cool lighting design blends modern details with Art Deco flair
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: nice hotel, good location, friendly staff
text: Everything was very good. Very beautiful design. The staff was special, very nice, responsive, helpful, always positive. The only note, the room could have been bigger, but that's probably the norm in Paris :) And the lighting could have been better in the bathroom near the mirror. Maybe the price is a little too high
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Hidden Gem - Wonderful
text: We had stayed at a disappointing hotel near Trocedero Square our first three days in Paris and I just couldn’t bare 2 more nights so we searched and found this gem! From the moment that Vincent greeted us at the door and Romaine welcomed us offering a coffee or juice it was hospitality at its finest!  Made our last two nights so much better! The warmth, positive energy were so welcoming and the decor was gorgeous. The room had little delightful touches and the room itself was beautiful and spacious. The so was such a treat too. Have to mention the great breakfast which we enjoyed on the lovely courtyard. This is the first place you should book while visiting Paris. People make a difference and their staff - everyone we encountered- were wonderful!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Great Paris hotel
text: We loved our four night stay at Hotel Saint Marc.  The staff was very friendly and helped make recommendation and reservations for us around town, including restaurants and attractions.  The hotel design is contemporary.  Breakfast in the courtyard is charming.  We look forward to returning.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Great for families, lovely location, great staff
text:
Lovely boutique hotel in convenient location with delicious breakfast + indoor pool + service-oriented staff, in particular the front desk and the service at breakfast. Nice mix of clientele, including families and couples. 
We were 3 adults and 2 children that stayed in 2 different rooms. Great location, especially when traveling with kids. Wide-range of nearby restaurants, from McDonald’s to a great brasserie, called Le Cardinal, to suit all preferences and meal needs. A arcade around the corner (La Tete dans les Nuages) and the hotel pool and steamroom are welcome respites after sightseeing in the summer heat. We would happily stay at the Saint Marc again!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Wonderful!!
text: We had an exceptional stay here. The room was spacious and beautiful. The breakfast was delicious and in such a lovely outdoor setting. The front staff could not have been more helpful and gracious and the location was perfect!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Summer stay in Paris
text:
Location excellent: 12min walk to louvre which is pleasant in summer time. Far enough that it is not noisy. 2min from metro station and 16mins train from Gare du Nord. 
Breakfast: not much hot food but plenty enough to have a good breakfast. 
Afternoon drinks and snacks: nice touch that some 5stars did not do.
Staff: amazingly helpful and nice effort. 
Rooms: beds firm which is good for me. I thought space was decent even though a little tight but then all paris rooms seem to be like that. Very clean and nice decor!
Maybe one feedback for management is that bathroom is a little dim, May need to install a spot light closer to shower and also to install rubber seals so water does not fly out of shower and leak in bathroom.
*Parking: it may not look like it is easily stoppable for taxi but the street was quiet all the times we walked down so probably not much to worry about.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Outstanding service and value!
text: Truly enjoying my stay here at the Hotel Saint-Marc. The ambience is incredibly charming and quintessentially French!  The staff is incredibly courteous and responsive to all of my needs—even making tea for my girlfriend at 1 am served elegantly on a tray with a napkin and teapot of water. The service, excellent buffet breakfast, and the outstanding location should put the Saint-Marc at the top of the list for anyone looking for a reasonably priced yet sophisticated and upscale hotel in Paris.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Lovely staying
text: What a nice discovery the Hotel Saint Marc. Central position,in a quite street. Comfortable, clean and furnished rooms, and the most important thing: excellent staff. Always kind, smiling and ready to every request. I really enjoyed my staying
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Hotel Saint-Marc
text:
Special shout out to Roman! 
We could not have picked a better hotel. The staff have been phenomenal, the hotel and the room exceeded all our expectations. Possibly one of the best hotels we have stayed at in all of Europe! 
Extremely accommodating with the added benefit that they are very centrally located! 
We will definitely be back here again!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Luxurious rooms, delightful service
text: Great location, within walking distance to Louvre yet away from the tourist crowds.  Rooms were luxuriously huge, including the bathroom for Europe standards.  And most importantly, the team at the front desk were helpful and exceedingly polite.  Special callout to Roman and Vincent who were always offering great recommendations for restaurants and places to visit.  Would definitely recommend the hotel to anyone visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: a little paradise
text:
super friendly service
very tasteful facility
best and easy offside location ensure relaxation and short distances to many attractions
we had absolute sleep on the garden courtyard side
SPA very pleasant, one would be happy about the possibility to cool down better
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Unique and Special Property
text: Even before I arrived the staff took good care to welcome me with their pre arrival survey. I loved that they proactively suggested places to dine and visit. The hotel was beautifully appointed and accommodating, and all the staff were lovely, especially the breakfast staff. The breakfast was also nice, especially the melon juice and dairy products. I also really liked how I was able to book the spa privately in the evenings. It was one of the best perks. I would recommend this property to anyone who wants something a little more special during their travels. I stayed at 4 different properties during my multi-city trip and the Saint-Marc was my favorite.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Great visit at the Saint-Marc
text: The hotel is nicely located, very near 2 Metro stations, and on a quiet side street in the 2nd Arondissement.  The front desk was incredibly friendly, accommodating me/others in English or Spanish, as well as French.  Good recommendations for a nearby bistro (Bistro de Vaudeville) that was charming and delicious.  Rooms are really cool, Art Deco, with all the amenities.  Just wished we had another night there...
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Like Home in Paris
text:
Perfect location, beautiful design rooms, service went above and beyond, the private spa experience Is really a plus ! It’s one of the most beautiful hotel I did so far, I strongly recommend to try the Saint Marc’s experience 
We will be back !
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Nikolay
text: Great location, very quite. Waking distance to Louvre, Gallery Lafayette etc. Friendly and helpful staff. They can book a taxi, or a table in a restaurant, can advise good restaurants around. Clean room. Good breakfast.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect!!!
text: Such a wonderful hotel.   I think the best part was how kind  everyone was.   I was traveling on my own and it was my first trip in awhile   They could not have been more friendly and helpful   They had great close by dinner reservations, helpful suggestions on attractions and a friendly welcome every time I came and went.  The room was immaculate every day. Very quiet and a super comfortable bed.   Breakfast was a nice treat each morning.  Definitely will be a repeat on my list
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Wonderful
text:
We loved it here…
Reception were friendly and helpful from the moment we checked in

The hotel and rooms are decorated in an Art Deco style to a really high standard, but it’s not style over substance at all. 

It looks amazing, and the hotel is amazing. Location is brilliant with lots of Paris on your doorstep, plus 2 metro stations nearby (1 min or 5 min walk)

We stayed in the superior room with Spa access (you get offered an hour in the Spa, it’s small, but worth it after a day walking round Paris) 

Would go back tomorrow! Wonderful. One of my favourite hotels I’ve been too.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: 48 hours in Paris
text:
First time at this hotel and one I will return to. Clean boutique hotel with welcoming staff. Great location. Didn’t eat here or use the Spa, but will next time.

Bit of street noise from 7am onwards as the work day starts, beds are comfortable by some better feather pillows would be a blessing.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect hotel, staff and stay!
text: A perfect stay. From the welcome by the superb team, to the high quality of amenities and rooms, Hotel Saint Marc is by far a top 5 hotel in Paris. My room well decorated, clean, lovely smell, complimentary water, high quality bedding and appliances. The breakfast was great, very cozy, and service was impeccable.
