The fact that the hotel is small, gives you a much more personal interaction with staff and the experience is much more unique. Everything is tailored to the guest to make you feel just like at home. I highly recommend it and will be back soon. Thank you to the wonderful team!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Wonderful boutique hotel in a perfect location
text:
My husband and I enjoyed a wonderful nine night stay at the Hotel Saint Marc.  The staff was extremely courteous  and I would like to thank Vincent, Lucas, Bertrand, Ousman, and everyone else at the front desk. Travelling during these confusing covid times can be stressful, and the staff at this hotel certainly helped us and answered our many questions!
Our room was quite large and the bathroom was one of the biggest that I've experienced in Paris.  We looked out onto the lovely Opera Comique and were a short walk to the Louvre, Musee D'Orsay, the Marais, and numerous shops and restaurants.  
There's a lovely afternoon tea offered at the hotel which is a welcome addition after a long day of strolling the Paris streets and when you're ready for dinner, the staff at the front desk will be happy to recommend a restaurant and make a reservation.
I can't wait for my next trip to Paris and look forward to staying at the Hotel Saint Marc.  Merci!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Definitely a hidden gem in Paris
text:
Beautiful boutique hotel,  centrally located but in a quiet street.  The guest experience from start to finish was excellent.  We were warmly greeted, our room was ready early for check-in and everybody we met was incredibly friendly.  The bedroom was beautiful and stylish,  and the bathroom modern with a great shower.  My only small suggestion would be to have better lighting in the bathroom as it's very dark and had black tiles throughout.  Trying to do make-up was a challenge! 
The room faces the Opera comique and was quiet enough to have a great night's sleep.  
Breakfast was really good with a great selection of hot and cold items.  
Overall we wouldn't hesitate to recommend the hotel and we'll definitely be booking it for our next trip to Paris
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Saint Marc in October 2021 and I would, hands down, recommend anyone who wants a boutique hotel and personalized stay to consider the Hotel Saint-Marc. Check in was smooth and Lucas helped us secure a daily hour time slot in their private pool and steam room. The steam room  is everything after a long day of traveling around the city. The pool area and steam room was consistently clean and sanitized. 

We booked the Executive room since we felt we wanted more space than what was offered in their standard rooms. However, after seeing the size of their Executive rooms, I think I would have been just as happy in a standard room. There was plenty of space, the bathroom was very large, and storage was available. As other reviewers have mentioned, depending on the room you get, it can be dark. We did end up with a room that was pretty dark. The linens were crisp and comfortable and I appreciate the pillows the most. They were firm and didn't lose its shape overnight. 

The bathroom amenities are available but the hair dryer in our room, 202, worked unexpectedly. It would not stay on consistently. The products available are Grown Alchemist and was of high quality. Towels and bathrobes provided were plush. The best part about the bathroom was the rain shower head. One of the best hotel showers, if not the best, I've had. 

The surrounding area is quiet but you are just blocks away from many great eats and cafes and attractions. I really enjoyed the lobby area and dining area. There's daily afternoon Nespresso and snacks (pastries, cakes) and mariage frere teas in the dining and patio area. I really enjoyed sitting in the patio and it was hardly used during our stay. 

This being a boutique hotel also means fewer rooms. It truly felt like an intimate experience. One thing to note is that the temperature gauge in the room did not seem to be available for control. We had no issues though as we were able to open the window and it faced the courtyard. Twice during our stay there was loud music and raucous conversation around 3-5am. In general, you cannot hear other guests in the hotel. The rooms are well sound proofed but it is easy to hear hallway noises. 

If I visit Paris again, this is the best hotel to stay at. The private spa, amenities, proximity to attractions and privacy afforded at the hotel cannot be beat. Excellent service and staff also--Lucas, Ousman, and David were all wonderful as were other team members.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Weekend stay in Hotel Saint-Marc
text: We had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Saint-Marc. We were very excited for our stay because of the excellent reviews and they did not disappoint at all. The rooms looked good, the staff treated us in the best way possible and I would really recommend the spa.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Wonderful Stay at Hotel Saint Marc
text:
Just returned from a wonderful stay at the Hotel Saint Marc in Paris. Our trip to enjoy Paris for the first time was made even better by the exceptionally friendly, professional, attentive and polite staff at the Hotel Saint Marc, which is itself, a gem - well-decorated and maintained, comfortable, clean, quiet and well-located for visitors. The staff showed us every consideration and ensured that we were comfortable and well-informed. We hope to visit again, soon!

We took advantage of having breakfast on-site most days and were very satisfied with the selections of pastries, eggs, cheeses and breakfast meats. This enabled us to get an early start at our daily exploration of Paris. We would opt to do this again, as it was excellent, as well as convenient.

To all of the people at the Hotel Saint Marc who extended themselves to help make our vacation a true delight, our sincere thanks and best wishes!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Best place to stay in Paris
text: We have stayed at the Saint-Marc previously, so therefore it was no question what hotel we were going to stay at during this trip! Communication with this hotel prior to our stay was phenomenal, always quick to answer any kind of question, helpful and ready with suggestions. check-in is easy and quick, the front desk staff is always helpful and friendly. The rooms are on the large side, especially for any European city, comfy beds, nice bathrooms. everything is extremely clean, has always been, but with a pandemic especially important. we enjoyed the spa, a great way to relax after a busy day out in the streets of Paris! Breakfast is good and plentiful, and there are many restaurant options for dining close by. The metro is a two minute walk from the hotel and gets you anywhere in Paris. For us it will always be the Saint-Marc when in Paris!!!!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Dream stay
text: Let's start with the design of the hotel. I'm a big fan of Dimore Studio, who did the design. It was a true joy to be able to actually stay in a room and experience several spaces designed by them. Everything feels very luxurious and you notice great attention was paid to every little detail. The staff did everything to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. Before check-in we were reminded of the possibility to book a slot to use the hotel pool, upon check-in we were offered a choice between a room with a shower or with a bath,... The hotel also offers nice extra touches, like free pastries and tea in the afternoon, or umbrellas you can borrow on a rainy day. The location is central, but very quiet. This hotel definitely ranks among the best I've ever stayed at, and it would be a great pleasure to return to the Saint-Marc.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect !
text:
Prestige room was big, quiet and really enjoyable. Bed and furnitures were on point in an "art déco" style. We had the spa (indoor pool + hammam) for ourselves for 1 hour and everything was really clean. Everyone from the hotel were nice and made everything in their possibility to make our one night stay unique.

Thanks a lot !
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Fabulous service, great location
text: My partner and I fully enjoyed our quick staycation at Hôtel Saint-Marc. The pool and spa were a pleasure, the room spacious, and the service second to none. Thank you to the team at the hotel who went out of their way to ensure our stay was memorable!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Amazing hotel for a Parisian getaway
text:
We stayed at Hotel Saint Marc over New Year’s Eve and were so happy we did. Our room was large, clean and we loved the decoration. We were on a corner which allowed for amazing views on Parisian buildings (room 404). 
The street is very quiet yet location is ideal for tourists as you are right in the center of Paris near the Opéra and Boulevard Haussman.
Service was also amazing with polite and very attentive staff and great breakfast (on the pricier side for breakfast, 21€ per person, but everything was fresh and tasty). 
We were lucky to have the spa for ourselves as you can book a 1-hour time slot in advance. The pool is very nice and the steam room is amazing with little star lights on the ceiling for a relaxing ambiance. 
We couldn’t have asked for a better NYE and will gladly come back next time we’re in Paris. 
I’d also recommend this hotel for a romantic staycation!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Outstanding Service
text: Stayed with friends for couple of days, great location for visiting paris, very clean and glitzy. Very posh and modern interior decoration themes. After a long day we enjoyed free teatime in the beautiful garden. 10/10
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Best Hotel in Paris
text: Very cozy and nice hotel. The room was clean and comfortable and very stylish. Perfect location close to subway and shopping. Very nice and helpful stuff. I had a great experience and can really recommend.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect Stay in Paris
text: We loved our 4 day stay in Paris and this little hotel was perfect. After reading all the positive reviews it still exceeded expectations. Lovely spacious room and large well designed bathroom with the best shower. Comfy bed, great sheets, large fluffy white towels. And the outside courtyard was a real bonus where we enjoyed breakfast and relaxed at the end of the day for drinks before going out for dinner. Perfect location for sightseeing and for shopping and dining in the Marais district which isn’t too far. The 3 staff who looked after us were so friendly and helpful we felt sad to have to say goodbye to them.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Fantastic hotel, amazing staff, perfect stay!
text: Our stay in Paris could not have been more perfect. The location of the hotel is great. There is a park garage available. The staff were super friendly. We especially want to highlight Bertrand who really looked after us so well during our stay. We loved the spa which we had booked privately every night and it was very clean and relaxing. Our suite on the top floor was super spacious with comfortable beds and a huge bathroom. It is a bit pricey but all of Paris is and this place is really money well spent. We will be back!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Beautiful Hotel and Fantastic Staff
text:
This hotel is absolutely stunning. My room was fabulous, quiet, and large for Paris. Wonderful touches throughout.
I was supposed to stay for 3 nights but had to cancel 2 because of COVID-19 quarantine being announced. The staff member handled the situation immediately and showed a great care for my well-being. This was truly exceptional service during a frustrating time and I can’t thank them enough. 
I really hope to be back to Hotel Saint-Marc as soon as possible!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Incredible
text:
An amazing hotel, very well located. The stuff is very kind and professional. This hotel is ideal for both touristic and business trips. 
Despite being close to all the touristic attractions, rooms are very calm and chill.
Totally worth to visit!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: My 30th Birthday trip! And such a fantastic place to stay.
text:
Oh my gosh it was such an amazing trip and experience I’ve nearly ever had, as I had never been to Paris or France before. My boyfriend got me this trip for Christmas, so that I could be away for my birthday. It is really great the location as it’s around an hour walk to the Eiffel Tour and also really central for tourists that haven’t been there before. The bedroom was spectacular, so comfortable and lovely air con to suit your own needs, the bathroom was so nice. The breakfast was lovely, something a bit different to what I’m used to and I enjoyed it! 
The staff at the hotel were so overwhelmingly helpful and such a pleasure to have there, because they were there for when you needed something and giving us advice of where to go to visit and good places to eat etc, and also changing like times for the spa was absolutely amazing prioritising that for us. 
The things they did in the bedroom and what my boyfriend got them to do for my birthday and writing note to wish me a happy birthday was just phenomenal, speechless and such a lovely thing they all did! I really appreciate it.
It was an experience I’ll never forget and I hope to me and my boyfriend will be back again some day because I enjoyed it that much! All I can say is I loved it. 

I would recommend this to everyone!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Chic design, great location and excellent service
text: My girlfriend and I could not be more impressed with the service that we received at the St. Marc Hotel - our stay here turned our Parisian vacation into an unforgettable experience. As a design-oriented couple, we were deeply impressed with the Hotel's interior designed by the famed Milanese studio, Dimore. Stepping into our room felt like entering a luxe, jewel-toned paradise with top-end features, super high ceilings, and an intelligent layout. After learning that we were architects, Adrian at the front desk offered to show us a few of the more coveted rooms, as well as the Wes Anderson-esque spa. A true treat! Moreover, the staff of the hotel were more than accommodating of a last-minute change in travel plans that we had. We not only received exemplary, personalized service but were also recommended to our now favorite Michelin-starred dinner spot in the city. We can't wait for our next stay!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect single night stay
text: Hotel SM is excellently located close to the Gard du Nord with lots of local bars and restaurants that are easily walkable. The staff are attentive and friendly. The rooms are spacious, comfortable and clean. They also have a spa with steam room, which is peaceful and a nice way to break from the city. They also offer tea, fruit and cake in the afternoons. Perfect stay. Would happily come again.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Great place!
text:
Well located not far from Opera.
Lobby is fine  Staff very friendly but professional. 
The room was very nice and trendy. Large and nice bathroom.
Room was super quite and we appreciated very much.
Breakfast was the only disappointment. Croissants were not great. Unusual in such a place .
Overall great!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: 10 wonderful days at Saint Marc
text:
On a recent trip to Paris we found this little gem in the hearth of the city. It is a small place but with excellent location and perfect place for exploring the city .
I was very impressed first and foremost by the eagerness of the front desk staff to make our stay pleasant. They tried to assist us and strived to make our stay memorable. Thank you.
Highly recommended hotel.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Charming and top location
text: I can’t say what I enjoyed most, whether it was the friendly and super helpful staff or the elegant hotel and all the included services. The spa and swimming pool are just amazing and go far behind what you‘d expect from a Parisian boutique hotel. Tea time is very nice too, with complimentary teas and home made cakes! As a tourist you‘ll be greatful for the location with all the famous sights easily accessible by metro and some even on foot.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Excellent choice for relaxing weekend
text: Great hotel at a very good location with a friendly and very helpful staff. Enjoyed the atmosphere, the relaxing spa and all the nearby restaurants. We had complimentary coffe in the very pleasant lobby. Metro stop very close.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Quiet superb location
text: This is a quite hotel in an excellent location. Strong suggestion to stay in. Superb service, very nice staff. Very clean excecutive room. Good restaurants around. Best shoping and the opera is steps from there!!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Best boutique hotel in Paris
text: I cannot find anything negative to say about this hotel. The staff is welcoming and professional, the rooms large for Paris standards. Modern and clean interiors.  Our room faced the Opera Comique so nice and quiet.  The setting is intimate and the wine selection is great. Love the honour bar concept. Breakfast is simple but delicious.  The hotel is close to everything. We were there during the subway strikes and walked everywhere. An absolute gem!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Just as special each time we stay there!
text: The management recently responded to what was in fact my 2017 review of Hotel Saint-Marc but, as we stayed there for a third time in the early days of this New Year, let me write another but briefer review. I wrote two years ago that Hotel Saint-Marc was a real find - a consistently good hotel with friendly and always helpful staff, and at a resonable price for Paris. One can pay a great deal more in a city bedevilled by poor hotels and uneven rooms even in better hotels. Hotel Saint-Marc is always good. A lovely art deco theme, very comfortable rooms (even in the smaller rooms, one of which we had this time), a petit dejeuner express which was great value (as probably was the full breakfast), complimentary coffee/tea/cake each afternoon, and thoughtful and friendly staff throughout. This is a hotel that really cares whether clients are happy. We were extremely happy and it is now our destination hotel in Paris, indeed knowing how comfortable we'll be there is one of the reasons we go to Paris more frequently.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Amazing service, lush place, smells gorge
text: Super clean. Smells amazing. They allowed us to check in early. Worth every penny. Great location. Keane Reeves lookalike at the desk was sooooo lovely and helpful. Will be staying here again for future Paris trips 🙂
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Long weekend in Paris
text: What can I say? I love this hotel!! Very comfortable and spacious rooms, excellent service and friendly, helpful staff. The concierge assisted with restaurant and taxi bookings and it made the journey so much more carefree and relaxing. Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Love this hotel
text: Me and my fiancée stayed at this hotel right after new years eve for 4 days. Our room was big and we loved the decoration. Bed was so comfy and big. Staff were amazingly helpful and friendly,one night we asked them to book a dinner in a nice bistro close to the hotel (vivienne) and it was really good. Breakfast was ok, fresh bread nice espresso and amazing butters were quite enough for us. We also booked the private spa, steam room was really good and pool and the pool area were clean and fun! (Was a bit cold but we didn’t mind.) location is great we loved the neighbourhood. We especially would like to thank Mr.Vincent from front desk to made our vacation even better. Would highly reccomend this hotel and hope to be back soon!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Classic Boutique Hotel
text:
The location of the hotel is brilliant. A short walk to many restaurants & shops. We also walked from the hotel to the Louvre & Eiffel Tower. The staff at the hotel are superb & are very accommodating. One of the best staffs we’ve encountered traveling. The room was very large for Paris standards and had a very retro vibe. Based on the price for the room I can see why the hotel is highly rated.

A few tips to note about the hotel:

-It’s a small hotel and doesn’t have the large scale amenities like a bar, shops, or restaurants.  

-The Mono Op grocery store is a short walk 

-Other travelers commented on construction near the hotel. The construction is still underway and was a light nuisance. 

If you enjoy a smaller B&B vibe Hotel Saint Marc is a worthy destination
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Best value for money in Paris
text:
Best value for money in Paris 
There is no possible improvisation in this business. Staff is talented, rooms are cosy, I really like the private spa (maybe tough to get a slot when hotel is crowded?) good breakfast in a great area. I strongly recommend this hotel
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Excellent service and amenities
text:
Stayed at the hotel during a short business trip in Paris. Location is perfect and very convenient.
Service was all you can expect in a high end hotel, with caring yet not invasive staff.
I especially like the fresh breakfast that honoured the French cuisine.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Loved it!
text: Excellent, chic hotel in a great area! The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The decor is stylish and chic. I love being in a location close to the Opera house and lots of restaurants and shops. It’s on a side street so it’s quiet. Close to metro.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Amazing Hotel
text: Stunning Hotel and amazing customer service. We stayed for 4 nights in September and were absolutely blown away. The front desk staff are extremely helpful when it came to anything we needed. The rooms are extremely beautiful and clean.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: A lovely place and friendly staff
text: Close to everything, beautiful interior and a nice spa. Everyone made us feel really welcome. Loved our spacious corner room. Would be nice it it would be possible to order a late night snack for our next visit, because we're definitely coming back! See you soon, hopefully!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Absolutely  beautiful room
text:
My wife and I feel  very fortunate to have stayed in this wonderful hotel. A surprise treat from our two children. This was our first journey on Eurostar what an incredible experience. With an Art Deco influence the hotel is a beautiful building and very central enabling access to many tourist sites on foot. 

When we walked into our prestige room we were blown away. It was a huge room with 4 floor to ceiling windows the Juliet balconies overlooking the square in front of the Opera Comique. A very large beautiful bathroom complete with a bath tub all the amenities you could as for.
All the staff were very friendly. A special thanks to Adrien and Vincent on the front desk who where extremely helpful.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Posh, clean, cozy, and friendly
text: The property was clean and beautiful. Tucked away on a safe quiet street. Concierge was extremely helpful and friendly. Breakfast was not included but affordable. Would highly recommend to couples or solo travelers!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Lovely hotel
text:
My boyfriend and I had a great 4 night stay here.  The location is perfect with loads of restaurants nearby and easy access to the Metro as well as walking distance to attractions such as Montmartre, Musee d'Orsay and the Louvre. The room was a decent size and very nicely decorated.  The hotel spa was a nice touch, particularly being able to book it for private use for no charge.  The staff were all very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful both before and during our stay.  There were building works across the road while we were at the hotel but the noise didn't disturb us as the hotel itself is really very quiet and well sound-proofed.  

If you're looking for nearby restaurants, there are many, but we could wholeheartedly recommend some we tried -  Accents Table Bourse (amazing 1 Michelin starred food), La Regalade Conservatoire (hearty but still very polished French food,) and Maison Dong (delicious Szechuan cooking).

We can't wait to go back!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Our Home Away from Home in Paris
text:
Hotel Saint-Marc is a gem of a boutique hotel located in the heart of Paris in the 2nd Arrondissement. We most recently stayed at Hotel Saint-Marc for one week in November 2019 (it was my husband's second time staying at Hotel Saint-Marc and the third for myself). The rooms and hotel are decorated in an art deco style with jewel toned colors and is very chic.

We like this hotel for many reasons but what keeps us coming back is the staff, particularly Adrien and Vincent, are the best. The staff are very kind, hospitable, and helpful - we truly feel like it's our home in Paris since the staff remembers repeat guests. Since it's a small boutique hotel of 26 or so rooms, the ratio of staff to guest is high and there is always someone around should you need any assistance. Speaking of assistance, they helped us with our questions and gave us ideas for places to see and eat. They also called restaurants to confirm reservations and to make reservations.

The hotel is conveniently located in Paris within walking distance to many attractions and good restaurants (ie: 15 minutes to the Louvre, 10 minutes to Galeries Lafayette, 10 minutes to Palais Garnier). The hotel and rooms are beautiful and very clean. Our room was cleaned every day. There is also a spa with a small pool and a steam room in the basement free for all guests to use.

We have always had an amazing stay at Hotel Saint-Marc and highly recommend it!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: A beautiful discovery
text: We came for a short weekend with a ballet at the opera and enjoyed the very good location close to opera Garnier, we liked the quietness of the place, the interior decoration, and the kindness of the staff. Looks like we found our place to stay when going to Paris.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Very comfortable hotel
text:
We enjoyed our stay very much. The room was spacious, more than usually in Paris, well-lit and there is everything you need. Our visits are very tiring and we enjoy a nice and relaxing hotel.
The staff is very friendly and helpful
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Still very good but  shy of perfection
text: I love this hotel because I can book the spa only for you and your partner for an entire hour. Location is fantastic. Staff is really good. Just I didn't like to be told that the room was fully paid at my arrival and then to be told in the following morning that was a mistake, normally when you provide wrong information you give a free breakfast to compensate the error (which is not cheap btw 24 euro each per person per day), but no nice gesture was received. Customer may still improve. For rest highly recommended.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Great Hotel and the location was perfect
text:
This was my first stay and the st Marc was happy with the service which was great and the ambiance of the hotel is cool and the decor of the mustard room I stayed in was great.

Thank you to the staff for a happy stay.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Very nice stay
text: This hotel was very nice.  A little off the beaten path but on a very quiet street.  Still close to the bus stops and subway.  Lobby of hotel was very nice, staff were wonderful,  room was very clean and comfortable, bathroom was nicely decorated, and good space.  The price was really quite good for the quality of the hotel.  They also had a nice outdoor seating area for eating or just relaxing.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Excellent
text:
This hotel is well located with excellent staff on arrival it was like having a personal tour guide for Paris who explained and and marked up maps for the 4 days of our stay.
The hotel it self is 4 if not 5 star the room we had was large and the bathroom was excellent.
Breakfast was more than u could wish for . Can’t wait to get back !
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Amazing team
text:
I stayed at Hotel Saint-Marc to show our latest collection for H2OFagerholt, and we couldnt have wished for a better place to stay. The room was amazing, the staff was super friendly and serviceminded. 

This was not my first time at Hotel Saint Marc, and I will keep coming back. I feel very comfortable and at home when staying there.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Hotel Saint-Marc
text: Very enjoyable and positive stay.  In a good location and good service. Rooms clean and comfortable.  Liked the room best exactly as expected which is unusual.  Would recommend the hotel to family and friends.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: sightseeing trip
text:
very helpful guys at the reception, had a big issue with a lost baggage, was solved by them.
Nice and calm hotel, the little garden is special. the bathroom is top.
housekeeping could  be improved . at 2 days nobody came to clean up until late afternoon...
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Perfect
text:
Can’t even begin to describe how much we loved our stay at your hotel!
Even prior to arrival Vincent was so kindly corresponding as I attempted last minute reservations at some trendy restaurants.
We had been VIP attendees at the District 13 Druout Art Fair and wound up at true Parisian bistros. We were made to feel as though we were at home at your hotel and in the neighborhood during our quick walk to the Art Fair and other classic tourist sites.
The interior is spotlessly clean as our the rooms. Thank you for the lovely upgrade on our preferred top floor (love your courtyard, conservatory view it warms my Dutch heart) during such a busy week (fashion week as well!) and the early check in. Honestly we have always stayed at The Castile (even popped in to see that weird drugged out seeming cat) and your hotel is head and shoulders above for our personal tastes for Paris adventures forever more!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: fabulous little hotel
text:
I read the reviews for the hotel but was still pleasantly surprised by this hotel.  The hotel is well located. We are walkers and could easily walk to any of the major Paris landmarks.  It was an easy 20 minute walk to the Louvre and about 30 minutes to Montmartre as an example.  There are also many restaurants and some decent shopping within 5 minutes of the hotel.  
The room was lovely with an art decor theme.  It was a very quiet and comfortable respite after a day of walking Paris.   Big bathroom with heated floors and a great walk in shower.  
I would  highly recommend a stay at the St Marc.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Staying at the Hotel St Marc was a wonderful experience while visiting Paris
text: The staff at the concierge we extremely helpful. They made dinner bookings & recommendations for where to dine also. The breakfasts offered traditional French pastries & continental cooked breakfast. We enjoyed sitting in the garden of an afternoon enjoying a quiet drink before heading out. The spa & steam room were an excellent way to relax. St Marc was a wonderful place to stay while in Paris
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Hidden Gem
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Saint-Marc.  Although tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, the hotel was just a 20 minute walk to the Louvre and other Paris sights. The room was tastefully decorated and the breakfast was lovely.  But what made this hotel special was the friendly staff who made us feel at home.
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: My favorite hotel in Paris
text: I booked this hotel because i really liked the hotel interior and cortyard. Sometimes i get dissapointed that reviews and photoes are too good to be true, but this place was so beautiful. The location is so close to opera galnier but this hotel is so quiet. I will definitely go back again!
name: Hotel Saint-Marc

title: Best location
text: If you want to immerse yourself in the culture this is where to stay!  walking distance to bakeries, cheese shops, fruit markets, butchers, et al.  Incredibly friendly staff.  Perfect place for our week stay with our kid too.   I'll be staying there again.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Fantastic apartment in a perfect location.
text: What more could you want, beautiful apartment 30 seconds from a metro station in a street that I would love to live in. Everyone was really helpful and pleasant, you could easily cook in every night or walk to a restaurant. Great little supermarket just down the road along with a butchers, fishmonger, cheese shop and of course numerous bakers and patisseries. We loved it !!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: A perfect stay in a perfect area
text: very nice appartment with everything we needed for a 4 days trip to Paris. The area is very cosy. Friendly and very helpful staff. We would like to come back again. The two bedrooms were perfect in size, and two bathrooms as well.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Perfect in every way
text:
The staff, property, cleanliness, location to travel network, shops and tourist venues was perfect. 
We travelled with our son who has multiple allergies and so required a self catering property. The staff were amazing and went the extra yard to ensure it was given an extra clean, contacted us prior to arrival re pillow (ie hypo allergenic ones required) and made sure that on the day of departure we had a little extra time to prepare food before we travelled. Honestly cannot rate this place high enough. Alex - yourself and Eloide
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Everything about our stay here was wonderful.
text: The place was clean, the view was lovely, the kitchen was well equipped. The location was close to the metro, and hidden just off the main street, it was very walkable. The building felt safe, and the staff was kind and helpful. We stayed a few different places in Paris and this was our favorite.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Very good location and great apartment
text: It was a really good hotel for our family. We had a good sized kitchen available. Same with the bedroom and the sofa bed was big enough. We also got a baby bed on request which was very good. Very central and very nice staff. Was a great size for a family of four. If we travel to Paris again, we would most likely stay there.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great place to stay in Montmartre
text: Really lovely apartment in Montmartre. Close to everything you'd need (fruit vendor, cheese, boulangerie, etc) and easy walking/metro to anywhere you'd like to go. Apartment was clean and comfortable. We were there in the crazy Paris heat and were incredibly grateful for the a/c.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Perfect Montmarte Location to Explore Paris
text: Had a fantastic visit to Paris using Montmartre Residence as our "base camp." Absolutely loved the studio room, with its full kitchen, comfortable bed, and large bathroom.  Lots of storage to be able to unpack our suitcases and put them away. The provided robes were a nice touch.  Large elevator to get to our 2nd floor room (3rd floor American) - in fact we have stayed in rooms in Paris about the size of the elevator!  The air conditioning was much appreciated given Paris was experiencing a heat wave (all too common these days).  Had lovely Montmarte street views, and while the room was not completely sound proof, it was pretty close given the lively area where it is located.  The staff were so helpful and responded to questions quickly, even arranged a taxi for us in advance for the day of our departure.  Would absolutely stay here again, and in fact areadly thinking about when we might be able to go back.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: A home away from home,
text: Our stay was wonderful. The apartment was spacious and clean and very comfortable, with a fantastic panoramic view of Paris. Located in the heart of Montmartre but quiet. The staff were courteous and responsive. We stayed one month, could have stayed forever.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Amazing Apartment, Great Location and even better hosts
text: It really does not get any better than Montmartre Residence. The location is amazing and we spent many hours just sat in the window watching the hustle and bustle of the busy streets below. Great facilities, large and comfortable rooms and the onsite management was very helpful, kind and courteous.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Lovely apartment at a perfect location
text: Our family of three (a middle-aged couple with a young adult son) stayed at the Opera (Prestige) 2-bedroom apartment twice - first in 2019 and then again in 2022. The apartment is lovely (if slightly worn on the edges) and very comfortable, and the staff exceedingly helpful. The living room has an air conditioner, which was a life saver during a heat wave. The best part, however, is the location - this part of Monmartre is lively but not overly touristy, there are a ton of restaurants and small shops, and the Abbesses metro stop is very close. This is as close to living in Paris as a tourist can get!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: enjoyable stay and I will stay at same place during my next visit and I will advise my friends as well. Thank you
text:
Location is perfect, close to every thing almost. Very helpful staff especially Mr Antonine.
Apartment is very clean beds very comfortable new furniture it has washing machine and air conditioning. The apartment has also elevator quite place
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great location, great apartment for the parks vibes
text: Loved staying here. It’s in the heart of Montmartre on a pedestrian street so little cars and traffic to ruin the vibe. The windows would open right up to the street with fab Parisian view and great shops and restaurants near by. Couldn’t hear the noise from the street  when the windows were shut. I just loved it! Thanks for having us!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Wonderful View Great Location
text:
We loved our time here! Great having a kitchen. Loved having groceries on arrival. It would have been a 5 rating except the bedroom got hot at night as there were no air conditioning vents in that room.  
I loved the view out the window onto the street.  So many cafes on the street. I know some reviews  complained about the noise but it didn't bother us at all. Most nights we were out until the cafes closed anyway.  I would highly recommend staying at Montmartre Residence.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great location and quality apartment
text: This place is good. Probably the best location in Montmarte, it’s got a real buzz. Inside everything is top quality. Highly recommended. Surrounded by restaurants and Close to Moulin Rouge (which was surprisingly good. We had a suite and it was plenty big enough.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great location, great stay
text:
We stayed in mid May, for 4 days. Great location, just 2 minutes walk from nearest metro station (Abbesses). Sacre Coeur Basilica is walking distance from here and so is Moulin Rouge. There are plenty of food options with many vibrant cafes and bakeries on the adjoining streets. There is a department store at walking distance as well. 
The apartment was beautiful, spacious, clean and very well equipped, with comfortable beds and clean linen and towels. The view from windows was so pretty, giving you a real feel of Paris. 
Staff was helpful and pleasant, especially Alex and Antoine who were always there to help. We had a great stay and actually missed it when we checked out. We would love to stay here again when we visit Paris again. 
Couple of things to take note of, its not a typical hotel and the staff is available from 9:00 to 6:00 in office. Also, there is no daily housekeeping. It is on demand and costs extra.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Lovely, bright studio in heart of Montmartre
text: We spent three nights here in early May 2022, and it was well worth it.  A very spacious studio with great kitchen area, washer for clothes, and bathroom. The location was ideal in Montmartre on a lively yet peaceful block. The neighborhood is lively but not loud.  Easy walking distance to Sacre Coeur, easy walking distance to the Metro.  Bistros, cafes on every corner.  We really loved the studio and hope one day we can go back. It really makes a difference when on vacation when you go back to your place and feel comfortable like at him.  Merci!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Spacious and tranquil stay in the center of Montmartre quarter
text: We had a spacious, very well equipped appartment on the third floor. Being in the middle of the very lively quarter on Montmartre, we did not really expect undisturbed sleep. But thanks to well fitting windows and a good aircondition all noise was pushed far in the background and we had relaxing nights after great sightseeings during daytime.  Staff was very friendly and supporting. Bookable secured car park is very close, but narrow. Beware with huger cars!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Lovely apartment and helpful staff
text: We stayed as a family of four over the Easter holidays. We have a 5 year old and a teenager. The location was perfect. I’ve always loved montmatre but this was the first time I’ve stayed and glad I chose montmatre residence. We asked them to do us a shop for the basics before we arrived. This meant when we got in after a long day of travelling and were all set without having to try and find shops on arrival. We had a few issues with the apartment (washing machine) which were dealt with by the helpful staff. All the staff went out of there way to help us and were so accommodating. I loved that the apartment had a spice rack such a small thing but so helpful rather than having to buy pepper, herbs etc when you only ever need such small amounts. it had all the equipment we needed. Beds were comfortable. Really nicely decorated with great furniture pieces.  A great place from where to explore.  beautiful Paris. Thank you
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Perfect Feel Good Location in Paris
text: If you want to feel great each time you step out in the morning and return each night, this is a fabulous apartment.  The local ambiance is just delightful from the little shops, to the Abesses metro and the spectacular art nouveau church across the square.  We were in Paris for a week and really felt like we could have stayed in Montmartre and been pretty pleased.  We stayed in the one studio unit at the Residence and it was across the street from Le Vrais Paris and while we didn't go it was quite a lovely sight to look upon.  We did find earplugs were needed for decent sleep as the street is busy until late and wakes up early.  The apartment was perfect for us with a spacious bathroom, adequate kitchen and lots of storage areas.  The bed was on the firm side.  The entrance area is really nice and there is an elevator.  The staff were incredibly nice and helpful.  We went to the pharmacy a block away for our return to US covid test with printed results in hand after 15min(25euro each).
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Fantastic
text:
Great apartment, clean and tidy. Fully equipped kitchen and bathroom with bathrobes and slippers. 
Short distance from a metro station,
Lovely restaurants, bistros and cafes with a 2 minute walk.
Brilliant information after we booked from the staff they couldn’t do enough for us.
Would definitely recommend
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great stay
text: Very nice place. Comfortable bed. Washer was very convenient. The door was easy to get into and check in process was easy. We also liked that we could leave our bags after check out. Thanks for a great stay.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Amazing lovely hotel apartment for a weekend
text:
The lovely and friendly staffs + the location of this hotel appartment is great. We enjoyed our stay there. However it would be more wonderful if the room can get a blackout curtains so that we can sleep better to even enjoy the trip more. 

Overal it was great and we definitely would come back here in the future.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Choose this location for a great break!
text:
A perfect location to explore this wonderful location. Spotlessly clean with every conceivable amenity. The staff are amazing.
Always lively, Montmartre comes alive at the weekends. The cafe across the road is great for breakfast, a drink or people-watching.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Brilliant location, fabulous apartment, friendly, helpful staff - great weekend!
text:
We had a lovely room with a view out over the roof tops. The location was perfect - close to Abbesses metro station and a short walk from Place de Chichy metro which meant we had easy access to the Catacombs, the Montparnasse tower (Abbesses) and also the Stade de France ((Clichy) for the big match. Also walking distance from Montmartre which was brilliant.

We went to a great restaurant around the corner Les Tantes Jeannes and had a lovely meal and we enjoyed the street market during the day all weekend. Popped into the bar over the road beneath our window for a couple of late beers after the rugby (they stay open very late!) and the service was excellent.

Alex looked after us extremely well from the minute we arrived until we left - huge thank you Alex! - and we were also helped by the lovely lady in the office.

We highly recommend this apartment and we will return when we can!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: A wonderful trip to Montmartre
text: The position is excellent - right in the heart of Montmartre and a short walk from the cathedral.  The room was amazing - in perfect condition, everything working and a lovely view.  The service was exceptional from check in to the end of the visit.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Topspot in cosy Montmartre
text: We had a lovely stay at Montmartre Residence. Our appartment with 2 bedrooms and a very good sleepingcouch in the livingroom, served us (a family of 5) very well. Although some small maintance has to be done, we enjoyed the luxury and comfort of the place very much. Sitting in the window, in the sun, listening and watching the people on the busy streets of Montmartre was a treat. As were the very nice shops in the neighbourhood. With 2 metrolines nearby, Paris is easely accessable. We will keep this place as our secret...
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Quality apartment in the heart of Montmartre.
text:
Excellent apartment, great location in the heart of Montmartre and a good springboard to the rest of Paris. Close to the Metro and walking distances to much of Paris as well.

It's a lively neighbourhood that never sleeps.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Perfect!
text: The location was very convenient, close to the metro station, shops and cafes.  The views were wonderful.  The apartments are modern, spacious and well equipped.  The staff was pleasant and responsive.  I highly recommend this property.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Absolutely Excellent!
text: Comfortable, the apartment felt like home. The location is unbeatable and easy to access. The locks to the building were secure and the amenities made an extended stay very comfortable. My favorite feature was the bathtub, to be honest. I love unwinding in a nice hot bath after a long day of walking around and it was an excellent experience.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great location, well arranged apartment in heart of Montmartre
text: Everythin about the Residence was appealing, especially the location and light above the streets of Montmartre. One glitch: upon returning from dinner we found the digital keypad to our room frozen. Fortunately we had a card with a late-night number and were able to open the door. Otherwise positive.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Fantastic Week at this Montmartre Studio
text: Perfect location and so close to Abbesses metro.  The studio was VERY well equipped and even had a washer included.  Towels and linens were superb and Elodie was a very special host.  My plan in to return to the studio and the next time, it will be for a month.  I just can’t say enough about this studio and I highly recommend!  You won’t regret it!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Would definitely stay again!
text: Elodie and the entire staff were so welcoming and helpful! From connecting us with transfers from and to the airport, grocery shopping services and hotel recommendations we couldn’t have been more pleased. Elodie even found us a pharmacy for COVID testing so we could enter back into the United States. We also loved the location in Montmartre. Very walkable to shops, cafes and Sacre Coeur.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: December 2021 Visit
text: Residence was clean and cheerful with a modern feel. View from room beautiful. While we did not use the kitchenette very much since our stay was so short, having the option was great. Residence conveniently located near public transportation and neighborhood quite chic and fun to walk around and hang out!
name: Montmartre Residence

title: very comfortable stay great location
text: lovely apartment with everything you need. having a washer/dryer was great next time i come i will pack less clothes the location was fantastic if you’ve hear not to stay in montmartre ignore it this was a wonderful neighborhood with lots of good cafes and restaurants
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Amazing
text: Excellent property, perfect  location at the heart of Mont Martre , and close to all famous places in Paris , apartment was very clean , nicely designed , warm staff as usual ,  we will back again and again
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Excelent!
text: The owner and the staff are excellent and the apartment is gorgeous! The location is close that ererything we needed. We had great days. We really like and recomend ! They have many options for different families.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Great
text:
Great apartment,
super location to explore monmartr,
fair pricing, nice stuff, fully packed kitchen/bathroom, very responsive personal, had good time while be in Paris for 4 days, will definitely consider to book again
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Wonderful apartment & location
text: Montmartre was beautiful! We enjoyed walking everywhere around this area. The food & shops were cute. The Montmartre Residence is a hidden gem, the location was perfect. We stayed in the 2 bedroom & there was a sofa couch in living room. The living room had a door so it felt like a 3 bedroom. Only 1 toilet but had 2 showers. The windows from the living dining kitchen area had great views of the streets below! It was very clean & comfortable. There was free bottle water, Nespresso coffee, hygiene soaps. A washer but no dryer. We would want to stay here again =)
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Quality apartment in the heart of Montmartre.
text: High-quality apartment in the heart of Montmartre, comfortably housing 3 people (double bed and single in our case). All the amenities included in the event that you need it, with a fully decked kitchen.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Very nice apartment in a nice neighborhood
text: Very nice Intereur and design and bathroom and very good service of the staff and the apartment is in a beautiful neighborhood but when you sleep bath than put ear plugs in because in Paris the noice in the street starts early
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Excellent stay in Paris near Montmortre with family
text:
Excellent stay in Paris near Montmortre with family.
I stayed here with 3 families in 2 apartments. One with 2 bedrooms and another with 1 bedroom (with living room & kitchen separately).
Very nice stay, very well furnished apartment and responsive (via whatsapp) host.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Lovely Stay at the Montmartre Residence
text: We had five nights at the Montmartre Residence and found the apartment to be lovely and the staff very helpful. They assisted us with a remote check-in as we arrived close to midnight, helped to point us to where we could convert our US vaccinations for COVID to the French system, and gave many other good recommendations. We will look forward to staying again.

title: Very nice place
text:
We stayed for about a week at the Montmartre Residence, and plan on staying there whenever we visit Paris.  The good thing about traveling today is that the Internet has made commonly accessible excellent lodging alternatives like this one.  

From a pros/cons perspective:

Pros:
- It's superior price and accommodation-wise to hotels that are similar in class, and you don't have the inherent risk associated with an Airbnb type of place.
- You're less insulated from day-to-day Paris life and can get a good feel of what it's like to live in this beautiful City.  
- The immediate area is very nice; the 18th ARR is vibrant, and you're still quite a few blocks north from where things start to get a little funky in the 9th.  
- While you're north of the major tourist spots (a good or bad thing based on one's perspective), they're still quite accessible via the Metro and Uber if you're so inclined. 
- The rooms are very clean and spacious and have a modern, indeed, luxurious feel to them.  
- The appliances are new and work, and all the things you'd need (e.g. utensils, cups, etc.) are provided.
-  It's great to be able to cook and do your own wash.
- The staff is very helpful and nice.

Cons:
-  Though there are washers in the units, there are no dryers, so you have to line dry and plan accordingly. 
- This is not really a con, but if you're a first time visitor to Paris and want a full-fledged concierge and staff to help you out, perhaps you might want to stay here on your second trip.
name: Montmartre Residence

title: Excellent Apartment for Families
text: I’m so glad that I found the Montmartre residence. The apartment was clean, and had everything one would need while traveling especially with young children. Thank you Monmarte we will be back!!

808126822

Overall a beautiful stay and would not hesitate to come back when the situation in Paris improves.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Nice decor, cleanliness not 4* standard
text:
I have to start with a big compliment to the staff of this hotel who were all extraordinarily friendly and helpful at all times, especially the women at the breakfast buffet who made you start your day with a smile! 
We also appreciated the size of our room, which was larger than what we were used to in Paris! 
While the decor and the location of this hotel are also top notch, we were rather disappointed with the cleanliness of our room. For example the mirrors had several stains on them when we arrived and have not been cleaned all the 7 nights we stayed there. The flush buttons for the toilets are chrome and thus your hands leave stains when you press them. Only on two of the 7 nights those stains got wiped off, which let us wonder if the toilet was cleaned at all. The carpet also seemed quite dirty, as well as the coffee table in the room.
One day the person responsible for cleaning has left the lid of the bathroom bin on the counter and took all of our towels (which we indicated didn‘t even have to be changed) away and didn‘t remove our dirty cups. When we complained about the towels and the cups the first time it happened, the receptionist was very friendly and apologetic and assured us that this isn‘t up to their standards and that they will talk to the person responsible for housekeeping that day. Unfortunately however, only the dirty cups got replaced every time after that, but the room didn‘t seem to get cleaned better and there was another day where we were only left with one large towel instead of two... Bummer!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Wonderful from a to z
text:
I spent a lovely weekend at the hotel with my daughter on the occasion of her 12th birthday. The staff could not have been sweeter, kinder, more efficient. Special mention to Manon and Tatiana who went out of their way to make our stay perfect.

The setting was truly magical, taking you back to the era of art deco. Luxury abounds in every nook and corner, From the intimate breakfast room to the Oh so relaxing and cosy salon. And the food... lovely. Best croissants and scrambled eggs. 

Another perk is the access from two to 11 to the buffet area, where you can enjoy a refreshing cold tea, fresh juice, coffee, and so on... Compliments of the house.

PARIS at its best. Will definitely return.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Would stay here over and over again!
text:
This is such a gem! Perfectly located IMO, a short metro ride away from the most popular parts of the city (eiffel tower, champs, etc) but a short walk away from fun nightilfe like Le Chat Noir and Moulin Rouge. We actually waked to Arc du Triomphe our first day, only took about 20 minutes. So many great eateries nearby (DO NOT sleep on Chez Papa-- WOW!) and 2 main Metro stops just around the corner. 

Despite the fact that this is in the formerly-known-as "Red Light District" it's actually a clean area with a younger crowd in terms of nightlife, bars, restaurants etc. You're a good two streets away from the historical sex shops that still stand, but I'd say this is a fine place to stay if you're with your family. The hotel is also literally nextdoor to a police station. There were many nights we were walking back from the Metro or just a walk and never felt unsafe.

As far as the actual hotel room, very ornate with gorgeous walls and bedding. The bathroom was updated and clean, and a decent size by european standards. We loved having the Deluxe room with the balcony and enjoyed croissants outside. 

The continental breakfast was a great way to start our day-- pastries, eggs, meats, cheeses, coffees and juices. I like that they kept coffees and pastries out practically all day for a quick snack as well. 

The staff was incredibly helpful and polite, attentive as well. Overall literally not a thing to complain about here!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great hotel, great location!
text: We stayed at the Maison Nabis for 8 nights in early June, and we could have not been happier with our stay.  The hotel is small and intimate, with lovely decor. When we travel we want to stay somewhere that feels local and not like every other chain hotel, so we appreciate the jewel tones and art nouveau/deco vibe. We stayed in two rooms on the Bordeaux floor. Rooms were perfect size and well-appointed. The rooms were close enough together that I felt comfortable with my two teenagers just across the hall.  Our room faced an inner courtyard and every morning we were greeted by the smell of fresh baked croissants on the breeze. The hotel offers a per fee breakfast which is delicious as well as afternoon tea, which was perfect after a day out and about. We also found several nearby boulangeries and dinner options nearby. Within walking distance to Sacre-Coeur and Galleries Lafayette; and close to two different Metro lines that got us practically everywhere we wanted to go. I can't say enough positive things about Maison Nabis. We will definitely be back.

The charging stations and comfy lounges, plus umbrellas you can borrow from reception were an added bonus! Thanks everyone for a lovely break - we’ll definitely be back!

title: Convenient at its best

name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: A pleasant stay
text: Overall, we had a very enjoyable stay: the staff was friendly (especially Cecile (?) at reception), the hotel a little jewelry box in a great location, the breakfast ample. My only reason for not rating it '5' is the bathroom; while it was clean and spacious, the facilities were quite impractical. (It is probably more of an architectural issue.) The bathtub was built in in a strange way and without any shower curtain, so after every shower, we ended up with a large puddle on the floor. Also, the toilet splashed water out and around at every flush. However, these were minor inconveniences compared to the ambiance and the amenities of the hotel.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: ATROCIOUS CUSTOMER SERVICE
text:
To whom it may concern,

I booked a standard room for 2 people at the Maison Nabis Hotel for 12th October to the 15th October 2018 via Booking.com.  I was deeply saddened and disappointed with my encounter with this hotel.  I had very high expectations and thought this would be a fabulous hotel to stay at for a short and sweet city break.  However, my ‘short and sweet’ city break became extremely stressful due to Maison Nabis Hotel.
We arrived around 11.30pm on Friday 12th October.  After a delayed flight and travelling, we were extremely exhausted and were looking forward to getting a good sleep before kick-starting the next day feeling refreshed.  So we were welcomed at the hotel and given the room key.  After squeezing into a tiny lift (good luck to those with larger suitcases!) we got up to our room on the 3rd floor (Room Number 30).  I have never been so horrified in my life..we opened the door to see a complete mess in the room and in the bathroom!  There were used towels lying everywhere, the windows were wide open, bed undone….it was a complete shock!  We both then dragged our luggage back into this claustrophobic lift to ask the receptionist if maybe she has given us the wrong room key.  She replied saying it is the correct room but she has no other rooms available for us.  Now you can just imagine how furious we were hearing this.  She did not know what to offer us and due to the time of night she advised she cannot contact her manager until the next morning at the earliest.  She reassured me that her manager will phone me first thing in the morning.  After waiting around for 45 minutes in the lobby with our luggage, she offered us a room in one of their sister hotels called Josephine Hotel.  She told us nothing about this hotel apart from the fact that it is about 10 minutes walk from Maison Nabis.  I looked at her and asked if she expected us to walk at almost 12.30am in a city we do not know at all and have just landed with our luggage to a hotel we know nothing about.  This was a huge downfall of Maison Nabis as their customer service was very poor from the get go.  I asked her to at least get us a taxi and for them to pay for it as it is their fault.  She agreed to this and so we waiting 10 minutes until the taxi arrived.  We got to Josephine Hotel which was obviously not our choice…it is a hotel I would never look twice at.  It was situated in a completely dodgy area.  We went up to our room which was multi-coloured and very tight.  The toilet was separate to the shower and sink.  It was just not a pleasant hotel and we were just so disappointed and tired.  We had paid for breakfast for Maison Nabis so we got breakfast at Josephine Hotel.  Breakfast was from 8am to 11am.  We got down around 8.45am.  We had 2 croissants, went up for more and were told they had ran out!  They had no English breakfast tea either!  It was a complete nightmare not being able to have a good sleep, nice hotel or good breakfast.  

On Saturday 13th October, we checked out of Josephine Hotel and got a taxi back to Maison Nabis to see if our room was ready for us.  The receptionist offered us an upgraded room because of the horrific incident that happened the night before.  We checked out the room which was a decent size and CLEAN!  I went for a shower and yes of course ANOTHER PROBLEM!! The shower was broken.  Just when I thought it can’t get any worse.  The shower did not stand up against the wall itself, the hotel staff must have done some basic DIY to keep it up.  However, when taking a shower, you had to hold the shower head above you yourself as it did not have a stand to be able to be positioned correctly.  So, I went to complain and they sent someone up to look at the shower.  The lady who looked at it told me it is broken and there is nothing they can do for me.  I told this to the receptionist who was completely unhelpful and just told me they cannot do anything to fix it and that I am lucky enough to have their upgraded room.  I asked to speak to the manager as she was meant to call me first thing in the morning.  The receptionist said the manager is unavailable until Monday, but I insisted I would like to speak to her as the receptionist from the night before promised I will get a call first thing.  So she called the manager and then said to me I cannot speak to the manager as she is in a meeting and will get back to me.  I thought this is just ridiculous!  So we had to make do with the broken shower.
Monday 15th October, we were checking out.  I asked the receptionist where the manager is as we were leaving Paris and would like to speak to her before we left.  The assistant manager came and was very unhelpful.  All she did was apologise but offered no solution.  She then spoke to her manager as she saw how unhappy we were and that we do not accept just an apology for the major inconvenience.  The manager, Sandra, came out from her room.  At first she kept apologising but I wanted her to offer us some compensation for the inconvenience.  She argued back with me and her own words were ‘other guests would understand and not put in a complaint about our hotel’.  I was furious when she said this.  She expected me to not put in a complaint against Maison Nabis?!  After arguing with her for about 40 minutes, she offered me 50% reimbursement from the first night.  Does she think that is a great gesture!?  Why should we pay a penny at all for the hotel messing up our whole first night, putting us up in another hotel as if they did us any favours and then expecting us to pay towards it?!  She then agreed to 100% reimbursement for the first night.  She would not accept any liability for the shower at all.  I expected a working shower for the money that I paid to stay at that hotel and she offered no gesture of goodwill!  She then said she will look into it and see what she can do.  But she did not commit to anything.  
I do not understand how Sandra is a manager as her customer service skills are atrocious and she is not a decision maker at all.  She was not confident in what she was saying and wasn’t very reassuring.  The hotel is a complete shambles, staff are very unhelpful, manager is questionable.  Avoid this hotel!!!  They still have not been in touch even though she took my phone number and email address saying she will contact me within the next day or so.  It is not Monday 22nd October.  A week later, nothing.  So disappointed and a very bad hotel experience to what was a great city break!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Pleasant and helpful staff
text: The Hotel we were scheduled to stay at was overbooked so they sent us to Maison Nabis.  Tidiane and Cecile were very welcoming. We had just arrived in Paris and needed help determining the best way to go to Versailles the next day.  Tidiane printed out the instructions for the Metro and train connections.  Cecile always greeted us with a smile.  Our room was comfortable and clean and nicely decorated.  Breakfast was delicious with many options.  We were able to walk to many areas of interest and had several lovely meals at nearby restaurants.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Such a beautiful hotel
text: Definitely recommend this hotel I had this trip as a 40th birthday present from my partner and it didn’t disappoint located in a nice quiet street with plenty to do around it lots of restaurants cafes and shops and supermarkets bars etc the hotel in itself was beautifully decorated lovely friendly welcoming staff and lovely breakfast every morning with a friendly cook free tea and coffee alday was a lovely touch when you get back from sightseeing alday . Tubes run near by . really enjoyed our stay here would definitely come back.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Beautiful
text: This hotel is amazing in every way. My boyfriend took me here for my 18th birthday an it was the best weekend of my life. The decor is stylish and consistent throughout and our room was gorgeous! The staff are really friendly and helpful. The breakfast and coffee was lovely. The location is absolutely ideal as it is on a quiet street but is in the heart of Montmartre with the Metro nearby, absolutely loads of restaurants etc and in walking distance to the Sacre Couer which was just wonderful! Anyone who has anything bad to say about the hotel in terms of the rooms or quality should be listened to with a pinch of salt because I have nothing bad to say at all :)
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Happy Stay at Maison Nabis
text: Warm and welcoming small hotel in great location; Friendly helpful staf made it special. .  Excellent restaurants and museums nearby; Quirky decor added to our fun stay..Shortt walk to Montmarte, Opera, Bit longer to Musee d'Orsay, Louvre.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Coziest hotel
text: I booked a night in this hotel and I can definitely say that it fulfilled my expectations in the maximum. Amazing service, I contacted the reception before my arrival to get a specific room colour and they arranged it with no problem. In my arrival the service from the reception was exceptional. The room was beautiful and in general the facility of the hotel travels you in a different world. Beautiful is the least I can say. The breakfast was very nice, huge variety of cold and warm things. One of my best experiences when it comes to hotels in paris!!! Can warmly recommend it 👌🏻
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Four day weekend!
text:
Booked three rooms as we were in Paris for a family wedding!
Location is great, roughly 10mins drive from Gare Du Nord station (Uber was €7) Close to shops, supermarkets and restaurants 
The hotel is beautiful, great ambience and great customer service. The rooms were big enough with a very good size bathroom, shower over bathtub. Very comfortable bed. 
The lift is super small, could hold one person with medium size suitcase in at best, Breakfast is okay, standard, and the same everyday. They provide juice/water/hot drinks throughout the day downstairs which is a bonus. 
All in all a very pleasant and comfortable stay! Would def recommend!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great spot for couples, friendly staff in a good location.
text: Me and my wife really enjoyed our stay here, we emailed in advance to try and secure a balcony view as they only have 2, and they were kind enough to arrange this for us if we let them know the day before which I did. Of course that view is subject to availibitiy but as we stayed from Sunday to Wednesday it may have been easier reserve the room for us for that night. When we first arrived the staff member on hand was a very polite gentleman who made sure to give us all the details and send us to our room. The decor was great in our room, we even took some great photos on the stairs and balcony and I loved the marble Fooseball table downstairs. The room itself was small but big enough and had good lighting and of course a great little balcony where you could drink tea and snack at night. The mini fridge had a water bottle which they didn’t charge for but it would have been nice to have a few more complimentary cans of 7up or something lolThe staff were all every friendly and polite and easy to talk too. Special note for Cecile who was not only extremely helpful but was thoughtful enough to wish us an Eid Mubarak, this was a really important gesture for us as walking down the streets of Paris in Islamic Eid garments meant we got a few stares but nothing we weren’t used too living in the UK, but it made all the difference to know Simone payed enough attention to wish us a happy Eid. It made us value the place and staff more. In terms of local food, there were a few local groceries, lots of easy to access shops on the main road including some Halal stores. The metro was also walking distance. It take approximately 25 minutes to get to the Eifal Tower via metro. Breakfast: This was the only thing we would have liked to be better, options were a little minimal for us, it would have been nice if there was a little more variety or vegetarian options. But there was enough to get us going.Overall a great experience, brilliant staff including Emily who was also very helpful on the night we left around 4am.I would definitely recommend this place to couples or anyone wanting a nice location with easy transport.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Perfect location
text: This is our second stay here, we enjoyed it so much in 2016 we came back. Location is close enough to walk to most places, metro is 5 minutes away for those who don’t want to walk,Hotel is typically French, nothing is a problem & staff are very friendly.We had a few issues with the room, but all were sorted quickly.Only negative is the breakfast area is a bit small, but the breakfast itself has plenty of choice & again nothing is to much trouble for the staff.Will be back again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Beautiful and romantic
text: Recently stayed here for a few days for my partners birthday. The hotel its self is gorgeous, the decor is incredible and I can't fault a thing. I requested the room with a balcony before I came which we were given and it really was special. Breakfast was impressive considering the size of the hotel, there were hot and cold options, everything was very tasty and there were lots of little touches. It is a small hotel with small rooms but that's all part of the charm, I would definitely recommend to anyone but this hotel is perfect for couples!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Average
text: Stayed in July 2018 for 1 week. Great location and close to restaurants and The Métro. Staff is friendly, but rooms were rather small. We stayed in one of the deluxe rooms, which seemed not to vary in size very much from a standard room. Not really worth the extra money. If they give you room 56 don't forget to put the lid down on the toilet when you flush, as the water from the bowl will spray all over the floor :). I don't think there is actually anything wrong with the toilet, that is just how it flushses. Breakfast room was very crowded and it was often hard to find a free table. The quality of the food was good, and  plenty of choices. Overall seemed more like a 3 star hotel, than 4 stars.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Experience
text:
My trip started so well but ended up messy!
Some members of the staff were kind and professionnal,others just lacked professionnalism. I checked out and went to run some errands leaving my luggage @storage.I got back to collect them just for me to realize my hand luggage (I spare you the details of all I had in) had been given to another client. The manager was just Zen telling me I will have it sent in my home country. We,  a friend and I had to look for solutions and boost the manager up. Thank God she was there to assist cuz I almost collapsed. 
  The man who had mistakenly taken the trolley was honest. He was already about to cross to London with Eurostar. What shocked me the most is the manager asking " Do you want to sleep somewhere nearby the hotel waiting for trolley?" Like giving a complimentary night wasn't the least she could do! Like I even cared about a free night! Matter of fact I cancelled my last night @hotel cuz I wanted to spend it w my family. 
  I paid my bill two days before checkout and I regret tipping them especially after I asked why they charged my card for an additional amount and they still haven't given me any explanations.
  Finally my box was brought back to me at 2 a.m @ my location.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Highly recommendable!
text:
We stayed here in June 2018 for a weekend stay. We found the location great, close to metro stations & we even walked from the centre once & it was fine. The room was compact but ideal and the bed very comfortable. No issues with external noise. All the staff were great and they speak many languages. Having stayed here we would definitely repeat if we go back to Paris! 

If you opt out of the daily cleaning service you can get a glass of champagne ;)
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Charming, elegant and arty.
text: Stayed for one night at Maison Nabis. The hotel itself is beautiful, stunning decor and wonderfully charming. The room was fantastic, requested a balcony room which was kindly granted. I would definitely recommend this hotel for anyone who is considering staying in Paris.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Good for brief business stay
text:
Although a small hotel and the room I stayed in was small, it had everything I needed, the bed was comfortable, good shower, great friendly staff, nice basic buffet breakfast and very clean and tidy. I was only staying for one night and really only needed a room to sleep in so it was perfect for my stay. The local area is lively, with plenty to see and do yet the hotel is quiet. 
I also noticed i'd lost my expensive earphones when I returned to the UK but the hotel had found them and returned without issue. Will definitely use the hotel again for future trips as one of the best hotels in that price I have stayed in Paris.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: One night in Paris
text: We stayed in this hotel for one night. Everything was great. Excellent location, cozy room and of course it is necessary  to note excellent service. We had a great time and highly recommend this hotel for everyone.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: hotel with a strong personality
text:
very nice hotel, cool and warm in the lobby as well in the room. Clean room and comfortable bed; bathroom could be better 
Receptionist nice and welcoming, smiling and professional. I truly enjoyed the open bar with sundried fruits, juice, lemon water and free coffee/tea.
I reccomand it!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Fairly disappointing, avoid room 1
text:
First the positives - all the staff on reception were very welcoming and friendly, we arrived early (around 9am) and were immediately given our room (number 1 on the ground floor). The hotel, in general, is well-presented and also in a great location. 

However, I can't rate it any higher due to the following:

As mentioned, we were given room 1 on the ground floor. I assume this is an accessible room as the bathroom was a wet room (with a hand held shower, very annoying). There was also almost no toilet paper left.

The room itself was small and was directly opposite the atrium, affording little by way of privacy. 

There are no tea/coffee making facilities (despite mention of Nespresso machines in all rooms in their literature). 

Both nights, our sleep was interrupted by the noise from reception which is about 3 metres from the room door and even closer to the elevator which you can hear like an earthquake everytime it went up and down.

The air conditioning was also locked to a central system meaning the room was ridiculously hot and temperature could not be adjusted. I mentioned this to reception after the first night and they said they would sort it but this did not happen. I can't understand why the system needs to be set up like this.

All in all, we were disappointed in the overall experience which could be much improved just by paying attention to the little details, something which you would expect from a supposed 4-star hotel.
