In hindsight, I probably should have requested another room but as we were only staying 2 nights and were only there to sleep, I thought it would be ok.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great, good location
text: Nice and clean hotel near metro, good restaurants, Clichy and more. We really enjoyed our stay. Helpful staff. Would stay again. 30 min from Orly Airport. Free wifi. Amazing bathroom. Small refrigerator. Good ac. Wonderful bed.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Outstanding
text: What more can I say the hotel was absolutely perfect, the staff were all friendly and went above and beyond to help us. The hotel is beautiful with amazing decor and all mod cons in the bedrooms. The location was brilliant about a 5 -10 minute walk to the Moulin Rouge depending on how fast you walk. Excellent restaurants nearby, and the metro 5 minutes away. What more can I say thank you Maison Narbis for a fabulous stay. The only suggestion I could make would be tea & coffee facilities in the rooms.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Very nice hotel
text: Very welcoming service. Very clean room. The breakfast was very good too. Your hotel made our trip to Paris the best so far. I can highly recomend this hotel to my friends. Next time I travel to Paris I will stay again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great hotel ! Great location! Friendly staff!
text:
If you are looking for affordable quality hotel in a fabulous location in Paris ... Stay here!
It’s perfect if you are travelling into Gare de Nord station.. so easy.. the people who work in the hotel are friendly ... helpful and so welcoming. The area feels very safe and there are lots of restaurant and bars close by to walk to. The hotel is super clean .. good size room .. we stayed in room 24 which even had a little balcony!! Good size bathroom with a very generous shower! Totally recommend this lovely hotel ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: very nice hotel
text: Kind Personal, clean rooms nice looks just perfect! The Perfect Hotel when you want to explore Paris. Top Location Close to almost every Monument. Metro is also Close by. The Bathroom and Rooms where realy clean every day!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Amazing hotel
text:
My husband and i stayed here for one night on our train trip through Europe, we were so pleased we found this gem in the heart of Paris.
Very friendly and helpful staff, clean and comfortable room, good sized shower room with thick towels and also a good breakfast sat in the small atrium with the sun shining on us, what more could anyone wish for?
It is furnished in Art Deco style which i absolutely love so this was a winner for me and will ensure we return when again traveling through France.
Thank you for a comfortable stay.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Affordable luxury; perfect for couples
text: We stayed in the Maison Nabis in mid-December 2017 and were very impressed. I fell in love with the look of the rooms online, scored a great price and requested a specific room via Facebook. They were kind enough to oblige and I wasn't disappointed in person. The rooms are as clean and luxurious as they are in photos. The hotel is perfectly located being around the corner from a mini supermarket and 6-minute walk to two different metro stations, which can take you straight to most of the main attractions. It's also a 15-minute walk to the beautiful Montmartre district. The highlight of Maison Nabis is certainly the warm and attentive staff, while the only minor criticism would be the tiny, slow elevator.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Perfect Honeymoon Getaway
text:
I would like to start my review on one note, I am an American taking my first trip to Europe with my wife (who has traveled the world extensively) on our honeymoon so i had no idea what to expect traveling to Paris.
The clerks and staff at Hotel Maison Nabis truly astounded me with their kindness and warm smiles and welcoming attitudes, even by standards held my many other hotels I've been to.
They were considerate, welcoming, and always found a way to accommodate you at the latest of hours.
The only slight downside I must disclose is that the elevator was broken down several time during our visit, but even then the hotel staff was more than willing to help us with whatever luggage and needs we had to get to out floor.
I would like to say a special THANK YOU to Helene Rougvine-Baville for you warm smile and help with printing our Disneyland tickets.
The hotel is perfectly located to get you to some of the best and most interesting districts in Paris, and is very close to alot of great cafes and eateries.
Thank you for a honeymoon my wife and I will never forget, and I promise we will be back!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Lovely hotel
text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights. We loved the decor and atmosphere of the hotel. The breakfast was well presented and enjoyable. The location is great  - only a short walk to lots of attractions. All of the staff were pleasant and very helpful too - when we return to Paris we will make this our 'go to' hotel.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Overnight in Paris
text: Fantastic reception at la maison nabis. We arrived late pm. Welcome by night staff who settled us in straight away and made sure we were happy. Felt totaly special. Fab room. Breakfast fresh and easy going. Left luggage for day. Left relaxed after great day exploring area. Good metro connections if wanted to move further.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Perfect!
text:
Maison Nabis was absolutely perfect. Everyone went above and beyond to welcome me, help me and make sure my time in Paris was everything I could ever want. They made this adorable hotel feel like home. The metro is just a short walk away if you are going to locations that are a bit further away, but the location was wonderful and I walked to many of the places I wanted to go. 

I could go on and on about how beautiful the room was, the comfortable bed, the incredible shower.. However, it was truly the staff at the hotel that made the stay so lovely.

Hélène, Cécile and the entire staff made sure my birthday trip was more than I could have dreamed of. I hope to visit again very soon!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Perfect Stay
text:
What can I say? Amazing stay, fantastic staff, and what a decor! 

The room was incredible, we were fortunate to have the only room with a small balcony wide enough to sit opposite each other and enjoy a glass of wine.

Service was fantastic, location was great and only a short walk from the metro which was perfect for going sightseeing, no more than 5-10 minute wander. 

The only query we had was trying to work out how to cool the room down, which you have request the air con facility to be switched on at reception before you can use the programmer in your room. 

The meal included in the trip was s continental breakfast with a selection of meat, cheese, bread and pastries.

Regarding the staff, the service was faultless, they did everything possible to ensure our stay was perfect and were extremely helpful with sightseeing and travel advice.

We will most definitely be going back, I would highly recommend.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: I’d vote 10* if I could!
text:
My friends and I stayed here for 2 nights in March and we could not have had a more pleasant experience at Maison Nabis! The exceptional staff, the hotel’s luxurious decor, the perfect location- close to many lovely cafés, and quite central! 

Our room was spotless, well sized and beautiful. All members of staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, Abdul was outstanding and is a true asset to the hotel. The ladies at breakfast (I believe Charlotte was one of them) were so cheerful and smiley, and the manager Helene was very kind and helpful! 

Everybody who works at Maison Nabis truly made our trip memorable. I will definitely be staying at this hotel in the future, whenever I visit Paris, I highly recommend a stay here! 

Thanks for a wonderful visit! 
Kitty
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Luxury - value for money
text: Great hotel, luxurious, great value for money, friendly staff, excellent service. Great recommendation for lunch just around the corner from the hotel. Stunning room, beautiful bathroom. We loved our stay!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Luxury Boutique hotel
text: This cosy, bijou hotel has been recently refurbished and features velvets and brocades in jewel colours. Our room was a decent size, very clean, with a comfortable super-king bed with quality bedding.Double glazing and thick curtains ensured a good night's sleep. The bathroom was as expected, and we took advantage of their 'green' offer for a free glass of champagne in place of daily housekeeping. The continental breakfast was freshly prepared, although the dining area was a tight squeeze on occasions. The staff were friendly and helpful at all times. The location is a quiet street between Pigalle and Gallery Lafayette, with Metro and St Lazare stations within easy walking distance. We would definitely stay here again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Nice deco and good situation
text:
I really enjoyed the hotel. I liked the touch in the deco of the lobby and of the room.

the staff is very friendly and helpful. I especially liked the cheerful lady in charge of the breakfast :) It is nice to start the day on a positive note.

Location is nice as well, subway close by and all you need in the small shops around. With Cinema's around, unfortunately the range of restaurants is not too big, but about 50m away you can eat organic food, sushi, oriental,...
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Friendly hotel
text: Lovely, friendly staff. Concierge Antonio was very helpful (thanks for the tip about the Trocadero!). Hotels Art Deco decor was welcoming and cosy. Room was clean and beds very comfortable. Asked for twin beds and this was provided. Would stay again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Really friendly staff, really nicely decorated hotel. Free tea and coffee. 2 glasses of champagne in lieu of room servicing. Free luggage room, we even checked in at 9:30 am as we arrived early and the room was ready. Can't fault anything. Would stay again. Very comfortable.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Aniversare
text: Very nice , great staff at hotel , clean room , very good breakfast. Locație liniștită , usor de ajuns la punctele de atracție , foarte usor de ajuns la aeroport Charles de gaulle . Rer B si apoi metrou M2.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Nice stay!
text: We had a 6 night stay. Joyfull  and personal interior, perfectly tidy room, good bed, spacey bathroom and friendly staff. Location is good. Atmosphere is peaceful. Wifi could be faster. Absolytely worth the money!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Art deco style chic hotel with great location
text: very lovely hotel with lovely staff and beautiful rooms. great location for a city break. the breakfast was lovely and very continental. the deluxe room was spacious and nice view out onto the french street outside. the Manager Helene was fantastic at our arrival and was very helpful and made us feel very welcome for our first visit to Paris.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Excellent Stay in the heart of Paris
text: We stayed at this hotel for 9 nights over the holiday period and had a great time. This hotel is in a great, quiet location. It's close to various metro lines and walking in central Paris is easy from here. It's only a 10 minute walk to Montmartre and there are lots of great little bakeries around the corner.  This hotel has been renovated and is in really nice condition.  The rooms are very clean, quiet and the staff is great.  We have stayed for years across the street at Le Grey Hotel and our most recent visit we decided to try something new across the street.  The rooms are spacious (depending on which room you pick) and the bathrooms are modern (the shower is GREAT)! If you opt for the breakfast option, it's great and includes everything you need. I would definitely stay here again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Lovely boutique Hotel near the Moulin Rouge
text:
We had a 3 night stay in the hotel- it’s in quiet street 5 minutes from the Moulin Rouge. 
The room was on the small size - it had lovely decor as did the bathroom- the only negative was the carpet - it was a cream colour which had a few stains on it - cream carpet and hotel rooms not always a wise choice. 
The breakfast was in our rate - but it was just a standard continental breakfast nothing to sing about. 
On entering the hotel you can see that it is a bit different- the reception area is striking - it’s a shame it is a bit dark
Having said all that I would stay there again - we had a good deal so can’t fault what we paid
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Unique decor, basic breakfast, fab location
text:
We found it easy to get around Paris from this hotel by using a 3 day metro pass that was in a card style a bit like an Oyster card that you scan at all of the stations. We arrived really late at night and we were pleased to see someone waiting for us. Positives would be the decoration, free coffee / tea / hot choc in reception & breakfast was adequate for a few days but nothing too fancy.
We had an issue with a slight smell in the bathroom when we checked in but it was easily resolved by running some water. Perhaps the room hadn't been used for a while. We stayed for 4 nights and after night 1 all was fine! I would definitely recommend the hotel as the beds were comfortable, the hotel was quiet and in a great location.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Excellent two-night stay
text: My wife and I enjoyed our stay here.  The location made it easy to catch the public transportation, find good restaurants (especially the nearby pastry store - turn right outside the front door, turn right at the corner and its on the left about two blocks).  The front desk was always very helpful with information and tips to help us find our way.  Refreshments in the lobby was a nice touch.  Our room was great.  Overlooked the cute street below.   We kept our windows open because the weather was she decor was a little bold for my taste, but that's me.  We'd stay here again.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Good hotel
text: Very good hotel. From the hotel there is a close metro station and a bus stop for traveling around the city. Near the hotel there is a big Auchan shop. Also near the hotel is a bakery, Chinese snack bar, grocery stores. Paris Opera and Palais Royal can be reached on foot in 30-40 minutes. Near the hotel there is the Moulin Rouge .
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Amazing Little Hotel
text: Great Staff, Great Room, Lovely Atmosphere, Good Location! 👍 Close to metro stations and Close to some good restaurants. Also walkable distance to Moulin Rouge! Staff are alway helpful and ready to help you out!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Perfect
text: Staff are friendly, great English, very nice. The decor is amazing perfect for a couples romantic break! Music in the bar/lobby area is great nice jazz feel to it. We had the breakfast. It was perfect for us, meats/cheeses/fresh croissants/cereal/scrambled egg etc. Drinks are cheap in the bar too and location is great close to hustle and bustle but quiet. Get Uber’s easy when your feet are shattered!!!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great location, poor breakfast
text: Great staff, very small and cosy hotel in a good location for the price. Not very happy with the breakfast, for additional fee on top of accommodation its quite poor selection and same every day. Not enough fruits, absolutely no vegetables but 3 different options of cereal :) Overall not bad at all but wouldn't recommend paying extra for breakfast.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Mr Skudny Evgeny
text: Very good breakfast, wonderful attitude of all personal, especcially Antoine, he made our journey much better! Good comfortable rooms, calm, the design of hotel is great! And good location, nice price. Its a pity that we couldnt get for degustations, maybe possible to make another time for it)
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Lovely hotel, great location, enjoyable stay!
text:
We took a mother-daughter trip to Paris stayed at this hotel for 8 nights. Save for a small snag at check-in (they gave us keys to a room that was already occupied!), the stay was smooth and comfortable. All of the staff members were super friendly and very helpful — we were given free champagne to compensate for the hiccup during check in, which was a nice touch. (Thank you, Antoine!). We didn't partake in the hotel's breakfast, so I can't comment on its value. The hotel staff speak English, so don't fret if your French isn't up to par. 

Our room was nice and clean and the decor is fun and chic. I was warned that hotel rooms are small in Paris — I found our room to be more than comfortable for two, despite its coziness. The cleaning service left our room spic and span each day. The rooms have several USB ports built into the walls which is SO convenient for charging your phones and other devices! If you happen to forget your travel adapter, you won't be stuck. Hotel had free wifi...at times the connection was super slow, but overall it suited our needs. The bathroom was nice and big, very clean. The AC in the room was great — whisper quiet and the room was always at a comfortable temperature. The hotel has a tiny, but functional elevator. It's small and rather slow, but it definitely works in case taking the stairs is a concern for you. Hotel offers pocket wifi for 3 euros a day which comes in very handy when you're out and roaming the streets of Paris! They also have umbrellas for you to borrow, free of charge. There were no items in our mini bar...this wasn't an issue for us, but it might be for others, so be warned. 

The hotel is in a GREAT location. The 9th arrondissement is a fun area of Paris with lots to do and Rue de Parme is a small, extremely quiet street. The hotel is right next door to a police station and we felt very safe there. It's a great spot if you're travelling solo. Despite the quiet street, you are only minutes away from all you could possibly need: there are a number of great bakeries and cafes within a three to five-minute walk and a bit further up the street there are several creperies, a McDonald's, a Starbucks, and KFC if fast food is your thing. Rue de Clichy is lined with several small grocery stores where you can get toiletries, fresh fruits, cheeses, wine and other goodies if you're looking for modest eats or forgot an important item for your trip. There are a few banks nearby as well as a handful of pharmacies if you need. The hotel is a short walk to either Liège or Place de Clichy metro stations and from there you are no more than 20 minutes away from most major attractions/locations: Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Musée D'Orsay, Palais Garnier, Moulin Rouge, and much more. If you like to shop, Galeries Lafayette is about a 15 minute walk from the hotel, and this area is also a great hub to catch a bus tour as well. The hotel is near to the hustle and bustle, but not right in the middle of it, which is nice. 

Overall, our stay was lovely and I would definitely choose this hotel again. Thank you so much for a wonderful stay in Paris!
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Amazing Experience
text:
The hotel is located in a quiet street, but close to two metro stations, shops and restaurants. It is also within walking distance from most Parisian landmarks. The hotel is small and intimate, and you will be dazzled by its lavish blue and gold decor. I stayed in a room on the top floor, so it was a bit small but very nicely furnished with a big comfortable bed and modern bathroom.

The check-in was quick and efficient, and the staff extremely friendly and helpful. Wifi was free and working well and there was a very big TV. Breakfast was good it had cereals, fresh juice, coffee, yoghurt and lots of bread and croissants.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Nice hotel in a quiet street in Paris
text: We stayed at the hotel for one night in October and we booked through Secret Escapes. The hotel is located in a quiet street, but close to two metro stations, shops and restaurants. It is also at walking distance from most Paris landmarks. The hotel is small and pretty, with stylish decor. The check in was quick and the staff is friendly. The room was nice, clean and quiet. Wifi was free and working well and there was a very big TV. There were no tea/coffee making facilities, but this was my first trip to Paris in a long time, so I am not sure what the standards are. Also, the minibar only had a bottle of still and one of sparkly water and nothing else, but these were complimentary, which was nice. Our package also included a complimentary galls of champagne. Breakfast was good but a bit crammed, as the breakfast room is very small and not well organised. All together I would recommend this hotel in Paris.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Fantastic hotel with exceptional service
text: We stayed at the Maison Nabis for 1 night in September. Their service was brilliant and we were checked in immediately on arrival. We had booked the room via Secret Escapes and it was all really smooth on check in. They have a happy hour where they provide free coffee / nuts and this was a lovely touch. We would highly recommend this hotel.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Great location and fantastic staff. Made our trip 10x better!
text:
Just got back from a two night stay at the Masion Nabis with my missus and I only have positive things to say.

From the moment we arrived (a few hours earlier than the check-in time) we were greeted by the wonderful manager Helen. Helen was kind, humorous and managed to give us a spacious deluxe room with a balcony, all whilst training a new member of staff. Whenever Helen wasn't around another helpful member of staff (Antoine?) took her place. 

They helped us with maps, directions and even wine openers when we ran down to the reception during the late hours of the night. The hotel is in a great location (few mins walk to Liege and Place de Clichy metro stations) and next door to a Police station if you feel unsafe for any reason!

Everyone also spoke good English so I'm a little confused by a previous review claiming otherwise. 

Thanks for the amazing service, we look forward to coming back! 

Victor and Alysia.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Good choice for staying in Paris
text:
Good choice for staying in Paris

good hotel service

good breakfast

good wifi - and for free

close to shooping malls: Lafayette, Paris Spring

close to Montmartre Hill   

close to Champs Elysees Avenue

taxi reservation service
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Small boutique hotel in a lovely Paris street
text:
The Maison Nabis by HappyCulture is a typical small Parisien hotel - complete with one of those weird elevator door set-ups you only really find in continental Europe. Check-in experience was great, as was the hotel's pocket wifi (available for a small charge). 

Rooms are kinda small but very nicely furnished. I had one of the front facing rooms which I'd highly recommend to make you feel like you're actually living in Paris. The little street this hotel is in is exquisite, with a boulangerie and patisserie at one end as well as a selection of restaurants. I wouldn't expect any problems as the police station is right next door! The breakfast room was also tiny and the selection not comprehensive, but you could always eat out nearby if this become an issue. 

If you don't fancy being on or near the Champs Elysées where you'll eat overpriced rubbish food, this is the place for you.
name: Maison Nabis by HappyCulture

title: Magical stay. Perfect girls weekend
text:
We were looking for somewhere special and exclusive to spend a girl's weekend in Paris, and the Royal Madeleine was just perfect! The design and level of service was astounding and we were treated from prior to our arrival up to the end of the stay. Our favorite spot was the Spa, where we were able to relax and go for a swim. The service was excellent, best place to spend time in Paris.
Definitely coming back
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Weeks Stay In Paris
text: Very warm welcome, friendly staff offered a coffee as room wasnt ready on arrival. Our room was on 6th foor with a lovely balcony which we had booked. Room was clean, a little on the small side but sufficient. The restaurant and bar were closed on our visit which was a shame, although they were still serving breakfast, we had that else where. My only negative is the room service was not done until very late in the day at which point we had usually returned to the room, also the toiletries were not renewed unless i actually asked. Also i had to ask for coffee etc for the room as that wasnt renewed on service. Loved the balcony. Staff always welcomed you into and exiting. Swimming pool was very busy so difficult to book to use although they tried to fit you in, so only visited the pool once, nice but slightly noisey with thalasso therapy fountain running most of the time we were in there as children in the pool at the time. Only three chairs which had towels on!!! So went back to room balcony for rest. Mini bar in room did not have a price chart so wasnt sure if was free, so assked reception to be told it was chargeable, It was not a fridge as all items were not cold inside sadly, fridge needs attention. Hotel is in excellet place near to main shopping area and close to metro station. Would defo stay again, nice friendly hotel.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Level of service not as indicated by four stars
text:
A concerning lack of willingness to make an effort when you need assistance. The level of service doesn't match the level of price. Overpriced.

Location in the city + condition of room + possible to cancel the reservation close upon arrival = good. But....

Repeatedly underperforming four star service level. First they wanted to charge us for the breakfast we couldn't eat one day due to early excursion, even though they in advance promised to be of assistance but perhaps not a complete breakfast. We had nothing instead and the people working breakfast, besides beeing rude, were not informed by their colleague making the promise. Complete lack of routine. On a daily basis they failed with simple things like the number of towels in the room. Four out of five days we had to pay a visit to the reception asking for towels. 

And no, we won't use the 15 % discount coupon we got for the next visit. The only "compensation" we received even though we had to speak to the manager on several occasions.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Paris trip with Amy
text: Really good hotel. Great staff. Great location. The bar etc is being refurbished, so no real drinks or snacks. Everything to a high standard. Rooms are very clean and tastefully decorated with a very classy  feel. I would definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Such a charming property!
text: The hotel is well appointed and well designed.  Despite having a very small room (which is to be expected in Paris) I was very comfortable.  A couple of attributes stand out- the first of which is the design, every space is well curated and beautiful.  The second is the cleanliness.  Every inch was well maintained and very clean.  I will absolutely choose this hotel on my next visit.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great little hotel
text: Very much enjoyed my stay from start to finish. The staff were excellent and could not do enough for us. The room was cosy (as they are in Paris), stylishly decorated and with a great bathroom. The little spa area was a huge bonus and a great place to relax after sightseeing. We tried the bar but they said they were closing even though that was not advertised hours. We later saw they were open so not sure what happened there but it didn’t matter much. Very centrally located and close to a metro to travel the city. We are two friends who love Paris and will very likely to return to this hotel for our next trip.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Experience of the hotel
text: Terrible service from the staff, they were incredibly rude and unprofessional. Most did not speak English and were unable to communicate with guests (only two members of staff were helpful). We asked for extra towels and the staff refused to give it to us. The elevator stopped working and guests on all floors had to use the stairs. They did not have a concierge service and did not help with booking restaurants, events or even PCR tests. The rooms are very small with no room to walk around, there was not even a mirror in the room. The TV options were terrible and did not have basic TV access.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Cosy hotel
text:
Good value for money. Had a nice stay at the hotel, in a cosy room. 
A restaurant has been mentioned on the hotel website but apparently not available, only a bar was open with limited choice of small appetizers.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Lovely hotel with a gorgeous pool
text: This is a comfortable hotel. I think for the price they could be more generous with the room facilities - we needed more nespresso pods, towels, sewing kit, drinking water etc - and the room we stayed in was very small. The pool is gorgeous though and the staff are nice. I would stay again for the pool and staff!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Wonderful hotel and staff
text: Four of us spent two nights at this beautiful hotel which is perfectly situated for tourists. The rooms were beautiful,  the swimming pool stunning and the staff couldn't have been more welcoming or helpful. All four of us agreed we would definitely return.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Peaceful and tasteful oasis in the heart of Paris
text: We stayed at this hotel for 5 nights as a family. The duplex room is beautifully decorated, quiet and perfect for 2 kids and 2 adults. We loved the little pool, the central location next to dozens of great restaurants with a number of public transport options. The service was impeccable, and Pamela at the front desk deserves a special mention: she was extremely warm, knowledgeable and helped us with restaurant recommendations and transfers.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Super location
text: Cozy hotel with perfect location for a city trip, spacious room for Paris, short walk to metro, nice restaurants nearby, good bar for a late drink and a warm swimming pool to relax after long days. We will come back again.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: A wonderful stay!!!
text: The hotel was just as beautiful in real life as it is in photos. The staff was super friendly and helpful the entire time! They definitely went above and beyond for my satisfaction. The pool was a dream and I would definitely stay again!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Wish we stayed longer
text:
We booked this hotel last minute after a disaster Airbnb booking. I wished we stayed here longer. 

We stayed at the Cocolili Suite, all the staff were wonderful, the kids love the welcome cookies! Thank you for the sweet gesture. We are a family of 4 and there was ample space  for all of us. The location is great, on a quiet street. We slept great as the beds were comfortable. This suite is directly below the bar of the hotel, but they have good sound insulation so there’s very minimal noise if ever. We love the pool and sauna. Not common for hotels in the area to have pool. 

Something I’m impressed about - they take their guest health safety seriously. You have to pick a time slot for their breakfast buffet to make sure there’s no overcrowding. Also when you want to use the pool, you have to pick a time slot. Not convenient for sure  but I felt more safe as my kids can’t get vaccinated yet. 

The buffet was good, a typical Parisian breakfast. We enjoyed specially the fresh warm croissant.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Excellent choice
text:
Excellent staff, location and services. I really enjoyed the time with my son. 
There are only 7 minutes walk by Opera in Paris and Lafayette Galleries. 
There are the main metro lines around, so easy to access any location and sightseeing.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Nursel pickett
text: Excellent staff, great service. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. I geniunely enjoyed my stay in this hotel. We arranged a surprised baby shower in our room. Receptionists and other employees helped us to make it perfect and a memorable one. The duplex room was also beautiful. The location was perfect, close to many shops. I highly recommend this hotel to everyone.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Pretty maybe, but management stole $3,000 from me. Be warned!
text: This hotel stole over $3,000 from me during the chaos of the inital COVID lockdowns.  I made a reservation on-line in March the day before Macron announced a lock-down in Paris, I then canceled on learning of that lock-down, literally within 24 hours of making the original reservation. The hotel took my money and wouldn't give it back, nor, unbelievably, would they give me a credit or voucher for a future stay.  In my world, that is called stealing.  AMEX was of no help whatsoever in disputing the charge.  Don't trust the management of this hotel.  Decor maybe pretty, but management's behavior is ugly.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Typically Parisian
text:
Pretty much standard for a boutique hotel in Paris.
Rooms on the small size but nicely decorated.  Bathroom was well appointed.
Nice towels and comfy bed. As usual next to no draws or gaming space.  Great location for exploring.
Bar is a big of s strange place.
Staff a bit dopey.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: AVOID AT ALL "€1,500" COST !!!
text:
Having booked our holiday to Paris for Christmas back in June 2019, a lot of research and time went into this trip and it's surrounding venues,
Truly I can't comment about the hotel nor facilities although it all looked very nice as we never made it there.
BUT, having continually asked the hotel for there Christmas lunch menu which was delayed with every excuse possible and never materialised.  We received an email the following day after the cut off date of the cancellation of any food being served at all and there wasn't a cancellation option now available to us. The hotel did recommended 4 places, all of which we contacted due to the lack of confidence withe this hotel, and were closed for Christmas!!??
No help there then at all.

This hotel deliberately manipulated the situation to accommodate themselves, making every effort to advise parties past the calculation date to ensure they benefited financially of all our €1.500. There was now regret nor empathy for the stress and frustration they had caused with VERY little help or support in accommodating our special Christmas Holiday.
As a hotel managers business ethics go, they should be ashamed of how they are permitted to continue serving the public yet alone still be advertising lunch on Christmas day. 
Not one to keep quiet, we contacted our agents "booking.com" I can not Express how helpful they were in seeing the situation that we were left in. It was confirmed that this hotel was breaching contract in still advertising lunch knowing full well there was none on that day. Our agent also could see our numerous communication with the hotel cashing a menu for months to no avail. 
We did finally get a cancellation confirmation with no charges incurred thanks to our perseverance, but with no apology nor regret of any kind knowing that this hotel had failed trying so hard to ruin our holiday, we were certainly not going to give them the satisfaction of our time nor money then or the near future. 
We did manage to find another hotel and lunch within the same location and continued our well deserved brake.

Paris is a wonderful place to visit during this holiday season and we are looking to return trip next year. It's a shame that there are people in the hotel industry that will give there place of business and country such a bad reputation that will tarnish any future custom there, TripAdvisor offers some guidance and warnings of establishments that you should be aware of, withered it be good or bad. For us it was the latter with this hotel, after all that said we proved that nothing can stop you having a wonderful trip once you set your mind on it.

Felix Sabbara
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Nice and comfy
text:
Great place - well located - awesome little spa - in the middle of the center

Very cute bar coming with the hotel. The staff is friendly and creative. It's def worth a try

They offer some tea time to the guests after checkin. The restaurant located next door (La cave des vins) should also be visited.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: GREAT place to stay in Paris!
text:
My family and I (2 adults and 2 children - 5 and 7 yrs old) stayed at the Royal Madeleine between Christmas and New Year's for 5 days.  We couldn't have been happier with our hotel choice.  We were on the top floor and our room had 2 levels - a cozy living room with a sofa bed and bathroom on the entry level floor, and a spacious bedroom on the upper level.  All in all pretty spacious for Paris standards and with a gorgeous modern-french design. The place was awesome and location was even better.  Walking distance to LOTS of sight-seeing spots and centrally located with easy access to every other part of Paris.  

But the BEST thing about this hotel was the service. The staff at the reception went out of their way to make our visit top notch -  special mention to Alvaro, who always had a great attitude and helpful suggestions.  I mistakenly forgot my backpack when I left the hotel (and France), and Alvaro was super helpful and went out of his way to help me recover my backpack and all the belongings inside.  

Without a question will be staying at the Royal Madeleine the next time I'm in Paris!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great hotel - spacious rooms for Paris!
text:
I stay at this hotel everytime I am in Paris for work. It is a great hotel with an amazing breakfast, "spacious" rooms in comparison with other Paris hotels, and in a great location. 

If you are looking for a hotel that will deliver consistent service, definitely check this one out!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Never experienced this kind of service...
text:
When our Thalys got cancelled due to the national strike and we were advised not to travel to paris by airplane/car - We were provided with the worst service ever from Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine. 

On Thursday evening (11PM) we got a message our Thalys train for the next day (6AM) was cancelled due to the strike.. We were advised not to travel to Paris due to the strike and no other transportation was available (total chaos). We were very dissapointed as we were travelling to Paris to celebrate our 5 year anniversary and everything got cancelled last minute. I called the hotel right away, unfortunately the manager already left so the clerk asked me to call back the next day at 9 AM... 
When I called back the next day, I spoke to the manager Claire, who simply told me we would not get any refund. I understand we booked a non-refundable rate through a third party, however have never experienced such service in an unusual situation like ours. 

I have worked as a reception supervisor for years  and learned that there are certain situations in which you need to be flexible - such as transport cancellations and national strikes. Unfortunately the manager did not want to change our reservation to another date or refund us.. She was not apologetic at all and did not seem to care about our anniversary, only about the costs for the hotel..

With this rude first impression of the hotel, I decided I will never stay with them again. Do not expect any service/flexibility/hospitality coming to this hotel...
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Decent Little Hotel
text:
The hotel is conveniently located and is just 5 min. walk from Madeleine station and 10 min. from Galeries Lafayett.

The hotel is clean and provides toiletries of Loccitane products. Hair dryer and kettle are also available in the room. I live in room 411 and the size is very small in which I can hardly put a large luggage. My friends were living in other room numbers and seems my room was the smallest.

Good choices of breakfast with hot and cold dishes and the variety was greater than many boutique hotels in Europe.

Generally I had a present stay but it would be much better if I could stay in a larger room.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great location
text: Really nice boutique hotel . Staff very friendly. Not much difference between the standard and superior room so I would go for the standard. Nice little touches like pastries to munch on in the afternoon. Pool tiny but very cute
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Beware of “spa”
text:
Calling what this hotel has a “spa” is generous and borders on false advertising. They have 1 TINY room where treatments can be received, and the other communal areas have children running all over them playing. Have you ever been to a spa that has 5-year olds playing and splashing in the pool? Nightmare. Furthermore, anytime you’d like to speak to a manager or supervisor, there is conveniently no one there to help and the staff is otherwise not empowered or unwilling to respond to guests complaints. 

Great area with tons of hotels- do yourself a favor and stay somewhere else.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Lovely staff but small rooms, hard beds and expensive
text:
Staff amazing (all kind and polite and expert- especially friendly and professional bed turn down team who all deserve pay rises as even sung to my sister on her birthday happy birthday) but very expensive for very small room, basics in room and ridiculously hard beds. Rooms too expensive for what you get. No space in room for even putting bag on floor but lovely sofas and decorations if you like all that (I just wanted space and sleep). Working lifts. Lovely foyer. Computers and papers to read. Very hipster. Paying for 5 star, getting 3.5. 

Spa fantastic though..worth every pennt... amazing!!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Horrible service
text: Service is horrible. Don’t recommend to anyone. Had a terrible experience with the front desk stuff. Not accommodating and completely unprofessional. We had booked a superior room with terrace, which had a sofa on the pictures, called to make sure that our son can sleep there and it was confirmed. Long story short - no sofa, no any solution other than “pay extra 100 euros”, even though the room is already 450 euros per night. We asked for at least an extra comforter and pillows, and got nothing. Not even extra blanket. The front desk guy at night said that “he doesn’t have an access to pillows and comforters, and his colleague just must’ve forgotten to send us the comforter we asked for”. Honestly, just shocked by the amount of neglect and complete lack of care from the hotel.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Wow!
text:
My family and I stayed here for just two nights at the end of our trip to Europe... and we wish we had more! We stayed in a duplex room and couldn’t have been more happy. 

The staff was incredibly helpful and kind with the kids. They were over the top helpful recommending one of the most amazing meals we have had as well as helping us navigate to Disney, (the lobby has an adorable play area for kids as well) The rooms are gorgeous, (we stayed in a duplex room which was clean, adorable and perfectly spacious for the four of us) the pool was great to have at the end of each day, and the area is super safe with amazing shopping and an abundance of food options. 

I highly recommend this hotel and will absolutely stay again the next time I’m in Paris.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel. Friendly Staff. Good Location.
text:
The hotel is very clean and has adorable little rooms. 
Rooms are a bit small but this is Paris. 
Staff are awesome, we had a last minute addition to our group and they did their best to accommodate us. We did need to take an extra room but we were fortunate enough to find one. 
Everyone was so friendly.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: My family enjoyed this quiet boutique hotel
text: We stayed for 6 nights during July, including the terrible heat wave. We are a family with 2 teenagers so we got 2 adjoining rooms each with a queen beds. The rooms are beautifully decorated and modern. We had a huge shower, great bathroom! Windows open so good to get a bit of fresh air in the mornings. We washed clothes in the sink and hung them dry on the towel warmer rack. Just hung them didn't turn them on. We used AC which worked great even during the 106 degree day and AC dries clothes faster too. We loved the room. But bring a wash cloth as they are not provided. We noticed this here and at Glasgow. Not sure if hotel has power adapters but room has couple of USB ports. Bring an adapter if you want fast charging. We did not eat here so can not comment about the restaurant. I did go to the bar a couple times. Bar tenders aren't too friendly/attentive. I asked for a beer on their menu but he said it might be too strong for me. Not sure what was going on there but I said ok and got a different one. They never asked if I want another after I finished it. I always had to ask for another one and the check. Nachos.. just cheese on the chips. The receptionist were all great. At check in and out. In fact at check out I told them that my under 18 kids stayed in one of the rooms and she said I should not pay VAT for that room so she removed the taxes. Thank you for saving money! Awesome. We did use the pool a few times. Very clean and quiet. Not sure if it's a cultural thing but the pool is heated, a bit too warm for me. We also noticed this in our London hotel. I would have liked a cooler pool on the106 degree day! There are some nice restaurants near by so we tried several during our stay. Sundays are difficult but there's a pizza place just down the street. Pretty good and friendly. So I would highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Good hotel but not 4 star service
text: Hotel is nice, good rooms and beds. Also nice en environment. Staff is not enough qualified for a 4 star hotel. At reception it’s like they don’t like their job, at breakfast if you arrive later it’s empty. They don’t put new things even there are 2 staff running there all the time. Is a bit of a joke, even the quality of breakfast is very good. Hotel is clean, I would go back, price quality is ok but staff needs to level up big time for a 4 star hotel. Also in the Spa there should be a dressing room.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Excellent stay in a great location
text: This was the perfect place for us to stay. Its very centrally located and the staff is helpful in ensuring the tour pickups/etc go smoothly. The rooms are updated and clean and the bathrooms are extremely spacious by Europe standards! Would definitely recommend and will be staying here on my return trip to Paris.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great facility. Ok service.
text: This is a very nice hotel. Good location and nice room. Bed was very comfortable and shower was great. They are a little understaffed at the front desk which led to long lines at checkout and check in.  We were supposed to be able to check in at 3 but didn’t get in the room until after 4. The staff was very cryptic about when our room would be ready which made it difficult for us to plan whether to wait in the lobby or go out. Facility 5 stars. Service friendly but not efficient 3 stars.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: perfect stay
text: the hotel was great. everything was perfect from the time we checked in till the time we checked out. welcoming and kind staff! the housekeepers are like ninjas. I never saw them not once. they would do our room in the morning and come back in the afternoon for a second touch up. the hotel is small and cozy the pool is lovely. the bed and pillows were extremely comfortable!! the bathroom was a bit small for my preference but it was still very nice. perfectly refreshing and revitalizing. the hotel is in a very central location close to many great places near by. I felt safe walking around at night unlike other arrondissements. I was very pleased with our stay at royal madeleine!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Romantic Weekend
text: We had a wonderful stay, 2 nights in this hotel. The room was spacious with good beds. They cleaned the room twice a day, and left chocolate every time. They really mastered the small touches which creates a good guest experience. Very friendly staff, always at your disposal. The concierge really made a difference. Good central location for us to visit many different places.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Small but Quiet
text:
Spent 1 night at the hotel, in a small nicely decorated room which was extremely quiet. I also had time to hit the fitness room, but passed on the decent-sized pool and sauna.

Overall well located, decorated and super quiet!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Poor customer relations
text: Had booked a superior double room but room very small and it was two single mattresses zipped together which left a seam down the middle of the bed not comfortable at all. Spa was full of 2 groups of women guest who had phones in the pool making an extreme amount of noise, there was no water for drinking gowns and towels litter the area and had our gowns removed from chair and thrown on the ground which was soaking wet. On check out this morning was due a refund of 150 euros but only 50 went through after taking to staff who where no help at all and calling the bank to sort problem, 50 minutes later still not resolved!! Had to leave as this was not cutting it fine for catching our flight home and informed taxis were on strike, no offer of help or transportation given we had to rush to try and get bus to airport. The staff and manager promised that an email would be sent of update of refund that afternoon but none sent, I am extremely disappointed and angry with lack of help and customer service. I would not choose to stay here again and it’s not a cheap option either staying here and still waiting for my MONIES and apology TERRIBLE TERRIBLE TERRIBLE
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Loved our stay until I got robbed in the hotel the last day
text:
So I can generally recommend this hotel, beautfiul rooms, extremely friendly staff and a great shower. So nothing to say here.

I was robbed by the dining area, standing 1 meter next to my table. It seems like it was a professional theft, as everything went really quickly and no one saw the guy - but that is exactly the problem. Being in a city that is quite famous for this, I think hotels should have at least 1-2 persons as staff who keep a close eye on people entering the facility and checking if they really are hotel guests or just oberserving the area. It could've saved me 2000 euros of personal financial loss. 

I understand that it is hard for the hotel to control and not everything is in the control of the hotel, but still this couldve been avoided. 

I'm mainly writing this review to warn people who decide to go to this hotel (which is beautiful, so go for it), that they need to keep their luggage at their chest at all times. 
Even in a Paris 4* Hotel you are not safe.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Never got the right room or refund
text:
We never got the right room, although we were promised to for two days. Only two rooms of the type we prepaid, and both are taken - sorry.

Some of the receptionists seem to have wandered unintentionally in the hospitality business.

At the end, we didn't even get a refund, only some peanuts from the minibar and free drinks coupon which we never used...
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Top Notch Boutique Hotel
text: I stayed here for 5 nights with business colleagues and we all had a delightful stay.  Each of our rooms were decorated differently and had been recently updated.  They bed, linens and toiletries were all first rate.  The staff were very helpful and went out of their way to be helpful.  I originally chose the hotel because it was in walking distance of a seminar that we were attending at another hotel but I fell in love with the neighborhood and will definitely stay here when I return for pleasure. All in all, it was an excellent experience!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Awesome staying
text:
Excellent atmosphere, great space, everyone was very welcoming.
I loved the decoration, the rooms were small but beautiful and the neighbourhood was great too.
Metro very close.
Wine bar exactly next to the hotel.
I strongly recommend it.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Royal Madeleine, oui oui!
text:
Paris, the most beautiful city in the world! The location of this hotel is great as you can wonder through the streets and just admire the architecture and the movement of the city, or take the cube.. 
For 2 nights it felt like it was our own private suite on the first floor. The pool and sauna are just that extra finishing touch, that made our stay at this hotel amazing. Overall experience is positive and recommendable, it’s clean and the staff is kind and attentive.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Excellent choice
text: Stayed at the hotel for a week during a business trip to Paris.  This hotel is fantastic.  Perfect location -- easy walk to numerous Metro stations and St Lazare, lots of good restaurants and great shopping nearby, and easy access by foot or metro to all tourist sites.  The hotel is lovely, well decorated, nice pool and sauna and restaurant/bar.  Room was very well appointed, lots of outlets and data ports, strong wifi, clean and modern amenities.  The staff were very friendly and helpful.  Highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Nice-ask for a working fridge
text: Clean hotel, beautifully decorated. 3 people stayed in the duplex-2 stories with 2 showers and 1 wc. Roomy for European standards. Pleasant staff. They advertise a mini-bar fridge, which I always look for, being American and knowing there is no ice machine. Ours was broken. I told the staff 4 times and was told my message would be “passed on”. I was finally offered to keep items in the restaurant fridge, however my earrings disappeared that day from my room (take valuables with you! I should have been smarter.) so keeping a decently priced bottle of wine in the restaurant fridge did not seem like a good choice.  Otherwise, the pool and sauna are nice to come back to after walking 10 miles a day. The hotel is centrally located, so unless you mind walking a good distance to the monuments and museums or know the metro system you may want to stay somewhere else.  Overall a good experience, just a little disappointed about the broken fridge and my missing earrings. Be sure to ask for a fridge that works if this is important to you.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Quiet, elegant, cozy, and chic.
text: This hotel is a delight. It is elegant and understated and decorated in a lovely, warm style. I stayed for a week and enjoyed the pool and sauna most days. The bathroom in my room was spacious, the bedroom was Parisian compact with clean, wood floors. Lots of pleasant activity in the common areas (tea room, breakfast room, and lively bar.) The shopping and sightseeing and metro access in the neighborhood are superb. The staff is helpful and unobtrusive. After many years of traveling to Paris, I have finally found my favorite hotel.  Merci, Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Double birthday trip
text: My partner booked a surprise trip to Paris to celebrate my 30th Birthday. We arrived on his actual birthday making it a double special occasion which we noted at the time of booking our 2 night stay. The hotel itself was lovely - nice decor. We stayed in the deluxe terrace room. We couldn’t get into our room until quite late in the day which was a shame. The small pool area was a nice bonus. As much as the hotel was well equipped and well presented, what seriously lacked was any form of personal customer service from the staff. Polite enough but uninformative to say the least. At no point were we given any basic information about breakfast times, check out, or any local information. There was no personal conversation or any attempt to find out about our visit or if they could help with anything. It may as well been a computerised check in service. The breakfast buffet was almost empty one morning when we arrived and was not replenished. Clean and well presented and the spa and terrace were nice but I would not stay here again as I really look for a personable hotel experience where you are really made to feel welcome and at home and this was not the case.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Stunning Hotel
text:
Absolutely stunning hotel, our room was so beautiful and high quality deco and bed linen. Lovely Juliet balcony looking out to the lovely street. Tranquil spa which just what you need after walking all day. You get changed to your robes in your room and go down in the lift to most relaxing spa with coffee and water. When I come Paris I can I wont bother looking for a hotel and just book this one straight away.
The bar was lovely and the lobby and restaurant, but the only negative was breakfast time, although food was superb you waiting ages for it. we waited 40 minutes for scrammed eggs and staff didn’t seem to be bothered. So next time will have breakfast out so out stay is 10 out 10.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Thoughtful, comfortable and relaxing
text: This hotel is wonderful- really nice little touches such as someone coming round each evening to offer chocolate and bottles of water, coffee machine in room, complimentary herbal teas in the spa and l’occitane bath products. Very nicely decorated hotel, spa was gorgeous and although small, we had this to ourselves most late afternoons which was perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Hotel very well situated, close to metros and nice bistros (would recommend cafe London-Paris). Hotel breakfast was okay, only had it once due to being overpriced. Deposit of €50 per night for use of Pringles and water in the mini bar is ludicrous, this is not charged if you don’t use it but guests should definitely be informed prior to their stay incase they don’t have a spare €250 to pay as a deposit at the time!! Ask for inward facing room on a higher floor as they are nice and quiet. Beds are comfy but no English breakfast tea in the room (be warned, take your own unless you like mint tea!). Rooms are serviced very late around 5pm which is not good if you want to come back and relax but are done to a high standard and we only had a problem with this one night out of 4. Picture of pigeon lady on wall was alarming- no other notes.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Short break with friends
text:
We spent 4 nights in this hotel which was selected by friends, and we got a 10% promotion discount for being over 3 nights.
The hôtel has a spa and pool, which we didn’t use though saw other guests going there. There is a good WiFi connection and the TV had several English speaking channels.
We found the mattress on the double bed rather firm, but as I declined the offer to change it, I rather blame myself!
The rooms are kept immaculate by the staff and someone turns up in the early evening to enquire if you need anything. We needed extra coffee and tea as the allocation per room for use in the coffee machine is not very generous. There’s a small fridge so we could keep our soya milk and hummus cool.
There’s the option of breakfast, but as we’re vegan and vegetarian, it’s not worth paying €20 pp for that when there are nice boulangeries in the vicinity.
The reception staff are friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Beautifully designed hotel in the heart of the city
text:
Our stay was from 12/29/18 to 1/3/19. This gem of a hotel is perfectly situated within Paris with easy walking to the main metro station, Printemps and the Paris Opera House. The staff at the hotel was amazing, they were incredibly helpful and kind. From reservations to directions, they went to great lengths to ensure that we were well taken care of. For example, I had an allergic reaction to my eye lash extensions and they needed to be removed, the concierge called every salon in the city until she found a salon near by that could fit me in immediately on the 31st! Wile we didn't eat in the restaurant, we did stop into the bar almost every evening for a night cap. The little restaurant across the alley from the hotel was nice with great service and food made from scratch onsite. 
Our room was spacious and had a separated seating area, with a wonderful soaking tub in the bathroom. The best part of the room was the terrace, which extended the entire length of the room accessible from 3 sets of french doors. Even though it was winter we tried to take advantage of the terrace, one night we sat at the comfortably at the table under a blanket drinking a bottle of Champagne watching the stars and listening to the city sounds. Pure magic. 
The spa with lap pool and sauna was a wonderful place to decompress at the end of the day. The massages we received were wonderful and reasonably priced.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Perfect stay, great location
text: Came here for my husbands 50th bringing our two teenage children. Great location, very central and nothing too far away. Rooms perfect as we had their interconnecting rooms, which gave us privacy but security. Hotel is beautifully presented following recent make over. Swimming pool and sauna were a highlight for the teens. Just the right size to entertain. Only criticism was the rooms were serviced very late in day and one was not ready for our arrival at 4pm. Saying that the lady that serviced our room was lovely and did a fantastic job. So didn't distract from a fabulous 4 day mini break. Reception staff also very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Incredible stay - we will be back
text:
My fiancé and I just stayed at Royal Madeleine for 5 nights. From 12/30/18-1/4/19. I don’t have enough positive things to say about the hotel and our stay. 

We had the duplex room - with the upstairs bedroom. We, almost instantly, began calling it our “apartment” - it was so nice to have something that spacious and luxurious to return to every day. 

The staff were very nice and very helpful. Room was perfectly clean. Location is absurdly convenient - situated directly between the Madeleine and Saint-Lazare metro stops, both just a few mins away walking distance - and with a boulangerie (bakery), cheese shop, restaurants, etc, all directly outside the hotel. 

I loved our stay. We both did. Would recommend the hotel to anyone. Get the duplex room if you can - it was incredible.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Nice hotel, friendly reception staff, missing items from room
text: We stayed at the hotel for 6 nights. The reception staff were nice and friendly, as well as the other staff. The problem is that since DAY 1 we started 'loosing' items in our room, Day 1 was a new sweater. Then 2 new hoodies and on the last day, forgot that the money and credit cards are in a purse? Disappeared. Not saying that someone stole it of course, as I can't prove it, just saying that I never lost anything before in a hotel room and I am traveling a lot.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great location, very clean, well decorated
text: We stayed here for 7 days/7 nights and just got back a few days ago. First off, the hotel is in a great area, just down the street from big shopping stores Printemps and Galeries Lafayette. Many little places to eat around there, especially one place Cafe Sud on side street, Rue De Castellane, the best food I had in Paris hands down, for $38 euros you get a appetizer and filet mignon steak with potatoes, probably better than what I have had living here in the US. You can walk to Rue St. Honore, Montaigne (more shopping areas) beautiful streets. You can manage walking to Louvre, but we did some Uber'ing for good rates. The hotel itself, is very well maintained, very clean rooms and bathrooms, nicely updated, although the beds could be a little more plush, they were more on the firm side, the bed side tables could stand to be a bit larger. We had a terrace in our room and that was great!. Beautiful view of the Arcade street and surrounding buildings. Our room was always cleaned when we would come back from exploring the city. The hallways are a little dark in hotel leading to the rooms. The little coffee pod machine in our room was great, my husband always used it. We would also store milk, or other snacks needing refrigeration in the mini fridge because we did not grab any of the fridge snacks. We would just go around the corner to a small store that had milk, water, fresh fruit, snacks, on Castellane street (across from that fabulous restaurant), and buy for us and put in fridge. All for much cheaper than hotel! I would say avoid the buffet breakfast at 20 euros per person, not worth it. We tried it to see how it was one morning, it runs from 7am-10:30 am, and we got there around 9:45 am and they had barely any scrambled eggs, no bacon, no sausage, and I only got a bit of eggs and had to share with my son, we waited over 30 mins to see if they would bring out more of the main dishes and they did not. Good thing we did mention to the hotel manager and she took our tab and we did not have to pay. Granted, we only really ate half a plate of somewhat decent stuff. The one small coffee cup we got at beginning, waitress never came back to check if we needed anything. Had a scowl on her face always. We ended up going across the street to PARMS, wonderful two sweet ladies who run the place and they have delicious panini's with a small side of salad and delicious vinaigrette, a dessert/fresh fruit cup and drink for 11 euros! Half the price as the hotel and filling. Also, the little cafe on corner by hotel is pretty good too, they have fresh bread, coffee, pastries, etc.. Overall, not sure if I would stay there again, but it was comfortable, at the nightly rate, it would have been nice if the mediocre breakfast was at least included. Can't see paying over $20 USD per person for that breakfast. Hotel Madeleine should work on that for sure.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Great location well furnished disappointed that i slept so badly for 2 nights and the spa was poor
text: Very noisy. Windows are not double glazed, outside noise very intrusive at night. No carpets in bedrooms so clearly hear footsteps and chairs being scraped on the floor from upstairs. Kept me awake and also woke me up during the night a number of times. The "Spa" is bit of a joke. Between the swimming pool and the sauna is a corridor that staff walk through about every 2 minutes. Then they open some locked doors, which then slam shut. My idea of a spa is somewhere you can relax in quiet. This is like a railway station. Also there is no shower for the sauna and there are no toilets. Makes me wonder what other guests might have done if they needed to pee...
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Small but well located
text:
rooms very small,crowded for family of 4,but we had a huge terrace that we enjoyed in the evenings after a long day of walking,luckily the weather was very warm.
Service was ok,depending on who you got...
Breakfast was good,though they kept wanting to charge us even though it was included in price we paid for room.
Hotel is very well located...close to metro,hop on hop off buses,shops and restaurants...as well as a handy mixed business shop.
I would consider staying here again.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: First time in Paris
text: Promised my wife 36 years ago that I would take her to Paris. Great choice of hotel - excellent location, service, cleanliness and having a pool and a small gym and sauna was a bonus. Bar and restaurant on the premises or in the covered attached passage.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Beautiful hotel
text:
I took my 5 year old son for 3 nights at the end of August. The hotel had been beautifully refurbished and only open about a month. The interior design is beautiful. Light and airy communal space in reception and the bar area and our room was stylishly lit and decorated with well chosen pictures and lamps. Quality tea and coffee in the room (a pod coffee maker that produced excellent coffee) and a super excellent spacious and beautifully tiled shower. Comfy bed. Great black out curtains. Movies available for free on demand. 
The pool is lovely. Small but smart. I was glad that there were no restrictions on kids’ access - we really benefited from a post-sightseeing dip. 
We didn’t eat breakfast in the hotel because it seemed a bit overpriced. But the patisserie literally over the road was absolutely lovely. Fabulous pastries and hot drinks. 

The only suggestions I could make to improve it would be 1. A drinking water supply in the pool/spa area 2. A more comfy chair in the bedroom - the chair in there was wicker or something. It snagged my tights and didn’t feel good to sit on. A small fabric chair would be much better!! 3. Bedside drawers instead of just tables.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: More show than go
text: Recently renovated hotel n a great central location in Paris close to a couple of metro routes, shopping, dining etc.  it is a good size for Paris hotels however, the floors are timber laminate which look great but mean that you hear your neighbours clunk Ng around on the floors around and above you.  The shower door in our room was put on back to front where ch meant that it leaked all over the floor when you had a shower.  Aesthetically the room looks great however the storage in the rooms is minimal and you have a stool instead of a bedside table with drawer, a desk top in lieu of cabinetry with drawers.  The spa, pool and sauna look great however to say that the hotel has any, is a joke. It is a very small room with two bikes in it, they have one set of dumbbells of which one of the handles is missing. I mentioned this to three separate staff members and they committed to sorting it out and nothing happened. Hotel looks great but scratch below the surface and it is a pretender. Not worth the premium you will pay unless you get a deal.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: A stunning brand new spa hotel in Central Paris
text: What a gem. Coming across this beautiful spa hotel right in the centre of Paris and close to all the attractions was fortuitous. After hours of searching the Internet I found this beautiful hotel. It's close to Gard du Nord where the Eurostar travels to and from. We walked from the hotel to the Eiffel Tower and if you enjoy walking can walk from there to Champ Elysees. There's a lovely scent in the hotel, it's bright and airy and the room is a decent size, comfortable, nicely decorated. There are books to read and free tea and coffee with cake in the afternoon. There's a nice bar with friendly staff. Many cafes and restaurants around the area too. You'll feel good in this hotel. Shame I didn't travel with swimwear to enjoy the spa too.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Just renewed
text:
Clean hotel, just after the renovation.

Good location: far from the Eiffel and the Louvre, but very close to shopping centers. 

Very quiet hotel with quite large rooms (for French hotels) and spacious shower. Nice staff, good restaurant.

The only thing I did not like was the  reservation of 50 EUR per day, “in case if you would like to use something from the minibar”... first of all it was nowhere stated, and just let me add a pic of this minibar, for better understanding of my confusion :)

Not very polite gesture from the hotel administration.

But the hotel prolonged our check-out from 11 till 12:30. Which was not really enough, but very kind anyway.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Spent two nights at Royal Madeleine hotel and spa. Room v clean, modern and recently refurbished. Staff v accommodating and polite. Walked to Louvre, Eiffel Tower and surrounding shops, all v near. Walked to notre dame but would recommend taking metro, which we got back to Madeleine, 7 stops direct with a five mins walk to hotel.  Would recommend highly. Photo from our room.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Wonderful Newly Restored Hotel with Awesome Staff in a Great Location
text:
We feel so fortunate and lucky to have discovered the Hotel Royal Madeleine on our August 2018 visit to Paris.  Due to an issue with a vacation rental, we found ourselves already in Pairs, looking for two rooms to accommodate a family of five for 11 nights, beginning the next day. We booked the Hotel online and when we showed up the next day we found that the finishing touches were still being put on the property. We felt like we were part of the opening team (in a good way).  It is brand new.  On arrival, Claire went to great lengths to provide us the perfect rooms for our family, right next to each other.  Our three teenage sons stayed in a duplex room which had a pull-out sofa and 1 and 1/2 baths on the first level and two singles plus another bathtub on the second level.  We had a very spacious room with a sitting area and a huge outdoor terrace. The decor of the rooms is very elegant and clean, with hardwood floors, intricate white molding and deep, bold colors on the walls; a perfect combination of traditional decor with a modern touch.  The bathrooms are beautiful with elegant and modern fixtures as well.  Air conditioning worked perfectly, and it was 92-97F when we were there, but our rooms were cool and comfortable.

The pool area in the below-ground level is a really inspired use of a relatively small space, which feels much larger and is another spectacular setting.  It was such a bonus to have a pool to visit to retreat from the heat of the afternoon.  The lobby and breakfast area are bright and cheerful.  The citrus grove in the center is a wonderful design element and it was nice to sit in the afternoon and enjoy the complementary tea, coffee and cakes. The bar was a great place to have a pre-dinner drink or a nightcap.

The service from everyone at the hotel was great.  The concierge and front desk team helped us to find restaurants and sights to visit and printed tickets for us when we needed them.  The housekeeping staff was efficient and friendly and the bar/restaurant staff were always cheerful and helpful.

Location was perfect - close to the Opera house and major shopping venues like Printemps and Galleries Lafayette.  Lots of cafes, restaurants, pubs, markets and patisseries within a block or two of the hotel.  Convenient to either St. Lazare or Madeleine metro and train stations.   Short walk to Place Vendome and Place de la Concord.

Thank you to Claire and the team at Hotel Royal Madeleine for making our stay in Paris special!
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: Absolutely Amazing New Hotel
text:
I surprised my girlfriend with a stay in Paris for her birthday, however I had a personal issue before my stay so I couldn't make the dates, Claire who works at the hotel kindly changed my dates for no extra charge or hassle, which gave me a great initial opinion that the hotels customer service is brilliant.

When we actually got to the hotel the staff were super friendly and welcoming, and we loved the design of the hotel, it was botanical and elegant.

I requested a surprise for my girlfriend in the room to have rose petals sprinkled over the bed in a heart shape with her age in the middle, and to my great surprise Claire kindly remembered and personally made the rose presentation herself which was once again amazing customer service and my girlfriend loved it!

Our room was really cosy and intricate and the aircon helped us so much during the night.

The bar staff were also really friendly and made some amazing cocktails for us, they also recommended their personal favourite places to visit in Paris which helped us during our stay.

However one of the highlights of the hotel was definitely the spa, I haven't seen a cooler swimming pool area in any hotel I've stayed at, the swinging chairs was a great touch and the swimming pool actually had really cool underwater technology in it. You could press buttons underwater to activate part of the pool turning to a jacuzzi which we found really cool.

Overall I don't have a bad word to say about the hotel, amazing staff, great design and we'll definitely be staying here again when we visit Paris next time.
name: Hotel & Spa Royal Madeleine

title: a wonderful couple stay
text: We had a wonderful stay in this hotel. Our room was very clean and spacious, just as described. The concierge was friendly and always helpful, particularly Dominic. It was a great location, very close to everything you need and more.  I would recommend this property and would happily come back for another stay.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Outstanding
text:
It all starts with a smile and helpfulness. This hotel was abundant in both. It started before we arrived  with notes to the concierge via email. Everything was prompt and courteous. It continued when we arrived. We could not ask for more. 

The location was great. A couple of blocks to the champs d’Elysees. But, don’t miss the great restaurants around the corner in the other direction. 

Rooms were clean and comfortable and breakfast was great. 

We will definitely visit again and highly recommend this Hotel.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Lovely hotel in great location
text: We travelled as a group & had a nice mini break in Paris. Hotel was lovely, great location & close to a metro too. Staff were friendly & helpful. Will definitely stay again & recommend to family & friends.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great location
text: Great location at a good price. Air con was extremely effective and we felt safe in the hotel. One member of staff was a bit off, but aside from him the rest were extremely helpful, welcoming and kind.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: The best in good $$
text:
1- The hotel is excellent and suitable for families and children.
2. The housekeeping service is very fast and the cleanliness is high.
3. The internet is free and fast.
4. The hotel is very respectful and maintains your
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel in Paris
text: Great location. You have Arc du Triumph walking distance and Eiffel a short 3 metro .stops away. Mini market, boulagerie,, restaurants very close by. So location is excellent.
