The hotel itself is very pretty, clean, traditional style, nicely decorated. Rooms are small but good for Paris standards, still super comfortable, clean, pretty.. AC was perfect. The staff is kind, professional and courteous. They are very helpful and very attentive. We will definitely come back and will recommend to everybody. We only had one issue when sending 4 pieces of clothes for laundry , they mixed it up when delivering it to your room and we didn't get them when expected. We spent almost a day very annoyed because we were not sure we'll get our clothes back. They managed the best they could but Dominic and Soraya went above and beyond ande found our clothes after a bit more of 24 hours of waiting for a solution. Other than that all was good and we will come back for sure next year... (but won't give any clothes for laundry, unless they change the method and give the option to pick it up yourself). Still a great hotel, price is good for the area and quality, , highly recommended.(Note to hotel: it can be a difficult de step into the bathtub as the border is very high which can be a problem for senior people or people with some mobility issues, specially when you almost don't have a handle to grab yourself while you step in and out from taking a shower. Also the half-glass door is a bit annoying and dangerous too as if you use it to help yourself while going in and out of the shower can be tricky and slippery. I think the bathtub and shower system can improve, but in general it was very good). Thanks for making our first time in Paris so wonderful
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Simply amazing!
text: Elegant hotel with amazing location; near the famous Champs-Élysées street. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful. I have booked a junior suite; so, the view is amazing overlooking Eiffel tower. I would definitely recommend it for families with children.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: There is no room service, at night the house keeping is non. The house keeping is terrible
text:
The house keeping didn’t clean our cups for 3 days despite we asked every day to clean . Very poor house keeping. 
The value for money paying 400 euro in august is realy too much for this property’s it worth 250 max and during the night since there is only 1 person working in the reception the hotel doesn’t look safe .
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great hotel
text: We travelled with 2 children. The hotel is in a  great location, easily reached taking the metro from the train station. The reception staff is friendly and the rooms are nice and clean. We will come again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Nice location,  nice service
text: It was really good! I love this hotel. The location was perfect,  service was wonderful! Just one thing that, basic room is little bit small. Except that, everything was great. I would like to recommend this hotel for the Paris tourist.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Comfortable, clean rooms
text:
My family and I had a lovely stay at The Rochester.  The rooms were very comfortable but, as others have mentioned, the air conditioning was not strong so it was a bit warm in July.  Not great for sleeping at night. But the room was clean and comfy. The front desk clerks were not very friendly but this is Paris. I guess this is to be expected.

If you stay here and want a Michelin starred meal, get a reservation at Apicius.  It’s walking distance from the hotel and a complete gem. Amazing food and beautiful outside grounds. A meal to remember! 

I’m not sure I would stay here again next time I go to Paris. I would try another Neighborhood. 
But the hotel was comfortable and clean.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Family visit
text:
Booked the hotel through a Eurostar Train & Hotel package mostly due to the fact of location & that it had a good section of information about being family/baby friendly. 

Arrival at the hotel was very easy coming from Gare du Nord via the Metro - hotel was a 2 minute walk from the metro station St-Philippe-du-Roule. 

The check in process was straightforward, however we had quite a wait for our room to be ready due to the previous guests departing late and the room not quite being ready yet. As a result when we were told we decided to go for a walk to get our bearings for a bit. We were able to leave our bags at the front desk and headed out for a walk.

The hotel has a fantastic location being 2 blocks (about a 5 minute walk) to the Champs Elysees and surrounded by little cafes, super markets and take away places for food. 

Once we got into our room - we had a Junior Suite, it was amazing. We had 2 rooms a lounge room and a main bedroom with toilet and bathroom it was clean & spacious for us and our toddler. There were a few bits of west and tear around the room but only very minor and not enough to put a dampener on the room or trip. 

Food is served at breakfast only, although it’s served 07:00 - 13:30 so plenty of time to get food throughout the morning if you required. We had the breakfast included in our rate, however can be added on if required. The food was of good quality and had a wide range of choices including meats, cheeses, fruit, cooked breakfast and pastries/bread. If you wanted food in an evening it’s a case of eating out - not a problem for where the hotel is situated with lots to choose from & a short walk to more restaurants on the Champs Elysees, if you wanted to eat in hotel it’s room service only which comes from a couple of local restaurants - this is somthing that we found a little confusing as it only showed one restaurant which didn’t have a great choice for eating with a toddler. 

Within the hotel there is a spa/fitness area, basic but nice - there were a couple of treadmills, exercise bikes, weights machine and some free weights. The spa element consisted of a Hamman steam room & Sauna perfect for unwinding after a long day! Due to Covid you had to book into use the gym or spa - a 45min slot with the reception team, again all very easy. 

Overall, a very nice hotel, perfect location, food was great and the staff were excellent throughout. If we return to Paris we would certainly use this hotel again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Friendly and cozy
text: The hotel was very cozy, nice rooms and very friendly staff. The breakfast was good, but I asked before arrival if they had gluten free options due to allergy. They replied and confirmed that this was available, but while staying there it was not. Little disappointed - less options for me. The shower was not completely good working: some lose parts and not able to use the bathtub.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Stuff
text: Stuff in reception not polite. Ac in room wasnt working and hasnt been fixed when i mentioned it. I requested late checkout always same lie that hotel is fully booked and same type of room was available
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent location- triple rooms very spacious
text: Super great location- close to Champs Elysees and shops there. Yummy cafe across the street for lunch. Easy to let older kids go for lunch there while I slept in. Easy walk to hop on hop off bus. Clean quiet hotel.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Fine but not great
text: We stayed in a Jnr suite which was spacious - however the bathroom was a bit dated with no walk in shower. The staff were courteous but not v engaging (except for Dominique who was great). Whilst the hotel is situated on a busy street the room was quiet and the location was good for accessing the Metro and walking to the key tourist sites.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Nice hotel and staff !!
text: Very nicely located at the most important part of Paris - Champs-Elysées!!! Its jist walking distance from the Fashion street of the world with Arc d triumph and Concorde on either ends!! Great food, very nice and helping concierge for every needs of a family!! Few rooms have the view of Eiffel tower too which is every penny worth!!!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Good located business Hotel with service outages
text: The Hotel is ok for a business trip and is very good located near to main attractions. The concierge service could not handle to call a taxi, the service at the breakfast has no idea of service and the reception was not able to produce a correct invoice!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Absolutely wonderful experience!
text:
Our travel agent booked a Junior Suite at the Hotel Rochester for my daughters' and my 'mother/daughter' stay in Paris -- and we are so thankful he did.  From the moment we arrived at the hotel, everyone welcomed us so warmly and treated us almost like returning family.  Even though we arrived a bit early, they assured us it was fine, checked us in, stowed our bags and recommended a nearby restaurant for a fantastic lunch.

Our rooms were large and well-appointed and the beds (including the pull-out sofa bed) had the most comfortable mattresses we've ever had in a hotel -- of any caliber.  (After long days of sight-seeing, we were all thankful to return to our comfy beds.)  The bathroom was large and had every amenity we could want.  

The hotel is spotless, decorated in a subtle but tasteful style and has a number of 'public' areas.  The breakfast is amazing (see some of the other photos) and, at night, we enjoyed sitting at the bar, discussing our busy days with our friendly bartender.  And we couldn't have have asked for a more central location.  Restaurants abound around the hotel (and we tried a number of them), an ATM is on the corner, grocery stores are nearby and the Metro (Line 9) was, literally, steps away.  

Would we recommend this hotel?  Definitely yes!  Would we stay here again?  Oh yes, in fact we all wish we were there right now!!  Thank you Hotel Rochester for an amazing ten days.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Stay away !
text:
You hear everything in the rooms next door and above. So impossible to sleep !
Worn-down rooms, especially the carpet. 
Shower door leaks, so water everywhere when you take a shower.
Rooms quite small.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Comfortable and well staffed.
text:
Conveniently located a few steps from the Champs Élysées.
Very nice hotel with comfortable (and relatively large) room and wonderful bedding. 
Good advises from the concierge. 
Nice breakfast buffet with large choice and freshness. 
Le Figaro and New-York Times availiable in the morning.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Extreme hospitality
text: We loved this hotel, right off the Champs-Elysees, for 3 nights in Paris.  The hotel room was large, well-stocked, very comfortable.  The breakfast that we chose to get each morning (extra fee) was ample-enough to carry us through the day.  Location was excellent for the major sights.  I particularly want to mention Dominique, the concierge that helped us.  He took a lot of time to help orient us, but one time walked with my husband to point out a nearby Mediterranean restaurant he'd recommended.   We will certainly recommend this hotel to others.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great stay!
text: We had a blast with my little nephew and my family, the people in the hotel were really nice to us. If you're planning on staying in Paris, this is a good spot. Coffee should be free lol, but really nice place.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Lovely property..
text: Excellent location of the place with beautiful staff... The place is very well located with many eateries around the area... Julie Boulangerie is great option for breakfast... The bar at Rue La Boetie is amazing for dinner and drinks and many more..
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: 2 nights
text: the room is big and clean the staff is so friendly the location of. the hotel is great. I will come back for sure. and would definitely recommend this hotel to a friend. its great for 3 nights in the heart of Paris.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Good location, tiny rooms
text:
Pros: good location with ease access to many tourist spots and shopping centres, good breakfast buffet with many options, clean bathroom, some staffs serving breakfast were really nice, 24/7 reception service. 

Cons: very tiny rooms and the floor carpet of the room was not clean, same breakfast buffet everyday.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: So perfect
text: Perfect location, near by Champs Elysee, metro, reataurants, supermarket e etc. We stayed in the top Junior Suite, with 2 excellent bedrooms and 1 bathroom. All staff polite and ready to help. We recommend!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent
text: Very nice clean hotel with great location this was my fourth stay in 4 years .. its consistent in good quality of service and helpful staff personel . We Will choose to stay there every time we visit paris.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: I highly recommend the hotel
text: Good location, very clean rooms , I highly recommend the hotel  and about 8 minutes walking to the center, I enjoy staying in the hotel , I will come again and stay in the hotel , the reception was helpful.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Top-hotel in top-location with spa area.
text: highly recommended! new renovated and stylish decorated hotel with Paris flair! Service stuff is very friendly and warm welcoming! the main bed is very good, wide, there is a tea cooker in the room and water is for free. i was in Junior suite.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Don’t except a 4 star service !
text:
Definitely not the service of a 4 star hotel . I had booked a junior suite , keeping in mind the rooms in Paris are small . The room at Rochester was nice and big , but the air condition was not working , when we complained to the hotel and asked them to come check , they informed us they had no technician and the hotel was sold out so we would have to make do with whatever we had . 
Extremely disappointed with the way the matter was handled , we were told to open our windows and sleep . After paying a premium and getting a junior suite also , this is the kind of service we got . Definitely a 1 star for their service and way of handling a situation .
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Well run hotel in good location
text: Nice property with professional staff and located within 100M of a Metro station. Some of the facilities were closed due to Pandemic restrictions. All in all we had a very pleasant stay in this property.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Perfect Boutique Hotel Experience nearbChamps-Élysées
text: Booking a Jr Suite here was the perfect choice for a long (18 day) stay that incorporated both intense work & rest/play.  The decor is chic & tasteful & the hotel staff couldn’t be nicer or more accommodating, Perfect location for walking all over Paris. The room was large enough that we didn’t feel crowded or cramped during our near 3-week stay & we made use of the fridge for the mini-bar & of course the ac during the hotter days.  My husband enjoyed the little gym/spa too.  Recommend & will return.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Best stay after Covid-19
text: Hotel is in full service,  professional and friendly service.  You feel like a guest in 5 star Hotel.  Location is top close to all Paris has to offer.  Breakfast was top, fresh and healthy food. For the city top choice
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel
text:
To start with, the staff were very friendly and kind (especially Christel & Jeremy). The 2 junior suite rooms we took were clean and large.The breakfast was average meaning there was no buffet (due to covid) but the food in general was good. We were able to go walking to the Champs-Élysées in just a few minutes!! 
Overall we would definitely visit this hotel again on our next trip to Paris since it’s one of the best.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Wonderful hotel, nothing was too much trouble, excellent location, we had a fantastic stay.Surrounded by great bars and restaurants. Our original hotel was closed because of Covid but we fell on our feet finding The Rochester, it turned out an even better trip because of it.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing Service
text:
We had a wonderful stay at your hotel. Kristel, Maelle, Nitish, Noemie are outstanding as well as housekeeping team.
Service was immaculate, the way of applying covid 19 measures were also very much follow with no hassle. BRAVO Kristel in the way you are leading your team. We will be back. The way you managed all our guests for business meeting were just stunning. Nitish, you'll go far! Keep it up!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing stay
text:
This place was outstanding. From the moment we arrived the manager Nitish took amazing care of us, made sure we had the right rooms and everything was in order. 
Hotel is literally less than a 10 min walk from Champs Elysee so location is perfect. 
Clean spacious rooms, comfy bed, good showers.
Thank you would recommend and definitely stay here again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Rochester
text: Can't thank nitesh anymore. Living legend. Thank you for your service. Will. Be coming back again when visiting Paris. The best hotel and the best services stayed in many hotels but the service at rochester and the hospitality from nitish was outstanding.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Early morning visitor
text: We booked to stay in this hotel after much research. A one off holiday away from our kids would mean a very rare lie in. It was all going well until someone walked into our room at 8am ruining this. And then again half an hour later. Very disappointed.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Paris Vacation
text: Hotel Rochester is situated in the Champ's - Elysees area. Walking distance to most of the tourist attractions. All of the Metro Rail stations is walking distance from the hotel. Getting around Paris is a breeze. The Concierge was very helpful providing maps and directions. Breakfast buffet had a good selection with tasty pastries. Pradeep went out of his way to make us comfortable.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great!
text: We had a great stay at Hotel Rochester! Minutes away from shopping . We were able to walk to most of the places we wanted to. Check in was seamless and employees are friendly. Our room was very big for Paris standards and we felt right at home.  We will definitely make this our go to anytime we are in Paris!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: fantastic location and friendly staff
text: The hotel location is wonderful, steps from a market and the metro is around the corner.  Conveniently located Starbucks also with a local bakery next door. Staff at the hotel was very accommodating and we enjoyed our anniversary trip- will visit again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Another great hotel for tour groups
text:
All I can say is that Viking River Tours really can pick good hotel for tour groups.  We were at three of them on this trip to France (Paris, Loire Valley and Bordeaux), and we were totally satisfied with all of them.  That is a strong statement because we haven't always been pleased with the ability to a hotel to take a large group and make the stay memorable.  Most of them have a weakness or two, but not this time!  And, this was probably the best of the three because of the location--so close to the Champs Elysees and all that it has to offer.

The check in (for 27 people) was a piece of cake!  Nothing to do!  It had all been pre-arranged and we were given our room keys at the front desk.  Our bags were magically carried to the room when we were getting our briefing in the private room--the only thing that would have made it better was if we were given drinks after the TGV trip to the city from Bordeaux.  NOTE:  For those of you that haven't taken the high speed train--do it on your next trip.  You can get from city center to city center faster than flying and the ride is beautiful--better than flying.  It is the best way to travel in France--we have used it with few problems (the only fear is the dreaded French transportation strikes) numerous times.  

The rooms are lovely (and very quiet) and have a small french balcony with large windows.  The TV has only 5 English channels, but you are in the room so little,,,,  The bath room is very large with a great shower.  The closet space is more than ample.

The breakfast is one of the best we had on the entire trip--that includes our on ship breakfasts.  The dining room is very attractive and the the buffet is beautiful as well as the individualized service for the egg dishes.  The staff is very good/friendly!

The concierge staff and the front desk staff are good and friendly--always available.  The business center is under renovation, but you can get assistance.  The porters are great at getting the bags to the limos for the trip to the airport.

The lobby area is comfortable and attractive.  The only thing that keeps it from getting a 5 is that it is not as big or dramatic as the really upper end hotels--and it has no restaurant for dinner in it; however, the breakfast room becomes a bar in the eventing.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: H.L.M
text:
Great convenient location  with an easy connection to public transit. 
 Excellent service.  Very good food selection for breakfast.  Room was immaculate.  Avoid street front rooms on Saturday evening as the club across the street is very noisy.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel with great location
text: We enjoyed 3 nights in this lovely hotel. One of the days was my boyfriend’s birthday, and in that occasion the hotel had prepared a sweet note and some treats to celebrate him. This was really nice. Room was ok size, but in return it was of high standard and very clean. Friendly staff and good location of the hotel.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Location location
text: great location, just 3 minutes walk from Champs Elysess, friendly staff, nice rooms, clean. Highly recommended for a short getaway if you want to have everything near. I have stayed there many times will come again
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great location
text: loved staying at this hotel- great location - very central and close to subway transportation.  will stay here again when we return to Paris- very clean and staff was very helpful.  there was a restaurant we loved around the corner- L'Artoise  - we dined there every night it was so yummy.  look forward to our next trip to Paris.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great Stay in Central Paris
text:
Location was everything! 

Champs Elysees was a 5-min walk away as well as George V Metro Station. 

Breakfast was great, lots of options even for vegetarians. Loved the croissants, their coffee and they even have crepes for breakfast!

Our bedroom was huge and clean with a nice sitting area. bathroom amenities were also good and bathroom was spacious enough. 

Staff showed enthusiasm in helping out guests, they helped us with our luggage getting it up and out of the hotel. Upon checking in the staff provided us with maps, information and warnings of things to avoid in the hotel, showing much care for their guests. 

Would definitely stay again when I come back in Paris!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text: This hotel was a surprise. The location is close to Avenue Champs-Elysees, the main boulevard in Paris. Our concierge, Dominique couldn't have been more attentive. He even gave us tips on how to keep our valuables safe while walking the streets of Paris! My husband and I booked this hotel months before our travel so we got good rates. Also, the food is delicious. The hotel has a breakfast buffet with a wide variety of tasty delights and the room service menu is especially good. I highly recommend this hotel.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful Hotel - Paris's little secret!
text: Stayed here with family, late October 2019. Wonderful Service, Lovely, clean rooms. The staff were very helpful and friendly, especially with my young grandchildren. We will definitely stay here next year when we come to Paris again. And the location is perfect - a 5 minute walk to the Champs Elysses and a 1 minute walk to the Metro. I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough  - we loved it there! John Reed, UK
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: A great hotel for seeing Paris
text: A really great hotel well placed for all the main tourist sites in Paris. Very friendly and helpful staff, the concierge even managed to tel us how to master the Paris Metro successfully! Restaurant served a good breakfast with plenty of choice. The hotel is well positioned for restaurants of all cost levels. I would thoroughly recommend the Rochester as a good hotel base for a Paris stay.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Worth it!
text: This hotel is a about a five minute walk to Ave Champs Elysees where there are a lot of shops and restaurants and a 10 to 15 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe. The rooms were so spacious and clean. The staff was pretty nice and welcoming. Only wish to at least have a little complimentary breakfast that would only consist of some coffee and croissants since the breakfast offered in their restaurant was $25. The price of the hotel depicts the quality and the nice location it is in. Worth the price and hope to stay here again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Paris Hotel
text: We loved this place.  Very convenient as it was just a few blocks off the Champs d"Elysees.  The breakfast was delightful and it changed just a little everyday.  Our room was charming and we could open the window and listen to the waterfall outside.  Can't wait to go back.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Avoid if Possible
text: While the room and personnel were overall good we found the hotel not to be acceptable. We were with a Viking Tour and after traveling from Los Angeles all night half the day, we had to wait 2 hours and 40 minutes to get into our room. We stayed several nights, one being Saturday. On Saturday night, it was so noisy from the street traffic and a dance club we did not get any sleep. This lasted from 10:30 pm to 6:30 am. Why weren't there any double or triple pane glass to reduce the noise? They could of also placed us in the interior or rooms not facing the club.. We would not recommend this hotel if staying in Paris during a weekend.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Exellent
text: Very good service. Beautiful room and Atmosphere, very clean in the room and outside.Silence. Nice garden. It was not noisy from the lift. Bar and breakfast  is very nice. Personaler is very friendly and nice. Close to the center and transport.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: 25th Anniversary
text: The hotel has a great staff, we enjoyed our stay. Jeremy and all other staff was very helpful. They had umbrellas when it rained so save your Eruo. It was close to all the shops, great for shoppers like us!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Boutique hotel in great location
text: Our room was very comfortable and the staff were pleasant and helpful.  The breakfasts were amazing.and we found local restaurants nearby (not on the Champs-Elysees).   There is a charming courtyard and comfortable areas to sit.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing experience at Rochester Champs Elysees
text:
Stayed at Rochester Champs Elysees for two nights. The bedroom was very spacious and quiet.

We were 2 adults. Beds are very comfortable, shower with plenty of amenities! 

Breakfast was very very good! 

The reason I decided to choose this Hotel was its location. It's in the centre with everything close to it. You can walk easily or get a metro. 

Really recommend this Hotel!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Fabulous hotel!
text:
Stayed here in April 2019 - birthday surprise!.
Fabulous hotel - amazing room with everything that you need although the mini-bar was a little bit over-priced but we had our own wine/drinks so not a problem to be honest!
The hotel Staff were extremely polite and helpful to us; room was immaculate.
Hotel is located really close to Champs Elysee with Metro just a few minutes walk away.
Lots of lovely little French cafe's to stop at, eat beautiful pastries, and take a few minutes to take in the surroundings and do a bit of "people watchiong"!
Really close to all main attractions and if not within walking distance, Metro is close at hand and is easy to use. 
Fabulous stay - would certainly recommend!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Nice well located hotel
text: Great hotel nicely decorated, great service and clean . It’s located close to Champs Elysees and has a metro line right in front . The service is excellent with a great breakfast . Rooms have a good size and are very clean and comfortable .
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great location
text: Good room, fast wifi, but room cleaning was average at best. Requesting 5 euros to have a plate delivered to our room was weird. Maybe they thought we were going to take it back to Australia, because we don’t have plain white plates in Australia.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent Stay as usual
text: Our fourth time staying at the Rochester, because of its excellent location, very friendly and helpful staff and very comfortable accommodations (we usually get the Jr. Suite).  Walking distance from all the important attractions.  Will return again.  Don’t have much more to say; just a worthwhile place to stay and worth the price - which is comparatively small compared to similar hotels.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful stay, great location
text: My husband were recently at this hotel for several nights prior to a river cruise. We did not select the hotel, it was part of a package, but we were very happy with the hotel choice.  The location, near the Champs Elysees and to many interesting things including a tea room we had wanted to try, was outstanding.  Other things we liked included the large, comfortable bed,  wonderful morning breakfast, nice tea kettle/tea things in the room, excellent service, assistance at the front desk with directlons.  Our only problem was that the shower was difficult to access due to the very high walls of the tub (we're both very short).  We managed by piling all the towels up so we could kind of slide across the metal rails without injury.  And bring your own washcloths/flannels, none are provided, maybe that's a French thing?  We bought some.   Anyway, it was great!
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great hospitality in heart of paris
text: Together with my wife, we spent five night in Paris before we leave to Nice for another three nights. Our experience in Rochester champs elysee paris was amazing. You feel the care and professionally the moment you step in. The reception and concierge staff were very helpful and extremely helpful during the whole stay. They upgraded us to a larger room when they found up that we were two persons ( the original booking was double room for single use).The room was very good, very clean with reasonable size and with all needed amenities. Breakfast was great and very rich quality and quantities. The hotel location is great, 7 minutes walk from the Champs-Élysées,  two minutes walk from number 9 metro station and 7 minutes from all the transportation and sight seeing tour buses of champs elysee.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing Hotel in Paris
text: The Rochester Champs Elysees is obviously beyond awesome and is a destination by itself. the room is magnificent, the service is outstanding and very friendly ! I highly recommend it ... thank you Rochester , one of the best hotels in the world .
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent stay
text: Very Nice experience, clean room, great location for what we wanted and very attentive staff. I would recommend this hotel to anyone. The price was good value for our suite and we where able to walk wherever we wanted and then take a taxi when needed.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great little hotel
text: This is a fabulous quaint hotel located just a few blocks from the Champs-Elyees. The rooms were great and the hotel just enough on the main thoroughfare to give you the real feel of Paris. It had full bar and a select evening menu but full breakfast. We enjoyed a late evening tea on the private terrace which was graciously served by the bartender. Definitely would stay here again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Very good because all employees are very helpful
text: The hotel is good with good location and all employees were friendly and helpful and I advice my friends to come to it . The breakfast time was perfect and the service was quick and nice . The conceirge were all helpful and friendly and always smiling and all staff in breakfast are very friendly and helpful and smiling also
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Disappointed
text:
Staff was not cooperative, I had recently acquired Genuis 2 status which qualified me for free breakfast at the hotel(which I requested), they did not do their due diligence to follow up with booking.com and I had to pay from my pocket for breakfast. 

Also, on the 2nd day some of my belongings were missing from the room and I informed the reception. The staff also did not cooperate, they said that they will look into it and get back to me, this kept going daily until I checked out. After that the employee's response that day was you're checking out there's nothing we can do now.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Faultless customer service
text:
Stayed 2 nights over very hot weekend. B&B rate worked best for us. The buffet breakfast was amazing but 25 euro as an add on would be steep even in expensive Paris.

But the best thing about this hotel is their service. We checked out but left our luggae there all day. When we returned to collect at 4.00 pm they offered all our party the use of the spa to freshen up before we travelled home. Nice touch and very much appreciated.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Just What We Needed
text: The room was very comfortable. The staff was very professional and helpful. We were given to use an additional plug adaptor since we didn't bring enough for our stay. Our room was over the front door so we had a view of the street. We kept our windows closed due to the heat so we didn't hear any street sounds. We were on the fifth floor so we usually took the elevator up and we walked down for exercise. Two small elevators are in this hotel beside each other so if there was a wait it was minimal. This hotel was very convenient within 5 minutes walking distance to  grocery stores, church, Metro and pharmacies. We would return to this location.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great room
text: Generous size, very comfortable bed, good shower, lots of counter space in bathroom, good climate control. Everything about the room was excellent. The breakfast offered was prohibitively expensive and the hotel doesn't have its own restaurant, which were negatives. Be warned that the streets around the hotel are currently torn up with construction and are challenging to walk on, whether to the Metro or elsewhere.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Fantastic!
text:
There are numerous hotels upon which you may lay your head for a good night's sleep, but if you're in the area, choose this place.  It's right near the Champs-Elysees, so its placement in the city is perfect.  The rooms are spacious, well kept, with all the amenities one would need.  While the dining area only serves breakfast, there are many places near by to have lunch or dinner.  The service is exceptional (and they do speak English).  We were warned to be aware of pick pockets, as they apparently are numerous and talented.  We  had no problems, but if you stay and go anywhere in Paris, be careful.  Just sayin'
I can't say enough about this place.  My only disappointment is that we stayed here for just one night before returning home to the U.S.  It was our last point of interest on a tour we had of Paris and vicinity.  If we return, however, I'll be sure to book here again.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Very good superbly located well run hotel - no complaints !
text: We were really impressed with this 4 star hotel. The location is absolutely superb, we walked most everywhere from the hotel, with the odd taxi thrown in. It's spotlessly clean, has a spacious and welcoming Reception and concierge, helpful, friendly, English-speaking staff, and it's quiet, despite its central location. Our suite - 207- was larger than expected, well laid out, with all the amenities we needed. We looked out on to the courtyard, and had a whole 2 walls of full length, fully opening windows, which is pretty unusual. The two rooms were large and clean and stylish, and the bathroom was well lit, modern, clean, and had lovely toiletries. which the staff were very generous with. Breakfast was also generous and delicious with a choice of hot and cold items, and lots of juices, things for children, teas, coffees and so on. All served by friendly, happy staff. I cannot recommend this hotel enough - it's very good for the price.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Great location and service
text: Hotel Rochester is in a very good location and it has good value. Nice room, very good breakfast and service. And also good service in all the hotel.  Great concierge service also.  Would definitely come back.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent, well situated hotel
text: We booked the hotel with our Eurostar tickets and were very impressed.  The staff are very welcoming and couldn't have done more for us.  The lobby and dining room are spotless and very comfortable.  The room was spacious and the 'quadruple' room plenty big enough for us and our two teenagers.  The toiletries provided, coffee and tea, bed linen and furnishings were all of a very high standard. We particularly enjoyed the view of the (top of the) Eiffel Tower, from our room. The situation is excellent, just minutes away from the Champs Elysee, right next to a Metro stop and there are plenty of good and affordable,  bars and restaurants to eat at in the local vicinity.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Lovely hotel, service not up to 4 star standard
text:
We stayed with a party of 5 in 2 rooms. Hotel was nice, rooms were a good size, clean etc. Only issue was concierge service. Simple requests like a taxi to the airport were difficult. No initiative. We also had difficulties with booking tours and car requests. When we asked to be called with updates on availability, no calls were ever received. We missed opportunities for Louvre tour due to lack of and/or delay in responsiveness. 

Location was great, I guess that’s what we were paying for.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Heart of Champs-Elysees.
text:
Location is wonderful. Centrally located on the Champs-Elysees.
 We could walk to the Seine, all the shops and restaurants, the Jardin and the Arche.  Multitudes of sidewalk cafes, and short metro rides to anywhere in Paris. The breakfast at the hotel was excellent, and the evening bartenders were fun. The rooms are comfortable, and large enough, but, still, hotel rooms. The staff was very nice and check out was uneventful.
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Excel hotel with fantastic location - highly recommend
text: We found the staff to be extremely helpful and friendly and professional, and would definitely stay here again whilst in Paris. Rooms were bright, roomy and very clean with lovely products and nice towels, and a big ;bus very comfortable firm beds with easy to use zircon / heating plus a juliette balcony with an differ tower (okay very top) but still view
name: Rochester Champs-Elysees Hotel

title: Fall at Paris
text: Location, location, location. Chic hotel located in a quiet road with access to public transportation and restaurants. If you like to walk, the hotel is located about 30 minutes from the Louvre and 17 minutes from the Pantheon. The suite was beautiful decorated with a full bar and 2 options yo make coffee.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Great hotel, extraordinary staff…
text:
Excellent hotel, beautifully decorated. Cleanliness and attention to details is everywhere. Having said that, the best part of our stay here was definitely its staff. They really take customer service to another level (special mention to Daniel)

Merci infinitement!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Excellent Hotel - Recommend To All
text: We visited the Seven Hotel for an anniversary trip to Paris and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The hotel was luxurious and well placed in the city and the staff were very friendly and accommodating - even willing to go above and beyond to make our stay special. Would recommend to all!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Very nice stay in Paris
text: Hotel has a great location, good last-minute deal, everything you need for a perfect stay, but most of all very kind and helpful crew! The surprise for my boyfriend's birthday was very thoughtful. We would love to come back one day!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Amazing!
text: Loved staying at this hotel so much. Booked another one for the next days in Paris, but honestly regret it! I wish I stayed here longer :) If you're thinking about booking it - do it! Thank you for this great time at your hotel!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Overrated
text: This is a four star hotel potentially but it does seem overrated. The rooms are very small like a box. The bathroom does not have its own door that shuts but rather is integrated into the room with a tiny toilet room, sink outside and a glass facade shower. No kettle in room, only coffee machine. The duvet is so thick that it’s too hot to sleep in-spite if the AC in summer. The staff is not particularly hospitable. The room is much better for one than for two given it’s layout and size. It is all very modern and well functioning in terms of the bathroom and room though so that’s a positive. But nothing great overall.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: modern but not practical
text: no closet, safety box in the corner next to the floor, that you have to kneel down to open it and use the flahlight to open it. no space to put things in the wash bassin area. very dangerous and difficult acess to rhe bath top. too expensive for what it is.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful hotel
text:
Biked here based on their TripAdvisor reviews, the hotel is modern,clean,welcoming and run by friendly helpful staff who do their best to ensure your stay is pleasurable.
Our room was light and spacious and spotlessly clean, the breakfast was ample with plenty of offerings,I would have no hesitation in recommending this beautiful hotel to any traveller.
Thank you to all the staff especially the ladies on duty Sunday 21/8 who sorted out taxi to take me to the hospital after having an accident, keep up the great work and look forward to seeing you in the future.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: A beautiful place to stay
text:
Stayed here for 4 nights in June with my partner. Everything was perfect, from the staff, location and the interior.
Our room was beautiful, extremely clean and a good size for a 4 night stay, we were very impressed with the trendy decor of our room and the hotel, the finishing touches and details were excellent. 
The hotel is in the heart of paris and is with in walking distance to everything.
Will definitely stay again if we re visit Paris!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Amazing stay and great staff!
text: We had an amazing experience at the Seven Hotel. The staff was very kind and helpful throughout our stay and always trying to makes us feel like home and providing a custom service: one night it started storming so we decided to stay at the hotel and have dinner there. Even though they offer some options, they also told us that we could order anything we like and they would put a nice table for us at the lobby so we could eat there. Also when we entered the room the first night, there was a handmade note wishing us a good stay and some macaroons… to me those little details make the difference. The day we were leaving, they offered us two small bottles of water for our trip back home. You can see that the staff is paying attention to every detail to make you enjoy from the beginning until the end. The hotel is also super styilsh, all new and cosy, in the heart of Quartier Latin and super close to the Pantheon and the Mouffetard street, where there are lots of bars and restaurants.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: A lovely three night stay
text:
An excellent, new, small boutique hotel. We were initially concerned that the location was a little too far out, but we actually appreciated being away from the main tourist areas and enjoyed walking through various parts of Paris from the hotel. There are also a few different metro stops near by, should you prefer this to walking.

We had a Superior room for our 3 night stay. This was quite small, but perfectly functional and very tastefully decorated. The shower was great! It was lovely to have coffee making facilities in the room and fresh coffee pods and biscuits re-stocked each day. (I would note that the hanging facilities for clothes were limited to a small rail, which had a drawer at underneath so you could not hang full length items at full length.)

We thought there was a bar at this hotel, however this isn’t quite the case. The small area, described by staff as the ‘sitting room’, is multi-functional. It is used for breakfast, general seating in the day and can be used for a drink at night. The area does not have a bar, but staff from the 24hr reception can serve beer, wine etc here, should you want a quiet drink.

The service we received from the staff during our stay was excellent.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Lovely, lovely, lovely
text: Overall an excellent place for a visit to Paris. Wonderful staff, breakfast, and decoration, reasonably priced and in a good part of town. Major tourist attractions are a bit further depending, but it is walkable to some parts, while others may need to Uber/public transit. This could be said about any Parisian neighborhood, though! I would most definitely stay here again, and would recommend it to anyone.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Wonderful hotel, would really recommend staying here!
text: Such a fantastic hotel including the staff helpfulness, breakfast, room set up, cleanliness, room set up, checkout and check in ease etc. Couldn’t fault the whole experience. Would definitely recommend staying here!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Flawless boutique, AC/stylish/quiet
text: Exceptional boutique hotel.  Flawlessly clean. Stylish, Queen beds & perfectly quiet.  Pleasant staff from reception to housekeeping.  Super safe neighborhood.  Easy walk to Luxembourg garden, cafes & shops.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Excellent experience
text: Fabulous hotel located in a very quiet area but near facilities. 15-minute walk from the Pantheon and 30-minute walk from Notre Dame. Nice staff, very clean rooms, exceptionally comfortable beds and great decor!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Incredible hotel, fantastic team!
text:
Wow wow wow! What a fantastic hotel. Such a lovely boutique hotel with really lovely design features. 

We arrived during a heatwave and our room was lovely and cool with the air con on for our arrival. 

Great location for the Latin quarter and a great base to get around Paris, especially with a scooter and bicycle station right out the front of the hotel. 

The hotel looks brand new and has a wonderful decor. Also very clean! 

The staff were extremely helpful and knowledgeable. They really were so helpful.

Thanks Seven! We’ll most definitely be back next time we’re in Paris!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful hotel
text:
Stayed here for 4 nights, everything from start to finish was amazing. The interior of the hotel is gorgeous and the attention to detail has been thought about well, very nice little touches everywhere. 
We stayed in a double room which was lovely, comfortable and extremely clean.
The location of the hotel is good and not far from the heart of Paris, set in a quiet street which is perfect. 
Staff were friendly and helpful, we really enjoyed staying here and would definitely stay again if we come to Paris!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Excellent hotel
text:
Stayed for 3 nights in this fabulous boutique hotel. Cleanliness was excellent, great decor and the staff were the most attentive I have ever encountered. Even at 2 am they greeted you with a smile and even bought a drink to the room!
It was so refreshing to stay in a hotel who look after their guests. Little welcome gifts left in room for a birthday stay much appreciated. 
Fantastic location and relaxing stay!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Respite from Other Tourists
text:
I agree with another review that “reality was even better”! I couldn’t have captured our stay…….well, better! 
We were hesitant at first mainly because of the location. As luck would have it another hotel we had looked at suddenly booked up and as luck would have it (for  us as it turned out), we booked a room here. We chose one of the “theme” rooms as we wanted more space. First to address the “location” concern. I could not have been more wrong. The location, away from all the tourists, is an amazing neighborhood with the best restaurants in the city. The hotel is few minutes from a well known street where you will find any type of food you could wish- Greek? Japanese? French? Cretan? Italian? Syrian? Check all the above. And more.. ….
Main attractions in Paris are only a handful of stops on the metro. But the service of course is what made our trip. Questions about A/C, solved in .2 seconds! Coffee maker possibly not working? New one in room when you return….  Nothing was a problem. Oh and the space in the suite? Extra large, actually huge. Sofa with  65-inch (?) TV + coffee table, mini bar….. oh and a popcorn machine to reflect movie/art theme! Will definitely return- highly recommend!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Great interior design and lovely staff!
text:
Wow, we didn't expect our stay in Paris to be this pleasant - of course, the pictures showing were great, but in this case, reality was even better!! The interior is stunning, the space extremly well used, the shower was just wonderful, the small balcony so typical french, the windows surprisingly soundproof, and, on top, we received a very warm welcome at the reception desk as well as great service at breakfast (were absolutely everthing not only looked but also tasted good!!). I could go on and on like this!
Thanks to the team - we won't forget our stay at Seven Hotel!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Very nice stay
text: Nice hotel on a good location. Clean and cosy. Some extra space for your cloths and stuff in the bathroom would be perfect. But it was a nice stay with nice people and a very good breakfast. We love to come back.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Great boutique hotel
text: Fabulous staff; beautifully decorated rooms, although quite compact. Ideal location!  We found it easy to walk to all the key tourist attractions and super cosmopolitan food areas.  Staff here were so obliging and welcoming.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Very nice staying
text: Amazing hotel, located very close to the bus station. The breakfast was delicious. The room was quite small for the price paid and a bit noisy, but in the end I enjoyed my stay very much. Would recommend it to anyone!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: A charming parisien hotel with a very central location
text:
The hotel corresponds to the information and photos available online. It is a beautifully decorated and confortable spot, with a proper parisien vibe and with a central and practical location.  
The staff we’re very welcoming and solicitous.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Stylish, clean but very hot!
text: The hotel is newly renovated to an excellent standard with beautiful interior design.  It was also very clean. It is located within walking distance of shops, restaurants and metro stations. The staff are friendly and helped us with recommendations for restaurants etc and the breakfast was very nice. Sadly, the room was uncomfortably hot and after telling several staff members, we told our air con was on the coldest setting (we were told this was 17 degrees!). With the windows open for fresh air, the noise of the main road underneath meant we got hardly sleep at all for the duration of our 3 night stay. It’s a shame to air con didn’t go cooler, if it had done, we would definitely had recommend this hotel.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Fantastic hotel
text: Fantastic hotel situated in a quiet road near Public transport. The hotel is just as beautiful and clean as it looks like at the pictures. The room is a bit small, but has good beds and a beautiful bathroom. Be ware that the shower is behind a glasswall and open into the bedroom. Toilet is behind a door. The staff is very helpful and serviceminded. Wifi is excellent.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Staycation
text: I checked the reviews online before committing my friends and I into booking and all the reviews were excellent. With such excellent reviews it was a perfect reassurance into booking . My overall experience from the receptionist to overall stay FANTASTIC!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Great stay in beautiful hotel
text: A very stylish hotel. Our room was as it described, cosy. We loved it, especially as it had a little balcony. Staff were very friendly and the breakfast was great. Location is great too. I would highly recommend.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Gorgeous Hotel
text: I visited Paris for my birthday and the hotel made it such a special trip!! We had mentioned it was my birthday and I arrived to balloons, flowers and some sweet treats!! It was so thoughtful of them. The hotel is gorgeously decorated, very clean, lovely sized rooms. The gentleman at reception was very helpful and friendly! I would definitely recommend this hotel and return!
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Modern and charming hotel - perfect for a short city trip to Paris
text:
We really enjoyed our stay (no breakfast booked and hence cannot comment on it) for the following reason:
- modern (recently renovated I believe) with a very nice atmosphere both along the hotel as well as inside the rooms
- clean
- easy check-in and check-out
- calm during the night and in the morning
- perfectly located for our plan (either walking towards Notre Dame and further travelling from there or 10min walk through a beautiful market to catch the metro)

We will definitely come back during our city trip to Paris.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Cozy, clean and comfortable
text:
My daughter and I loved our stay at Seven hotel. Room a bit on the smallish side but that is not uncommon for Paris I find. Nice amenities (hello Nespresso maker!) and extremely good bed and bedding. My pre-teen loved that they had Netflix access on the TV. We didn’t have breakfast but it looked very nice. 
Location wise it is OK (my daughter is not a walker) but with the Velib city bikes that was not an issue. Lovely staff and overall good stay. Would book again.
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Lovely hotel
text: Seven Hotel is a great boutique hotel at a nice location with an excellent staff. Very friendly and service-oriented. The room was superior, well-equipped, clean with a very comfortable bed. The shower was great. .
name: Seven Hotel Paris

title: Birthday Trip
text:
We had the most amazing stay! It was one of the most enjoyable hotel experiences I have had. The person on the front desk was so welcoming and helpful. He made sure the taxis knew where we needed to go and gave some good recomendations. 
We were upgraded and the room was beautiful with a lovely balcony and view. 
We will definetly be staying here again when we return to Paris ❤️
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Pleasant hotel for couples!
text: This was a really pleasant hotel. The rooms were clean and modern and the location is excellent, with the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees and Eiffel Tower all within walking distance. The view on the street-side was also nice, a typical French avenue.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Perfect location, great price
text:
It is always a pain to find a good place and hotel in Paris - wether the price is extremely high, or the location is not great.

I found this hotel accidentally. The location is just perfect - 5 minutes walking to Champs-Elysées, same for Dior gallery, same to the river, same to museum of fashion. Louvre and Eiffel tower are also in a walking distance. It's just in the center of everything and it's reasonably priced.

The suites are not big, but it's fair, and, after all, who stays in the suite when they are in Paris? It was very clean and the beds were comfortable.

The breakfast was good, the reception personnel was very kind and helpful.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: A Jewel in Paris
text: The hotel was perfect. A little Jewel in the heart of Paris. Close to everything in walking distance. The staff were all friendly. The room was clean. We were lucky enough to have room 55 with the balconies. Breakfast was ideal for our needs and made well.  Clean charming friendly.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great location. Amazing staff!
text: Loved my stay here, beds were comfy, amazing location. The staff is super friendly and welcoming! Def will stay here again! The view from the balcony was such a good surprise ❤️They even let me charge  my phone at the reception when my charger died 🙈
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Super staff, really helpful
text: It is a great small Hotel very close to Arc de Triomphe. We had a very nice breakfast, the staff was extremly helpful and nice, and the hotel was very clean. We could walk to the Eiffel Tower and reached easily the Louvre with the subway. Our train was leaving from Gare de Nord, it was also easy to reach with public transportation. The room is not very spacious but this is not the first hotel we took in France and it seems there the standard is simply smaller as we are used to in other countries. All together we had a very nice stay and I was especially satisfied with the staff. They helped us with the internet connection and even changed our room as we wanted one with two beds. I can recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Lovely!
text:
I had a wonderful stay in hotel Marceau Champs Elysées. The location was awesome, 2min from Arc the Triomphe and there was a metro station was less than 1min away. 
The staff let me do an early check in, so it was very convenient. The room and the common areas were very clean and the covid-19 measures were respected. 
I would definitely come back again and I recommend it!!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nive boutique place
text: Neat tidy hotel.  It was well finished and very nicely equipped great staff and. service.     Fairly priced which explains why so busy.  great central location. Good wifi bedding decor etc.  What's not to like
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Bijoux hotel in convenient location
text:
The rooms are not huge, but are nice and modern by comparison with most hotels I’ve stayed at in this price range. Excellent value for money and double beds which seem rare in Paris (often twins).
Decent breakfast, clean rooms coupled with a convenient location plus very friendly staff and a ten minute walk to work make this my hotel of choice when I am in Paris.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent
text: The location of the hotel is fantastic, only minutes away from the arc di triomphe and the Senna river and ponte del alma. The rooms in the hotel offer great views of marceauau Avenue and right next to the hotel there are two cafes which I visited and was very satisfied with the food and prices. The hotel is cleaned daily and thoroughly and the cleaners always leave something behind for you to enjoy. The beds are very comfortable. Most of all, I would like to point out Adonnis from the front desk who was very professional and accommodating all throughout our stay.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Small Hotel in a great location
text:
This hotel is in an excellent location if you are going to Paris for tourism.
Near Eifel tower, Champs-Ellyseé, train and metro stations.
Is also easy to find restaurants nearby.
The rooms are not big, but if you want big rooms in Paris you need to pay a lot.
The sleep quality is excellent, because they have special windows and courtains that block sounds and ligths.
Breakfast is simple but good and was included.
If I return to Paris I will choose Hotel Marceau again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Fantastic!
text: Adorable, quaint hotel in prime location. Everything we had planned to do was within several blocks! Verde by yeels, crazy horse, l’oiseau Blanc, Eiffel Tower, Arc du Triomphe. This was a rescheduled trip and the staff were so helpful in rebooking the dates. Great choice!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: AMAZING BOUTIQUE PARISIENNE PARADISE
text: We have just returned from a 3 day break at the Hotel Marceau and it did NOT disappoint.  It isn't much to look at from out the front but once inside it is the most charming parisienne home.  Very homely and welcoming with staff to match.  Every member of staff wa pleasant and accommodating and helpful.  We particularly interacted with the staff in the breakfast room, which is just adorable, small and homely and the food is absolutely perfect.  Not great if you want a hot breakfast as the bacon is more of a ham and the sausage is more of a hot dog sausage.  The pastries, cereals, coffee , juice and cheese and fruit are delicious and it really sets you up for a very long day sightseeing in Paris.  The hotel is around a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and about the same in the opposite direction is the Arc De Triomphe.  Definitely get yourself a 48 hour for the Bato Bus on the river as this is a continuous hop on and hop off tour which stops at 9 different iconic sites.  We paid 29 euros for one adult and one child for 48 hours, brilliant value.  The room was very small and adequate as we only had 2 people in the room.  It was spotlessly clean and the cleaners were very friendly also.   The air conditioning was really good for hot nights.  HUGE thanks to Adonis, the receptionist for being such a great guy, friendly and welcoming and really is an assett to the hotel as we really felt totally at home.  We will definitely return to this hotel, one of the best hotels I've stayed in because of its incredible homely feel.  Bring good footwear because Paris is a sightseeing wonder.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great experience
text:
We had a lovely stay at this property.  The staff was lovely and helpful, especially Ines!!  We arranged for breakfast each morning, which was really great.  The rooms were clean and quiet, bed comfortable.  Great location with proximity to upscale shopping (Louis Vitton, Elie Saab, Dior, etc) Champs Elysees, Eiffel Tower, Metro stops, etc.  

They could use a bit more help in the mornings for check-outs as it seems common that guests need help calling for town cars, Ubers, etc.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Celebrating 50th Birthday
text:
Where do I begin?

When I arrived, I did arrive a bit early, around noon.  The lady behind the desk said she didn’t know if they had a room since “you arrived early”.  I told her I was fine to wait if they could hold my bags and I could go eat and walk around until a room was available. I’m pretty easy, I said and I know that I arrived early.

Throughout the stay, they changed desk people it seemed like every 6 hours.  Some of the staff was great and would help me with my French. Sometimes you would find them sitting in the lobby area talking on their phones and when you asked a question, you could tell their phone call was more important than their guests.

One guy was very nice and even though my French isn’t all that great and his English was like my French, he was always helpful and smiled a lot and would help me with my pronunciation and with giving me direction.

Two other guys, not so much.  When I was leaving, I asked the guy for a taxi and he told me because the taxi service was busy, I needed to go outside with my 3 pieces of luggage and wave one down?

I’m sorry, but that is rude and he wasn’t busy at the time.

You could tell he was mad at me for asking him again and letting him know I’m not going to go outside and walk up and down the sidewalk with 3 suitcases in tow.

The lady from the first night showed up and either her or another guy had found me a taxi. I told the other guy outside that I had asked the man before going to bed was it easy to get a taxi and he said yes. He also could have asked what time I wanted to leave and he could have made arrangements, I found out from the man outside, but that was not offered at all.  

The location was great, but the lack of attention from most of the staff was subpar.  At least there was one person there that made it a little enjoyable!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Wonderful Surprise
text: A truly wonderful surprise. Nearly everything was much better than expected. The rooms and bathrooms were new and very beautifully designed in a very modern way. The rooms looked more like rooms in a 5 star hotel - and this was an especially pleasant surprise in a city like Paris where I have stayed twice before in three star hotels and was shocked to find rooms that looked like hostels elsewhere. The location was excellent - very close to the Champs Elysee and George V in the middle of the city. The hotel was clean, comfortable and is very highly recommended. The only thing that was not beyond our expectations was the breakfast which was regular and simple and similar to other hotels in Paris. All the front desk staff were very friendly and helpful especially Adonis who was extremely warm and seemed happy to give us very useful advice.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Can't beat the location!
text: This is a wonderful old boutique type hotel, with a wonderful location.  A 5 minute walk up the street takes you to the Arc the Triomphe and the Champs d'Elysee, while a 5 minute walk down the street and you are in the heart of the fashion district (or so it would seem!) and at the Seine River.  This time we never needed to take a metro, we just walked.  We stayed on the 4th floor and I was expecting the room to be small based on prior reviews.  That it was, but with beautiful windows that opened onto the street with a Juliette balcony made it fun to watch the 'goings on'!  The bathroom was a good size with some modern upgrades and heated towel rack that we weren't able to figure out how to turn off... so it was hot towels day and night!  The breakfast room was bright, with a great assortment of baked goods, cured meats and cheeses, eggs, juices, coffee and tea, and I sure many other things that I missed.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Location - very nice service !
text: We really enjoyed our stay at Hotel Marceau. We came for the weekend to attand early Monday morning business meeting. The hotel is in great location with walking distanc to the river where you can enjoy everything PAris has to offer.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Another great stay at the Hotel Marceau
text: I love this hotel - I stayed for a  week or so five years ago for work, and was amazed to be recognised by Adonis as I walked in, even after so long.  Hotel is excellent - while the rooms are a little small, they've been designed and stylishly decorated  to make the most of the space available. Very clean, good breakfast in peaceful breakfast room, pleasant  staff - and Adonis, who is so helpful, efficient and charming. The night manager is also very good. Hotel is very well located  between two metro lines, making it very easy to get around Paris.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel- Excellent Location
text: The hotel was in a excellent location for any first time visitors to Paris. The room was very clean and well kept each day we returned from. We really enjoyed our stay and would come back again the next time we are in Paris. The receptions were always friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Golden wedding anniversary
text: Warmly greated by Adonis the hotel manager who advised us throughout our 3 day stay of places to visit and metro advice. Room was modern and clean. Breakfast was plentiful with wide choice of cereals, bread, croissants, fruit or cooked scrambled egg and ham. Would certainly come back again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: The Real Paris Experience
text: We spent 5 days/4 nights in Hotel Marceau. The hotel is, first, greatly located. Avenue Marceau is a calm street, makes you feel the Paris vibe. It is a 5 minutes walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees, a few minutes away from a metro stop as well as a bus stop. As for the hotel itself, the room was spacious enough, very clean and comfortable. Water was always hot for showers, and warm since it was cold outside. The staff were really friendly and helpful. We did not have the breakfast option as we opted to try a different bakery every day, but we heard it was good. The hotel is also surrounded by a pharmacy, supermarket, some bakeries and a tobacco shop, which made everything easier. Definitely recommended!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Perfect boutique hotel in Paris
text: This is a perfect little boutique hotel in Paris. Close to the metro lines, cafes and short walks to the sights of Paris. We love the breakfast room in the morning. Rooms are cosy and beds are very comfortable. I would recommend this hotel to people visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: A Fantastic Stay
text: We had a fantastic stay. A great base for exploring Paris, away from the crowds and noise, and only a short walk to the Eiffel Tower, Champs-Elysées, and River Seine. The room was clean, comfortable and furnished well. Hotel staff were nice and friendly.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel, Excellent service and Good location
text:
It was a great stay at Boutique Hotel Marceau. 
The rooms are a good size, clean and comfortable. And the location was excellent, just walking distance to the Champs-Elysées and many attractions.
The staff and management were very accommodating, making us feel at home.
Adonis was always in a good mood and very helpful. 
I absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone looking to come to Paris.
Loved this place and will come back for sure.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Magnifique
text: 4th visit to this perfectly placed boutique hotel in Paris, booked two standard rooms which were upgraded on arrival to a superior & a delux free off charge ( I guess repeat custom does pay off ) Reception staff are excellent, nothing is too much trouble for them. Rooms were clean on arrival & cleaned every day, breakfast more than adequate to set you on your way to explore this magnificent city. Thanks again guys for another very enjoyable stay, see you again soon.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Honeymoon break, fabulous hotel
text: We had a lovely mini moon here, the hotel upgraded our room and left macaroons for us, lovely touch. They gave us a lovely friendly welcome, all the staff was helpful. The rooms are just as they are on the photos, fresh clean rooms, comfortable beds and a great breakfast. The hotel is in a great quiet location but only a 5 min walk to George V underground on the Champs Eylsees and 15 mins to the Eiffel Tower, it’s a good location to access the sites easily from. We would recommend this hotel
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel, good location
text:
Nice hotel, the hotel looks really nice and well maintained.
Friendly welcome, nice welcome at the reception. 24h open.
Clean room, the room was clean and nicely sized. Good bed and nice shower.
Good location, just around the corner of the Arc de Triopmh.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great value
text:
We've booked this hotel because of the location but the room itself was quite comfortable even if small. But hey you're in Paris, so don't stay inside but go out and explore.
Location is really just perfect, if you have good walking shoes you don't even need to use public transport. 
Breakfast was quite decent and lovely to be included in the price.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Location & Welcoming Staff
text: The property is very well located just five mins walk from Arc of Triumph and Champs Elysees. Room was a bite small but thats what you get in Paris. Special call out to Adonis from reception who went far and beyond to make our stay a wondeful experience!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Tiny rooms, below expectations
text:
The client booked that hotel for me. Given the corporate rate and the website, I was expecting a quaint hotel. When I got there, I realised how wrong I was... 
I was nicely welcomed though by the single staff working there and given my keyI then headed to my room, very small and weirdly set up. Luckily I was travelling alone. But with my wife, it would have been impossible to stay in this room. Opening the window was the first thing that came into my mind. But it was impossible to keep it that way given the noise of the street. So I ended up in that tiny environment. Since I went out for dinner (there is anyway no restaurant at the hotel), and left early the morning after, it was OK. But that was clearly my first and last stay there...
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Quaint lovely stay!
text: This hotel was great for our whole family. Although the rooms are a bit small, we all loved this hotel and were all extremely comfortable there. It is also in a perfect location next to the Champs and Etoile!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Ideal for a business trip
text: This hotel is conveniently located, being close to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysées. Breakfast was just right. Choice of pastries and English breakfast. The staff were extremely helpful and cheerful. The price is definitely competitive. Will definitely be back.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Cozy hotel with a great location.
text: Our stay in Paris was very nice.The hotel has a good location close to Champs-Elysess and the Eiffel tower, clean rooms and a helpful, friendly staff. We would definitely choose to stay in this hotel again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Perfect hotel
text: Our second visit to this hotel and we wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Paris. We stayed for 5 nights and we love this hotel because it is so central and convenient, there is a lovely cafe bar just across the road and lots of lovely restaurants near by. We stayed in a deluxe room, room 22, the room isn’t big but it’s cozy, very clean and has everything you need. The breakfast room is beautiful and peaceful and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The staff on reception are very pleasant and helpful especially Adonis he was very professional, helpful and informative and he couldn’t do enough for us, thank you for making our stay so enjoyable Adonis 👍💋🗼🇫🇷
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent choice
text: Great location, clean rooms with all the amenities, polite and helpful staff at acceptable prices. Hotel next to Champs-Élysées, arc de triumph and Eiffel Tower. Restaurants, cafes and bars of all prices nearby. Unbeatable! We will certainly visit again!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: An amazing weekend in Paris
text:
The hotel has been a fantastic surprise.
The room was nice, romantic and clean.
The hotel personnel was extremely kind. The price is not so high for the place, in the centre of Paris. 
All things have gone in perfect way.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Dirty sheets (not changed) - poor reaction from management - NO TRUST Don't GO THERE
text:
I stayed 2 nights. I worked late the first night,, to discover at 11pm that sheets had not been changed from former customer (corpse shape on Bed, hair), tablets where filthy. Receptionist told me hotel was full so he could not offer me another room (never seen a full booked hotel so quiet). So he gave me new sheets AND I HAD TO CHANGE SHEETS MYSELF... 
Hotel management offered ridiculous 2 breakfast payback and 100 € credit For a 3 stars hotel, there are a lot of better choices around, so stay safe and don't go there
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Little Treat.
text: Wow. This hotel was such a delight. I loved every minute of this place. So clean, modern and has beautiful views. The room was so lovely and really was something special for me and my partner. Couldn't have asked for a better hotel to stay in while visiting Paris. Hotel staff were always so friendly too.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent location
text: This hotel is near the arc of triumph, Champs Elisee and the attention and service from the staff is really good. The room and bathrooms were clean and I definitively recommend this hotel. They do offer breakfast which offers enough options to please almost everyone.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: WHAT A GREAT FIND
text:
We stayed during the cold snap in mid FEB . What a delightful boutique hotel in the centre of Paris . I booked two rooms st the last minutes , we were two couples . Check in was smooth and our rooms ready upon arrival . I called the hotel prior to request rooms be on the same floor and were happy to discover the hotel was obliging. We stayed in a deluxe room , and A superior room . I would definitely recommend upgrading to the deluxe category, just for a little more space .the deluxe room is a corner room with 2 windows that open up . Enough room to fit our luggage and there is a desk and chair as well as kettle , tea coffee making facilities. The staff were wonderful, always willing to assist .allowed us to use the umbrellas on the day it snowed . The location is great very central . So happy I was able to secure 2 rooms at late notice . The breakfast is great , the pastries so fresh , has the usual cereal, juice , fresh fruit , cheeses , yogurt as well as scrambled eggs and sausages and ham . Coffee is percolated , was sufficient. The lift is big enough for 4 people or 2 with luggage . Never had to wait too long to use the lift .
The tv has mainly French or European channels , cnn kept us informed.
There was a great little Spanish tapas restaurant around the corner on BASSANO, amazing and well priced . CASA PACO
We ate across the road st Villa Sofia, very good pasta
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Perfect location for walking distance
text:
