We spent NYE here, perfect walking comfortably to Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triumph, Louvre, local bars and restaurants, cafes, sushi, shopping high street and couture, other hotels, just amazing.  
It is my 3rd time to Paris and this is definitely the best stay.
Hotel room was very small but clean and had good storage for suitcases and clothes so all out of the way. 
The large tall window opened beautifully onto Avenue Marceau, with cafes that opened until late.  Fantastic for late drink or coffee, desserts. 
Only let down is there was no kettle / hot drink service at hotel.  Great job it’s located next to bar cafe across the road. 
The service from Adonis at reception was amazing, he was the sweetest and most passionate receptionist at lobby we have ever met.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Terrible stay, stay elsewhere
text:
Noisiest hotel we have ever stayed in. Walls are paper thin and 4 out of the 6 nights we stayed we had to call concierge to complain. There is no real atmosphere, this is more like a serviced room (no kettle in room, no services available) rather than a hotel. Bedsheets were hardly changed.
What has left the most sour taste with us is that we left some belongings behind and they are saying they haven’t got them. Very strange as I purposely left my coat as I couldn’t fit it in my luggage. Unfortunately we accidentally left a pair of Prada sunglasses and a hat behind, they said they only found the hat which is very odd and we can’t believe is the truth. Clear to say we will not be recommending this hotel nor staying again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent and nice hotel near the Arch of Triumph, Champs Elysées Avenue and quite near of Eiffel Tower
text:
LOCATION:
The hotel is located in Marceau Avenue, 300 m aprox from Champs Elysées Avenue (Nice Commercial Avenue) and around 15 min walking to the Eiffel Tower. Respect to the Metro Lines, you are near the "George V" Station (5 min walking aprox) and:
- 04 stations more you are in "Tuileries" Station near Tuileries Garden and Musée d'Orsay (Art Museum)
- 05 stations, "Musée du Louvre" Station
- 06 stations "Louvre Rivoli" Station, near the Rivoli Avenue, very commercial Avenue in the Center of Paris, near several attractions
From this place you can go walking around 15 min to Notre Dame, also by he metro line, but doing changes

If you are catholic, as me, there is a catholic church "Saint Pierre de Chaillot" besides the "Hotel Marceau Champs Elysées", there are masses in French, English and Spanish in determined days and schedules. 

TAXI:
There is also near a Taxi Station, just few meters, crossing the street from the hotel, so you can get a taxi there by your own to the airport if you need it. You could save around 7 euros, if you take the taxi by your own to the airport. 

The price of the taxi from the hotel to the Airport "Orly" costed 35 euros (03 persons) and 03 little baggage. If you reserve the taxi it could cost around 42 euros. So this information is useful when you arrive to the airport and need a Taxi to go to the hotel.
Please take official Taxis, which has a sign over the car. If the sign is illuminated with green light it means it is available and you can take it.

VISITS OUTSIDE PARIS:
If you want to visit near French cities, out of Paris, you can arrive to the Main Stations as: Gare Saint Lazare, which is located around 5 Stations from "George V" Station (near the Marceau Hotel), but changing the metro line, for instance in "Franklin D. Roosevelt" Station. 

ROOM, BREAKFAST AND PERSONNEL:
I was there with my mom and son - 03 persons. The room was small, very nice and clean. My room was located in the 5th floor in a corner, so we had 02 big windows to see the street from the room.  It was good specially for my mom. No so much space for walking in the room, one of the bed was a sofa-bed, but it was OK. There was a window between the bathroom and the room, however as we are not so tall, it was Ok, I think. 

There were a minibar, and an electric kettle for tea or coffee available. In my opinion it was a quite room. The breakfast was complete and sufficiently varied. Very Good. It is available since 7:00 - 10:00 h if I remember well.

The personnel of the hotel was very nice and helpful.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great little hotel
text:
Stayed here with my wife for three nights during city break. Received very nice welcome and receptionist gave us chat on the location and how to get about using metro lines.
Room was small but compact, well appointed and comfortable ideal for a city break. The toilet/ shower room with glass doors takes a bit of getting used to but as long as your comfortable around room mate no problem. Would recommend to anyone as excellent base to see Paris.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel in great location
text: Lovely little hotel in a very central location about 5 mins walk from both the river and Champs Elysess. Friendly staff, spacious rooms. Good enough for a short trip to Paris. One thing that needs to be said- the toilets dont have fully closed doors, which is very weird and seems a bit unclean.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nice Hotel in a great location
text: Nice cozy room with great linens and a nice view. Nice neighborhood with cute bistros nearby. The staff were friendly, accommodating and helpful. We were able to check in early, borrow umbrellas and leave our baggage (after check out) until we departed on a river cruise. Walking distance to the Champs Elysees and the Metro.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Nice hotel close to Champs Elysee
text: Good hotel, close to Arc de Triumph and Champs Elysee. Did not try breakfast but would go again. Nice rooms, friendly personal ! Ideally located to those places and nice restaurants/bars around . Was lucky to find a parking place close by
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Hotel!
text:
All the staff are friendly, the location is near George V Metro line which connects across the northern bank of the Seine, it's also week within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and and centre of Paris towards the Louvre! 

Had a lovely room, compact,  but all the facilities were there and very clean and well designed.

Breakfast was a nice little continental spread of pastries, bread, cheese, yogurt and fruit.

Would certainly return if we go back to Paris!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Comfortable boutique hotel in a walking distance to the center
text:
Nice clean hotel to stay while in Paris for a few days. Very helpful staff, most of them were speaking Russian. Rooms are quite small, just 11sq m. If traveling alone, this will be a good choice. 
Breakfast is served in a traditional Parisien style with a good variety of croissants. Walking distance to the Tour Eiffel and Champs Elysees street with the Arc de Triumph.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Lovely boutique hotel with friendly staff
text: Enjoyed a lovely few days at the Marceau for a business trip. The manager and the front desk staff were all helpful and charming. The rooms are all immaculately decorated and contain everything you need, including tea and coffee facilities. The breakfast was a large continental selections as well as a small amount of eggs/sausage/bacon. I had a high room which was nice and quiet facing a side street, colleagues who had the rooms overlooking avenue Marceau did not complain of noise and especially liked the rooms with lovely balconies.  Our firm has used this hotel before and we'd definitely go back.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Decent with some flaws
text: I stay here fairly regularly for business. It's a decent hotel, clean, comfortable beds, decent wifi. My only criticism is that the rooms are a little bit small and people walking down the stairs can be quite noisy. Other than that, it's nice!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Between the champs elysees and the eiffel tower
text:
I was amazingly surprise by the proximity of the champs Elysees and the Eiffel tower.
The hotel is really nice, clean, modern and comfortable.
The front desk workers are very friendly and helpful.

I would definitely come back here if I visit Paris again!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Value and style in one property
text: This hotel suited our needs perfectly.  We are a couple in our mid-60s looking for a well-priced but gracious accommodation and we found it at the Marceau.  The reception is welcoming and our room nicely arranged to make the most of the space.  Like many French rooms, it was small, but we never felt cramped.  The breakfast, which generously includes scrambled eggs, cheese, and an unusually varied choice of pastries for a hotel, was served in a charming, bright room -- a great start to the day.  The hotel is a short walk to the ever-useful #1 metro line and also the #9 that takes you to the large department stores and the Opera.  We will definitely return.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Hotel in a handy location!!
text: Nice hotel, we stayed in it for 3 nights 2 couples and were all very happy with everything, breakfast was very good , desk staff very nice, and location very handy for metro, air france buses to airport and short walk to Champs-Elysees, Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel tower, we would use the hotel again definitely ..
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Very good hotel closed to the Champs Elysee
text:
I stayed in this hotel for two nights in February 2017. The room was small but comfortable, with all the necessary for a good stay; the hotel is within walking distance from the Champs Elysee and is a great base to get everywhere by feet.
Absolutely reccommended.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great hotel, would thoroughly recommend.
text: Small "Boutique" style hotel. Exceeded expectations. It's very well located, great for most of the tourist attractions and public transport. The rooms are more compact than a standard size hotel, however the standard to which the rooms have been decorated is great. Bright, clean and fresh. It was a joy to stay here, I just wish I could have stayed longer. The breakfast also exceeded our expectations, in terms of what was on offer. A decent spread for the size of the hotel, all food appeared fresh and tasted good. The staff were also very helpful and offered good customer service. I would not hesitate in booking this hotel again in the future.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: "Wonderful stay."
text: Everything, in a general way, was good. The location next to the Champs-Élysées (on the Arc de Triomphe side) is the main one for me. The room was not very big but very nicely decorated, with an excellent bed. I loved the curtain to cover the bathroom door because when running it made the room very cozy as if it were another window. A good breakfast. If I return to Paris it is for this hotel that I will always!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent location!
text:
Excellent location, close to the principal touristic attractions, the breakfast was included and was more than we were expected, the service was very kind the room was small but you have all that you need
I definitely recommend this hotel
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Ideally situated, within walking distance to most landmarks/attractions. 5 minutes from the Metro on the Champs-Elysees.
Clean room, good overhead rainfall shower, friendly staff. 
I stayed with a friend from 01/12/2016 - 05/12/2016 and it was just what we needed. We spent a lot of time outside the room enjoying the Christmas scenes in Paris so it was good to have a cosy room to retreat to late at night.
No complaints. Would recommend.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Brilliant location
text:
Located less than a 5 minute walk to the Arc De Triomphe and the Champs Elysees makes this hotel perfect location wise. There are also numerous cafes, restaurants, bars, bakeries etc all within walking distance.
The rooms itself are rather compact but well appointed. Comfy beds, good bathroom, and wifi. Breakfast is offered but I preferred to try out the local eateries instead.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent hotel with fantastic service
text: The service was most excellent. Adonis, the reception manager, was so gracious and most helpful - beyond my experience even with some of the 5 star hotels that I have stayed in. The rooms were well appointed and clean. The breakfast was tasty and convenient. We plan to use this hotel next trip back.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Ideal location
text: This hotel is in a perfect location, 5 minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, and a few minutes to shopping, restaurants and metro stations. We booked a standard room and it was pretty tiny but we didn't mind as we didn't spend much time in the room. Helpful staff. Nice breakfast. We would definitely recommend for a not too expensive stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excelent Service, perfect location
text: This is my second time in the Hotel Marceau Champs Elysee, the location is incredible almost three blocks to all the important train services, and it is located in a strategic point between Champs Elysees road, Arc of Triumph and the Eiffel Tower. Breakfast is very good, the rooms are small but incredibly comfortable, the two person's room, is big enough for three persons.  I really enjoy this hotel, and next time I will repeat it without doubt.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Adonis the reception was really great and helpful
text: Tiny and small room but very confortable. Bathroom well equiped. Nice bed. Clean. Nice people. Situation is great. Between Champs Elysee and Alma Bridge. No comment  about the breakfast because I didn't take. Good ratio quality / price...but I got a special discount on the normal fares
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Location - Eat and Shop !!!
text:
Hotel is walking distance from Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees road. It’s brilliantly located as most of the monuments are close by (Not walking distance). Since we were a group of 4, we used to taxi to the monuments like Eiffel Tower / Louvre Museum. Metro station is also walking distance and you can get taxis just outside the hotel. 

The hotel is comfortable if you using to sleep in only. The rooms are small but very clean. We were in the superior rooms which were compact but comfortable. The room had electric kettle and mugs and tea/coffee bags. My suggestion is not to bring big bags as the room can get very crowded and uncomfortable.

 The bathroom was clean but my only grievous was that the partition was not big enough. You had to be careful while having your bath as water would spill over the tub ( By the way some rooms have bathrooms with no bath tub). Basic toiletries are present in the bathroom. Towels are clean and fresh.

Breakfast is basic. Not a big spread. If you are a pure vegetarian, you will have to settle for breads/cheese/cornflakes as the hot dishes consisted of eggs and a non-veg item. 

My initial experience at check-in was not a very pleasant one. I was not happy with the room I had initially been allocated on first floor. I immediately requested staff on duty to change the room.  He asked me to come down to the reception area with my bags . He made me wait and told me that he was going to the room himself to check if I had used the bathroom even though I told him I had not used the bathroom or toilet, as I had just checked in. I found this very insulting and told him so. It was as if he did not trust my words. He gave me some lame excuse but I was very upset. 
I also did not find the staff's attitude and behavior customer oriented. In fact I felt that because I was an Indian, he treated me the way he did. He was not a very friendly staff and did not make us feel welcomed. He was matter of fact and never smiled ( maybe he had a bad day).
I was then allocated room on the fifth floor, which was very nice. 
  
However, even with the initial bad experience at Check in, other staff like Adonis / Sid (or Simon sorry I can't recollect the correct name) at the reception made us feel welcomed and were very polite and helpful. On the day of my departure, the staff on duty Mr. Adonis was good enough to give us late check- out. He was very courteous and friendly.

Over all the hotel is comfortable. It’s basic not luxurious. There is no hotel restaurant. They only serve breakfast at the hotel. All other meals have to be outside the hotel.  There are eating joints like a bagel shop/pretzel coffee shop near the hotel. With Champs Elysees at walking distance, you can't go hungry. The chemist shop is adjacent to the hotel. There is a small grocery shop close by too. All shops barring few eating pubs close early.

Hence Location wise this Hotel is "PERFECT."
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great location, great staff!
text:
We had an excellent 3 night stay at this hotel.  The location is excellent..can't get any better! and the staff were so friendly and helpful.  They printed off for us our boarding passes and online reservation tickets for the museums.  They provided great advice about places to eat, about advance bookings of things.  They held our luggage and gave us a place to freshen up and also reserved many cabs for us.  Each staff member was very helpful and friendly.  
The bed was very comfortable, especially compared to many beds in Europe.  The bathroom was nice.  Wifi was good.  & the location, the best!  
My husband and I would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Overall...great value
text:
Great location
Average quality breakfast
Not comfortable sleep. Every night my skin was itching me from the  washing powder used for linen.
Room very small, bathroom much bigger in terms of size. 
Visited in Jan 2015
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: fairly good, but .......
text:
this hotel could be such a gem - the location, the excellent shower, the very efficient a/c .... however having worked almost 20 years in hotels, one of the key words for a successful operation - and more importantly making sure guests return - is flexibility!!!
I had a 5 nights reservation. Before noon on the fourth day, I announced I had to leave for work reasons.
Hotel decided to charge me the full 5th night rate. Explanation: you should give at least 48 hours advance notice, and all hotels do it. Well no. They don't !!!
If you use that arguement, well then I have to mention that hotels change bedlinen after two nights. Four nights - no change. Vaccum cleaner only after two days.
I can only recommend you avoid this hotel, as the complete lack of flexibility (suggest I pay 50% or 1/3 of the rate) should you be faced with a last minute change in plans ... well tough luck !!!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: 10/10 ..................... Again !
text:
This was our 3rd visit with friends to Paris & the Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees.
Yet again the hotel went out of their way to accommodate our every need.The rooms we requested over 6 months ago were allocated to us on arrival, overlooking our favourite watering hole the Cafe Marceau where we break bread with the locals on a daily basis. ( see Café Marceau review )
The rooms were spacious, clean & well appointed, they even included coffee making facilities & fully stocked mini bar which have been added since our last visit.
Breakfast was a good as ever & a perfect way to start the day before exploring this great city.
Staff are always helpful, attentive & friendly, keep up the great work guys

Regards
Guy Parsons
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great Times
text:
The Hotel Marceau is a great location to stay while you´re in Paris. It is in the city center, right next to Champs Elysées and the Tour Eiffel is close by and can be visited by foot. The room they gave us was great, it was big, very clean and the bathroom was very modern with a walk-in shower. Also the people at the reception were very kind and friendly and helped us with any question we had.
The breakfast was very delicious and we will definitely come here again, the next time we will be in Paris!
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Simple but lovely place to stay
text: We stayed here for 4 days with my husband. Staffs were very accommodating & friendly. Our room was very clean. Location-wise, it is perfect. Walking-distance to Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel, metro & busses, restaurants, etc. Inexpensive and practical hotel rates. Would definitely stay again here when we visit Paris again.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Perfect
text: My wife and I stayed here for a few days whilst traveling from the Middle East to the UK. You just can't skip Paris. This hotel is in a great location near major attractions and metro lines. The staff were wonderful, the facilities were great and the rooms were small but perfect! We loved our stay and would definitely return. Thanks guys and girls.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Won't be returning!
text:
Have stayed at the Marceau many times when visiting Paris but this I am sad to say will be the last.  I visited with my young family and mother. 

Over the past twelve months the rooms have started to look tired.  For example peeling window screens to bathrooms, grout that is discoloured, marks on walls.

Our rooms were next to the breakfast room which didn't cause me a problem on check in as my toddler is always up early!  What I had missed struck at 3am! Everybody who had been in Paris for the nightlife had to pass our rooms!  

I can hear you saying, reader, that's not the hotel's fault.  But it is! Whilst I am not suggesting they plied the guests with copious amounts of alcohol they should have the experience from the past to realise that these rooms are badly affected by noisy guests.

To be fair reception apologised on check out and offered and upgrade on my return, sadly I will not be taking them up on this any time soon.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Smart, intelligent, professionally.
text:
Intelligent designed interior, services and management..

Excellent location.

Simple, outstanding in its class.

Easy parking, quiet, paris at its best.

Light, claen, efficient, cheap.

We will return soon.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Tour de France break
text: We decided to try a different hotel when visiting Paris this year and so pleased we did!  Hotel location is central and only minutes from Champs Elysees and well within walking distance of all the sights too.  Room was very clean, wifi an added bonus, breakfast choice more than ample, staff friendly and available 24hrs a day if needed.  We ate at a restaurant next door (Villa Sophia) one evening which was also very nice.  Will definitely stay here again in the future
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Great location
text: Modern, expensive, tiny rooms, high class location at the center of everything. Nearby, at a walking distance, the subway, the river and many popular sights. No easy connection to wifi, very friendly stuff. Nice place for weekends and honeymoons.
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent hotel in an excellent location
text: This hotel is situated a few hundred yards from the Arc De Triumph and two metro stations.  The staff were welcoming and very professional.  The room was excellent and very modern.  I would recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Paris for a few days
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Euro 2016
text:
Booked last minute - superb hotel for a short stay , very helpfull staff . Room nice and clean, if on the small side, but we were only there for one night. Would stay again definetly.
Thanks for the welcome.

View from our room , we had a meal in the restaurant opposite which was very nice and very busy. The metro was just a short walk from the hotel.
We also walked to the Arch de Triomphe
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Fantastic!!
text: Booked a last minute trip with my partner to go and watch Wales play at the Fanzone in Paris! Our flight landed around 8am we got to the hotel around 9.30, when booking we were told that we wouldn't be able to check in until 3pm, we went alot to the hotel to see if we could leave our bags to which a lovely man on reception gave us our room early with no added cost as he could see we were super tired from travelling, which I thought was a lovely gesture! Room was immaculate, shower was most possibly the BEST one I've ever used! Was perfect for what we needed the hotel for! Great location I would highly recommend! Thank you very much! Xx
name: Hotel Marceau Champs Elysees

title: Excellent choice for families!
text: We travelled to Paris for family holidays and I have to recommend this as the best choice made.  It is clean, quiet, close to train and metro stations, close to restaurants with variety of choices.  The rooms were cleaned every day, fresh towels when requested.  The staff is friendly and provide tips and recommendations.  We definitely stay again in this lovely hotel next time we get to visit Paris again!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great hotel
text: We have spent a night at Hotel du Printemps with a large group and it was just perfect. The hotel is easy to reach, the rooms were nicely furnished and everything was very clean. The staff was friendly and everything was to our complete satisfaction. The breakfast room is a bit small but the service was really quick in cleaning tables for new guests. The breakfast was much more than a typical french breakfast. We would definitely book there again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Clean, quiet, perfect.
text: I booked this hotel because I was looking for an inexpensive hotel in Paris.  As long as you understand that it's small, you'll be more than happy.  The rooms are teeny tiny, but seem all very new, sparkling clean and well appointed.  We had a great view from our window, the front desk staff was very nice, and I'm more than satisfied with this hotel.  The bathroom was also new and sparkling clean.  Free wifi was not enough to stream any movies, but it worked well for checking email, etc.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great service !
text:
Great team, quick response, great room service
Room clean, quiet place , following the covid 19 protection rules perfectly. I can say anymore except it’s gonna be my favorite hotel for my next trip.
Thanks !
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Very nice boutique hotel
text:
This boutique hotel is literally 1 minute walk from the metro station and few minutes walk from Nation area. 

I really loved the warm atmosphere, the cleanliness of the room, the friendly staff and most important the delicious breakfast served in the room. 

I really recommend if for short stays and business trips. 

Nana

@forcedtowork_borntotravel
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great stay
text: Nice hotel with friendly staff and renovated rooms. Very good value for money. A big plus for me was the parking deal they offered (garage parking for 15,- a day, which is a bargain in Paris). Would definitely recommend this place!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Good Value for Paris
text:
Recently spent 9 nights at this hotel. This was a last-minute change from a planned Italian trip, so hadn't done much research before booking. I was in room 11, a standard double/twin room. The hotel has clearly been recently renovated, and to my untrained eye tastefully so.

Room: by Parisian standards, larger than average. I could actually take 3 steps from end of bed to the bathroom entrance, which I have not been able to do in other Parisian hotels. Besides the bed, room had luggage rack, small desk, TV, and closet. There were plenty of electrical outlets. Wifi was fine--fast enough for a hotel and never dropped. TV had many non-French channels to choose from. My room faced the street, but there was effective sound-proofing so no street noise. You will here some internal noise from the hallway from other guests, but nothing out of the ordinary. Room was cleaned, and cleaned well, daily.

Bathroom and shower are what you would expect in Paris (small when compared to some other cities) but functional. Hot water never ran out, shower water pressure was average. They do supply shower items (soap and such) but I did not use any of them. 

Breakfast: You're paying for convenience, but the selection was good--cereal, milk, yogurt, fruit, various breads, croissants and pain au chocolat, eggs that could be boiled, meat and cheese, juice and a coffee machine. It is the same every day, so no variation if you are there for several days.

There was an espresso machine that was available during the rest of the day in the kitchen area, for which there was no cost. This was a nice feature. The small lounge area on the ground floor was inviting.

Front desk staff: friendly, helpful, gave good advice for a local cafe (Le Cosy). There is someone at the desk at all hours. They do add to the friendliness of the place.

Location: You will probably be taking public transport a lot. However, the hotel is located quite close (5-10 minute walk) to a large Metro/RER stop (Nation) and one smaller Metro stop (Picpus). Except for sites on the left bank, you will be a single quick Metro ride away from most  sites using these two stops. As one example, I believe the trip on Metro Line 1 from Nation to either Louvre stop is about 12 minutes. My trip happened to coincide well with the Navigo weekly pass, and I used it extensively. To give you some idea of how much I used  public transit, I used the pass for 33 trips during the week the pass was valid, including out and back to Versailles. 

Getting there: I took the RER B to RER A from CDG to get to the hotel. The connection between these two heading to the hotel from the airport is easy, despite being in the cavernous Chatelet Les Halles station--no stairs, same platform, easiest transfer you'll make while you're in Paris. Don't make the error I did and mistake Rue de Picpus (the wrong street) for Blvd de Picpus. I did some extra walking because of that!

It was raining the morning I was going back to CDG, so I took a taxi. I don't know how easy or difficult the transfer would be between RER A & B if heading back out to the airport.

Neighborhood: seemed much less touristy than central Paris. I was there in March, so low season, but even taking that into consideration it seemed there were more locals/fewer tourists than in more central areas. Plenty of cafes, restaurants, bakeries, shops, and the like located all around, all filled with people speaking French, which I liked.

Overall, I was quite pleased with this hotel. You get much more room for your money here than you do in more centrally-located hotels, and the area felt more authentically Parisian. I would definitely stay there again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A cosy hotel with a friendly atmosphere
text:
I stayed in Paris for 4 days for a conference nearby the hotel. Though the hotel was booked for me by the conference organisers, the room was reserved via 3rd party. 

The hotel is ideally located in zone 1 of Paris with the Metro station "Nation" around 650 meters away (well within walking distance). There are numerous eateries nearby but these seemed a bit overprice for the quality of the food they served.

The hotel room I was given was a twin single bed room, it was a bit on the small side but the spaces within the room was well utilised. The room had a wet room walk-in shower. TV had a wide range of international channels, and WiFi was free with the hotel room booking. 

The breakfast costs 9.90 euros and to be honest is not worth paying for. It is you usual continental breakfast, very limited choice and something you can get from the supermarket at a fraction of the price. It is not possible to make any teas or coffees in your own room as the idea is that you went to the lobby to buy your drinks and snacks.

There are no facilities for gym and spa nor there are any parking facilities. This makes the hotel at a maximum of 3 stars but the limited amenities the hotel makes a 2 star rating apposite. 

Looking at the costs, for a single room it would cost 80-97 euros, double 100-120 euros and a triple 150 euro upwards. 
There is a small courtyard within the hotel for those who wish to smoke.

On the whole it is a small cosy hotel with a good atmosphere at the lobby/foyer. Appreciate that there is a premium for space, but for what this hotel is worth and the pricing, I would not necessary book this hotel again given the lack of amenities. However on the other hand the close proximity to the zone 1 Metro station makes this hotel ideal for those who wish to stay within the confines of central Paris. For those who are intrepid explores, this hotel may be a little on the expensive side.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: lOVLELY HOTEL
text: I love everything about this hotel. The staff, and at breakfast are so helpful and friendly! The breakfasts. The power shower. The coffee machine. The clean rooms. The neighbourhood. Picotin is our favourite restaurant - highly recommend their burger. The hotel is only 15 mins from Gare Du Nord on the RER so really easy to get around.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Was the right choice
text: We had a great time here in two adjacent rooms.  Spotlessly clean, pretty rooms with windows that open, and well serviced every day.  I was a little concerned 12th might be out of the way, but the neighbourhood was comfortable to walk around in the evening with lots of choices for dinner.  Great access to Nation so transport to both central sights and Disneyland very easy.  Franprix and Pharmacie couple of minutes away for general grocery, medicine items.  Very friendly reception staff available 24 hrs, happy to let us practice our French, themselves having great English and practical advice on how to get around during the strike.  Pretty church nearby and many interesting shops.  Enjoyed our stay here.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: lovely stay
text: Lovely location in a lovely neighborhood not over-populated with tourists and close to the station. The rooms were very clean and well maintained but not so big. The breakfast was a very good large spread. I recommend.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Completely satisfactory
text:
This was a good base; Nation and Picpus were convenient, and it was easy to reach from CDG RER  (but pre-arrival, check the map carefully; the streets aren’t as simple as they look on the map)

Staff were helpful, beds good, room good, breakfast very good; overall good value

The restaurants nearby are a good match for the hotel. It was good to be in a neighbourhood, one that isn't dominated by tourism.

Recommended.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great little hotel
text: While the rooms are quite small... they are clean and nicely decorated. My window looks out onto a canopy of trees and a row of beautiful historic buildings. The hotel is very close to “Nation” and “Picpus” metro stations which is very convenient. There are many grocery stores and restaurants in this area. It is fairly residential so not touristy at all. The staff are very helpful and there is a nice breakfast. I will likely stay here again sometime.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Excellent location
text:
Clean, comfortable and welcoming, but more importantly - very well placed! There's easy access to the metro and the trains, making it simple to get to Disneyland, the Eiffel Tower or pretty much anywhere in Paris. 

The breakfast was a really nice spread and the staff were very friendly. The room was quite small, but we didn't really spend much time there and the bed was very comfortable. 

There are lots of bars and restaurants around if you want to explore locally.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Comfortable and convenient
text: Comfortable, modern hotel in a quiet area with good transport connections nearby. Room very comfortable if a bit small, as was the shower room. Pleasant staff. Excellent breakfast. Thoroughly recommended.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Lovely stay at Printemps!
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights end of September. Loved this hotel!! 

The rooms are small compared to North American standards but didn’t bother us. The rooms are super clean, nice decor, modern bathroom. Nice hot showers. Comfy beds and great wifi. 

The staff were very friendly both day and night staff and kitchen staff. Spoke great english, as our french is terrible, and they gave us advice on how to get to certain locations. 

The street the hotel is located on is very quiet. And has a very wide sidewalk meaning the cars are further from the buildings. Didn’t hear any street noise what so ever in our room. Very close to the Metro and many places to eat close by. Lovely bakery on the corner with amazing baguettes. 

Staying in this part of the city was a little far from the Eiffel Tower area but easy to get to by train. About 30 minutes. The neighbourhood is very local with not many tourists which is what we liked. You get to see how the locals live. 

This hotel had one of the best breakfast spreads we have ever seen. Fresh fruit, eggs, yogurt, pastries, meats, cheese, fresh juice, tea and a coffee machine that made all kinds of coffees. Fantastic value. Don’t know if this is common in France but haven’t seen this anywhere else. 

I honestly can’t find anything too negative about this hotel other than we could hear people going in and out of their rooms at night a couple of times. Walls seemed a bit thin. 

But would absolutely recommend staying here if you don’t mind being in this area of the city. Thank you Printemps staff for your hard work and friendliness! We would stay here again next time.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Nice Hotel
text: Clean rooms, very nice staff.  Close to the Metro.   Beds were comfortable and the rooms nicely decorated.  Located in a nice neighborhood with tree lined streets.  I would definitely stay there again amd recommend it to everyone.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Don't get the adjoining rooms if you are with very young children
text:
I stayed here with my wife and 6 year old son. 
We stayed for 3 days, checked-out and went to Disney and then came back for another 3 days. 

The good

1. The location is good. 10 minutes walk from Nation station, which is reasonably near Disney and La Vallee outlet. 
2. It's clean and the staff are kind. 
3. The air-conditioning works beautifully. 

The bad. 
1. There is no refrigerator in the room. Though they do give you ice if you ask for it at the front desk. 
2. On the first stay, I stayed in a triple room. When we were leaving, I told them that we would come back, and the front desk confirmed this. They said, you used the upgrade to adjacent rooms. I said, That's strange, my Hotels.com says it's one room. The front desk again said, but it's two rooms, next to one another. I thought, maybe it's two rooms that can be joined by a communicating door. So I left and then came back late. 
We found that the term "adjacent room" meant any room on the same floor (to be fair, it's a small floor), with my rooms being diagonally across from each other. We said that we rented one room. However, the exact wording in the Hotels.com was adjacent rooms. They don't have any which are connected to each other so don't make that mistake. Second, Paris doesn't care that a six year old doesn't need another bed. Regulations state that 3 people cannot stay in a two person room, which I perfectly understand. Therefore, I suggest getting the triple room if you are taking a young child with you. Of course, if you want to sleep in a different room from your wife and kid, then this may be better for you. 
3. The door needs to be locked by the room key from the inside or outside. This means that if I take the key, lock the door and go out to get some bread early in the morning, my wife and kid are either locked in or have to wake up to lock the door. This poses a potentially great hazard, either in case of fire or intrusion. To be fair, not all rooms are like this, but of the 3 I was in, 2 were like this. I suggest that they update the locks in all the rooms. 

The people were nice, the surroundings were nice. It was my mistake that I didn't see the adjoining rooms on reservation, but they should not allow reservations of such rooms to families with one young child.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Hotel Review
text: very nice hotel. Modern room, very clean. Good location and air-conditioned! The breakfast was decent, soft or hard-boiled eggs, cereal, coffee, [cappuccino, etc.] Orange juice, yogurt, etc.  I would use it again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A little Gem in Paris!
text:
The Hotel du Printemps is a great value given the convenient location in Paris.  It is a few blocks to the Arch and subways there will take you anywhere in the city..  Great restaurants and shopping around the area and you don't get gouged like in the more central touristy areas.

Expect smaller rooms typical of most older Europeiean cities.  Micro showers... I am not a big person and I kept turning the water off when I turned around in the shower...  Also minimal toiletries.

The breakfast was nice and has everything you might want to start the day, including a personal pot of coffee.

The staff was exceptional.  Friendly, helpful and very professional.  

One note-  Stairs are at the entry.  Anyone with limited mobility should probably NOT stay at this hotel.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Perfect hotel in amazing neighborhood!
text: Prior to booking our Paris hotel, I did A LOT of research on TA, reading dozens of reviews. I kept coming back to Hotel du Printemps as my top choice and I have zero regrets that this was our hotel for 6 nights. In fact, staying in this lovely hotel in this very quiet French neighborhood in the 12th arrondissement was a highlight of our trip! Even though this hotel is not in central Paris (which turned out to be a benefit), taking the metro to where we wanted to go was never more than 15-20 minutes and frankly was part of what made the experience fun, especially for our two teenagers who enjoyed figuring out the metro system and became our leaders every time we went somewhere. More importantly, I knew that after busy days of touristing, we would need a comfortable and quiet hotel experience, so I booked 2 triple rooms for the 4 of us, and the extra room made a big difference. My daughter and I had our triple room on the 5th floor and our view was amazing! The neighborhood also gets so quiet at night, that we slept with the windows open the first 3 nights until the weather warmed up then we started using the A/C, which was very quiet and worked really well. Paris can get quite warm in July and August, even though we were there in June, sleeping in a cool room is important to me. The front desk people who work here (Loretta,Kevin, Antonio and Wafa) really make you feel very welcomed and like family. All of these young people helped us with different issues and answered our many questions. For example, my father developed a mild case of bronchitis toward the end our stay and Loretta helped him make an appointment to see a doctor. That is personal customer service! We also enjoyed meeting the owners of this fine hotel, Laurent and his lovely wife Collete, both of whom speak excellent English. The owners obviously care deeply about their customers enjoyment and comfort because they have thought of everything! From the well appointed rooms with many outlets, super modern bathrooms with great hot water and good pressure, the soft sheets and very comfortable beds and pillows. Our room didn’t lack anything. Now onto breakfast! We enjoyed their breakfast every morning for several reasons. First, at €9.50 per person, we felt it was a good value. They had available chocolate and regular croissants, fresh banquettes, multiple lovely jams and butter, various meats and cheeses, fresh organic eggs you can boil yourself to get the exact doneness you desire, several cereals, yogurts, Nutella spread, fresh fruit, etc. lots of choices which I appreciated. Then there’s the coffee machine...It must be the Cadillac of coffee machines because it makes some of the best coffee I’ve ever had. Seriously! I’m still missing their coffee machine which is the kind where you pick exactly what you want, push a single button, it grinds the beans fresh and it makes it for you very quickly. It also has a hot chocolate button which the kids loved. The neighborhood is full of restaurant and brasserie options but we ate at Chez Gudule 3 times! They were super nice to us, spoke English and their food and prices were excellent. They have a plat du jour everyday that seemed to run around €12, an excellent value. We were usually the only Americans there, so the whole experience was very French. We wouldn’t have had that if we stayed in central Paris where Americans are everywhere. That is one of MANY reasons why Hotel du Printemps was our #1 choice for Paris and should be yours too!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A cozy stay at a hotel with a great location!
text:
My boyfriend and I recently stayed at this hotel for four nights and we had no complaints! We arrived early in the morning after our flight hoping to just drop off our bags and it was a pleasant surprise that our room was ready ahead of schedule!

The room was quite small but that is to be expected in Europe so that was not an issue. It was cozy and very clean. The location is absolutely wonderful, being near many great restaurants (try Le Cosy and Nona Rita!) and a quick walk to two metro stations.

The breakfast each day was very tasty as well!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Would stay again
text:
Affordable, great location, nice service. Rooms are small but comfortable and clean. Nice modern, updated bathroom. 
I would most definitely stay again. Being close to transportation and food options was a plus. Visit Le Cosy nearby and order the burger and risotto, butternut squash  and scallops dish!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Good location
text: Good location near Nation, a major transport hub, in a nice, tranquil neighbourhood. Staff really friendly and helpful. Spotlessly clean, comfortable bed, good heating/air conditioning, strong WiFi, good TV channels, good breakfast.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Best place to stay in Paris
text: Best place one could stay at in Paris! Amazing warm hospitality, cozy rooms, lovely breakfast well connected to metro Picpus and nation, and buses.. Didn't have transport problem even when we came back very late at night around 12. The staff make you feel so welcome and comfortable.   the shower, beds and room amenities were excellent! Like home away from home ! Highly recommend for both long and short stays! Lots of good eateries and supermarkets nearby as well. The neighborhood is very pretty too.the breakfast in hotel is lovely. Happy that we chose this place, made our visit memorable.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great comfort!
text: We stayed here last October. We’re a family of four and the triple room was perfect for us. Comfortable, clean, well equipped! Market, patisserie, pharmacy, and METRO were located within 5 minutes walking distance. The front desk staff were excellent, friendly,and helpful with directions. We’re planning on going back to Paris this fall and will definitely stay at Hotel du Printemps again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great location
text: A short walk away from Nation station where the Metro and RER are. You can find plenty of bakeries and express supermarkets around the area. There's even a wet market on the weekend! The room is small but it is good enough if you dont have a XXL luggage each and the night staff was fantastic. The weather was cold and kettle was not provided in the room but that's perfectly fine because the receptionist was very willing to help us prepare some hot water every single night we stayed. The only hiccup for my room was a sudden blackout in the morning. We weren't sure why but the building's electricity was working fine. Fortunately it was on our last day of the stay.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Quick holiday in this fine hotel
text: Only stayed at this hotel for a quick two nights, after we left another hotel we were not happy with (separate point). We found this one online kind of last minute and it did the trick at the moment. Positives are the location, the staff are very fast and professional with all requests, and the entire stay had no hiccups. Negatives are the room was smaller than we would have preferred, but oh well. Free wifi worked well and was free, the concierge was helpful, and we enjoyed the breakfast.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Top notch!
text: We had a wonderful time in du Printemps, the room was super clean, the staff were very attentive, breakfast was just great. The location was very easy to get around of the city center. We definitely recommend this hotel to anyone.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Charming and Clean
text:
I loved everything about this hotel, It is charming and comfortable and clean. I also love the location. It is near two metro stations and the neighborhood is quiet. There are a variety of restaurants (Italian, Chinese, Japanese restaurants, etc) and stores (grocery, pharmacy, bakery, etc) near the hotel. 

The staff were also very helpful. Overall, my stay here was incredibly wonderful (I only wish though they had a laundry facility). And when I visit Paris again in the future, I would surely pick this hotel again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Loved everything!
text:
We had a great stay at hotel du printemps. The service, the staff, the room, the food... Definitely returning on our next trip to Paris.
The room had a private bathroom with great quality regarding shower pressure and temperature. It was also very clean.
The room was spacious enough, had a functioning TV, a very comfortable bed and a nice overall temperature. 
A great surprise was their ecological concern: all napkins and tablecloths were recycled paper, the food served on the breakfast was all organic, even the shampoos were bio. 
The breakfast was very good, having croissants, various types of bread, cheeses and hams, eggs, fruit purees, little delicious pains au chocolat... The coofee was also very tasty (rly important to me 😂). 
We chose this specific location because Nation is a very versatile metro station. We were close enough to the centre of Paris and only a 35 min train ride away from Disneyland. 
The neighborhood is quite nice during the day, having supermarkets, restaurants, food trucks, pastries shops, clothing stores, pharmacies... 
On Wednesdays and Saturdays there is a flea market and food market on the big avenue (didn't catch the name, but it's the big one, can't miss it).
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Lovely comfortable hotel
text: Great location for getting in and out of the city. Small rooms but that’s paris. Breakfast was fairly good value and tasty. Cosy reception area. Bathroom was clean and modern. Free use of umbrellas which was useful for bad weather we had during our stay. Would highly recommend.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Fantastic staff, clean, well appointed. Great value! Good location. Non-touristy.
text: My wife and I spent 16 days at this facility in late Sept. We loved it! The staff suggested sites not mentioned in the guidebooks. Nearby restaurants treated us like old friends. The optional breakfast was a good value. The housekeepers kept our room immaculate. The room was small,but very quiet and comfortable. The neighborhood is safe- day or night. The nearby marketplace at Nation Place was very interesting. We took buses and metro trains everywhere we wanted to go. We easily took trains to the Palace of Versailles. We definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Quaint Spot
text: Upon entry into my single room, my first though "omg, this room is tiny".  The single room i stayed in was EXTREMELY small.  Smaller than the room pictured on the site.  I assume this is because I was given the corner room, by the staircase which was arranged differently to accommodate the location.  Once I got over the room,  I figured I need to just accept it.  However, the next morning, I was awakened by noise in the roof, (I was on the 5th floor).  I called downstairs and they said that the guys were in the attic,  conveniently located above my roof, working.  Then the front desk called me a few minutes after and suggested I came downstairs and spend about 10 minutes in the lobby because they will be setting off the fire alarm and it would be better for me to not be in the room.  I was the only one to receive this call.  Other than the small room, noisy day, the staff was tremendously kind and helpful.  They serve breakfast which consists of boiled eggs, croissants, ham, coffee, tea, hot chocolate, butter and a little treat.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Beautiful modern hotel
text: Amazing place to stay. Very modern room with good air conditioning. I had a few problems with my room but they were solved with good customer service in reception. If you are picky like me the breakfast is not worth of money. I really appreciate that everything is organic and the hotel really tries to save environment! If I ever go to Paris again I will defenitely stay in this hotel!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Value for money
text: We stayed at this hotel with 2 small children while on vacation. We were so impressed with the service. The staff made our stay so comfortable. We loved that the hotel is a short walk from the metro station. Lauren was such a fantastic help. We highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A charming boutique hotel in a great neighborhood
text: My husband and I stayed six nights at the Hotel du Printemps and were delighted with the hotel, the staff, and the services offered.  The office staff members were all extremely friendly - helpful with directions, with recommending neighborhood restaurants, and with any questions that we had.   While the guest rooms are small, they are well-equipped with a room safe and a very hot and powerful shower.  We had a room on the fifth floor overlooking the street outside - a lovely view.  Morning breakfast was part of our hotel package - my FAVORITE feature was the commercial machine that made individual cups of coffee, espresso, cappucino, latte, etc. and was self-serve.  There were croissants, pastries, baquettes, and other sliced breads every morning with gourmet fruit spreads, Nutella, butter, cream cheese, etc. along with hams, cheeses, muesli and granola, fresh fruit, fresh eggs with a cooker to boil your own, yogurts, etc.  The area is small, but seemed to work fine most of the time as there is a three hour window of service.  The hotel is a five minute walk from one metro line and less than ten minutes to the Nation metro station, which has multiple metro lines and RER (faster suburb trains that make less stops) lines.  We purchased the Passe Navigo weekly pass and could get anywhere we wanted in less than 30 minutes.  We enjoyed being able to go out to all the tourist areas, but to come back to the neighborhood at night for dinner.  The restaurants catered to the local French people (we were the only English-speaking patrons in each restaurant, but the wait staff always spoke enough English to help us out) - we had some wonderful meals (shout out to Le Picotin and our absolute favorite, Le Millau, plus if you want the best tiramisu on the planet, visit Amalfi just down the street).  On Wednesday and Saturday, there was also a open air market one block away that was delightful.  In addition, there are cafes and boulangeries on every street, a couple of groceries within a couple of blocks, and if you fancy French department stores, Printemps is only a five minute walk away.  We would love to return to Paris and Hotel du Printemps.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Truly recommend this hotel
text: Everything was lovely. Although the hotel was about three miles from the central sites it was a direct and easy ride on the Metro. It cost no more than if it had been a few stops nearer. The room had everything- good shower, curtains that kept the daylight out, sockets well placed, easy lighting, air con that worked - no complaints whatsoever. Breakfast was good - fresh fruit, quality muesli and granola, yogurt, breads, eggs to boil, ham and cheese, unlimited coffee. Staff friendly and helpful. Tea and coffee available free when we returned to the hotel after sightseeing. They also left out the pastries from breakfast and guests could help themselves.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A good deal in Paris.
text: Maybe one of the best hotels we have stayed in this range of price. The location is convenient at two blocks away from Metro Nation that will take you directly almost in every touristic direction. A more cozy and friendly place than any other budget hotel, a friendly service that speaks English and Spanish fluently. The rooms are not that small, bigger than usual Parisian hotel with wardrobe. And a good size bathroom too.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great little hotel
text: We would really recommend this small hotel for its friendly, helpful staff, quiet yet convenient location, just a five minute walk from Nation metro, lovely breakfast, small but clean and newly renovated rooms, luggage room etc etc etc
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Good hotel
text:
We stayed at the hotel in July 2017 for 5 days for our vacation in Paris. The location of the hotel is a little farther form the main attractions of Paris, however it a near to a metro station that makes it  easy to commute to the places of interest. 

The only let down is the size of their rooms . The room has a width of a king size bed that makes it difficult at times as in space contrains . This may be due to high land prices in Paris in general. 

The breakfast spread was good but could have been better . 

The rooms and other utilities were kept clean.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great little hotel for the price but way out of town
text: This is such a lovely little hotel. It was very clean and the staff were friendly. The rooms are small and the bathroom is a challenge (the shower is tiny) but there is plenty of hot water and some toiletries if you need them. The beds are really comfortable and the air conditioning is super. There is a lovely patio area where we had coffee and wine but there aren't any balconies. It isn't very far from two subway stops but it is a fair way out of town so getting anywhere takes some time. All in all excellent value
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: our favourite hotel
text: We have stayed here many times over the past ten years. It's still wonderful. Paris was very hot the weekend we stayed so were delighted our room was properly air conditioned. We love everything about this hotel. The staff, both on reception and at breakfast are so helpful and friendly. The air con! The breakfasts. The power shower. The coffee machine. The clean rooms. The neighbourhood. Picotin is our favourite restaurant - highly recommend their burger. The hotel is only 15 mins from Gare Du Nord on the RER so really easy to get around. It's just perfect! thank you. If only every hotel in the world could be like yours! We'll be back next year!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: A lovely stay
text: I had a great stay here.  It's clean, comfortable, and in a great neighborhood.  It's not near the popular tourist sites but it is close to several train stations so I could get wherever I needed to go quickly.  The staff/customer service was great (on property and online).  I misunderstood the payment/city tax and made several inquiries.  This was completely my fault but they were patient and willing to explain as many times as needed for me to understand.  I'm sure it was annoying to them but they never showed it.  Huge plus.  The breakfast is a bit pricey but I took advantage because of convenience.  They did have a nice selection.  I would love to stay there again.  It's a great little gem.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Perfect Printemps in Paris
text:
I've just spent a wonderful weekend in Paris with my family and it was made all the better for the fact that we stayed at the Printemps. 
My sister found the hotel via the internet and what a find it was. We needed to be close to the Gare de Lyon and the Bercy concert hall so it was perfectly situated near the Place de Nation that has many metro, bus and RER lines running from it. 
From Loretta on the front desk during the day to Kevin at night and the whole team (especially the breakfast ladies who were so friendly and helpful) the welcome was just wonderful. 
Our room was very clean, quiet and comfortable.....not always an easy find in Paris unless you have a massive budget! And the breakfast was fabulous and set us up for the day. 
I can't recommend this hotel enough and I will certainly be going back. 
Well done Loretta and the team you're doing an excellent job!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Very clean hotel. Great service!
text: We stayed on 2 separate occasions. They were very nice. The front desk was always available 24hrs a day. Always answered our questions. English was pretty good overall. Fair warning, the hallways are very small(one person at a time) The rooms are small too. Although, the biggest plus for us was that they were willing to hold out luggage when there was a gap in time between flights so we didn't have to pay for a storage place to hold our luggage! breakfast was 9 eu, so we passed on that, but coffee was always on the house! Would definitely stay again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Truely a wonderful 'Hidden Treasure' steps from Metro, Shops, Restaurants- the REALFRANCE!
text: We are so thrilled we were blessed to stay at this hotel which feels like a home because staff is amazing friendly and helpful. Traveling with my wife and kids from USA and we do not speak any French. No need all staff spoke very good English and eager to help. Loretta, Antonio and Wada all went above and beyond in delivering Exceptional Service everyday. They explained everything from how to hop on Le Metro subway to zip to the Effel Tower- one train- 20 minutes to how to complete the ID Passes for unlimited Metro Train, bus and related public transportation us. A big deal because I'd your picture is not affixed to Unlimited Pass with your name written in the correct place, and you need a photocopy of your Passport- then when you get of train to exit transportation officials audit you and it is $35 Euro fee per person! We did get stopped but thanks to Wada front the hotel front desk making photo copies and helping us construct ID for Unlimited Passes we we in the clear! Others were getting fines! Many others lines of them. Finally breakfasts are lovely, rooms and entire hotel completed renovated maintaining the classic historic feel, water pressure and temperature outstanding (my daughter has very long think hair so water pressure and volume much appreciated, entire hotel immaculently clean and in perfect repair, neighborhood sidewalk is very quiet with little car traffic but lots of foot traffic. Our room #14 had a wonderful view of trees and sidewalk. Lots of sidewalk cafes, restaurants, bars, bakeries! and grocery stores within 30 seconds walk. I appreciated the variety and some we quite inexpensive and others were mid range. I saw no Americans and all local French people and they were very friendly as this is a neighborhood. Great parking right outside hotel on street. Took Metro line at all times of day bouncing between Eiffel Tower to here- and my kids easy did it by themselves. They are 15 years and 14 years boy and girl. Very SAFE and Pleasant.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Excellent Hotel
text: This is a 2 star hotel with 5 star service and features.   Rooms are small but well equipped with terrific air conditioning, fast wifi and even a TV with CNN and other foreign language channels.  The lobby and breakfast area is charming and the staff here are all very nice.   While the furnishings are rustic, they are very new and everything is super clean here.  It's about a 10 minute walk to Nation where there are four Metro lines and RER-A, or a 3 minute walk to Picpus where you find Metro line 6 along  with buses 29 and 56.  The neighborhood is quiet and "normal" with nice people and many shops and restaurants nearby.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Wonderful hotel
text: Stayed 6 nights at this hotel. It's well located between Picpus and Nation metro station which made our travels to many Paris attractions so convenient and easy. There are  many nice restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, cakes and pastries shops around the hotel. We love their small but very nice and cosy lounge area where we can have a coffee and chat about our day. Feel like home. On top of all these, thier front desk staff were very helpful in many ways especially Lorreta. Housekeeping is immaculately clean too. A hotel that makes us feel home away from home!If we ever come back to Paris we will stay at this nice and cosy hotel again. Would highly recommend to any travellers!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Nice, very clean hotel and excellent reception service
text: Just checked in for 2 nights. The hotel location is very good as very near the metro station. Room superbly clean. Very friendly staff especially Loretta for helping us in changing our hotel reservation, a very patient and understanding lady who will sure excel in her scope of duties.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Nice and clean
text: Thuis hotel is Nice andere away from the crowded places. Nevertheless it is near a metrostation so you van easily reach the must sees in Paris . As the breakfast room is rather small you have tot make a reservation  time
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great location, Clean and well appointed.
text: Wonderful hotel, excellent staff. Would stay here again and again. Night staff was super accommodating for our late night gatherings. Rooms were spotless and bed comfortable. Nearby subway and excellent restaurants. The neighborhood was wonderful and so easy to explore we felt just like part of the locals.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Much better than average 2 stars!
text:
We've been staying at this hotel for 3 nights for Easter holidays. Our room was small, but functional,very well mantained and spotless clean. The bathroom was equipped with toiletries and an excellent shower (water pressure was always very good, even on the 5th floor). Breakfast was good, but very busy.
The hotel is located close to two metro stops (Nation and Picpus), which include all of the lines needed for visiting Paris and its surroundings. 
We'll definitely be back!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: We Loved Our Stay Here. Perfect Location and Super Clean and Friendly
text: This was our first trip to Paris and I could not be happier with our stay. As I was on a budget and did not want to screw this up and have my wife upset, I read tons of reviews. I can say without hesitation that this hotel exceeded all my expectations and in a perfect clean and safe location for seeing all the sights. There is a grocery store across the street for wine and cheese and plenty of great restaurants within a 5 minute walk. (I recommend Cafe Cosy and Royal VI Nation)  The rooms look like they're brand new and the beds were very comfortable. It's a 90 second walk to the Picpus Metro Station.(Subway). There is a large Metro Map in the Lobby and the front desk staff showed us everything we needed to know. Breakfast was included in our stay and I loved it, but I learned that it is optional when you book. If you do not include it in your stay, it's 9 euro. The rooms are smaller than us Americans are accustomed to, but that's part of the charm of Paris. Besides, who goes to Paris to sit in a Hotel Room? We met another couple there and stayed 6 nights. The front lobby has tables, a couch and lounge chairs that we used every night to sit and catch up on old times and reflect on what we did that day. Yusef at the front desk was outstanding and made us feel like we were sitting around our own home. He would get us wine glasses and ice. Everything was super clean and everyone treated us like gold. As the power is 220 volts there and different plugs, I took my own adapter, but they do provide adapters for free with a 10 euro deposit. They also have a 110 volt american plug on the wall mount hairdryer base, however, both sides are for the small prong, so you will need to butcher the prong on your hair straightner or buy a 220 volt one. They have an iron and ironing board if you request it. We had a couple conversations with the couple that own the hotel during our stay. They are delightful and you can tell that they strive for providing a quality experience for their guests.  Do not hesitate to book this hotel, you will not regret it. Can't wait to go back!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Great Location, friendly staff
text:
I stayed for 6 night in February. The location is very convenient: outside the center but close to 'Natio'n and 'Picpus' metro stations. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Few mini-markets and restaurants around.

The room was clean, however the room size is Parisian small, so don't expect you will enjoy spacious suite. The bathroom is clean and has the basics.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Short Paris trip
text:
We found the Hotel to be well placed and excellent value. The room was small but perfect and we really enjoyed our stay. 

The staff were pleasant and helpful. The view from our room was enjoyable and facilities clean and provided all we needed.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Above and beyond
text:
We spent 3 nights in this wonderful hotel. The neighborhood (12th arrondissement) is very quiet and safe so it is great for families as well. Furthermore, around the hotel lies several varieties of stores (food, clothes, supermarket) which is quite good for a quick visit. The location is very strategic due to its placement between two metro stations, Nation (lies on the RER A and Line 1 which is one of the primary lines for transport) and Picpus, so travel is not an issue at all.

We used a triple room, and the room itself was very, very spacious (considering Parisian standards!), clean, and the beds were comfortable. There's also a safe box for your personal belongings. Internet connection was fast, and for people who watch TV the choice of channels were quite good (a mixture of french and international news channels). The pictures you see advertised in the hotel website/other users' photos are what you get - and it does not disappoint us. We slept very easily here!

All the staff were extremely helpful, professional, and very understanding. Our special thanks to Fabien, Youssef, Zdravko and Lorretta (plus the caretaker ladies who made our room perfect every night) who made our trip a truly pleasant experience. The staff here embodies the spirit of professional hospitality and possesses the attitude and qualities of people working customer service must have.

Honestly, we could not praise the hotel enough. It should have been a 4 star in our opinion!

If we do return to Paris, we will be sure to return and stay here!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Small but nice
text: The staff is very friendly and is willing to help you. A huge advantage for us was the available parking space for €15 a day instead of €30. The room we had was very small (the bathroom was ok). But it is quiet and clean. Also the metro station is at walking distance. I would come back.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
This is my second review for Hotel du Printemps in 14 months. I have spent a total of 20 nights here and have been VERY happy with my choice! The hotel is modern and very tastefully decorated. The foyer is a comfortable and welcoming space to sit with a drink and the owners have a library of lovely books and current magazines to look through. The staff have always been extremely helpful and are more than happy to speak English with guests (which is a relief when my limited French is exhausted!). On this trip my father (whom I was travelling with) became ill and Loretta was very quick to book an appointment with a local doctor who could speak a little English also. She also helped my dad to construct a statement of his symptoms! Loretta was so kind and helpful, asking every day how Dad was feeling. Camille was also extremely friendly and helpful, making a doctor's appointment for me also when I needed a prescription for some medication I had run out of. All members of staff are very welcoming. The owners are a lovely couple who have a quiet and supportive presence at the hotel during the daytime. The rooms are SPOTLESSLY CLEAN - attended to every day by friendly staff - and the beds are very comfortable; we slept very well. The bathrooms are also SPOTLESS and comfortable in size.
The hotel is located in a clean and quiet family area of Paris with wide footpaths and all of the amenities you need within very easy strolling distance including eateries, post office, supermarkets, pharmacies, doctor, metro stations, bus stations, patisseries and the cleanest laundromat we visited overseas which has a central payment machine so you don't need to worry about having change.
We ate most nights and every morning at Cafe Marco Polo- at the top of the street- because their food is delicious, reasonably priced and the staff there are delightful. We
used Metro Nation (Picpus is a little closer but Nation is a big interchange which means that more metro lines go through it) and it takes just 20 minutes to get into central Paris. It's very convenient.
For me, this hotel is perfect, as is the local area and I HIGHLY recommend it. A big thank you to everyone at Hotel du Printemps.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: There's better choices
text:
The wifi was not working during my stay at this hotel. Rather than have it fixed "tout de suite" the hotel staff seemed to drag their feet and let the issue go on for days. I stayed at the hotel nearly a week and the wifi was broken the entire time.

My room was small and although it included a toilet and shower, it did not include an actual bathroom. The toilet was separated from the bed by a glass partition. The room also lacked a coffee machine.

Breakfast is not included and costs an additional 9 Euros. It seems pricey considering breakfast consisted of bread, pastries, spreads, yogurt and boiled egg.

The hotel is far from the major attractions. So one is forced to take the metro or drive to visit the attractions. I have stayed in Paris many times and there are better choices than this.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Amazing Value in Paris
text:
We booked this hotel, because of its proximity to Disneyland and stayed here before and after visiting Mickey Mouse.

I was quite amazed how comfortable the rooms were, with plenty of space. The staff were also very pleasant, with english speaking employees at the reception that were ready to help.

I must also say that the breakfast was good value, and we really enjoyed it. Definitely would stay here again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Modern, welcoming hotel in great location
text: Lovely modern hotel, with friendly staff and great restaurants within walking distance with Metro close by. Clearly recently renovated, the hotel is situated in a quiet, lovely neighbourhood for a very reasonable price. We stayed only one night but was perfect for a stay in Paris.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Fantastic hotel
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights early August. The hotel is absolutely fantastic. I cannot praise the hotel including the staff enough. The whole hotel, including the rooms are immaculate and clean. The room had air-con and the bathroom appeared almost brand new. The value for money was second to none. This hotel should be a 4* in my opinion, I have stayed in 4* hotels which were not as nice as hotel du Printemps. We did not try the breakfast but I'm sure it would have been lovely. There is always a staff member at reception and they are most helpful with restaurant suggestions and anything else you may need to know. 

Hotel du Printemps is ideally located in a lovely area, close to two metro stations which we used frequently. 

I would not consider staying any where other than this hotel when visiting Paris again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Faultless
text:
We stayed one night here in a family room ( 2 adults and 2 children 7&8) and we loved our stay. The room was just what we needed, big enough and very clean and the bathroom looked brand new. 
Super mention to the staff : Loretta at reception when we arrived and left , Fabien in the night and Mounia at breakfast who were all very friendly and more than ready to help and make sure we had everything we needed. In a professional and discreet way.
The location is very convenient and we had dinner in a charming Italian restaurant a few doors away (Amalfi). 
Would definitely recommend this hotel and come again when in Paris.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Nice stay
text: We stayed 3 nights here. The location was easy to get to at the Picpus metro station. The hotel lists a different metro station to get there but this one seemed closer. There is a small elevator and the rooms are small as well but function for a good nights sleep. They get very dark and the hallways are quiet. The bathrooms were nice and clean. One of the pillows did smell of cigarette smoke despite being smoke free rooms. The breakfast was good. Some of it is not self explanatory but there is a host to help out.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Comfortable, friendly and convenient
text:
We found this hotel to be spotlessly clean with friendly staff. Whilst the size of the room was small, especially so given this was a 'superior double', my wife and I found it adequate and compact with tasteful furniture. Close to Picpus (3min) and Nation (5min) stroll to metro stations. I was impressed when an email was sent asking for any requirements pre visit and survey post visit. One negative is to say we were surprised to find the luggage room was not locked, though I would add all was ok and was thankful for the facility. We did not avail of breakfast.
All said we would most certainly stay at this hotel again and with value for money, cleanliness and easy access to central Paris we would recommend for couples or solo travellers in particular.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: We felt comfortable
text: The hotel is well located (near Gare de Lyon), also few steps to the next métro-station, nice rooms (small but cozy and very clean), friendly staff, good price-performance (90€). On a next Paris trip we would stay there again.
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Excellent little hotel
text: We stayed here with our baby. Really friendly & helpful staff. Quiet and convenient location with easy transport links. Good breakfast with organic food. We would stay here again! The family room was ideal for us. Thanks to staff for being so nice!
name: Hotel du Printemps

title: Very good choice!!
text:
Small hotel, far away from the centre of Paris but this was exactly what we were looking for.
What else we were looking?
