I recommend it to my son &his wife when they go back instead of Hotel Raphael.... loved all the bakeries nearby (especially Smiths).... also found a laundry mat and grocery store nearby...we walked nearly everywhere, took metro to Flea Market & Printemps and RGR to Versailles... BEAUTIFUL city...again HIGHLY recommend to young people, families ( room are small but so what, it’s Paris!)It’s very much a neighborhood feel ... go, enjoy.... THANK YOU hotel staff for a marvelous holiday ❤️
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Quiet hotel. Great staff.
text:
Great little location in the 6th arrondissement. Handy for all the usual 'big' tourist attractions. Booked online so got a pretty good price. The room, just like every other hotel room in Paris, is smaller than expected but it was clean and considerably quieter than other hotels I have previously stayed at.
Hotel staff and front of house service were great. Very helpful and very informative. Their recommendations for local restaurants were spot on. A big thank you to all the staff at the Dauphine.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Never disappoints
text: I stayed at Hotel Dauphine in Feb 2020 and had a beautiful stay. This is my fifth time at the Dauphine and as always I had a beautiful time. This hotel is in a fantastic area. The staff are lovely, particularly Adrian and Najim who are so helpful and friendly. If you're traveling to Paris, you must stay at the Hotel Dauphine.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Unjustifiable laziness
text:
Was at hotel Dauphine last week and I have to admit that the set up is charming. This boutique hotel is well nestled in one of the best night life street of this side of town. Beautifully presented for those who like this kind of places it is at a walking distance of almost everything that is interesting.
This been said, first morning there and due to vivid-19 I asked for breakfast in the room which I got and had and walked out at around 9 am. Came back at 3:30. The room was cleaned but the breakfast tray was still there. I had to call and ask for it’s removal which they did around 6 pm leaving me the dirty cup of coffee. The second morning I left at 8:30. Came back after 4 the room wasn’t cleaned when I asked why they told me that the personnel already left I then complained about not having clean towels the receptionist arranged to get me a couple clean towels to my room. 
Checked out the third day with the dirty dried cup of coffee still on my night stand. The pre check-in was so meticulously done online that we were looking positively forward for this experience. No. We’re not repeating it anytime soon.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Very Very Disappointing
text: Bean meaning to get my pre-Covid travel reviews done.  This hotel was really poor.  It's location spared it from a one star rating.  Have traveled to Paris plenty. This place wasn't well-kept or clean (again, PRE-Covid). Rooms were smaller than the pictures and descriptions would suggest. The staff wasn't helpful AND half the time I simply couldn't find anyone to ask a question. I may be the outlier but this wasn't good - at all. No way I'd go back and no way I'd recommend to anyone.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: My home in Paris!
text: Hotel Dauphine, my home when I visit Paris❤️ So charming and accommodating, in a great location! I think I have stayed there 5 times, and they welcome me like family. Was planning this Dec., but COVID seems to be in my way 😢I highly recommend Hotel Dauphine. A tout a l’heure!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Beware Pictures are Deceiving
text: We booked this hotel for a special occasion directly with the hotel, and told them. We were assured a lovely room. Communication prior to our stay was very good. We were pleased with the location. Our first room was unacceptable. It was dark and dingy, we were offered 2 other rooms which none looked like the pictures on their website. We paid for an upscale room. We paid for breakfast which we were told was a fabulous buffet. The buffet was below average. If you wanted a soft or hard boiled egg you must cook it yourself. There was little variety of cheese, cold cuts , or yogurt. We had a 4 night reservation, and left the hotel after 2 evenings. Another couple left the hotel as well. We checked into another hotel for 50 euros less in the same area. Received a beautiful cheerful room, and breakfast including hot items. There are many. Eajtiful hotels in Paris. I do not recommend staying here.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Wonderful hotel in a perfect location
text:
I have stayed at this lovely hotel many times in the past few years. The location is exactly what I want- close to everything with many shops and restaurants on nearby Rue Buci. The staff at the hotel has always been very pleasant and helpful. I have stayed solo and as a party with several rooms and in all circumstances found the hotel to be delightful and practical. It is clean and nicely decorated with an elevator, good security and WiFi. 
I will stay there anytime I want to be on the Rive Gauche.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: French charm with Paris at your doorstep!
text: I loved my stay here. The location was excellent and the staff always greeted you on your return from sightseeing. My room was charming, with toile de joie wallpaper and wall sconces. The bedroom window overlooked a typically French courtyard, and the piece de resistance was a small window with a view of half of the Eiffel Tower!  For the price I paid I was delighted! If you’re used to modern, minimalist 5-star hotels, the Dauphine is not for you, but it was definitely my cup of tea. It also provided everything a good hotel should provide, a very comfortable bed, clean linen, tea and coffee and a hot shower. I will definitely stay here again if I’m lucky enough to return to Paris.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Great location and friendly staff
text: During our time in Paris last summer we stayed at the Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain.  The location was superb, down the street from Pont Neuf and over the bridge to the Louvre, Notre Dame and other interesting sites.  In the opposite direction, Sorbonne University and within walking distance to the Musee d'Orsay and Eiffel Tower.  My family was jet lagged and the morning after arrival, the hotel staff graciously helped carry up a tray of breakfast items to our rooms.  We would recommend Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Average hotel with an excellent location and staff
text: Location is excellent on rue Dauphine in the 6th arr. Hotel lobby and breakfast room are adequate and rooms & bathrooms very small. The small bar area was only attended by the front desk clerk and not what we envisioned, so we opted to take our nightcap upstairs and had a drink elsewhere the rest of our stay. Staff was lovely and very accommodating when we asked to switch rooms due the noise from the street facing rooms (very popular, fun but noisy bar scene during the weekends). We obtained a very good rate for our dates and felt it a very good value, but the bathrooms/furnishings are a bit tired and could use a refresh. I don't believe we'll stay here again, but if you are looking for basic, no frills accommodations at a low rate, then Hotel Dauphine fits the bill.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Anniversary in Paris
text: We were thrilled with everything about our stay at Hotel Dauphine St. Germain.  The staff treated us very well.  They made great suggestions for "what to see and do". Breakfast was delightful.  The location was fantastic; we walked to museums, shopping and restaurants - 10 minute walk to The Louvre and Notre Dame.  We are looking forward to a return trip to the beautiful city of Paris and another stay at Hotel Dauphine.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Vacation before New Year
text:
Paris  is beautiful. Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain  is beautiful. Dauphine is conveniently located. To the right of the hotel entrance are several blocks of restaurants, bars and cafes for every taste. Two minutes to the left, and in front of you is the embankment of Saint Germain, the Louvre, Notre Dame. Right down to the nearest street, five minutes and you are on St. Germain Boulevard. Here are parisian boutiques, shops and the Latin Quarter is not far off. 
Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain provides a lot of amenities. That are friendly staff, comfort, large room (for Paris), surprisingly large  bathroom. The hotel is very quiet.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Such a charming hotel with great location!
text: Location of Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain is unique! Very quiet and clean standard double rooms. Welcoming, helpful and pleasant staff at the reception desk with interest and care by them and the manager for our stay! It is obvious I would stay there again.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Excellent location, value and hospitality!
text: Wonderful staff, clean efficient room and EXCELLENT location! Centrally located in beautifully quaint small street in St Germaine, within easy  walking distance to many of Paris’ main attractions, cafes, groceries and stunning authentic old town architecture! As in most European rooms, the room and shower are tiny, think single, but the Dauphine was well kept and has a very courteous and helpful staff. Would definitely recommend and stay here again!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Charming hotel well located
text: We really enjoyed our stay at Hotel Dauphine. The hotel has been decorated beautifully and we felt that we had truly had a French experience. The small rooms are bit small if you plan to spend time at the hotel. Better to book one of their larger rooms. But for those out for the day, the location is perfect.Near museums and near a direct metro station to Gare du Nord. Staff very welcoming and helpful. Good and affordable restaurants nearby .
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Quaint hotel.  Great Location. walk to Notre Dame. Lot of cafes and Bakerys. Hotel food good. nice and Clean. Good price
text: We found the location to Be Very Good. walk to a lot of things. Notre Dame the River Walks. Shopping, art, cafes. Good part of town. We stayed two days before we boarded on a River Cruise. close by. may be 6/8 blocks from Eiffel Tower.   We would stay their again when we go.  and would recommend it .it is a Boutique  Hotel. Love it
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: The perfect spot
text: A great place to stay.  We visited during the strikes and without the usual public transport were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go.  There are great restaurants, shopping, and sites all around.  Lots of interesting art galleries. Staff are friendly and always at your service.  The rooms are small, but very French in atmosphere.  Great bathtub and water pressure.   Each room has an electric kettle and tea and coffee.  They arranged transport to and from the airport for me.  Communication using the internet and email before our trip was easy and efficient.  I'd definitely return.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Second stay here.
text: We found the staff very friendly and helpful with taxis, neighborhood advice, help with navigating the city during the strike.  The bed was comfortable, the location is great, and the free breakfast is very nice.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Wonderful weekend a deux!
text: This is a lovely little jewel right in the heart of Paris.  Everything is in walking distance so it is a wonderful location - Notre Dame, Louvre, Marais, Luxembourg . . ..  Streets filled with fun shops and restaurants.  Hotel was small and charming.  Modern bathroom.  Nice room.  Many amenities appreciated by Americans: washcloths, inroom coffee with milk, CNN.  Friendly staff.  Lovely to come back at the end of the day for fruit infused water, coffee, tea, and some goodies set out to enjoy.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Nice hotel in central location
text: We stayed here during the strike and I knew if I could get to the hotel from CDG i’d Be okay. We walked everywhere, but the charming St. Germaine area was just outside the door. There is a small lobby, breakfast room and a bar in the back. There are lots of stairs but also a small elevator. The rooms are decorated with dramatic fabric and the bathrooms are up to date. I recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: LOVE!
text: As usual, this hotel is spot on. A true boutique hotel with excellent service and friendly staff. The bed was comfortable and breakfast had everything I needed to start my day. The hotel is walking distance to both Notre Dame and the Louvre and many lovely restaurants.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Terrible service and follow up
text: Bathroom Tub drain was stuck for first 2 nights.  I informed the staff and it took them two days to fix it.  Then bathroom ceiling started to leak.  They put towels and bucket for falling water but did not do anything else.  Upon my return back to USA, I emailed these issues, they acknowledged and offered 20% discount but never followed up or refunded any amount.  I have stayed in multiple hotels across US and Europe but never experienced this level of poor customer service.  They failed to provide piece of mind since I came back to room to find another problem almost every night.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Perfect Hotel for Tourists
text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain for a week during our recent visit to Paris and we loved it. The staff at the hotel were incredibly friendly, helpful, and polite, the location is ideal for tourists who want to walk the city (we only took the metro one time the whole week). I thought for the price, the room is a great value. I also was really impressed by the cleanliness of the room and the bathroom was spacious by European standards (great water pressure too, which is important!). We only had breakfast one day before our day trip to Versailles and it was delicious and a good value. Close to the Saint-Michel Notre Dame metro stop, lots of restaurants and bars. Check it out!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Great Paris Stay
text: incredible value!  Everything was super clean and front desk/ dining personnel extremely friendly, efficient and aimed to please.  They knew the local restaurants well and had an easy map to guide.  Really could not have been more pleased!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Hotel in the heart of Paris
text: This quaint, small hotel in the heart of Paris is not only ideally located, but it is a value for your money. I have stayed twice now and recommend it to friends. It's location is excellent with all the sites in walking distance and a variety of good restaurants all around. From Gare de Nord it is a simple ride on the metro or an inexpensive taxi ride. The breakfast offered is plentiful with yogurt, eggs, fruit, pastries and more. While coffee and tea are provided, you can order cappuccinos as well. The rooms are small (like all of Paris) but perfectly fine. They are very "old world" in decor which is charming. The rooms with bathtubs have much larger total bathroom space. Room 66 has a view of the Eiffel Tower!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Gracious Staff
text: On our check out on a Sunday morning a new person at the hotel was working the front desk. We told him that our hotel had included breakfast in our room fee. He graciously accepted our word and for this I laud his initiative and courage. The entire staff was friendly and easy to work with. Thank yor for a great stay.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Two day escape in heart of Paris
text: The Hotel Dauphine is very well situated near the lively St Germain area full of restaurants and cafes and close to the Seine and art galleries. It is on a charming small road full of private galleries and interesting boutiques. We appreciated the tea making facilities in our room and the efficient quiet aircon which was essential in this hot August. The room was tiny but clean and had a good bathroom.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Wonderfully located!
text: We loved the fact that the hotel was within walking distance of many of the main tourist attractions. A few metro stops are close by for easy access to other parts of the city.  Also, very central to lots of great restaurants in various price ranges. A very helpful staff as well! We were well taken care of over our week long stay!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Great location and friendly staff.
text: We have stayed at this hotel for several years. The neighborhood of the 6th is ideal for restaurants, art galleries, museums, shopping, parks, and easy metro access. The rooms are clean and cozy. Breakfast is served in a comfortable room with street view. The staff is excellent. Always friendly and helpful. We always feel welcome.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Perfect small hotel
text: This little beauty is perfectly situated for your Parisian adventure. We spent three lovely evenings in this hotel. The room was compact but beautifully decorated with everything a traveller would need.  Quite room with a comfy bed ensured a restful nights sleep. Will definitely return.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Great Place
text: Very nice hotel close to great restaurants, shopping and msjor attractions.  Steps to St. Germain des Pres, the Seine River and Notre Dame caothederal.  Staff was wonderful, very helpful (and all english speaking)  Will definitely return again on my next trip!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: At Home in Paris
text: This is my favorite place to stay in Paris!! It is well located and yet still a neighborhood, relatively quiet but close to the places that I love to wander. Although I want to keep it “mine,” I keep telling friends about it.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Charm and Location
text:
We stayed here for four nights and had a wonderful experience. Lovely room. Size typical of Europe to which we are accustomed.

Clean room and bathroom. Comfortable bed.  

Front desk personnel very nice, especially the young lady that works 7 to 7.  

Perfect location near many restaurants in and shops.

Nice bar with happy hour each evening. 

Okay breakfast. it would be nice to have more than one choice of meat and cheese. 

Would definitely return as well as recommend.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: BE CAREFUL WHEN CHOOSING THIS HOTEL...
text:
My review is long overdue because i have been waiting for the hotel to contact me , unfortunately, they never bothered. 

My friend and I went to visit Paris last Aug. All the reviews about this Hotel are true, it is perfectly situated, the people, particularly the receptionists in all shifts and kitchen crew are very helpful and accommodating, room and bathroom are clean.  Unfortunately, for me and my friend, we had a  terrible experience. 

I bought a very expensive watch and it was stolen inside our hotel room the day before we were headed back home. I accept my mistake that I did not use the safeboxes provided , one beside the bed (which we were not informed about, i didnt know about this until they were trying to blame me for losing the watch inside my room) and the safebox inside the wardrobe cabinet (which was not working, it wouldn't open). Or i did not put it inside my luggages. I , however, hid the watch tucked inside the top shelf of the cabinet. 

When I found out that my watch was missing, i immediately informed the receptionist on duty and the attitude given to me was that they cannot do anything about it especially when  he said he reviewed the cctv and it was only me , my friend and the cleaning lady who went inside our room. Everyone else's attitude was the same way because there was no break in technically and that I didnt use the safe boxes to hide my valuable item. I was expecting the manager to at least see me in person because of the gravity of the situation, unfortunately  it did not happen. They said that It is impossible that the watch was stolen because they trust all the people working for them and this kind of situation has never happened before. They tell me that all hotels, even if i stay in a 5 star hotel, all laws are the same. I didnt put my valuable item inside the lock box provided (which again is not working) then it is my fault.

Just be aware that the policy in this place is "Anything not kept inside the safe is not valuable to you and therefore it is your responsibility if something happens to it"
Having a key to your room does not necessarily mean your belongings are safe. 

I really hope this review will give a warning to all you guys out there looking to book this hotel. It would've been a better experience if management at least responded to any of my follow up emails, but nothing. The moment i stepped outside their hotel, they didn't even bother anymore. If my credit card didn't have what's called a "purchase protection", then my issue would not have been resolved. Maybe they worked my my credit card's insurance, i don't know. but at least they could've responded to me, instead, i was ignored.  

I had to cancel my flight and re book, i had to miss another day at work and i even paid for the extra night i stayed in the hotel. All these just to get ignored . Management didn't even have the courtesy to keep me posted on what is happening and what they are doing from their end. I guess because they were so sure no one from their team would steal from their guests. It basically felt that they only waited for me to leave. 

Let us try to protect our fellow guests from experiencing this kind of treatment and having to experience this situation. Please consider my review when choosing this hotel.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel in Perfect Location
text: This was our first time in Paris and I did a lot of research on which neighborhood and hotel to stay in and we were so happy with our choice!  The Saint Germain neighborhood is a quaint area with cobblestone streets lined with cafes and shops.  The hotel is in the heart of the neighborhood and short 15 minute walks to the Louvre and Notre Dame.  It's a small boutique hotel with a very friendly and helpful staff.  The room makes you feel like you're in old Paris which we loved!  I was pleasantly surprised with the water pressure being amazing which I wasn't sure how it would be in an older building lol!  The room has an antique feel but the bathroom is very modern which is a great mix!  The hotel was very clean and quiet even if there was loud chatter on the streets.  After walking most of Paris and seeing the other neighborhoods, I would definitely recommend the Saint Germain area and this hotel.  It's the perfect little hotel in a perfect neighborhood if you're looking for an authentic Parisian experience!
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Wonderful place!
text: We have stayed here both times we were in Paris!  The second time we brought friends and they loved it too!  It is a wonderful place to stay and the location is fantastic if you want to tour Paris.  It is close to transportation and an easy walk to many of the popular spots in Paris.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Dauphine Saint Germain

title: Fabulous boutique hotel in the middle of everything
text:
We stayed two nights at this hotel that was recommended by a friend who stays here whenever she is in Paris.

The rooms are small, but who goes to Paris to stay in your room? The bathroom was large. We stayed in room 18 on the 2nd floor (in the US that would be the third floor) and our windows overlooked a vibrant brick street with cafes. The Metro is just around the corner. It wasn't that loud and after about 11 pm very quiet. It's a short walk from Notre Dame.

The included breakfast was great with bread, pastries, baguettes, meat, cheese, yogurt etc. If only US hotels could do this.

There is a small, really small one-person lift. There is a gentle and graceful staircase that is wide and easy to use.

I will stay here again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Quality and taste
text: This is our favorite hotel in Paris. Despite the pandemic, the hotel if anything has surpassed its high standards and level of service. All the staff is excellent, but Leo has been very helpful to us over the years.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: I highly recommend this hotel.
text: Well kept up, comfortable room in a great location close to public transportation, Notre Dame and many other standard Paris attractions. . The price was unbeatable. The hotel was very quiet at night and the continental breakfast was great.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Hotel du Levant is EXCELLENT!!
text:
- I stayed at the Hotel du Levant for one (1) week in July 2022 and two (2) weeks in August.
- All of Hotel du Levant's 24x7 staff was very professional, courteous, helpful, and hard working. 
- The daily included "continental" breakfast was excellent. The breakfast staff provided superior service to hotel customers. The selection of food and beverages was both very generous and high quality. 
- The two Hotel du Levant's rooms for this solo traveler were up-to-date and of decent size to handle my one (1) large check-in bag, one (1) carry-on bag, and two (2) backpacks.
- The rooms and bathrooms were up-to-date, super clean, and very well maintained on a daily basis.
- For the hot July & August 2022 Paris weather, the Air Conditioner (AC) system was superior. The room had its own individually controlled thermostat, that allowed me to keep temperatures at a very cool temperature during both days and nights. Superior AC!         
- Hotel du Levant has an a very, very central location in Paris (i.e., "Latin Quarter"  in 5th Arrondisement). 
- Hotel du Levant's location is enhanced by its short and/or moderate walking distances to: 
(a) Two (2) Metro station & one (1) RER station (i.e., Saint-Michel / Notre Dame [Metro / RER] and Cluny-Sorbonne [Metro]); 
(b) Multiple restaurants, patisseries, candy stores, grocery store, pharmacy, etc.; 
(c) Seine River; Shakespeare's Book Store; Place Saint-Michel; Musee de Cluny;  Luxembourg Gardens; Pantheon;  Sorbonne; Ile Saint-Louis; Ile de la Cite; Sainte-Chapelle; Cathedrale Notre-Dame de Paris; Boulevard Saint-Germain (e.g., Cafe de Flore, Les Deux Magot, Brasserie Lipp, Le Precope, Le Jacobine; Relais de L'Entrecote, Musee Eugene Delacroix, etc.), and much more.   
- Hotel du Levant has only one (1) small elevator. It was only during the very "busy" times of the hotel that strained the patience of hotel guests. As the Paris buildings are old, if at all possible, recommend the installation of a second elevator.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location and friendly
text: Great location, quiet, friendly staff. Only one key per room so if one person in asleep you have to wake them up to get in. The breakfast is decent but not great. Just café au lait, no espresso. Rooms are small but this is typical in popular parts of large cities. Overall a very solid place and ok for the price.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Honest family establishment
text: Hotel du Levant has absolutely unbeatable location, it boasts good room size for Paris and mediocre cleaning. Helpful reception and fair breakfast. Price is very fair for the location and service. Would stay again given its proximity to walking everywhere.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A charming hotel
text:
Stayed here in August 2022, a lovely hotel in a great central location surrounded by bars and restaurants, given the location there was no noise at night, though I was on the 4th floor.

I have no hesitation in recommending  Hotel du Levant.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Excellent hotel for a short stay in Paris!
text: Excellent hotel, great location! Just north of the medieval museum, which I highly recommend checking out due to their Lady and the Unicorn tapestries. And just a very short walk to Notre-Dame-de-Paris and the Ile de la Cite. The hotel offered wonderful breakfast as well. My only complaint was that there was a faint high-pitched noise in my room (Chambre 5) seemingly coming from the TV? I imagine it wouldn't be noticeable to everyone.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Our stay at Hotel Du Levant
text: We stayed in late July and  early August 2022 for four nights. We had room 8 on the first (not the ground) floor which had our windows open on to the Rue de la Harpe. We really enjoyed that, and yes there is some noise from the restaurants and street performers but that was not an issue and added to the charm of this lovely hotel in the Latin Quarter. Location Is superb and an easy walk to Notre Dame. Rue de la Harpe in front of hotel has many good restaurants and we tried 2 of them and were very pleased.  We used the metro extensively and the route stops very close nearby got us everywhere we wanted to go. Room was small but well appointed and very comfortable. Breakfast every day was the same, great croissants and good coffee but good luck figuring out how to time egg boiler machine! We loved our stay, no complaints at all.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Very nice hotel in Latin Quarter
text: Located in the Latin Quarter, surrounded by cafes and small shops. The room was clean, relatively roomy for a family of three, and beds were comfortable. Front desk very kind as my spoken french is not that great. Almost forgot to mention hotel has A/C which was greatly appreciated during heat wave. Our stay was too short. Would love to come back for a longer visit someday.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Boutique Hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
True to the boutique hotel in Paris !
Staff is amazing, so caring and upbeat.
 I love the area, all is accessible including Direct RER to The airport.
This is my go to anytime I am in Paris for work or fun!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Superb hotel
text: This was rather coincidental as I was searching for a stay in Paris, I did everything in the last moment and kinda went with it. But it was a very positive surprise: I had a wonderful stay at the hotel, staff are friendly, competent and very helpful. The rooms are very, very clean. I’m quite picky when it comes to the bathroom but found no issues with this hotel whatsoever. Didnt even know that breakfast is included, delish and fresh! I love that the overall place is very clean and tidy, no smoking smell. I have already planned my next stay next month, so I’d be coming back to this hotel.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A nice stay
text: Perfect location. Nice and helpful staff. Quiet and peaceful in the room. Many restaurants nearby. Close to public transportation.  Close to many museums and attractions in Paris. I think it has a good value for money.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Excellent hotel in a great location
text: I stayed here in late May and found the hotel staff very friendly and helpful. The room was clean and looked out on Rue de la Harpe. Good breakfast each day and just a 2-minute walk from Transit. Had a great stay!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Very Accommodating Staff
text: This is the third time we've stayed at the Hotel du Levant.   It is located  in a very convenient (albeit touristy)  area and provides guests  with a nice breakfast at a good price.  Our room, which was on the 5th floor facing the Rue de la Harpe,  was quiet when we shut the windows and drew the drapes.  We had no problems sleeping. The important thing to mention is how great the staff is.  We had  to make some changes and, to say the least, the staff was very accommodating.  We really appreciated their willingness to help us. We will definitely stay there again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Time to go back
text:
Lovely hotel with a history. Nice staff. Great continental breakdast.
My choice when in Paris. Good location for many restaurants, shops, & sightseeing.  Not for tourists who like big elevators & large rooms. Quaint & efficient for savvy travelers.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: An unexpected gem in 'Gyros Alley' ø
text:
Breakfast at Hotel du Lévant.  Such a pleasant surprise: the freshest bread and pastries, boil-it-yourself egg 'tank' , ham, cheeses, fruit, juice, youghurt, cereals.  Great filter coffee. Plus  a sweet, attentive girl serving the breakfast room. 

If you can accept a very small single room, you won't find a better place at 89€ incl. this breakfast - only 3 minutes from the Seine and Notre Dame. 

The single rooms face the interior courtyard, i.e. they are completely quiet at night. Great water pressure, thick towels, all toiletries etc. Airconditioning, minibar and wifi. 
The bed is wide (approx 110 cm), firm mattress. Ample cupboard for clothes, with deep shelves and hangers.
There is a safe in the cupboard for valuables.  I haven't tried it, though. 

Nice cleaning every day. Polite, friendly staff.  Monsieur Léo, the reception manager, runs a very tight ship here. 

IMPORTANT NOTE: the larger rooms face Rue de la Harpe,   infamously known as  one of the top 10 most awful tourist alleys in the city 🤮   I suspect those rooms can be a challenge due to the all night street noise. Perhaps they are sound proof, but then you might risk  cooking odeurs from gyros, raclettes etc. 

Hotel du Lévant is a surprisingly pristine gem in the middle of this morass of unsavoury gyros joints and 'Pirate Candy' vendors. 
I will gladly stay here again. 
#hoteldulevant
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Lovely Paris experience
text:
Hôtel du Levant has old Paris charm, is very clean and comfortable. 
All the staff are efficient, friendly and helpful.  The breakfast has something for everyone.
Thé location can’t be beat - you will be close to Notre Dame and lots of great restaurants while Hôtel du Levant itself is quiet and safe.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Still an excellent hotel
text: I have stayed the hotel previously--in 2018--and I was very pleased with the location, the friendliness of the staff, and the comfort of the room.  All of this remains the same.  The hotel is well situated near many restaurants and near Notre Dame, Blvd Saint Michel, and the Cluny museum.  The staff is very welcoming and accommodating.  Rooms are very comfortable and are very clean.  I will certainly stay here again when in Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Lovely little hotel
text:
Charming hotel in the perfect place.
The hotel is about a block from the RER and metro station giving easy access to CDG and Orly.
Great breakfast included. Tiny elevator. Single room was well appointed, nice bathroom.
No air conditioning, so might be an issue in the summer. Friendly staff. Great bargain for a single room.
Area on Rue de La Harpe has many restaurants.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Professional staff, comfortable accommodations, centrally located!
text: Very pleasant and professional staff, delicious breakfast, comfortable accommodations, competitively priced, centrally located in the 5th arrondisement of Paris within walking distance of major cultural and historical attractions! Highly recommended.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great Hotel Location
text: What a beautiful French hotel. Staff was super nice, breakfast was great with French breads and croissants. The room was nicely appointed and nice size.  Location was convenient however area is quite busy at night.  Lots of cafes and other eateries within walking distant and close to several train and bus stops.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Charming hotel
text:
We really enjoyed the location of the hotel, and its old charming atmosphere. We also enjoyed our spatious room (52) with view over the roof tops, but have a two suggestions to make it even better:

- add a softer matress to the master bed, it is superhard.
- add at least one cosy bedlight in the "childrens" department of the room (with separate beds)

In terms of the breakfast, it was very good, but we have a few suggestions:

- remove the little milk jugs from the class shelf (no one seems to use them anyway) and add coffee mugs instead. We saw so many guests lifting the jugs thinking they were cups.
- add some vegetables to the breakfast buffet, for example tomatoes and/or red pepper.
- encourage the breakfast staff to say good morning and to cheer up a little.
- add some soft bakground music 

Thanks for a lovely visit!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great stay in Paris
text: We had a great stay at our hotel in our 4 days in Paris. Hotel is in a convenient location and super easy to get to the metro. We had two rooms and they were both very comfortable and clean. Front desk staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast was perfect.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Most amazing hotel I've ever stayed at
text: Staff were so friendly and helpful. Breakfast was absolutely outstanding, fresh and delicious. I was in room 35 and view was amazing, felt like I was in a fairytale. The locaiton in the Latin quarter is unreal. Room was immaculate. Decor in hotel and old featres just beautiful. Will definitely be back. Blown away by this hotel.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Just what I needed, when I needed it.
text: The locations just could not be beat.  I hopped off public transportation, centered myself and found the hotel with not much trouble.  My room was clean, comfortable and  the staff was curious and inviting.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Good value for a great location
text: The hotel retains its charm from decades past, while being updated enough to keep us comfortable. The rooms are reached by walking up stairs, so leave your large bags behind. The bathrooms and doorways are small because it is an older building. It is not pretentious, and has a classic Parisian charm about it. The theme is a theatrical one, with some great old photos of thespians in the hall ways. The breakfasts were accommodating and my only problem was with other guests who were being careless with Covid protocols. The location is on a busy tourist street, but everything quiets down eventually. It is ideally located for a weekend in Paris, and I highly reccomend this hotel for their friendly hospitality!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Clean and Convenient
text:
This is a reasonably  comfortable, albeit a little over-priced, family-run hotel ion Rue de l’harpe in the heart of the Latin Quarter in Paris, a short stroll from Place St Michel.   It is not our usual choice of hotel for our frequent visits to Paris (that being the Holiday Inn  Paris Opera - Grands Boulevards) and  we chose it  solely  for  the convenience of being with other family members who had chosen to stay there.
Here’s my views on the hotel:
1.  LOCATION:  The hotel is in the  heart of the Latin Quarter, on the cobblestoned Rue de le Harpe, a short walk from Place Saint-Michel.  The metro and RER station of Saint-Michel Notre-Dame provides very convenient  and direct access to the hotel from Gare du Nord and Aeroport de Paris-Charles de Gaulle.  The hotel is located within walking distance of many major Paris attractions. However, note carefully  that the hotel is located in  a very popular  tourist area full of cafes and restaurants, and  right on  a street with many restaurants.  Whilst this was not an issue in the evenings, we were awoken every morning around 06:00 by the unpleasant  and very loud noise of the rubbish trucks collecting the trash from the commercial properties.  Street-facing rooms are certainly not soundproofed.
2. FACILITIES:  The hotel is a three star hotel and does not offer flash facilities such as pool and gymnasium.  It has a pleasant public are with comfortable seating, information board and library.  The hotel offers a continental breakfast in a pleasant breakfast area.  Breakfast as expected was a traditionally French affair:  a fresh croissant (delicious) and an ‘artisan’ baguette (tough), boiled eggs, ham, cheeses, and cereals.  The coffee was, at best, average.  We had an early departure on our final day in Paris, before breakfast was being served.  Despite the hotel knowing this, we were not offered the packaged breakfast like other guests were.  Wifi is available throughout, though connection speeds were not always great. The hotel occupies four or five floors, but rooms are serviced by one  very small  (almost claustrophobic) and extremely slow elevator; it was quicker and easier to take the stairs. 
3. ROOM:  We chose a superior room (Room 35).  At 215 Euros per night (including local taxes) it was quite expensive for what the room consisted of.  The room wasn’t huge by any means, and quite old-fashioned and quite dated in appearance, though it was clean and the bed was comfortable.  The room overlooked the busy street below, but as mentioned previously was not soundproofed.  If you are looking for ‘quiet’, request a room at the back of the hotel.  The bathroom was clean and fresh, with containers for used towels in line with COVID-safety measures.  Face washers appeared on our last night.  What we did not appreciate were hotel staff entering the room whilst the ‘Do Not Disturb’ sign was in place AND not waiting for a knock to be responded to.  The privacy of hotel guests need to be honoured at all times.
The hotel has some fine points, but there is room for improvement.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Very pleasant stay in a central location
text: The hotel is located very close to the Boulevard St. Michel Metro station. The central areas can all be reached by foot or public transport. The room was nicely decorated and very clean and the breakfast buffet was good too, compared with other French hotels, although it offered a small basket of white bread only (piece of a baguette, tiny croissant and another roll), which is not exactly healthy. But there was yoghurt, fruit, and a boiled egg available too. If room neighbours are noisy, it can be difficult to sleep, since the walls between rooms are thin. Reception staff were very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Wonderful Stay in a Great Location
text: My father and I visited Paris for Thanksgiving and had a great stay at Hotel du Levant. We took the RER B from CDG airport to the St Michel Notre Dame stop and emerged right at the hotel - can’t beat that! The hotel is close to many restaurants (check out Fish La Boissannerie nearby), pharmacy for COVID testing, currency exchange, and of course Notre Dame. The staff were so friendly and very helpful. We stayed in a triple room that allowed us each a bit of privacy, but do keep in mind these rooms are tight (which we expected). Plenty of closet space in the room, though! And the cleaning staff did a phenomenal job each day. The breakfast was great & convenient. Easy walk to everything! We would definitely stay again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: December 2021 at Hotel du Levant
text: Great stay. CLEAN ROOM, nice breakfast, quiet, hospitable management. Everyone at the hotel made my stay enjoyable. I would stay again. I was traveling solo and had a single room which was quite nice.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location. Pretty clean.
text:
I just spent eight nights at L'hotel du Levant. A very good stay. 

Leo, at the front desk, was especially helpful. A warm welcome, helpful tips, always smiling, even a few helpful French lessons. Thanks, Leo! The other staff members are fairly helpful too. Not warm, not cheerful, but helpful. The lone breakfast staffer works hard.

The AC and fan were turned off for the season. Opening the window (mine faced the interior/tiny courtyard) cooled the room and provided fresh air.

Yes, the rooms, bathrooms, and elevator are small as is the breakfast room.  Get used to it, this is Paris. I am 6'3" and managed just fine. I have stayed at nearby hotels that were much more expensive that provided no more room than L'Hotel du Levant. I found the accommodations at this hotel to be more than adequate. 

As described in the other reviews, historic and beautiful Paris surrounds this hotel. Just a great location. An RER B train stop is just minutes away which makes CDG airport trips a breeze. 

I have already made reservations for my next trip. Un grand merci à L'hôtel du levant et Leo.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Good hotel in the centre of Paris
text: We stayed 4 nights at the Hotel Levant. It's a family owned hotel in the middle of the Quartier Latin. The location is unbeatable: 5 min war to Notre Dame, 20 Min to the Louvre etc. The room has been remodeled recently (nice) and was very clean. On the other hand, it was really very small. A small toilet, a tiny shower etc. But it had everything You need. It was how to be expected at such a central location. We had room facing the street which can be loud. But the windows closed very well and shut off the noise almost completely. The only slightly negative point was the breakfast: not much variety at the buffet, and a quite breakfast small room. On Sat/Sun people had to wait outside because the breakfast room was full. But overall it was a good stay, friendly staff and very clean rooms. –– and, by the way, the elevator is also tiny. 2 people barely fit in with one piece of luggage...But this posed no real problem
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Customer service atrocious beyond words
text:
Housekeeping has repeatedly left out items. But their lack of attention to details, while irritating, is actually not my reason for posting this review.

My review is about the woman manning the breakfast table during my first 2 days. I’ve encountered the MOST offensively rude behavior from a hotel staff at Hotel Du Levant. 

First, She refused to acknowledge my presence. I asked her a question and she would either turn her back to me or walk right past me. 

Second, assuming I’m an ignorant American, she also made disparaging comments about me to another hotel guest—in.front.of.me. When I asked her for an espresso after seeing her serve it to another guest (she NEVER offered it to me) she rolled her eyes and berated me in French, again in front of everyone. Her racial and cultural bias towards tourists and foreigners were blatantly and disgustingly on full display and her behavior did not let up during her entire shift. 

No paying customer deserves this type of treatment. My room also looked NOTHING like the photos!

I’d recommend spending your hard-earned American $ elsewhere!

BTW, watch out if Hotel DU L rebuts, makes excuses, or starts the blame game on Trip Advisor. Anything other than an apology would speak even larger volumes about this establishment.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Always a pleasure!
text: Hotel du Levant is our “go-to” hotel in Paris.  The location cannot be beat.  Almost all of Paris’ must-see venues, monuments and activities are within walking distance. With the added benefit of hearing lovely church bells from a nearby cathedral throughout the day.  Très magnifique!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great stay, great price
text: It isn't a 5 star hotel.  But it is clean, has air conditioning, good breakfasts, and pleasant and helpful staff.  It had everything I needed for a short stay.  Close to important sites, close to the Metro, and close to the train to the airport.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Do not hesitate.
text: The hotel is very well located to visit Paris. It's clean and charming. The staff is nice and helpful. I recommend this place without any hesitation, for those who want to visit the center of Paris.**
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Feeling at home in Paris
text: We stayed 4 nights beginning with New Years Eve. Hotel du Levant was a great base of operations to explore and enjoy Paris - museum, restaurants, shopping, jazz. The hotel is well maintained: lobby is cheery with books and umbrellas for guests; hallway carpets feel fresh, bathroom felt new, room heat worked well and we also opened the casement window for fresh air as needed. The staff is friendly and very responsive. A pleasant part of our stay was breakfast, which was included: fresh croissants, pain au chocolat and other breads, meats, cheeses, boil your own fresh eggs, cereals, fruit, tea, and coffee. They replenished the food as needed right up until the end of breakfast, so no worries if you wake up late. We will be back!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: The Quintessential Parisian Boutique Hotel
text:
We absolutely loved this hotel. When in Paris, why would you stay at a big-brand hotel that is mostly the same anywhere in the world? You want to stay in hotel like this! A hotel that was born Parisian and screams "Paris"! 

It is on a quiet, mostly pedestrian side street, but still very close (1 block) to main boulevards. Perfect decor, cute small elevator (or spiral staircase) to your room. The rooms were very clean with daily housekeeping, an in-room safe and AC / heat, and honor bar / fridge in room. As other reviewers point out, Hotel du Levant has an outstanding location. Maybe 2 or 3 minutes walk to St Michel Metro, 5 minutes to Notre Dame (bless it) & St Chapelle, and 11 min walk to the Louvre. There is also a great small grocery store very close by.

Breakfast was great with a good variety, and the gentleman staffing breakfast during our stay was also very friendly. Our group of 5 had 2 rooms, one with 3 twin beds (Triple Room), and the other with 2 twins. Also, the hotel had the foresight to put our rooms right next to each other without us having to ask, so merci beaucoup!

The front desk is at the entrance to the hotel and is always staffed with a helpful & friendly concierge. I think this helps them get to know you and overall it feels more secure. All front desk staff were great (we met at least 5 of them in our 4 day stay), and they were quick to help us with local information and helped to schedule taxi vans on 2 mornings which was very helpful to us especially during the metro strike, special thanks to Julian & Leo for that!

Overall, this is a memorable hotel that is a perfect match for Paris, and makes me want to return to Paris simply so I can stay here again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great for families!
text: We are a family of four and the family quad room was perfect!  Our 12 year old twins got their own beds :).  If you are looking for a chain hotel, look elsewhere. But If you are looking for a cute hotel in an excellent location, this is it.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great Boutique Hotel
text: We have stayed at Hotel du Levant many times over the past 20 years and have never been disappointed.   We love the location and the price is reasonable.  Breakfast room is comfortable and breakfast options satisfying.  The hotel is clean and safe.  The rooms are small but efficient.   The elevator only fits one person.  If you don't want to deal with the elevator request a room on the lower floors and enjoy the walk down the quaint stairway.  We have never had much luck with the restaurants around the hotel.  However, we do enjoy the Bisrto La Departure on the corner of St. Michelle and the Seine.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Perfect Location
text: My son had recommended the Hotel Du Levant to us and he was right on. Nice room , very helpful staff and a wonderful location in the Latin Quarter . Hotel provides a very nice breakfast.  Highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A HAVEN IN CENTRAL PARIS
text: I've been staying here on and off (OK more off than on) for some 25 years. It is the perfect hotel, Central Paris off Bd St Michel/Bd St Germain. A couple of minutes walk from St Michel Metro. It's been run by the same family for 3 generations. Unchanged since I first stayed here back in the 80s. Decor boasts many Theatre photos from the 20s/30s. Very friendly and helpful staff and so convenient for restaurants, bars (the brilliant Monk/Taverne de Cluny just along the road). Have recommended this hotel to friends, as recently as last month, and all have been delighted.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Such a pleasure to come back here!
text:
This was our second visit to the Hôtel du Levant in two years, and we were delighted to see that it continues to meet all the high standards we had experienced before: a warm and helpful staff, a comfortable room, a prime location in the Latin Quarter, and that wonderful, wonderful breakfast.  In making our reservation a few months in advance, we had asked for a topmost floor facing the courtyard, and the hotel came through for us.  In fact, when we checked in, we received the very same room we had enjoyed on our first visit in 2017.  The high floor and the courtyard resulted in a quiet room at all hours of the day and night.  We slept soundly with the window open to enjoy the cool evening air, even in late October.

One distinct advantage of the Hôtel du Levant is that the reception desk is staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  It was a pleasure to go in and out of the hotel, no matter what the hour, and be greeted by a staff member.  We had no issues that required staff assistance during our stay, but it was reassuring to know that someone was always there at the reception desk in the event that we needed something.  A staffed reception desk is also a good security measure, as no one can enter the elevator or the stairs to the guest rooms without passing by a staff member at the reception desk.  

One suggestion we would make to the hotel: it would be helpful to have a grab bar to help guests get in and out of the shower.  Our room had a walk-in shower on a slightly-raised marble platform with no doors, requiring a step up and over the marble to stand inside the shower basin.  After a shower, the basin and all its surrounding marble were slick with water, and there was nothing but the wet wall to hold onto as we stepped out of the basin and down onto the floor.  There was a real danger of slipping, and a grab bar attached to one of the shower walls would have made us feel more secure.  

The shower issue aside, we give this hotel and its staff the highest possible recommendation.  If we are fortunate enough to return to Paris, the Hôtel du Levant will be our first and only choice as our home in Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: All Good but Too Noisy
text: I would have given the du Levant a top rating if it hadn't been for the noisy room environment -- stomping from above, neighbors' voices amplified by the adjoining air shaft, and housekeeping noisily clattering about.  Ironically, noise from the busy street outside was never an issue.  Everything else was just great -- hotel location, front desk staff, lobby, breakfast.  I value a good night's sleep in a tranquil environment and that wasn't possible in my room.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Nice hotel, very good location, great staff
text:
I really found the location of this hotel to be optimal for seeing so many sites of Paris. You're in the Latin Quarater (5th), next to upscale 6th, a walk over the bridge to Notre Dame, then a left down towards the Louvre . . . just choose which way to go and you'll be upon sometimes interesting/historic in no time.  Also, there are quite a few really good restaurants in the area.  The 5th is up &coming with new ones. And coming from CDG, you can take the RER-B - it's a very short walk from the Saint-Michel station to the hotel.

Besides the location, the hotel itself is quaint, cute, and reasonably priced. The breakfast, included!, was very tasty.  I honestly think they served the best croissants! ...and large. Fresh local butter, jams, eggs, etc. Just enough. Great way to start the day. The rooms have a refrigerator/minbar as well a tea/coffee tray. 

The staff was very pleasant and helpful as well.  I had a few requests prior to arriving and they corresponded quickly via email (thanks Leo!) and accommodated to them. On site, they greeted me with smiles as well as helped with a departure issue per SNCF working on train line to CDG.  Out of their way to do so and so appreciated. Hope to see Leo, Gerard & Murielle again!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Very good value
text: I got this hotel for a deep budget price --95 euro/night single with breakfast.  Pluses are  its awesome location for touring central Paris, its nice decoration -- the lobby especially is kept in spotless condition, and my small single was nice enough, clean, well-maintained.  The only negative was the poor soundproofing.  I heard my neighbors more than I liked to.  It wasn't a major nightmare and I was otherwise quite happy with the Hotel du Levant.  But, if noise bothers you, bring earplugs.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel in Latin Quarter
text:
Making a reservation using the internet in another country can be tricky.  But in this case the process was easy, the hotel great and the value wonderful.  I emailed the hotel that I would arrive early, and they provided a place for my luggage.  When I arrived 6 hours early, they allowed me to check into my room but didn't charge extra for the early arrival.  That's customer service!!   
The breakfast is great, I loved cooking my own eggs, and the variety is fine.  I picked up the wrong pitcher and got HOT milk on my cereal, but no big deal.  The desk clerks were excellent, helpful and kind.  
I would totally go back to this hotel again if I am in Paris.  
One small complaint...my room was postage stamp size, but I only used it for sleeping, so no big deal.  
Great Place.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: My Second Visit!
text: This was my second stay at the Hotel du Levant.  The location is right in the heart of the Latin Quarter and very close to the Seine.  Lots of places within walking distance to walk off all of the fresh and delicious offerings in the breakfast buffet.  As always, all of the staff were welcoming and readily available for questions or just to wish you a "Bonjournie" !  Laundry service was a special treat again this year -- prompt and nicely folded and hung.  The price is right for the location and my standard/double room was very comfortable and quiet with a nice window into the courtyard.  I look forward to my next visit to Paris and the Hotel du Levant!  Merci to you all!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A gem of a hotel in the Latin Quarter.
text:
I just love this historic hotel in the Latin Quarter and thoroughly enjoyed my third stay there. It’s in a fantastic location, on a very busy street full of people at all hours, but very quiet once inside. 
As always, the staff on reception were welcoming and helpful. Rooms vary according to price, naturally enough. I had a standard single which was very comfortable, but in the past I’ve had small budget single rooms which, although very small, have also been comfortable. The comfort single I saw was a lovely room, and worth stretching the budget for if possible.
Hotel du Levant offers fantastic value in Paris. Their very reasonable rate includes a good and plentiful breakfast and, joy in joys, a hospitality tray in the room with tea and coffee-making facilities.
If and when I return to my favourite city, I’ll be more than happy to stay at this lovely place for a fourth time.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Perfectly fine; nothing special
text: The location was great, the room was tiny, staff was helpful. I would stay here again. Just don't expect anything very fancy and you'll be fine. Even though it's on a busy street, it wan't very noisy.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Gem near center of Paris
text: Great charm, great included breakfast, inexpensive small single rooms, terrific location near St. Chapelle and Notre Dame.  Located on Rue de L'Harpe in the midst of hundreds of restaurants and charming streets in the Left Bank.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Nice Small Hotel in Great Location
text: Stayed here many years ago, and decided to try it again.  Still a wonderful, small hotel within walking distance of lots of major attractions near the Seine and Notre Dame.  Also very convenient to the train from CDG airport and to the Paris Metro.  Staff were very friendly and helpful, and lots of restaurants nearby.  Would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: My favourite hotel in Paris
text: I have stayed in the Hotel du Levant a number times in recent years which is a recommendation.The hotel is situated in a very convenient location in the St Michel area and is surrounded by many restaurants serving a variety of menus.   My last visit was in July this year and or room was on one of the upper floors and appeared to be newly renovated.   It was very comfortable,spacious and we enjoyed our stay.   To add to the convenience breakfast is served in a very pleasant breakfast room.   Our recent stay was as good as the other visits to this hotel.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Perfect location
text: This hotel is very charming and picturesque. Centrally located to subway, walking distance to Notre Dame and just around the corner from the river. I booked this hotel because there were tons of cafes and places to grab a snack (for example macaroons) all on the same block. Breakfast was blah - but I may be bias as I love a big breakfast (omelette, bacon). If all you need is a croissant, you’ll be happy.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Excellent Hotel Location and Value!
text:
I would highly recommend Hotel du Levant for anyone looking to stay in the Latin Quarter, it's very centrally located. The room had very nice amenities for the price range and was a tremendous value.

On top of the great location and amenities, the staff was absolutely excellent. As American tourists on their first visit to Paris, all members of the staff we experienced were tremendously helpful and went out of their way to provide recommendations, tips, and overall were super helpful.

As an American, the rooms were smaller but that is to be expected in Paris. But everything was great, the air conditioning worked perfectly as we arrived on the hottest day in Paris history.

I had a wonderful stay and again I would recommend this to anyone looking to stay in the Latin Quarter.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Outstanding!
text: I  have  stayed  at  the  Hotel du Levant  many  times  and  without  exception  on  every  visit  I  have  treated  with  a  kindness  that  makes  one  feel  that  they  are  truly  an  important  guest. The  hotel  is  located  in  the  heart  of  the  Latin  Quarter, in  an  area  that  caters  to  all  the  needs  of  a  traveler:  wonderful restaurants, shopping, the  cathedral  of  Notre Dame, and  the  Seine. There  is  easy  and  convenient  access  to  the  Metro. But  it  is  the  staff  at  the  Hotel  du  Levant  that  always  makes  my  stay  memorable. The  rooms  are  always clean  and  tidy, the breakfast  is  good, and  desk  staff  are  always  attentive, personable, and  willing  to  help  in  any  way  they  can.Its  a  cool  place!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A Quaint Hotel
text: The hotel is nice, clean, & centrally located.  Rooms are small with the bathroom facilities split between two rooms.  The elevator is small but it does the job.  The staff was great.  It is located close to Notre Dame & the Louvre.  It is an older hotel but decorated for that age.  Breakfast was very nice & varied.  We needed some clothes cleaned & they were very reasonable.  It is a great place to stay.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Overnight stay with kids
text: Clean and comfortable.  The beds were a little harder than we are used to, but the rooms were extremely clean.  Our room had a big double bed attached to a room with two twins for the kids.  There is not a lot of privacy in the bathroom - things can get uncomfortable.  The beds are within hearing distance of the bathroom - let's just leave that there. There is not a door from one bedroom to the other.  The room had skylights with electric shades on the outside to block out the sun.  The double bedroom had a fridge, electric coffee/tea set, a little table with three chairs, etc.  The bathroom had a double sink and was large for a Paris hotel.  Again, did I mention the room was extremely clean.  The elevator is small - we used the stairs.  No biggie.  The breakfast was plentiful of parisian foods.  The hotel owners were extremely nice and helpful!  We stored our luggage upon arrival and when we checked out.  It was hot outside and they let us sit in the lobby even though we were checked out.  The are is busy with restaurants and across the river from Notre Dame.  I would recommend and I would return. There is a Monoprix grocery store down the road and a 15 minute walk to Jardin of Luxembourg.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Lovely Hotel!
text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Hotel du Levant.  There were four of us, so we had the family room with four beds.  I did not think it was too small but we are used to European hotels.  The room and bathroom were nicely decorated and clean. The elevator was small, so we sent the luggage up with one person and the rest of us walked.  It was fine.

Breakfast was very nice with typical coffee, tea, croissants, meats, cheese and yogurt.  The location was very convenient to the metro stop.  The only complaint I have is that it was very noisy at night since our room faced the street.  Someone was playing the saxophone on the street at 1 in the morning, so even with the windows shut, it was hard to get sleep.  I had to buy some earplugs. It did not bother anyone else in my family.

The wifi was great which was important for our two teenage boys.  If I ever return to Paris, I would be happy to stay here again!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Weekend getaway
text: This was our first visit to Paris. This is a quaint boutique hotel in a great location. The staff is great. Great breakfast of fresh local items, the chocolate croissants and raspberry jam are a must. Even though the street is an active Latin Quarter side street the room was quiet. Will definitely stay again when we visit Paris again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Another wonderful stay at this great hotel
text: We have stayed at this hotel many times, most recently for two week-long stays one in late May and the other just last week. The other five-star reviews have covered just about everything – the wonderful, comfortable rooms, the great breakfasts and, especially the outstanding staff.  There have been a couple of new hires since our last stay, and they are doing a fine job upholding the hotel’s traditions of excellent service. Because our stays were long, we twice used their laundry service, which was splendid and reasonably priced.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location, great hotel!
text: Nice room, loved the AC and fan option in the room.  Having hot water for tea and coffee in the room an added bonus.  Breakfast was the best.  Delicious assortment of croissant, breads, fresh fruits, cheeses, ham, yogurt and granola.  And a hard boiled egg maker.  Inexpensive dining options just outside the hotel.  Easy metro options.  Walk to all the sights in Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A charming little hotel in the Latin quarter
text: This charming little hotel is decorated in a Parisian style. A few minutes' walk from the Notre Dame Church, a metro station and the lively St. Germain street. There are many restaurants, bars, bakeries and many good shops nearby. The hotel is clean and well maintained. Our room was tiny and so was the bathroom and the bathroom. Breakfast is good in Paris and has a variety of pastries, cold cuts and cereals. The service at the hotel is very good, smiling and right to help in any matter. Excellent hotel for those interested in staying in the Latin Quarter.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great stay
text: A great hotel in a fantastic position. Staff very friendly and helpful. Very good breakfast. Rooms may be on the small side, but you are in Paris. Many restaurants close by and metro Saint Michel also close.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great Location
text:
Other trips to Paris, we've stayed in the L'Opera area but decided to go with this more central location this time. Did not regret the choice. This hotel is wonderful for a Paris 3 star. The staff are so friendly and helpful and make you feel at home. The room is the typical small room but very clean and comfortable. The bed was good and the bathroom clean and satisfactory with all required amenities. The wifi in the room was very fast and consistent.
Unlike many Paris hotels, the breakfast is included and very good with fresh farm and bakery products.
We had an interior room which was very quiet so can't comment on whether other rooms are noisy at night. There are certainly loads of restaurants in the area to choose from and it is a quick walk to the river for an evening stroll. Very close to metro and RER which makes it so convenient for getting around.
Really enjoyed our stay here and will repeat for our next trip to Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: The staff are so helpful and the location couldn't be better
text:
The hotel is very close to RER and Metro station, so getting there from CDG airport was relatively easy. Even though we arrived well before our room was ready, we were offered baggage storage, and a late breakfast.
We walked around various parks in the area, watched people playing petanque, had lunch and returned to the hotel where our room was ready and we were able to take the miniscule lift up to our room with our luggage.
All the staff were very helpful and friendly, the breakfast was tasty and plentiful and the breakfast room was charming, as were all the rooms and the hotel. 
But the best feature is the location - there is a terrific choice of restaurants just outside the door, Sainte Chapelle is a short walk away, as is the Cluny Museum, Musée d'Orsay is a longer walk away, and the metro station is nearby so it's easy to get to other parts of Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Return Visit
text: Over the past three decades we have stayed many times at this hotel.  The Hôtel du Levant is a nice little Paris hotel, perfectly situated on left bank just a block from Blvd. St Michel and St. Germain.  Convenient to metro & RER (the RER line serves both Charles de Gaulle CDG & Orly ORY), the hotel is an easy walk to the main Paris attractions. The rooms are not large but perfectly adequate with en-suite bathrooms, tv, tea/coffee maker, and wi-fi. A good continental buffet breakfast is provided.  Hotel staff are always friendly and helpful. Will stay at du Levant on our next visit to Paris.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Location and staff are great!
text: A perfect location right in the heart of Paris. Close to a lot of great sites (Louvre and Notre Dame) plus lots of restaurants and cafes. Rooms were nice and clean and the breakfast in the morning was good to. Staff was also very friendly and answered all questions we had. The value/price was for sure worth it and will return!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: nice hotel in good location
text: We spent there eight night on our family vacation. The hotel is very nice and quite elegant and the room is clean. The room was cleaned and made-up every day. The small breakfast buffet is good and satisfying. The location of the hotel is great, not far from some main attractions, in an area full with restaurants and cafes. The metro station is one minute walk from the hotel. I would recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location in Paris
text: We spent 4 nights here in April and found this to be an excellent location and value.  With a multitude of restaurants just outside the door in the Latin Quarter, we were amazed at how quiet and peaceful our room was.  We chose a “comfort double” and were satisfied with the size.  This location is steps from major sites and the metro, so see Paris from here is a breeze.  The staff were very helpful, and the breakfast was satisfying.  We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location , Clean Room
text: The area where is located is very lively, latin quartier, you find any food you want and also many bars around. However my room was quiet. I really liked to stay here. It was very clean, withall the amenities need it. I recommended. It is strps from cluny station and st michel.great location!
name: Hotel du Levant

title: A really wonderful hotel in the 5th arrondissement
text: On the Left Bank, by Place Saint-Michel, close to the Ile de la Cite. Easy walking to museums, 1 block to Metro stations. Hotel staff, including Leo & Ophelie, were quite helpful. Nice included breakfast room with a good selection. Sitting area in the front of the ground floor to hang out and read. Rooms were comfortable and quiet. Although the neighborhood was quite active, even into the night, the hotel was quiet! We will definitely be back.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Perfect location
text:
We stayed as a family of four at Hotel du Levant around Christmas. The location is perfect. It's close, just a few minutes to walk, to underground and train station Saint-Michel Nôtre-Dame, which has trains to both Orly and Charles de Gaulle airports.
It's also very nicely situated in the 5th arrondissement, Quartier Latin. We walked to Nôtre Dame Cathedral in about 5 minutes and since it's very central it was also possible to walk to many other places and otherwise the subway is very close-by. There are plenty of restaurants just outside the hotel.
Staff at the hotel were very friendly and our 4 bed room had one double bed and two single beds. The breakfast served at the hotel was basic.
The corridors and the elevator were very narrow and small.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Excellent hotel
text: The hotel is excellent situated next to Norte-dame. Service was excellent and the rooms too. Breakfast was simple but tasty, typically French. The area is very vivid and offers all kind of choices. Very good choice to stay.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Perfect Location
text: The location is perfect 10/10. 2 min from Metro Cluny la sorbonne (right of the hotel) and 2 min from Metro St michel (Left of the hotel). From Cluny station, you can take the RER B for the airports. A lot of restaurants, shops and souvenirs around the hotel. The Notre dame of Paris is 5 min from the hotel . The breakfast 5/10. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Free wifi very good. The bed is not so comfortable. very hot in the room and you cannot do anything because it's a central A/C so you have to open the window but if it's raining and the window is open , what will happen ...???? and my room was opposite of the other side of the building, so no view and very hot. The shower is fix and you cannot move it .... A lot of voices around you : you can here the people who walk around your room : up, near...
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location...excellent breakfast
text: Enjoyed a stay here in October. The location in the heart of the Latin Quarter was convenient for everything we wanted to do. It was easy to get on the Metro or Uber if walking was not how we wanted to get around.  The staff was friendly and helpful. The historical building is great, and the room was a good size. Be aware...the elevator is not roomy. We did, howeve, manage to get 4 of us in there one time. Let’s just say it was good we were all friends! The bathroom was good, but there was not designated shampoo provided. I loved opening the window and hearing all the activity on the street at night. The continental breakfast was great in the morning.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Lots of old fashiones paris...maybe too much
text: We've been there 3 nights with the kids. Price was good. Not very comfortable, a little old (or more than a little) but superbly located for central paris. Comsi comsa, next time we will go elsewhere and no kids :-)
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Great location, nice staff!
text: It was as good as it can in the heart of Paris at that price point! Room was decently spacious, breakfast was good, staff was courteous and English-speaking, and the room had a good set of toiletries (something I care about a lot). Besides, the hotel is located very close to St. Michel Notre Dame station, which is a major station if you want to take the RER metro to airport or to Versailles. Walking distance from Notre Dame, Sainte Chapelle, Louvre, and Tuileries Garden
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Good hotel for short stay
text:
I stayed at this hotel as a single traveler for two nights. It is located in the left bank in a very touristy area. There are many restaurants nearby but they cater to the tourist crowd. The entire hotel seems to have been refurbished recently as everything appeared to be fairly new. The staff were very friendly and helpful and spoke perfect English. My room was very small ( not unusual for European hotels ) but it was comfortable. The continental breakfast served had everything required. 
For a short stay, this would be a good choice.
name: Hotel du Levant

title: Good hotel
text:
The hotel was very good, but I was with my father and the toilet does not give two much privacy if you’re not partners with the other person on the room. 
We asked for two single beds and they were put together as if s double bed 🤷🏻‍♀️
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: My former go-to hotel -- no longer!
text: The Aida has made many changes since the pandemic -- all for the worse. The new decor is horrific and unwelcoming, the staff are young, rude, and inexperienced -- it is frankly heartbreaking that my family and I will never stay here again.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Pleasant Hotel
text: We booked this hotel thinking it was an easy walk from Gare du Nord and close enough to the main tourist sites.  While we made it work it is important to note that this requires more walking than you'd think.  That's nothing against the hotel, however.  The rooms were clean but small (which is to be expected in Paris).  We had a lovely street view that was still very quiet.  The bathroom was bigger than you might expect and the water always hot and with very good pressure.  The bedding was very good as well.  Our room had a regular bed and a sofa that folded out into a bunkbed.  Breakfast was good but not extensive.  There are several restaurants nearby as well as a small market.  The staff was extremely friendly.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Great location for exploring Paris by foot
text: 1 night stay for a party of 6, in two rooms. The family room with bunks was great. Facilities were modern and clean. We were on 1st floor, and there was street noise as expected. Free water and sodas in room was a nice touch.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Ann Port
text: Had a very pleasant stay at your hotel, the room was quiet and comfortable and the staff were very helpful. Breakfast was tasty and overall it was a very good price, would book up at the hotel the next time that I come to Paris.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Good location
text: We wanted to stay close to Gare du Nord as we had an early train back to the UK and this Hotel certainly ticked that box. Conveniently located in 10th District Close with metro stations  close by. Nice clean hotel,  with bright decor which my children thought was fun. Staff were friendly enough, and we had no complaints. Plenty of restraunts nearby. We would certainly stay here again.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Short break in Paris
text: We would most definitely use this hotel again. A lovely base to enjoy our short break in Paris. It is approximately a 10 to 12 minute walk from Gare de nord. the train station on the RER B line. The metro line is approximately a 5 min walk away.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Family
