text: The location was very good with loads of restaurants and cafes in the neighbourhood, The room was big,, modern and  clean.  A liitle bit too cold as we could not adjust the AC. Good an well refilled breakfast.
name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: Good value for the price
text:

name: Hotel Aida Opera

title: An amazing week in Paris
text: We had a really nice experience for our week in Paris. We had a really nice street view room with balcony. The receptionier with mustache is really friendly and helpfull. The rooms are clean. If you chose the breakfast option again it's simple but totally satisfying. Rooms are modern but still Parisien. Front desk service also amazing, definitely will be staying here again when back in Paris. Room size for the l
Privilege room is more than enough. This is Paris if you expect 500 square feet then you are in the wrong country. Even NYC isn't like that unless you want to spend $400 a night. Shower is great, small fridge perfect for my wine and drinks and small finger foods. Balcony view is amazing. Looks like a background for your computer. title: Unexpectedly fined
text:
At Hotel Aida Opera Paris, the room had a high price in relation to the quality. During my stay, the shower siphon didn’t work properly, it was clogged. Due to it, after my bath, the floor got wet, naturally I tried to dry it. 

At my departure, I asked the hotel personnel and room service if everything was in order. Days later, after checking out properly, the hotel accused me of flooding the room, and leaving blankets in the siphon while the shower was running to damage everything. Under these false accusations, they charged me a 1000 euro fine. 

The hotel took advantage on the fact that I left my wallet at the room, to oblige the payment of the fine and press the signature of a document assuming responsibility. I was pushed to it since my documents and wallet are vital when travelling. I did not flood the room, only the shower floor got wet. It is a lack of professionalism and respect towards clients to accuse and fine without fundament nor reason.

title: Peaceful charm, personal welcome
text:
We stayed at Villa du Square in Chambre Deluxe jardin for three nights in late September, 2022. This delightful boutique hotel did not disappoint.  Everything was done to put the comfort of the client first.  The historic house reflects the owner’s attention to detail, from decoration to a well-planned book of information in each room, comfortable bedding and a great continental breakfast.  This is in a quiet, off the main track area of Paris and is a very desirable place to be.  No crushing sidewalk crowds. There’s a small Auchon grocery steps away along the street. Wonderful restaurants are only blocks away and you’re centered two or three blocks from two metro stops.  We felt safe walking in the area and particularly enjoyed shops, cafés etc. along Av. Mozart and in the upscale Auteuil neighborhood.  
Our room was quiet, bright and cheerful with a large window overlooking the garden terrace (rain prevented us from enjoying the courtyard) and a large comfortable bed. The bathroom was spacious with 2 sinks, large tub and great walk-in shower.  
The petit déjeuner was well presented on a finely set table, generous wIth croissants, cake, baguettes, yogurt, butter, jams, cheeses and more. The coffee was made to our specific desire and was delicious. 
Owner and host, Christophe is charming and friendly, ready with many local restaurant recommendations and helpful with getting around Paris (making reservations) and especially knowledgeable regarding airport access.  
We hope to visit Christophe and Villa du Square again.  Three days was not enough to do the area justice.

title: Amazing Villa and Host in Paris
text:
The Villa Du Square and its host Christophe deserve 10 stars!  Our first trip to Paris was delayed from 2020 to 2022 due to the Covid Pandemic and Christophe was very kind and generous in working with our reservations.  The delay was so worth the wait!  The Villa is a truly magical and amazing place to stay.  Close enough to the heart of Paris you are there in a 10-15 minute Taxi or Metro ride but far enough away to be quiet, safe and comfortable.  The Villa itself is so beautiful, peaceful and beautifully decorated with both art, sculpture and amazing photography..  We stayed in the Garden room ( V)  and Room IV as we had added a day and had to move on our last night and both rooms were so comfortable and relaxing.  There are many delicious dining options within a short walk and Christophe made many wonderful recommendations on both food and attractions to see. title: Can anything be more Paris than this?
text:

Towels and shower gel / shampoo are provided, as well as a hairdryer and there is a well-functioning AC in the room if needed. However, it is important to remember that the house does not have an elevator.

Traditional French breakfast, always with fresh bread, good coffee and grapes from the garden. There are many restaurants and cafés within walking distance. The host is ready to help with recommendations and bookings if needed.

Across the street there is a small supermarket.

A perfect accommodation for those who are not looking for the big hotel experience. A Bed and breakfast above the rest.

text:

While it would seem that Square's location is a bit distant, two Metro stations and the Raffett bus stop are 5 minutes or less walk, and within no time you are at all the tourist sites, or cool/trendy parts of the city (yes, some are more cool than others), while still having a very quiet neighborhood and if you've driven, a place to park. title: 温かく迎えられ、ホームステイしているみたい
text:
◾︎立地/ Location / Situation
16区の緑豊かで閑静な住宅街の中に位置し、
落ち着いた滞在向けの素敵な立地。可愛らしいお庭から敷地外へ出るとル•コルヴィジェのアトリエにつながっているほか、印象派、とりわけモネのコレクションが壮観なマルモッタン美術館にもほど近い。

Location is absolutely wonderful for relax staying. This villa is located in 16th Ward which is a quiet residential quarter with lots of green. We can go out via its pretty garden to visit the studio of Corbusier. It is also near from Marmottan Museum. This museum have worthy collection for Impressionism, especially for Monet. 

Il est à l'arrondissement 16eme et la situation est très propre à un séjour reposé.  C'était calme et plus vert. Le joli jardin continuer à l'atelier de Corbusier et le Musée Marmottan Monet qui a l'impressionniste collection splendeur est à côté aussi.

◾︎室内 / Interior decoration / Intérieur
ラウンジもダイニングも居室も、ハイセンスの一言に尽きる。壁には絵画や写真、本棚にはインテリア関連書籍や各種ガイドブックが並び、眺めるだけで楽しい。
また、居室には乾燥機があり、急な大雨に振られた際の衣類を乾かすことが出来たので本当にありがたかった。

Lounge, dining room and guest room are all extremely sophisticated. Walls are decorated with paintings and photos, book shelf is filled with interior magazines, guidebooks for all over the world etc. They please the eyes of guests.
As for guest room, dryer for clothes was very helpful for us to wash our clothes and dry with it as we were drenched into skin by sudden heavy rain.

Le salon, la salle à manger, les chambres sont très raffinées et vraiment agréables. Les murs avec des photos et dessins, l'étagère à livres avec des livres pour décoration d’intérieur ou guide touristique de toutes les parties du monde égayes.
Je voudrais ajouter à cela, séchoir à linge dans les chambres sont vraiment pratiques. De fait, nous avons pu sécher des vêtements qu'était trempé jusqu’aux os à grosse pluie.

◾︎食事
朝食はマダムが買ってきてくれるパンや、シリアル、フルーツサラダを用意いだだける。パン•オ•ショコラやシュケットなど、甘いパンが並ぶことが多い。紅茶の種類が色々あって、毎日選ぶのが楽しかった。もちろんコーヒーもある。

Madam prepares bread(mainly sweet roll like Pain au chocolat or chouquette), cereal and fruit salad for us for breakfast.  There are variations for tea flavor. Of cause coffee is available as well.

Madame nous a préparé du pain pour petit déjeuner. C'est du pain sucré comme du pain au chocolat ou chouquette en général. On peut prendre des céréales et salade fruits aussi. Il y avait beaucoup de thé sélectif. Le café était bon bien sûr.

◾︎コミュニケーション / Communication / Communication
ご夫妻とも仏英両方話してくださる。メーデーの日にはマダムからすずらんをいただいたり、ムッシューに周辺のおすすめスポットを教えてもらったりなど、ご夫妻の温かいおもてなしに感銘を受けた。旅に人との交流を大切にしている方は是非、ご夫妻の人柄の温かさに触れに訪れてみてほしい。

Mr. and Mrs. are available for both French and English. We were really impressed by their warm consideration. For example, madam have gave us a lily of the valley for celebrating May Day. And on another day master have kindly gave us a sightseeing recommendation plan. If you think that relationship with people of the district is important for your trip, I hope you will visit to see them and feel their warm welcome.

Monsieur et madame peuvent perler anglais. Nous avons ressenti une impression profonde pour un accueil chaleureux de madame et monsieur. Par exemple madame a offert un brin de muguet en mai premier et monsieur a consulté notre plan de tourisme. Si vous pensez qu'une relation est importante, je vous recommande !

title: Delightful!
text:
We recently returned from a 9 night stay at this small, lovely, boutique guest house.   My husband and I had a room and our 16 year old son had a room of his own.  Being a bit away from the center of Paris, the reasonable prices made this far preferable arrangement possible.   While one does need to use the metro a good deal if one is in Paris as a tourist and stays here, the closest metro is a 3 minute, nice walk away and the metro system itself if clean, efficient and excellent.

The rooms were a very comfortable size, almost generous by Paris standards, and beautifully and uniquely decorated.   We always felt like we were coming home every evening we were in Paris.   The living room is for guest use and decorated with the most lovely arrangement of unique items and aperitifs/digestifs for guest consumption.  We also enjoyed the lovely back yard on a couple of evenings.  We checked out a couple of cafes/restaurants nearby and were very pleased!

Breakfast is delicious and quite generous.   A basket of fantastic breads/pastries for each guest, plus fresh fruit, yogurts, juices, baguettes and cheese/butter, and some of the best coffee we've ever had.   Completely relaxed, guests come down at their leisure and serve themselves from the well appointed offerings.  A couple of mornings, we ate breakfast at the large table in the kitchen as the Villa was full and that was even more delightful with the bright light coming in from the huge window, the view of the garden, and the fact that the kitchen is very pleasant and attractive.

The beds were super comfortable.  We had a lovely little balcony and the peace and quiet was exactly what we were looking for in staying in the 16th.  We were not disappointed.  The bathrooms are very comfortable and the showers are great.  The heated towel rack was a great added touch as the mornings were quite chilly during our stay and we loved to sleep with the french doors open onto the little balcony.  Housekeeping service was excellent.

Our hosts were so very gracious and generous with their love and knowledge of Paris.  Our son even made friends with their daughter and got to spend a couple of genuine Paris Teen evenings with her and her friends.  Such a nice memory for him.

Villa du Square was exactly what we were hoping to find and we are so very glad we decided to stay here.  We'd return in a heartbeat, and hope to one day very soon.

Their recommendations were very helpful throughout our stay.  Christopher left us a very nice bottle of wine to take home after our conversation about his wine collection, and he will be happy to know a nice Napa Cabernet will be coming his way as a thank you.

title: Breakfast in a Parisian garden
text:
We stayed at Villa du Square for a too-short two-night stay the 9th & 10th of July.  Such a pleasant, quiet, Parisian gem should be savored like a good glass of wine.

We had been alerted via email that Monsieur and Madame would be on holiday with the family, but a relative would be there to take care of us.  The relative turned out to be a quite pleasant young man named Frederick who, upon ascertaining our identity, buzzed us in and began a brief tour of our base for two days.

Our tour began in a family living room right off the foyer, complete with seating and a large array of tourist literature spread across the baby grand.  This was followed by a brief introduction to the dining area and a comment that "The garden is through there" as Frederick pointed further back past the kitchen.  Up a couple of flights of stairs Frederick introduced us to our room which was light and, by Paris standards, quite roomy.  After providing us with instructions on the air conditioning (a blessing as the temperature had risen to almost 30) Frederick left us to settle in.

We gathered from Frederick that Monsieur's restaurant was unfortunately not open as Monsieur was on holiday so we struck out on our own and discovered a charming bistro just around the corner and up the street.  We were too early for dinner, but after a short walk to the Hippodrome and a tiny corner of the Bois du Boulogne we returned for a very reasonable and very tasty evening meal.

Breakfast the next morning was served in the garden, a cool and quiet retreat behind 26 Rue Raffet.  We ate in the pergola under grape vines in welcome shade, with Frederick serving us croissant, pain au chocolate, jam, coffee and tea, juice, and fruit.  Granola and yoghurt were also available.  The pastries were fresh and local.

Villa du Square is within easy walking distance of three Metro stops.  It is also an easy walk to the Marmatton Museum, home to the most Monets collected in one building, and to the aforementioned Bois du Boulogne.  Just down the hill, just past the Jasmin Metro, is Avenue Mozart with a string of boulangeries, patisseries, fleuristes - everything you would need to create a picnic for the park.

In short, the Villa du Square is a "find" and well worth the price.  If you are planning on visiting the Bois du Boulogne and its environs the Villa is ideal.

title: Paris may always be a good idea, but Villa du Square will be a great one!
text:
I can not possibly say enough wonderful things about Villa du Square. Paris may always be a good idea, but Villa du Square will be a great one! My husband and I had an fun time in Paris, but an amazing stay at this Bed & Breakfast.

I booked through their website directly, it was very easy and I had no difficulty. I received confirmation of my reservation to my email promptly and was sent a personal message from Marie-Victoire shortly after, she helped make recommendations for dinner before a show we had purchased tickets for. We reserved Bedroom IV as well as a parking space, which is available at a very good price, and is off the street in a secure alley. We felt totally comfortable leaving our car alone for a few days. 

Upon arrival we were warmly greeted by both Marie-Victorie and her husband François-Christophe, both of whom speak English. They checked us in, walked us to our rooms and showed us around their gorgeous home, pictures don’t do this place justice, it is stunning. We stayed over Easter weekend, and the garden was just coming alive, but even partially awake it was very tranquil and green.  Our bedroom was up a few flights of stairs, and beautifully appointed, it had a small balcony overlooking a street, but it was not loud at all. My husband loved to stand and people watch. The bathroom was clean, and pretty. The bed was very comfortable and there was adequate storage for clothes and the like. Tech speaking, there was a Bluetooth speaker, flat screen TV, and fantastic WiFi, which was also free- take that hotel chains!

Breakfast was seriously delicious. I almost forgot how wonderful fresh-squeezed orange juice is, but it was nearly upstaged by the wonderful Parisian croissants and other assembled baked goods. There was also an assemblage of yogurt and cereal, but the wonderful jams and fresh fruit were more than enough for me. Oh, and let us not forget the coffee. Fully automated espresso machine with built in grinder. If you want it simply press a button and voilà! If you love tea, there were nearly too many to try, but I do recall some tea tins from Laudree sitting out as well as Twinnings which is always a solid choice.

The location is perfect for anyone who wants to walk, bike, or metro Paris. There is a bike station literally up the street, and Metro just a few short blocks away, though you don’t need either if you are looking for dinner, because the affiliated restaurant (Le Berger et les Poissons) is nearby and beautifully art nouveau, of course the food and drink are very good as well. They also have a wonderful German gin I am now hooked on (Thanks Pierre), and I will be giving him a spectacular review just after this. 

If I sound like I am gushing, it is because I absolutely am. Why would you stay in ugly dull hotel, when you can stay in such a beautiful home and meet truly wonderful people? My only hesitation in writing this review is they may be booked up the next time I want to stay!
