A variety of delicious meats, cheeses, hard boiled eggs and more added to the obligatory croissants which (might I say) were the best we have ever had. The staff was so friendly. It was a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and steps from Les Invalides. I will definitely be back and highly recommend!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Wonderful stay and close to Eiffel Tower
text: Great location and fabulous rooms! We had a very nice stay and were happy with the amenities and especially the size of the bathroom.  Loved having a bathtub! We had a view of the Eiffel Tower and the staff were very friendly. We ate breakfast one morning in the restaurant and definitely thought it was worth it.  The hotel was walking distance to The Invalides, Eiffel Tower, subway stops, etc., and many fantastic restaurants. Highly recommend!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: IF YOU DON’T STAY HERE YOU’LL REGRET IT!!!!! 10/10 experience!
text: Unbeatable view and incredible staff! The hotel itself was VERY clean and so beautiful! It’s located in arguably one of the best locations in Paris. Seconds away from the metro and generally walking distance to many attractions like the Eiffel Tower, champs élysées, latin quarter, Le Bon Marche etc. The staff were so friendly and helpful and did a great job of making us feel so at home here. This is an absolute MUST stay. Just look at the view… if you can, spend the money. It’s worth the upgrade. If you’re between two hotels PICK THIS ONE. All and all 10/10 experience, would happily come back here next time I’m in Paris!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Honeymoon in paris
text:
Hotel was fantastic and the location could not have  been better. We paid the extra to have a balcony with excellent views of the eiffel tower.
Clean and tidy with friendly staff and would recommend to friends who may visit paris in the future
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great stay
text: A little tight on space, but that’s France. It’s in an awesome location with a great view of most of the Eiffel Tower and easily walkable to restaurants and sightseeing. Staff was wonderful and very attentive, with great local recommendations.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Best hotel to view the Eiffel tower from your room
text: Extremely happy I chose this hotel. Great location, great view, every day the room was found neatly cleaned when we returned from a long day. Probably my only complain is I wish the hotel had more in room service options from the restaurant. But this place has great options to eat all within a few blocks. Will definitely come back to this hotel on my next Paris trip.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Romantic Stay
text: We had a magical 3 night stay here with beautiful kept amenities. Staff were always friendly & made our stay even more special. Close to all attractions but quiet & peaceful surroundings. Within walking distance of restaurants & parks.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: A perfect stay!
text:
This hotel is great. The straff is friendly and very helpfull. The rooms are clean and beds and pillows very comfortable, i slept even better then at home! Also the air condition works very well. Out room was spacious for being a hotel room in Paris, we had the Duchesse room. 
Some rooms have a balcony with a view of the Eiffel tower, we had a room with a sideview. (we had to pay 40 euro extra  per night for that) It added a nice edition to the trip to be able to see the lightshow on the Eiffel tower from our own balcony. 
It was a perfect stay, i have no complaints at all.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Incredible stay at a great hotel
text: We can’t say enough good things about our stay here. We were able to upgrade to a room on the 5th floor with a balcony, and a perfect view of the Eiffel Tower! The beds were extremely comfortable, the staff was lovely and the area was perfect for us. There was even a Nespresso machine in the room where we had coffee on the balcony every morning. We will be staying here every time we come to Paris! Well worth it!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Paris vacation
text: Such a quaint hotel, loved the decor, location was perfect and close to metro station, loved the blue lighting at night, and view of Eiffel was awesome.  Nice affordable breakfast available.  The staff at front desk were helpful and spoke English.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Poor Customer Service
text: They needed credit card information, and they wanted me to send it using email. I told them I would rather give it on the phone because sending cc info thru email is not secure. He said, "This is their policy and if I want to stay at this hotel then I need to email the credit card information." Lol, I found another hotel that knows how to treat guests.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Perfect place to stay for 1st time traveller
text: We are so happy that we made a right choice to stay in la comtesse …the place is perfect close to the eiffel tower and other tourist spots just walking distance…the convinient stores and restos are every where the area. The staff are so wonderful and friendly especially Emelie and Mr. Daniel the hotel manager. The Breakfast in the resto are so good. We really enjoyed our stay there. Merci Beaucoup… Highly Recommended
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Perfect location
text: The room is tiny, but we only needed it to sleep because we spent most of our time walking. The location is perfect. Walking distance to the tower and beautiful view. Check in is at 3pm (most hotels is 2pm) if the room is ready before 3pm, they will let you in with a charge of $55euros. Which is kind of nice? But why the extra charge? most hotels just let you in. Staff are really nice. They only have 1 elevator and was not working so we had to drag ours bags up and down the narrow stairs. My husband has a bad back so it was an inconvenience. The hotel and room was clean.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Mr and Mrs Mike Beamish and Family
text: We can’t say enough good things about La Comtesse… It’s centrally located in a great neighborhood with lots of shops and cafes-each of our rooms had a great view of the Eiffel Tower!! The staff was professional and warm and assisted us with our plans, such as finding restaurants, closing times for attractions-We will definitely be back. It was a great experience!!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text: Great hotel, not least very nice staff. So helpful ! Even if it was hot outside the room was climated, so no worries for not sleeping. Situated just a few hundred meters from the Eifel tower. Metro just 100 meter away. Easy access to the area with Metro 8 from Concorde. Line 1 from there to LesHalles, the main station, connected to the RER B train that goes to Charles de Gaulle and Orly Airport.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Mr
text:
Great stay! Will be visiting again!

Lovely view of the Eiffel Tower and the surrounding area of Paris.

Close to a lot of restaurants and activities to keep you busy whilst on holiday in France!!!!!!!!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Very nice Eiffel view, staff, location!
text: There was a small problem when we first arrived at the hotel, but they actively solved it. If the purpose of coming to Paris is the Eiffel Tower.. The location is so good that you don't have to go through the dangerous Parisian night streets. If I go to Paris next time, I want to stay at this hotel again.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Best place to propose ever!
text: We just had to write a review after we got engaged at this hotel during our recent stay (Thursday 11 August to Saturday 13 August). I had been planning our surprise trip to Paris for a couple of months and the hotel staff couldn’t have been more helpful as the whole experience was one that we will never forget. Not only was the room prepared with champagne and flowers, the staff were fantastic to welcome us to the hotel and they played along with the surprise when needed. The room itself (605) was a dream. We have never stayed in a room with a better view - seeing the Eiffel Tower day and night was truly amazing - from the balcony and even from the shower! The hotel clearly made every effort to put us in a great room to make the proposal a special occasion and it was really appreciated. The location of the hotel is fantastic with a short walk to the Eiffel Tower and access to the local metro service, there are also some great restaurants nearby. We will definitely be returning here to relive the amazing memories at Hotel La Comtesse.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Cute Hotel, Very nice staff
text: We had a great experience here. We only stayed one night and did not utilize the cafe. The staff was super nice and helpful. The hotel room was a bit small but it seems to be the norm for Europe. It is the perfect location! So close to the Eiffel Tower and cafés. Overall, a wonderful stay.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great location and nice hotel
text: Location was great. Staff were very nice. The hotel is clean and updated. We were right by the metro as well as the  Eiffel Tower itself. Room was small but we got the view of the Eiffel Tower that we wanted. All around happy with the stay. Would stay again
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great Stay
text: We really enjoyed our stay here. The views were wonderful and the location was very convenient. We opened the window and viewed the Eiffel tower each morning and night. The staff was professional and spoke several languages to accommodate all guest. The rooms were cleanly and well designed. We knew they would be on the smaller side but honestly you do not need that much room when visiting a city with immaculate views.  The breakfast was also amazing and the staff within also great. The ONLY knock I will give it is that there were parts of the room that showed a few design flaws (i.e. the light in the bathroom had a cut larger than the light that was inserted within) but this is me being SUPER picky. I would highly recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Amazing hotel with brilliant views of the Eiffel Tower.
text:
Fantastic hotel, location & staff. Our room (507) had a balcony and the best view of the Eiffel Tower - it was genuinely beautiful. 

 I highly recommend and will return to Hotel La Comtesse every Paris trip.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Amazing!
text: This hotel is very nice! The room, location and view were absolutely incredible! The only minus would be that the breakfast experience could have been a little more relaxed. We will definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great Eiffel Tower views
text:
The location in the 7th is nice, very near the Invalides, really quick walk to the Champs de Mars and tower. Close to Rodin Museum, Rue Cler, etc. A bit of a haul to get to Notre Dame, Louvre, Arc, but doable if you don’t mind a 30-45 min walk. We found it easy to get Ubers & taxis from this spot. Not the best area for restaurants in the immediate vicinity, compared to say, St Germain, but we found some nice spots and weren’t ever disappointed. Koi right across the street was really good sushi if you need a break from baguettes and butter. Skip the breakfast at the hotel, €22 is pretty steep for the offerings.

Staff was all great, everyone was friendly and put up with my terrible French, and was happy to switch to English after I exhausted my couple of phrases. They are happy to hold your bags before or after checkout, which is helpful. Place was clean, well kept, very nice and big (for Paris) bathroom that meets most American standards. Had a hair dryer for my wife. Bed was good, rest of the room was pretty normal.

Let’s be real though, the reason everyone books here is the view of the Eiffel Tower. The five rooms right at the front with the head-on view are where it’s at, and honestly a great value. We had the third floor and the view was awesome, especially at night with it all lit up.

Overall, great little hotel. If you’re looking for proximity to and views of the Eiffel Tower, it’s hard to do much better than this.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Good
text: I enjoyed my stay (wasn't prepared for the tiny room) but very clean and quiet. Restaurant was just ok until meeting Daniel (I think that was his name). He was awesome, extremely informative and friendly.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Nice & Cozy
text:
Very good location, near metro station and a short walk to Eiffel tower. Coffee shops, restaurants & Supermarket in the near by the hotel. Staff is friendly and very helpful. The rooms are small, but very clean, nice and comfortable.  
The breakfast is ok, as you have some options and the coffee is very good.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Go for it.
text: Very nice Location, all you need is right there: supermarket, metro station, coffee shop. the staff is very very nice and funny. very clean, perfect view, comfortable beds. We enjoyed staying here and definitely recommend it.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: cons disconss
text:
Short walk to the  Eiffel tower

Ive seen better breakfast.

the bed was amazing. but the space was not so good.

No balcony on the forth floor sadly

My frend said  that  there was a smas balcony on the fifth foor
🛬🗼🌆🗼🏛
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Incredible view, friendly and helpful staff, top-tier location, small but nice room
text:
- Paid extra for the room with a front view of the Eiffel Tower. Was not disappointed.
- Staff were friendly and helpful; a staff member was available 24 hours a day.
- Location in the 7th arrondissement is top-tier and provides an excellent seat to observe and explore big attractions (Tour Eiffel, Champ de Mars, Invalides, even the Louvre is relatively close)
- The room itself was small but quite nice.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: THE VIEW!!!
text: This is more than I generally pay for a hotel, but I couldn’t resist this view! La Comptess is in the 7th, so close to the Eiffel Tower and walking distance to almost everywhere you will need to go in Paris, also very close to the underground train. The room was well appointed and comfortable, the front desk helpful. Delicious breakfast too!!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: A wonderful weekend in Paris!
text: We spent a memorable, lovely weekend in this wonderful hotel. The level care and quality was top notch. The staff is very friendly, kind and eager to help. The neighborhood is very pleasant and even quiet during the weekend, especially compared to the chaotic inner city areas. Of course, the view of the Eiffel Tower is priceless! With its close vicinity to both Metro and bus, you have very convenient connection to any of the other neighborhoods in Paris. There is also a taxi stand across from the hotel. We loved our stay at this wonderful hotel!!!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Nice hotel with a great view of the Eiffel Tower
text: The balcony view with the Eiffel Tower was amazing. Got some great photos and got to watch the lights sparkle during the evening hours while even laying in bed. The front desk is staffed 24 hours and were very helpful with any of our requests.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Sweet little boutique hotel with the most beautiful view!
text: Nice little hotel in the hart of Paris. Just a walk away from the Eiffel Tower and it’s just lovely to sit there and eat your breakfast. We where staying in the room with the front view at the Eiffel Tower. It was such a dream to stay in Paris that way. Thank you for having us! We had such a great time!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Very cute Hotel with an amazing view
text:
If your looking for a cute hotel close by the Effel tower, go to La Comtesse! very charming hotel, lot's of restaurant around (10 min walking form the Effel Tower, 25 min from the Champs Élysée) 

The view from the room at night of the Effel Tower is simply magical
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great location
text:
Very centralised. Has a bus stop with buses that go to tourist spots.
Room is small and have thin walls. No toothbrush or bathrobe. 
Staff are amazing, especially Emilie. Thank you for the great service!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Horrible service and tiny room
text: Check in went fine, but it went downhill after that.  The staff is extremely rude and super unhelpful. The rooms are extremely small.  We were told to use one form of travel that would have made us miss our event time, thankfully we were able to get a taxi and made it with minutes to spare.  While eating breakfast we dealt with more extremely rude people.  This is how your start your day and you have these negative unhelpful people.  At checkout I had to deal with another rude and obnoxious person.  I would highly recommend you do not stay at this hotel.  There has to be much better choices.  There is no way this hotel should be a 4 star hotel!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Wonderful
text: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel La Comtesse. Room was very clean upon arrival, staff was friendly and helpful, and the view was wonderful from our side window. Metro station being right around the corner was very convenient for us as that’s how we chose to get around. Easy walk to the Eiffel Tower (about 18mins). Would definitely book again.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great place to stay, close to the best places to visit in Paris
text: We had an amazing stay close to everything we want to see. Breakfast was free and really good. I wound highly recommend this place. The staff were very helpful with eating recommendations as well as helping us get taxis if needed.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Excellent choice!
text: Very impressed with the rooms and service at this hotel. Also an excellent breakfast included. Highly recommended if you’re on a visit to Paris. I also was very impressed that the team allowed me to change the day of the booking although strictly they didn’t have to. Thank you.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Beautiful Views
text: Beautiful room and the view was amazing. Housekeeping was also good but the check in with the concierage was terrible. He hardly agknowledged my daughter and I when we arrived. We were the only 2 persons in the lobby! I aske if there was an early check in and he said "no". That's it. I asked  if he could call us later in the day when the rooms were ready and he said "no".  I asked if we could store our bags and he gave us tags and offered no help with bringing the bags to the storage area. Later when we returned to check in, he again offered no explanation of amenities and gave us room keys. Again no help with bags into elevator etc. He spoke perfect English. It was the worst check-in experience I have ever had and this is not an inexpensive hotel. Finally, the room view was incredible (Room 604) so we had a great stay despite the front desk. The wait staff in the breakfast room was amazing.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Perfect location
text:
Perfect location. Abundant bistros and restaurants to choose from nearby. Metro and bus stops are just a few meters away.

Small, comfortable and elegant. Breakfast was great. Staff is friendly and helpful.

Great view of Tour Eiffel from the room.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Have good cost-effectiveness for Eiffel view
text:
It is located near Eiffel tower and also within ten minutes of walking distance.
 Room was nice and clean, every stuff was well-equipped. Toilet also looked clean but unfortunately it was smelly. I guess the smell was from the sewer. except for that, everything was good. Breakfast was simple and nice, and all staffs was nice as well.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great location
text: Hotel overall was great, room size was what you expect in Paris, very clean and shower was perfect. Had a view of the Eiffel Tower when sticking my head out the window. Very close to the metro and bus stops. Many outdoor cafes in the area.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Quiet and clean
text: Great hotel in a popping area. Lots to see and do around. The best part was the quiet, cool room with soft linens and a great shower the view and the proximity to the metro. The staff were very friendly and helpful and helped coordinate  transportation for us for an early morning tour.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Hotel recommended
text: Hotel is nice, staff are polite, esp Ms Emilie is so helpful. It is an outstanding 4-star Hotel in the city centre. Many restaurants and supermarket nearby, very close to metro. Overall this hotel is nearly 5-star category apart from the size. Value worth. High recommend.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: 36th wedding anniversary
text: Perfection with a view! Excellent place, professional and courteous service. Given room size and rate, breakfast included would cost so little internally and would be a gracious and competitive decision.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great Hotel with a Great View
text: This was a beautiful little hotel with a friendly staff. The view was amazing, my wife and I spent every night on the balcony with a bottle of champaign watching the sunset behind the Eiffel Tower. We would stay again!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Fabulous hotel and lovely staff
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights and have nothing but praise for this hotel and its staff. Excellent position for sight seeing and very near a metro station which is handy for getting around Paris. The view from
the hotel of the Eiffel Tower is stunning and eating the excellent breakfast whilst looking at this world famous monument is quite the experience. Would highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Beautiful hotel
text: Perfect location for Roland-Garros which was the purpose of our visit. Staff very helpful, rooms were super, very comfortable and a lovely decor. Restaurants and bar/cafes on your doorstep. Very quiet considering it’s central location. We will certainly return next year. Merci beaucoup, a bientot!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Amazing View and Location
text:
Great view of the Eiffel tower! Worth checking off the bucket list, especially on our first trip to Paris.

The room itself was simple and clean, but remember, you are paying for the view of the Eiffel tower
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Beautiful view! Worth every penny
text: Amazing experience! The staff is very friendly and always accommodating any needs. Definitely coming back! Very close to the Eiffel Tower (15min walk) as well as restaurants and bars. The breakfast is good and worth adding it to your booking if you are only staying for a couple of days and want to go early in the morning.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Mr Farrow
text: One of the best 👌 hotels 🏨 I have been to and also a great price in a lovely location just out of the centre of Paris and also 15 minutes walk to the E Tower. All of the staff on the front desk where great from day 1 to leaving. We would definitely stay there again if we go back to Paris.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Location is outstanding. Walk to the Eiffel Tower an the Metro in minutes.
text:
The location is wonderful an the staff is also wonderful.
There are two items that we can criticize. One that the pillows are rock hard.
We actually removed their pillow cases and used their decorative pillows to sleep with. Also the beds were covered with these nice white quilted comforter type blankets. Which made sleeping very warm. As a result we had to lower the thermostat  down to below 21 degrees centigrade to be comfortable a night. Thus wasting electricity.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Lovely Rooms, Wonderful Employees
text:
Checkin was seamless and front desk employees pleasant and helpful. Our room was well very well designed but the intersection at which the hotel is situated is heavily trafficed. 
We were on the first floor balcony room.
although traffic did die down after 10PM.
The beds and linens were very soft and comfortable,
Great shower.
Our waiter in the restaurant was beyond wonderful, attentive and easy to talk with, we loved him.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Fantastic Hotel.
text: This is one of the best hotels 🏨 I have been to. From start to finish the stay was fantastic. The front desk staff where very helpful from day 1 to leaving. It is in a great location for food and the Metro and also a great price. Try and get a room with a great view of the tower which is only a 15 minute walk.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Amazing Staff and Amazing Views!!
text:
Each staff member at the Hotel was gracious and kind. And each request we had they delivered and made our Mother/Daughter stay even more memorable.

The location was perfect. It is within walking distance to Le Metro, Eiffel Tower and many wonderful places to eat and shop.

I will absolutely come back if given another opportunity!!

A bientôt, j'espère!!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Great Start, Traumatic Ending
text:
It started out quite favorable, and if you can avoid an accident, it will be to your liking. The hotel is lovey, great Eiffel location. The staff in the cafe are exceptional, and our greeters and encounters upon our arrival were so welcoming. It’s clean, cute and on one of the safer areas, neighborhoods of Paris.

I had an accident while staying here. I went to the cafe after breakfast to give a tip to my server and the safety wasn’t on the trash elevator. I deployed it, when walking across the floor, lol  it started rising and threw me to the ground. I was cut up, bruised and it literally shocked me because it all happened so fast. I was bleeding, the cafe staff came to my rescue and aid. No incident/accident report was filed or mentioned. Management never checked in on me. No compensation of any sort was offered. I’ve attached pictures; I’ll be treated in the states. 

What started out as a relatively content decision in staying at the ascribed hotel turned into a traumatic experience, which could have been prevented had safety measures been executed on, not forgotten, and had management done their job.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Simply espectacular
text: This is my third time staying at La Comtesse.  What is there not to like about the hotel? Everything is wonderful.  The rooms and views are espectacular.  The location to certain attractions is perfect.  Staff is mostly nice and helpful.  Breakfast is delicious.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: “Fabulous room with a fabulous view”
text: The hotel staff were extremely welcoming and accommodating. The room was perfect with a great mini bar and spotlessly clean with a great view. Highly recommend and will definitely return. Thank you for having us.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Best view of the Eiffel Tower!
text: Very close walking distance to Eiffel Tower. Great cafes and restaurants close by. Beautiful view from our balcony room 501. Great breakfast and cafe options right downstairs. Exactly what we were looking for. Highly recommended!
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Beautiful Hotel!!
text: We stayed in the Deluxe Duchesse Room here for one week (picture with side of building view) and then moved to the prestige Comtesse Room for one week (front view). The hotel is beautiful, the rooms are clean and maintained well, the view is INCREDIBLE! The staff was wonderful and helpful! We enjoyed talking to Michael when we would return from our adventures and he would show just as much enthusiasm as we had for the beautiful city! The hotel is so close to the metro so its a hop skip and away from your favorite sites. The breakfast in the morning is great! If you are looking for a great location and view, dont hesitate to stay here… you wont be disappointed.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Gem of a Boutique Hotel
text: Hotel La Comtesse is a boutique hotel located in the 7th arrondissement. The location is fantastic if you want something that feels like a local vibe and within walking distance to Champ de Mars and the Eiffel Tower. The staff is wonderful, friendly and accommodating. We arrived to the hotel at 9am from the US and they stored our luggage while we explored til our room was ready.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: All that we expected, and more
text: The staff anticipates your every need. Several are fluent in multiple languages. They are more than up to the task for any special occasion you may have. The location is the best, and breakfast is out of this world, as is “tea time.” The views of the Eiffel Tower from many of the rooms are superb. This is our family’s fourth stay at the Comtesse. We will certainly be back.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Comfortable hotel with good view if the Eiffel Tower
text:
I stayed for 2 nights at the hotel in 2 different rooms (one room with Eiffel Tower side view and one room with the front view of the Tower). Both rooms were very clean and comfortable. The junior suite with Eiffel Tower front view is especially nice and spacious. I’m very particular about room with good view and very cautious about small hotels; therefore, I did a lot of research before booking. I’m sure that the price of the suite was very good for the spectacular view that I had. Both the room and the suite were better than expected. 

The reception staff were very helpful. They kept my luggages securely before checking in and after checking out. The move between the rooms was easy. The breakfast was adequate and very well presented for a small hotel. I particularly like the cream caramel that they offered for breakfast.

If I ever come back to Paris, I’ll definitely book the junior suite at Hôtel La Comtesse again.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: Perfect for a long layover in paris!
text: I stayed here as a recommendation from a friend who was also a traveling for a long layover. This was a great location to hit a few must see sites in paris for a short amount of time. Staff was great and accommodating. Room was pristine clean and view of the Eiffel Tower from the balcony was magnificent! 10/10 would recommend and will definitely be back.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: A stay in the Eiffel Tower area
text: In general the hotel is well situatedand has good views. We had a 4th floor room and the view was good and, if you leaned a bit out the window, you could see the Eiffel Tower and the top of the Invalides cuppola. Breakfst was OK but there are better spots out there if your schedule permits. Very small room and limited storage for our seven day stay.
name: Hotel La Comtesse

title: bad wifi
text:
Few channel choices on TV,
room too small to feel good,
bad wifi connection when I had an important poker tournament but all night the connection came then stopped, i lost a max , not good value and i will never come back
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Perfect stay
text: I am very very happy that I found this hotel - great location, amazing people at the hotel. realy nice,touches at the room. Definitely my choice for my next stay in Paris and  I am looking forward to it.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Finally back!
text: After a two-plus year-imposition on travel abroad with all the pandemic regulations and restrictions (some quite silly), we returned to Paris and our favorite hotel therein. It didn’t disappoint.  Service, quality of room and location all remain excellent and highly recommended.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Boutique Élégance
text: This property is an eclipsed jewel in a city of emblematic brands. It’s location is perfect for those who prefer to dwell amongst locals, shop for unique, artisan items, dine in some of the city’s lesser known bests, and have excellent metro transportation to see beyond it. Some of the greatest sites are within walking distance: Picasso Musée, Place des Vosges, République, Oberkampf, Centre Pompidou, Isle Cité to name a few. Staff well organized and versed, atmosphere is meticulously neat and tidy; newer hotel with lots of elegance that evokes a sense of yesteryear, refined.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Exquisite boutique hotel in Le Marais
text: This beautifully appointed hotel is a real jewel in the Marais. Gorgeous decor and details. Extremely helpful and welcoming hosts. Well located amidst a broad variety of restaurants and shops. We enjoyed our very cozy and comfortable room with its marble bathroom. And, despite all the activity in the Marais, it was very quiet during the night. We would definitely go there again.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Small room
text: A few nights in this hotel during a congress in Paris, the location was convenient for my appointments, but the room was too small when I had chosen a suite, decoration too old and too busy, I had chosen this hotel in relation to the excellent comments but I was really disappointed because small room but too high prices
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Best boutique hotel in Paris
text: This was my fourth time at this gorgeous property - beautiful rooms with comfy beds, generous delicious breakfast, spotlessly clean, kind and helpful staff and an excellent location in the Marais. Perfect.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: One Night in Paris
text: I love La Chambre du Marais.  This was my second stay and I would return without hesitation.  Great location.  Easy walk to all the sights.  Beautiful small hotel, comfortable room, and spacious bath.  Love the ornate french decor!  Staff was available 24/7 to answer questions and help with any issues.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Recent trip - 5 night stay
text: The rooms were nice and quaint. The hotel is very clean. The staff is very attentive. The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of the city. It is very expensive.  It is the most expensive hotel I have ever stayed at in 60 years.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: The Pierre room is smaller than you might imagine
text: The hotel was overall fine and we had a pleasant stay. However, when you are comparing the size of the Pierre room with other hotels (by square metre space), just be aware that the reduced head height / sloping ceiling means that much of the room is not useable space. We are both relatively tall, meaning that we constantly had to be watching out for the reduced head height throughout the room (even above the loo). So, whilst this room is advertised (and priced) as a suite, it's actually quite a small and compromised room because of the head height.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: another most enjoyable stay
text: an excellent small hotel in a great location in the northern Marais, not far from the Place de la Republic.Have stayed here now for the 7th time within the last few years, so that should speak volumes along. Well-appointed rooms, friendly and helpful staff, a delicious breakfast served in an elegant setting. Can highly recommend.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Convenient and beautiful stay
text: It was lovely in every aspect.  The staff attentive and welcoming.  Well located to many of Paris sights with a nice walk.  Easy walk to great resturants.   The bathroom was beautiful with big shower and great water pressure Thank you.  Will highly recommend
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Our Paris Experience!
text: We selected this hotel to be able to experience the Paris vibe, cafés, restaurant choices and location to visit the sites. The staff were excellent as was the included breakfast. We were able to walk or get to public transportation easily to visit the various sites we wanted to see.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Luxury in the Marais
text: We chose the Chambre for its location and it didn’t disappoint. We walked to the Picasso Museum, Norte Dame and the Tuileries (after getting hot chocolate from Angelina’s). We also managed to eat fantastic falafel at L’AS.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing Hotel
text: Amazing hotel! The staff, location, clean , comfort of the beds & bathroom, breakfast was delicious! I highly recommend ! next time in Paris will definitely book this hotel again. It is relatively close to metro station but if you are looking to be in the heart of the touristy areas it is not for you.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing hotel, amazing staff, just amazing
text: When asked for feedback upon leaving all I could say is “nothing but positive”. The location is right on the middle of the Marais. The rooms were clean and well appointed. The breakfast was filling and relaxed. At the end of each day of sightseeing we returned to friendly staff and a spotless room. I would 100% stay here again when in Paris.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Boutique Hotel Marais District
text: Charming hotel close to local bars and restaurants.  Very quiet at night.  Room was spacious with an excellent shower. High quality linens and decor.   Breakfast was wonderful lovely selection of bread, croissants  fruit, yoghurt and eggs.  Staff were lovely, extremely helpful and welcoming.  Highly recommend.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: An absolutely recommendable little pearl. Excellent service. A home away from home
text:
We stayed at La Chambre du Marais for a week, in connection with our first visit to the city of cities, Paris. La Chambre du Marais is a beautiful and charming little boutique hotel located in the enchanting 3rd arrondissement, Haut-Marais. There is many small streets with hip cafes, restaurants, delicatessens, hidden pearls as well as local and international shops. It is easy to get around the city to experience the many landmarks Paris has to offer.
Before arrival, we were contacted by La Chambre du Marais, where they offered to help with booking activities, visits, tours, and attractions, so that we could get the most out of our stay.
On our arrival we were welcomed by the staff and offered a beverage while we were checked in and our luggage was taken to our room.
The breakfast is exquisite with small variations during the week and is absolutely recommendable. It is possible to choose the coffee/tea you prefer and whether you want soft-boiled eggs, omelettes or scrambled eggs for your breakfast.
Throughout our visit, we have been greeted by a helpful and friendly staff who have made us feel at home. We can highly recommend this small hotel and hope to use it again on future visits to Paris
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: A magnificent find
text: Everything at La Chambre du Marais exceeded our expectations. The location was perfect, the hotel and its rooms were stylish and comfortable, and the staff was superb - taking care of every detail. Highly recommend this gem in the heart of Marais!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wonderful hidden Marais Boutique
text: Stayed with my wife and 3 year old daughter. Loved the comfort of the entire hotel. Felt like our own private apartment in the heart of the Marais. Everyone was courteous and helpful. The vibe was chill and relaxed. I would and plan to staying here again.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: August in Paris
text: The staff gave us a very warm welcome. It has been a very pleasant  stay. from th beginning on. The hotel is situated ideal for exploring the many sights of Paris. Also there are many restaurants in a short walking distance where you can spent the evenings.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Simply the best
text:
When we arrived on our first morning, Lucien greeted us by saying “Welcome home” and it indeed that is how it felt. This hotel is a small gem. It is in a 
Quiet neighborhood which is walkable to busy streets of shops and restaurants. The rooms are impeccably clean and comfortable. The breakfast is perfect with fresh pastries, fruits and cooked to order eggs each morning. But the best thing about the hotel is the staff. Everyone was gracious, friendly and helpful. I cannot say enough good things about this hotel and we can’t wait to return
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: this is the only place to stay in the Marais!
text: everything about this hotel is magical!  We always stay here.  The staff is gracious, warm and friendly, the breakfast is fresh and delicious.  The rooms ate lovely, clean and welcoming and the location is safe and centrally located!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Enchanting boutique hotel
text: This is an unequivocally lovely hotel in Le Marais.  The hotel itself is conveniently near several restaurants, boutique stores, and bars.  Our room was stylish and impeccably clean.  Staff was professional, yet very friendly and accommodating.  The daily breakfast array was fresh and delicious.   I note that a reviewer below stated they were at the hotel during the recent heat wave and had issues with their air conditioning temperature. I wonder if this was brought to the staff’s attention?  My stay at the hotel was also during the heat wave and I had no such problem.  Based on my interactions with the staff though, I have no doubts that they would have rectified the problem immediately if I had.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Stylish comfort in Marais.
text: This hotel offers French style, comfortable accomodations and a most hospitable and professional staff.  They were always warm and friendly in helping us with directions, recommendations and questions.  The rooms are so comfortable and luxurious.  The hotel is well located for travelers interested in strolling the stores and cafes of the Marais neighborhood and beyond.  I would highly recommend this fabulous hotel and plan to return myself.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Hidden gem
text: We absolutely loved the location of this hotel - it was walkable to everything. It was clean and comfortable and I cannot wait to return!! The staff were amazing as well - always available should we need anything. Highly recommend this property!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great Place to Stay in the Heart of Marais
text: This is a small boutique hotel centrally located in the Marais district.  The service is superb.  The staff knows each person and her special requirements if any.  The quality of the food presented for the breakfast buffet is just awesome.  It is new and very clean.  We had the Catherine suite with a sitting area as well as a living room and hallway closets.  The bathroom is small and a bit awkward in design, but the shower is roomy.  Our suite is on the 4th floor facing Rue des Archives.  The traffic noise can get very loud at night. Overall, it is a good place if you are looking for a hotel in Marais.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Most wonderful hotel ever!!
text: We absolutely LOVED our stay at La Chambre du Marais. Perfect location, perfect accommodations, perfect breakfast, perfect staff. The breakfast was the best part to be honest. Fresh baked goods and pasteries, deliciousI wish we could always stay in this hotel!!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Too hot
text:
We had come during the heat wave in Paris, warm welcome from the staff, clean and good-sized room, we were surprised that the temperature in the room was so high but we thought that the staff had just turned on the air conditioning,
but at bedtime we couldn't lower the temperature in the room,
we hadn't been able to sleep it was so hot, not even an apology from the manager
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Fantastic!
text: I stayed for a couple of days as a solo traveler. The hotel is heaven. Location is brilliant and the rooms are luxurious. The staff was so polite and friendly and helpful. I absolutely would recommend this hotel and hope to visit again soon!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: New surprise
text: We were in the neighborhood and decided to try it. Exceptionally good service and their suggestions were delicious, even though I am very meticulous. I loved the paté and a "secret sauce" to dip in the bread.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Exceptional Luxurious Parisian Boutique Hotel
text: We can't say enough good things about the staff and our stay at this hotel.  They have a superb concierge service that started weeks before we arrived. The staff was courteous, knowledgeable, friendly and attentive.  The breakfasts were sumptuous and always fresh.  The rooms were exquisitely appointed and extraordinarily comfortable.  This is a gem in the heart of the Marais.  Can't wait to return.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Lovely and clean, with exceptional service
text: This is a beautiful small hotel in the Marais. I have stayed there twice and was impressed both times by the excellent service and attention to detail. The rooms are elegant, not huge but very tastefully decorated and comfortable.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: The perfect hotel in Paris!
text:
It is absolutely the perfect hotel in Paris! Everything is well thought of! Every detail…. It even have the Perfect breakfast!
Everything is fresh and perfect!
The standard room is small… but very clean and pleasant !
We deeply recommend
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great location!
text: Wonderful staff, but room was a bit smaller than expected. Also, housekeeping had to be reminded to attend to the room and to replace free beverages daily. We stayed for 10 nights so were given a free breakfast. Nice touch!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Thank you for the amazing stay!
text: Great cosy boutique hotel in the Marais. Amazing feel as soon as you enter the hotel, very warm welcome,  very tasteful decor.  Beds are so comfortable ! Feels like you are coming home!I will be back! This will be my hotel in Paris forever!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Simply the Best
text: This hotel is a gem in the heart of Paris. You can walk to all the major sites. I can’t imagine I’ll ever stay anywhere else. The staff is excellent. The rooms are excellent. The location is excellent. It’s simply the best.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing stay in quaint neighborhood
text: We loved this hotel and would absolutely stay there again. We spent 6 nights in a deluxe double room and the extra space was wonderful. From the beautiful daily breakfast to the comfortable beds, they think of everything for your comfort. The staff was very helpful with transportation needs and helping with departure Covid testing.  This has been the nicest hotel I’ve stayed at in Paris and I’m looking forward to the next trip.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Lovely hotel!
text: I loved my stay here, found the room so comfortable and pretty and quiet even though it was in a busting neighborhood. The service was great, the bed so comfortable and the location perfect. I will definitely stay here again!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wonderful Experience!  Charming and Relaxing!
text:
To quote another reviewer, I hesitate to advertise this amazing hotel because I want to keep it a secret from everyone else!  
The service was amazing! The staff were so kind and went out of their way to assist!  I apologize if I don't spell their names correctly and I can't remember everyone's name but shout out to Lia and Lucia and the rest!  From the moment we arrived, they took our luggage and brought it to our room which wasn't quite ready and we arrived before noon so we just wanted to drop off our luggage.  They served us coffee and made us feel very welcome.  They were always available to answer questions and assist with transportation reservations.  
Lobby - charming and beautiful! Very clean!  Board games set up if you want to chill and hang out!  Someone is always on duty literally behind the scenes.  Felt very safe and comfortable.
Rooms - the building is a typical European historical building with a smaller lift (2 people max) and a narrow stairwell but very easy to maneuver to get to your floor.
Our room was perfect! It had windows that swing in to allow the feeling of a Juliet Balcony while you relax in your room. Bed was roomy and very comfortable.  Bathroom was great - huge tub and shower!  Toilet room was also nice with a very small sink.  Plenty of closets.
Suggestions: for the small sink in the bathroom, do not turn it on fully as it will spray and get all over the floor.  Perhaps leave a small bath mat below the sink to absorb the puddle in the toilet room.
Suggestions:  add a few more towel hooks.  The heated towel bar is great however would benefit from additional smaller hooks to hang other towels or clothes that need some airing out.
Did not discover the luggage rack under the bed until our last day.  
Beautifully designed rooms.  Bathroom contains everything you need.  The closet also has a hidden beautiful box with items you may have forgotten for your trip.  Bathrobes and slippers were a nice addition!
Contrary to other reviewers, I believe they did refill our small shower gel and shampoo.
When we arrived there was a beautiful box of handmade carmels on our bed.
In addition, they arranged for a surprise gift for me that was ordered by my sibling for my birthday.  They served us champagne on ice with a dozen roses in a beautiful vase!
I can't wait to go back.
Yes, it is pricey but it is a very special boutique hotel.
Location is fabulous. You can walk everywhere.  Great restaurants - located near corner of Rue des Archives and Rue de Bretagne.  

Good note:There is no smoking in the hotel - which is great!

Paris Note:  However, beware that throughout Paris, it seems like everyone is smoking at every outdoor cafe!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Hidden Parisien Gem
text: We stayed here four nights in late April and it was perfect. The hotel has a relax boutique feel to it while being luxurious at the same time. The bed was great, staff was on top of everything, and the included breakfast each day was perfect. Highly recommend!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Beautiful place-Good Location-Great staff
text: Beautifully decorated boutique hotel. Delicious breakfast options. Great location for seeing the district and people watching. There are many dining and  shopping options available. It’s not from rail  Staff is very friendly and personable .
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Another very nice stay at La Chambre du Marais
text: The hotel is situated in a lively but still peaceful area with park, cafes etc. The hotel itself has a 'classical' layout, and nicely decorated rooms with excellent bathroom facilities. Breakfast is very good, and staff very helpful so you feel very welcome
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Stay for 3 days in La Chambre du Marais Paris
text: we stayed at La Chambre du Marais for 3 days, a family of 6 (2 Adults and 4 children), the hotel is beautiful, the stuff is amazing, the location is great and we enjoyed every minute. we recommend  the hotel, for couples and for families, we sure we will be back visiting the hotel.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Gem of a Hotel
text:
Picking a hotel in Paris can be very overwhelming so, please, reach out to me if you have questions and know you can book this hotel with confidence.  

If you can afford this hotel and like boutique experiences, look no further.  There is no front desk staff but the staff is there to welcome you all hours in the beautiful foyer you step in from the street.  Leah was my favorite person there.  So helpful and sweet.  They all are very attentive to every need.

The rooms are beautiful and cozy and the bed is absurdly comfortable. There  is also a Nespresso machine, a towel warmer, Frette sheets.  They do need more drawer space for clothes but a small detail I'm happy to overlook.

The breakfast is lovely if you want to take it slow in the morning.  

Wonderful.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: A gem in the middle of a beautiful Parisian neighborhood
text: We were looking for the perfect place to stay on our trip to Paris and we found it! A gem of a hotel -  boutique - in the Marais, a beautiful and centrally located neighborhood. Safe, fun and interesting. I wouldn't think of staying anywhere else. The room was lovely and comfortable, the staff was amazing and helpful, breakfast was delicious and plentiful. Highly recommend!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: A gift
text:
It’s a gift when you have the greatest hospitality in the lovely Marais. The hotel and her staff made our days in Paris great.
The location is perfect. You walk out of the door and the buzzle is just around the corner. Top!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great stay in Paris!
text: Thank you for a memorable days, amazing stay and great service and attention for all details! The staff was very attentive and gave us good feeling , making our stay wonderful! We will definitely come back to stay again here! Thank you so much!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Extremely wonderful experience
text: Everything - the staff, the room, the ambience, the location (fantastic location), amenities - was fabulous. I had the smallest room in the hotel as I was travelling solo and even then the room was more than adequately sized for me and extremely clean and comfortable and chic. Couldn’t recommend this place enough, I’ll surely live here on my next trip to paris
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Gorgeous.  A little gem in our favourite area of Paris.
text: We love this hotel and  wish we could have stayed longer. Everything was perfect -  very high quality and and very special - and cosy and friendly. A real home-from-home - with luxury!.  And the location is perfect - right in the middle of our favourite area of Paris. We will definitely come to stay again,  and will recommend to friends.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: I would highly recommend La Chambre du Marais  to anyone visiting Paris.
text: The staff were extremely welcoming and accommodating. The location was excellent. I would recommend getting the breakfast, it was a great start to the day and delicious. The rooms were clean and comfortable. Our experience was 10/10.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing hotel! Definitely coming back
text: Great location. Really get the local Parisian vibe. Rooms are very well furnished and the free unlimited tea and coffee are amazing. Staff very helpful and easy going. Spaces are small but it is compensated with the high quality hotel amenities
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Beautiful, Personal Boutique Hotel
text:
Incredibly special hotel located in one of the best neighborhoods in Paris! 
The attention to detail and service makes this boutique hotel one of the best I’ve stayed in. It is so lovely how they bring you a free coffee every morning, and they even remembered what my specific order was. 
The room was cozy but felt luxurious at the same time. It always smelled so good everywhere in the hotel. 
This beautiful hotel will be my go-to whenever in Paris
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Very beautiful and cosy hotel on top location!
text: Very personal and elegant hotel in Le Marais. On walking distance of lots of great restaurants and bars. Room was small but luxurious and the bed is fantastic. The minibar has a great selection of spirits. Faby the manager made us feel at home right away! I will definitely come back!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Highly Recommend
text: I almost don't want to write this review because this is a secret that I almost wish to keep that way.  But that would not be fair to this small but excellent little hotel.  Great staff and excellent location.  My wife and I have stayed here 4 times and each time it is a pleasure.  Rooms are small as are typical with neighborhood hotels in Paris, but well appointed and the service is personal and thorough.  Only problem is the slow internet but they will improve that - encourages one to partake in Parisian life anyways.  But could be a challenge for business travelers.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Nice stay
text: Very good, friendly staff and breakfast was very good. Good location close to some good restaurants and things to visit. We can recommend it to everyone. The staff also speaks english if your French isn't good.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Excellent! Nothing to improve
text: Really loved it, will come back next time. The room is small and the bed is not big enough for certain people. Be aware of that (the staff did clearly inform us of this in advance). It was not a problem for us, being a mom and daughter. But for a couple It might be a bit small. I loved everything about the hotel, especially the wonderful people working there. And the whole atmosphere. Will definitely come back
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great hotel - great stay!
text: Very cool and pretty hotel. The location is unbeatable with lots of bars, restaurants and shopping places around. The staff are amazingly nice and helpfull. My room was the smallest kind in the hotel but it was still very comfortable. I will absolutely stay there again! 10/10
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Perfect Paris Hotel
text: We traveled to Paris for my Mum’s birthday. From the moment we arrived until the moment we left, everything in the hotel was perfect. We felt that the staff genuinely wanted us to have a lovely time and would do anything to help. I would not hesitate to recommend the hotel and look forward to returning.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wonderful stay at La Chambre du Marais
text: A gorgeous boutique hotel in the Marais district.  I was travelling solo to meet up with my son and wanted a comfortable room with an ensuite.  If you are looking for comfort, an excellent location and a delicious breakfast, then stay here!  The staff are friendly and extremely helpful.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing hotel in the best part of Marais
text: We spent a weekend at this amazing hotel. Service and food was excellent, the junior suite fit perfectly to our need and the staff was very friendly and service minded. I really recommend that you choose this hotel!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Excellent choice
text: Very good choice. The suite was lovely (the hotel had some details like small bomboms and the location in "Le Marais" is perfect for visiting Paris. Very good atention at the reception. I would recommend it for couples
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Amazing!
text: We loved the hotel! The staff was the friendliest staff we ever met. They made sure our stay was as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. The location was superb in the heart of Le Marais. The only thing we didn’t expect is that the room we got was a bit small for a couple.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Nice and Cousy hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
Loved my stay at this hotel, the staff (all of them) are amazing, really friendly and helpful.
The quality and variety of breakfast is very good, the room is quite small but the bed is so comfortable and that is the most important for me,
I definitely recommend this hotel, I will come back for sure.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: A perfect stay in the Marais
text: This is the second time I have stayed at the hotel- it's brilliantly located to explore the district, the rooms are stylish, clean and cosy but, above all, the staff are exceptionally helpful and welcoming.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wonderful place at Le Marais
text: It was my second time in this hotel, The first time I chose it for its proximity to my workplace. This time because I falling in love for this wonderful small hotel at Le Marais, one of my favorites places in Paris
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great location, friendly staff
text:
Pros: location, clean room, spacious room, responsive & friendly staff, quiet, nice amenities (Clarins, coffee & tea).

Cons: seemed pricey, but this was a last minute booking and Paris was packed.

Notable: there was a very minor maintenance issue that was immediately & thoroughly addressed after we brought to the staff’s attention.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: LOVED IT!!!
text:
I love Paris and have been there a bit for work over the years.  This time though I really wanted to stay in Marais because I was brining my 11 year old daughter (plus my friend and her daughter) for her first time to Paris. I specifically looked to book a cool, small 4-5 star hotel that felt special, lux and local....and not super formal , stuffy and overly lux. 

I read a ton of reviews and booked this one. During COVID we had to reschedule and we had a few questions about COVID, etc during the months leading up to our stay.  The hotel staff  was responsive and timely over email which is always a great sign of customer service.

From the moment we entered, we were happy.  We greeted by the Lea.  She always had a smile and it never felt forced.  We would come in and out, and she always greeted us and asked if we needed anything. The whole staff -- Lea, Aurelien, Sarah, Mario and housekeeping, -- is great.  They are professional, relaxed, friendly and helpful. 

Upon entering the rooms, we were pleasantly surprised.  There was a ton of light, everything was spotless and the sheets were crips white.  The rooms had this cute local feel and were welcoming.. Every morning we would open the windows and just look out because the street was the perfect photo on a sunny day -- beautiful buildings and a little cafe below.. Also -- and this almost never happens -- I slept so well cause the beds, linens and pillows were so comfortable. Housekeeping did an impeccable job with our two bedroom (which felt like an apt and perfect for 4 people).  We knew we were not going to spend a lot of time at the hotel, so having huge rooms didn't matter to us.  A cool, beautiful, clean, cared -for hotel with good staff + amenities + awesome location mattered most.  The Hotel du Marais checked those boxes for us. Small things like friendliness, sweet treats in the room when you arrive and so on make a huge difference. 

Lastly, the neighborhood is GREAT.  There is so much to do, load of shopping, restaurants, cafes, coffee shops and more.  I would/will stay there again!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Fantastic Stay!
text: Such a beautiful hotel, with such kind and gracious staff. We booked at the last minute for one night and everything was perfect. Our room was one of the smaller rooms but the shower and bathroom were enormous by hotel standards, and everything was perfectly designed for beauty and comfort. The room had a beautiful view onto the neighborhood and Square du Temple, the bed was extremely comfortable, and there were so many little touches that made it special.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Nice hotel in the heart of Marais. Grumpy staff.
text: Beautiful and clean hotel with the best position in the heart of Marais. French style and comfort. Good and varied breakfast. Very quiet and nice beds. Too bad for the mostly grumpy and not very efficient staff.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Perfect location and amazing staff
text:
Centrally located in an amazing area surronded by great restaurants and shops. Beautiful boutique hotel with small (Paris standard) but beautiful rooms and a spacious bathroom. Very comfortable bed and accomidating, friendly and lovely staff.

Highly reccomend - we will go back!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wes Anderson style lobby. Topnotch service and staff. This is a must-do hotel.
text: This charming botique hotel understands the importance of details: prior communication,  customer service,  beautiful lobby and rooms, Covid clean and safe, comfortable rooms (4 pillows!,) pampering, and convenience. This was our favorite hotel experience in Paris and Chinon, by far. The General Manager, Faby Thibaud, was stellar from start to finish,  as was the entire staff. The location was good as well. We had three rooms and we ranged in ages 23 to 63, and were all made to feel welcome and loved the experience.  Their reception greeting with beverages is lovely and a rarity amongst hotels who check you in and send you on your way. They arranged airport transportation and printed our required Covid documents needed to return to the USA too. No detail was overlooked by this wonderful staff. This hotel is 100%+.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Lovely hotel with friendly staff and good location
text: Lovely hotel in Marais with super friendly staff, good location and great breakfast. The room was very small, but cosy and clean, and very nice bathroom. Quite noisy street, but other than this it was great!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Perfect boutique hotel in Marais
text:
I was in Paris for 2 weeks and stayed in three different neighborhoods.  In the Marais, I stayed at the lovely La Chambre du Marais.  The room was spotless and the bedding very comfortable.  The room overlooked Square Temple and with the windows closed was very quiet.  The breakfast is exceptional.  Eggs are cooked to order and beautifully presented.  The staff is very pleasant and professional.  

Great location.  Several very good restaurants nearby.  I was planning to stay 5 nights but, unfortunately, needed to change my flight home to the States and only stayed 3.  I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend.
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Wonderful honeymoon
text: We stayed at La Chambre du Marais for our honeymoon. We had postponed our wedding and honeymoon three times because of Covid but each time Faby, the manager,  changed our booking without a problem.  The hotel is in a perfect location surrounded by bars and restaurants and it is easy to get everywhere on foot. Our room (Pierre) was gorgeous and the downstairs bar area was so elegant and comfortable.  The breakfast was amazing - the best hotel breakfast we've had. But what really makes this hotel so special is the amazing staff - from the moment we arrived (very late at night after our wedding in London) we were made welcome , and the staff went out of their way to make sure we had a great time. We will always stay at La Chambre du Marais when we come to Paris from now on
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Great stay in Le Marais
text: Excellent hotel, friendly staff, great breakfast, close to shopping and metro.  If you want to stay in a real Parisian neighbourhood, try Le Marais, you hear mostly French!!  Staff at hotel very helpful and accommodating
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Stay in Le Marais Boutique Hotel to get a taste of French life
text: Lovely boutique hotel, great location, easy walking to everything or short walk to several Metro lines.  Staff were wonderful and accommodating.  Rooms  clean, perhaps not overly spacious…but this is Europe.  Bathroom lovely, update with nice amenities….highly recommend adding the breakfast which was fresh, plentiful and something for everyone.  Would stay in Le Marais again…its where people live, if you prefer not to be among all tourists!
name: La Chambre du Marais

title: Excellent stay, perfect location!
text: La Chambre du Marais was the perfect little boutique hotel with upscale amenities and very friendly staff that made us feel welcome.  Perfect location with many dining and shopping options close by.  Metro within a 5 minute walk.  Will definitely visit again, we loved the neighborhood and hotel.  Made our first trip to Paris a true treat!

title: Wonderful place to land, great neighborhood

title: The best boutique hotel in the coolest neighborhood
text: So happy with our (too) short stay at La Chambre.  Faby, the manager, was onsite daily and so so friendly.  The room was very European in size but beautiful and spectacularly clean. I’m not sure I’ve ever seen a more pristine hotel room.  The bathroom was very roomy and absolutely beautiful.  This being our first visit to Paris we were told by friends to stay in the Marais neighborhood and we are very glad we did.  We fell in love with Paris immediately and are constantly looking opportunities to return.  Faby and La Chambre du Marais are fantastic.

title: Lovely Hotel
text:
Had a nice welcome from Dillon on arrival. View from our suite of the Eiffel Tower was amazing, exactly like the photos. Room was spacious enough for a huge bed plus a single bed for our daughter. Shower was great also. We enjoyed the breakfast on the first morning, however on the second morning it was busier and difficult to find a table, so chose breakfast in our room for our final morning, which arrived at the time requested. 
The hotel is perfectly placed, close to the Eiffel Tower, shops, restaurants and bistros - even a McDonalds 200m away. Sandwiched between 2 metro stations makes the rest of the city easily accessible.  There was even a small street market on the central reservation in front of the hotel on one of the mornings.
We've knocked off one star mainly because of our breakfast experience on the second morning and some very minor points in the room (lack of a bin in main bedroom, not enough milk for drinks -although I appreciate this may be a british thing🙂).
For a really nice reasonably priced hotel, well located, with cracking views of the Eiffel Tower then this hotel is well worth considering. 
Thanks for a lovely short stay.

title: Nearly there… great staff though
text:
My partner had booked this hotel for our weekend getaway to Paris for my 30th birthday. On arrival (quite late) I had to phone the hotel as there wasn’t anyone in the reception area to check us in, we had been waiting over 10 minutes. I did eventually get through to the night attendant through my phone-call who swiftly came to us after I believe sorting something to do with parking? 
He was really welcoming, pleasant and helpful and checked us in to our room. We were given a room on the first floor so we then took the lift up. 
On arrival into the room, our window was nicely open and the room was spacious and clean. Sadly, it wasn’t an Eiffel view but I think my partner had got a little confused when booking- I am typically the organiser for trips but this was a surprise. 
What really puzzled me and slightly annoyed me, was why we had clearly been booked into a disabled access room? I despise wet rooms and this is exactly what we had. Being late, I couldn’t be bothered to discuss this with the hotel and as we were in Paris for a short time, it didn’t seem worth it. But this did upset me as we really didn’t need this type of room. The bed was also very creaky. 
The bathroom, being a wet room, looked like it could do with a touch up. The door was splitting from water damage and around that area it looked untidy. 
The toiletries were great however, my favourite L’occitane.

Those were the parts that were disappointing but I will outlay the positives here! 
- close to 2 metro stations
- excellent staff
- able to leave luggage until departure 
- close to the Eiffel Tower 
- quiet 
-opposite market

title: Great boutique hotel
text: Perfect location in Le Marais, a walking distance almost everywhere. Super helpful staff and they were very flexible with our booking requirements. Room was quite large for central Paris and had all the amenities.
