title: Lovely, hip and comfortable
text: On a great street with plenty of restaurants, Jules & Jim was a gorgeous getaway for three ladies looking to stay in a room together. Our duplex was small but comfortable with great amenities. The courtyard is beautiful and the staff were super friendly.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: I love the Jules et Jim!
text: I can't even call this a hotel as it is more of a home away from home. The personalized service is amazing. From the moment you walk in you are greeted with a smile by everyone that you meet. The staff (another word I don't want to use) is so friendly and knowledgable. This was first stay in many years for obvious reasons, and while the faces may have changed, everything I remember is still intact. As someone who travels constantly for work it was nice to spend 5 nights and feel just as comfrtable as I would in my own home. And 2 thumbs up to Nicolas! His patience with this crazy NYer's questions was very much appreciated.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect location for a mini break in Paris
text: In the heart of Le Marais, this was the perfect choice for our 2 day stay in Paris. We stayed as a couple - enjoying the 40 min walk from Gare du Nord and the proximity to the excellent shops nearby. Very clean, lovely staff, perfect gym too! This is a hidden gem - we will be back!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Amazing and so very perfect!
text: Jules & Jim is a sweet little boutique hotel in the heart of the Marais. Even though we arrived at six in the morning Paris time knowing that the room was not ready the staff couldn’t have been any more accommodating. Simon from the moment we arrived was so attentive and so kind and really made sure we were comfortable. The Aesthetic of the hotel was modern and officiant.  The room was like a little ship everything had its place and purpose. Simon investigated things for us and stayed on top of everything he made us feel like family accommodating our every need. He even helped us to rearrange our trip. I would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling. As a mother daughter duo it was very comforting for our first days  in Paris.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great hotel in the 3e
text: During my 4 week stay in Paris, I needed the weekend at the end.  The staff is excellent and very accommodating.   Having air conditioning was great...and I had the top room with the balcony...and yes, you can see the stars at night!  I would highly recommend.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great Stay, Wonderful staff
text: Not usually an internet review person, but after our stay at Jules et Jim, i had to! We stayed for a week, in the heart of le Marais. The staff here (Bonjour Simon et Ricardo!! ) made us feel welcome and at ease right away. After a long trip from Pennsylvania, coming into the artful lobby and being greeted with smiling faces and a clean and fresh room was a welcome sight for two tired travelers. The staff never missed the opportunity to ask us if we needed anything and helped us with whatever we asked for, from taxi's to covid tests and recommendations. In addition to the great staff, the location put us within a 10 minute walk of all the bakeries, cafe's, wine bars, shopping and first rate people watching that you could ask for. If you want an authentic Paris experience, stay at Jules et Jim, You will not be disappointed.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great hotel in a great location.
text: We had some difficulty with our booking but the care was dedicated and the hotel seems to be trying very hard to give us the best service possible. The room was small but neat and well designed. The decor is very nice and it was fun to come back to the hotel every day. The location is perfect for me.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect
text:
Wonderful staff, wonderful room (hi-macs), the design of the room is great ! The barman makes his own cocktails and i got the best cocktail in my life !
The decorations outside is super nice too ! 
Loved everything, i absolutely advise this hotel.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great on ALL Fronts for Vacationing in Paris
text: Jules & Jim lived up to all the great reviews — location, service, rooms, food/drinks from the bar were all exceptional.  If you can…get top floor (8th) — ours had fabulous view of Sacra Couer and nice balcony.  Know that rooms are small…but if you want a big room — pay way more elsewhere and lose the charm.  (PS:  our cheese plate with negroni’s was one of our best meals in Paris.)
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: My favorite hotel in Paris
text: I stayed at the Hotel Jules et Jim for three weeks, and I had a marvelous experience. The hotel is super clean, with super spacious rooms, and a very modern/ trendy common space. The team is always friendly, and helpful, and made me feel like I was at home. The location is also great, very close to trains, bars, restaurants, and little shops. This hotel is now the only hotel that I will stay at in Paris.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: My favorite hotel in Paris
text: While I'm sure many people think of Jules & Jim for a leisure stay, I love to stay there for business trips. The staff is always attentive and responsive. I love to use the patio as my own semi-private work space -- and for a drink at the end of the day. Plus, there are some great restaurants and bars nearby. Highly recommend.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Jules et Jim is awesome
text: Best place ever! Staff is so friendly, neighborhood is so charming, and hotel is so quaint, we always look forward to our trips here. This is truly one of the best finds in the cool Marais neighborhood. And check out the bar for some killer cocktails!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: 5 Star Boutique Hotel in amazing neighborhood
text: Incredible boutique hotel in the heart of a great neighborhood. Customer service was above and beyond - early check, late check out.  Friendly staff, great cocktail bar with friendly bartenders (Ricardo is the man) Gave me all the info I needed to explore the city. Rooms were clean and modern design. Highly recommend this hotel and plan on returning just loved everything about it.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great stay
text: Lovey staff made my staff most comfortable. Highly recommended. Proximity is perfect near to the shops on Rue Rivoli and attractions. Notre Dame is just 10 mins brisk walk away and the Louvre 15 mins.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Jewel of a Hotel with fantastic staff
text: A descreet boutique hotel in the heart of le marais.    Is a quiet oasis on an eclectic quiet street.    Top-notch gym (Technogym equipment).     Simon at the front desk was simply amazing -  great attention to detail with reservations, printing travel desks, and organizing travel.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: We lived our best Paris life here!
text: This will be our go-to place whenever we visit Paris, it was absolute perfection! We stayed for 4 nights and loved every minute of it. The staff are very friendly and super helpful. The location in the Marais was perfect - near multiple subway lines and within walking distance to major attractions. We stayed in Room 2 just off the courtyard and it was bliss - just the right size, not too loud despite being next to the courtyard and the hotel bar (the bar gets some locals stopping by, which we liked, and closed around 10:30pm so there were no noise issues when we were ready to sleep), huge bathroom, and super comfy bed. The morning breakfast is just the right size with several simple but satisfying options. The hotel bar (which is the same place breakfast is served) is a great place for pre or post-dinner drinks and snacks. The bartender was very friendly, chatty, and gave great recommendations. I can't say enough great things about this hotel. We can't wait to visit again!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Amazing hotel and exceptional staff
text: The hotel is a chic boutique hotel located in the heart of the Marais, in an excellent area. The design of the hotel, the common areas and the rooms is spectacular. But above all stands out the very high level of cleanliness of the hotel and even more the level of courtesy and service of the staff. I have been to many hotels in Europe and have never encountered such a pleasant and good treatment. warmly recommended!!!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Excellent things combined
text: Whether you are in Paris for business or pleasure: hotel Jules et Jim is an excellent place to stay. Perfectly located in the 3rd for all things cultural but also for shopping and eating. There is a quiet and comforting luxury in the rooms - that makes you feel at home - and there is the constant quality of the breakfast, cocktail bar and all other things that are offered. The staff is kind and super helpful and the intimate courtyard and breakfast / cocktail room offers a lovely space for occasional business meetings. - Nanda
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Amazing location and staff
text: We stayed for the weekend and could not choose a better hotel to experience the city to it’s fullest. The staff were very welcoming from the very first moment and had great tips for places to visit. They were always one step ahead, caring for all our needs. Could not recommend more, we will definitely be back again.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Very nice, merci!
text: It was a very pleasant stay. Everything and everybody from reception to breakfast/ bar and cleanliness just perfect. Genuinely friendly staff, well chosen cosmetics in the comfortable room, nice baguette, croissants and pain au chocolat for breakfast and good wine at the bar, cozy green backyard. Merci!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Style over substance
text: Style over substance. Surprised by the high ratings after many years of staying in many hotels Paris. Yes, some rooms have interesting design but there are many different levels of accommodation. We were first given a ground floor room overlooking the bins and told that the hotel is full. We were eventually shown several other rooms that suddenly became available. The room we were finally given at least had some outdoor space but the overly complicated electronic blind and lighting system made it impossible to enjoy fresh air. Air-conditioning was controlled by the desk and for some bizarre reason put on heating when the temperature was 20+ degrees outside. They did change it for the second night but for the first night it was impossible to sleep. The walls are paper thin and we heard  every sound from the neighbours. As pretty as the room is we would wouldn’t stay here again. It is expensive for what it is and there are equally good options which provide a better nights sleep with less  technology and over design to complicate things.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: An amazing stay at a charming hotel
text: I've known Hotel Jules & Jim for years, and used to go there for drinks 10 years ago when I was living in Paris. This summer I decided to stay with them for the first time, and we had an amazing time, the hotel is the perfect example of a charming boutique hotel in the center of Paris. I stayed with the kids (2 and 12 yo) and the staff did their best to make our stay easy. I strongly recommend staying there, especially if you're looking for a romantic hotel as a couple
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: I know where I will stay next time
text:
What a great stay! 
First i booked for 3 day’s -  after one day- I extended for another 3 day’s.  That’s because of this great place!
Nice helpful people at the front desk. Clean and beautiful room. In the middle of the hip neighborhood of Marais.
I’m happy to know where I will stay next time in Paris!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: A little boutique gem in Paris
text: This little boutique experience was one of a kind in my first visit to Paris. The staff was super friendly, location perfect and the room so lovely and clean with fresh flowers, little balcony and the very best bed and sheets!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great Hotel!
text: We recently stayed and Jules and Jim and would highly recommend.  Very friendly and helpful staff, nice location, and great rooms.  Breakfast was great as well.  Overall, a great place to stay while in Paris.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Very nice hotel in the middle of TheMarais. Friendly people, clean, rooms with a very special architecture (top!).
text:
Very happy to have chosen this hotel. We are sure to have find a new (temporary) home when we are in Paris. Very tasteful interior, helpful people (French/Englisch spoken), well situated in the Marais, close to metro, delicious breakfast and clean. 
Fresh flowers in your room!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Fantastic hotel in Le Marais, would love to come back!
text: This hotel was beautiful!! The design, atmosphere and service was fantastic, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We stayed three nights on our honeymoon, this location was also amazing; easy to walk to everything, which we did. Great restaurants and bars nearby, fun to choose between so many choices. Staff was also friendly and very helpful, we enjoyed their suggestions to places nearby (Thanks Pierre!) We're also very tall and this location used the space perfectly, we were amazed how spacious it was. We had a wonderful time and would love to stay again!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: The finest hotel for romantic weekend
text:
Me and my wife were visiting Paris for a long weekend. 
We chose to stay at Jules and Jim and it was absolutely great. 
The hotel is located in a very joyful surroundings, lots of coffee places, patisseries and Boulangeries. 
The hotel itself is clean, modern and have a lot of style. 
The crew that runs it are nice and professional. 
It has its own bar which has a unique atmosphere. 
Very much recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Lovely balcony, tiny room.
text: Interesting earthy party of Paris. Nice bar and feel to the hotel but we'd booked the most expensive room for the rooftop balcony. The room though was tiny which will make us think twice about returning. Shame.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Unique Boutique
text: This was a very cute little hotel, on a quiet side street but very near restaurants and museums.  We walked everywhere after taking their recommended transportation from the airport.  That was flawless and we were glad we had that initial introduction to Paris, never having been here before.  The hotel is very well done, but be prepared for a compact space, equivalent to a typical exterior room on a cruise ship.  The bathroom and awesome shower overlooking the street below made up for the tiny room size.  We would stay here again.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: "Tremendous staff!" "Lovely Room!"
text: All the staff at the hotel were really great, welcoming and super helpful. Our Hi-Mac room was delightful and actually quite fun. The clever design of the room, complete with a small balcony, made our 9 night stay a delight. The hotel's location was also fantastic, on a quiet street, centrally located. Special thanks to Zulema and Pierre for their help in recommending and securing reservations at wonderful neighbourhood restaurants.We look forward to our next chance to stay at Hotel Jules&Jim.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Cute place
text:
Have been there for one night. Very clean, renovated and elegantly devoted place. 
The bar is absolutely charming and the breakfast excellent (gluten-free friendly)
Rooms are a bit small though and bath room was very cold when I arrived at night
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: A lot to love
text: I was surprised by my partner by a trip to Paris for New Year and this hotel is amazing in every respect. The quirky yet comfortable decor and such friendly and helpful staff. Special thanks to Pierre and Ben who could not do enough to help from booking taxis to making us great cocktails. A gem in a great part of wonderful Paris!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: What an incredible hotel and experience.
text: From the moment I arrived to the moment I left, I was thrilled with this hotel. It was the loveliest experience, with the friendliest hotel staff ever. I say this, because they felt like friends. They were kind, helpful, and genuinely wanted to insure that their guests had the best time while staying there. If I needed anything, they promptly addressed it. The room itself was absolutely adorable and remarkably well-designed. Both the circular shape of my room and the private feel of the elevator landing were big points for me. Little touches, like the TV behind the mirror, dimmable lighting and electric shades were huge wins as well. And I'll be dreaming about that showerhead for some time...
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Super hôtel! J’ai adoré!
text: Great hotel at the heart of Le Marais. Good location close to bars and restaurants, excellent service and very comfortable room. I loved staying there. It felt like a home. I  would like to highlight that the receptionist Pierre and the Jules and Jim staff are very kind, attentive, and helpful!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: 6 out of 5 stars!!
text:
Wow, what an experience! Charming and quirky, and well located, but most of all an exceptional team who after just 4 days felt like friends: everyone from front desk, cocktail barman, breakfast staff and cleaners always went the extra mile to make our New Year family trip a fantastic success. Can’t wait for our next visit.
Thanks Team J&J!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: An amazing stay in the heart of Paris
text: A great hotel, with a great service. You feel special and you are treated special. The rooms are clean, cosy and sexy. The neighborhood is very vivid and central, but yet quiet. Restaurants and sight seeing are all nearby. When we were there, public transportation in Paris was down, but that didn't bother us since we could everything on foot. Don't hesitate, just book, the place, you will not regret it.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: weekend in paris
text:
we had a great time in Paris
great location 
great stuff.
room with balcony small but beautiful.
beside an option for tea/caffe in the room the room are eqipimet very well.
planning to return :).
,,,,,
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Keep coming back for this amazing gem in the center of Paris
text:
I've been coming to this hotel for the past year and each time they seem to surprise me. 

Last time I stayed in the Hi-Mac room, the same comfort as the other rooms are there but these rooms are very digital. One simple console for the blinds, lights and everything. 

The staff is exceptional, always with a very personal touch and friendly. The bar is very lively and cosy and all around the central courtyard which brings an oasis of rest. Design of the hotel is beautiful with many changing art. 

The best little secret gem in Paris, looking forward to come back!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: A beautiful surprise
text: situated between centre Pompidou and les Marais, this little hotel is a real jewel. Super kind and efficient personnel , cozy rooms and very silent! I really recommend this place for a long weekend, definitively to check !
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great boutique hotel in the Marais
text: Superb boutique hotel in excellent location in the Marais, just a short walking distance from the metro. Good sized room with everything you need. Friendly and helpful staff, and great cocktails in the hotel bar!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfection all around
text: Stayed here for one night - had a perfect stay. The staff was very friendly - from offering me a cappuccino to wake  up after a red eye, to helping me find local options, the whole staff ensured i had a perfect stay. The layout of the hotel is very cute - from the outdoor seating area, to the vertical layout, I really felt like I was in the heart of the Marais. Prices are reasonable, location is ideal, breakfast is easy, the rooms were very clean and stocked very nice amenities. Perfect for a couple on a few day get away. Could not have asked for more
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Shorttrip to Paris
text:
The 4 days in Paris were wonderful.
We stayed in this Hotel in the middle of the older part of Paris, called Marais.
From there it was possible to WALK! to all the famous monuments as Sacre Coeur, Notre Dame, Louvre - only to the Eiffelturm we took a velotaxi.
For us it was a great pleasure to walk down the street, slow down an arrive with much more impressions at the sightseeings than go there by metro.

If we come back - an we will come back! - we would choose Jules & Jim again, that's sure! There could be no better Hotel to explore in few days the heart of Paris

We don't eat in the hotel, because we want to breath the daily life of Paris and therefore we go always in different bistros to have breakfast, lunch and dinner - and there are a lot of possiblities surround....
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Nice quiet place in heart of Paris.
text: Very quiet very private rooms.  While a little snug for American tastes, it is Paris after all.  Nice walk to Notre Dame, ville de hotel, shopping. Convenient to metro.  Staff is excellent.  Friendly, knowledgeable.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Wonderful for solo female traveler
text: Everything about this hotel was top-notch - the front desk was super-friendly and professional and also accommodated my early check-in, the room was clean and felt new.  My room was the only room upon exiting the elevator - so I felt extra safe, which is important to me as a solo female traveler.  Loved the fresh flowers and the adjustable lighting in the room, as well as Molten Brown products in the bathroom and the bottle of fresh water.  I didn't try the bar or breakfast.  Will definitely be going back and also recommending to my friends.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Excellent Boutique Hotel, Phenomenal Staff - STAY HERE!
text: My six-night stay at Hotel Jules & Jim was exceptional. My room was modern, chic and comfortable as is the entire hotel. It's tucked away on a side-street in the Marais so the location is quiet yet very convenient to just about everything - shopping, sights to see, Metro, restaurants, patisseries, cafes - everything. Everyone on the staff is friendly, helpful, confident, welcoming and highly professional. Upon my arrival, Pierre at reception introduced himself to me immediately and said he would be my concierge, so if I needed directions, dinner reservations or anything else to make my visit to Paris enjoyable I should let him know. He had excellent suggestions for restaurants and shopping areas and made sure I had a well-marked map to help me find my way around the Marais. Everyone else I encountered at Jules & Jim were also as friendly and helpful, so my thanks to Pierre, Simon, Henri, Alex and everyone else whose names I don't know for making my first trip to Paris so enjoyable. Vous êtes génial et je reviendrai!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Consistently Wonderful
text:
I stay here a lot so i am the best kind of biased.   However i have stayed at many other hotels in the are before i stumbled upon this great place!

The hotel really is a hidden gem in the bustling Marais 

There are many small hotels to choose from in this area - but the Jules and Jim is by far the best.  Service and the concierge are first rate - the staff really cares about how your stay is going and acts on any request in a low key highly professional way.  The rooms are fantastic - well thought out contemporary and sparkling

Breakfast and the bar are first rate as are the staff both morning and night.   Best of all - even with an active bar scene the hotel is quiet.  Set back and well constructed - there is no noise

Highly recommend the Jules and Jim and can’t wait to come back!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Lovely little gem
text:
This hotel offered perfect experience and had a real boutique feel to it.
The room was well designed and super clean and the staff was nice and helpful. The location is great too. 
Will definitely return here.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Excellent hotel, great staff and service, wonderful location
text: Loved our stay at Jules & Jim, clean and chique rooms, staff friendly and helpful. Enjoyed all the facilities, especially the bar and the art on the walls. Location is great, right in the center of the Marais,
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Hot location, cool hotel
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Jules & Jim in Le Marais for five nights, but my positive experience began before I even arrived, with Pierre helping me with arrangements for my Paris Museum Pass and then giving me the info I needed to book a "niche" (time slot) at the Louvre. 

The hotel is tucked away and easy to miss if you're not looking, thanks to it's grey exterior and subtle signage. There is a courtyard in the middle that serves as the outdoor morning breakfast / afternoon-evening drinks area, in addition to an indoor common space. The courtyard is quiet and tucked away, like a secret.

My room felt spacious after the pension in Munich, so small by American standards but big enough, with a queen bed, two petite chairs and a little table. The shower could have held two people and the rain head was delicious. The bed was comfortable as were the pillows, and the thermostat in the room was responsive.

I had an interior room that overlooked the courtyard so no view of Paris but that was fine with me, as it made my room a quiet little hideaway.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Fabulous! Fabulous!
text: We had two rooms for two nights, and I was truly delighted with this boutique hotel.  The staff were super friendly and attentive to every matter.  The rooms are modern chic and warm, not modern cold in vibe.  The courtyard, bar, breakfast, and location are all a delightful retreat in Paris.  I long for more hotels like this in the world. I am certain that I will be back.  -- A very frequent traveler.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Nice boutique hotel with fantastic view
text:
가장 탑층인 81호에묵었습니다 발코니에서 샤크레쾨르사원과 마레지구의 지붕들이 아주멋지게 파노라마로 펼쳐집니다. 방은 냉장고나 티비가 없고 아주 작지만 홈피에서 미리알고예약한거라 괜찮았어요.천장에난 창과 발코니에서 구름과하늘 시시각각변하는 풍경을바라보느라 시간가는줄 몰랐네요 마레지구북쪽이나 쇼핑가를가기에도 적합한위치이나 메인골목보다안쪽이라 조용합니다 조식도맛있고 만들어주는커피도 좋습니다 직원들도 굉장히친절하구요 저는아주만족했습니다 I stayed in room 81 for 2days.
The room was small but very well planned in structure. However, I think it would be better if the showerbooth's glass was opaque.
 From the balcony of the room, I could see the fantastic view of Sacre-Coeur, and from the window on the ceiling, I could also see the beautiful clouds of the sky. 
Breakfast was the best. The baguette was very delicious and the coffee was also good.
 The best thing of this hotel is its friendly and warm staff. They always did their best, and whenever I asked a favor, they immediately answered and handled it. 
 Thank you to all the staff.
I recommend this lovely hotel to everyone.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Very "cool" hotel
text: Smart and very nicely designed hotel. Rooms are Paris standard size (which is small) but it is what you would get anywhere else. Staff was very friendly. Location is great in the middle of Le Marais. It would be great if they can add tea and coffee making facilities to the rooms. I will definitely stay again if I have the chance.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Beautiful and Friendly Boutique Hotel
text:
We absolutely adored our stay at Jules & Jim.   The location in the Marais was amazing, it was tucked down a semi-quiet side street, but a quick 5 min walk to bustling areas and multiple Metro stops.  We loved the cafe on the corner (Le Roi de Pique) for a night cap on our way home from all the amazing dinners Le Marais has to offer.

The lobby of Jules and Jim is gorgeous and such a surprise when you step in off the street (and it smelled so good!).  The staff was phenomenal from before we even stayed there, we had an overnight trip to Bayeux planned the day before we were to check in and they let us drop of our bags and chatted with us about what to expect on our mini-trip.  When we got back the next day to check in at 10 pm, they had everything ready and waiting for us and had even put our bags in our room.   Such great service! 

Our room was Room 1, which is right off the courtyard and directly next to the bar.  We were a little nervous about noise, but had absolutely no issue with it either late or night or during morning breakfast.   Our only complaint about the room was the wifi barely worked, but we could move in to the lobby to pick it up if we needed directions (and the staff tried so hard to help us get it to work, so this isn't even really a complaint).   The room had a ton of space (huge bathroom!), it was really clean, the bottles of water were a great touch, and the toiletries provided smelled great.  

Without a doubt we would recommend this place to friends and family.   The friendliness and helpfulness of the staff alone warrant two big thumbs up!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Staying at Jules et Jim made our visit
text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Jules et Jim in the Marais for a week in August, and honestly, it was the best decision of our trip. The super friendly, helpful staff made our stay a delight. They made great suggestions, they were tireless with their helpfulness, they researched every booking scenario we asked about for us, and were very patient with our poor French... one day they even called to make sure we got to our destination, as we were a little unsure with a lot of Metro transfers. We felt very well taken cared of. The rooms were very comfortable, shower heads were GREAT— you almost hated being done with a shower, big fluffy towels, great bar, really good mattresses... Jules et Jim is in a great location on a little side street between Rue de Temple & Rue Beauborg — bear the Metro, a chic boutique 20-room hotel that was reasonably priced and such a great value for the euro. Quiet. I’d say more for adults vs families — but we liked this about it. Highly recommend. Breakfast not included in the price.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great Boutique Hotel Experience
text: I had a wonderful experience at the hotel. The location was super convenient in Le Marais and the hotel itself was modern, clean and comfortable. The hotel staff was super helpful and went out of the way to provide me with any answers to questions and suggestions for areas to wander, restaurants for dining and bars for drinks. 100% recommend.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Modern and Friendly
text: Stayed for 4 nights, great staff all very friendly, helpful, great advice from Pierre our concierge. Bar staff were great. Everyone spoke English. Lol. The room was spotless, cleaned with fresh towels every day. 24hr access with key card. Would happily recommend staying here again.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: The perfect base for wandering Paris
text: Jules & Jim is a treasure in Le Marais. I was able to walk everywhere from the hotel, and there are some great places to eat nearby (don't miss Hank Pizza across the road!). I stayed in a Hi-Macs room, so stylish and cosy. I slept soundly every night and loved the small touches that made the room experience that bit more special - from the Molton Brown toiletries to the Tivoli radio and rain shower head. The bar is cosy, all the staff are super friendly and so accommodating for early arrivals and late departures. Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect small boutique style hotel for a short stay in Paris. Modern, stylish, comfortable and very friendly.
text: A wonderful small hotel in the middle of the Marais area. Accessible and easy to find even with a car which can be left in Temple Parking. We very much enjoyed our stay at Jules & Jim and will def. return on another trip to Paris. The hotel is stylish, modern and quirky with very friendly and helpful staff. The bar and breakfast area was lovely and very pleasant as was the outdoor area with open fire place. The perfect hotel for a short trip to Paris!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: A Treasure in Paris
text: From the moment I walked in, I knew this was my kind of place. The staff were friendly,  helpful and all around wonderful. They recommended places to eat, helped me find my way to destinations and even suggested a couple hidden gems to check out while I was in the wonderful city of Paris. Their courtyard area was perfect for a drink after walking the Paris sites. The bartender Henri' made the most delicious drinks and was great to talk with. Oh and did I mention how affordable it was!!!! I feel like I won Hotel Lottery when staying at this place!!!! Thank you Hotel Jules et Jim for making my Paris trip one to be remembered!!!! I will be staying here every time I visit your amazing city.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
We loved this hotel. It's the first time we stayed in this area, (as we usually stay near St. Germain).  The location of this hotel couldn't have been better. So wonderful to be in the heart of the Marais.

We stayed 3 nights, and it wasn't enough! The rooms were clean and spacious with ample light. The air-conditioner was amazing, and very easy to regulate the temperature. The beds were very comfortable, and the caramel candy that we received on the first day was delicious! There are no minibars or refrigerators in the room, but they were very accommodating about storing the caramel and chocolates that we purchased, in the hotel refrigerator.

The staff were all so friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. The restaurant recommendations were perfect, and they gave us great tips for wandering around the Marais. 

I can't wait to return to this hotel, and I will certainly recommend it to my friends.
Thank you for such a lovely stay!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect!
text: We stayed here for 2 nights. Small, but everything is well designed to maximise the space. Our 'Jim' room was lovely, modern, high end and clean with a balcony over looking the pretty courtyard. The staff were very polite and friendly. Breakfast was good and served outside (or you can sit inside) in the courtyard. Actually the best hotel we have ever stayed at and a great location.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: AMAZING place
text:
everything was just great - the location, the room (with perfect AC - in Paris it is not that common), the staff and the total atmosphere!
I would only advise the owner to improve th wi-fi - which is good, but in some parts there is no signal. you really dont pay attention to it most of the time. 

would definitely return!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Spread the word
text:
The hotel is small but well designed. Our room looks new and was exactly like it was reflected in the hotel website pictures. The staff was beyond any expectation, kind and always helpful in good will. I will definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great experience in Paris. 
Thanks
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect
text:
Let it be known, I’m a big fan. 

Jules and Jim is a fabulous gay friendly hotel in the middle of gay Paris Le Marais. 

Clean and spacious accommodation with a central court yard. Some rooms with balconies and others didn’t (ours didn’t) but what makes these guys enchanting is their staff. Kudo to Simon, Pierre and the wonderful Noëlyne who bent over backwards to make our stay in Paris comfortable and enjoying.

My only regret is not being about to stay longer. Well recommended by us, I guarantee you’ll enjoy this little piece of gay heaven.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Cute hotel in a great area of Paris
text: The hotel is small but so cute, and the staff are so friendly and helpful. We asked for recommendations of where to go to eat and all the suggestions were fantastic. The hotel is located in a great part of the city. Lots of shops and restaurants around but doesn’t feel overly touristy. My wife and I would for sure come back to the hotel on our next visit to Paris.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: So comfortable that I had a hard time leaving...
text:
I stayed at Hotel Jules et Jim for a few nights this past June. I booked one of the Hi Mac rooms and could not have been more pleased. The room and the bed and the pillows and the breakfast were all so comfortable and good that I had a difficult time getting motivated to leave the hotel to sightsee. 

Friendly, courteous and helpful staff. This is a modern hotel with a minimalist air but not too barebones--everything is comfortable. Great location for exploring this beautiful city.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect All Around
text: This hotel is a jewel tucked into the tiny streets of Marais. The staff were young and sweet and enthusiastic and so so friendly. The small courtyard and bar doubling as a stop for petit déjeuner is lovely and clean. The morning selection is curated perfectly- a table of healthy options along with all the beautiful buttery pastries you hope for when visiting Paris are there. The rooms are modern and minimalist and appointed with many of the room ‘extras’ you typically find at more expensive brands- luxurious cotton bedding, Molton Brown bath products, a large rain-shower head, complimentary drinking water replaced daily. The rooms are small but so well organized with shelves, closet and under-counter storage for your belongings that it’s hardly noticeable. Plus, who wants to stay cooped-up in a hotel room when there’s an incredible neighborhood to explore right outside the hotel entrance? I’ll return to Jules & Jim without any hesitation on my next trip to Paris. Un délice dans tous les sens!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Perfect boutique hotel for a Paris jaunt
text: My spouse and I had a terrific time at Jules & Jim for a three-night stay. We stayed in Room 02 (Jules room), which had a spacious bathroom, queen-sized bed, and Ikea-style closet, and opened right onto the terrace. We brought two carry on roller boards and two backpacks, which fit comfortably in the room. What set it apart for us was the staff: the concierge, Pierre, was an absolute delight! He brewed us tea when we arrived while waiting for our room, provided ample maps, and pointed us to a delicious bistro on the always challenge late Sunday evening in Paris. The bartender Alex also took great care of us on two nights and makes a mean cocktail. We were so smitten with everything. Can't recommend enough!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Edgy fun place to stay
text: The hotel and neighborhood are edgy, safe, and fun. The staff was knowledgeable and helpful. They have a bar that is worth hanging out at. Great find! The terrace is a plus. It faces over the bar area, which is fun. Breakfast is available. The outside bar area feels very Le Marais.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Very good location, great staff.
text:
Great location, friendly, helpful staff.
Rooms are spacious for Paris and very clean. Breakfast is very good, bar is great. We will be back next year and have already recommended the hotel to our friends.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: %100 feeling good
text:
We realy enjoyed staying there.Very nice place, clean and very very friendly❣️.The hotel location is perfect.You can also walk easily many nice place The bar is very nice , it is hidden .
See you soon guys, thanx a lot✌🏻
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Beautiful, intimate Paris Marais experience
text:
Stayed for a weekend in a Paris and the hotel was absolutely the right choice for what I was looking for. A Parisian original in the middle of the Marais Quarter:

Beautiful, stylish and modern rooms, equipped with a comfy bed and an amazing rain shower.

Sunny Balcony overlooking the backyard, so quiet one could hear the birds sing in the morning.

Elevator with private room access!

Very nice and helpful staff with 24h front desk.... really nothing could have been better.

Thanks again for this wonderful experience!
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Great stay
text:
This hotel is perfect for a stay of any duration. Wonderful design, prime location, great clean rooms, and a very helping and friendly staff who are there to help you with anything at any time of the day (or night :)).
The bar is also fantastic. I really don't have anything bad to say, and we'll be sure to book here again. If you are aiming to stay in Marais (which you should be), this is the best spot without a doubt.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Another Great Stay
text:
We are writing this review after having just completed our 5th stay at Jules & Jim. 

Another fabulous experience!  This boutique style hotel has been a “go to” for us when we visit Paris and we try to get there at least once a year. The quality of the rooms, bar and common areas, the knowledge and professionalism of staff and location make this is excellent choice. 

Modern yet warm and inviting, the decor is unique and comfortable.  High-end products for your room and extremely
comfortable beds and pillows makes this hotel hard to beat. 

Perhaps most beneficial are how genuinely helpful and knowledgeable the staff and management is. They are quick to respond to questions or the need for assistance and welcome opportunities to help. We can’t thank them enough for their hospitality. 

If you are planning a visit to Paris and are looking to stay in Le Marais (it’s the best location in our opinion) then you cannot go wrong with Jules and Jim.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: My go-to hotel in Paris
text:
This is where I stay every year. 
Excellent and friendly staff, good bar with a courtyard and good-sized rooms. 
However, I find the air conditioning to be suboptimal this time. It was way too warm even when I set it to 17°C.
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Location location
text:
Great hotel ,clean and cozy 
Best location ,the staff is very helpful and kind .the room was very clean every day.
Beautiful neighborhood lots of coffee places galleries  Picasso museum and the Pompidou center 
Definitely will come back
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Best customer service & delightful hotel !
text:
This is an excellent little hotel with the absolute BEST customer service!  Thank you so much to Pierre who helped make my engagement special and who provided excellent help to us.  Also, thank you to Noelyne, Ali and Simon who also made our stay very special.  Each of these amazing people provided so much care.  They emailed me whenever I needed questions answered.  They respond extremely fast and with amazing care.  And at the hotel, they were the coolest kindest people to talk with.  This type of excellent hospitality makes customers so happy. The huge hotel chains are the worst !   This little gem of a hotel is so special.  And it is because of special people like Pierre and the front desk customer service.

The room we had was lovely.  Quiet, clean.  They have the BEST showers!  An extra lovely touch is the "Molton Brown" lotions and soaps (lovely touch !).  

We cannot wait to return to Jules & Jim again and again!   Thank you so much, Pam and Shyam : )
name: Hotel Jules & Jim

title: Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain
text:
The Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain is a gem. The location is excellent, with easy access to the Metro as well as an easy walk to shopping and restaurants. 
The setting is tranquil and provides the perfect place for respite after sightseeing. The rooms on the main floor are beautifully decorated with several options for both indoor and outdoor seating. The breakfast options were delicious. One can relax with a glass of wine and a snack in the late afternoon or evening in a very comfortable setting
The staff were very accommodating and helpful. I highly recommend this lovely boutique hotel if you are seeking a refined and beautiful setting in St. Germain.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Our only place to stay in Paris
text:
This was maybe our 8th stay.
Great hotel.    We feel very at home and love the location.
If you have certain requests, communicate with the hotel.   They do the best they can to accommodate.
Years ago, we were frustrated with our hotel choices, and someone at a party suggested L’Abbaye.
We would not consider staying anywhere else.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Absolutely amazing!
text: Everything about this hotel is amazing. The staff wi absolutely wonderful in every way possible. Extremely accommodating and helpful from making recommendations to assisting in setting up reservations for transport and meals. You will enjoy every minute of your stay!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: I love to return to this hotel whenever possible. It’s in a great location, at the quiet fringe of St Germain. It’s charmingly appointed, has tasteful furniture and a knowledgeable staff. I’ve mostly stayed in the small rooms, but am looking forward to one w a terrace one day. Garden and public rooms are beautiful.Highly recommended!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Special Boutique Hotel in the 6th
text: My husband and I stayed at l'Abbaye on the recommendation of a friend and were just stunned by the beauty, comfort and friendliness of the staff.  The hotel itself is set back from the quiet street with courtyards in the front and back of the hotel.  The rear courtyard is like a hidden garden oasis and we lingered taking our delicious breakfast there daily. The rooms are so comfortable and luxurious. Great bed, roomy bathroom with Diptyque hair and body products, great lighting (including make up mirror), and walk in closet.  Staff was incredibly helpful in arranging taxis, restaurant reservations, and general information.  We cannot say enough about this gorgeous hotel in the middle of the St. Germain and all it has to offer. We will stay here again when visiting Paris!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Comfy and Classy value
text: I stayed at L’Abbaye on my honeymoon 38 years ago and loved it so I just spent a week there and enjoyed it greatly once again.  Be prepared for relatively small rooms and a lift that only carries 3 persons.  It is old fashioned and most of its clients are 40+ Americans but you get good value, great location, great service, wonderful breakfast and a homey comfy feel
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A lovely Paris retreat
text: This is a lovely Paris hotel which was highly recommended by a close friend with whom we were traveling. The several sitting rooms, breakfast room and terraces were inviting, beautiful and comfortable. I wish we had more time to stay!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Intimate and beautiful small hotel
text:
We just loved our four nights at the Hotel de L'Abbaye.  It is in one of our favorite neighborhoods in Paris,  tucked away on a very quiet street just a couple of blocks from the wonderful Luxembourg Gardens and adjacent to busier streets full of restaurants and shops.  The hotel itself is a tranquil oasis.  It is beautifully designed in a classic style, with several small public rooms to relax, and a nice small garden. If you like a classic style, you'll love the warm, elegant and inviting decor. The staff are friendly and helpful.  There is a bar serving drinks and light meals. A basic but tasty breakfast was included in our rate, including juice, yogurt, a bread/pastry basket, and I think one optional thing such as fruit or cheese.
We stayed in the largest category of room, the Appartement Terrasse.  This is a spacious two-story unit, with a living room and main bathroom downstairs, and a bedroom upstairs.  For those reserving this room for a family, be aware that the bedroom is on a sort of loft, not entirely private.  So this room is better for a couple.  The bedroom opens to a small terrace with table and chairs.  There is also a small 1/2 bath off of the bedroom-- not advertised and very convenient.
We can't wait to go back.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Perfect stay
text: I loved everything about this boutique hotel.  Everyone was so helpful and professional and the setting and location are perfect.  I loved the garden and my room looked out on it.  Very clean and a great value.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Didn’t live up to recommendation
text:
Traveling from Ni’ce to Paris by train. Requested pick up from hotel and got what seemed like an automated message about needing arrival information and meeting me at customs. Also requested my telephone information which I gave when making reservations. After sending them a picture of my train ticket didn’t hear back from them to confirm pickup until 15 minutes before my arrival, again asking for  flight information and contact number. They didn’t appear to understand or read my messages. Ended up just taking a taxi. No mention of this misunderstanding upon our arrival. Concierge on one occasion gave wrong key and had to walk back down to get correct key. No offers or suggestions on restaurants or sights, didn’t find them to be friendly. 
Also room so small we had to squeeze by our two suitcases. No room to stretch after long day of walking. Room smelled musty, would leave window open to let in fresh air but the staff would close window.  Carpet smelled old. Bed short for 6 foot person and felt saggy, two twin beds pushed together.  Not comfortable stay.
Found wait staff in dining to be much more pleasant. Wouldn’t recommend for the price or the hospitality.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: So lovely
text: I feel fortunate to have stayed a second time at the lovely Hotel de l’Abbaye. I hope it will not be my last. Everything is perfect from A-Z. A beautiful oasis in Paris, but no matter how charming, if the staff is below par one might as well be anywhere. Here the beauty and charm of l’Abbaye is only enhanced by the the wonderful people who work here. It is truly a gem. Thank you to everyone for making our visit so special.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Great small hotel in the heart of Paris
text: Lovely hotel in the heart of Paris. Great staff. Very helpful.Shower/bath was small for me (6'7"), but manageable. Very nice courtyard to pass through while entering the hotel. Ground floor has wonderful sitting rooms.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: The classic Parisian boutique hotel
text: My parents stayed here 38 years ago and so I wanted to return. It is lovely and the front courtyard and back garden are beyond charming. Breakfast every morning--fresh croissants and pain au chocolat  served by the wonderful Memet who has been there for decades, always with a smile--is calming thanks to the ancient fountain right there. The building dates back to 1650's I think, a former abbey for nuns under the protection of Louis XIV's mother, so you're talking about real history. The rooms are small, we opted for one of the bigger ones, it had TV, AC, great shower with strong water pressure, thick towels and very comfortable beds. The location is great-- Pizza Chic on the corner has some of the best brick oven pizza i've had; The St. Sulpice church is a 2 minute walk, and everything else that's classic Parisian is within walking distance. There's no gym, FYI but the rest is charming beyond and very good value.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful Small Hotel
text: Stayed in a Terrace Apartment for a week in August. Great small hotel, friendly staff. Loved having morning coffee with a newspaper in the garden terrace and the lobby is so warm and inviting. Very quiet at night, nice clean rooms that are well appointed. Terrace restaurant staff were amazing, always smiling, friendly and happy to serve you. Great location. Highly recommend this hidden gem to anyone.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A Perfect Pied a Terre in Paris
text: I am thrilled to have discovered this Paris gem! Central location walking distance to many iconic places - La Coupole, Les Deux Magots, the bouquinistes... The staff were friendly, helpful and Olivier (Chef de Reception) went above and beyond. Loved, loved, loved the courtyard where breakfast or cocktails are so enjoyable to start or end your day of exploring the city. Rooms are small like all Paris rooms but beautifully appointed and with plenty of closet space.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Beautiful boutique hotel in St Germain des Pres
text: My daughter and I stayed to celebrate her birthday. We felt like we were the hotel’s most important guests, with every request attended to right away. We had breakfast in the garden and drinks before dinner in the lounge - perfectly lovely places. The rooms were perfectly appointed with luxurious bedding and large plush towels. We will most definitely stay there again on our next trip to Paris.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Elegant and Peaceful
text: A charming hotel conveniently located in the 6th arrondissement with walking distance from Metro and restaurants. Loved the garden and courtyard. Nice place to relax. Very friendly and helpful staff. A quintessential Parisian experince.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Great hotel, great staff, great location.
text:
We have been to Paris a few times and this is the best hotel that we have stayed at for our budget. It is a great location (we don't like to be too close to the tourist locations), excellent staff and a very comfortable bed. 
The e-bikes that were available was a great bonus!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Beautiful Hotel!
text: We stayed for two nights. Everything was lovely. The room was small but very nicely appointed. The bathroom was nicely laid out. The staff at breakfast was very accommodating and the food was delicious. I would highly recommend this hotel and look forward to staying there again.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Perfect home in St Germain!
text:
This is the perfect home in St Germain du Près.
The hotel is elegant, comfortable and all rooms are of extremely high quality.
The garden and conservatory the perfect place to unwind and relax.
The staff are kind, courteous and helpful at all times.
I did not want to leave and will be back!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Excellent
text:
We enjoyed every minute of our stay here, fantastic staff, decor, room was lovely and comfortable.
The courtyard garden was a little retreat from the summer Paris heat!
Location was awesome and just a delightful stay all round!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Always happy to return
text: We’ve been returning to Hotel de L’Abbaye for over 20 years.  It’s familiar and their standards of service has remained attentive.  You feel like you’re part of the family there.  They respond to requests promptly and they’re always friendly.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: lovely small hotel near St. Suplice
text: As its name indicates, this hotel is on the site of a former abbey with a beautiful garden and lovely ounge, The rooms are lovely with all amenities you would need, and it is in a wonderful left bank neighborhood, though it is a bit of a hike to attractions on the right bank.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: You Home in the Heart of Saint-Germain!
text:
This was just what we were looking for. So much character! Exactly the type of hotel you want in Paris, in the heart of Saint-Germain. 

We were in one of the smaller rooms, 45. For a tall guy, the bed was a bit small, the only reason I did not award 5 stars. But I would definitely stay there again - maybe just spring for a larger room.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Absolutely wonderful
text: Hotel is beautiful, beautifully designed, beautiful decor, very comfortable beds, linen. Excellent toiletries. Great terrasses, indoor lounging. Staff very helpful, friendly. I can’t wait to return, my only regret: dogs are not allowed
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Impeccable
text: Beautiful boutique hotel. Serene garden, lovely service, perfect omelette (I added to their delicious breakfast), adore the Saint-Germain-des-Prés location, steps from my favourite Jardin du Luxembourg, and had the best sleep in the most comfortable bed. Old world charm, with wonderful small touches. Thank you for a lovely stay.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A quite oasis in the middle of a bustling city
text: We recently returned for our second visit and were not disappointed. This property is on a quiet street within a few steps of the bustling Rue de Rennes. The decor is elegant, the cleanliness is impeccable, and the employees are gracious. I am looking for an occasion to make a third visit already.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Still a delightful place to stay
text:
Our first visit to this hotel a few years ago was so good that we decided to stay there again last month.
I am pleased to say that the hotel is still as good as it was. The room was very comfortable, nicely decorated and quiet. The bathroom had everything one needed.
The only negative comment is that last time the reception staff were very  knowledgeable and helpful about Paris and things around the hotel, but some have changed since then and have rather poor knowledge and don't show too much interest.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Charming & characterful: the little heart of Paris
text: Loved our stay at this quintessentially Parisian hotel. The decor was chic, the staff charming and the location convenient. Yes, it wasn't perfect: the service at breakfast could have been better, the outdoor seating more comfortable, and because the walls were so thin we were often woken up by our neighbours/goings on in the corridor, but the hotel had everything necessary and there were touches/attention to detail that made the trip feel special. I would still recommend it to anyone who wants to discover Paris — this hotel feels like its heart.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: 2nd Visit
text: The location is perfect and quiet. The courtyard is magical. The rooms are beautiful. Everyone on the staff bends over backwards to make you feel welcome (even if you are American) and helps with everything from restaurants to taxis. Service staff in the courtyard for breakfast and evening drinks are wonderful! I will dream of coffee with steamed milk and a basket of bread until I return for a 3rd visit.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Lovely hotel, sneaky breakfast service
text:
We had a pleasant 3-night stay at the hotel. The room was well upholstered and the service was quite friendly. The patio garden in back of the hotel is a clear highlight. 

However, we were overcharged for breakfast. There is an “express” option available for one coffee and one pastry (€8), and a “normal” option that is a full breakfast (€22). When we asked for just coffee, the staff delivered a plate of breads and juice with our coffee. It turns out that this is the “normal” option. So, we were charged full price despite our communication for the “express” option. For our group of four this amounted to an €108 overcharge during our stay. While the hotel is otherwise excellent, please be aware that you will be given the full breakfast as a default. We brought this up to the concierge and they refused to adjust the charge, which made us feel as though we had been tricked.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Comfortable, great neighborhood, great breakfast, cute patio
text: Wonderful! English friendly, quiet, and close to lots of places to eat! Easy access to metro. Beautiful patio to relax with flowers and fountain. Great breakfast. Strong wifi. Very cute room - small but everything we needed.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: If you had a ranking for boutique hotels this would be #1!
text: Perfect smallish boutique hotel.  I’ve eyed it on past visits but didn’t stay there until now.  Inviting courtyard.  Classic decor. Decent sized rooms.  Staff is attentive and helpful. On showing us the room they asked: what’s your first impression and then agreed to move us.  Lovely terrace garden for breakfast. Walk just a couple blocks to shops and restaurants. Public bike stand around the corner.  Bonus: two ebikes to share, much better quality than public ones.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Bastille Day Celebration
text: Returned to our favorite hotel on the left bank to celebrate Bastille Day. A gem of hotel and location. Quaint, rooms are good size, comfortable, and decor is very beautiful and traditional chic. Staff are helpful amd very friendly. Service very good. Outdoor seating are wonderful to enjoy the day. Breakfast is very good and afternoon and evening menus offer great drinks, snacks, and some meals. Look forward to returing.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: I’ll never stay anywhere else
text: Hotel de l’abbaye is my absolute favorite - no just in Paris, but anywhere. The hotel is gorgeous, the garden terrace is a rare gem, but it’s the kindness of the staff that really keeps me coming back!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Charming hotel
text: This hotel was for us a perfect place to call home during our first visit to Paris. The hotel sits on a quiet street in the lovely Saint-Germain neighborhood which is conveniently located to many parts of the city either by foot or the nearby metro. The hotel was full during our stay but somehow quiet tranquility was maintained by staff and guests alike. The conservatory, courtyard and sitting rooms are beautiful, as was our modest sized room. Having windows that opened onto the courtyard with the option to lower an awning to keep things cool and shady was one of our favorite features of the room, along with a deep bathtub with a shower option. Breakfast and lunch options were excellent...fresh and thoughtfully presented. Another reviewer said it well....the hotel has the feel of a family home with luxurious touches. Our special thanks to the gracious reception staff who were able to return to us some items we accidentally left behind. We hope to be back soon!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Everything and then some!
text: From the moment you pass through the iron gates and cross the stone-paved courtyard you have stepped into an oasis of charm and tranquility. There are beautifully decorated sitting rooms a lovely garden and sun room, all furnished with comfort and beauty in mind.  Room was lovely, loved the French windows, air conditioner ran top notch, amenities are no joke.  I was a solo traveler and felt well looked after.  The thing that makes it is the staff.  You get the feeling this job is personal with them.  They really care. Believe the hype!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Convenient Charm
text: Lovely little hotel. Perfect location for busy days in Paris. It is close to the metro. Lots of cute restaurants in the neighborhood. The staff was eager to help with sightseeing activities and taxis.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Great St. Germain base camp
text: friendly, elegant, comfortable, helpful, charming, close to the Metro, quiet ( except for a brief moment of squeals of delight from a woman enjoying the attentions of her partner - but, then, this is Paris).
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: The perfect stay
text: Ambience, charm and service all combine here with location and furnishings to make a pleasurable stay. The front desk team is efficient, friendly and charming. Always helpful. The breakfast server was attentive and kind.,
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: All Quiet on the Left Bank
text: This is a beautiful, small hotel on a quiet street on the left bank.  A pleasant walk to Ile de la Cite and Luxembourg Gardens, and very close to Blvd. St. Germain and the St. Sulpice Metro station.  The staff will work you through any troubles you may have.  I have stayed here many times.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Perfect little luxury hotel in Saint Germaine
text:
Always looking for small elegant hotels in big cities.  This may be one of our new favorites.  Tucked away in Saint Germaine, lovely little garden & dining area for Bbreakfast & lunch.  Service first class.  
Would recommend getting a suite if possible.  Rooms are a but small, but otherwise perfect in every way.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Beautiful hotel experience
text: Hotel de l’abbaye gives the experience of a private home with caring, personal attention from all the staff. Last minute dinner reservations were always accommodated and excellent in their variety. The interior design of the public spaces as well as the individuality of the rooms was fabulous
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Charming hotel!!
text: This is the second time we have stayed at Hotel de l'Abbaye and we would not stay anywhere else. It's in a great location, very charming rooms, garden, lobby area and the staff is so friendly!! Would highly recommend.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Feels like at home
text: This was our third time at l'abbaye. It is a beautiful property with the perfect location. The hotel is very private and quiet. The neighborhood is safe and has everything you need. The hotel staff is very nice and helpful and their service is amazing.They have the perfect lounge area where you can enjoy the best Parisian breakfast. Paris 100%
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text: Was in Paris years ago and walked into the courtyard of this hotel and always wanted to go back there to stay -  fast forward to 2022 and had a wonderful 5 night stay. Beautiful hotel with a lovely garden area and great breakfast. Service was perfect and always helpful. LOVE that we got to finally stay there and would recommend highly - great value too!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: I never want to stay elsewhere!
text: I spent 3 nights here in early June (2022).  This was my fourth visit to the hotel.  Hotel de l'Abbaye is such a comfortable and cozy retreat from the hustle and bustle of Paris.  I never want to stay elsewhere.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful hotel in Paris
text: A terrific find, lovely in every way. The beautiful building and  rooms are matched by the lovely staff. Quiet and very comfortable. It is not an inexpensive choice, but well worth it if you can and like small personal hotels. I hope to return soon and often.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Perfection in every aspect
text: If you like superb service and attention to detail this well managed hotel delivers.  I was impressed with professional attentiveness of the staff who go out of their way to meet every request.  The hotel is extremely well run as they pay attention to the smallest detail.  Everything is of excellent quality and the staff is well trained.  A quiet oasis to recharge in bustling city.  This hotel delivers exceptional value for the money.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Great hotel
text: This was a great hotel. The room was spectacular, with two floors and a balcony. Air conditioning was exceptional. Staff was all pleasant and helpful. Good central location that was quiet and felt safe. We will be staying here again.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: The World's Greatest Hotel
text: I have been staying at the Hotel L'Abbaye since 1977. as with all great institutions The Hotel has only improved with age. There is a constant effort to improve the hotel in physical terms, but also in  the quality and knowledge of the staff. You are always warmly greeted and welcomed with a smile. Great location!.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Beautiful, small hotel in St. Germain des Pres area
text: Hotel de l'Abbaye is a beautiful, quiet oasis amid the hustle and bustle of Paris.  The staff are professional, knowledgeable and very friendly. The lobbey and garden are private, quiet and beautiful.  Our hotel room was lovely with a large marble bathroom.  We only ate breakfast at the hotel and it was very good.  Hotel de l'Abbaye is close to a Metro stop (St. Sulpice) and walking distance to the famous Deux Magots Cafe and Restaurnt de Flore.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful stay
text: We very much enjoyed our 4 night stay and felt very much looked after by the excellent staff.  Very comfortable bed.  Beautiful decor throughout. the hotel and we appreciated the many vases of fresh flowers.   Lovely bedroon flooded with daylight.  Quiet and great location in the Latin quarter near to Metro. The breakfast in the peaceful courtyard garden was the highlight of our stay.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Cozy elegance on the left bank
text:
Highly recommend this hotel...  it is so charming and elegant...  well located..,  public rooms comfortable and delightful.  A real respite!

I wished for a little bit larger room... but it was beautifully decorated and comfortable.  

Having a lounge with a small menu in the evenings was a bonus...  try the omelet!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: First class hotel
text: as good as hotels come.from check in, to check out every thing went well and smooth quite and comfortable, Will definitely stay there if we go to Paris again. Its quiet, comfortable, with easy access to all attractions and activities.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A complete gem
text: My husband and I have just come back from spending four nights here. I am rather loathe to recommend this hotel as we selfishly want it to remain our secret, but in all honesty I cannot recommend this place more highly. It is quite simply an oasis of peace and calm, situated in a beautiful courtyard setting  minutes away from the church of Saint Sulpice and the Luxembourg Gardens. The rooms are stylishly decorated, with the feel of a  country house rather than an hotel. The staff are exceptional. We cannot wait to return.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: First time in St Germain
text: Our first visit to the St Germain neighborhood in Paris was enhanced by the Hotel de L'Abbaye Saint Germain. The staff was very welcoming from check in to check out. The room was spacious and the bed was very comfy. The back patio  is very peaceful and very little city noise was ever heard. Hotel may not be recommended for younger folks as it was quiet and probably more suitable for older guests. We thoroughly enjoyed the use of their electric bikes and spent our last day biking all over Paris.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A special place that you can call your home in Paris
text: In the heart of Paris close to museums, places of attraction, best restaurants, cafes, while hidden in a cul de sac nestled between a stylish front courtyard, and a beautiful garden of eden that one enters from a brilliantly designed greenhouse housing the restaurant at the back, birds singing, and sounds of water flowing out of the fountain replace the noises of the streets of the city.  This is a hidden gem, a small palace, that after a long day in the museums and streets of Paris, one can enjoy a relaxing, and peaceful evening, a very comfortable night in beautifully furnished, comfortable and practical rooms.  The mornings are another story, waking up with the singing of the birds, refreshened, looking forward to the unique experience of a traditional Parisian breakfast with the best quality elements you could possibly get nowhere else.  What a beautiful way to start a another beautiful day in Paris.  In addition to her location, unique amenities, what makes the Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint Germain so special is the people who run this place from their general manager Ms. Caroline, executive staff Mr. Lionel, Mr. Olivier, front desk personnel Mr. Beauclaire, Mr. Christian, Mr. Frederique to friendly waitresses, Mr. Mehmet, Mr, Burhan, Mr. Denis, Ms. Mimi with their warm smiles, kindness, friendliness, professionalism, always taking the extra mile and making everything even the impossible possible, all of which definitely makes Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint Germain, a 7 star Hotel.  However, they only had five stars in this review. If you are lucky enough to book a room at this outstanding boutique Hotel, you will not be able to stay at another place in Paris.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful!
text: We love the Abbaye! A beautiful, quiet hotel in the 6th. Comfortable room, an excellent friendly and warm staff. A little bit of heaven in the heart of Paris. Our stay could not have been better. We’ll be back!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Excellent stay at Hotel L'abbaye
text: A well located, truly Parisienne hotel with kind and helpful staff, wonderful landscape-perfectly preserved and maintained, clean and well cared for hospitality. In short, excellent facility for days in Paris.... Thank you..
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Beautiful oasis in the heart of Paris
text: This hotel is a beautiful oasis in the heart of Paris, located between the the Luxembourg Gardens and the Seine. Very tastefully decorated. Nice terrace in the front and a small beautiful garden in the back. Helpful staff and English speaking. Everything just perfect. Recommend this hotel for couples and families, might be a challenge to stay there with toddlers. Will return.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: An excellent place to stay and relax in Paris!
text: The Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain is a small, comfortable hotel, offering a perfect possibility to discover Paris (metro station and restaurants nearby) and afterwards to relax in the wonderful decorated lobby rooms or the cosy winter garden or the small green inner courtyard
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Nice Stay, Good Location
text: Nice small hotel in a good location. Very quiet street but close to Metro and St Germain. Very clean and nice French style. Breakfast was good and included. Beds very comfortable. Staff was fine..could have been more interactive and helpful but generally fine.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Perfect Paris
text: A charming, friendly and cosy oasis in a busy city. The food, rooms and the staff in this pretty hotel are a complete delight. I wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Paris. It’s quiet location belies the fact that it’s also very central
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Exceptional Experience!
text: From the arrival moment to departure, we were so impressed with the quality of the property and friendliness of staff.  Location is perfect for metro travel and charming neighborhood walks. This place is a true “gem”.  We will return!
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: A lovely stay

title: I found the perfect hotel in Paris!
text: Located in the center of one of the most charming and safe areas in Paris (Saint-Germain); the staff is very friendly and professional; the hotel is wonderful with AMAZING winter garden where to have breakfast or read a book. And the PRICE is very competitive compared similar hotels nearby where I have been as well.

title: A classic not to be missed
text: We booked a last minute three night stay at this hotel based on TA reviews which we rely on for honesty. The hotel is safe and secure. It would suit a single woman traveler well. The breakfast is high quality with soft boiled eggs, breads, butter, confiture, yogurt and fruit salad. The coffee is not good. The rooms are small but well appointed. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom is modern but I can’t seem to keep the water from splashing onto the floor! The window opens and our room faced a quiet courtyard. The noise from the hallway and other rooms is evident but luckily the guests were quiet. The sueoinsong area is very pleasant all there are many sights within walking distance. The area is safe and we would return again gladly.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Wonderful stay, great location.

title: Perfection personified!!!!

title: Beautiful boutique hotel in the 6th!
text: Hotel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain, in the heart of the 6th arrondissement of Paris, will be our new absolute "go-to" accommodation in the city. A handsomely appointed and beautifully kept small hotel, the management and staff were enormously helpful to us during our week-long stay. Flawlessly professional, courteous, and thoughtful -- we can't say enough good things about the folks who work there. Because of the pandemic, we chose to eat a number of our meals in the hotel, where the service was perfect and the atmosphere enlivened in December by warm fires in the fireplace and good drinks from the bar. Delicious coffee and pastries at breakfast and more choices if one wants them. Situated on a quiet street but just steps from the activity of the Saint-Germain des Pres area -- we really appreciated the quiet and comfort.
name: Hôtel de l'Abbaye Saint-Germain

title: Lovely

Thank you!

title: Hotel near Eiffel Tower
text:
This was my last hotel of 5 that I stayed in on my solo trip to France.  
The location was EXCELLENT!  5 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower, including lots of places to eat and shop.
10 minute walk to the Musee de L'Armee (their night show is amazing!) and Cafe L'Esplanade, as well as so many other popular placed.
There is staff 24 hours at the front desk.  They were all very friendly and helpful.
The breakfast was included with my stay and was Excellent! - yogurt, eggs, cheeses, meats, croissants, fruit, cakes, juices, hot chocolate, and more!
My room was tiny but just right for me.  The bed was very comfortable, with lots of soft, fluffy pillows.
The bathroom was a bit of a tight fit, but very clean and modern.  There were no toiletries, but I had brought my own anyway.  Lots of towels which were thick and soft.
Tiny elevator (which I found in all the hotels in France), but I was on the 3rd floor and preferred to walk the spiral staircase.
Very quiet - I did not hear any other guests at all (but did see them at breakfast, so it was not because it was empty - lol).
And there is A/C which is very  important in the summer in Paris!
I definitely recommend this hotel. :D
