title: Great little hotel in a convenient and active neighborhood
text:
Arrival

The hotel is half a block down a pedestrian alley so expect the taxi to drop you off a short distance from the front door. There was one person behind the front desk and no other attendants that I could see. 

Check In
Was smooth and friendly. We got into our room earlier than expected which was welcome. Front desk people were very friendly and helpful on our stay.

Lift/Elevator
It's small even by European standards. It also has a weight limit of 180kg. We went one at a time with one bag each.

Stairs
There is a circular stairway from the basement to the top floor. It's easy to navigate and helps with the aesthetic. Only problem is that it stops at a very very narrow landing between each floor. If you have bags it's better to go a floor higher and carry the bag down. Be careful not to fall when the lift opens.

Room
There were two of us in a small room. We had a narrow view of the street but nothing special. The room was extremely small. There was hardly any room to put one suitcase much less two. And the bathroom was tiny. The room and bathroom were smaller than any of the cruise ship cabins I've stayed in. 

Breakfast
The free buffet started at 630a. It was usually empty but there are plenty of tables. Food included fresh croissants, fruit cups, coffee machine, fruit juice, ham/salami/cheese, etc. Everything was fresh and tasty. It was a nice place to start the morning.

Neighborhood
We felt like we lived in Paris. There were restaurants and shops all around -- shops for people who lived there not for tourists. Bus and Metro stops were also convenient. We mostly ate in the neighborhood and didn't feel at all crowded by the hoards of tourists at all the tourist spots.

Tour Eiffel
We chose this place because it was a five minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. That was definitely worth it. But we also loved the neighborhood.

Language
Everyone in the hotel spoke English and probably many other languages.

Noise
The walls are thin.

Conclusion
Low cost, convenient place in a friendly neighborhood with great staff.

Overall a decent stay for our needs, but probably would not return.

title: Great place to stay, but not to cook
text: We have stayed here on every Paris visit for the last decade or more. Previously, we had found the staff charming and very friendly. This time they were merely efficient. When we rent in an apartment hotel, which this pretends to be, we plan to do some of our own cooking, especially in France where there is so much good food available and in this case a market steps from the front door on Wednesdays and Sundays. These units are so poorly equipped that this is virtually impossible. Even then, there were shortages of what was supposed to be available. One teaspoon for two people? One coffee mug for two people? Two small glasses, which is less than you usually get in an ordinary hotel room. The studio rooms are adequate and well insulated for sound, even those at the front a few feet meters from the metro trains. It is extremely convenient for three Metro lines and lots of restaurants. A great place to stay, but as a self-catering apartment it is a dismal failure. We bought some of our own utensils and containers to get by. For example, they have a microwave but no containers to microwave anything in!

title: Rated way too high for actuality
text:
Pictures definitely don’t tell the whole story here. 
   The staff was great and friendly. The view of the tower was also spectacular. But….
   Once you look down, the metro station is right there. It’s like a scene out of Rocky 1. The train goes by all night, so if you don’t have enough drinks to knock you out, it will keep you up all night. 
   The mattress was so broken down, it was only half the depth that it should be, not to mention the spring in my back all night long. The mold in the bathroom was disgusting. There is no ventilation or fans to keep it from growing. 
   Bed never gets made or new towels (towels were like a 1 ply toilet paper). No coffee maker in the room, have to bring your cups from the room down to the lobby to get your coffee. 
   We were scared to try the breakfast, so skipped it for our entire stay. Laundry is do your own. 
   Far from the 4.5 rating. Definitely a 2 to 2.5.

title: Highly recommend!
text:
Stayed 4 nights at a one bedroom apartment, kids  slept on the sofa bed, no issue at all. Apartment was clean had a full kitchen even though small but it worked out good for us.

Our room had the Eiffel tower view on the 6th floor, you can see the lights at night. So beautiful. Even though it was in front of the metro line, we weren't too bothered about the noise as some reviews mentioned.

We also had breakfast at a local cafe across the road, I forgot the name but I recommend the green cafe as it was cheaper than the other ones, and the breakfast set was good, omelets, croissants, baguette, jam, OJ and coffee/tea for €11.

Will definitely stay again if I visit Paris 🙂

title: Great Rooms-Needs to turn up AC
text: This hotel was perfect for two couples. The configuration of the rooms is such that both couples will have privacy, although one of the couples will be sleeping on a sofa bed. The mini kitchen in the apartment has everything you could possibly need, and the bathrooms are configured so that the toilet is in a separate room from the sink and shower, also allowing for a bit more privacy if more than one couple is sharing an apartment. There is complimentary water and coffee available in the lobby. The only reasons I am giving this hotel an average rating is due to room cleanliness/repair issues (there was blood spattered all over a curtain in the room, and one of the bathroom doors would not close properly due to the fact that it had obviously been bashed in at some point) and the fact that they have the air conditioning turned off. You can turn it on and hear it functioning, but there is no cool air being circulated. Depending on what time of year you are visiting, Paris is much too hot to not have at least some functioning air conditioning, even the lobby was a bit stifling.

title: 2 night stay with view
text: Unfortunately not the best of stays at Citadines and quite upset. We arrived at the hotel around 11am to check our bags in and pay the full amount, we then returned at 4pm to check into our room. We were told to take a seat and waited nearly half an hour without being told anything except 'someone is checking it', but it was very obvious the room was not cleaned as the women can down with a cloth and spray to tell them its okay! We received free breakfast the next morning as an apology what helped but I preferred if they were more honest about the room not being ready.  When we got to our room we impressed by the view, but unfortunately that quickly changed when we realized we were right next to a metro station. This was quite loud every night and extremely disappointing for the price we payed. It was my partners birthday which she made them aware, the hotel didn't say anything about this, I understand it isn't mandatory but it does go a long way to show respect. When we checked into our next hotel they were much more friendly and expressed their interest in the birthday. The staffs English wasn't so strong, I am in belief this is not a hotel I'd suggest to a foreign tourist, this seems like a much more local hotel with the guests. On checkout the women on reception was not made aware of our complimentary breakfast but in the end took our word on it. We got back home to realize we left two items on the bed. We emailed the hotel and didn't receive a reply, so I called them for them to say no we haven't got the item, when it was left on the bed quite obviously left, so the cleaner must of binned it and failed to admit it was there. They said they couldn't check properly till Wednesday, which didn't make any sense as they must of already been in the room for the next guests? There seems to be many problems with communication in the hotels staff, after checking into our second hotel it made us upset to not spend the two nights at this place instead. If you are on a budget and want something close to the Eiffel tower then maybe this is an option but unfortunately I cannot see myself staying here again.

title: Dont stay here esp if it's your first time in Paris
text: We arrived early after travel difficulties, and were not surprised to find our room wasnt available early. We were exhausted and had an evening appointment, so getting in at least on time and having time to clean up and rest was important. After 4 hours wait, knowing we were available, and well after our room was supposed to be free it still wasnt ready, they simply coldly said "no, its not ready yet, try again in a half hour." No apology for running late, nothing. When we finally got in later it was not the twin bedroom we reserved, and the bedside lights didnt even work, infact one was falling off of the wall. The bed was very uncomfortable. There were no USB chargers, and for one person to read in bed all the lights had to be left on. The curtain was hanging with several hooks off also. Aside from this the simple efficiency apartment was adequate, and had a view of te Eiffel Tower as promised. The promised available breakfast however, one of the reasons we had stayed here, was not available "we just have a bag" they shrugged. This a year and a half into COVID, when many hotels have been able to offer lovely COVID safe breakfast options. They should have updated their site to indicate that this was not available, so as not to deceive customers. The doors to the hotel are always locked, often front desk was unmanned, and when it was, with one exception in 4 days, no one ever even bothered to look up in greeting, while guests were entering or leaving, even though they were never with another guest. Other than one evening desk worker (a young man), everyone was cold and indifferent, and one middle aged man even actively refused to help answer questions myself and another guest had one evening. He just waived us off rudely and went back to eating in the back. Before you say-"Well, this in France, that is how people are", in every SINGLE shop, restuarant, tour, museum, everyone was friendly, and said "bonjour, bon soir", etc, everyone except our own hotel. Unless you just want an uncomfortable bed in a convenient area, and dont care about non-functioning things in a room and no promised breakfast available, and a cold, detatched, uncaring staff, I recommend staying elsewhere. They really made my daughters graduation trip less enjoyable. There are many other places to stay.

title: Good location, average service and no free housekeeping
text:
Check in at the hotel was relatively smooth. The deluxe room was spacious, clean and air-conditioned and offered an amazing view of the Eiffel tower. 

The location is unbeatable- close to the metro and plenty of cafes and bistros. On the second night the flush of the toilet did not work, so when I advised reception, she was very curt and abrupt and said I had to wait 30 minutes before anyone could come solve my problems. I asked for an alternate room, but not a possibility. Please keep in mind this was already almost 9.30pm at night and I was ready to unwind after a very long day of walking in the Paris heat. A kind staff member showed up 30 minutes later and did a quick fix.

The kitchenette offers basic kitchen utensils, but bring your own coffee/tea. Additionally, I had to rewash some of the mugs and plates as they were a bit dirty and were chipped. 

The biggest downside for me: There is NO housekeeping offered unless you want to fork out an exorbitant daily fee. If Citadines wants to use the name "hotel", then they really should be offering housekeeping and especially, in times of COVID, the least they could do was take out the garbage. I would recommend guests bring their own sanitizing solutions.

title: Great stay, perfect location
text:
We had a 2 night stopover here on our drive through France as the kids were desperate to see Paris. We chose the Citadines Tour Eiffel because of its central location and secure underground parking (we had bikes on the back of the car.) Parking was €30/night. The apartment was compact but had everything we needed and was spotlessly clean with a good shower. Double bed was very comfortable with a decent mattress. Sofa bed mercifully split into 2 so the kids didn’t spend all night fighting over who had rolled across the halfway line. 

Management are clearly taking COVID precautions very seriously - single use pens to fill in the check in form, screens at reception, obligatory mask wearing in public areas, used key cards quarantined on check out and hand sanitiser freely available - so it felt like a safe place to stay. The reception staff were friendly and helpful (from a safe distance!)

I’d recommend for anyone wanting a centrally located apartment for a short stay in Paris. Easy walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and river and right next to La Motte Picquet Grenelle metro station with 3 metro lines. Monoprix supermarket directly opposite and plenty of places to eat and drink nearby (or a few stops on line 10 to the Latin Quarter for dinner.)

title: Underwhelmed.  Apartment more than a hotel.
text:
Family of four from US visiting Paris for first time. Location picked by travel agent. We would not choose to stay here again if opportunity arises. 

Room:  this location is more of an apartment than hotel especially thinking about some of the services you may expect in a hotel (housekeeping, room service).  We had a spacious room with a bdrm with a king bed and a sofa sleeper in another room that folded out to 2 twin beds so it can sleep 4 comfortably.  On arrival, the room was clean but there is no housekeeping and you have to get your own towels and supplies.  If we wanted to stay in apartment, we would have used airbnb. 

I have seen reviews about view of eiffel tower. well - we didnt have one. The location is near the Eiffel (15 min walk). Having the metro station across the street is convenient but if you have young children (stroller age) , you probably wont be using the metro much. Having a McDonalds and a grocery store (monoprix) nearby was useful. there are many places to eat as others have written in their reviews. 

Customer service: adequate 
Cleanliness: there was a definite odor to the hallways that was not pleasant (1st floor)
Breakfast: we did not participate 
Noise:  the disadvantage of being near a metro is the train rumbling by. But the main noise complaint was hearing all the flushing of the upper floors in our room. That was annoying. 

Supplies: the kitchen was supplied with fridge, dishwasher, utensils/bowls. We didnt use these much during our 4 days there.

title: That view, that room, very good option
text:
Reception: Maybe the week part of this apart hotel, the reception is ok but not as good and kind as some 4-5 stars hotels.
*You can get free choco or coffee all days anythime next to the reception :)

The location: Very good just in front of Grenelle metro station, is a studio so we just went to the monoprix shop in the corner to buy our food, perfect

The Room: Believe me, just pay the extra for the Eiffel view room, wooh, we were in the studio three days, to sleep every night seeing how the eiffel tower lights turned on and off in the early morning was great! what a way to go to sleep.

Will I come back? Very good option for Paris near the Eiffel tower, is not thattt close, but is near. The best is the view and the modern services of a studio

Suggestion:
If you plan to stay several days in Paris and close to the metro and everything like that, I will suggest this option seriously, you can save a lot with meals and is fun. Cool rememberings here :)
* high floor and eiffel view is a must.

title: Nice staff, everything else desperately needs a major renovation.
text:
工作人員雖然服務周到，但酒店本身的裝潢以及一切設施都在廉價汽車賓館（還要是過時的廉價汽車賓館）的檔次。入住的人都應該是 1）沖著巴黎鐵塔景觀（只在最高的 6/F 和 7/F）和， 2）酒店的便利性而來的吧? 

訂房的時候，我提早 18 日前 email confirm 並註明我的額外要求。雖然所分派房間可能受到多個因素影響，但我最後成功獲分配到頂層風景最好的一間轉角房間，擁有 L 型露台，一間可在不同角度，日與夜都能夠完美地擁抱巴黎鐵塔的房間!!!!!

切記，大前提是要在合適的時間提出合理的要求!!! 若你於 1 星期前提出，而該房間有其他旅客的話，酒店可能無法配合。若你兩個月之前提出，酒店亦沒有可能空著那房間等你。不過，你可以自訂酒店一日起每個月都聯絡一下酒店，這樣人家也可以有充分的時間為你預備。

得到酒店方面的配合，讓我就算只待在房內都能夠拍照拍到最後一刻才捨得出發去已預約的餐廳吃飯，酒店的員工當然功不可沒。在巴黎，比這間酒店更用心，更願意去服務旅客的酒店工作人員並不常見。

地點方面也是一流，3 條地鐵線，另加幾條巴士線（因為怕被打荷包，我很多時候避而不乘地鐵出市中心 1 、2 區而選搭巴士，搭巴士去老佛爺也安全方便）。酒店旁邊就是佔地兩層的中型超市，斜對面馬路更會在星期三、六有中大型市集（約有 40 多個排檔和地攤。另外 15 區因為不像其他區般擁有特色景點，所以地鋪租金相較其他區段低，這卻造就了一個食肆林立的美食創業區域，十分值得饕客探索。

酒店的設施雖要更新嗎? 陳舊到不能，絕對需要。需要更有效率的升降機維修公司嗎? 我住的 5 天當中其中 1 部升降機都封著，正在維修，絕對需要更換另一間維修公司。房內設備需要大更新嗎? 房內所有東西都像是 90 年代一般平價汽車旅館的陳設，沒設計沒風格，絕對需要大更新。

員工出色，但酒店的硬件也需要接軌才會讓客人回頭。以相同的價格，除非酒店大換妝吧，否則我想我並不會再回來。

(我選擇不貼照片，因為我不想其他人只看了我的照片便跑去訂房，完全忽略了這間旅店的重大缺點。)

title: Citadines disappoints!
text: Had read great reviews about this Hotel/Apts,  yes, it is a good location, near the Metro and the Eiffel Tower, and good neighborhood.  But, the purpose of hotel when you are traveling is a starting point and ending point to your day on vacation where you can recoup and refresh yourself for the night or the next day.  This property is very "dated" and could use some "refreshing",  the carpets are worn and the walls and door ways could use new paint and touchups.  We were there for 6 days, there are two "tiny" elevators, one was out of service our entire stay, it's an 8 story hotel, so you either wait in queue to go into the elevator or use the stairway! Lastly,  i have never stayed in a hotel, where i had to go out and buy cleaning products to clean the smell of urine from the bathroom, but i had to, our's smelled so bad it was unbearable.  When i talked to the girl at the desk about the issue, she was indifferent, as if i shouldn't have really been complaining.   My family and i will one day return to Paris, but NEVER back to this  property.  The Citadines greatly disappoints!!

title: Great stay at Sonder Atala, Champs Elysées!
text:
Staff were excellent, so kind and friendly. They were so patient, willing to answer all our questions and give us recommendations, and would regularly ask us how we were doing, what rhsh could do to help. We felt really welcomed! 

Room was beautiful. I recommend requesting a room on a higher floor with a balcony as you'll be able to see the eiffel Tower that way. In the mornings and night-time, you could just sit outside there for a few minutes and enjoy.

As there were three of us, we requested an extra bed. This turned out to be an extra, fold out double bed and we were given a sliding door between the two beds for privacy. This was brilliant, as the room never felt too crowded or like we were in each other's way.

Facilities were fab. We didn't go to breakfast (we wanted to eat outside) or use the gym, but both looked great!

Felt really safe. We were just on a street on the corner of the champs elysées, literally a 1 min walk away from the main shopping street. This way it was a bit quieter and more relaxed. 

But because we were so close to champs elysées, it was a great location. 10 min taxi ride/30 min walk to eiffel Tower and parisian boat rides, 10 min walk to arc de triomphe, 2 min walk to George V métro Station on champs elysées, 2 mins walk to avenue Montaigne and other beautiful shipping streets. Honestly, absolutely brilliant ❤️

Couldn't recommend this place more ❤️

title: Great location at a great price
text: Right next to the Arc de Triomphe, the Sonder Atala is a great spot to stay if you’re coming to Paris for some great food, good shopping (though it’s super crowded this time of year) and lots of sightseeing on foot. It’s walkable (within 30 mins or so) of the big spots, like the Eiffel Tower and the Palais Garnier Opéra. title: Nice hotel, but poor customer service
text:
Stayed there for business already a few time. Always a pleasant stay, normally small but nice and practical rooms. Clean and good breakfast.
Location is great and in general the hotel is very quiet, it never feels busy, very calm.

So, I thought I bring my wife there for a weekend in Paris.
On the website of the hotel it was stated that during April a complementary breakfast was included when staying weekends.
When we arrived at the hotel and checked in the lady of reception informed us that breakfast is not included. When I referred to the promotion, she ignored it and said she is not aware of any.
Even after I showed her the reference on the hotels website she refused to acknowledge the offer. She said: you can go for breakfast but we still might charge you. She was rude and arrogant and not a representative that knows the meaning of customer service.
The next day in the morning she was still not confirming the offer and we left the hotel and had breakfast outside.
I wrote in the meantime an email to the hotel manager to ask for sorting the situation. Never gotten a reply.
In the evening, with other reception staff, we checked again and the complementary breakfast was confirmed.
Overall we had a very nice room (much bigger than the once I had before) and the beds were comfortable.
Unfortunately the stay was overshadowed by the non existence of customer service.
What a shame! It’s so simple, but still so difficult to get right.

title: Great location and staff
text:
Great location near to Notre Dame and St Germain. We had adjoining rooms so our grown up kids could share the twin room next door. The bed was extremely comfortable and rooms were clean and well maintained.

Staff at reception were very helpful
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Lovely hotel in a perfect location.
text:
First trip to Paris since pre-covid , and such an ideal base for our stay!
The Trianon Rive Gauche is situated close to Boulevard St.Michel, making it a perfect base for exploring Paris on foot- which we did quite a lot- or by the nearby Metro. Also. proximity to the Luxembourg Gardens is an added bonus , especially in Spring!
The hotel is stylish, but not pretentious. Love the Art Nouveau decor.
Our room was spacious, comfortable and well supplied with everything. I especially liked the shoe brush, after dusty walks!
The hotel has environmentally friendly policies in place; another big plus.
Staff are friendly and helpful. 
We tried the breakfast on one of the mornings: delicious, plentiful and choices for all tastes.
This will be my 'go to' hotel when I return to my favourite city!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Good location but very overpriced and dirty room
text: I have stayed in quite a few hotels in the last 3 years near the Sorbonne, 5th arrondissement,  each classified 3 and 4 star hotels and was always happy with the rooms and the price I paid. This time I have booked for 2 nights the 4* Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche and stayed in room 704. The price I paid did not reflect in any form or shape the value of the room: The room was dirty, tiny and in parts presented a health hazard.   For example, fresh stains on bathroom walls, door frames, mouldy food under bed, one wall lamp above the bed was loose and looked like it could fall down on me any second, danger of slipping in bathroom as  after a shower the bathroom floor become unavoidably wet (tiny shower and rather large gap between shower curtain),   the chest of drawer  could not be opened as there was only a 15cm gap between bed and chest of drawers. The room was so tiny that the desk chair had to be relocated to the window sill in order to walk to the door and bathroom. It was an adjoining room and there was no privacy - I could hear every single word of the people next door, although they spoke quietly. I addressed the issues the next morning with reception (no manager available on that day or the following morning when I checked out), they offered a 10% discount and put a complimentary fruit basket in the room. I felt, that this wasn't adequate to address the issues and  was convinced that the rate charged must have been a mistake for this room in particular. I especially was disappointed with the  very late management's generic reply (complimentary breakfast and room upgrade for my next booking) to my email and my subsequent prompt.  I would be happy to go back to any of the other hotels I have stayed in that area, but after the poor experience with this overpriced room and the poor handling of management I would not recommend staying at that hotel in that specific room.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Top location but no 4Stars Standard
text: The hotel is divided in two houses. One is, we assumed, nice and 4stars Standard, the other one is the one we stayed in. To arrive to that room you need to take stairs and a lift which is from the last century and so small that only one person, hardly with suitcases fit in. The room was ok, but not very good isolated, so it was very load. There was no cupboard, just a place behind the curtain to put the clothes in.The bathroom was ok, clean but not very warm because there was a huge window in it. For that equipped room we payed a lot of money which is not reasonable.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Don’t believe the pictures
text:
We upgraded our room to a deluxe room with a terrace. I would have hated to see the non-upgraded room. I have been to Paris many times and I know the rooms are small, but be prepared, ours was very small. We were on the 6the floor in the wing to the far right of the lobby. 

My complaint is not actually about the size so much as the cleanliness (or lack thereof) there were stains on the walls, something splattered on the ceiling and part of the ceiling over the “closet” was missing.  

The positives: We had the breakfast included, which was actually pretty good if not repetitive (bacon, eggs, lots of breads, cold meats, fresh squeezed oj. The bed was small but quite comfortable. The bathroom was modernized, although being on the 6th floor you had to let the water run for about two minutes before it was hot.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Charming place in the heart of it all
text: The hotel is conveniently located in a vibrant, well-connected part of town. Some of the best sights, including Notre Dame and Le Jardin du Luxembourg are just a few blocks away.  The hotel is clean, fresh, inviting and refined without being pretentious. The staff was always pleasant and eager to help in any way.  I was nervous about not knowing enough of the French language, but the knowledgeable staff will make you feel at ease.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Wonderful Stay
text: We had a wonderful stay at the Trianon. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. The room was cozy and clean and the morning breakfast was delightful and satisfying. Lot of things to do and see in the area. We highly recommend  the Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: weekend Paris
text:
we were placed in a very small dark room with a very small bathroom. There was not enough room in the breakfast space, so had to eat outside of it.
Staff is friendly, Hotel is well situated but overall the hotel is average.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Paris Girls Trip
text: The hotel is small but lobby is beautiful, we had an adjoining room that was perfect for 4 woman that need an extra bathroom. Breakfast was delicious many options staff is welcoming and accommodating. Loved the location as well.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Dated, Dirty and Overpriced
text: This hotel charges extreme rates for poor quality. The photos on the listing are not accurately representing how dated and dirty this hotel is. My room was $500 a night for a twin bed, scratchy sheets, and not even a bottle of water in the room. A total waste of my money and time
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Just okay
text:
The staff was mostly unfriendly but the real turn off is how small our bathroom was in our upgraded room. (2.6 feet by 3.6 feet to move around in) but maybe this is the standard in Paris although we’ve had bigger bathrooms in the past. 
The bed was very comfortable. 
Location is good. Breakfast was also very nice.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Slaven Lekic , Montenegro
text: My wife and I are regularly visiting this hotel last 15 years every September. The location is excellent, surrounded by the best and most iconic Parisian places. There was one person from reception who was very rude and agresive to me(she was even shouting at me) and I would be very happy to share her description and name internally with the hotel's senior management. Of course, if you are interested in it. The hospitality industry does not need such people. Others were great, especially people in the restaurant who were supporting us all the time having in mind that we had a one-year baby with us. Food is very good, maybe there is a need for some more varieties because, after five or six days, you are becoming saturated by eating the same food. Special thanks to Yasmina and Hugo who were all the time at my disposal during the booking process. To underline, we will come again.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location and service
text: The hotel was as expected, and the location is great, near plenty of public transportation options as well as walking distance from Notre Dame. Breakfast is varied and fresh, and staff was pleasant and helpful.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location
text:
Great location, we had 2 rooms at the front of the hotel, lovely balconies on both. Rooms are a bit dated but clean and tidy. Air con in rooms was and plus as it was very hot when we stayed.  Quality toiletries provided including Elemis room spray and Clairol products.
We had a deal for a free bottle of wine and they happily changed the red for a bottle of white wine.
There is a coffee machine in room but had to request milk as not provided.
Continental buffet was really good but a busy place at 9am so go earlier as it gets packed out later and stag struggled to keep up. Water and coffe in reception area are free.
Overall we we had a great stay and the staff were very helpful.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Never again
text: Terrible stay. Staff overworked because they work too hard. Staff was crying outside with a cigarette. The reservation at the credit card is not corrected by departure and they don’t answer mails you send to the hotel about this case. Think twice before you confirm.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Not a 4- star!
text: This hotel is not a 4 star hotel!  The location was great!  Staff was helpful, BUT the rooms were not as pictured. They are super dated, and bathroom was dirty with mold and smelled. The hotel upgraded our stay when I wanted to cancel upon arrival but still was less than enjoyable.  For the price spent, the hotel should be renovated and freshened up.  I would advise others to look for other hotels in this neighborhood that can offer a clean and suitable experience.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Lovely hotel in a great location.
text:
The hotel is in a perfect location. It is on a quiet street in which felt like a safe neighbourhood. The hotel was stylish and we liked the decor, the tiny elevator was not very practical if you had lots of luggage but very in keeping with the old style of the hotel. 
We had a room on the 6th floor with a lovely unexpected view of the Eiffel Tower. The room was quiet and we heard no noise from the street or other rooms. 
We were expecting the room to be very small based on reviews but we found it absolutely fine for 3 nights. We only had a small amount of luggage which also helped. 
Bathroom was also a good size with a bath included. 
We didn’t have breakfast during our stay so cannot comment on this. Staff were friendly and helpful.
A small negative would be that housekeeping only really made the bed. One morning our bin wasn’t emptied and the coffee cups were not cleaned/changed during our 3 night visit. The coffee sachets were not replaced and there was no milk for tea, also no bottles of water. This should be expected for a 4 star hotel. 
The room was also a little expensive for what it was, but we expected that given the location.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location but Roma are 100% dated! Bathroom is no near a 4**** Hotel
text: Requested an invoice with my company details and no one at the desk (2 pp) was able to do that! Still waiting for the invoice after 1 week! Rooms are 100% dated and really small bathroom tub looks dirty and old no near a 4**** hotel.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location and view
text: The hotel is in a great location in Paris with many good restaurants/cafes within minutes.  It is also only about 15 minutes from the Seine.  We stayed in a "top level" room with a view.  There were incredible views of the Eiffel tower and sunsets.  We left for the airport before 7am (before restaurant opens) and the person at the desk was incredibly helpful.  Besides arranging taxi, he got us coffee and pastries to have on the way to the airport.  It is an old hotel so the room was very small and the walls were paper thin (we could easily hear our neighbors talking).  Overall though, the room was very comfortable, the location was perfect, and the hotel is highly recommended.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Tri Again
text:
We booked innice and early but sadly however the room we were assigned wasn't what we booked and paid for.

It was small, awkwardly shaped with a small bed, malfunctioning TV and right next to an allnight groaning and whining lift.

After several strenuous discussions we managed to get a new room for the second night which was in line with what we booked and paid for.

An apology eventuated with a small bottle of wine, but what is really needed and if trip advisor do their job is a discount for the one awful sleepless night.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Highly recommended
text: I stayed with my daughter for 2 nights in a twin room which was very comfortable and spotlessly clean.  We thoroughly enjoyed Paris and we were particularly happy with our choice of hotel as the location was excellent and the hotel staff were very welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Good located, top view, slept well!
text:
The location in the 6th arrondissement was great - close to the Jardin du Luxembourg and with many good restaurants in the close area. Furthermore our room was on the 5th floor - therefore we enjoyed a great view on the Tour Eiffel! We also slept well, as the bed was very comfortable and it wasn't noisy, although we slept with an open window (in August).
A slight minus for the small room with the missing wardrobe. And the old, dark carpets in the entire hotel. And the elevator is really mini - as well as the stairs.
But in total we enjoyed our stay in this hotel.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Relaxing weekend in Paris
text: The hotel exceeded our high expectations. Accommodation: super comfortable and clean. Breakfast: delicious and plentiful. Staff: kind and professional. A staff member went above and beyond providing sympathy and first aid to my daughter.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Authentic Parisien Hotel
text: Lovely hotel, excellent location near Notre Dame. Lots of cafés nearby. The rooms are on the small side because the building is an authentic Parisien building. Bathrooms are good & everything is very clean. Very comfortable beds & great air conditioning. Lovely friendly staff.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Amazing hotel and hospitality! We will be back!
text: We spent three wonderful nights in the Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche in Paris this July as part of our honeymoon. The hotel staff were extremely welcoming, competent and kind. Upon hearing that it was our honeymoon, we received many complimentary extras in our room, including a great coffee machine, mini bar, shower pods and shoe shining kit, which were very much appreciated. The robes and slippers provided are so plush. We had the most beautiful clean room, with a gorgeous balcony and stunning views over Paris and the Eiffel tower. We really did receive the most excellent treatment from staff during our stay. The location is ideal and within walking distance of many tourist hotspots. It really is a great base for sightseeing, but also to enjoy spending time and relaxing in the beautiful room and balcony taking in the views! We will most certainly be back when we return to Paris! Thank you, Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Very small rooms. Not responsive.
text:
They were very rude and non flexible in changing dates with no reason. They canceled my reservation at 7pm because we were late and did not refund although they sold the room immediately.
Had to 0ay 500 Euro more because of that.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Ideal location
text: Professional, very helpful staff, ideal location with many great restaurants and cafes nearby, you are spoilt for choice, and the Jardin de Luxenbourg is basically around the corner with easily accessible transport links and the price good value for money during high season in comparison to other hotels in the neighbourhood. The room was compact but only needed for sleeping afterall; we had a traditional continental breakfast in the room upon departure with delicious fresh orange juice but, otherwise, took breakfast at several of the delightful outdoor cafes and enjoyed watching the world go by.  A/C worked well although the room did smell a bit damp upon returning after a day's sight-seeing, not altogether uncommon in older buildings which is the only negative comment, alongside the lack of face cloths in the bathroom - I forgot many hotels in Europe curiously do not supply them. Overall, we were more than satisfied with our stay and would return.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Two days
text: Friendly, attentive, and competent personnel. The additional day was organized perfectly—close walking distance to most tourist hotspots. The historic hotel makes you feel like you are visiting the last century.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Paris Trip.
text:
First let me start with the good things. This is an older lovely boutique hotel in a wonderful quiet neighborhood. It’s close to a lot of nice restaurants and things to do. The staff were all very friendly. Breakfast offered was very nice every morning.
Now here’s what I did not feel were up to my expectations- The bathroom was very small and there was nothing to place toiletries on. The tub is treacherous to climb in and out of, Every time you take a shower you have large puddles of water all over the floor and nowhere for the water to drain- we had to actually use our bath towels to soak it up after showering every day. The towels are very small and we never received a washcloth. We stayed in the midst of a heat wave and they try to keep up with leaving cold water in the lobby however there were many times there was not fresh water available. 
All in all we enjoyed our stay but I think there are things that can be improved.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location, comfortable room- Paris size!
text: Beautiful, well positioned hotel. Our room was on the 5th floor. There is a very small lift . Fantastic view of the Eiffel Tower from the window, lots of period features in the building. Breakfast was a bit lacklustre, no smiles from staff. Reception staff very helpful and pleasant.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Scam / Robbery
text:
The last thing I wanted to do was write a bad review but I have had no choice.

To start this whirlwind of monstrosities I enquired about getting my hotel room decorated for me and my partners anniversary and the response from the hotel was that they had me booked in for different dates from which I had on the email. I then had to go out of my way to contact my holiday provider to get this sorted out even though it is such a simple task and unexplainable how my dates got blundered.
(If I never contacted the hotel about getting the room decorated I would of turnt up to the hotel and they would of had me booked in for different dates which is a would of been a disaster)

On arrival at the hotel I was told to pay a €1 deposit along with the city tax for me and my partner which was €17, I payed this in cash and did not get a receipt but I did not ask for one because I am assuming there would not be any problems upcoming.

Check in was at 3pm, we came back from our outings at 4pm expecting the room to be available as we are an hour later than check in time. My surprise of getting our hotel room decorated was completely ruined. We opened the door to find an employee still decorating the room an hour later after check in, we was then told that the room would still not be ready for 15 minutes. Whilst sitting in the lobby the employee strolls past with roses which exposed the surprise even more (If that was possible)

The room we was given (209) was dark, dingy, in the corner of the hotel, the bathroom light was flickering and not working and the TV wasn't working either. The view was of airvents and brickwalls which didn't add any value to our experience. It felt very prison like. 
I believe I was given this room as the hotel messed up our dates and this is what they decided to accomodate us with.

The following day I requested a new room which I did get and was thankful for but I shouldn't have had to have these complications in the first place.

In the new room to celebrate I decided to order a bottle of wine. I specifically and slowly said over the phone I wanted the 37.5cl bottle which cost €17.20, 40 minutes later a 75cl bottle turns up at my room which is double the price. My partner and I didn't need this much wine as we was waiting so long already and was due to go out for a meal. 
I tried to get this rectified with the reception and the lady said the following "I'm sorry sir but I am all by myself, I have lots of customers to deal with (Basically implying she doesn't have time for me) and that I will be charged for the bigger bottle which I never wanted/ordered in the first place. Ridiculous.
In the new room basic things were not available such as no milk and having hand gel instead of shower gel in the shower.

On our final day we headed to the reception to check out, we were served by a young lady with glasses. I was presented with a bill which had 2 big bottles of wine, city tax and the charge for getting the room decorated. 
I said to the receptionist firstly I didn't have the wine. Abruptly and before I could finish speaking she said "It's only 9am, It's my first hour at work, I'm done. Everyone apparently has a problem and everyone wants something for free" by her saying this it clearly shows I wasn't the only one that had a bad experience and that lots of guests have been complaining which only reflects the service of the hotel. She then walked away to speak to the 'manager'. She came back and told me that they took off the wine from the bill but left the city tax and decoration fee.
I stated that I already payed the city tax on the first day and why should I be paying full price for the decoration of the room even though I could not check in until over an hour and a half later and the surprise ruined.
When saying I have already payed the city tax she said that this is impossible because customers are not allowed to pay it on the first day (Which I did) and that her colleague would not get something wrong like this (Failing to put it on the system) ?
I said again I can't pay the city tax as I've already payed it so it doesn't make any sense for me to do so. She had the worst customer service I have ever experienced in a 'hotel' she was accusing me of lying about paying the city tax, she was fine with quarelling with me infront of other hotel guests then walked away and said "When I come back from talking to my 'manager' I hope you don't come up with something new to say" (This is disgustingly rude)
She comes back for a 3rd time. Why hasn't the 'manager' come out yet? Was there even a 'manager' in the first place?
I tried to prove I payed the city tax from showing her my credit card statement of when I deposited the €1 and she demeaningly said "I will refund you the €1 if you want hahaha"
Her final answer was that I pay for the city tax and 50% of the decoration (Meaning I pay for the city tax twice) or pay for the wines and not the city tax (WHICH I NEVER ORDERED)
I payed the city tax again just to end the stupidness and to get me out of the situation.

Mine and my partners belongings where stored in the luggage room. My partners £1500 luggage bag was then scraped and scratched infront of our eyes and we didn't even get a sorry.

When we was walking out the hotel the receptionists were sniggering and laughing indirectly at us.

To finalise, the service from the staff was appauling, rude, argumentive and belittling.

My city tax money was stolen from the staff and the amount of errors made on my check out receipt makes me wonder how many other guests were wrong too. 

That was my experience at the Hotel Trianon Rive-Gauche. 

Happy to say I will never in my existence be returning or recommending.

title: Beautiful hotel in the Latin Quarter
text: The hotel is very convenient to the bus and Metro, bakeries, cafes and shops.  It’s a quirky, French building, with magnifent views of the Eiffel Tower (we stayed in room 654).   Yes, rooms are not big American square boring rooms - they are 13th century sizes, but are you staying in your hotel room or exploring the city?  Bed was super comfy, bathroom well equipped and modern.   If you want a 1600 super strong hairdryer, bring your own, because this is a mild, hose style dryer.  But it did the trick!!!  The elevator is a triangle with room for maybe 2 people and a suitcase, max weight 225lbs, so enjoy the single rides or getting a great workout climbing 6 flights of stairs.   But it is SO cool.    Breakfast was delicious, room service quick, coffee and tea great.   Staff friendly and helpful.   Nearby Luxembourg Gardens are beautiful.  We sat and had coffee and just people watched and listened the Sunday orchestra at the bandstand.  The Seine cruises are hop on and off and well worth the 16 euros for 24 hours.   Amazing views of all the major landmarks.   The Louvre grounds are excellent.   The Moulin Rouge was a great, fun evening.   Metro easy to figure out.  Traffic is everywhere and fast,  so whether you are walking, on a scooter, bike, motorbike or car, it’s a free for all, no rules but weirdly everyone is respectful of one another.  Champs Élysées is beautiful.  High class shopping and amazing views.   If you try and speak the language, Parisiens are happy to help.  Everyone was friendly.   We loved the hotel and would definitely stay here again.  Fantastic holiday!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Beautiful last night in Paris
text: This hotel provided us with comfort and a totally competent staff in two lovely rooms at a well-located facility.  We were pleased to have air-conditioning and well appointed rooms with amenities.  It is an establishment to which I might very well return.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: My go to hotel in Paris
text: I could stay in many hotels in Paris France though I continue to chose Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche. It has a great location allowing walks to many major attractions and small quaint restaurants. The staff has continued tobe excellent and the leadership has an eye for selecting true hospitality professionals. In particular Eve and Swa, (sp) were wonderful.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Not a 4 star hotel!
text: Hotel was in a great location, close to lots of restaurants, Luxembourg Gardens and a number of metro stations. The staff were all very friendly and helpful and our room was serviced every day. I would say that this is a 3 star hotel and definitely not a 4 star. Our room was tiny (which we expected), but the decor was very dark which made it feel quite  claustrophobic. It also felt quite tired. There was a kettle and coffee and not very nice tea bags, but no milk. We had to buy our own milk and tea bags so we could have a decent cup of tea!  The bathroom was small and dated, nowhere to put any toiletries and the extractor fan didn't work. The tissue holder was loose and fell off the wall numerous times. The bath towels were tiny.  The shower wasn't great, sometimes cold, sometimes hot and temperature changed during the shower so you had to get out and wait for it to get to the right temperature again. The bed was ok, but the room above us had a very squeeky bed (say no more!) and you could hear the people in the room next to us talking. We were located next to the lift and heard a constant tap tap noise eveytime the lift was used.  I don't think we would stay here again, due to all the things mentioned above. We put up with it as we didn't spend much time in our room.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Lovely hotel in a great neighborhood
text: Lovely hotel in a very nice neighborhood.  Breakfast was good. The view was spectacular and the beds are very comfortable. Very nice restaurants nearby for instance at Place de Sorbonne.  I would love to come back and stay at this hotel the next time I am in town 🇫🇷🥐.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Terrible disappointment - more like 2 stars
text:
We were really excited for our birthday stay in Pairs in the Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche.
Sadly, when we got there we were terribly disappointed. 
The staff at the reception was unwelcoming and rude.
The room we got was tiny and in desperate need of a renovation. The furniture seemed only and outdated, the "closet" was a little corner with a clothing rail and a curtain in front of it and the ceiling had a hole in it. The safe didn't work. The promised view of the main attractions in Paris turned out to be a view of the opposite building.
The bathroom was even worse. If you wanted to reach the bathtub, you had to climb over the toilet, and in the process of the shower the whole bathroom got drenched. The only outlet near the sink didn't work. Worst of all, there was dirt and dust and even hairs in the bathtub.
Upon complaint, we received a bottle of champagne and some macarons. Sadly, that didn't quite make up for the over 400€ we spend on two nights in what I would describe the worst hotel I have stayed in in my life.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Disappointing
text:
I don’t think the service of this hotel is very good when it comes to booking a room, and I wonder how many other travelers have had the same experience. My interaction with the hotel had a disappointing outcome. 

I tried to book a room several times through booking.com and hotels.com with three different credit cards (2 visa and 1 American Express). At first Trianon would confirm, only to cancel a few days later. This procedure was repeated for a week or so.  Now, you could think there might have been a problem with (all) the credit cards? That is not the case. They’ve all worked fine for years and have been since. I can book any other hotel, I’ve tried, but not this.  Of course, maybe they just don’t want me to come and stay ;) anyway, it was quite tiresome and frustrating. Not to mention time consuming. And it was all in vain.

Naturally I contacted the hotel, but they just informed me what I already knew: that they had been canceling my reservations. They did nothing to try to solve the problem. 

So my advice is: if they cancel your reservation, it doesn’t mean there’s anything wrong with your credit card(s). So in stead of wasting a couple of weeks trying to book it, just pick another hotel and book that in stead.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

Thank you thank you thank you
I would completely recommend this amazing place it’s truly wonderful.
Everything was perfect
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: HoHum

I like to unpack, hang up clothes, have a bit of space in which  to stretch out. You can barely turn around in the room we had (deluxe double). No drawers anywhere to put clothes. title: Charming Parisian hotel in a great location
text: Very charming Parisian hotel in a great location. Views of the rooftops of Paris from the room were delightful and the room itself had nice decor and was clean. Reception staff were polite, but not overly friendly. Cleaning staff were nice.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Lovely
text:
Excellent location near Boulevard St. Germain and in a very quiet neighborhood. Nice lobby.  Rooms are typical for Paris - very small. Furnishings are very nice, comfortable beds & quality linens. Mini fridge in room.  Small balcony (Room 605), where if your crane neck you can see lights on top of LaTour Eiffel.
Rooms are "soundproofed" so there was no street noise at all.    HOWEVER, we could clearly hear the woman in the next room who worked on Zoom videos most of the day and night.  The sound came through the locked adjoining door. Also, the plumbing sounds made it seem like there was a fountain inside the ceiling of the room.  I understand it is an older building without much choice for upgrades, but the flowing water sounds were at the same time bizarre and soothing - crazy, right?

Overall I would recommend the hotel.  Location, price and quality were very nice.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: City break
text: Good location,  good room size and nice breakfast and staff always restocking up, enjoyed the stay. Nice staff. Hotel room got too hot at night time. Will come back and would stay again at this hotel. All in all perfect
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Well recommended hotel for the location

title: Great location

title: Our Stay in Paris

name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Would recommend. Great location
text:
This hotel is in a fantastic location. 5 minutes from Luxembourg Park, lots of cafés and restaurants, ATM and shops.
The room was small but we expected this in Paris. It had all the amenities we needed, a safe, fridge, complimentary water (every day), robes and slippers and daily housekeeping. Room service was good value, we didn’t have the breakfast in the dining hall but it was popular.
The staff are very friendly and accommodating. We had one small issue that was dealt with straight away. The towels weren’t great and I would star this hotel a 3, not 4.
Would definitely stay here again though.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Good location and helpful staff
text: We had a lovely night at this hotel.  My husband and I started our European vacation with a night in this hotel.  It was close to the Gare St. Lazare train station, which we walked to in the morning.  And there were a number of small nice restaurants within two blocks.  Notre-Dame and the Seine were less then an easy 15 minute walk away. While the rooms were small which is typical for Paris hotel rooms, they were clean, well appointed and we had a quiet night sleep.  And the staff were able to converse with us in English, which we appreciated since we do not speak French.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Charming hotel in very nice area
text: Situation is perfect for those who want to stay away form the most crowded tourist spots but still be close to really nice neighbourhoods such as St Germain, Quartier Latin, Luxembourg Park etc. Really nice and cosy restaurants and cafes nearby. Our room had stunning view over Eiffel tower. Apparently there are big differences in the quality of the rooms even within the same category so a tip worth money and convenience is to ask for a room with a view and a little balcony. Breakfast very good though bit expensive and breakfast room was so crowded during the weekends that people had to queue to fit in. But all in all a very good choice and would definitely come back!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Perfect Parisian Boutique Hotel

We were able to jump right out to the Garden for morning runs, then easily walk to all the usual spots along the Siene. And the immediate neighborhood has amazing restaurants and our favorite patisserie.

title: Excellent stay
text: Great stay: very friendly, clean and quiet; comfortable beds, hence a great night’s sleep, which is not usually the case for me staying in hotels (especially the first night). We had two rooms joined, with our two children in the room next door. This was perfect, as usually we all end up in the same room and no one gets much sleep; the price for this was very reasonable compared to other places to stay. The breakfast was good and plenty of choice - great selection of loose tea, with tea pots, which, as a tea-lover, was lovely. However, the breakfast was not quite worth the price. Plenty of cafes nearby for a good breakfast. Great location to explore from. Will definitely stay here again.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: nice location and staff

title: Birthday weekend in Paris

title: Good location
text:
Reception was kind and understanding about some of my disappointments.  However some of what was promised didn't happen.  I was told by booking.com that I would get an upgrade because I was a 'genius' status.  We stayed 4 days and not once did we get upgraded.  They did offer a free breakfast the final 2 days because I shared my disappointment.  The interior room was nice but the hallways and staircases could be freshened up to give it a better ambience. We were told we would have fresh water each day and it never happened we always had to go and ask for it.  The 'Welcome' ride service to and from the airport - They promised to meet us with a sign at the luggage exit, gave us the car type, license plate number and name and picture of the driver - NO person at the exit we had to search him out in the parking lot with out luggage in tote. and it was not the car, person or license plate promised.  Not good. 
We loved the location in the 6th and love the restaurants in the area.  Room is small but quiet.

title: Lovely Hotel Great Location BUT...
text: Stayed here for 3 nights and it really is a nice hotel, clean and in a great location. The only bad thing about it was you can literally hear everything the windows and walls are paper-thin. You can hear all the horns beeping, sirens going past and even the room adjacent TV but other than that it really is a good hotel.

title: Hotel Trianon Rive Gauche
text:
Hotel Trianon was an excellent choice for our Oct/Nov 2021 visit to Paris.
It was a perfect combination of comfort, service and location.
We were a 5 minute walk to the Latin Quarter, another couple of minutes to Notre Dame and Isle St Louis, and maybe 12 minutes to the Louvre.  The morning breakfast buffet was amazing and the staff would gladly pack a small breakfast to go to if we were pressed for time.
The front desk staff was incredibly helpful with special mention to Colleen that helped us navigate our covid-19 PCR test at a nearby pharmacy that didn't show up in our email on the expected day.   She called them to speak to them in French on my behalf to find out what had happened and expedite the results if possible.   Within an hour, I had the email in my inbox with what I needed.
Room was a bit small but had a nice little balcony with a table and two chairs that was great for days when it wasn't raining.
I would definitely recommend Hotel Trianon and will book it again on our next trip to Paris.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Great location for romantic trip
text: Friendly staff. Great location, relaxed atmosphere, 15 minute walk from Notre Dame and Louvre. Nice breakfast with fresh orange juice, viennoiserie, French cheese... Cosy room with a view. I can definitely recommend.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Best hotel in Paris!
text: My favorite hotel in Paris! Best location and service. I can see Eiffel tower from my balcony, it was unforgettable! I like the atmosphere there and personal was really kind to me, help me to find information about vaccine and other staff. I will come back in September ♥️ thank you!
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Location, Location, Location !!!!!!!!!!!
text:
The first time that we stayed at this hotel, it was because our friends who had been to Paris told us to stay on the "Left Bank". I picked this hotel because it seemed to be central to where we wanted to be. Having stayed at this hotel, I will tell you that the best point of this hotel is "the location".  If this is your first visit to Paris, I have to tell you that hotel rooms are smaller than we see in the U.S.

This is a list of the locations that you can walk to:
- Boulevard Saint-Michel (get a taxi into central Paris);
- Sorbonne entrance/plaza is directly across Boulevard Saint-Michel. There are three cafes located in the plaza.
-Pantheon
-Luxembourg Gardens
-Restaurant Polidor
-"Dalloyau" Store ( sweets )
-additional cafes on the short street to the Pantheon.

It is a safe area. We took some walks in the early evening after dinner.
 
One of the fun things was talking to the students of the Sorbonne. They like to practice their use of English. They ask a lot of questions. Apparently, we have the word "American" stamped on our forehead.

The prices for a room are generally close in the area. 

We had a good experience twice at this hotel  and we would go back if we return to Paris.
name: Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche

title: Not worth the money
text:
We have paid an approximate amount of 1200 Euros for a two-night stay at this hotel thinking it will be worth the money, given the reviews and the location and the fact that is part of the Accor group. It is not. We were given a room on the second floor close to the corner of the hotel. The Eiffel tower view is obstructed by the building near the hotel. This type of room is charged the same as a higher-level room, with an unobstructed view. There was "nothing to be done" about this as the hotel was fully booked. The Eiffel tower view is a side view. Right in front of the hotel, there is a sports field and the alley in front is always buzzing with taxis. The windows of the room are poorly isolated and the room is very noisy even with the doors closed. On our first morning, we were woken up by trucks and forklifts because there was work done on the sports field. The second morning we were woken up by loud noises coming from the sports field as there was an event going on that started at 8 a.m. The night before this there was a private party at the hotel rooftop that finished past 1 a.m. and the music was so loud you could hear it from the 2nd floor. We were not even extended the courtesy of a late checkout for the trouble. And everything wrapped up with us being charged twice for the stay. The hotel is so busy and the personnel is so overworked that they could not even coordinate on the fact that we were already charged. 
The room is however well kept and modern, having all the facilities you might need. Unfortunately, this does not compensate for everything else.

title: Ticks boxes
text:
The proximity to the Eiffel Tower is of course second to none here. But I don’t really think this hotel offers a truly Parisian experience if that’s what you’re seeking. 

The lobby is constantly jam packed and busy with guests checking in and out and waiting for their group bus tours. The buzz of complaining from people who wanted a better room and didn’t receive it frustrated me on behalf of the hotel staff. I felt so sorry for them having to encounter such rude people! 

We had bought a bottle of wine to enjoy however we had to pay 5 euro to get a bucket of ice and wine glasses delivered. And then they would not open the bottle and made me go to the lobby restaurant to have it opened. 

There is a shopping centre a little walk away and a grocery store too. There is also lovely walking/running and exploring in the Eiffel Tower vicinity to be enjoyed. My children loved watching the soccer matches at the sports field in front of the hotel and that was their highlight. 

I describe this hotel as catering to the “cookie cutter tourist” and if that’s you then go for it. But if you want to feel more like you’re in Paris, and less like you’re on a package tour, then try elsewhere.

title: Horrible Hotel
text:
My family of 5 decided to stay at this hotel because of the good ratings on TripAdvisor. First I want to say we are seasoned travelers and have been to Paris a few times before. This is one of the worst hotels I’ve been to. I had booked 2 rooms with Eiffel Tower rooms which I paid extra for. I arrived at the hotel around 4 pm and the lines were long and slow. Waited for my turn to check in. The guy at the counter gave us 2nd floor rooms with only one room being Eiffel Tower he said he doesn’t have any available. Well if I paid for it and I’m there during check in time then you should of held it for me. I asked for the manager and few dollars tip and all of a sudden the room type was available. Ok moving forward took the small stuffy with people elevator that we waited for 15 min to our room. The room door had smudges of grease. Walked in the room very small typical 4 star counters and door handles walls were not clean they had things splattered or grease. Small bathroom with again just whatever to me not the best. The bedding is cheap and motel type. The only hype about this hotel is the balcony which has a beautiful view but other then that the balcony is old too. I mean I didn’t have a good night sleep. This hotel is for young crowd that doesn’t care about quality. I honestly had a restless, uneasy stay. I didn’t even feel comfortable leaving my valuables in the safe. Because one of the bellman told me let me hold your bag I said it’s ok I got it. He said it’s LV that’s why your not giving it to me. Now maybe I have woman’s items in there and I want to keep it with me how can you assume. Made me feel uncomfortable. Everytime I tried to call downstairs for something they never answered the phone. If there was an emergency they would not answer the phone. This hotel felt like a big outdoor Bazaar but the hotel version. People keep checking in and out with crazy lines. They get so many quests they can keep track to value each guests responds or needs. We had breakfast in our package we never used. I didn’t like my room, bed or the hotel to even use there restaurant. I wanted to be out all day to avoid staying
I’m this hotel. The only good thing was the area. It had many cafes that around the corner and I found an amazing hair salon that I loved. This place will be nice if they renovate it and have more professional caring staff with great service. But if your looking for a quick motel or inn type of loud crowded place to stay then go ahead. Everyone has a different taste. Not my cup of tea.

I hope the hotel will eventually provide refund. Please be aware of this when you are planning to book this hotel.

title: Don’t book a triple classic room, they don’t exist
text:
The hotel has a great location if you want to be near the Eiffel Tower.  It is a few minutes walk from Bir-Hakeim Metro station and a five minute walk fro the Champ de Mars and the Tower itself.  The hotel is smart and mostly clean.  We did have a bad experience checking in.. after a 10 minute wait, where only one of the 3 check-in desks was staffed, we were told that the room we had booked (via American Express Travel) which was a triple classic, does not exist and that rooms are just for two people.   I still don’t know whether that is an Amex issue or a hotel one, but I can’t believe we are the first to have this issue so the hotel should sort this with its booking agents.  The hotel was full so on the first night we were put in a classic room with an extra single rollaway bed.  Once the single bed was in there was no room to move.  On the second day they said they would move us to a larger room, which they did but failed to move our bags as promised which led to a worrying few minutes while we located them.  Then the new room was not really any bigger than the first but with a slightly better layout which meant at least that we didn’t need to climb over the furniture to get to the bathroom (and paying £300+ per night for the privilege).   The rollaway bed was poor quality, with two of the slats falling out the first time anyone sat in it.  We fixed it ourselves temporarily and didn’t want to waste any more of our time sorting it out. 
So taking away the annoyance and mis-selling of the room fiasco, the hotel is nice enough.  Breakfast was good with lots of options - and there is an egg/ omelette station, which no-one told us about, we just noticed people getting omelettes on the second day we were there. And it could take a long time to be served/offered coffee.   
The room we were moved to had a balcony…but no balcony furniture and a very dusty/cobwebby front panel.  Had a walk in shower which was nice, though hard to avoid flooding the room unless you use the overhead shower.
There was a pop-up bar on the 10th floor which was nice though the staff were a bit snooty.   And don’t even try to go in just for a look as you’ll be turned away very firmly.
Unless you really want to be near the Eiffel Tower I don’t know that I would not particularly recommend the hotel.   It is comfortable enough but the staff weren’t overly helpful/friendly and it doesn’t have much character.

title: Exceptional Location, Good Prices For Paris, Great Service from Staff
text:
My wife and I recently stayed here for 7 nights to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. It was our first time visiting Paris and What a wonderful place it was. You really couldn't get a better place to stay if you wanted to be close to the Eiffel Tower and in walking distance to cafes, shops etc.  The staff were friendly, attentive and went out of their way to ensure our comfort. I can't express enough how grateful we were to be put in room 613 ( i think probably one of the best rooms for the Eiffel Tower View (not to low or high so you get the perfect view off the balcony)
Also I requested the full works to make the room romantic to surprise my wife, and they didn't disappoint as they dressed up the room with heart shaped helium balloons, rose pedals everywhere, a boutique of about 50 long stem red roses, chocolate, and champagne on ice with glasses, and a nice card, it was all so special and very memorable.

The room was comfortable, bed was great, hot water was adequate, towels and robes were good, bath products good.

Could you hear people from the other rooms, yes but this isn't uncommon for hotels in Paris from what I read in my research prior to coming here.  I read in some other reviews that this hotel didn't clean the rooms often, this isn't true, all you need to do is be proactive ask the front desk for whatever you need and they will arrange it for you.
I also read on the reviews that there were hours long wait times to check in to this hotel, again this also wasn't true, I was able to walk in no problem, speak to staff right away, have my luggage stored, left for the day, came back checked in, and the room was ready with no problems.
We went to the restaurant (the lobster roll is amazing), Top floor sky bar, and had room service though out our stay and all were good with no issues.
If you go to this place and show respect for the staff, be kind and appreciative, it's wonderful how you will be treated.
Thanks to all the staff for your kindness, hard work and ensuring my wife and I had an enjoyable stay to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary.

title: Excellent
text:
This was a great, seven night, centrally located hotel experience for us. We were given adjoining rooms
 Particularly noteworthy were the helpful staff—Victor at the Concierge Desk and Céline in the Dining Room.
The Breakfast Buffet was absolutely outstanding. It was fresh and had a lot of variety.
The bar and balcony on the top floor bar provided unbelievable views of the Tower especially when the lights sparkled on the hour. 
Staff were very helpful

Now we mistakenly ate at one of those tourist traps close to the Tower where I first encountered the new trick being played on tourists—marking up the bill—“for service.” When I challenged the server—“I understood service was always included”—a new, correctly totalled  bill was produced.
This happened again at another restaurant-Le Beaujolais—a lovely spot a little further away from the hotel where the waiter simply wrote the word “Tip” at the bottom of the bill and suggested if I was happy with the service I could add something on. (I didn’t.) Then speaking with the French folks at the next table, they showed us their bill which didn’t have the word “Tip” written on it. Even they knew that tourists were sort of being targeted, perhaps by Servers who had been severely financially setback by COVID .
On another occasion the waiter asked me straight out—would I like to add something on for service.

All in all, this was a great hotel experience in an area which was very busy. I highly recommend this hotel.

text:

The hotel has a great all you can eat breakfast buffet at a charge. We took advantage of this buffet before heading out to explore the city.

title: WARNING! YOUR CREDIT CARD IS NOT SAFE HERE

I stayed at the Pullman for 1 night and paid my bill in full. However, nearly 2 months after my stay my Visa card was suddenly charged again for €600.00.

title: The Worst Customer Service!
text:
We stayed here as a part of Viking River cruise Pre Extension. I had texted hotel 2 months prior and requested early check in, they never responded! We checked in at 10:00 AM and told our room would not be available till after 4:00. We did our thing and checked in at 4:15. We were given two twins… I said no. The woman at the desk said we requested it, I said no. She said Viking then requested it, I said that’s impossible because there is a preference for stateroom on river cruise for bed configuration and we requested beds together. She said nothing she could do, but I could call Viking. Our room was two single beds in a very smallroom on the first floor, with a view of AC units and the carpet was stained, 2 outlets were broken and the bathroom was tiny! I called Viking to inform them, they got on the phone with the hotel and were told they had no rooms to change us! Later that evening I went to desk to inform them that 2 outlets were not working… a lady came to the same desk and stated she had requested 2 twins but was given a king! I couldn’t believe it! The same woman that told me there were no rooms, told this woman right away she could change the rooms! Our room was horrible! Viking River cruise offers a pre & post extension at this hotel and there must be over 30 customers at the moment and most got a queen/king beds and some with a balcony and Eiffel Tower view! We all paid the same amount of money for the extension! I’m upset, this hotel took advantage of us and Viking! 
The next day I asked for a bucket of ice, they said it costs 5 Euros! I refused and then was informed they had an ice machine on odd floors. I asked for a bucket and again they said that would cost money! I went to ice machine and they had large cups available! 
When we checked in there was no information given to us about WiFi and how to use our card to operate elevator! When we return from our outings there is no friendly “hello”… this hotel is just awful on customer service! Very rude! 
The breakfast buffet was good. Would I recommend this hotel if it was not part of a tour? No! Too busy, and customer service sucks! By the way they never fixed the broken two outlets!

title: Nice hotel, convenietly located
text: We really enjoyed staying at this hotel - two adults and one eight year-old boy. The room was bright, clean, and spacious and the rollout bed for my son was comfortable. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Wow what a view of the Eiffel from our room!
text:
The room of our dreams was one we never expected to get!
We booked a 3 day extension after our Viking River cruise. They picked this hotel. We had no idea where it was or what kind of room we'd get. Imagine our surprise when we opened the door to our balcony room and saw the view of the Eiffel Tower! See how happy my wife is in the attached photo. 

The room itself was fine, a moderate size, comfy bed, nice large bathroom. One weird thing about the bathroom was the walk-in shower...half a glass wall and no door meant taking extra care not to flood the room. Not unique, as we saw the same setup in another hotel, too. Who thought this was a good idea? Not a deal breaker.

Hotel has an excellent buffet breakfast which was included in our deal with Viking. Not sure if everyone gets this for free or not. But even if you have to pay, go for it! Fresh pastries, made to order omelettes, fresh squeezed O-J, and French Toast, pancakes, cold cuts and more. Best yogurt I've ever eaten!  It's all you can eat to fill up for a day of sightseeing.

Viking has an excellent concierge in the lobby if you need post cruise help and recommendations for restaurants, etc. The hotel concierge was also helpful in getting us reservations for a dinner cruise on the Seine and getting us taxis around town.

Hotel location is excellent. Easy walk to the Eiffel Tower and several cafes.Hotel is set back some distance from the busy main drag which helps keep it quiet for sleeping. That said, Paris is one busy city! People are out and about at all hours here, almost like NY City.

Bottom line: Consider staying here for the view of a lifetime. It doesn't get more romantic than this!

title: Three and a half ...
text:
This is a large, fairly modern hotel with some comfort but little or no character. It has 430 rooms, meaning there are over 800 guests when it’s full, as it pretty much was when we were there, due to the French Open tennis being on and many players and their teams (and fans) staying at the hotel. We stayed for four nights and have mixed feelings.
People rave about ‘the location’ and ‘the view’ – but really neither are that good or important. I booked a ‘superior’ room with tower view – you look at the view for maybe ten minutes a day but sleep for several hours, and anyway the view is just outside the main door. The location is good for the Eiffel Tower, but not much else.
Our room was comfortable and clean and quiet – these are important things – and the shower was very good. The room was not large and had very, very little space for putting clothes – if (as we were) you’re a couple on a longish trip with big cases, you’ll not find much space to hang or put clothes. In retrospect, I’d book a bigger room with no view, but then we weren’t on honeymoon or stuff.
Plus side: very good staff, from check-in to check-out and specially at breakfast. The variety at breakfast is good. Sleep quality good too.
Negative side: there are three lifts and often it’s not enough for a place this size. Breakfast was always a tad chaotic – so many people around – and on two mornings the cooked food simply wasn’t hot enough, you’d expect better. Staff were sometimes struggling to provide enough plates / bowls / cutlery. The restaurant (Frame) overcharges and underperforms – avoid.
My wife and I love Paris and we stayed here because it was (relatively) close to Roland Garros. As an Accor Diamond member, I wouldn’t stay here again (I had to ask for the welcome drink) mainly because places like Scribe offer so much more.
Stay here if you’re obsessed with the Eiffel Tower. Otherwise, look around a bit. There’s so much more to Paris than this.

You can not go wrong with a stay at the Pullman Eiffel Tower.
