title: Only good for the view.
text:
Very poor. Not worth the price. Sadly - Not even worth the view. Firstly the staff - I expect far more from a supposedly upmarket hotel, but they seemed disinterested, disingenuous and bored. Arrived too early for check in but wanted to find parking and leave our bags. The manager was greeting people and showing them to a receptionist for check in. The manager looked us up and down and decided we did not look important enough and assisted the guests next to us - ok trying to think the best it could be an honest mistake, we waiting again. Next a bunch of pilots walked in about 15 minutes after us and were immediately seen too and taken to a desk. Now I am pissed off - when no one but us were left waiting the manager then greeted us as if ‘oh I didn’t see you there..’. We tried to do the paper work as much as we could and asked for the wash rooms. We booked dinner for that evening and asked where we were dining and were told upstairs. Much later we were back to check in and people queued to be seen by a receptionist no manager in sight which was better so we were not discriminated against. They said they have no record of us booking dinner - so booked it again but this time the guy said we had booked down stairs. After taking our bags and checking in, the first glance the room was lovely, large and had a Superb view, we went back to explore the city. Coming back in we asked the manager to clarify where we are dining this evening and he showed us to the restaurant and again had no record of our reservation so we booked in for the 3rd time with a blond lady in a boob tube. (Very classy for a 4 star hotel, of course!) We came back just 2 hours later after changing and spoke to the SAME navel displaying women who said we did not have a reservation!! My husband tried to say we booked with you 2 hours ago and she dismissed him,Obviously getting frustrated we explained this is now the 4th time of trying to book dinner when she held her hands up and said ‘fine we will seat you but there definitely was no booking!’. So disappointed to be treated like this we quietly took our seats still trying to make the best of the situation. Menu was different - expected French food you know being in the capital of France and all but got a weird mix and mostly seafood. The bread was stale as could be and the courses mediocre at best. Ordered a cocktail and large beer from the bar and the first cocktail was delicious (the best part of the meal) the second cocktail came in a glass with a fresh crack and chip at the top - I pointed this out to the waiter and they apologised and poured my cocktail into another glass! Normally if was water or wine or something you could see through this would not have bothered me in The slightest - however being a thick pineapple based cocktail there was no way to see if the glass chip was in my drink or not. Seriously fed up with this hotel now we left went to a bar down the street. Came back to sleep and because of the not great experience in the restaurant decided to eat in the room at an additional cost but enjoying the best bit about the hotel - the view. Again breakfast was just ok - bread, croissants and pastries again not appearing to be the freshest. Why?! You are in Paris for fluffs sake! 
The view is fantastic, but not worth the faults with this hotel or the staff. The room would have been fantastic if it was cleaner - stains on the shower, the floor and the back splash behind the sink and door were really off putting! 
The Pullman paris was our first stop while travelling through France it was the most expensive, and by far the WORST hotel we stayed at during our travels.

The bathroom was very nice with a ceiling rain shower and full amenities, bathrobes and slippers. 

The location was perfect and you could walk to the Eiffel tower within five minutes. We used the hotel as our base of operations and took in many of the sights, sounds, and restaurants around the city. It's location was perfect for us, and one night after dinner we walked home from the Latin Quarter along the Seine. 

I travel quite a bit in Europe with my band and I have to admit this is probably the best breakfast buffet I've encountered, a large variety of really good food, and once again really helpful and attentive staff working in the breakfast room. Check out my photos. We did not get a chance to eat at the restaurant other than breakfast, but the food and menu looked delicious, and we did have drinks at the bar.

However the most important part of the hotel for me was the friendliness, welcoming and helpful staff. When we showed up to the hotel we were greeted by front desk staff Othmane and Hictor, they checked us in promptly and answered all our questions making us feel instantly a home. My French is not very good and it was nice that they spoke fluent English. We stayed for several days and had many questions and Jeff Board who had lived in California was very helpful throughout our visit. They were all so thoughtful and helpful that we felt like family. When checking out Alberto was very gracious, hoping we would return for a visit. For me this is what made our stay so rewarding, and we look forward to visiting again soon. Not only did we have a wonderful time visiting Paris in the spring, but I felt like I made friends here. To everyone that we encountered or helped us at the Pullman Paris Eiffel thank you for making our trip a fantastic success! Merci beaucoup!!! Vous êstes tous rock!

title: We'll be back for sure
text:
We'll be coming back for sure! We stayed here in March 2022 for 4 nights with a child and a teenager. Fabulous stay overall. Based on our experience, I have no hesitation in recommending this hotel if you are coming to Paris. We would definitely return here again with the kids. They really loved it too. 
Would highly recommend it for a number of reasons.....
1. Ease - effortless check-in and check-out.
2. Clean - Spotlessly clean in all communal areas and in the room. This is to be noted, as it's busy but was always really clean and tidy.
3. Good food - plenty for breakfast. Ate dinner one night, all enjoyed it.
4. Extras - Little added extras that the kids loved: a passport photo machine to take selfies (and you can stick up your photo on their hotel reception wall) and one morning there was a guy making free balloon creations for kids too! 
5. Quiet room - no noise. General area is quiet too.
6. This is probably one of the most important for me - the hotel room had a superbly comfortable mattress! I had a great sleep in a family room!
7. Every day - The daily room clean was one of the best I've ever seen......spotless every day (thank you!), with added extras like a personalised note on arrival, chocolates, daily bottles of water in the fridge.
8. Location - near loads of good restaurants, shops, pharmacies (max. 5 min walk). We walked from the hotel every day to the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe (approx. 30 minutes brisk walk to each but very straight forward). Hotel is in a very central location to everything.
10. Staff - really friendly and helpful staff...all that we encountered could speak English too which was a great help for us when making enquiries re: restaurant bookings, local attractions, etc. And a special thanks to the housekeeping staff for cleanliness/tidyness.
11. Space for a family in a family room! In- the ground floor and first floor have various "chill out" zones/areas.....so if you want a quiet coffee, to browse the internet or read a book there's loads of alternative spaces to sit too (not just hotel room). This is a bonus for a family with a teenager as sometimes a family room can seem small/crowded, but not in this hotel as there's loads of other different areas for all to use too when relaxing.

title: Wonderful family hotel, best stay in Paris ever!
text:
We chose this hotel for its accommodation for a family of four, with two young daughters of 12 and 14. The room given was spotlessly clean, with the sofa turned into two comfy single beds with nice pillows and matress.
Also for its location in Necker/Falguière residential neighbourhoods, where districts 6, 14 and 15 meets each other. Lots of restaurants/cafés/boulangeries/pattiseries/brasseries nearby. Also many small supermarkets, pharmacies and services (rent-a-car, etc).
The hotel is 7 mins walk from two Metro stations: Pasteur (Green 6 and 12 lines) and Gaîté (light blue line 13). It also has ebikes and electric scooters parkings in front of the main entrance and in many of the surrounding corners. They're a fantastic way of transport.
Last but not least, the hotel is just three blocks away from Gare Montparnasse, with connecting railways to almost anywhere, including the TER/N lines to Château De Versailles in 14 (!!) minutes non-stop.  
As for the service, it was brilliant in all the sense of the word. I had to receive a package coming from the UK that was already waiting for me in the room the night we checked-in. The staff at the front desk was immensely gentile and helpful all the time, addressing each one of our requirements with diligence and good mood/attitude.
Breakfast was fantastic. An abundant buffet in a large salon with an open cuisine attended by a chef providing special preparations like eggs and such. Plenty of pastries and bread varieties, gluten-free madeleines, two Melitta automatic coffee makers, bacon, fresh fruits salads, cheeses, jam, french marmalades, you name it...    
Beds and pillows were extremely comfortable, and noise isolation in the rooms was absolutely perfect.

We spent 11 nights in this hotel and we are absolutely grateful for the special care we received as a family group. Novotel Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse is a team effort. Each one of its members is a highly committed person trying to do its job the best way they can. Merci beaucoup Elise, Emmanuel, Alex and Alexandra, Chloe, Mairie and each one of you that made us feel like home in this wonderful place.
We're looking forward to visit you again!

text:
We recently stayed at the Novotel for our stay in Paris and visit to Disneyland Paris. 

The room was spacious enough but there was very little space to hang clothes. We could not hang 2 adult and 2 children’s winter coats. 

The hotel is fairly central to lots of cafes, bars, shops and bakery’s. 

The hotel is a good 20 - 30 min walk from several metros stops enabling you to travel around Paris fairly easily. It was tricky with cases and tired children. We are seasoned travelers too. 

You can see the Effiel Tower from the end of the street and from the 8th floor of the hotel.  It is also an easy 20 - 40 min walk to the tower from the hotel. 

If returning to Paris we would not choose it again as it was not close enough to the metro stations.

title: Nice hotel - Select room with Eiffel View
text:
We stayed at Novotel Paris Centre Gare Montparnese during our time in Paris. We had a good experience although check-in wasn't as smooth but the overall experience was pretty good. 

We had booked a classic room but had requested for a room with Eiffel tower view. Being an Accor Plus Member definitely pays off as we got the upgrade and a room with direct view of Eiffel. 

Regarding booking, we never realized booking in Paris is gonna be such a huge task since we read reviews that rooms are expensive, small, staff is rude etc etc. After few weeks of research, Novotel fitted our requirements perfectly. We booked directly from the Accor app and were also able to use the rewards points for payment which gave us 40 euro discount!

Check-in: While we got confirmation on Eiffel tower view room 4 days before our stay, we were told early check-in is only subject to availability which is fair. We reached the hotel at 11 am and we were room isn't ready and we'll get the desired room only at 2 pm. So we decided to best utilize the time by visiting Arc de Troimphe. We were back by 2 15 pm and lady at the front desk who had assured us that room would be ready by 2 pm told that there was a misunderstanding and room still isn't ready and we had to wait for 30 mins. Now this was really frustrating because you wouldn't want to waste time in Paris for check in especially when we had Eiffel tour booked at 4 30 pm. Nonetheless after speaking to the manager and explaining him the situation we did get the room by 3 pm. But check-in experience was really not one of the best experiences of our stays with Accor hotels!

Rooms - Considering the reviews on TA about rooms in Paris, this a sufficiently big room and we got room 815 which had lovely Eiffel views! Bed was also really comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed the stay. 

Breakfast was healthy and had decent vegan options. Considering we follow strict Jain diet, we got good options for the breakfast on both days!

Room service could definitely improve since we had asked for extra towels couple of times but we never got them.

Also during our first day of the stay, there was a protest right outside the hotel against Novotel. The noise of the protest was really troubling. Wonder what the issue was about. Thankfully we weren't staying longer on first day and weren't disturbed a lot. But it would definitely affect people staying on front side of the road. 

Accessibility of hotel is really convenient. We came from Gare Du Nord. Best option is to take Pasteur metro station for all the travel!

We definitely enjoyed the stay and would for sure consider it during our next stay in Paris!

We stayed in a Queen room travailing as a party of 4 (myself and 11 year old daughter and my friend and her son same age)
The reception is amongst a bar/bistro was very welcoming and given it was past 10pm we were still greeted with a friendly and helpful staff. 

Our room on the 7th floor was spacious, spotless clean and had some extras we wasn’t expecting in the form of the children having sweets and a Eiffel Tower keyring on there bed and the adults robe and slippers. The mini bar was free and stocked with branded drinks of water, cola and juices. Again a lovely touch. 

Location wise it was a 42 minute walk to the Eiffel  Tower on the maps app on our phone. Although a pleasant and straightforward walk if you have mobility issues like me once you do the walk n sightsee it’s hard. Taxi to it was 15 euro. 

We used the Metro from CDG airport it was very straightforward and took us to a stop that was 15 mins from the hotel again a very straight walk. 

We had breakfast on the second day for the 4 of us it was €36 euro and it was a buffet style. Having 2 fussy kids we were amazed the amount of choice and filled up everything was fresh and tasty and the kids were made up as a Magician was around doing tricks! There was a free photo booth to take holiday selfies and print them off there too. We had room service too one night of pizza and few drinks. Again we didn’t feel over charged and food was good, hot and fresh.

All the staff encountered were friendly and helpful we had a great 2 night stay. Would definitely recommend!

To use the metro from the airport it was 20+ euros and a taxi was 50 hope this helps!

title: Awesome convenient location with a great bartender
text:
We just finished a wonderful stay at Novotel Gare and stayed in room 819 this week at the hotel. It is a great location that was less than a 10 minute walk from the train station. Beautiful room that had a view of the Eiffel Tower which was especially awesome at night when it was lit up. Breakfast was superb with lots of choices. Many pastries including chocolate croissants, juices, fresh coffee and a hot food station for waffles crepes and you could also cook up your own fresh eggs to go along with the bacon, sausages and beans.

The service at the bar provided by Adele was awesome. We ended up sitting right at the bar and had such a great time chatting with her that we came back the next night as well. We normally skip the hotel bars but she was so awesome that we had to come back. She was humorous and provided just the right amount of banter.  It was also nice that she knew so much about our home in Canada. She is a beautiful person inside and outside who is an awesome addition to the hotel. 

She had lots of advise on what to do in both Paris and SW France. We took her advise and visited Cognac after we left Paris. So historical with great places to sit down for a drink on numerous terraces after we did a Cognac tour. 

All in all a great hotel with an awesome bartender that we will be sure to use on our next trip through Paris.

title: Family friendly hotel but annoying
text:
A very clean and modern hotel about a 10-min walk to Pasteur metro or Gare Montparnasse.  My family was given two mid-sized adjacent rooms but not connecting despite repeated requests before and during our 7-night stay.  Wi-fi worked great.  WC or toilet was in a separate room from the sink and shower.  Showers were weak, not particularly hot, and leaky (on the floor).  Sinks were super shallow without a soap dish.

Hotel caters to family as evidenced by the somewhat chaotic breakfast buffet.  Lots of variety with good selection of fruits.  A good start to our day.  Rooms were surprisingly quiet.  And clean -- we saw a carpet cleaning crew.  But be careful of their card keys -- they tend to erase when near metro cards or cell phones.

title: Were they being racist?
text:
A nice hotel and a nice room! that's about it

Had to wait nearly an hour after scheduled check-in time for my room to be allotted. We were asked to busy ourselves in the other rooms (we had 4 rooms totally for 3 nights!), when my room was allotted. I was expected to go down to the reception to collect my key!
What happened to courtesy of coming over to give the key or an apology for the inconvenience?

Found a piece of steel scrub in our scrambled egg! when we told the staff - "let me check" - comes back after 10 min - "sorry about that"

Would this be the response to any guest or is this type of response reserved for Indians?

Day of checkout, we leave luggage in the lobby to finish breakfast, Person at the reception shouts out rudely
Staff - I am not responsible if you lose your luggage
Me - I haven't placed it outside the hotel on the pedestrian path for someone to cart if off, its inside the hotel
Staff - I am not responsible
Me - Then what are you responsible for
Staff - My desk
Me - Ok. move the luggage to the restaurant

Btw, I did notice that other guests did leave their luggage at the very same place and other reception staff didn't have such statements to make to them (of course, those guests were not from India)

Is this how guests are treated at this hotel?

If the reception staff is responsible only for his/her desk
Who is responsible for the steel scrub in the scrambled egg?
Who would be responsible for the delayed room allocation?

title: Travelling with family
text:
This is a good and convenient, if slightly boring choice when travelling with children. The rooms, although on the small side, are not a bad size by Parisian standards. There is enough room to accommodate two extra children’s beds which the hotel will arrange for no extra cost.
Rooms are clean without much character.
A plentiful and good quality buffet breakfast costs €18 per adult but again, children eat for free. 

Travel tips - from Gare Montparnasse, follow signs to Gare Vaugirard. The Novotel is next door. There is a taxi rank round the back of the hotel serving Gare Vaugirard SNCF station. The most convenient metro stations are Pasteur and Gaité. Use these rather than Montparnasse Bienvenue which is further and much more complex.

title: Great place to stay not far from City centre
text:
We really liked the feel of this hotel. we were lucky enough to be upgraded to a superior room with a balcony  - we could even see the top of the Eiffel Tower.
Room was a good size with very comfy bed and a good double sized shower.Being a superior room there was even a complimentary mini bar with water, soft drinks and chocolates  The staff were very friendly and efficient, and everywhere in the hotel spotlessly clean. The bar area was OK but very expensive - escecially as the Euro was so strong against the pound when we visited Paris.
Its a few steps from the nearest Metro but we felt safe in the area - there are lots of bars and cafes close by.
We didn't have breakfast in the hotel but ate outside one of the cafes on a typical leafy Parisian street and watched the world go by - excellent.
A good place to stay - only a few stops on the Metro from the main city sights (watch out for pick-pockets on the Metro) and the area of Montparnasse is vibrant and buzzing - recommended.

title: Paris stop over
text:
5 nights in Paris, and the hotel and it's staff could not have be better, assisted with early check-in at the last moment, helped with faulty laptop just great service where and who to see. While I stay at the Sofitel hotels all the time this proved why.
a bientôt
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Wonderful hotel
text: We stopped at this hotel for the first time and was delighted by the experience. The room was nice and comfortable the staff were friendly and we were made to feel very welcome. Thank you for an excellent time
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Not a 5 star - bad value for the money
text: Very disappointing experience. The room was very dingy with a dirty carpet, mold or something that looks like it on the bathroom ceiling, our shower didn’t have a door, cracks on the toilet seat, very poor air conditioning, and our room was extremely tiny. The nice rooms must only be if you’re paying for the more expensive rooms. I also asked for a freezer to be accommodated as I pump breast milk for my baby and I was told that they cannot accommodate me. The receptionist that helped me and told me that I cannot be accommodated was also very rude - upon check in, she told me that they can’t check me in early as my room isn’t ready. The receptionist next to her must not have heard as this receptionist checked my friend in, and said she was working on getting me my room key to check in. The receptionist helping me looked at her and was shaking her head “no” but I suppose realized that she had to check me in since my friend was checked in and our rooms were clearly ready. That made me feel like a very unvalued guest. Also, our electricity went out. I would highly recommend looking elsewhere for a luxurious stay in Paris, especially if you’re spending this kind of money.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Excellent stay - Amazing team
text:
A perfect hotel experience. Extremely professional and experienced in hospitality. This is a five star establishment but feeling as a parisian palace. We stayed in their largest suite and it was excellent and spacious and well furnished with a beautiful view. 
The front desk staff are very helpful and friendly.
The bar downstairs makes great cocktails. The breakfast is delicious and always served with a smile. 
The location is between best of both sides of the city, 5 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower in one direction and 10 minutes walking in the opposite direction gets you to the arc de Triomphe and Champs-Elysees. We would like to thank all the staff at the hotel for making our visit to Paris one not to forget we will definitely visit again and stay at Sofitel Baltimore. 

Thank you.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Look and book elsewhere
text:
Never a 5* hotel (a 4* are a push), even compared to poor standards in Paris.
Booked a Junior Suite - our 1st room was dark and look onto a generator. The only other option available (although hotel was not busy) had more natural light but was small (and I doubt the same category). In fact the room had an odd layout with little storage.
Shower (rain) head was leaking water.
The bed linen did NOT smell fresh at all -neither did the towels.
Service at bar and front terrace was poor - there appeared no one in charge.
Front desk didn't even bother asking how our stay was at check out --- I wonder why ??
We have stayed in may 5* hotels all over the world, and also many Sofitel hotels,
I no longer have any brand loyalty to Sofitel after this experience.
Don't forget - we are taking about a 600 EUR room rate .. I would expect a lot more that what we had here.
The ONLY good thing about this hotel - the breakfast staff - could teach front of house a lesson or two. (Also saved a 2 star rating.)
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Fantastic hotel, absolute 5****
text: My boyfriend booked this hotel for us as a surprise trip for my 30th birthday & honestly it is the most beautiful and amazing hotel! One thing we are super fussy about is a comfortable bed & this bed was soooo comfortable we did not want to get up each morning! From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, the customer service was incredible. We were given VIP treatment and every member of staff we encountered across our weekend were amazing! My boyfriend booked a birthday package with the hotel which was again an incredible surprise! Arriving to the room with balloons in and a cake was so beautiful! We had a mini fridge and a coffee machine which the coffees were so nice! I would definitely recommend and stay here again! Thank you to the wonderful hotel staff for providing such a wonderful service and helping to make our stay so perfect!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Good hotel; Great location; Be your own conceirge.
text:
Great location relative to the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triumph. Easy walks to cafes and other cool neighborhoods. Breakfast is wonderful and the staff in the restaurant is super!

If you want to avoid the big crowds of big box hotels this is a good place.

The one negative of this Sofitel is the conceirge services. Way below average for a hotel of this caliber in its own hometown. We asked for local eating recommendations- we got touristy places. We asked for seafood- they made reservations at a place with no seafood. At one point everyone was pitching in as “conceirge” with Google searches which is just unacceptable. One evening we had no idea if we had reservations or not. As locals, the guidance should have been better regardless. 

Overall, good place to stay but very low points on the helpful meter.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Good location but not 5 star
text:
Disappointing. We stayed in a Superior Queen double room and this was our superior view.  It’s not all pelargoniums and balconies. We asked to move and we could have for an extra 50 euros per night. Decided not to as it’s not all about the room view. We didn’t feel the reception staff were that interested in supporting our request. 
It’s in a good location for the Eiffel Tower and Arc De Triomphe and Champs - Elysees if that’s what you want but that’s about it. 
Would not book again.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: What a Gem
text:
Stayed here last weekend, it was a surprise gift from my daughter.  From the moment my daughter and I arrived, we were treated like VIP"s.  We were met by the Conceige,  his smile made the start of my time here, he took our cases, and we proceeded to check in. The staff on duty were so welcoming, they were professional, courteous and nothing was to much trouble..
We were booked into the deluxe suite,  it didn't disappoint,  just WOW, slippers, robes, even little gym hand weights, little pots of sweets, nuts, beautiful coffee machine with pods, mini fridge which was well equipped, the bottled water was free, the wine and champagne was to be paid for if consumed. We had a view of the Eiffel  Tower from our balcony( see pics below). I have never seen a bed like it, it was HUGE,  and I can honestly  say I had the best nights sleep EVER, even my daughter was shocked that I slept so soundly.
A beautiful restaurant but sadly we were told it didn't open on a Saturday and Sunday so we could frequent there,  however they had a very good menu, and the food could be served outside or in their reception area,, which was filled with the most comfiest sofas and chairs.  There was also a bar, which served a wonderful selection of wine, spirits and champagnes and a few cocktails. 
We had room service once in the evening , it was quite late about 11.30pm , the food was amazing, we chose a light snack which was croque Monsieur with a side portion of fries, perfect!!.
The following morning I rang down for room service, and the breakfast was exquisite (see pics below) breads, pastries , omelettes ,coffee, fresh fruit and a wonderful selection of Jams.
Sadly due to a family emergency back home we had to leave this beautiful hotel a day early. 😢 but I can assure you , Jessica and I will be back..all your staff are a credit to you ❤️
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Fantastic!!!
text: We absolutely loved our stay. The hotel is only a short walk from the eiffel tower,  but far away enough to not be overcrowded with tourists.  Tons of cafes up and down the street.  The breakfast each morning was just incredible.  I didn't expect it to be so good but we made sure not to miss a day! The staff was so friendly and helpful.  Our room wasn't huge but we were totally fine for 2 adults for 8 nights.  We can't wait to go back!!!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Beautiful hotel.
text: The Sofitel Baltimore tour Eiffel is a fantastic hotel. We have just come back from a week stay in Paris at the hotel. All the staff are fantastic. The staff were superb from start to finish of our stay no one could do enough for us. Breakfast was fabulous huge selection of food many items cooked to order. Our room on the 6th floor was fabulous top of the range linen on the bed lovely pillows. The bathroom was very modern and clean. Every night we were offered chocolates tea or coffee before bed which was a wonderful addition. We ate at bar restaurant LE88B on two occasions the food was excellent as was the service. We cannot recommend this hotel enough. 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower in one direction and 10 minutes walking in the opposite direction gets you to the arc de Triomphe and Champs-Elysees. We would like to thank all the staff at the hotel for making our visit to Paris one not to forget we will definitely visit again and stay at the Sofitel. Thank you.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Lovely hotel, great location, amazing staff and service
text: I travelled to Paris for a week for a wedding and stayed at Sofitel.  Staff was amazing, included breakfast was incredible and everyone was very accommodating to any special requests I had.  I would definitely stay here again.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: My stay at the Paris-Baltimore Sofitel was quite enjoyable. The staff were very friendly and respectful, coming up to the room and offering drinks and also delivering things we asked for. The room was a nice Junior suite with a king size bed and a sleeper couch. The room was very clean and comfortable, the bathroom was also very nice, clean and modern. Overall the room was wonderful, the only downside was the bed was a little too firm. The hotel breakfast was delicious, firstly, you would have your choice of a hot drink and an egg or an omelette. There was also a very nice buffet with croissants, fruit, drinks, yogurt and more. Located in the 16th arrondissement of Central Paris. I liked how the Eiffel Tower was just across the river from the hotel. I would definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Emergency management needs to be improved
text:
Overall it is a nice hotel in the 16th. We booked a junior suite which by Paris standard is of good size, comfortable bedding, and high-end bathroom amenities (Balmain). When we checked in, the front desk staff were friendly and helpful. 

However, the emergency management of the hotel needs to be further improved and enhanced. On the 3rd day of our stay, there was no water in the hotel from 10am to 3pm as in absolutely no water in anywhere in the hotel. And there was only a small notice put on by the hotel next to the elevator...there's no letter to the room, no notice from the front desk. Just a small notice pasted next to the elevator door which we only saw it later. 
 
We got up late and obviously there was no water and we couldn't wash our faces, brush teeth or take showers. The hotel didn't offer any solution, not even a bottle water ...this is a 5-star hotel not some Airbnb or 2-star lodge and it charges EUR600+ each night. And normally they would know there's a pipe project coming and they could have told the guests beforehand at check-in or sth. Quite disappointed. Well, but at least they allowed us for late check-out. At least that.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: stole in my room
text:
If you visit the Sofitel Baltimore in Paris, France, be wary about being robbed.
My Louis Vuitton sunglasses were stolen by one of the Sofitel Baltimore hotel's employees in Paris France, which was a terrible circumstance. We left our hotel room around 8:00 p.m. on Sunday, July 12th, and I asked my husband if I should take the sunglasses with me, to which he said, "No, we're going to the Senna Gourmet dinner, and I don't believe you'll need them because we'll be back almost midnight." As a result, I put them back in the box and placed them in top of the mini fridge. We returned around 11:30 p.m. to find the box open and the sunglasses missing. We called the front desk and spoke with Nora, who informed me that there was nothing she could do now, but that she would leave a note for Manager Ema to assist me. After waiting until noon and not receiving a call, I called the front desk again and spoke with Sean, who informed me that Eva was aware of the situation but that she was in a meeting and that she would call me back, which she never did. When I arrived at the front desk, Ninon LAMBERT, the Guest Relation Manager, took my case and informed me that she had requested the video and the login document so that we could determine who would be allowed to enter my room during the three-period timeframe
We looked at two of the three films and watched a lady enter the room around 21:56 and spend 10 minutes there, then same lady return 10 minutes later and spend another 4 minutes there. The login schedule shows that another staff entered the room for one minute “to leave clean towels”. I inquire as to why three personnel had entered the room, and she responds that it was standard procedure to clean the room. Naturally, I did not believe her and noticed that she was concealing the employee.
After three sessions, she concluded that the hotel could not be held liable for the theft.
What pisses me off the most is that they don't care about their clients, no matter how irritated they may be; they only care about their staff, whom they claim to trust more than me.
So, anyone planning on staying at the Sofitel Baltimore in Paris should be warned that there are thieves in the interior of the hotel and that the management will not care if something occurs.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Beautiful hotel.
text: Without question this is a great hotel, a beautiful restored old French building with modern styling and comfort in an enviable location. Our deluxe suite on the 5th floor was amazing. Classic French styling, lovely tones and the view from the balcony of the Eiffel Tower unforgettable . Here comes the “But” Like so many other hotels I’ve been in since the pandemic ended the service can be very questionable. It is no where near the level it should be especially considering it is a five star hotel with five star prices!! I was sent a pre arrival welcome  email with various packages I could add on. I chose a souvenir package consisting of a Chocolate treat and two embroidered pillow cases with our names on them. I thought this would be a lovely touch for our anniversary . However they weren’t ready when we checked in and only appeared on the evening of our second day. The old pillow cases were removed and just left in a ball on the floor. Having returned from a night out we asked for some soft drinks to bring to the room, we were told this was not possible and we could only get water!!!! I questioned this with reception on check out to be told he was new and didn’t understand our request!!!! Again I have to say 5 stars!!!! Not really. I asked for some bath foam/salts to have a bath, this is an amenity I have found in other Sofitels readily available in the bathroom, this request was ignored. Hotels can not just hide behind there physical product anymore they have to match the customer service and experience that’s expected  in order to win us back.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

text:
My husband and I visited Paris from Bermuda in April and we had a fabulous time. Our stay at the Sofitel Baltimore was wonderful- the staff was friendly and helpful, our suite comfortable and well appointed, and the hotels proximity to the metro ( just across the street- Boissière metro) made it a very convenient place to stay. 
After our long days out touring we were pleased to have comfortable accommodations . The hotel was cozy, yet sophisticated, and perfect for a our weeks stay in Paris. We enjoyed its location to some iconic sights too. On Kléber Avenue and surrounding area there were plenty of options for dining too. We also enjoyed a few breakfasts from the hotel room service. 
We hope to visit again one day!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: More 4* than 5
text: We had this trip booked for 2020 but due to Covid had to cancel and rebook 3 times and finally got to go April 2022. We had lots of email communication and were promised a free upgrade if we re-booked. As we initially booked direct but this time through BA (so we had protection if needed to cancel given the way the world is now) we were told they couldn’t honour this but would try their best. My husband had also communicated this was a special 30th birthday trip that seems I had waited 2 years he wanted to make sure was even more special. They arranged flowers that he paid for which were lovely but there were no other tokens or even a happy birthday from staff (we travelled on my birthday still even if not technically my 30th). I know you can’t expect this but given others reviews and pictures we had seen with token gifts sent to the room etc for birthdays/special occasions this was dissapointing. As for the room we received no upgrade and the room was 1st floor close to the road, I do feel that the promise should have been honoured as we re-booked this hotel based on this and there were no stipulations when promised. The room was nice but on the smaller side, beds very comfty but would say more 4 star than 5 star rooms based on other 5 stars we have stayed in. All the staff were very friendly and helpful during the stay and breakfast was great. Location was also really good. Overall as a standard stay it was great and to re-iterate all staff were also great, it just lacked the special touch and we felt dissapointed with them going back on the ugrade promise.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great location, service and view of the Eiffel tower
text: The location of this hotel is great.  Within walking distance to Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower.  There is a taxi stand and the metro station a block away.  We stayed in the Deluxe Junior suite that had a nice balcony with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  Great service from everyone, especially the concierge who helped us arrange for the nurse to come to the hotel for our required covid tests to get home.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Superb location, great rooms, fabulous food at the bar and restaurant. This hotel has it all.
text:
This hotel was superb. Thanks to you and all the staff. We know we were very noisy with the kids, sorry about that. But you guys made us feel like part of your family. The staff in the restaurant, at the bar, at the lobby, the concierge, everyone was kind and caring with all of us.

The hotel is perfect, well located and has the unique amenities a Parisian Hotel has to have. Congrats
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Comfortable, connecting family room
text:
This hotel is nicely situated between (and walking distance from) the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe. The breakfast is excellent, but we didn't try the restaurant at lunch or dinner. 

The rooms were connected. Quite small, no view of anything, but very comfortable. 

The staff at reception and breakfast were friendly, and good with the children. Nice bar for pre dinner drinks but right in the lobby so lots of coming and going.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Not a Sofitel experience
text:
The superior room I was placed in, if not the worst, one of the worst possible: next to the service elevator and with a horrible view of the "courtyard". The hotel with hundreds of rooms could not get a decent room for a Platinum member.

The fruits I received as a welcome gift were definitely not fresh. In the bathroom, the shower was defective.

My room was not cleaned on Saturday. I left at 8:30 am and returned at 3:00 pm. After that I put up the Do Not Disturb sign and even so a lady entered the room for no reason. Another embarrassing situation as I was undressed and warned not to be disturbed.

Location is good. Rooms are very small. No view at all. Staff OK.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Wow! What a Stay
text: This hotel is wonderful. I had to extend my original 10-night Paris trip for one night and stayed at the Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel on the last night. It was--in one word--incredible. I selfishly wish this place can remain a hidden gem, so that it's always available when I want to visit Paris.   The hotel is on a lovely street, just minutes from the Eiffel Tower, with a metro station (No. 6) literally across the street. The Hotel is incredibly well-appointed, with a cozy masculine decor, especially in the hallways and landings of the guest floors, which are clad from ceiling to floor in shades of grey and dark brown punctuated with stylish furniture. The guest rooms are equally well decorated, well at least ours was. The room wasn't ready when we arrived, so my travel companion and I enjoyed a fantastic lunch and cocktails in the lobby lounge. It was so good we decided to have dinner there that evening after an afternoon of exploring the neighbourhood. Moreover, the staff was amazing. From the front desk staff who checked us in, to the lobby lounge staff, to the gentleman who checked us out the next morning and helped us with the luggage, the service was impeccable and professional. This place is, hopefully, my new "go to" in Paris. I really wish I had stayed here for the earlier 9 nights.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: View from Suite
text: I was disappointed. The room had the worst view in the hotel. The service was not 5-Star. Turn-down service was late or non-existent most nights. They did not refill soap or coffee unless I called down. The desk char was uncomfortable.  The concierge was not very accommodating. I would not recommend to travelers on a multi-day holiday.  It's not at the level of care I've come to expect at Sofitel
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Four star hotel marked as a five star hotel
text: I booked through the Accor website and was disappointed to find that the room allocated to myself and my husband was an extremely pokey double bedroom with no space between the bed and the walls. I had to ask for another room and had to pay an upgrade of euro 140 per night. The new room was quite nice but we could not use the a/c because there was a musty smell. That being said the staff were very nice and the room clean. The hotel was also nicely furbished downstairs. However I could have had a choice of proper five star hotels in the same area for the price I ultimately paid.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Excellent hotel
text: We had an excellent experience at Sofitel.  The rooms were small and cosy, but really clean and comfortable.  The breakfast was superb.  And the service was exceptional.  Reception staff were incredible and we had a memorable stay here.  If looking for a location close to Eiffel tower / Trocadero, look no further!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Mediocre
text: Very mediocre experience considering the price, everything from the lobby, the tiny bar, only OK bedroom and miserable breakfast. Would have been acceptable for say sub $200 per night but it was twice that. I will definitely go elsewhere next trip.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Fantastic Staff!
text: During three nights we enjoyed our Junior Suite (510) with balcony on a quiet side-street of this perfectly located hotel (between the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower) and its delicious breakfast. The real big asset of this hotel though are the staff.! The staff (reception, breakfast room, bar, cleaning staff)  are all, without any exception, extremely friendly, helpful and efficient. The hotel management must have spent a lot of attention to selection and training of their staff. I'm sure it pays off. On our next trip to Paris we'll return to this lovely hotel.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Cosy, little and quite well located hotel in Paris
text: A great alternative to the big chain hotels, but yet with all the service and comfort one would expect from a five stars in Paris. Located in between the Arch and the Eiffel Tower, with a metro station just in front of it, the hotel could not be better placed.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Bad experince
text:
This hotel not like any sofitel in the worldwide, the services, rooms and staff was not as expected
I’m dimond member and I didn’t take any advantage on this stay.
As well as I will not go back to sofitel again
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Fabulous, magical, fantastic, gorgeous!
text:
What a magical stay in Sofitel Baltimore! I don't know what to start my review with... 
Location is superb! Hotel's design is fantastic! Our room was so beautiful and it had a real Parisian balcony with red flowers! The mattress and pillows were so comfortable, that we didn't want to wake up in the morning :). Delicious breakfast! The main jewel of this hotel is their staff -- so caring, so knowledgeable, so kind. 
I am a very spoiled traveler, so I can assure that this beautiful property will meet all your expectations.  
I miss this hotel already and dreaming about going back!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Simply the best!
text:
Thank you to all the lovely staff at the Sofitel Baltimore, we had a fabulous anniversary weekend in Paris.
There was an issue on arrival because the previous guests refused to leave the room we were to take but the staff worked tirelessly to arrange a solution that satisfied everyone involved.
The room was fabulous (I understand why the previous clients did not want to leave!)
Throughout our stay we were made to feel very special and all of the staff were friendly and professional. Difficult to fault. 

The hotel is in an excellent location, good restaurants close by, Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe easily walkable. Shopping on Champs Elysees also very close. 

We will be back. 
Thankful to Camille and Louise in particular..
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Best area to stay for peace and quiet
text:
If you prefer to stay in a quieter, residential area and travel to the more vibrant parts of town when you feel like a bit of buzz, This hotel will probably suit you well. You’ll still find great restaurants and good shopping areas, just not quite as busy as around Chatelet, Boulevard St Michel or the Champs Elysees.

The hotel is very clean, chic and the rooms are amazing (but Parisian small) with a small balcony. The breakfast was ok, but too pricey (32 euros). 

There is metro station close by and a place to find e-scooters.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Heartwarming staff
text: The Sofitel Paris Baltimore awaited us with well considered tipps for the city, caring staff with no exeptions and very cozy and spacious rooms. Also a special thank you to 'Emma' - she made our Birthday celebration/stay even more magnifique!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great service, great location... pricey
text: Great staff, great welcome, room is functional with nice bedding and clean, a little bit on the noisy side and air conditioning was weak. Very well located property.  A bit too expensive given for the amenities. Breakfast was expensive and weak
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: A perfect stay in Paris
text: We stayed at this hotel as Gold status Accor members staying in a junior suite which was upgraded at check in. We also received our welcome drink vouchers.  Due to Covid this hotel has enhanced cleaning in place and I have to say it was spotless. Plenty of hand sanitiser and protocols in common areas. Breakfast is continental only at the moment but still very good. We had room service one night and the bar menu has a limited but tasty range of food available. All staff members were excellent, we loved the amenities including Hermes toiletries. After months of lock down we were glad to be treated to a luxurious stay at this hotel.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: COVID is a disaster for your travel experience
text:
While I understand social distancing, plastic glass, ... I do not understand why I had the impression to pay 400€ for a Mercure type of experience. I am Diamond, Loyal to Accor, but this experience was terrible.
- no mini bar
- limited pilow (only one for a king size bed), limited towels 1
- I was upgraded to a nice suite last time. Today, I kept my tiny classic room with a shower while my profile shows I prefer bath

No personal treatment, no upgrade, no fancy.
You lost the pleasure of visiting Sofitel, you just get a bed. no fun, no fancy gifts or services.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Lovely hotel in great location
text:
We stayed here for 2 nights the weekend that France went in to lockdown for COVID-19 (unfortunately we had to leave a day early).
This is a lovely hotel situated between the Arc De Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower. It’s not too big and we were able to upgrade for no extra cost to a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower (probably because they weren’t very busy!). 
The staff were excellent despite the uncertain times and could not do enough for us.
We will be returning to Paris to visit all the places we couldn’t this time, and we will be staying here again.
I wish all the staff well during this difficult time.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great Location - Great Service
text: We booked a travel package and had multiple hotel options  but I chose this hotel based on the reviews. Luxurious bedding, windows open for fresh air, mini-bar, hotel restaurant and great walking location. Will stay again!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: I Would Stay Here Again!
text:
This hotel is centrally located between the Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysees. 5 min. walk to the tower and 10 min. to the shopping Mecca of Paris. 
The hotel is very clean and comfortable and staff is very friendly and attentive. Several local cafe’s and restaurants to choose from, all within walking distance. The package we had included breakfast which was a very nice spread of a typical European breakfast. Fruits, juices, cured meats and cheeses, breads, croissants and omelettes to order. The French pressed coffee is excellent as are their cappuccino’s. We would definitely batty here again.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Holiday
text: From arrival to departure, the best service from a very competent staff. Very good restaurant. Also the location on Paris is very good. The only little item is, that there was one less chair than usual and we needed a place to put pur suitcases’s.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: My favorite place to stay.
text: The beds are amazingly comfortable. The staff are very nice and helpful. I love that they leave me fresh fruit and free bottled water. Very close to the Eiffel Tower and metro. The breakfast offers a lot of variety.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Work trip
text: I absolutely loved this hotel. They were extremely accommodating and the rooms were really nice. The staff was great the rooms were clean and the food was really good. I highly recommend staying here. It’s a short 3 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and it was really nice to walk around the neighborhood I wish I had more time to explore but I will absolutely come again.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Sofitel Baltimore paris
text: I stayed at Sofitel with my family and children. Although the hotel is good. The service is terrible. The receptionist does not value Plaintinum members. The room service is terrible, they take 2 to 3 hours to delivery even after repeated calls. We had requested for airport Cab for early morning flight, in the morning they tell as cabs are not available. I had to book two different taxis with my small kids and luggage. The service for kind for rates they charge as five star hotel is terrible.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great Stay
text:
What's not good about the hotel:
- rooms are not well cleaned (especially room 509)
- hairdryer of room 509 was damaged, and not good for a Five Star Hotel of Accor Hotels
- plumber got in our room, without our consent to fix the sink in the bathroom
- after my request, as a compensation I asked for new room, and instead of giving me a better room, we got same class but in 2nd floor (room 209)
- noise on the second floor from the streets
- For that I requested late checkout (which was approved immediately)
- during our trip, we were victims of pocket-picking in Louvre Museum, so when we went back to the hotel we needed to use a pc and telephone , since we lost both of our phones. The computer station at underground didn't had a telephone next to it. So we had to go from the underground , to our room all the time. Up & down...
- breakfast was okay. Specifically when I asked if there is a possibility to have caramelised bananas on my pancakes, the waitress told me that this is not possible. When I told her, "is it possible to ask the chef, maybe he can do it?", she answered, that "no we don't do it". In 5 star hotel everything is possible, or at least, go ask the chef and then come back to me to tell me "you know this is not possible, or its possible but there will be a charge etc."

The good things about this hotel:
- very good location
- our room had a small surprise for my birthday (however, there was another small surprise on the ceiling of the room. 3 Spider Webs hanging there). 
- most of the staff helpful and polite
- rooms and hotel well decorated

If we ever come back to Paris, we will definitely choose Sofitel Baltimore but you need to improve the above mentioned negative points.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great Stay
text:
Stayed here with family (2x adults and 1x13yo). Booked Junior Suite. Well worth it. Very spacious room. 

Staff all very helpful from the movement we entered the hotel to the time we left. 

Bar well served with a fun and helpful barman (Alfredo). 

Amazing location with decent restaurants near the hotel.  Be prepared to walk however due to the strike. 

Overall, a great stay!
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Amazing experience
text:
Not sure what to say that have not been said. Exceptional venue and even more amazing level of service, incomparable to other places I have been in before. A friend of mine who adviced us this Sofitel told me "there are 5 stars and 5 STARS". I totally get what he means now. 

Context, I went to that Sofitel to spend a special evening with my partner and the staff went among and beyond to make our stay memorable and unique. It's for this level of service that the next time we travel, our first step will be to look at Sofitel offers.

An exceptional experience, top to bottom.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Concierge Maurice Jureidini  *****5 Star Exceptional Service***** Thank you!
text:
My partner and I stayed at the Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel hotel for the 2019 Bastille Day Celebrations.  We asked Concierge Maurice Jureidini, if there were any French fine dining restaurants from which we could watch the Bastille Day fireworks.

Being very last minute, Concierge Maurice quickly checked and advised that there was only one suitable restaurant that was still showing an availability.  He said to leave it with him and go about our sightseeing, and that he will have the reservation confirmation for us upon our return to the hotel that afternoon.  Upon our return to the hotel, Concierge Maurice had our reservation confirmation waiting for us.

During our dinner, the restaurant Manager advised us that Concierge Maurice from the Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel had personally visited him at the restaurant earlier in the day to secure our reservation, as his staff had failed to answer the telephone due to being so busy with preparations.  Concierge Maurice had walked to the restaurant during his own lunch-break, (45min round trip) to personally secure our dinner reservation at the restaurant!  

We were astonished.  We visited 30 continental cities over 80 nights.  Concierge Maurice’s service, professionalism and integrity was unparalleled anywhere in Europe.  His exceptional service made possible our truly unforgettable stay in Paris, the best it could possibly be, and the highlight of our monumental European trip.    

Thank you, Maurice.  

Scott Lambert
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Misleading Pictures and Delayed Check-in Time
text:
The image posted in travel booking platform, Agoda, provided a misleading image that the Deluxe Junior Suite room has a view to the Eiffel Tower. Upon checking-in at the hotel, the front desk told us that there is only 1/10 rooms that has the Eiffel Tower view, and my family consequently did not get the room with the Eiffel Tower view even though we booked the Deluxe Junior Suite room, which makes the picture misleading. 

Second of all, when checking-in to the hotel, we were informed that our room was not ready although we came at 3.10PM, and the room was only made ready after we waited for more than 30 minutes.

title: Week in Paris

title: Sadly a trip to Paris turned sour
text:
We have booked a Eifel tower view suite for a romantic weekend together and to visit some feiends. The choice in the hotel was due to the view and the lack of our normal hotel due to the Batimat Exibition (fair) were Eifel tower views were scarce, as were good rooms. We booked the Sofitel Baltimore hotel long in advance via the Accor portal. One day before our trip I checked that all is in order, since I wanted to surprise my wife with this suite. At the day of arrival I received an email if I would like to check in. Sadly, due to a tight work schedule I did not do it. Picking my wife after work, we drove to the train station to take the TGV to Paris. We were so excited, me disconnecting from work, my wife having a nice weekend just us two. In the train I received a phone call I could not take due to bad reception.
Arriving at the train station we took a taxi to the hotel. Arriving at the hotel, we went to the concierge desk to check in.

Monsieur, you do not have a reservation... Shocked, I asked what was wrong. The friendly but not competetent receptionist told me that they sold our suite an hour ago since we did not have a credit card disposed in their system. After explaining that my credit card is in the Accor system they were sorry but they can not access it. They tried calling (the train) and sent emails on the 12th October. Since the email wasn't via Accor portal it went directly into my spam. They did not have any rooms with view and asked us to go to another hotel for a day, then migrate back to them for the last two days. I did not understand why that happened and why they could not respond via the portal I booked with (their group portal) or call several days before, not 2h before arriving. Especially when all things were signaling green (booking confirmation, speedy check-in for silver/gold members...). Due to the Exibition, it took us 1h to find an expensive alternative in their hotel lobby, where they offered us still water and condolences. It took us 2,5h in total to get to the new hotel, missing our dinner reservation in our traditional restaurant. 50€ cab ride, 25€ reservation fee and a ruined day later, we arrived at the Lutetia Hotel, where we just ate some mini bar nuts and fell to bed. This situation hung over us like a dark cloud and kost us almost double the hotel costs we wanted to spend. A bad momory...
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Birthday treat

I surprside my wife for her birthday with a short visit to Paris, we stayed at the amazing Sofitel Paris Baltimore... from the moment you enter the hotel you're greated with a warm welcome. Location is perfect as it's a short stroll to the tower and easily accessble by public transport.

title: Amazing hotel !
text: I'd give  this hotel more than 5 stars if it were available!  The staff was so very friendly & helpful throughout our stay. They upgraded our room - complimentary - and had decorated the bed with intertwining swan towels & red rose petals upon our arrival ! They also gifted us with a delicious fruit assortment plate & a mini chocolate cake!  The rooms are small but beautifully furnished with plush white terry robes & slippers. Everything was spotless! The breakfast buffet was absolutely amazing with a huge variety of fresh fruit, juices, breads, pastry, & hot & cold items . In addition eggs, bacon, etc. are made fresh to order. Only minor problem was the bidet wasn't quite working ne day & when I called they offered to switch our room.  But it was not a big  issue for us - we wanted to stay in that lovely room !  I highly recommend !!

.

title: Anniversary Trip
text: Over a year ago my wife mentioned to me she would like to spend our 27th anniversary on June 27th in Paris.  Our stay at Sofitel Baltimore was outstanding.  Hotel as nice as you can get.  Staff amazing.  The morning breakfast superb. But what made this stay truly remarkable was our concierge Christopher.  I asked him for a location to buy some wine for our room, and he walked me three blocks to a wine shop as he shared with me his recommendations.  We were on our way to sit with the masses to watch Eiffel Tower sparkle at 11:00, and he showed us a private location on the river that was spectacular.  Finally, USA women’s soccer was playing France in the quarter finals and he pulled up two chairs for us in the front row.  Thank you for making our trip to Paris unforgettable.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Decent but not wow
text: The hotel Sofitel Baltimore was a perfectly decent hotel; it just didn’t wow us.  We couldn’t help but compare it to the Melia Vendome, where we first stayed in Paris.  True, the Sofitel Baltimore is just a 5 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower but the Melia Vendome was right next to the Louvre and the Tuileries gardens and was, for us, in a better-positioned neighborhood.  The Sofitel Baltimore, while still perfectly comfortable, was also less impressive, less grand. And the charm wasn’t there.  The décor was more modern, less Old World Paris.  The rooms (at least ours) was on the small size and we found it difficult to navigate without bumping in to furniture or each other.  Additionally, the hotel was stiflingly hot on the top floor (where our room was) with no apparent way to get any cooling or ventilation.  We heard a number of complaints about the heat from other guests on our floor as well.  In short, this hotel was perfectly acceptable; we just probably wouldn't choose to go back.  To us, it seemed like an upscale business hotel that catered to companies who needed to put up their employees for the night.  It was just meh.
name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel

title: Great hotel and even greater staff!
text:

The rooms were also great. Tons of USB plugs for all of our devices, and a surprisingly large bathroom, especially for a European hotel. I totally loved the place and will definitely return if ever back in Paris.

title: Earth 🌍 friendly economy lodging
text:
Most amenities in this hotel show commitment to better our planet.

There are no more plastic water bottles in the hotel, rather cold still water and sparkling water on tap in the lobby, where you can refill your container or grab a glass, for free.

Access to floors and rooms is with bamboo-made magnetic cards 💳, very stylish.

There are also 4 automatic coffee machines ☕️ where one can help oneself to cappuccinos, mochas, single and double espressos, americanos, etc.

Free breakfast included croissants 🥐 , chocolate croissants, cold meats, yogurt, fruits 🍎 , cheeses 🧀, cereal 🥣, eggs 🥚 you can boil at your own taste and more. From 6:30am to 8:00am is the best time to get it, after that, it gets busier until 10:00 am when it’s removed.

ROOM AMENITIES
There were eight European type-C 200V outlets across the room and 2 USB outlets by one side of the main bed.

When we arrived, the sofa beds 🛋 were already converted to beds and made; we thought of this as a very nice and smart gesture, considering that many hotels we’ve stayed at have sofa-beds with missing linens and we have to do the work.

The bathroom is a minimalist expression of a bathroom: Curtains or sliding door is missing from the shower so after showering 🚿 you’ll notice a bit of water that needs to be wiped off, just for your own safety. Toilet, shower and sink are all in the bathroom and there was no lock in the room we got.

Blame the jet-lag or not, the IKEA-type simple beds 🛏 were very comfy! It just would have been nice to have light sheets during one warm night, instead of just the thick covers.

There was no safe in the room and only one safe for the whole hotel, operated by the manager. Apparently they haven’t had an incident “ever” and we didn’t experience anything either, leaving valuables such as passports, electronics, home keys 🔑, etc.

AROUND THE HOTEL
Excellent location: 🚶🏻 Walking distance from about 20 different restaurants as well as the Port D’Italie Metro 🚇 and Bus 🚌 station, where you can easily and inexpensively find transport.Oh, and very close to Paris’ interior circuit Boulevard Périphérique Intérieur, in case of driving around.

Considering the €125 nightly rate for a room that can host 6 people that can be fed breakfast everyday, I’d say it’s a great deal.

title: Post COVID - Dirty room & unhygienic.
text:
Room 722 - upon check in there was a problem with the room rate and an unhelpful front of house manager who’s sole recommendation to resolve the issue was to tell me that she would refund the booking and I can  find an alternative hotel. Not very helpful when you’ve travelled from the UK and you’re standing in reception. But that’s another post. 
On arrival to the room it was dirty. Bed linen was stained, hairs present and black fluff all over it. The bathroom mirror was stained with previous toothpaste splashes. The toilet seat was stained and the bedside table was stained also with oil marks and handprints. Considering Ibis pledge extra sanitation post COVID this room wasn’t fit for purpose. 
Hotels are meant to take cleanliness seriously and clearly this hotel doesn’t check rooms before being allocated. 
Dirty rooms are unacceptable and a health hazard. 
Despite it only being 18:00 there wasn’t any management presence apart from the earlier representative that hardly instills one with confidence. 
I’ve been lucky to travel all over the world and I’ve never witnessed a room this dirty, let  alone post a pandemic. The ibis responsibility to health and hygiene is severely lacking.

title: A quiet stay
text:
Greatly located next to a lot of public transport stations (one minute to the bus station and two minutes to the metro and tram stations) but also next to some bistros and markets, IBIS Styles Meteor offered us a quiet stay for 4 nights in Paris.
Even though we arrived a few hours before check-in time, the young lady at the front desk was very open and took our backpacks and trollers back so we could go down to a bistro nearby to eat and to drink a cold beer.
At 14:00, the room was waiting for us clean and cool, only good for a short rest before taking the Trocadero and climbing the Eiffel Tower.
Breakfast is ok, except the option to boil your own eggs in a small dedicated kettle (at one point there was a queue to boil an egg ...).
The staff was exemplary, both at the reception, cleaners and at breakfast.
In the morning at 6 o'clock, upon departure, check-out was extremely easy (we left the card at the reception and the invoice then arrived by email).

title: New Hotel.  Close to Metro 7 and T3.  1/2 hour Metro ride to Louvre.  Comfy.  Friendly Staff.
text: It's a new hotel, sidewalk is still being worked on. Average room size for a big city.  Modern.  Small, but working desk and chair.  Open armoire functions well and I prefer it to a dresser. title: Not what we were hoping for...
text:
As someone else mentioned, this is the 2nd day we've had housekeeping come into our room unannounced.  Today I asked her to leave, but she doesn't speak english, so she huffed and puffed and rolled her eyes because we stayed in the room.  Then she came back 10 minutes later and just entered AGAIN without knocking.  Unacceptable.
The construction outside is so loud we cannot keep our window open.
The motion sensor in the stairwell doesn't come on right away and has once shut back off while we were still on the stairs.  That's downright dangerous.
As someone else mentioned, we had 2 bottles of water on the desk when we arrived but no refills since.
Breakfast here is pointless.  It's disorganized, poorly stocked, dirty, and it's just basics like cheese and lunchmeat, yogurt, bread, and apples and croissants.  The juice machine was empty this morning also.
Most staff doesn't speak English.  Definitely not as well as you'd expect in a tourist city at a hotel.
Nice things: it is very close to public transport.  Hot drinks (coffee, tea, hot chocolate) available around the clock in lobby.  Lobby has a bar with VERY LIMITED selection (don't try to get decent food here though). WiFi is good.

title: Regret booking this hotel
text:
1. When we entered the hotel we were not greeted in a friendly manner we were told to show our ID given our room cards and that's it. No friendly welcome.
2. The room is very basic, not much storage room for clothes. Could not even watch TV due to every channel being in French and no way of translating it to english.
3. We asked one of the girls at reception for help with ordering food. She tried to help us and got very frustrated and began to have a bad attitude towards us and we felt very uncomfortable.
4. On the hotel page it states that there are staff who speak English French Spanish and Arabic, no english speaking staff 1 or 2 staff members spoke slight english making it very hard to communicate. People will be coming to stay here from all over the world you cannot have a hotel with just french speakers.
5. The morning after arrival, we went to get breakfast as this was included in our room stay. The breakfast was atrocious. It consisted of cold ham cheese a few fruits 2 choices of cereal and croissants. We asked for eggs we got boiled eggs which looked black and grey in the middle. No warm food at all which was the worst part about our stay at this hotel
6. We came back from shopping and we decided we wanted a few drinks. No staff behind the bar, we asked the hotel staff and she told us the barman would be here in 30 mins. We waited and a couple of staff behind the bar turned up and then they all left. A hotel Male staff informed a lady at the reception that we were waiting for drinks and they exchanged words in french and we were still ignored. We went back to our room and called the reception. Spoke to a man spoke in French then a lady told us to come downstairs and a colleague would make the drinks and we could hear laughing in the background which is highly unprofessional. Why couldn't we be told this when we were waiting downstairs for over a hour. 
7. The air conditioning was not working and staff at reception could not speak English for us to ask how to do it.
8. The house keeping staff could not speak english either. We asked for our room to be cleaned. We arrived back and the bed sheets or pillow cases had not been changed and the bed had just been spread, our cocktail glasses were still on the side, the rubbish in the bins and by the bins were still there. No cleaning done until the second day.

This hotel was a disappointment in nearly all areas. Staff do not care about guests and ate not very helpful at all. The only positive aspect of this hotel is that the bed is comfortable and there is free wifi throughout the hotel. Would not recommend this hotel as it is very basic and not a friendly atmosphere.

title: Great Value for easy access to Paris and free breakfast
text:
First close to bus and metro stations, many restaurants and stores, all are within short distance of walking. A lot of choices to decide.

Third the place was new and just opened with small quiet comfortable room and wifi
Fourth was the free great breakfast with plenty of choices (observed majority of french people staying there).
I will stay there in future. Recommend! Great value for close to Paris with easy access.

title: New hotel on the edge of Paris
text:
Pros:
- Brand-new hotel with large, modern rooms and stylish common areas
- Friendly and helpful staff
- Very affordable if booked early + free breakfast
- Just 4 minutes away from metro line 7

Cons:
- Located in a desolate neighborhood that is still under construction and utterly devoid of charm
- No cafes, restaurants or shops in the immediate vicinity
- Requires at least 30-minute metro ride into center of Paris (hotel is located on the fringes of the city)

If you’re looking to immerse yourself in the charm of Parisian life, this is not the place to be. However, if modern and very comfortable accommodations at a great price is your priority (and you don’t mind being further away from the heart of Paris), you will enjoy this modern hotel that is part of a reliable and recognized chain.

title: Lovely modern hotel - perfect for our trip
text:
This hotel had only been open a couple of months when we visited so everything was brand new. The rooms were clean and of a good size for a place to crash after a day of sightseeing in Paris. 

It’s towards the end of the metro line but that means it’s nice and quiet in the area and the metro station is a very short distance away from the hotel. 

The breakfast is included in the price and was a good basic selection of continental breakfast items. There is also free coffee and tea at the entrance to the hotel for guests to take away with them. 

I would return to this hotel again.

title: It was an okay stay.
text:
It was an okay stay.

The location is good, you *can* walk to nearly all the major attractions  (I should know, they were on a transport strike when I was there!), but I chose this location due to the proximity to a Metro station (two lines), which I unfortunately didn't get to use.

The Pigalle neighborhood was, uhm, unexpected (for a lack of a better word). There is a store around the corner and a lot of kebab places. Like I said, the location is good.

We stayed there with an infant (7 months old) which was our mistake, there is no kitchen available and I don't think they generally assume small babies will stay here. At least, they offered nothing to assist or make the stay more pleasurable for them.

The service varied greatly between staff. Some were great, others the exact opposite.

Would I recommend staying here? Sure; it's not expensive and the location is good, but I will not stay there again.

title: Nice hotel. Noisy area
text: Nice hotel Close to metro but also  if you like walking everything is less than an hour away   . Room was a good size clean and comfy. The bathroom was OK  a bit cramped if 2 of you were in there but still large enough. The shower was good nice and hot. Friendly staff. Just a couple of negatives. Information says kettle on request. I asked for one but was told I could only have hot water which I wasn't going to do being on the 3rd floor and you had to buy pods for coffee machine. The biggest thing wrong tho not the fault of the hotel as it is the area it is in. It is situated by bars and clubs so was VERY noisy in the early hours with drunken people coming out and music blaring I did not get a lot of sleep the 5 days we stayed so take ear plugs if like me you are a light sleeper. title: Central and Convenient
text:
We arrived at L’hôtel Opera Frochot on a Saturday afternoon, after a 15mins walk from La Gare Du Nord. The location is ideal if you want to visit Montmartre. We were completely drenched, because it had been raining. The lady at reception was really lovely and helpful.

She helped us check in, gave us our key cards and a map of the restaurants and attractions nearby.

There are various shops, brasseries, pubs, clubs and restaurants within walking distance of the hotel.

As for the rooms, they are much bigger and spacious than many boutique hotels where I’ve stayed in Paris in the past. The room has all the basic facilities, except from a kettle and a mini fridge. However, there is a coffee machine, but you have to buy the coffee pods from reception. 

The staff are very helpful and pleasant. Most of them speak very good English, so ideal if you don’t speak any french.

The breakfast was a bit basic, but had all the essentials.

In short, we had a very good stay and it was in a very central location, which made it very easy for us to walk almost everywhere.
