text: The hotel is in great location - with easy access to metro and bus. There are nice bars and restaurants in the area. The rooms are very well designed - they’re small, but efficient. It’s super clean and cosy. We totally enjoyed each time we returned to the room after a day in the city.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Nice Stay
text:
Cute boutique hotel. Conveniently located (across from the famous Follies Begere!). Decent room size (by European standards). Great shower and water pressure, cute chic lobby, decent complimentary breakfast offerings included in room price. Walking distance to Paris Opera House, Galleries Lafayette, Parfum Museum (all approx 10-15 mins). 

Would stay again at Maxim Follies for sure.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Enjoyable stay
text:
We really loved our stay at Maxim Folies.
Cleanliness, courtesy and a very good breakfast.
A special mention to Fad at the reception: he is so kind and professional. He made us feel welcome in a very professional way.
If I had to mention a suggestion it would be to consider having an English speaking person during breakfast time. It happened to us a few times that the person who asked for room number could only speak French.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: A very pleasant and comfort hotel, perfect for a getaway!
text:
We enjoyed everything about this Hotel. Maxim Folies is located perfectly within 20 minutes walking to the opera or Galleries Lafayette. Two metrostations within 8 min walk. All the facilities are top in the hotel. It is very clean and the Hotel employess are very helpful and nice! We got engaged the second day we got in Paris, so we told the reception. A minute later we got a surprise at our hotelroom with a personal note, which made it an extra for us. 

The breakfast is good and you can sit in a room with very nice interior. We enjoyed our stay there and will definetly be back when we will return to paris. Plus points are the location, the staff and the comfort.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Great for short Eurostar visits
text:
We stayed at Hotel Maxim Folies for one night - timed with the Eurostar for two full days in Paris. 

The hotel is perfectly located for those arriving into Gare de Nord - a 15 minute walk away. Check-in was very friendly and efficient with the wonderful Jill who made us feel incredibly welcome despite our short stay. Our luggage was stored before check-in at 3pm and after check-out on our last day - meaning most of our time in the city was without baggage. 

We booked a Superior Room which, while very small, had everything a couple would need for one or two nights away. The bathroom was incredibly well appointed and the bed was very comfortable. 

The room had total blackout curtains and looked out onto a communal courtyard. We didn’t eat breakfast at the hotel - though this was offered for €15pp, there were cheaper and more attractive options within a minute’s walk. 

Overall, we’ll definitely be back at Hotel Maxim Folies.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: A lovely hotel, tucked away of La Fayette. Friendly, helpful staff, excellent breakfast
text:
The location is very good, just off the Rue Lafayette from Gare du Nord (Eurostar terminal) Fairly quiet, nice staff, really good breakfast with quality meats etc.
The room was spotless, it is a little small, but you expect that in the centre of a large city. Kettle available, TV, heating and air con. Comfy bed, good bedding, good shower. Would definitely go back.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: What an absolute gem
text:
We booked here as we like the Opera area as a base for going to the 6 nations games. It was our first time in Maxim Foiles and it did not disappoint. We booked the suites and while small they were perfect for the weekend. They gave us extra space and didn’t feel on top of each other.
The hotel is spotlessly clean, lovely L’occetaine toiletries, staff are so friendly and helpful (special mention to Jill who was so helpful with our booking). Breakfast was lovely, just right to start the day. 
We walked everywhere as it’s a good location, we did the TootToot bus tour as a quick way to see the main sights. 
Highly recommend Maxim Foiles will stay here again if we return to Paris
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Boutique perfection
text: Situated among many independent small restaurants and bars, it is a lovely place to come back to after visiting the sights.  A boutique hotel, with stylish decor, super clean, with staff who were so keen to help with anything required, and were friendly and professional in just the right measure.  The 2 adjacent rooms suited our family perfectly.  We hope to go back again, our 1 night stay just wasn’t long enough!
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Good Hotel
text: Good hotel, in relation to the price quality. At the reception are all attentive and friendly, all well organized. Shampo and L'occitane shower gel which I liked very much, by default hotels have cheap products. In the room there was nespresso coffee machine, fantastic. The clothes in the room were changed every day. The only problem I found was the amount of dust in the air. It really burned my eyes to the point where they went red. It's the only weakness. So the experience was very good and I'll be back.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: CLEAN, CUTE, MODERN
text: I went to Paris for a quick three day city break. I stayed at this hotel and the staff were lovely. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was very aesthetically pleasing. The room had a balcony and it perfected the Parisian experience. Highly recommend for a lovely, affordable yet rich experience.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Stylish stay
text: We arrived early evening for a 3 night stay. Check in was quick, reception staff were friendly, helpful and efficient. There was a lift. Complimentary tea, coffee and soft drinks were available in the breakfast area at any time.  Our room was small but perfectly formed. It was spotlessly clean. There was a great shower and air conditioning. Decor is modern and a little quirky. Lots of places to eat nearby and the hotel is a short walk to Cadet metro stop.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Amazing
text:
Amazing.

Nice staff !

Amazing food!

Great ambiance!

WILL COME BACK !!!!!

Much better than other places we stayed on our trip! 

Location is phenomenal also!!

I don’t want to say more because if it gets too popular then it might lose its touch!!!
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Perfect
text:
I  stayed 2 nts with my wife.
Everything is perfect.(Location, Room; breakfast, Staff)
Price quality ratio %100.
I advise honestly to everybody who plan to visit Paris whrther for leisure or Busines.
Thanks for everything
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Perfect location and great sleep
text: We took a suite here recently for 3 of us (ladies) for a night in Paris.  Felt entirely safe with the location and the room.  Totally clean, cool decor, nice shower, good toiletries, good breakfast, and lovely service.  The food out couch was a bit on the hard side, but after a few wines in Paris - who cares!  Easy walking distance to the Louvre etc, and a great area to explore.  Plenty of supermarkets, bars  and restaurants nearby.  15 minute easy walk from the Gare du Nord - really great location.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Excellent service and central location
text: Pleasant and friendly staff. Central location with many restaurants and shops nearby. Near metro and within walking distance to the lourve and galleri la fayette. Would stay here Again. Many thanks to the front desk who were so friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Good for value
text: We stayed at maxim folies for 2nights. Friendly staff, clean rooms but a bit dark and a bit noisy probably because our room is at first floor. A lot of restaurants nearby and you can just walk to shopping areas. Taxi is very accessible too. A great experience at this hotel wiah we could stay longer.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: The Perfect Parisian Base
text:
Hotel Maxim Folies is perfectly positioned in the vibrant 9th arrondissement. We selected this hotel for its central location including three metro lines all within a short walking distance from the hotel that allowed quick access to sightseeing hotspots. The hotel was also positioned among an excellent range of dining options, ‘happy hour’ bars, supermarkets plus there was a laundromat conveniently across the road. 

All staff we interacted with during our stay were wonderfully friendly, helpful and spoke English to assist with check-in/out, general directions and questions. Merci! 

The hotel and rooms have been renovated with a stylish yet vibrant vibe. Our room was compact but comfortable with a comfy bed, hot shower, storage space including a safe and heating/cooling - everything you need from a hotel room. The complimentary L’Occitane products were a nice touch.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Hotel boutique with home's touch
text: Just renovated but not defigured. Personnel well prepared and very kind. Good wi-fi connection, cleanliness, mattress, and decoration. A great touch: a Nespresso machine in the room and another in the reception - free capsules. Even with the Euro so expensive, this hotel is a bargain. My first choice next time.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Well located boutique hotel
text:
This hotel is conveniently located for those arriving at Gare du Nord.  You can walk to the hotel in approx 15 minutes.  Or there are 3 Metro stations all within 5 minutes of the hotel, taking you to most corners of Paris.

The hotel itself has been recently refurbished.  The room we had was small, but typical of a capital city hotel, we expected this and it was not a problem.  The furniture and fixing in the room were nice, the bed was comfy.  Of note was the exposed brass fittings in the bathroom.  To improve it would have been nice to have somewhere to dry the towels.

Though the hotel had been refurbished for some reason the lift was missed out.  It was shabby and the light and control panel were held together with tape.  This gave the wrong impression to the hotel.  This poor first impression as we went to our room for the first time detracts from an otherwise lovely and quirky decorated hotel that was clean and tidy.  

The breakfast was disappointing.  Cutlery and crockery were hard to find if you came down for a slightly later breakfast (0830), not the best selection of food, and the coffee machine did the worst coffee we had in Paris during this trip.  

That, being said, it deserves my 4 star rating for the good service on reception, the decor and the location, it could be 5 with a little more effort with the breakfast.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Magnifique!
text:
I just love this place. 
Great location, good breakfast, awesome staff. 
Cozy and super clean rooms. The wifi works just perfect. Definitely I will choose this 
hotel in a future. You are close of the main attractions and the closest metro station is just 3 blocks away.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Charming, Well Located Hotel
text: Lovely reception desk staff. Decent option for breakfast. Very well located in a great neighborhood. Lots of restaurants, bars, shops, cafes nearby. Rooms are pleasant, if smallish (but that's most of Paris for you).
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: OUTSTANDING in every way = 5*
text:
We have just returned from a 2 night stay at this hotel and WOW, what an amazing choice.

It is situated in a perfect location close to the metro. Upon arrival, the reception staff were so friendly and welcoming.

We were in room 602 and it was spotless. Yes they are small but so what! They are immaculately clean and the comfiest beds weve ever stayed in. Complementary shower gels and toiletries in the room too.

Theres a beautiful restaurant literally next door where we ate. Reasonable prices and fantastic service.

We paid €14 each for breakfast in the hotel and it was worth every penny. 

I cannot speak highly enough of this hotel. The staff go out of their way to make your stay comfortable. When we return to Paris we will definitely be staying here.

Thanks to everyone at Maxim Follies!
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Great Value
text:
Stayed for 2 night with my husband.

The hotel is in a fab location, near to several metro stations and surrounded by bars and restaurants.

The room was small but we only slept and got ready in it. We found the room clean and the beds very comfy with lovely pillows. The shower is amazing also. 

The staff were so friendly and even let us check in early. On our last day we were not leaving until the evening, they kept our luggage safe for the day while we went out. 

I would definitely recommend.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Good hotel,  great staff,  very centrally located
text:
We stayed at the Maxim Folies for 4 days...our stay was very pleasant and the staff were very helpful.  One of the best things for me was the less than 10 min walk to the Metro and the free coffee in the lobby. You can even take it to go. 

At first,  seeing the size of the room, with the sink out by the door, I was taken aback... but it has it's advantages.  One of us could use the sink while the other was using the bathroom.  So be prepared for that. 
The breakfast spread was a bit limited for us vegetarians, but what they lacked in variety they made up in quantity.  The croissants and muffins were yummy and we had our fill of them,  apart from fresh fruits and juices. In the evenings you can sit by the window and have some wine,  watching the world go by, which we did on a rainy evening. They have very limited service when it comes to food, but there are plenty of very good restaurants close by. 

It was value for money, with good service, centrally located.  I have to mention the very nice staff again.  They really made our stay in Paris very comfortable.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Modern hotel with helpful staff
text:
My sister and I stayed at this hotel for 2 nights. Firstly I must commend the staff that work here. They were very helpful and accommodating from booking all the way to check out. The hotel is located is a nice spot in Paris with a metro stop (cadet) less then 5 mins walk away. 
The room was lovely, loved the decor. It’s small but as it was a city break was all we needed. The bed was very comfortable. 
The only reason I didn’t give this hotel a 5 was because of the noise. Now when I say the noise it didn’t really bother us but may bother some people who are light sleepers. You can hear the floorboards in the hall creak, people next door taking close off the rail and chargers out of the wall. There was also building work opposite us which started at 8am. But as I mentioned before this didn’t really disrupt us too much and would definitely recommend the hotel.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: It was good
text:
We had a nice stay at Maxim Folies with the family. Everything is fine and it went smoothly. The rooms are good but be aware of most of Paris hotel has small rooms. This is nothing to blame the hotel for. Some of our wall sockets didn't work and this is something that can happen to everyone, but the negative side of this is the reception told we used fake chargers even we used the original ones. I investigated the issue and it was the hotel lamp that triggered the fuse to go off. We didn't bother discuss it further and enjoyed Paris. Next thing is you can hear the swing in the lobby in the first floor rooms.
However very nice and kind reception overall.
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Sweet Hotel at the best location of Paris
text: we stayed here with my brother for 2 days. The first thing i would like to say is the location (Grand Boulevard) is the best place to stay in Paris. Hotel is very close to the metro stations (both Cadet and G. Boulevard) and the city . Ladies at the reception were very very helpful and always polite. only negative issue i need to write  was the smell in the room. could not understand where was it coming from but did not worried about it a lot because we were only sleeping in the room. So it was ok..Do not hesitate to stay at this hotel!
name: Hotel Maxim Folies

title: Hotel location good house keeping service very low

With the big surprise when i came back to room late night they have not cleaned the room as routine so had to wait out side.  House keeping poor 
There location very good 
Bar very lively nice atmosphere specially weekend
Receiption good service 
Spa very good
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Terrible service and attitude from staff. Hotel needs new management and training asap
text: Rooms fine but Terrible attitude and service. I had a craving for sushi which I arranged through Deliveroo. Food was turned away as they claim in ever answered phone. Subsequently they admit my phone conveniently wasn’t working but they have now fixed. No apologies just appalling attitude from reception staff and doorman. I appreciate they want room service fees but to deliberately obstruct customer requests is remarkable and the attitude from the staff is off the charts poor. What a shame as rest of hotel is really quite nice
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great location, beautiful hotel
text:
An amazing hotel. This is our second visit there. We love the location and the hotel inside is just beautiful.  Staff are so friendly. The only downside is we had no fridge in our room which I think is a must in summer to keep cold water in.
With a hotel of this standard you would expect a mini bar or light snacks to be on the side with a espresso machine. 
This hotel though is a must for it’s location, just a short walk to the Arc de Triumph and restaurants. A great restaurant called Lino is a short walk
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 Star rating 2 Star Service
text:
5 star on looks 2 star service

This is possibly the worst 5 star hotel I have stayed in. The service at times was something from a comedy sketch  ranging from giving numerous people in our party the wrong room keys so that they walked into rooms already occupied. Moving people after a 2 night stay to other rooms. Providing the wrong coffee pods for coffee machines. No usable iron. Room service that provided the wrong orders & took hours to rectify issues. I could go on.  My recommendation find somewhere else to stay & if you do choose to stay here avoid the first floor above the bar where the noise level is high & you will not sleep before 3 am.  If you think this is a grumpy review please bear in mind these are just a few issues our large party faced. All were reported to staff. The response was zero interest & no attempts to rectify problems.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Avoid
text:
A milieu of strange and unpleasant odours haunt the entire hotel, like a stale, musty reminder of how unloved the premises is. 
Getting into ones room on arrival is problematic enough as their system seems to run on a largely raffle-based system whereby whether or not ‘your’ room is actually empty is an exciting part of the process.
The room itself was basic , made more so by the fact there was a kettle, but no tea bags, there was a coffee machine but the wrong type of pods, and the mini bar was empty (not even water). Oh, and none of the lamps worked.

Staff were generally disinterested in the problems as a sea of complaining guests seemed to be something they are accustomed to… 

Breakfast unremarkable but ok 

Location central but area is dull 

Avoid.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: What a mess!
text:
Room was not ready. Things happen, right? Except this is an ongoing thing, there were several other guests waiting for their room past 7 pm, I spoke to one who got his room at 11 pm! The scene of angry guests in the lobby repeated itself every day.

Our room was close enough to the restaurant / bar to hear noises until midnight, and next to the cleaning room so we we able to hear the conversations of the staff all day. 

The chatter may explain why our room wasn't cleaned once in 5 days. All the other guests I spoke to had the same issue.

To give you an idea of customer service, I had bough a "romantic package"we never got, t has been a month since I have asked for a refund, 1 call and 3 emails, still no reply.

Bear in mind this is supposed to be a 5 star hotel...
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Has the potential
text: The Hotel had a history of having a film made at the facility, the higher staff and concierge (Hugo and annalies) but the rest of the staff are not performing their tasks as you like. The refilling of coffee the cleaning process and the hygiene was not up to expectation. I stayed for around 8 days with the trash from the previous guest in place. The Restaurant for breakfast is not at a level of a 5-star hotel. No weighing scales are available upon request.  With food tries outside the rooms causing a smell and aesthetically not pleasing.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Nice enough aesthetics, overpriced, poor guest treatment
text:
Upon arrival, the hotel looks grand and the rooms are spacious with very comfortable beds. The spa facilities were nice considering they were included in our rate. We did not try breakfast or the bar (other than an extremely expensive bottle of water for which we never received our change). The hotel is nothing special compared to others of the same sort.

A deposit of 600EUR was taken when checking in, quite a large one for a four night stay.

Upon checking out, instead of giving me back my deposit as they said they were, when I looked at my account later, the hotel had actually taken further money from me, almost £1000, without telling me.

I gave it a couple of days to see whether this was the deposit working itself out, but nothing changed. After an email to the hotel owners, I was told the money had been taken mistakenly and that I'd get it all back later that week.

I did receive the two amounts back separately, but because of the time lapse, the exchange rate meant I was given back less than they had taken. Only by £3 or so, but the principle of stealing money from a guest and not giving it back in full pushed me to ask for that amount back so that I was not short changed from their theft of my money. They refused to give this to me. I doubt whether I ever would have received the whole £1500 I was due had I not asked.

Overall I would not stay again, due to the stress that the financial requirements and mistakes of the hotel caused me. The hotel as a place to stay was fine, the spa being the most unique thing about it that added value. Take or leave the rest of it.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Okay but needs work
text: We found the location good and the staff pleasant. The room however, was a disappointment and felt in need of modernisation. The hotel was in the process of having work carried out, so perhaps this is the plan. The breakfast room was excellent, with a huge choice of food on offer.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Rude personnel!
text:
I’m a travel agent, and I booked 4 rooms for my clients at Hotel du Collectionneur, and after flying for 11 hrs and finally arriving at their hotel, they were not given the rooms they booked. They tried to talk with the front desk lady but she said they were fully booked and couldn’t help them. I had to call my clients to talk to her, because the hotel wouldn’t pick the phone up!
Finally they were given more rooms as to accomodate all of them, and when they went our for dinner and came back, were recieved again by the same lady at the front desk and manager saying that the rooms couldn’t accomodate them, because they were too many. I had to call them again and explain the math to them!
I will never recommend this hotel to anyone anymore.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Terrible horrible no good very bad
text:
We arrived here as a family of 5.  We had paid for 2 rooms to be adjoining or close together.  Our rooms were placed on same floor several hallways apart at complete opposite ends of the floor.  We complained and asked to be put closer but hotel was at full capacity - they had not planned accordingly for us.  Many patrons were complaining, many long lines at check-in.  Decor in restaurant very outdated food not so good, old hard boiled eggs.  Rooms old and not well maintained, wet spots on carpet, minifrig completely missing.  Was told did not pay for breakfast when I did- hostess would not check rather engaged in argument- terribly embarrassing.  Hostess claimed my husband's room had breakfast included but not mine which was completely false.  How could that be. 
 Never apologized when manager came and told it was a mistake.  Room was not cleaned 3/4 times.  I complained was given champagne and chocolates- but they forgot to clean my husband's room at the same time when trying to rectify my complaints still couldn't keep up.  At nighttime the lobby was overcrowded with party guests/ wedding guests with garbage and food all throughout the hallways.  We paid thousands for just 3 nights and were not treated respectfully at all and did not receive what we requested which was a family vacation.  If I would have wanted just beds to sleep in I would have stayed at a hostile.  Paris is beautiful and I hope to return again.  Location of hotel is quiet- no open restaurants on Sundays close by.  Please stay away from this hotel many other options in Paris.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: That this has any star is misleading.
text: AC in July would not get below 75F (23.8C).  Service guy came to the room to argue how it was fine. Minifridge does not work.  Have been in better quality Parisian hotels for less money.  Not a great location if for family trip.  Near the Arc de Triomphe, but not much else.  No great French cafe experience in this neighborhood.  Rather sterile.   This "luxury" hotel has great views to the ugly 70s rusting office building across the courtyard.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Hotel du Collectionneur - First Day / Bad Experience
text: I arrived this morning at the hotel with our kids and although we had booked a room full of amenities (including room upgrade/early check in/late check out, if there is availability) we were only allowed into our rooms after 5PM - while guaranteed check-in as per hotel policy is 3PM. We also repeatedly called the front desk to make a few requests that were never  answered. Very disappointing experience thus far. We still have 5 more days to go - I will continue the review as we go.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great location and service
text: Highly recommend this hotels for families😍 it is very close to arc de triumph and rooms has shatafas( if u know u know)  and has a very nice courtyard👍🏻 The concierge was perfect and very helpful ❤️ We loved our stay
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Service levels have gone down
text: Visited the hotel after two years of pandemic . Found that the service standards of the hotel right from room cleaning , breakfast and house keeping services have gone down . The house keeping takes ages to deliver tea bags, the executive lounge and business centre have been closed down . The breakfast variety has been curtailed . On one of the days there was shortage of bread and croissant for breakfast with one hour still left for the breakfast buffet  to close . The excuse was that too many guests came for breakfast and the hote had not planned it. The English speaking staff in the hotel is now quite a few so there is a difficulty in explaining things.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 star service in the heart of Paris
text: My friends and I just spent an amazing 10 days at this oasis within walking distance of the best and classy parts of Paris. The hotel furnishings from reception to the rooms are pure class. Rooms are big and the service is immaculate. Every staff member from Concierge to Bellboys and Cleaners just rolls out the red carpet. We were in Paris for Roland Garros and there were lots of other Guests who were there for tennis. Tennis pickups and drop offs were a breeze at an extra cost of cause.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Terrible hotel
text: We stayed at the hotel for our anniversary. Hotel staff is rude and lacks in customer service. Valet parking had accident in our car which caused lots of damage to the vehicle we had wait for around 30 minutes for manager to come out and speak to us about hotel driver damaging our car still no apology rude manager. We didn’t even check out and not requested our car out not sure why our car was driven at the time. We had to drive back to London with 3 young children. It’s been 3 months we been chasing repair from hotel and explained it’s our everyday use car for school pick ups and other reasons but still it takes manager 2-3 weeks to reply to simple email who is defiantly not trained to deal with matters like this. Requested information few things in emails which been completely ignored it’s like they don’t even acknowledged what we requested.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 star establishment of International Standards
text: Just had an amazing 10 days in this deserving 5 star rated hotel. The furnishings from reception to the rooms is classy, the service from each staff member absolutely stunning. As an English speaker I was not made to feel like a foreigner (as is typical of establishments in France).
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Please do not stay here they damaged my car and refusing to repair
text: So we stayed here in Feb for our anniversary. Paid for valet parking. The Valet smashed our car pics available. The hotel no apology and we are still arguing with their insurance company. They take two weeks to respond to any correspondence. Please dont stay here. We had three young children and were left to drive home in a severely damaged car which we can't drive as the police have said it is illegal. mathilde vial is dealing with the complaint but rarely responds.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Dr.Kateryna
text: I have never seen 5 stars hotel with absence of mini bar, inability to pay the restaurant bill from deposit, and waiting time for room service ( regular salad) 2hs 45 min and stuff who hangs up on me.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Nice Hotel but way I overpriced for what you get.
text:
As usual, check in is at 3:00 and they are very strict about it. We arrived at 10:00 am from the states and was forced to wait until 3:00 to check in even though numerous people came in after us and got their rooms almost immediately. They said our room was “different” than everyone else’s. The hotel is ok but for what you get, it’s way overpriced. The “Superior King” is much smaller than an average Holiday Inn or Motel 6 room in the states. 

There were two decorative pillows on the bed but no sleeping pillows. We had to request pillows from housekeeping several times. 

The upside is they had wash cloths. Most European hotels never have them so not sure how they wash their face.

The location is nice and close to places of interest but be prepared for a 1-2 hour cab/Uber ride from the airport. Traffic is as you would expect in Paris. You sit still as much as you move. Uber quoted me one price but charged nearly double due to the traffic. (€135 one way)

My advice is that if you want to check in as soon as you arrive, book the night before. That way you can check in right away. Maybe.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Not the best, but definitely not the worst either
text:
With COVID-19 now (hopefully!) receding, 2022 promises to be a return to conferences, at least a bit. The first one for me was in Paris so it was back to the Hotel Du Collectionier, which was also the conference venue.

What surprised me a bit was that I couldn’t really detect any significant work that might have happened during covid; the hotel seems content to inhabit the ‘faded glamour’ spot that so many often do. The room was pretty functional – some plug sockets were in quite odd places – but it worked. Ironing board was included, which was great. But it was quite noisy – not the quietest room I’ve stayed in by far.

As for the rest of the hotel, the conference ran relatively smoothly, although at time I felt the staff could have left the food out a little longer for those of us running late! One of the big selling points here is the location, which remains great, and obviously hasn’t changed. 

Overall, not bad but not great.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Helpful staff
text:
Set on a not too busy street 10 minutes from the Arc de Tromphe and the Champs Elysee. The front desk staff and concierge were very helpful, and let me use the phone to rearrange flight bookings when my cell phone would not connect.
The rooms are not too small, and the bed is good. The coffee maker in my room was a bit stiff to open and close. 
The bathroom has a separate bath and shower cubicle - which makes the shower cubicle a bit small.
Choice of English TV channels is a bit limited, but then this is France.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Nice but not luxurious
text: Hotel has a good location near Parc Monceau and Champs Elysee. There is a fairly good service but not portier. Breakfast is quite extensive (buffet). Room has enough closet space. Bed is firm and good. Shower in a bath. Fast wifi. This is rather big hotel, not very intimate.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Disappointed
text:
Pros: concierge and front desk staff were courteous and working hard. The lower level common bathrooms were beautiful and nicely  maintained. 

Cons: Hotel seems understaffed, lobby smells, and attention to detail in the guest rooms is totally missing. Heard another guest complaining the temperature in her room was so hot she was sweating each night she was here. Unfortunately we had the same experience and it was hard to sleep. Maintenance was called several times in our first 24 hours and so has housekeeping. The shower head stand was broken and was promptly removed and replaced. They came to address the air two times and nothing changed. The bidet spray was leaking and there was water dripping all over the marble floor. We had  to call 4 times over 2 days to get an iron and an ironing board. Blow dryer cut out after a few minutes from over heating and looked like the lint filter at the back had never been cleaned. Came back to our room after the first day and and it was not serviced. 

Toiletries provided were half made in China and very poor quality. 

Would not stay here again.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Alleluia, Collectionneur is back!
text: After a long covid closing it was wonderful to see so many of their excellent professionals returned to this extraordinary hotel.  The very special hospitality offered by outstanding leaders like Vincent in the front office, Christian in the lobby, and Adrien in the dining room set a standard of  teamwork and customer care that new hires are following and returning customers treasure.  The careful housekeeping seems even better than it was before the shutdown, and a large new private garden is a great addition.   A week's R&R at the hotel in March was just what we needed, and we look forward to the reopening of the Executive Lounge.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great luxury hotel for family
text: A delightful hotel with nice rooms and service, and very walkable from key interest points.  Grounds were clean and fresh.  Service again, was excellent.  Trained in from London for a three-day visit and hotel was very easy to navigate.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Birthday weekend
text: I and my wife just came back from Paris from staying at this beautiful hotel and it was so great that I have to leave a review. We celebrated my wife 40th birthday this weekend and from start to finish all the staff have been amazing. I like to say a big thank you to MAX the Restaurant Manager of providing  us the cake and champagne and to all his staff. The staff at reception have all been great. I’ve stayed in a lot of 5 star hotels and this has to be at the top. Please avoid any negative reviews about this hotel which nearly made me not book it ! I will definitely be coming back to Paris and book this hotel again.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 star gem in the heart of Paris
text:
Stay 3 nights in Paris on a bussines trip. The hotel was very high standard. 
Located in the center of Paris within walking distance of shops and good restaurants and the Arc de Triomphe.
The staff was very professional and helpful. Rooms where well furnished and clean. The restaurant was closed for the time but the Bar served good drinks, snacks and even burgers.
A real gem on a good location.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: The Room that the hotel forgot
text:
For a 5 star hotel this hotel certainly needs to try a lot harder. I've stayed in better equipped for star premises. 

To begin with we were greeted by an extremely busy conference taking up the entire ground floor and foyer and a Union protest making it unbearably noisy to check in. To give the team credit they offered us a free drink in the bar for the 3 of us which unfortunately did take longer than expected because of the conference crowd. 

For a high level seminar to take place in a 5 star hotel I would expect it not to impact on other guests stays but we had to wait to find a seat in the foyer due to the event. Surely such an event should book out an entire hotel or certainly not in anyway impact the pleasure of other guests. 

We waited until 3.15 for our Room to be ready normally it should be from 3 o'clock. We were sent to the 7th floor to the Room the Hotel forgot. We are a family of 3 and there is no way a supposably superior king Room has enough space to comfortably sleep 3 people.  

My child's bed was not already in the Room and all they supplied was a thin blanket and sheet. She got cold on the second night and I attempted to request an extra blanket but no-one answered the phone on the reception or housekeeping.  I  left a voice message early morning but on return to our Room at 8 tonight it was still not delivered. I had to request it again. 

 We had to request a 3rd set of towels cups and glasses. On the 2nd day once the room had been serviced they had already removed the extra towels, and third cup and glass making it difficult to provide a drink for my child.

 The extra bed had to be butted up against the desk blocking the tea and coffee making facilities which had a very limited selection of tea and coffee and no drinks for a child. According to staff it is because of covid there is no Mini bar. 

There was no kettle in the room so we had to request it. We had to ask 3 times for the kettle as they did not believe we didn't have one in the room. It required a long wait and someone to come and check then go and get one from the service quarters.

I noticed on the TripAdvisor reviews some have talked about the drain smell. This is definitely the case in the foyer and corridors. If you work here you probably don't notice it.

 If you are looking for a child friendly hotel this is not it. The most they offer is a colouring book and a packet of cards. There is no swimming pool or any other facilities suited for families very disappointing.

 I notice on other tripadvisor reviews there is a stock template reply from the hotel and they don't seem to pay attention to any of them.  I also sent a version of this review this morning to the hotel to give them a chance to make thibgs better for us but i received no reply.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Sewerage Smells in Lobby & Elevators
text: DO  NOT STAY HERE horrific sewerage smells in Lobby & Elevators, hotel ignored complaints from us, all other guests in our party also complained. How can a 5 star hotel get away with this,  We were guest 11.02,22 to 13.02.22 and the foul smell was there all weekend
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Outstanding Hotel with Amazing Staff!
text: My wife and I stayed at this wonderful hotel 4-6 Feb 22 to celebrate a significant birthday. Aesthetically stunning inside and out, we could not have chosen a better place to stay. There were so many things the staff did during the weekend that made the memories that extra bit special. I specifically want to thank and highlight Tarek in Reception, who seemingly made it his mission to make our stay the best it could possibly be. I cannot rate this hotel enough.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Wonderful boutique hotel in Paris.
text:
My wife and I really enjoyed this hotel. It has a “boutique” feel and not a generic feel of a big chain. We stayed here for five nights about a week and a half before Christmas. The lobby and courtyard was decorated with lovely holiday decorations and lights. It had a great Christmas feel. We had a room on the eighth floor facing the courtyard. It was a decent sized room with a comfortable king sized bed. The elevators always arrived quickly and house keeping seemed to come by before noon each day. The bar looked really nice, but closed early so we never got to go. We didn’t have breakfast at the hotel either, I think that’s more of a business travel move. Anyway, we preferred to go to the nearby cafes and restaurants. 

The location is excellent, I mean, pretty much everything in the 8th arr. is great. It’s nearby Parc Monceau, which we didn’t really get to explore, but next time! We’ll definitely be back!

Covid stuff: Staff was consistently masked as well as the other guests. There were also hand sanitizer stations everywhere. We did however confuse the concierge when we asked about what was needed for the Covid Pass Sanitaire. But so many things were changing that week, so you should probably verify requirements ahead of time. They changed a few days after we got there.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Excellent hotel
text: I have booked this property  via booking , price was really good. The hotel itself is really great , Art Deco style , room are really big for paris standard the only bad thing would be the size of bathroom but i prefer a bigger room than a bigger bathroom. The reception staff are really nice and helpful, we have been granted with a free bottle of wine, very nice gesture. I will for sure will be back on my next paris trip.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 stars hotel without minibar
text:
Very bad experience. I was surprised to see for the first time in my life a 5 Stars Hotel without minibar in the room. The worst thing is you don’t have any list in the room to order something. When i called the room service asking the list, she told me that she can tell me the list by phone. Amazing. 
In the bar and also at the room service they have limited options to eat. I will avoid this hotel for my next trips to Paris.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Nice hotel located in a fabulous location
text:
The facade of the hotel is gorgeous with its Art Deco theme.

Lobby was equally nice and the concierge very efficient.

We had a double / double executive room on the 6th floor which amazingly enough had a view of the Eiffel Tower.

The room was fine albeit starting to show some signs of age, the bathroom was adequate.

During our stay the restaurant, executive lounge and other guests areas were closed!!

The bar area was nice and the staff attentive (cocktails were limited)

Breakfast was a buffet affair with hot & cold food available, I have to say the coffee was horrible !

Location was the main selling point, it’s very close to the Champs Elysee and the metro.

From the hotel it’s 10 min walk to the Champs Elysee, 30 min walk to the Eiffel Tower and 20 mins on the Metro to the Louvre.

Would have given 5 / 5 if the facilities were all available.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Luxury hotel does not quite live up to expectations
text: I went on a 3 day Paris trip with my 14 year old son. We paid around €300 over Destinia.com per night, which is a good rate for a King size bed room in a 5 star… Hotel reopened from COVID shut down mid October 2021. Location is excellent near Parc Monceau; 20’ walk from Place de L’Etoile. Staff at reception was extremely friendly, we got twin beds in lieu of our King size. We booked breakfast for €15 p P p night additional. Room was large, nice & large bathroom, room would deserve some fresh paint and new furniture. Room quite & working air conditioning. Unfortunately Spa was closed (not written anywhere in the booking) and would have been closed for under 16 year old anyway (not written anywhere on the booking either). Breakfast buffet was nice, though you would expect cooked dishes a la minute in a 5 star. Not the case. The hotel has a nice Art Deco bar; €10 soft drinks; €15 a glass of wine. Decent hotel, maximum 4 star, you probably get better value for the money in Paris.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: EXCELLENT SERVICE AND VERY PROFESSIONAL MANAGER MR VINCENT LAUGERY
text:
We have stayed at the collectionneur hotel for overnight last weekend ( 16/10 to 17/10).

The hotel just opened after covid.

Mr Vincent LAUGERY took very good care of our family, was very reactive to all of our demands, truly excellent as he took excellent care of everything.

Many thanks to him and we will certainly come back.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Lovely hotel but terrible breakfast
text: I stayed here for one night for business - the hotel is lovely, a very grand feel. Room is spacious (considering average size of rooms in Paris) with all amenities required. The only shame was breakfast - nothing felt fresh and not the best service from staff! The hotel is also located very close to Champs Elysees (10 mins walk) and 10 min drive from Eiffel tower.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: HOTEL NOT RESPONDING TO EXISTING CUSTOMERS
text: We are all going through hard times, but interestingly enough this hotel is helping with new reservations (online chat pops up), but is not responding to existing customers (like myself) who booked months ago, paid close to $3K (and took  out insurance).  I have emailed multiple times, emailed the insurance company, and started a chat with the online person.  Why is this okay!!!  This is a defining moment for business to do the right thing.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great Location, Beautiful Hotel and Amazing Staff
text: Beautiful Hotel,Great Location, Excellent Staff. Large rooms and American style accommodations.  I will book again.  Nice park if you want to jog a block from hotel.  Metro stop about 2 blocks away.  John - Chicago, IL
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Second time, better time
text:
Second time for me at this hotel for a business trip (the first time wasn't excellent).
Check-in late (around 22:00 CET), a bit long (+10 minutes), but very warm welcome.
Wonderful decorations in the hall for S. Valentine's Day.
Beautiful room, with an open (yes, open) bathroom with both bathtub and shower. Nice view on the internal garden and confortable bed and shower shoes. Mini bar space with interesting things, even condoms!
Breakfast was very fast because I had very little time, with a tasty cappuccino.
Definitley, a good stay.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great experience
text: Small room, but great size for Paris. Comfortable bed, nice bathroom and excellent shower! Incredible breakfatsm with the best breads, yogurts and croissants! It is located in a nice part of the town, easy access to subway (2-3 blocks distant) and main streets.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: $2k view of an office building
text:
We braved Coronavirus and rainy weather just to stay 4 days at this lovely hotel. Our favorite memories are of the wonderful breakfast and very special room service celebrating a birthday.

Be prepared to walk 10 minutes to metro stops. We Uber'd most of the stay. Shopping/restaurants near Arc de Triomphe are 10-15 minutes walk away. Walk to Lourve: 40 mins. Walk to Eiffel Towers: 40 minutes. Ride to CDG airport: 40 minutes. I was grateful for the umbrellas in the room.

With the seemingly low March 2020 occupancy, I was greatly disappointed to be given a room third-floor room in the back corner of the establishment. Our view day and night was an eyesore concrete office building - in Paris! We viewed cubicles and calendars instead of the beautiful city street or garden. Was there really no better room available?

We saw no other children during our stay. The spa/jacuzzi is for guests 16 years old and up. 

We had minor issues with housekeeping and a late-start breakfast, but overall it is a lovely hotel that aims to impress. The bottom line is, however, that Paris is full of lovely hotels. If in the City of Lights ever again, I'm not sure I need to revisit.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Akimasa
text: Good service at the hotel.The food was delicious, and the front also supported the gentleman for me who couldn't speak English.The Eiffel Tower seen from the hotel was spectacular. I wanted to stay again.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Excellent Honeymoon Experience!
text: Lovely experience in a lovely hotel, would recommend to anyone looking for a couples retreat. Excellent amenities and hospitable staff that speak great English. Make sure you make the most of the concierge they are incredible.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Good stay, great staff
text: I had a pleasant, but short stay at the de Collectionneur. The only critique would be small issues around the presentation/condition of certain items throughout the hotel, but on the whole, good value.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 5 stars
text: The spaces inside the hotel are all amazing, excellent amenities, great food, super clean, personnel always very nice, respectful and responsive. A very comfortable place to stay. In the better location, near everything, a quiet area in Paris.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Hancocks in Paris 2020
text:
Great location, first time to Paris and we loved it.
The hotel has art deco theme with a light modern touvh in the communual areas.
Staff are brilliant and friendly and very knowledgeable.
Rooms are clean but in need a little updating.
Beds are very comfortable and luxuriuos bedding.
Lots of shampoo and lotions in the bathroom.
Great coffee machine.
What a great short break we had here !
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Very nice hotel near Arc de Triomphe
text: This was a very nice hotel with very accomodating, friendly staff. Given that one wants to be OUT in Paris, this hotel is the right balance of luxury and proximity. Perhaps a bit dated in places but overall very nice stay
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great staff
text: Loved our stay here during valentines week. Clean, neat , great staff and loved the Art Deco theme! It was legitimately right round the corner of Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées which was great for all our shopping. We also got a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower, which was a great sight to see at night. Enjoyed using the gym and the spa too! Thanks for a great stay!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Dush
text:
Good location   4 stars needs updating rooms hallways needs more lifts on each floor need brighten rooms with white colours rooms too dark location is great. Near shopping. Central  staff were helpful 
Good service when having issues
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Beautiful Hotel. Has amazing view if you have a little extra to spend on there executive room with a view.
text: Beautiful Hotel. Has amazing view if you have a little extra to spend on there executive room with a view. Close to shopping and attractions if you like walking and the tour bus ride around is 10 min walk away.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Weekend in Paris with the family for our 15th wedding anniversary
text: The hotel was beautiful and the breakfast was our favourite part. We really enjoyed our stay and the staff were very helpful, welcoming and courteous. We would definitely stay here again when we are in Paris next time.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great experience!!!
text: A great option to stay, near interesting places. If you like to walk to get to know the city, this is a perfect place, if not, also you have really near subway stations or taxis just at the door. I highly recommend it!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: good place
text:
stable quality
coming renovation welcome,,although not urgent-
good service executive lounge most appreciated, with good staff and friendly ambiance-
overall ,from concierge to gouvernante and cleaning ladies, at home feeling.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Good location
text:
Stayed here 12th - 15th December 2019 to celebrate my 70th and our Golden Wedding as a present from our daughter.
Booked into a Classic suite which was perfect as there was a living room  adjoining the bedroom and with British TV channels!!! This also gave you access to the executive lounge which was perfect for breakfast and other goodies, cakes, drinks (alcoholic), teas etc all at different times throughout the day. Had breakfast in the dining room once and found it to be a bit disjointed, to assemble a breakfast you had to go from one place to another and no trays so it was a pleasure to have breakfast in the Exectutive loung after that.
Room was very clean, and a nice large bed and adjoining lounge very clean.
Staff very courteous and could not do enough for you.
Customer relations girl offered us champagne which we declined, wife tea total and myself a beer man, however when we came back from our first walkabout, beer on ice, fruit juice and cakes awaited us in our room. Thank you very much.
A couple of negatives, was that the restaurant was closed 2 nights out of the three which we did intend to use, close by eateries were recommended by the large happy concierge chappy!!!!
Outside by the windows of the suite, some kind of metal (zinc???) was used for water run off - to be honest not a clue, however when it rained, which it did, your heard the rain against the metal.
During our visit, there was a transport strike which just started the Monday prior to us arriving, this curtailed our travel as we had to walk to the Champs Elysees to get the unmanned metro line but a few of the sight can be accessed from this line.
If the transport system was up and running as normal, a bus stop was 100 meters away and Courcelles Metro stop was a few minutes walk away.
Hoping to visit Paris soon and when no problems with their transport systems and would stay at this hotel again.
Had a lovely view of the Eiffel from the suite at night in all its Christmas glory!!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Comfortable stay
text: Nice hotel - excellent breakfast spread with  superb service . Want to thank especially Anees for the soja latte . The gym is locked before 8:00 am so if you have to go early you have to approach the reception . The executive lounge has a good spread - hope they can add some more vegetarian options. Overall a good stay .
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Stayed Here Twice This Year and Good Both Times
text: We traveled to Paris in May and September and stayed here both trips. Very nice room and comfortable beds. Service was excellent. Concierge excellent and recommended perfect places to check out. Good location to walk many places. Only downside is that it is a very busy business hotel so as we were there for pleasure there was a lot going on.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text: We were at a family trip and the hotel was perfect. Within walking distance to the metro station, George V avenue and Champs Elysees. The rooms were big, we were upgraded to a higher class roon upon arrival.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Do not have breakfast
text: Charged €104 for two breakfasts consisting of a bowl of fruit and a croissant.  The hotel buffet breakfast at €48 per person is more expensive than any other hotel I have ever been to. The check in/out experience always take ages as they are understaffed and poorly organised.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: visiting hotel on 10 year wedding anniversary
text: Staying in hotel did fill the expectations, nice small suprises from hotel brought in room. Location was good, not long walking distance from Champs Elysee. Couldn't use metro's, but still very accessible location with taxi or walking.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Fantastic hotel
text: Couldn’t fault the hotel or the friendly staff, as near perfect as possible. The bedroom and bathroom was comfortable and luxurious, the breakfast was lovely with plenty of choice and the spa facilities were the icing on the cake
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: 50th birthday celebration
text: Beautiful hotel, extremely friendly & helpful staff. Made to feel so welcome and a great place celebrate a big birthday. Rooms are lovely and the breakfast was gorgeous. Spa a great place to spend a cold January afternoon. Great location too. Thank you so much For making my birthday extra special.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Not maintained well enough to be a 5 star
text:
Despite having renovated their bar and restaurant, I found the Hotel du Collectioneur to be far from a 5 star hotel experience. Large enough to be 5 but more of a 3 star experience. 

Having stayed at at least one hundred 5 star hotels over the years for both personal reasons and business, in Paris and elsewhere, I have to say that this hotel fails on several key fronts, even by Paris standards:

1) cleanliness
2) maintenance
3) billing/processing
4) no wow effect/small touches like chocolate on pillow
5) limited /insufficient security

In regards to the first and second, there were hundreds of stains on the carpet throughout the hotel as well as marks and large scratches on the walls and furniture. In addition we found food left out by guests every time we walked to our room....even when we checked in at 14.00 there were still many plates left out in the hallways from the night before. It was not fresh and was clearly from the night before despite what staff told me. Staff blamed this on a shortage of service staff but why couldnt other staff just remove the trays and plates? It smelled foul from all the rotting, left over food and of course this contributes to all the carpet stains which no one clearly cares about addressing...you would not see that Athenee, Intercontinental, Ritz, etc. Never. Ever.

In regards to billing/accounting:

1) I could not open my door on the second night and had to get the card (key) reactivated again which staff blamed on some mistake when we checked in...small but completely basic and avoidable...
2) having prepaid my stay, hotel billed me after I left and I had to spend hours on the phone and playing detective to resolve...

On the plus side, most staff seem well trained although not the best I've come across as more inclined to go through the motions and refute any complaint rather than focus on simply resolving the matter.  

Also, the location is excellent and the rooms are good quality although we did unfortunately learn at 5 am that you can hear your neighbors talk and slam doors.... bad luck for us on top of everything...

Finally, the breakfast was solid. Plenty of choices although not the best Ive had at similar hotels.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Good value
text: The hotel was nice but a bit less than we expected.  Was not a fan of the lobby and hallway smells.  The lobby was very beautiful and the staff were very accommodating.  While we did not eat in the hotel we did have drinks in the bar and the bartender was very entertaining.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Great hotel
text: This hotel is absolutely great. Many thanks for the stuff who did take an absolute care of us at the arrival as well as at the departure. The concierge is very competent to advise the clients concerning the city...
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Excellent stay!!!!
text:
Everything was great during our stay! 
Reception, room, spa, breakfast, normally I do not post comment for hotels, but for this one, I m taking few minutes to share my great experience. The spa is super clean and the breakfast was excellent
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Epic fail
text:
If you are in that hotel without making your study, well Goodluck.

1. always have a notebook with you with the prices that you agreed with the hotel.
For instance since they gave me a price for the parking on 25 euros when I was going to make the check out they wanted to charge me 42 euro which neve happened of course.

The dinner was agreed for 280 euros - 10%discount per person, when we arrive they didn't want to give us the discount we had again to make a fight to agree with the 10% discount and the most funny even when we agree for 504 euros for 2 people they charge 505 euro! The receptionist increase the price by herself 1 euro. The problem is not the 1 euro  extra that she charge me but other is to give it myself as a tip and other is to take it by force from me.

We book from 31 Dec to 4 Jan price was 1800 euros in total. When we arrive they request 1200 euro insurance. Yea correct we prepay 1800 euros and we give an other 1200 euro insurance.

Do Not loose your time with the reception team DO Not!! Do as fast you can to avoid them they are not professionals they don't have experience.

I will never go there again for sure!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: WONDERFULL !!
text: This hotel realy meets all your requirement. You receives an excellent service on each level. We never had such a briliant service before. I would recommend this hotel to everyone who wants to visit Paris.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: A Pleasant Stay
text: This place is close to the major attractions. The breakfast and service was good. I would come back and stay at this place again and pick a bigger room if it they have availability. Overall not a bad stay.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Our worst Experience in Paris. Do not go to this Hotel!
text:
It looks like a beautifull hotel and in fact it is. If you have ordered executive service please be aware of the fact that it does noet exist. 
There is a separate part of the desk for executive service but it is mostly unmanned so you have to stand in cue. It also takes a lot of time by the front desk managers to fill in all the necessary forms (15 minutes).

The hotel claims that the 6th. and 7th. floor have executive rooms. On the 5th floor (as we had a room also there) the rooms were exactly the same. with on both floors extremely small bathing rooms!
There is no way of paying your bill when you leave by only signing it. Since they have your creditcard number they could put the bill during the night under your door but they are not able to do so you have to cue up again.
The breakfast is included in the executive part, however if you want it in your room you have to pay the full price of E 35,00 for a poor breakfast. They do not inform you a bout these extra costs!
They do not inform you that if you want your car parked in front of the hotel you have to pay for it in cash to the "garagist". A nice way generating "black" money! Your payment for parking in front of the hotel cannot according to the concierges information(mr. Alexandre) be charged to your credit card! In fact the concierge mr. Alexandre told us to walk to a TMT to get money!
This mr. Alexandre, one of the concierges, is a man who should not be allowed to work in the service sector. He should perhaps be a commanding officer in the army! Service and politeness as well as friendliness are words unknown to him.

One thing is excellent, the restaurant downstairs, friendly and gentle people who provide a very good service. The food is excellent!

Also the hall porters were extremely nice and friendly!

Unfortunately i will have to write an article about my stay which will bring back all the bad things I encountered during my stay! 

MY ADVISE TO ALL PEOPLE CONSIDERING A STAY AT THIS HOTEL: GO THE INTERCONTINENTAL OPERA OR THE HILTON. YOU PAY THE SAME PRICE AND GET EXCELLENT SERVICE!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Pleasant stay
text: The service is good especially the concierge. The down side is the tv channel and very movie need to paid. Location is great, in the centre of Paris, you can reach everywhere by walking leads than 30 mins
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Excellent location and service
text: Ideally located with outstanding staff. Direct booking is best to enjoy excellent buffet breakfast. Spa and concierge really useful to extend you stay after check out. champs elysees at walking distance, useful during strikes in Paris
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Hotel du collectionneur
text: Amazing Christmas tree in lobby and friendly staff. A very good experience. We had one problem, when we arrived our room was two single beds and we requested a king. It was amended but they only put the two mattresses together which left a slight gap between the two mattresses and made it slightly uncomfortable but apart from that, it was an amazing hotel and definitely will stay again!!!!!!
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: A night in the stars !
text:
Wonderfull night at L’hôtel du Collectionneur ! Everyone from the staff are here to make your stay unforgettable.
From the moment of the arrival until the end, we felt special ! 
The check-in and check out were quick and lovely, the dinner at the restaurant was just AMAZING, such as the professional and attentive staff !
Cocktails from the bar are delicious, and the SPA of the hotel is just perfect to relax after a long day !

Special thanks to the Front Desk for the late check-out and the nice room ! 

I hope to come back soon ! 😃
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Fantastic stay
text: We booked through Expedia and were very pleased with the hotel and the service upon arrival and throughout our entire stay.  The experience was fantastic!  The concierge team deserves great kudos for helping guest navigate the strike and made sure we were minimally interrupted during our travels.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Perfect!
text: We had a short stay there and we honestly can’t wait to come back for a longer one, we really loved this place! Everything was on point, the location, the hotel itself, the breakfast, the lounge and the staff of course, always helpful, polite and lovely! Thank you to everyone again and to Vincent Laugery for his warm welcome! We will be back!! :)
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Amazing Stay
text:
Got a good deal over Black Friday for a Superior King Room (their most basic). On arrival, hotel was beautiful. Check-in took a while, but was given a free upgrade to next room, Spa Access and vouchers for money off reatuarant and bar.

My wife was given a complimentary bottle of champagne and treats for her 30th birthday by staff which was an amazing touch and made our trip. 

Wouldn't have wanted to pay full price for the room, but they seem to have offers frequently so it makes it worth it. Just down the road from Champs Elysees, but far enough away that it is quiet. 

100% stay again.
name: Hotel du Collectionneur

title: Highly recommended
text:
Highly recommend! Clean, friendly staff. Great location. Five minutes to a metro, two minutes to a bus stop . There are a lot of café and stories around there.
We really liked visit Paul bakery for fresh baget and so on.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: PERFECT PLACE TO STAY IN MARAIS
text:
the location was perfect. Near saint Paul Metro, main street in the heart of the Marais quarter. 9 minutes walk from the Bastille Opera.
the staff was amazing, kind and helpful with great ideas! everyone  spoke excellent English and always with  a  kind smile .
We ate breakfast every morning there was plenty of cheese, meat and great Nespresso machine with all the testes existing! really great
the room was super clean the view was amazing double glass glassing so we slept very peacefully. TV with CNN channel. 
We will surly come back!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Amazing staff
text: The hotel was very good, the cost and benefits worthy, the room was small, but very comfort and functional. However what hightlight this hotel as wonderful was the staff, kind, they were always available to help and give tips and answer questions, even at helping me with my french. They were amazing!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Location, comfort and great price
text: This is a great location in the Marais just a block from the #1 metro line. The room size is average to small but the beds are very comfortable and it is quiet. The ac worked great, which is important in the summer. The staff was inviting and helpful. What more could you want?
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great location, clean, functional
text: We enjoyed our stay here. Location is super - there are 2 metro stops nearby (Saint-Paul, line 1 and Bastille, line 8). Rue Turenne is right off of Rue Saint-Antoine, lots of restaurants, cafes, shops,etc.  Place des Vosges and Maison Victor Hugo are just around the corner. You can easily spend the day in the area (Marais) just exploring without ever having to take the metro or any transit. The hotel itself is clean and amenities are included. Mini fridge, AC (that was a life saver as we had arrived during the infamous July heatwave), small TV, a small cupboard to hang our clothes on, coffee and tea and electric kettle. The staff is friendly. My husband left a set of keys in our hotel room and the hotel returned it to us via mail, that was nice.   We never tried the breakfast, as you can easily find a few boulangeries within 5 minutes or less. Just a small hiccup, we used the small stirring spoon in the morning to have yogurts, but we found upon our return to hotel in the evenings, that the housekeeping staff did not clean the spoon or replaced them with clean ones. I ended up washing them myself, which was not a big deal, but I thought it's worth mentioning. It would be nice to have clean utensils every day. Other than that, it was a great stay. I recommend the hotel.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Perfect location, very clean and functional
text:
Perfect location in the Marais. Small room and tiny bathroom but very functional,new, clean, modern but also the deco, wall paper give it a boutique, unique style. Overall very good
The check out time 10am is too early but they can keep your luggage in a safe room with tags.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Sufficient
text:
The hotel has not been renovated for a long time. The view from the main room looking at the bathroom window, wardrobe where you can not hang a dress in, stains on the floor - leave a poor impression.
The location is great. Other than that, nothing else really.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: They made booking error and charged me for 1st night
text:
I booked online at this hotel for 2 nights in September. After submitting my credit card information I received a confirmation that I had booked for 2 nights starting tomorrow. That's crazy. I'm in Tucson and there is no way I could be in Paris tomorrow even if I wanted to be (and I don't).

When you cancel they charge you for the First Night of your stay, even if they made an error and you try to correct it within MINUTES of receiving the erroneous confirmation. I tried using their site to change dates, but they claim no availability. THIS STINKS.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Superb location
text:
We stayed a night at the double room. The room was average size by Paris standards, with an efficiently arranged bathroom and a comfortable bed. Storage space is however limited, so you might wish to consider a larger room if you have substantial luggage. 

Service was excellent - warm and efficient. A similarly attractive selling point is the brilliant location - right next to the bustling Rue Rivoli with its plethora of dining and shopping options, and the Lourve a 15 mins walk away.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great stay
text: We really recommend this hotel. All the staff we came into contact with were very helpful, friendly and gave good tips when we asked. Our room was clean, a good size, lovely shower and was great to have the robes. The location was perfect too. I would definitely advise others to stay who are considering
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Another pleasant stay
text: Great location where you can walk out to restaurants ,cafes, shops, museums, attractions, Bastille Opera house, and Metro lines!  Friendly reception, good service. When arrived heard the most wonderful words after an overnight flight from US, "Your room is ready!" at about 11am.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Very nice hotel on perfect location
text: Nicely decorated, very clean room with big windows and French balcony. The hotel has a perfect location in our favorite part of Paris - Marais. The staff is very nice and helpful. Everything was to our satisfaction..
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Goog, but not a 4 star hotel
text: Overall Hotel Turenne is clean and in a excellent location. Only one gentleman at the front desk made me feel welcome. The breakfast had excellent cheese selections, bread and coffee, but it would have been good to have hot eggs and cereals on offer. My room, bathroom and separate toilet  were too small for a 5 night stay, but clean. Upon checking out, I asked if because of my 5 night stay, I could get a discount. The gentleman checking me out said I should book a larger room next time and a discount is impossible. I've stayed at other hotels that immediately offer a discount for extended stays. Overall, I probably would not come back to this hotel. For the price I would expect more on offer. Le Marias has too many competing hotels that are truly 4 star. With a few updates Hotel Turenne would be an excellent 4 star hotel.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Perfect location, redecoration & some renovations are needed to match the room prices
text:
Perfect location, very nice and friendly personal, good wifi.
Poor deco (whole in wall), filthy carpet, heavily used and dirty pillows, very poor water pression, very little space for storage 
Value for money is not good. But still a ok hotel.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great hotel
text: Very pleased with this hotel. Big room for a Paris hotel. Newly decorated toilet and bathroom. Loads of toiletries. Great location in the Marais and loads of restaurants and bars nearby. I recommend miss manon for breakfast 2  minutes walk from the hotel. We did not have breakfast in the hotel but they have a good coffee machine.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Hotel Turenne Le Marais - perfect spot
text: Love the location of this hotel, the size of the hotel, and the friendly front desk. The room was small but perfect in decor, cleanliness, and quiet. Also, love that there's a balcony to see a dramatic view up Rue Turenne.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: excellent hotel
text: Management was very welcoming and friendly.  The room was clean and comfortable.  I especially appreciated the queen-sized bed, which was very comfortable.  And unlike so many other hotels in Paris, the bathroom was not tiny.  I've made many trips to Paris, and this was one of the best rooms I've had.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Nice Hotel in Le Marais
text: Nice hotel in a very nice district, easy to reach any important landmark of Paris. There is a lot of bars and restaurants around. The metro station is also walking distance. The room is not very big, but tidy and clean. Enjoyed the stay. Recommended
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Very good hotel in Paris
text: Really nice hotel, clean, comfortable, very good location. Good price quality, very good for family as the triple room has plenty of space. Location is very good and besides the busy street you cant hear anything in the room. Really nice hotel, clean, comfortable, very good location.really recomend it!!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: LE TURENNE is the only place to be in the Marais.
text:
This was my 5 stay in this Hotel.
Situated next to the metro, Taxis and Bus and near everything. 
Plenty of Restaurants, Bars and Shops to choose from.
Excellent service and helpful staff.
Special Thanks to Sergio for his kindness and sympathy.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great hotel!
text:
Great location!!! First night we arrived, we asked for restaurant location and she recommended a delicious restaurant. Great first impression!
Pros
-Rooms were clean
-Location is amazing! Close to metro, cute little cafes close, taxi stand right down the road
-Friendly and helpful staff

Cons
-Walls a little thin. We kept hearing our neighbors sing (they did sing beautifully though :)
-Towels are thin

Cons are very little and would not dissuade me from staying there again. I would recommend Hotel Turenne Le Marais.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Good value for money
text:
Very good location, in the Marais.
The persons at the reception are very pleasant and helpfull. The breakfast is good.
The rue de Turenne is a rather quiet street. 
Variety of restaurant in the vicinity of hotel
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Decent Hotel in a great location
text: We chose the Hotel Turenne Le Marais mainly for its location. Its close to metro and in the 4th arrondismont. We enjoyed our stay and would consider booking again. Bathrooms were nice. Services were good. Bed was comfortable. Just a little dated and small, but overall it was a good stay. Would stay again if we return to Paris.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent stay with my best recommendations
text: Great location in the heart of Marais. We experienced great hospitality. Clean and comfortable room with everything you need. Great with quiet air conditioning. Comfortable beds. The breakfast buffet could be improve with more fruit and veggies.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent Hotel in Great Location
text: This hotel was excellent for the price. Clean rooms and lobby. excellent staff especially the young lady during the day. Very helpful when we had a small problem. Rectified immediately. Typical Paris view from the window. With church bells ringing. Loved it.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent small hotel in a wonderful neighborhood
text:
I don't get to Paris as often as I would like but for the last 30 years, when I do, this is the area I stay in. I had a favorite hotel but now that I am mobility-impaired (I walk with a rollator), that hotel no longer suits me. So I tried this hotel that is very close. I stayed there ten nights.

First, it has an elevator which solved that problem. Second, it has been newly refurbished. The rooms are small but adequate. The bathroom is very good. Third, the location remains wonderful. Fourth, and perhaps most important, the staff is excellent--helpful and resourceful.

Should I be lucky enough to return to Paris, I will stay here again.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Wonderful location but a tiny room
text: We were only in Paris for one night and wanted to stay in Le Marais. Hotel Turrene was perfectly located near the Place de Vosges and steps away from dozens of restaurants and cafes. The staff was very pleasant and helpful. Our only complaint was the tiny room - barefully enough room to open the suitcase next to the bed.  The bathroom was spacious and well equipped, and the view was beautiful.  If you're not planning to spend a lot of time in your room (which we had no intention of doing - we were in Paris after all!) the hotel is a nice place to stay.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Everything was great
