text: Super hotel in great location. Easy to travel about  and a 10 minute stroll to the Metro. Rooms are not large but perfectly adequate, most importantly clean and warm. Breakfast, pay extra, but re Paris, good value and good choices. No cooked breakfasts, but so what !!. Staff very attentive and very helpful. Would definitely stay there again. Well done team.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: A Marais winner
text: Clean room, good bed, convenient location, friendly staff, close to Metro and many good restaurants.  Room was small, but more than adequate. Renovated recently. Place des Voges, Bastille and the Seine are all within a 15 minute walk.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: excellent value for money
text: Rooms quite small but beds a good size. Bathroom tiny. Very friendly staff. Excellent choice of food at breakfast.Many good restaurants in the immediate vicinity - Place des Vosges just round the corner.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Hotel Turenne Le Marais
text: The location is great in Le Marais. Close to shops, dining and the Metro 1. Our stay included breakfast with different cheeses, pastries, coffees and teas. There were also different cereals and fruits and meats. Room and bathroom were clean. Toilet area is separate from shower/sink area. Beds were twin size. Staff was nice and helpful even though we knew very little French.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Europe winter holiday
text:
lovely staff I speak a little French which they appreciate event though they all speak good English.
Clean and comfortable I was with my daughter, small rooms but this is Europe. 
Great location easy to get around we walked a lot, lots of good eating places
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Hotel
text: The hotel is in a good location . There are a lot of restaurants nearby. The room was very small . Clean but the carpet was dirty . The price is decent. They have people who speak english so you should have no language barrier!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent location
text:
Inexpensive hotel well located for all that is good within le Marais; clean and simple with good sized double rooms - some with a bit of a view too.  The breakfast area is a little small for the establishment but if you time your arrival well there is no problem and food is replenished regularly.  No gluten free bread but there are places nearby where you can buy some and bring in to eat.

We would return.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Nice Hotel, Ideal Location
text: If you want to be in Marais and experience the great section of Paris that it is, then this hotel fills the bill. Small rooms - it’s Paris! - but nice, helpful staff. Plus, easy access to rest of Paris.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Pay just for location in Marais
text: They forgot to change the towells one night, room and bathroom were not very cleaned. Other night there were not bath towells. They claimed to have problem with towell delivery (????). Small room, not very confortable, average breakfast. Kind reception and location.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Wonderful hotel in excellent area
text: We recently stayed at Turenne Le Marais in August 2019 for five nights and found it to be absolutely charming for our first trip to Paris.  The neighborhood is lovely with many excellent restaurants within a two block walk. Getting around was simple, with two local metro stations and historic sites within walking distance.  The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful with directions and recommendations.  The rooms are on the smaller side, as is customary in European cities, but were nicely decorated and spotless.  We would gladly return here for another Paris holiday
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Lovely stay
text: My daughter and I stayed here for a week in early July and we had a very nice stay. The room and bathroom were small, of course, but the location, the helpfulness of the staff, and the comfort of the hotel were great. We’ll definitely be back. My only caveat is that the airport shuttle company whose placard is at the front desk did not show up for our ride back to CDG, so I wouldn’t recommend them (obviously not the Hotel Turenne’s fault).
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: A pleasant hotel in a good location.
text:
We stayed here for a three nights on a recent visit to Paris. We picked it because a friend who knows Paris suggested the area, and TripAdvisor helped find the hotel.

The location is good, there are dozens of tiny restaurants, cafes and bars in easy walking distance, (and a small square about 20 metres away has 4 cafes ideally placed for a beer or aperitif before dinner). It is a short walk from the St Paul and Bastille Metro stations, and many of the “sights” are walkable.

We were in room 605 which no one would describe as big, but this is a small Paris hotel and small rooms are the norm. Having said that, the bed was comfortable, the room was clean and very well equipped - bathrobes, TV, kettle with tea coffee etc., good wifi, fridge, safe, hairdryer, and most important - functioning aircon. This was a blessing to me as it was hot (30+) and I dislike the heat, so the retreat to our cool room in the afternoon was a delight. The bathroom was tiny, but usable and clean. On the minus side, storage space was at a premium.

We were on a B&B deal and breakfast was comprehensive (for France). Scrambled egg, French sausages, cheese, cold meats, cerials, fresh fruit, yoghurt and the usual selection of bread, jams, croissants and pastries. Coffee is from a Nespresso machine, and includes decaffeinated options.

Overall we were happy with hotel, the staff and the price. Ask for a room on the upper floors (5,6) for a quieter night (there is a lift), remember that you are in Paris, and you will probably enjoy your stay.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Very nice hotel in a good location
text: We stayed at Turenne Le Marais for four nights and while we were initially surprised at the small room size, we quickly got used to it and really enjoyed our stay. We were able to order breakfast to our room every morning, which came served on a large tray. The bathroom was very clean and the air conditioning worked well. On our last day, they stored our bags in a locked room for free so we could explore the city without them. I would stay here again.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Friendly staff - awful rooms
text:
The staff were very nice and location is wonderful. It was clean. That's the good. 

I know Paris is expensive, but over 200 euro for the smallest hotel room I've ever stayed in is ridiculous. I've stayed in small, I've stayed in dated. Small and dated together is not a good combinsation. 

The bathroom was a cupboard. Couldn't actually move in it. These days, small rooms are often beautifully designed to make the most of the space. However, this was not a room I'd want to spend any time in whatsoever. I know better value can be had in central Paris.

It wasn't my choice to stay here - friends had picked it - and it was absolutely fine for a one night stay, but I would not go back.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Good for shorter stays
text:
Good location for exploring Le Marias and “inner city” of Paris.

Very small room and bathroom (narrow, so you might sit sideways on the toilet).
Good hotel for few days. 
Good bed and aircondition = good night sleep, which was the purpose for us.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Unfriendly and inflexible. Don’t go.
text: I never experienced such an unfriendly and inflexible receptionist. Typical arrogant Parisian style and attitude. Asked to send them personal details of my husband who offered me that night at the hotel, although i’ve already showed them all they needed to know. And the night was already paid in advance. So they had their money. He also had my credit card details, in case I take something from the fridge. That’s not how it should be. Don’t go.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Wonderful hotel in Le Marais
text: Hotel Turenne Le Marais is in a great location and have a wonderful staff.  Additionally we enjoyed a very comfortable bed, room darkening curtains, an updated bathroom and it is in a quiet area.  We will stay there again when we return to Paris.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great Location with Clean Rooms
text: Room was not ginormous, but felt right for the two of us. Very clean and nice with great location to food and metro stations. Staff was very friendly. We did not have breakfast at the hotel, but they had lots of tables for guests and lots of other guests seemed to enjoy it. A little expensive, but so is everything in Paris
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: A True Gem
text:
I very seldom rate a hotel "Excellent," but Hotel Turenne is an exception.  The location is ideal. Located in the Marais, it is outside of the crowded "tourist" areas and surrounded by restaurants, cafes, and small shops. Only three short blocks from the "St. Paul" Metro stop, on the "1" line, which goes through the heart of Paris, with stops at Louvre, Concord, etc. Place de la Bastille, the Picasso Museum, and Place des Vosges, called the most beautiful square in Paris, are an easy walk away.

The hotel staff are really friendly and helpful. I do not know if it were the "luck of the draw" or as planned, but my single room was large by Paris standards with a good sized bathroom. It was on the rear side of the hotel. So no street noises, and I did not mind the lack of a view. I did not opt for the 16 euro breakfast but had my morning coffee at one of the many nearby restaurants. (Tea bags and instant coffee with a hot water kettle are available in each room.) The room has TV and a mini fridge stocked with snacks and drinks for which you are charged if consumed. Free wi fi worked fine and quickly. It is not secure, so don't send sensitive information with passwords.

This is a three star hotel with very acceptable rates.  I would not hesitate to return.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Perfectly acceptable hotel, but there are better options in the Marais
text: This is a perfectly acceptable hotel in a good location in rue de Turenne, just off rue Saint-Antoine, and very close to Place des Vosges.  Nearest Metro:  Saint-Paul - just a couple of minutes walk away.  I had a 'standard double' room on the 5th floor (there is a lift!) which was extremely small, even by Parisian standards.  I was on my own, so it was fine, but for two adults it would be pretty uncomfortable.  The modern and efficient shower room was of similarly tiny proportions.  That said, the room was well equipped (bathrobe, TV, kettle, good wifi, fridge, safe, hairdryer, functioning aircon, safe) and the bed was very comfortable.  Being on the 5th floor meant that, with the french window closed, there was almost no street noise - I gather this was not so much the case if you were on the lower floors. The aircon is effective, so sleeping with the window closed is an option.   Internal sound-proofing isn't bad, although the plumbing is noisy. The breakfast is a definite plus point for the hotel:  there are cooked options and cheese and salami, in addition to the usual choice of cereals, rolls and viennoiseries, fresh fruit and yoghurt.  Coffee is via a Nespresso machine.  The breakfast room is on the ground floor (much nicer than being in the basement, which is the case in many Marais hotels) and is pretty efficiently run.  A word about the service:  generally the staff were pleasant and helpful, but on our arrival, the welcome from the individual on reception was certainly lacking in warmth - one might say charmless! - which rather coloured our view of the hotel overall. As far as value for money goes, I felt the hotel was a bit expensive given the size of the room, but all the essentials are there, and the breakfast is good value.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Nice location, nicely priced
text:
Well located. Service was nice and the room clean and tidy (very small shower room though in my standard single room). 
My only reservation is the noise insulation from the street. In spite of the double glazing, I could still hear traffic in the street, from quite early in the morning.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Lovely for the price in Paris, but you can't mind living "out of your suitcase".
text:
We  had just finished a cruise where our cabin was maybe 2 feet longer but where we could unpack completely.  It was a rude shock to be in a room where the storage was horribly organized (a couple of shelves, no drawers  and  hanging space was hard to get at) so  we had to be either contortionists or live out of our suitcases.  We got over it by reminding ourselves that that's usually the way it is when visiting family.
          Otherwise it was lovely.  The bed was comfortable.  The room lighting was much better than average hotel room lighting.  The bathroom was well arranged and nicely appointed, the shower was terrific, the robes they provided were excellent.    The staff couldn't have been nicer.  The breakfast selection and the coffee were unusually good.  The location relative to the subway, patisserie, groceries, restaurants was great.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Non smoking hotel in great Marais location
text: Loved my fresh fluffy pillows and new smelling bed and new bathroom. Very friendly helpful staff. Fabulous location.loved the French restaurants, bakery and grocery right on my picturesque charming block. And beautiful 10 min walk to river and 10 min to metro.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great location in the Marais
text:
Friendly front office staff, spoke multiple languages and helped me print museum tickets!
Central location in the Marais near Place des Vosges and metro line 1.
Room small but well appointed and good daily service. Breakfast was ample. GREAT Italian restaurant just across the street!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Really good localization and comfortable. Friendly staff.
text:
Really good localization pretty closer nice bars, restaurants, bakery and supermarkets. 
Comfortable room. 
Friendly staff.
We haven’t tried breakfast since it wasn’t included. 
WiFi signal was Acceptable despite of sometimes we had poor quality.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Paris Hotel in Marais
text: Well situated hotel with friendly staff and comfortable rooms.  Always enjoy Paris and the Marais and we are happy staying at this particular hotel near good restaurants and not too far from main avenues
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Amazing boutique hotel in a fabulous neighborhood., very lively.
text: Excellent staff, cozy hotel, great price for the rooms,  amazing breakfast.  I will never stay anywhere else. Just refurbished 2018. The staff will help you find restaurants; tours, suggest where to go. Etc etc  always willing to help you to make your stay unforgetable
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Poor value for money
text: I chose Turenne le Marais because of its good rating on Booking.com. I was sadly very disappointed. My room was tiny, slightly bigger than the double bed and it was very hot in the room, even when they turned the heating off. There was no ventilation and no way to sleep with the window open because of the noise from the street. The carpet was old, discoloured, and didn't look so clean. There are better hotels in the neighbourhood for the price. The only highlight was Rosa, at the front desk, who was lovely and tried what she could to accommodate me.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Can't beat friendliness or position
text: If for you, a successful visit to Paris requires plenty of time spent in the Marais, this is an excellent hotel. A minute's walk  from the Rue Francs Bourgeois, a minute from the Rue St Antoine and a minute and a half from the Place des Vosges, rooms are spacious for hotels in the area, staff are lovely and access to the hotel and the rooms pretty straightforward. Prices are spot on for this class of hotel.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Comfortable friendly hotel in a great location
text:
This was a lovely hotel, friendly staff and great location  Don't miss out on the local area, full of interesting places.. Hotel sully, place de vosges.
 carette cafe on the place de vosges should not be missed, a beautiful experience in coffee, hot chocolate  etc.. Boats on canal at Arsenal, cross the river and follow to park beside Sorbonne .. Beautiful
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent little hotel in the Marais, an excellent area to stay in
text: This hotel appears to have been recently renovated.  My room, small as they all are in Paris, was very well appointed, spotless, a very good shower and all the amenities.  The staff were excellent and very helpful.  The area is perfect.  Very close to the St. Paul Metro stop and all the restaurants and shops in Place des Vosges and Rue Saint Antoine.  I've stayed in other three star hotels in the area and this one is, by far, the best.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great place to stay for a short weekend
text:
This is a good place to base yourself for a weekend in Paris.  Close to Metro and connections to the centre.  This is my favourite area of the city  and i keep coming back. 
Some excellent restaurants near - Bofinger never disappoints.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent hotel
text: Perfect location. The staff was welcoming and very friendly. Hotel and our room was very clean. Also really confortable bed and quiet place at night.We enjoyed our stay and we recommend it to everyone visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Small, but Grand
text:
Every staff person was a genuine "person"--no robots. But even better, real individuals. Each one was interested and interesting enough to have real conversations, and to put up with my bad French. 
From the excellent woman who cared for my room, to all the competent front desk staff, every one of them cared enough to know about me: the gallery show and all that was important, giving feedback on attire (when asked), finding a doctor and being concerned about my welfare, each person created a uniquely comfortable atmosphere.
I would definitely return.

Rooms are small, but it's Paris and the Marais. I've never had a huge one.
Food was plentiful. Coffee and croissants in the afternoon was a civilized, unexpected surprise.

This is a good, safe, warm, and inviting place to stay. The staff are above and beyond "doing a job"...yes, they are real people.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Really nice!
text: The hotel is located near metro stations and good restaurants. The staff is friendly and helpful, and the breakfast is great. If you want to stay in a good hotel in Le Marais, I definitely recommend it!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: 2 days trip in Paris
text:
It was our first time in Paris. The hotel was  really clean and our room was quite big. Worth the money.  Central location, really easy to travel around Paris. Friendly and nice staff.
I Recommend it!!!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Lovely stay
text:
Room was small for 2 people but the staff and the cleanliness of the hotel made up for it, as well as the great position in Le Marais.

The hotel is very close to the popular quint road Rue de Rosiers, as well as the metro station for Le Marais. 

We would definitely stay there again when we return to Paris.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Warm, Comfy and Quiet. Excellent Location
text: The kind of efficiency, cleanliness and services you apreciate when you are abroad in a business trip.Excellent Location in the beautiful Paris. Thank you to all the staff for their help and .... their GENTILLESSE!!!!!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Almost perfect hotel at a perfect location
text: The staff of the hotel is extremely friendly and really makes you feel welkom. I came with my 76 years old mother and she really felt at home in the hotel. The location is just perfect. There are nice shops and restaurants around the hotel.We also loved the breakfast. Especially the big choice of good french cheeses.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great Place to Stay in Le Marais District
text: If you are traveling alone or with your partner and are looking for a nice affordable room in the Paris' Le Marais district this is the place to stay.  The room I stayed in was small, but nicely layed-out - but I was traveling alone, and there may be larger accommodations.  The friendly staff made the stay even more enjoyable.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Mother & Son holiday
text:
Location Location Location
The hotel is in the 4e walking distance to everything. Two great restaurants in front, all you need is steps away. Hotel is old, decor old, carpet old, rooms are small, but great hotel. Helpful friendly staff, good breakfast,clean,reasonable pricing. We enjoyed our stay at Hotel Turenne Le Marais and would definately stay there again. I do feel that they should invest in some renovation, eg new carpets, paint.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Perfect area in Paris, at a nice, clean and friendly hotel.
text:
Hotel Turenne Le Marais

Paris

Perfect area in Paris, at a nice, clean and friendly hotel.

621299816

My mother, brother and I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. We shared a family room with three single beds (two of them twin beds). The size of the room was OK, but maybe a bit small for 3 grown up persons. The beds were quite narrow, but very comfortable. 

We stayed in room 207, which had a view over rue de Turennes. The street was quite quiet at night. 

Great with an elevator for heavy luggage. 

Small but OK TV, electric kettle and coffee (powder) and milk (powder) in the room. New supplies every morning. Minibar with a small selection of beverages. Nice to have a fridge for storing water and other beverages/food. Breakfast was a bit expensive 18 eur/person/night but decided to have breakfast at different cafés in the neighbourhood.

The room was nicely made up every day before we returned to the hotel, about 2 PM. 

Le Marais is a really nice part of town with all its cafés, shops and restaurants. It is also easy to get around Paris, as the nearest metro stop St. Paul is connected with many of the main lines, not very many stops away.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Lovely Stay in the heart of Paris away from crowd
text: If you plan to stay in le Marias, this is a lovely Parisian style hotel. Obvioulsy in Paris do not expect big rooms or hotel lobby. So this small little gives you a flavour of Parisin city centre apartments. The staff is very helpful.  Always opt for rooms with windows if you can.I loved my stay here. Thank you Hotel turrene le maarais
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Good place to stay
text: Staff was friendly. Great location. A good place to stay in Paris. Very comfterbule bed & fantastic shower with bathtub. I have to use 200 characters but don’t know what else to say. It was a good place.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Excellent stay at great price!
text: This quaint little hotel proved to be the perfect base for a 4 day Paris visit.  Close enough to walk to almost everything - the metro, the trains, and many sites. And still very quiet and comfortable.  Rooms are small, but extremely clean and efficient.  Fadila and the entire staff are very friendly and knowledgeable about all things Paris!  Our new favorite Paris home away from home!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Terrific Honeymoon Spot
text: We stayed for 6 nights at the Hotel Turenne La Marais. Clean, beautiful, and quiet. Within 1000 feet if the Saint Paul Metro Station, it was centrally located for virtually every Possible day trip. Breakfast is available and there are numerous cafes, bakaries, and restaurants within a few blocks. Whenever we stay in Paris , from now on, it will be at the Hotel Turenne La Marais!
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great hotel
text: We enjoyed our stay at Hotel Turenne Le Marais.  The hotel itself is clean, modern and efficient.  They offer a decent buffet breakfast for €14 with lots of healthy options in case you want a break from cafes and croissants.  Our triple room facing the street was very nice.  Two singles in one room with TV and a single in a separate room with a door and TV.  The bathroom was modern and spacious. The 24-hour reception desk was always very pleasant and extremely helpful.  The location is great: close to shopping, dining options, supermarkets, small markets and transpo options. I will agree with others that the carpet is quite worn and not that clean.  Hopefully they will fix that soon, given all the comments about that. The shower water pressure and the WiFi reception were excellent. And the beds were very comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Great Hotel Fantastic Location
text: Just returned from a 4 night stay at this hotel.  It was recommended to me due to its location.  It is only metres from the Metro and is surrounded by many excellent bars and restaurants,  Only 4 stops to the Louvre and 10 mins walk to Notre Dame  Only drawback is the bathroom is tiny  never had one this small before but in the city space is at a premium
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Weekend break in August
text: School holidays until end of month in Paris, so good time to visit. All sites open, and only smaller businesses appear to be closed. Buy Metro tickets in set of ten. One ticket valid all over city by metro, bus or local train for a single journey, but journey ends if you leave the system - don't leave metro station to change route!Most museums closed on Mondays, but free on first Sunday of month (therefore can be very busy).
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Warm hospitality
text: Facility and location is really good. All the staff are very kind and helpful with warm hospitality. hotel is located in narrow street. so very silent in night time. location is close to metro station.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Nice and easy place to stay
text: While the room was tiny it was new, modern, comfortable, nicely decorated and perfectly clean. The area has a range of fantastic restaurants, not just the touristy bistrots that you see throughout Paris. Very very close to two different metro station and an easy stroll to the Seine. Thanks for having us.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Welcoming and great location
text: Easy get to from metro and well located with good restaurants, parks on its doorstep. Would request a room looking out over the street so you can watch the world go by. Rooms small but big enough and the rainfall showers are amazing. Helpful staff would go again.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Very friendly and fluent English
text:
Great Location for walking to Notre Dame, Pompidou. They also arranged a taxi to the airport!

Shopping (SHOES!!) and convenience stores nearby for snacks and drinks for your day.

Watch your taxi to the place, though. Our taxi from the train station doubled the trip length so make it clear that you are mapping the trip, too.
name: Hotel Turenne Le Marais

title: Central, clean, and comfortable hotel with friendly staff
text: Comfortable and clean boutique hotel in the center of Monmarte. The staff are extremely friendly and accommodating. Good price compared to other hotels in area. The only negative were the black walls and ceiling as it made the lighting bad in the room to do any makeup etc.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Good location, but disappointing
text: Good location, great staff. Room was tiny and not worth the cost. Was woken up by cleaning staff chatting outside our room. I wouldn’t stay again unless I was going alone - maybe. The terrace was much smaller than expected too, so overall was disappointing.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Eugène needs a little more effort
text: Very convenient location, the check-in depends very much on who is at the desk. Some are outstanding, some are frustrating. The hotel is cozy, rooms are nice, but there should be again a fridge in the room, for the price. Breakfast is good, but again, plates, glassware and table setting is a little improvised. You often need to ask the staff to bring what is missing, and somehow they do not seem to notice it on their own. Also, you should not start cleaning the breakfast area while clients are still having breakfast (and time was not over). Overall, a nice hotel, but either you upgrade the quality of staff, or you lower the rates.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: A delightful stay. Highly recommended.
text: Quirky, I loved the decor. Staff were very friendly. Comfortable & clean. We booked Breakfast & it was good. Easy to get from the station to hotel and easy to get around, a very short walk to Monmarte & the Big Bus Tour stop. The terrace was a favourite for us. Highly recommend …  A first trip to Paris, it won’t be our last.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: An excellent place in Paris!
text: I spent five nights at Hotel Eugene en Ville and had the most delightful experience from the moment I arrived, until my departure. The front-desk staff and room-maintenance were friendly, courteous and efficient. My room had a private full-size terrace where free-of-charge breakfast was delivered on time each morning. The terrace added to the charm and spaciousness of the room. Daily room-maintenance and overall cleanliness throughout the premises was excellent, with careful attention to restocking amenities. The location cannot be better, within walking distance to L'Opera, major landmarks, neighborhoods, shopping and transportation. In spite of many restaurants and locales in the immediate area, the soundproof rooms were quiet at night. I will definitely choose Hotel Eugene en Ville for my next stay in Paris and I recommend it highly to anyone looking for a comfortable and very nice hotel. Thank you Hotel Eugene en Ville! Merci beaucoup!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very nice hotel
text:
Very friendly staff, nice small hotel . Room was very silent even in a city full of traffic . .  We liked very much the interior 
We did not take the breakfast formule but it looked very ok  .
we will come back!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Business and leisure stay in Paris
text: I have chosen the hotel because I know the area and I wanted to be in 9th arr. Perfect location for business and leisure. The hotel staff is very helpful and friendly ! I will definitely choose the hotel for my next stay in Paris.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel
text: The hotel is a nice cosy hotel with excellent and friendly staff, willing to help you in anyway they can. Rooms are clean and well kept, the hotel is close to the center and metro station is just 30meter away. Will come back for sure.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: A perfect find!
text: We loved our stay. It’s comfortable clean beautiful and well located. Staff were always nice and helpful with any questions about Paris. Especially Elizabeth! The entrance is secure. The restaurant is lovely and chic. We often had our breakfast here. There are plenty of great shops on rue Cadet for croissants wines salamis and cheeses. Eat at Lorette & les garçons for dinner.  Easy walk from hotel. Great recommendations again! I felt really pleased with our experience at Eugene en Ville and hope to be back!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Excellent stay, centrally located, great staff
text: Great hotel, approx 1 mile from Lourve and 1 mile from Montmartre, we walked everywhere but only a stones throw from the metro. If you don't plan on partying ask for a quiet room. We hadn't realised some rooms face onto the Main Street however we were able to move rooms the next day no problem, the staff are really great and couldn't of don't more for us! Would definitely stay again
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Good hotel worth to recommend
text: Good hotel located verder central. Nice room with almost all facilities. Enjoyed the balcony. Good breakfast, nice helpfull staff. Only downside: instant Coffee in a superior room is a little bit strange.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Centrally located, good breakfast
text:
Very nice staff, stylish hotel even though a bit too black.
Good breakfast with international ingedients.
Well located between 2 metro stations
Cleaning could be improved
Breakfast room is too small when the hotel is fully booked, nice patio could be used for breakfast tables as well.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: sound insulation equal to zero
text: the sound insulation of the windows equal to zero, there is a bar in the street, we spent two abominable nights.  the stuff was accommodating, the breakfast was good, the hotel ist centrally located. Too bad.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel in a great location! The staff is welcoming and charming, rooms have character and breakfast was delicious! It is very well connected (metro is 2 mins walk and buses take you everywhere). I'll be back!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Lovely stay at Eugene!
text:
Lovely hotel;  large room, special for French understanding....and very good breakfast. 
Service is very good.  Only the sink in bedroom is too small; everything gets wet..... Also at the door of the shower.......  the floor gets wet.  The hotel is very good located. Close to metrostations.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel
text: Great hotel and location. Very comfortable bed. Good breakfast. I loved the decoration!! Helpful and professional staff ! As the hotel is very central, the rooms on the streets are very noisy: request a quiet room at the back of the building! I will come back !
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Fantastic
text: The room was amazing and very clean. When we got in to the room there were rose petals and we ordered a bottle of champagne. The breakfast had everything that it needed. For Dutch people was the cheese cut into big pieces. all the staff spoke good english on all bases and helped us very well! We were really happy with the hotel and the location was perfect
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Cool place to stay
text:
Great location,near to Mounmarthe, Shopping centre Lafayette so it’s cool when you love shopping;),  tasty breakfast, friendly stuff and very helpful, I'll be back there for sure :) 
I like the design of this hotel ;)
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Friendly, comfortable, quiet and well located.
text:
We loved our stay at Hoetl Eugene en Ville. A very warm welcome on arrival. Comfortable, clean and quiet room. Great location an easy walk from Gare du Nord and in an area buzzing with local shops, cafes and felt very must an authentic taste of Paris. 
Would highly recommend and will return.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Paris in November
text:
Stayed here for a short break with my friend. The location is great as we came in on the Eurostar and were able to walk to most of the main tourist attractions or hop on the metro.  Lots of restaurants and bars near by too. 
We were slightly disappointed that they did not provide robes or slippers in the room. However, the beds were the most comfortable we have ever slept on and the shower was excellent too.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Belated to trip to Paris
text: At last managed our trip to Paris to celebrate a big birthday. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel is excellent. Continental breakfast was good and plentiful. It was the perfect hotel for a long weekend.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Wonderful
text: Everything was wonderful. Staff was so friendly, room was clean and comfortable, and breakfast was delicious with a lot of options (organic, veggie friendly). I would recommend this hotel to family and friends. Thank you for our stay!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Good but..
text:
I booked a triple room with my cousins, they had a really nice room but I had to sleep on a folding bed in the bathroom. Thats not nice with the privacy and humanity. The bed also creaked a lot. There was also very bad light, it was impossible to put make up on. 

I will recommended this hotel but not the triple rooms.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Stylish Hotel in bustling neigbourhood
text: Very warm welcome and the possibility to move into our room already at 12.30 pm. Very helpful and friendly staff. The room was really calm, facing the inner yard. Nice interior, enough space, separated toilet from bathroom. Big bed but a bit hard mattress.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Nice small hotel at an excellent location
text:
Clean, with a nice design and an excellent location. You're within a reasonable walking distance3 from Les Grands magasins and a nice walk awa from Le Louvre.

Don't expect luxury, but you will get excellent quality for your money.

Very comfortable beds.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: a good choice
text: a good and richt choice for up to 1 week in Paris. Very bright choice of differnt restaurants. Very good location to public transport and many touristicks plaes. The quolity of the breacfast was a very suprised!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: loved it
text: Location was great,near Gare du Nord. Loved the comfortable and clean room and staff was extremely helpful with directions around the city as well as other things that came up. Would definitely recommend and plan to visit again
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great Hotel at reasonable price in attractive location
text: Good experience: very clean, attentive service, excellent breakfast. Room was comfortable (bed, bathroom, equipment). Quarter is safe, also at night and has a lots of good restaurants nearby. Nice bar in the hotel. Absolutely recommendable!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: stylish and elegant boutique hotel with perfect location
text:
Hotel with perfect location, stylish, elegant rooms and a
on top a colorful breakfast served in the morning. As in many hotels, the shower function was difficult to understand. The internet connection was good and the staff very friendly and helpful. In all a full 5 star boutique hotel.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel!
text:
Wonderful hotel in the heart of Paris. Within walking (or cycling!) distance of many of the major attractions. The neighborhood itself is lively with some great bars and restaurants. 
Good breakfast, comfortable rooms and a friendly staff. Highly recommended!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Good location, very Cleaner, trendy and a very good breakfast
text: We have been in August 2020 in paris. 4 adults, 2 Rooms. The Design is trendy, tbe location is perfekt. 100 m to the metrostation. Although we habe been there in corona times, the Breakfast was very good. It was delivered to the Room to the chosen timeslot. Thank for a nice stay!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Poor comfort in reality
text: We chose the hotel because the concept looked interesting - black walls with gold details and this spacious rooftop terrace, perfect for hot days. Once you arrive, the entry area and hallway is nakedly designed. Nothing really welcoming - except the staff. They we're friendly and their English was good. But when we asked them if someone helps with our bags, they refused *because of covid`. So washing your hands or wearing gloves is no option? Secondly our room was really small and REALLY dark. Not really a chance for sunlight. We stayed for two nights, so I asked for a better room, "but they were all booked". Now the cleanliness: Overall okay, but when you looked closely not. Stains on the toilet seat and dirty coffee cups. They only had instant coffee in the rooms and no fridge. They also forgot to place a towel for a second person. AND worst if you're on a business trip - WIFI didn't work/poorly work. When I gave my feedback during the stay and even at checkout they could see, that we were not happy (btw, the terrace is not accessible, so it was 3 days this dark room with no light concept) and gave me cheeky 20 euros reduction. First and last time there.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Comfy hotel with great location
text: This great hotel with nice staff is very well located. It is very near to the metro and city center. It has comfortable beds and styled rooms. The breakfast is tasty and very good selection. The atrium is very enjoyable.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Gem of a hotel in a perfect location.
text: Lovely hotel. Fantastic staff. Great breakfast, Very fresh & lots of choice. Comfy bed, very clean room. Loved how quiet it was. Best night's sleep in a Paris hotel ever! Decor is very quirky & striking. A bit darker than other hotels but it just adds to the style. Bar area is perfect.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Romantic and great location
text:
I booked this hotel through secret escapes and it was fantastic. 

The hotel decor is very gothic, dark and romantic. I am not sure if all the rooms are like this but the only thing that might be an issue for other travellers is that the shower is not separate to the bedroom - we didn’t mind as we were travelling as a couple but if you are staying at this hotel and sharing with friends then you will have an issue with privacy.

The room was also small but we also didn’t mind too much as we were in Paris to explore the city. 

The hotel was clean, staff were friendly and it was an excellent location.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Hotel Eugene in Paris
text:
an excellent team, especially the Italian and French ladies who welcomed me and looked after me while i was there. I am sorry but I dint have their names unfortunately. .

The bedroom was great, breakfast too.

A very nice staff !
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Excellent Boutique Hotel in Great Location
text: Lovely boutique hotel in great location near the nice department stores, Galeries Lafayette and not far from main attractions.  Breakfast was very good with fair amount of choice and options.  Bedrooms were little small but not bad for Paris.  Everything clean and lovely with large bed.  Only downside for us was the lighting in the room was so poor and the decor was very dark so overall getting ready to go out was difficult.  Would go back as good value and good location.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Absolute gem 💎
text: Loved our stay, the rooms were the right size and well soundproofed plus beds were extremely comfortable (the blackout curtains were a great touch). We celebrated our 5 year anniversary and the staff made sure our stay was special. A huge thank you Camille who always welcomed us with a warm smile and nothing was a big ask for her. She did an excellent job throughout our whole stay. Couldn’t thank her enough.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: The Staff are amazing
text: Excellent location, cleanliness, and comfort but above all the two ladies on reception really helped support me when my phone was stolen at Gare Du Nord, they went above and beyond to show kindness and help me with the practicalities of being shaken, alone & without contacts. They make the hotel shine.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel!  Clean, comfy, nice decor, great balcony!
text:
I stayed for a business trip and loved the easy, access to both train stations.  The hotel is on a quiet side street and my room had a lovely, sunny southern exposure with a large patio.  The bed and linens were very comfortable, as well as the pillows.  Breakfast was great.  Two minor suggestions: lower the volume of the music in the hallways; lower the price of a late check-out (50euros for 2 extra hours is a lot).

Overall, this is one of the best hotels I have stayed in in Paris and I will stay here again!  Great for business travellers.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Fantastic Hotel
text:
We read the reviews and chose this hotel on that basis. We were not disappointed. Super clean, great location and simply wonderful staff at reception.

15 minute walk from Gare de Nord and 30 minutes to Place de la Concorde (we like walking!).

We have no hesitation recommending this hotel.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very good
text: Recommended for business and pleasure. Very good location, stylish environment, friendly staff. The rooms tend to be quite dark, but not too small. Overall a pleasant experience, with some small improvements could become top.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Family visit to Paris
text:
We stayed at Hotel Eugene en Ville for 11 days and we loved the hotel. Our rooms were spacious, nicely furnished and had interesting wall coverings.
The breakfast has a good variety of choices and the grapefruit juice was a winner. We could walk from the Hotel to all the famous landmarks and there are a lot of places to eat at in the area.
The staff were friendly and helpful and accommodated us when our flight landed earlier than indicated.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great location and staff, not so great room
text: First and for most, I would like to emphasize that staff of this hotel was amazing.  Every one at the front desk was really great.  Location of the hotel is really great as well, you are within walking distance to most attractions.  My issues are more with the quality of the room that I received.  I stayed in room 302 (i am pointing it out as I realize that every room in this hotel is different).   I suspect this is probably worse room in the hotel.  It is the darkest room.   I haven't seen anything darker than this room. However, the major issue is shower, the shower in this room is not enclosed so you have water all over your bathroom whenever you take shower.  It is ridiculous why would anyone design shower facilities in such way. Also, hotel claims to be 4 stars but considering the shower, no refrigerator in the room, the safe is very small and practically useless, there is a very small closet where you can put only 3 items at most and you need to ask for most things.  Furthermore, every morning (around 6 to 7 am) as the kitchen starts working, we got all the cooking smell coming into our room (our friends who stayed in same hotel but different room didn't have this issue with the smell).  If you are sensitive to smell, that would be an issue.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Not the best Experience
text:
To be honest what I liked about the hotel is the location as it's near to most key places , room design is good looks Parisian
What i didn't like : room was extremely small , breakfast isn't good, we saw a rat in the restaurant downstairs during the new year's eve ! I informed the gentleman at the reception, he took it super easy as if there's nothing happened !
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: A lady in Paris
text: Wonderful hotel , great location and really friendly staff . The hotel could not do enough for you . I was offered a complimentary cheese board  and bottle of wine as it was a winter offer .  The breakfast was very tasty too . Lots of variation.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Amazing Hotel
text:
we stayed at this Hotel in the Christmas holidays, the staff was always nice and helpful, the hotel is in a perfect location to see all the main attractions of Paris, it is clean, tidy and comfortable.
When we return to Paris we would be happy to return to stay here. recommended.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great location
text:
Very economy as a 4 star hotel but:
Great location.
So close to the metro station.
So close to lafayette gallery by 10 min walk.
Near to opera.
Very freindly staff and so responsible.
But:
There was a terrible smell inside the hotel all the time, ( at the elevator, hall,and even at the room).
 no fridge inside the room.
Very very small room.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great Hospitality
text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our short stay.  Decorated for the holidays, the property is beautiful.  The staff was exceptional,  assisting us in obtaining transportation in the wake of a transit strike.  Also the dining, starting with an evening reception, room service. and a buffet breakfast was outstanding and reasonably priced.  All and all a great experience.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great Stay
text: Stayed at this hotel and it was a very pleasant experience . We had a deal with Secret Escapes so our room was probably one of the smallest but adequate for a weekend . Staff were very friendly and breakfast was exceptional. Will gladly stop here on our next trip to Paris.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Four nights in Paris
text:
We literally used this hotel as a base for four days in Paris. 
Great location - we clocked up over 100,000 steps during our stay. But near to the Metro too if you prefer.
The hotel is modern and staff are attentive and friendly. They always pass the time of day and offered us umbrellas when it rained. We loved the complimentary bottle of wine in the bar on the first night. 
We didn’t eat in the hotel. 
The room was cosy and the bed was comfortable. The room was cleaned, bed made and fresh towels every day. 
We would stay again. Thank you.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Would definitely recommend
text:
I am a seasoned traveller and pretty high maintenance when it comes to hotels and Eugene en Ville did not disappoint.  We stayed 2 nights in October,  had a lovely cosy little room at the end of the corridor on the second floor.  It looked out on the courtyard so was very quiet.  It's the first time in many years that we stayed in the centre of Paris and slept through the night.  There was no noise whatsoever! 
The room was cosy,  bathroom well appointed and lots of small touches.  
The only area for improvement is the light.  I found this room very dark and this included the bathroom.  Very difficult to do make-up in dim light! 
Overall the staff were very friendly and helpful and we would definitely come back!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Comfortable hotel
text:
Friendly helpful and responsive staff.
Quiet comfortable room.
Good that one can order things like an iron and ironing board online in advance.
The room was on the small side, but I guess that’s normal for Paris.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: We had 2 nights in this hotel, it was clean, lovely decor, fabulous staff, delicious breakfast, and fantastic location. Would highly recommend. We got a great deal on Groupon UK so it was a lot cheaper than the standard rates (which are up there!) including breakfast so if you can find a deal, book this place! Best bathroom we have ever had in a hotel, the shower is superb.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel in the 9th arrondisement
text:
Really pleased to have found this hotel, we often stay in Paris and this is amongst the best hotels we’ve found.

A short walk or taxi from Gare du Nord, the 9th is a really good spot to explore and wander around Paris. Quiet, but close to everywhere you need to go.

We had a superior room with a great terrace (not a balcony, but a large terrace). It’s worth paying more for this. Good breakfast for French standards, small rooms but again for Paris, not too small. Well designed, good linen, shower and toiletries. Very friendly staff.

Definitely will be returning.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Visiting
text: We booked a weekend here to visit our daughter in Paris. The hotel is well situated for the metro for connections to Gard de Nord station and Charles de Gaulle airport and close to the centre of Paris. We found the staff friendly and helpful and the complimentary cocktail on arrival most welcome. The hotels decor is quite unusual in a black and gothic style but we had a very nice stay.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: This is an awesome place! Well situated and close to everything.
text: Best staff in the world! Fine little hotel within walking distance to all major sites. Uber is johnny on the spot from here. Seriously good restaurants all around. Really close to Montmartre. Nice kitchen and bar. Rooms very clean. I love it and will stay again!
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Gorgeous
text: Stayed here for 4 nights. Fantastic hotel. Clean, quirky, friendly. Nothing was too much trouble. Great location too, far enough away from the bustle to be reasonably priced but a 15 min walk to the Louvre. Will be going back at some point.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Perfect Stay
text: We stayed for three nights and I couldn;t have asked for a better hotel. Beautiful decor, great room, comfiest bed I've had in a hotel, great price, great breakfast, great staff. The list is endless. Next time we're in Paris there is no doubt we'll be staying here.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Nice hotel, small rooms
text: The property is located in a convenient location near the metro stations and the train station. The staff were overall very professional and attentive to all my needs. I also liked all the small details, from the fortune cookies to the complimentary water. However, the rooms are tiny! The breakfast buffet is delicious but there isn’t a lot of variety, hence I got tired of the same food after day 2
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Fab hotel in a great location.
text:
We stayed 2 nights from 01-08-2019 to 03-08-2019 as a party of 12. Check in was easy, staff at reception were great, answered all our questions and were really helpful.  

We arrived early and only one of the rooms was ready, so the others sat and relaxed in the lounge.

We had 4 separate rooms, one of which was a family room, which had a tv, kettle, tea/coffee etc. 

We had a twin room with a cot. The room was a bit cosy but was fine. Quiet which was great. The only odd thing and the others had the same was that there was no privacy to the bathroom, it just had the shower screen or glass door which you could look in to. Wasn’t ideal but especially not for my sister who has three boys and they had to be sent in to the adjoining room and have the door closed. The lighting could also have been a bit brighter. 

Considering it’s a small hotel the breakfast was lovely and had a good selection. The croissants, pain au chocolate and pain au raisin were absolutely delicious and freshly baked. You could make your own boiled eggs and a timer was provided, fresh bread, scrambled eggs, cheese, fruit compote, yogurts, fresh orange juice, coffee machine where you could have your latte, cappuccino etc.

Great location, only 10 minutes, if that, by uber from Gard du Nord. Peletier metro about a 5 minute walk and Grand Boulevard metro about a 10 minute walk to the main road where there are shops, book shops, cafes and restaurants. As you come out of the hotel, whether you go left or right, there are plenty of eateries, pharmacies and a supermarket. 

Overall we had a great stay. Quirky little touches all over the hotel from the decor to the layout which makes it really unique. 

Service was excellent and the staff were really lovely. I would definitely come back here.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel on a good location
text: A reallyu good independant hotel. Not corporate but that's a positive - the team were really welcoming and efficient. Breakfast is very good - a great choice and very good quality. The rooms are comfortable and clean. Great location for Montmatre/Sacre Couer and the stations Gare du Nord and L'est.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Worth it
text: Absolutely loved my stay here. Excellent service. Beautiful dark Victorian decor. Rooms are small, but very comfortable. The only problem was the charging outlet in there. Would have been wise of me to have taken a charger that would connect to their outlets. The one they have for any USB cable did not work well. The closet is small; enough to hang about four shirts, and place two pair of shoes on the shelf. I would love to stay here again on my next trip to Paris.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: The Best!
text:
The staff and accommodations at the Eugene are top notch. We stayed for 7 nights and we were treated as of part of the family. The staff is personable and are eager to ensure your stay is relaxing and pleasurable. A special shout out of Eduardo, the front desk manager, who is very friendly and accommodating and will assist you with whatever you need. 5 stars across the board!

part of the
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very good for bussiness trip
text:
- small comfortable hotel in city centre
- perfect for short stay, eg bussines trip
- rooms are clean and well equipt 
- hotel service very helpfull and speaks english very well
- very good breakfast!!!!
- maybe rooms may be a bit bigger
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Ingrid
text: we enjoyed the stay in the hotel; the staff is very friendly, professional  and helpful; the rooms a very clean, good breakfast; good connection to the Metro and hotel is close to the center; we will come back;
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Average at best
text: Overall just average definitely better hotels with much better service in Paris. Check in was a nightmare they have a written sheet so old school and not very focused on data privacy. I did not like that other guests could see this list. Breakfast order came wrong and when I rang to reception it seemed like an inconvenience to them that I’d complained it was wrong! Rooms are very basic and cleanliness is not what you would expect. I wouldn’t stay again.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Excellent stay
text:
We booked this hotel last minute for 3 nights to extend a trip to Paris. 
Excellent service, very good location, close to buses and metro and within walking distance to a lot of tourist destinations in Paris. 
We had a superior room with terrace. The room itself was on the small size, typical for this part of the world, very well appointed, efficient and beautifully designed. Very comfortable bed, clean and well equipped bathroom with an excellent working shower, the toilet was separated from the bathroom, a plus for us. 
Breakfast was plentiful, local fresh produce and very good coffee and teas. 
Fully furnished terrace, as big as the room, a lot of plants to provide shades where we enjoyed some good wine from the bar or even breakfast in the morning. 
Friendly , knowledgeable front desk, fluently speaking English. 
Highly recommend it for service, location and beautiful amenities.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very Enjoyable Stay
text: We have previously stayed at this hotel and chose it again for our recent trip to Paris. The hotel is very clean and comfortable with extremely pleasant and helpful staff. Our room was smaller than previous but was big enough for the three nights we stayed. We had the usual amenities, toiletries, tea, coffee, bottled water, safe box etc. Shower was really good and AC very welcome as Paris has just been extremely hot. Metro at the top of the street, good restaurants and some bars nearby. Thanks to all at Eugene en Ville for a lovely stay.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Lovely 🖤
text: Me & my mom stayed here for 2 nights. Was an amazing short trip. Hotel very nice & clean & great decor, the women on reception were great & so friendly & helped us with our map getting around Paris. Hotel in a great spot & very close to metro so could get to all tourist places very quickly. Great bars nearby. Would recommend this hotel. 🖤
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Wonderful Stay; Wonderful Staff
text: We stayed for four nights and it was great. In the 9th within just a few minutes walk of multiple Metro lines and flanked by a street filled with multiple restaurants and cafes. Walkable to most parts of Paris if you are a walker as we are. The staff was wonderful and the room was spotless.. We decided to get the room with more space and that was the right decision. Would definitely stay here again as it was a great location.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very Good
text:
Great location, really pleasant Hotel, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay are the staff. 
All the people are incredibly helpful,  and i want to highlight the front office manager, Mr Pedro Gonçalves, which was always very available and made this experience very positive for me.
I'm sure I'll come back.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: A breathtaking experience
text: My partner and I stayed here recently to tour Paris and our stay was nothing short of excellent. Our room with a terrace was lovely, with many amenities missing in most modern hotels: free mineral water, fresh juice and various vanity products. It was so nice in fact we got engaged on the terrace and enjoyed an excellent bottle of champagne from the hotel bar. This hotel oozes quality and comfort, especially the staff. I’ve stayed in nearly one hundred 4 and 5 star hotels in Europe and never experienced such attentiveness and warmth. All with a great location and price.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Lovely stylish hotel in bustling area
text:
We visited this hotel for a long weekend and were charmed by its style and the friendly staff. The room was extremely spacious with a large kingsize bed and a roomy wardrobe. There were plenty of charging sockets and a good quality hairdryer. The shower and sink were situated in one area of the room with a curtain that you could pull across if you wanted, the shower was an incredible walk-in rainshower style shower and the provided toiletries were very high quality. We were given plenty of sparkling white towels on a hot towel rail. 
The room itself was stylishly decorated and felt very luxurious.
The local area is buzzing with cool cafes and shops and the hotel is a 2 min walk from a metro stop if you wish to get to the centre more quickly. 
The staff were all very friendly and polite and helpful.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Great hotel!
text: Really great hotel, with friendly staff and nice size rooms! The bed are so comfortable - it is my default hotel for business in Paris! I would not stay anywhere else in Paris unless this hotel was fully booked
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Weekend  in Épernay
text:
Great hotel, location is perfect. 
You can walk to Moet & Chandon Château, and also to downtown to sightseeing and to eat.
A little expansive for what is offered.
Good swimming pool tempered water)...the staff is really good at making you feel at home..
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Best price for the best star hotel
text:
I almost do not want to recommend this so that i can keep this gem for myself. We liked the hotel although the room is rather small. But small rooms are a known Paris 'feature'. 

We were in room 502 for 5 nights. The air-con did not worked for us. We didn't call to get it fixed because we simply just open the window and let the cold air in but i reckon that this would be a problem in summer. I wish that the sink table is flushed against the wall (like the small study desk) because that would instantly make the room bigger with a bigger walking space.Love the heated towel rack. The shower is very clean. This bathroom is just separated by curtains. So if you are with friends, it does not offer much 'privacy'.

Breakfast is 16 euro if you didn't include it into your room. There are many eatery around so you don't have to worry about food. The location is very convenient. You can walk to the Louvre in 20 mins.

The reception is modern and staff are young, helpful and friendly. This place is an overall gem and i would stay here again :)
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Nice little hotel
text: Very good location, walkable from Gare du Nord and walkable to the Louvre, Tuileries, Galleries Lafayette. Staff when we arrived in early evening were very friendly, spoke excellent English, check in was quick and good elevator service to our third floor room. Room was quite tiny even by Paris standards but had a beautiful terrace that was actually larger than the room :) Sadly it rained the two nights, one day we were there as we were looking forward to eating breakfast out there. Although room was tiny, bed was extremely comfortable, firm, as we like it. Toilet is separate from shower room which we have noticed is common in a few modern Paris hotels. Very good shower, plenty of shower gel and shampoo. Basin is quite shallow but all very modern and the heated towel rail was nice as we needed to dry out some things after being soaked in the rain. Complimentary bottle of water and I think the bottle of wine might have been complimentary but as we don’t drink alcohol, I didn’t ask. Breakfast was excellent. It was complimentary to us as an upgrade, normal cost was €16-00. Several restaurants nearby. Would recommend for short stay but beware if you have a lot of luggage; there is no room in the room. Might suggest you move the clothes you would use for the stay into one case and store the others in the hotel luggage room.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Very good location
text:
This hotel is situated very central, near everything you need like restaurant, shopping, metro buses etc. So it is walking distance to the opera, Sacre Cour the metro is just around the corner.
The hotel itself is quite small, and specifically very dark everything is more or less black. Breakfast is on ground floor.
Reception is very small, like everything else here, the staff is nice and friendly and especially in the breakfast area, we think though we could have gotten a better welcome when arriving at 10 am and did not get our room until 3 pm, we had to take care of ourselves with no help out support way so ever.
Our room 407 is the smallest room I ever stayed in, and I have been to many places... You are in the bed when stepping in and no place to put luggage when you are 2 persons. We upgraded our room so this room has a terrace which is very nice wonderful flowers and so but it would have been nice to have cushions (metal chairs) and a heater when you sit there at night.
Everything is black in the room, walls ceiling floor toilet etc. Like in the hotel sometimes it is difficult to see....
Bed is a bit on the hard side.
The most enjoyable thing is a amazing breakfast... normally in France this is rather simple, but here you have plentiful of nice stuff.
All in all, we have problem matching this as a 4 star hotel and do not feel to recommend it.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Another relaxing stay
text:
Second visit to this lovely boutique hotel. Nicely situated walking distance fron Gare du Nord, Opera and the Grand Boulevard. 4 mins walk to the Folies Bergère. 
Stylish, quiet and confortable,  the perfect place for a long romantic weekend. 
Will certainly be back again.
name: Hôtel Eugène en Ville

title: Excellent Apartment hotel
text:
We visited Paris for the first time. From the time we made our booking to the time we left Paris we had an exceptional experience with all the staff at this hotel apartment. Excellent customer service.
About the hotel it is located in a nice area very convenient metros walking distance, cafes, grocery store, bakeries, shopping and just waking around.
If we go back will definitely stay here a again a very comfortable stay with great customer service.
Thanks to all the reception staff very welcoming and also helped us with our many questions on navigating the area.

title: Summer in Paris 2022
text:
Good location. Rivoli street is always nice to walk and go shopping. Not far from many visiting places. We walked to Seine river, Louvre museum, Musée d’Orly, etc. There is a Carrefourre on the opposite site. So it was very convenient for us to get some snacks or daily stuffs.

We like the room. We stayed in a one -bedroom suite with a living room (a sofabed). There was a full set kitchen with an oven, a stove, a fridge, a microwave, a dish washer and cooking equipments. It was more like an apartment with luxury furniture. 

There was also a balcony with a small chair. Our daughter loved this a lot. She read here with a nice view of Rivoli street.

There was no restaurant though. If we wanted a breakfast, they would send us a basket of bakery with fruit juice. We tried one breakfast and it was just ok.

text:

title: Not recommended !
text:
We stayed 5 nights here. The property location is very good, but we had several unpleasant experiences as follows:
1. Reserved room studio premium 28 sq. meter, but in reality, the space seems very narrow and small even for 2 people.
2. On 1st day, we found the bin lid broken, the cupboard cover over the kitchen bench was broken, the pan Teflon peeled-off. We reported those things to the front desk since day one but no one comes to fix or replace (see pictures). The oven hood was unfunctional, and bad design (see the picture).
If you cook, all smell would be inside the room.
3. No window for natural light and scenery. Open a small window in toilet was noisy.
4. On 2nd day, we reported the front desk that the air cond. controller showed "air filter needs cleaning" and the thermostat was not working because we set temperature to 20 degree C, but the controller can not reach to this set point ever!
Had stayed for 5 nights but no one comes to fix it.
5. The front desk was odd and unprofessional. On 2nd day morning, she offered us to move to another room by saying that my room needs to be maintenance (without saying apologize). Once we were ready to move, the lady at front desk told us that the room for us was then not available because it was given to another customer. What's the pity !! When we asked her what things to fix at my original room, she said nothing to fix. What is a Liar !!!!
6. On that day, I have to stay at the same room without cleaning as the front desk said the housekeeper works only from 9:30-14:30, what's the 4 star hotel given?
7. Housekeeper was poor. No toaster, not fill the salt and pepper, found one red wine glass, and one white wine glass.
8. On last day, the water is not running for 8 hr. There was no notice letter (in advance) providing to let customer aware of. 

In summary, we won't come back to such poor service hotel.

title: Felt deceived and apartment small
text:
Stayed in a premium studio for 6 nights as this was the only available option. Had booked this hotel after emailing to inquire about their air conditioning. Wanted a room in Paris with actually good temperature control. After the email response assuring us the thermostat went down to 16 deg Celsius, we booked thinking a small kitchen might be nice to have. 

Big mistake. When we arrived, sure the thermostat could be turned down to 16. But there was a constant error message asking for a filter change. And the room never got colder than 23 degrees, as confirmed by the staff!

When we called asking if anything could be done, they would assure us a technician was coming. But each day, no change, and we were told the technician was standing them up. No one had showed. Because it was a small hotel. For 6 nights! 

Just open the window, we thought. Some nights were cool. Nope. There are no screens on the windows, and the common courtyard is shared with a restaurant with oily cooking smells abounding. So, flies and mosquitoes with an oil smell, or stifling room. We requested a fan which helped to make our throats dry the whole time we stayed. 

The studio felt small with little closet space. But it was quiet with all the windows shut. Only ambulance noise made it through. 

Housekeeping was a bit odd. They would knock even with a do not disturb sign on. And all towels hung up still taken, but not always replaced. 

Would not recommend for anyone used to North American standards! Go elsewhere. The kitchen alone is not worth the headache.  Pity, as staff decently nice and try their best I think.

title: Shiny Gem!
text: I absolutely adored this apartment-style hotel! Three words: heated bathroom floors! Need I say more? I will, because this place deserves more. I was in Paris in May 2022 for a writer's retreat 10 minutes away and chose this place after ruling out multiple closer (and more expensive) places. I was SO glad I did. I went into some of the other places (both AirBB and bougie hotels) of other writers and this was HANDS DOWN the absolute shiniest gem of them all. Not only the floor thing, but the bedding was so above par (and I'm a person who travels with my Blissy so I'm super picky), it smelled like French Laundry (not the Napa restaurant, but the candle smell! So good!) The Nespresso maker was just like mine at home and the kitchenette was perfect when I just needed those quiet evenings to eat in and write. There is a desk perfect for the writing part. The staff are delightful. The only place I ran into a problem was trying to get a driver to pick me up at the airport which was an "extra" service they provided. title: Amazing stay at a beautiful hotel!

I had a room for two booked at Roi de Sicile - Rivioli. The reservation stipulated that cancellation fees would be 100%. Because of the corona-outbreak my trip was cancelled and so I had to cancel my reservation at Roi de Sicile – Rivioli. Within a very short time I received a message that no cancellation fee would be charged!
I very much appreciate their magnanimity, especially in these dire times for tourism industry. I will travel to Paris at a later date and most certainly will make reservations at Roi de Sicile - Rivioli, once again.

title: A luxurious boutique aparthotel in the superb Marais
text:
Transformed into a luxurious stylish boutique aparthotel located in the Marais, this a fabulous place to stay. Located on the Rue Rivoli, you are close to two metro stations either Hotel de la Ville or St Paul, both are within easy walking distance.  Close by are excellent shops, bistros, bars and restaurants. 
Even before you arrive the friendly and efficient reception team are in contact with you to arrange dinner reservations, transfers, etc. Check in was efficient and you are escorted to your apartment by the receptionist who will give you a briefing on how to operate the entertainment system, the safe, Wi-Fi, other facilities in the apartment and the access procedures for returning out of hours.
The air conditioned soundproofed rooms are very comfortable with a well equipped kitchen area including cooker, fridge, microwave, and dishwasher. The excellent on demand entertainment system offers a variety of movies in both the sitting room and the bedroom. We stayed in an Apartment Premium which was located on a higher floor with a small terrace overlooking the main road, however there was very little road noise. 
The bedrooms are located to the rear of the property overlooking an internal courtyard so there is virtually no noise, the bed was extremely comfortable with high quality bed linen, plenty of storage space and good blackouts so sleep quality is excellent.
The bathroom is stylish with good quality toiletries and towels and an anti-mist mirror. The apartments are serviced every day. 
Whilst reception is open until late evening there is also out of hour’s security on duty. If you are looking for a luxurious apartment in the Marais, with great service then look no further. Recommended and we shall definitely stay here again the next time we are in Paris.

title: Elegant, well-staffed and comfortable
text: This section of the apartment hotel has been open for four months and some services are still to come (e.g., a cafe and food buying service). However, the apartments are complete in furnishing, lighting and amenities. They are beautifully designed, tastefully furnished, very spacious (especially for Paris), and fully equipped for light or serious cooking. Though this branch is on a busy street, the soundproofing is excellent and bedrooms face a very quiet court; of the may apartments we have used in Paris this is by far the quietest. The front desk, in an elegant lobby, is staffed 24/7 with English-speaking staff who maintain an exceptional level of friendliness and very intelligent service. There are many special touches and unique features here: a big elevator (for the Marais), a Nespresso machine, induction stove top and a rain shower. Even "tough guys" will enjoy feeling pampered.

title: Great Location but Beware!
text: The hotel mismanaged our reservation despite repeated assurances before and during our check-in that we were fully booked for our stay (we added an extra night after the original booking, but still months in advance). However, we were notified on the third day that there been an error in the booking system and we would have to leave early. In addition to using our vacation time to pack and look for another place to stay, the alternative hotel the staff helped to locate was expensive, noisy and uncomfortable. Thanks for ruining one of the few days and nights we had in Paris! About the facility itself, we appreciated the space and location. But for a hotel that wants to be considered 'upscale', the coffee pot was flimsy and had a broken lid; the cushioned chair, ironically, was the hardest piece of furniture; towels were on the thin side; basic amenities were sparse (don't sneeze!); and the bed was fairly small for two. For service, housekeeping was good but consider the concierge a non-starter -- quirky attitude and often the desk was unattended, especially at night. I can now understand why some professional travel reviewers gave this hotel a good review, due largely to the space and location, but then also suggested you consider their competitors. I suggest you do the same.

title: Exceeded our expectations - we plan to come back soon!
text: We are a couple from NYC, with 7- and 9-year old daughters. After a stay over the Easter/Passover holidays, we would recommend the apartment very highly and intend to stay here again. It's a first class accommodation and in perfect location in Le Marais. The property manager, Eva, was a delight. She helped us with anything we needed, and she did it with a smile and professionalism. On Easter Sunday, she surprised my daughters with Easter baskets from Maison Georges Larnicol. It was so appreciated. There is no washer/dryer in the apt. but there is one a block away if you need it. Twice, one day at 8 p.m. and another day before 10 a.m., the fire alarm in the building went off (rustling us out of bed) and continued for at least 5 minutes. We walked downstairs, saw another family, but there was no fire. The 10 a.m. alarm was apparently a drill/test but we were never told ahead of time. Also, there is a Starck hotel being built across the street. From the 4th Fl., you can hear the construction noise (despite the thick windows) starting at 7 a.m. It may be done soon so ask the hotel before you go. Other than those two things, we had a very pleasant stay.
