title: One of the nicest Marriott properties I’ve been to
text:
I loved this place (and Paris) so much my 3 night stay turned into a 7 night stay, then 9, 11, and finally 12 nights. The hotel is new and beautifully designed, I am absolutely obsessed with the modern decor, the wood panels, the sliding decorative bathroom doors, the rainforest shower etc etc!!! The only thing I would change is make the bathroom mirrors larger, they have a huge magnifying circle in the middle that obstructs your view when getting ready. But the beds are comfortable (especially if you get a King… swear it was cushier than the Queen in my first room), the views are insane from high floors, the windows have nooks with leather cushions you can sit in and drink coffee while watching the sun rise over Paris, etc. As a Titanium Elite, I’ve stayed in several luxury collection properties, ritz, W, etc. yet I would say this is one of the nicest Marriott owned hotels I’ve been to when it comes to room design, cleanliness, and quality, second only to Solaz in Cabo (which is temporarily closed) and maybe a couple of the Editions. I also had an insane rate through my employer - so if you work for a global org, make sure you check for that while you’re booking! 

From a customer service perspective, this hotel really seemed to go the extra mile and while some properties do not make you feel appreciated over status, they do here. I was upgraded mid-stay to a junior suite and even through all of my last minute booking extensions in a sold out period, the staff was able to work their magic so I wouldn’t have to change rooms. I also got a free drink ticket. I did have a few issues with housekeeping, as others have also called out, and felt like every day I was asking for water or tea or cups or whatever that hadn’t been replaced - but the front desk staff would always just bring it up. Before I came to Paris, my friends were warning me about the customer service in general, but I thought most of the staff here were phenomenal! 

Other things - Breakfast is plentiful though somewhat redundant, if you get free breakfast through status or rate, take advantage - even if you don’t use it every day, it will keep you full on the days you do. I would switch off going to hotel breakfast vs. to a cafe when I was there. They also have a really nice spa, where you rent out the jacuzzi and sauna areas for just yourself (+ your guests). Trust me, if you are not used to cigarette smoke in Paris, you will DREAM of the steam room to clear your airways. Godsend. There is also a gym, it’s pretty small but I was the only person there when I went. 

One last thing - and it’s totally out of the hotel’s control - but travelers should be aware this isn’t the nicest area of Paris. Lots of yummy walkable restaurants (Chameleon, Les Rupins, L’aller Retour, to name a few), but you probably won’t be walking to the Louvre or any of the designer shops. On the plus, it’s SUPER close to the Republique metro station, which is amazing and easy to figure out, but at night, it can be seedy. If you take the metro back home to Republique, make sure you look for exit #6, which lets out just across a small walkway from the hotel. Otherwise, you will get out in the statue/plaza area, which is where the sketchiness peaks. And, while eating at some nearby cafes, local transients could get quite aggressive. If you are from a major city in the US, it won’t be anything you aren’t used to, and it’s not as bad as LA/SF/NYC - but if you are from the suburbs, Midwest… it might be a shock.

Speaking of, this is a hotel that very obviously caters to Americans and most of the people I met or overheard were from the States. So if your French is not great or you just want the security of English speaking staff, this is perfect for that.

All in all, I miss the hotel terribly, it became a second home to me, and I’m already planning my next trip back. I’ve recommended it to all of my friends and coworkers (and now you, TripAdvisor reader) so hopefully there’s still space when I want to go ;)

title: I expect more from the Marriott Brand
text:
I echo almost the same sentiments as the previous reviewer about this property.    

The hotel is located in a great area, super close to the Republique metro line that can get you swiftly to anywhere in the city.   The property itself is well taken care of and has a very good vibe - especially the lobby, restaurant and outdoor terrace area.  The bar staff and restaurant staff were top notch. 

Staff was all very kind, hospitable and helpful to a point.   I realize that most guests here were American, so the responses from the staff may that the staff is just beaten down so they tell you whatever you want to hear, but just do not follow through with the promise.  (see previous review on accountability)

As a Platinum Marriott Member, I expect to receive at least an upgraded room.   I made this reservation in April for June and requested the use of my Suite Night Awards then, for a 2 night stay.    We were arriving early (12 noon) on our check in day and I called a week before to note it in the reservation and then made multiple checks 48 hours in advance directly with the hotel via the BonVoy app. While I am aware that early check-in is never guaranteed, it would have been nice for the guest services agents to say - we are full the night before, we are short staffed and we will not be able to offer early check in.   

The night before check-in the Suite Night Awards were declined.  I checked again for a 12 check in and was told it should "not be a problem". We had a family meet up about 30 minutes away at 15:00, so once we arrived at 12:30, we thought we would be just fine. 

We were warmly greeted by the staff, told that the suite nights are all controlled by "corporate Marriott" and they don't have control over them, we would possibly be able to check in a little earlier that 15:00 and there was no place except the public restrooms to change and freshen up, but we could wait in the lobby.    Which we did.   We waited, waited, waited.  All the white, I could hear people checking into multiple rooms with no wait from 12:30 on.  At 1:30, I went to check - perhaps we could downgrade our request for an upgrade and just get into any room.  I was told by Lachlan (always kind but clearly trained to tell guests it would only be a moment longer) that we had a nice room "set aside for us" and that it should be ready soon.      
At 14:00, we went to the public restroom, changed and washed, stored our bags and left, very disappointed.    I received a call at 15:15 while on the metro that the room was ready.  

Once we returned that evening, I was excited to see what lovely room we had been given since the wait was so long.  Just a simple room with a courtyard view, looking into other windows.     We kept wondering if all those other people checking into rooms had Marriott status and had spent many, many euros on their stay as well as on the BonVoy brand over the years.      Who knows, but I was sorely disappointed. This property has no Exec Lounge, either.    We were granted a late checkout, which was appreciated. 

We normally stay at the Marriott Opera in the first but we thought this property would be a change of pace.   We won't be returning.

title: Won’t be returning
text:
I wanted to give them a higher rating, as a matter of fact, I wanted to give them 5 stars, however, I felt that we weren’t told the truth when we asked for upgrades. 

The good - 
Super nice and attentive staff in the bar/ restaurant.
Good vibe throughout the hotel.
Great location.
Nice gym.

The not so good - 

We stayed 6 nights, paid for our rooms $$ (didn’t use points), rate was more on the high side and for what it’s worth, I’m ”top” tier with Bonvoy. After thanking/begging/tipping we got a room with a view on a high floor which has been in my profile preferences forever.

We were tentatively promised an upgrade to a junior suite which never happened. I totally  get it when hotels are near-full and when others have paid for these suites. However, we noticed the suite next to our room was checked into multiple times during our stay and on our 4th night, 2 ppl checked in at 9:30pm, on the same day I tried to upgrade via SNA and by speaking directly with one of the receptionists. I don’t mind not getting upgraded but I’m trying to understand why and what it takes and more importantly why do hotels not tell customers the truth. We spoke to the couple who was checking in late, and they neither booked a suite nor asked for the upgrade. So the hotel could have moved us to that room for our last night or two. 

I think it comes down to the timing of when you book, some hotels are lazy, they pre-assign rooms and then if you book late, they give you the “left overs” even if you pay a higher rate or have a higher status with their program. 

 I think that’s ok so long you are not a loyal member or someone who’s eligible for an upgrade.  For about $500 per room / per night, we got a room with a view and the kids got a room on the first floor without a view, both are on the small side and I’m just tired of negotiating and begging hotels every time we check in. We spent over $28k on Marriott hotels this vacation and I feel that I don’t need to be doing this. 

Just signed up for the IHG challenge and going to change my upcoming business trips in July to IHG hotels… not sure it will be much better, but I definitely  need to diversify my hotel options.

title: Just a tiny Annoyance with Almost Everything
text:
Wife and I were here for 6 nights end of Nov to beginning of Dec.

We have been to Paris many times. We decided to stay near Republique since it's in the middle of Le Marais, Bourse, and Canal Saint-Martin. The hotel is perfectly situated for repeating visitors. We loved this super walk-able area along with convenient public transits. 

Our check in process was friendly and simple. Our room wasn't ready which was a bit annoying but that's OK since we arrived at 14:30, we dropped off our bags and onto plenty of wonderful coffee shops near by. Front desk eventually called around 15:30 to let us know the room was ready.

Everything in the room and the hotel just caused a tiny bit of annoyance everywhere we went. Our room was wonderful with a great view with a seat on the windows ledge for reading. Bath room amenities were top notch and towels were fluffy, luxurious and soft. There were plenty of space in the room with a comfortable bed. Central Air worked perfectly through out our stay. There was a self shoe shine service in the basement which was perfect every time we needed it.

The toilet was separated from the bathroom, which gets a bit annoying when you need to wash your hands after usage and had to walk all the way around to do so. The bathroom design was beautiful but annoyingly less functional. For example, the sink was shallow so water gets everywhere around the counter. The lights in the hall way can't be controlled with the switches by the bed. WiFi was in and out in the middle of the night which was during business hours in PST our clients were annoyed by us coming in and out of the WebEx meetings due to the hotel's unreliable internet. The business computer in the basement of the hotel did not work (internet was annoyingly slow) and was also password protected for some strange reason that I had to hunt down the password via front desk. The gym was not really a gym with insufficient weight dumbbells and no resistance machines as advertised. They did have a treadmill but it doesn't have an incline option. the night stand by the bed doesn't fit a glasses case, a large size phone, alarm and remote control. The Nespresso coffee machine's reservoir was annoying to remove to refill in a tight space. 

All the staffs here were wonderful, it was the best part of the hotel. Everyone happily assisted from printing documents to answering all my questions. There was a pharmacy near by at Republique Square that did a COVID antigen test in 15 minutes so we can have documentations to come home.

When we checked out, they charged us for items in the mini bar that we never touched. Someone I guess enjoyed a Heineken on our behave. After emailing the hotel, they fixed the bill. Like I said, everything was just a tiny bit annoying for a 5 star hotel. 

Overall despite all the small annoyance, we still love the hotel and the area, we will most likely be back.

title: a.	Outstanding Stay—Superb Service
text: During a recent 5-night stay in Paris, we split our time with first two nights at the Renaissance Republic and the last three nights at the Marriott Opera—both are Marriott properties.  We split the time entirely based on location with the opera area being a bit more convenient for what we wanted to do in Paris. We were upgraded and had a very comfortable room facing the road with some views.  Everything in the room was superb and most comfortable.  The included breakfast buffet was outstanding and included omelets, eggs, pancakes, etc., prepared in an open kitchen.  But, most distinguishable about the Renaissance was the outstanding service from the front desk/reception, concierge, and the service staff at the bar and in the restaurant—always with a smile and cheerful greeting, every one went out of their way to be helpful.  Being in Paris is all about location, so just ensure that this is an area that you want to be in.  Overall, a great stay and I highly recommend the Renaissance.  For the General Manager:  great job with customer service from everyone who works in the hotel—it is noticeable and it makes a difference for us customers.

title: Modern hotel in a vibrant neighbourhood
text:
SUCH a good experience staying at the Renaissance Paris Republique Hotel. That’s the only way that I could start this review! 

Arriving my train to Paris (Gare du Nord) it’s a few minutes by taxi or a 20 minute walk to the hotel, which is extremely conveniently located in a vibrant neighbourhood of Paris and in front of metro station Republique. 

Location wise this is what you want in Paris. Nice restaurants on walking distance, a metro that takes you to all the sightseeing spots, but also cool hotspots and concept stores around the hotel. 

Upon arriving we heard that we were upgraded to an Urban View room on the 6th floor, overlooking Paris rooftops. For a girl who has loved in Paris a few years ago, my jaw dropped at the pretty sight. If I stood on my tiptoes, I was able to see the Notre Dame and Pantheon in the distance. Rain shower, fantastic bed, you don’t want anything else. 

After sharing something on Instagram and tagging the hotel, I was virtually greeted by social media manager Laurine, whose service blew me away. She immediately shared her personal recommendations in the neighbourhood with me in a nicely crafted guide, and sent some accounts over Instagram of things I might like. Thanks for this attention Laurine!

Breakfast buffet was great. Fresh options of both bread and some cold cuts, and an open kitchen where you can order any style eggs. The team at the breakfast was very friendly, but especially Jacques stood out. His big smile can only provide you a fantastic start of your day and had me smiling, even before I drank a sip of my barista coffees. 

Only comment would be that the Front Office could be even more friendly and proactive in greeting upon entering back in the hotel. Different evenings upon reentering the hotel I was trying to get eye contact, didn’t get it, and said hello myself before entering the elevator. That’s the only small remark to make the experience even better! Thank you!

title: Would stay here again in a heartbeat
text:
We had to shift our stay a few days earlier in order to escape the COVID-19 lockdown occurring in Rome, but this hotel refunded my points and made the change with no issue.  They gave us the best rooms they had available.

Location:
Amazing location.  There is a Hop-On/Hop-Off bus stop 15 feet from the door, a subway entrance about 50 feet away, and another subway entrance within a 5 minute walk.  That's helpful sometimes because the main lines going through those stops were different.  It was often easier to walk 5 minutes to the other stop rather than jump on the closer one and having to stop and change trains again.  There are an enormous amount of restaurants near this hotel.  You can find everything from expensive dining to reasonably priced street baguette vendors.  

Amenities:
This hotel had a reasonably sized swimming pool, a hot tub, a fitness room, and a massage spa.  I did not ever see anyone in the massage spa, so that may require reservations.  The fitness room is pretty pathetic.  It's tiny.  There were two stationary bikes neither of which worked.  There were just 2 treadmills and 1 elliptical.  There were dumbbells but not a single place to sit, so the number of exercises I could do were limited. If you like to exercise in the hotel fitness room on your trips, look elsewhere.

The Staff:
I cannot say enough about how amazing the staff at this hotel were!  Nearly every employee spoke fluent English.  That's quite a bit different from when I visited 20 years ago.  They booked site-seeing bus tickets for us, booked taxis for us, and made great suggestions on when/how to see which sites as well as restaurants.  The front desk staff was so friendly that it felt like they'd all been trained at an American Chick-fil-A.  I don't travel to Europe often, so I forget sometimes which cities/countries expect tips and which don't.  We were reminded often that tips are not expect from us.  I must say that I left a few anyway due to the exceptional service.  I just wanted to reward and reinforce such great behavior.

The Restaurant:
I rarely use the hotel restaurants for anything other than breakfast and that's true here as well.  The breakfast here was extremely good with an omelet station and oatmeal (ie. porridge) upon request.  The juices were freshly squeezed.  I could eat breakfast here every day.  It does help that my breakfast is free due to my Ambassador Elite status, but there are plenty of places nearby to eat if you don't have status and don't want to spend a small fortune on breakfast.  During this trip, we stayed in Rome, Paris, and London and technically my status gives me only 2 free breakfasts, one for me and one guest.  I can't ding this hotel for sticking to their rules, but I have to note that my hotels in Rome and London allowed my entire family of 4 to eat breakfast for free with my status.  That was a huge perk considering they charge $29 per person for breakfast and typically my kids eat a bowl of cereal and a donut.  The restaurant  was adequately large but due to COVID-19, I don't know how many guests the hotel had.  During peak tourist times, it probably gets pretty crowded in there.  There is an elevator that opens at the restaurant which is oddly placed.  It was the closest to our room, so we always took it, but it opens within the middle of the restaurant behind the maitre d' which felt odd.  The restaurant staff were as amazing as all the other staff, friendly, prompt, helpful, etc.

The Room:
The room was fine for my spouse and I and pretty typical in size for most hotels.  We had a king bed.  The room is not roomy enough for two people with large suitcases and lots of clothes.  We don't overpack, but we were in Paris for only about 2.5 days of a 10 day trip, so we had a lot of clothes.  The bathroom was nice and roomy although enclosed by glass walls/windows so you everyone can watch you shower and such.  There is a curtain you can draw down to help with that.  I lowered it simply because I didn't want to wake my spouse with the bright lights of the bathroom when I got up to shower in the morning.  The shower got plenty hot, but it took a very long time and then was scalding hot.  We struggled to get the right temperature.  The TV was unique in that it is built into the foot of the bed.  A remote raises it to view and lowers it to get it out of the way.  I thought that was pretty neat and the room had our own private balcony that could seat 6 or more people.  Our children didn't get so lucky.  I booked a two-bed room for them, but the beds were adjoining almost as if it were a single bed.  This was not especially pleasing to my young adult children (one is a boy and one a girl).  Otherwise their room was similar to ours.

We would stay again.

Another satisfying stay at our home away from home in Paris. We've always received a room upgrade because of our Marriott status, and for that we're truly grateful. From the balcony I could see the light beam of the Eiffel Tower at night which was lovely. 

I ordered room service twice and both times it arrived in ten minutes. Amazing service. 

Breakfast was delicious. It included a hot and cold buffet with an omelette station. 

Check out was hassle free and the same lovely associate was on duty. He remembered about my plans for the coming day and wished me an early happy birthday which was the next day. 

I’m due to go back to Paris in March and have a different Marriott hotel booked but I will be rebooking the Renaissance again instead. 

Thank you to your wonderful team!

title: Wonderful boutique hotel with top tier staff
text: Family of three just returned from our weeklong stay at the B Montmartre hotel. We had read a lot of reviews in advance when making our hotel selection and were confident this was a solid choice and indeed it was. The rooms are small, but well maintained and very clean. We were on the 3rd floor of the newer building in the courtyard so it was very quiet. If we return to Paris in the future, I think we would prefer the same room type and undoubtedly will stay at this hotel again. Housekeeping was efficient and did a great job, especially given we had a ton of luggage and shopping bags scattered throughout.  The Barmen, "Pranab" and "Hasim" (may have spelled incorrectly - sorry) were marvelous and took care of us when we were in the mood for wine. Also we brought pizza back from neighborhood place one night and some charcuterie on another night and were given utensils and welcomed to eat inside (it was quite hot outside during our visit). The French wine selections were well-picked and reasonably priced. We enjoyed several bottles. Also several wines by the glass and regional beers. The front desk staff was wonderful and very accommodating of our lack of French - we knew only basic salutations. We were always greeted upon departing for the day and returning from our adventures. Sergio helped us on our departure when our Uber did not show despite confirming both the driver and vehicle the evening before. This apparently happens with some frequency in Paris so I would advise you to use taxi's and avoid Uber.  We also used the busses and subways, which are closely and took us to the local landmarks and museums. Some good eats in the area are Mamma Primi (Italian), Lovebird (small plates/tapas), and, not too far away found the best sorbet at a Chocolatier "A La Mere de Famille".  Had the restaurant "Le Moncey" on the nearby corner as well. On all subsequent days, the proprietor of that restaurant would greet us or waive as we walked by on our way to hotel - very kind as were all of folks we encountered in the neighborhood. Also, there is a charming cat that strolls through the B Montmartre courtyard in the evenings - very friendly - laid on my feet while I petted him.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: A fabulous boutique hotel with welcoming staff
text: This was our second stay at this hotel. As we booked it at very short notice (just 2 weeks prior to arrival while we awaited news of rail strikes in the UK) the only room available was the classic double. It had everything we needed and was larger than some we have stayed in elsewhere. The bed was super-comfy and meant we both slept well. The day we arrived was our 17th wedding anniversary and we'd ordered a bottle of champagne when we booked, which was brought promptly to our room when we asked if we could have it shortly after arrival. We booked directly with the hotel which meant breakfast was included in our rate. It had the best range of choices we have experienced anywhere, with freshly made coffee and set us up for the day perfectly. The breakfast staff were all lovely and listened patiently while I attempted my 'not so perfect' French! The location is perfect, close to Clichy metro station (yet down a quiet street so your stay is not interrupted by lots of outside noise) and just a short walk into the heart of Montmartre or Pigalle. It makes it a great base to explore Paris from as a short metro ride can take you anywhere. The hotel has a bar with a lovely terrace garden where we enjoyed welcome drinks and a couple more glasses of wine. The barman remembered us from our stay in 2019 and had a friendly chat with us. And that is what really makes this hotel - the staff - they are all so friendly and welcoming at all times. They all greet you with a smile and ask how your stay is going and take time time to wish you a good morning/night at every opportunity and you feel like nothing would be too much trouble if you needed any assistance. I'm sure that we'll be back in the future!

title: Excellent service. A great choice.
text: Very nice hotel with very attentive service. Very comfortable rooms although the one we stayed in was a little bit dark. Very comfortable beds and high quality linen. Excellent service and very convenient location.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Calm, clean & great service
text: We stayed 4 days. The bed is great, rooms are clean and quiet at night. The size of a room was quite small, but had all we needed. Delicious breakfast in a cozy garden. Close to Montmartre, we took bicycles to experience the whole Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: I didn't want to leave
text: This is a must stay if visiting Paris. room was very generous in size and fit out. The bathroom was large and really well equipped. Staff were number 1. And the bonus garden that I did not expect was the cream to top it off. Although it's right in the middle of the city, you'd swear you were in suburbia that's how quiet it was. This will be my go to hotel the next time I visit Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Fantastic hotel in brilliant location
text: Hotel staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming and helpful. The hotel is located in a perfect place for getting in and out of the city and is very clean. It’s in very good proximity to excellent bars and restaurants; as well as the metro.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Good location and lovely hotel
text: Booked this hotel for a last minute trip to Paris for my mums 60th. The Hotel is lovely and a good location. Near lots of food places and the street beside it is nice and lively great atmosphere. Near the metro also and bus stand. Not far from there city centre which is also great. The hotel is nice and clean. Modern vibe to it and has a lovely garden to have tea and breakfast in. Staff are lovely and friendly!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Wonderful stay at B Montmartre Hotel
text: This is a wonderful hotel with the nicest staff. They helped us with everything. Arranging a second bed in the room, advice for close-by restaurants, suitcases. I just love this place. Good for business traveler and holiday makers alike.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Elegance and luxury at it’s best
text: I can’t say enough good things about this hotel! The accommodations were luxurious. The location was perfectly situated away from busy streets and conveniently located by the metro. The room size met our American standard (we had a suit). But what takes this hotel over the top is the staff! Emmanuel and Ruben were absolutely amazing! They gave us directions, recommendations and even added extra  mattress cover on the bed. I would recommend this hotel to everyone and anyone who asks,
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
Our family of 5 had a wonderful stay here! Our rooms were clean and as spacious as an European hotel can be. The bathroom was also clean with great amenities-heated towel holder, heated floor, heated bidet, and waterfall shower head. Each day our rooms with cleaned and bottled water was left to put in our mini frig.
Everyone at the hotel was helpful, polite, friendly, and spoke perfect English and let me speak my limited French with patience. The front desk helped with getting taxis and dinner reservations, and all question we had. The breakfast each morning was a nice way to start the day with eggs, bacon, juice, coffee, meats and cheese, cereal, bread and croissants available. 
Our favorite part of the hotel is the beautiful courtyard, where we could eat breakfast, enjoy afternoon drink, or sit and read or play cards with our family. It was a welcomed oasis from the busy street of Paris that were feet away, but quiet as could be in the courtyard.
The hotel is steps away from restaurants, bakeries, supermarket, a short walk to the lively neighborhood of Montmarte. I do not hesitate to recommend this hotel and it's wonderful staff.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Our favorite in Paris
text: Always a pleasure to come to B Montmartre.  Welcoming friends and exceptional service.  The surrounding cafes and bars are great and sitting outside in the courtyard of the hotel is a relaxing experience.  We will be back and highly recommend this hotel in Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: quiet oasis in Montmartre
text: this hotel is a quiet oasis in busy Montmartre. We loved to sit in the green garden and enjoyes the breakfast buffet.Clean room, a bit on the small side, but we are used to that in Paris. Next time we'll book again!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: I enjoyed my stay here
text:
The place is very practical and very friendly staff.! Thank you
I enjoyed my stay here.! 
I highly recommended.! 
The room has patio and lots of plants made the place looks great .!! 💜🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🪴🪴🪴🪴🪴🪴🪴🪴
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Perfect Paris Hotel
text: Ideal hotel within Paris. Lovely, lush garden courtyard in which to eat breakfast or enjoy a drink in the evening. After a long day exploring busy Paris, it felt like a tropical escape to have that green outdoor space. Very clean rooms. The most comfortable of the beds we slept in in France. Nice showers. Very friendly staff. Tasteful decor. Nearby metro station.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text: Just returned from a short stay at the B Montmartre. We booked last minute and despite multiple trips to Paris I was not familiar with Montmartre. Well we lucked out! What a lovely hotel! This is a small hotel with a beautiful courtyard filled with palms (in Paris!) and other foliage - what a respite from the noisiness of the city. Every room (and we had three different rooms) was modern, elegant, and extremely clean with crisp, high-end sheets. Breakfast was better than the five star hotel we stayed at in March! But what really stood out was how kind and helpful each person who works there is. They went out of their way to assist us and even checked that we got to our train on time once we left. This hotel is a small gem in a city full of great hotels (and not so great hotels!) The neighborhood is full of little restaurants and cafes and one gets much more of a feeling for how life in Paris is for the locales. Thank you B Montmartre!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Fabulous little hidden gem in Montmartre
text: We stayed for several nights in this hotel. Cozy and cute, it has a wonderful Paris vibe. The rooms are a little small, but the friendly staff and wonderful breakfast certainly make up for this. Enjoyed the restaurant recommendations from the staff.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Clean, quiet, lovely and GREAT staff!
text: Lovely accommodations in the heart of Paris - easy access to the Metro makes it great base to explore.  impeccable rooms, well maintained, but the best part is the amazing staff.  They really make the stay in Paris perfect.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Excellent Stay in Montmartre
text: The hotel was comfortable, good location for walking and metro and staff was friendly, exceedingly helpful (dinner reservations, taxi, recommendations). The tables in garden area and wine bar were perfect for after a full day of touring in busy Paris. So quiet. Comfortable bed very clean. I can’t remember all staff names but Patricia was outstanding
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel!
text: We loved our stay at B Montmarte and I was particularly impressed by the very friendly and helpful staff, and our lovely balcony room. I would thoroughly recommend this hotel in the bustling Clichy neighborhood of paris to fellow travelers
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: friendly staff, good location
text: the hotel staff is very friendly and helpful, there are many good restaurants nearby which is a plus. the hotel staff will help to book a table in the restaurants. Bath room is modern and comfortable as well. Overall very good experiences.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: The Hotel is really nice. Stuff are all friendly. Tge rooms are nice and clean. They have a really nice terrasse with a fantastic garden. The breakfast was very good and they had lots of food. We are from Luxembourg and the owner is also from Luxembourg and very friendly. The metro station is very close to the Hotel.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Basa family stay
text: The location is perfect with a nice garden patio for a quiet retreat.  The room we stayed in is clean and loved your toilet.  Great breakfast.  Warm and courteous staff.  Special mention to Alicia, Hashim, Amar and Sergio.  We'll definitely stay again.  Thank you.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Excellent hotel with great staff
text: Located central. Quiet rooms with very comfy bed. The staff is kind and thoughtful. Beautiful courtyard garden. Love the fact that the keys are handed in when leaving the premises (no chance losing keys). Will definitely book here again when in Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel with friendly and helpful staff
text: We had a wonderful stay at the B Montmartre hotel. Our room was comfortable, clean, and had a really pretty view! We stayed in the room with the hamam on the top floor, and it felt luxurious! The staff was so kind and helpful, and they recognized us over the course of our stay. The hotel is conveniently located near the Place de Clichy metro stop, and we made great use of the metro to get around Paris. I highly recommend this hotel. The only downside is that they didn't tell us that there was an included breakfast, but I guess this was probably just an oversight.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Over achieved expectations!
text: I was very satisfied with our visit on b montmadre. The staff is very helpful and professional. Also the location is super! Rooms are not very big but clean, cosy and fresh! I would highly recommend this hotel
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Great place to stay!
text:
My husband and I were here for four nights in May 2022.  Super nice and very helpful staff - they were very accommodating and professional assisting with tours, restaurants, etc.

The location is good, close to the Place de Clichy metro stop. There are restaurants, pharmacies, and small markets nearby. Everything is within easy walking distance. Be advised that the hotel is in a busy traffic area so there is road noise. Request a room on the back side of the hotel over the garden/patio and you should be fine.

The room was clean, well appointed and comfortable. There was a small fridge as well as a safe for valuables. The rooms and bathrooms are small in Paris as space is at a premium. There is an elevator. 

The breakfast layout was great. A comfortable cafe setting, beautiful buffet with lots of choices including fresh pastries and coffee made to order.  They serve drinks and small plates in the afternoon evening if you need something light.

Would definitely stay here again.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: TOP OF OUR LIST!
text: After spending a month in Europe, B Montmarte was the PERFECT spot to stay in Paris!  The hotel itself is just the right size.  The beds are amazing (yes, we had slept in a lot of beds during the month) and the location is perfect!  Close to Sacre Ceour, Moulin Rouge and charming neighborhoods and the Metro as well! The garden is gorgeous and a nice quiet spot to end the day with a glass of wine or cocktail after a day of sightseeing.  And the breakfast was amazing as well!  All that said, the staff makes you feel so welcome and knows how to pamper you like royalty!  Big shout out to Hashim and Rubem who couldn't have been any more helpful and pleasant!  Don't miss this gem in Paris!  Thank you B Montmarte to the perfect end to our holiday!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Amazing experience!
text: Very nice everything! The hotel was exactly what I was expected! I recommend it for short or long visits in Paris! For sure I will be back soon and stay for a longer period! Thanks again for all the support!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Great little hotel
text:
Stayed here for a two night break and was very impressed. Everything was very clean. And the staff could not have been better. Very friendly and accommodating.
We would definitely return when in Paris again.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Great hidden gem boutique hotel
text: This is an outstanding boutique hotel.  The rooms are very lovely and spotlessly clean.  The beds are very comfortable.  There is a small courtyard on the ground floor and a restaurant where breakfast was served but we did not have time to use these.  The staff are outstanding and helpful.  I really recommend this hotel and will stay here next time we are in Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Charming, Convenient Yet Off the Beaten Path
text: Clean, well appointed rooms, outstanding staff and excellent service. I will return to this hotel without a doubt! The neighborhood is more residential, a refreshing break from the usual touristy parts of Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Very good service and very calm! Perfect location for trip to Paris!
text: Very good service! Nice rooms and very calm! Very nice garden with Palms and fliers.Close to Moulin Rouge and a couple of good restaurants e.g. Strobi and a wine bars. Little Italy at Place Clichy not to be recommended.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Excellent hotel - Great people
text:
All the staff were smiling and always willing to serve us. Breakfast is excellent. I traveled with my daughter
which on the second day the crepes were over and immediately the lady at the bar went to the kitchen and made it for her. Great location. The neighborhood was artistic and had many restaurants with cuisines from around the world, small bars and cafes but also very quiet.
best of all of course the excellent garden where we took our breakfast
perfect hotel but also great people
thank you very much b-monmartre team!!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: B Montmartre Hotel - 5 nights
text: Small, very clean, quiet, confortable room No. 12 - shower, every day clean towels, hairdryer, TV, aircondition. The hotel provides excellent services and has a convenient location - subway, restaurants, sights, shopping.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Hidden Gem in Paris
text: Location, staff and interiors were amazing! Couldn't fault the hotel staff who were really welcoming and helpful throughout our stay.  Perfect base location for exploring Paris with the metro 2 mins away and a short walk to vibrant Pigalle and Montmartre. And the hotel garden is a hidden gem for a chilled drink amongst the busy Paris lifestyle.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: A fantastically helpful and lovely stuff!
text: It’s a small but absolutely lovely hotel in a great location! Everything was just really excellently done, very clean, with lots of attention to guests. The stuff is super friendly and helpful! Loved the stay!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Fabulous
text:
Stayed for four nights on a City break to Paris. This is a gem of a boutique hotel. Rooms are cosy, immaculately clean, nicely decorated, bed linen and towels are crisp and white, in short beautiful. Slippers and bathrobes, mini bar, hairdryer, TV and safe. Beds are so comfortable and the hotel is quiet, we slept like babies. We didn't include breakfast in the stay, but paid €15 each on 2 mornings and there was something for everyone with a good selection and we enjoyed it. There's a small courtyard garden which is lovely to sit in for breakfast.
The staff here are exceptional. Warm, welcoming and friendly and highly efficient and professional. The front desk is 24hr and they go over and above to make your stay the best experience ever. Whether it's advice on places to eat, routes to tourist attractions, taxis or booking tickets for shows they are amazing!
Location of the hotel is ideal, not right in the middle of everything, but only a bus or metro away . No.30 bus around the corner (be sure to buy tickets at the Metro station prior to your journey) takes you most places, or catch the metro at Place de Clichy (2 min walk away)to almost anywhere. 10min walk to Moulin Rouge and nightlife. Lots of places to eat round about.
Love this hotel and would stay again in a heartbeat.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Great Hotel
text: a very nice hotel, perfect location with many restaurants around. Very nice inner courtyard, breakfast that leaves nothing to be desired. Comfortable bed, nice room, great bathroom, everything is clean and everyone is very friendly.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Great place, great location and great staff.
text: The title says it all. B Montmartre hotel was everything we had hoped for. The staff were very accommodating and helped us sort out the initial hiccup we had. The rooms were as advertised and beautiful. The breakfast buffet was wonderful. The staff really make the stay comfortable and relaxing
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Decent Hotel
text: There are some things to like about this hotel. It's close to a store. Not far from the subway. Staff was welcoming and responsive. Our bed was comfortable. We had a rooftop room. The view made you feel less closed in than many Paris hotels. In a safe area. Nice garden area for warm days. They didn't have a good sitting set up in the room--hard chair with no back. Also be aware beside the Sacre Coure and other things in Montmartre other tourist things generally are 20 minutes to a half hour away. No warm eggs for breakfast--so most days we would go around the corner to a boulangerie. So though it is a nice hotel I prefer to stay closer to the Louvre.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Wonderful stay in Paris at a great hotel
text: We cannot say enough about how helpful and friendly the hotel staff is. They went out of their way to help us get tickets to Versailles when we were unable to do it online. We always got greeted with a smile each time we entered the lobby. They made a great time in Paris even better!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Very good
text: Great place and great staff Good breakfast All so helpful the hotel beautiful and location great Highly recommend this hotel and will return I chose a room that was not big enough it is the only one I would change next time I come
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: High quality comfortable hotel with friendly staff in the centre of Montmartre
text: High quality comfortable hotel with friendly staff in the centre of Montmartre. Rooms are excellent. We had the room on the top floor with balcony, and our friends had the room adjacent to the lush courtyard garden - both were perfect and the breakfast is excellent too.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: C'est magnifique!!!
text: What a wonderful experience! First time in Paris, and this delightful hotel made it all even better - beautiful, comfortable, clean, great service (at a time when that can be understandably challenging). Wonderful location for walking and other transportation. And we always felt like we were in good hands. Thanks to the staff at the B Montmarte! I will recommend to everyone
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Exceptional Hotel in perfect location
text: Absolutely lovely hotel. Staff was all so friendly and wanted to ensure that we had a wonderful stay. Beds were so incredibly comfortable. Breakfast was fantastic!  Lots of variety, delicious cheese, meats, fruits and of course a selection of several breads and croissants. We could not have asked for a more perfect stay.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Above expectations
text: Traveling for business, surprised to see such a nice hotel. It’s small, however everything else was above expectation. Super friendly staff. Good location and superb breakfast. Eye for detail, cosy atmosphere.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Long weekend stay
text: The service was excellent, really friendly and helpful reception staff. The rooms were very comfortable with all amenities required. Location was central in close proximity to the metro. Overall could not recommend this hotel enough!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Absolutely Wonderful!
text: We stayed here for 4 nights and it really was quite a gem. A Very good location, close to the metro. The staff was absolutely phenomenal, they were attentive, very professional, and went out of their way to make us feel special. The rooms are a bit small but they are very calming and relaxing. We could sleep the entire day! Loved the breakfast offering and general ambiance of this amazing hotel.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Excellent hotel
text:
Excellent hotel at a great location. Very friendly staff, great service and very clean. 
The breakfast is fresh and also there very friendly staff. A modern hotel with a Parisian feeling. Also a very beautiful room with space and a big balcony. We are very happy to have chosen this hotel and will recommend this to our friends and family. Thank you for everything!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Nice boutique hotel with perfect location
text: Extremely friendly and helpful staff. Helped us with booking table for dinner which would have been much harder to do on a busy weekend without French skills. Room was very clean and bed confortable. Breakfast was also excellent!
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Had a great stay in the B Montmatre hotel - the staff were wonderful, very pleasant and easy to speak to and made us feel at home. The rooms were clean and spacious, the breakfast was very good and the location was brilliant. Would thoroughly recommend for people visiting Paris
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Very nice!
text: Very nice small hotel with excellent and friendly services. Clean and well smart designed room and bathroom - even though it was small. Good breakfast. We will stay there again next time we travel to Paris.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Long weeks in Paris
text: Excellent hotel with very friendly and helpful staff. Great location with a good choice of bars and restaurants. The rooms are clean with comfortable beds and a good breakfast buffet. Would definitely stay again.
name: B Montmartre Hotel

title: Reasonable standard of Hotel for Business Trip
text: Good service from reception staff and breakfast. Reasonable room (i.e Room 36), however, with the exception of the bathroom) was looking tired and could possibly do with decoration and new carpets. Overall satisfied.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Hotel romance
text: I really recommend this hotel, the staff were so friendly and helpful and I even got a chocolate bar and roses for my birthday. The room was spacious and bed was comfy and the breakfast was good too. You can also leave your luggage in storage room too which is great for later train/plane. We will definitely be going back in the future.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Paris hotel with friendly staff
text:
We arrived at the hotel very late at night because of transport problems. It was a quick & smooth check in. Our room was quite small but it an old city building so this is understandable. The decor wasn't to my taste but it was clean & tidy. The bathroom was clean but the shower was hard to get in & out of. The back of the shower/bath was sloping & with no handrail to hold on to it was very slippery. The window in the bathroom was screwed shut & did not have any blinds so if the light was on at night you felt very exposed. 
There were not any tea/coffee making facilities in the bedroom. 
The breakfast was good & the staff very friendly. 
The hotel is near a metro station & bus stop, it takes 27 mins by bus to the Gare du Nord train Station.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Friendly welcome at a hotel of charm in a fantastic part of Paris
text: The staff were friendly and helpful, the accommodation attractive, clean and comfortable and the value for money great in this lovely hotel located on a quiet street in a lively Paris 'quartier'. There are loads of great cafes and restaurants within easy walking distance of the hotel, as well as beautiful parks and great public transport. I will definitely be back!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Fine
text: Small rooms but oke when it's only to sleep. It was kinda noisy and hot. The bed was good and the bathroom is nice and clean, every day we got us some clean towels. When you had to go downstairs for breakfast it was very dark in the hallway and the breakfast was not oke.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Great name for a lovely small hotel!
text: We had 3 nights here to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. Absolutely delighted with it.  Great communication once booked; warm, friendly and helpful team; very comfortable bed; really good shower; spotlessly clean. Very well soundproofed. Only a few minutes walk from Metro and buses. Tasty breakfast.  Only improvement would be a small chest of drawers in the bedroom.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Nothing to fault for the price
text:
We stayed B&B for 3 nights.  We had the room by reception.  We'd asked for a quiet room with twin beds, but they never picked it up in our request so we had to choose.  We went with the wider beds.  As a result, the room was noisy.  Otherwise, 5 stars.
Like all cheap places in France, the room was small.  The bathroom was usable, but tiny.  Beds comfortable.
Breakfast was an all you could eat buffet down stairs in a nice setting in the cellar.  I couldn't of asked for more, it was delicious if a bit packed.  Set you up for the day.
The hotel is located about 7 minutes walk from a key metro station.
I would recommend it to people on a budget and would stay in the area again.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Decent hotel.
text: Good value. Ok hotel standard. A bit far from city center but a nice and calm area  Decent breakfast but a bit overpriced. Would stay there again. Hard to find something better in the same price range.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Overall cozy
text: Small room but bed is large and you can open the window to let a breeze in. Whenever we went out we had to leave our key with the front desk. Elevator was down so we had to use the stairs. Thankfully our room was on the 2nd floor but the swirl of the stairs made it a bit difficult to carry everything down.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Good value
text: Great welcome and helpful staff.  Good location,  Room small but it had a large bed which was comfortable and did have everything we needed in the room despite the size.  It was close to a metro station which was convenient.  Breakfast was really nice.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Cheap & cheerful hotel
text: If you’re looking for somewhere cheap to stay but nicely located look no further. No frills, nothing exceptional, but clean & functional. With a few very small improvements the hotel might have got a better rating - remove dead Ivy hanging baskets outside hotel, offer water in the rooms or at least a glass for bedside drinks, improve lighting in hallway/stairwells, tightening up plumbing in some rooms. Positives are that it is situated in a quiet street with good restaurants nearby & lovely local shops & cafes. Overall if on a budget a good choice. If you want a bar, seating areas, romantic ambiance this is not the hotel for you. The walls are very thin & one night the guy in the next room was being unwell which got me was a very unpleasant experience (my lucky husband slept through this).
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Excellent!
text: Can’t say enough about the staff here, especially the young lady at the front desk in the morning, Eric (Derek?) who is the day manager, and the hostess in the small restaurant. They were all very friendly and professional. Eric was especially helpful in resolving an issue we had with TravelZoo. While the rooms may be somewhat small, the area is very quiet and peaceful, creating a tranquil place to sleep. The subway is a 10 minute walk and you can be at most destinations within 15-20 minutes. (And the subways are VERY well maintained!) Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Weekend in Paris
text:
The hotel was in a great location. The metro is close by. If visiting Versailles you can get on the train at Pont Cardinet. There were loads of restaurants close by. Breakfast was amazing. Loads of choice. Fresh bread everyday. Also a supermarket 1 min from the front door. 
The corridors and bedrooms look like they could be updated. Main bedroom light switch was outside bedroom. Stayed in room 44 and bathroom was modern and shower was great. Standard hotel shampoo and body wash supplied. Lift seemed very dated and it broke down whilst we were there but fixed really quickly. Not all of staircase was lit so walking up and down stairs was a bit worrying. Got locked out one evening so they may lock the front door quite early so remember your key (we had left it with reception). 
Would stay here again.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A Very Friendly Hotel
text:
Good position and very friendly staff Typical French hotel lots going on around it and very closed to tube and trains to get anywhere easily.
Some nice parks near buy for walking or relaxing and plenty of bars and restaurants within easy reach.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Stay the week before eastern
text: Thank you for your nice service. The hotel is a great place, code to city centre with nice restaurants and bars close by. Rooms are clean, good cost - quality ratio. We had breakfast at some small backeries close by, very Parisian.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Excellent location with friendly and helpful staff
text:
Great location in easy walking distance of main arc de triomphe, sacre coure and Moulin rouge. Excellent bars and restaurants on door step.
Would certainly go back.
Bus service local and really good.
This survey requests too much detail.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Pleasant stay
text: Great location, walking di arance to 3 different metro stations and plenty of nice restaurants in the nighborhood. The rooms are clean and the beds comfortable, and the staff is kind. I would recommend!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Quaint and Charming Hotel
text: We LOVED this hotel. We've traveled in Paris many times before and most of the hotels are wonderful but this one was charming and quaint. The staff was warm and friendly. It was conveniently located  from the metro and the main train station. The breakfast was good, the rooms, although small, very comfortable. We had many changes to out itinerary  due to the pandemic and their are fine with all of them, going out of the way to help us. We will definitely stay there again the next time we're in Paris.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Very polite and caring staff
text: I stayed a single night, however was very satisfied with my room! The location is good and safe, the staff is very polite and helpful. I didnt hear anything from other rooms, so I assume it is more soundproof than other small hotels. Even though the breakfast was a bit small (typical french), it was of good quality. The rooms are of good size and clean (maybe a bit dusty on radiator and carpet corners, so i would recommend guests to bring slippers). Overall very satisfied would come again and can recommend! Thanks!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Cute hotel in good location
text: The hotel is conveniently located near a metro stop, from which you can be in the city center within 10 minutes. Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. The rooms are rather small (perfectly fine in a city like Paris), clean and cozy. Breakfast selection could be a little more comprehensive but it was overall alright. Value for money is very good, so we'd recommend to stay at this hotel.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Had an amazing stay
text: My friend and I loved this hotel, the room was well sized and very clean. It is located in a great area, Restaurants, a Tram Station as well as a grocery Store are very close. We would definetely recommend this place for a stay in Paris. A small Feedback would be to offer full breakfast for All hotel guests. Breakfast is officially till 10 and even when we arrived before 9.30 we were told that "egg time is over" or we  couldn't get baguette, only what was left over. Other than that it was through and through great. Especially the hospitality of the hotel receptionists was outstanding. Very friendly and welcoming staff! Don't hesitate to book this place!!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Nice place to stay!
text:
We have never been in the area of this hotel. It was a pleasant stay and it in a short time you can reach the center. The area is very quiet. The staff is very nice and caring. 
Breakfast in the “ cellar” was a real nice experience
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Tres bon sejour dans un hotel supere
text:
We had a really good stay in this lovely hotel. We did slept well and the breakfast was great
Because of the covid, we had some significant problems with the pcr tests and we will again say thanks to Pierre, lovely guy from the desk who saved us so well in this matter
See you soon, we will definitively comeback one day 
Karoline
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Charming hotel in the 17th arrondissement
text:
Quaint and charming hotel where we spent a couple of nights early June. The staff was very nice and breakfast, which is served in a cave, came with a selection of the yummiest French pastries (croissants, pains au chocolat etc ....).

The hotel is also well located in a chic arrondissement of Paris and close to the Parc Monceau.  I would definitely recommend this place.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: It is so god to be back!
text:
After all these months of anxiety and wfh, it feels somewhat strange to be back on business travel trail. But it feels very familiar to be back in Paris and specially at Hotel Romance, where you could easily close the parenthesis and it is aS if you were there last week or last year! The staff is genuinely pleased to welcome you back and make your stay as Pleasant as possible. Comfort and delicacies are abundant.
It is good to be back and be sure I will be back before next year !!
Keep the good vibes
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: You took Paris to a whole new level
text:
Clean hotel, with nice employees and ideally situated in the center of Paris.

During a business trip in Paris, I stayed at the Romance Malesherbes Hotel.
The room was clean, the bathroom was modern and the breakfast was great.

You will find many buses and subway lines next to the hotel. Therefore, You will be able to reach any parisian district easily and quickly.

The hotel staff is nice, professional and always ready to answer all your questions.

This hotel is now my place-to-go for my next trips to Paris.

See you again soon!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Fabulous Boutique Hotel
text: We purchased a Travelzoo Voucher that included 4 nights and breakfast at Hotel Romance. We loved our time there. It's a European Hotel so do not expect large American sized rooms. Our bed was two twins pushed together (also very common), we didn't even notice while sleeping and dare I say prefrred having our "own" space. . The bathroom/shower was a good size! The location, while seemingly out of the way, looking just at a map,  is actually really great. We walked to the Arc de Triomphe, to Monmartre and took the Malesherbes Metro which was located a short walk away, just about everywhere. The Staff is really lovely, they have 24 hour desk service which is good because you leave your key with them when you go out. Much preferred as it was one less thing to carry. The breakfast options were plentiful and delicious, and the dining area was adorable. We've already booked our next stay back next March.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Beautiful&charming hotel
text: My fiancé and I stayed at this hotel during the Covid-19 outbreak. The staff were accommodating and informative. They helped us find the attractions and supermarkets still open to still make our trip as good as possible. The room was very clean and breakfast was yummy. At one point we had to move to their “sister hotel” a few blocks away due to the Covid-19 outbreak closing down businesses, and they were very helpful with the transfer as well. Highly recommend!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Charming, comfortable jewel box of a hotel
text: Jewel box of a hotel in a residential, quiet part of the city. Absolutely perfect for my first trip to Paris. Walkable to 2 metro stations - one that gives you access to almost all of the sites in the city center, and the other that takes you direct to Versailles. Elegant decor and loads of cozy charm with a distinctly Parisian feel, modern and spotless bathroom, and EXTREMELY comfortable bed. Room was larger than I expected. And a lovely buffet breakfast with a variety of foods. The staff are very friendly and helpful. An EXCELLENT value for a low-maintenance, self-sufficient visitor.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel! We stayed here for 3 nights and we loved our time at Romance Malesherbes :) Hotel staff is great as well as breakfast and position, close to all the major attractions - even walking; definitely recommended :)
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A three star hotel that does its job
text:
The staff is nice, welcoming and helpful. The neighborhood is surrounded by nice multiethnic restaurants and bistrots, and it’s quiet and practical. 
We had a nice 3 star hotel stay, despite the room being a little too small and the power going missing in the middle of the night until the next morning at 10 AM. The bed was very comfortable and everything was perfectly clean. Props to the staff! 
We would suggest an early check-in option for people coming with early flights.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Great city hotel
text: The hotel was in a good location. It's within walking distance of 2 metro stations, easily connecting you to the whole city. The room was a little basic. No air-con in the room, but a fan was provided. No view from the room's windows - would have been nice to have some sort of view, but we didn't spend a lot of time in the hotel so it wasn't really an issue. Despite this, the beds were very comfortable, the bathroom was nice, with a waterfall shower, and the room and hotel was clean, which was all we really needed for our one-night stay in Paris. Check-out was at 12 midday, which was an added bonus - we hate rushing in the morning! Overall very happy with our stay & would recommend!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Nice and Cosy
text: Stuff was very polite. Room was clean but a little bit small. We were missing one more chair and a bigger table. It was pretty loud outside, bad sound isolation. In order to get to the city center better use Metro, is pretty far to take a walk. Metro station is ap. 700 m from hotel.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Good hotel very convenient for transport
text: Good hotel very convenient for transport only minor criticism is the lack of tea and coffee making facilities in the room. My room was very clean and warm enough.. I would certainly use this hotel again.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Small room with tiny shower, but it served the purpose
text:
I stayed here for 2 nights, and the receptionist Thomas was a great help during my stay. He was speaking good English and he managed to help with guiding me to visit places around the city. 

My room had a bathroom, and a toilet, two separate units, both of which are quite tight. Especially the shower space in the bathroom was tiny. 

It's good for a quick stay (1-2 nights) as a couple or solo.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Short 3 day trip
text: Overall excellent value for money. Short 3 day trip. Light walls, so noise from neighboring rooms has to be accepted as it is an old building, but well kept and maintained. App,800m to Metro, 30 min. to are de Nord.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: excellent
text: the room location cleanliness and comfort are very good, breakfest could be better. the staff was very helpful and informative. It was a sort of homey environment, with easy access to metro which is in walking distance
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A great hotel in a beaufiful part of Paris
text: Excellent! I felt like I was coming home. The staff was friendly, professional, helpful and always available, it was like staying with very goods friends. I loved my room: so cosy, so beautiful. I look forward to my next stay!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Nice for a few days trip to Paris
text: Nice small city hotel close to Montmatre area. Very friendly staff and a very clean location. The hotel is surrounded by several nice restaurants and the location is quite. The rooms are very small but good for a few days.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A good way to discover French hospitality!
text: This hotel really cares about it's costumers. Everthing about our stay was prepared carefully and the staff and manager were very friendly and ready to help. The room's interior may not be the fanciest of all, but it was very clean! We also loved the (continental) breakfast buffet with croissants, pains de chocolat, toast and baguette, different kinds of jam, cereal, fresh orange juice... Over all we had a very good stay here!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Perfect!
text: Stayed at this place in April 2017 with my family. Very cosy, comfortable hotel that's located in the centre. Metro station 3 minutes by walk. Superb breakfast. Amazing staff. My daughter loved the place. Thank you for great hospitality.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Excellent
text: Excellent hotel in the hart of Paris, with many restaurants and shops nearby, Quiete and clean and very tidy room. The breakfast was very nice.Personnel very helpful and available at any time for prviding all needed services.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Average
text: Rooms were smallas they are in Paris but bathrooms were big and nice. Decently located. Rude man on the reception who was always in a hurry God bless him with patience. But the other guy on the reception guided us how to book for lido which saved some 💰. Overall okay nothing great but it's Paris...
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Pleasant stay in Paris
text: Pleasant little hotel, quite a walk to the metro on a hot day. Eric the manager good fun.Would have liked an English speaking news channel like BBC Word/Sky/CNN in this day & age its pretty expected. We were not told about the free coffee & water until we were leaving, would have been nice to know it was there in the lobby.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A good stay in a nice hotel
text:
A nice hotel with friendly staff who were all very happy to help. The area is a lovely area for exploring and long walks around Paris but also very accessible by trains.
 Rooms are basic and could do with a lick of paint but are comfortable and very clean. We had a fan in our cupboard in case we got hot but opening the windows sufficed for us and as we were in a quiet area was not bothered by outside noise.
We’d stay again
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Lovely hotel and staff not too far from anything
text:
We stayed for 3 nights, 4 days in Paris and are so glad we chose this hotel. We had a great time, and the staff were great, and helped us book the river cruise which is definitely worth doing. 
The breakfast had just enough selection for us to be full every morning, although I would have loved some hot options but I know this isn’t the continental way. The ladies at breakfast were very helpful and attentive, constantly refreshing the juice and hot drinks. 
The bedroom was very comfortable, although the bath was on the smaller side. 
Location wise this hotel is just outside of the main tourist part of Paris, but we walked everyday and found routes through Parc Monceau which made the walk to the champs elysses fast and lovely to look around whilst walking. 
There are shops very close by which is great for buying lunch or food for the journey whilst walking to attractions abit further away as there are not many shops by the Seine.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Average
text:
Overall, we had a lovely time in Paris.  The hotel is fine but average.
Pros: The location was great for us.  Just outside the main hotspots but easy to reach by transport and fab local shops/cafes.
The people at the hotel are approachable and helpful.
Cons: We had the two ground floor rooms, noisy, unable to have windows open as it was on a main street (that said hotel provided a fan) One room was opposite the check in desk and the other room was opposite the main front door.
The room is tired and basic.
If you are using it as a base only - then it is fine.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Lovely stay
text: The hotel staff were incredibly helpful. We were in a great location and enjoyed walking throughout our trip, although the metro was close by. Lots of lovely restaurants nearby and supermarkets everywhere. The hotel provided a nice breakfast although not a huge selection.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: We will come again
text: The hotel had a good location. They also recommend a cheaper parking. Metro and bus are just around the corner. The services are great. The room was also clean. Very nice hosts. We recommend the hotel.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Fantastic location & staff really helpful.
text:
Really lovely well located hotel, room with kitchenette really good as supermarket local. 
Staff really helpful and appreciate attempts at French communication even if really limited.
Would recommend for reasonably price accommodation.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Good value boutique hotel near the Parc Monceau
text: Whilst the hotel looks unprepossessing from the outside, it offers quirky but comfortable accommodation in a pleasant quartier. You couldn’t be anywhere but Paris as you are reminded when you step out of your room on to a carpet designed as a city map. Rooms are small but clean and comfortable and the recently refurbished showed room was excellent. Helpful staff on reception with a small seating area in the lobby and coffee-making facilities. Close to Malsherbes Metro and plenty of cafes and brasseries and shopping streets used by locals. The breakfast room in the cellar is a bit cramped and the coffee was awful so I only used it once and went to local cafes for the rest of my stay. The television failed to work on two of the three mornings I was there. The receptionist said it just needed to be unplugged and plugged in again, but it was wall mounted and out of my reach so not something I was prepared to take on myself. Niggles aside, I would go there again.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Thanks to Eric
text:
They offer you comfortable bed and good cleaning. There is no big lobby but even in that conditions they offer you to bring coffee while you are waiting for something. Cleaning was perfect but towels little bit old. If you need some info about city or want to talk about sports, politics, history find Eric. 

Ps: room 35 bathtub floor is sleepery, im sure they will take care of it soon
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Feels like home
text:
This is our 4th stay in as many years. Yes we keep coming back. We like the location, the privacy, the cost, the breakfast, the beds, the staff and yes everything about this location. 
It’s across the street from a grocery store, down the street from many brasseries, patisseries, wine shops, metro and markets.
In the 17th.. it’s perfect.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Friendly staff, good price-quality
text: We had a very nice stay at hotel romances malesherbes. The room was clean and comfortable with good beds. The staff was awesome at reception and breakfast. Breakfast was simple but sufficient. Metro stop at 10 minuts walking distance.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Good hotel
text:
The hotel was good, with the staff as it's biggest asset. The guy at the reception desk went out of his way to recommend us some places in Paris we didn't visit yet. 

The room itself was not super-big, but good. The bathroom had a very nice walk-in shower. The room temperature was fairly warm, so we didn't sleep well for the first part of the night, but opening a window fixed most of it.

Breakfast was nice and the breakfast room is very cosy and cute! Again, the staff was super-friendly and there was plenty to choose from. The hot chocolate is to be recommended!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Bad experience

name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Lovely hotel in quiet location

Breakfast was served in the 'cave' which offered a great selection of cold food, croissants, pastries, cold meats, eggs, fruit and yogurts. Really recommend this small select hotel in quiet backstreet of Paris.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Definitely would come back to this hotel
