Hotel is very well located, 20 minute walk to the Champs Elysée. Walk through a realy nice park. Hotel staff is real friendly and helpful. 
Breakfast is not real big but good. A typical french breakfast
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Great value for the money!
text: The staff were very accommodating and nice.  Our stay was very pleasant.  The hotel is very close to the Metro and bus lines and just a quick drive to the heart of Paris.  The Hotel was as advertised quaint and well cared for.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Paris
text: What an excellent chic hotel, close to public transport. Staff are extremely friendly and very helpful. Definetely worth a visit. Room was a bit small for a family but due to the area/property it is understandable the rooms may be small.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: All ok
text: We have had a very pleasant stay. The hotel staff has been very friendly and helped us a lot. The location of the hotel is adequate. The metro stops are not too far and the neighborhood is a quiet area.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Hotel Romance Malesherbes: neither disappointing nor satisfying!
text:
Positive: friendly staff, good location (5-10 min to metro station; easy to get to all the sights; multiple grocery stores and restaurants around the corner), quiet neighborhood (most of the time), comfortable bed, excellent wifi connection (see picture of wifi test).

Negative: room wasn't ready when we arrived (check-in time was supposed to at 2 pm but we had to wait for one hour), room was rather small, not enough clothes hooks, hair in shower from previous guests or cleaning lady (see picture), loose/wobbly toilet seat.

Overall: Neither disappointing nor satisfying! I would try a different hotel next time.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Excellent hotel
text:
Hi I just wanted to thanks all the staff at Hotel Romance. They were all amazing and very friendly especially Eric who was very helpful and Alice etc
The hotel is a bit far from Gard du north but with the metro it is less than 30 min
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Staff was excellent, nice top floor room
text: A little off the beaten path but no issues at all with the place. We had a larger than expected top floor room with a nice street view. Bathroom had been updated. The front desk staff was pleasant & helpful. Street market close by in Levis Street. An excellent restaurant across the street. Overall good value but will pay a little more next time to be more central the sites & action.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: My stay in Hotel Romance
text:
This is a small hotel in a nice neighbourhood in Paris. The hotel is less than seven minutes walk from Villiers metro station. From Villiers it takes five minutes on metro, and 20 minutes walking through Blvd Courcelles  to reach Etoile. Villiers is a neighbourhood with plenty of nice restaurants and brasseries. It is 15 minutes from Place de Clichy and Moulin Rouge. 
The hotel is an old building making the most of the tiny space it occupies. This is not a hotel with a big lobby or fancy restaurant. The architects converting the old building into a hotel have done a good job; they have created a highly functional environment for the purpose of the business. The staircase is spiral, tiny and typical of other older Parisian buildings tricky to climb down. 
The eatery is in the basement; again another outstanding conversion of the smallest spaces into a space in where somehow miraculously seven coffee tables are fitted. The transparent plastic chairs and light cold colour play a major role here.
The rooms are spacious with good sized beds. Even more, the hotel offers free wifi and room safe; amenities that some of 4 star hotels in Paris dont. My room was clean, of good size and with clean and modernly decorated bathroom and shower. 
On the downside, I found the pillows an mattress too soft for me. The room was too hot in Paris' hot and humid July evenings. An air conditioner would be a welcome addition. My room oversaw rue Cardinet that was a bit noisy in the evenings. Improved double glazing should address this issue. 
Perhaps the most important asset of this hotel is its staff. They are genuinely nice and helpful. Very professional. 
Would I recommend this hotel? Of course I would.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Excellent
text:
A very nice place to be, I highly recommend this hotel.
Just 3 days of stay but we will be back. 
The room is very spacious, comfortable and  with a bathroom absolutely lovely and clean. 
The location is in a pleasant quarter we only had to walk few minutes for a bus or the metro. And we have been really touched by all the staff always there when we had questions or just to say hello. 
Thank you so much We will see you soon !!!!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Romantik Parisian place, sweet staff but not memorable
text:
I stayed at this hotel for a weekend getaway in Paris with my boyfriend. The hotel is cute, romantik and decorated with a typical Parisian interior which is wunderful. You totally get a Parisian vibe at this hotel. The staff is so kind and helpful and totally at your service at all time - AND they speak english very well.

The rooms are small but clean, cute and comfy. The bed was, in our opinion, quite hard so our backs were sore the last day. It's great for a weekend getaway where you are not planning to spend that much time at your room. It's a fine room and clean, as I said, but it's not something special and the view isn't good.

The breakfast was disappointing. It was fresh and the selection was poor. But then again the stay wasn't that expensive, so of course you shouldn't count on everything to be perfect.

Overall a nice and safe stay that we aren't totally satisfied with but not disappointing either. It's quite valuable for the money though.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Little gem of a hotel
text:
This is a small but very nice hotel. Location is very central - walking distance to the Etoile, and the staff really tried their best to be helpful and answer any request.
Breakfast was surprisingly good. 
Overall this was excellent value for money - great for a short romantic stay.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Really good hotel in Paris
text:
Room was small, but clean and nicely decorated, also very calm, we have not heard any noise from the street or other rooms. Only lamp on the table did not work, so the room was quite dark with one lamp at the bedside.
Breakfast was excellent, especially orange juices and apple pies, but we had a small misunderstanding on first Sunday morning, because nobody worked at 7 a.m. as there was written, that‘s why we took what we found on the table, and since we had own small electric kettle, we made a coffee ourselves. We had not any problems other days as we got up later.
Staff was helpful and friendly. Location is good - a walking distance to the Arc de Triomphe and Montmarte.
We would stay here next time.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Very nice staff
text: The hotel is very small but comfortable, very clean and with nice decoration. The staff is incredible nice, they do their best to be helpfull and kind, it was a pleasure to stay in this hotel.  Greetings from México.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Amazing Hotel
text:
We booked for 1 night , but everything was so great that at the end we stayed for 3 more nights. The room was big enough, also the bathroom, and the breakfast was really good!
Very cosy atmosphere and perfect location in Paris...
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A pleasant stay
text: A romantic weekend in a quiet hotel equipped with all comforts. The staff was kind and helpful. The hotel is conveniently located for visiting the city. The bedroom was clean and tidy as the other hotel premises.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Perfect for a Parisian stay
text:
Rooms are very clean and nicely decorated in the Parisian style. Breakfast is excellent. The hotel is perfectly located in the charming neighbourhood "Batignolles". 
Absolutely perfect for a Parisian stay !
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Charming and modern
text:
First, I love the fast wifi. I rely so much on it when i travel so when it's not working or it's DSL speed, it makes the whole experience miserable. Good job on that
The rooms were somewhat small (but expected based on the hotel *** rating) but clean and well appointed. I like the breakfast room and the continental seemed pretty good but didn't have time to sit down for breakfast the 2 mornings I was there (although i did enjoy the orange juice). I'll be back.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: A cosy and charmful hotel
text: I slept here only one night but really enjoyed my stay. The receptionnist has been very helpful and booked a cab and museum tickets for me. The breakfast was good, which is not always the case in other hotels... Highly recommend the hotel for business trips to Paris.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Perfect Parisian Hotel
text: We stayed here for 5 nights from 1/03/17 to the 6/03/17, and it was such a wonderful stay. The hotel is located only a short walk from the metro, and it is surrounded by an abundance of lovely restaurants and little bakeries. Malesherbes was the perfect Parisian area for our first trip to Paris. The staff couldn't be more friendly, helpful and accommodating, and we felt so at home because of this. The room was brilliantly clean, a perfect size for us, a very comfortable bed and the bathroom was excellent. The decor was a perfect blend of modern and a traditional Parisian style. We were so impressed with our stay here and would return again in a heartbeat. It was the cherry on top to a perfect break away to Paris.
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Beautiful and romantic stay in Paris
text: Breakfast was amazing very yummy bread and fresh orange juice. We enjoyed the polite and nice staff that helped us around and all in all the stay was perfect! It was easy to get around you can either walk everywhere (4 days 140km) or take the metro or bus which is nearby!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Great hotel for citytrip in paris
text:
Great hotel for city trip in Paris, near metro station, Arc de triomphe, Sacre Coer.
good price, clean room, great breakfast in beautiful cellar of the hotel.
Nice staff to help you on you're way in Paris
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Average
text:
Small hotel located outside the most busy areas

+ Good price
+ Friendly staff
+ Clean
+ OK breakfast

- Sound travel very easy between rooms and from street
- Tight space everywhere
- Location not the best
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Fantastic service
text:
What an amazing place to stay. Very friendly staff who are eger to help and support you with your stay. 
Very good facilities and nice and central to all the big attractions via the metro system. 
Good rooms and nice complementary breakfast. 
We will be back again!!!
name: Hotel Romance Malesherbes by Patrick Hayat

title: Good, but could be great
text: The hotel overlooks a courtyard and there are great city views.  This is a very quaint hotel and would be a much better hotel if the rooms had more towels, provided wash cloths, a mini fridge and had fitness center.  Montmartre is one of the coolest areas in Paris.  I call it the "Lincoln Park" of Paris.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Quiet and friendly
text: Great location on a quiet place. Close to cafes, bars and small shops. The metro is only 2 mins walk away. Everything is clean and quiet. Everything you'd expect for a hotel in this price range is provided. The staff are friendly and efficient
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Small room.  Great staff.  Nice breakfast. Pricey
text: The location is fabulous.  We enjoyed a superb view from our 5th floor room, overlooking Paris.  The staff are lovely.  The breakfast is plentiful and varied.  Clean room.  Only 3 stars because; small-ish room with little storage space for clothes etc, very small bathroom (plenty of hot water though), drab decor, minimalist coffee and tea making provisions, tiny lift (slightly nitpicking), basic and uninspiring breakfast area, and finally, very expensive.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Best short term hotel!
text: Very nice, pleasant hotel. Clean and nice rooms (lived in double superior). One minus is only lack of some vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers during the breakfast. Rest -wonderful. But you are to visit Paris, not to eat breakfast, so location is the best!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Super nice location and fine value for money
text: A nice location at Montmartre where you find this relaxed wibe you want during vacation. The hotel offers precise the service we asked for, in a very kindly and serviceminded way. The breakfast cost was fair with 13€/day
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location, but room was just ok
text: The location is great, just a short walk to Sacre Coeur. However, the hotel is located in a small square with about 10 steps as well as a few steps to enter the building. This was fine for me, but could be a problem for some people. However, when I arrived, I was told the elevator was not working and I would need to carry my luggage to the 5th floor. After carrying my backpack up the stairs, I realized that I would be unable to carry my suitcase. I told the young lady at check-in & then she carried it up the stairs. I've attached a photo of the staircase. The elevator was working a few hours later and continued to work for the rest of my stay. So, I don't know if that is a common occurrence. The room itself was small, but ok. The AC did work well. The breakfast room was small & crowded and the food was mediocre. The best part of my room was that if you leaned out the window, you could see the Eiffel tower.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Good Location, SoSo Hotel
text: Nice location, close so Sacre Coeur and Montmartre.  Our "standard" room was very tiny.  No storage, so we lived out of our suitcases.  No place to even put your soap in the shower.  Breakfast was pitiful.  Scrambled eggs were doled out just enough for a couple of folks before they were gone.  The side of ham was a glob of sliced ham in a warmer completely unseparated.  Front desk seem uninterested.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Lovely hotel in the best area of Paris - Montmartre
text:
It's only 3 stars but very comfortable, clean and with great views over Paris. The front desk gives excellent service and the rooms are very clean and quiet so you can sleep with the windows open.
The only negative was the lack of drainage in the shower zone so the bathroom got very wet and held the water near the WC.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Fabulous view!
text:
Although the walk up the hills is tough, it is well worth it for the views.  From our room 417, we were able to view the Eiffel Tower and watch the lights.  What a wonderful way to end the night. 

Our room had a small balcony where you could see everything.  We enjoyed watching the foot traffic below.  There was live music all the time. When we decided we didn’t want to hear it anymore, we simply closed our balcony doors. 

Our room had a wonderful view and very comfortable beds, 1 double bed and 1 twin bed. The air conditioner did not really keep the room cold, but we did not call the office to correct the issue.  There is a small wardrobe and enough room to move throughout the room. There is no mini-fridge in this room and the bathroom shower was large. 

The 2nd room we had was room 418, one double bed which we did not appreciate.  The room is too small for 2 people with luggage. 

The elevator is super small and stopped working while we were there but the staff was quick to fix it and keep everyone safe. The staff was knowledgeable and friendly.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Best hotel in the area!
text:
Close to metrostation, beautiful surroundings, great views from hotelroom, friendly staff, nice breakfast, close to restaurants.
Tip: book a 'room with view' for the most amazing birdview over Paris / Montmartre.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location in Paris
text: Great location. Helpful reception and good restaurants close by. Easy access to the rest af rest of Paris. Book Your room at the top floors to get a great view over Paris. We did not try the breakfast.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Paris
text: Well situated hotel nearby Sacre Couer and the metro.  Rooms clean and comfortable.  Nice breakfast and good staff. Good restaurants nearby and nice view from bedrooms.  Wifi good and walking distance to Sacre Couer and the markets.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Location excellent, rooms could be better
text: Very limited wardrobe capacity (especially the number of two-piece hangers). No coat rack in the corridor of room 412. Second chair would be nice for a superior room for two people. Only one duvet (which was too thick for the current temperatures). Request to service for second duvet was not fulfilled and the extra cover that was put on instead of the duvet was removed again the next day. Price increase for room compared to pre-pandemic prices is strong but room quality is not at that level. I was a bit disappointed this time and will look for alternatives next time.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Very Good
text: Went for a Friend's Wedding. The hotel was the Perfect location, it was clean, friendly the rooms were a little small but well equip. Montmartre is a buzzing beautiful part of Paris.  Will definitely go back.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: The worst experience... we were robbed
text:
I went with my family to this hotel and we were robbed. They opened our room and the safe and stole all our money.
the manager was very rude.
The cameras coincidentally were off.
The worst experience with my family, I do not recommend this hotel at all.
As i read , this is not the first experience of this hotel...
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Excellent value in a vibrant neighborhood
text: The front desk staff, the location at the center of the neighborhood and the tower view room made our stay special. Comfortable quiet room was welcome after wandering around this unique neighborhood during the day.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Presque parfait!
text:
Very nice hotel at a beautiful  little square, friendly staff and very nice breakfast.
Recommend it for a short stay in pittoresk Montmartre. Very well situated.
Search no longer, book this hotel.
 👍👍👍
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Timhotel Montmatre
text:
We were in Paris for 4 days and felt comfortable at Timhotel Montmatre. Although the room and especially the bathroom was quite small, but compensated for our view of the city and the Eiffel Tower (room was on the 5th floor). The breakfast buffet was sufficiently rich (with scrambled eggs, ham, cereals, fresh fruit salad,...) and the location pleasantly quiet (despite the proximity to Sacre Cour) and nice and central to explore Paris from there. 
We felt very well.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: For the location thumbs up
text: Perfect location in the Montmartre. We paid for city view which was great, but at that price the room should've been bigger. Hardly room to move around, and a small closet. A very old and dirty wall-to-wall carpet - tear that out and I might be back. The staff were very helpful and so nice and friendly!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Perfect location for weekend trip
text: Unbeatable location in Montmartre - steps from restaurants, cafes, bakeries and shops. Despite being so close to sights and eateries, the rooms are quiet and you'll get an undisturbed sleep after a day of walking up and down the neighbourhood's steps. Rooms are small but efficiently designed and clean.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Good
text: Timhotel Montmartre is a good hotel, with -as usual in Paris- smaller rooms, but clean, looking almost new, with a very enjoyable hard showerbeam on an excellent location. Nice terrace accros and sometimes musicartists on the square of the hotel. Would recommend.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Lovely little hotel, perfect location
text:
Great location, helpful friendly service from reception, breakfast and cleaning staff.
5 minutes from main square and great views of Paris.
Plenty of great bars and restaurants within walking distance.
Very good buffet breakfast.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Beautiful Place in Monmartre
text: Beautiful, quite place in a very nice district. Close to shops. Beautiful view from my room!!!!! All the staff is excellent! Nicolas has been amazing! There is a little courtyard infront of the hotel which is not touristy. Good price fos a beautiful view of the city.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Jenna status hotel the lady who works the morning lobby is lazy she does not do her job they made me check out early
text: If you want to go to Paris and have a ruin vacation then I suggest you go to this hotel because they will definitely ruin your stay my main reason why I went to Paris France was to go to the Saint Michel there was supposed to be a taxi cab driver in the lobby at 7 AM I was in the lobby at 7 AM and there was no I repeat no taxi cab driver the receptionist was outside smoking and then the manager wants to carpool face lie but they cannot show me evidence that there was a taxi cab driver there when I had to pay $50 for a taxi to take me to where I was supposed to meet my tour group and they had left and I am yet waiting to receive my refund from France tours do not use them either  because they also lie to tell me that day and a half prior to me going that the trip was booked but I had booked my vacation back in October then they said there was a computer error and they said OK I was going to be at the travel place  where we was the all meet up I got there at 7:25 and the driver was gone he said he was there till 730 but I cannot get in touch with nobody from France tourism but yet the receptionist was able to get in touch with at the Driver you go figure but if you want a ruined vacation  yeah go here stay here if not I suggest you stay somewhere’s house and don’t mess with France tourism they go by four different names
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Room with a view
text:
A very nice, tiny hotel. We've been here 5 years ago as well. Make sure to book the room with a view on top level. 
The surrounding area is very unique and has a great atmosphere. 
The breakfast is small but not only enough, it's just delicious. 
The hotel is clean and the employees are very friendly. Looking forward to another stay and some of my friends will be there soon.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Fantastic
text: Stayed in a small cozy room in mansarda of the top floor with views over Eiffel tower and roofs of Montmartre: incredible and stunning. The queen bed was comfortable and clean. The water was hot in shower. The personnel is super helpful and responsive all the time. The location is amazing. Very recommend
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: There was nothing negative about this Hotel.
text:
A lovely hotel in the beautiful Artist region of  Montmartre . 
A clean and stylish entrance with welcoming staff. The check-in process was quick and efficient.
We requested a balcony with city views ……. and we were delighted to have got both.
Their is a spiral staircase to the rooms or an elevator which can hold 4 people, both were well maintained and clean.
The room had a electronic key entrance and was easy to find. We were on the fourth out of five floors.
The room was amazing. Parisian hotels tend to have smaller rooms then places like London, but our room was spacious. 
We had a wonderful view of the city and the Eiffel Tower, which we requested, with opening French doors onto a balcony.
The bed was very comfortable and there were tea and coffee making facilities in the room.
The bathroom was small, but well decorated…… very modern and fully equipped.
The shower was hot with a lot of pressure and our towels were replaced daily. Hair dryer and shaving point were built into the bathroom.
There were no slippers or bath robe as the amenities stated, but that was fine.
Breakfast was between 6.30am -10.30am and was amazing, everything you could have wanted from a Parisian breakfast and to set you up for a day of sightseeing.
The neighbour of Montmartre is a vibrant, lively Artist part of Paris with amazing restaurants, boutiques and places of interest to visit.
The area is a high part of Paris so there are a lot of steep walkways and cobbles streets, so you will be able to easily burn off all you eat or drink.
All in all a wonderful hotel in a beautiful area. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Central place by a park
text: A very central place, close to a little park. On the fifth floor we had a marvelous wieu. Very close to Montmartre but not turistic around us. A nice café in front of the hotel and good restaurants close.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Visit to celebrate L´Arc the Triomphy by Cristo
text:
Located at a beautiful square in the "village" (Montmartre) within the "megacity" (Paris) Timhotel Montmartre is a good spot to stay if you love the "vie francaise" with the nice cafés, restaurants and shops around the corner.
With a no-frills concept that combines elegance, efficiency, friendliness, and (especially in corona times) cleanliness this is a place worth returning to.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: best hotel in Montmartre
text: It's quiet but close to the Butte. Also close to several of the best restaurants in the 18th/19th. If you want a room with space, ask for it. They do exist. In my case, the room had a view of Place Goudeau, but was too small to even have a desk to work on,
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: A four-day trip to Paris
text:
Considering all the aspects, I find only advantages and highly recommend the Timhotel Montmartre for a trip to Paris.
Perfect location and a very polite and professional team.
We will be happy to return there next time.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Super lovely clean room, tiny space
text:
First of all do NOT follow google maps, especially if you’re walking - it’s WRONG.. 
We lugged our suitcases from Gard Du Nord up hills, to find out it was 1/4 mile further away.. even now when I look on google maps it shows the TimHotel in 1 spot and it’s totally wrong..
Urghh that got us off to a bad start. The hotel is right next to Montmartre  Museum.

Right around the corner from Abbesses metro. It’s in a great location, literally 3 minute walk to the beginning of Montemarte Square it’s also next to Montemarte  Museum Close. And pretty close to Pigalle station.
€14 for breakfast we didn’t indulge.

We loved staying there it had beautiful clean rooms. Rooms were small (but most of Europe’s hotels are) but we had beautiful white clean linen & duvets 
We ordered a triple single room I believe it was the superior triple (a few € extra) 1st floor, corner room with double windows  which gave us a  street view (we didn’t want to be in an attic at the top of the stairs)
A small closet to hang coats no drawers & 1 luggage rack so it meant a lot of juggling with our cases to make sure we could actually move around  in the room. 
Kettle with tea & instant coffee and 2 creamers!! 
Why are hotels so stingy on giving cream to their patrons - 3 of us to share 2 tiny creamers!!!! 

Anyway the bathroom was compact but clean had a fabulous hot towel rail so we could  rinse out our bits & dry them overnight. Had a large window overlooking the street which we obviously kept closed for the most part, but it was lovely to have the option to open.

The beds were very comfortable the pillows were comfortable and overall we were very happy with the Modern clean look of the room we would definitely all stay there again
The guy at reception was very friendly and helpful.
There is a tiny lift.
For the price we paid we totally would recommend,  it’s a small hotel but extremely clean with a modern feel especially the bathroom. The bedding was lovely.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Simply Perfect
text:
Good location. Friendly staff.  Comfortable beds and pillows. Very clean. Powerful showers.   All you can eat buffet style breakfast with a good selection of choices.
Would definitely recommend and will stay again if travelling in the area.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Location and Comfort 5 stars!
text: Comfortable bed and room.The front desk staff was excellent -- very knowledgeable and caring. They gave recommendations for nearby restaurants at various price points and they did not disappoint. The location was perfect! Would definitely return.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Terrific small hotel
text: We loved our room with a view over the city of Paris.  The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful.  Rooms are small but comfortable.  Great location just a couple of blocks from a Metro stop.  Restaurants and shopping are close by.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: My very favourite hotel
text: The views over Paris were absolutely gorgeous and beyond anything I could have imagined. Considering the view and its location, the room was incredibly affordable and very quiet. I love the sustainability efforts of this boutique hotel and the staff were lovely. Despite being a few minutes late for checkout (due to getting hopelessly lost) the reception staff were extremely understanding and accommodating. A gorgeous romantic hotel that I adored staying in.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location
text: The rooms although on the small side were very clean and tidy. The location was great for sightseeing and restaurants. would definitely recommend it.My wife and I were only there for three days and found the hospitality of the locals very friendly and the food excellent.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: The worst hotel !
text: The bathroom had mold in the shower, the heater didn’t work, the room was small. Their idea of a room with a view of the city was looking at trees and a run down neighborhood. The elevator didn’t work. We stayed one night, it was so bad we left and went to another hotel and didn’t get any of our money back for the whole week.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location with a fantastic view of Paris!
text: Great location near the heart of Montmartre with a fantastic view of Paris!  Good breakfast served until 10:30 am. Safe and quiet feel both inside and outside the hotel.  Very friendly and helpful front desk staff.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Nice place situated in an excellent location
text:
The hotel is cute and cozy. the bathroom is very clean which I'm particular of when travelling.
Few minutes walk from Eiffel Tower. There are many cafes, shops, resto near the hotel. Reception staff are all nice but there was only one staff who always ask us how are day went, his name is Ola. He makes sure we have a great stay in the hotel. Ola is the best. He is an asset to the team. We have a great time.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Formidable
text:
Great little hotel close to place du tetre and le sacred coeur 
Rooms were very quaint and a nice size
Beds were comfy if not a little small but perfect for our needs 
Service at front desk was amazing. Cheery happy and very informative 
Breakfast was ok ! Pastries were great and cold buffet too but the scrambled eggs were not good, microwaved to death , service at breakfast was rough and rude which was a shame as it tainted the stay. 
I would definitely stay again
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Excellent
text: Stayed for three nights with friends. You can find so many things to see in the neighborhood.  Close to Sacre Coeur, we loved the location, very nice stuff, very good breakfast, would love to go back :)
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: My partner and I spent a few day in Paris and stayed at this lovely boutique hotel in Montmartre. If you’re looking to spend a lot of time in Montmartre this is the perfect hotel, it’s halfway up the hill to Sacré-Cœur and is walking distance to the Moulin Rouge (take a nap, Paris streets are tricky) the hotel staff were lovely and helpful (particularly Alex who checked us in). It is super close to Rue des Abbesses and Place du Tertre.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Amazing city view and location!
text: My girlfriend and I requested a room with a nice view. I wasn't expecting a view of the whole Parisian skyline and a balcony AND a bottle of champagne. Location was also great. Right in the heart of Montmarte, but the service was more than adaptable. Would stay again, definitely!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Delightful Stay
text: My wife and I stayed here for three nights in early October. It is very well run. We received a warm and helpful greeting upon our arrival. The room was good sized and clean. Just a small problem with the bathroom door that wouldn't latch. The breakfast buffet was great each morning. We loved the location in Montmartre! Great restaurants and stores nearby. Would love to stay here again someday.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: was nice
text:
Our room was small, but was very nice. Staff were very friendly, And helpful. The cooked breakfast was great. Will stay here again next time we stay in Paris.
Out side the door is this great sitting outsdide area. We sat down, had a beer each (not cheap) but the people were lovely, someone was playing live music, it was just peaceful. The only problem was that you had to walk up this hill to get to the hotel.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location great staff
text:
Stayed here with 4 friends for 3 nights. All of had our own room, a compact clean and quiet space with all amenities. The breakfast was very good with fresh juice and fruit and freshly cooked eggs and a variety of breads etc.
The location was in a quiet corner of Montmartre near metro stations and a wide variety of restaurants. It has a lovely 'local neighbour's feel and the staff were very welcoming and helpful and had perfect English.
You will not be disappointed in this hotel.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Wonderful location
text: Our family stayed in the Tim Hotel on our last night in Paris. We chose the rooms with a view of the Paris skyline and the Eiffel Tower. The rooms were very clean and well appointed and having the view was a great end to our time in France. I was travelling with my daughter and grand-children and they were delighted when on the hour the Eiffel Tower put on a light show. From the bathroom of one of our rooms you also had a view of Sacre Couer. The staff were most helpful and we would chose this hotel again.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location, comfortable bed
text: The location is excellent as long as you don't mind walking up and down hills (we don't mind). We had a superior room with view which was on the top floor. Our assigned room had a very bad drain odour so after the first night we asked for a change of room which was done without any fuss. The bed was very comfortable and the room very clean with great views over Paris. Unfortunately, the top floor rooms in the roof area are very tight and the bathroom we had very difficult to shower in etc. The front desk staff were excellent. The breakfast is your usual continental buffet style with a few additions, however, once again the breakfast room is so tight so we went out to local cafes and achieved a better outcome in our estimation. We would go to another Timhotel but be careful about room selection.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Timhotel Monmartre experience
text: Pleasant hotel and helpful staff but rooms and particularly en-suite facilities are small. Breakfast facilities are very poor as they are simply far too small to accommodate guests at peak times.  The tables are so close together it is difficult to pass by without disrupting other guests and on 2 of the 3 days of my stay guests were queuing for tables.  The self service area is also extremely poor as it is far too small and only accommodates 2 to 3 guests comfortably at any one time. This is made worse by staff continually pushing past to replenish breakfast items.  Need to relocate the toast and drink machine elsewhere as these are the items that take guests time and therefore puts extra stress on the self service area.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great place to stay
text: Lovely quiet, clean and cosy with a lovely area in front with trees and benches, breakfast was excellent with plenty of variety and lovely  friendly receptionist, lots of nice restaurants and shops, near Sacre Coeur
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Weekend with my sister
text: Chose this hotel as it looked great value for money so was expecting low budget. It exceeded all our expectations. Arrived for 3 nights as a treat for my sisters 50th birthday. On arrival we were greeted warmly at reception who provided us with useful advice and recommendations. Our room was snug but it was only somewhere to rest our head each night after exhausting the sights of Paris and the view of the Eiffel Tower was breathtaking. Coffee making facilities and hairdryer were a lovely touch and the room and bathroom were clean and spotless. Didn’t have breakfast as was room only so can’t comment on that. The hotel is situated in a lovely area and if you can manage the steps up to the square and Sacre Coeur you will not be disappointed. Wonderful restaurants and cafes to stop off for a meal or a cheeky glass of vin and stunning views over the city. The metro is a short walk away and great for getting to all the attractions of Paris. Thanks to Timhotel Montmartre we are now going to make this an annual event. Paris has stolen my heart and this hotel helped us create fabulous memories.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Perfect little hotel for city break in Paris ❤️
text: Montmartre is beautiful and the location of this hotel is just perfect. Close to everything but not so close you’re in the middle of it! The staff were very helpful and kind and made us feel very welcome. The breakfast choice was fantastic and we will be back next summer to stay again. Thank you Timhotel ✨
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great place to stay
text:
The Timhotel at Montmartre is a hotel that we have stayed at several times and always come back to.  The hotel is very quaint - nothing outstanding but nothing bad either. It's a bit tight for space - but so are most affordable Paris hotels.  It is a neat clean hotel - the staff are always helpful and friendly which makes it a pleasure to stay there.  It has the world's smallest and slowest lift - but I need the exercise on the stairs anyway.  The location is it's most outstanding feature. After ascending the 25% climb from Abbesses metro station you reach this lovely shady square with this quaint hotel at one corner. The restaurant oppose is also very good.  While sitting at the restaurant opposite my son in law (who was not all that keen on making the trip anyway) said "this is my favourite place in the whole world at this moment".  I always say "if you don't stay at Montmartre you wont love Paris".  I'm willing to extend that _ "If you don't stay in Place Emile Goudeau - you wont love Montmartre" - well maybe you will! 

Oh - surprisingly - the square/restaurant isn't noisy at night.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Location is great
text: Although my room was small it had everything I needed and was very clean. Breakfast was tasty with a good variety of the usual continental and cooked breakfast offerings. The location was great with a range of cafes, bars, tourist attractions and metro close by . My room was onto a small square and I did hear revellers at night but the bed was so comfortable I soon went back to sleep. Would use again.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location, friendly staff
text: Very nice location and friendly staff. Rooms rather small and those at first floor have no great view. Breakfast was nice with yoghurt, egg, toast, croissants etc. The eating room is a bit narrow and therefore easily crowded.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: They charged me my brakfest incorrectly
text: Everything was great except by my breakfest that was included in my rate and they charged me in my check out (at the time I was not able to check the information, just saw back home). The services are great (except for this inconvinient about my breakfest) and the room is super good. The shower is small but it compensate with other qualities.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Good value for location
text:
As the rooms and hotel is small, it would not be suitable for larger people and defiantly not suitable for disabled. 
Good location, nice rooms even though small. 
Could do with an extra sheet for the summer months.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Birthday surprise
text:
Booked a surprise birthday weekend on behalf of my son as a gift for his wife so the review is from him. Very enjoyable. Hotel in an excellent position with fab views over Paris with good breakfast.  Price reasonable for Montmartre.  Friendly staff and room was lovely. 
I am glad this is a positive review as I am booked to go there later in the year!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Hidden Gem
text: This hotel is tucked away but in an excellent location. The hotel staff were friendly and helpful. Our room was clean and very comfortable. We paid for a room with a view and we had a lovely view of Sacré-Cœur. The buffet breakfast was very good. We would certainly recommend this hotel.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location
text:
Lovely hotel in a great area in Montmartre. Plenty of bakeries, restaurants and bars within walking distance. Short walk to Sacre Couer.
Great view of Paris from our room which was cleaned daily with fresh towels. Staff friendly and helpful. Would not hesitate to return.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Enjoyable stay!
text: We really enjoyed our stay at this hotel. The location is perfect for exploring Montmartre, and if you opt for one of the rooms with a view you won't be disappointed. The staff were friendly too, especially Marina who was so lovely. Our only real criticism were the cardboard cups for tea/coffee in the room as opposed to pot ones but that is only a minor point. I want to thank Timhotel Montmartre for welcoming us, and for being our home for three nights. We had a really enjoyable stay and have no hesitation in coming again. Many thanks for a great stay! Merci beaucoup.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: good hotel
text: good hotel in the heart of the Montmartre, small but cozy. the rooms are quite small but clean and comfortable, the breakfast if good and the subway is very close to the hotel and can take you almost everywhere in Paris. The prices may vary  alot depending on the event in Paris
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: 2 star or less
text:
The standard double room is poor. If I owned Tim hotel I’d be embarrassed to offer this room - it’s out of the 70s. Truely substandard. I had to pay €40 extra for an executive room which in any normal hotel
Would be standard. Staff are friendly. Rooms are shocking
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: An Excellent Hotel in a Great Location
text: Reopening in late 2018 after refurbishment, this hotel is situated in a great location in the hilly 18th arrondissement. Access by Métro is to the nearby Abbesses station on Line 12 and nearby, through the narrow streets of Montmatre is the Sacré-Cœur Basilica. The friendly staff are courteous and always on hand to help.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Amazing View
text:
We stayed on the 4th floor facing out towards the city. The view was BREATHTAKING. The room itself was clean and comfortable and the staff were very friendly with good English. The area is idyllic and vibrant with a lovely bakery next door and lots of cafes, it feels like you’re in the heart of a very trendy suburb! 

The only downsides were the shower (my 6ft but very slim husband had to get out to wash his back as couldn’t move his arms inside) and the lift, which is even smaller than the shower are services the whole hotel. During check out times (obviously the busiest) housekeeping kept filling the lift with bags which rendered it unusable. It’s a stretch to expect a hotel of that size to be served by such a small elevator, but for housekeeping to also rely on it was just silly!

The only staircase I could find was tiny and spiral, it didn’t seem intended for customer use.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Excellent Location
text: Nice little hotel in the heart of Monmartre, a few minutes from the Sacre Coeur. Very friendly and helpful reception staff. Breakfast was OK but would be improved with proper coffee rather than the machine. Small room, especially bathroom/toilet but clean and comfortable.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great room with fantastic views
text:
I booked a "Superior Double Room with a view" and we were lucky enough to get "the best room in the hotel". We had fantastic views over the entire city on one side AND Sacre Coeur on the other. The room was very clean and large. 
   
We arrived early, so we utilized the luggage storage for a couple hours while we waited for our room. The staff is very friendly and professional and speak English. The location of the hotel is great. There is a small park/sitting area just outside, a restaurant just steps away, and it's halfway up the hill to the basilica. That being said, there is a bit of a hike up to get up to the hotel, but that can be said for every place in Montmartre. 

They do have an elevator, but it's very small. The two of us with carry-on sized bags and backpacks had it absolutely full. Larger parties or bags may require a couple trips.

Overall, I definitely recommend!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Charmer in Montmartre
text: If you are looking for an American-style hotel, this is not the place for you.  However, if you are looking for a place that exudes the charm of Paris and Montmartre, you will love this hotel, as we did.  The reception people are lovely and will help with recommendations and reservations as needed.  The rooms are small, but the bed was divine (they upgraded certain floors recently with new beds and new carpet).  If you can, get a view room of the Eiffel Tower. The bathrooms are extremely small but clean and upgraded.  To lie in bed at night with the balcony doors open, hearing the chatter of the bistro clients below you, accompanied by a busker either on accordion or guitar, is a divine experience.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great position
text: Great position for discovering Paris.near to Sacre Court and The Moulin rouge..Friendly and accommodating place to stay.Very nice breakfast on offer.Rooms small but quiet and nice decor.close to Underground as well.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Cozy and romantic
text: Very Nice hotel with lovely rooms with a fantastic balcony and The location is wonderful in The mittle of montemartes heart. Se loved lur stay in Paris when we also engaged by The eiffeltower! Merci...
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great location, fantastic views
text:
This hotel was perfect for our two night sightseeing trip to Paris. Great location in the heart of buzzy Montmatre. We paid extra for a city view and this was 100% worth it. We had a view of Sacré couer from one window and the city and Eiffel Tower from our other window. You could even see the Eiffel Tower from the bath! 

The price was reasonable for Paris. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable.  We paid extra to have breakfast and this was worth it. The coffee was good and there was a good selection of food at the buffet although it can get crowded in there at rush hour.

title: Quiet location
text: Friendly and very helpful staff, always cheerful . .Useful Shuttle service to and from Airports .Good views of City .Facing pretty square. Very good breakfast with good variety of food . Near Abesses metro station.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Love this place
text: My daughter and I stayed here for 3 nights and loved every minute. The staff was great and so helpful. They spoke English and were able to assist us with places to visit and restaurant options. The area of Montmartre is great - very safe! The location was very convenient to many restaurants and attractions.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great Monmatre hotel
text: We had a great stay here.  The room was very clean and the staff was very friendly.  The room is small but it had everything we needed.  We were surprised to find a great view out of our window of the Paris skyline.  The hotel is up a very large hill from the closest metro stop but this is not uncommon in Monmatre.  Otherwise it was pretty centrally located for the neighborhood and not too far from downtown.  The closest metro stop has a TON of steps which was difficult with our luggage.  There was an elevator but it took awhile.  It wouldn't be a deal breaker but would have been good to know.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Incredible view of Paris.
text:
Absolutely perfect,  the view was incredible and within walking distance to the Sacré Coer.
The hotel staff was assisted our very need and they were very accommodating.
The higher up you go the better the view. We had a wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower. Lots of restaurants in walking distance.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: From Toronto
text: The staff were very friendly and helpful, the room was very clean and quiet and the hotel is in an excellent location.  Can't comment on breakfast because we didn't partake.  We will certainly stay here again.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Long Weekend in Paris
text:
Just returned from Timhotel Montmartre. Very clean, comfortable and nicely situated for metro. Staff friendly and helpful. This is a little gem of a hotel as a base to explore Montmartre and Paris in general. Will certainly return.
Thanks to all the staff for making our short break memorable.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Great view to Eiffer Tower
text: Lovely hotel at Montmartre, very close to metro station. The staff is excellent, the breakfast very good, the rooms a bit small (as always in this city). A lot of great places to eat & drink around, I can't wait to come back! Highly recommended!
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Ideal location, great value for money, friendly and helpful staff
text:
The hotel is ideally located in the heart of Montmatre. It’s only a 10min walk to Sacre Coeur with a beautiful panoramic view over Paris. There are dozens of charming little restaurants, bars, and cafés int he direct vicinity of the hotel. The staff was very friendly and helpful and the checkin and checkout processes were very quick.
The rooms are on the smaller side but make good use of the available space in a historical building.
name: Timhotel Montmartre

title: Lovely staff, good, safe location, clean... Two reasons to question perhaps before booking
text:
We recently stayed in this hotel for a few nights. We found the location safe, above all, plenty of restaurants and cafe's. Even if not eating in the area ( as often we ate where we were visiting that day) they were open late when we returned, to have a drink before returning to the hotel. 
Staff, very friendly, lovely smile from the lady every day. Our room had a balcony, very good, lovely to open the door for some air at times. Wouldn't stay there without that option..Rooms are tiny, please don't expect anything large at all. The bathroom was a fair size . It was good enough for a few nights stay, considering out most of the time. The good thing, there is a kettle. Wardrobe small, we kept most of our clothes in the suitcase, leaving the jackets in the wardrobe. There is a small safe. Room and rest of the hotel clean, no complaints at all there. We didn't have breakfast there as plenty of options nearby and a reasonable cost . No bar or restaurant at this hotel , but no problem as local places open many hours or buy things at the supermarket , like water for your room. Only TWO things which are important to consider here ..I would stay again, but would ask these questions. Do all hotel room bathrooms smell ? Ours really smelt, we had the door constantly shut because of it..but unpleasant when having to use the shower / toilet..the smell comes from the drains..enough to give you headaches..that really put me off. I don't know if just a room like it ? but I suggest to ask that question beforehand. Heating? is there any? well, we couldn't find anything suggesting that. We were cold in bed. It wasn't that cold outside, so I would certainly be concerned later in the year if we are right with the rooms not having heating. There seemed to be an air con or some kind of heater by the ceiling, no remote.not sure if air con or some kind of heater, but impossible to reach if that is the case. We had to air the room at times due to the drain smell, so that didn't help I guess. As I say, just two concerns. I would return if the staff say that it was just that particular room . Thank you for having us. Oh, the other very good thing about this hotel, they keep your luggage for you on the last day, if you wish to explore before returning home :) that was a big bonus

title: Nice Little Hotel Close to Sacre Coeur - Small Rooms
text:
My wife and I stayed there for a total of 4 days and we were quite satisfied with the hotel and particularly the helpfulness of the staff. At no point did we experience anything else than smiles, helpful attitudes and funny banters with the receptionist.
We had a Superior Room (room 601) on the top floor - this room have view directly towards the Sacre Coeur Cathedral and is quite nice. One note, though: The rooms are SMALL - and the room we had was even one of the bigger ones, it seems. That meant no room to relax other than on the bed.
Furthermore, the hotel doesn’t have any bar or restaurant, so anything to drink “after hours” has to be taken at one of the many cosy bars/cafes nearby, or bringing it in from a super market.
The breakfast is very basic and does not change - always the same things. Nice, in essence, but certainly not exciting.
To reach: Bus lines 31 and 60 passes by the hotel very often. Bus 31 will take you to or from Gare Du Nord from where there is an airport train to Charles De Gaulle Airport. Due to one of the usual French strikes, we ended up doing so, and found it to be not only easy but also convenient - price was in total EUR 28 for two people, including both airport train and bus ticket. Can fully be recommend to do.
Would we stay at this hotel again? Probably, as the staff and the location is really nice. TONS of cafes and restaurants within walking distance from the hotel. Our favourites became NORD/SUD cafe for drinks and watching people go by.

title: Pleasant hotel for a city break
text:
We stayed in this hotel for one night with breakfast included and were place in room 001. The room was on the ground floor around the corner from reception and through the breakfast area. 
The room and hotel we found to be very clean and modern. Fixtures and fittings were all functional and the bathroom was a decent size with a lovely powerful shower. 

The room had very thick blackout curtains which was a nice to have although as a Scottish couple we found Paris quite warm while we were there and asked for assistance to turn on the air conditioning (advertised). The gentleman from reception who helped up seemed baffled that we wanted air conditioning and told us that it was only available during the summer which led us to having to open our window for fresh air (not ideal as we were ground floor so could only have open for a short while to avoid anyone sneaking in). 

We found the staff to all be fairly pleasant however do be warned if you are assigned this room as the kitchen area for serving breakfast is right beside it and if you are not an early riser the sound of dishes clattering and preparation would most definitely wake you up. Luckily we rise around 6am so we only noticed it but didn't find it too much of a bother. 

Finally, breakfast was - again - pleasant however could do with improvements. Maybe more variety as there wasn't much to choose from and the offerings were all cold, it would have been nice to have a wider variety.

All these things being said, it was a pleasant stay and more than suited our requirements. The location is excellent, only a 5 minute walk to the nearest metro and a handily placed Pizza Hut just 5 minutes further along the road which does reasonably priced meal deals if you fancy a late night snack!

Finally - do be aware of pick-pocketers on the tube and in the streets, do not accept clipboards to sign etc as all these people are looking for your money and relying on your good will. We were extremely vigilant on our trip and it paid off.

title: Average but not great for babies/toddlers
text:
Booked at the beginning of December based on their ability to accommodate our 21 month old daughter. I made a request for a travel cot (as noted on the hotel info this would be possible) and a baby bath. 

When we arrived no travel cot was available so for the first night our daughter had to sleep in with my husband and I. Not great and resulting in us all being tired for our first full day in Paris. 

We did receive a travel cot on our second night but the rooms are so small it took up what was left of the space. I don’t understand why the hotel advertises these rooms as being suitable for a family of 3 (toddler age) when clearly they are not!

We never did receive a baby bath which meant a screaming event every time my daughter had to have her hair washed. 

The room itself was small but mainly clean. We had a 1st floor room facing the busy road which again not great with a toddler at night but thankfully our girl is a great sleeper.  

Bathroom was clean and plenty of clean towels. The shower head would not stay up however meaning my 6ft 1 husband had to keep ducking under the water to wash. 

The hotel is in a good spot for the Metro and Gare du Nord is not far away in an Uber. We walked to the Sacre Coeur our first evening which was lovely. The area does feel a little unsafe in the evening but I’m sure that could be said of any busy city late at night.

title: A Parisian hotel with a good-sized bathroom
text:
The Best Western Prince Montmartre was a pleasant surprise.  The room was air-conditioned, clean and comfortable – and it had quite a large bathroom.  There are no bar facilities, but they do offer a very pleasant continental breakfast of cereals, yogurts, cheeses, eggs, meats, breads and pastries for 12 euros.

There are any number of cafes, restaurants and patisseries in the surrounding area.  The further away you move from Rue Ordener, the cheaper the prices become.

The hotel is 5 minutes walk from the Jules Joffrin metro station – and the Paris metro is a breeze to master.  It is a steep walk of nearly 2 kms from Rue Ordener to Sacre Coeur, and does require a certain level of fitness.  Or you could take the metro from Jules Joffrin to Abbesses (1 stop), walk along the well-signposted street, through the colourful shops and cafes to the funicular.  This will take you up to the cathedral, and you can use your metro ticket for this ride.

Tip:  We booked an airport shuttle through reception, and were charged 36 euros (cash only).  Upon arriving at the airport the driver informed us that he had to be paid an extra 36 euros.  I showed him my receipt, but he insisted the first 36 euros was the hotel's booking fee, and he required an additional 36 euros.  Without any cash, I had to leave my bags with the driver and search the airport for a cash machine.  I'm still not sure if I was ripped off or not, so make sure you ask exactly what the fixed price for the shuttle service will be.

Nothing much wrong.

title: A True "Prince" of a Hotel
text:
This is a great little hotel that on paper looks quite far from the heart of Paris until one measures the distance on a map!. It is close to Jules Joffrin Metro and so everything you will want to see is quite accessible. We had three nights recently and found all the staff [it changes a lot over the weekend] were helpful and friendly. Breakfasts are simple but even "simpler" ones are available from a nearby Boulangerie! There is also no shortage of restaurants and bistros close by. 
Entrance is generally controlled by reception [they will see you or be called by a push button buzzer] which might seem a nuisance but is really another layer of security for guests. Our room was 6th floor and opened out onto the street and we had no noise issues. [And it is great to have a window that opens!] 
We were a bit concerned about references to small rooms in some of the reviews, but this really only refers to the amount of free space at the end of the bed,where it is a bit less than in some. Anyone travelling with a "standard" amount of luggage should not have too much trouble.
We had booked and pre-paid through a well known booking site and had absolutely NO problems with our account.

title: A lovely hotel and holiday, which was ruined after returning to the UK
text:
Firstly I would like to say how great a hotel this was for me and my girlfriend to stay at for four nights a few weeks ago. The rooms are great, clean and the hotel is in an excellent location. 

I wish I could leave my review as above and award the hotel the five stars we felt it deserved.

However.. the hotel can not be trusted. I had booked via hotels.com and choose the option to pay the hotel in the local currency at the end of our stay. This went as expected and when we checked out I got the bill for the four nights and paid the full amount in Euros. The booking had however been guaranteed with my Visa debit card when making the reservation on hotels.com.

After realising approx £140 was missing from my current bank account I called Natwest's fraud department who confirmed two payments had been taken on 31st March and 2nd April from a company called 'AJ Hotels'. Via Google I have noticed this hotel used to be called AJ hotels so the link is there. Natwest have refunded me the money but I am still yet to hear back from the hotel with an explanation.

We didn't check in till April 3rd so why on earth UNAUTHORISED transactions were made a few days before I am yet to find out. Maybe this was just a mistake and I will be able to give the hotel the 5 stars it deserves but until I receive an explanation I can not recommend this hotel. There is also concern that potentially a member of staff has done this without the hotels knowledge.

My review will be updated accordingly once I've heard an explanation from the hotel management.

title: Jardin Du Faubourg - Truly 5 Star Experience
text: Wonderful stay at this amazing 5 star boutique hotel nestled in the heart of Paris. It is a short journey from Gard Du Nord and walking distance from some of the most famous french monuments. The hotel boasts a wonderful garden, one of a handful that can be found in paris. The rooms are spcious and designed using modern decor. In regards to the service, the staff were fantastic. title: Excellent stay thanks to the staff, location and quality of the hotel
text: Our first time in Paris we were fortune enough to stay at this lovely hotel; the interior of the whole hotel - so peaceful and tranquil, the friendly and helpful staff that made their most to make our experience superb - assisting us in every need or wish we had. Walking distance to almost every "arrondissement" Special thanks to Guillaume 🌟. One of many examples: the clerk in one of the shops in Paris forgot to return my driving licence, Guillaume went to the store, collected it and send it back to me after we had left. 🙏🏼
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Magical evening
text: Recently discovered this little hidden gem in the 8th / tucked down a quiet street, just steps from the hustle and bustle of the St-Honore shopping area / understated charm / pretty covered garden (too chilly to sit out there last night) but I'll be back when the weather warms-up!  The service (Jeremy) was delightedly easy-breezey and very accommodating .. provided crisp and lite garden salad that wasn't on the menu and allowed a swap-out of fries for risotto / how nice when people just make it about what you want!  Amazing steak with a sauce that I could have eaten alone!  Suggestions: come on guys...'French' Fries are named after your country ... make it proud!!
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Exceptional stay in Paris
text: Les Jardins du Faubourg is ideally located, the team are incredibly kind and helpful, the Spa and pool are super and the hotel is extremely well appointed (very comfy beds) and beautifully decorated. We’ve been there as a couple and as a family and would thoroughly recommend.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: A gem to keep coming back to
text:
Returning to Les Jardins de Faubourg is like coming home every time. From the moment you enter, you are welcomed by the wonderful and genuinely friendly staff and they are there for you throughout your stay.

We have tried several rooms in the hotel and one by one they are fantastic. They are spacious and the interior is modern, stylish and warm. 

On a grey day, you can always use the spacious indoor pool or relax in the sauna and hammam.

The location of the hotel is ideal, in the heart of Saint-Honoré: beautifully central and in a very quiet area, and the most secure area of Paris.

Thank you for the wonderful stay and see you soon!
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Exceptional hotel
text:
Les Jardins du Faubourg is probably the nicest hotel I’ve been to in Paris. the service was excellent and the staff were very welcoming.
we loved everything about the hotel and specially the courtyard.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: A true gem in Paris!
text: Every now and again you find something special in this city that makes you love it even more. This hotel is one of them. From the minute we arrived to when we left, our experience was total perfection. We got a warm welcomed as our luggage was swifylt taken out of our hands, given blankets (as we were cold) and although 4 hours too early for checking-in time, they made sure we could get into our room. And what a room it was! Every detail is so thoughtful. From a bed that you just don't want to get out of, with 4 different types of pillows, (2 delicious chocolates on your pillow before you nod off), a bathroom to die for, we were in heaven. In the morning, decked in our stylish robes, we checked out the grecian style pool with steam room, and sauna. It's dreamy! And there's a fab gym that's so minimalist yet has everything you need including Evian water in the fridge and a few almonds for protein as you leave! Nice touch! This is a hotel that completely spoils you without any snobbery. You feel pampered with a staff that are so professional yet fun and friendly. Can't say enough about it. We're coming back for more ...v soon! Try it...you'll be raving too.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: One of the best Boutique 5 stars hotels in Paris
text:
I was very lucky to have discovered this charming and elegant 5 star hotel in Paris.

I have just good things to say about my stay: from the very much attention to details, the  warm welcome from the staff, the excellent location of the hotel, the delicious breakfast on the magical garden, the comforting and luxurious room         ( one of the best mattresses and duvets I have ever sleep on ), delightful Jo Malone London amenities  ( that was a real treat ).  And above all the amazing assistance and attention of Mr. Guillaume Collin who like a magician makes the impossible to become a reality. 

If Paris is considered as the City of Lights, Les Jardins du Faubourg is one of them!
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Magnifique!
text: Having stayed at Le Crillon, the Georges V, and the Plaza Athenee, on previous visits to Paris, we decided to try a more initimate hotel in Les Jardins du Faubourg.  It did not disappoint even as compared to the bigger names. It was a fantastic boutique hotel, phenomenally located in the 8th. The staff spoiled us, even surprising me on my birthday with  balloons decorating my room. The accommodations were gorgeous and elegantly appointed. Guillaume, the guest relations manager, took such great care of us, securing restaurant reservations at wonderful eateries and helped us navigate COVID restrictions.  Jennifer, the hotel’s manager, was attentive and treated us as old friends.  A wonderful experience in every way!
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Amazing stay!
text: My husband and I loved our stay here, specially because Guillaume and the rest of the concierge staff went out of their way to help us get reservations at the restaurants we wanted to go to even though they were full for fashion week. Highly recommend! Will be staying here again for sure .
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Beautiful and quaint location in Paris
text:
Absolutely delicious boutique hotel in the heart of Paris 8eme arrondissement. We had a lovely lunch and video shoot in the afternoon and I must commend the staff for being extremely pleasant and helpful.
Beautifully decorated and  well organised rooms complete with all required amenities and a perfumed hand gel which makes clean hands a pleasure !
Thank you again for a wonderful short stay.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Amazing service!
text:
We had the best experience at this hotel! Aesthetically beautiful with a very good pool, spa and gym. Perfect location in the 1st arr.

The attentiveness of the staff and level of service were incredible. We actually had to leave the hotel on the morning of Bastille day to catch a train to Cannes - little did we know that ALL the streets around the hotel will be closed on the morning of Bastille Day so we would have no chance of getting a taxi. The hotel proactively alered us to this the night before - not only that but they sent two of their staff to help up carry the suitcases all the way to the nearest open metro station early in the morning. They planned everything for us the night before and waited for us in the morning to help us get to the train station through a muriad of closed off and barricaded streets with 4 huge suitaces (traveling from Australia). There would have been no chance that we could have navigated this route without them! 

We recommend this place to everyone and will definitely be back at the next trip to Paris.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: My experience.
text: Such a wonderful place. The food. The design. The spacing. The flow. The service.  Esp Carl and Eva and Céline.  Well worth it. And a terrific area too.  I would repeat.  Very little could be done better. From the first moment you are treated well and with kindness.

title: The perfect hotel, from now on my number one in Paris!

From the moment i made the reservation, i got a message from Carl saying they are ready to welcome me. Its no big deal, but its nice. I arrived and felt like everyone already knew me for years. text: The location is central and easy to walk to all things Parisian. The hotel itself is stunning, clean and effortlessly comfortable. Our room was immaculate, furnished with care and the bed was unbelievable comfortable. We used the bathtub every evening as our window looked into a beautiful skyline. title: A gem of a hotel
text: I never post about experiences, but our experience at les jardins du faubourg in Paris was extraordinary. Our trip to Paris began in an Air bnb that was burglarized while we were sleeping. They stole our passport, cell phones and credit cards. We had a lot of work to get everything straightened out. Needless to say we were not going to finish our stay in that apartment.  We selected Les Jardins du Faubourg because it was near the Embassy.  When we arrived we were amazed at the service and the beauty of the boutique hotel. It is a true hidden gem and has only been open a few months. We were so relieved to feel safe and welcome. The Managing Director (Jennifer Boccara) heard our story and immediately offered assistance from the staff. She was so concerned and wanted the balance of our time in Paris to be a wonderful experience. Our flight home was scheduled to depart from Paris on Tuesday morning. This would give us time to get to the US Embassy on Monday for a replacement passport. We arrived on Monday only to discover it was a US holiday( Columbus Day) and the Embassy was closed. Jennifer checked in with us and when we told her, she immediately said “ you will be our guest for the extra evening” and insisted on covering the room charge for the additional night. She also had her staff help with airline calls and changes. This is a special hotel and a Jennifer genuinely wants every guest to feel the warmth and passion of Paris. We hope to return and to once again thank Jennifer and the entire staff.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: A new pearl in the heart of Paris
text:
We really love Paris. It's like our second home. And by discovering this beautiful new hotel in the heart of Paris we have found our new address to stay. 

The service is exceptional and the staff goes way over the extra mile to make your stay as great as possible. For example due to a strike, we could not reach the hotel by car so we parked in a public parking a couple of streets further. When it was time to go home, they fetched the car for us from that public parking.

The room was beautiful and very spacious. The design was a nice mix between modern and original touches. It also has a lot of storage space. Ideal for when you ar there for more than a few days. 

We love walking around in Paris so in the evening, before going to a restaurant, we enjoy taking a long bath to relax the muscles. On top of that, there is a relaxing spa area with a swimming pool, hamam and sauna. A great way to end a busy Parisian day.

We're definitely going back here for our next visit to Paris. A big thank you to Guillaume and his wonderful team.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: A lovely trip
text: I have booked one of the most comfortable hotels of paris...i have spent 6 nights and not an hour of those 144 that i had got disturbed out of something...once we arrived we had such an amazing warm welcome...and they had shown us to our rooms..and everything was made professionally...the hotel is located just Rue Saint Honoré...the middle of paris everywhere is a nice 10-20 min walk...shopping all around...museums are at every corner...and most importantly a very safe neighborhood...the hotel is small and cosy...the interior is modern but those Parisian touches are still there...the high ceilings...the French historic...walls the marble...i will definitely make sure to make this hotel my home in paris.

title: A perfect stay in Paris.
text:
We have been for 4 nights in Paris and looked for a personal, cosy place in a perfect shopping area. It was important for us to explore everything by walking.

The Lobby: the hotel is in an amazing Haussmann house. It is small, but with high quality materials. The garden in the backyard is very groomed and you can relax there well. They are offering there nice drinks.

The staff: they are amazing and all of them are very professional and friendly. They make everything happen for you and are there for you 24/7. The concierge is doing an amazing job and asked us every morning if he can do something special for us. The staff in the restaurant gaved us the 
feeling like a personal buttler, the service was really unbelievable.

The Room: we came in and felt well. We had a fantastic superior Room, it was very clean and it has an amazing design. The King size Bed is very big and comfortable (in Paris normally the beds are queen size). The Bathroom in this Room had a big shower, but there are also rooms with an bath tube. 

The breakfast: in France is breakfast not so „big“ as in Germany or England, they are offering a typical french „continental breakfast“ with croissants, madeleines, and hot beverages. If you want to have more then this, can you order everything of course (like salmon, sandwiches, eggs, Omelett ...) on top of this. There are no wishes open.

The Spa: you can swim there in a big indoor pool and relax in two different Saunas. They are offering massages and facials as well, but we didn’t had the time to try everything. But maybe at our next stay.

My Resume: we will come back to Paris and I will book the „Les Jardins du Faubourg“. I don’t need another research :-)
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Paris best boutique hotel
text:
The staff, service, decor, and the location you won’t regret any part of this hotel. 
I’ve booked a deluxe room it was spacious  definitely recommended.
If I’m trying to find an error in my stay it would be hard, but I can only advise the hotel to offer some complimentary water in rooms and refill the Nespresso capsules every day.

text: Fantastic location next door to the Élysées and close to lots of attractions and just a minute walk from the famous Rue Faubourg St-Honore. The staff is fantastic, we had the pleasure of meeting Jennifer the hotel's Ambassador. The hotels amenities are first-class. I particularly enjoyed the top of the line fitness equipment and the pool. The sheets and towels are the softest I have ever felt. Bravo!

title: Stunning new Luxury Hotel in Paris
text:
A true gem of a new 5 Star hotel in Paris!
Tucked away in a very quiet little lane, I was just steps away from Rue St Honore and and Galleries Lafayette and the very best shops in Paris.
Les Jardins du Faubourg feels every bit like a private residence. The inner courtyard has been decorated as a beautiful garden with a terrasse for its fine restaurant and is the perfect place to enjoy breakfast, lunch or dinner.
The rooms are super luxurious, I loved the bed and the bathroom in my Deluxe room 211 had a huge shower and bathtub with best amenities by french luxury brand Codage.
The surprise of my stay was the Spa, featuring a 15 meter pool with Sauna and Hamam and latest Technogym equipments fitted out gym, and the massage is by renowned masseurs a must try in this busy city. A true gem for a hotel of this size!
Helmed by renowned hotelier Jennifer Boccara, Les Jardins du Faubourg is a stunning addition to the Paris Luxury hotel scene and a true gemstone in every sense.

title: Most fabulous place to be
text:
Did not know this place that just opened a month ago. A real paradise behind the Élysée in the most exquisite part of Paris. A restaurant in the garden with jasmin all over in the middle of Paris !! Perfect service and great restaurant. 
The place to go
