title: Luxury, Location, Security, Cleanliness, Internet WIFI, Comfort and 6 Star Staff.
text:
An associate and myself spend 4 nights in this incredible and newly opened hotel. We were greeted upon our arrival from Jennifer "The Ambassador" and Guillaume "Les Clefs d'Or" who welcomed us as if it were their home. there's no words to describe how in a matter of hours we felt as if we had known this hotel and staff for years.
The rooms are big when compared to 95% of the hotels in Paris. I've stayed in dozens and they are much bigger than average. The beds are the most comfortable by any standard. As for the bathrooms, they are equipped with the softest towels, amazing products and a strong hair dryer. Wait till you try on the bathrobe!!
Unlike the majority of the hotels in Paris "LJDF" offers an awesome pool (16 meters), sauna, hamman and gym (Pro equipment). If you want a massage ask for Olga, she's amazing. I also strongly suggest that you try the restaurant "La Regalade", you will not be disappointed.
I'm not one to get to know hotel employees but this particular place is different. There's Caroline "Maître d'hôtel" from the restaurant who would always come out of nowhere with a glass of water or an offer of an espresso. Not to mention she's a good conversation. And then there's Inês and her lovely smile. 
If you are considering a trip to Paris and you enjoy being in the right location and feeling secure you just found the right place. And upon your arrival make sure to find this wonderful woman named Jennifer, she's been in the Parisian hospitality industry for decades. She just looks at you and knows what you need. She's extremely professional and also she's adorable.
Le Jardins du faubourg is now my new home away from home.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Quiet 5-star Luxury Hotel in the Heart of the 8th Arrondissement
text:
I found Les Jardins du Faubourg online, knowing that I wanted to be near rue Faubourg Saint-Honoré. When I showed up at the hotel, I discovered that the hotel had just opened the day before, and I was pleased with the amenities of the hotel and the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. The hotel is tucked away on a quiet street near the British Embassy, not far from the Palais de l'Élysée, which makes it an ideal place to stay if you are in Paris to shop or sight-see. The hotel is in walking distance of L'église de la Madeleine and Place de la Concorde, both of which offer connecting stations to the Paris Metro. 

When we arrived at the hotel, we were warmly greeted by the Concierge, Guillaume Collin, and the members of the Reception Team, including Carl Vetus and Ambre and were offered a drink on the terrace by Emma, who oversees the hotel's bar and restaurant. The staff couldn't have been more attentive and accommodating to our every need during our stay and really made us feel like we were valued clients, which other larger hotels seem to disregard nowadays. This is the perfect hotel for travelers with discriminating tastes. The restaurant was just about to open during our stay, which will be one of Chef Bruno Doucet's restaurants, following the success of La Régalade in the 1st arrondissement. For other gourmet dining options, Jean-François Piège's Le Grand Restaurant is located next-door to the hotel. The hotel's knowledgeable Concierge, Guillaume, will be more than happy to recommend other dining options in the area.

We were fortunate enough to meet the hotel's Managing Director, Jennifer Boccara, who brings years of experience and knowledge in the luxury hotel sector, having managed 5 star properties in Geneva and Paris before being appointed as the Managing Director at this property. Many members of her team have worked with her in the past, so you feel that the staff is really a small family, and this warmth is extended to the hotel's guests.

The hotel features an indoor pool and spa, gym, and a courtyard garden terrace area, which is the perfect place to relax after seeing the sights of Paris. The hotel has 36 rooms and six suites spread across three floors. Although this is a small hotel, the layout feels spacious and luxurious. The interior design is contemporary with attention given to the smallest detail in furnishes and fixtures. 

I highly recommend this hotel if you wish to be in the heart of Paris, in exclusive surroundings, and be treated as a special client. The team at Les Jardins du Faubourg will make you feel at home.
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Pure bliss!
text:
We spent 3 wonderful nights here. Everything you could possibly imagine was incredibly perfect. The first thing you notice when walking is the calming scent and indoor/outdoor feel with the courtyard. It is like a sanctuary in the city.  We booked a suite and a standard room for our party of 4, both rooms had plenty of space, mini bar, nespresso machine and both bathrooms generous and spacious in a very Parisian way.  
The location is absolutely one of the best in Paris, in the heart of the Faubourg, 1 block from Hermès and everything was absolutely impeccable.  I am obsessed with the toiletries, and decor (Art is everywhere). The scent matched well the ambience of the room as well as the hotel. 
Breakfast and service was extremely good and I have been impressed by the little details. Thank-you Carl and all the staff for this wonderful stay. We will be back!
name: Les Jardins du Faubourg

title: Very enjoyable stay in a classy hotel
text:
We were at the Hilton Opera because of a special family occasion and stayed for 2 nights.,We were fortunate to be upgraded to a King Junior suite and aside from the air conditioning not working in the room, could not have been happier with the room itself. It was spacious, had a very comfortable bed and although the bath itself was surprisingly narrow, it was still a room which we enjoyed.
Position of the hotel is excellent for exploring the city as it has a Metro station across the road from the hotel and many of the Paris sites are within walking distance. We also enjoyed using the Executive Lounge primarily for the continental breakfast and had a drink in the stunning bar area. 
Special praise for the helpful front desk staff and bell men who were always willing to assist and were both polite and cheerful at all times.I have no hesitation in recommending this hotel.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Wonderful stay in a lovely building with great staff
text:
My wife and I had a brief 3 night stay at the lovely Hilton Paris Opera. The building itself is lovely with a great history. All areas, including the rooms reflect that, and it's nice to see that they chose to preserve this history while modernizing the amenities of the hotel. Le Grand Salon in particular was mesmerizing. We ended up spending quite a bit of time in there, having lunch or drinks in the evening, just because of how amazing the space is. The breakfast was also on point, with all the usual suspects and the quality being there as well. 

The staff was excellent. Very professional and friendly, a balance which is often difficult to reach, they accommodated our every request. Cleaning was on point, covid safety observed at all times, we felt completely secure during our stay. The location seemed perfect for us to do a bit of casual exploring around the area.

Special mention goes to the bed, pillows and linens. Having a good night's sleep (and sometimes an afternoon also) was critical for us to unwind after a busy few months of work, and the bedding worked wonders!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great property
text: A beautiful property with fantastic large rooms.  It’s a great location, wonderful breakfast and we enjoyed the club level.  The robes, pillows and beds were so comfortable. We will definitely stay again.  The hotel lobby is beautiful and a great place to enjoy drinks.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Wonderful stay
text:
-5*
We had a great experience in our 5 night stay.
 
-Member upgrade
We booked using reward points, and were upgraded to an executive room because of our recently acquired diamond status. 

-Luxury stay
The hotel feels luxurious from the get go as just past the lobby is the gorgeous bar. 

-Hospitable
We were immediately greeted in English, and were able to drop our bags off around 12:00 checking in later in the evening. 

-Large room (executive)
The spacious size of the executive room surprised, and we had more than enough space for the 2 of us and 3 bags. All three bags fit in the closet and stayed out of site. 

-Close to metro
The hotel was also right next to a major transportation hub making city transportation a breeze. 

-Breakfast
The breakfast was fabulous with plenty of options. A hardy start to the day gave us the energy we needed to explore the city everyday.

We would definitely stay here again!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Perfect Paris Hotel!
text: We enjoyed our 5 night stay at the Hilton Paris Opera Hotel very much!  The hotel staff is exceptional, the location excellent for shopping and seeing all the sights, and the rooms are a good size and met all our needs.   The Lounge/bar is a beautiful historic room that we spent a lot of time in relaxing with coffee, a glass of wine and/or dinner.  There are many restaurants within walking distance as well.  Taxis are available out front regularly and the train station and metro are next to the hotel, with the Opera bus tour stop only a 5 minute walk away.    A perfect choice for a Paris vacation!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Wonderful and historic place to stay
text: Hilton opera Paris survived WW2 and used to be a train station.  The architecture and art still stands today and is a wonderful remnant of the past. The facility itself is clean and modernized, while keeping the old vibe and art alive and well.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Staff, Small Room
text: We are Hilton Diamond members and were unable to obtain a room upgrade because of hotel occupancy.  We were given a standard room which would easily qualify as the smallest hotel room we have ever stayed in.  That being said the hotel staff was very friendly.  The executive lounge manned in the evening by Saleem was very good.  Saleem was excellent and helped us many nights with our food selections.  The Diamond breakfast included an excellent breakfast buffet including custom omelets.  The buffet had something for everyone.  The hotel was built in 1899 and has a wonderful bar area with high ceilings just behind the front desk.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Beautiful hotel, location, and great Staff!
text: Loved this hotel and the location and the staff. Beautiful hotel historic and beautifully renovated. The staff were fantastic here and the food was delicious the bar service was great. Will stay here again next visit into Paris
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great location, very quiet and nice acommodation
text:
Our experience started off very well as we got upgrade to a Queen Suite before we arrived!  The hotel location is great, just short walk from the E line which goes to Gare Du Nord so it is very easy to get to.  Whilst its on a busy street the hotel itself is very quiet.  Check-in was nice and quick and we were in a room shortly after arriving.

The Queen Suite isn't huge, but this is Paris and its more than big enough for a couple.  The quality of everything was great, from TVs to the excellent climate control and a nespresso machine.  The room faced into the courtyard so no view but made it quiet.

I found the bed so comfortable that on the first night I dreamt that I could reception and told them I was buying the mattress!!!  Sleep quality was excellent, with virtually no noise from the corridor.

Breakfast was great, a nice buffet but never felt too busy.  The gym room is nothing special but has some cardio machines and light dumbbells.

Overall we stayed 4 nights and it was a fantastic experience, highly recommend.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: A Perfect Location
text:
This hotel is everything you expect from a nice hotel so I won’t say more than that. The true selling point is its location. The Gare Saint Lazare train station is literal located 50 feet behind the hotel. Every type of transport is at your fingertips — main line trains, regional trains (RER), the subway, bus lines, and taxis. You can go anywhere in the city with ease. We made day trips to Versailles and Normandy. Just jump on the RER line and go! And then we used the metro to get anywhere in the city fast and easy.  This is a major metro stop you you can get anywhere from there. Likewise, it’s in a great neighborhood located just a few blocks from the Paris Opera house and fine shopping district.  There is even a post office less than a block away so you can mail your purchases home. 

Btw, you might think the train station creates  noise at the hotel. In fact, it is quiet and peaceful.  

Beautiful hotel, friendly staff, good breakfast, and clean rooms. 

All in all, a superb location and a great experience.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Good Location/Nice Property/But no Wow Factor
text: First Time to Paris so decided to stay with trusted accommodations. The Hotel is centrally located on the north side of the river and within an hour walk of most famous attractions. Taxi and Ubers were very easy to get too.  Hotel was super clean and professionally run, but once inside the environment was somewhat cold. Reception staff was nice, professional, but a little robotic.  Definitely a good spot if you are visiting for work/job. Our room was really small with limited view when compared to cost.   We had no major issues but I would recommend looking for something South of the River with more of a boutique feel.  Our very good rating was well deserved based on the outstanding service of the Bell Service and an amazing concierge named Raphael ! Despite supporting an entire hotel, he took time with us to find a great place for dinner(which was amazing), arranged reservations, and helped us get transportation there.  Thanks Raphael!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: What a location!
text: I just stayed at the Paris Hilton which was right next to the subway and near many great stores. The rate came with a very good breakfast and the room was a charm. Many described it as outdated but this room was charming and had many French touches a comfortable bed and a great shower.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great property
text: Loved the location of the property. Several restaurants, shopping & the train station are in very close proximity. The hotel staff was very friendly & the accommodations were clean & comfortable. I would definitely recommend this location.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Paris Trip May 8-12 2022
text: I came to Paris because I wanted to back to a place haven't been to since 2018, I opted to stay at Hilton Opera in Paris, France. I flew from Rome to Paris on Air France and landed in the morning to Paris, France and checking in was a little smooth compared to the other hotels in Paris I've stayed at.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text:
What a great experience for us, perfect for exploring Paris on foot! All desired sights are within walking distance.
Spacious rooms with well appointed bathrooms and beautiful lobby and bar.
Excellent breakfast and service in the Club-lounge.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: good located but very expensive
text: good location  but very expensive. The room was not  at the hilton standard, not clean and very hot. The staff was friendly and helpful . the breakfast was  to  our satisfaction. the prices are very high. I would not return.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Gorgeous hotel
text:
PROPERTY-Gorgeous property (the nicest hotel we have ever stayed at). The lobby bar area is so breathtaking that it looks like a museum. Enjoyed taking the spiral stairway instead of the elevator, because the stairway looked like a work of art. Very clean (the room was spotless). The shower was so nice with pretty marble tile. The room was bright and cheery and we had those sweet looking French windows with the fancy ironwork railings outside. The bed was very comfortable (not too hard or soft, but the pillows were harder which might not be good for some).

FOOD-The breakfast was the best breakfast ever. On the first day we ate breakfast in the Executive lounge as we have Hilton status and we thought the food was incredible (perfect). But the next day we ate in the regular breakfast area and it was even better. Everything was so fresh and delicious. It might be nice if they could add a bell/buzzzer/phone outside the Executive Club door in case a member forgets their card (or if it doesn’t work) so they aren’t locked out (like I was briefly). 

STAFF-The concierge gentleman from Brazil was lovely and provided really helpful train information with detailed routes on paper too. We were appreciative of that since we were not familiar with the area. He was very nice and warm. The other gentleman who checked us in was great too and provided a nice room to us for our first stay in Paris.

LOCATION-The airport bus from CDG drops you off very close to the hotel (very easy walk). Tons of restaurants and places to eat (quick take out bites) were within walking distance (even across the street). The train station Gare St. Lazare is on the same block so that was easy. There’s also nice shopping within the station. You do have to transfer trains to get to some of the big sites but not a big deal. Busses are within walking distance. There’s a pharmacy too within a block or so if needed.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Very nice hotel
text: The staff was lovely and the hotel was very Parisian!  Good location.  Great choices for breakfast and the bar was a relaxing place to stop for a cold drink.  The concierge was particularly helpful to us.  I would stay there again.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: The Best Hotel and Staff ever!!
text: So I have never written a review  -  but I have to do one on this hotel. I’m on a family vacation with my two adult sons (23 and  almost 21) but I can’t say enough about this hotel -rooms are spacious and clean and everyone is very attentive and so friendly. Special shout out to Raphael (the concierge) - he was so helpful -we had not preplanned  our trip as well as we should have but Raphael was incredible-got us tickets to everything we wanted to  see (even when on the website they told us they were sold out) -this is a great place to stay - convenient to everything we were interested in seeing!!! If I ever come back to Paris -this is where I will stay!!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Avoid this hotlel
text: What a truly dreadful stay, dont bother have Hilton status they don't care. Rooms small no upgrades. Linen was dirty, housekeeping turned off air-conditioning during 40 degree days. Room poor failed, staff did not care. I would not stay.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Fantastic location
text:
The Hilton Paris Opera is a lovely hotel in a fantastic location of Paris.  
We stayed 3 nights in the Executive rooms and used the executive lounge for breakfast and drinks in the late afternoon/early evening.  

Our room was bright and clean with a coffee machine and fridge.  Bottled water was available everyday.  The only thing that let the room down was housekeeping not replenishing the toiletries, but this was quickly rectified when we phoned down.  The next day we had the same issue and also we didn't have the tea/coffee replenished either.  This is something the hotel can work on with housekeeping.

The concierge  do not know Paris or local transport links which I feel is imperative in a hotel like this.  We asked about visiting the Latin Quarter and the concierge hadn't heard of it.  This was disappointing as they are the first point of contact when arranging your day/evening. Again something the hotel can work on.

The Executive lounge was excellent, offering a good breakfast and an excellent choice of everything.  What let it down for me was that there was no cups and sauces available for your hot drinks, only mugs.  I did ask and was told that the hotel doesn't have any.  I prefer my hot drink in a cup and saucer, but I am English and maybe the hotel caters for the American market more.  This is personal but otherwise the rest of the offerings were excellent and plentiful and the Executive staff  helpful and friendly.

Despite one or two gripes I highly recommend this hotel which is convenient to the Eurostar, route 26 on the bus which takes 15 minutes.  The hotel has a very large train station Saint Lazare and a metro station on its doorstep.  You can also walk on foot to many of Paris's attractions including Galeries Lafayette and the Opera or the opposite direction to the Arc de Triomphe. 

The hotel has many restaurants and shops surrounding it so you couldn't want for more.   I also highly recommend that you book the Executive rooms and take advantage of the Executive lounge and its perks.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great stay!
text: Took the family to Paris and had a great time at this hotel. Rooms were nice, clean, and spacious. Breakfast was good and had enough choices. Good location for restaurants and Metro/train. Very friendly staff.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Convenient location and good
text: Overall a good place to stay. Enjoyed the proximity to things and decent value for money. Rooms were a bit pricey for our stay! Good executive lounge even though we experienced some temperature issues. Decent food at the executive lounge and friendly staff all around the hoy
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Loved staying at Hilton opera
text: The entire staff is friendly and makes you one feel at home. The staff at the lobby to the breakfast were helpful and ensured we had a pleasant stay. The location is convenient for all the attractions and is closer to railway station. There are plenty of food options close by.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: A gem in Paris! Loved our stay!
text:
This was our first time in Paris and as a longtime Hilton Diamond member, I felt staying here would be a safe choice. It was that and so much more!

We got in to the city around 9am and were exhausted. Our rooms were not ready yet (understandable) but they sent us to the Executive Lounge to get some food and rest. There was a nice selection of fruits, pastries, juices. They even had eggs and waffles which my daughter loved. 

Shortly after noon we had one of our rooms which was so appreciated!

The rooms were much larger than I expected. We were upgraded in one of them to a King Junior Suite. It was nice to have the extra room. Our suite was an ADA room which could explain it.,,there was only a shower and no tub, which was fine with us, as we prefer showers anyway. 

Le Grand Salon was beautiful, a nice spot for drinks and food after a busy day! The service was fantastic. I really wanted my family to speak French as best they could to show our respect and the staff was very kind and patient. 

The location was prefect, near many of the major sights  and great shopping. 

We loved this hotel. We loved the staff. We will be back ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️. ️️️️️
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Highly recommended
text: Great location, was able to walk to most of the sites I wanted to see.  Staff was very friendly and the executive lounge above average!  Rooms were clean and for Paris, very spacious. Only suggestion is if you are flying out, order the taxi or uber in advance, it can be very challenging to get one on demand.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Outstanding!
text: This was our absolutely best experience at a Hilton hotel. The concierge was very helpful and the executive lounge staff was outstanding. Housekeeping did an excellent job cleaning our room each day and it was overall an outstanding experience. I can’t say enough good things about this hotel.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Convenient location, lovely hotel
text: Hotel was very clean and room was excellent. Next to train station and Metro. Walking distance to shopping, cafes and restaurants. Executive Lounge good. Staff friendly and helpful. Grand Salon lovely place for drinks.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Felt like royalty
text: I have only good things to say about this hotel.  Check in was efficient (if not warm).  Our corner room was a palace.  The breakfast buffet had everything you can imagine although my recommendation is to stick to the French classics: regular and chocolate croissants, brie and other cheeses, charcuterie, etc.  Bellmen were superb.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great hotel in great location
text:
Fantastic hotel with great style, at check in got upgraded to a king junior suite, room was amazing had everything we needed, The executive lounge is amazing the alcohol and food served is lovely and so much choice, Breakfast is great everything fresh and delicious, used the gym had all the equipment,
All the staff are so friendly and helpful 

Thank you 
MR Mann
Room 167
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: DECENT HOTEL FOR PARIS STANDARDS
text:
This is a decent hotel, people is helpful, breakfast is healthy, but that's it. This is not a deluxe hotel. Rooms are spacious and have nice furniture, but already look old.
The executive lounge is ok. They serve some food in the afternoon and drinks until 7 PM.
Location is very convenient.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: A rip off for 2000 eur - do not recommend
text:
n 2017 I promoted the Hilton as an invited social media influencer, obviously everything was great, caring staff, treats, great room with a front-street view. We decided to go back in April 2022 since we liked it so much before (how naive). 

The stay was a total disappointment and waste of money. We had to move out to another hotel on the second day out of 4 so we don’t have to pay more for this rip-off. Here’s why it was a total failure:

Useless unhelpful and sly staff which only thinks about their own benefit. If you’re not a diamond member or an invited influencer don’t even think about receiving good service.
We arrived at the hotel around 9 a.m. after travelling for 6 hours. The room was obviously not ready despite in our chat with customer service they said we should just come to the hotel when we enter the city and they will look at options with us. The man at the front-desk, Lorenzo, told us to wait till 12:30 so they have a chance to clean the room, but he did offer us another room which was available immediately for an additional €400,-. 

We came back to the hotel at 14:30 and they had not even started cleaning the room yet. When we asked about the possibility of a place to freshen up and change clothes because we have reservations later in the day his answer was suddenly that officially check-in is at 16:00 and we should just wait.

Another receptionist told us the room has a technical error and that’s what it taking so long. We lost all our reservations only to find out that the room we got is not at al the room we booked. The room was 10 times smaller, dirty, old and missing a door (!!!).

Also the noise from the station was very loud in the room, we had to change the room + we were promised an upgrade by the Hotel Manager Anaelle. They switched us to an identical room,  same small and dirty, but with all doors intact. Still not the hotel room we chose on the website and when we asked about this room they said they don’t know which room we’re speaking about Are you even serious?

Room Upgrade
The Hilton had asked us to come to the hotel the next day between 12:15 and 12:30 to look at the discussed upgrade. We came back to the hotel from the other side of the city at 12:15 and were told that obviously the room is not ready for inspection until 13:30 and we had to wait for this. (Unacceptable to ruin someone’s day like this.)

When we were finally shown the room it wasn’t an upgrade at all. The room was even less spacious, but had an additional living room at the end of a hallway. Completely not dealing with any of the complaints we had about the room being not spacious enough, and missing the couch and bigger clothing closet we had discussed that we expected our room to have. We showed photos from the website of the room we had before, which is the same as what we were expecting to get. But according to the staff “each room is unique”. Which effectively means that some rooms are a lot more beautiful and luxurious for the same price as the smaller less luxurious rooms.

1) Lying / Unhelpful staff

Lorenzo - pushing a €400 upgrade repeatedly after declining and after we were told to come to the hotel early in the day to look for options.

Anaelle - Unhelpful & not guest-oriented, indifferent. It’s normal to her that doors are missing in rooms and that there’s big spots of tooth-paste on the bathroom ceiling in cleaned rooms. She also promised to send an e-mail with her e-mail address which she never did.

Concierge service - Lazy and unhelpful - Asked them to make lunch and dinner reservations for 4 days and it took them almost two full days to make 1 lunch reservation.

2) The rooms
Dirty, old, small, filthy rooms for jackpot prices. Some of the rooms we saw are of their highest category but have a view on the roof which is no view. The best rooms they reserve for their “privileged” members.

In the rooms you can find:
- Toothpaste on the ceiling
- Broken mirror
- Very scratched furniture
- Old, dirty spotted, ripped bed sheets
- Dirty walls and dirty dusty carpets
- No toiletries, toilet papier, tissues in the room
- Paper tea cups
- No bathrobe and slippers

N.B: Totally different story when you check their instagram account. All rooms there are clean and have normal glass toiletries.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Ridiculous service - We went to another hotel in the middle of our trip
text:
Intro
My fiancée and I stayed at the Hilton Paris Opera hotel 5 years ago. We stayed in a very nice room called an executive room and had an amazing stay. We were invited by the Hilton for a complimentary stay since my Fiancée is a social media influencer.

Last week we took a trip to Paris to celebrate our 11-year anniversary and decided it would be nice to revisit the Hilton for three nights in the same room for €1800,- and unfortunately the experience was shockingly awful.

Arrival
We arrived at the hotel at 09:00 in the morning after a long drive and tried to check-in. Here we heard that check-in times start at 16:00. We were hoping that we could shower and change somewhere in the building so we can spend our first day in Paris in something other that sweaty travel clothes.

There were however no facilities available to us, we were told that the guest currently occupying the hotel room had to checkout at 12:00 and that after that the room would be cleaned quickly and would be ready for use for us and that we shouldn’t stray to far from the hotel.

We managed to entertain ourselves until 13:45 before we went back to the hotel to see if perhaps the room was available already. We got told that the room was currently in the process of cleaning and that they were almost done, we just had to wait a little more.

We went out to grab a bite te eat and came back at 15:15 to see if the room was ready for use yet, since we had reservations for a museum at 16:30 we really needed a quick shower after all.

A different employee this time informed us that the room hasn’t been cleaned yet, but they will start cleaning it ASAP and will have it ready for us at 16:30. This story did not at all align with what we had heard before. This employee did end up giving us access to another hotel room for a quick shower, which was very sweet of her.

After we had showered we got our own room key and had our luggage moved to the room.

Room #1: No door
 When we arrived in the room a few things seemed off immediately. 

1 All rooms in the hotel have two doors, one to the hallway and another for soundproofing, we lacked a sound-proofing door, the hooks were still there however. You could hear every footstep outside the room.
2. The room was a whole lot smaller than the room we had previously, it had no couch, the clothing closet was significantly smaller and looked a lot less beautiful. It seemed like a lot lower-tier room, but we found out despite the big differences they are the same rook type and same price class.
3. The room was dirty and damaged, the bedsheet was ripped, the furniture everywhere was scratched, half broken bathroom mirror, dirty spots on the bed, dirty spots on the wall and a big spurt of tooth paste on the bathroom ceiling Not really a €600 a night feeling from this.
4. The room had no basic facilities, no tooth brush holder, no chocolates, no toilet paper, no tissues. 

Instead of making our plans for the museum. We immediately went to the reception to ask about the different room and all of the above complaints. We were told the following things:

- We don’t know which room you were expecting, all rooms in this building are unique.
- We have less facilities in the room due to Corona.
- We will move you to a similar room which does have a double-door. If you spend the night in this room, we will upgrade you to a better room the next day for an additional €110 a night, just come to the hotel at 12:15 and we will show you this room. 

We accepted this offer.

Room #2: The upgrade
The following day we came to the hotel from the other side of Paris at 12:15 as agreed and were told that a mistake was made because the room still had to be cleaned and we had to wait a full hour before looking at the upgrade.

This is the second day where we are sitting around close to the hotel waiting on promised on a 4-day trip. Quite a waste of valuable time I would say.

Eventually, the room was ready and we saw the room. This was a room with a the worst view, the room felt even smaller than our current room, the only upside was that it had an additional living room at the end of a narrow hallway.

We did not accept this upgrade, none of our initial complaints were better in this room. 

By now, we were shocked that we had chosen a luxurious spacious room to spent our anniversary weekend in and had gotten a much different room, a room that wasn’t clean and didn’t even have toilet paper which is a bare necessity and the upgrade which was promised which we were sure was to the room we had initially booked was to something else that was just as bad.

They said they couldn’t help us further. Later that day we came back to the hotel and headed up to our room to again find a room without toilet paper. (Third time now)

We packed our suitcase and headed to the lobby, asked to speak to the manager and explained at length how horrible our experience was. She was polite, but not shocked that guests were leaving mid-stay, not shocked that we again didn’t have toilet paper, not shocked that we a “cleaned room” with tooth-paste on the ceiling.

She offered us a 50% discount on the one night we spend there and wished us on our way. We had already called another hotel to see if they potentially had a room for us. This hotel did live up to the set expectations and we had a lovely time there.

Bonus: The Concierge 
As soon as we arrived at the Hilton at 09:00 of the first day we went to the concierge desk to help us arrange some restaurant reservations. We wanted to have lunch and dinner at good places everyday where a hotel concierge simply gets you in the door more easy.  Our Paris trip was 4 days and we had 7 restaurants on a list for lunch and/or dinner options. We were told we will get phone confirmation of any appointments that were made. The next day we went back to the concierge after breakfast and we found out that his coworker had forgotten to try and book anything and will do so today.  It wasn’t until 16:00 on this second day that they contacted us by phone because they needed our creditcard details (number, security code and everything) because they were booking the restaurant through the restaurants website. This succeeded for a single restaurant after which we heard nothing about the other restaurants or other days.

Conclusion
We did not have a good time at the Hilton Paris Opera hotel in the slightest. They made us wait for hours, they did not offer us a suitable room as we booked, the rooms we got were very dirty and lacked basic facilities, they were not at all surprised when we complained about any of these things and the concierge desk spent almost two full days to get us a single reservation and didn’t bother with the other reservations.  In the past I have had a good experience not only with this branche of the Hilton but with other branches as well, they have always had a great service and I can’t imagine why the service was simply poor during our stay. I can only imagine poor management creeped into the business during the pandemic.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Wonderful hotel
text:
This is a gorgeous old hotel with a spectacular salon/bar area. The hotel was renovated in 2016, so the facilities are modern and comfortable. We were lucky enough to be upgraded to a junior suite, with a very large bedroom area and a spacious bathroom. It faced an interior courtyard, and we heard no street noise at all. Having Hilton Honors Diamond status meant we had access to the Executive Lounge, which served breakfast as well as wine and hors d'oeuvres in the evening. We also had the option of the sumptuous complimentary buffet breakfast in the restaurant. The staff couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating. A special shout-out to the bellman Olivier, who helped get us taxis, etc.

The location is very good, just across from the Saint Lazare train station, and a couple of blocks from the major department stores Galleries Lafayette and Printemps, as well as the Opera and the Place Madeline.

The only caveat is for those who are handicapped or have trouble with steps. Because it's a historic building, they are restricted from making changes without special permits. So there are 4 steps from the street into the entrance, and another 7 steps from the entrance level to Reception, without any handrails. However, there is an easy work-around. One can go to the back of the building (an easy walk), or be dropped off or picked up there by a taxi, and use the back entrance, which puts one on the Reception level where the elevators are to the hotel rooms.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Five star
text:
I recently proposed to my partner in the Hilton Paris Opera and with the help of the 1st class staff, she said Yes! The hotel is very grand with high quality, classy decor (particularly salon bar) and the building has a real romantic vibe so it was definitely the right choice! It is also the perfect location to explore the city of love! Oh and breakfast buffet is incredible, you will need an hour at least… 

Special thank you to Charlotte and Frederique for helping me with the proposal logistics, Martin for running through the plans and taking some incredible photos and to all the staff who helped us on the night!
 
Thank you for an incredible weekend that we will never forget and we will return again soon!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Wonderful stay! Great location!
text: We stayed at the Hilton Paris Opera for 5 nights and loved it!! Great location and we walked practically everywhere. We took the metro 2 times and the stop is right next to the hotel. We also took the train to Versailles and the Gare St. Lazarre is right next to hotel. Also took train to Normandy from this train station. So convenient. The included breakfast is amazing! The croissants are delicious. The executive lounge is open and everyone was so nice and helpful! I highly recommend this hotel!!!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Some good, some bad.
text: Staying here four days during French vacation. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They go out of their way to help us in place where the language is foreign to us. The building exterior has old world charm as does the main salon and reception area. The room, however, is tiny, which I understand is pretty much the norm for Paris. Our two large suitcases pretty much filled it up. The bathroom of marble and tile is beautiful and almost as large as the room. They gave us one tiny bar of soap for the sink, which had to double for the shower too. The second day they didn’t even replenish that. We had to ask for more soap and toilet paper. The furniture is old and scratched, as is the paint on the walls. Air conditioning is inadequate. The location is good with access to the Metro, buses and taxis. The buffet breakfast is a plus.  Disappointing for a brand as prestigious as Hilton
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: One night in Paris
text: Stayed one night using points. Received as Diamond an upgrade to a (slightly larger) executive room. Location is great for walking to the usual highlights in Paris. Executive lounge was disappointing, only wine and beer, and food mediocre af best. Friendly front desk staff, and i appreciated the late check out. No valet parking, due to Covid, but parking in train station is very close (although without electric car charging options).
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Location.  Average Service
text: The Hilton Paris Opera is a magnificent building conveniently located at the heart of the city.  The rooms are all different. You really have to spend time finding the right one. The Executive Lounge is very small with limited offerings. Overall the service is average at best.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Very poor customer service.
text:
I was here to spend vacation time with my family, who came all the way from India. I paid extra to get a room with a view and requested  a room on the same floor as soon as I arrived. The First person at Regis assigned a room, but it was getting cleaned. So after it was cleaned, we were supposed to get that room. The location was perfect. And we saw, that 1 hr after we spoke to him, the room was cleaned and ready. I went back to registration desk after waiting for the time he requested me to wait and seeing that the room was cleaned and ready. But after he left, All people on registration gave such a run around, that I spent almost 5-6 hrs, just trying to get into the room we paid for and requested. Wasted half my day of vacation, only when manager was called did they even co-operate. Bryan, at registration was terrible. 
Donot talk to him. He will try his best to not honor your request.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Fabulous Stay! I Highly Recommend!
text:
I can't say enough good things about the Hilton Paris Opera.  Everything from communication prior to our arrival to beyond our check out was excellent!   I was traveling to Paris with my daughter as part of her 21st Birthday celebration and emailed the hotel a few days prior to confirm our room would have 2 beds. I mentioned I wanted everything to go smoothly at check-in because it was her birthday and we had plans that evening.  I also inquired about breakfast being gluten-free due to her having Celiac Disease.   I promplty received not only a reply from the hotel about the room but the Hotel Food and Beverage manager, Nicolas, also emailed me to tell me the breakfast buffet had many GF options.  That is excellent customer service!
We arrived at the hotel and were instantly greeted by the doorman out front and concierge inside.  We went to the desk where Liselott expertly handled our check-in. She said we had been upgraded but the room wasn't quite ready yet and directed us to the Executive Lounge to wait.  What she wasn't telling us was our delay was due to the staff finishing up a Birthday surprise in the room for my daughter.  It was just a short wait and when we arrived in the room there was a beautiful  gluten free cake and macaroons that Nicolas had prepared for her along with a hand written note from him and another from Martin of Guest Relations and his team wishing her a Happy Birthday.  What a wonderful and unexpected surprise!!  My daughter will never forget that, how kind of them!  The room was spacious and well appointed, we could not have been happier.  The breakfast buffet was excellent and we really enjoyed our visits to the Executive Lounge.  Saleem was always there to greet us,  smiling and working hard to make sure everyone had what they needed.  
We knew we'd miss the hotel when we left, it was the best of our trip.  It's in an excellent location next to Gare St. Lazare with multiple Metro, Bus and Train options right there. The train station also has a grocery store, shopping and food.  There are also plenty of good restaurants close to the hotel.  
I travel all over the world for work and stay in multiple hotels every year.  It is obvious this hotel is very well managed and the staff is trained to provide excellent customer service.  It is some of the best I've seen!  Thank you for making our stay one to remember!   I cannot say enough good things and this will be our families choice of hotel in Paris as long as it is open.  Merci Beaucoup!!!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Property!
text:
This is a great hotel with an excellent staff.  It is within feet of the Gare St. Lazare train stations (for trains in the Normandy-direction) and within feet of a major Paris Metro subway line.

There are two reasons why I didn't peg this at 5 stars:  First is that there is no formal restaurant within the hotel serving supper - the bar has an extensive menu, but it isn't the same.  And second, a lack of handrails for the stairs.   I am slightly mobility challenged and could have used a handrail to enter the property.

That being said:  Highly Recommend
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Accommodations, Great Location, Good Staff
text:
The location of the hotel is excellent near several shopping malls, metro stations, and train stations. There are great food options directly across the street and all throughout the neighborhood also close enough to walk to all of the attractions the Louvre, Musee D'orsay, and Notre Dame. 
The rooms were very good in size they came with slippers very clean and a lot of bottled water outside in the main hallway. All of the staff spoke English the only disappointment was the food  menu  there were only a few options but we compensate  going out to the restaurants nearby.
 Our room was on the Saint Lazar side of the hotel it is a very noisy street so if you open your window or sleep with windows open at night expect to hear a lot of road noise and people 
Overall I would stay at this hotel again it is very convenient and modern
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Beautiful stay in Paris
text: We just had the most amazing stay here!! The rooms are absolutely gorgeous and very clean. Although it was the staff that made our stay exceptional. The co concierge team was the best!! They helped plan the most amazing trip for us before we even arrived with our 5 and 7 year old in mind. Then they answered our million questions a day and were able to change our plans as needed. We couldn’t have been happier. We highly recommend the hotel!! The breakfasts were great too and we loved the snacks in the lounge!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Awesome services
text:
Absolutely great service playbook. 
Everyone is clearly well trained and genuinely service people well! The executive lounge lady was so nice and treat our 2 year old with lots of patience. 

The breakfast is great. 

The location is great.

Overall it’s a really pleasant experience to stay here with the family!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Hotel, Great Staff, Great Location
text: During our first ever visit to Paris, we stayed at the Hilton Opera Hotel for 4 nights. Turned out to be the perfect choice. Even though the building itself is historical, they have done a great job of turning it into a hotel. Very comfortable, nice space, a great sized bathroom, and very clean. While none of us in our group of 6 spoke french, it didn't matter as most of the staff spoke english and we had not problem communicating. Before we went on this trip, we had heard multiple times that French people were typically rude to Americans who did not speak French. Not true. Almost all the people we interacted with were quite nice. Finally, the location of this hotel is great, if your goal is to visit all the main attractions. It's right across the street from the Saint Lazare metro stop, and we had no problems getting anywhere we wanted to go. And the included breakfast buffet every morning was great. Highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: My favorite hotel in Paris
text: Had a 3 night stay at the Opera with my family. I stayed there a number of times pre-covid, and so knew what to expect, but things have actually gotten even better.  The hotel is very well situated for visitors to Paris, with easy access to multiple metro lines and the train to Normandy.  Breakfast is outstanding, with a huge selection of fresh bread products, fruits, yogurts, cereals, etc.  I had exec lounge access, which provided a nice respite before dinner, with light snacks and wine in a comfortable room.  I was most pleased with the service-- all of the staff with whom I engaged were friendly and helpful; the desk staff, lounge staff, and bell staff all went out of their way to assist.  The hotel was kind enough to provide connecting rooms, which made my stay with family much more enjoyable.  I'd highly recommend this property to travellers looking for a great base in Paris, and can't wait until I can return.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: A nice treat if you are visiting Paris
text: This is a lovely hotel , you really do feel you are visiting an opera house when you enter the hotel. My room was beautifully decorated and extremely comfortably . The breakfast is good and if you have a window seat the view of life passing bye in the morning is nice to observe. I needed a taxi and found the staff eager to help. The staff I encountered were very nice at reception and at the front of house.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Very nice Stay
text: We had a very nice 3 night stay in December.  For our 25th anniversary, we received a very appreciated upgrade. The staff - from bellman to front desk to concierge to lobby bar - all wonderful. No complaints. Would have given it 4.5 if I could have.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Paris owes us nothing!
text: My sister in law and I spent the weekend in Paris at the Hilton Paris Opera. The staff was beyond helpful, especially when we had trouble finding a taxi on Sunday!  We had a spacious corner room with a view of the beautiful architecture of the train station and clock next door. We were in walking distance to Printemps and Lafayette Galeries…ooh the food court!   And our Big Bus stop.  If you have a chance to stay at the Hilton Paris Opera…take it!   C’est Bon!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Old and tired, particular bad for group events
text:
This hotel has seen better days.  It is a historic property, but is living on its laurels at this point.  The hotel itself has been partially updated; the rooms have been renovated in some recent era, but the public spaces are really aging.  The room was very small; about 18 inches of space around the bed but that was about it.  The best feature of the room was the bathroom, which was comparatively spacious.  Amenities were ok but barebones (e.g. instant coffee only in room).

If you are planning an event here, I would think twice about it.  I was attending an event of about 100 people, and the overall service was really poor.  There seems to be a staffing problem; coffee and food running out, not enough bathrooms anywhere (one working toilet for the entire first floor of the hotel, which included the lobby, restaurant, and a meeting room for 100+; needless to say there were very long lines).

The only reason I could see to stay at this property would be if the room rate were unusually low, well below that of credible alternatives.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Impressive building, but not an impressive hotel
text: This is a Hilton Hotel, but not as I remember them as there is no room service or bar service after 11pm. It is an impressive building with friendly staff but it is more like a Travelodge, comfortable beds but no facilities for late night snacks or drinks. You have to ask for water for your room and ice at the bar. It just seems a little like the management are running the hotel on the cheap.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Mesmerizing architecture!
text: As soon as you enter, you see their incredible lounge which is a masterpiece in itself! Great location and staff were on point. Only downside was we opted for the larger rooms which were still quite small. Coming from London and having been to major cities in the world, I guess it's expected for the standard room but not the more expensive larger room
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: No AC - room to hot
text:
The room it self was ok but a bit outdated for my tastes.  The room was extremely hot when we got there and since there was no ac we had to open the window in the living area and bathroom.  Since they had hooks they only opened an inch so it never cooled down.  The bed the first night was extremely bouncy and I got a horrible sleep.  

Right near the train station which takes you to normandy.  So if that is your purpose it is a good spot.

Lounge had light snacks and drinks.

I would recommend staying elsewhere in Paris.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Lovely stay in a beautiful building
text:
My husband and I stayed here for two nights at the end of a trip to Paris. The building is stunning, and is in a highly desirable and convenient location if you anticipate needing to rely on public transit extensively. 

We arrived in the morning and were given our room early, to our surprise. The staff at the reception were friendly and helpful. The room was comfortable and attractive, and we appreciated the good use of space and the double doors to ensure quiet. 

Breakfast was good, but became crowded at times. This hotel is a lodging location for at least one tour company.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: They ask me to pay $800 deposit even my stay was paid in full
text: Hilton Paris ask me to pay double time deposit , around $800 even my stay was paid in full . They force me to pay , treat me like I’m homeless and can’t afforded. I never have this kind of experience , I visit 82 countries . Not recommending to book this hotel
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Way Overpriced
text:
The hotel, mainly, is way overpriced. I paid the hotel with my points and cash. The rooms were okay, but they hadn't changed my bed sheets for 3-4 days, internet in the room never worked. The noise was way too much. There are no signs to hang on the door. Housekeeping barged in many times when I was sleeping or even showering. 

A cup of coffee cost me almost 10 Euros. Their breakfast wasn't good enough. As a gold member of Hilton, I have stayed at many Hilton properties but this wasn't the best one.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: A stay at the Hilton Opera
text: Okay location for shopping.  Tad bit of a walk to tourists attractions such as the Louvre.  Beautiful lobby bar. Bottled water was not supplied - thank goodness we had Executive Lounge access.  Inconsistent supply of coffee and drinks cups in room.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Overcharging and I paid extra $800 deposit even my stay paid in full
text: Hilton charge me almost $800 deposit , even my stay already paid full . Be careful when they gonna charge you in lobby cafe , they can add you extra and cheat you , I’m not recommending this hotel , never coming back again here . Very disappointed , this is my second stay here
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Do Not Stay Here for Your Honeymoon
text: My wife and I came to the Hilton Opera Paris to celebrate our honeymoon. They did absolutely nothing to accommodate our special occasion. I used 320k points for a very small room. I Will be switching to Marriott
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Loved our stay!
text:
We had a 3 night stay at the Hilton Paris Opera Hotel. We were greeted and assisted immediately upon arrival.  The hotel lobby was gorgeous. Check in was quick and easy.  After presenting our Covid cards and passports, we were given our room key and informed that we were  being upgraded to a suite.  I am a Diamond member, so I expected an upgrade.  We were given a suite!  The room was very large and had a huge bathroom with heated floors.  There was a Nespresso coffee maker and robes and slippers.  The bed was a little harder than what we liked, but we were so tired at the end of the day did not have any problems sleeping, other than the issue of the time change and jet lag. Breakfast was included with our room rate.  Breakfast was a buffet which included a typical English style breakfast but also included fresh breads, cheeses, meats, fruit, spreads, yogurt, cereal. juices and more.  An automatic coffee maker provided various coffee drinks. Staff at this hotel were friendly and went out of their way to be helpful.  We asked that the hotel keep our bags for one night while we took the high speed train to Strasbourg, France for the Christmas Markets.  We were staying at a Hilton in Strasbourg for one night and did not want to haul our roller bags just for one night.  Staff gladly kept our bags safe and secure until our return the following day.  We had an issue with the coffee maker in the room on our first night. We called the front desk and received an immediate response from staff who brought another coffee maker with several coffee pods.
All in all our stay was great and the hotel was in a great location where we were able to walk to several sites.  The subway was a short walk away and the train station is a 15 minute walk away.  The hotel was easily accessible from CDG via train and subway.  I would definitely stay here again.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great facility poor response to complaints
text: I made a complaint to the staff that was important to all guests and they ignored it.  Very sad could have easily been resolved     The local area in front of the hotel sb clean.    This is very sad.  This is not good
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Beautiful but Old
text:
It is our second visit to Hilton Opera and we didn't want to book a different hotel since the location is perfect (close walking proximity from a lot of beautiful areas and sites). Last time we had a suite and this time we booked superior room - which is quite small but comfortable. 
- The hotel bar is outstanding 
- The rooms are getting old and could use some refreshment 
- Amenities - POOR. It's not the ice age anymore - nespresso machines are everywhere and I think Hilton can afford to change the cheap nescafe sachets. And if you are a woman, you will be disappointed to find an OLD hairdryer and no cotton buds, etc.
- The staff is nice (especially Karim - who helped us before our arrival with information and found/made restaurant reservation, which is currently impossible in Paris since it's packed). However, the reception staff could be more attentive and guest focused (and not stare on their screens without paying attention even when you approach them).

Overall, we recommend this hotel as it is conveniently located, has a nice interior and the rooms are comfortable.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great experience
text:
Very good accommodations, good location and specially an excellent level of service. 

I use this hotel for business travel. If booked in advance the cost can be similar to other smaller hotels, and special tariffs apply for Hilton Honors members. The hotel is well located for tourism and also for business trips, right besides the Saint Lazare metro and train station.

Rooms are spacious and have a modern decoration with all amenities you would expect from a four-star hotel. I had to eventually work from my room some times and it makes a difference to have enough room and good support to do so (good value for the experience). Most other smaller hotels in Paris are small and offer no additional support.

The lobby bar is very pleasing, great ambiance. The menu is limited but has interesting dishes. Same menu for the room service.

I had a late meeting the day of checkout, the front desk arranged for a vary late checkout and gave me all necessary support to let me focus only on my work issues. This service level and the excellent accommodations is what makes it a great value and a great experience.

Definitely going back.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Did not meet my expectations at all
text:
Nice location. Breakfast terrible.
Rooms are not as nice as they look on the website. Cocktails at the lobby are way overpriced for their quality. Make sure to buy water or something to drink before you get to your room. No complimentary water or minibar available:(
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Super noisy building even on top floors, couldn’t sleep, dirty carpets
text: The trains run underground cause the building to vibrate every minute. I couldn’t sleep. So noisy. The carpet is not very clean. Internet is so slow I couldn’t even load websites properly. The AC didn’t work, my room felt like a sauna. Breakfast closed at 10am, and wasn’t even that good.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Easily accessible beautiful hotel
text: Beautiful hotel! Right by the metro and train station, so it’s easy to access transportation to get around the city. Great staff, especially the concierge! However the beds were very uncomfortable, they charge you for local calls without telling you up front, and the room is hard to keep warm.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great time at s great location.
text: We traveled to Paris for sightseeing snd shopping. Stayed at the Hilton Paris Opera house because of its central location and beautiful decor.  We were greeted by a friendly bellman that helped with out bags, upon checkin, we were upgraded in our room to a beautiful 2 room suite because of our Hilton honors Diamond status and availability. The bar in the central area was absolutely stunning!  Lots of nice restaurants within a short walk.  Was about 12-14 euros to Uber to Louvre, Arc d’Triumph and Eiffel Tower. Will repeat our stay
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Excellent location and amazing staff
text:
Mr Karim from concierge will be your greatest support to handle any emerging issue or question.
Location is very central to Opera, shopping and metro transportation.
PCR test location is nearby the hotel (ask concierge for priority voucher)
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Beautiful Property.
text: We love staying at historic, charming hotels and this one did NOT disappoint.  The staff was courteous and all-around fantastic.  The hotel was clean.  The room was comfortable, modern and clean.  We will be back!!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Location needs updating
text: The lobby is beautiful and a the bar is great for drinks.  The room I had needs new carpet.  My floors were were stained and dirty.  You do get slippers. The check in area is small and gets very busy! Breakfast was just ok and the breads were a bit stale.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Worst hotel to price combination experience
text: Room rate overpriced but needed hotel in certain area due to late arrival / business meetings. No reception area to mention bar a small desk / 1 person. Bar area impressive but closed early. Box sized room at best. Breakfast was not included and was average at best. Blackened croissants (a new French speciality ?). Won’t be repeated as failed to live up to price point on virtually all levels.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: One of our best visits to Paris over thirty years, thanks to the  wonderful Hilton staffduring these difficult times.
text:
Excellent services in particular the front desk staff and the concierge services.
Unique concierge service regarding getting the European QR code in less than 24 hours for American travelers.
Also they will set up appointment for COVID Test at pharmacy nearby for travelers returning home.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Awesome
text: The Opera experience was fascinating. The stage dancers and music kept are attention and we never lost interest or became distracted in any way. Thanks for putting on a wonderful event that made the night
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Location. Great Breakfast. Needs an Upgrade.
text: What a great location if you love to walk.  Staff is attentive but a little distant. Good job with the breakfast buffet.  Lounge is beautiful but expensive. Many restaurants within blocks.  In need of an upgrade b
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Terrible  hotel with bad service
text: Terrible service, rude staff, this Hotel is in desperate need of renovation. Beds shake when a train goes by every few minutes. The concierge are unhelpful and rude, the front desk staff are equally rude  Overpriced and very disappointing - avoid unless you like the above.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Terrible for families - overpriced
text: The Hotel seemed to lack compassion, especially some of the male check in staff. We checked in and upon asking for an upgrade, as I am a Gold member, I was given the answer that they could not upgrade us to a suite and as we had already booked the highly expensive executive room, it cannot be upgraded further (nb the executive lounge was closed because of Covid, even though breakfast etc was open, just wondering what the executive room benefit brings). The hotel doesn’t have a ramp for disabled nor children’s pram. And even though the staff saw us struggling carrying our pram up the stairs there was often no help. The heights was that when we had checked out and were wanting to head to the train station, some of the taxis were not taking us, as we were four ppl (one was 6 months old). Upon asking the concierge desk to order us a bigger Taxi, we got the answer that they couldn’t order it, why don’t we try public transport! (As if the hotel conveniently forgot that Covid existed and that we were guests at a five star hotel, with two small children!). Overall I totally regretted that I booked this hotel, and also was a big disappointment from the Hilton Brand). I don’t think I would easily book another Hilton property if there is another choice ever again!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Sad Decline for a Beloved Hotel
text: What a sad decline for a hotel we have enjoyed for so many years in the past. This once grand dame has stained and ragged carpets, sewer orders in 2nd floor hall, flooring detached in the fitness  center, breakfast room with inadequate staff to the point of having no clean dishes or tables. No room upgrade for a Diamond member with 2 million points. We canceled our return reservation and are in a Novotel that is clean, brightly lit, fresh smelling, and could be a model for the Opera Hilton. And the room costs half the Hilton price. The Opera Hilton owners disgrace the Hilton brand.
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Management has totally failed
text: I stayed in this hotel on 4 September. The communication between the reservation department and the reception is abysmal. My special requests were not taken into account. I asked for high floor and got a room on the first floor, I asked for a room with a view of the train station and did not get one. It would have been very competent if you had contacted me to say it was not possible. As a Gold member I expect better communication and professionalism. No coffee maker in the room although described. The management cannot represent the Hilton brand. Very sad about the beautiful hotel.  As a Gold member I felt totally out of place. No welcome greeting and no attention. Lounge was closed without me being informed. Unfriendly staff at check in. My stay was just annoying. I informed the management about it and they assured me to do better. I have decided to give it another try and will book again on New Year's Eve for me and my friend for 3 nights. I am very curious if the management will really do better and give me a good feeling of professionalism this time. My review will follow on 3 January 2022
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Beautiful hotel
text:
We stayed 5 nights in their queen junior suite, pretty spacious for a hotel in Paris and very nice to have a separate living room. 

The hotel lobby bar is beautiful and a perfect place to have a drink before dinner. On top of that, their staff were all very friendly and accommodating. Especially Anna (not sure if I spelled her name right) at front desk as well as Charlotte at Concierge. 

Only suggestion we would give is that, please place real glasses and coffee cups in the room instead of the paper ones!
name: Hilton Paris Opera

title: Great Hotel,  great help with lost property
text:
clean, modern and friendly staff right in the middle of town
would stay again anytime

I left my headphones in the room, and the staff posted them to Australia for me no issues

Well recommended 
thank you
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Great Hotel, Great Location
text:
Very nice hotel and very close to the Arc De Triomphe. My wife, two daughters and I visited at the beginning of August 2022 and stayed for 3 nights. 

We had a one bedroom suite, the kids slept in the salon on a fold out bed. The suite is fully equipped for self catering including a well stocked mini bar. As a family of four (My daughters are both young teenagers) it was a tiny bit cramped, but we were out most of the time. One doesn’t visit Paris to hang around a hotel.

Staff were all lovely, nothing too much trouble. Even borrowing a plug adaptor for us from a neighbouring hotel when we forgot to bring ours. 

Close to the Champs Ellyses, the metro and a monoprix. Perfect for a trip to one of the nicest cities in the world
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Nice and great value!
text: This hotel suite was very nice, clean and cozy. The front desk was so helpful in arranging our transport to the airport and they were also accommodating on allowing us to check in a little early. The room we had was a mini studio it was very small but perfect for 2 people. I would definitely stay here again.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Nice!
text: Nice hotel, great people and superb location! I lost my e-reader on my bed when I left, and the staff was super friendly and send it back to me to the Netherlands. Would really recommend booking here when visiting Paris.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Excellent Hotel
text: We were a family of 2 adults and 2 teens. This hotel suited us perfectly. Location is fantastic near all main sites and suite had 2 rooms, one with sofa bed, small kitchen and lounge area. Would def recommend
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Great stay
text: Great location for tourists and 5 minutes from metro. Lots of high-end (expensive) shops. Amazing restaurants, one a few doors away. Very friendly & helpful staff. Clean & cozy room. Great communication before, during and after stay. Comfortable bed but pillows too soft. Would stay again! Recommended.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Great little weekend
text:
Spotlessly clean hotel. Staff very polite and friendly. Room cleaned daily. Downside, coffee/tea/milk chargeable. 
On a main road so slight road traffic if your in one of the front rooms and a light sleeper.
WiFi good, no bar area for a chill
Great location
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Few days in Paris
text:
Excellent location, very friendly and helpful staff and brilliant value for money. Perfect for a few days exploring Paris. Very highly recommended. 
Отлично местоположение, любезен персонал и добро съотношение цена-качество. Перфектен за няколкодневен престой в Париж.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Business Trip
text:
Perfect solution in the center of Paris. 
Very clean and cute room.
Staff kindness and support has been simply perfect. 
I recommend it for a buisness trip but also for a weekend holiday.
Tatally recommended.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: From California
text:
Great location friendly staff and helpful 
Kind of compact for two with one bed but very clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again when visiting Paris 
You are able to open windows if too warm as well
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Perfect Stay For Romantic Getaway
text: The apartments are small but for a stay in the middle of Paris it was great. The apartment was functional and quiet, with transport very close by. Would definitely recommend. Staff were friendly and they made an exception for our very late check in, so thank you for that
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Great
text: The location of the hotel is excellent. The staff was very nice and the rooms wel very clean. I would highly recomend this hotel if you want to stay near the champ elysee and the shops. Thank you for the service!
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Great Staff
text: My stay at the Helzear was very comfortable and welcoming. Mariem made sure my family was in good care while we visited Paris. The breakfast that is served is very good as well. The location of the hotel is superb. Will recommend to friends and family.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Conveniently located and service is good, but images are misleading and layout can be better
text:
I struggle a little buy think 3* is a reasonable overall rating.

First the good:
- Excellent location near Champs Elysee. The George V station and shopping street is literally a 5min walk away. You can also walk lightly to the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tower from here
- Professional staff. They are not exactly knowledgeable, but they will smile and say hi when you pass the lobby. 
- Room cleaning service was excellent.
- There are basic cooking amenities like microwave, stove, kettle and utensils.

What’s missing:
-  Names of room types are inflated, and images don’t show the room accurately. As such you can’t really tell accurately what you are booking. Our room was one bedroom suite, which was actually a tiny room with a loft for a “bedroom”.
- Room layout was incredibly tight. Once the sofa bed was set, you’d literally need to climb over the bed to get to the bathroom. You need to crawl  into the loft bedroom because there is no standing space.
- Ceiling and floorboards were very thin. There was one night we had a family above which dragged furnitures late into the night and talked loudly, and we could hear them well. That said the reception did try to help to talk to them.

On hindsight we would have booked something bigger for our family of four. But I think they could have more clearly represented what the rooms actually are like on their website and on the booking engines, so we can make a more accurate booking. And the “suite room” layout that hinders access to the bathroom is really mind-boggling.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Amazing stay
text: My boyfriend and I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights as a treat for our 9 year anniversary. We were absolutely delighted that the staff at the hotel gave us a room with a fantastic street view and a complimentary breakfast. It was absolutely amazing! The room itself was spacious and immaculate, the bathroom & shower so nice. Every single staff member we spoke to was polite, friendly and really helpful. The cleaners were also super lovely and left our room completely spotless. We will definitely be back! Thank you so much for an unforgettable stay in Paris.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Good but not great
text:
Decent room and good location.
Room did suffer from small amount of road noise. It didn’t both us but if you’re a light sleeper then may be not good. Biggest disappointment is that my pre-authorisation monies from check-in have not been returned 3 weeks after returning. I have had to chase this 3 times and still no success. Having read other reviews this seems to be a common theme and one which the business should address sooner rather than later should they want repeat business.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Central location, clean, good service!
text: The hotel was very well located - parallel to Champs Elysees. There is a lift in the hotel - good for those with rooms on upper floors, with luggage. Unfortunately, we were allotted the room on the ground floor located right next to the street - and we could hear traffic noise or people walking by talking/laughing along the street. Thankfully it isn't a major road, so traffic was not so heavy or noisy. Also people entering/leaving the hotel for check in, etc. We requested for a room change and the hotel staff was very nice and accommodating - they agreed to move us if there were any other available rooms. Unfortunately, there weren't any. But the hotel offered us free breakfast the next day - it was a nice gesture. We stayed there for 3 nights - after the 1st night we got used to the noise, and it became more like background noise. Our friends booked another room in the hotel - it was located on the 2nd floor, very well placed, so quiet. So overall, the hotel was a good one, and I would recommend staying there!
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: good location for culture and shopping
text: great friendly staff, near to Champs Elysee, Etoile, Seine and Metro, loved to stay there for my culturall trip with visit at Opera Bastille, Theatre de Champs Elysee, Louvre, Le Marais, Bois de Bouelogne and so on
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: My experience here at the hotel
text: Honestly it was An amazing experience. The service was great , the people who work here are all nice and helpful the rooms are spacious and overall very nice and most importantly the location is outstanding it’s just walking distance from the most important street here in Paris the champs Élysée
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées

title: Christo
text: I wanted to stay close to the Arc de Triomphe  in Paris and this hotel came up during my search. I booked the Junior Suite in the 6th floor. I loved the cleanliness and modern design. The nespresso machine unfortunately was broken and I wish there would have been more Nuxe products to sample in the bathroom. There was personal note in the room however it would have been nice to be addressed as Ms rather than Mr. There is a lovely boulngerie close to the hotel so I could have a lovely breakfast on the balcony. I’d love to visit again. I would have preferred if staff had encouraged mask wearing as several hotel guest walked around without a mask.
name: Suites & Hôtel Helzear Champs-Elysées
