title: Great service and location
text: We are a family of 5 who have just spent one week in Paris at the beautiful Au Boeuf Couronné Hotel. It is an amazing hotel located next to the Metro. We were amazed by the hospitality and service by all the staff members from the cleaners to the front desk. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. We had booked a double room and a three-bedroom for our three teenagers. This was a great solution since the room has a double bed and an extra room with a bed and a small desk. Breakfast is delicious and the croissants are simply to die for. We would recommend this hotel to anyone and we sincerely hope to be back again in the near future.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Really enjoyed my stay
text: The staff are very nice, the area is not the best during the night but during the day it's fine. Local shops nearby and the hotel room was an ok size, very clean and comfortable. Only thing I would say is that the entrance can be hard to find
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Nice Hotel
text:
Nice and clean rooms, good breakfast, very good Service and well located With metroline just 50 m away.
We enjoyed our stay very much.  Could  be we Meet Again. 
English was no problem at all.
Roomservice worked good.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: I LOVE this hotel!
text:
I booked 3 nights at Au Boeuf Couronné online after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor & the hotel turned out to be even better than I ever expected. My daughter & I had an amazing experience - we LOVE this hotel! The room was beautiful, spacious, super clean, had unique furnishings, a huge shower with lots of hot water & great water pressure, super comfortable beds, tons of lighting options, a refridgerator, awesome air conditioning that we could control ourselves with the digital wall panel which we desperately needed b/c it reached 100 degrees that weekend in Paris.
The staff were so friendly, effecient, helpful, polite, accomodating - I can’t say enough good things about them. They gladly brought us a bottle of ice when we came in after a long hot 100 degree day.
The breakfast - oh my gosh! - the breakfast was AMAZING! The flakiest croissants, super creamy yogurt, fresh fruit & fruit juices, ham, cheese, salmon, cereal, dried fruits & nuts, bread, jams, Nutella, honey & more. Delicious coffee, too. We left the table stuffed every morning so we never needed a sit down lunch during the day. The outdoor covered patio for breakfast was a delight.
There is a beautiful restaurant downstairs but we never had time to sit down & eat there.
The metro is so close that the entrance almost reaches the edge of the hotel - about 15 yards away. 
I will definitely stay here the next time we go back to Paris. Don’t hesitate - book this hotel now & you’ll be glad you did!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: We'll Be Back!
text:
Such a warm, inviting, hotel.  The staff were so professional and accommodating and could not do enough for us.  The rooms are clean, AC/showers worked well, and the spaces were quiet. Continental breakfast included omelettes, fresh croissants, etc. 
Directly across the street from the Paris Conservatoire, and 50 feet from subway entrance.  We'd gladly go back!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Amazing decor! good prices! lovely staff! next to metro
text:
The hotel is absolutely lovely!! The front desk, Carlo allowed me to check in a bit early. He greeted me by name each time he saw me. 

The room is so cute, great decor, good size & perfect for solo or a couple, as the toilet/showers are semi-private.

It is right in front of the Metro 5 orange line exit number 4. 10min metro ride from Gard du Nord. 20-30 mins from central. 

I will gladly stay here again! Good prices,
beautiful decor and lovely staff!!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Amazing
text: I stayed here with my other half, we didn't arrive until very late in the evening on the 16th of may , A very friendly gentleman checked us in and gave us a map of Paris to help us get around. advised us where the restaurant was so that we might have a glass of wine before bed. The hotel was clean and perfect for a few nights stay. I cannot wait to come back soon.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Lovely stay! Friendly staff and delicious food
text: We loved our stay. Staff was extremely friendly. and personable. Carlo( manager of the hotel) was extremely helpful. I would recommend to contact the hotel directly for rates as they are normally better yah. Expedia or bookings.com. Hotel is well located and the restaurant is superb. I would recommend their French Toast - beat one I’ve ever had!.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Nice stay in Paris
text: Hotel literally next to a metro station, so travelling around is facilitated. Nicely decorated, very clean rooms, with comfortable bed and excellent sound proofing. If you plan to visit the Philharmonie, the place is ideal, you just have to cross the street. Very friendly staff at the reception and breakfast is hearty. All in all highly recommended- I have already booked my next stay for April😊
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Finally back in Paris!
text: Great to finally start travelling again and having the chance to come back to Paris, even if only for business reasons and for a very short stay. As soon as I realized that I had to come, I immediately though of this property, as I stayed here a couple of years ago. Nothing has changed since then, same quality service, same staff's courtesy and empathy, same cleanliness than before. Totally recommanded.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Always at the top
text:
Good as usual, even after long months that I couldn’t come because of pandemic. 

Had an exquise slice of meat in room service, non extra charge compared to regular menu and all specialties available.

Same welcoming service, rooms still in a very good shape, everybody still very smiling and helpful. 

Keep on guys!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent stay
text: This hotel is situated at a perfect place to "do" Paris and his surroundings. It is clean and has nice employees. His restaurant is Michelin star worthy. The breakfast is certainly not only a croisant and some poor coffee. And the Metro is very close to it. In the neighborhood you find a lot of possibillitys to snack on a global matter or with fastfood.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent attention to customers needs
text: A boutique hotel well situated next to Parc Villette; stylish interior décor; room was comfortable with good amenities;  restaurant and terrace are  welcoming; the manager was very attentive to our needs and ensuring a comfortable stay,
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Travel dreams of returning
text: I miss traveling so much during this current COVID pandemic that I have resorted to  visiting some of my favorite hotels and restaurants online.  Sad.  However I am compelled to mention that Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel and Restaurant where we stayed in June 2019 is at the top of my list.  The room was lovely, clean and modern.  The included breakfast was very nice and the terrace location was quite pleasant.  But primarily we were so impressed by the service!  The front desk staff and manager were not just efficient, but genuinely caring.  They went out of their way to inquire if we needed anything and to assist or advise us.  At one point I tripped and slightly turned my ankle, and they were fussing over me like mother hens.  On this occasion I was with my partner, but on other occasions I have traveled solo or with a female friend, so I am always on the lookout for places that feel safe for women travelers.  This place definitely fits that criteria.  Although it is not in the center or the tourist area, the Metro line just literally across the street was very convenient for traveling to all of our destinations.  I also have to mention the excellent attached restaurant, where we ate several times and were very impressed.  It is a beautiful space with high quality food and proper service.  Hotel au Boeuf Couronne, I miss you and I will be back!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: A perfect Stay
text:
Despite COVID-19 situation, excellent welcome, property at the top, cosy and elegant property. a real shelter during this not easy Parisian stay, very professional assistance received by the staff.

See you soon in happier times.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great value for money
text: The hotel offers quiet rooms with a resolutely contemporary decor featuring wood, leather, marble, and earthenware to create a warm atmosphere. Breakfast is a generous continental buffet and there’s a 24-hour front desk. The staff is multilingual and extremely friendly and helpful.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great Stay
text: This hotel was a great stay. We arrived to Paris early in the morning . The staff was gracious enough and allowed us to check in early which was awesome because we were exhausted. Its literally across the street from the metro station. The rooms are a bit small but nonetheless for us it was a short trip so it wasn't a big deal. As others have stated the shower is basically in the room and the doors are transparent, which wasn't as issue. The staff was exceptional always greeting us and providing assistance when certain things were needed. Our last night we tried the adjoining restaurant and the food was good .
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Lovely stay for the money
text:
Fanatstic staff. So welcoming.
We stayed in a Superior room at the rear of the hotel.  There are some building works at the back but were not too bother some.  Room size was great for Paris with nice bed and superb shower.
Breakfast was very nice and plentiful.
make sure you pre book parking if required.
Would not hesitate to stay again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Obnoxious staff
text: I was sent to hell after complaining about the condition of the toilets. Very French situation and reaction. Otherwise, I am not in a position to have an opinion on the other amenities of the hotel. Please refer to other reviews.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Very good address in Paris 19th district
text: Au Boeuf Couronné is best known as a meat lovers' Paris favourite. But it is also a hotel and definitely a good option in an area of Paris lacking small-sized, comfortable and modern hotels. The location is very good, close to Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, the Paris Philarmonic Orchestra house, the Grande Halle de La Villette and with a subway station literally next door. The lobby has nothing impressive but rooms are nicely decorated mixing leather and wood elements with dark colour tiles in the bathroom. Room size is OK by Paris standard. Preferably ask for rooms looking over Avenue Jean Jaurès that are quiet and offer a better view. Very professional, welcoming and service-oriented reception staff. Breakfast could be an area of improvement as the room is relatively small and options limited (e.g. no yogurt, fresh fruits, ...). However, Au Boeuf Couronné is a very good address in this area of Paris and I have no hesitation to recommend it.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: A short break in Paris
text: This hotel has an excellent location -just yards from the Porte de Pantin Metro station. The room was relatively small but was comfortable and contained everything we needed. The view was not spectacular [ construction crane ] but we were out so much it was of little consequence. The breakfasts were excellent [ continental and ham and eggs on request ] and the staff were most helpful, particularly on the last day when the manager hailed a taxi for us to get back to the Gare du Nord when there was a Metro strike. We would certainly return.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent hotel and service by staff.
text: We booked a twin room for our 2 daughters to stay celebrating our youngest's 18th birthday and visiting a music festival.  The room was as in the picture, very clean and lots of facilities,  The staff were very attentive helping our daughter who had hurt her ankle getting ice etc to reduce swelling.  The breakfast was excellent and had very good selection.  Thank you.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: THESE GUYS ARE LIFESAVERS
text: Totally Great old style PARIS hotel close to the Gare du Noord train station. But the rooms have a really cool modern style to them and they have great window views. But more importantly the manager Carlo and the staff are really great people they help you solve your travel problems and really accommodate your needs. Everything from locking myself out of my hotel room safe to accidentally canceling my Barcelona reservations their staff really helped me on my trip. I will definitely make this hotel my go to first option when coming back to Paris.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great stay in a great room and staffed by lovely people
text: Thanks for having us! Our rooms (one for us and an adjoining room for our young daughters) were lovely; clean, well decorated and really comfy! We felt incredibly welcome and were really well looked after, we even stayed for dinner and the onglet and skate wing were both amazing. Lovely breakfast as well, hopefully we’ll come back to Paris, and when we do we’ll come and stay again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: High level
text:
These people are awesome, never experienced such welcoming staff.

A 3 stars property with 4 stars standards and 5 stars service.

Smiling people all around, a Manager present in property litterally night & day, exhanging with all the guests from breakfast 'til goodnight. 

Felt like home all the time.

Go on like this guys.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Good room and location, great bed, ok breakfast
text:
I stayed here for a conference at Cite des sciences et de l'industrie, and it was a great location for that with good access to transit and some restaurants. Not a very central location for sightseeing, but good for the business trip.

The room was small but clean, quiet, and well-maintained. The bed was very comfortable.

Breakfast was not a good value; 15EUR for pretty good pastries with Nespresso and unimpressive eggs. I ate there several times for sheer convenience, because many surrounding restaurants did not open early enough for breakfast before the conference.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Boutique experience
text: Almost every time I travel I book chain hotels (Hilton, Accor etc.) but during this trip I realized how much I am missing. Hotel Au Bœuf Couronné is a real experience! Check-in was smooth and receptionist welcomed me with a smile and some advises about the hotel and the neighborhood. The hotel is located in the old but refurbished building which gives a lot of charm to this place. Unfortunately the room was quite small but for my 2-night sightseeing stay it was very good. I loved the modern and thematic design of the room. Bathroom did not have the door so for a single traveler or couple it is fine but it might be tricky for friends / family – I would not necessarily want to see my friend taking shower naked. Breakfast selection was quite limited however all products were high quality – juice, cheese and pastry. I also liked good, strong coffee from the capsule machine. Overall for the price I paid for the room, given the design, location and the overall feeling of a boutique hotel I would definitely come back!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent location and good room
text:
The location of the hotel can't be better: Metro station Porte de Pantin it's just in front of the hotel.  Take exit 4.  The station is just 6 and 5 stations from Gare de l'est and Gare du Nord. Gare de Austerlitz is on the same line.

The area is safe and there are number of eateries and Carrefour is nearby.

Our room was large in Paris size.  It's design was good that you could put you bags under the long desk.

Room was clean and modern. The shower, sink,  and toilet were separated.  I liked that design but some people may not.  The door of the shower room was glass.   It may be inconvenient for friends.

Service is very good and helpful.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Very convenient location, clean and modern
text:
The location of the hotel is very very good, particularly if you will travel around by train.  It's just 6 and 5 stations from Gare de l'est and Gare du Nord.  Gare de Austerlitz is on the same line.  You need not to change for lines.  Sometimes you need to walk upstairs, downstairs and a long way to change line in Paris.  When you walked for a whole day, you will not want to walk so far!!
Sortie(exit) 4 of Metro station Porte de pantin of line 5 is just 10 steps in front of the hotel.  It's a few steps and no elevator.
The area is safe and there are number of restaurants of different kind of food and cafe around.  A Carrefour is nearby.
Our room was large, clean and modern in Paris size.  I had been to Paris for many times and it was the largest and newest room we  had.  The only reminder is: the shower room with window door.  So, it may be romantic for couple, but may be inconvenient for friends.

Service is very good.  Smiling and helpful.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: European Academy For Childhood Disabilities
text: Family oriented hotel with very pleasant staff. The staff are very accommodating and the service is prompt and good. There’s a metro station very close to the hotel and the disabled room is very spacious and thoughtfully set up. There’s the age old restaurant at the hotel and there are lots of different restaurants on either side of the hotel.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Pleasant Stay & Excellent Service
text:
Service is excellent all around. The manager is always around quickly addressing issues. A very friendly team that tries hard to please.

Rooms are modern,  spacious and have been decorated to a high standard. Despite my room being on a busy street overlooking Porte de Pantin metro station, there was no noise as they have triple sound proofing. Also they have wonderfully thick curtains with button snaps that keep the light out. 

The one problem is the  solid security doors that slam shut loudly and wake up anyone in the adjoining rooms. It's fine if you are getting up about 7:30 AM, but if you want to sleep in, that's another matter...:) Perhaps advising guests of this at check in and a sign reminding guests to hold the doors might help?

Also, note that the shower is see through and just off center from the bed so don't share the room with anyone you aren't intimate with.

WIFI free but very weak even at reception. 

Room very clean. I like the neighborhood too. It is not yet touristified. Lots of local color and many interesting Asian, Lebanese and French eateries nearby if you are not a carnivore intent on eating at the adjoining restaurant.  Steps from the Parc de la Vilette (currently hosting the King Tut exhibition) and a twenty minute walk to the Museum of Science and Industry.

I would happily stay here again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Very good
text: Lovely clean room, comfortable bed and delicious breakfast. Very caring helpful staff. Close to Parc de la Villette with its science museum, shopping centre and three concert venues including Le Zenith.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Très Chic ;-)
text: I stayed here with my daughter for 2 days. We were on the 5th floor, in a lovely quiet location, although we were on a fairly busy Paris street. Our breakfast was included in the rate and was a laid back affair served between 7-10am. All the usual continental breads and pain au chocolate, yogurt, muesli, cold meat, cheese, tomato, honey and jam and on request, any kind of egg, omelettes and egg and bacon. Friendly attitude and helpful staff. The beds were comfy, wall mounted TV and the place was spotless. Rooms didn't feel too small, ours was listed as Superior. Adjoining steakhouse served good food, but was a fairly specialist restaurant with not much else on the menu.. great if you wanted steak :-) Would definitely return, great hotel 💙❤
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: A weekend with George
text:
I booked tickets to see George Ezra as a Christmas present for my better half. Having tried all his UK concerts I found that £260/ticket was a trifle expensive. So I settled on a weekend in Paris in Springtime. I originally booked a single night via a bookings site then increased this by way of a phone call to the hotel itself. I had a couple of conversations with the 2 ladies (Maria and Matilde) who worked in reception. Both of whom were extremely helpful and pleasant and spoke excellent English as did the manager. After an exhausting trip due to the French airline strike we arrived to be greeted with the good news that our room been upgraded to a superior. This was gratefully received and on entering the room found it to be spacious and luxurious. 

We were facing onto the main road but both noise and light were kept out during the night by way of a excellent double glazing and the efficient black out curtains. Nor were we disturbed by the nearby Metro which meant the centre of Paris was only a short distance. 

We didn’t have dinner in the hotel restaurant although the prices seemed reasonable for a capital city, but did enjoy breakfast in both days which was both continental and a version of an English breakfast. 

I don’t believe George will  play The Zenith again as he will have moved onto to larger stadiums, however we will certainly return to the Boeuf Couronné hotel and will inform our friends and family of this excellent establishment.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Stylish and comfortable.
text: It’s hard to park so if you are with the car you have to find a spot to drop off your luggage and go to their parking which is about 300mt away and underground. Staff was friendly and room was very warm thanks to the independent heating.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Nice hotel, right next to metro, super nice staff
text: We spent 5 days in Paris. Before our trip made a reservation directly with hotel. All was perfect and exactly as we agreed. The hotel is clean and the rooms are functional. The only one thing is missing, the place to dry towels. The reality is the same as photos on the web. Metro station is directly in front of the hotel (Porte de Pantin, line 5). Super, thank you once again!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent choice and location for Philharmonie
text: We had a delightful experience on all counts. Our superior room was well decorated with quality furnishings, and very comfortable. Although street-side, we heard no noise, and slept peacefully. Its proximity to the dynamic La Villette complex, and in our case the Philharmonie, made this a very enjoyable experience. We finished off the evening in its restaurant with a very good meal and just had to go upstairs to our room - a great value! We will be back.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great small hotel
text: Clean, quite, comfortable with sleek and fun decoration. I only spent one night and had a good night sleep which I needed. The room has everything you need, has a nice modern design and is clean. The breakfast was very basic and lacked the charm. I would recommend better tea and coffee options and some healthy treats like fresh fruit and vegetables that would have made a huge difference in terms of experience while being a quite simple addition.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Beautifully decorated, great space. Amazing staff - so friendly! Excellent location.
text:
We had an awful experience with another hotel, and walked into Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel without a reservation needing accommodation for the same night. Mathilde on the desk was amazing - she was so friendly and welcoming, and really went out of her way to help us with somewhere to stay. After our terrible experience elsewhere, the Au Boeuf Couronne was just perfect.

The room (Super Double) was beautiful - really tasteful furnishings, wifi worked perfectly, and a long narrow table for working. Small fridge. It was a really welcome place to come back to at the end of a long day and to work from. Excellent location right by the metro stop.

Although very beautiful, the only thing to be aware of was that the shower is completely glass and see-through. For a twin room, this was an interesting experience for friends/colleagues travelling together!

Otherwise, all perfect.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great hotel, location and service
text: This hotel is 3 stations from Gare du Nord. The welcome was delightful and we were expected, super organised. The room was really lovely! Good shower, more than adequate space and a restaurant just next door. Metro station on the doorstep. Will definitely stay again!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Comfortable Room, Smart Design
text:
A little out of the way and from the center of Paris, but it was worth the distance to have a nice and comfortable room to return and relax after a long day of shopping, walking, and sightseeing.  

Staff was friendly and allowed me to check in early after a long overnight flight— much appreciated. 

I loved the room design, which is true to the website pictures. For a small space I found the room to be very functional, smart, and aesthetically pleasing. In my room the shower was open and visible to the bed, so if you’re sharing just be aware.  Bed mattress was firm, but Iike that as it’s good for my back.  Duvet and pillows very soft and fluffy, made it hard to get out of bed in the morning. 

I tried the restaurant next door.  The prefix menu for 35 euros was a good value.  Food was very good ... not outstanding, but for the price can’t be beat.  Should give it a try.

The surrounding area reminds me of the burbs, but there are enough restaurants, stores, and supermarkets in the immediate area that you won’t feel isolated.  I can image in nicer weather with the Parc de la Villette next door the area will be bustling. 

If you don’t mind being outside the center of Paris and/or have no problem using the metro, I strongly recommend staying here.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: For a short stay only.
text:
This hotel is suitable for 1 night only not for a longer stay. You give up a comfort for a cute design and decor. I had to keep my clothes in suitcases as there was no drawer/wardrobe in the room.  Sink is right in the room. It was clogged. Shower is in front of the bed separated only with a glass door- no privacy. Toilet is very tiny, may not be good for a very tall or a big person. Rooms are quite dark. Forget about make-up. Stay natural looking as you will not be able to put it on due to the bad lightening. Good soundproof. 
 
Overpriced, not worth the money that I have paid for it. Had to change a room as the window was facing a Pyramid roof that was blocking any view at all, and was charged for that. Receptionist pointed out that I should make reservation directly with the hotel rather than with agencies. 

Location is o.k. Subway is right in front of the door. Supermarket is around the corner.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Value and comfort
text:
This is a great choice both in value for money and comfort. I stayed three nights. There is a metro station about 30 meters away that takes you into the tourist centre in 15 minutes. 
Breakfast is good and you can order eggs in addition.
The hotel is on a fairly busy street but the sound proofing is excellent - I had excellent sleeps here.
Toiletries were excellent. There is a small refrigerator in the rooms.
Staff were always very helpful.
The rooms are smart and done in a modern but quite tasteful design. 
The associated restaurant is very good.
I would certainly stay here again with confidence.

 · A few additional english language TV stations would be welcome but a small matter.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent stay
text: Had a 3 night stay, out of the city, but so easy to get around due to the metro Porte de Pantin directly outside (exit 4), didn't take us long to find our way about.We stayed in the area on the advice of a french colleague, and also because the cost was somewhat cheaper. The hotel is very good, standard room somewhat larger than where we had previously stayed, very stylish and very clean, room quiet on top floor Furnishings are excellent, great size shower , only thing missing in a cheaper room is tea and coffee facilities, but no matter.We didn't have breakfast , just wanted to get out and about, had some great recommendations for places to go from both nice male managers on the desk, they were so nice to us, spoke excellent English and hospitable in every way. We dined in the restaurant on the last evening and it was also outstanding, delicious food,more than happy to recommend this hotel, great science park across the road, and also canal trip. Thanks for a lovely holiday !
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Lovely hotel - ideal location!
text:
We stayed at Hôtel Restaurant Au Boeuf Couronné for 2 nights in November and couldn’t have asked for more. The rooms are modern and decorated to a boutique hotel standard, the beds were very comfy and although the room is not huge it is perfect for a city break. The staff were also very friendly and helpful with their advice.  

The location was ideal for us – just 4 stops from Gare du Nord on the Metro to Porte de Pantin which is practically right outside the hotel door. There are a few supermarkets nearby, and we found a great restaurant called Café Jean just down the road. Connections to Disneyland via the train/metro were easy and our only travel issue was twice when leaving early in the morning we had to walk to Ourq to buy tickets as the machines were out of service at Porte de Pantin but this only added an extra 10 mins to our journey. 

Our one downside to the hotel was breakfast was not worth the additional €15 and I wouldn’t recommend eating there in the morning because of this.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Visit @Paris 17 tm 19 november 🌞
text: Paris ❤️ we had a pleasant stay @your hotel 👌🏻 Room & bed are comfortabel 😚 the breakfast service is TOP ! And the restaurant is 👌🏻 we made a reservation for a parkingplace and the service is suberbe, on the day we asked if we could left the car in the garage and that was no problemme 👍🏻 Price / quality / service and kindly People is OKAY 😊 we come back 4sure 😍
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Perfect boutique hotel
text: Very nice and cosy hotel, no downtown placed but very well managed. Staff is very helpful and caring, rooms have just what you need, even more, as in my case I have been upgraded thanks to my reservation made straight to the property's official website. Minibar and kettle only available in Superior Rooms, anyway good to find them as 3* hotels don't usually provide such services. Breakfast might be improved: quality is good, you can feel there's a real restaurant behind as they have one but service is slow, rather unconcerned, no eye contact meanwhile rarely present. Anyhow, totally suggested, excellent good for value.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Good hotel, issues with temperature controls and shower
text:
This is a nice hotel within a 2 minute walk of Parc de Villette. Great if you are going to a concert etc. It has parking off site,which is charged for, and there are cafes etc nearby. 
The rooms are well decorated and clean and the bathroom a good size. We did have issues, because of its design, with the shower soaking everything in the bathroom and making the floor very dangerous. 
Also our room was like an oven with a broken air conditioning unit. We had to open our windows meaning we had little sleep as the hotel is on the main road so it was very noisy. On leaving we were told by reception that they control the temperature which they had set at 25 degrees!  We hadn’t approached them the night before as we got in very late from our concert and reception was deserted and we could find no one to help. 
All in all if you want somewhere close to the concert halls this is a ok choice.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Well connected, cool and quirky rooms
text:
We loved our stay at the Boeuf Couronné; we didn’t spend much time in the hotel itself as we wanted to explore as much of Paris as possible but pretty much everything was spot on. The staff were incredibly welcoming and lovely - I’ve seen a few previous negative comments about the manager which were (from what we could see) completely unfounded. The room itself was gorgeous, not too dissimilar in style to the Hoxton in London. Very fresh and modern with a great shower and a comfortable bed. The hotel is only about 15 minutes away by metro from Gare Du Nord so super convenient and I think reasonably priced. 

I have one gripe and that is the breakfast set up - breakfast is served in restaurant which is stunning. Continental breakfast is pretty standard, comprises of cereals, yoghurts, bread (there is nothing ‘standard’ about French bread), eggs with bacon are cooked at your request which was truly delicious. The staff at breakfast seemed inefficient and not as attentive as the staff on reception. It felt as if they simply weren’t prepared to serve anyone, even though there were only a few people down at breakfast at the same time as us. This could do with some tightening up to make the rating a five, but we still thoroughly enjoyed our visit and would stay again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: C'est Magnifique
text:
I really liked this hotel, a lot. I loved the style/design of the public areas and the room was small but perfectly functional, very clean and had a great shower. An excellent continental breakfast was included in the price too.

The staff were very friendly and attentive, nothing was too much trouble and the location is ideal for those who like to be away from the centre and explore other areas of the city. The path along the canal is close to the hotel and is a lovely walk and we walked to the Seine and Notre Dame from the hotel. The metro is just outside the hotel for those preferring public transport and the street (avenue jean jaures) is lined with all manner of restaurants. However, you will be very well served by eating at the hotel in which you are staying. We ate here one evening and the food was superb, as was the service. We will definitely stay here again and recommend to others.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Paris in the Snow
text: Prior to arriving we were in communication with the manager Carlo, his responses we quick and informative. As it turned out we arrived very early and they were able to accommodate us. Check in was quick and gracious. The rooms in Europe are generally smaller than in North America however a lot of thought and details went into the appointment of the amenities and features in our room. We were facing the street which provided a quaint view , due to the insulation and double pained glass the room was very quiet and the blackout window treatments were wonderful. For a small fee a breakfast can be added to the room charge and I would highly recommend the purchase. The selection of food and beverage was excellent. The steak house that the hotel is above is definitely not to be missed. Neither of us spoke French and our server did not speak English. We were able to communicate what we wanted and had delightful service and fantastic food, her wine suggestion was delicious. We would not hesitate to stay again at this delightful property and will be sure to revisit the restaurant.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Enjoyable but ruined at the end due to hotel managers unprofessional behaviour
text:
Nice decor, quality materials used in the hotel, front of house staff friendly and helpful, Musa was particularly inviting as he checked us in and provided us with any information we needed.

Hotel manager was extremely unprofessional and rude. When we arrived we were given a double bed despite booking 2 twin beds, unfortunately that was the only room available in the hotel so we were forced to stay there for the first night. The hotel manager was very dismiss of the fact that this caused us great inconvenience and proceeded to argue with us at the front of house, regarding the discount that can be offered. The hotel manager ruined the whole experience right at the end of the trip, due to his unprofessional and defensive behaviour.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great
text: Truly amazing hotel on top of a restaurant. The staff is very courteous and helpful. The rooms are small, but very well decorated, very clean, and have a hipster vibe to them. If I had any complaints, it would be that there was a faint smell of mildew/mold in my room that concerned me. I wondered if it could’ve been in the vents or coming from the walls. The other complaint would be that the eggs at breakfast were probably the most greasy/oily I have ever had. I had the Omelete one day and the scrambled eggs another. The scrambled eggs were way too loose. Both could use an upgrade. Otherwise, A+!!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Biggest room ever in Paris
text:
We are quite often in Paris for a weekend but this hotel had the biggest room we ever had. It was a superior room what is I guess the "standard room" . On the fire escape plan we saw there are smaller rooms so we just had luck :)
Remember that the shower is middle in the room so you should be Couple or have no problem with it. 
Breakfast was very nice with fresh ingredients. Order some egg dishes!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent hotel - all you need
text:
Recently spent four nights here whilst taking a break in Paris.Excellent rooms with all you need including super-comfy beds,good power showers,modern flat screen tvs and most important strong air conditioning to cope with the 34c Paris summer.
Front of house staff very helpful and knowledgeable too.Ample breakfast for all tastes.
Great all round and only one minute's walk to the Metro nearby.Nice area with all facilities.Only a 15 euro / 15 min taxi ride to Gard du Nord too - thanks to front of house guys' advice,we avoided the Metro crush on our way back for the Eurostar at very little cost
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: sacred all night
text: I stayed (traveling alone for business)  in that hotel in April 2018 and I felt totally unsafe late at night when the “gardien de nuit” knocked at my door (last floor) at 0:30 am (after I had checked in 15 minutes earlier and ready to bed ) with the pretext he had assigned me the wrong room (as I refused to open my door) ... he had told me the hotel was pretty empty that night ...  I wonder what they put me on last floor and why he knocked so late at my door while normally the staff would call on the phone...not professional and I was scared he would open the door during my sleep ! I'll never go there again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Good location, modern furnishings
text: This hotel was really close to the metro station to get into the centre of Paris. The hotel was very modern in terms of its decoration. We must thank Michael who was a consummate professional in all our interactions with him. He was helpful, knowledgeable, friendly and really understood the meaning of customer service. If you choose to stay at this hotel, I would suggest you seek out Michael. I cannot sing his praises more highly.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: I had a great stay
text: Great little boutique hotel located in an entertainment precinct. My room was newly renovated, very comfortable & thus i had a very enjoyable stay. The front desk staff were extremely helpful. Thanks Michael & Rafael! I will definitely stay there again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice little hotel. Rooms look fantastic well rennovated and comfy, also mine was very quiet which is rare for Paris. Hotel Staff friendly, excellent breakfast. All in all i can strongly recommend this property. The attached restaurant is also quite good
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Small quadruple rooms but very acceptable
text:
The family room (two rooms joined 302/303 by a door) was small and without a separate bathroom as such. But this was exactly as indicated on the website, and the quality of the furnishings is very good. The rooms were on the back, so very quiet! The layout of the hotels show many other rooms that are larger, so if you want to pay more, you will find what you need. The breakfast was as expected: continental and delicious. We were offered eggs (omelettes, fried etc) and the omelettes were great. Friendly staff who spoke good English. All in all a lovely stay.
As for location, it is just within the Peripherique. Some will find this a long way from the centre, but the metro stop is just outside the door, so getting to the attractions of Paris is simple, even if it might take longer than you had hoped.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: A Birthday Weekend Getaway
text:
When you arrive at this hotel, it seems well presented and of a good standard. The member of staff at the front desk greeted us and was very helpful and attentive. Our room was clean and tidy. However, although the decor was fitting with the theme of the hotel, the design was favoured over the functionality. 

The Bedroom

The design of the room looked inviting, but as a large room it was left quite empty. As such, this made the room echo quite a lot which you could also hear from rooms either side. 
The bed was a double, which was smaller than we are used to but adequate. It was slightly too hard for us and we struggled to sleep well though the night though. However that’s our personal preference. 

The air conditioning worked well, so we were very comfortable in the room. 

For the storage, there was only a rail in a copper pipe design, which had approximately 6 hangers on it. There was no wardrobe or additional hooks to hang coats etc on the walls, so everything had to be either draped over the pipe or hung over the hangers twice. 

There were tea/coffee making facilities, a shelf/desk and lovely big windows letting lots of light in. Strangely, there was no bin inside the room, so we had to find a plastic bag to make do. 

The Bathroom 

The bathroom was very large which was clean and designed really well but It was another large room with not a lot in it, which echoed every sound!
As a wet room (no bath) it didn’t work as expected. After a shower, the room would be flooded and we would need to spend time sweeping water with the shower mat to the drain as the floor was unsafe to walk on. After leaving it for the day (thinking to might drain by then), it was still flooded. The functionality of the shower drainage was not fit for use which is a shame as shower itself was great! 

The Breakfast

I have more of a biased opinion of the breakfast due to our experience. My partner had booked through a third party website which had an technical issue. When he chose the option for bed and breakfast for two people, the website only created a booking for 2 people staying, but only one person having breakfast. 

The staff (another member of staff)on the front desk highlighted this to us as it was stated on the booking and started to reassure us that they were already aware and this was a technical issue from the website. However, they then expected us to still pay an additional €15.99 per day for the other person to have breakfast there. For me, this created a slight grievance. 
On the first morning, we decided to go to breakfast and talk to the staff about the options available for breakfast. When we asked if they catered for gluten intolerance (for me) the staff at reception said they didn’t and to only eat the things that were not gluten and when he asked the waitress (in French), she responded in a abrupt fashion of “no!”, stared at us, huffed and then walked away. The receptionist then told us we should have told them before we’d arrived, but there was no indication to do so. I don’t expect everyone to cater for this dietary requirement but I didn’t appreciate the response. I felt very unwelcome.

This upset me and left me feeling so embarrassed in front of other guests that I went straight back up to my room without eating. My partner scouted the breakfast on offer and told me the choices. As a continental breakfast it seemed adequate, but not worth the price they were charging. Therefore I went round the corner to the local shop and stocked up on what I needed. After that, my partner ate alone downstairs and I ate up in the room. Sadly, at a point where the hotel could have redeemed themselves, they simply made it worse.  

Based on our experience, I didn’t feel 100% comfortable at the hotel. Overall there were good points and bad points and some based on circumstance. 

I am sure there are many guests who felt they had an enjoyable stay, but sadly we didn’t feel the same.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Boutique style rooms offering excellent accomadation
text: Stayed here for 3 nights with my wife in April and we couldn't have been happier with all aspects of the hotel.Excellent customer service from all the Reception staff,Our room (407) was comfy,stylishly decorated and well proportioned .Great wet room bathroom .The breakfast included in our price was  great value with plentiful choices on offer.Its location enabled us to walk to all central Paris attractions but Metro options were easily accessible if required.Thanks again to all who made our visit to Paris so memorable.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: 2 days conferences in Paris 19e
text: A nice discovery in the area of La Villette and Zenith de Paris. The hotel rooms are brand new and the decoration and comfort are just great! We were on the first floor and spent 2 nights in this cosy place. We found the hotel far MORE better than the Mercure located 200 m after. The bed was comfortable as well as the bathroom with amenities and air dryer. A safe and a kettle with tea / coffee are also there and welcome. They also have a great restaurant with fabulous meat. If I have another conference or concert in this area I will definitely come back!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: While the place is very nice, the service needs improvement
text: We stayed at the hotel for several days. The room was nice, comfortable and clean. During our stay we ran into series of small disturbing things. The small things that need to be refilled ( shower gel, tea, milk...) we're not provided consistently. On departure, my wife was asked to pay an additionawe payment even though we paid everything on the night before. There is some room for improvement
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent hotel, comfy beds and good location
text:
We stayed at the hotel to attend a concert. We arrived late due to delays but were welcomed and quickly checked in. The bed was very comfy. We would have preferred a larger bed but that's just our preference. 
The rooms have a shower and bath and desk area with TV and a little cupboard. The toilet is in a separate little room. The decor of the hotel is beautifully done. 
There is no fridge or coffee/tea facilities but this didn't bother us. We didn't have the breakfast so cannot comment on that.
Considering it's on a fairly busy road the noise outside did not disturb us. There are several places to eat nearby.
We found it to be very reasonable cost for our stay and will no doubt return if we are back in Paris.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Superb
text:
Excellent in every way
Staff amazing and very helpful 
Yummy breakfast
Great location for metro 
Lovely rooms very modern and comfortable 
Incredible value 
Fabulous restaurant with great value club menu - highly recommended
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Fair enough
text: Stayed here and the hotel is fine and new. The only thing which could be much better was the breakfast which is really very very very small. The salami isn't whether peeled not cutted, which was cutted the days before. The eggs, where u can only choose between fried eggs and Omelette was burned below and not finished on the top. There was only only one waitress which is way to less to refill the buffet and serve the clients. Breakfast finishes at 1000 what is also too early when u r on holidays. Last but not least u can see the other staff preparing the main restaurant in private clothes as training uniforms and open shoes but they don't get the idea to help their colleague. Last but not least the waitress is leaving on time (1030) and if u r sitting there finishing your breakfast expect dirty tables all around u. U can feel that the manager is trying to save money at the staff which is reflected in poor service. Expect waiting time during peek hours at breakfast. If u r not keen on breakfast it's alright.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Just amazing!
text: The team is very service-orientated and super friendly. Englisch, German or French - all languages are spoken. The accommodation itself is very stylish and the interior and accessories are well chosen and represent a lovely little boutique hotel. We booked a classic room which was located on the first floor. We were a little unsure if with the street in front it would be too noisy but it wasn't at all. The windows are perfectly soundproof. The room was so cosy and nice - yes small - but so inviting and clean and the price-value was outstanding. German TV and a coffee/tea maker would be nice to have. It is only available in the superior rooms. As we booked a parking lot we were happy to park our car only 20 meters away in a secured car park.Breakfast was absolutely ok and for our short city trip we got everything we needed in a fresh and appealing quality. The restaurant was quite pricey but the quality and atmosphere were very nice. Try the cheese plater - we loved it. So we will definitely come back and are happy to have found this little jewel in the peripherique of Paris but with great possibilities to discover the whole city.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Perfect accommodation for Zénith music venue
text: This hotel is 2 mins from Porte de Pantin metro station and a short walk to the Zénith music venue so ideal for gigs. Our room was small but funky and immaculately clean. Small but comfy bed. No tea or coffee making facilities. Service was very polite and friendly, especially the concierge that we met on arrival. We attempted to speak French out of courtesy, but the standard of the staff’s English was fabulous so we quickly stopped being embarrassing and gave up! The hotel has a restaurant specializing in beef and the steak we had was pricey but brilliant. Really good. No bar in the hotel but you could sit in the restaurant and order drinks there. Breakfast was buffet style and largely self service. It was a bit like an initiative test working out how to work the coffee machine in the absence of any waiting staff. You could order hot food but no one came so that wasn’t really an option. Good coffee, lovely yoghurt, usual continental selection. Would thoroughly recommend.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Cracking little place
text:
6 months old hotel above a famous 150 year old restaurant. reception staff were very friendly, spoke great English, and were happy to talk about the hotel, its history and the local history. everything in the hotel is bespoke apparently so the design is quite unique. the rooms are small as per most of paris. my room faced the street and was really well soundproofed. yes, I heard a police siren at 2am, but you'd hear that from any rom in the city. air con worked although i couldn't switch it to cool (I like to cool the room down before switching the AC off, even in winter). shower had good pressure and i had two sets of towels even though i was travelling solo (hate it when you only get one a la all german hotels, for example). my only gripes are: the safe is only big enough to get you passport and phone in (not a lappy or iPad, for example), the bed was very firm - too firm for me, and you don't get a free bottle of water (there's a small bottle in the mini-bar which you are charged for). The wifi worked very well and is, I believe, free. 
Breakfast is continental, and due to its proximity to the restaurant that it's attached to, everything was fresh. OK, it's a little limited, but there is an A La Carte option if you like eggs, and whilst the coffee machine was a bit tricky to use, it made a decent espresso.
Would definitely stay again, but really would like a mattress topper to make it much more comfy.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Comfortable and fresh
text: A fresh room that looked recently refurbished. Clean and practically furnished. A bit of a surprise to see the shower cabinet and sink in the same room as the bed, but it was no drawback. Comfortable bed. Excellent breakfast. Will try the restaurant as well if I get to stay again. Very polite staff with excellent English. The Au Bouef Corroné is situated very close to the exhibition arena La Grande Halle, as well as the Paris Philharmonic and a very nice adjacent park. The nearest Metro stop is literally just outside, so this is a great place to stay to enjoy any piece of Paris.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Best kept secret hotel in Paris
text:
Au Boeuf Couronné is already famous for its belle epoque restaurant, the oldest steak house in Paris. It now has a fabulous hotel which is contemporary but with a nod to its beefy connection. The rooms have leather accessories and there’s even a leather studded entrance hall. I am amazed this place is classified 3 star, I’ve stayed in higher starred hotels that were nowhere near as good as this. The rooms are big, the bathrooms are fabulous, and the WiFi is speedy. It’s quiet and comfy and welcoming and less than a minutes’ walk to Port de Pantin metro (line 5) stop.

It’s a bit of a steal as it’s not expensive at all, though it looks like it ought to be. Location-wise, it’s terrific and it’s easy to get into the centre of Paris taking just 15 mins to Bastille from the Metro outside the front door. Its close to the Cité des Sciences, Zenith music venue, Philharmonie de Paris, La Villette and loads of other major monuments and sites. At just 5 minutes from Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est by metro - I'll definitely be staying here again.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Fabulous new boutique hotel
text: The strikingly well designed interior of this new hotel is just one of the many reasons we wanted to extend our stay. The lovely breakfast is another. With friendly staff and good connections (just outside Porte de Pantin métro) it’s definitely a place to come back to. Highly recommended!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Funky rooms, nice location
text:
Very nice hotel. Looks like it was newly done up. The interiors are refreshingly different. It is located literally within 2 minutes from the train station (take exit 4 from the train station). The bed is incredibly comfortable. The lights are quite uniquely done up and they aren't your regular run-of-the-mill lighting found in most hotels. A lot of spirit and character for a new hotel. Also, the toilet and the shower area are separated, so it saves some time while you're getting ready. 

The only reason I'm not giving it 5-stars is because we got a room on the first floor, and it was incredibly noisy. Keep in mind there's a restaurant on the ground floor and when you've had a long day and want to crash in your bed, you won't be able to, because the restaurant starts to wind down and you can hear furniture being moved about. Quite frustrating. What made it worse for us was that our room was facing the traffic and the window wouldn't fully shut, so it got really noisy. By the time we managed to sleep, it was close to 3-4 AM. The hotel couldn't do much because they were packed. A bit frustrating, especially because they couldn't fix the window that didn't shut.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Good size room with very comfortable bed
text:
I love the room and the bed (and pillow) as comfort as at home. Accessible, close to the metro, and many good restaurants.
Just unfortunate, it was rainy days and we were staying only for a couple of nights.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: nice little boutique hotel
text: we stayed there during  a 3 day trip in Paris and it was great.Loved the room decor especially though a bit on the smaller side.Staff were very helpful especially irfin and michael who helped with recommendations, helpful tips on our way to Disney and transportation.Also had dinner at the restaurant which was good.Great beef  and steak.would definitely recommend and return there.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Great stay  - a real gem
text: Beautifully designed, newly refurbished hotel. Very welcoming and helpful staff and director. Much better compared to most Parisian hotels, the room was large, comfortable, good quality bedding, minibar prices not excessive, bathroom well designed, separate toilet, lovely toiletries, tea/coffee in room, no noise from inside or outside hotel. Breakfast delicious with a lot of  choice, eggs cooked to order and typical French cheeses pate & saucisson. Restaurant very good too! Well done !
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent!
text:
Immaculate, well designed rooms.
The separate bedroom within our room for our son was great as it gave us extra space! 
Porte de Pantin station is just outside so you can be in the middle of Paris in 15mins. The car park over the road and lots of cafes just minutes away. Beautiful restaurant downstairs. Friendly staff. Recommend!
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Amazing Staff!
text:
When I was in Paris last week, I attended an event in the large park across from the hotel. 

After looking for a taxi for nearly 40 minutes, tired and frustrated, I walked into the hotel to see if they could help me. The front desk staff was LOVELY .. they called me a taxi, offered me something to drink and made sure I could connect to the wi-fi if I wanted to while I was waiting. 

I just wanted to say THANK YOU, again. Honestly, I wasn’t sure how I would have been able to get back to my hotel without your help.

All I can say is, if that’s how they treat a random person walking in from the street..I can only imagine the exceptional service they give their guests.
name: Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel

title: Excellent on all levels!
text:
We had a wonderful nine night stay at the Hotel Malte. Everything was exceptional and we only have good things to say about all aspects. This is the perfect hotel for couples who want a quiet oasis right in the middle of the city. I was astonished by how quiet the rooms were; I never heard a sound from anyone above, below or beside us. Our room was on the 5th floor and had two nice windows that opened up facing the National Library which made it even more quiet. 

You can’t get a better location. It’s a 10-15 minute direct walk south to the Louvre, so we walked through there almost every day at some point. All the top attractions are no more than a 30-45 min walk away. We didn’t use the Metro but I believe there are several nearby stations. The neighborhood is very safe and lined with shops and restaurants, many of which seem to be very popular with locals.

The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The breakfast buffet is a wide array of French pastries, juices, and hot items which rotated every day - waffles, crepes, eggs, sausages, etc. It was a huge benefit to have a hearty breakfast before a long day of walking and nice to not have to search for a breakfast place in the city.

Overall this is the perfect hotel for couples who want a beautiful spot to come home to after a busy day exploring Paris. This hotel offers a level of quiet, comfort, and friendliness that beat all the rest. When we return to Paris we will be staying at Hotel Malte-Astotel. Thank you to the amazing staff!

title: Quiet, cozy, inviting hotel in the perfect location
text:
There's so many great things to say about this hotel. The breakfast/snack area and lounge are so cute and inviting. I really enjoyed having breakfast each morning. There's great options and it's worth the price for both quality and convenience (15 euros). I eat a vegan and gluten free diet, so my options were more limited. The kitchen staff did help me find a few things (oatmeal, granola, cereal, gluten free bread, jams and peanut butter, soy milk, fruit, nuts). I'd like to see potatoes added to the line up.  

We stayed in a superior twin room. The beds are right next to each other, but at least we had our own bedding (I traveled with my mom). There's plenty of room for suitcases (we had two large and one small suitcase) and there's a small closet to hang some clothes and jackets. There was a tub with a shower in our room. The room is very clean, looks new and is cozy. We asked for a quiet room and it was very quiet. We couldn't hear other guests except if people were talking in the hallway. 

The hotel staff are very nice and helpful. When I became sick during the trip, I knew the staff would be able to help me find an urgent care facility. I'm so grateful to them for their help. 

Location is excellent. 10 min walk to the Louvre. The opera house (which was one of my favorite buildings) is a 10 min walk away. The area around the opera house is very nice...lots of shops and cafes. Also next to the hotel are lots of Asian restaurants which came in handy since I eat a vegan and gluten free diet. I went to a sushi restaurant twice and it was excellent. Place Venome is a beautiful square that is a few minutes walk away. 20 min walk to an excellent vegan restaurant called Le Potager de Charlotte. I highly recommend it. We went there twice. 

This is the best hotel I've stayed at ever. I can't wait to go back.

title: Well Located, High -End ‘College Dormitory’
text:
Great location a few blocks from restaurants, Louve, Opera House, etc, it’s on a narrow street facing a very long blank back wall of a government building.

The hotel itself has the look and feel of a high-end college dorm. Very basic, colorful, functional and utilitarian. 

The common areas are fairly sterile French contemporary with too many mirrors, busy wallpaper and institutional tables and chairs clustered on one side of the lonby in a breakfast room area.

The building is locked at night, with no bellman or card-key access. You have to ring the bell at the front desk (if he’s there) and wait for him to let you in. It’s the only hotel I’ve ever been to like this. Sort of what you expect at a jewelry store, but not a hotel. 

The daytime front desk staff are great! Best thing about this hotel. Friendly, helpful and knew the local restaurants really well.

At night, however, the front desk is only staffed by one person with authority limited to basic check-in and access. Like you’d expect at a college dorm.

The rooms are quiet, clean, utilitarian and very, very small. Barely enough room to get around the bed. The decor is black, white and grey. The bed was firm and the windows open. The bathroom had new fixtures and a bath/shower combo with good water pressure. Instead of furniture and closets, it has two small open shelves and an exposed hanger. Again, like a nice dorm room. All in all, I found it a bit depressing. 

A fairly drab, buffet style breakfast is included in the room charge. They will provide american-style coffee on request. Otherwise the coffee comes from a machine.

Given the location, it’s probably a very fairly-priced hotel for Paris these days.

However, if you’re used to American high-end hotels, then this isn’t your hotel, but do expect to pay two to three times more than this hotel charges.

title: Trust the 5-star Reviews
text:
This place: the hotel, the rooms, the staff, the location, the prices....all top notch. I've already thought, if/when I get back to Paris, I'll likely stay here....

Paris is very expensive. This hotel does not skimp on quality, but the price was definitely one of the lowest I saw, short of a hostel or other undesired accommodation.

I started a review that I apparently lost.
The staff are very friendly and helpful.
There is a safe parking garage about 3-4 blocks away at The Bourse. It would be wise to book in advance for discounts. You can download a parking app to do it all electronically. I wish I knew that in advance.

There are a lot of useful establishments nearby (a carrefour (grocery store), a laundromat, a pharmacy as well as restaurants and a quick walk to the Palais Royal area with the Louvre, etc. I believe the Eiffel Tower is about a 45 minute walk along The Seine with it's views and lower level where folks exercise, have dance instructions at night, etc.)

I could spend a month in Paris exploring more that it has to offer, but alas I just had 5-1/2 days.

Enjoy!

title: Great experience overall
text:
My husband and I recently stayed at this hotel during our week in Paris and are very pleased with it. The staff were extremely helpful and accommodating. We had a "privilege room", which was quite spacious for 2 people and even had a designated dressing area/alcove and fridge. The drinks in the fridge were complimentary and replaced every day. Our room was cleaned well every day. We used their laundry service, which we were happy with and was reasonably priced. And even though they told us laundry given in the morning is usually returned the following day, our laundry (cleaned, pressed, and folded) was returned to us that afternoon on the same day. We were very impressed!

It rained occasionally during our trip (first week of September), and the hotel has plenty of umbrellas you can borrow. We took advantage of the buffet breakfasts in the lobby most mornings we were there, which were delicious! We stayed a week and there was enough variety that we didn't get tired of their breakfast options.

Our favorite part of the hotel was the free drinks (including a machine that makes most essential coffee beverages) and snacks (chips, nuts, breads, and pastries) that were available in the lobby all day. Our vacation involved a lot of walking, museums, sightseeing, etc. And it was such a welcome relief to take breaks at the hotel to relax, refuel and rehydrate, before going back out to see more! And the hotel is conveniently located that we could easily come back to it between stops on our daily itinerary. And another bonus is that there are multiple Astotel hotels all over Paris (17 locations I believe?), which we had access to if we wanted to use their restrooms, sit and rest, drinks/snacks in the lobby, etc. Which again, we found very helpful.

The only constructive criticism is that we found the sheets on our bed to be a little coarse. On a scale of 1 to 10, with 1 being the texture of sandpaper and 10 being very nice and soft bamboo sheets, we'd say the sheets on our bed were a 5 or 6. We didn't think it was that big a deal and didn't ask for them to be replaced. But it felt rough enough that we noticed it. 

Thank you for the wonderful stay at Hotel Malte Astotel. We highly recommend this hotel, and will definitely choose it again the next time we're in Paris.

Very average

Breakfast is totally ok. I was shocked that coffee is from a machine-it’s undrinkable! Like come on…this is Paris! A hotel in Europe and coffee from a machine?? 
We ended up having to leave the hotel each morning to do a coffee run. 
Staff are very friendly. 
I booked this place because it was #1 on Tripadvisor. 
If this is the best place in Paris…I hate to think  what the others are like.

name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Still great staff but basics are now slipping.
text: I have been in this hotel for the last five years. The ambiance is well-designed for the 25-40 well-heeled bunch (In French, les bobos). I am outside that range, but I enjoy the atmosphere and the staff. During this visit, I noticed that the hotel basics are no longer in place: during a 14-day stay, not a single day with a complete set of towels, a significant drop in WiFi speed (a few times below 1 MBps morning and evening time), and a feeble and rickety A/C (the outside temperature was 40C certain days, becoming the rule in summer Paris). I hope Mama will address the issues with urgency. A bobo twist is fun, but only if it colors a robust professional foundation in hospitality. A final note of warning: on F/S/S, the rooms closer to the main street are noisy due to the presence of a loud bar/concert venue opposite the hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Dirty and kinky
text: We booked this hotel because it was one of the cheapest options in Paris, but we should have spent a bit more money to get a decent hotel. Our room was not well cleaned, there was a small smear of feces on the toilet seat and the carpeted floor had numerous large stains, as well as many smudges on one of the mirrors (presumably left by previous guests). We also were confused and uncomfortable by the kinky undertones present throughout the hotel and in the room, as it was not promoted by the hotel nor mentioned in the reviews I read. Minor but worth mentionning, there was no kettle in the room and there were two hooks inserted in the wall beside each bedpost, presumably playing into the "kinky" undertones. Would definitely not recommend this hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Poor Service and Poor Room Design
text:
I stayed at the hotel for 5 nights. Each night I was provided a different number of hand towels. The hotel provides you one tiny bar of soap per day, which you are supposed to use on your face, body, and hair (SEE PICTURE). On my second to last morning, I was using the toilet and leaned against the wall with my hand, which caused the wall in the bathroom to collapse, and it was not repaired by the end of my stay (SEE PICTURE). Further, it was never even mentioned to me after I had spoken to the front desk about it.

As other reviews have stated, the lighting in the hotel room was terrible. To even have a chance of seeing things properly in your room, you have to turn all of the lights, which requires you flip no less than 6 separate switches located in different parts of the room. Also as other reviewers have stated, the climate control in the room does not work well. Further, the shelf in the hotel room for suitcases was too small to accommodate my suitcase, and most normal, non-carry-on size suitcases. The drapes in the room are also poorly designed in that they let in some light where the window meets the wall.

One morning as I just exited the hotel, I spat down a sewer grate near the front door and thought nothing of it. Well, apparently, one of the front desk associates or managers (who was heavily tattooed and had a mustache) saw what I had done and in a fit of rage, went off on me (yelling), and told me no less than 5 times in a row what a rude, horrible, disrespectful person I am. Whether what I did could be considered offensive or not, I thought it was extremely inappropriate for a hotel employee to be treating a guest that way. Admittedly, I maybe could have shown better judgment, but it was handled extremely poorly by that employee.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Dark, unsustainable, bad service
text:
Let's start with the positive things: the staff is generally friendly and we liked the neighborhood off the beaten track.
But: I cannot remember the last time I stayed in a hotel where you had to fight in order to prevent them from giving you new towels every day. By default, you should only get new towels  if you throw them on the floor. Here you get new ones unless you discover that special sign that you need to hang up for the staff to see. Also very unusual not to have the electricity in the room linked to the room key. Instead you have to switch off all lights when you leave. One day, when we came back, the cleaner had obviously switched on the light and left it on the whole day. Again, not sustainable.
Also: making everything very dark might be stylish but it means artificial lights everywhere, day and night. Reminds me of an Abercrombie & Fitch store in the early 2000s. Finally, the rooms are far too hot! and there is no way you can influence that. You cannot open the windows either. They say it's because now (in April) the 'system' is still in 'winter mode' and cannot be adjusted to 'summer mode'. So, even when temperatures outside are high, the building is heated as if it was winter outside. maybe time to adapt to the reality of climate change? Anyway: not my favorite place. Sorry for the staff, they try their best (except for the one day when they forgot to clean our room at all).
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Hidden Gem
text:
What a hidden gem of a place. Me and my wife walked from the local metro to the restaurant, my advice would be to not be put off by the surroundings and if you're not careful you'll miss it, but once inside you won't be surprised.

Really nice vibe playing some soul classics, friendly bar staff and the food was outstanding too. Would highly recommend for those of you looking to experience something different in Paris
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Very nice design hotel but in need of some upgrading and TLC
text: Over the years we have stayed in this hotel several times and it is a good place for the beds, the short drive to the highway, the parking with EV charging but it is losing its edge. Where in the beginning the concept was unique it is no longer one-of-kind and you get annoyed by the lack of lighting in the rooms, the roof-top not being open, the Airco only heating and the decor fading. Nice masks on the lights but they have been there for several year now. Nice chalk drawing on the ceiling of the ground floor but it is not fresh any more. Great tapestry of the reception wall but is loosing color. The food is good, staff is more than friendly but it is not longer the place for design “pilgrims”.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Not my cup of tea
text:
Dark, so very, very dark. Black walls, black light switches, black electrical sockets, very poor lighting.  I had to use the torch on my phone to find the light switches and the electrical sockets.  I even had to use the torch on my phone to find my black handbag on the black floor in the dark room one evening.  
Small room almost entirely filled by the bed and a ginormous television. No desk space, and just a cheap plastic chair squeezed in at the table with the ginormous tv.
Basic and ageing bathroom.
On the plus side there was a microwave and a fridge, but nothing to make use of them - no cutlery, no cups or glasses, no tea or coffee.
Personally I found the bed too hot.  Fluffy mattress cover and big fluffy duvet combined with a hot room made the whole thing feel suffocating. 
Food in the restaurant tasted good but the service was incredibly slow, even though I got there early before it got busy.
All in all not to my taste.  Lighting and fresh air are more my cup of tea.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Weird vibes but comfortable and with a great restaurant
text:
Stayed for a few days on business. The hotel has a very sexy vibe which felt a bit odd for a business travel, but past that, the rooms were very comfortable, with decent wifi and particularly a great hotel bar/restaurant. While the food service was slow to come, the food itself at the restaurant was very good, so were the drinks.

This isn't a family hotel for sure, besides that it's pretty good !
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Good stay but loud music
text:
The hotel was conveniently situated for visiting friends and it’s a really cool hotel. 
The room was spotless and the bed really comfortable. The  breakfast was also great. 
The only downside was the room I had in the second floor had bad sound insulation. The music was banging loud until 1:30 and then the scraping of chairs, putting them back in to place went on until 2:00 in the morning. This wouldn’t put me off from booking again but I’d ask for a quieter room
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Nowhere to plug in your electronics!
text: I stayed in a suite with a balcony, so a "nice" room. I had a rather long Zoom call during my stay and I was shocked to see that there is NOWHERE to plug in anything extra except the bathroom. There's a desk but no outlet (unless you unplug the light). No outlets close to the bed to plug in your phone. I had to move the heavy couch and dig around for an outlet (I found an extension cord finally) and set myself up awkwardly on the couch for my meeting. That's a HUGE oversight or omission on the part of the property IMHO. I won't stay here again.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great vibe, good location & small rooms
text:
We had such a great time staying in this hotel, that we went for a second time. The interior is super creative and en outages you to explore and find out all the details. Staff was knowledgeable and friendly, as you may expect from a hotel like this. 

Rooms were a tad small, nothing too bad but do keep this in mind when you need a bit more space for your suitcase, for example. 

Will definitely try again, but will go and book their new hotel in the west side of Paris!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Dark, very dark!
text:
Firstly, don’t be put off my review if you’re a 20 something hipster with a beard and doesn’t enjoy sunlight and talking!

This hotel deserves 5* alone for service and high quality rooms and restaurant!

I had a gorgeous room with black walls and high quality fixtures and fittings.  Beautiful rainforest shower & fluffy towels!  But despite the many lights, it’s just dark and apparently‘ atmospheric’! 

They don’t do any form of rooms service and after an exhausting day of meetings, I didn’t want to eat in a restaurant that is dark and atmospheric and not knowing what I was eating because of the light!

I had to track to the restaurant for food and drink because there was also no tea or coffee facilities, despite there being a beautiful area in room to house one, alone with a little fridge!

This hotel is gorgeous, it’s cool hip and trendy.  The food, despite not being able to see it very well was beautiful and tasty, served by wonderful and thoughtful staff!  They couldn’t do enough!

The staff are getting zero natural light and they should be given vitamin D, because I asked one of them what it was like working with no natural light, and they said they felt permanently exhausted!  This really concerns me, because I travel a lot for work and their staff are 5* and nothing was too much trouble!

This isn’t a bad review, it’s a ‘not my kind of place’ review!  So 3* from me, 5* if your younger than me (40 something!) xx
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama’s not so welcome in Paris...
text:
After three great stays in Mama Shelters Lyon and Bordeaux we recently found ourselves needing a bed for the night in eastern Paris and were delighted to find a Mama Shelter. We’ve loved the slightly kooky styling, nice clean rooms and great locations of the other hotels so it was a no-brainer to book in.

We arrived late after a 6 hour drive and wanted a drink & something to eat before we went to bed. The bar/restaurant was busy but not full when we arrived but we were told it was a 1.5hr wait for a table. We hadn’t been offered a table at check-in or suggested we reserve one in advance so we were quite disappointed. The maitre d’ was unhelpful & unfriendly, I felt we didn’t ‘look right’ to get a table.
