Usually good hotels keep a couple of tables free for their hotel guests, apparently not here. Fortunately, we found a lovely little bistro (Le Papillon) just 5 mins up the road with lovely food and welcoming and friendly staff.

Mama Shelter Paris East unfortunately does not ‘love you’ like the others Mamas do...I’d give it a miss unless you’re desperate.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great Lunch!
text: ¡Qué lindo hotel! Upon arrival everyone was very friendly and I was sat at the dinning room, beautiful room , handsomely decorated! The food was good, the staff was great, and the overall ambiance of the place was very smooth. I think it's a great place for a work meeting, a date, a friendly date, friends night out, solo dinner.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Cosy but modern hotel with a very good restaurant
text: Nice, young Hotel in which we were welcomed very warmly. Stylish interior. The rooms are not too big but very functional and modern. I liked it very much and would definitely consider it for the next stay in Paris.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great hotel and perfect service
text:
This designhotel (Philippe Starck)  gave us a great stay in Paris: modern comfort with lot of charm.
The whole staff (all young people) on the front desk and the restaurant were lovely and helped us with everything we needed, specially Hafizah helped us a lot with an internetbooking and is a wonderful lady.
Breakfast is excellent.The metro is only 10 minutes away and the busstation is 50 m from the hotel.
We would stay here again and we would definitely recommend this hotel to everyone who likes to explore the city and enjoys French hospitality to its best.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Still hip
text: Although mama shelter is around for many years the place is still trendy. The restaurant overcrowded and therefore does not give great service. So place looks nice but would recommend them to put bit more mama love in the hotel. Hallways are messy and the smell on the sixth floor was unbelieveable. But despite this still worthwile to pay a visit
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great music and average service
text: We were a table of 7 people and we chose this place for the good music to have dinner. Unfortunately the service we had was not the best, the waiter was not friendly and had a hard time waiting us. We could eat more at the end of the meal.. I recommend it for the drinks and dance floor
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Out of the way But Way into it!!
text: Located in an upcoming area of Paris this hotel is excellent. Specially decorated on a super hero theme and super friendly staff, you feel comfortable from the first minute in. Excellent Bfast included and also dinner was very good. interesting communal area to sit and have dinner with totally strangers leading into nice conversation. The lounge is a very eclectic place. excellent views and site seeing. living in the real Paris.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Hip decor and basic rooms
text: I stayed here on a work trip. The restaurant was fantastic. The breakfast buffet was the best I’ve had at a hotel. Despite hip decor, I felt the room amenities were underwhelming and run of the mill. Good luck finding an outlet or escaping the perfume smell of the hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great hotel
text:
Situated in the eastern part of Paris this hotel has a sort industrial theme to it. Rather fun actually. It was clean and had a friendly staff. 
Buses close to the hotel can take you downtown or why not go for a walk. Takes about 40 minutes to stroll to the city center. The neighbourhood is quiet and mainly residential. Not many shops or restaurants close by. The hotel has a bar and its also possible to get dinner there. I don't know if there is breakfast. It was not included in the price. So, would I stay here a second time? Yes I would.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Worst Possible Sleep Quality
text:
It is 4:58 AM and I am lying in my bed writing this review on my second night at Mama Shelter. Although I must say that it currently feels more like Stepmother's Hell. 

The room temperature is over 26 degrees and the air-condition is not working. I have opened the window but the slight breeze from outside isn't bringing relief. Despite having a nice Parisian autumn-y weather of 17-19 degrees, the entire 9,5 sqm of space in Room 516 remains heated, even more so than my own mood. This of course is amplified by the laptop from which I am writing from. The fact that it rests on the bed itself is not helping, but the lack of any desk or table space leaves me with no other option. 

I am now contemplating if this experience supersedes the one from the previous night, which I have spent in Room 621. The room was more spacious and the air condition worked flawlessly. However due to the proximity to the lift - and we are talking about less than one meter between headboard and elevator box, separated by only a thin wall - there was a loud banging every 10-30 seconds. This is a busy hotel with only two elevators. So you can imagine the noise and its frequency. 

I am a frequent traveler and stayed at over 75 different accommodations in the past 12 months across 6 continents. In retrospect, even my tent at the South Pole last November provided better sleeping condition than this current stay. 

With this being said, it is not my first time at Mama Shelter. 
My previous visit in May 2019 was decent and besides the rooms my experience this time around was solid as well. The restaurant & bar has a wide variety of options and the breakfast is of high quality too. 
Staff members were approachable, easy-going and trying to assist. It is just very unfortunate that both rooms I checked into were disastrous.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Eclectic Hotel off the beaten path in need of a revamp
text:
Mama Shelter Paris East is a cool, trendy, boutique style hotel tucked away in the 11th ARR section of Paris.  It's in a quiet neighborhood, close to a couple of Metro stations, and a bunch of invader symbols (if you are into finding them).  

The rooms were cool and eclectic, each having a comfortable bed, some cool masks you can wear if you want to be a little voyeuristic.  The bathrooms were nice with plenty of room to take a shower and get ready in the morning.  There was a safe and a minibar in my room which was also cool.    

The restaurant/bar was nice, and the pizza they serve was pretty damn good (and I live in NYC).  Each night when I would get back from seeing Paris I would marvel at how crowded the it was, which is deserved as the food was very good.  The hotel also offers a breakfast buffet which you can package into the room price when booking and its worthing doing so, as it was a very good breakfast.

There were some issues though that I had with the hotel...

First issue was with the Air conditioning.  When I checked-in and entered my room, it was pretty warm in there (I am one of those guests that love it cold) and so I looked at the thermostat on the wall and noticed there was no display panel to set a temp, just a knob that went from + to -, which I assumed meant hot (+) or cold (-), so I put it all the way to - and left the fan on 3, but it never really cooled off and luckily enough for me the windows opened in the room and it was nice and chilly every night, so that helped to cool the room off, but in doing so it also allowed a few bugs to get into the room which I then had to hunt down and exterminate!  Really wish the hotel would update those thermostats with some new units...

Second issue was with the bar area (yes, I know I just said it was a great bar/restaurant).  Each night when you are trying to go to sleep all you can hear are the very loud conversations of drunk people, which may or may not affect how you sleep, so if you want to avoid that, try to ask for a room away from the bar.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: very pleasant hotel , funky and fun , needing a revamp !
text:
really a great stay at this funky boutique hotel. Having stayed at their hotel before I knew what to expect, and they still deliver.

this is one of the early ones and due to be renamed I think? 

Staff are really delightful and make the stay really amazing.

bus stop at the front of the hotel takes you right into central Paris , all very easy n
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Always welcoming, fun, clean, comfortable
text: I’ve stayed here many times and it’s reliably brilliant. The staff are super helpful and friendly, the rooms are always really clean, comfortable and spacious. The food downstairs is great, it’s a short walk to the metro and everything looks great because Philip Starck designed it. I can’t recommend mama shelter enough.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Awesome doesn't even begin to describe it!
text: This hotel is just so good!  The only drawback is that it is not close to a metro station.  You will need to walk about 10 minutes to get there.  But there are a couple of bus lines nearby so if you know your way around Paris with the bus, you will find one that takes you directly to the city center.  Except for the location of the hotel which might not be for everyone, I love every thing else about this place.  The rooms are small but super comfortable, clean and cosy.  The staff is adorable and most helpful and the restaurant is really a special place.  I highly recommend booking the Sunday brunch which is phenomenal.  I have never seen anything like it, the food was amazing!  It really is worth the price.   I have stayed in this hotel three times already because it's my favourite.  I stayed in other good hotels in Paris but I keep coming back to Mama, especially because the excellent value for money and the "grooviness" of this place ;)
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great hotel
text:
Our basin got blocked, air-conditioning stopped working, it was dark as hell everywhere (it's our concept, they kept replying), not much wardrobe space - usually enough for me to create a scene but everything was fixed in a timely manner. I actually looked forward to coming back every evening and didn't mind that getting into central Paris and back took longer because it's on the edge. The buffet breakfast is amazing and pizzas are great, I didn't like the restaurant menu much but the food I ordered was good. The roof terrace is very cleverly photographed because it felt much smaller and not so fantastic as we had believed. Nevertheless, I felt at home in Mama Shelter - don't ask me why!  
]
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama Shelter is awesome
text: I traveled to Paris alone and wanted to find a place where I could let my hair down and have a good time without going out in them Paris streets alone late night  if I wanted to. I selected the spot because there was a rooftop bar (it was closed ) but I still had an amazing time. The restaurant was always live and the staff was very friendly. I never took the metro which I probably could’ve.  I Uber’d EVERYWHERE around the city. All in all Mama Shelter is it especially if you’re traveling alone. I cannot wait to try another location
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Very friendly
text:
We had a lovely stay at the hotel - we found the staff to be really helpful and friendly and enjoyed the atmosphere of the hotel. I didn’t give 5 stars because the room was too hot and dark. We had the cooling on full but it wasn’t enough - I can only think that it would have been unbearable in the previous week when Paris was over 40 degrees. There was a good selection of everyday films in English - there were also adult films easily available. Sound proofing was excellent as I didn’t once hear other guests in the corridors. 
I liked the location as it was reasonably quiet but felt safe. There was a pharmacy next door and a small convenience store close by. It was about a ten minute walk to the metro but we found that ok although didn’t have large bags. The restaurant was quite good but we preferred The Papillon which was a short walk away (and was quite a bit cheaper). Overall would thoroughly recommend this hotel as it added to our Paris stay because it was quirky and French!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Another great Mama Shelter hotel - but the location is a bit boring
text: Mama Shelter Paris East is a great choice, when visiting Paris - cool, funky and modern (despite already being around for more than 10 years). The rooms are pretty basic, but the restaurant and bar is very cool and lively. We visited in winter, so didn’t see the rooftop bar (which’s only open in summer). Only minus is the location, which is a little too far from a metro stop (around 10 minutes walk) and furthermore is in a rather residential and a little bit boring area with not much of interest around.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Friendly and quirky
text: What sort of hotel writes messages on your mirror and has a range of sex toys in the lobby? This one! We really enjoyed our stay at Mama Shelter. It ticks all the boxes for a modern hotel: fast Wi-Fi, tasty buffet breakfast, well appointed bars. The restaurant provides both up-market and budget (pizza) options - be sure to book as it is very popular with the locals. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable. The location is close to shops and Métro stations. One thing lacking: the refrigerator in the room is a vending machine so nowhere to keep your own drinks cold.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: A little 'off the wall', but good fun!
text:
It's not every hotel that invites its guests to pre-reserve a feather duster and related items, but I am happy to confirm that even without buying this option, the stay experience was great fun - and all for a similar price to a (rather more conventional) ibis stay! 

Most impressive of all was the evening restaurant and bar experience. My colleague and I had been thinking that we would go and find somewhere to eat in the neighbourhood, but it was clear that Mama is a 'destination' in and of itself, attracting non hotel residents with its lively atmosphere. The food itself was excellent too.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great mama but she need some maintenance
text:
For Paris standards is this a great hotel, but as a part of the design chain of Novotel I’m a bit disappointed in the maintenance of this hotel. The bathroom was not always cleaned very well (mold at different places) and the tap was hanging out of the wall. But the worse was the led light behind the bed that we couldn’t get out. We arrived quit late and we had an early flight, so the couple of hours we could sleep were terrible! We made a complain in the early morning (4 am), but we never heard anything from them except a mail to ask to fill a survey (pity). 

On the other hand was the service at arrival excellent! The girl informed us very well and even walked with us to the restaurant and finally to the elevator. 

Also the service and food in the restaurant was great. The terrace is sunny, small but nice located beside an old train rails around Paris. Perfect location for a dinner of a drink even when you don’t stay at the hotel. At the top you have a roof top terrace with a great view in the summer. 

The rooms are a bit dark and don’t look fresh because of that in my opinion. But they contain some funny details. Most facilities are available it I missed some coffee facilities I’ve you need to get up early and no free bottle of water. Something that you miss in most hotels. 

Some attention on the property and keep the service as high as it is today and this is a great hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Birthday dinner
text:
I wanted to find a rooftop dining experience which felt more 'in the know' than the typical hotel terraces.  Mama Shelter delivered.  It's got a cool, quirky feel and the rooftop restaurant is always in big demand, (we booked the day before to secure a table then called back on the day of the reservation to secure the outdoor space). Our party of eight, loved it and it seems to work for all ages, since they are equally welcoming of children (not always the case in Paris especially at dinner time).

Don't expect any views of the city, but do expect a great atmosphere, delicious food (BBQ, but also vegetarian offerings) and genuinely friendly and helpful staff (pretty hard to find in a typical Parisian venue).  The first floor restaurant seemed equally lovely so we'll try that next time.  We'll definitely be back!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama Shelter Paris - just one little improvement
text: I really loved my stay but suggest to have an electrical outlet or USB connection close to the bed ( without having to disconect the bed side light(s) so you can have you phone being charged next to you! Everything else is just very good and I will return!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: No brainer with Mama
text:
Great hotel as always with Mama. Staff as you would expect, above professional and friendly indeed.
Restaurant food is really good, try it. Although, organisation a bit messy. But no big deal. Thanks to Laura, miguel, Nicolas and Paul for a great 1 night stay.
See U next time.
Michael
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Watch out for extra inappropriate charges after check out ... poor communication
text:
My wife and I stayed here for one night on 9th May 2019. We checked in the afternoon and there was no running water in the room until 6pm, so we couldn't shower until that time. Not great. Although the reception staff did send up some bottled water for us to drink. But I would rather have been able to have a shower. 

The food in the restaurant was excellent, but it was difficult to get a good night's sleep as the hotel is in a noisy Paris location with the sounds of traffic waking us intermittently throughout the night. We stayed in other locations in Paris which were much quieter/had better sound proofing. 

We paid around 150 euors in advance for the room, and were happy to pay a bill of around £56 on checkout for the meals we had had at the hotel. 

However, on the day of check out we received an email saying that we had removed two 'boutique glasses' from the room and my credit card had been charged an extra 25 euros. This is absolute nonsense. We did not remove these glasses, and this most likely reflects disorganisation/poor housekeeping on the part of the hotel. We contacted the hotel by email explaining this and asking for the 25 euros charge to be refunded, but we have not received a response from them, and so are in the process of claiming this back through my credit card company. Be wary!!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great service and amazing food
text:
Thanks to souleyman and Caroline for their great service, we heard a lot about this place and we weren't disappointed at all. 
Great recommendation for the food and beverage. This place has a really good reputation in Paris, they nailed it !
Top notch !
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Too brief a visit
text: Booked a stay at Mama Shelter partly because I'd never visited that part of Paris on previous trips. The photos of the property were intriguing.....but nothing compared to how amazing it is in person. Check in was a breeze, the room comfortable and well equipped, the bar was wonderful. Sadly I had to depart very early the next morning so I wasn't able to take advantage of many of the features of this interesting hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama’s Loves
text: Mama Shelter East Paris comes with a Michelin starred restaurant, which is very well received by the local community. Restaurant and bar is packed with patrons very night. The hotel is carefully designed in a way that the restaurant is like a separate entity. Mama Shelter has created a lot of merchandise items of theirs. The room is small and can be more properly designed as some wastage of space behind the bed. Room is pretty basic and light controls are just not convenient. Breakfast is charged separately and offering ample choices, however the buffet breakfast selections never change everyday, it became boring after seeing it for 3 day.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great for a short stay....
text: We spent 5 nights here mixing business and pleasure the hotels well designed with helpful friendly staff and good breakfast.  We booked a table in the restaurant, sat down ordered and waited and waited....we waited 2 hours before we finally gave up and left.  I spoke to the manager the next morning and was booked into the restaurant again a few days later, the staff that night were really attentive but the food was not great.  I'd stay here again if visiting for a couple of days but no more I found the dark decor depressing during the day more of a night venue.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama loves you, they say, but Mama wants to kill you
text: Handicap room confirmed by e-mail. On arrival no handicap room available. Second night room changed but shower without security bars or chair (room not accordingly legislation). Very rude staff. Room not cleaned 1 day and not solved even front desk noticed. Really a nightmare stay, and because handicap room was not provided prevented for shower duing 5 days. I will never return
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: No Refunds for Cancelled Trip
text: I previously was a big fan of Mama Shelter, having stayed in both Paris and LA. My recent trip to Paris was cancelled. Despite contacting the hotel 7 days in advance, they would not refund my reservation. I find such policies unacceptable and won’t be staying here moving forward.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Wonderful hotel!!!
text: Wonderful hotel!!! Creative rooms very clean, Hotel in a good location near metro station, near turist place! Good services, lobby have super restoran with big meny and prices are good. Have beatiful bar if you love drink 🍹 miksed things you can offer. Game place. I like this hotel.👍
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Enjoyed our atay
text: The staff here are extremely friendly. It’s a good location, quiet and pretty. The food is nice and also are the cocktails. Rooms are spacious and clean. Ticks all the boxes. I’ve stayed here twice and would stay again
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Mama designs my experience
text: Again a so good experience in Mama. The design is not only in the furniture but Mama succeed to design your overall experience. Great people at your service, extra breakfast and dinner, DJ set, comfortable room, etc. Must stay here. The only bad point in the location. No nearby metro station but take the bus 76 to go to Paris center
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: to be continued ....
text: a wonderfull alive place, bit out of the centre but a place to be more in the hotel then in the city.  Yes it has its first signs of aging but the atmosphere is still the same !  I love to go there and to continue my story with Paris...
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Very friendly staff
text: I had heard so much about that hotel that I guess I had great expectations. The hotel in itself is quite original, unusual decor for the lobby, same for the restaurant. However I was disappointed by the room. Did not make me feel comfy. The black walls made the room quite small, the ceiling was deliberately left bare. Minimal equipment in the bathroom. No minibar. The heating system was not working properly. To be noted is the friendliness of the staff!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Starting to show its age
text:
We have been staying here ever since it opened in 2008. This is the original Mama Shelter and there are now others around the world. It is still cool and funky, but this time we were less satisfied than usual. The bathroom was showing its age - some tiles needed grouting and the toilet seat was fixed crookedly. I had forgotten my razor and in such a situation, most hotels would give you a little packet containing a disposable razor and some shaving cream. The only possibility offered to me was to buy a razor, plus a shaving brush and shaving soap from the gift cabinet; not what I needed. It was suggested that I go to the nearby supermarket, so I came back with a packet of 5 disposable razors plus a giant can of shaving cream, I suppose I shouldn't have been is forgetful. Also, the toiletries offered in the room are the absolute minimum - a small bar of soap and a combined shower gel/shampoo.
There are other cool, mid-price hotels in Paris (Room Mate will soon open). Mama Shelter risks being overtaken.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Modern Vibe
text: We organized a global business meeting for a group of 20 people with the hotel and restaurant. We wanted someplace "different", more hip and innovative than the usually stark hotel conference centers. Mama Shelter definitely provided this. Everyone who worked there was friendly, helpful, and food was great, albeit F&B arrangements overall was a bit less organized than some of the larger hotel chains we've worked with in the past.  The conference room and breakout rooms were a bit oddly shaped and smallish for a group our size (but we wanted "different", and they were!) Off the beaten path location, so any place we went required transportation arrangements.  Not sure we would do the same again for business, but the place is definitely nice for casual travelers.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Book at 9pm
text: We reserved our table at 7pm and once we got settled and ordered our food we could tell the action was going to happen later. So if you want a trendy scene with a DJ and very good food or drinks and snacks this is the place. Our dinner was very enjoyable and then found out that there is a Mama's 1 mile from our house in Los Angeles...lol lol...These places are of the under 40 ha ha we are not, but loved it.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great experience
text: I enjoyed my time here. I was initially unsure about the location but in reality it's only 4-6 stops on the metro to get to the centre of Paris and it's nice not to be in the middle of the touristy areas. I used the train/metro system to get from CDG airport to the hotel and back and it was easy enough to manage with one large suitcase and my backpack. The hotel is modern and attracts a young fashionable clientele. The staff were always very friendly and welcoming. It's good that there is a restaurant onsite so you don't have to head up the street to find food. There are supermarkets near the Metro too. The hotel's brand is clearly to encourage a bit of mischief. Each room has an iMac mounted on the wall as the TV and you can take photos of yourself doing whatever and share it or view pictures previous guests have taken. It's hilarious what some people have snapped and left. Only feedback for improvement I would give is if you want to encourage a bit of debauchery, more supplies are needed in the room. I booked a small room with double bed and aside from 2 plastic cups, there were no wine glasses, bottle openers, spoons, knives and forks or even tea cups and saucers to use in the room. The refrigerator is one of those ones where it is stocked and only those items can be stored there so there is no room for your own purchases. The rooms are also very dark. I was on holiday but I had a little bit of work to do on my laptop and the dark, small room just wasn't conducive to being productive. Maybe a point to note for business customers... I booked the small room so maybe a larger room wouldn't have been as bad. The lighting in the room was coming from three lamps that didn't have off buttons. To light the room I had to plug or unplug the cords from the wall. three of the five sockets didn't work in the room so I had to alternate between charging devices and having light. These were all just small things and I would still recommend Mama Shelter to friends. I only discovered it on my last day as I wasn't told when I checked in and the rooms don't have an amenities guide but there is a communal iron and ironing board and laundry on level 5, which is useful.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Nice restaurant , very good food
text: Usually I don’t like to eat in hotel restaurants but this one is exceptional. Actually we went there especially for dinner. Beautifully designed, kind of American approach of staff. Food was very good, staff kind, just a bit confused, nothing critical. We were group 10 people. See pictures for food.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Worst hotel experience of my life
text: I chose this hotel as a surprise birthday present as I wanted somewhere hip to celebrate a special b day with my husband. I booked and paid for it a month in advance, organised for our three kids to be looked after and was so excited for us to stay in a designer hotel. When we got there we were told the hotel had overbooked - on purpose- and instead we were forced to stay in a very un-hip anonymous chain hotel on the periferique. When we’d wanted a super cool experience! Instead we stayed in a crummy room in a bland hotel overlooking other ugly buildings. On the ugly edge of Paris! What a completely rubbish thing to do to someone. Totally ruined my husband’s birthday. I’m disgusted at our treatment - we weren’t even offered some kind of compensation. Reprehensible.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL !!!
text:
BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL!!!!!!

I had a tantrum in the lobby of this hotel. I’m not proud of it, but I’m going to try to explain why. 

My wife and I live in the Paris suburbs with our 3 children.  For my 5Oth birthday she organised diner at an incredible restaurant with my mother who came to visit from Australia, then she surprised me with the news that my mom was going to head home to look after the kids and we were going to spend the night in a very cool hotel in an area that I absolutely love.

We were pretty excited when we walked into the lobby, lots of buzz, funky cabinets displaying all these design oddities an ajoining restaurant with heaps of weird and wonderful people coming and going.

I sat down on these very odd but surprisingly comfortable metal stools while my wife sorted the reservation.

It wasn’t long before she gave me a distressed look from the counter.

I headed over, she explained that no room for us!

Me: No room !?!
Concierge1: Oui monsieur...no room.
Me: No you must be mistaken, we have a reservation.
C1: Sir we are very busy.
Me: I can see that and the vibe is really cool that’s part of reason why we want the reservation.... that and we paid for the room in advance.
C1: Oui monsieur but this is not possible...We have arranged for a room  in another hotel.
Me: Oh.....OK....Where?
C1: The Novatel!

Me: Are you kidding me?

In the meantime another concierge has sensed the défenses need shoring up. There are now 2 of them.

C2: Sir, you must understand this is fashion week.
Me: FASHION WEEK, WHAT HAS THAT GOT TO DO WITH OUR RESERVATION?

People are starting to stare, and my wife has her head in her hands, she doesn’t like scenes, but I can’t get my head around it.

Me: IT’S MY 50th BIRTHDAY, AND THIS IS REALLY SPECIAL FOR US AND WE DONT CHOOSE TO SPEND THE SPECIAL MOMENTS OF OUR LIFE AT THE NOVATEL!!!

I spot a well dressed group on their way to the restaurant.

Me: (to the passers by) NEVER BOOK A ROOM IN THIS HOTEL GUYS ..... (I realise that they’re probably in fashion.)

C3: (they are stacking up back there). Shall I call you a taxi?
Me: Can I ask a simple question? Why wouldn’t let us know you were overbooked and saved us the trouble.
C4: Well...ere....I....ahhh.

4 blank looks.

C3: Sir you are not the only people with that have had to go to the Novatel .
Me: WHAT YOU MEAN TO SAY YOU PULLED THIS ON OTHERS TOO?.....IS THAT SUPPOSED TO MAKE ME FEEL OK?

More blank stares.

And then the penny dropped this was not an oversight. 

They did it deliberately. It was just business for them. 

They overbook on purpose, took our money, hoping to get no shows. If everyone shows up they have prearranged deal with the Novatel to take the excess. This was confirmed when we received an envelope when we arrived at the Novatel titled ‘no name1 - mama shelter’, with our Novatel room keys.

It’s a scam in a way, to max out their profit. It it doesn’t happen enough to harm their review average. It’s just a numbers game, but it’s also dishonest and cynical.

The Novatel was right on the périphérie , a jungle of criss crossing highways. Just the place you want to spend you’re 50th birthday, when you already live in Paris.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Brunch or bar scene
text:
The best in town. For sure. The daily brunch at 17€ a person, is already pretty great. The Sunday brunch, which is double the normal rate at 44€, is even better.  

As a bar scene - the place is super cool.  It gets really crowded.  But mostly hip and cool Parisians.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great bar, great night's sleep
text:
I spent my last night in Paris at Mama Shelter and it was a great way to end the trip. The hotel is clean and comfortable and is located in one of the a very cool up-and-coming neighbourhood. 

It's a short walk to some really cool bars and restaurant areas and the Mama Shelter Bar was a really fun, lively spot. Recommended.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great base from which to explore Paris
text: Settled in a quieter neighborhood but still with easy access to all Paris highlights, mama shelter offers a different setting than most. Modern, hip yet calm and comfortable. We travelled with two children (9/11) and had a wonderful base in Paris. After a day’s ‘work out’ seeing Paris’ highlights, we could relax at the adjourning bedrooms. Boys watching a movie while we’re having a drink in the bar. Also the restaurant, although quite full over the weekend, has a nice atmosphere and it’s own character.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: One of the greatest hotels I have ever stayed at
text:
Everything about this hotel is amazing; from the great atmosphere throughout the property, the friendly staff at its Front Desk and at its restaurant, the food, the rooms... 

I visited Paris with a friend for 1 night as a last-minute 'Birthday Weekend' and the staff did everything to make our stay memorable: from an upgrade and a birthday message on the mirror to a birthday dessert. 

Its location is not too central, but we really enjoyed the more residential area as we have visited Paris many times throughout the years. Plus, we came by car and the hotel is very well accessible from the highway and has its own parking. It also only takes 30 minutes to get all majors sites and shops by metro. 

We decided to, from now on, make this Paris trip an annual tradition, of which Mama Shelter will definitely be part!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great hotel
text: Spent one night at Mama Shelter whilst on a weekend away in Paris. Great hotel, full of character and well located. Staff are extremely welcoming, rooms are nice, deco great. We had pizza in the evening - which I highly recommend. And the breakfast buffet is great.  Rooftop bar is a MUST! Will definitely return
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Trendy, quirky hotel!
text: Easy and smooth check in. The rooms are compact but good enough size, I had 2 rooms next to each other as they didn't have a family room. Cartoon masks and light sabres for lighting provided some initial entertainment on arrival to the room. One of the rooms TVs was not working, hotel staff tried to fix but no luck so no free movie for the kids. They compensated us for this on check out. The pizzas were fab, strange that they wouldn't at first let my husband have something from a different menu in the pizza restaurant but after a quick chat with staff it was sorted. Drinks at the bar are quite pricey. Breakfast was really good. Located very close to metro stations and bus stops. Really nice stay even though it was just one night.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Urban and chic
text:
The hotel is really cool, our room was very clean and the bed was comfy, the cleaning lady came every day so if you want to sleep in, use the do not disturb sign.
The restaurant was mostly crowded in the evening, the breakfast was good, and the staff was really kind.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Welcome to Mama
text: Our first visit to Mama Shelter. Although not central Paris it is well located for public transport. Designed for the younger traveller, Mama still offers comfy shelter for the mature traveller. Decor is somewhat basic with lots of exposed and black painted concrete. But the jolly decorations make up for that. Lunch on the terrace and breakfasts were superb. A well conceived idea, professionally run. Special thanks to multi-lingual reception staff. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: A contemporary hotel
text:
This hotel is very funky and has a great vibe to it in both decor and crowd. 

As an Accor member my check in process should’ve been easy and fast, especially as o had pre-paid for my stay, instead it was long and painful with a very argumentative and rude member of staff who threatened me with not staying if I continued to question their check in procedure. 

The rooms are very good and the medium size had ample space. 

It was my second stay here but I don’t think I will return again.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Great, quirky hotel with exceptional staff
text: My friends and I stayed for two nights. It was Avery busy period over the weekend of the Beyoncé concert and the World Cup final. The service from the staff was amazing, Paul was very informative and gave us a tour of the hotel. The rooms are small but have everything you need and have a unique edge to them. The only downside was the lack of lighting. The food in the restaurant was really tasty and the buffet breakfast was one of he best I have had. It was close to a tube station and supermarkets. Overall an amazing stay.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: My stay in Mama Prague
text:
Very nice hotel with large and comfortable room (with a high quality bed). Well located, close to the city center with a tramway stop just in front of the hotel. Ticket machine to take the tramway immediately located in the entrance of the hotel. Lots of choices for the breakfast, good quality of the products and possibility to take the breakfast inside or outside in a nice environment.
Really professional and helpful staff. All the contacts I had with them were very good, with an excellent English. Hotel open for only 8 days when I arrived but hotel staff did their best to provide guests the best stay they can wish.
Bar with a DJ in the evening + lots of entertainment available in the hall (baby foot, billard and video games).

I am personnally travelling a lot and can say that this hotel is providing high quality services for a correct price. Will go back for my next stay in Prague.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Best A/C for Hot Paris
text: In the recent years, the temperature in Paris has been rising and Ozone alerts more frequent. It is sometimes critical to get a good night sleep after a long day in hot July/August Paris where buses do not have A/C and Mama Shelter delivers on that aspect. Now, if your idea of a hot night is a "hot" night, Mama Shelter offers hipster bar/night lounge and free "interesting" videos in the rooms. Your call. BTW, ask for a kettle at reception, none in the rooms.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Contemporary hotel
text: If you like a trendy hotel eith nice rooms, a very comfrtable bed pick this hotel. Very serviceminded staff even when their English is not so good. For the breakfast choose the lovely buffet. This was my 4th time and still very pleased...... This is not my last time in this hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Love Mama!
text:
Always a big fan of Phillipe Stark, so you didn’t have to twist my arm to give this place a try.And as always, he came through in spades.Then add the restaurants by none other than Guy Savoy ,a rooftop lounge and great service overall you now have my new Paris favorite.Very affordable from the rooms to the restaurants.Great ambiance throughout.
A little far away, but just factor in an Uber or taxi. It will be well worth the ride.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: The place to be for the Brunch
text: There is no secret, if the place is always busy it means a lot. The service is extremely friendly, attentive and efficient. The buffet is quite amazing a large selection a food from cold cut to nice croque monsieur, maybe they should had some pizzas. Congrats to the GM
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Nice hotel but check out misled and cheated and hotel doesn't solve it.
text:
Let me first point out the positive things here. Comfortable small rooms, great food and a nice ambiance. 
Let me tell something about our experience. 
We booked this hotel because a friend of us lives around the corner. We found a nice package incl. breakfast. Our friend told us that the Sunday brunch is famous here so we decided to book that one for the 3 of us just before we had to say goodbye. At check in on Thursday I asked the receptionist if there was an arrangement if you take the brunch instead of the breakfast. She said there was. She could credit 2x17 euro's (costs of breakfast) from our brunch bill (44 euro's each) as compensation for the not taken breakfast. That sounded perfect for us so we agreed and booked the brunch. Well, the brunch was very good. But at check out we were told that the receptionist made a mistake and that the 34 euro's for the breakfast could not be taken from our account. I was surprised about this because it was promised by the receptionist (hotel) to us. I wanted to speak with the manager about this but he/she was not around. We had to take the taxi to the airport. At home I sent an email to complain again. Then I got back an email that they admitted they made a mistake but that they had a policy not to refund the money back even while it was promised. On the information given to us by check in we made the booking for the brunch (161 euro's). I have been working myself in the hospitality business for over 30 years now, I stay around 150 nights a year in hotels all over the world but I have never experienced this before. A promiss is a promiss and ok, everybody can make a mistake but then you should keep to your promiss and pay out 34 euro's and take your loss as a company to satisfy the customer. Because now it feels like fraud and lies to me. And I have such a different feeling about my stay here and the weekend in Paris overall. It can't be the customer who have to pay for the mistakes a hotel makes. Such a bad customer management.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Quirky Hotel
text:
You have to admire the designers and concept creatures of this brand! Very unusual property, very very trendy with a brilliant bar!
It is a little pricey but worth it for the experience. There is underground parking at the hotel 20€ per night.
Bedrooms are a little tight and a bit dark, but again well designed and quirky! 
Be careful what you do with the in room ‘masks’ and taking pictures with the MAC is not advised unless you really do want to be plastered all over the screens in the bar!
Shower experience is amazing!
Staff are also very funky and attentive.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Trendy, yet extremely HOT
text: Ate at Mama Shelter on behalf of a business party. Trendy place, nice decor, friendly and fun service, okay menu yet incredibly hot while outside it was actually just around 15 degrees. Not so nice area either.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Amazing Spot
text:
I Love this trendy concept hotel. The food and the breakfast are good. The room are a bit tiny but it’s more than enough. Nice rooftop and great staff. I recommend this nice and lovely area.
Well done!
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Very Nice Hotel
text:
Very nice concept hotel with trendy crowd. Rooms are small but it’s more than enough.
The rooftop is very cool. The Restaurant and the staff was amazing. The Tv didn’t work and also internet in the room. But I was lazy to call the front office to fix it.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Very modern; however, can be better
text:
Interesting experience. I arrived quite late because of a business dinner - that was also very interesting - and wasn't sure they still would have a room reserved for me. Luckily, they did. The hotel is very modern, and I was regardless of the time absolutely not the last hotel guest strolling around.

A very modern room and a very nice Apple device as TV. I had some problems switching off the lights... did it the hard way (pulled the plugs).

In the morning I had a small breakfast in the hotel, that one was a bit disappointing for me. Not very logically organized, and not very appealing either.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Perfect place for a weekend in Paris
text: After staying at the Mama Shelter twice I have to say its always a pleasure. The idea of making you feel home works out perfectly. The restaurant has a good mixture of nice food and the bar perfect drinks. And great breakfast the next day. The hotel team is young, relaxed and very friendly. The location might not be perfect centred but that doesn't matter. Always happy to stay here again.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Relaxed atmosphere newer building in residential neighborhood.
text:
Quirky art and laidback atmosphere make this hotel a comfortable relaxing place. The friendly staff is welcoming and helpful. Mama shelter is a lively, modern hotel located in the old Industrial district next to an abandoned rail tunnel. The hotel is situated in the 20th arrondissement and this east side neighborhood feels like authentic Paris. Small bars and great little restaurants are populated by people from the neighborhood. It’s a very short walk to Perre Lachaise Cemetery and three metro stations serve the area. 
The Rooms are comfortable and clean but not large. This isn’t a city where you will be spending much time in your room. We sprang for a patio room which was very pleasant. The patio is a great extension to the room. It provides a nice place to kick back and open a bottle of wine and hang out after a long days march through the sites of the city. Beds are comfortable, and features a TV with good WIFI connection. Bathroom fixtures, lights and furniture are very “Ikea” like,
The restaurant, bar and pizzeria are great, with dinning outside or inside options. The bar seems fun and is surprisingly lively. It’s crowded some nights, has music and dancing and seems frequented by locals and is a good place to hang out and party. The adjoining pizzeria keeps you fed during those late night binges. The restaurant is nice for those less adventurous days. The Brunch on Sunday was great! There were wonderful tasty options for those who like to serve themselves. There may be a roof top bar as well, not sure what the hours are or if it’s open year round. 
There was some reservations about being a distance from major attractions and all things tourist. This is more compensated for, by the great, “off the beaten track” bakeries and restaurants. The hotels location is relatively close to three metro stations. The Metro will take you anywhere in minutes, so distance isn’t that big of a factor for the savvy traveler.
name: Mama Shelter Paris East

title: Excellent -5 star not enough
text:
Beautiful hotel 
Breakfast service runs so smooth with excellent customer service ,we were made to feel so special and welcomed at breakfast 
Location -multiple restaurants ,pubs,shopping right at the door step 
Metro station -2-3 mins walk with great connectivity everywhere 
Family friendly-staff always interacted with our toddler 
Great spaces to sit around lobby 
Reception staff always easy to approach and helpful 
Great checking in experience 
If we or anyone we know visit Paris again -we won’t be staying anywhere else
Only comment - please change carpets on the room they are quite old
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: excellent hotel in a lovely area
text: spent 5 nights here travelling from scotland with wife and teenage children. the hotel provided an excellent base for a superb visit to this amazing city. reception staff very friendly and helpful with the rooms serviced every day. nice leisure facilities to relax and recharge in. and the table tennis and table football facilities are a nice addition. we didn’t eat here but there are a full range of bars and restaurants a short walk away in bercy village. the nearby cour st emilion metro station is currently closed which is a little inconvenient. a very busy replacement bus service for the 14 line is the best public transport option to reach the hotel from gare de lyon station. there is the 24 bus service which stops very near the hotel. this connects to gare de lyon and has the pantheon as its terminus but we found this service a bit unreliable.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Poor house keeping and not up to Pullman standard
text:
Pullman Bercy
Overall not satisfied, the house keeping let it down big time. 

1. Upon check in, the shelves, worktop were dusty, it’s visible and a layer to be wiped out, and my wife have to do it herself as the child is allergic to dust, not acceptable for not only Pullman standard but any hotel should have cleaned it when it’s clearly visible. 

2. The hotel seems to be refurbished at some point as there’s many old obsolete fixtures around. The ceiling paint were peeling off and not very nice to look at. 

3. The swimming pool has an one hour per guest rule and need to book in advance, not very easy to plan around when my family book this hotel because we wanted to spend time in the swimming pool. So an hour seems too little. There were a long queue to get in pool and staff clear pool by the hour, so if we turn up say 19.20, you only get 40 min to swim and will be asked to leave. Felt slightly pressured when I want to relax when staying in Pullman for a long swim. 

4. The house keeping is not acceptable. Called 10min on phone with no answer, after requested for items, no show for 30 min and require 2nd and 3rd chase and even go down to reception in order to get what you needed. Felt like some very badly managed hotel. The front desk will simply said they thought it was dealt with already…

5. The washing product were never topped up. I stayed in the hotel for 5 days, they never top up automatically and must request and wait for 30 min to be dealt with. My wife was waiting in the shower for shampoo the first time round and ended up waiting for too long and have to come out and wait as it was way too long. And when the body wash ran out the next day, the house keeping came after serval chase, but do not think that it’s empty, as the bottle were stripped on wall, it’s not possible to tell how much it’s left other than keep pumping only only abit comes out every 6-7 pump, I gave more days to stay and must have this sorted out so I have to ask the maintenance guy to take it off physically from the wall to check until he realised two bottles were empty and then he replaced for us. There shall be under no circumstances a housekeeping staff confronting guest like this, just get on with work and check and change it! This is something I would never expect from a Pullman! Totally unacceptable!

6. Also when the housekeeping comes, they just knock once and let themselves in, my wife was in between shower as she was waiting and wasn’t wearing properly, but the man just came in even before we answered. His shoes also bring a lot of dirt inside and the towel by the bath tub were all marked. I understand we can use another towel inside, but the staff doesn’t seems to care in Pullman. My family is upset. If his shoes marked the towel, he can try to replace for us as I understand sometimes it’s unavoidable when it was dirty, but he just walk out after. 

7. The key cards kept failing, I have to get card replacement serval times during stay as it fails to let me in room or to operate the lift. It is a recyclable card which is nice, but after going swimming, it’s half deformed and I have to wear my swimming gear to lobby to get a card replacement. 

8. But the pool is quite nice, water was warm and I do enjoy swimming there despite the hour slot and over crowded queue. 

9. For the bath rope, it was very nice that the house keeping took all our wet rope away, but no new rope been replaced. We have been asking for the 3 ropes replacement when we returned to hotel and caused delayed to our swimming slot. After 20 min we decided not to wait any longer as there’s only one hour pool slot. After we returned from swimming, only one rope was provided. Clearly staff don’t listen and doesn’t care, it’s totally not up to expected Pullman standards. 

10. The cup in the room is not clean, the second day when I use the cup for coffee, I noticed the coffee mark ring in the cup from the day before. Obviously the house keeping just gave it a quick rinsed before placing it back on tray, that’s not acceptable for any hotel. 

11. The basin and bathtub in room do not drain well, need to wait for water to clear a few time when brushing teeth and constantly standing in inches of water when having a shower. Wonder if the hotel management care the status at all? They charge a lot in peak season but not really getting it right. 

12. The breakfast, I saw a fly trapped in the serving box crawling on the cooked fish. I have informed the staff and he had the fly removed by hand. And then closed the lid and left the fish for serving. And I have to ask the staff back and request the food to be replaced which he does after I made the point. Quite concerning with the level of hygiene of food. 

13. The house keeping only remove items in the bin, other rubbish like empty used paper cups with coffee stains were left around. I am also into recycling but I don’t think I will reuse the used coffee paper cups and would expect housekeeping clearing them. Also there were metal spoon we used to ate dessert with chocolate and crumbs stuck on it, they were left on the TV table til checkout for 3 days! Does the hotel expect me to wash them? 

14. I used the iron board for clothes and ever since it was left out by the window til check out. I expect every day I come back the room is made up in a presentable status similar to how it looks when check in. I don’t understand why Pullman expect otherwise. It looks bad and it’s danger to have the iron out when I have child staying in the room. If Pullman expect guest to pack themselves, I would expect a clear reminder so I know what to expect. 

The list really goes on and this Pullman experience is not a nice one and I don’t think I would recommend to my friends.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Very good option!
text:
Good location, near to subway station, close to restaurants and supermarket, good services and friendly attention. breakfast is a very good option to be added. It's an excellent hotel for families. 
Is not located in the center of Paris but the mobility is easy and safety
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Overcharged and left vulnerable as single woman
text:
My flight was cancelled and so I booked a room in PPC on booking.com for €217 but after payment was taken I got a notification to say that the hotel was fully booked (even though the money been taken from my account). I went back on the app and found it wasn't and a room at PPC was available but this time for €476.29. As I was desperate, as a single woman by herself, I reserved it and got a taxi straight to the hotel.

When I arrived around midnight, I was asked to do a pre-authorisation for €505 that was apparently declined even though it had been taken out of my account. I started to panic and burst out crying and the hotel staff looked at me blankly - offering no support. I asked to speak to the manager who was aggressive. Eventually, I was able to pay on my card (after working things out by myself and moving funds). This time it did go through on my card and the second pre-authorisation of €525 came out of my account.

The next day, I paid €505 for my stay (for one night!!) however the first pre-authorisation of €505 still remains on my account and hasn’t been refunded or returned over a week later!

As a young woman in Paris by herself at midnight - I was put in a vulnerable  position where I potentially had nowhere to stay and felt like the hotel staff were not only unhelpful but also unkind. I've never experienced anything like it. I have filed a complaint today with Booking.com and await to hear their response.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Excellent - with one exception
text: We are staying with our three children for five days,  and we must say we are very satisfied with the rooms (connecting superior) and the hotel as such (nice swimming pool). Clean and modern. We have only eaten breakfast at the hotel, but it has been delightful. Fresh omelet and a good variety of food. The hotel is situated a bit outside the center, but it has a nice little village just a few steps away. Here you can eat and shop, and you will also find the metro station St. Emillion. We have had no problems getting around seeing all the famous places. The staff is very helpful and friendly. Unfortunately, the hotel bar closes way too early! The hotel web site states that the terrace bar is open till midnight, unless out of season or bad weather. Not so, it has closed way earlier every night. Yesterday they closed just after 22, while kids still were running around playing and guests just came back from dinner. We had to visit another hotel bar in order to have a night cup. I think a hotel of this standard should be able to provide their guests with a bar service at least until midnight in the most busy tourist season.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Very good stay
text:
Good stay in general.
Potential improvements: size of the beds, evening restaurant speed (we had to wait nearly one hour before getting any drink or food)
Positive points: service, localisation, breakfast quality
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Nice hotel nice location easy access to city center
text: This hotel is located within walking distance to the concert place and nice little food village not far from Paris sightseeing center. They have professional and friendly staff and nice bar but asain food wasn't good here but cant complain since you are in France lol
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Very dusty rooms and cobwebs along corridor
text:
Very dusty rooms. It actually make us sick. Check out the air con vent. The corridors  also have a lot of cobwebs. When the manager is informed he promised to clean but nothing is done. How can a 4 star hotel have cobwebs!

Regret not heeding the advice of an earlier post.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: A fantastic hotel for families in Paris
text:
Lovely location for our short city break in Paris. A very convenient spot to travel to from the Eurostar terminal, and great to get around Paris from. We did a day at Disney & saw all the sights from this location. 
Staff very welcoming, friendly & helpful. Nice pool. Breakfast was expensive so we didn’t have it in the hotel.  
Lovely restaurants nearby. Very comfortable rooms. Would definitely return!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: An amazing staff makes this hotel wonderful
text: It has been a couple years since I was last able to travel to Paris and stay at this wonderful property. The hotel itself is great - I would recommend booking a room on a higher floor for the best views. Yet what really sets this hotel apart is the welcoming staff. They are so willing to help in any way they can, and have always made my visits to Paris excellent experiences. Although I was away for two years, all the members of staff who were still working at the hotel remembered me and called me by name each time we passed. I see this hotel as being my home in Paris, no matter how often or infrequently I visit. I would immediately recommend this hotel to anyone, since as a result of being on Métro Line 14 it is very fast and easy to reach the centre of Paris. Yet the distance from the city centre allows the area around the hotel to be "Very Paris". There are plenty of friendly locals and lots of small colorful shops. I enjoy exploring the area around the hotel at least as much and sometimes more than doing that in the centre of Paris.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Not great service & small rooms
text: Very tiny room. We had a superior family room for 4 people and it looked more like a two persons room with two single beds! The beds were really small. There was also only two towels. We had to go to the reception to ask for more towels. After waiting like hours, we called again and they came with towels. We also wanted to use the microwave to warm food for our toddler.. the staff in the restaurant refused first to warm it up for us. I mean it doesn’t take any effort to warm something up. You also don’t get any parking deal by the hotel.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: SPA ACCESS & MASSAGE
text:
I booked the 1hr spa and 1hr candle massage. 
The staff was very friendly, helpful and professional. 

I 100% recommend the lomi lomi 1hr massage by William. The experience was great and took place in a comforting, calm, clean well-heated space. The massage was masterful and it is also quite an amazing rhythmic feeling that totally lulls you into a blissed-out state. I left feeling very relaxed, soothed and regenerated.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Sothys at Pullman
text: Wonderful experience at Sothys Spa at the Pullman. I was looking for a specific muscle recovery massage, and Elodie delivered perfectly. Beyond the wellness skillset, she had quite a good knowledge of deep tissue, which is often lacking in spas where pampering is the norm. I’ll be back!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Melissa is excellent masseuse!
text: Scrub + 90 min Swedish massage. Nice facility and comfortable tables. Melisa was very professional and exceptionally good at pinpointing my areas of stiffness and in need of focus. I was hoping for a lower cost per minute from the spa, but an excellent masseuse Melissa is. 😀
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Lovely Cock Tales
text: Had one of the best evening in my life. Jeremy was so knowledgeable and the cock tales he made me were out of this world. I'd defintely go back for some more, as long as I'm served by this lovely gentleman one more time  😉
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Le SPA by Sothy’s
text: My son and I were traveling and in Paris when he asked me if we could get a massage. After I got over my initial shock that my 19 year old wanted to get a massage, I thought it was a fabulous idea. My hotel recommended the Spa by Sothy’s. Booking was easy and fast and they got us in for same day appointments. Our masseuses were Melissa and Liane-they were both fabulous and super professional. The hour service left us refreshed and ready to tackle another few days of travel. I highly recommend this Spa. Safe travels.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Convenient hotel
text: room was nice . Team member was helpful and welcoming.  The room service menu is quiet disappointing.  Same apply for the bar: food menu . Selection is too small .The hotel location is very accessible .
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Amazing
text: Great location near the Seine and Bercy Village. Easy access by car or public transport. The room was amazing. Breakfast delivered in your room free of charge with delicious ingredients. Amazing!! Great for a family as there are a lot of games in the lobby
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great location at super nice Pullman Hotel for weekend break
text: We cam from London by train to Paris and were quickly at the hotel from the main train station. The hotel is very nice from the inside with lobby bar, boutique shop and large lounge area with ping-pong table. The rooms were clean and nicely designed. The beds are very soft which gives you a good rest after an exhausting day of sightseeing. The hotel team is very friendly and helpful. We felt that they took good care of us.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: fantastic
text: this is a great hotel 3 minutes walk from the metro at Saint Emilion. You are right next to Bercy Village with great bars and places to eat. Great location for a visit to Paris as 10 minutes into the center but lovely and quiet. Great service and the best hotel Breakfast ever.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Disneyland Stay
text:
I enjoyed my stay at Pullman Bercy. We stayed here for my brothers 18th birthday gift and we were going to Disneyland for the day.
They upgraded his room for free which we appreciated. The rooms were clean and spacious- we would of appreciated a easier navigation of the tv in terms of languages. 
The lobby is beautiful with lots of things to do- barber, nail technician and a bakery section.
The hotel was only 30minutes from Disneyland which was about 40-50 euros.
The hotel was around 25 minutes from the airport which was around 40 euros.
The shopping village next to the hotel was lovely. We ate at Vapianos and went shopping in Rituals and Sephora which added an extra layer of enjoyment to our trip.
I would definitely stay here again!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Terribly inconsistent
text:
We had 3 nights in this hotel and it was like staying in two different hotels each night..
First night was amazing. Awesome service, great room service and breakfast was wonderful.
Second night was a disaster.. rude room service that evening and at breakfast the next day. Breakfast itself was poorly cooked - it felt like we were dealing with entirely different waiting and kitchen staff :( 
Unfortunately as it was so inconsistent I would not take the chance again at staying at this hotel
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Amazing staff
text:
Amazing hotel. It’s a bit far from the main attractions but we took Uber and it was just a beautiful ride especially while coming back in the evening when all the lights in the city are on. The next day we took Uber to notre dame which was only 10 euros and from there we took hop on hop off bus. Hotel is very clean and friendly. Dylan upgrade our room for free and he was very professional! 
Night before my birthday amazing server  Lea from the bar sent Champaign and cake in our room. I was over the moon. That was a real surprise. 
Staff is definitely the highlight ! 
Would come here again for sure !
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great place - conveniently-located and lovely service
text:
Encountered a good check-in, very engaging service - nothing was too much trouble for them and there was a great sense of welcoming a valued customer, irrespective of your nationality and language barrier.

I was issued a key-card (used to operate the lift and power room) and pointed to the lifts around the corner.

Thought the room was very good, large and spacious equipped with plenty of power points: beside the bed were a combination of UK, Euro and USB sockets (definitely had the international traveller in mind) with more below the desk. I'd prefer if they wall-mounted the phone, there's no reason it should take up so much bedside cabinet room!

Bathroom was clean, warm, functional, bright and nicely-styled - can't fault it.  There's some pleasing views out the front but little noise; I had a pleasant night's sleep all nights.

Definitely a great stay away and I'll certainly welcome the opportunity of stopping here again!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Pretty good, flash hotel
text:
First off, this is an impressive hotel as befits its price tag and star rating.

I was checked in by an extremely efficient and friendly person and offered a freebie glass of fruit juice and a chocolate biscuit by their equally friendly colleague. I was told they'd upgraded my room and indeed when I got there it was big, with two sofas, a double bed and a desk. Plus there were ample wardrobes, two fluffy towelling robes, and a huge TV.

All seemed in order. I noticed some ambient noise outside but ignored it; a city centre hotel will always have some kind of noise outside and some kind of clunking or grinding machinery indoors somewhere. I then ordered, and was brought by a delightful room service person, a burger and chips (excellent), some coffee (a cup, it was ok - I should have asked for a cafetiere), and headed off to bed.

And there was that noise. It was like the firing up and then down again of some machine, perhaps the aircon, perhaps some kind of waste processor. It was outside the room, but there was nothing visible when I looked. OK my fault - I should have said or done something about it as soon as I arrived at the room; I certainly couldn't be bothered to do anything then as I was in bed and about to turn the lights off.

Except...I couldn't turn the lights off. As usual in a hotel like this there were lights all over the place and at the bedside there were three switches. I turned them all off but some lights stayed on. I got up. I went to the door and turned off what was evidently the (only) master switch and everything was plunged into darkness. So I turned that back on to see what I was doing and make sure I didn't walk into the TV and then for about five minutes experimented with each of the other switches around the room to get all the lights off. I ended up by leaving one bedside lamp on, unplugging one of the lamps at the end of the room which stubbornly stayed on, and then turning the bedside lamp off from beside the bed. Surely a master switch by the bed would make sense?

Throughout the night there was the noise but it didn't keep me awake too much. 

In the morning all was good, with a hot and powerful shower, plenty of towels, and an ok sink (square and shallow). On checkout the staff, yet again, were super friendly and helpful (I was walking to my meeting 25 minutes away).

So in all a great, "grown up" hotel and vrooming noise and light switches apart, not much wrong with it.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: No recommended
text: I would not recommend this hotel...you will receive conflicting information from the staff.  Most of the staff are not friendly at all.  There are better hotels than this hotel and at better locations.  It is not value for money
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: A lovely property with an amazing staff
text: I stay at this hotel at least a couple times per year for my leisure trips to Paris. I enjoy the location, as it's far enough from the touristy center of Paris to be relaxing, yet Métro line 14 makes reaching the first a ten-minute ride. (Note: because this is an automated line, it was operating normally during the recent transit strikes.) The hotel itself is quite nice, having undergone significant renovations in the common areas over the past few years. Yet, what sets this property apart for me is the staff. They are warm, welcoming, caring, and always helpful. I see this as "my home in Paris" as a result. I know beyond any doubt that the staff will make every possible effort to assist me, no matter what my request is. In terms of the accommodations, I'd advise booking a premium room if you are able, as the view from the upper floors of the hotel toward the city is beautiful. Highly recommended!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great family hotel for a holiday stay with a GREAT fitness area
text:
We stayed here for a couple days during the New years.

Lobby & service
I was pleasantly surprised when walking into the hotel, whereas the atmosphere / vibe was really relaxing and welcoming. So was the staff! Very helpful, respectful. They even remembered our names every time we passed the lobby.

Room
The room had decent space with a comfortable bed, the bathrobes were utmost nice compared to others I've had. The lighting in the room added to the pleasant stay as well.  We asked for a baby cot and they took the liberty to think of any additional stuff we might need for our kid (baby tub, diaper bin and a teddy bear!)

Breakfast
Pullman hotel had an outstanding breakfast; serving a diverse set of warm food (eggs, beans and even chicken wings) to cold (yoghurt & sliced fruits).

Fitness
This hotel must have one of the BEST fitness areas I have ever seen in a hotel!
Hands down for their blessed fitness area!!!

Spa
Unfortunately the spa was under renovations so couldnt use this service. Read from other reviewers that it was closed a while ago so thought by time we reached we could use it again. Unfortunately the renovations were still on going.

Wouldn't mind staying at the Pullman Bercy again.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great value for money
text:
We stayed here during the Christmas break witha family of 5. We booked classic rooms. The hotel perfectly arranged 2 rooms with a connecting door. At arrival the 5th bed was not in the room yet. After a call the bed got installed. For Paris rooms are reasonable spacious, even with the extra bed you still could move around.
Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. The concierge (Hamid?) is brilliant, what an enthusiasm.
Hotel Lobby is an active area. Well designed and spacious, including two table tennis tables.
Location is great. Metro stops 4 minutes walk away and without many stops brings you directly downtown Paris. Hotel area is nice with Bercy village on 3 minutes walk. 

Why only 4 points out of five. The room showed some small maintenance issues (loose wallpaper, damaged paint etc) and the breakfast was not great. Choice enough, but things were often cold and the breakfast space is too small. Despite the hotel staff is very friendly, they didn't pick up the phone when I tried to call the reception desk.

Conclusion: A few small things to improve to make it 5 points, but an absolute great hotel for visiting Paris. Better stay here than downtown. Will save you money and provide you more space and a very friendly staff.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Amazing experience at the Pullman Centre Bercy
text: Amazing experience at this hotel, from arrival to departure the team at Pullman has been a incredible help to us. The staff of the hotel is ready to provide any information that you need and they will sort out any problem. Staff is extremely kind and helpfull and the receptionist that helped us most of the time (Antoine) seemed not only professional but also actually interested in helping. The pullman itself is really good compared to the other ones in Paris and the location is great. Its about a minute away from the nearest metro (cour saint emilion, line 14) and the Bercy Village has most of your needs. The hotel is clean and provides most things you need, the minibar is free and there is a free Nespresso machines witch gets refilled every other day. The rooms are large have windows that can be opened, very comfortable beds and clean showers with rain shower system. The breakfast has way more than you can try during your stay. Our experience at this Hotel was amazing!
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great place to enjoy holidays !
text:
We spent a wonderful stay at the Pullman hotel ! 
We had booked a family room which was perfect for us and our sons, even if the room was a bit tiny with all our luggage pieces.
Breakfast was splendid, large choice which pleased all our family.
The concierge team was sensational helping us moving in Paris, with great advices, special mention to them !
Special mention to Alexandre which was so kind when we arrived late at night after a pretty long trip !
We’ll come again !
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Service
text:
The member of staff in this restaurant called Jeremy was great, his service was excellent, very polite. Very helpful. 
The whole experience bring in the hotel was very pleasant, 
I would recommend this hotel for great stay
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Hit and Miss
text:
Very mixed feelings with this hotel . Room is clean bright and spacious ( junior Suite ) 
Check in was awful which has probably clouded ourstay . Lisi ? From the concierge was amazing , can not thank her enough for her care and energy . Avoid breakfast. Stone cold food and cold service to match . Variety was good but a cold egg and bacon is not appealing to me . Staff were not interested. If you are a fan of customer service this place based on our experience will disappoint. Location is convenient with metro 4 minute walk away . Could be a great hotel but the service level is very patchy . Would I stay here again ? Only if I was guaranteed that there had been some changes with the hospitality side.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Back from Australia
text: Another terrific stay @ Pullman Bercy. Merci Beaucoup to the Front Office team who were wonderfully kind & helpful to me before & during my stay - especially Lise, Julie, Dylan   & Concierge. Hotel looked lovely for Christmas. I look forward to another stay.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: The management listens and problem-solves without any dithering
text:
We stayed 3 nights in 2 rooms as a family of 5 (2 adults and 3 children.) Check-in was excellent - less than 5 mins, and the front office and postal services was helpful also. The restaurant staff were very professional and helpful despite being busy and there was a variety of food. Generally the the hotel was a clean and relaxing environment with good service, and the bar was chilled out too with good music. The rooms were stylish, spacious and well-appointed and the beds were great for my back and neck pain, with memory-foam pillows that helped too. There was a couple of instances of blocked sink, toilet and bath but the problems were resolved quickly and efficiently. The management listens and problem-solves without any dithering although I would say one or two members of staff would benefit from retraining, but as a whole the staff are professional, attentive and friendly. 
The hotel location was also great being right next door to Bercy Village with shops and food places, as well as not too far from the heart of things in Paris - some 30 minutes train journey to the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysee district. Also not a long drive to the Notre Dame.
Would definitely stay again.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Great Stay
text: Clean room. Bed is 2 twins that they separated for us. There is a bar that you enjoy. We stayed there our last night before flying home. Has a TV with many stations. There was no clock that I saw but I had my phone.
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy

title: Nice infrastructure- inefficient and expensive servie and, mice!
text: The Pullman Centre Bercy is conveniently located if your business is in the Bercy area. The hotel infrastructure is nice. Rooms are spacious and the design is modern. Wonderful gym. Food is expensive for its quality and service is very slow, inattentive and inefficient. Even when there is only a couple of clients in the lounge it would be annoyingly time consuming to get attention from staff. We observed several mice in the lounge. Staff informed us that it was unfortunately caused by the proximity to the river and that the hotel was taking measures against it.....
name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy
