title: Great Hotel, Perfect Location, Value for money
text:
We are from Thessaloniki, Greece and we chose the 45 sq. feet two bedroom suite for our visit to Paris.
The rooms are spacious, bright, with a huge corner window in the master bedroom that overlooks the gorgeous french roofs that stem Marguerit Sq. They are clean and well designed with a smart system of sliding doors that separate the master bedrooms’ way to the bathroom  from the secondary space and vice versa, a very convenient way to feel comfortable in your room, especially if you are sharing it with your nephew as I did. 
The bed was very comfortable, note that I have serious back pain issues and every morning I woke up feeling great. 
They change the towels every day and the pillowcases by demand. The suite has Molton Brown products for showering etc. 
The staff was very helpful and polite, especially in the dining area. You must try the hotels’ breakfast, its a value for money choice, everything is delicious and fresh. I think I’ve noticed five or six counters with different breakfast menus. Their baguettes, croissants and crepes are exceptional. 
On top of all, the best that this hotel has to offer is its location. The neighbourhood is full of small cafes, patisseries and multinational bars & restaurants. The atmosphere is happy and welcoming as you can walk on pebble stone paths without worrying about cars passing by. Although the hotel is in near everything, it is very quiet during the night. 
Rivoli Ave. where you can take a taxi to other parts of the city, is a 2 min walk. We payed about 15 - 20 euros for taxi transfer to Eiffel Tower, Or Basilique Sacr Coer in Montmartre, Le Ciel Montparnasse etc.
Pompidou Centre is a 5 min walk. The Louvre is a 12-15 min walk. The Seine is 7 min walk. Saint Chapelle is 15 min walk and you can walk another 15 min from there and reach Museum D’Orsey. So you actually have half the the things worth seeing in Paris in walking distance.
The hotels’ entrance is right in front of a metro line elevator, you can take the RER line from the airport and walk straight into Novotel Paris Les Halles. I wouldn’t recommend it though, because the train from the airport is extremely crowded, there’s no room for suitcases and the people are not willing to even move aside so as you can walk out of it. I would recommend you bought a taxi from and to the airport, its 60 euros worth spending. 
In the overall I was very glad I chose Novotel Paris Les Halles for our stay in Paris and I would recommend it to anyone who thinks that the hotel is not only for sleeping but it is part of your trip and a pivotal part of your journey. It’s a value for money experience.

title: A good stay, but watch out for the prices of extras!
text:
I stayed in the Generator Hostel in Paris for one night. I arrived between 23:00 and 00:00, so having a 24-hour reception desk was great as it enabled me to check-in. It's in a good location; it's easy to reach from Paris Nord. I (25 year old male) walked over and felt safe along the way.

The room was clean and the bed comfortable. I stayed in a 10-person dorm (~34 euros) and everyone was friendly. Our room had a sink and bathroom. One thing that was frustrating is while the toilet in the our dorm was in a room behind a door, the sink was not. It was opposite the coat rack in a little nook as you walked into the dorm. That meant anyone coming back from a late night caused a bit of noise brushing teeth and using the tap.

Staff were very friendly and helpful. I felt pretty confident that I could always get some help or even drop down for a chat.

The atmosphere was great - lots of people around chatting, playing pool, having a drink.

The security of the premises was ok. Having staff always on reception helped. However there's nothing really stopping a random person walking in, using the lift and tailgating into a room. That's pretty classic with hostels, but I mention this because if you want to use the locker in your room you need to bring a padlock. Alternatively you can buy one there, but I think this is a bit cheeky of Generator because obviously people staying in a hostel want security for themselves and their items - it's an essential. Charging extra for an essential is, to me, a big no no. Why not offer customers a padlock if they pay a small deposit?

My main issue with the stay was the cost of all the extras. I personally would not recommend breakfast, and I would also find another bar if you wanted a drink. I paid 9 euros for a beer; the average cost of a beer in Paris is 6.76 euros (2021 data). From memory, breakfast cost about 8.50 euros. For this you can get muesli, bread rolls, jam, ham, cheese, tomatoes, cucumber, juice and tea/coffee. It's very simple for 8.50 euros. A croissant was an extra 1.50 euros and cooked breakfast another 2-3+. That wasn't clear when I booked breakfast so I felt a bit ripped off. Charging extra for croissants is a bit ridiculous.

Overall a pleasant stay, and definitely a good option for travellers. Just mind out for the extra costs!

title: Great Experience
text: This is our first time visiting Paris so we didn’t know what to expect.  After a long trip we checked in with a very friend staff.  We are a family of 4 and the room is so spacious!  We stayed 6 nights.  We had 3 suitcases and able to unpacked all 3 and find a place for everything.  We decided to try the breakfast the next day and was pleasantly surprised at the selection.  For $30 per person it was like dinner for us due to the time change.  Our room was on the 1st floor and we used the stairs very day for exercise.  The days that we did use the elevator, it was not an issue.  The location was great with a lot of restaurants near by.  We had easy access to the train and hop on hop off bus.  The views are wonderful.  We even walked 2 blocks to rent a car to drive to Normandy.  The rooms are cleaned each day and we received turn down service at night with 4 bottles of water and snacks.  They made us feel very special and all the staffs we encountered were friendly and always greeted us with a smile.  Highly recommend
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Total Disaster
text:
Unsanitary nightmare place for your Paris Stay.

Marriott shamelessly claim this hotel as 5-star, which fooled me into booking this place.  The moment I stepped into my room, I realized it is no where near 5-star quality. I would not even give it 3-star for the poor room condition it was in. Let me just list a few: Very obvious and gross stains on the sofa; crooked door lock that cannot be secured locked from the inside; hair on the towel before I even touched it; broken curtain. Oh by the way, someone mentioned that one of the elevators was fixed in August, but guess what? it is broken again in September!

I have stayed at more than 6 different 5-star hotels in Paris. I know what to expect from a 5-star property at this price range in Paris, and I can say this hotel is no where near that. Save yourself some trouble book elsewhere instead!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Pretty serious housekeeeping problems and no retribution
text:
on the positive side, the location is just 250 meters from the Arch of Triumph, has a nice sized room with comfortable bed and a superb concierge

The fitness center is barely adequate with one chest machine, some hand weights, a few non-Peloton bikes, and one elliptical   

Breakfast buffet was ok, worse than Paris Marriot Opera and  not included 

It was surprising hard to get a taxi or uber from location during day 

Front desk took long time to answer calls 

Most importantly , Housekeeping and engineering were flawed  The air condition would not shut off from max so our temp was in mid 60s  Engineering was unable to repair it during stay  Additionally on our last morning, a man entered the room without na audible knock to service it, frightening both my fiancé and me  It is unclear why servicing would occur before checkout and why someone would not call us prior  to top it off, nothing was offered other than “we’ll make it up to you next visit” ( as if we plan on coming back)

Sp for $600 a night, one can do better
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: I LOVE the Renaissance Arc de Triomphe!
text: I used to travel to Paris regularly for work and after trying several different hotels in Paris, I discovered the Renaissance Arc de Triomphe! It became my home away from home! The staff always made me feel like family! Well I just returned from a visit and this hotel staff and service is still second to none! They are so kind and attentive and again made this my home away from home! The hotel is extremely clean, has great amenities, tremendous staff, and perfect location.  I would highly recommend this hotel for your next visit to Paris!!!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great experience!!!
text: Every interaction we had with the staff at this hotel was amazing. They could not have been more polite and accommodating. We arrived very early, at 7AM and we were able to go directly to our room, even though check in was not until 3PM. I want to point out BOTH elevators were working! I cannot speak for other reviewers comments about rude staff, and bad service but we experienced excellent service, and a very warm welcome each time we walked through the lobby. We stayed for a week, two adults, two children and could not have been more satisfied with the experience. The street the hotel is on is quiet but full of restaurants and in between two metro stations, and a five minute walk to a grocery store. Would definitively stay here again!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Bad service!!!
text:
One-star service...
For the start, Marriott sent me an email before I  arrived and ask me for assistance to contact the hotel,I sent an email and didn't get any response. ( wanted help and advice about arriving at the hotel and restaurants nearby)
Check-in was an hour late.
Want I approached the manager and tell him about it the official answer was “ok” so how I can help you right now?
On the third day for the first time, I felt like a Thief!!!
After ordering and paying for champagne and breakfast at the hotel
I ordered a glass of champagne from the bar
I left my staff on the counter and walked five steps to the lobby to give my wife the glass.
On my way back to sign on the bill the waiter already get out of the counter and started coming my way.
When he saw I am coming back he and his manager started laughing together!!!
Not funny at all.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Elevator out of order for 6 days!
text: The rooms are spacious and good. Location is ok, not great. But … service overall is bad. Front desk and cleaning people are not helpful.  I asked for an extra towel that was never sent. We run out of toilet paper (a first in a hotel—having traveled often) and had to ask for it twice before they sent it to the room. There was only 1 elevator working during most of our 7 nights star. This meat 15-20 minutes waiting time for the elevator. These many inconveniences really show how the hotel industry was affected by the pandemic. Even Marriott hotels are clearly struggling to keep up offering good services.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Loved the location and the room - the front desk staff are clueless....
text: I am Titanium Elite status with Marriott, and after arriving at 5pm it took over 2 hours to get a room.  We were offered to wait in the bar area and were given a coupon for drinks - no alcohol.  What were we supposed to order?  Water?  The front desk clerk said she would change it and allow us to have a beer.  Over the course of 2 hours we had 2 draft beers each and some falafel.  And were charged for them.  Come on Marriott - at over 500 euro a night, pick up the tab. At Titanium status breakfast is included and we were told on check in that since there was no lounge we could have breakfast in the restaurant. On checkout - sure enough, 60 euro charge was added per day.  The desk clerk actually argued with me - she said, Yes, I know you are entitled to free breakfast but no one added it in the instructions on check in.  Huh?  A quick apology should have been given and the charges removed - nope, she proceeded to explain that it wasn't on the computer.  She finally took it off - but why do I have to spend my time asking for what your hotel policy entitles me to.  Maid service was sketchy - sometimes we got it sometimes we didn't.  Which is fine - I have traveled a lot during covid and staffing is at a minimal. Maids were happy to hand me fresh towels. Shout out to the bell men who went the distance (literally - running down the street in the rain to find us a cab!!).
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: I used to stay here often, now I won't stay here again
text:
Proximity to the Arc de Triomphe is the big plus.  The street itself and the hotel location is just OK.  The rooms are on the larger side for a European hotel and all the ones I've stayed in are bright and have nice glass walls. 

The downsides though are many:  (1) it's gotten expensive and at nearly 500 Euros per night you have lots of other good options, (2) the neighborhood is less good than in the past and the street itself lacks life -- e.g., all the cafes near the hotel are bad, slow even by France standards, (3) they're rude -- never seen worse manners of hotel staff from front desk to even the bartenders, (4) they're inefficient -- everything from the front desk to the elevators runs slowly -- but boy are they quick to try and get you out of your room after noon.  I have stayed here numerous times over the years but will not be back.  Also, for me, at this point, I probably won't stay near the Arc de Triomphe as there's too much "Times Square" vibe.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Afwul experience
text:
I have stayed in the hotel last week for a three days and unfortunately had my emporio armani tracksuit stolen from my room whilst I was out for the day.
I was mortified, I couldn't believe it, I came back to the room and it was gone. Got on to reception straight away, enquired if anyone took my clothes to the laundry, only to be told that that they weren't. So I asked manager to come to my room, which he did. I've explained the situation, that I was gone for the day, housekeeping came to clean the room... And my expensive tracksuit, that was hanging on the chair, ready to be worn the next day.. Simply vanished!!
Manager asked me to check my luggage, which of course I've already did numerous times before calling reception.. He said he'll speak with housekeeping and get back to me. And he did, only to tell me that he has spoken to the housekeeping and no one took my clothing.
I said well someone has, because they're not where I left them.
Then he told me that he'll pass on this issue to his senior manager who will be in the next day and they'll speak to laundry department 🙄.
Either way, I was leaving the next morning and asked to let me know ASAP when my clothes have been found, as I was intent to wear them for my travels.
Unfortunately the next morning, I haven't heard anything back from anyone, checked with reception, no explanation.. Apart from when they're found, they'll send them back to me.
Made sure, I've left my correct email address and asked manager and reception to keep me informed about this unfortunate incident...
Sadly to say, I've been back to the UK a week now... And nothing!

Written them an email last night, saying how sadly disappointed I am at how they're handled this matter.
For a so called 5 star hotel, that is not cheap, it's absolutely appalling. To say that I'm beyond disappointed and shocked it's understatement.

I'll definitely never go back and stay there again, even if they offered to me the best room free of charge.
Most afwul experience I've ever had in all my years of staying in different hotels.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Wrong rooms and management
text:
Lovely lobby.  Sadly in 3 hours that is all I have seen.  Was sent to a dirty room.  Then to the wrong room. Now told the upgraded room I paid for will not be available. 

Have seen no management. 

Have only been given drink voucher which only covered beer or wine in lobby bar. 

Hotel has not attempted to correct room
Mistakes.  

Both couples here for 20th anniversary.   Paid for upgraded room.  

Not site seeing sadly stuck in purgatory waiting for clean wrong room.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Waiting Elevator Forever but Worst is Writing something on Guest Personal Items are Unacceptable
text:
One elevator working during our 5 day stay, waiting for elevator is totally bad experience.   Hotel doesn't care guests waiting time during peak hours to use only 1 elevator for the entire building sharing with House Keepings?

Worst than ever is Hotel staff wrote on my Louis Vuitton package which hotel supposes to ship it back to me.   When I decide to take my package from hotel conceirge back, I have found hotel staff writing on my LV package.   I have tried to contact the hotel for reason/ explanation, but they kept silence and no response.   No response or no reply from anyone.   It shows totally irresponsibilities of the hotel and management.

Are you expecting this experience from this 5 star hotel?
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Depressing
text:
The first hour that I checked in I called to see if they could place me in another hotel. The atmosphere in my room was so unremarkable, so sparse in design that it was actually depressing to me . 
I was on a high floor with a balcony, which overlooked the courtyard, again a very unremarkable view .
The staff was very nice, and accommodating, and the cleanliness ok for the most part. The first day, I went to use the remote for  the television, and it was so disgustingly filthy, that I requested it to be cleaned or replaced as I went out that day . That evening I came back to a clean one.  The next day when I came back from being out all day there was no remote for the television and I had to wait for an hour and 2 phone calls to get another one. Only one elevator was working, which was annoying. The bed was very comfortable which was this hotels “ saving grace” as far as I’m concerned. 
I cannot in good consciousness give this hotel a good rating.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location BUT elevator out of order (ONLY 1 working)
text:
The location & staff are very helpful and professional. One of the elevators is OUT OF SERVICE which caused a headache. I was talking to another guest who said it's been OUT of service for months. This was unacceptable!!!!
 I also understand that this hotel is a franchise which explains why the elevator has been OUT OF service for months. Marriott owned properties are usually better managed which would have corrected the elevator issues months ago. The staff are the best!!!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Highly recommend
text: Quality hotel with high end amenities, excellent service, attentive staff, and great location. Only complaint is the single working elevator. Great views, ask for a room overlooking the street. Quieter than expected. Very comfortable bedding and bath amenities. Highly recommend
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location, great staff, a few rough edges
text: 1st time in Paris for vacation. We loved this location - within 2 mile walk of almost everything we wanted to do. Staff was friendly, helpful, multi-lingual (plenty of English speakers for us). The quirks - our room facing Wagram, had a curved glass facade on entire exterior wall that transferred tons of heat from the sun in the morning and overwhelmed the air-con (yet no noise transferred from street). Stand-up shower had only partial glass wall, leaving open area that always resulted in water on bathroom floor. One of elevators broken for several days, and hotel designed without service elevator for staff, so lots of waiting. No taxi stand nearby - kudos to the bellman who ran down the street and flagged a taxi for us to get to train station!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Amazing hospitality
text: It is rare that I would say that a chain hotel can have such a personable approach and touch. But Renaissance Arc de Triomphe has that something. But hotel is really people more than just a building. Let me recognize two very special gentlemen who made our stay very memorable - ( it was a celebration of my cousin and my birthdays, not to mention that it was my cousin and his wife's first time in Paris) - Joris at the welcome desk / reception and Youssef, the hospitality maestro. Not only both couples got  beautiful upgrades (granted, I am a Marriott Titanium member, but it is always good will of an employee that makes that happen), but Youssef went out of his way to make the suite b-day ready . And it was such a great surprise for our guests. So memorable. Joris made sure that we felt at home right from the moment we entered the hotel until we left . It was truly a great weekend all around -  Joris and Youssef, merci beaucoup pour vos efforts !
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: One of the few hotels that have family room
text:
Travel to Paris as a family of 4 is not easy, most hotel rooms can only take up to 3 guests despite the age.  We were lucky to have a family room at this very well-maintained hotel and with a convenient location.   

The service was also awesome.  The guest relation manager Marie went on and beyond to make my husband's birthday celebration memorable.  

Being a Marriott Elite member, we were offered daily breakfast for 4 for our 7-days stay.  I got to say, we were so impressed by their food.  I usually get tired from the breakfast buffet after a couple of days, at this location, I could totally do all 7!  The wide selection of food is surely a foodie's heaven.

The location is about 2 min. walking to the Arc de Triomphe.  There were also many restaurants and shops around.  

We don't mind staying at the same place next time we return to Paris.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great hotel, lacking in service
text: Room was great, clean but the service was non existent. I sat in the bar area with colleagues several times and every time not a single person asked me/us what we wanted, I went to the bar, was pretty much dismissed, not listening to what I wanted and nothing turned up, I had to go up 5 times for 1 coffee !! no apologies.  As I've seen in the other reviews too, very high deposit of €1000 for 2 nights !!  Only one lift still working (saw someone elses review from Feb saying only 1 working). Breakfast was very poor, hardly any choice, no menus - that I could see, no staff interested in taking any orders ?! Would not go back.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Absolutely not a 5* hotel……
text:
Myself & my partner stayed here over valentines as part of a corporate events package, this meant the hotel had 100+ guests for the same event & needless to say they just were not equipped. 

One out of two lifts were working so going up & down took absolutely ages & the lifts were crammed to capacity. Our room was a ‘Prestige’ one & it was basic to say the least, one tea bag, a couple of toiletries & the most awful quality slippers & robe. You can also hear everything upstairs & the kids running around in the hallway. 

Breakfast was shambolic, we did not eat anything ….because there was nothing there to eat! Pretty much everything had run out (including the water!) & we waited 1/2 hour for a pot of tea that didn’t arrive! Although breakfast was included in our rate we didn’t bother both mornings & went elsewhere. 

Lastly & most importantly the bar & bartender…was again shambolic. One man making & serving drinks who not only expected you to wait 20mins+ for a drink, he was super rude. He clearly fancied himself a comedian attempting to strike up loud conversations with all guests but actual was really rude & making an attempt to embarrass guests saying ‘No’ when people politely asked for a drink & asking really loud & inappropriate questions (including using the C-word & saying it was ok for guests to buy him drinks). He was a middle-aged man with short/bald hair & said he was Australian. He made us feel really uncomfortable (not to mention the incredibly slow service) & ruined the vibe, so we went elsewhere. 

The location is great but Paris has SO many beautiful locations this hotel is just not worth it. Unless you pay ££££ your room won’t have a view of any landmarks. We much preferred several other areas so if we were to return we wouldn’t choose this hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Mixed experience
text: Me and my boyfriend booked 3 nights through my dads staff discount, as he is a manager at a London Marriott hotel. At check in, they charged us the price of the entire stay as well as €100 a night deposit, which I thought was crazy, I’ve never known such a high deposit, especially with Marriott hotels. Nevertheless, I paid, showed proof of documents to show that my dad works at the Marriott and went to my room. The room was beautiful, I have no complaints. However, staff kept walking into our room numerous times, even without knocking, and even when we had the do not disturb sign on. One day, we had room service in the morning ( they cleaned the room, gave us new towels etc). Then we went out for dinner around 8pm, we came back at 11pm and they had been in our room, but didn’t give us new towels or change our sheets, they just made our bed and moved my bra from the floor to a chair. I’ve never known a hotel to do room service of a night time, I found it really strange. On another day we had room service in the morning, then about 4pm a staff member walked into our room saying we needed tea bags, when we didn’t. From the start it felt like the hotel staff thought my booking was fraudulent, whether it’s because we’re young and mixed race I’m not sure, but it felt like they kept coming into our room to make sure we weren’t doing anything suspicious. Despite paying upfront, when checking out the staff member was telling me I need to pay €300 deposit, which 1) I already paid and 2) why would I pay deposit when I’m leaving? It felt like he was trying to catch me out somehow. The location is amazing, and you’re right in the heart of the city, just a shame about  the staff.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: A great Parisian stay
text:
A superb hotel right in the heart of the city. Compared to all the other hotels I’ve stayed at in Paris, the Renaissance Arc de Triomphe is a cut above the rest. Our room was spacious, quiet, and extremely comfortable. Room service was excellent too! All the dishes we had were tres délicieux, especially the scallops and the cajun chicken. 
The staff were great too - everyone went above and beyond to ensure that we were enjoying our stay. Breakfast was excellent - plenty of hot and cold choices. However, I just wish coffee was readily available, rather than having to order from the wait staff. 

The hotel is situated in a prime location. Champs-Élysées is just a short walk away, other tourist attractions such as the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre are walkable too.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Good room ... excellent staff
text:
We booked this for a 6 days pleasure visit to Paris.

The location is great, a pleasant walk to the Arc de Triomphe with a good choice of restaurants and shops in vicinity.

Our room was on the top floor and featured a little balcony. We wish we would have had a view to the Arc or the Eiffel Tower but were told that the balconies all face the other side. The upside was a very quiet and relaxing area. 

The room was of great size but I missed international plugs.

What stood out for me in this property was the staff; every time we passed by the Reception we got a row of smiles and Bonjour. Very nice! Also, the restaurant staff were amazing; we felt very much at home the 2nd morning already.

And yes, we absolutely loved the Bulgari toilet accessories which the staff provided one day ... I need more of those!!!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Still my favorite hotel in Paris
text: Great location, great room design, clean and most of all GREAT STAFF!  I've stayed in 3 hotels in Paris on this trip thinking I may find a better hotel than this hotel.  I ended up booking at this hotel for my last few nights of stay since I feel most comfortable here.  Next time, not trying out other hotels and am sticking with this.  :)
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Never again at this one. For tourists if you read this Better choose a hotel for 100 euro this is not 5*hotel. They don't give a
text: I was at the hotel between 24/09-26/09 we booked through booking and never again will book this hotel and never again will. Use booking as well. Hotel should be 5***** but actually it's more like 2 and half or 3***, no balconys, no roof top with bar Nothing. We should go and ask on reception on this 5* hotel someone to come and change our towels and the worse it's the next. 5 days after I did the check out and calling at the hotel many times and calling booking as well many times, hotel manager still don't want to move his ass and send me the invoice for my stay. This is kind of very very poor experience paying 720 euro for 2 nights and they even don't provide you a Invoice. After many times speaking with booking they said that contact a person/manager  from a Hotel called  Brouillaud and he or she promised that will send the invoice few days ago and still Nothing.    MR./MS. BROUILLAUD  you are there to give great service for the clients not to make them look like idiots I wrote you a private message on your email and still no answer for my invoice. Pay attention my roon was 204 ask your colleagues from reception for my details and prepare me the Invoice
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Perfect Location, Big Room!
text: I was surprised at how big the rooms were, we had stayed at another Marriott property in Paris a few year prior and the rooms seemed much smaller. There were 3 of us in one room with no space issues. We had a beautiful city view of all the gorgeous historic buildings. Very quiet, concierge checked in with us to see how we were doing. They had wonderful recommendations for restaurants and got us a last minute private tour of the Eiffel Tower because everything was sold out.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great Hotel
text: My daughter and I stayed at this hotel for six nights in March of 2020. Great staff. Great location. We enjoyed the great breakfast buffet each morning. There are numerous restaurants in the area. The metro stop and the bus stop are both located near this hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: VERY disappointed
text:
We picked this hotel because our son  is Titanium Elite and rest of us are all Gold Elite. 

We paid more to stay at Marriot than we would have at a hotel with full view of Eiffel Tower just because everyone had status with Marriot. That’s our first mistake...  

Let me preface that When we checked in, the front desk was very nice and we were all very tired.  But apparently our expectations were over the top too.  

As you know from my previous reviews, I am generous with my stars especially when it comes to customer service .., that is everything to me !! I will stay in a inferior place if the customer service is off the chart !!

We asked for a roll away bed in one room because our grown kids would rather have separate beds ..  that will be 30 Euro per night ?!?  

Then we asked do you have a room with 2 beds then?  
Keep in mind that rooms are 350 a night ..  she said yes we do, that will be another 40 euro per night ....  so now our room is 390 euro per night for a 2nd bed. 

Got our rooms ... views of a parking lot and views of the street.  Keep in mind that we used 2 suite upgrades on the reservation which got us nothing. 

We asked for an upgrade possibly.., knowing it’s not guaranteed, but also knowing that the hotel usage and cancellation is down dramatically currently with COVID 19 issue going on and we have relatives that work for The chain that can see occupancy.  Nothing ...

How about lounge access ?  No sorry , not available for titanium elite 

How about a free roll away bed ? Sorry no, those are no longer included 

And to top it off, no USB stations for charging .  

We stayed In a 90 year old hotel yesterday outside of Paris that had USB chargers in the room .... 

Ugh, we plan to check out tomorrow and find a hotel with a view ... 

4 people ALL so very disappointed !!  Why bother working so hard to build up status if it just does not matter ....
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Quite good,but...
text:
Overall nice hotel in great location close to Arc dT and many other attractions. Reception and concierge very friendly and helpful. Rooms nice and clean.
Only one annoying thing....  aggressive waiters almost jump on  you to sign for breakfast before you even sit down. one wanted me to sign whilst i was pouring juice at the buffet. He said in quite aggressive tone “ it’s not for free...” without that i would hv given much higher rating
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Beautiful and modern
text: A gorgeous hotel ! The rooms very clean and modern ! Our balcony was huge and it overlooked the garden! The staff was very friendly and helpful! Definately world class service and I will definately come back to stay!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Fantastic view and Incredible Staff
text:
We stayed at the Renaissance Arc De Triumph in Paris recently as we toured Paris. I am Rayo g this property 5 Plus stars for many reasons:

Front desk Staff - The staff was knowledgeable , hospitable, professional. When we checked in the staff gave us the full overview of hotel and our room “ which was a balcony view that showed the Eiffel Tower and Arc De Triumph! Maria the manager gave us a full tour of room and hotel also informing us that our mini bar ... breakfast , and room service was all included “ this may be due to Ambassador Elite status so just FYI”

Our concierge Jonathan took care of all of our needs quickly and . He even got us Leonardo di Vinci tickets regardless of them being sold out.  If I needed anything i would email him and his response time was under 5 minutes. All other conscience personnel were also very informative with dinner recommendations among other questions we had.

The breakfast staff was amazing and very attentive and really took care of us. Every morning we started the day with spectacular service. Hats off to the staff here .

I also want to send a special thank you to Ines who upon checkout provided a very nice gift to my wife which made our day. 

The cleaning staff had our room made up fast and they kept our needs met above expectations.

Thanks to all employees  at this Awesome hotel and hats off to all the staff  for a great and wonderful stay.

Mr Castillo
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Very nice hotel!
text:
Fast check in, staff was very friendly and helpful. Vallet parking good. 
Room clean and comfortable. Great location. Good restaurants and cafes close to hotel. Close to metro station. I really recommend this hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: negligence
text:
I have been in this hotel 4
Days in the last month !! The room need to be fixed!! Door handle of the bathroom door is broken and when do you try do open it’s cone in your hands !! The toilet seat is loose !! Every day the housekeeping get in the room and nobody fix it !! It’s unacceptable this kind the service in this category of hotel !!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Business Travelers Think Twice
text: The location and room at this hotel were both really great and the staff were courteous and helpful. If you're a tourist that won't be sticking around the hotel then it could be a good choice. However, business travelers might think twice. Internet was a total disaster. I even had techs come to my room to trouble-shoot, yet the service dropped every few minutes at best. It absolutely was not functional from a productivity standpoint. Also, my food experience in the hotel was remarkably bad. At breakfast I just wanted two poached eggs - they said no problem but then I got a plain egg omelet and the girl looked at me as if I had two heads when I questioned it. I had lunch from the bar menu (basically the same as the extremely limited room service menu) and the sandwich was really bad, served with a "salad" that was just lettuce and vinegar (after they served me the wrong fries and had to correct with the salad). For a higher end Marriott property I was really disappointed. As a side note - I was really surprised with the high use of unnecessary plastic - including plastic stickers on the toilet paper to close the leading edge. Silly.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Good location but service needs upgrading
text:
Overall first time stay at this hotel 

I usually like to stay at the marriot on the Champs Elysees but they were fully booked , overall for Paris , rooms are comfortable , but in my marriot card preferences it states I like a queen or king bed and high floors , I was given 2 double beds and on the 1st floor so not exactly happy about this , when I asked for toothbrushes the 1st evening it took 45 mins to get to my room and 2nd day when ordered water and toiletries, I waited 1.5 hours and still didn’t get it and since I had a flight to catch , never got them , their breakfast spread could use a improvement
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Avoid
text:
It’s definitely not the worst hotel but for the price and rating one would expect a much better hotel & experience. 
As a disclaimer, I’m top tier with Marriott, so a lot of this is based on experiences I get at other Marriott properties here in Paris. 

Rooms:

If you’re a top tier and expecting an upgrade... well you might get  “upgraded” but if you want a real upgrade be ready to beg for it but in this case, it was not something I was going to do. With over 140 nights/yr, I felt that it wasn’t worth for me to keep asking for a suite or a view (although I was promised during check-in) if they didn’t give it to me on their own, although the app is showing plenty of availability. 

WiFi 
Unfortunately not reliable at all. I’m having to use my phone’s hotspot to get my laptop connected to corporate.

Breakfast 
I got free breakfast and to be honest it doesn’t compare to any similarly rated Marriott property in Paris.

Location
Excellent location especially if you have been to the city before.

Gym
It’s pretty good. When I went, I was the only one so I truly enjoyed it. 

Business center 
It’s not a center, it’s a desk in the hallway. 

Staff 

It sort of goes with the whole room experience. They do smile a lot so I would give them that but not much more. After checking-in the upgrade story changed, and no justification was provided. They called me the next day and wanted to explain more but I was busy and didn’t want to deal with that (no need to beg). 
At breakfast, used plates sat there for over 20 minutes while I was on a call and were still there when I left. Room wasn’t cleaned, they tried to come in once around 3pm when I was back in the room... 30 minutes later, I told the front desk to have it cleaned, but of course it didn’t get cleaned that day.

All in all, not super impressed. Room is comfortable, location is good but don’t expect more.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location but Loyal no more!
text: So, let me start with the pros!  It is the best location!   You can see the Arc from the street in front of the hotel!   The hotel staff are all lovely! They aim to please, speak great English and will take care of your every need within their power!   Within their power is key!   Our trip started off badly when we were ripped off by a cabbie (in the cab line at Gare du Nord, they must be working in cahoots so be aware!) Don’t get in a cab unless the meter is running or better yet, use uber, not a cab.... much much cheaper and we found the Berline Uber to be superb and less costly!  So back to Renaissance... I am a Gold Bonvoy due to SPG Marriott Merger and it sucks!   No upgrades, no breakfast, nothing!   It was my mom’s 80th birthday and she had never been to Europe, wanted to make it special and simply got no view or upgrade and instead, 4 free glasses of wine at the bar ,,,,we had just left a fabulous stay in Trafalgar St. James London at a Curio with macaroons, balloons, etc so the rough towels, no make up table, free mini bar, no breakfast or rooftop view and no internet with hotel rates 3x higher was disappointing and I will be only staying at Hilton after this trip 😩.  Now, this hotel was perfectly situated, great location to everything but it was very expensive (the most of any of the 4 hotels in our 13 day trip) and I had to buy breakfast and wine and used all of my data because the wifi was sooooooooo bad!  In summary, PROS:   Great location, free water, no thefts and great staff, Edward at the bar and the concierge Tiago, Jean and the rest were all fabulous.  The room was okay but is dated and could use a renovation.   CONS:  no executive lounge or Bonvoy upgrades, lousy towels and shower, lousy wi-fi if it even works, beds are small and lumpy (we had 2 queens for 3 people), no breakfast and a piece of chocolate to recognize Bonvoy status!  This is not a 4 star hotel!   I don’t even think my mom was wished a happy birthday, who is also a Bonvoy member.  Maybe it is just Paris but we won’t be back!  If you don’t care about breakfast, internet or the towels and shower, it is a good hotel because of the nice, knowledgeable staff and great location!   Oh it does have a nepresso machine and safe in the room which was a plus!   I can’t compare to another Paris hotel and perhaps they all lack the 5 star quality and perks I have come to expect by being loyal....but loyal no more!  Hilton here I come!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location
text: Hotel has a great location you are able to walk or scooter to most points of interest. Rooms are spacious for Europe have smart TVs and Ethernet hookup for laptops. Edward at the bar/restaurant was very friendly and knowledgeable about the area. My only complaints are the internet connection was spotty at times and the gym was small. All in all a great stay and for the majority of people coming here for leisure the small issues I had wouldn’t be a problem.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great New year eve  fireworks view
text: Paris sky view room is spacious with a perfect view of new year Fireworks over arc de triomphe. Unfortunately, the illumination was on the other side of arc de triomphe and not visible from the room. Minibar also included for the stay with decent drink selections.  Breakfast buffet was excellent.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Christmas vacation
text: In general the location of the hotel is great, close to the Arc as well Champs-Élysées. Also it is close to a train station (train strike was going on, so can’t comment on train service). A grocery store is about 10 min walk. There are some restaurants nearby within walking distance. The hotel amenities are great. Room was clean and spacious, we have a toddler and luggage so space is always important, and staff are very friendly. However the room service wasn’t great at all, twice we ordered in and we were disappointed.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Not what was expected
text:
The hotel is in a great location, however visiting during the holidays left me lacking. 

I book this hotel months (almost a year) in advance of the New Year's rush so that I could be in a great location and have an awesome street view. However, upon my arrival I was placed in the last room on the floor away from the Arc. In spite of my request months in advance! Next I also had a hold place on my card, dispite having paid for my room in full (they did not charge for upgrade until check out). The numerous times I have visited Paris I have never had such a thing happen.

The room was just ok, clearly cleaning staff don't look behind the curtains due to a toy that was left from previous occupant (if you open the curtains it would have been visible). The bed was not soft or comfortable all, definitely not what I would expect from the Renaissance brand. 

Lastly, inspite of not getting the room I requested, having a safe that did not work, a sub cleaned room. I asked for euro conversion to tip staff and taxi ride. Front desk staff of hotel was going to charge a 10% conversion rate on the exchange. Considering I'm a guest and am already paying prime rate for my stay and not even breakfast was included in the price. I find that just added insult to injury.

Again, a great hotel location. However I won't be recommending a stay there during major holidays. It seems there focused is nothing more then about profits and not the guests.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Excellent Location and Service
text: This is a lovely hotel in a great location with a top notch staff. We arrived very early from the United States and only one suite was ready. Since we were tired they did their best to give my friends an alternate room. It tuned out to be near the elevator and very noisy. When we told them they were able to move my friends to the original room without issue. We had a suite with a spectacular view of the arc and Eiffel Tower. The suite was large and clean. As with all Renaissance brand hotels the decor is very modern. Room service was very efficient and nice. I would not hesitate to stay here again.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Good service and great location
text: I booked this hotel way in advance with my points and upon arrival had to pay a little extra for the terrace with a view of both the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. Because of the previous guest suddenly deciding to have a late departure I was allowed to stay in a temporary room until this room was ready and given 2 complementary beverages at the hotel lounge and restaurant. I am here for New Year’s and wanted to have a great view of the fireworks.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Top notch hotel and staff!
text:
We just completed a stay here and it was as close to perfect as can be.  The staff was amazing beginning with Emma at the front desk.  I am a Titanium Elite with Marriott and this was of the best stays I’ve had all year.  The hotel is in a very convenient location and well kept.

We stayed in a room that had a balcony and overlooked the Arc de Triomphe.  Well worth the upgrade!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Perfect
text: Wonderful boutique hotel with amenities that are just superb. Our room was immaculate and the room service was wonderful. We did site see quite a lot and will definitely be returning to this fabulous hotel.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Excellent property, excellent location, excellent breakfast, large size rooms.  Exceptional concierge staff.
text: Excellent property (clean, new, and well maintained), excellent location (walking distance to prime shopping, restaurants, Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, subways, etc.).  Great breakfast (has fresh prawn and real fresh squeezed juice, etc).  Spacious rooms by Paris standards vs other properties.  But by far the biggest standout is the super professional, knowledgeable and helpful concierge staff, especially Annelyse.  As a business traveler, I stay 50+ nights across multiple properties/countries every year (including staying at 5 different Marriott properties in my recent EU  trip), and it’s a high bar, but this hotel has some of the best concierge staff I’ve met over the years.  Would actually stay here just for that.  Made navigating the chaos in Paris with all the transportation strikes/protests extremely easy.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Rare Gem in the Best Area of Paris!!
text:
I had the pleasure of staying at this Renaissance "Arc de Triomphe" for five nights during my time in Paris. The moment you walk in the lobby you are made to feel at home. Their lobby is cute with beautiful holiday decorations, and each staff member greets you with a friendly "bonjour" each time you walk by.

The hotel was great for numerous reasons.

1. Rooms: Their rooms are WONDERFUL. They have all the amenities one would like in a room; cushy beds/pillows, nice city views, and a fantastic waterfall shower head that really helps you get over your jet lag. Their finishing touches with modern designs, beautiful dark wood, flat screen tv (that connects to the internet), and wonderful views of the skyline really make it a standout room.

2. Unique Moments: They take special occasions into consideration. I had surprised my mom with a special "once in a lifetime" trip to Paris, that I'm sure will not happen again or for a very long time. I had asked them to give me a nice room with a view if possible to make it more memorable for her. Marie, who runs guest relations, was able to accommodate my request and gave me a very lovely room on the top floor with a view of the city and a balcony. She even personally stopped by my room to ensure I was having a good time, and to welcome me to her city. She was incredibly friendly, charming, and made sure I felt "at home." That type of service you don't get anywhere else. It was touching and truly brought my time there to a whole new level!

3. Employees: The rest of their staff are FANTASTIC, and extremely attentive to your needs. Every interaction I had with them I was treated with the utmost respect and care. A few members of their team definitely stood out, specifically Marie, Thiago, Fabio, and Julian. We also had a very friendly engineer come to our room whose name I didn't catch, and the GM Solveig was very welcoming as well. All were a pleasure to speak with, and made sure I had everything during my stay that I would need. They understand what it means to listen to your customers and give them exactly what they need! You can tell they have a passion for what they do, and are happy to help you enjoy your vacation. 

4. Cleanliness: The rooms were extremely well kept as the maids come 2x a day to do cleaning and an evening service. Each time I would return to my room it was thoughtfully cleaned and restocked with all necessities. This really spoiled me and made me wish that all hotels took that much care and attention with their rooms.

5. Neighborhood: The hotel is located on a fantastic street (Wagram) with a many places to grab a drink and delicious food spots. Many nights all we needed was within a 5 minute walk from the hotel. The Champs-Elysees is right around the corner, and other sights are just a short ride away. They also have 2 metro lines both within a few minutes walk from the hotel to take you to all other areas of interest.

Overall, I would not hesitate to stay here the next time I am in town. Their special touches, thoughtful staff, and pristine rooms make it an unforgettable stay where the staff felt like family.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Very nice place and people all happy with big smiles
text: Had business meetings in the La Defense and had stayed at this hotel in 2007 (hey, only reference point) so booked it via Concur.  Needed early check in so made that request (not guaranteed) via the Marriott web site.  Happy that on arrival at 10:00 AM a room was available and I had an upgrade!  Hotel room was good size, separate toilet area and nicely laid out.  Didn't spend much time in the room.  Only negative comment is the shower had that UK typical glass flap hinged at the shower head wall and so water control takes extra care.  Ate at the restaurant that was #1 rated in the area, it was good and very good service and used the club lounge also very good service.  Everyone I saw was very happy and would go back again for business.  Only comment is this area is very business oriented and seemed to be cater to the employees who came in for work via the train (right under the hotel) and back home after work.  Surprising limited selections for food and nightlife except the one medium size mall next door.  For families only to get in and out.  Not for wandering around and having a cup of coffee at a French cafe.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: A must
text: Traveling regularly for business and having many choices, this Marriott property did not fail.  Every interaction was pleasant and everyone went above and beyond.  Specifically Marie Le Roux was EXCEPTIONAL.  In addition,  great location, beautiful hotel and clean.  I would certainly recommend for your next trip in Paris.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: A Paris Gem
text: The stay at this hotel was an absolute pleasure.  Not only is the property clean, well located and welcoming the staff was exceptional.  Marie Le Roux, Guest Relation Supervisor, went above and beyond her role.  She deserves this title and more.  The most beautiful person inside and out. She made me feel like a princess and I would certainly return!  Thank you and I hope to return to the Gem in Paris.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Exquisite find in Paris
text: What an outstanding hotel just steps from the Arc de Triomphe. Great restaurants within walking distance. Extremely close to several metro lines. Fantastic customer service all around. The workout room is quite impressive… A rower, spin bike, ellipticals and treadmills. They even have kettle bells and a wide range  of free weights. The hotel fitness center provides Evian bottled water. I normally stay closer to the third district. This may be my new go-to for future visits in Paris!!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Delightful stay
text:
We stayed in the hotel for 6 nights in November. The location is great. Location is near the Arc de Triomphe plus very convenient for using the Metro. The Navigator staff was very helpful particularly Tiago.

Regret was eating breakfast at the hotel. Food was fine. Would have been better to visit other restaurants in the area.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Nice stay near the Arc de Triomphe
text:
This is a lovely hotel in a nice residential neighborhood 4 blocks north of the Arc and a short walk to major metro lines. The gorgeous Parc Monceau is close by. Our upgraded room was larger than most in Paris, comfortable with a new, modern bathroom. Breakfast buffet was fine with fresh pastries fresh fruit and delicious baguettes. Not much of a business center, but it's not that kind of hotel.The gym was well furnished.
Only one serious problem. On our last day in Paris we left for the day at 9:30 am, returned at 7 pm and our room had still not yet been touched, much less serviced. We waited in the lobby for 40 minutes while it was being cleaned. The concierge explained some staff was unable to get to the hotel by public transportation that day because of shutdowns in expectation of protests. Hard to complain when we were staying on an award, but it delayed our plans for the evening. On the other hand, at my request the evening desk clerk left a message for the Monday day manager. She apologized and provided us with 12,000 Bonvoy points for our troubles Sunday night.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Service Excellence and friendly warm hospitality in the Heart of Paris
text: My husband and I recently stayed at this hotel for the second time in just under two years. We chose to stay here again as we were happy with our previous overall experience of this hotel and its incredible location. Our trip to this stunning city was made even more memorable on this trip by the highly customer service focused staff who really made us feel incredibly welcome and truly it felt like home away from home. My personal feel of this hotel on the whole is that they really try their best with true sincerity and pride to ensure that you the guest enjoy both the stunning city of Paris and their hotel and to feel as comfortable as possible. From the staff at the concierge desk who were so helpful in making suggestions of places to see or advise on directions and which transport to use and will even make a dinner reservation for you at a recommended restaurant, they really were so friendly and really do want you to enjoy your time in Paris be it for business or leisure. The breakfast buffet offers a variety of delicious options! The breakfast team of staff are also the most warm welcoming group of people and really made the start to our day! Alex, Jean Louis and Sami , you guys greeted everyone every morning with your warmth and friendliness and always making sure every guest was taken care of during breakfast and even asked guests if they were enjoying their time in Paris. The rooms at this hotel are extremely well maintained, very comfortable and well equipped. I believe there is always going to be something that one does come across that they may not be happy with but my experience with this hotel is that they really do listen to the guest if there is any problems that may arise and for me what is the most important is how it is handled. This hotel is highly professional, the staff really and truly have the guest first and foremost as their no one priority and will definitely try their very best to ensure that you have the most memorable trip of Paris. Thank you to Marie - guest services manager, you and the entire team definitely made our time in Paris memorable. If you are looking for that hotel with that something special, the warm hospitality, sincerity towards the guest and that hotel that tries to go that extra mile for you, I highly recommend this wonderful establishment....and did I mention its amazing location too!!!!! Just steps away from the Champs Elysees and Arc de Triomphe. Thanks to you all for our wonderful stay, sending you all our best regards from Judy and Gavin in South Africa
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Beautiful hotel, excellent customer service
text: My 10 year old daughter and I went to Paris on vacation.  We stayed at this hotel and I have to say I was very impressed.  The rooms were very clean (I’m quite picky) and the staff was attentive and friendly. The front desk was one of the best as far as customer service that I have ever encountered.  They did many things to accommodate us.  I would absolutely stay at this hotel again and refer friends to stay here.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Disappointed Again
text:
This was our second visit to this hotel and hence my second review. We stayed in this hotel for 6 nights about 3 years back during our marriage anniversary and had a mixed feeling – while we were satisfied with the room quality and location, we felt that service was below what one would expect from a true 5-star property.

We wanted to give another chance this time and booked a Junior Suite for a 3-night stay. I also wrote to the hotel about our preference about a city-facing suit well in advance. We reached the hotel a bit late in the evening. Upon reaching our room on the 5th floor, we realized that we were given a room facing the rear side of the property – facing not-so-good-looking structures, plant room of a neighbouring property and certainly not what we were expecting. The room, although having a cramped balcony, was not how a junior suite would look like. It was at a corner of the wing, oblique shaped, a small sofa placed just outside of the entry of the washroom. Next morning, we realized that there was not ample day light even if we ignore the unpleasant view. In our previous trip, we stayed in an architectural room with full-length glass on one side, enabling pleasant city view with ample sun light.

Immediately upon checking in, I called up the front desk about changing our room to a city facing one and the lady replied back saying that there was no other suite available and she would try the following day. Later we discovered that the washroom was not cleaned properly and the light placed inside the cupboard did not go off as it was directly facing our face while lying down for sleep. Immediately, I wrote to the hotel and informed them about the inconvenience and requested to change the room. Next morning, the manager approached and tried to allay my concern about the room being a proper junior suite and due to full occupancy, they were unable to change etc etc, assuring that the other issues would be addressed on priority. On our return to our room that evening, we noticed that the light fixture was not repaired. We were tired and decided to put up a towel between the cupboard doors, blocking the light somehow.

Next morning, again I checked with the front desk if they could arrange a change of room and requested if they could at least arrange an architectural room (a downgrade from Junior suite). In reply, I was told that there was one room available and they just gave it to someone who checked in early that morning. It was clearly evident that all they were telling me since checking in were merely lip service. We really became sick and tired of checking with them about the room and gave up finally.

Now if this was not all, there were comedy of errors in the service. One late evening, we asked the house keeping to help us open a wine bottle. One staff came, took the bottle and didn’t appear for a good 40-45 minutes. We again called up the housekeeping and one lady came with a cork opener. I was amused and explained to her that her colleague took a bottle and if she could check if the same can be opened and given back. After waiting for half an hour, I gave up and went to sleep.

Amidst all these disappointments, I must say that the staff at the breakfast were amazing and helped us during more than one occasion on taking customized orders, while putting up smiling faces. In comparison to our last trip, this was a pleasant change and we truly appreciate.

Overall, the location is all this hotel offers. The rooms are showing signs of wear and looked jaded as compared to our last visit or could be it was the room where we stayed. After spending top dollars for a junior suite, the experience has left us wondering whether it was worth staying there for a second time. It was disappointing no doubt but it also took a lot of time to fix issues that one would not expect in a five-star hotel. Given our past experience in the likes of Paris Shangri-la, I strongly feel that a couple of hundred dollars extra would be worth paying if one wants to enjoy a true five-star experience.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great Hotel lousy service
text:
I recently went to watch how to be a Parisian in an hour. This typifies this hotel as they just cannot get room service right. 

First morning they missed 3 items off the order, by the time they got them back to us  (22 minutes) the rest of the breakfast was cold, so we eat what we could. 

The Guest Services Supervisor (Mary) asked what I need to fix it, which is unbelievable as they are the ones that should be saying how they will fix it. As a nice touch we got a small bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries in the evening which made us forget the issue...

Next morning, breakfast is ordered, when delivered it is delivered on a tray with nowhere to put the tray, but the floor. I felt sorry for the girl who was given this task to deliver as the hotel doesn’t know it’s rooms. 
Asking for a trolley to eat breakfast meant that the breakfast would again be cold so, he we go again. 
To add to the disappointment they ran out of orange marmalade (specific request as it was delightful the day before to eat cold toast). The guest services manager (Guillaume) called and said it will be corrected. Approx 25 minutes after the initial mistake we got the breakfast on a trolley with Guillaume delivering along with the lovely girl.

All is OK, but for the second day no plates to butter the toast but I guess that also is to much to ask for a four star hotel.

The management just don’t care as they only work weekdays and the issues guest have are not known to management and thus not fixed.

I wish Marriott cared enough to publish an area on the website so complaints could be shared, and maybe problems are fixed or exposing the fact management see they are far to important to work weekends.

I am only a Gold Bonvoy member but if this continues I will have no status and they have lost another customer. Marriott management should go to see ‘How to be a Parisian on one hour’ as this is so apt...

Not a great experience but a lovely hotel and location...

John
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Some problems
text: While it's really close to the heart of Paris, there are some things about this hotel that really grate on me.  My room was very good, with a bay window, and the usual amenities of supposedly a top notch hotel.  The downside of my room was that if I used the loo and flushed it, the flush lasted forever and kept me awake at night, although I did say to one of my colleagues it sounded like a waterfull and wasn't particularly eco-friendly. One criticism I'd make, but this applies to very many hotels I've visited, is that if you are trying to work using a PC and a "pointing device", the mice don't work on glass surfaces. Also, it took a while before you could figure out where to charge stuff. I discovered it. The staff were extremely friendly, apart from one barman who was decidedly snotty. I was so taken by surprise that I didn't have a riposte until I thought of one the morning after.  The rather expensive breakfast leaves much to be desired, although, again, the service was extremely efficient. It's not often I write negative reviews about hotels, but I think my score of "average" is quite generous, really.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: C'est très magnifique!!!
text:
If you are looking for a fabulous hotel with amazing and caring staff, please look no further than Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel.  This boutique hotel is stunning, clean, and the Marriott family there is extremely warm and friendly.  They went above and beyond for my husband and me.  Marie Le Roux, Tiago, and Rachida took the time to listen about what we were looking for regarding our experience and followed through with flying colors.  Our room was upgraded, the food was fresh and delicious, and we had a fun and romantic Parisian experience.  I loved this hotel and staff so much that I will be returning this summer.

I recommend very highly, and I have stayed at many hotels around the world.

Best,
Jen & Scott Shuster
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location but found the staff to be lacking
text:
We cashed in Marriott points for a three night stay and booked this hotel based on the Tripadvisor reviews.

We arrived early in the morning and had a great check-in experience with Laura who gave us a welcome gift and had us seated in the dining room with complimentary coffee and pastries as we waited for the room to be ready.  Once we were settled in we left to see some sites and the concierge desk desk booked and printed admission tickets for us which was helpful.

However with the staff change after that morning we were quite unhappy with the service.  The reception and concierge staff became quite indifferent to helping us.  They consistently push only one local restaurant for dinner which is very good but a bit expensive.  When we asked for information to help us navigate points of interest for us we were given very vague answers.  There appeared to be an attitude of relying on your phone to navigate for you which is not possible if you do not have outside internet access. The concierge desk supplies promotional maps of Paris produced by a department store and are difficult to use. It can be quite frustrating.

The hotel does have a great location near sites and transportation.  Our room was comfortable with a nice small terrace.  There is nightly turndown service.

Though we are Marriott Platinum Elite we were not offered free breakfast service so had breakfast each day at a Starbucks less than a block away.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Excellent place to stay in Paris
text: Excellent hotel and service. Baptiste at the hotel check-in was so great- we were given an upgrade.  The hotel is very well managed and food, service and ambience is all great. Not to mention the hotel is in a very good location close to the arc and Champs-Elysees with access to shopping and tons of great restaurants. Our stay here was very comfortable and made our trip to Paris even more enjoyable.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Awesome Experience
text:
I stayed at this hotel in October 2019. The staff is exceptional. We were treated warmly by everyone all day every day.  
Pro’s
The room was tasteful, spacious and had had every needed amenity. 
The location is in walking distance to many main tourist landmarks and lots of great restaurants. 
Breakfast, while French in nature, is more than adequate for the American pallet. 
Service was always good and Drinks at the bar are done well. 
Con’s 
None for me!  I will stay at this hotel again and again!  

You can ride the bus from the airport for about 17 Euros per person. The hotel can arrange tours, private transport from the airport,  and the train is close and very convenient.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Perfect Hotel in Best Location
text: The stay here was everything and the staff was absolutely superb. Very welcoming, accommodating, knowledgeable, and professional. Our room was ready for check in when we arrived at 7:00am, which was really great because we were exhausted from the flight. The bell man came out right away to get our luggage and had it in the room before we even got to the room. Location was the best....Starbucks a couple of steps away, Arc de Triomphe about 5 minutes away, shopping and great restaurants everywhere. The room was clean and very spacious (for Paris). The complimentary bottle of champagne was a nice touch. We stayed on the 8th floor in room 810 and our view of the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe was amazing and beautiful. We ate at Cesars which was right across the street and at Le Hide (reservation required) and both of these places were awesome and the food was so delicious. The hotel staff arranged our transportation back to the airport and that was helpful and very much appreciated. I would definitely recommend this hotel and will be staying here for sure when we return. Thanks Marriot for an amazing stay.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great Stay in Paris, Hotel in Good Location
text: Stayed here three nights in October.  I thought this hotel was very comfortable and the location was convenient for being able to walk through Paris or for getting on the metro.  The staff was very pleasant as well.  My only gripe would be about the shower in the bathroom.  Not a huge issue, but the shower is a tub with high edges and then it has one of these half glass doors that only covers part of the tub.  So any shower taken equates to flooding of the actual bathroom floor.  I've never understood this design!!  But anyway.. this is a solid hotel to stay at in Paris.  Think they do a good job keeping the rooms clean and providing accommodation to travelers.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Perfect Place to Stay in Paris
text: We spent 8 wonderful nights at the Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe and we absolutely loved it. The service in every aspect was impeccable. We felt that everyone was genuinely glad to have us stay there and all of the staff was so friendly. Our room was nice, modern and large. And the very best thing was the location. There were many great restaurants near the hotel, it is right next to great shopping on the Champs Elysees, and within very short walking distance to two metro stops with direct lines to many of the attractions we wanted to go to (Louvre, Eiffel Tower, etc) and with only a few stops in between.  Our only negative is that we only had 8 nights. We will be back in the near future though.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great place in Paris!
text:
Location:  can see the Arc from the entrance and metro stops within 5 minutes in both directions for multiple lines!
Rooms:  great with a high end bathroom and Nespresso machine.
Concierge:  Tiago made this trip amazing.  He helped with tickets, restaurant suggestions and reservations, directions to attractions, and set up airport transportation.   He's fantastic!!!!!
Breakfast:  great buffet to start the day off.
Would stay here again.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Location, Location, Location
text:
No doubt location is one of the best things about this hotel; the other being a North American hotel chain that caters to Anglophones in the heart of Paris. Merci beaucoup! Literally down the road from the amazing Arc de Triomphe, as well as the metro, if you head in the other direction, you’ll come across many neighborhood shops and a lovely little market. 

The rooms are large enough by European standards, even if the decor is a little underwhelming. However the bathroom was delightfully spacious and well stocked with amenities. We were part of a tour group so a full breakfast was included in our rate and had a good offering of items. The croissants continually tasted like MORE! Actually, the entire bakery selection was amazing. Good job!

It’s not cheap, but was a quiet and comfortable place to return at the end of every busy day in the ever beautiful City of Light.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Stunning hotel, great location, modern room
text: Really friendly staff. Location is brilliant. Room is modern & luxurious. If you are a Marriott collector this is a great option. It is far superior to the Marriott in opera and a similar price point. The bar is cool too And has a nice energy.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great hotel, great location
text: Great hotel and easy walk to the Charles de Gaulle stop on the underground. Baptiste at the front desk was very helpful and friendly... actually the whole staff was friendly!  Left my car keys and cash in the safe and the concierge team arranged to ship them to me overnight by the next morning. Breakfast was yummy too!  Room was clean and updated.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location to explore Paris
text: We have stayed here twice.  Both times have been great.  The location is between 2 Metro stops, so you can easily access trains.  There are a number of shops and restaurants in the area.  Also, you are just blocks from the Arc and Champs d Lyse.  We will definitely continue this as our home base when we are in Paris.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great experience
text: Beautyful hotel, well located. Great breakfast and confortable rooms. I've been twice for work and enjoying with my wife. I'll visit it again. Walking distance to the Arc, Champ Elysees and good restaurants.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Made Our Parisian Trip Even Better
text:
My wife, 7 year old son and I stayed here from 09/19/19 to 09/22/19.  We absolutely loved the city and our trip was accented perfectly with our stay at this hotel.  The Renaissance Arc de Triomphe took time to make our stay memorable, so I believe that I should also take time out to give them a great review.

As we arrived at the hotel, which was at 10 AM local time, Chloe was greeting us literally as we stepped out of our car service vehicle.  As we checked in, there was a small wait for them to prepare our room, which at that early of a check in, should be expected.  But Chloe made our wait relaxing with some hot chocolate, coffee, water and a nice children's play kit to keep our 7 year old entertained.  Before we knew it, our room was ready and our luggage delivered up.

We had read reviews that many people with high Bonvoy status received upgraded rooms.  Even though both my wife and I are Titanium members each, we wanted to play it safe and use our suite upgrades.  We were upgraded to a Junior suite with a King and this was perfect size for us.  I have to admit I was quite surprised with the size of the room.  Much larger than you would find in any other European hotels.  The room itself was clean, well decorated and modern.  We felt very comfortable during our stay there.  The toiletries were Bulgari products, which makes you feel like you're at a spa.  And to top it off, there is a full size Iron and Ironing board.  The iron is the kind you find at all US hotels, ones where you can add water and use it as a steamer.  I've been to several hotels in Europe, and this is the first one ever that I've seen that provides them in each room.  For my family, that is a HUGE plus for the hotel.  

Also being Titanium members, we are accustomed to properties with Concierge lounges.  While they do not have a lounge here, it is because they look to maximize the space in the rooms and other amenities in the hotel.  But no worry because they did offer full complimentary breakfast buffet for all three of us, each day. And the offerings on the buffet were great.  Even if you are paying for the buffet, the cost is a good deal considering everything that is on the menu.  You could easily spend much more at any restaurant on the same block, for half of the offerings.

The next thing that is important to note is the location.  There are so many reviews that past guest have mentioned how great the location is.  They were not kidding at all.  This really is the perfect location.  You are literally a 3 minute walk to the Arc, 5 minutes to the Champs Elysees and have many local restaurants to choose from.  There's a Starbuck, McDonald's and Burger King up along the same street if you want some familiar US type of food.  We used the Big Bus Hop on Hop Off tour buses, and there was a stop right at the Arc on the Champs.  Again, 5 minutes to get there, which was so convenient.

One last thing to mention was the hotel's attention to detail to really making us feel special.  I had emailed the hotel a couple of weeks before arrival and let them know it was our 10 year wedding anniversary and my wife's and son's first time to Paris.  When we came back from one of our excursions, we had a bottle of champagne on ice, some macaroons, and massage oil, waiting for us in the room.  There was a nice hand written note wishing us a Happy Anniversary and special welcome to Paris to my wife and son as first time visitors.  Even though I had written them 2 weeks prior, they took note and did something special for us.

We have already pledged our loyalty to this location as this will be our go to hotel on our next trip to Paris. =)
