If you're like me and have been reading tons of reviews to figure out the best Marriott property to stay in Paris, look no further.  I'm telling you, this is the one to stay at. Everything you could possibly want and need, this hotel provides.  Do yourself a favor and book with the Renaissance Arc de Triomphe.  You won't regret it!

Thanks to all the folks here!  You really made our stay there so memorable.  We look forward to our next visit there.

Merci Beaucoup from the Mendiolas!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great Hotel & Perfect Location in Paris
text:
The staff at the hotel was super friendly and helpful when we checked in. We had a good room that was a great size and everything was very luxurious. The location was perfect--very close to the Arc de Triomphe and therefore walking distance to the metro. I would definitely stay here again as it is a good area and everything is easily accessible from here. 

Breakfast was included in our rate and the buffet in the morning was wonderful. A variety of options and seems to have easily met all dietary requirements for our group.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Every stay is perfection
text:
I am writing another review about this fantastic hotel to let all readers know that this is the best hotel to stay in my opinion, in Paris. The impeccable service, the warmth and friendliness, the convenient location, the comfortable rooms, let’s not forget the hard at work housekeeping—nothing could be better! 
Claire, the manager of the front end of the hotel is always lovely, professional, and a perfect example of what hotel management should be.  Rashad, Julie, Tiego, and Laura we’re always happy to help us and ensure that our trip was perfect—They were always so great to work with. I have had friends and clients stay at this hotel upon my recommendation and everyone has always been happy. 
The location could not be better, you are just a couple of minutes walk from two very good metro stops.  Ternes, and Charles de Gaulle etoile. 
I will always stay here while in Paris. 
To all my friends that work at the Renaissance – I miss you already and look forward to hopefully seeing you next year!
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Great location, even better staff
text:
This is a nice hotel located very close to the Arc de Triomphe so close to metro station with multiple lines and popular attractions.  Lots of restaurants and shops nearby as well.  All to be expected from a Renaissance hotel.  The concierge staff here is also one of the best I've interacted with.  They were helpful with all things from confirming crib availability for our 4 month old, providing babysitting options for our 4 month old (didn't end up using this, but great that it was an option), to coordinating our luggage transfer, to finding a place for my wife to nurse our 4 month old after we had checked out and come back from exploring Versailles.  They are super friendly and go out of their way to help so many thanks to the concierge staff.  The room we had was also quite nice and on the larger side of typical Parisian hotel rooms.

A couple of hiccups that we noted.  The room service menu says you can order from the on-site restaurant, but when we tried we were told that's not possible.  Hope they fix this and allow ordering from the restaurant as the options are otherwise limited. 
 The front desk staff needs a little more training generally as to the hotel's services as there were a lot of instances of having to check on our questions.  I mention this mostly because it was such a contrast with how well trained the concierge staff were.  Probably would not have stuck out to me otherwise if not for the fact that the concierge staff were so impressive.  Overall, we would definitely stay here again.
name: Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel

title: Stella review
text: Shower leaked out onto the bathroom floor so the floor was wet. Towels were thin and kind of small. Thermostat was unable to be adjusted and there was just one duvet, so it was warm in the room. Better tea would be nice. Nice location near the arc of triump
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Great location
text: The main positive features of this hotel are the friendliness and professionalism of the staff who are all great in addition to the fact that you can walk to a major connection point for the metro equally you’re able to walk to the Arc de Triomphe. Our room accommodated my wife and I and had an extra twin bed for our daughter which is perfect for us. The woman who served us breakfast was so sweet as well as being able to cook great eggs! The guys at the front desk spoke English well and very helpful. This isn’t a five-star hotel but this is a nice warm place to spend your time in Paris.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Outstanding hotel in Paris
text: Outstanding hotel in Paris a few minutes from Metro Charles DeGaul Étoile and Arc de Triomphe. Our rooms were clean, had all the amenities we needed, location was excellent and staff were very professional and helpful. Merci! We will definitely stay at Stella Étoile Hotel next time we are in Paris.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Outstanding hotel in Paris.
text: Outstanding hotel in Paris a few minutes walking from Metro and Arc De Triomphe. Our rooms were very clean, had all the amenities we needed, great location and very good service by staff. We will definitely choose to stay at Stella Étoile Hotel next time we are in Paris.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Would recommend
text:
We really enjoyed our stay here. We booked a room with a balcony and you could see the Arc de Triumph as promised. FYI, there was scaffolding a few doors down that interfered with photos. 
The location is very near the metro and the Champs Elysee.
There is a 24/hr front desk attendant and they let us check in early.
The room itself is quite small. There is a mini fridge to keep your macarons cool haha. 
The shower leaked everywhere around the bathroom no matter how we tried to prevent it.

I would recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Stella Hotel
text: It was very nice. Rooms are small and I felt like the price was high, but the hospitality was excellent. Great location. Front desk staff were very very helpful. Room cleaned everyday. I would stay again, but would need to book earlier to get a much better price!!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Friendly staff
text: Staff was very friendly and helpful especially the lady who worked the desk. Shower only had the hand held wand working and shower head was missing. Never got the shower head replaced. They did offer free breakfast to compensate which was a nice offer. Room was very small but expected in Paris. Would have been nice if they put a shelving unit in the rooms to have some place to place your clothes. Only a small closet to hang things. This was the biggest issue with the  room since we stayed 9 days. Would stay they again though.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Aged property
text: Aged property, a bit neglected, small rooms, soulless. Great area though. Will do the trick for one night, but not for a 3-4 days visit. Expensive for its quality but I guess that's Paris hotels for you these days.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: perfect Stay in paris
text: Nice hotel in nice area of Paris. What you need you all find in all the small streets. Hotel is clean and very nice staff behind the desk. breakfast is perfect. Rooms are small but typical Parisien.Hotel is in front of a parking (€ 40 a day). Very good reachable by other means of local transport
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Nice small hotel
text: Nice small hotel. Newly renovated rooms. The rooms are quite small but had all I needed. The desk could be a bit bigger for more comfortable working. Located very close to the Arc de Triomphe, metro, restaurants, etc. On a quiet street. Friendly staff. Luggage storage available.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel to attend a conference in Paris. The "Palais de Congres" is within walking distance. The hotel staff was very friendly. I had a very quiet room and even the air conditioning was so quiet that it did not bother my sleep.  Many small bistros are within walking distance and it is also only a few minutes to the nearest metro stop. I can fully recommend the hotel and have stayed here myself five times now.  I will book here again for my next stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: A small fine hotel. We would come back.
text:
The lobby was cozy and conducive to rest. The owners have put a lot of thought into how they can make the style of the hotel unmistakable. The old telephones (which also worked), the use of large mirrors in the room to optically counteract the narrowness, the photo wallpaper with a view of the city. They made the most of the limited space in the old building. In the single room, for example, you have an open bathroom separated by a small wall. The ventilation in the bathroom worked well. The air conditioning as well. You could choose between different programs: air, dry, cool. If you had a balcony in front of the room, you could see the triumphal arch. The breakfast buffet was sufficient. You could also order omelets or fried eggs in the kitchen. There was also a kettle, cups and tea bags and instant coffee in the room. We thought that was great. As for the location: it is 2 minutes from the Arc de Triomphe and at the Charles de Gaulle Etoile metro station. A parking garage is also right in front of the door if you arrive by car; it is of course chargeable.

Disliked · There was no magnifying mirror in the bathroom, nor could one be provided upon request. Since that's part of the standard, I didn't bring my own. Otherwise the hotel was more than adequately equipped with mirrors. You could have left out one or the other for a magnifying or make-up mirror.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Lovely stay!
text: Have been here couple of times, and I will definitely be back! Lovely, helpfull staff, very good location, comfortable and clean rooms! The balcony view is amazing! Though we did not try the food there, the stay overall is always pleasant.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: good hotel
text: I had a pleasant stay. The breakfast was very good. The room was small, but comfortable. I liked the decoration with the large photo- wallpaper of the Eifel tower. It was in the heart of Paris, very close to the congress center where I needed to be. The air-conditioning in the room worked well. The shower was in my opinion too small.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Sincere and honest Review (hotel not as good as what we read online)
text:
Don't be fooled by the relative cheapness and proximity to "les champs Elysées et l'arc de Triomphe".  First the guy at the front desk, doesn't know his way around the area and his mouth was full of food when he talked to us. This so callled "hotel" is in fact some sort of cheap student/youth hotel. The staff is rude. We were a group of caucasians and we noticed that the staff at the front desk were even more rude with people with darker skin color... the rooms we booked REALLY stink. They are NOT clean. The sheets were not clean. The bathrooms were gross, with bugs everywhere. The sink was so dirty you won't dare leave something around it; matter of fact you can't because the sink is so little you can't set anything around it. You have to set your belongings on the tiny shelve just above the toilet seat. The sink is so little whenever you wash your hands the water splashes everywhere, just like little kids when they learn how to wash their hands. The breakfast is not worth it, we went to have our breakfasts at others hotels (four-five stars hotels) nearby with the same prices, better food and of course BETTER services. I will never recommend this place to anyone, especially to families. I don't even know how they got good ratings online. We wanted to stay at this place to save money to do more activities and nice restaurants but it was a very bad bad BAD decision from us, it was not worth it, at all. 
Bottom line: DO NOT EVER WASTE YOUR MONEY on this hotel, the place is disgusting, horrible customer service, worst experience ever.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Stella Hotel
text:
I had reserved a room at a different hotel for 9 nights. I liked what I saw with the pictures of the room. When I got there It was a whole different story! I wont go into detail but I immediately went on the web to find a room. I found stella hotel and it had so many of the things you want at a hotel! The bed I requested was as it was said to be( Queen) The other hotel had 2 singles and wasnt put together as a double.The room at Stella was small compared to US standards, but had pleant of room to go around the bed(24 to 30 inches) The other had no room on one side and about 15 inches on the other. Stella had a refrigerator, plenty of AC outlets and had air conditioning. The front desk people are by far the best people you will ever meet or need to do business with! The lad there is awesome!! She hepled us get any tickets we need and gave us outstanding recommendations for eating out!  We had french, Italian,and American food! They were all awesome!!! The hotel ahs a breakfast that was awesome also! Eggs cooked to your order, pancakes, meat rolls, pastries, and jucies and coffee! They also have a bar that you can get mixed drinks and beer. And one of the nicer things about this hotel its about 3 blocks from the Arch of Triumph! 
If you'd like to get a room and not kill the bank account this is by far the best Hotel you can get!!
 I highly recommend anyone to stay at this hotel!!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: 5 day Leisure trip
text: Good location, close to the arc de triomphe , theres a bar in the reception and the employees are helpful, just think the cleaning could be way better , as that was the only thing that bothered me. Also the price couldve been a bit better but it was high season.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent experience
text:
Stayed there for 4 nights with the family.
Nice room, clean, silent.
Very close to Arc du Triomphe and metro station (100 meters from metro station). Would certainly go back.
Reception very friendly and helpful.
Didn’t take breakfast as there are many options around.
Good value for money.
Keep up the good work!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: 3 day business trip
text: Excellent small hotel, very clean in all areas and friendly and helpful staff.  Next to Arc de Triumph so great location for tourists too.  Hop on hop off bus pick up 5 mins walk from hotel, lots of bars and restaurants within walking distance
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: I love the tiny room
text:
everything was excellent  and lovely, the people were very friendly and the room was clean 
i love the enviroment, it looks very classic and nice 
i like the way of decoration 
location was just great .. i will visit again
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Redicolous Price! €800,- per night
text: This Hotel is abusing the Hotel requests while conferences. 3 Star minus in Quality! Supertiny Rooms. Night Portier incompetent. Gives you a lesson how you could take the room key with you?!! Many little tiny things just don’t work. Don’t book this! I am writing more than necessary just because that my comment has to have min. 200 letters.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Friendly But No Frills
text: I stayed here for a work conference. It was a basic small European hotel room. Although the staff was friendly and the room was clean, the room temperature couldn’t be adjusted and there was a constant smell of cigarette smoke seeping in. I was stunned when they charged me $90 to do a small bag of laundry.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Strategic Place to Stay
text: Stella hotel provide comfort to stay in many ways. Clean hotel, friendly, supportive and informative services. Warm greetings. I am doing business then family trip, all could be done in short efficient time because of the site of the hotel and the service. I recommend this hotel to my friends when they visit Paris. For me and family, would love to stay in Stella hotel again.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Good
text:
Small room but good enough for two people. Located on an excellent place very close to Arc de Triomphe in a walking distance and very kind people that allowed us to keep our luggage.

There was a piece of furniture not very clean below the TV.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Charming Hotel, great Service
text:
We stayed in a 3 bed room. The house keeping was very quick and neat.
The concierges were very sweet and helpful.
We loved the location near L‘Arc de Triomphe and we even saw the tip of the Eiffel Tower from our room.
Can very much recommend this hotel!!!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: dissapointly small
text: we have visited you again after 6years and got terribly small room & bathroom.  We couldn't manage to fit with three bags we brought without falling over them often.  My wife couldn't place her cosmetics in hand range near mirror in a bathroom. Last time our room and bathroom were much bigger and we were absolutely satisfied so we decided to choose your hotel again. But this time we are disappointed. Food service was very good.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Amazing
text: The hotel was super cute and the staff was very nice! We had to stay an extra day and it wasn’t a problem at all! Everything is close and walkable! From a market to a cafe and only 20 min from the Eiffel tower! The view from our balcony was super cute and we could see the arc de triomphe which was amazing at night when it as all light up! The room was nice and clean and perfect for two!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: 3rd time staying at Stella Etoile, and loved it as much!
text: Lovely welcoming and helpful staff, clean rooms, I was lucky with a great view! And the location is perfect for getting around Paris. This is the 3rd time I have stayed at Stella Etoile, and it did not disappoint. I'll be back!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Stella Etoile of my Heart. Steps to Arc de Triomphe
text: From the moment I walked in the door, I felt happy at this hotel. The lovely front desk lady was so warm and kind. I chose the place because my Pug was named Stella, but I am glad I did, and I will stay there again. It was a good value, and the location near the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees could not be beat. The best part was the cafe on the corner, Le Vin Coeur! A handsome waiter named Saif, and fabulous fois gras and champagne rose.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Great stay
text: Our room was lovely, with a balcony with a beautiful view of the Arc de Triomphe! Location was superb as it was literally in front of a metro station and very central. The staff was super friendly and helped us with all the enquiries we had. Highly recommend!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: very good venue
text: The room was rather small, but very tidy and comfortable. Had all the listed features (i.e. wi-fi, A/C, kettle and so on). Staff was very nice too. I asked for earlier check-in and they were very helpful with that.  I definitely recommend!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Stella Etoile Hotel
text: Really well situated near the Arc De Triomph, near the Metro, so easy access to the city. The receptionist was very helpful and kind. I found the room to be tiny, but by European standards it was fine, the was enough space for my needs, air dryer provided, clean, comfortable bed.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Clean, friendly and well situated
text:
I don’t usually leave reviews. After reading the reviews on Trust pilot and freaking out 🤔 by firstly , that children aren’t allowed to stay (NOT TRUE) secondly that the staff are right rude (NOT MY Experience)…
The Hotel breakfast was great: I was traveling with my 9 year old. They had great coffee( proper coffee machine) croissants, tangerines, butter , fresh bread. Perfect start before we went out on our trips around Paris. The room was small but perfect size to sleep in. The bed was so comfortable. Everything was new and clean. I am a bit OCD about cleanliness and it was perfect. The bedding  soft and clean.
I want to thank them all for being so lovely. The woman on reception was friendly and kind.
I’m not sure what the other reviewers were talking about: they must have been having a bad day!
Great place would recommend to friends and Defo stay there again when in Paris. Great 👍
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: excellent hotel for everyone
text:
Nice hotel, super place, friendly staff, everything was perfect.
Hotel is good for everyone, sure come back soon.
Or maybe some of my friends will visit this place and this hotel.
Good price for such palce.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent position
text:
Bus station to/from CDG and B airports very close
5 mit walk Arc de Triunf 
Hotel 3 stars clean with excellent friendly and helpful staff
excellent friendly and helpful staff
Basic sweet and savory breakfast, perhaps a little expensive for the variety offered, however sufficient to face the day
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Pleasant Stay
text: Pleasant stay.   It was lovely to have a balcony.  Unfortunately, there is no sound proofing and we had to complain about music being blared and shouting from the room next to us at 3.30am!   The issue was rectified very quickly.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent location and room services
text: The location is perfect, 200 meters from Arc de Triomphe. The arc can be seen from the room balcony or window. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Housekeeping and cleanliness of the room was excellent.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Just what we wanted...
text: Perfect location close to (and within sight of) the Arc de Triomphe. Recently refurbished small hotel. Helpful reception staff. Room small but adequate, especially with its (small) balcony and clever use of a cityscape mural to make the room feel bigger. Fridge, safe and kettle. Didn't try the hotel breakfast.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Not recommended hotel
text: The staff was not friendly and not customer oriented, internet was very poor, check out time was at 11 in the morning, the old man working in reception should work at police 👮‍♀️ not in customers front desk. I miss one night due to flight overbooking and COVID-19 procedures, I called the hotel to postpone the reservation but the reply to me directly with rejection and deduct the amount of the first day directly with no mercy.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: I had pleasant stay
text: Very functional small room, good value for money. Cleaning has to be improved. To the part between the bad and WC has been stains from drink first day and stayed all days of my visit. Also the floor is with dust and the furniture.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Fantastic
text: The lady at the check in was fantastic she looked after me during my stay and she gave me a room with a balcony and a nice view, unfortunately I did not get the chance to get the name, as well Amir the night receptionist. Thank you.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent!
text:
Location is perfect, very close to metro, landmarks, restaurants and many others. We could see the Arc de Triomphe from our window and balcony. Reception is very kind and very helpful, especially Dominique. Room is small but nice and tastefully furnished. Breakfast good and sufficient for Paris.
We got more what we expected. Thank you so much!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Very beautiful stay with a marvellous view
text:
A very nice small hotel with a beautiful view to the ( wrapped) Arc de Triumphe. Very friendly Lady at the reception and in the room service. Everyone tried to fulfill what I asked for.
I loved the Galerie in the " Treppenhaus" - good pictures and motivation not to use the elevator ;)).
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: recommendable hotel
text:
Very nicely renovated hotel in a very good location. I will recommend it to others. 
We were there to see the wrapped up Arc de Triomphe.  You could even see him from the room.
The rooms are very tastefully renovated.  The staff is courteous.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Perfect Weekend Stay
text: We booked the Hotel over the internet just trying to get a good bargain and a hotel that is in the city centre. We really got lucky with the Stella Etoile. It was a great place, with super friendly and helpful staff. The rooms are as they are advertised, very clean and comfortable. I can really recommend this hotel and would come back anytime.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: very nice hotel
text:
I really like the Stella Etoile Hotel for 35reasons:

1. The lady at the reception was so nice and helpful, it really made me very happy
2. Sitting on the (small) balcony with a great view of Arc de Triomphe
3. The location was perfect for visiting Paris. With the RER train station around the corner it was very fast to get around.
4. The room was small, but really cozy and had a good atmosphere
5. I got a great recommendation for a really good restaurant (Gabilou)
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Nice vacation in Paris
text: This was the third time we were guests of the hotel during our vacation and we were not disappointed now either. All our needs were met, the staff is kind and professional. The rooms are practical and clean. And its location is excellent! Whenever we can we will stay here.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Amazing Weekend Stay
text: This hotel has a perfect location just a stone-throw away from busy areas, but still without any noise or disturbance at night. The staff was very helpful and friendly with all of our requests. The room was small but modern and clean. We will for sure come back again.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: The hotel has an excellent central location, very close to the metro station, the bus station and Champsellyse.
text: Rooms have a perfect size with modern furniture and perfect bathroom size. The breakfast was just right. Coffee machine would be a plus though.  Staff are very helpful and friendly.  Overall a great experience above our expectations at very reasonable cost. Thanks to everyone at Stella Etoile and would definitely stay there again.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Friendly, clean and convenient hotel.
text:
Stayed here for a business trip and the staff are very welcoming.  The room is clean and has everything I needed.  Ideal for business or pleasure trip to Paris.
Will be back again soon.  Breakfast was also very good.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Great Hotel
text: The Hotel was great the service , location the hotel located just few minutes from the arc de triomphe Paris , the staff all were fantastic helpful and Friendly , the only concern is my deposit wast not  returned back. they blocked an amount from my card and never released back .
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Well located, good price/quality, attentive personnel
text: The hotel is very convenient to go to the airport by bus. Very polite and attentive personnel. Really appreciated their care: they prepared a room with a small balcony for us. And yes, the rooms are not big, I guess this is a short stay type of hotel. We also liked the cleanliness of everything and a kettle with tea/coffee! Will definitely come back for a couple of nights.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Nice place to stay near Champs Elysees
text: Perfect location, nice and clean hotel, small but very clean room, friendly welcoming reception, historic building former house of the writer Aragon, just a few steps from Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees, lots of shops and restaurants. Definitely a hotel to come back.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: As great as always
text: Ever since  the first time I stayed in this hotel in 2016, I never even considered staying in another hotel. Since then I've been visiting this hotel on annual basis. I really love the place and so does my daughter. I recomended the hotel to a group of friends who loved it too. The place is a 100 meters away from the RER A and metro station which make all places close to you. the rooms are clean, convenient & cozy. I recommend this place big time
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Great location
text: Met my expectations, location was great, rooms were small, but that's quite normal in paris. Check in was quick and easy, just a few meters to metro station CDG Etoile, which didn't mean much because of the strikes. Only comment is that the beds were not the most comfortable thing, however, All and all, it was a good stay.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Very bad property take care
text: I didn’t stay bacause the reception didn’t allow me to enter the room beacuse i have child 2.7 years and my booking was for 2 adult so they told me if you need to go to room you must book another single room I don’t have enough money to pay 300 € more i told them i cant so the reception man fire me and told me we took our money and no rooms for you and child if you want to go the room you must pay the 300€ because you lie and you said you are 2 adults only!!! I called the police but unfortunately they didn’t help me so i book another budget hotel.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Stay at Stella Etoile
text: Overall decent. The bathroom made noises during the night which was annoying. Temperature of the room was difficult to control.price was reasonable these other aspects would have made it better. Front staff was excellent.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Great location & staff
text: The hotel is situated near the "Arc de Triomphe" and very close to a subway station. The room and restrooms were always very clean. The staff was gently and they had always the best attitude to help us.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: room review
text: nice, small, cosy room. but Noisy, maybe linked to showers taken in other rooms and resulting in kind of hammering sound very early in the Morning. no slippers but most important things available in the room
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Very cosy hotel close to parking and metro
text:
Stella Hotel is very close to Arc de Triomphe, Parking and Metro.
Clean room and good beds. Very friendly staff , check-in was efficient.
We didn’t choose for breakfest in the hotel but went to the coffee bar in the street towards the Arc with great bagels, coffee, muffins and fresh orange juice!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Nice hotel
text: I like to spend time at this are, you can find everything nearby, the hotel is very calm, the rooms are very clean and comfortable, every time I reserved i fell more welcoming and smiling personnel faces
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Clean, small yet cozy room near the Arc de Triomphe!
text:
I found this place last minute in Booking.com. The drawing factor was that it was a few blocks away to the Champs-Elysées, The Arc de Triomphe and the Metro station l'Étoile station was really close. There are also plenty of good restaurants and cafes around there. The room is fairly small for a couple, but it didn't really matter to me since right outside was this magnificent city.

I liked the cute inviting small lobby. Trendy decorations and colorful couches and sitting areas. The room had the basic necessities, small fridge, decent sized bathroom, comfortable bed and really quite. Service was great, even the folks at the reception. Breakfast was basic so didn't opt for that since there were so many good places to eat. It's a 3 star hotel in the 17th arrondissement. My boyfriend and I had a comfortable and pleasant stay and would recommend it to couples and solo travelers, maybe not for families since it is quite a small hotel. Had a wonderful experience! 4 stars!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Good hotel but....
text: I have been in this hotel several times in the past few years and I always found a very friendly staff and clean rooms, with a good soundproofing from the street traffic, which is all I need when I am in Paris for business. Recently however I have the impression that room rates - on average, across the year - have increased significantly. This week I found a disturbing noise from the heating system and, at the check-out, I learned AMEX is no longer accepted.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent
text:
We have been staying at the Stella for years. It has kept its quality. Close to everywhere because of Metro station close by, easy access from CDG airport by bus, wonderful management and service.
It is always a pleasure. Merci Hotel Stella, et à bientôt!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: GOOD BUT IMPROVABLE
text:
Just highlight points for improvement::
Wifii Quality, it almost never worked
TV Channels in spanish. there was in italian, arabic, japonese, german  ?¿?¿?¿
Heavier breakfast, small varity an quantity.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Family sightseeing trip to Paris
text:
Excellent location 
Very friendly and hospitable staff
Very Convenient for sightseeing 
Restaurants, bars and shops adjacent to the hotel, very close to Champs Elysees and Arc de Triomphe, great nighttime views from the sixth floor bedrooms!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Very pleasant and comfortable.
text:
I was very pleased with my stay. I am very picky and the place was satisfying. I only have 2 minor complaints (not as deterrent from staying but as feedback..): the lights are a very harsh cool tone, could be switch for softer warm ones, the toilet seat had cleaning product residue twice after cleaning. 

Additionally, it should be noted everything was very tight but I was solo and I didn’t find it an issue. I stayed in another place comparable in ratings and this was better by far.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent location
text: The hotel é very good for the price. The attendants are very polite and the room is very clean. The cost-benefit is good for the location. The down side is the size of the room. But this is a problem of almost every hotel in that area.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Hairy Towels
text: The lobby and front desk staff were lovely however the cleanliness of the room was very poor. I stayed two nights and when I checked in there were long black hairs in the bathroom. Then when I took a towel to wash my face, there was a clump of hairs (like from a dryer) folded into the towel. I raised this to the hotel and they told me that they clean their rooms daily. Well, apparently not very well! The next day, I had a different clump of hair in another towel which almost got on me when I got out of the shower. The showers and bathrooms are tiny so good luck trying to do your hair or make up- there is no counter top space! I think the hotel tried.... but cleanliness isn't optional.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: good place
text: the hotel was very comfortable and clean the people how works there was very nice and helpful in anything you ask about, the location is wonderful near of the tram station so very easy to go and back any where.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Quiet erea and Simple
text:
I am satisfied to have beautiful view and quiet. Good transportation.
I think the room is small and suitable for people with little luggage.
About the room where we stayed, please need to check water facilities, especially toilet.
So this time it ’s average.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Excellent time
text:
Very good experience, nice stay, perfect location. I would definitely come back.
Rooms are quite small but have everything you need. My room had a balcony & a stunning view. Hotel is very clean. I would recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: The worst experience of Paris
text:

title: Perfect location
text: Location was perfect we walked and use the metro for the seight seeing but the rooms are very small. We even couldnt open our suitcase in the room. Other than that it was ok. The man in the reception was wery helpful.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Weekend Family trip
text: Great location a few steps from the subway, from the Triumph Arc, ,and the champs Elysees, comfortable room, great breakfast, nice workers, no sound, bathroom with plenty space we were 4 and was good,
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Really nice hotel
text: Had a nice couple of nights here. Really comfortable beds, friendly staff. Only down side was being woken at 08:00 on our first morning by heavy plant machinery replacing the road out front. We were first floor overlooking said road. Didn’t complain as it wasn’t the hotels fault. Would stay again when the road is finished!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Nice
text:
Nice place, location is very good clean and staff is friendly.
Room little bit small. 
I didn't try breakfast so I can't judge. 
Landry is expensive one jeans around 13 🇪🇺. 
🚇 Station few meters. 
Really good.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Lovely location and perfect for a quiet couple
text: We loved the location with easy links to sights in Paris and Versailles. The balcony room was a brilliant choice and was clean, with air conditioning (needed on a hot week) and the staff were very friendly. Would recommend!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Romantic location
text: Fabulous location with balcony looking up to the Arc de Triomphe. Bed was comfortable. I would recommend this hotel to anyone wishing to stay in the centre of paris. Public underground parking is directly across from the hotel - perfect!
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: Paris
text:
Quaint small room, but very comfortable. The bathroom looked to be newly remodeled nice and clean. Front desk staff was very pleasant and helpful. There are many excellent restaurants in the area.
5 min walk to Arc de Triumph.
name: Hotel Stella Etoile

title: The only place to stay in Paris
text: I stayed at the Villa Haussman recently with my son who has special needs. Patrick at the front desk was outstanding and so caring. The room was very good, beds were very comfortable, the AC was outstanding, the shower pressure was great, bathroom was beautiful. Great location and very quiet. Very clean and nicely decorated. Front desk were always kind and friendly, outgoing. I left a day early for a Hurricane that was coming to my home and they refunded me on my last night even though I am sure they didn't need to as per their booking policy. I would stay there again at my next visit to Paris. Thank-you again Villa Haussman! Until we meet again.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Good choice for a stay in Paris
text: Overall excellent one night stay as a tourist in Paris. Hotel is centrally located on Boulevard Haussmann and in short walking distance to Printemps and Gallery Lafayette. A Metro station  is just around the corner. Rooms are on tge small side but nicely decorated and well kept. The sound proof windows and doors are among the best I have experienced. Even with a direct view of the busy cobblestoned Boulevard Haussmann it was complete (!) silent in the room. Staff was very friendly and attentive. I will definitely come back. Highly recommend.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Brilliant facilities and unmatched customer service
text:
We stayed at the Villa Haussman for our summer break during August 2022 for 8 nights in total. The hotel experience was absolutely amazing and from the moment we checked in, we could see the superior customer service from all of the staff. We stayed in 2 adjoining rooms which were at the end of the corridor so they could be opened up and joined fully and this proved to be a wonderful setup for us and our 2 kids. 
The rooms were spacious and very comfortable. Even though you are at the center of a busy road, there is no noise coming through and you are able to get a very good and sound sleep during the night. The hotel location is perfect as every major attraction in Paris is easy to get to and there are really good rail links very close by.
The food in the hotel is absolutely wonderful and we had breakfast here everyday where we found several options catering to any type of need. The staff are also very helpful in recommending nearby options if you are interested in trying something outside.
The attentiveness and care the staff showed at all times, especially to our kids was brilliant and made us feel right at home.
This is a great hotel for a stay in Paris and definitely on our visit again list.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: What a place! We will be back.
text:
The quality of furnishings, room layout and bed linen all made this room feel special (deluxe).

  The attention to detail and our need by the staff was second to none and we felt special throughout- we were definitely welcome. 

We will definitely be back.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Best hotel in Paris, modern, clean, central to everything & quiet nights rest! Plus awesome Pool!
text:
Michael  and Sander were amazing! La Villa Haussmann is an amazing hotel in Paris, actually the absolute best I’ve stayed at in Paris in my past 5 visits.

Traveling for the first time with my 8 year old & 30 year old brother. La Villa Haussmann is centrally located and had a great pool (oversized hot tub with excellent multiple jets) perfect for an 8 year old daughter who wants to wade around the water or for adults wanted to rest achy feet from exploring.  Rooms were spacious and sooo modern and had gorgeous views on the 6th floor. Even a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower. Michael, Sander & the evening team were so accommodating - they all deserve raises 🙌.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Once again a great place to stay in Paris
text: We stayed here for our 20th anniversary in 2017 and returned for our 25th.  Perfect location, price and an amazing staff and room quality.  Easy access to any part of Paris via the Metro (several near-by stations) and from there any of the train stations and airports.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Fabulous!
text: We stayed here for 5 nights in May with our 12 year old daughter and I honestly don’t think we could have picked a better hotel. The location was perfect, 8 mins walk to the Champs Elysee, 5 mins walk to the Opera House and 2 mins for the subway.  Some nice bars and restaurants nearby that serve late if arriving late like we did. The style and decor of the hotel is very chic but it was the staff that made this trip so memorable, they honestly couldn’t have been more welcoming and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and everything was with a smile. It made such a difference. The pool was fabulous and so welcoming after a day walking the city. We had a suite on the 6th floor with a view of the Eiffel Tower. It was amazing. Very stylish, quite spacious with everything you might need. I would definitely recommend this hotel and if the pop arises, I will definitely return.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Highly Recommended
text: Great service from every member of staff very helpful professional polite and very welcoming, good location, clean stylish rooms, fabulous spa area we will be returning for sure and would highly recommend.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Superb!
text: Superb hotel on Boulevard Haussmann. Very classy and brilliant location near all the major attractions . The staff are amazing. Breakfast is fantastic. The rooms are on the small side but that’s Paris for you. They are beautifully decorated
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great Hotel
text: We have visited Paris for the first time and what a great experience !!! Villa Haussemann contributed a lot for our lovely stay. Hotel staff were very professional,  helpfull and no small thing is too much to ask. We have stayed 4 nights, breakfast included. Very chill and relax atmosphere at the breakfast restaurant downstairs. Lovely corner room with two balconies,  clean and always tidy ! X comfortable beds like you are on cloud nine !  100% will come back . Reception staff very helpful  to hold our luggage after checkout so we could go shopping before our travel outbound.  Thank everyone at Villa Housemann !
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Nice Hotel
text:
We enjoyed our stay at this hotel! The rooms are small but are very clean and well kept up. The hotel staff was friendly and always greeted us as we were coming and going. The hotel breakfast was perfect for starting off the day. On the whole, a very nice hotel and good experience!

The only slight downside to this hotel is the location. While it’s very central, it didn’t offer much walkability to major attractions. You will need to take a cab most places to avoid a long walk.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Simply wonderful experience with a great staff!
text:
Finest staff of any hotel I’ve stayed in many years! From the desk staff and waiters to the manager himself, these kind folks could not have been more helpful and accommodating every hour of the day and night. Knew where to steer us, called ahead for reservations, fixed emergencies, and accommodated our every request. 

The food was excellent, wait staff attentive and swift. Hotel is centrally located close to Champs Elysees, shopping, and Metro. Nicely appointed, and the facilities are great - spa and indoor pool to boot.

Only drawback…rooms are tight, but that’s the way it is in most of Paris, friends. Unless you stay at you stay at the Crillon, don’t expect a huge sweet. But this hotel does have larger suites at higher rates. 

Altogether a wonderful experience and in my many upcoming trips to Paris I’ll be staying right here.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great Hotel in a fantastic location
text: I visited Paris together with my daughter and it was a great experience, especially for her first visit in Paris. The hotel is located perfectly to visit all interesting hot spots in Paris even by walking. The service at the hotel is outstanding, rooms are very clean, well designed and very cozy. Breakfast was excellent and Spa wonderful. it was a great experience! Merci beaucoup La Villa Haussmann!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent hotel !
text: this hotel has a very high standard, the personnel is very friendly and competent, room with view on Eiffel Tower is magnificent, nice room with lot of space, nice swimming pool per couple for 20min during Covid, roomservice and breakfast is excellent !
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Wonderful place to stay
text: La Villa Haussmann is a wonderful hotel in a fantastic location. The hotel is beautifully decorated and the rooms are very comfortable. A special thanks to Florian who paid attentive care to our needs while at the hotel. Thank you.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Clean and friendly hotel
text: Clean hotel but room was quite small. White modern bathroom and spacious shower. Gorgeous foyer and restaurant downstairs which we didnt eat at as it was expensive. About a 10 to 15 minute walk to the champs elysee. Can walk to all sites of attraction. Lacks good resturants around it but the bakery across the road became our go to for breakfast. Hard to find well priced restaurants in Paris in general. Close to gallerie lafayettes if you enjoy shopping. Streets are a bit dark at night and can sometimes feel unsafe. Good thing that its away from the hustle bustle but also may want to be closer to the tourist areas.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Okay boutique hotel
text: We got a corner suite, so that was fine. The hotel has a pool but a bit depressing down there as it is too dark. The restaurant was only okay and the service is below what you would expect. Not a bad stay but wouldn't go back. Stayed July 2018.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Awful Horrible Terrible
text:
Our hotel stay was booked months in advance for my wife's birthday. Two days prior to our stay I contacted the hotel because of the upcoming strike that would shut down the airport in Paris we were flying into from the US. They assured me if our flight was cancelled due to the strike and airport shutting down we would be able to cancel our stay and get a full refund. I told the person i spoke with that I was outside the 48 hour window to cancel but if I waited for my flight to be cancelled it would not. He assured me because of the crazy  extenuating circumstances it would not be a problem. I waited and the day of our trip the flight was cancelled. I contacted the hotel and they told me we would not be refunded because it was inside 48 hours. I told them the situation and what I was told 2 days prior but they denied my request. Long story short, everyone I have spoken with at the hotel, everyday for the last 10 days has been very rude.  I have asked to speak with the general manager every day I call and they tell me every day he will be in tomorrow and will call you back. Still NOTHING!!! Today I was told I could not talk to him because it wasn't his problem. She also told me she couldn't talk anymore because she had other customers to help. I was shocked! I would love a full refund but today I even asked for a stay in the future or to just pay for the first nights stay because I notified them we would not be coming. All denied. 
I travel a ton for work and for pleasure and have never given a negative review. After speaking with friends I know who have lived in Paris or stayed there have all said they are not surprised with the customer service I have received from this particular hotel. It's apparently a decent place to stay but when it comes to the employees caring about their customers, they could care less! 
I refuse to give up so if anyone has any suggestions on how to help that would be great! We are currently out $1,000 still!!

My wife and I were planning on coming back next year to Paris but I can guarantee we will not be staying here!!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Perfect boutique hotel with exceptional staff
text:
We stayed 2 nights for my wife's birthday, and from the second we arrived until departure it was an immensely enjoyable experience. The hotel is extremely clean and rooms really comfortable. We had a corner room facing onto the main boulevard, with windows on both sides. However once the windows were closed, you couldnt hear any traffic. Leaving them open in the morning to hear Paris waking up was a treat!
The location of the hotel is an easy 10 min walk to the Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Élysées. And if you want to stretch the legs, 40 mins will take you to Montmartre and the Seine. 
We were treated to a glass of bubbly during our stay, and we also took advantage of the basement pool after a walk. 
Id also like to add that all the staff were extremely helpful and courteous, and made us feel very welcome. In particular Jonathon who was exceptional, always greeted us with a smile and is a credit to his profession.
We would definitely return here in future.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Nice little boutique hotel
text: We stayed at La Villa Haussmann for one week in a Junior Suite, and overall felt it was a nice little boutique hotel.  We had initially booked a Deluxe Room but after reading from several other reviewers about how small the rooms were, we upgraded to a Junior Suite and were very glad we did as even the actual size of the Jr Suite was a bit smaller than how they look in the pictures on the hotel website.  Keep in mind though we are coming from Los Angeles where we have very spacious hotel rooms, but all in all the Junior Suite was very well suited for our needs, and even had 2 really nice large windows you could open up and stand out on very small balconies where you could see the Eiffel Tower. As others have noted, these windows are also super sound proof where once closed you wont hear a peep from outside.  The bathroom was a nice size with a rainfall shower and even a stand alone tub.  Overall though, if you're coming from the states, do yourself a favor and grab a junior suite.  The location of the hotel was nice but does get pretty quiet on the weekends. There was a nice little bakery across the street where we grabbed coffee and croissants every morning.  A couple blocks up the streets were 2 small bustling cafes (St Augustin and Le Pepeniere) where we sat and people watched and had some wine a couple nights.  Keep in mind though, pretty much all restaurants close around 10pm in paris, so if you're used to late night eating, youll need to adjust your eating times.  La Pepeniere though does stay open a bit later. The metro also was one block away and we used it pretty much everyday with no problems getting anywhere in the city.  We also used Uber a few times when we got a bit dressed up, and it was just as easy as using it in the states. The front desk was also super friendly, spoke wonderful english, and always helped us with any questions we had. We never ate at the hotel, but ordered room service the first night as we were super tired.  While the room service says its open 24hours, once it becomes later into the night, it looks like they dont have everything in stock as they had to change a few of our dishes based on what they had at the moment, and also did not have many of the desserts avaiable.  Overall though, if you're looking for a nice little boutique hotel in Paris, with nicely designed and appointed rooms, close to the metro, and in a slightly quieter area of Paris (away from the touristy area), La Villa Haussmann is a great choice.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great stay for three, October in Paris
text:
Really nice, well-maintained luxury hotel. Excellent location within a few minute walk to Metro. Buffet breakfast is expensive for what is offered; would opt for any pf the many neighborhood cafes. A/C unit did not work the first night but was fixed soon after
informing them.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Made our vacation!
text:
Yes, Paris is lovely and wonderful, but our vacation was so value added by staying here! The attentiveness to all our requests was outstanding. Location was perfect! Near a Metro, walking distance to Champs Elysee and Arc de Triomphe, close to great restaurants and in a quiet neighborhood setting. Our room (family suite) had a wrap-around balcony and was very well appointed. Even could see the top tip of the Eiffel!
Will stay here again on vacation.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent 4 star hotel
text: La Villa Haussmann is an excellent option of hotel in the 8eme in Paris. The rooms are new, clean, elegantly decorated. The staff is very polite and professional. The swimming pool is perfect and my daughter just loved it. The breakfest is also very good even though a little bit expensive. I highly recommend and will return on my next time in the city. The windows have sound isolation wich is perfect for that busy part of the city.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: First Time in Paris
text:
This was my boyfriend and I's first trip to Paris and this hotel made the trip even more memorable and enjoyable. It was the little touches that made the difference. 
-they did their best to get us an early check-in as we were exhausted.
-they take all your bags upon arrival and then put them in your room when it is ready.
- the concierge took us into the elevator and walked us all the way to our room upon arrival.
-the room was clean, spacious, and comfortable (the classic room was very pleasant and not crammed like some reviews said. High ceilings, plenty of space for both of our suitcases. You do have to rearrange some furniture to open the window all the way but that was not a big deal).
-the room was sound proof and the bed was so comfortable. They offer three different kinds of pillows. I spilled hair products on the memory foam pillow I brought from home so I was relieved to see they provided the same kind.
-their was a personalized letter to welcome us with little lemon cakes when we walked in.
-the room temperature was adjustable and we were always comfortable.
-the curtains can completely block out any light, very cozy for sleeping but I recommend not closing the curtains. We were so comfortable our first night we slept in way later than we wanted! 
-pool was so warm it was like a big hot tub. I loved it. The last day we stayed it was a few degrees cooler. Not sure why but it was actually a pleasant change as it was more comfortable to actually swim around in. 
-we used the gym every morning. It is small but large enough for both my boyfriend and I to get a bit of exercise in before we start our day. Mostly cardio machines (fine by me!) and my boyfriend made due with the adjustable dumbbells. It's not a lot but enough for a vacation and quite workable. 
-the cleaning staff were wonderful and worked around when my boyfriend and I were in and out of our room. They always kept all the shower products and teas well stocked.
-everyone was welcoming and I wouldn't change a thing.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great hotel in a great neighborhood!
text:
The hotel is really well located in a fun neighborhood! There is a great little terrace just out front where they serve drinks and snacks. We waited for our room there.

The room itself was a bit small but very nice and well equipped. Very comfortable. We had a great view of the statue out front from our window.

Service was great as well. We had our small dog with us and they made her feel very welcomed! There is a small gym and pool. Breakfast, served buffet-style, was quite good as well.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Five star hotel for a three star price
text: If you’re looking for a hotel to stay in, that gives great service, that has excellent air-conditioning, and is moderately priced, this is the hotel for you. Me and my wife enjoyed it very much. When we call down for a request to the front desk, they responded within five minutes. They pride their selves in good service. Their rooms are very nice and clean. They have a nice spa, and a nice bar and restaurant. We would definitely return to this hotel.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Could be a great hotel but NO AC without a solution was a disaster
text:
DISASTER
We booked a 3 night stay to start off our European honeymoon and arrived around 1 PM local.  Understandably the room was not ready for check-in since we were early so we went to explore the area.

We came back at 3PM as requested and the room still wasn't ready.  There were 2 other parties waiting to check-in as well.  After 30 minutes,I politely asked how we were doing & the front desk lady said 15 mins.  More than 30 minutes passed and still not ready.

FINALLY around 430PM our room was ready and of course, the A/C DOES NOT WORK!  This was never mentioned until I asked about it.  The front desk said that the hotel is aware and the entire 1st floor had no A/C

Came back that evening to a room without A/C and it was SUPER HOT out.  The front desk offered us a SMALL bucket of ice to perhaps cool the room down.  Small as in maybe 50 ice cubes which melted in 10 mins

The next day, I asked for an update.  They said that we would not have AC for Sunday night either and it maybe up on Monday.  The hotel had no other rooms available

We cancelled the rest of the stay and went down the street to Maison Albar Hotel Opera Diamond.  It's a 5 star hotel and was same in pricing.

No mention of a refund or at least some discount for staying.  They KNEW that the room didn't have AC yet made us wait hours for checking in.  The hotel should be upfront and honest when we first arrived.  Give us the option to stay in a NO AC room or cancel.

Glad we left when we did and salvaged the rest of our trip.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Haute Hotel
text: La Villa Haussman is a lovely boutique hotel located in a quiet residential neighborhood.  Walking distance to Galleries Lafayette and Printemps stores.  My only comment is that all the surrounding cafes and bistros do not serve dinner after 10:00pm so if late night is your thing you are better off staying closer to Champs Elysee or other more commercial area.  The rooms are small but very stylish.  Hotel was quiet.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great Parisian hotel offering
text: Visited here for the night whilst on a business trip - efficient check-in, pleasant staff, room reasonably spacious for Paris, and with good bathroom. Bed very comfortable, and room came with good size TV, nice coffee/tea making facilities etc. Very central and ideal location.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Fabulous stylish hotel
text:
Just returned from a three night stay at this hotel in the centre of Paris and can’t recommend it enough! Pretty, central location, gorgeously appointed hotel (particularly comfy beds/bedding) lovely spa facilities with a very warm pool, nice food and lovely staff.
Would definitely stay here again if visiting Paris and would highly recommend it.
We stayed in room 601, a junior suite which was well appointed and reasonably spacious with a view of the Eiffel Tower
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: We didn't want to leave!
text: Everything from the staff, beds, bath, neighborhood, couldn't have been better. We booked 2 junior suites and they were perfect with two adults and a child per room. The rooms had views of the Eiffel Tower and the tree lined streets just added to the ambience of a wonderful stay. Wish we could have stayed longer.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Well-run and extremely comfortable!
text: One of the most comfortable hotel beds I’ve ever experienced. Everything about this hotel was clean and friendly (except that it seemed more complicated to get ice than I’d expected), but the bed itself was absolutely perfect. Highly recommend!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: A Real Gem!
text:
We transferred here after a 2-week tour that ended in Paris. The tour hotel was nice but too  far away from the center of town and I’m familiar with this Arrondissement from when I lived in Paris many years ago. It was just perfect for us!  Thanks to the efforts of Lea and Arnaud, our transition went very smoothly and we were able to check in early. The room was small—as expected in this area—but well appointed and we loved the doors that opened onto the balcony with fresh air and a view of the neighborhood.  When closed, there was absolutely NO traffic noise. We appreciated the Nespresso machine and the electric kettle—very handy. The room was spotless,
comfortable, and very well maintained. The restaurant was closed most of our stay due to the holiday (Ascension) but we did eat there the first day and both the food and service were excellent. We also had a cheese plate delivered from room service which was very prompt and absolutely delicious, with generous portions that were plenty for two.  There is also an excellent bakery across the street that is good for both breakfast and lunch, as well as a Monoprix within a short walking distance.  The steam bath was awesome and we also very much enjoyed the indoor pool.  Arnaud also arranged a private car for us to DeGaulle airport which was very affordable and convenient for an early morning flight. We couldn’t have been happier with our stay here and would return in a heartbeat!  Highly recommended!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great service
text: A wonderful hotel with very personal service. Loved the breakfast, set us up each day. The staff were friendly and helpful and the rooms very comfortable. The street epitomised Paris and the interior of the hotel was elegant and very French, no bland anywhere in the world feelings here. I will recommend this hotel to family and friends.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Amazing!
text: We have been to Paris a number of times. I have to say this hotel tops them all! The hotel it self is stunning! The staff and level of customer service are outstanding! We will definitely stay here again!’
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Amazing!!
text: We stayed here for 5 days and it was nothing but pure perfection!! We are at the restaurant for lunch and food was absolutely delicious! The staff was amazing and soooo friendly! I didn’t get the name of the guy who helped us during our entire stay but he had glasses, short brown curlyish hair, skinny. He was so helpful whenever we needed anything! Room service was great too as well as the layout of the room itself! I have nothing but good things to say about this hotel! Also train station near by so super convenient!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Amazing Hotel
text:
This hotel is brilliant. The staff are lovely and cannot do enough for you, even kind enough to book things for you or make reservations before I arrived.

The room service is spectacular and so well presented. I would recommend the Foie Gras. There are so many nice little touches by this hotel.

The pool and steam room are so modern and clean and great for a dip in the morning or after a day of walking around.

Big shout out to Arnaud and Heron, so lovely.

The breakfast was too expensive (although that’s Paris all over) so we didn’t get that. There is a lovely bakery across the street though with sensible prices.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Beautiful Hotel with Amazing Staff!
text: La Villa Haussmann has an excellent location, walking distance to the Champs Elysees and the wonderful shopping areas as well as many excellent restaurants.  The hotel common areas and the sleeping rooms are beautifully appointed and updated, very clean, inviting and comfortable.  The pool and spa area is lovely; although we didn't use it, we did take a trip downstairs to have a peek.  Breakfast is plentiful and delicious with lots of options - a real treat.  The real stand out by far is the hotel staff; they are all without exception genuinely friendly, helpful, and all around delightful.  They made our stay especially wonderful.  Special thanks to Apolline for helping us to order our dinner through Deliveroo on the hotel computer the one night we wanted to stay in, and to Heron, who never failed to smile at our goofy jokes.  We will definitely stay again!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Fantastic boutique hotel
text:
Well renovated hotel, pleasant and doted of a beautiful SPA. Rooms are very fonctional but size will not allow to have an additional kid bed

Very pleasant staff, always at your disposal.

The restaurant is more a brasserie offering good meals

Great experience - would recommend
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Best ever
text:
Not often moved to write a review. Villa Haussmann is the finest hotel I have ever stayed in. I have traveled all over the world and have paid 3x as much. Never stayed anywhere in the world that moved me to write. This is the place!!!  Total home run!!!

Went to the monuments and wondered what it was like to be treated like a king. Now I know!!!!!

Probably my best stay ever.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Be careful with your stuff, they steal from your room.
text: I stayed at this hotel with my family at room 501. most of the time I was studying so I wouldn’t leave the room at all, because I had an important exam in Paris for my school.  After two weeks of staying there, the day that I passed my exam, we decided to go out. We were out for about 6 hours and when we came back, I saw that the room was made and my Louis Vuitton backpack with all the stuff that was in it was missing. The person who stole it must have had the card to get into my room, other than that who else could have gone inside my room!!! But unfortunately the manager Myriam was really rude and not helpful at all. She didn’t find out who did this shameful thing. And now after 4 months of waiting for the hotel insurance still we did not get any money back. This place is super small. The rooms are super small. The staff are so mean especially the ones at the restaurant. They barely have food at their restaurant, room service is so bad. The manager never ever said sorry or apologizing for what they did to us. Please be careful with your stuff if you ever go to this hotel. The worst experience about Paris. We expected to get robbed outside but not from our own hotel room. It’s a shame.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent and Central place to stay
text:
From arriving to departure the staff were amazing, friendly and helpful. The food was good and spa lovely. The room was so quite considering where it was. House keeping was good and the room amazingly clean.

Only thing is a little more milk in the room although as there is a supermarket up the road you can easily buy extra milk.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Pleasant surprise
text:
Hi, my wife and I are, just wanted to let you know that we had a nice and relaxing time In you hotel. 

All staff were very helpful and friendly, no rush and food was fantastic. 
Room was amazing, nice surprise with the views of Boulevard Haussmann. 
Pool and steam room was clean and very refreshing. 

Also like to thank the staff for assisting me today with problems checking in on airline website.

Hotel is located really close to the city centre.  30 minutes walk to the arc de triumph. 

A superb hotel.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Above and Beyond
text:
The main purpose of the trip was business and thus the location chosen strategically as LVH was a mere 5-minute walk to the client's office. However, my wife accompanied me and we decided to stay a few extra days in Paris given this was the first time in France for the both of us. We couldn't be happier with the decision as LVH was central to a number of attractions and VERY walkable to many restaurants and shops.

From the start, service was impeccable. We had a late check-in but were completely blown away by the attentiveness of Nicolas, who was essentially the only person on site. In the following days, each and every one of the hotel employees went out of their way to make sure our needs were met.

Rooms are on the smaller side but that's really about the only downside. They were new, clean and comfortable. As an added bonus, the downstairs spa lounge (with pool and steam room) are a treat. We'd absolutely stay here again given the opportunity. Great job, keep it up!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great Hotel and Service
text: Had a great time at the hotel, well situated, good facilities and great service (unusual in France). Specifically to mention Arnaud who has done above and beyond to make the stay pleasant. Would definitely come back!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: What a horrible hotel!!!
text: I stayed at This hotel , thinking it should be a good hotel since it’s located in a good area. But don’t get fool. Their restaurant sucks, they don’t have a good food at all and one of the server who also checks mini bar, is such a crazy rude person. He’s always mean and angry. The manager Maryam is such a rude lady too. The pool is so small but when you look at the pictures, you would think that it’s wow, and most of the times it’s closed and they are repairing. The water had too much chemical and they had to close it. No wonder why my eyes were burning when I went to the pool. There are tons of other hotels on this area. Try to make sure you go somewhere much better with more polite people.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Good location, good rooms, good.  Tout bon.
text:
This was a one night stopover, with a late checkin.  The pool was a relief in the morning, and the location very good for business and shopping. I had lunch in the restaurant which was also very good.

My room had good view down Blvd Hausmann, was clean, quite stylish with good bathroom and shower.

The staff were friendly, efficient and helpful.

Definitely a recommend.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: nice hotel, very good soundproofing but small standard rooms
text:
While on a business trip I spent two nights in hotel La Villa Haussmann. The hotel is well located, not far from several metro stations (Miromesnil, lines 9 and 13) and a ten minute walk away from Gare Saint-Lazare. 

Check-in was smooth, during which I was assigned room 203. This seemed to be a standard room, facing Boulevard Haussmann. Although the street my room faced is a busy road, I didn’t hear any traffic as they had double windows with double glazing, this was great. The room itself was nicely designed although somewhat small. The bathroom was small but functional and had a nice design as well. There was a small bathtub which also functioned as a shower cabin. The toilet was separate from the main bathroom. The bed was very comfortable and the WiFi reasonably fast and stable.

In the basement of the hotel (level -1) there is a gym (read workout room, very small and not a lot of equipment), a pool (very nice, water temperature around 38 degrees C) as well as a steam room (press the button just next to the entrance door of steam room and give it 15 minutes to heat up).

My experience is that French hotels are not world famous for their breakfast, and this hotel is no exception. Breakfast was not bad, but nothing special either. They served good espressos though. 

What I liked:
-very comfortable bed
-nicely designed room
-extremely good soundproofing towards outside
-fast WiFi
-pool
-steam room

What I disliked/ points for improvement
-small room
-sink in bathroom was damaged
-vibrations from nearby metro line/ train line could be felt

All in all a good hotel in a very nice neighborhood of Paris.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent service
text: Perfect service at a great location in the beautiful 8th arrondissement, a typical Parisien style architecture that is very appealing. Room service is super fast. Very friendly staff. Many thanks for the room upgrade!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Nicely renovated and modern. Needs some service polish
text: This beautiful hotel is perfectly situated and very comfortable. Breakfast each morning is very nice. I love fresh orange juice. It does feel like the room service needs a tiny bit of polish. I had to ask for shampoo after using the same bottle for a week and finally running out. Sometimes water was put in my room and sometimes not. It’s the little things that make a big difference. Overall it was very nice.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Exceptional!!
text: ALL the staff were amazing, friendly and professional.  This was the last stop on our honeymoon and when we told them they gave us a great room!  The rooms are more modern and very clean.  We loved the pool and sauna!!  We went there nearly every night to unwind!  When we come back to Paris, we will only stay at this hotel!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Good Hotel in a Great Location
text: My partner and I stayed at the hotel in mid Sept 2018. We found the hotel to be very nice. The staff were always very curteous. The rooms are a little small, but that did not bother us as when you are in Paris you should only spend very little time in your room :) the breakfast was very nice although somewhat limited. The hotel is in a great location to explore Paris and the pool and spa area is excellent. I would recommend staying at this hotel.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: First trip to Paris
text: We recently had 4 nights at La Villa Haussmann in Paris. The room size is small especially by Australian standards. It does have a separate toilet from the bathroom which was handy. The tea and coffee facilities are limited so be prepared to buy your own milk etc from one of the many convenience stores around. Having said all that the room is very comfortable and well appointed. The location is great from both the shopping district, about 10 minutes walk, and the Champs Elleyse which is a slightly longer walk at about 15 minutes. We had breakfast included and it was also good,  The staff were very friendly. We didn’t experience any of the negative things that are said about the French. To the contrary, and we have travelled through The Netherlands and Germany on our trip the French were the friendliest. Overall highly recommend the La Villa Haussmann!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: EXCEPTIONAL STAY AT THE LA VILLA HAUSSMANN LOCATED IN AN ELEGANT AREA
text:
We had an exceptional experience during our stay at LVH.  Our room was ready upon arrival at 10:30 am.  The staff  were fantastic. The hotel is located in a very elegant area and very safe for walking around late at night. The hotel appears to be new.  We had the Deluxe room with a step out balcony over looking Haussmann Blvd.  When the balcony door is closed you can not hear noise from the street.  The room was spotless.  Although the room was small, the layout was well organized (huge flat screen TV, bar, refrigerator, 2 large chairs, a bench, table, two night stands, king size bed and a large closet for 2 people).  The bed was extremely comfortable. The decor of the room, the hotel and paintings throughout are beautiful.  The bathroom was a nice size, the shower was wonderful, and there was a table with three shelves for whatever you wanted to use it for.  
We highly recommend this hotel and will be back next year.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Review
text:
Pros -
Bed was very comfortable 
TV good

Cons
The room smelled of sewer gas.  Reported it.  Read online to close sink and tub drains which appeared to solve the problem.
Restaurant staff were overworked.  Not really a restaurant more of a lounge.  
No real concierge only hotel staff that gave mixed recommendations.

Wouldn’t stay again.

Definitely not 5 stars.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Average hotel
text:
For business trips a hotel has to provide some basic functions right first time to avoid being average.
At the daily rate charged I don’t expect to have to do running repairs on the shower heads (scaled up) and water taps (broken mechanisms).
Equally would be helpful to provide basic instructions beside non logical air con controls.
Not good enough I’m afraid even with great staff.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great little hotel
text: Nice hotel near St Augustin. Friendly staff. Rooms small but well laid out. Restaurant looked nice but I ate at a nearly Brasserie. Didn’t have breakfast as wasn’t included in rate. Would recommend as well centrally located.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Small But Nice Rooms
text:
Location: Very handy location. Easy to get around from. The station we used most was Miromesnil. With a transfer or so you can get about anywhere. 

Staff: all staff were very friendly and provided top notch service. They were very personable and really showed an effort to assist at all times. 

Room: room was nicely done but it is extremely small. I suppose that is expected in Paris but wanted to point it out. We had two mid sized suitcase and barely managed to find spots for them which took up any seating area available. Shower was great. Air conditioning was quiet. (I hate loud fans). We were able to sleep very well each night. 

Amenities: we were out pretty much all the time and didn’t get to make use of the restaurant, gym or pool. However we did take a look at the gym and pool out of curiosity. And for those that work out. The gym is very small. It’s got two cardio machines and one set of adjustable dumbells. Again I’m not expecting a big gym or any gym in Paris hotels and I had zero time anyways. We did go for a jog outside one day so the gym is nice but not really expected or necessary. 

Overall: Great hotel and I would stay there again.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Romantic Parisian Bijou Hotel
text: I cannot say enough good about this hotel. It's small, but boy is it beautiful. A mix of classic Parisian style (white marble bathrooms and little balconies from the rooms). But it's also slightly Rococo, with it's mix of dark wood, marble floors and rich pinks, turquoise and green upholstery. The breakfast was excellent and the spa - true luxury. The only let down was that there didn't appear to be much on the menu for lunch or dinner. That said, the hotel is on one of the main shopping streets and there are many, many restaurants to eat in there.
name: La Villa Haussmann
