title: Quaint Boutique Hotel
text: The entrance for the hotel does not have a visible sign but the entrance to the restaurant is visible. The rooms are very small. It is about 220 square feet. Really just enough room for the bed. The rooms are decorated nicely. The bath tub is high so if you have range of motion problems this will not work for you. Location wise is not bad. The metro is 700 feet away, Eiffel Tower is 2.5 miles away. The coffee maker was dirty. Drinks from the lobby bar are weak, even the beer only comes in a 8 oz glass (not worth the cost). The night bar manager is very nice.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Fabulous Hotel and Great Time in Paris
text: We were very excited about our upcoming stay at La Villa Haussman in Paris and were more than delighted with the hotel.  The location was great, the rooms were quiet, and beds very comfortable.  The staff was very friendly, courteous, and helpful. The pool was truly a treat.  We decided to take it easy on our last day and couldn't have had a better experience.   Biggest disappointment was checking out!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Honeymoon/ 30th birthday
text:
Hotel was amazing. Decor inside was lovely, the staff were very friendly and helpful and the spa area looks every bit as good as the pictures. 
It’s also in a good location to walk to all the major attractions. Would highly recommend and would definitely stay again.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great time in Paris with a swimming pool
text: My wife and I had been in Paris before but this was our first time with our 3 year old daughter. Since it was a July we decided to look for a hotel that had a swimming pool. La Villa Haussmann was perfect for our needs. Location is great with easy access to the subway but we could walk to the Arc de Triumph and even the Eiffel Tower. Service was friendly , the room larger than usual for Paris with a large bathroom. The pool was great, we used it every day of our stay and most times had it for ourselves. Our daughter enjoyed it a lot but I was pleased to find that the pool also had an artificial tide so it was great for a hard workout as well. So after this experience La Villa Haussmann has been added to our list of “go to” hotels in Paris.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: A great hotel with great service, very polite team with fully support
text: A great hotel with great service, very polite team with fully support in term of all aspects, the breakfast is diverse and delouses and the room are very comfortable. bathrooms very good with a lot of facilities, there are a gentleman called David and lady Called Maria oriented us for a lot of things Paris with very kind way to deal, and the hotel dealing with a agency to facilitate the booking for the most popular touristic places at Paris. hopefully I will back again to La Villa Haussmann.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: What a lovely stay
text: We spent two wonderful nights in Paris. The hotel is centrally located to everything and every person we dealt with at the hotel was extremely helpful and friendly. Thanks La Villa Haussmann for a lovely stay. Absolutely perfect!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Mixed bag
text:
La Villa Haussmann was a mix of very good, okay, and very bad.

THE BAD: Some of the deluxe rooms.

We reserved a deluxe room (258 sq ft) and asked for a high floor, good view, and balcony. LVH delivered on exactly what we asked for...but we Hated the room. It’s impossible that that’s 258 square feet; there was about a foot of space on the two sides of the bed, and a foot more at the end of the bed...but there was a table there. There was a couple feet of space BEHIND the bed, and a shelf...but it was just insanely cramped. Maybe it’s 258 sq ft if you count the balcony...and the shower. 

There is a lovely view out the window to the side of the bed. The window is actually an interior and exterior pair of tight-sealing large French doors. When those doors are closed, the room is incredibly silent. When opened...just kidding! You can’t open the doors to the side of the bed because they just hit the bed. There’s no way out onto the balcony. You also have to walk around the bed to get to the other door. You also can’t open the doors to the foot of the bed because the table is in the way. The room was a nightmare. (We got moved to another Deluxe room that was much better.)

THE BAD: The minibar. 

One night, we put some food from a market in the minibar, which LVH was kind enough to empty out at our request. The next morning, we learned that the minibar is technically a cooler, not a refrigerator. If you have medication or buy something perishable, you need to find another solution for storing it safely. We asked, and none of the rooms have a device that will keep contents from spoiling. It’s for beverages only. We threw the food out. 

THE BAD: The staff walking in on you.

On several occasions, we had someone knock and then walk right in despite “Just a minute!” and then more protestations as they barged on in. We’d seen this complaint in other reviews, and didn’t have to wait even an hour to experience it firsthand.

THE BAD: The not-downstairs staff

On our first evening, there was a knock at the door. I said “wait!” and ran to the door. As the gentleman opened the door anyway (third time so far), I was able to stand in the doorway so he couldn’t walk into the room. He said that he had bottled water for us. I said great! He asked if we already had two bottles of water. I said yes, because two were in the room when we arrived. He said “okay!” and started to move on. I said “Can we have two more?” He said “No.” 

For all the reviews wondering why this isn’t a five-star hotel, “No” is a great example. My wife and I got a good laugh out of it. Where else are you going to get refused water? 

I left the Do Not Disturb sign up permanently after that. As a result, every time we had to call downstairs--which was frequent--we had to remember to take the sign down. 

THE BAD: Housekeeping

***This is the category that really costs LVH’s rating.***

On the first night, we discovered that there was a duvet, but no top sheet on the bed. We called downstairs, took the Do Not Disturb sign down and waited for someone to walk in, got the sheet, and put the DND sign back up. 

The next morning, we discovered that there was no conditioner. I mistakenly expected housekeeping to notice that when they refreshed the room later that day. They didn’t. We called downstairs, took the DND sign down and waited for someone to walk in, got the conditioner, and put the DND sign back up. 

We tend to drink (a lot of) decaf and had gotten some extra decaf Nespresso pods the first evening. We finished them the next morning, but they were replaced with only caffeinated pods. At a five-star hotel we stayed at in Rome (Grand Hotel Via Veneto), when they understood that we were big decaf fans, they gave us a tray with at least a dozen decaf pods on it. At LVH, they never caught on.

Also, when they refreshed the room on Day 2, they took but did not replace the mugs, bathrobes, or top sheet. We called and did the DND routine. I will say that the staff responded quickly and addressed the issues. So, the service was excellent, but only after it was shockingly lacking. 

The next day, the towels were taken but not replaced. Call, DND, etc.

The next day, the conditioner was not replaced. Call, DND, etc.

The next day, the mugs and towels were not replaced. Call, DND, etc.

The next day, the top sheet was not replaced. I think that yielded our tenth housekeeping-problem call, which resulted in us being provided a second duvet cover instead of a sheet. I gave up at that point; it was our last night.

I’ve traveled a lot, and I’ve stayed in all levels of hotels. You’d never find housekeeping this poor in a $100-per-night Hampton Inn. If you did, they’d refund you your money. At $400 a night, this went past annoying and into the surreal. 

THE MIXED: Some other deluxe rooms.

The Deluxe room we got moved into (301) was a huge improvement. You could actually open the French-door window, for starters. Not all the way, because it still hits the bed. But it could be what you would call “open.”

It also had a ton of closet space and shelves that let us move in and stow our suitcases. LVH actually offers a service where, once your suitcases are empty, they’ll store them downstairs for you until you’re ready to re-pack; they know the rooms are SMALL. But compared to the first room, 301 was a paradise. Needless to say, there’s no desk; this hotel is not recommended for business travelers. But the shelves made it perfectly livable for a romantic week in Paris. 

The room has two chairs and a table that can fit two place settings but not much else, and the room is too small for a rolling room service tray--so we had to put the hand-carried room service tray on the bed. It worked, but we were constantly aware how small the room was. Again, this was the larger of the Deluxe rooms.  

We slept surprisingly well. As in the nightmare room, the double window-doors seal out all noise. 

The bed was pretty hard, but felt pretty close to true USA king width, and that matters a bit when one of you has the Jimmy legs. 

The blackout curtains aren’t, quite. They leak enough light above and around them that you’ll wake up with the sun if you don’t bring a mask. 

LVH does provide an electric kettle, and if you’re American and like big coffees, I strongly suggest bringing some instant or powdered coffee and making your own in the room. Bring your own mugs, too, because housekeeping won’t be replacing the ones you use. 

THE MIXED: Room service

Room service our first night arrived pretty quickly, and the club sandwich was far better than I’d expected. Seriously, order the club sandwich! 

On our last morning, our in-room breakfast (six euro surcharge per person--a steal on your check-out day) was pretty inaccurate. We indicated quantities on the order sheet but they didn’t see them. They also gave us caffeinated rather than decaf coffee. The hard boiled eggs varied from hard to soft to almost raw. We called and it got corrected very quickly, of course. But it was yet another call to address yet another issue. 

THE GOOD: The location.

The location of this hotel really can’t be beat. It’s not especially close to any sights, but it’s a block from a large market (Monoprix), a block from a two-line metro station (Miromesnil), and a block from several restaurants and cafes. A pharmacy is literally next door. We went to Paris to stroll and feel what it’s like to be there. We found the 8th and 9th districts, up to Montmartre in the 18th, to be hands-down the best. (St Germain--the 6th--is nice as well, and it’s easy to access by metro or Uber from LVH.)

THE GOOD: The bathroom.

At least in 301, the shower has both a wand and a rainfall showerhead--and a tub. The toilet is in a separate room. There is another set of large French door-windows (frosted for privacy) that seal silently or can be opened into the bathroom. There’s plenty of room, and even a cabinet with shelves under the sink so you have room for all your stuff.

The toiletries--when housekeeping bothers to stock them--are fantastic. The shampoo, shower gel, and lotion are Heeley Cardinal. The conditioner is Replica Jazz Club. It’s a testament to the quality of the hotel when you want their products in your own home!

THE GOOD: The quiet.

Seriously, the seals on the French-door windows in the rooms are worth their own separate mention. If you want to guarantee that you will have a quiet night’s sleep, LVH should be high on your list. 

And 301 was actually right next to the elevator, but we didn’t hear a single noise from it. 

THE GOOD: The buffet breakfast.

Breakfast downstairs was excellent. 

Christophe, Eman, and Maud were accommodating, kind, responsive, funny, and made us feel incredibly welcomed. Christophe was especially great. 

The spread is entirely adequate, and the baked goods are especially tasty. They have a fantastic gluten-free chocolate cake, and a pound-cake-like loaf called quatre-quart that I fell in love with. 

There is also a device that lets you soft/hard boil your own eggs to your liking. Pro tip: Turn it up to 100 a few minutes before starting the timer. I “boiled” eggs in 60-degree water my first day. That didn’t work--but that was my fault. 

THE GOOD: The downstairs staff.

When we asked to be moved to a different room, the front-desk staff (Pauline and Megane) were incredibly gracious, and took care of everything quickly. 

Despite all the problems we had, the downstairs crew was constantly doing their best to recover from the upstairs staff and housekeeping’s errors. 

At checkout, Maud gave me a few slices of quatre-quart as a going-away present. That kind of thoughtful touch is a big part of why I’d consider staying here again. But the gulf between the quality of the folks downstairs and the folks barging into the room or forgetting to put sheets on the bed (!!!) is why LVH can’t possibly earn more than 3 out of 5 stars.

I feel a little bad posting this review precisely because the staff tried so hard to overcome all the issues we had. But I want to help other travelers know what to expect in their stay. If you want absolute silence at night in an upscale hotel in a great location, LVH is for you. If staff barging into your room, massive housekeeping issues, and a lack of space is going to be a problem for you, look somewhere else.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great location and amazing pool
text:
My wife and I visited Paris in the middle of the summer. The hotel is very nicely appointed and the staff is very helpful. Our room was small but had everything we needed (A/c, mini fridge, coffee) and the bed was super comfortable. The pool is amazing, there are jets that can give you a bubble massage while laying down. It's a magical spot. There are chairs to lay down and chill too.
Very centric location.
Marko
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Better options available at this price
text:
We stayed at La Villa Haussmann for 2 nights recently. Overall the stay was a mixed bag.

Good:

Location is nice, safe and quiet.

Megane checked us in, she was lovely, helpful and her English was excellent - much better than my French!

Good tech in the room - Bose Bluetooth speaker, big Samsung flat screen, Nespresso machine.

The pool area was a great feature and was a nice relaxing end to the day. 

The welcome drink was a nice touch.

Not so good:

Whilst the pool area is a good feature, it doesn’t feel that well maintained. There are uplighters around the edge of the pool, 6 of which weren’t working. The metal strips at the edge of each run of tiles (there are lots) are all rusty and the ledge around the edge of the pool was dirty.

The room is small. Whilst the room sizes are outlined, ours was more of a layout issue. You cannot move around the room with another person sharing the room, you’ll be dodging each other and climbing over each other constantly. 

At this price point I would expect a bath in the bathroom, not just a shower; especially in a ‘Deluxe’ room.

When we arrived the Nespresso pods hadn’t been restocked and there was sugar spilt in the tray - this obviously hadn’t been tended to by housekeeping.

The rooms have nice big windows but unfortunately the curtains that covered ours were almost impossible to move. They were so stiff, my girlfriend couldn’t move them on her own and it took me several attempts.

Lastly, on our first morning, the housekeeping lady unlocked and came into our room without knocking. This is completely unacceptable. I’m not sure if she thought the room was empty but rather than leave she kept asking to clean the bathroom - why couldn’t this wait until we had left? And more concerningly as we were getting ready, what if we weren’t fully clothed? It left us feeling intruded upon.

Overall Villa Haussmann is nice, but I feel a lack of attention to detail really affected our opinion of it. I think next time we are in Paris we will revert to our original hotel of choice.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent customer service
text:
My wife and I had booked an apartment using Airbnb and we found that it was somewhat lacking in its description so for the last week of our one month stay we searched for a hotel in the 8th Arrond of Paris and found VIlla Haussmann.

The hotel is well located in this district of the city that has a bit of a business feel to it, although the area still has a few boulangeries and in fact a wonderful wine store just down the street that has been around since about 1850.

The rooms were somewhat highly priced, however the hotel has a pool, albeit a modes sized one (about 20 feet - 6 or 7 meters in length) and has a nice wet sauna (Haman) .

The rooms were somewhat on the smaller size but comfortable and the bed was nice and pillows were adequate.  The curtains cut out the sun when one wanted to sleep and the bathroom amenities were good, although there was not that much liquid soap supplied.

The location was good as we could walk about 25 minutes to get to the 1st Arrond and 20 min to rue St Honore to check out the local high end boutiques.

I did wonder though why the hotel did not make more effort to entice us to eat in the hotel.  Perhaps this is something they could work on.  All in al a comfortable place, quiet in the evening, relaxing with great customer services.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: The best hotel in Paris!
text:
We had the pleasure of staying here last week. What an amazing place in Paris! 

The incredible staff made us feel so welcome, we have 2 children and they added an extra bed in the room for us which helped as otherwise we might of had to book 2 x rooms and slept separately. 

Great service! 

The indoor pool and wellness area was the best we’ve seen in all hotels. 

The Hammam was first class. It smelled of eucalyptus and was so perfect to refresh after an 8 hour day walking around Paris. The pool? How fantastic! It had these jets that made it hard to swim for resistance training, the spa had the perfect amount of bubbles and the twirly action in the water meant you could float. Just wave your hands by the blue lights for it to work! 

It’s seriously a beautiful and luxurious hotel. Worth every $$$$$
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Quick 2 night break
text:
I decided to show my friend Paris after she visited me from Australia in the UK as a surprise trip. Of course wanting things to be perfect I decided upon La Villa Haussmann as a hotel base. Our plans where thrown together at the last minute and anyhow we finally arrive there around 11am and I knew it would be a wait till we got our room.
After being greeted by a friendly front desk we where told our room was ready. Wow first treat and up to the room we went.
Everything clean and in nice order Rebecca was impressed and so was I
The hotel staff couldnt have been more helpfull with anything we asked of them.Extra towels, tea bags etc etc nothing seemed a problem, even booking a romantic meal reservation at a posh fish restaurant.
The hotel is in a good location, north of the river and central, but its so easy to get an Uber or taxi anywhere.
I really want to say this is a great Hotel with amazing staff, just fantastic.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent, Quiet & Modern
text: My husband and I stayed here for our first trip to Paris and we were not disappointed! The rooms we super clean and modern and the whole vibe of the hotel was delightful. Hotel staff were very friendly and accommodating. One thing I really liked about this hotel was that the windows were very soundproof, so despite the very busy street outside, it felt calm & quiet inside of our room. The pool and sauna were amazing after a long day of walking around Paris. Centrally located to all major landmarks and shopping.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Excellent customer service
text:
I like it at this hotel as the customer service was awesome from all members of staff that I interacted with. 

The rooms are lovely but a bit small even with my upgrade to Deluxe Suite but Parisian Hotels are typically small. 

This hotel has a restaurant on the property and the food was great. 

The hotel is centrally located as I was able to walk to both  Galeries Lafayette and Champs Elysees for shopping (15mins walk). 

It is a small boutique hotel that is convenient and great.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Lovely
text: This hotel is beautifully quirky. We stayed 5 nights in June and enjoyed every minute of it. Room was clean and compact, with a balcony overlooking the street. It's Location is perfectly close to public transportation and major shopping centers such as Printempts Haussman and Galeries Lafayette. The staffs were friendly and helpful. On the last day in Paris, we easily took a bus to Gare du Nord. Overall, it was a lovely stay.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Good Hotel
text:
Nothing wrong at this hotel. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Room was nice and clean. 
Swimmingpool is a nice to have at your staying. 
Hotel is close to metro but also very central to walk to your destinations.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Great property, great staff, great stay
text: We stayed for a week at villa haussmann and higjly enjoyed it.  We stayed at suite 602 and everything was perfect and very nice.  Highly recommend it.  Not a very touristy area, nice and relaxed.  Hotel is very nice and staff very nice as well.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Outstanding, a Great Choice
text:
When choosing a hotel in Paris is difficult since there are so many to chose from.

I researched a lot before choosing this one, and did I hit the bulls eye!

The location is great. About a mile from the Eiffel Tower and within walking distance of so many attractions. Well, location anyone can see it on a map, so enough about that.

The hotel itself is small and I would put it under the "Boutique Hotel" category. It has 43 rooms spread through 6 floors.

We reserved a Junior Suite and the room was great. Hotel rooms in Paris are smaller than anywhere else that I have ever visited, but this room had plenty of space for 3 people. The view was great, we could see the Eiffel Tower from it.

I have to say that the best thing about this hotel, the one thing that made our stay truly special, was the staff. When I booked the hotel I exchanged a lot of emails with them to set up airport transfer and a few other details. The response time was amazing (12 hours max) but usually only a couple hours. 

Then when we arrived everyone was so friendly and nice. Stefano was great helping us set up a attractions "plan" so we wouldn't waste time in Paris. They also set up tickets for a few places like The Louvre, Bateaux Parisiens, etc. Every time we came back to the hotel we were greeted with smiles, it was really nice, it made us feel welcomed.
I have to thank Stefano, David, Pauline, Stéphane, and everyone else that helped make our time in Paris a wonderful experience.

Iron and ironing board is available upon request, and they can leave it in your room if you have something to press everyday.

The pool is amazing, to bad I didn't take my swimming attire to enjoy it.

This hotel is great, I highly recommend it.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: New and improving!
text:
I had the pleasure of staying at this hotel just for 2 days! The rooms are really nice and clean. They have awesome bathtubs (I love bathtubs!) They also have an incredible breakfast selection that is absolutely delicious! The spa is not bad either the pool is a great temperature and they keep it. Very clean!

 I would definitely stay here again!
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Would love to stay again!
text: A fabulous base for exploring the delights of Paris.  Close to a metro station, or a pretty easy walk to the "main sights" if that's what you'd prefer.  The staff were delightful - friendly and helpful, and graciously put up with my stumbling French! The room was as you'd expect in Paris - on the small side!  However, spotlessly clean and very comfortable.  Lovely shower with good water pressure.  Considering it is on a fairly major boulevard, the excellent double glazing provides a quiet space, and it was lovely to throw open the doors onto the little balcony in the morning, for a peaceful view across the plane trees.  Would absolutely recommend.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Génial!
text: We visited LVH for an easter trip as a couple. Having done the standard trip advisor search, we decided to stay at LVH. A greta choice for anyone visiting Paris. The hotel was of superior quality and the pool is a lovely touch for an afternoon relax! The location is really handy also. Being on boulevard Haussmann itself provides a central base for trips to the whole of Paris. We ate out every night but the restaurant menu looked very appetising. If I return to Paris, I wouldn't look any further.
name: La Villa Haussmann

title: Nice Hotel in a Fantastic Location
text: We experienced a great stay at the Au Manoir hotel.  I would recomend this hotel for couples or families that are visiting Paris.  Our room had a large bed room and a living room with a small bed for our daughter.  Everyone who works at the hotel is very nice and they all speak English.  The breakfast is very inexpensive.  I recommend purchasing the breakfast just so you can get coffee and drinks and then go outside to a local patisserie.  The hotel has very good coffee.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Location, Location, Location...
text:
Just completed a two-week stay at Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres. The four-star property is located on Boulevard St. Germain, next door to Brasserie Lipp, and across the street from both Cafe de Flore and Les Deux Magots. The nearest Metro station is St. Germain (Metro Line 4) which is also only about 100 yards away. A Monoprix (with a large supermarket downstairs) is located very conveniently right around the corner. 
Our modestly decorated room was roomy (by Paris standards) with a very comfortable king size bed, plenty of storage space for a longer visit and a small but adequate bathroom/shower area. 
The hotel WiFi's signal strength (at least in our 3rd floor room) left a lot to be desired. It was weak and inconsistent. 
The continental breakfast (if you book it in advance) is only 5 Euro PP...which by Paris hotel standards is a BARGAIN. 
The staff is friendly and eager to please. 
We would definitely book this hotel again.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great Boutique Hotel..Perfect Location
text: Loved this chain of small boutique hotels.  This one was my favorite.  The location was perfect.  The rooms were spacious. The staff very accommodating.  The breakfast that was included excellent lots of choice.  The bar was small and limited but still great.  Loved
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Charming boutique hotel in my favorite neighborhood
text: I just got back from a week stay in this lovely hotel. I had a deluxe room on the fifth floor with a king sized bed overlooking the boulevard.  Nice sized room, soft sheets, great mattress. Small fridge and safe. Slippers and robes provided. Bathroom had large deep tub with rain shower. Plenty of hot water and excellent water pressure. Loved the heated towel rack. I would have like a makeup/ shaving mirror though. Full length mirror in bedroom. The location is great. Line 4 metro across the street. A Monoprix (like Target) around the corner with large grocery in the basement, Citipharma with all your French beauty products a few blocks away, Louis Vuitton across the street, Laduree a couple of blocks away. Easy walk to museums and the Seine. I took a car service from CDG as I didn’t want to deal with the numerous stairs of the metro. Breakfast was boiled eggs, meats, cheeses, fruit, breads. Friendly staff. I would stay here again!!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location and great service
text: We stayed here for three  nights while we toured Paris.  The location could not be any better...the metro is across the street, the Seine is a 10-minute walk away and it’s an easy walk to Le Louvre, Notre-Dame, Les Tuilleries, L’Orangerie, the Musée Rodin and tons of restaurants and coffee shops. The bed was very comfortable and the room was a good size...by European standards. We especially appreciated the friendly and  helpful people who work at the hotel. The breakfast is lovely and should definitely be booked when you reserve your room online to get the reduced price. Can’t recommend this small hotel enough. We will definitely stay here when we return to Paris!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Internet doesn't work
text:
I am happy with hotel, but there is no WiFi.  They tell you to connect through a browser, but it sends you to MSN.COM.

Very frustrating to pay as much for a room, but there is no way to connect to internet.

Some phones connect, some don't.  I have the newest Android phone, can connect anywhere, but not here. It's a great trip to Paris, but I am isolated without the ability to use WiFi and share anything on this trip
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Lovely small hotel in great area
text: This is a lovely small hotel in a great area for a reasonable price.  It is within walking distance of the Seine, Louvre, Musee d'Orsay and many other sights.  There are many restaurants and shops nearby. The room was a good size and the bed was comfortable. Breakfast was available for a reasonable price in a lovely dining area. Taxis were available outside the door. There was a safety deposit box in the room.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great Location
text: I love this hotel. The staff is wonderful which is very important to us. Also, from here, we could walk everywhere we wanted. There are great restaurants close by. The rooms are charming. Yes, our room was a bit small, but we really didn't notice because we had a terrace. We would buy a bottle of wine from a store nearby and some cheese and sit outside. We loved the room--much better than a big chain hotel. Most of the time, we were only in our room to sleep and shower. Too many things to see and experience right around the corner! My husband and I had a room and a friend of ours had his own room. I can't wait to go back!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Central Location.Expected a view of Cafe.Received view of walls.
text:
I paid for a triple room with a view of a French Street and Famous
Cafes and received a view of walls.
Very small bathroom.
The room did not have an extra section with a second bed in it as per website pictures.
Would be too small for three people.We received a double not a triple.
I told members of the Reception.Two agreed with me as to the size,a third older in charge just argued with me saying the guests could not all have rooms they wanted as only 28 rooms available.I recommend not arguing with customers in this manner.
The website should have been more clear.
900 Euros-3 nights with windows on to a so called unattractive courtyard and other buildings.
We were not offered another room.
I know due to the location,there will always be someone else to take the room.
I stayed at their sister Luxembourg Parc hotel which was much better.
Au Manoir does not look as a 4 star.
Breakfast okay but if you want an espresso or any cooked eggs-all extra on top of the breakfast price.
Self Service coffee from a Flask-4 Star ??
There is a big choice of other hotels in the vicinity.
I recommend staying elsewhere,
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great find in the perfect location
text: We love this area of St Germain, but the hotels can be pricey and just OK.  Au Manoir's location is perfect for sightseeing and shopping and is the real deal.  Lovely room, great bath. You're not giving up anything and saving a LOT of money.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great hotel on the edge of the action
text: Nicely appointed hotel just on the edge of the tourist district in St Germain. Easy walking distance to the Louvre, Notre Dame. Outside the tourist area enough to find lots of local food and shopping. Good night life, walking distance to lots of shopping.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great spot to start our 30th anniversary trip
text: We were very satisfied and pleased with the accommodations and service at this hotel. The location was perfect with easy access to almost everywhere we wanted to go, as well as feeling comfortable strolling along the avenues with restaurants and cafes galore!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: A Quaint Spot
text: The best and cosy boutique hotel for a romantic getaway. It was our second time back here and we did not regret a single moment.It is ideal because it was right opposite Cafe De Flore and to some iconic landmarks. Will definitely come back.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Warm welcome in the Left Bank
text: Au Manoir is in the perfect location in the Left Bank, right on Blvd St. Germain. The hotel is charming with a lovely breakfast area and extremely warm and accommodating staff. Highest recommendation!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Quintessential Parisian
text:
We were given two of the best rooms: one was for me, my hubby, and our toddler son and the other was for my parents. Botj rooms sat on the sixth floor of the hotel which is the top floor. They were two out of the three rooms on that floor. Both rooms were facing the boulevard and have period furnitures that were very charming. We even had a view of Notre Dame from both rooms! We also had ample walk space and space for our luggage. We never had problems with space or noise. We slept like babies at night time; often missing our alarm clock because the room was nicely dark and the beds were so comfortable haha! It’s very centrally located; its overlooking both historical restaurants: Cafe De Flore and Les Deux Margots plus really close to some designer brands (it’s across Louis Vuitton, for example,less than a mile away from Hermès, and just two doors down from Armani Exchange) and other high-end shops, if you’re into shopping. All the receptionists were kind and accommodating. Always has smiles on their faces no matter what time of day pass by. One of them recommended a really good restaurant three doors to the left if facing Cafe De Flore. Food and server at the restaurant were impressive and the prices are pretty much half
of what they’d charge at Les Deux Margots! We walked around everywhere and got to really enjoyed our time at Saint Germaine des Pres even more this time around (we’ve been once before) all thanks to how conveniently located this hotel was. I highly recommend this hotel to any one looking for hotels in Paris. We’ll definitely stay here when we return. Thanks for making our vacation wonderful and very comfortable!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Ideal place....
text: Great staff...from the front desk to  housekeeping to the breakfast staff..Comfortable room...Ideal location...Will use this place again in a heart beat....Made our stay in Paris so enjoyable...Great breakfast...
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Very central
text: Lovely place to stay plus we had the added bonus of a massive bathroom. No street view but quiet courtyard facing room so happy with that. Very small lift though! The station is super close and you can walk to Notre Dame, Louvre and loads of famous landmarks.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Disgusting
text:
This is by far the worst hotel in years.
Riding to airport, I received the message from the hotel stating that they didn’t know how I had managed to book them as they were full. Landing I received the message that it’s ok, they managed to find a room for me.
Room without a street view feels like in a cellar. Furniture is old. Vacuum cleaning happens once in 4 days.
Two out of four people at reception were rude, nervous and obnoxious.
The third one was not obnoxious but slept well and didn’t let me in after midnight for 20 (!!!) minutes.
Breakfast is as basic as it could be and you better off in restaurants next door. 
Finally, the guy was not able to print receipt during check-out. Utterly disgusting.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent location and beautiful, clean and comfortable room.
text:
On the main road with plenty of shops, bars and restaurants in the area. Warm welcome and swiftly in our room on the 4th floor overlooking the Main Street where superb glazing kept all noises out. Lovely old wooden furnishings, two chairs & a tea tray made the room very comfortable. The night porter was readily available and loved that he called the lift to be ready for our immediate use! 
Breakfast at €15 euros was very good with the usual fruits, meats, cheeses and pastries. All very good quality. Plenty of bars and restaurants just a block behind and the metro very near. Will definitely return!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: It´s not a 4 Stars Hotel!
text: It´s a small Hotel in a very bautiful area, one the best of Paris, It´s not a 4 stars it´s 3 stars. The rooms a really small, mine didn´t have drawers to put out clothes. I also hear the noise of the elevator during the night. The breakfast it´s flat.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Best place to stay in Quartier Latin
text:
I have been there 7 times already and I was never disappointed. Great location , very good rooms (they have a very traditional decor but are functional , good bathrooms and very good size considering Paris Standard).

Walking distance to all key Places in Paris (except Montmartre - but that is far from everything else). Also very good location to those interested in having a more relaxed experience in Paris far from crowded places and close to nice restaurants, shops , and high end places as well.

Do reserve in advance (at least 4 weeks).

Hotel staff very friendly .
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Lovely one night stay
text: Needed a one night stay in the Saint Germain.  This hotel was right around the corner from the apt where I had been staying.  The staff couldn’t have been nicer.  Breakfast (for a fee)was perfect and my room, while not spacious was quiet and very comfortable.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Another Wonderful stay at Au Manoir
text:
3rd Visit to Au Manoir Saint Germain, w so many choices !! Love it each time as much, or more than initial visit!  Great views across the Blvd to Cafe Deux Magots and Cafe de Flore directly across from beautiful french windows. 

Everything is perfect with this hotel...Perfect  Location to Seine, Ile de Cite, Ille de St Louis, Rue de Baci, Bac for Lauduree Bakery and very popular outdoor cafes!!  Luxemborg Gardens one our most favorite places to go since 1983 is 10-15 min walk and is the most incredible public park, in any city.(Also w a great history....Florentine  Medici daughter marries the King of France!!)  So much more in this area, but esp the infamous St Germaine blvd.It  is a shopping and walking paradise!  We also like everything about hotel and staff!  Hotel and rooms are  
beautiful w great breakfast room and choices!  We left fully satisfied!  Proteins, cafes and teas, sweets, and much more!!!   

The staggering difference between this hotel and others  is that the Staff are Incrediably Lovely,everyday!  Not just polite, but relational!  We love this  hotel staff!! Each and every shift is covered by the same familiar faces which are competent, humorous, and lovely in all respects!

We had a pharmaceutical nightmare w someone forgetting crucial and controlled med.  Aziz worked furiously and compassionately to help us get a Dr's order for med.  He was just so kind and very supportive to our family in a worst case scenario situation! Pharmacy was not our great Hope... but Aziz really was, with such a  sweet spirit! He  went out of his way to make a very difficult task happen, despite it being a weekend!  We are forever grateful!!!

Shoutout to Wilfried, whom we Adore and appreciate w every visit also!   The other 2 staff members we have forgotten names..... they are cut out of same fabric.... professional, polite but so relatable w smiles and information.  Great senses of humor, while always attempting to make visit Perfect!  Take time to visit, it will be rewarding as much as the incredible comfy beds and rooms everything needed.  Terrific view of Notre Dame from room. There is so much more, but have no concern booking this hotel!  Fabulous!!!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Friendly staff and great location
text:
We stayed her for 3 nights with our 2 children aged 1 and 6 and the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. I had questions before I booked which Wilfrid always responded to very quickly. When we arrived the kids were greeted with sweeties and although our room was not ready we were able to store our bags while we ventured out for a few hours. Breakfast choice was good and the room was clean and tidy with all the amenities one would need when travelling with 2 small children. Location was very convenient and within walking distance to most attractions. Cabs were available directly outside of the hotel and were very reasonably priced (about the only thing in Paris that is cheap!) so that was convenient as the Metro was not very accessible with a pram. 

If you are using the metro, be sure to put your ticket through the barrier to validate it otherwise you will be fined 60 euro pp as we were (120 euro total as they let us off the fine for our 6 year old but the guy in front with 2 small kids had to pay 180 euros!)

Overall, the only part of our trip we enjoyed was the hotel! We wont be rushing back to Paris in a hurry but when we do return (without kids) this hotel will be top of our choices list.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location and well-service
text: The hotel is in a perfect location.And they are all kindly to help you.The breakfast is simple but good.Our room was comfortable and classic .So it's a great option. We will return to the hotel when next time visit in Paris.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Wonderful Hotel in Saint Germain!
text: Perfectly situated, located on Blvd Sainte-Germain and only a few minutes walk from shopping and countless Cafe/Bistros.  Metro Station Saint Germain des Pres. is less than 100 meters away.  Hotel staff was courteous, professional, and absolutely accommodating.  The Hotel and our room was very comfortable and clean and had every thing we needed. Highly recommended if you plan on staying in the Saint Germain area.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Comfortable and well-situated
text: This small hotel is situated across the boulevard from the historic Cafe de Flore.  It is an easy walk to restaurants, art galleries, museums, and many of the attractions of the Left Bank, while also being accessible to the Seine at not too great a distance, and to the metro for longer excursions.  Our room was quite comfortable and the breakfast provided made for a good start to the day.  The overall atmosphere was charming and hospitable thanks to both the physical environment and the cordial and accommodating staff.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location
text: This hotel is in a great location!  Although they have few employees available to help you, they are all very gentle!  There are very good options of restaurants and attractions to visit in walking distance.  The breakfast is simple but good enough to start the day and the lady who serves it is very nice!  Although we don´t speak French she made all she could to communicate with us and serve us with a smile in her face!  We will definitely return to this hotel whenever in Paris again!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Charming hotel in a great location
text:
Charming hotel located on Blvd Sainte-Germain in the center of the 6th Arr.  Taxi stand out front, metro station about 100m away, and easily within walking distance to many sites.

Room was very nice.  Ours was in the front overlooking the Café de Flore.  Comfortable, clean and nicely appointed.  Loved the rainforest shower head too!

Straight back from the lobby is a small lounge and an eating area where breakfast is served.  Nice breakfast selection and very friendly service (important before that first cup of coffee).

Aziz at the front desk was very helpful, as were the others who manned the desk.

Would definitely recommend the hotel to others and we'll be back.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Beautiful period Parisian hotel
text:
We stayed here in May, traveled as a family with a toddler. 
Well, the location is perfect. I know many people say this about many establishments, but this was really perfect. 
The underground is literally across the road. There is a Monoprix supermarket literally round the corner. The taxi stop is right outside. Louis Vuitton is opposite 😉 
We Norte Dame, Musee d Orsay, and Orangery, Tuileries, Jardin du Luxembourg, the Seine, the Pantheon, Saint Chapelle, are literally 10-15 mins walk in all directions. Location was everything for us, so that we could siesta in the middle of the day. 
The rooms are charming, well appointed, very clean. I loved the curtains - very French. The cleaning lady is full of cheer, she was also very good with our little boy, so this made us feel really good. 
One of the reasons why I booked this was the option for a triple room. We wanted to be able to put our son to sleep at 8pm withiut putting out the lights. We could do this as he was in the connecting annexe between our room and the bathroom, which were separated with a sliding door. This was a well thought-through interior design touch, which I thoroughly appreciated. Lots of storage for bags etc.
Other good things -very quiet, wifi good quality, well appointed bathroom. 
A few very minor gripes:
- as previously mentioned by another TA reviewer, the sockets were at floor level. This made boiling a kettle really very impractical (and potentially dangerous) 
- breakfast was basic - but I think this is the way the French do breakfast! 
- elevator small, but again, this is a period hotel, but worth thinking about if you have lots of bags and are placed on the 4th floor! 
- receptionists were helpful when asked, but otherwise indifferent. A bit of a smile wouldn't hurt now and then :) 
All in all I would stay again,.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect Location
text: Very nice hotel...close to taxi and metro and within walking distance to many famous landmarks and superb restaurants...our room was very clean with all amenities...breakfast was well serviced and variety of breakfast options...room service is available too! We would chose this location again! Thank you!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great home base for Blvd Ste-Germaine visit
text: Terrific location on Boulevard Sainte-Germain across the street from Café de Flore, Les Deux Magots and Sainte-Germain des Pres church and next to Brasserie Lipp.  This side of the 6th Arr is a charming district with many interesting nearby sites and far enough away from 1st Arr crowds to provide a measure of peace.  Our room faced the street which made for a great view of café crowd at night but slightly noisy at night.  The room was very nice for the price and reasonably new and well kept.  The staff, including the manager Aziz was very professional.  Recommended as a good 4-star value in the heart of Paris.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Lovely boutique hotel in a great location
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights and found this hotel to be in the best neighborhood in Paris, with fancy shops, restaurants, cafes, taxi rank or train station just right below or across the street. It’s also within walking distance of many attractions.
Our deluxe room, overlooking the boulevard, was surprisingly quiet because of awesome sound proof. The room looked a bit small and the bathroom was kind of weird (no door and with no shower at all), though. Perhaps, Parisian room standard is smaller than ours. However, it was nicely furnished and the bed was very comfortable. Additionally, the staff were friendly and helpful, especially room service. 
I would recommend this hotel to any Paris lovers searching for traditional Parisian charms and ambience.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect Location
text: This is a lovely boutique hotel right in the heart of shops, cafes and walking distance to the Seine. Very modern bathroom, with typical Paris size room. Enjoyed continental breakfast in their very inviting breakfast area, loved the decor.  All staff were very welcoming and helpful. Would highly recommend a stay here.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect place on the Left Bank
text:
We adored staying here in the center of St-Germain-des-Prés.  The room was quite comfortable and even facing the busy, bustling Boulevard St-Germain, it was quiet enough for my husband to sleep.  Simple, clean, quiet, well appointed.  New bathroom.  Everything in Paris is small — you just have to expect that, unless you are really rich!  The room is small but normal for Paris.  Who cares?  You want to get out of the hotel and onto the street anyway!

About three blocks to the Seine; 10 minutes walk to the Musée d’Orsay; 20 minutes walk to the Louvre.  Next door to Brasserie Lipp, across the street from Café Flor and Deux Magots.  Google these legendary places.  St. Sulpice is about three blocks in the other direction.  We really enjoyed our stay in Paris and plan to go back to this hotel.  Highly recommend for a real left bank experience.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great small hotel in central location
text: Lovely hotel! Small, very French and pretty and the location is excellent, close to central Paris and walking distance or short taxi ride to all the sights of Paris. It's on a main busy road so felt safe always and there were many great restaurants nearby so after a day's sight seeing we were able to return to hotel for a break and then go out later to eat locally. We had a room to the front, it's a busy street but I enjoyed looking out and the area quiet in the night. The bedroom and bathroom was small but we expected that in Paris, bed and bedding were very comfortable. The front desk was not very friendly but courteous and helpful. I recommend this hotel and would definitely stay here again!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Quaint hotel in a great location
text:
For this trip to Paris, I decided to stay in a location that was near all.  This hotel along St. Germaine Boulevard is exactly that.  It's near great restaurants, Monoprix and City Pharma.  

The decor is old style French and rooms small (typical in French hotels) but they are clean.  Bathrooms appear to have been updated which is great.  One comment- there should be an electrical outlet where the water kettle is. I had to use the outlet by the floor.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: EXCELLENT POSITION
text: The perfect positioned hotel for shopping and eating and yet easy access to crossing the river. The rooms are well presented if a little quirky and the breakfast room is airy and light especially if you manage a table in the conservatory. Plenty of choice for breakfast and attentive staff.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect hotel in a even better location
text:
What a great boutique hotel! My wife and stayed here for our babymoon and loved everything about it. The location is amazing, right across the street from Abbey of Saint-Germain-des-Prés and famous cafés Les Deux Magots and Café de Flore. It is also just a 5 minute walk to the seine river and the Louvre and about a 20 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. In addition, there are so many great restaurants nearby that we never felt the needs to leave the area to eat.

We upgraded to the Standard Room, which was on the second floor with a view of the abbey and cafés across the street. This is happening area and I thought there would be a lot of street noise, but the room is well insulated and the area surprisingly quiets down at night. The room is quite large especially for Paris and the bed was very comfortable. The bathroom is small, but efficient and the shower was great with a rain shower head in addition to a hand-held spray head. The front desk employees were very courteous and helpful anytime we had questions or needed assistance.

I recommend this hotel and would definitely stay here again when back in Paris!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect location for a first time in Paris
text:
The hotel is in the heart of Saint Germain, so you stay at a walking distance from beautiful places in Paris, with excellent restaurants around.
Very comfortable and clean bedroom and also a very nice staff.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect stay
text: The hotel is in a perfect location with quintessential French cafes opposite. A great location to stay in Paris. Hotel room is clean, bathroom recently renovated and rooms traditionally French. Can’t fault it. My only feedback would be to have better pillows.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Under our expectations
text:
The hotel is not too bad, but for sure it’s not a 4 star hotel. Very well positioned (I guess that’s why the price is relatively high).
As a general experience I can’t really complain, the room was big and cosy, breakfast was good (make sure it’s included otherwise it costs a lot ).
As I mentioned before, it’s expensive for what it is, I would not go back there.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Wonderful Stay at a Fantastic Hotel
text:
We found the hotel through TripAdvisor. The reviews on the TA website were mostly very good, but the only thing we were sure about was the fantastic location, in the middle of St. Germain des Pres (the heart of the Left Bank) very close to three Metro stations (St. Germain, Mabillon, and Rue du Bac).  The hotel is a five-minute walk from St. Sulpice church (beautiful), a ten-minute walk from the Musee d'Orsay, and fifteen minutes from the Louvre.  Also, it is next to Lipp's Brasserie (very good steaks and service), and across the Blvd. St.Germain from Cafe de Flore and Les Deux Magots (all pricey tourist spots but a must-try for anyone who likes Hemingway, Picasso, and/or Sartre).  [N.B., there are a number of very good and less expensive restaurants and cafes just around the corner near St. Sulpice (try Chez Fernand and Café Six) and down the street on the Rue de Buci—for more, check out Rick Steve’s Paris book, which we used extensively.]  A nice feature is that the hotel is separated from the traffic of the boulevard by a wide parking lane, with a taxi stand immediately in front of the hotel. 
 
We made our reservation via the internet about a month before we arrived, and because we stayed for fifteen nights (the last two weeks of October) we got a very good extended-stay discount.  We were extremely pleased with our room, No. 202, a deluxe room facing the boulevard.  The room is beautifully decorated in a French style with what I would call a queen-size bed, and is easily large enough to be comfortable for two people with a lot of luggage and reasonable expectations.  The room has two large windows which because of nice weather we usually kept open, even at night.  For the most part, we found the street sounds to be very pleasant with the windows open, and we heard practically nothing when they were closed.  The bathroom is very acceptable, with very good-quality soaps, shampoos and toiletries (replenished daily), a heated towel rack, a tub and overhead shower with very hot water, and a good strong-flushing toilet (which I find to be very important).  Also, the maid service was excellent (they even folded some of our clothes, and every few days we were supplied with fresh bathrobes and new slippers).  [N.B., in another tripadvisor review someone complained that the bathroom had no washcloths but only paper facial wipes, which is true.  So we brought a couple of cheap washcloths of our own and it was "problem solved".]

We would also recommend the delicious continental breakfast buffet that is serviced by Rosalyne.  As part of our room discount we paid five euros per person per day for breakfast, seated in the comfortable breakfast room or the adjacent and very attractive day room.  The buffet has very good-quality croissants, sweet rolls, bread, jams, butter, cheeses, cream cheese, ham, salami, yogurts, cereals, fruit, fresh fruit compote, milk, orange juice, coffee, tea, etc., all of which was more than enough to fill us up and keep us going until dinner.

Finally, I have to say that one of the very best things about the hotel is the very friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable staff—including especially Aziz, Wilfred, Mohammed, Sanjeeva, and Rosalyne—all of whom speak English and were willing to put up with me trying my few words of French.  Without exception they were more than happy to make recommendations, give directions, answer questions, and help in any way to make our trip memorable.  (They also kept me well supplied with ice—des glassons—for which I seemed to be constantly asking.)  All in all, we highly recommend Au Manoir as a great place to stay, and we hope to return as soon as next year.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Disappointed
text: I love Paris.  I visit almost every year.  This is important to know from the start.  I have stayed in hotels in three different neighborhoods in various parts of the city.  I thought this would be a great hotel due to its location and the photos online.  However, the photos were taken using panorama and are actually very narrow (think cruise ship cabin.)  So if you really want to stay in St.Germain and don't care about space and comfort, this is probably a great hotel for you.  However if you want to be able to return to your room and quietly relax in the evenings or on a rainy day, you should probably look elsewhere.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Good location in a great area of Paris
text: We had a nice room overlooking Saint Germaine.  The bathroom was economical but well appointed and had everything you need.  The room had ample space and was clean and well decorated.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  The only issue we had was the street noise on a Saturday night kept us awake but other nights were fine.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Great location and very professional staff. Our deluxe room was very comfortable and well appointed. So glad I selected this hotel as a base for our Paris trip. Within walking distance of many key places to visit in Paris, as well as lovely restaurants and cafes. Superb service at reception.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: A great place to stay at Saint-Germain
text: Location is superb: Brasserie Lipp next door (literally), Café de Flore and Les Deux Magots - cross the street. My room on the second (French first) floor was small but comfortable (not too small, compare with a usual Parisian hotel room ), facing the back yard (quiet). Staff was polite and spoke fluent English. Bathtub, shower, all worked well. Writing desk, armchairs, even the electrical outlets and switches - were all user-friendly. The price was quite logical. All in all - one of the best stays in Paris I've ever had.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Very disappointed
text:
Ok it was clean. Ok at the reception they were very kind. Ok the location is good.
But please, it is not a 4 star hotel.
Our room (and it was not the cheapest type) was the size of the bed, and the bed was small. We could not even walk, just either be in the toilet or on the bed. 
The toilet...i had a shower and there was a pool on the floor.
Not exactly worth the money we spent...
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: AN EXCELLENT  HOTEL
text:
My family have stayed here when they visit Paris,maybe ten visits.
The location is ecellent, the staff go out of their way to make your stay an excellent experience.
Rooms are well appointed and large for Paris
Price is good value.
Hotels can be a problem for visitors to Paris but this one is a true delight.
We will always return ,my son who recently stayed told me it was "like coming home".
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Our second stay
text: We have stayed at Au Manoir St. Germain before. I am happy to say it is as lovely as the last time. The location is beyond compare. The rooms are charming and beautifully decorated. The breakfast room is delightful. This time, we stayed for 8 days and truly enjoyed it. A special mention to Wilfrid for his assistance and kindness. A big thank you to Rosaline for being such a lovely, friendly person each morning at breakfast. Also, thank you to our driver, Mr. Sherif. The people who work here are simply the best.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: French classic
text:
My wife and I spent 3 nights here.  The location is amazing, and the place itself is very beautiful and quaint. 
The rooms are on the smaller side, but the location offsets that.  Highly recommend.  Would come back.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Absolutely Charming!
text:
Couldn't have asked for a better location! Just steps from the metro and several good cafes. The view from our room was the Blvd St. Germaine which was so quintessentially Parisian. Loved it! 
We didn't eat at the hotel but took advantage of the Cafe Flores and Les Duex Maggots which are both right across the street from the hotel. However, minibar prices are reasonable so we did make some purchases there.
There is a creperie just as you get off of the metro and lots of high end shops in the  area. Always felt safe! Would definitely stay again.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Lonely location lovely staff
text: Found this hotel very randomly and what a pleasant surprise! It's a walking distance to the Louvre. It's on Sarit Germaine which is absolutely lovely - street cafes, shopping, vibe ++. Metro stop is right near the hotel. I would recommend it.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Paris stop over
text:
Excellent location (parking quite far for those who are driving), nearby shops, cafes, restaurants, service, charm 

Au Manoir Saint Germain 
A pretty Parisian hotel situated in the 6th Arrondissement of Paris. It is very central to famous cafes, restaurants, galleries, attractions.   The hotel offers fairly large rooms compared to many of the hotels I've stayed in Paris. The details, decor, sheets, pillow cases, frames, artworks, wallpapers, rugs, doors, lighting etc take you to another place in time.
It's a very charming, cozy hotel! I have recommended it to family, friends, and will definitely stay there again! 

Thank you!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Good Hotel, Superb Location
text: Au Manoir Saint Germain des Pres is right on the Avenue Saint Germain de Pres at Rue Bonaparte - a short walk to the Louvre and the Tuileries Gardens.  The hotel is small and everything is compact.  That said, our room was well equipped and fine for our (two persons) needs.  Breakfast (5 Euros per person) is fine.  The staff was excellent - helpful, knowledgeable with good suggestions for restaurants and the area.  The hotel is a base for one of great running routes - anywhere.  Down to the Seine, through the full length of the Louvre courtyard, up to Notre Dame, back to through the Tuileries to the Place de la Concorde.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent all round - would recommend
text: Photo is accurate - very helpful staff on reception, our rooms were well appointed, spotlessless clean, tea making facilities in rooms, very french hotel, lovely environment, handy to metro, supermarket around the corner, very good cafes close by.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Did not get what I paid for
text: I looked for a room with 2 different sleeping areas (couch separate from the bed).  I paid in advance and pictures indicated a separate room.  No couch just a fold out bed.  Very cramped space.  Excellent location.  Also air condition offered but not turned on right now.  You could open windows but NO screen.  Mosquitos in the room so we closed the windows and it was quite stuffy.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent service and location
text: Lovely little typical Paris hotel in an excellent location near Brasserie Lipp, Cafe Flore and Deux Magots and plenty of specialist bookshops. Right by metro and taxi rank. Nice young woman served a good breakfast and M Aziz had wonderful dinner suggestions, plus bagged us a free couple of glasses of champagne at Le Train Bleu. A very petite room but had everything  ncluding a nice big window and a view over the various cafes. Only criticism is the bizarre plastic face cloths.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: One night in Paris
text:
After a 14 hour flight we arrived at hotel early around 8.30am, we were warmly greeted by reception staff.  We had made no arrangements for early arrival but we were checked in early for a small 20€ charge.
Our room 402 was beautiful decorated, immaculately clean and very spacious with a huge comfortable bed our bathroom had a modern bathtub and rain shower.
The view from room looked over St Germain boulevard of the infamous cafes Cafe de Flore, Les Deux Magots and as well as the Church of St. Germain.  

Au Manoir Saint Germain De Pres is located in the Beautiful St. Germain district which is only a short walk to Notre Dame, Elle tower and a short Metro ride from all the other attractions of Paris. 

Nothing to dislike about this hotel, tics all the boxes
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Fantastic!
text: What a lovely hotel. A warm welcome to start by the lovely gentleman at reception. They give you a handy guide of good places to eat in the area and how to get to the main attractions. This was very useful to us. Our room was lovely and clean, comfy bed. Room was cleaned and made up every day. Great amenities including a dressing gown and slippers. A newly renovated bathroom I believe, lovely bath and rainfall shower. We decided to treat ourselves one day and had breakfast in bed, very good also and arrived on the time we choose. One of the best hotels I've stayed in for hospitality and cleanliness. Also, very soundproof it appears, I slept well. I would stay here again on another visit to Paris. A quirky boutique hotel.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Bit of a bait and switch
text: We booked a superior room and were put in a deluxe room - the front desk said we were upgraded. After along night of flying we just did not want to argue.  I did not look at the booking until we got home to confirm that it was a superior room we booked -  but be it as it may just note the deluxe rooms don't give you much of view unless you like looking into a wall. The hotel is nice though - Parisian and close to many of the attractions that you would want.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent location
text: The  hotel has a great location, you can walk to great stores or cafes. The room has character with a newly renovated an spacious bathroom, comfortable bed, very clean. It is a small hotel with great and helpful staff.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Lovely, Parisian hotel. Wonderful staff.
text: We loved this hotel for many reasons. The location cannot be better. It is next door to Brasserie Lipp, across the street from Cafe de Flore and Deux Magot. It's within walking distance to everything. It took us barely 10 minutes to walk to Musee d'Orsay and about 15 to Notre Dame. The Metro is a couple of minutes on foot and the taxi stand is at the hotel. Our room was small but elegant, comfortable and quiet. The beds were very comfortable. We appreciated the kind, welcoming, friendly and elegant staff.  Overall, this is a very good hotel that reminds you that you are in Paris. Last time, we stayed at Hotel du Louvre (Hyatt chain) right next to the Louvre, and although it was fine, it was big, impersonal and did not feel French.  We definitely prefer Au Manoir St Germain des Pres to international chain hotels. Wifi is free. If you need to print boarding passes or e-tickets, you can email them to the reception and they will print them for you. There is an electric kettle with tea bags and coffee in the room.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Wonderful Boutique hotel
text:
We have now stayed twice at this hotel, same room.  Top floor facing the Boulevard.  Very quirky but wonderfully atmospheric and great views.

Great location and very handy for seeing Paris, particularly the Left Bank.  And don't miss dining  or at least having a drink at the brasseries next door and opposite the hotel.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: stopover in Paris
text: A very quick stop over in Paris, allowed us one night in the city.   Great location, 5 mins from the metro, attentive and helpful staff, very comfortable, quiet room!  We definitely hope to return, for a longer visit next time!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Incredible location, good hotel
text:
The staff was attentive, the room we had was clean and comfortable but small.

Great shower and amenities.
The location for tourism and transportation is ideal.
If I were to return, I would make sure to ask for a larger room. 
Do ask for a street view since the rooms are soundproof.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Delightful boutique hotel in St Germain de pres, Paris
text:
Regretfully a short stay, but overwhelmed by charm, position, helpful accomodating staff 
Have stayed in bigger, more expensive hotels in Paris, this easily a better choice, small 
things that count, love their discrete charm and elegance. Staff get a big plus in everything they do. Followed their tips on restaurants nearby, judgement is outstanding
Next visit to Paris, this will be a first choice, left bank position helps.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Superb Holiday Stay
text: This hotel is located in the best street on the Left Bank of Paris. The hotel staff are excellent and very helpful. Hotel rooms are spacious by Parisian standards and very nicely decorated. High quality is what you get here.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Good Find.
text: Gracious and helpful front desk staff.  Made us feel at home right away.   Cozy sitting and breakfast areas.  Wonderful little elevator that went from ground floor up.   Amply sized rooms.  Good seating.  Honor bar.  Firm mattress.  Good SG location but on a very busy and noisy street.  Not a bad value at all.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: A wonderful stay in a perfect location
text:
We loved it. The hotel was clean and charming. 
The staff was friendly and very helpful. With Brasserie Lipp, Les deux magots, and cafe de Flore within feet, you can't go wrong here. Tiny lifts, but they were cool. Nice bathrooms. 
Bathrobes and slippers included in the room and mini bar, a big plus. Free wifi as well. 
Loved it, would stay again.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Wonderful small boutique in the best neighborhood.
text: The rooms were well appointed and had both a new and an old world feel to them.  The drapes around the bed and the chairs along with the tile bathroom did them well.  The breakfast, though small and continental, was perfectly good and the little dining area in the back was adorable.  The hotel is located right across the street from Cafe De Flor and there's a cab stand right there as well.  You're 10 mins from the Louvre and St Germain is a fantastic street to be on.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location but not perfect
text: The hotel has a great location just across cafe flore and brasserie Lipp. The breakfast was a little disappointment, the rooms are clean but old fashioned. Should need  some redecoration and update. The bathrooms has been refurbished and is okay but overall it's not fully 4 stars
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Perfect location
text: Tiny wee quirky hotel just across from Les deux maggots and cafe de flore, 2 famous French cafes. The price you pay is for the area. We walked everywhere from there. 1 day got a pass for the hop on hop off bus which is a must. The rooms are quite small but it's Paris. Big bed and room around it but bathroom tiny. I would stay here again.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location on the Boulevard Saint-Germain.
text: We loved the location of this hotel and it felt like we were among the Parisian people rather than in another tourist hotel. Unfortunately my wife was having problems with her knee so accessing Paris via the metro was not possible but with a taxi rank outside the door we could go anywhere and taxi was certainly more interesting than the metro. Our room was located at the back of the hotel.It was large and had plenty of space but we found the bathroom to be on the small side. The staff on the front desk were very helpful even having a range of wallking sticks for my wife to help her get about. The breakfast area was also very charming and providing a continental breakfast. For the location this hotel is hard to beat.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Excellent location and Customer Service
text:
Within walking distance of most attractions on the Seine, this was a good location. There are lots of restaurants in the neighborhood and a metro station one block away and taxi station right outside the door. The beds were comfortable. Room was small but had everything we needed. Breakfast was one of the best we had in Paris with plenty of choices at 15 euro each. We paid separately because we booked the room with booking.com, which didn't include free breakfast. It was nice to have air conditioning and a coffee pot in the room. The room we had was facing an inner courtyard and was very quiet. 
The staff here are wonderful.  They offered assistance with every question we had and came up with better solutions than we could have done on our own, saving us both time and money.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Cozy & charming
text: I was pleasantly surprised with this cozy and charming hotel in Paris. It's an old building but it's relatively clean and well-maintained. It's also located in a very convenient area, within walking distance to the Notre Dame, shopping, restaurants. The staff are very polite and helpful. I highly recommend the breakfast.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Loads of Parisian charm and location, location location!
text:
The Au Manoir is truly a hidden gem in Saint Germain De Pres.  

If you are searching for charm and location at a reasonable price you can do no better than M. Azziz's little inn in the heart of St Germaine.  

Manager Azziz is a wealth of knowledge and he and his team (multi lingual) can assist and attend to any of your questions or needs. 

As other reviewers have said you are in the center of it all and walking distance to many key sights.  Taxi and metro station literally out the front door.  Some of the most traditional cafe and restaurants are literally steps away.  

The traditional breakfast here is a great way to start and sustain you for a busy day of sightseeing.  

There is an elevator, air conditioner, good wifi. Teapot minibar etc.  

Yes the Bathroom is small but new, sleek, meticulous and modern and frankly bigger than many I've experienced in Europe or Asia

Room is super clean with great bedding and all you need- shouldn't you be out seeing the sights anyway! 

We have been back twice and our kids - 6 and 9 - love it here and have been treated with such kindness during our stays.  So I would not hesitate to recommend you bring your family.  

You'll love this place- but don't tell your friends- keep this great little secret to yourself!!
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Most unfortunate experience
text: The hotel was not even close to four stars. Maybe two but only because of the location. The accommodations were very cramped. They did not supply wash clothes instead they used disposable clothes much like a Clorox Clean-Up. You walk directly into the bathroom when up enter the room...so if you're in the shower the person entering the room will get a show too! The coffee cups weren't washed they both had remnants of a prior guest's lipstick on them as did the teaspoons. The water in the coffee pot was left for days without the housekeeping service ever looking at it leaving it with a stale smell and film on it. The carpets weren't vacuumed nor were the chair cushions ever fluffed or turned. The fabric on the chairs, dust ruffle, and foot blanket were all worn, faded and tattered on the edges. And the ultimate worst part of the stay if you could stomach the accommodations was the constant jack hammering that persisted from 7:30/8:00 am until 5:00pm everyday with the exception of Saturday and Sunday which the staff did absolutely nothing about, completely disinterested in helping several of the guests dealing with issue and tried to say that moving to another room would be better. FYI moving to another room was just as loud as it was in our room and every other room in this hotel. we originally tried to cancel our reservation because we had an opportunity to stay in Northern France but the contract that we had through Booking.com would not allow us to do so without losing all the money we paid for the 5 night stay. Booking.com stated that we could ask the hotel for a refund and of course, the hotel stated they would keep our prepaid 5 night deposit. Well now we know why...they couldn't get anyone to take the room if they gave them away coupled with the constant jack hammering. It was truly one of the most unfortunate situations when you're on holiday to have to stay at this hotel
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Great location, decent hotel
text: As other reviewers have stated, this hotel is in a great location.  Taxis waiting right outside the hotel, metro stop five minutes away, and within walking distance of many attractions. The rooms are small and when you book a triple (a cot setup next to the bed), the room becomes even smaller.  For folks who aren't used to traveling in Europe, you have to put your room key in the slot near the bathroom light switch to get everything to turn on.
name: Au Manoir Saint Germain Des Pres

title: Location, location with Parisian Charm
text: If you want the perfect location for your visit to Paris, Hotel Au Manoir will not disappoint. Yes, the rooms are smaller than your corporate hotels, but you gain the traditional Parisian ambience and decorations. The beds were comfortable and the shower was a pleasant surprise. Walking distance to many sights, restaurants, churches, and shopping. Small elevator to help with your suitcases. Continental breakfast is served if you are on the run, but there are many famous cafes in the area. Service was wonderful as Mr. Aziz and his staff kept communication open to our needs before our arrival. Everything they promised was arranged for us from transportation services to room locations so we can be next to our daughters, which made our whole visit to Paris so much more enjoyable! Thank you! We will return again to our new home!
