Would stay again.
name: Hotel B55

title: Very nice & clean
text:
No thing to complain
Nice clean, good room service,
Beds are very soft and warm
 The staff are very friendly
Nice coffee machine
Wonderful decoration

I wish if they put a big sign outside to easily locate the hotel
name: Hotel B55

title: Good stay
text: The hotel is located in the 13th Arrondissement. It´s close to a university in quite good area. It´s possible to take a direct train (RER)  from the airport (CDG)  to the neighborhood where the hotel is located - exit  station "Cité Universitaire“. From there you can walk through a nice park in a few minutes to the hotel. Directly in front of the hotel is a "Vélib" - bike hiring station. A bus station is a few meters away, the next métro station is ca. 10 minutes walk. During our stay in March 2019, the hotel seemed quite new. The decor is modern, stylish and cozy. The staff is friendly and helpful. Overall, the cleanliness is very good. We had a family room which was spacious and well equipped. The beds were very comfortable. The windows have good sound insulation. Swimming pool and sauna are not very big, but it´s a nice opportunity  to relax after a long day walking around Paris.
name: Hotel B55

title: Be careful when giving credit card
text: Hotel is ok but be careful when you give your credit card they take 200 euros without informing you still waiting to get money back.location ok about 8 min walk from metro .Breakfast is average but fresh orange juice is nice
name: Hotel B55

title: Fantastic family friendly find in Paris
text: All areas beautifully decorated, welcoming staff and fantastic set up for family stop overs. We stayed in a quadruple room with two bedrooms, like a mini apartment within the hotel. Well equipped bathroom with all you could need including hairdryer, toiletries of all kinds and a very large shower. Only very small negative is the breakfast room is a little cramped, but food was lovely! We will definatley be back its a great base for exploring the city, easy travel (we walked across city) to all of Paris' famous landmarks (2 miles to Notre Dame)
name: Hotel B55

title: Valentines stay did not disappoint!
text:
Beautiful! Really happy with our recent find of this hotel, was not disappointed with any aspect of our stay. 
Clean and well appointed rooms/bathroom, breakfast delicious, spa lovely and quirky touches in the rooms and hotel really made the stay feel special. 
Not too far out on the Metro with about 10 mins walk to hotel. A little difficult to find without maps on phone as signage not particularly visible on outside.
Lovely market opposite on Wednesday morning with a few french treats! 
If staying remember to purchase a metro pass for the three days we really made use of it but remember it doesn’t run from the point you purchase so if arriving late just buy one ticket to get you to the hotel and buy in the morning for remainder of stay. 
Super hotel!!!!
name: Hotel B55

title: Lovely design boutique hotel
text: The hotel provide family suites, which is perfect for families. Plus, the modern sleek design is just spot on - we enjoy our stay and must say breakfast was delicious! The small pool can be soothing after a day of walking around Paris. A but far off the center but nothing that public transportation can’t easily solve (or Uber).
name: Hotel B55

title: Overpriced and not as advertised
text:
I can not fault this hotel for the bedrooms or facilities IF they were marketed as a basic hotel, however to call yourself a wine and spa hotel is a massive stretch. The wine aspect is a literal joke, they have 6 wines on offer via a self dispense machine (3 red 2 white 1 rose) the selection was embarrassing and 1/2 the wines were either empty or out of order. A basic hotel has a bigger wine selection so since this is marketed to be a wine specialist hotel I think the choice is disgusting. The duration of my stay only 1 white was on offer and 1 red. The spa aspect is also a bit of a joke, it is not a spa but a small pool and tiny sauna. No steam room, jacuzzi, plunge pool, no where to get spa treatments. It was just not a spa in any way shape or form. The breakfast is in my opinion over priced for the little variety you get, there’s no hot food except eggs or waffles, the rest is just cold meats, bread and pastry. The fresh orange juice machine was good when they actually provided oranges, was told twice there was none left even though I came down at 9 and breakfast hadn’t been on long. You’re not located near anything although the public transport is fairly simple and cheap to use.
Overall wouldn’t stay here again considering the price you pay for a spa and wine experience you cannot receive and defiantly wouldn’t recommend to anyone who wants to go to enjoy fine wine or relax in a spa.
name: Hotel B55

title: Overall great stay if the location is what you want
text: We chose this hotel for the swimming pool and sauna as we had a baby with us. Overall, location is ok if you are willing to walk or take tube/bus, but otherwise you are not in central Paris and it takes 50-60 minutes to get to central Paris where Louvre and most things are.
name: Hotel B55

title: Fantastic, well-located, modern hotel
text: The hotel was just opened, all the amenities are brand new (netflix equipped tvs, espresso machine, and cool bluetooth speaker in each room). The staff were quite pleasant and helpful. The neighborhood was safe and quiet, yet just a few minute walk to several metro stations including one that goes directly to the airport. The pool and sauna were amazing.
name: Hotel B55

title: Very comfortable and well appointed small hotel
text: We were delighted with this new hotel. It is small, very clean and very comfortable with friendly staff. We did not try the breakfasts as our family live very close by.. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Paris. Probably not well placed if you wish to visit to see the sights though.
name: Hotel B55

title: High quality 4 star
text: The hotel is brand new, rooms are spacious and airy and very clean with large bathrooms that you don't ways see in Parisien hotels. Good access to Metro and biking or scooter distance to Marche St Germain with an incredible choice of restaurants. Internet was super fast and the hotel offers a sauna and swimming pool.
name: Hotel B55

title: Nice Hotel
text: Rooms were clean and silent. There was a coffee machine in the room. There was three metro station on walking distance and some bus stops near the hotel. Sauna and swimming pools were good. Breakfast was very good. Finally, the staff was very friendly and helpful (Special thanks to Ellias).
name: Hotel B55

title: Wonderful weekend
text: Very much enjoyed being here. Easy to get to many places by bus or walking very close to the 5th arrondissement which is the best zone in Paris,Staff are very warm and welcoming I really appreciate unfortunately it's very rare in thees days especially in Paris. About the room kind of luxury the bed was very very very comfy , there's a nice pool,and a beautiful landscape,my husband enjoyed the breakfast I couldn't cause no Gl brekkie.
name: Hotel B55

title: Excellent hotel!
text: excellent hotel, competent and kind staff! very very beautiful structure! relaxing pool and sauna and very large. very large rooms is very clean. the abundant breakfast is very good. easily reachable by metro. very calm area
name: Hotel B55

title: Everything was Great
text: I’ve stayed at 3 different hotels in the 6th arrondissement and this one is my favorite. The location was excellent, room was spacious, and staff was superb. I received help with meal reservations, laundry and places to purchase electronics. As I tried my French language skills with staff, I received tactful suggestions on ways to improve. The breakfast was good and afternoon tea a real treat. I’ll be back.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: The best choice in Paris
text: A very charming hotel in the best location, 2 min from Jardin du Luxembourg. The rooms are beatiful and very clean. The staff is very friendly and professional. The breakfast is very rich and tasty. I absolutely recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Hotel Recamier
text: Couldn't fault the hotel or service or proximity.  We loved it all and the staff and the food and the intimacy of the hotel..The staff were very helpful and pleasant and made bookings for restaurants and our necessary Covid Tests.  Command of English was wonderful and made it all very easy.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Beyond
text: We stayed for 9 days at Hotel Recamier and I can say without hesitation that it among the nicest hotels we’ve ever had the pleasure to lay our head. The service is incredible, the rooms well-appointed and the location exceptional. The best part though: so, so quiet at night. Highly recommend.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: A Jewel Box of a Hotel
text: I cannot say enough things about my wonderful at the Hotel Recamier!  The location is ideal, the staff is top-notch, client services are exceptional, and the rooms are beautiful, well decorated, and stocked with every essential. The lobby and the terrace are lovely, and the lobby dining area is so charming. Truly a wonderful experience. I am already looking forward to my next visit!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Excellent
text: Perfect hotel in a perfect location. The hotel staff are extremely helpful and accommodating. Very quiet at night yet close enough to the Seine and all the restaurants/shops. This is our go to hotel every time we come to Paris.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great trip once again
text: We enjoyed our stay at the hotel once again. Staff is welcoming and super helpful, location is amazing for those who like to stay in the less touristic areas and rooms were comfortable. We will continue coming back.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Just love this hotel
text: This hotel was a delight from the minute I arrived until I left. The staff is warm and professional at the same time. The decor is charming, everything you would expect for a chic small hotel on the Left Bank. The location is superb. You are two blocks from a wonderful small street of restaurants and equally two blocks from the Luxembourg Gardens, If you want to really get the feeling of Paris, this is an excellent choice. As a single traveller, I felt known in the hotel and that was a lovely dimension to my stay. I definitely look forward to returning.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Character and style
text: This is a beautiful atmospheric boutique hotel. Not for those who want a big hotel but you’ll get personal, warm service. Located in a gorgeous quiet square but moments from shops, restaurants and bars together with lots of sightseeing. We loved the room which was clean and spacious with a lovely view over the square and the amazing church. The afternoon tea and snacks in the pretty lounge is a lovely touch. Antoine the concierge was so helpful in making excellent restaurant suggestions and taxi reservations. Thanks also to the very nice and friendly English intern ( sorry we didn’t catch your name!).  A great stay and we plan to return to the hotel very soon!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely hotel!
text: Beautiful small hotel in the Saint Germain neighborhood, close to everything but still nice and quiet, across from a large church. Very clean and high standards, lovely bed and bathroom, thoughtful breakfast and great service.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Perfect hotel in a perfect location
text: This is the most charming and beautiful hotel close to St Germain and Luxembourg Gardens. Wonderful staff, cozy atmosphere and delicious breakfast! The room was spacious and spotless clean. Lots of shopping, restaurants and cafes nearby, but it still very quiet . We will come back!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great location but ear plugs may be needed
text:
Pros
(1) Great location in Saint Germain. Near Bon Marche department store, Luxembourg gardens, wonderful patisseries and restaurants 
(2) Helpful staff who can make bookings for you
(3) Afternoon tea
(4) 2 rooms can be connected to form one big room with a common door.
(5) Good shower pressure.

Cons
(1) Normally quiet but on a Friday night, there was a loud party in the next flat in the adjoining corner building until 4am plus. Was told by reception that other guests had complained before of this situation but nothing could be done about it. So good to bring ear plugs to this hotel if you stay in the biggest room which is next to these flats.
(2) Smaller rooms are tiny. A squeeze in the bathroom and hardly enough space to even open a full suitcase.
(3) Much more expensive compared to the past.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Best hotel experience in Paris ever!
text:
I almost don’t want to disclose this gem of a hotel… I have been to Paris many, many times - and this is by far the best hotel I have stayed in. Intimate, friendly, warm and cosy ambiance. Clean, well-kept, quiet location… I could go on… The small salon/library where the exquisite breakfast is served is so unique and gives you the best start of the day. If you weren’t in Paris, you might not want to leave at all…
We found it by accident due to a cancelled flight… but we will most definitely come back and stay much longer - AND enjoy the afternoon tea which we missed…
name: Hotel Recamier

title: A very nice stay, again
text: This is a delightful boutique hotel in a great location. Charming room. Breakfast has good fresh juices, croissant and pain au chocolat with yoghurt and cheese; have the honey if available! Afternoon tea and coffee are offered. There are bottles of liquor as well but we never partook.  Employees are very helpful. Hotel is quiet.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Hidden gem
text: Very warm and lovely place in the 6:th Arr. nicely decorated and with superfriendly staff! Slept like a baby in the bed, small room as always in Paris but comfortable! The location is superb, everything you need is just outside and with walking distance to almost everything:) The only thing missing is a coffemaker in the room for us who needs coffee when we wake up, otherwise nothing to complain about, just adorable! We will be back!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text: Extremely friendly and supportive staff who fulfills all your wishes, cosy and lovely decorated rooms, very quiet, excellent location with many restaurants and museums in walking distance, elegant and sophisticated atmosphere, delicious breakfast in a cozy and elegant room
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Hotel Recamier
text:
A unique, sophisticated and welcoming hotel in a great location. Have stayed there many times and excellent in every way.. 
Design of the rooms, lobby and everything else has a special feeling along with a very attentive and polished staff..
Wonderful breakfast served in a very nice setting as well.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Excellent boutique hotel
text: Hotel Recamier is in a leafy residential neighborhood but is located within a 5 minute walk to St Germain with lovely boutiques and restaurants on the way. The hotel is very stylish, has an excellent and very efficient breakfast and extremely attentive service. It was a joy to stay at Hotel Recamier and we hope to visit again.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Hôtel Récamier is wonderful!
text: I stayed at Hotel Récamier for 13 days in March. Wonderful and welcoming and always lovely. Every time I am in Paris, this is where I stay. The staff is superb; they embody the soul and spirit of this special place in the heart of the 6th arrondissement, with the bells if St. Sulpice in the background, its spires casting luminous shadows over la Place. I could go on and on. I am attached. I give this hotel my highest recommendation.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Nicola
text:
Fabulous stay. Staff welcoming, efficient and helpful. Easy check in and check out. Immaculately clean. Lovely towels and bed linen. Great room service. Complimentary afternoon cakes, tea and coffee. 
Perfect location in the Quartier Latin. Close to many charming bistros, bars and shops. 
Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great staff
text: The staff is amazing! From the front desk to the breakfast staff.  Great views from the square/ church courtyard facing rooms and very quiet so we could get a great nights rest after enjoying beautiful Paris. The shopping area around the hotel is superb. The best thing about this hotel is it is close to everything without being in the middle of the hustle and bustle!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Recommend’ier
text:
Great stay - clean, high service ; my third time, so go figure I like it. Only thing missing is a gym/sport or a service with a partner close by. 
Bla bla bla, this have to be 200 characters … bla bla bla bla bla bla bla bla bla
name: Hotel Recamier

title: The Girls of Recamier
text: Great place for Girls trip to Paris. Friends and Family, wine and food; tours by locals for the 7 year old;  visits to our favorite historic sites, finishing with late night conversations and more laughs.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Quiet and chic
text: We loved staying at Hotel Recamier. Location is perfect, the neighborhood is fantastic. Everyone at the hotel were very helpful. They make you feel at home.  Without a doubt we will be staying there again. My kids loved the place too.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: This hotel is not worth the price
text: I stayed in this hotel for a weekend with a friend. I am not that picky but the plumbing at this hotel is outdated and dirty. See photos. The water if the bathtub did not get hot either. A real disappointment for this price!! The staff of the hotel (Antonio!!) and the location are excellent though.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Fantastic service, location and accommodation.
text: We stayed in two connecting rooms - a family of 5. The joined rooms provided everything we needed for a 6 nights stay. The staff was SUPER helpful in any way they could and the atmosphere at the hotel was super relaxing. The location is PERFECT - close to restaurants, bars, shopping and public transportation. For those who like great boutique stay in Paris - go to Hotel Recamier!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel in a Great Location
text: We had a lovely 2 night experience at Hotel Recamier. A friendly accommodating staff from the moment we walked into the hotel to our departure. The rooms while small were cozy and most comfortable.  Definitely a place to stay for a few nights.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely Place to Stay
text: We just returned home from a 7 night stay at Hotel Recamier.  We had the best time!  The location is absolutely perfect, with lots of great places to eat just steps away.  Staying right off of the St. Sulpice square was amazing.  The room was clean and comfortable, and the staff amazingly friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Well located small hotel with traditional furnishing and friendly staff
text:
This hotel has a great location, so close to the high spots of the Left Bank.  A short walk will take you to some of the best bars, cafes and restaurants in the area.
The hotel is compact and the rooms quite small and traditionally furnished, buts it’s very clean and has a cosy feel.  
The breakfast was served to us in the dining room by friendly staff who offered a good variety of options and spoke fluent English.
I’d say this hotel is very suitable for an overnight or few days stay where you’ll be out most of the time doing things in the city. For any longer I’d probably seek a hotel with larger rooms and more public space.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Sweet, small hotel in a great location
text: Went for a girls weekend and we loved the room and view. Our breakfast was amazing- endless and delicious. We had such comfortable beds and good service. They also introduced us to the most amazing restaurant around the corner- truly one of the best meals I've had. It is called Le Bon Saint Pourcain. I will never forget this weekend!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Simply perfect
text: Great experience. Really friendly staff and a marvelous breakfast. The location is perfect  for tourism and shopping. The made to us an upgrade without changing the price. The room was big for the Paris standard and had superb views
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming Hotel
text: We loved this hotel. The rooms and bathrooms are small but the hotel is so charming. Breakfast was included and was exactly what you would want from a French breakfast. Croissants, good coffee, baguettes, cheese etc. The hotel is beautifully decorated and centrally located. It is easy to go to lively streets in the St Germain area for dinner and drinks. The staff also went out of their way for everything.We will definitely come back to this hotel the next time we are in Paris!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: A very nice stay, again
text: This is a delightful boutique hotel in a great location. Breakfast has good fresh juices, croissant and pain au chocolat with yoghurt and cheese; have the honey if available! Afternoon tea and coffee are offered. There are bottles of liqour as well but we never partook.  Employees are very helpful. Hotel is quiet. We will return.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming boutique in perfect location
text: I always stay in this area - my favourite in Paris. This was my first time at Hotel Recamier after a problem with another hotel booking. I found it to be lovely and charming for a solo stay. Yes, rooms are tiny and the bathroom so small you can’t lift both arms at the same time. But everything is well appointed and the bed was super comfortable.  I was allowed an early check in and slightly later check out with no fuss or hassle and service was always cheerful and nice. The location is great - in the Center of Saint Germain but in a quiet corner over looking the church and square. Would highly recommend.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Perfect Holiday Trip
text: My husband and son and daughter-in-law enjoyed a lovely four day holiday in Paris and the Hotel Recamier was perfect. Conveniently located in the 6th, it is quiet, lovely and the staff incredibly nice and helpful. We had  a beautiful view of Eglaise San Sulpice and even the tip of the Eiffel Tower tip. Highly recommend.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Terrible!
text: The hotel is not client-oriented. I do not recommend staying there. We were planning to stay one night at this hotel, but, due to the strikes in Paris, our train was canceled. We were informed 2 days before the trip and we couldn't get there. We tried to cancel or to move our stay to other dates, but the hotel refused, even though it was not our fault, and we were charged 350 eur for not staying there...
name: Hotel Recamier

title: bad customer service
text:
I can't really rate the quality of rooms and overall stay in this hotel, because I never got to the point of actually checking-in into this hotel. BUT, I know that I will not even try doing it for the following reason. 
I had a booking for 1 night at the hotel mid December 2019. I was meant to come to Paris from another country just for 2 days and wanted to stay in a good place. Train tickets and the hotel were booked a month in advance or so. Unfortunately, a national strike happened in France first half of December 2019 and my train got cancelled, which I learned about 2 days before the trip. I had to other way to get to France for the days of my stay at the hotel. This all was nicely explained to the hotel, and the hotel was asked to either cancel the reservation without penalty or move it for another date if cancellation was not an option. But the hotel was adamant they would not make an exception and I was charged full price for a my stay, which didn't take place, even though I had nothing to do with this force majeure. 
This whole situation just tells me that customer service will never be anything good in this place.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Wonderful stay at Hotel Recamier
text: My husband I recently stayed at Hotel Recamier in Saint Germaine des Pres’ and it was a lovely stay. The staff was accommodating and delightful. We had a beautiful well appointed room. I cannot wait to return!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming hotel in Saint Germain
text: What a lovely location and very special boutique hotel. While the rooms are not large, they are beautifully appointed and maintained. Very helpful and friendly staff always ready to answer a question or provide info about the area. Close proximity to Luxembourg Gardens is a bonus.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great small hotel and location!
text:
After traveling around we returned to Paris at the end of our vacation and the Hotel Récamier made that a very pleasant experience.  The hotel is located in a great location that is a short walk to several Metro stops, shopping, cafes, restaurants and sights.  Just the Sint-Surplice church and square outside is amazing.  We had a sixth floor room and could see the Eiffel Tower......what more could you ask for?

The room was standard size and bathroom modern and all clean.  The bed was comfortable and we slept with the window open partially and could hear no noise from below.  

The staff was very helpful and friendly.  We got to the hotel early and our room was ready, which was nice.  I guess you are supposed to leave the key with the front desk when you go out.  They forgot to tell us that but apologized and it was a good laugh after that.  It is a small hotel and they appear to know all their guests as they walk in.  It is a very nice touch.

We will stay here again upon returning to Paris.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: great small boutique hotel, great neighborhood
text: The Recamier is a charming hotel in beautiful Saint-Germain. The staff is friendly and helpful. Our room was very small but comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet yet full of cafes and shops.  We could have stayed the entire week just in Saint Germain and been happy.  Saint Sulpice church and plaza are just out the door, Jardin du Luxembourg is very near, and it's an easy walk to the Musee d'Orsay, Bon Marche, and Saint Chappell and Notre Dame.  We would definitely return to the Recamier.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Nice hotel
text:
We booked the Club room and it was large and comfortable, and nicely decorated. The staff was very pleasent . The location is very good and central, but quiet at the same time.
we did not like the bed - very hard matress and too soft pillows, could not sleep well. Also, we got 2 bottels of water in the room when we arrived, but it was not refilled since- not like we are use to from other hotels we've been in.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: 3 nights in Paris
text: Amazing location, great staff and quiet in evening.  Perfect for couples getting away and want to stay close to active areas.  Easy walk to all major locations and sights.  Would recommend and stay there again
name: Hotel Recamier

title: The soul of Paris
text: One of the most romantic places in Paris. The welcome here is always warm and unfussy. It’s a special place in the corner of St Sulpice that evokes the spirit of all that is romantic about Paris. The staff are always helpful and polite. The rooms are tasteful and quiet.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Perfect spot away from the crowds
text: Recently spent a night here while in Paris for a work meeting. Lovely little hotel that felt independent and intimate with kind and welcoming staff. Tasteful, clean, decor not “tired” in any sense, great location and very accommodating when I needed to arrive a bit early before a meeting. Will certainly stay again
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Hotel is in a great location but rooms are much smaller than expected
text: The hotel is pretty, the staff were warm and welcoming, and the afternoon tea is a nice touch. The best thing it has going for it is the location, right off the St Sulpice square making it quiet and serene, yet close to Boulevard St. Germaine and a good option for any sightseeing in Paris. However, for a 4 start hotel, the rooms are still tiny. The bathroom tub was steep and awkward and bit tricky to manuever and there was a relatively small area to store your toiletries. The bed was very comfortable, the sheets and pillows were very nice and I appreciated the USB ports in the room.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Another wonderful stay
text: When I booked the hotel my wife questioned if shouldnt try a different hotel having stayed there the last 2 years and there are plenty of great hotels in Paris. However, her opinion changed as soon as we arrived. Between the first class hotel, their helpful and professional staff, the famous church next door, the Luxembourg Gardens behind you, the great shopping, restaurants, bars and sights all within a block to a 1/2 mile, plus a bus station almost outside your door and another major line and metro down the street, I cant believe you can do better. You are tucked away in essentially a pedestrian area so no street noise. Often markets in the church plaza. We had this year room 42 and before that 32 which have the same view of the church courtyard. By European standards we felt those rooms to be a decent size. Extremely comfortable bed. Nice and elegant breakfast but some great places nearby to get breakfast or a pastry and coffee to go. Every year it seems I have some issue with reservations or tx for something and they always go out of their way to assist. I have no desire to try another hotel
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Excellent Property
text: I would highly recommend this property, Hotel Recaimer! Perfect location, close to everything and yet secluded and very secure (St. Germain area). Staff was accommodating, pleasant, and available 24/7. Breakfast room and outdoor zen area a real treat. Rooms are small but efficient and typical for the area. Excellent property! Thank you.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Second stay at Recamier
text: I have stayed at the Hotel Recamier twice now and have enjoyed each stay immensely.  The location cannot be beat (for my taste)  and the staff, although small, is attentive and professional.  Unless I find a better hotel, I will continue to stay at the Hotel Recamier when in Paris and highly recommend it to anyone else who wants to be in the St. Germain area.  .
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Boutique hotel with great charm
text: We stayed here for three nights in a June and had a wonderful time. The hotel is in the heart of St Germain, fifteen minutes walk from both the Louvre and Notre Dame. The nearby streets are full of boutique fashion shops, good bars and great restaurants. The rooms are small but well appointed and you’re not planning to spend much time in your room. There is no noise from the street. The staff are friendly and good natured, knowledgeable about the local area and helpful. The hotel has no restaurant but offers breakfast in the lounge and in-room dining, but, frankly, if you’re eating in your room you’re wasting your visit to Paris and to this arrondissement which is full of great restaurants and bars.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Super special setting across from Eglise Saint Sulpice
text: We loved our stay at Hotel Recamier - staying in this petit hotel in the heart of St. Germain-Des-Pres is just perfect. The staff was warm and welcoming, our room had a view of the square and ample space for 2 adults and 1 child. It felt like we lived in the 6th.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: A hidden gem in a delightful Paris neighborhood
text: Polite staff with greet you at the door & guide you throughout your stay. Rooms are fresh & clean. The charming courtyard is perfect for an afternoon tea or pre-dinner drink. Location is perfect for walking anywhere in Paris. Fabulous shopping & restaurants are just around the corner.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely charming place to stay in Paris
text: Charming lovely intimate hotel. A must stay while in Paris. Your every wish is taken care of & the hotel staff is wonderful. You stay in the heart of old Paris with cafes, resturants, shops everything within walking distance. Enjoy the church bells of Saint Sulpice. This was our 4th visit & it wont be our last.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Almost perfect, but the small, I mean tiny, rooms take away from the overall enjoyment...
text: High quality hotel with friendly front office staff, well located in the 6eme; comfortable beds and pillows, quiet, so getting over jet lag is not a problem if one sleeps some during the day, breakfast is acceptable continental with eggs as an option. Water pressure good. So everything is pretty good, except the rooms are very small, at least for me...
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming small hotel near city center
text: A charming small hotel.  The staff was very helpful and kind.  The small breakfast excellent, and coffee wonderful, no small thing for me.  Easy walking distance to the things a typical visitor would want to see in Paris, and the Metro is close.  Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Lovely hotel
text: I stayed at the Hotel Recamier for two nights in mid-December. I stayed in room 664 which has a very lovely terrace in which you can see the tip of the St. Sulpice church and some Parisian rooftops.  The room was tiny but very well appointed. The bathroom was large, with fluffy towels and robes. Breakfast was delicious--high quality pastries and juices. I didn't have a chance to try to the afternoon tea, as I was at work. The lobby and breakfast area were small but very elegant and charming.The location on the church plaza is quiet and pretty, yet walking distance to lots of shops and restaurants. My only quibble is that the reception gave me a recommendation for a creperie that was closed Sunday night, but luckily I found another place to eat nearby. The hotel is quite pricey, so i don't know if I would choose it if I were paying for it myself, but as a place for work, it was beautiful.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: One night in Paris
text:
Exceptional boutique hotel in the heart of Paris! Great location, staff were welcoming, lovely and very friendly.

Will always stay in this hotel when I come to Paris. It's typical French style. 

Couldn’t have asked for a better room, we had a view of the Eiffel Tower, very modern and clean, excellent cosy interior! Just absolutely adored the hotel! 

Thank you, until next time! Merci x
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming
text:
A charming boutique hotel in the best part of paris.  
We were a family with 3 kids and we took two connecting rooms. 
Everything was great.

We had the nicest view to the beautiful place st Sulpice, the staff was very friendly to the children, the breakfast was generous and perfect, gouter at 16h is a great idea and we enjoyed it very much. 
Really a gem.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: An absolute treasure...what a find
text:
A fabulous little boutique hotel in the best area IMO of all of Paris. Really great welcome, no hassle, very helpful staff and comfortable rooms. 

A cosy little bar area that offer free Tea between 4 and 6 was a delight and so comfy that we went for the Tattinger (at a price of course) as we were discussing the day.

St German/ Odean is a very short walk, littered with many great restaurants and bars that dining at the hotel is not required. The Reception guys anyway recommend their faves and worth listening to them.

We had a view of the Place de Sulpice and also the Eiffel Tower. Just wonderful.

Don't tell anyone though!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: This boutique hotel is fantastic!  Impressed!
text: I would agree with “Quiet Luxury”.  From the inviting entrance at the Place St. Sulpice to the warmth of the lobby, to the plush feather pillows on our bed, every attention to detail is not lost in this family owned hotel.  Everyone, from the gentleman at The Concierge, to the breakfast room attendant, everyone is lovely.  The place was recently renovated and designed by a famous Interior Designer.  They have made the most of every corner of this hotel to make it aesthetically pleasing.  It was extremely clean.  This is very important to us.  The owner greeted us in the breakfast room and wanted to make sure everything was perfect.  This was so elegant and spoke to the best in the Hospitality Business.  It is conveniently located on The Left Bank, not far from Musée d’Orsay.  It was very well priced and booking through Expedia, we included breakfast, which was excellent.  Excellent boutique hotel!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: So welcoming and peaceful
text:
Hotel Recamier is wonderfully located in the quietest corner of Place St Sulpice and a short walk from the St Sulpice metro which takes you straight to Gare du Nord. Once at the hotel, we walked everywhere, including Les Invalides, the Louvre, Rue St Honore, Ile de la Cite and Ile St Louis.

We received a very warm welcome from the charming lady on the front desk, who could not have been more helpful. Our Deluxe room overlooked the corner of the square - not a large room, but very stylish and comfortable. My only disappointment was the black mould on some of the tiles in the shower.

What struck me most was how tranquil the atmosphere was. Being tucked in the corner of the square with a large paved area in front, you hear hardly any noise from outside or inside the hotel.

Breakfast was a good quality continental breakfast. A nice touch was the complimentary tea and cake from 4-6pm each day. If you book through Mr and Mrs Smith, as we did, you also get two free tickets to the Louvre or Musee d'Orsay which avoid any queues or waiting at the museum.

All in all a charming place to stay.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Quiet Luxury
text: Beautiful and elegant hotel where sleeping in was easy with a late check out and easy access to all you want to see.  So quiet it was hard to believe we where in the center of shopping and food.  Very engaging and helpful staff- a repeater!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Typical Parisian hotel with timeless charm
text: Hotel Recamier is very well situated: in one of the most charming neighbourhoods of Paris, nearby many historic sites and buildings and on walking distance from les jardins de Luxembourg.  Hotel is in an authentic Parisian building, so small rooms but well equiped and comfortable bed.  it is nice to see that the hotel, in which I stayed exactly 20 years ago, has remained itself and kept the unique charms of a Parisian hotel.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great romantic couples weekend stay
text: Can't recommend the hotel enough. It's in a fantastic location, opposite a lovely square near eglise saint sulpice. It's stylish and comfortable, and the staff were warm, inviting, engaging and professional. We walked to all the major tourist spots. There are also plenty of cafes/bakeries/restaurants within walking distance. We would certainly return.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Floridian
text: Wonderful hotel conveniently located with a well trained and friendly staff from top to bottom! No problem with English speaking couple needing assistance. We were there for a week and never had a problem the hotel staff did not take care of with ease.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Great boutique hotel
text: Excellent location, quiet and great walking in the area. Very quaint.All the staff very friendly and professional.Highly recommend this hotel.Complementary afternoon tea is a great idea after doing tourism during the day and being able to rest before enjoying a good dinner at a cozy and excellent restaurant close by.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Spacious quiet room- Divine Staff
text: This was my first time staying at Hotel Recamier, although I have visited Paris many times. This hotel is a gem! The location is wonderful- right in the heart of the Left Bank but on the far side of plaza so it is wonderfully quiet yet steps from the action- and a taxi station too! The staff was very helpful and the tea in the lobby area was a very nice touch. The room was beautifully appointed- spacious and with a terrific bathroom. Also the air-conditioning was top notch which is not so common in Paris! Highly recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming, wonderful location
text:
We were only here one night, location is prime and the hotel is charming.
The rooms, even for Paris are a bit small but well appointed. We found our bathroom to be updated and no problem with the shower as other reviews mentioned. They do have a lovely tea from 4-6 which is a nice touch. They offer 2 types of breakfast the express which consists of coffee/tea and a pastry or a full breakfast- it’s nice to have the choice. I would mention it would be wise to check your bill when leaving, we had the express breakfast however was charged for 2 full, the staff promptly changed it when I pointed out the mistake.
If you stay more than 1 or 2 nights would
Advise a larger room.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Beware!
text: Beware of the glamour shots posted on the hotel website and this website as this hotel is anything but glamorous. I'm not one to get hung up on the little things but after spending 5 nights at 400 Euro per night in this aging "gem" the little things started to bother me. Some of these included the stained carpet, the ripped wallpaper, the leaking shower that would leave water all over the bathroom floor, and the toilet with its rock hard freezing cold toilet seat which was in a completely separate room on the other side of the hotel room (not in the room with the sink and shower like a standard bathroom). You should also know that only a handful of rooms overlook the Saint Sulpice square while the vast majority of rooms like ours overlook a tiny "courtyard" where you can see directly into other rooms because of the proximity to them. The turndown consisted only of removing the decorative pillows from our bed and closing the drapes. Our slippers were not placed near our bedside nor were there any chocolates or water bottles placed by our bed- again things that I expect when paying 400 Euro per night. The staff were just okay- nothing that made us overlook all these negatives. In a city full of overwhelming sights this place is underwhelming at best. Don't get scammed like we did... stay elsewhere!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming and wonderful!
text:
My husband and I stayed there our first day/night in Paris..and our only night in the city proper.  Upon arrival at 11:00 am, they quickly showed us to our room.  (Thank God!)

The hotel is absolutely charming in a quiet and sophisticated area of Paris.  The location is great so we walked to the Louvre.   Restaurants are close by as well.

The staff was exceptionally pleasant and couldn’t be more helpful.  I would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay there again!!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Charming Boutique Hotel
text: A wonderful small hotel tucked into a tiny square across the street from Saint-Sulpice on the Left Bank. Snug rooms but great service, within easy walking distance from good restaurants and the great shopping of Saint-Germain-des-Pres.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Good, but very far from great, especially for the price
text:
I’m really surprised by the reviews claiming this place is perfection, it is very clearly not perfect. 

On the positive side it’s in an excellent location, it’s a nicely historic building and the service is extremely proficient. The rooms are a small, but this is to be expected. 

However, the hotel is let down in 3 ways. First the shower heads are very old meaning water sprays in all different directions, and in the absence of a shower screen, mostly on the floor. Seems like a small point, but it’s actually really hard to have a decent shower and just plain annoying. Second, the pillows are decorative rather than functional, meaning they have no neck support and are very uncomfortable. 

So what is the third drawback? Quite simply for the money you pay and the very small cost to the hotel to rectify the shower and the pillow, especially given many reviews citing these complaints, it’s unacceptable that these issues persist. 

It’s a good hotel and it could so easily be great, but without just a little bit of investment these small issues really tarnish an otherwise nice experience. 

I would not stay again until I read reviews indicating these points are fixed.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Perfection
text: This hotel is small but perfect ...everyone is so very nice and the rooms are wonderful !! We wish that we could take the bed mattress with us !!!!  It is close to everything ....Do yourself a favor and stay here
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Beautiful hotel in a peaceful location.
text: We have stayed at Hotel Recamier before and it met up to expectations on our recent trip to Paris.  It is a lovely hotel, based in a peaceful square and overlooks an old church.  It is within only a few minutes' walk of a range of bars and restaurants and is also conveniently situated for the metro.  We found the reception staff to be welcoming and extremely helpful.  We would like to stay for longer on our next visit.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Everything merits its description as a left bank Gem!
text: Where should I begin. As a first timer to France, I spent much time researching where I should stay, eventually ended up here. From the second we checked in, we kept on being surprised by the things here one after another. The staff first off are very friendly, answer questions promptly. For those of you need a SIM card, a store named SFR is within 5 minutes of walking distance, for a 4G data and unlimited text and talk it’s 30 euros plus 18.99 card cost. Shops like Sandro, YSL are close by, also a pharmacy is right by the corner. It’s literally right next to St Sulpice church with great square view. Metro is close by 5 minute walk. A plus is that not one but 3 metro stations are close by, so regardless of where you want to go, you could always find a direct or indirect metro. Rooms are smaller compared to US standard, this was a big minus IMO if I have to name one, but very quiet and comfortable. What I miss is clothe iron in the room but a steamer can be requested from the front desk. Slippers are a plus. Breakfast is very good, dishes are fresh and you can order customized eggs and sandwiches, or if you want to grab coffee from Cafe De Flore for which many famous artists, celebrities and politicians including Zhou EnLai (Chinese Primer) had been their guests. Afternoon tea time between 4-6pm daily offers free sweets, juices and tea. Overall, if you want a hotel that’s continent and safe, has a touch of Air BB, great access to metros but don’t mind slightly smaller rooms (which I think maybe is typical for Paris), I will highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Wonderful stay!
text: Everything about our stay at Hotel Recamier was perfect... from the location, to the wonderful staff, to the surprise chocolates left in our room.  My husband and I stayed for 4 nights and wish we stayed longer!   This hotel was conveniently located and we were able to walk to top destinations like Notre Dame and the Louvre.  Afternoon tea was offered daily as well breakfast, which had fresh pastries, fruits, yogurts, and cereals, which was just enough to start our day.  We loved our stay and can't wait to go back one day.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Perfect Hotel, perfect location
text: We stayed here last year and said if we were able to return to Paris we would stay here again. I know there are tons of hotel choices in Paris but given the fantastic service, the perfect location and the comfort of the hotel, its hard for my wife and I even considering staying anywhere else. First the hotel. We had room 32, which overlooked Place St Sulpice. If you are going to spend the $ to stay there I'd pay a little more and get the view. Room decent size. Not huge but sufficient for 6 nights. Small sitting area, very comfortable bed, closet. Decent size bathroom/shower. Staff amazing and helpful. From helping with reservations to anything/anywhere, to giving advice to just asking about your day. I had trouble using a web site to get museum tx and one of the staff used his phone, bought the tx and I paid him back. Saved us a lot of time in line. Another time they told us about a web site you had to use in order to get tx to climb up Notre Dame. You do have to pay for breakfast but its elegant, you can sit in an outside patio, and if you are there more than 1 night odds high they will know your coffee preferences by the 2nd morning.Of the 6 days I think we ate there 4x. There are many places nearby if you want something else. Second reason to book is the location- The Luxembourg gardens are right behind you. There are many very good restaurants and bars just across the square. There is a bus stop across the square and a metro nearby. You can easily walk to Notre Dame, D'Orsay, even the Louvre (or a bus drops you off in front). And we are 60+.. We pretty much walked the entire 6th Arrond. Lots of shopping nearby and along St Germain. Despite all of this the area is pretty quiet. You also have a famous church right in front of you and maybe a even more famous one a few blocks over (not counting ND). There is even a grocery store (Marks and Spenser) around the corner. We have friends in Paris and even they were impressed when they found out where we were staying
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Everything a Hotel Should Be
text: Our family of 4 recently spent one week at the Hotel Recamier, and from check-in to check-out we could not have been happier with the service, hotel amenities, rooms, and location. We booked a Club Room and adjacent Deluxe Room for our teenage sons, and the set up was perfect. The Club Room was spacious and well laid out, especially by Paris standards, and although the Deluxe Room was smaller it was more than adequate for 2 tall teenage boys. The location is spectacular, with easy walking to excellent restaurants, shopping, and attractions. We recommend doing some homework on restaurants prior to a trip to Paris, or you can take our advice and dine at Boucherie Rouliere (traditional french bistro, 1 block away from the hotel, best we had for traditional French), Hotel Amour Restaurant (best scene in Paris, request a terrace seating), Mama Shelter (eclectic French, seriously cool vibe, request a roof-top table), or Lao Tseu (fine Chinese, to mix it up). If brunch is your thing, we had a very nice one at Eggs and Co. and if you're pining for falafel or shawarma we liked mi-va-mi in the Marais district for lunch. If you're looking for a boutique hotel with the feel of an intimate family home where you're known to staff, this is your place. We'll be back.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Wonderful Hotel, Wonderful People
text: My daughter and I spent 8 nights at the Hotel Recamier.  It overlooks the Church of Saint- Sulpice – a beautiful cathedral.  The hotel is perfectly situated, quiet, yet only a few minutes walk to literary cafes, such as the Café Flore, to the Sorbonne, Luxemburg Gardens, and great shopping.  The hotel is beautifully designed in neutral colors, lots of shades of grey, white and black.  Our lovely room overlooked the cathedral.   Although the Hotel Recamier is excellent in many respects, location and design, for example, the service is truly outstanding.  The people at the heart of the Recamier (Bruno, Paulo, Cecilia and most recently, Qwen) are knowledgeable, kind, gracious and generous with their time.  On a busy shopping day, I had lost a bag containing a recently purchased dress. Because my French is minimal, I asked Paulo, a concierge, to call various stores where I might have left the bag. In many ways this was a pointless exercise, but Paulo patiently and kindly made the calls on my behalf.   My daughter and I were eager to practice our French.  Paulo, Cecilia, Bruno and Qwen encouraged our efforts.  They also suggested a number of excellent restaurants, and interesting routes for us to take when were sight seeing.  Bruno always seemed to have just the right words when greeting us in the morning or listening to us describe our day in Paris, encouraging our French, or expressing a kind word about one of his colleagues.  As beautiful as the Recamier is, the people who work their have created a truly outstanding hotel, combining their knowledge of Paris, exceptional professionalism and personal warmth to ensure that their guests enjoy  Paris. We were delighted to be at the Hotel Recamier and grateful to have met this wonderful group of people.
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Romantic Paris weekend
text: Hotel Récamier and staff were the ideal selection for our romantic weekend. The location is perfect for shopping, dinners, exploring... looking forward to returning as soon as possible. Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Recamier

title: Paris
text:
Arrived to a very warm welcome. Beautiful reception area.  Very quick and efficient check in.  Room on the 4th floor. Lift straight to the room. 
Beautiful, spacious room. We had a room for 3 people. So much room to put clothes with shelves, 3 wardrobes and a desk/dressing table. 
Beds were so comfortable with amazing pillows. Towels and toiletries supplied. Shower beautiful with plenty of hot water. 

The location of the hotel is excellent. Near lots of restaurants and bars. Near the hop on hop off bus stop and Notre Damn.   Also I would recommend the batobus which is a hop on boat and is for a full day and is €19 per person. 
The breakfast is from 7.15 until 11 am and is continental. There was cornflakes, muesli, boiled eggs, toast, yoghurt, fruit, hams and cheeses and croissants.  Tea, coffee, water and orange juice available. 
The only negative would be that the tables for breakfast were extremely small and there were only tables for 2 people. The dirty plates etc were not taken away, we had to ask for them to be removed. 
The day of our departure we could leave our luggage at the hotel after we checked out which was fantastic as we had to check out by 11 and did not need to leave until 2.30. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel!
name: Hôtel Henri IV Rive Gauche
description: L’Hôtel Henri IV Rive Gauche vous invite à un voyage dans le Paris littéraire, et artistique au cœur du quartier historique de la ville lumière. title: Mixed Experience
text:
We have stayed at this hotel 4 times since 2014, 3 times pre-pandemic and the last recently.  The location is fantastic.  It is on Rue St. Jacques about a block off the Seine, one block east of the Blvd. Saint Michel.  It is a heavy tourist area, with narrow streets and an endless variety of cheap restaurants of all types.  But it is so close to so many things -- Notre Dame, the Pantheon, La Chapelle, Luxembourg Gardens.  It is wedged between the fashionable 6th and 7th arrondissements to the West and the Sorbonne to the East.  

Other than location, however, the hotel does not have a lot going for it.  On our last stay, we were given a very tiny room, and I mean tiny.  It was a double, with maybe a foot of clearance on each side of the bed and no more than about 5 feet from the foot of the bed to the wall.  Our booking said the room was 173 square feet, but this was nowhere close.  I measured and it was about 120 square feet, including the bathroom and a useless little hall that connected the bathroom to the bedroom.  If memory serves me, the measurements of the bedroom proper were about 8 x 11 with a 2 x 6 foot indentation where the desk/minibar was kept.  There was not enough room to open our suitcase unless we put it on the bed, which is not optimal to say the least.  (See pictures.)

We objected to the front desk, and while the clerk was very professional, the bottom line was there was nothing he could do and he tried to convince us that this was a "classic" double and would be the same at any other 3 star hotel.  This is not true and does not explain why it would be billed as 173 square feet.  

The next day we were given a larger room which was 173 square feet and quite adequate, even comfortable.  The bed, linens and towels were about what you would expect from a 3 star hotel, no complaints about that.  The toiletries were minimal and practically useless.  The internet was painfully slow.  Housekeeping was borderline.  The sheets were not changed, which does not bother me for a 3 night stay, but I don't think we were given fresh towels.  The 1/8th inch sliver of soap was not replaced, nor were the 1/2 ounce tubes of shampoo / body wash.

Breakfast is not included and unlike most hotels there is no option to include it.  Thus you pay full price, which is way too much and has declined over the years.  The offering is a couple types of cold cuts, a couple types of cheese in tiny individual wrappers, three flavors of yogurt if lucky, two types of cold cereal, a croissant, a few pieces of fruit, small loaves of bread, puff pastry pain au chocolate and hard boiled eggs.  There is probably sliced bread and a toaster.  Due to the limited selection, every breakfast is going to be the same.  The tables are extremely small, and great care must be taken to fit everything, and we are talking about a plate, a cup and saucer, a pot of coffee and a small pitcher of warm milk.  One careless motion and something is bound to land on the floor.

One distressing change was that the coffee was awful.  It used to be good, that is, traditional French roast. strong and flavorful.  This last trip it was weak and undrinkable.  Literally, I did not drink it.  It tasted like they were not using enough coffee beans and were keeping it on the warmer too long.  What a shame, considering how good French roast can be.

The staff ran hot and cold.  The front desk clerks were all very pleasant if not cheerful.  The housekeeper remembered us from previous visits, but the manager could not be bothered to say hello to us, even when she was standing a few feet away.  As others have noted, she is not the warm and fuzzy type, to put it mildly.    There used to be a lovely woman who worked in the kitchen and always made us feel welcome, but she was gone and replaced by a kitchen attendant who was downright unfriendly.  I never saw him smile.  He also did a poor job keeping the minimal selection stocked.  At our last breakfast, there was a single container of plain yogurt and no butter.  There was one other table with guests, so it is not like he was overworked.

My wife and I typically stay at 4 or 5 star hotels, but we have always found 3 stars to be adequate in Paris, because we are not spending much time in the room and do not need or expect much from the hotel.  We've been coming back because most of the shortcomings are not all that significant, and we liked the location and (mostly) friendly staff.  Our feeling, however, is that it is time for a change.

One last word, there is apparently another Henri IV hotel on the Isle de la Cite, and a couple of the reviews seem to have mixed them up.  In particular one claimed that the hotel was not on the left bank.  It is.  The other one is not.

title: Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful
text:
We stayed in this hotel with our teenage daughter for one night. I would happily have stayed for longer.
The location is excellent, right in the heart of old Paris, and just a few minutes walk to Notre Dame, the university, the river, and the metro station. The Lourve is also walking distance. Lots of restaurants and bars are nearby, with lovely Parisian streets to stroll and get lost down.
The staff are very helpful and welcoming, both by text message before we arrived and when we were there.
Our room was lovely. We liked the layout, with the single bed in its own area from  the double bed, so our daughter felt like she had her own space. The decor was nice, it was spacious enough for three, there was plenty of storage and the beds were very comfortable. The only mystery to our room was that it had its own fire escape, but the door to it seemed to be locked and unable to open. Thankfully, of course, there was no fire and no reason to use it, so it remains nothing but a mystery, but if there had been a fire, this door might have been a lot more significant than a little mystery.
The only disappointment for me was the breakfast. It was very crowded with tables that seemed too small and not enough seating for everyone. The food was nice and fresh, with everything I'd expect from a continental buffet breakfast, but there was never a point when everything was out at once, and I had to keep waiting for what I wanted to reappear. The lady working the breakfast was very nice and clearly working hard to keep it all stocked up, but it just didn't seem to flow as well as other buffet breakfasts I've had, and didn't seem worth the price. However, it is a small hotel, and I cannot see how they could have done breakfast any differently.
The breakfast would not stop me booking this hotel again, I'd just grab something in one of the nearby shops or cafes.
This hotel is charming, friendly, convenient and comfortable, and I would definitely stay here again or recommend it.

title: Outstanding Service under Exceptional Circumstances
text:
Exactly one year ago today, as the first wave of the pandemic was slowly descending upon us, my adolescent daughter and I arrived at Hotel Henri IV for what would be a week of extraordinary events in France as a few short days later, Paris went into its first full pandemic lockdown.  As we were all facing shifting rules and closures by the hour, the staff at this hotel and its owner demonstrated competence, diligence and essentially, did everything possible to permit us to adapt to the circumstances.  For instance, when the French government required one to carry a form to present to the authorities when venturing out for an errand or a stroll, the hotel staff printed the form for my daughter and I almost as soon as it was issued by the government so that we would not be caught by surprise if approached by law enforcement.  When the day of our departure came and it was unclear whether we would be permitted to leave the country or if our flight may be cancelled, prior to taking the taxi to the airport, the hotel manager told me that should we be turned away from the airport for whatever reason, not to hesitate to return to the hotel and they would assist us in figuring out what to do next, all the while continuing to offer very comfortable accommodation.  

On a different non-pandemic note,  I can vouch for the positive comments in relation to the cleanliness, the attractive rooms, the service-oriented staff and overall, very pleasant ambiance of this hotel.  The neighborhood is simply delightful.  It was my daughter's first trip to Europe and while it was disappointing that so many of our planned visits to typical Paris tourist attractions were cancelled due to the pandemic, we were able to thoroughly enjoy walking for hours and taking in the many sights close by the hotel.  Despite the rather trying circumstances of that trip, my daughter has been asking when we can return to Paris.  I have promised her that when COVID is a distant memory, we will, and when we do, we'll certainly be staying at this hotel again.

title: The return to my "Home" in Paris
text:
Hotel Henri IV Rive Gauche

I am indeed an avid fan of this hotel, not only for its location but the people that made so much of difference on our stays.  This is the 2nd time we have returned to them, despite last minute changes to our hotel booking, and the choice was still to go back to this fellas.  

What can I say about this place?  For most of the reviews giving 4/5 stars the hotel, they are true.  For us, it’s the sense of belonging and how this hotel, still was in Aug19, created a home away from home ambience.  How do I know?  My kids felt right at home and we are not French speakers.  This says a lot, and in the minimal correspondences with the Pantry/Kitchen during breakfast time, or hailing for a cab to send us around town, or even getting recommendation for nearby food eateries, the people working here made the those difference for us.  The attractions nearby, the morning Sunday bell ringing from the opposite Catholic church, the impromptu dancing of whom I believe to Latin American people 1 street away, just gave such zest to the place.  Mind you, at this point of time, we could not access to the Notre Dame due to fire, and yet we fitted in like a glove.  So the entire location creates that ambience, and when we return to the hotel – arhhhh it really was like home.  We had 2 rooms, yes because we booked late hence we couldn’t get back the old room, but it was very manageable.  The rooms were comfortable, the girls had a jolly time doing girly stuff while the boys hung out and just chatted.  We had the windowed rooms and we could just gaze onto the busy street, and people watch.  Isn't that what you also do when you are in Paris?  People watching ...      

Everything in the rooms were working.  The beds were soft and great comfort for rest after a full day of galivanting in the city.  The services were great – we made so many friends with the front desk and whilst at night, there was an elderly man greeting us with such warmth.  

Pertaining to professionalism, I thought they are very sensible and professional in all their dealings.  Not that I want to brag, the hotel was fair enough to refunded me for the nights that we could not stay due to trip curtailment, and I have always been grateful for them to be so.  Of course, if it’s a non-refundable rate, I would not have expected them to return – but they extended that very kind gesture to us, then.  

I always ask myself, how do I give a fair and decent review especially it’s all matter of angles - I would ask myself if I would return to this hotel despite having to invest a lot of money and missed out on trying other hotels.  For that, I know I will always want to return to this hotel, anytime we are in Paris.  There is absolutely nothing to complain about them.  I hope to see you again, sometime in the future – where COVID19 won’t impact the world anymore.  Au revoir et à bientôt!

title: Quiet, Clean and Convenient
text:
This stay was our second time at Henri IV Rive Gauche and we requested a quiet room.  Check in was a breeze and pleasant and we took the elevator to the second floor.  The room was small but had a lot of storage space and overlooked the inner “courtyard” so no view.  But the room was very quiet and we could sleep with the windows open.  The bathroom was an adequate size and had decent toiletries.  

Breakfast is not included and we opted to have the “Express” one for 6€ each.  The full meal appeared to be good with pastries, meats, etc.  Coffee was perfect and the lady helping with tables and beverages was very sweet. 

The front desk folks were helpful with restaurant suggestions and were always friendly.  The hotel has a reasonable car service to CdG which we took advantage of since we had to leave by 6 am for our flight back home. 

We’ve recommended Henri IV to several friends and we would definitely stay there again. A note about rooms:  During our first visit about 14 years ago in early spring we had a room with a view of the church, and during that stay, with the windows closed the street noise was not a problem.

title: Yes, it's in a good location but doesnt get 5 stars from me
text:
It's a block from the metro station and a short walk to the Loivre, Notre Dame, Luxembourge Gardens, the Pantheon, saint chapelle, etc etc.

The hotel itself was clean and the staff was friendly. Most all spoke English. The hotel is right across from a very old cathedral Saint Severin. It looked old and dirty from the outside but was fantastic inside. It is one of Paris' oldest churches.

The 2 small gripes I had about the hotel was that one of the front receptionist could not tell us where a good place to eat was. She said that she doesnt eat there and could not reccomend anything. Well unbeknownst to us at the time a whole restaurant district is only a minute walk behind the church. When we finally discovered it, her comment was a little weird to us. The other was that breakfast was late in being set up on the day we had to get up early to give to Versailles. We 
were charged for the full breakfast when the only thing out were some croissants and some room temperature milk.

FYI, if you have a room along the busy street, the windows DO block all the street noise

title: Perfect Location and Great Staff!
text:
We just returned from a 6 night stay at Hotel Henri IV Rive Gauche.  Even before we arrived, we established great communication with the hotel. They responded quickly to every email that I sent.  In fact, they called me twice to review my additional requests before I arrived.  They also arranged for transportation to and from the airport with a company they contract with.  Our arrival and departure were virtually stress free.  

Our room was cleaned daily, and the bed and layout of the room was comfortable.  There is a mini-refrigerator stocked with orange juice, cokes, and water.  Breakfast is served daily for an additional fee.  We requested a kettle for our room to prepare our own coffee in the morning, and they were very accommodating.  There is also a safe in the room to store passports and valuables. 

Our room was located on the 2nd floor facing a very busy street.  But once the windows were closed, the room was pretty much sound proof.  Best of all, the hotel is located two blocks from the Seine and a couple of blocks from the Saint Germain de Pres area where there are tons of restaurants and great shopping! 

We were very pleased with our accommodations, location, and service!  One thing I would suggest to travelers is to request a room with a lower rise tub.  Ours was high in comparison to our standards.  If you are elderly and have difficulty stepping into and getting out of a higher rise tub, you should ask for a room with a lower rise tub and also a safety bar to hold onto while exiting the tub.  Other than that, everything was perfect.  We would definitely stay here again when visiting Paris.

title: September in Paris
text:
This hotel is full of charm and amenities. For starters, it's nice to know you can get a nice breakfast to start your day, or not, depending on what you want. You pay directly for the breakfast you take and do not have to commit to it up front. There is a 24 hour staffed front desk. Location can't be beat as it is 3 minutes from the metro/RER direct from Charles DeGaulle airport. It's around the corner from Notre Dame and the Shakespeare Book store and a 20 minute stroll to the D'orsay museum. There are lovely dining spots all around and it's also an easy stroll to the Marais.

The price especially if you book direct on the hotel site is fair for everything you get. The hotel tub was hard for my husband who has some mobility issues so I'd ask about the bathroom if there's any issue like that at all but the elevator worked well and was always available.

Highly recommend this place for any kind of traveller.

title: Charming Hotel
text: We celebrated our 50th wedding anniversary in Paris, staying nine days at Hotel Henri IV Rive Gauche.  We were very happy there.  We asked our French friends and others where we should stay, and all said, “near the Seine, but the rooms will be small.”  We did not want a hotel that was like those common in the U.S.  Hotel Henri IV was perfect for us.  Being a small hotel, the staff takes care of your needs immediately and with good cheer.  The building was old, of course, and it had been tastefully renovated.  Our room was on a busy street, but because the windows were double-glazed, we did not hear a sound, unless we opened the windows.  The mattress was more comfortable than what we have at home.  The bathroom and shower looked like new and were stylish.  We overlooked the beautiful Gothic-style Church of Saint-Severin, resplendent with lovely windows, flying buttresses, and gargoyles.  We also could see the Eiffel Tower in the distance, especially at night when it was colorfully illuminated.   Breakfast was typically European, with hardboiled eggs, yogurt, meats, cheese, rolls, juice, and coffee.  On three occasions the staff made us excellent cheese omelets for a small additional charge.   At breakfast and in the lobby, we met several interesting guests: one couple attending the French Open, a pair of women traveling without their husbands had humorous tales about the south of France, and a family of three generations seeing Paris for the first time.  Other guests were French-speaking and appeared to be on holiday or on business.  The hotel is near numerous cafes and restaurants and the Metro.  The hotel is well-located for site-seeing.  It is a short walk to the boarding sites for open-top buses and a river cruise.  Notre Dame is a 15-minute walk, and the Louvre is a 45-minute walk or Metro ride.  This is a charming hotel, and we would happily return.

title: Best Hotel in Paris! Wonderful, Wonderful, Wonderful! Such a Value!!!
text:
Well for us it IS the best hotel in Paris.

This wonderful little boutique hotel is a fabulous value.If you are looking for swimming pools, rotating bars or spas, this is not the hotel for you. The Henri IV Rive Gauche is perfect for people who want a hotel IN THE MIDDLE OF EVERYTHING. 

The Henri IV is very, very clean, smells nice and has a newly renovated lobby and breakfast room.

The rooms are clean and comfortable. The rooms are large (by European standards) and the bathrooms are absolutely huge! 

The rooms are generally quiet but if traffic rumbling is going to bother you then ask for a room at the back of the hotel. But, if the low rumble is ok with you they ask for a room at the front, the views are WONDERFUL! 

The front desk crew is helpful, really helpful, friendly and speak wonderful English! 

The housekeeping staff are fast, efficient, thorough and friendly. If anything goes wrong in your room, they show up within minutes and fix it immediately. 

We stay in this hotel every year and even spent 13 days there on one trip, it is like having a great little apartment in the heart of Paris. 

The room prices are phenomenal for Paris and we would recommend that you book a triple room, you won't regret it. Three twin beds let you really spread out comfortably. The triple rooms also have small balconies, it is so cool.

title: Perfect for girls’s trip overnighter
text:
Our friend was staying with us from the States and wanted to take a short trip to Paris. We flew to Paris on Monday morning and back to UK the following evening so a real whistle-stop tour. We wanted a hotel which was near Notre Dame, was reasonably priced and a triple room to share. The Hotel Henri IV ticked all the boxes. Great location, the room was plenty big enough for the three of us, the beds were comfortable, the linen and towels were good and the staff were friendly and helpful. A perfect base for a busy sightseeing stay. 
 I unfortunately lost my necklace down the back of the fixed headboard which couldn’t be retrieved whilst I was still there. The staff were incredibly helpful, especially Zaid, and assured me that they would rescue it for me. This involved getting a carpenter in and what must have been a real inconvenience for the hotel. Zaid could not have been more charming and helpful. In just over a week from my departure from the hotel, they had found the best way to securely post it back to me and it arrived this morning. I could not be more delighted! So thanks to Sabrina, Zaid and all the staff who got involved in this mini-drama. Definitely beyond the call of duty. My friends and I will definitely stay at this hotel when we next return to Paris.

title: Underwhelmed
text: Having seen the photos on the website (and reading reviews here) I was expecting more. The location was ideal for sightseeing, plus there was a good selection of places to eat and drink nearby. The window looked out on an internal courtyard with windows from other rooms facing into our room. Therefore we kept the curtains closed for the duration of our stay. The door to the room opened onto the bed and we had to negotiate who would walk around as there was not enough space for both of us to cross. In the photos you can see mirrors beside some beds, that is the clothes storage space, wardrobe is too generous a word for the cupboards. The other two couples had bigger rooms, wardrobes and one had a view of the church opposite (not Notre Dame} which was nice for them.  All three rooms were priced the same. I think this is unfair. Our room should have been cheaper, what we paid was too much for our room. I think the photos are misleading, they make the hotel look more sparkly than it is and raises expectations. We did not have breakfast, what was on offer was basic and more expensive than restaurants around the corner. Lovely location but I would chose somewhere different next time.

title: Delightful small Parisian hotel in a great location!
text:
We were part of a group of 3 couples that stayed at this hotel for only 1 night July 27, 2018, and we were all very pleased with the hotel.   We were enroute back to USA from a Viking river cruise Avignon to Lyon and a train trip to Bayeux in Normandy for a wonderful private tour of the American D-Day beaches.  
The hotel helped us arrange transportation from St. Lazare train station to the hotel on 27th and from the hotel to CDG airport on 28th.  The driver met us at our train with my name on a sign, and helped us move our luggage to the street.  The prices he charged were quite fair.
We were very pleased with the clean, well-furnished rooms, and expecially the air-conditioning!!  AC was excellent, comfortable and absolutely necessary on the 27th with temps in high 90s!   Another plus was the small elevator, and the charming front desk staff.  We had a very comfortable small room on the front on 5th floor facing the church across the street, as well as the Eiffel Tower in the distance, much like the one in the 1st picture.   Our friends had comfortable quiet rooms in the back of the building on the 1st & 2nd floors.  Next door is a nice little convenience market with beer, wine, bottled water, snacks, fruit, etc. 
The location was just perfect for our 1 day/night in Paris.  We had Big Bus tickets and the stop was less than 2 blocks away toward Notre Dame Cathedral.   We certainly recommend the Big Bus, but unfortunately the heat on the 27th was so extreme that we could not enjoy the upper deck.   We saw all the bleachers and other preparations for the final day of the Tour De France which happened on July 29.
Absolutely would return to this hotel if in Paris again.
