The power went out in my room. I have never experienced such a thing in all my travels and I am almost the oldest living baby boomer. 

After the power was turned back on and I had turned off the iron, the room was airy enough with the fan running and the window open. BUT then I glanced down at a notice on the desk which said, “Dear Guests, for safety we kindly ask you to close your windows when you go outside and during the night.”  REALLY! And so I spent my night there in a dingy, airless, warm room. I checked out the next morning, before breakfast,  earlier than planned.
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Classically Parisian
text: Back in the 80’s on our jaunts to Paris, in the days before internet, we would rock up on the fly and knock on the door of a classically Parisian 2* hotel looking for a room. In those days they were dimly lit places, with tall windy staircases, and soft beds that dipped in the middle, but I look back with huge affection.  Arriving at Hotel Jeanne D’Arc I smiled as I flashed back 35 years.  The same tall beautiful windy dark staircase and big French windows, but modern, fresh and friendly with a big comfortable bed ... and a little lift.   Deserving of its 3* rating the current owner has clearly invested in making the hotel a lovely place to stay, and goes the extra mile with her communications even before you arrive.  We were in room 16 on the first floor overlooking Rue Necker.  We’d booked a classic room and which was quiet, clean and bijou as expected. There was even a much needed and good quality fan due to the exceptionally hot weather. Fabulous location, with a gorgeous little square literally around the corner with good restaurants.  Walking distance of many of the sights, and near the Metro.  Polite, helpful staff and a delightful 2-night stay.  This is certainly somewhere we’ll be back to.
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Sweet + in the heart of a perfect neighborhood
text: The Jeanne D'Arc is a lovely, small hotel in the La Marias neighborhood. The rooms were very comfortable with tremendous beds, huge windows and excellent bathrooms. The staff are really accommodating and charming. The hotel is in a super little neighborhood, walking distance to so much (The Seine, Notre Dam, and millions of restaurants and coffee shops. Bus stops, laundry, train station, all close. The hotel is 5 or so stories high and has a very adorable, teeny tiny elevator (2 person maximum) mostly for transporting luggage to the upper levels. Like most hotels in Paris, there is no air conditioning. We were there for Paris's hottest week on record and it was sometimes hard to get cool even with the fan the hotel provides. The Jeanne D'Arc is down a quiet street, but oh so close to the bustle of the city.
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Great Experience! Great Staff! Charming Place!
text:
I stayed one night in this cute Boutique hotel in Le Marais, Paris. My room on the 6th floor was charming. The bathroom was small but had everything I needed.
Gwen at the front desk was amazing. He is polite, attentive, professional and looks happy to share his knowledge of the city. Being greeted by this smiling professional was a real pleasure. I wish all hotels I stayed during my trip in France had the same kind of professionals at the front desk.
Breakfast is good and worth the additional fee (10 euros I think)
Before check out, I had a great conversation with the manager of this boutique hotel. 

I read bad reviews posted by other guests on this hotel. Seriously??? This hotel doesn’t have umbrellas (is it really a big deal in a 3 stars hotel?), Air Conditioning (Who wants to damage an old and nice building with such equipment in a city where heatwave eventually occurs every 10 years). Coffee is excellent and service is amazing and attentive.

I would say that the only things they miss in this hotel are a nice statue of Jeanne d’Arc and USB outlets on the desk. 

I will come back…
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Perfect family hotel
text:
Perfect hotel for our family of 4. There was a small lift up to our room on the top floor, where we had a 2room suite. First room with a queen bed and second room with 2 twin beds. Very clean and sound proof.  The staff were fantastic! Very friendly and most helpful; giving us detailed directions on using the metro to get to where we wanted. Always smiling and happy to see us.  
Best location: near transit and sites. Many places to eat or grab a cafe and croissant. 
The Marais is my favourite arrondissement.
The only thing that would make this more perfect would be air con.  The fans were helpful, but we are spoiled Canadians, so not used to being so hot😉.
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Amazing staff and great location
text: This hotel was absolutely amazing! All of the staff were super accommodating and friendly, they also all spoke english which was very useful as I barley speak any french. They were always willing to help find a place to eat or to arrange transport to any given place. The food was also really good, just I would recommend going outside of the hotel for breakfast. The location was amazing! The hotel is very close to a metro station and is surrounded by bakeries, restaurants and boutiques. It is within walking distance to the louvre as well as the notre dame. This is an excellent place to stay and i have no complaints.
name: Hotel Jeanne D'Arc

title: Spacious and very clean facility
text: The frontdesk personnel are courtesious and warm. Room spacious with excellent facilities. The floor of bathroom and kitchen non slippery. Fast lifts, 24hour coffee/tea machine at the reception, laundry room and cosy waiting area.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Beautiful appartement
text:
Very good checking.
The place is kept clean and fresh .
Corridor maybe need a bit a colors ,I found them very sad.
We  book a  suite"couture" appartement,absolutely beautiful and clean ,nothing to say .it is a small reproduction of Dior Avenue montaigne flagship store.
I have noted 4 as the next time I will make sure we are not in the courtyard by the entrance as you can heard all the late customers coming back at night very late and it is very annoying as they used their mobile phone.
The hotel direction should ban peoples talking or smoke outside in the courtyard after midnight. 
The hotel appt is very easy to access in a quiet street.
Breakfast too expensive,head outside to that lovely bakery on the corner.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Good base!
text: The hotel has a great location and quiet rooms, the staff are perfectly friendly (thank you Alessia for showing us the rooms on our first day) and it’s got the basic amenities you need to live day to day. The shower is quite clogged and takes a long time for water to drain after each use but apart from that, we don’t have major complaints.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Not for family trips
text:
We booked a family Studio for 4 persons. 2 adult, 2 Kids. When we arrived, they said, that they only have 2 double-rooms, no Studio available. 
No discount or anything. They didn't try to contact us in advance.
We are very disapointed. Not good for Familie trips
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Did the job
text: We stayed here for a week. The room was fairly comfortable: good wifi, good air-conditioning, and the beds were ok. The storage space was very good indeed. Some disappointments: the shower pressure was poor and (as normal in hotels) the drainage in the bath was poor. There was no plug for the bath, but the drainage was so poor it may almost have been possible to have a bath. Unfortunately the water pressure was too low to make that a realistic possibility. The location's Covid precautions were excellent, in common with France in general.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: OK , LOCATION IS GOOD
text:
The location is good but the rooms are not clean, maybe with the covid restrictions it wasn't clean. I want say there again. 
It was ok, the dishwasher doesn't work and the place is smelly. I feel because of the covid restrictions, they don't  clean the rooms.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Fine Small Hotel In Paris
text:
The Hotel Citadines Opéra Paris is a small apartment hotel in central Paris. 

Like many city hotels the rooms were rather small - but with good sleeping quality and all the facilities you would need. As such the hotel is perfect for business travellers as well as vistors needing a base from which to explore Paris.

The hotel offers a decent breakfast (incl. very good coffee) – but if you prefer there are many fine cafes and restaurants within easy walking distance from the hotel.

The Hotel Citadines Opéra Paris is recommended.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great
text: I really liked this place. I have been coming to Paris for work for many years and stayed at so many hotels with tiny, tiny rooms this was a wonderful change.  The apartment was clean with a large living area, kitchen with everything you could possible need, nice size bedroom with a very comfortable bed. Two flat screen tvs, one in the bedroom and the other in the living room with a decent selection of English language channels. The gym was big enough to get a workout in and there was a laundry room in case you wanted to do your clothes. I would definitely return
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Superb Experience
text: Well equipped apartments with everything youcan think of. Also n a great location which was in close proximity to transport or even walking to some of the main sites. The staff were so helpful, friendly & welcoming. I will definitely advise staying here if enjoying Paris.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Nice location in a quiet environment
text: Great location next to Grands Boulevards and Opéra. Several bars and restaurants around. Clean and quiet apartments ideal for families with comfortable beds. More services could be provided to the clients...
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Paris  week-end
text: The hotel is very close to the metro station. Around there are dozens of restaurants shops and groceries for those who want to prepare food in the room. The gym for those who use it is open 24/24. Staff is available just in case. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to spend a weekend in Paris.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Chic, comfortable, clean and convenient
text: Very nice apartment in a very good location in Paris.. Very well managed and clean. Pull out beds in living room were the most comfortable we have ever slept in. Pretty much walked to all major spots. Patisserie right next door was an added bonus.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Comfortable room; beware construction
text:
4 stars because the room was comfortable.
2 stars because everything else was ok. If you’re someone who prefers to feel like you’re coming to a hotel versus a construction zone, don’t stay here now. Our stay was totally overshadowed by feeling like we were in construction zone. I was kind of surprised they stayed open during such work, and even more surprised that the prices were what they were given the setup. 
The whole front facade of the hotel is under construction - meaning you walk through scaffolding on your way in. There is a nice little water display at the entry, but it appears to be not properly installed because it was flooded most of our trip. So we walked in through scaffolding and water, and entered our room with wet shoes the whole time.
The construction is not limited to the exterior/facade - the lobby also and certain areas off of room corridors.
If I had known the extent of the construction I would not have stayed. I recommend calling to confirm the end date of the construction before booking.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Spring trip with my 11 year old niece
text: Beyond my expectations.  The apt was larger and nicer with two full beds and baths and a kitchen but it also had a gym and full concierge.  It was comfortable quiet and the front desk was helpful. They had a breakfast we didn’t use but it looked substantial.  Overall it was a lovely ho,e to us fir a week and we would stay here again.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great staff and good location with parking.
text: Nice location with parking facilities( even though you need to pay 25 euro) still good deal. Nice big enough living room area and comfortable bed. Clean toilet and bath. Staff were ( especially two ladies at the reception) always smile and act really fast. One of really good experience from Paris. Many thanks~
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Citadines Apart Hotel
text: Ideal accommodation for a family of four.  Well presented and equipped.   Staff were friendly and helpful.   Excellent central location.  Metro more or less outside the door, many restaurants nearby and many sights were within walking distance.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Medium quality
text: Unfortunately entire side of the hotel is u der construction in progress. Other than that upper medimu accomodation. Well connected via underground and as soons as you walk out of hotel you can experience city vibe.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great location
text: Citadines Opera has great a location, just walking distance to eatery, shops and entertainment. It is quite pricey but then again everything else is pricey in Paris. Rooms are kept clean and beds are  comfortable. Friendly service and breakfast is good.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: satisfied
text: good location. close to Opera, Metro station.easy to access main tourist's spots.many shops, restaurants and super markets around the citadine.comfortable to stay with nice facilities.clean room with enough space.but one thing - noisy all through nights because of thin glass window?
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Good but service issues
text:
I regularly stay in Citadines and am usually happy but this time the service at reception was appalling. I’m hoping it was down to Christmas staff.
We had to wait 45 minutes to check out, then paying parking and breakfast was a challenge and it was only because I reminded them that we paid the the parking. No invoice.
However during our stay they called us repeatedly about paying for the parking.
Despite there being other staff there was only one person at reception, hence the massive queues.
Really a very disappointing experience for an expensive price.
It was not cleaned either. So despite being a nice duplex room generally not a great experience.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Below average customer service, very loud and disruptive construction work
text: I paid for 2 rooms for 4 nights, as our family were having a reunion with my Mother in Paris.  The rooms initially allocated to us were rooms that had major construction work being done right outside the window on the facade of that wing of the hotel.  I am not a fussy customer but the noise was unbearable.  There was drilling, banging and clanging sounds that were incredibly loud.  I requested a change of rooms to a part of the hotel that was not under construction.  They changed our room relatively quickly.  However when my Mother arrived early the next morning we found out that her room was also allocated in the same wing of the hotel that was under construction.  Once again we requested a room change.  However this is where the problems set in.  Despite paying for the room for the day before so that my 70 year old Mom could go straight into her room after a long flight throughout the night we were made to wait almost 4 hours.  Nobody could tell us how long it would take or when it would be ready.  There was no effort to find out what time we would be able to take the room, no effort to contact house keeping and get a time estimate.  We were just informed that we would be told when it was ready and had to just wait it out. We were met with relative ambivalence when saying this was unacceptable.  I had wasted my money paying for a room night when in actual fact we were only allowed access to the room at 12.30 in the afternoon. So if you are intending to stay in this hotel - be aware that there is a huge amount of construction being done on the one wing - and unless you are a business traveller who is out the room all day - you are going to find it rather horrible.  Citadines Opera are quite happy for you to stay in these rooms with all the noise.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: November in Citadines opera, Paris
text: Great location but so are many hotels nearby. Room with kitchen smelled, toilet had leaks and construction going on. Customer service at front desk during check in was poor. Dismissive when we had question regarding prepaid service. We subsequently waited for another shift for our question that was answered easily; turned out American Express had issued us wrong information. She could have addressed that with our receipt but chose to dismiss us. Thought that was rude.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: A more comfortable stay if...
text: Overall am happy with my stay at Citadines Opera Paris but would have been better if a request for a luggage rack when I checked in at around 8 pm (after housekeeping hours) could have been acceded to. I even volunteered to help and carry the rack to the room myself but still the answer given by the lady staff on duty was a flat no. 😲 (the rack was found delivered in our room when we came back at the end of the next day, but it was too late as we had placed our luggages on makeshift racks from the tables and chairs in the room).
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Room was better than expected
text:
We like Citadines for longer holidays as they have a laundry facilities which are always appreciated. Having stayed at the Citadines St Germain previously which was very old and dark, we were pleased with our room which felt a bit more like the ones we have stayed at in Melbourne and Kyoto. 

The Aparthotel is located closed to the Grand Magasin and in a small street. The rooms are located overlooking a small courtyard. Eating options are nearby. 

The room was newly renovated with wooden floors and has a small kitchenette with dishwasher, stove and microwave oven. There was a small gym downstairs as well as laundry where you could use coins to do washing and drying. There also are heated towel rails in the rooms which dry clothes quickly!

A Buffet Breakfast is available for and extra E16 per person but there are cheaper options nearby. 

The front reception team look busy at times (only one or two people) so I can understand why some reviews report inconsistencies re service. The lady when we checked in though was very nice. 

Overall we thought this was a good value option compared to other big chain hotels nearby (with the plus being the washing facilities and kitchenette).
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Spiral Horrors
text: This is an apartment rental, not a hotel so don’t confuse it with such. The positioning in the Opera area of Paris is fantastic. It’s surrounded by cafes & restaurants with major attractions within walkable distance. We were greeted warmly & check in was simple. But as soon as we walked into the 1 room apartment & saw the spiral staircase I knew we had a problem. First of all it’s almost impossible to get your luggage safely upstairs so we left it down. Secondly the toilet is on the ground floor & the bedroom & bathroom upstairs so when you need to go during the night you have to negotiate the spiral staircase. I had the horrors that one of us would slip & die!! Thirdly there was no shower curtain so to try & shower meant you flooded the bathroom so we found running the bath & sitting to use the flexible shower head was the only way to wash your hair. During our stay they also had a problem with the sewage so every now & then an obnoxious stink arose in the room, which was so bad we opened all the windows & went out. The bed is very comfortable & we would have slept well except for the worry over the spiral staircase!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: A bit pricey but very good apartment hotel near the Opera.
text:
The apartment hotel is a side road of a main road, boulevard des italiens (only 3-4 meters away). It is a nice chic hotel with good practical facilities. It offers studio and one-bedroom apartments, we were three adults, so we chose the latter. The 1-bedroom has a small bedroom, about 10 square meters with a double bed and a big wall closet and a TV. There is little space around the bed, but enough for sleeping purpose. There is a sitting room with a TV, a 4-chair dining table and a sofa bed that opens into one or two single beds, this room is slightly bigger than the bedroom, about 12 square meters. The bathroom is small with a tub shower, the WC is separate but next to the bathroom, it has a small sink which is thoughtful. There is also a small kitchenette with a fridge, a hot plate, electric kettle, toaster, dish washer, sufficient utensils and cutlery. There is another smaller closet near the sitting room offering more storage space. Both rooms have separate air-conditioning. Lighting in the apartment is good.
There are different studio types with slightly different areas. There is standard studios and duplex studios, the duplex has the kitchenette below and the bedroom and bathroom up. They are both priced the same but there are only two duplex studios and booking one cannot be guaranteed. There are also deluxe studios which are perhaps the same area as the standard but better furnished. They are also more expensive.
If you stay six or more days, housekeeping is done once in mid stay. Less than six days no housekeeping. If you require room cleaning there is a fee of €17 for studios and €28 for apartments, for one-time cleaning only. Used towels can be exchanged free at the reception. You also need to remove and dispose of garbage in a designated place, new garbage bags given free. This may not be a big issue specially if you are staying for a few days. The place is worth it.
There are many restaurants and shops nearby on both sides of the main road. The opera is within walking distance, about 10 minutes. There is a metro station a few meters away. The hotel offers free coffee in the lobby. There is a laundry room with two washing machines and a one dryer, very useful. Special coins must be bought at the reception. Five euros for one wash and 4 euros for one dryer cycle. There is also a fitness center, entry can be arranged through the reception. The lobby is well planned with a central open area and plenty seating. The entrance to the hotel is also pleasant. Overall, this is a very nice and clean place to stay, it may be a bit pricey, but well this is Paris.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Good location and bigger room space
text: Nice location and convenient close to metro 8;9 line.Classic France apartment layout; my room is suite, bedroom is separate from living on second floor,kitchen has everything unwed for cook.Front desk are friendly.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Safety hazard collapsed ceiling and taped smoke detectors
text:
I am absolutely appalled by my recent stay at this hotel. Upon check in I was offered a free upgrade and directed to the « suite couture ». I arrived late and it was about 8 pm when I first entered the room. Part of the the ceiling had collapsed on the pillow. I left the room and went back to the reception where I showed the receptionist the picture of the collapsed ceiling. She was very nice and seemed shocked by the picture and she gave me the key to another room. I dropped my bag there and left to a work dinner. When I came back I took my shower and was about to go to bed on my new room when I noticed that two of the detectors (there were 3 rooms and one detector per room) were covered up in tape. I called the front desk and asked if they had another room. The night receptionist said they were full and that he could send me to a partner hotel for the following night but that they too were full that night. I had only booked one night so that was not very helpful to me. I decided to leave the hotel and go to another one given the dangerous level of negligence and blatant lack of safety procedures in that hotel. When I left I said I expected 
not be charged for a room that was not compliant with safety standards and were I didn’t even sleep and left my email address and asked for the hotel director to contact me first thing the next morning. 
It wasn’t until the afternoon the next day that I received an email from the « senior receptionist » apologising for the « inconvenience » and « incident » and confirming I would get refunded. Absolutely no offer was made to compensate me for the taxi ride & last minute other hotel booking I had to make or any other form of compensation or explanation for the safety violations I had witnessed. 
I don’t know what kind of hotel director or management doesn’t put in place crisis management procedures where in the 48:00 hours following the occurrence of such circumstances no one above a receptionist even bothers to contact the client and provide explanations and reassurance on the severe safety issues reported. 
Shame on you Citadines for putting clients safety at risk and not even taking it seriously when breaches are reported.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Central Paris
text: Great location only minutes to Centeal Paris the River. The rooms are spacious clean and well presented. It is self serve you have a stovetop, microwave and dishwasher. Rubbish needs to be disposed by you facilities down stairs. Breakfast is extra but we ate out. All in all great spot to stay staff very friendly to.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Location coveinant, accomendation great
text:
Booking in easy, great room very large bed, kitchenet, complement expresso coffee machine in the foyer., quite location , staff very helpfull and understandable english.
Coffee shop/ conveniant shop on thr corner . Would stay again
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great location for exploring Paris
text:
Just finished a 3 night stay with my wife and two kids (both under 7). The apartment was spacious with a kitchenette and sofa bed in the living room. Some have complained about rude staff, but this is not what I experienced. Check in was easy and quick. At check out our bags were stored at no additional cost and the receptionist happily booked a taxi for our onward journey to the airport. At all times the staff were polite, helpful and courteous. 
The hotel itself is in a great location - 2 mins walk to the Metro and 5 mins walk to Opera. There are plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. There is also a supermarket about 6 / 7 mins away where you can stock up on drinks, snacks and things for breakfast.
Would stay again when next in Paris.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: BAD EXPERIENCE EVER SINCE
text:
I booked an apartment suite room good for 4 pax in citadines opera for 4 nights stay and expecting a very pleasant ending of our vacation in europe since Paris was our last stop. but unfortunately, it was ruined by the reception lady in eyeglasses who told us that our booked apartment room (already paid in advance) was given to others by technical error(what?). when i questioned her how it happens, she simply told me thats not her decision, it was coming from the mgment and she has nothing to do with it. my only choice is: to accept 2 studio rooms or move us to other hotels under their group. she even told me two studio room is more expensive than an apartment suite, so it means i am already taking advantage of the situation. its was 9:15pm in the evening, i have no choice but to accept, and no sincere apologize was given. what i feel from her expression is "take it or leave it",such an errogant manner! 
   during our last night stay, when we go out for dinner, we passby the reception and inquire about the "DODOW" - a sleeping device which they put an advertisement inside the room and said to be test use for free during our stay, we ask the night shift lady if we can borrow one and will pick it up while we return from dinner, she definitely say "yes", but when we came back from dinner, the lady was not ard and another beared gentlemen was on duty and we mentioned to him our request, he told us he had never heard of this "DODOW" and pretending to find it in the cabinet, we waited for arround 10 minutes and as expected, he told us he cannot find one and still claiming he has no knowledge about what "DODOW" is. unbelievable right? The room we stayed has a weird design. The shower room was far seperated from the rest room which is good but the weird thing is, the rest room doesnt has any water sink ，it means that after you make a bowel movement you need to go wash your hand in the other side of the room
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Rude staff
text:
Hotels location seems okay at first but overall was not ideal for our style of holiday. Very busy with cars but not very touristy! Not the best part of the city! Check in at the hotel takes an age and expect lots of unnecessary singing of documents and don’t forget the most important tourist tax! Which in itself is a complete humiliation for all tourists visiting- charging customers for simply stepping through the door? This was €100 for our stay. Hmmm. It was discovered later on in our stay the the receptionist was supposed to give us a map and small explanation on Paris but she did not do this! She couldn’t really care less and although we asked SEVERAL times for 3 twin studios they could only accommodate us with one! And even with us checking in at around 6pm one of the rooms was still not ready. Rooms are a good size however for the price paid not fantastic. The  bathroom and toilet are separate and no sink in the toilet - which is weird and gets rather annoying towards the end of a stay. Rooms are only cleaned if stay is longer than 6days, we only had a 5 night stay so this was very annoying as simple things like towels and toilet roll were required or just a simple clean of the room which again for the amount paid daily cleaning should be included. We could have paid extra for this but at a ridiculously expensive price. Breakfast is served in the reception area downstairs which is again overpriced and not very well attended.
 The “24hour” tea and coffee machine is a good add on however, on one occasion the machine had run out of milk and when the receptionist was asked if he could refill it he refused and was extremely rude in return treating us as if we were stupid which was rather insulting. He continued to argue that the machine cannot be filled till breakfast. Don’t offer a service if you aren’t prepared to serve it at the advertised time. Receptionists seem to spend their time looking at computer screens ignoring customers. Building works were also going on during our stay which meant any chance of a long lie was out the window. 
Overall an okay place but don’t expect staff to be polite (with the exception of one very nice receptionist) and don’t expect much from the advertised facilities. For the price of the rooms they are not adequate and with no cleaning service extremely overpriced. Hotels outside does not look like the pictures and could do with some updating as it looks rather dirty and uninviting.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: ์Nice stay in Paris
text: Good location near shopping area and Metro. Actually Metro station is almost right in front of the hotel. I check in quite early in the morning but the room is ready for me. It helps a lot from long journey. Room is clean and well equipped. It's really worth money that paid for.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Wonderful place in a great location
text:
I have spent in total over 5 months in this hotel, due to business trips.
I have tried regular studio rooms, but also duplex apartments.
All the rooms are very comfortable.
The location is perfect, just next to Boulevard des Italiens and Grands Boulevard.
There's supermarkets nearby, bars, restaurants, cinema, etc.
All in all, it's a really cool neighbourhood.
The staff is always very nice.
My only note is: for business trips it is wonderful, but for a solo leisure trip it can be a little expensive (although you get really good return for your money)
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: A taste of Paris
text:
If you're looking for space, then this is the place. We loved how the room is not like a typical European room (tiny). We really glad that we decided to stay in an apartment hotel. 

Location wise, it's very close to all sorts of food and dining. The Opera Garnier and Galleries Lafayette is just around the corner. The location is perfect and the room is huge. We got a 1 bedroom apartment and my kid loved the fact that the bedroom is on the second floor. 

One slight problem that we encounter was just on the last night, there was a little water leak from the ceilings. There weren't any stand-by or on-duty technician to repair, so the reception offer us to change the room, but since we were going to check out early in the morning, we didn't want to go through all the troubles of moving all of our belongings. 

Like all other Citadines that we've stayed in during our UK and Europe trip, they all have this 24 hr Espresso machine that can make hot chocolates too. We loved this machine, but unfortunately it was broken during the last day of our stay in Paris. 

All in all, we had a great experience with Citadines, both in the UK and in Paris. All of them basically give the same services. We would recommend staying in Citadines for families with kids.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: LVMH stay

name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Enjoyed each day !
text:
Location- excellent 
Extraordinarily friendly stuff. 
Apartments are spacious comparing to usual deals in Paris. Fully equipped kitchenette. We felt comfortable - 2 adults and 2 teenage kids. No room cleaning but rowels are changed in demand. Grocery store 5 min walk. Metropolitan station 100 meters away. Very center but quit and cozy place.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Beautiful room but terrible experience on checking in
text:
Through Agoda  I made a booking for a Studio Luxe at Citidines Opera. On checking in I questioned  and was confirmed that I was getting a studio Luxe. 
I later realised that the room was different to that chosen and checked on the website and had been given a lesser  "Studio"room.
I told Alexsia in reception I had booked and paid for a studio Luxe. she asked for proof and I showed a  photo of my booking confirmation stating Studio Luxe with the price. 
She advised they didn't have Studio Luxe and get some more proof of what I booked. I showed her the photos from the Agoda website, on my computer and she confirmed they were Studio Couture which was the same as Luxe.
 I thought that would have been the end of it, but no... she said the booking is from Booking.com, so no the Agoda confirmation was insufficient and the price was not enough and I needed to have a confirmation with the price on it. The original photo shown to her with the price on it also stated that the booking would be in the name of Booking.com.
Eventually, several hours later after I had complained to Agoda who contacted her I  finally got into the room I booked. She requested more money which Agoda refunded to me.
In all my travels, I have never had to produce so much proof of my booking, be continually questioned  and then to be advised that the total amount was insufficient for the room.Those figures were taken directly from a website and several websites all had a similar price. I question how so many websites could have all got the price wrong. It really did take the shine off staying at Citidines Opera.
I love the room that I finally got, but to take so many hours to get it, and go through such an inquisition, so based on that could not stay here again nor could I ever recommend the property.
 I'm still scratching my head wondering why Citidines would want an ordinary staff member to act in such a strange manner to guests checking in????
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great experience!
text: I arrived early and walked to the hotel from Gare du Nord. Yes, it's close enough. Even though it was before 9 a.m. the room was ready! That was huge. Stove-top, microwave, dishes, fridge, dishwasher. The toilet was separate from the bathroom. Bed was very comfortable. Actually brilliant. Location is fantastic! Walkable to the major attractions. Would definitely stay again!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great Space
text: This is an apartment style 'hotel', and they describe it to be, so there shouldn't be confusion as to why they don't offer same services as a traditional hotel. I loved my stay here. The room was bigger than I expected and it included refrigerator, sink, microwave, and dishes. It is in a good location - close to many restaurants that you can walk to, and very close to other attractions. There is a bar/club called Le Biz that is right at the entrance of the hotel that is convenient to grab a drink, which proved to be very fun at night. The room was clean, staff were pleasant and free breakfast was sufficient and tasted good. I enjoyed my stay here and it is a great option if you are staying for a week or longer in Paris as it is like a small apartment. I would stay here again!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Nice place in a great location.
text: First time in Paris with the family, we have 2 young kids. It's close to lots of restaurants, and a metro station which is easy and is what we mostly  used to get to all the sights. Otherwise great place.
