The coffee service is available for free of charge. We liked it.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Perfect location
text: The location is perfect. The Aparthotel is located in short walking distance to many attractions such as   Louvre, Opera House. You have just a few steps away to a metro station and bars, cafes, restaurants, shops. The staff  is very  helpful, polite and friendly. We had the quiet  suite couture located on the 4th floor. It was quite spacious, very clean and nicely decorated.  The kitchen equipment was in good condition.  Definitely, a very good choice for Paris.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Good Choice
text: For our short stay it was perfect. Well kept property, clean rooms, nicely decorated apartments.  Breakfast service is good especially for those rainy days.  Overall it was a good experience. I missed the cleaning of the rooms every day.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Absolute rubbish
text: We arrived at midnight to be told we only had 2 rooms, it is not our job to read the paper work it’s yours, the night porter kept us there for 3 hours in which time our 5 year old threw up in the corner. Still he was so fixated with the fact it was 2 rooms, he managed to yell at everyone . We did get given free parking and 1 free breakfast for our trouble however on check out they tried to over charge us again 16 euro for a cup of coffee. The room was very dirty, no second elevator working, no towels, no kettle. For the amount of money we paid we where we’ll and truly ripped of. Would never return
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Value for money at an excellent location in Paris
text: We stayed here for the Christmas weekend, which is of course not the cheapest period of the year. Yet, we were pleased with the apartment and the services. The location is super, close to the grand boulevards (Haussmann, Poisonniere, Des Italiens), and walking distance from the Louvre, Les Tuilleries. The 2nd arrondissement has become more pleasant too, it feels safer and cleaner. This is a hotel that provides apartment type of living. A spacious studio with a small but complete kitchen, a small but pleasant bathroom, a separate toilet, a comfortable bed, desk/table and chairs, safe box, etc. Everything is cleaner than most places we stayed in Paris. Breakfast is a bit expensive (but this is Paris), however a rather complete buffet. Coffee and tea free of charge all day. Parking garage in the basement is just as expensive as a public garage, but very convenient and parking spaces are more dan adequate, which is a rarity in Paris. Service is very friendly (again, not so very common in Paris). Metro station, a convenience store and restaurants are all close by, around the corner.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Correct for the price... if you are not too picky!
text:
Well located near the grands magasins, grands boulevards and the Opera, this middle class apartment hotel is convenient and surprisingly quiet for the place.
The deco is modern but furniture are a little bit cheap.
Bed was a bit hard for me.
Cleaning is made once a week except if you pay additional fees.
Breakfast for 8 bucks is a bargain!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Spacious apartment in Central Paris
text: We had an enjoyable stay here for three nights with a family of four (2 adults and 2 teens). We were told all apartments in Paris were quite small and we found Citadines Opera to be spacious enough for our needs. The two floors made it easy for us to feel like we were in a spacious apartment. If I had one criticism is that the staircase would not be suitable if you had small children... I struggled a little but that is very minor. Staff were helpful and the hotel was quiet yet close to restaurants, shops and transport. Would stay again here.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great location, excellent staff.
text:
The location, Citadines opera, is a little misleading as the property is a good 5 to 7 minutes walk from the Opera Garnier and the same to the major department stores Printemps and Galleries Lafayette. However, it is without doubt in the Opera district. That said, the property is extremely well located in central Paris. It is two minutes walk to Richelieu Drout Metro, and a touch more to 5 of the major bus lines in Paris: 20, 39,48, 67, 85. Heaps of good quality French restaurants very close by.

 The staff at this property are extremely helpful and speak a number of languages quite fluently. So, why am I giving it only three stars?  The reason is that everything does not work as it should and in the greater scheme of things it would be fair to say that these are minor. One lift was out of action for the entire week of my stay and was probably going to be out action a lot longer.  There is a computer and printer in the lobby for guest use but it was out of action for the entire week of my stay. My room key suddenly did not work, the sink plug was broken....these are small niggles that can easily be fixed – the point is they shouldn’t happen at all.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great stay-highly impressed
text: During my stay at Citadines Opera I was highly impressed with the attention to details that they have. Apart from the rooms which have absolutely everything a person may nerd(ironing board and machine, dishes, kettle, shampoo and cream, hair dryer and towels) the personnel is also very warm and well trained making you feel welcomed. Also the distance to the center is quite small and the location is a highly safe one. Very good option no matter the purpose of the trip
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Excellent stay
text:
I stayed 3 nights with my wife and daughter. It was a wonderful stay. Every staff were very friendly and responded to our questions and requests. The location is perfect, just above the entrance of Metro.
In my experience, staying at an apartment hotel in Europe usually brought me some trouble, but here we could satisfied almost everything.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great Location in the middle of Paris
text:
I stay in this aparthotel for more than 10 years. The location is great. With 2 lines at your door step you can reach anywhere within Paris not more than 30mins. This is if you are going all the way to city limits. Close to shopping and the museums. Restaurants, bars, and clubs are very neer.
I also like the spacious rooms. Having a small kitchinette also helps if you just want to have small breakfast in your room. You can also prepare meals if you want as they have the utensils. I prefer the restaurants. :-)
The property also have a car park available if you are driving to town.
I am a regular, and I will go back again. I don't look for another place.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: my favourite hotel in Paris
text: Beautiful modern apart hotel in Paris, best location 3 min walk to Opera. Large and bright rooms, clean and comfortable beds. Love this hotel. Especially when you travel with kids this is the best hotel with the kitchen and washing machine
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Bare necessities of life
text:
I am staying here for Paris Fashion Week and while the hotel looks modern, the floors are quite dirty in the room (that horrible slimy feel on the tiles) and they really lack basic necessities - no tissues, no bathroom mats for the toilet which is separate from the shower, no robes and no bedroom slippers. I asked for extra hangers only to be met with “we can only spare extra 5 hangers cos of the other guests here.” I am staying 9 nights! Hello - what am I going to do with 3 hangers?! 

They managed to change my room from the two storey attic to a nice garden room but I really feel the kitchenette, basic neccesities (seriously one pebble of a soap for the whole stay?! ONE!) and lack of cleanliness needs addressing. 

Yes the hotel is in a gd location but pls upgrade with better basics - your guests should feel comfortable and looked after. 

It feels as if I am at the YMCA brining my old towels to be changed at reception for new ones. 

And pls get some help for guests with a concierge to help with bags when guests check in and out?

U r supposedly 4 Star - it doesn’t feel anyway close to the star rating.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great hotel in a good location
text:
I have stayed here several times and always had a great experience, The rooms are really comfortable; and a good size for Paris. The modern kitchen is ideal if you are staying for a few days.  
Staff are really helpful and always polite and courteous.
With a location 30 seconds from the metro and a 5 min walk to Opera, it really is ideal for getting around.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Convenient Location
text:
Citadines Opera is a decent hotel with a very good location in Paris.  Metro stops are near by and you are withing walking distance of quite a few places. Price is a little on the higher said than what I would like to pay for a similar amenities, but overall it is a good hotel.  These are definitely quality living quarters for the longer term stay, when you don't want to eat out every day.  The staff is friendly and it was a good experience.  I would recommend this hotel if it's within your budget.

Safe travels!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Enjoyable family stay overall
text:
We stayed for 4 nights in a one-bedroom apartment which had two pull-out beds for the two kids. There are several Metro stops within a few blocks of the hotel, making all of the attractions very accessible. We also were able to walk to the Louvre, etc., so great location overall.  Lots of nearby restaurants, as well as shops not too far away for grocery items. 

The staff was very friendly.  The accommodations were overall quite modern and well-kept.  Great WiFi signal. We loved the coffee/espresso machine in the lobby, as well as the cold water dispenser.  And having a dishwasher in the apartment was wonderful; it was even stocked with plenty of dishwasher tablets and dish soap, which many apart hotels do not do. 

There were two things that were not quite adequate, however: 1) our bathroom had some black mold in the corner, and even worse, the bathroom sink was clogged even upon arrival.  If the housekeeping staff regularly cleans the sink, as it should, it would know that the sink was significantly clogged and would fix it.   There was also evidence of some type of flooding/water leakage in the bedroom in the past, and an open hole in the ceiling in the hallway, both very unsightly.   2) Housekeeping only comes if you stay more than 6 nights, else you pay something like 30 Euro. We did ask for (and receive) fresh towels mid-way through, so this would have been less of a problem had the sink been properly working and not getting dirtier and dirtier every day. 

Despite these problems, though, overall it was a good stay and we would stay again.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Great location in Paris
text: We just stayed for 5 nights in a studio room. Very quiet, clean and well appointed. I found the bed very comfortable and the air conditioning worked well. Staff were helpful. The use of a washing machine was very convenient. Lots of choices for restaurants close by. Would stay here again!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Good location, price value
text: The Citadines Opera Paris is located in Bvd de Italiens and Bvd Haussman very near The Opera Theatre and Galeries Lafayette, as well as the Madeleine and Place Vendome. Its a very good location if you are looking for proximity to all the well known tourist places. You have a metro station just in the corner which gives you good connection to everywhere. The rooms are comfortable and neat. A quiet place to stay.  Friendly staff.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Perfect Aparthotel in Paris
text: We stayed in Paris and two other cities in France for a week and the Citadines Opera was our permanent home since we left our big luggage in the apartment and travel just with a carry on. The locaition is near to a lot of restaurants and train stations.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Convenient alternative to the traditional hotel
text: The room was functional and the apartment big enough for us to stay with our baby. It was great value and a lot cheaper than the usual Paris hotel. Parking is tricky to find and the receptionists were a little slow.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Excellent Receptionist
text: I have stayed at various Citadines in Paris. However, I have never received such great friendly customer services as I got from a new receptionist at Citadines Opera, Melodie. She was very helpful and understanding and helped get my issue resolved in a friendly and timely manner. I wish the rest of the staff could reach this level of kindness and caring customer service. She is truly an asset to that company.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Everything is good
text:
My friend and I stayed at the studio apartment for 11 nights,  We took Roissy bus from CDG Airport to Opera and walked to Citadine approx. 10 mins, very convenient to reach with public transport, Line 8 and Line 9 are just 2 minutes walk away.  EUR54 ride to CDG.

Room is big with nice small kitchen, we prepared breakfast and dinner there every day, very quiet all the time.

They offered free room cleaning once a week, you needs to get free clean towels at Reception every day, it is fine with us.

I would like to stay here if visit Paris again.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: EXCELLENT APART'HOTEL IN OPERA DISTRICT
text: If you're in Paris to do sightseeing & shopping whether luxury or highstreet, look no further! The apart'hotel is along Rue Favart on the corner of Boulevard des Italienes, adjacent to Blvd Haussman where high end department stores are, also Zara, H&M, Mango, Uniqlo etc. Walking distance to the Opera Garnier, Roissy Bus Stop (transpo to CDG Airport) and walking distance to Louvre too. Blvd des Italienes has all sorts of restaurants, fast food chains and most importantly a grocery store MONOPRIX! Metro station is literally a few steps and across the street from Citadines Opera. Kitchen is well-equipped but if you are fussy about house cleaning, you must know they only offer it for FREE if you stay 7 nights or more. But overall, my husband and I really loved this place! Will be back on next trip to Paris!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Nice place
text: We stayed here for 5 nights and it was lovely. Comfy bed, nice size room, kitchen had nearly all you needed, we bought a spatula so we could turn our food. The hotel was fairly centrally located to most iconic sights. The only downfall was if you wanted to have the door open onto the balcony the noise coming from the restaurant which extended out into the courtyard can be very loud.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Excellent
text:
very nice hotel!
The apartments stylish and comfortable !!
The hotel itself is located near the Opera  in 2 district of Paris !
On a quiet street, especially has a good lobby and courtyard with landscape
Be sure to come back!
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Dated Aparthotel with poor staff
text:
Stayed at this hotel for 1 week, only saving grace for this hotel is location (close to public transport and tourist attractions) 

PROs
Location 

CONS 

The rooms are dated, dirty, kitchenette is not "full equipped" despite claims on their website. I think we were unlucky to get a two level room which resulted in cramped space. 

Checkin staff were fine, although after checkin , call front desk to check the half broken sofa bed , no one attended during the stay. No room cleaning every day, (once a week i believe) have to pay 16 odd Euros for the priviledge.

My biggest bug bear was staff barging in without knocking TWICE, complained to front desk and the staff shrugged it off. 
Entrance to the hotel has a water feature which has never been cleaned. 
Citadines website/plus advertisment inside lifts state that late check out allowed , the hotel was half empty, request 3:00 pm checkout, staff advised that this was only possible to 1:00 pm . Chose to get out of this sub standard place and pay for a hotel room at CDG for 6 hrs.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Lovely place to stay
text: I really enjoyed my stay here. It was perfect for my gf and I. The kitchenette was quite useful to us. Careful with the shower though, the tub was elevated and I felt like I was going to fall every time I stepped out. But other than that everything was quite nice and very comfortable. The bed was nice to sleep on. The room was clean. Everything worked perfectly.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: If you are on business do not stay at this place
text:
I am the old customer of Citadines for a long time.  I have stay at Citadines Opera for three times.  This time I went for business meeting in UK.  I sent the email to inform the hotel that I expect to have my parcels there.  It is the sample from my business partner to be used for presentation.

The staff at Citadines Opera rejected all the parcel even we have the booking name there.  They told a fairy tale that they don't know that this is under guest name. (Other famous hotel in Europe always know how to handle this professionally.)

They I have to go to the meeting without anything in hand.  I came back to Paris again to get my parcel.  Before my arrival I was told a fairy tale that they don't have the booking name. I have shown them the evidence of my booking so they keep shut up.  The manager doesn't do anything just keep quiet.  I have to follow up all the parcel myself and was told a fairy tale again once more that my parcel is going back to the sender.

From the post office system shown that all the parcel rejected.  I can follow up and get one parcel back. Still another two missing somewhere.  The staffs in Citadines Opera you can not trust them only one guy seems to know what is right or wrong.

So they is no way how to complaint through their channel.  The front desk will tell you that they don't know this issue.  They will ask from their colleagues.  None of them seems to be ok and care about customer feeling.

Beware if you thing that this hotel will handle thing for you.  They will not do anything and just keep shut up and let the issue gone this is how the management of Citadines and Ascotts Group do.  They will not take a look in to the details even the email said there.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Excellent
text:
Location is so good. There is a station of the metro in the hotel side and there is a market near and is convenient.
I was glad that I could always drink coffee free.
The kitchen goods was prepared, but I was sorry that I did not do a frying pan well without a bottom being saved by heat, and hitting a heater
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: A haven in Paris Opera District
text: We stayed for a total of 6 days over a two week period and experienced 2 apartments.  Both apartment were classified as 'Suite Couture' on the company website.   We have previously stayed at this apartment hotel a couple of years ago.  We have realistic but reasonably high standards and these were again met.  We found the apartments to be clean, spacious and well maintained, were quiet, had very good natural lighting and opening windows.  The beds were large and very comfortable.  The kitchens were well equipped.  The 24 hour reception staff and all other staff were pleasant and helpful.  There was a good guest laundry open 24/7.  Lift access to rooms. We found the hotel to be well located for access to retail, eating and very close to the metro.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Stay confortable
text:
I had staied with my husband at this hotel for three days.
We could cook for dinner at the nice kicten after shopping at the marche.
The room is enough space so we could relax.
It is also good to have free coffee at the public space.
The staffs were kind , because he resarched how to go the department store .
We hope stay there again.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Not recommended at all!
text: I would never stay here again.  The location is the only "positive" about this place.  Fresh towels for three people were 20 Euro (I could have bought them cheaper), the downstairs bathroom had no sink to wash hands, and there was no way to get even a small suitcase up the narrow, circular-winding staircase.  Definitely not recommended.  The sleeper sofa in the living room was horrid.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Comfortable, great location
text:
Spent 6 nights at the studio apartment. It's never easy to find a hotel room in Paris that is not too small, which is what brought us to choose the option of Citadines, 
The size of the studio room and the lovely small kitchen were just perfect for us. 
We like to be independent, and eat our breakfast and sometimes other meals in our room. The location is good if you're interested in shopping at the Grands Magasins (Galleries La Fayette, Printemps), or a concert at Olympia. 
A great experience all round.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: An awesome stay in a great hotel
text:
After travelling around Europe for a number of weeks arriving at the Citadines Opera Paris. First impressions is a tidy hotel off the main road. However the room was amazing and of a high standard. Spacious, very clean, modern decor. It was a great stay for a family that included two small children. Cooking facilities in the room, seperate toilet and bathroom, laundry available down stairs.

Located in the Opera district of Paris. Lots of restaurants down the road, Metro 20 meters away and near the hop on bus route.
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: central location
text: Hotel is located near Opera, very convenient to reach with public Transport, clean and in good shape, very good breakfast and very friendly supporting service staff, as Boarding house, daily cleaning Service can be booked
name: Citadines Opéra Paris

title: Small but perfect
text: An excellent small independent hotel just around the corner from the Bastille Metro. Extremely clean, friendly staff and comfortable rooms. The rooms were cleaned every day and breakfast was good for despite some reviews I have seen suggesting otherwise. We would  definitely return!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Fabulous Boutique hotel in Bastille area
text:
Perfectly located in the Bastille area, 500m from the Metro making sightseeing very accessible.
Professional welcome with a friendly touch.
We had a fabulous room, not big, but exceeding expectation, on the 5th floor with rooftop view over the city, very French. Loved the juliet balcony, made the room feel bigger & perfect for your morning coffee.
Super comfy bed & quality bedding
Lovely bathroom with power shower over bath, fluffy towels and robes.
Tip: Try Bofinger Brasserie literally just round the corner for fresh oysters, Moules & flambé crepes.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Lovely hotel with bars and metro on your doorstep
text:
Excellent location for the metro, bars and restaurants. Opposite bastille metro station and the shops too. Lovely corner hotel overlooking typical Paris street scene. The hotel was welcoming, well fitted with air conditioning which was welcome. 

Lovely rooms and really comfy bed too. 

Highly recommend it for anyone looking to visit Paris
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great hotel
text: This hotel was in the perfect location for our stay. The staff were friendly, approachable and extremely helpful. Our room was small but had a double aspect and a great shower. All areas of the hotel were spotlessly clean. There were plenty of bars, cafes and restaurants in the locality.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Not worth 200€ and do not get breakfast
text: While the location is great, the general experience was below average. I fluctuate on whether it’s reflective of or not worth 200€. Either way, avoid the breakfast at all costs. The 20€ “meal” consists of poor pastries, yogurts, microwaved eggs, and a Nespresso machine that was broken.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Best hotel I have stayed in in Paris
text:
Hotel is fabulous! The location, the staff, the rooms, all fab. If you have any requests they do their best to help.

I was so surprised with how nice this hotel is, we are already enquiring about another trip in December.

Would definitely recommend!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Better than other hotels of the same price
text: Very comfortable room and bedding. Nicely decorated. Spacious. Very well situated next to metro Bastille. Very good bathroom. Clean. Professional staff. One of my best experience in a hotel of this category - I travel to Paris several time a year. Would definitely recommend. Count with the normal city noise if you sleep with an open window - but nothing abnormal in such a central situation.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Will Come Again
text: Lovely well positioned mid-range hotel, perfect for exploring Le Marais and Bastille areas.  Room cleaned and tidied really well each morning.  Helpful, relaxed yet professional staff.  We had a room overlooking the main street which was lovely - we can't comment on rooms opening onto the central / internal light well but these would not have the same 'Parisien' feel as those with an external outlook.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Very nice and good location
text: Very nice hotel. Rooms were clean. Staff was very friendly always. We did not have the breakfast so I can’t say anything about that. There’s a lift so that’s nice for the luggage. We stayed with a group of friends. Perfect for that.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Hidden Gem
text: The hotel is very well located and the overall feel is more 4 star than 3 star. Our room on 6th floor was comfortable and spacious with street views. They have Fragonard products in the bathrooms and a decent hairdryer. The staff were also helpful in trying assisting with restaurant reservations. The area is also very vibey with lots of restaurant and bars as well as small boutiques and galleries for shopping.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: excellent hotel for a magical stay in the city of love
text:
It was a pleasure staying at Hotel Bastille Speria. Upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed and shown to the elevator which took us to the sixth floor, the deluxe room. The room has the most comfortable kingsize bed an two windows overlooking the inconic parisian streets of the Bastille neighbourhood. It was very clean, and included a coffee- and teastation. The bathroom is spacious and includes a deep bath that'll serve you well after a day of wondering the streets of paris and needing some rest.
Breakfast was amazing! It was very varied and included something for everyone. There are amazing options for bread (croissants, baguette, pain au chocolat), lots of cheeses, sausage, fresh fruits, dried fruits, cornflakes, fresh jus d'orange, good coffee and ommelettes. The tables looked classy and offered a cozy and charming start of the day.
The Hotel is located near nice restaurants, fun bars for going out and getting drinks, massage salons, flowershops and there's a pharmacy right next to the hotel. It is in the very heart of paris and located next to metrostation Bastille from which you can explore the beautiful city.
I would highly reccomend staying here to anyone. For those who enjoy a calm and peaceful stay to get some rest, for those who love to go out and party (because there's many bars on walking distance) and for those in town for business (good wifi for online meetings). It is truly a hotel that keeps in mind the needs of their guests and offers an unforgettable stay in the City of Love.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Wonderful happy hotel
text: Wonderful hotel. Happy and helpful staff. Great location near multiple metro lines, great local restaurants and sights like high-line walk, Notre Dame and Chapelle. Superb beds and very quiet rooms. Super breakfast and great value. Bravo!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great location and interior design
text: Lovely hotel and very clean. The staff were super welcoming too. The only thing I’d improve is to offer bigger and firmer pillows. The area is great, so close to cute French shops. Definitely would stay there instead of close to the Eiffel Tower.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Mouse in Room
text:
I would love to give this hotel a better review but unfortunately after our 1st night we discovered our bitten into crisp packet and mouse droppings on the carpet. I notified  reception and she took my room number and said they would take a look. 

When we got back to the hotel the mouse droppings were still on the carpet and nothing was done about it even though we showed her a picture of a mouse online as she didn't understand.

Also we struggled to get any hot water after 4pm, this was also notified to reception who said they would look into and it and nothing improved so we ended up having cold showers in the evening before heading out to dinner. 

In all it is a nice hotel but lacks any action taken seriously and would have been forgotten about if they had actioned the mouse complaint along with offering a form of apology or free night.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Very disappointing hotel staff but perfect situated hotel
text:
Perfect location near metro station, restaurants and cafés. Very very clean rooms but small, narrow and little space for two persons although it was a deluxe doubleroom! The bathroom was very clean and nice. The staff was correct and did his job. But NO warm smile, I felt NO real interest for my request but they did JUST their job with no delight. No more, no less. The hotel DID NOT satisfies my request, although I explicitly asked for it twice and they confirmed my request previously by e-mail. That was disappointing!
The deluxe room was not as described on Booking.com. Instead of a nice view as described, I had a direct view of a wall and a emergency exit stairs. The room was very dark. This was the most disappointing hotel and staff for me so far. I can NOT recommend this hotel. But the location is really perfect and the cleanliness was exceptionally good. I deeply regret to have chosen this hotel. And just a little smile costs nothing and it works wonders.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Gem in the Marais
text: I have been staying at the Bastille Speria for over 20 years.  The location is wonderful and there are many Metro lines close by.  The hotel is charming and the staff is very helpful, professional and friendly.  I always feel welcome.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great location and chic decor
text:
Brilliant location near the Marais and very quiet considering 
Rooms were modern and very clean and chic 
Friendly reception staff and nice common area
Comfortable bed good wife and British TV option
Will definitely come back when here again
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Very Good Hotel and a Great Location
text:
Very good value for the money. Steps from Bastille Metro and numerous restaurants. Very close to Marais and lovely shops, but we really felt like we were amongst locals. 
Breakfast was typical Euro style. Staff were very accommodating of our request for GF options.
We had a few minor housekeeping issues but front desk staff immediately supplied the necessary items. 
Internet was poor and we found it had to regulate the room temp. Bed was comfortable but pillows were not. Room was a reasonable size but we could have used some storage options or hooks to hang clothes.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Amazing place!
text: Do not hesitate to book! This hotel is exceptional, and ideally located! Easy walking access to the sites, shops and restaurants, as well as being close to the metro line that can take you across the city.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Perfect hotel for a Paris trip
text: Very nice hotel, lovely decorated  with all the wallpaper and tiles at the entrance. Also a very good location near to metro, restaurants and shopping. We will for sure come back! We had a double room which was very convenient to be in touch with 4 persons.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Highly recommended
text: Really good experience at this hotel - ideal location in the heart of Le Marais, stylish and comfortable, very friendly and helpful staff (especial thanks to Juan who made a big fuss of our kids) and our two separate rooms were accessed through one door so felt that although the kids were in a different room they were very secure.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Basic but good
text: I slept very good and had enough information, it was little too pricey for what it is. I mean you get basic hotel room, basic equipments and sleep a few hours. €240 is just too much for that ^^ i liked the coffee facility in te room.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great experience!
text:
Great experience! 
We enjoyed the stylish and colorfull hotel and the room’s view! 
Staff very nice and friendly. 
Confortable bed and pillows. 
We will be back soon! Best place to enjoy time in Paris!!!!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Dog friendly, clean boutique hotel. Located in great location.
text:
Great boutique hotel, great location, dog friendly.
We definitely enjoyed our stay here. Staff were friendly, room size was perfect. Walking distance to restaurants, bars and shops. Definitely recommend a room with a view of the city. We will stay here again!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: A fine hotel
text:
Great location, clean and newly decorated.  Good value for money, working airco and wifi.
Quiet room in a busy neighbourhood with vast choice of restaurants. Close to metro and bus connections. I wouldn't hestitate to stay again.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Excellent location and very comfortable bed and bathroom!
text: Stayed here for a few days with my husband. The room was not large, but laid out perfectly with a desk, chair and table by the window, comfortable bed, and a large, modern bathroom. The location is ideal to explore Le Marais. Right around the corner from the hotel are excellent restaurants, shops, a pharmacy, bakeries, neighborhood open market, museums, and more. Easy to get to from the airport and the Metro.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Customer Service wonderful
text: We were booked for May 2020 but due to COVID we had to cancel. However this generous hotel allowed us to hold the booking for 6months without penalty. These are the hotels you should be supporting when things get back to normal. Please look at this hotel if you intend to stay in Paris. We will be booking again when we finally have our trip to France. Highly recommended due to customer service and decency in dealing with us.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Decent hotel
text:
it's an all right hotel, for the price it absolutely ticks all the boxes. The rooms are super  tiny, but you would expect that in Paris anyway. The location is perfect for exploring the city, Bastille metro station is less then 2 minutes away! The area is not super touristy (as non-touristy as it can be in the center of Paris) nice brasseries and boulangeries around.  Le Marais shopping area is not too far away too.

Although we did get bed linen with a few stains and wifi was rubbish, still would recommend this place because of the location and affordable price
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: really nice well located hotel
text: we spend a very good time in this hotel. the room was very nice and comfortable. The bathroom was good too. The shower was big. However, we hadn't got a nice view but I think you can ask to the hotel before if you want to have a certain type of view. The only negative point was the bad quality of the wifi.The employees were very nice. the price is really correct.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great hotel for the Opera
text: We were looking for a hotel near the opera and the location was fantastic for the Metro as well. Very comfortable beds, very clean, recently refurbished, perfect for a weekend in Paris. Breakfast fine and helpful staff.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great location, great stay
text: The hotel location was ideal, the hotel met our expectations (if not exceeded them), would definitely stay again. Great for couples and great value for money this central in Paris - marais is a great place to eat & drink!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Great hotel in a great area
text: Unfortunately only stayed one night but probably the best reasonably priced hotel I have stayed in Paris.  The area was superb and if it wasn't for the strikes would have great transport links.  Coming back!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Perfect
text: The hotel is very clise to the Metrostation. Nearby are many good restaurants and bars. The staff is super friendly and helpfull. They can give you a lot of good recommendations. The hotel and the rooms are clean and pretty. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to my friends!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Perfect Location - Perfect little hotel
text: We spent five days in September in this hotel and truly loved it.  The location was just perfect and we loved the neighbourhood.  There was so much to do around there and so easy to get around Paris.  We lucked out with this hotel.  The room although small had everything we needed.  The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was very spacious and well appointed.  The staff there were so very helpful and friendly.  I cannot say enough about them.  They made our stay perfect.  We would definitely stay there again.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Not worth the $$
text: The only positive comment I can make is that it is in a good location. The rooms are ridiculously small even by Paris standards. There is ZERO customer service. In fact the staff is pretty rude. The breakfast is awful. You are much better off going across the street for a great coffee and a croissant. The hallways are so narrow that it is only enough for one person to pass. Tiny common area. Very claustrophobic
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: The Hotel Stands on a Busy Corner
text:
I chose this Hotel for its location, free WiFi, room safe and dark room drapes.
Le Marais area is an upscale location surrounded by restaurants, bars, cafes, shops and a park surrounded by old world charm architecture named Place des Vosges.
The Bastille and St Paul Métro station are nearby to take you to the tourist sights.
The Batobus moves on the water, an excellent way to hop on hop off on nine different locations while you rest your feet and view the sights.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Paris Hotel Bastille Speria
text: This is a  gem of a hotel the staffs were very friendly and accommodating, rooms and bath extremely clean. Rooms are pretty big and comfortable mattress extremely comfortable. The Hotel went thru a recent upgrade of all rooms and baths. Great location near all metro
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Newly remodeled, but needs work.
text: The rooms are ridiculously small, even by Paris standards.   Two adults and suitcases put a strain on the available space along side the bed.   The bathroom was adequate, although fairly small as well.   Stay away from the breakfast.  The coffee is just this side of nasty and the offerings are poor at best.   With breakfast spots on every corner, there is no reason to waste money there.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: perfect value for money
text: was my 4th time at Hotel Speria Bastille. Love the location, the new rooms and the service. Quality of the bed is very good. The new renovated rooms are very pleasant. Will come back also next year for sure!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Chic Hotel Near the Metro
text: Very Chic Design. Room was Clean and Comfortable. Bathroom was very clean and new. Love this Hotel! Super Friendly Staff. Short Walk to the Metro. It was a great find and I'll definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Good For The Price
text: It's newly renovated and the rooms, while small, are quite beautiful.  Nice big windows, smart rooms and big bathrooms with good amenities.  Our room was in the first floor and over looking the street but We slept well and it was not particularly noisy.  We'd recommend and would stay again.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Nice boutique hotel in Marais
text: We booked this hotel based on Rick Steves. The hotel itself was nice and well priced. The room was fairly spacious but the shower was not great. We did not care for the location as much as we had hoped although there were lots of restaurants close by and a market nearby on Thursdays and Saturdays. Staff arranged airport transportation (38 Euros) which was helpful. They offer a breakfast option.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Lock-up everything if you stay here.
text: The majority of the desk people were rude. They told us to leave our room keys when going out because the room # and hotel name are on them. When returned a man was at the counter complaining his camera had been robbed from his room. When we went to our room gold earrings were missing. When I reported it to the desk they acted like they could care less and said oh well you do have a safe, its not our problem. I believe it is their problem and that a bunch of thieves work there. The only reason I didn't give it worst rating is the Italian restaurant across the street was excellent.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Pretty Good For The Price
text: Overall it’s not a bad hotel. They recently remodeled and were still remodeling while we were there. We were placed in one of the newer rooms, it’s was very clean and spacious. It had a small refrigerator, and a hair dryer so that was a plus. The location was pretty good, there’s a metro station right around the corner so you can connect with the whole city. My only complaint was the elevator, it had problems while we were there. One day it was stuck on the 3rd floor and we were in the 5th, so climbing the stairs wasn’t fun. Also you should know that every time you leave, you must leave your key at the front desk.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: The worst hotel ever!! A nightmare!!
text: The worst hotel ever. We were stolen on the first day in this hotel. Someone/some people entered in our room (with the key since the door was not open or damaged) and opened all our locked luggage (they broke the lockers and the luggage zips in order to open them) and stole all the money we had and my daughter's jewellery. We informed the receptionists (one different per day) and the hotel manager who did nothing about that. They all said they could do nothing and the manager said that it was our fault because we didn't use the hotel room safe to store our valuable things. This was an absurd since we paid a three star hotel and we believed that our locked luggage would be secure inside our locked hotel room. On the same day of the theft we went to the nearest police station and did a formal complaint there. After that we sent this formal complaint to the manager attached to an email where I explained again everything that had happened in details. We didn't receive any answer so far. We would never stay there again. It was a nightmare. Besides all these horrible things, the room is very small, the security is horrible (according to one of the receptionists that talked to us, we where the second guest with the same problem that day), many different staff members each day, the breakfast is poor and very expensive - 14 euros per person (no fruits despite the fact that they mention they have in the ad, no eggs, no toasts, one option of fresh juice) and the staff struggles to speak English in this three star hotel.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Good hotel except for theft. Be warned!
text: I was nervous about staying here after reading reviews about the hotel being under renovation. But we were pleasantly surprised when we arrived because the renovation was complete and our rooms were very clean, modern and more spacious than we expected. We had two rooms; one for us and one for our teenage kids. We were disappointed that they were not closer together but on floors 1 and 4. Everything was going great until we got back one later afternoon to find our kids' room had been burglarized, their bags were rummaged through and their money and a charger taken. It was not forced entry so it had to be an inside job. The man at the front desk said someone else in the hotel had been robbed that day as well. We were told to speak to a manager the next morning but then the next day were told the manager was on vacation. No one seemed to be particularly disturbed about what happened and we were not given any offer to help make it up to us. We asked to change rooms but were told they were at capacity. We filed a police report but I don't expect much to come from it. I'm surprised we still have not heard anything from the hotel with any attempt at even a simple apology. It's a shame because it's a nice property in a good location but I would never stay here again or at any other property managed by the same company, Regetel.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Can't recommend. Good location but...
text:
Hotel is in a good location, the room was clean and the morning coffee/continental breakfast was fine. That's it for the positives. 

I don't mind a small room but the room was TINY. We had trouble finding a place for our two suitcases to fit on the floor. Free wi-fi was advertised but it was spotty to the point of useless unless you rent a portable hot-spot for extra. In the evening when we went down to the lobby to ask for a portable hot-spot (because we were trying to do work in the room and needed wi-fi for email) the guy at the front desk told us they didn't rent portable hot-spots. We showed him the poster in the elevator a few feet away that advertises portable hotspots for rent at the front desk and he told us he didn't know anything about it and we'd have to come back in the morning to ask the day desk person. We encountered different friendly but clueless front desk people each evening. 

French people have a reputation for being rude but I only met one rude person during my entire stay and he was the guy who seemed to be the manager or main desk guy during the day. He seemed annoyed to speak with us, was unhelpful (gave us faulty info on a couple of occasions), and he charged us extra to check out, saying we needed to pay an additional $400 for an "extra person" despite the fact that we'd paid for a double room before arriving. We were rushing to catch our flight so we didn't have time to argue before leaving. We fought for, and got, a refund once back in the US. The hotel never apologized for the overcharge or the hassle. Can't think of a worse experience with staff at any hotel in all my travels.  

There was major construction going on throughout our stay. It was quiet at night but felt a little hazardous during the day, and dusty. This was in May of 2019 so not sure if that's still an issue.

Note that the elevator is very, very tiny and someone with claustrophobia or a plus-sized person might have a hard time with it. No joke.
name: Hotel Bastille Speria

title: Excellent Hôtel and and Staff
text:
All the staff were excellent, caring and smiling.
Every member of staff brings satisfaction to the customer.
An outstanding experience, a great customer experience.
The breakfast was more than perfect with gluten free products, vegetable milk.
Special attention is given to each guest and it is pleasant.
name: Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe
description: The Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe is a haven of peace with its location in a quiet street that is nonetheless close to the Champs-Elysées, the Faubourg Saint-Honoré and outstanding museums. title: Chic, sophisticated, yet very friendly
text: Stayed for 5 days in 2 junior suites with elderly parent.  Staff could not have been nicer.  Concierge Carlos, doorman Michel, reception staff Anastasia and Nicolas and barman (I think Francois) all went out of their way to be helpful and gracious -- "Why use an app if you can get personal service with a smile?" was Carlos' question when I couldn't complete an online ticket purchase to Musee d'Orsay.   Rooms are modern and comfortable, with climb in bathtubs that aren't for the faint hearted or unathletic and roomy showers with rain and handheld fixtures.  Interestingly, no bidet.  Must be out of fashion in France.  Bed is super comfortable, lots of closet space; complimentary coffee, tea and Evian. Hermes toiletries.  Only peculiarity is that for such a high-end hotel (it's pretty pricey, especially over the holidays), it has a very casual restaurant.  No tablecloths.  No dress code.  Pretty limited menu. But the simple breakfast in the bar (breads, coffee/tea, juice) is fine and, given the location of the hotel, reasonable @ 18 euro per person. And the location of the hotel is, of course, one of the key reasons for staying:  it's a 5 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees (12 minutes if you're with an elderly parent). Because taxis in Paris are plentiful and most trips to the main sights were less than 10 euros, the transit strike wasn't much of a problem.

text:
We had a phenomenal stay at Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe. Upgraded to jr. suite when we checked in. Gentlemen at front desk overcharged us to say the least (and put a hold on $$$ from my bank acct even though we prepaid)but interestingly enough, we never saw him again our entire weeklong stay. Tip: please make sure your do not disturb is up (although we did),as the housekeeping had come in a few times while we were taking evening naps (only to go out later at night!).

I would highly recommend.
It is a bit pricey, but given that it was our wedding anniversary, it was worth spending a bit more for our first time in Paris.

You are better off just going to any nearby restaurants that are in close walking distance.

title: Hidden gem in Paris
text:
I want to thank the Sofitel staff especially Alice from guess relations for making my first time in Paris so memorable. This was a birthday that I will remember for a life time. From the moment we walked into the hotel we were greeted and surprised with balloons, cake, and a written note since I was celebrating my birthday. The staff was also very personable with our toddler and provided her with a bag of goodies from Paris. These are moments that we will cherish for a life time. 

We had a suite and our rooms were spacious for 3 and we were provided with complimentary Nespresso coffee every morning along with water. Room service came to clean our room three times a day. The location of the hotel is perfect for those who like to be near the city, but enjoy their peace at night. We were walking distance from many of the main attractions in Paris like Arc de Triomphe which was a bonus. Room service was phenomenal and had great customer service since we ordered milk from them daily for our daughter. 

There was even a time where we walked into our room to find a hand written note for our daughter with a stuffed animal. Our daughter could not stop smiling. I would highly recommended this hotel in Paris especially those with young children because the staff are very helpful and nice. They truly made us feel welcomed. 

Thank you, Sofitel! 

We can’t wait to be back someday!

text: The Sofitel Arc de Triomphe is an excellent hotel that is perfectly located in the center of Paris and within easy walking distance to the Champs Elyesee. There's really no excuse for that in a hotel of this calibre.  The front desk and concierge staff was very courteous and helpful.  The restaurant staff were just OK.  I would still recommend the Sofitel Arc de Triomphe overall with 4 stars.

title: OK in a pinch but not great
text: We only stayed at this hotel because we ran into issues with our Airbnb host who was uncontactable, and this hotel thankfully had availability at midnight when we needed last minute accommodations. The room size is small but decent. The guy working at the front desk on the night shift was very friendly and empathetic at check in. Note that the elevator is extremely tiny and slow so if you have a lot of luggage you may need to take multiple trips. Rooms are also jam packed close together but thankfully we did not run into noise issues. Our main complaint is that on the second night the thermostat malfunctioned (red blinking light with a service/maintenance “wrench” icon flashing!) and started blowing incessant hot air all through the night so we had to keep a window open. The minibar fridge also stopped cooling and was warm (probably same electrical issue!) so everything we stored in there had to be discarded. Was disappointed that the hotel management did not offer any remedies or credit back for the poor experience we had on the second night; all they said was they would try and do better next time which is frankly not acceptable. We will not be returning in future.

title: Don't TOUCH Breakfast-IT IS NOT FREE
text:
DON"T TOUCH BREAKFAST--IT WILL COST YOU
Our stay was lovely. Just as it should have been. Until we checked out! At check out, the reception asks us to settle a bill for 67 Euros. I asked what for as we paid in advance. She say's "for the breakfast". EXCUSE ME!!!! Why are we being charge 30 Euros per person for breakfast? We weren't told there was a charge? She then pulls out a manual (large binder) in French to show me. I tell her I don't speak or read French and no one told me about any charge. She didn't care! The best part: I had one hard boiled egg and a glass of orange juice two mornings in a row. My husband had one yogurt and milk two mornings in a row. This cost us 60 Euros. We are going back to Paris for 4 more days next week and have chosen a different Hotel Chain. Unreal... Their breakfast is a normal Continental breakfast of terrible foods and they are charging people without their knowledge. Poor business practice. I emailed them and of course received no response. I am a very good Best Western client and this left me with a very sour feeling towards them. I will continue to report this until someones responds.

title: Unexpected Stay
text:
I recently stayed at the Best Western Hotel Folkestone on a business trip.  We had booked an Air BnB and upon arrival we did not feel safe or want to stay one minute - so needed to find a hotel fast.  We chose this hotel for the location and although I had reservations (Yes, I'm a snob) we were extremely pleased.  We booked 3 rooms and jumped in an uber and arrived at 9pm at night.  The hotel is wonderfully located and although the street was being torn up by DPW it was fine.  The people at check in were wonderfully accommodating and friendly.  The lobby is small, but there is a nice room for breakfast (downstairs).   
The room itself was clean and comfortable, but very small.  I was traveling alone, so not an issue, but if my husband was with me it would have been tight.  The bathroom was tiny.  My co-workers rooms were a bit more roomy than mine.  We were on the 7th floor - so perhaps the rooms on the lower floors (some have balconies) were larger.  
Nevertheless, we were safe, and comfortable.  
Close to the metro and plenty of restaurants, shopping and sightseeing very close.  You can walk everywhere.  
They staff was amazing  - secured taxi's, helped with restaurant recommendations, and were very knowledgeable.  I would recommend and stay there again.

title: Very average
text:

Hotel is somewhat run down though. Room carpet greyish, toilet door knob falling off and bathroom layout just strange. Difficult to use the sink tap as its fixed at a weird angle. Bathroom tiles still in pretty shape but nowhere to put toiletries (yes we left toiletries bag on the floor...) and the toilet paper was put on stand on the floor.

Our room is on level one facing the small street, soundproofing is bad. Could hear the garbage truck siren early in the morning from our room. 

Book this hotel for the location and nothing else.

title: Cozy and Comfortable
text:
I stayed one night only. I totally enjoyed my stay for that night only. The room was small, but it was cozy big time. I felt comfortable in it. The hotel is near the Opera and, if you're a keen walker, then all of central Paris and its main sights will be within easy reach. 

Staff were very friendly and accommodating. Breakfast was served in a stylish, chique ambience. 

This hotel is a typical French terraced building, and the business created a series of small rooms next and on top of each other. Do expect some noise from your neighbor, if you're a light sleeper. 

Also, the bathroom of the room I was in, did not have a working fan, meaning there was no ventilation to take the moisture away. Mould has started to build, and the hotel management had better look into this as soon as possible. My advice is to check all rooms at the same time.

title: Generally good hotel but with some issues
text:
I was booked here for two nights for a business trip; some way from the office but availability everywhere was limited due to Valentines.
I had mixed experiences in this hotel.
Good points:
Quick, easy check-in and friendly reception staff
Nicely decorated room with good modern bathroom with bath
Kettle and tea in room
Minibar in room
BBC1 and BBC2 on TV
Very quiet - slept well
Very good buffet breakfast for an additional €15
Bad points:
Room very small with window facing offices (quite close)
Door wouldn't lock the first time I left the room (they sent someone up to fix it while we were out)
Bath had no plug - first night they couldn't find one, second night they found one but it leaked
No information on cost of mini-bar - asked at reception and told soft drinks were free but seemed unsure about everything else
Didn't wash cups/glasses or replenish tea/milk when making up room so had to go and ask for more
Safe not digital coded as normal but had to pay deposit/get key
Toiletries not great (no facecloth or handcream)
Overall it was OK for two nights but I would look for somewhere else next time

text:

The room was clean but the carpet had seen better days as there were large stains in places.
When we return to Paris we would stay here again. There is a bar round the corner called Cricketer which is open late and a small shop next door that never seems to close and has everything we needed.

title: Great location, hard to beat
text:
Me and my friend stayed here for 5 nights in the end of April. We stayed in a classic double with terrace. The room was lovely, but quite small. When we had our suitcases open at the same time there was barely any room to move. The terrace on the other hand was really, really big, and offered a lovely view of the Parisian rooftops on the side street. Only downside was that the flowers in the pots where dead… By the end of April it´s Spring, and I’m sure some nice flowers would have survived. Otherwise we were pleased with the room, it had Everything we needed, including facilities to make tea, and a minibar. The interior was really classy as well, homely, but not old. I loved the exposed beams in the ceiling. 
We didn’t have breakfast, so I can’t say anything about that. The staff at the reception was nice, and greeted you whenever you arrived/left the hotel. The only disappointed thing was that there was no recognition what so ever of the fact that we were celebrating my friends birthday, although I had pointed this out in the reservation (which was made directly with the hotel and no third part). Other hotels I have stayed at have recognized birthdays in some ways, some more then others, but to completely ignore it felt quite arrogant. 
The best thing about this hotel is the location. It’s located in an upscale neighborhood, close to the embassies, the Palais Garnier (Opera), Place de la Concorde, Tuileries Garden and Louvre. It is a 30 minutes walk to Arc de Triomphe, and we also walked to the Eiffel Tower. There are many Metro stations close to the hotel, and the RoissyBus, which is a direct bus between Opera and CDG AirPort, stops at Palais Garnier, only 5 minutes walk from the hotel.
I would recommend this hotel to others based on the location, which I think is hard to beat.

title: A well situated and inexpensive hotel
text:
We recently spent four nights at this hotel.  It was wonderful.  The hotel is very well situated, being close to the Paris Opera and the shopping district. The room was quiet and well appointed with a very comfortable bed.  The bathroom was clean and modern and had the usual array of toiletries on offer. We thought that the hotel was very well priced although breakfast was not included. Breakfast was well worth the extra payment of 15 Euros per person.  The food on offer was plentiful and varied with something for everyone.

The staff were very cheerful and helpful and they contributed to a really enjoyable stay. This hotel is really good value for money and we would certainly recommend it.

title: Security concerns and did not honor reservation
text:
Weekend of July 22nd - 24th 2016 was our 5th wedding anniversary.  We booked a high floor room with a terrace.  The reason we wanted this is because we enjoy bright rooms and outdoor space while on holiday.  When I first checked in, I was told my room was not available, to come back after 2 pm.  I had no issues with coming back but I had to leave my bag for safe keeping.  My bag was left in the lobby lounge area, non secured.  When I returned to check in, there was two major problems, first I saw my bag out in the open with other bags.  A big security issue from my perspective.  The second big issue was the room I booked was given away to a prior guest who decided to extend their stay.  I was not told this until my payment was collected.  I expressed my disappointment because we were really looking forward to a nice high floor room with a terrace.  They said they would upgrade our room but the "superior" room they decided to put us in was on the 1st floor, in the back of the building, facing a back alley overlooking garbage dumpsters from the restaurant next door.  There was zero sunlight.  The room was small, dark and a smoking room.  Since we are both non smokers, our eyes had allergic reactions from the imbedded smoke smells in the carpet and furniture.  I asked for a high floor non smoking room and was told non was available and no change in room was possible.  We were also awoken in the am around 6.30 am by garbage trucks making metal to metal banging sounds for 15 minutes.  What was suppose to be a special weekend in Paris was runined by several inconsiderate decisions to favor another guest despite having a confirmed reservation.  

While onsite, I asked no less than 4 times to speak to the manager and the day reception person kept saying she would reach out to the manager.  No manager even bothered to reach out to us.  Finally on the last ask to speak to the manager, the receptionist said, there is nothing else can be done and the manager decides what he wants to do and since he did not call back, that we needed to accept that.We were told the manager was Mr. Amoua.

The day reception person and management did not care about registering our complaints.  in the end, we receive free breakfast and the worst example of an upgraded room.  What they have not grasped was how disappointed we were after months of planning a romantic weekend.  Instead the receptionist raise tensions because of her indifference and poor understanding of customer service.

title: Nice location, Very limited Service
text:
The location is wonderful here close to a subway station and within walking distance to Galleries Lafayette and the major European chains.   We had some problems with our rooms. We booked two rooms for our family of four, and told we would be on separate floors.  We asked to be on the same floor, and we were reassigned a room on the 7th floor.   The 7th floor rooms have low ceilings and the rooms are tiny compared to a standard room on the 5th floor.  The electricity was not working in our room with the room keys given.  When we inquired at the front desk about having someone take a look at the problem, we were told it would be an hour before someone could check, but we could move to another room if we wanted.  We needed showers before dinner so we opted to go to a room on the 5th floor which ended up being much more space for us.  There was no other staff on duty besides the receptionist all day so we did not have any help moving our luggage from room to room.  It worked out because the 5th floor room was larger than the 7th floor room.  So we are back to being on different floors. Ha!

We asked Valeria to make a dinner reservation for us, and she called but the restaurant was closed at the moment.  Dead silence.  There was no offer to try again later and let us know like we experience in so many other hotels.   I have stayed in hotels all across Europe, and we just came from a very friendly Marriott on this holiday so I felt getting information about parking and restaurants was like pulling teeth out of her.  Her idea of a nice French restaurant suggestion to us was Hippopotamus (a chain).  I did not come to Paris to eat in a chain restaurant.  I can only conclude that it was the stereotypical French reservedness and lack of hospitality training.  If this was my hotel, she would be working in the back office, not he front desk.

Another problem came at check out.  I paid extra 10 euros a night per room to have two twin beds per room through Booking.com.  Because we moved rooms, and only two rooms with double beds were available, Valeria told it was "impossible" to modify the rate.  I felt like cold water was thrown in my face when she said "but you moved 3 times".  We only moved from the 7th floor to the 5th floor, but in her reasoning asking to be put together on the same floor counted as a move. I also did not think the electrical issue was our fault, and we were offered to move.  We did not ask to be moved.

The location is great, and the rooms are updated and modern. Still, there is no way I would ever return here or recommend this based solely on my interactions with Valeria.  There are lots of other options in the neighborhood, and you should check them out.

title: Fantastic for business
text: Fantastic facilities, customer service, comfort. And the rooms have the best technology you could wish for. (Apple Air Play as standard on the in room tvs.). Delicious food, and the most friendly and attentive service from all staff.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Perfect stay in paris
text: Location of hotel is excellent with perfect views. Hotel rooms super clean and modern. Many restaurants around the area . Everything you need for a perfect stay in this beautiful city. Connected to mall with pharmacy and stores , perfect for a rainy day !
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Upscale and modern high rise hotel
text:
This hotel stands out not only in the height and location but also in the modern style. The check-in  It is on the outskirts of historic, storybook Paris which makes it harder for a tourist/vacationer to get around and to explore nearby cafes and neighborhoods.  Our visit unfortunately coincided with major road and other construction work and the traffic was nightmarish.  Just walking out of hotel was a maze of makeshift paths.  This will subside in the next 12-18 months hopefully, and especially once the Olympics arrive in 2024.  More specific to our stay, we found the desk attendant was rude with respect to our check-in time and process.  Our host had to intervene to secure our room AFTER the 3pm stated move-in time.  The concierge on the other hand was very pleasant and made good recommendations.  In-room coffee amenities were very disappointing and cheap.  The other room appointments and temperature control are very good. 
Suffice it to say, if you want to be immersed in the quaint, traditional Parisian experience, a more central smaller, boutique hotel might fit the bill better.  For business or for guests who have already experienced "gay Paris" (as they say), this could be a winner.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent Service
text: Despite the distance from the lower arrondissement and the lack of parking at the hotel, what helped in my perfect rating of the hotel was the quality of service of its staff.  To name a few: Sebastien, the concierge helped me out so much when I and my friends, celebrating our milestone birthdays, arrived and there was no parking at the property, Sebastien called the rental car company to check if I could return the car off-hours.  He told me about a parking garage a couple of blocks away from the hotel but I was very uncomfortable and he facilitated that a baggage staff accompanies us to the parking garage.  To me, that was above and beyond. This brings me to Christophe, the baggage staff that accompanied us to the parking garage a couple of blocks away when we couldn't find a spot, he brought us to another one with actually a slightly bigger space to park. At this point, when we haven't even checked in yet, I was very pleased that we chose this hotel to stay at. Then, there was Tsering, the front desk person.  He had a presence about him that was very calming.  He checked us in, upgraded our room with an Eiffel Tower view for a minimal charge, and had a supervisor, Carolina, check the room to make sure all was in order.  Last but certainly not least there's Renata Bandirola who had a bottle of champagne and a box of chocolates waiting for us in the room.  How's that for a welcome?  Much appreciated, of course.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Bad customer service
text: Great hotel and location.front desk staff is so  rude . I wish Hyatt will train their staff better. Stayed there many times because my company booked it the room. I asked to speak with manager. I was told I manager is not available
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: THE BEST HELPERS!!!
text: Everyone was always so very helpful!!! Always going out of their way to assist and make sure we had what we needed to have an excellent stay at the hotel from the time we first walked into the lobby until we left out for the airport.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Nice stay
text: Worth the money and had a good night sleep with great views! I also loved the lounge club access- food was amazing. The location may seem a bit detached to the central tour sites but most places are within 30 min by subway which was manageable for me.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent view of Eifel Tower
text: The staff of front was really nice. The service was perfect. The most fantastic experience was the view of the room. The Eifel Tower view was beautiful. The breathtaking view made my 8 year old daughter fell in love witg Paris.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Extraordinary Experience
text: Our 2nd vacation in Paris and also stay in the hotel in 7 months.  Our hotel of choice for the location, facilities and, most importantly, great authentic service.  This recent stay was on point again.  Our gratitude goes to the warm welcome of Ms Sojin who was always professional and most thoughtful, and Ms Laetitia who ensure all guests at the Regency Club were well looked after.  Apart from personalised service, the view from higher floors of the hotel is breathtaking - I have attached a photo showing the spectacular sunset view from the Regency Club which greeted us on our first night there.  Best wishes to the team at Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile and see you all again in 2023!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent place to stay in the heart of Paris
text: Very good hospitality, friendly staff. Nice breakfast. Very clean rooms with nice Paris view. Located in the heart of Paris with well connected Metro system. Need improvement on the touch screen near the lift area. Always cause people to double touch.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Stellar hotel - absolutely unforgettable stay!
text: I stayed at this hotel as a kid with my parents, some 35 years ago, when it was called Concorde La Fayette. I had very fond memories of it, so now that I have my own family, I decided that next time when I went to Paris, I would stay there again. The property operates now under the Hyatt brand and offers everything that you would expect from a top-class hotel in Paris. We -my wife and two kids- stayed there for 3 nights at the end of September, 2022. Everything was absolutely perfect- this is a beautiful, modern property, conveniently located next to a subway station, and the staff is extremely polite and ready to meet all your needs. Every morning we got access to the breakfast buffet, which was absolutely delicious, and quite frankly, after having breakfast/brunch there, we didn’t need to eat anything again until the evening. Staying in Paris is tricky and expensive- you should research well where are you staying, as rooms can be extremely tiny and cramped, even at properties that are advertised as 5-star hotels. We loved everything at the Hyatt Regency- perhaps some day my kids will go back there again on their own!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Very poor check-in and breakfast experince
text:
I brought my daughter to Paris for a short 3-day trip to celebrate her birthday and mine.  We booked Hyatt Regency's high-floor two twin-bed room for its view.  Although we arrived before check-in time (3pm), we were not able to check in until almost 4pm, as we were told that there were no rooms available.  The check-in staff told us that he was new and couldn't find any available rooms for us.  After much await, a more senior staff took over and asked us whether we wanted a 12th-floor room.  Here were his words: "that's the only room we have available, if you don't want it, you will have to wait longer."  So, we took the room, because we had sightseeing planned that afternoon and were already late for it.  When we entered the room, we found out that it was not set up as two twin beds, but a large king bed.  So, we had to request the staff to come to separate the beds.  Those are really unnecessary hassles if the hotel had planned ahead of time based on our booking.

Then, the second morning we went to the breakfast at around 8:45am.  The pastries and fish are almost all gone and they were not replaced the entire time when we were at breakfast.  

I usually stay at Le Meridien Etoile when I visit Paris.  This is the first time I tried Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile, as it has higher floors.  However, I am deeply disappointed by my experience.  Will not stay there again.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: A disgrace to the Hyatt Regency Brand
text:
Falls extremely short of the high standards of other Hyatt Regency hotels. Too many problems to mention which I have fed back to Hyatt.
This is a Business Hotel there are no comforts here for couples celebrating anniversaries. Rooms are extremely basic and the bathrooms extremely small. Very clinical and minimalistic no flowers plants or softness anywhere. The lounge bar has only a limited amount of drinks on offer and the view is of dozens of meeting rooms. The attitude and care of the staff leaves a lot to be desired with a few positive exceptions.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Lovely property with panoramic view
text:
I always stay at Hyatt Regency when i visit for work. The hotel lobby is different than any other property in Paris, it is open space and full of life. The concierge team are the best! I stayed in a club room so i had the access the the club lounge at the highest floor which had a very stunning view of Eifel tower which was my view every morning for breakfast. There are big construction next to the hotel but it did not bother me. The location not far from the champs elysee but can be a bit further from other attractions.
Easy access to the metro next to the hotel..

title: Very helpful and kind staff!

title: Nice hotel. Poor attention to detail.

Very noisy outside with building work and sirens. Thin windows I guess. 
Friendly staff though.

title: Very nice hotel just outside Paris
text: Good value for the hotel. Very convenient to a metro stop that gets you into Paris in less than 15 mins and price is much better than downtown locations. Lots of construction happening to the roads in the area for Olympics so some inconvenience but not bad.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Extraordinary service and attention to detail.
text: Recent stay at Hyatt Etoile far exceeded expectations. Have never experienced this degree of service anywhere. Bravo to Renata Brandiola for extraordinary effort, and with done with unparalleled grace.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Business trip
text:

Cleanliness: very clean. Specially for Paris. Thank you for providing a water supply hose in the toilets, we do struggle with that in many countries. Towels were provided. Rooms didn't smell snuffy (alot of hotels do smell weird in paris).

Value: I cannot comment as it was paid by the company. 

Service: very helpful staff, they speak both english and french. Nobody got angry at english-speakers.

Rooms: coffee machine provided, towels, a big comfortable bed, clean bathroom. It is small but I guess it's normal for big cities, also, the windows were big with a beautiful view so it gave the room some space.

Food: excellent breakfast (yes, I've tried other hotels in Paris they did not have the same quality for breakfast).

title: Amazing hospitality
text: Our trip to Paris was to be  a special one as I was planning a surprise proposal for my now fiance. Initially it was very important for our suite to have an Eifel Tower view, and I realized when I booked the reservation that it was not guaranteed. Several months before our trip, I called and spoke to a very friendly staff member who explained that there are only two suites of this kind and one had the view while the other did not. The staff member explained that they could not guarantee, but that she would make a note of it on our reservation for check-in time. The day of our check-in, we arrived significantly earlier than check-in time, nonetheless, staff was willing to help and see what they could do about the view. Isabel made it happen! Not only did we get the room with the view, but we were also able to check in early. While we waited for our room to be ready, we hung out in the regency lounge where Renata introduced herself, greeted us, brought us our room keys, and informed us that our luggage was already on its way to our room. WOW!!!! talk about five star treatment. The entire stay staff was checking in on us assuring our needs were met, and we have no complaints during our stay. I must also mention that before our trip, I had coordinated with the concierge team for a surprise in the room for the morning of the proposal. Following the proposal, we returned to the room and the surprise was exactly what I had asked for. It was magnificently put together. My fiancé and I are beyond grateful for every staff member that made this a very special stay. Renata and her team made this a magical trip and we are beyond grateful. Thank you very much for this amazing service and hospitality.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: CIGRE Meeting Stay
text: The Hyatt hotel is near to Palace des Congres where we had CIGRE conference. It was really convenient. The Hyatt charged me 455 Euros for a no-show though our travel agent cancelled the reservation.  They should reimburse this money to my credit card.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Paris view is worth it, as it the conceirge floor.
text:
Pros:
