Conceirge room is well stocked, personnel are great.  A key feature of hotel.

Staff are VERY helpful and friendly.

I would stay here again unless I wanted to specifically be downtown.

title: Tiny rooms
text: Tiny bare rooms. We stayed here prior to a Viking cruise and I was disappointed. The rooms were small and barren. I think our stateroom on the riverboat was as big as these rooms. The only thing I can really say for the hotel is it had a great elevator system. It also had a fairly good buffet breakfast.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Outlandish drink prices
text: My wife paid 13 Euros for a small bottle of water and I paid 17 Euros for a small glass of Jameson.  Also our waiter told our group of 14 that we could not charge our purchases to our rooms even though we had left our credit card information at check-in.

title: All was perfect, view from room and skybar great

title: Disappointing experience
text: Average location , somewhat dirty carpeting on our floor (27). Evening cocktails were an absolute joke. The buffet breakfast spread was just as poor. Lots of construction around the hotel. Concierge was very condescending to my wife when inquiring about Louvre tickets
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile
text:
Good location, great service!
Staffs were attentive and helpful. 
Housekeeping staffs were respectful of your privacy and the Cafe staffs and Staffs at the breakfast buffet were welcoming. Well done and thank you for the hospitality !
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Hyatt experience in Paris
text:
The Hyatt Regency Etoile is a large corporate hotel - don't expect quaint Paris charm here.  However, the staff go a long way to make this feel a more personal experience - a friendly welcome at Reception, and chatty staff in the lobby bar.

The rooms have been fairly recently refurbished, so it was clean and fresh.  There was a great view from floor 20 overlooking Paris, out to the Sacre Coeur in the distance.

Breakfast offered a good range of items and of decent quality.

Wifi worked reliably.

There are a range of restaurants and supermarkets in the neighbourhood, and the property is close to numerous Metro lines.  The Arc de Triomphe is a relatively short walk away.

I had a problem with one of the lights in my room in the late evening, and was very impressed that the Concierge had a maintenance staff member with me within about five minutes to sort it out.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent hotel with an excellent view of Paris!
text:
My family of 5 recently stayed at the Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile on a vacation for 4 days.  We were very impressed with the room and view we got.  Our "family suite" was an interconnected room, so we got a decent amount of space and 2 washrooms.  The view was phenomenal and we could see the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, etc... all from our room.  It was great to be able to see it all lit up at night.

The hotel also very well anticipated our needs and without asking, had set up the extra couch as an additional bed since we have 3 children.

Paris in summer was hot and after walking around all day in the heat, it was amazing to be able to relax in a nice clean, AC room.  

The only drawback was the location was a little further from the main areas that we would have liked, but it was close enough to the Metro station and was never a real issue as the Metro system in Paris is excellent.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Family Trip
text: Our family was in Paris for a few days on vacation, and we stayed in this hotel mostly because we could get two adjoining rooms at a reasonable price.  The hotel itself is great and everything you'd expect from a  Hyatt.  Clean, updated, good staff and service.  The only thing to say is that it's a bit outside the main tourist area of Paris, so it you are wanting to get that cozy Paris hotel experience this is not the place.  However it you want a modern hotel with all the amenities and shopping a food nearby and about a 15 minute train ride to the hear to Paris, then this is the place.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent location unbelievable view
text: Don't listen to the naysayers about not being in the heart of Paris. You are minutes from the #1 line of the metro which will get you to the must see sites. The metro and all of Paris is very connected, Europe has this figured out. If you're able to book an Effile Tower view do it, it is a magical experience when you enter the room.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Lovely staff
text: It was a great place to relax and enjoy the holiday there. My family and I love the staff and it was a every things more than great. Moreover, the supermarket was a nice idea we like the icecream and the coffee their.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Awesome Stay
text: it was a very pleasant stay , i really enjoyed  my stay and i will recommend this hotel to anyone, and will come back for sure.  The staff is very friendly and nice , the food is great and the room is very comfortable.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Great Hotel and well located
text: The Hotel is well located and close to Metro station. One can walk it from the Port Maillot train station. The rooms are fairly ok size. Has a nice roof top Bar with a fabulous view of the Eiffel Tower and Paris. Staff are friendly and helpful.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: We love the Club Lunge on the 34th floor of Hyatt Paris Etoile
text:
We stayed at the hotel from 8/2-10 on the 29th floor. The room offers an excellent view of the city. Our room is with a view of The Eiffel Tower, the golden top of Invalides and Arc of Triumph. The room is spacious based on European standard. It is clean, modern, and comfortable. We were able to have our breakfast, buffet style, at the Club Lunge on the 34th floor, which offers a rich and tasty selections of food choices. We are a family of 3 generations and we all were able to find our favorite food there. The staff are friendly and responsive to take care our needs. When it was a bit crowded, they were able to expand the roof to find a table to accommodate our party of 6.  In addition to the breakfast,  the Club Lunge also offers snacks in the afternoon, which we also enjoyed very much. Paris is a great city to visit, but I will say that our stay at the Club Lunge is definitely one of the highlights of our trip. Since we stayed at the hotel for about a week and spent quite a few mornings and afternoons at the Lunge, we got to know the staff well. I would like to thank the supervisor, Slava, and his team, including Tenzin, Axelle, Raphael, and Falon, for their kind and warm service.

One comment about the hotel location. I was amazed that our hotel is only 3/4 mile away from the Arc of Triumph. And a Metro station for Line 1 is just around the corner of the hotel, which takes you directly to the old and elegant Les Marais district, and other parts of the city, but it involves to change to different Metro lines, which is just as complicated or as easy as any other metropolitan city. But the Paris Metro is clean and efficient.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: we have stayed at this place for 6 times...

We liked the location... it was easy to travel on trains [RER]...we walked all over the city to our favorite spots and ate at wide variety of places, near by.
room is small compared to American standard but was clean and would say 4+ ... room serivce was real nice ...they have a wonderful resturant and a small snacky place to buy... adjustant to the hotel is a big mall with a grocery store and bakery . we walk out  across the street and bought fresh baked stuff at local bakery.   and we enjoyed couple times view of Eiffel tower from our window.... couple times other famous spots... I love Paris and really do not have anything bad to say about this area or experiences. title: A View to Remember
text:

Still, very comfortable and very close to a metro station.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Nice hotel, OK location
text: The hotel is recently renovated and very up to date. My only complaint about the rooms was the lack of top sheet on the bed. It was way too hot for a heavy duvet,  but that seems to the style in Europe. You have the option of sleeping without a cover or sweating all night. The view from the room was incredible, but the location was just ok. A lot of construction around the hotel and many restaurants nearby were closed. The metro was close and easy to use. If I ever return to Paris and circumstances allowed I would spend the extra money to be closer to the center, but this hotel is an excellent option if you are on a tighter budget.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile
text: Very convenient to Meeting and Conference Spaces.  Lots of small local restaurants within walking distance.  Good views from upper rooms.. Staff very cordial. Hard to get Ubers but lots of Taxis available.

title: Nice hotel friendly to foreigners

name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Cleanliness

title: Beautiful Hotel

The Regency Club room was well stocked with good wine and the attendants were extremely professional.  I would definitely stay there again and would recommend it to my family and friends.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: The Hyatt Etoile
text: Beautiful hotel with stunning views of Paris. Very convenient location to the sites. Fantastic staff. Overall a great hotel. The sky bar was a lovely place to end out evenings and our children were welcome.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Best place to stay in Paris
text: Stay here for the staff.  Exceptional front desk staff who were fluent in multiple languages and go out of there way to ensure you have a smooth check in process.  We upgraded to the Executive Suite, which had 2 large rooms and lots of space.  Breakfast was also outstanding, whether in the downstairs restaurant or at the Regency Club. Service was amazing at both places and the view from the 34th floor was fabulous. Great location near the #1 Metro line.  Just walk through the mall for the shortest and coolest path.  Money change in the adjacent mall with great rates. Would definitely stay here in the future.  The kids did not want to leave.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Great Hotel
text: The Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile is a terrific place to stay.  The staff is terrific, courteous and very helpful.  There are always taxi's to take you wherever you wish to go.  The rooms are clean and the beds are very comfortable.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Did not willingly provide Globalist benefits until pushed
text: This is a nice hotel brought down by the employees including night management.  As a Globalist, I was entitled to a suite upgrade based on availability which I verified before checking in around 1 am.  However, the front desk person who barely spoke English and didn't answer my basic question did not provide us with a suite even though he told us that we were getting a suite.  Then, after contacting the night manager Sara regarding this issue, she lied and stated that all standard suites were sold out (they were not, I'm a seasoned traveler and I verified availability).  When I pushed her on this issue after she put us in an upgraded room (but not a suite), she lied again and said that "there was a cancellation" (at 1:15 am?!?) and suddenly we got our suite.  Being lied to was completely unnecessary and left a terrible taste in my mouth.  How about this - simply honor the stated benefits and then you don't have to embarrass yourself when you get called out on your lies?
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Spectacular View of Eiffel Tower
text: Hotel is well-connected to public transport amenities and offers spectacular view of Eiffel Tower from its king deluxe room. Great customer service and breakfast experience. Would highly recommend it to anyone coming to Paris.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Good for a short trip
text: We had points and stayed for free with lounge access. The rooms are small but we weren’t in the room except to sleep. There is construction going on around the hotel, which didn’t bother us (we couldn’t hear it on the 32nd floor), but didn’t make for very picturesque walks to/from the metro. Although not located right in the middle of the tourist areas, it was easy to take the metro everywhere.  The lounge had a great breakfast and happy hour. Beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Extraordinary
text:
I didn't expect this level of service after COVID. It was a nice surprise to me. The personal is always taking care of your needs. The food is good. 
The Mayo market is a great idea for a quick fix in the late hours.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent
text: I was there for work, everything was exceptionally Fast at check-in, Very professional, Friendly and very Courteous. The Manager Hugo ( Boss ) at the front office is excellent and very hard working. The next day at Break fast every  one  was helpful, How ever Jade in my section was amazing, Courteous, professional and very attentive. Room was Not renovated one, still did the job and was clean.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Extremely disappointed at the level of customer service and quite astonishing for a Hyatt hotel
text:
We were in Paris two weeks ago for our honeymoon which we kicked off with Fete Nationale (Bastille Day). I reached out to Windo Sky Bar, about 1 month prior, to make reservations for the “Sparkling Night with a View” event being held the night of July 14th. I exchanged half a dozen emails with Ms. Eva Merian who stated that we could not make a reservation but the space would be open on a first come first served basis. We adjusted our plans accordingly and shortly after arriving in Paris, we made our way to Windo Sky Bar to prepare for the evening. We arrived around 7PM to a completely empty space and were greeted by a manager who told us that we could not be seated for the night. I explained the numerous emails with his staff in which he stated that he made a “last minute change”. 

A note to management. DO NOT offer the option of “first come first served” if it is not truly available. I would’ve preferred if someone said that the space was reservation only so I could continue to look for options that would be better suited for myself and my husband. And at the very least, they could have allowed us to enjoy the space for a short time before releasing our table to those with reservations. No accommodations were made.

To say we were disappointed is an understatement.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: New hotel experience
text: First time we visit this hotel in the park 17 arrondissement and is a bit of a drive to the opera house or the Louvre. The rooms were great and good size too. The hotel doesn’t have parking facilities  but there’s one a block away Indigo Etoile Meridien for around € 39 a night.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Amazing Experience
text: This is the most amazing stay I have ever had at any Hotel. They did all the efforts to satisfy our needs and they managed to give us a great room facing Eifel tower and managed to provide consultation for us on how to spend an unplanned vacarion.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: The most amazing view of Paris
text:
It was my first time in Paris and I asked for a room in a high floor. The front desk person assigned me a room on the 32nd floor. It was a derream come true. Unforgettable. I enjoyed the most incredible views of Paris day and night and made lots of pictures and videos. 
The viw from the bar is also incredible as well as the cocktails and food, not to talk about the kindness of the staff. 
Breakfast is excellent, with marvelous french vienoisserie, cheeses (I'm a fan!!), seasonal fruits... mmmmm. I hope I'll come back some day with my husband!
The location is incredible also not only because of the views but also because you will be walking distance form some of the most beautidfuful spots of Paris, and just a few meters from the mestro or train stating to go anywhere in Paris in minutes!
One reccommendation: plan your movements walking or in metro, traffic can bre tricky in the area!!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Wonderful Paris Hotel
text: Despite the 104 degree heat, the hotel was so comfortable. The staff, rooms and restaurant were all excellent…especially the breakfast buffets. The location wasn’t near Paris attractions and we needed cabs. But the neighborhood has many wonderful cafes.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Nice Hyatt
text: This is close to restaurants and metro- - Breakfast is good very large selection was very good.  the view at the top of the hotel is a great view of the city, but the folks at the top of the building have some attitude.  In Paris, I would stay there again.  The front desk was very warm and helpful
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Delighful hotel and stay
text:
Beautiful hotel and great service! Definitely worth the extra money or points for club amenities. The only downside was there was construction outside in both the front and back which created confusion for our taxi driver when arriving and leaving, and also for getting to and from the subway (located through a connected mall at the rear of the hotel).  

For what its worth, the shower was amazing, as were the quality of the linens and towels.

Unfortunately, the 34th floor Windo SkyBar was closed for renovation and I had been looking forward to seeing the view and having a meal and drinks there. The 34th floor Regency Club was also closed, but was relocated to the main level and still offered breakfast and snacks and beverages. During the current heatwave being able to stay in the hotel to relax and have a glass of wine was definitely welcome! 

I'm not planning on heading back to Paris anytime soon, but will definitely stay at this Hyatt again, if I do!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: horrible service ,not 4 star
text: The staff with a black face all the way ,and very rude,looks like I own them. No politely greeting! No smile!!! No helpful! Bathroom not very clean with used lotion and shower gel.Water is so cold which my colleagues complained as well. Noisy from the metal pipe , I have no idea what's that. The traffic in front of the hotel is horrible. Every time when you out ,you have to wasted at least 30-40 minutes to wait for the taxi at the entrance. The service even worse than the UK 2 star hotels. Don't recommend !
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent location, Staff are very friendly and helpful, room view is excellent.
text:
Excellent location, safe, clean ，close to  
everywhere. Staffs are very friendly and helpful. Room view is excellent, enjoy the club lounge. Close to subway, easily explore the city. Nice choice when stay at Paris!
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Poor checkin experience
text: Very poor front desk staff knowledge and  professionalism. After more than 12 hrs long trip and despite my 2 months before hand request early checkin, my children ended sleeping on chairs in the lobby and checkin close to 4 pm instead. The rooms were not ready and we were given different rooms. Front desk ladies didn’t show any understanding or sympathy, so what! One of them told me when I was expressing my frustration!! Never going to that hotel again. It could have been an isolated incident but it was the worst checkin ever.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent
text:
Great property with excellent views of the city and very helpful staff specially the Concierge team. Location is great for connectivity to different parts of the city through public transport.
One area for improvement would be the options on the food menu (dining and breakfast) - there is scope to add more variety specially for vegetarian options
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Near the Arc de T and the Champ de L'
text:
Great Hotel, good location.  Clean room and quality finishings.  Well maintained hotel.
Early check-in was the only down side.  They offer it on the web, yet in person its a NO. That is unacceptable.  Then when they take your number and promise to call you when its done being cleaned then don't call you
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Highly Recommend the Hyatt Etoile
text: Every aspect of our stay at the Hyatt Etoile met our expectations.  The WINDO restaurant on the 34th floor was a wonderful addition and our room was comfortable, clean and offered an incredible view of the city.  The MAYO market offered a wide array of foods and drinks, including bottles of champagne, wine and waters.  There were delicious meals that were healthy and representative of the local foods. The staff was incredible and met our every need.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Best avoided with so much construction
text: Stayed for four nights with a Viking cruise... very modern hotel with amenities.  However, we were assigned a "handicapped accessible" room which was very uncomfortable, and had a roll in shower with curtain.  The hotel was packed and we had a view of the Eiffel Tower, so we did not ask to be moved.  The location is far from the must see sites, and there is construction surrounding the hotel which makes it dangerous to navigate for pedestrians.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Not a 4stars service
text: To begin with, it is the first time that I get to a hotel and I have to queue for check-in. I had paid more to have a room on the high floor with a view to the Eiffel Tower and they gave me the middle floor, and when I complained they told me that from the 8th floor it is considered high (of a tower of 30 floors). You have to pay extra for breakfast in the room. When I went down for breakfast my name didn't come out so I had to wait  again and fix it. And with the check-out I had to wait one more time and go from counter to counter because the system was not working and then the printer was not working to print an invoice that I did not ask them to print. The service is diplomatic but does not help or solve anything.  There is no place where you can work from, yes in 4 star hotel with 30 floors. definitely a bad experience. The stars go to the view from the room.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Decent Location; less than decent everything else
text:
Short and sweet - I've stayed here twice and had bad experiences both times. I won't stay here again and encourage most people reading to find other accommodations. 

The location isn't horrible - next to a mall and a short walk to many restaurants. And you'll have to go offsite for food and drink since they won't actually serve you on site. At least, that was my experience the one time this trip I tried. 

I won't drop her name here, since this review is (honest and fair, yet) negative, but the person that tried to help me check in at first was as helpful as she could have been. Of course, the system wasn't taking payments for some reason, the Hyatt app showed I'd be upgraded to a room that wasn't available, and I was checked into a room that was dirty (wet towel on the bathroom floor) with "no alternative room" available. Forgot the room, I should have insisted they check me into another hotel. 

In the future, I'll save them the trouble. I won't be back and I highly encourage you all to look elsewhere.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Bad attitude of manager
text:
Just stay here for one night to see the fireworks on 14 July. I understand today must be very busy but the way that person did was not acceptable.
So we arrived at the lobby there was no guests in the line, there were two counters no guests and we were just wondering if we should go directly or just wait in the line. Then this person from the lobby yelled in the lobby said “please line up there”. He said please but the tone was so bad and rude which I didn’t expect it at all. I’m sure he is the manager because staff went to him to solve the problem. And when he yelled no one dared to say anything, there is no way anyone can be this rude. Well I didn’t say anything since I know he is the manager but I wonder if he can treat guests like this how does he treat the staff. 
The girl who checked in was friendly, the touch screen for the screen doesn’t work very well and I tried 2 different panels to get to the floor I want to go.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Excellent  value for money
text: Excellent location easily accesible on foot and via metro from most major Paris sites,  no fuss but modern areas and rooms, clean, excellent breakfast, stunning views of eiffel tower from the higher level rooms, professional and friendly staff - all  aforementioned at a very reasonable price considering Paris hotel prices. I am a regular visitor in Paris and throughout the years I have stayed in much more luxurious hotels ( and much more expensive) and I consider this Hyatt one the best value for money hotels, considering all parameters. I would like to make a special mention to the very capable concierge team  and in particular to  Olivier head of concierge, Max and Djamell head iof security who really went out of their way to assit me in finding a mobile phone that was forgotten in a taxi. They are an asset to the hotel and I am extremely grateful.
name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

Even now, I still feel very painful at the moment I wrote.

name: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile

title: Great experience
text:
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted by Charlotte & Samuel, the proprietors of this boutique hotel. They went out of their way to provide us with the best room that suited us. The hotel itself is a charming 30 rooms on a street away from the hustle and bustle of the inner city of Paris.
Our room had beautiful windows that opened out to this laid back Parisian neighborhood
accompanied by wonderful stores to purchase bread and pastries, wines and cheese, a gastronomical heaven. The hotel itself has a great cafe with indoor or outdoor seating to enjoy a cup of expresso or a wonderful lunch or dinner. The staff of Helen and Yasmin helped to arrange all of my tours to the Eiffel Tower, Versailles and the Louvre and a day trip to Lyon on the TGV in the south of France. The two gents in the cafe, Ryan & Max were wonderful also. I can’t say enough about this hotel, a small gem. We were treated like family, I highly recommend for a great experience like no other.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Discreet Parisian home-from-home
text: This hotel is a bit of a find for anyone wanting to soak up Paris.  Its style is low-key and unobtrusive.  From the outside, it is not even obvious that it is a hotel at all.  Inside, the service is quietly slick and efficient, with friendly and approachable staff.  One of the big attractions for me were the comfortable, spacious rooms; they are decorated in the minimalist aesthetic typical of Parisian apartments.  My own light-filled room, with its enormous double windows, overlooked the Place du Caire.  Meals are served in the hotel bistro  which opens out onto the public square.  The bistro is frequented by locals, which adds to the sense of the hotel being part of the neighbourhood.   Those wanting facilities such as a gym or spa might be disappointed as it is not that sort of place.  Still, it offers a particularly authentic experience of the City of Light.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Love this place!
text: Best hotel in Paris hands down. Great price and ideal location. Super clean rooms with excellent service. Staff is super courteous and welcoming. I highly recommend booking the room and getting the breakfast!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Great centralized location, great clean good sized room
text:
Our stay was so wonderful at Hotel du Sentier. The Hotel is situated in a great neighborhood location within walking distance to shops and restaurants, and the metro. 

The room was clean, larger than a lot of the rooms around Paris, and the breakfast is awesome! The staff was friendly and very accommodating, helpful with directions and information, and it felt as thought they really wanted us to have a great vacation which we did! 

Thank you for such a great stay!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Love this spot
text: If you are thinking about booking this place, you should. We booked one of the superior(?) Room. One level above the regular one. First of all, compared to other hotels in Paris that I looked at, space is much bigger which is one of the main reason I chose this place. When we got there, we were very happy that it was such a pretty room with two full length windows with ton of sunlight. It is on the right bank I believe. Good location to all the tourist spots. Staff are lovely too, they were all very sweet and helpful. We had included breakfast downstairs in their restaurant which was always delicious along with regular meals if you chose to. If you want a quiet and peaceful location this would be it. Personally we did not use public transportation but there is a main road which is minutes away which is where we would order the Uber.  (There is a small supermarket nearby fyi to stock up on snacks and drinks)
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Perfect Stay in Paris
text:
The rave reviews are spot on - our stay exceeded our expectations! We had a group of 14 women that traveled from the US, and every guest was thrilled with our hotel choice.

The staff is so friendly and welcoming. They helped arranged transport, tours and provided excellent recommendations. 

My Superior room was incredibly quiet, comfortable and clean! Between the bed/linens/pillows and the perfectly controlled air conditioning, I slept remarkably  well. 

I recommend adding breakfast - you can choose between room service or the cafe, and everything on the menu is delicious. I also ordered room service for dinner one night and delivery was very prompt and the food outstanding.

The location is fantastic, walkable to many sights, yet tucked into a less touristy area with amazing cafes and shops.

If/when I return to Paris I will definitely stay at the Hotel Sur Sentier again - don’t even need to look around, it’s simply the best!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Don't Fall For the Hype! We did :-(
text:
Mildewy towels. Broken shower. Dirty teapot. Dangerous steps. Early AM clanking construction on scaffolding outside our windows. Smug, argumentative, petty front desk clerk, insensitive to visually impaired guests. 

We had read a breathless Conde Nast  Traveler article  entitled, "10 Paris Hotels With Incredible Views,"  which featured Hotel Du Sentier as one of the brightest  hotels in Paris. CNT splashed a photo of a room w large balcony. We booked online, 2 nights in the highest category deluxe room available for a special anniversary occasion, and called reservations to follow up, requesting a balcony and a sunny room.

At check-in, we were shocked to find a dark and narrow room, with one sad window. Turns out there are only TWO ROOMS with balconies in the entire hotel. It gets worse. Right next to the bed, a set of trip-hazard, toe-stubbing, floating steps lead to an open loft bathroom. No handrail. The dangerous set-up would flunk code regs in the US, and perhaps in France as well. There is neither a photo nor text disclosure of the  floating steps on the hotel website. 

Attitude of the front desk: sucks for you! We have your $$$! 

When we explained that we were visually impaired and could not navigate floating steps with no handrail, that we couldn't risk falling down the steps on the way to the bathroom at night, reception offered a substitute downgraded room on second floor. We asked if we could check out of the hotel after one night. Management said no -- both nights were non-refundable. 
 
The shower in our downgraded room was broken. Towels smelled so musty we had to hold our breath to wipe our face. Construction workers drilled on scaffolding right outside our bedroom window early in the morning, and smacked stucco outside our bathroom window. 

Management refused to refund the 40 Euro price difference per night for the downgraded room, even though we showed them screenshots of the nightly rate for the different rooms on the specific two nights we stayed at the hotel. They claimed they could have sold the deluxe room to someone else, although a search revealed that there were other vacancies in the deluxe category. After a ridiculous amount of back and forth, they offered continental breakfast for one morning only -- a baguette, juice, tea and yogurt (no eggs! that costs extra! let's argue for sport because we enjoy antagonizing guests!) which amounted to only half the price difference of the rooms . Were we going to beg for a second baguette? They seemed to have endless, petty appetite in arguing -- over a piece of bread. It was ruining a precious anniversary getaway. We gave up.

 It’s hard to go wrong in Paris. So many lovely hotels. We have never been disappointed by CNT before, but we began to wonder if the publicity went to Du Sentier's heads. All issues were resolvable if not for their attitude of arrogance. 

Conde Nast Traveler please take note -- you gushed and we suffered!!!!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Great boutique hotel in Sentier!
text:
Stayed here for a few nights and the hotel was truly lovely. Very clean, spacious, light-filled, wonderfully located with access to a number of varying metro lines. Really nice and helpful staff, great hotel restaurant for breakfast and the random coffee (can't speak to the lunch and dinner as unfortunately I didn't get a chance to try it). It's also nice and quiet as it's not in the center of the busiest part of Sentier - definitely appreciated.

Only one complaint - could not get the chromecast to work.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Hidden gem hotel
text: Absolutely fantastic hotel in a superb location. Super friendly and helpful staff with w cute restaurant downstairs. Immaculate rooms with all the needed amenities and very good AC! Couldn’t have asked for a better hotel or room especially at such a good price point.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Best boutique hotel in Paris
text: Incredible hotel. The rooms are just like the photos online. They are huge. But the best part about the hotel being built in 2021 is that there are USB outlets everywhere, a bluetooth speaker for playing music, and modern touches throughout. The breakfast is amazing (definitely pay to get that included) and like the other reviewers said, it is at a neighborhood hot spot vs. a quiet windowless hotel breakfast room. The adorable petite mocha master coffee pot in the room is a huge bonus too if you need your coffee asap when you wake up (however, breakfast is also delivered to your room free of charge). But what TRULY sets this hotel apart is the incredible service. From the moment we checked in, we felt like our friends were helping us with our stay. I honestly can't say enough good things about this hotel!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Comfortable,friendly and great air conditioning!
text: This hotel is a find! Opened in 2021 the rooms are well designed, comfortable and Big! Great bathroom with lots of water in the shower. The toilet is separate which is always a nice option. The room has beautiful windows overlooking a quiet street and offer great noise insulation. The breakfast was simple with the highest quality ingredients. We took Hal board so enjoyed a simple 2 course dinner that was classic French bistro.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Charming Small Hotel
text:
What a lovely spot in Paris, on a peaceful square not far from the Rue Montorgeuil and the Upper Marais, about a ten minute walk to Les Halles. Our nicely designed room overlooked the Place du Caire, which feels more like a neighborhood than the usual tourist areas. Plus the staff were so kind, always offering kinds words, even umbrellas for the inevitable Paris rain.

This is a really good spot if you're looking for something a bit different.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Lovely, friendly, fantastic location
text: It was difficult to choose a hotel in Paris, and I'm so glad we landed on Hotel du Sentier. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. The room was comfortable, stylish, and clean. The hotel is really cool and well-decorated. We weren't familiar with the surrounding neighborhood, but it quickly became our favorite part of the city. There are a number of pedestrian streets filled with wonderful restaurants and shops. It's very lively and walkable. All the major sights are accessible on the Metro or by bike or walking. Highly recommend!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: No Complaints At All
text:
I only stayed here for one night, but, I will definitely come back again. 
I was impressed with the room layout and bathroom layouts. My favorite part of the room though were the windows. The room was very spacious, clean, and the bed was quite comfortable. The staff helped me with my luggage, and the location of the hotel is near the 2nd arrondissement's shopping district. It's truly a hidden gem of a hotel.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Great central boutique hotel.
text: This hotel is a real find. Clean, great products, comfy beds, lovely staff. Great breakfast if you’re happy to pay for the convenience of not having to go anywhere else. Lots to see and do nearby and if you’re coming from the Eurostar, it’s a really easy 20 minute walk. We’ll be back!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Calm and elegant boutique hotel
text: We stayed in paris for a week and had the best stay in this calm and elegant hotel. The staff was friendly, the placement ideal for any paris activities (we walked down to louvre). Also the area Sentier is a fun neighborhood to explore. Highly recommend a stay!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Perfection
text: Amazing hotel in a beautiful part of Paris just around the corner from Ru du Nil! Service, cleanliness, comfort of the hotel, everything is spot on. Restaurant is very nice as well for a drink or dinner. Stay here few times already, could not recommend more! Will be back for sure!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: ...and we thought we were special!
text:
Just got home from a 4 night stay at this delightful hotel. We thought we were special because Samuel, Mrs. Samuel and the  staff were so unbelievably nice. But having just read the Tripadvisor reviews I realise that they are equally helpful to everybody!
It is a true family business and while we were there we almost felt like part of the family. I didn't even mind Joseph crowing about France beating England at rugby. 
I could write about the location etc. but it is the people who made the stay memorable.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Vacation in Paris
text: Hotel was comfortable, clean, and spacious. Location was central. Great customer service - the staff were really nice and sweet and went out of their way to get us anything we wanted. Beds were comfortable and room was quiet.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: heart of Paris
text: A stay at the boutique hotel Le Sentier is a venture in living today's Paris while basking in the glow of its fabulous past. The location is ideal for any adventure into the city and its sights. The staff are delightfully alert, informative and charming. Everything about this new hotel in one of the most ancient districts of Paris adds to the pleasure of being in the city of Lights. Heartily recommend.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Perfect Boutique Hotel w/ Great Service
text: Great service. Great location. Quiet and comfy. Cute cafe downstairs. On a cute corner withs lots of shopping and affordable rooms. Loved everything about my 5 night stay. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to soak up Paris.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Second visit to this lovely hotel in a great location
text:
This was our second visit to Hotel Du Sentier after a short visit over the summer, but stayed for three nights this time and loved it just as much.
The hotel is both modern and charming at the same time and in a great location with loads of nice bakeries and restaurants in the neighborhood. The staff are all incredibly welcoming and helpful and the restaurant is great all on it's own. 
We had a superior room with a great view over the square and with a decent amount of space for luggage and relaxing. The only potential downside is that you can easily hear people walking on the floors above as well as water in the pipes etc, which can be annoying to light sleepers, but we'll definitely be coming back for more weekend trips to Paris and stay here again.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Great Location, English speaking reception, newly renovated
text: I was very happy with my stay at Hotel du Sentier.  I actually re-booked for another stay a week later.  The classic room is basic but very accomodating, comfortable, clean and well appointed.  The second stay I had a different room which also had a view which was a bonus.  As advertised, there was always someone at the reception desk that spoke English - a service I used a lot.  There are lots of restaurants and shops within a couple of blocks.  The Hotel is centrally located and I easily hopped on the Metro to get to each of my destinations.  The hotel is very nice and the people were super helpful.  I did suggest they either provide electrical adapters to buy or borrow (the one I brought broke).  I hope to be back and stay at Hotel du Sentier again.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: BEST PARIS HOTEL EXPERIENCE WE HAVE EVER HAD!
text:
This hotel exceeds the five point Tripadvisor rating scale by at least 5 points. It is a 10! We spent Five nights here. The reception was complete and easy and the checkout seamless with proprietor Samuel helping with our luggage. Both Samuel and his gracious wife are often on premises and offer service from their hearts. They and their family were heavily invested in insuring our stay was most enjoyable. Our room was the largest I’ve ever experienced in Paris and was beautifully appointed with a beautiful king sized bed and very slick electrical systems. I wanted to take the large bathroom home, awesome shower!
Locationally it is centre ice for touring Paris on foot.
DEFINITELY A TEN! We Highly recommend it.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Wonderful hotel in a wonderful neighborhood
text:
Absolutely fell in love with this place and would 100% book again the next time I’m in Paris. The hotel is less than a year old, so everything feels fresh, contemporary and updated. Loved the bedding and beautiful wood floors. The soap and lotion they use in the bathroom smell utterly INCREDIBLE! Special shout out to my fellow Canadian, Yasmin, at the front desk who made such a warm welcome to the city. 

As someone who wasn’t all that familiar with Paris, I absolutely fell in love with the Sentier neighborhood. It’s not as chic as, say, the Marais – but you also don’t get the constant bustling insanity of it. That said, you are at the top of Rue Montorgueil which is a pedestrian street chock full of amazing restaurants, some of Paris’s best bakeries, and cute little boutiques. And you’re walking/biking distance to so many of the top sights in Paris: Bourse de Commerce, the new Samaritaine, and even the Louvre are pretty much a straight shot down to the river. 

I got the top floor and had beautifully tall ceilings. The wifi was strong and I was able to use video conferencing. My only wish was that there would be more closet space. While I was able to hang some items, there wasn’t really anywhere to store folded things like socks or underwear or t-shirts. So I just laid them out of the daybed. Also, this hotel has AC which is not always common in Paris. And believe me, it was a welcome relief for the late summer. Def book here if you can.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Loved our stay here
text: I booked an overnight stay here for our arrival in Paris. After I made the reservation online and requested early check-in, a hotel employee called me in the U.S. to offer early check-in for a small fee, and I was delighted to pay it. (Such good service—and I wasn't even in France yet!) The hotel is charming, recently refurbished to a high standard, and has a delightful terrace café on pretty Place du Caire. Our room was very comfortable, with a good mattress, elegant linens, bottled water, a mini fridge, and a huge bathroom (since it was a wheelchair room). The window shutters blocked out the light and the individual climate control kept the room cool, so we slept off our jet lag very well. In the morning we sat outside and had a nice breakfast that included excellent flaky chocolate croissants. All the desk personnel spoke English and were super nice, as was the owner Charlotte, who kindly chatted with us for a bit. They also called us a taxi when we left. We hope this stylish boutique hotel continues to prosper as more tourists visit Paris again.
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Chique hotel with good value for price! Highly recommend!
text: Super friendly hosts!! Rooms beautiful, thought about the details in design, location great, quiet comfortable rooms. We took bikes to get to the main attractions. The neighborhood itself was really nice. Food tasty and variety of options. Will come back!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Lovely stay in Paris
text: What a charming hotel in the heart of Paris! Beautifully refurbished historical landmark building. Very comfortable beds and stylish fittings. Every last detail in the room made us feel at home. As Parisians in lockdown, this was a lovely break in a different neighborhood, the room service was perfect and the staff attentive. We will be back!
name: Hotel Du Sentier

title: Nice hotel
text: A good hotel conveniently located near a metro station. We bought as a package with the Eurostar which was good value. We stayed 5 nights and the service was good, breakfast was nice, room was clean and we really enjoyed the pool and sauna. What more do you need!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: First class everything
text:
This trip was booked for our 45th wedding anniversary. After a long day of travelling we arrived with great expectations gleaned from earlier reviews. We were not disappointed - hotel is superb and the staff even better. The room was large with a great shower. The balcony was fantastic although through the heatwave it was too hot to sit on for any length of time.
Having been to Paris many times this is the best hotel i have stayed in. The location is good - nice safe neighbourhood - five mins walk to the metro and 10 minutes metro ride to central Paris. I have no hesitation to recommend this hotel to anyone who wants a nice city break in Paris.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Location and Amenities Great, Service for Issues and Room Disappointing
text:
First, the good: the hotel is in a great location which feels more local/less touristy and is close to restaurants and train station. The spa was very nice; I got a great massage from a very pleasant masseuse. The breakfast spread was lovely and worth it if included in your room but I probably wouldn't go out of my way to pay for it if it wasn't included. The service was good for general requests but they don't really go out of their way for you - maybe it's a Paris thing but I'm generally used to higher end service for a place that claims to be 5-stars (e.g., it was both of our 40th birthdays and there was really no acknowledgement). The shower/tub in the room was awesome - newly redone, clean, modern, good design.

The disappointing: the room we got was the most basic one and it felt very cramped. I had to work a few days and the desk was barely wide enough to place my laptop and a small portable screen. The wifi was not working in the room but when we told the front desk, they simply said they'd never had issues and suggested we come out of the room to use lobby wifi. I was traveling with my dog and could not find a listed pet policy, all third party sites indicated that there was no charge. Upon check-in, I was told there was a 25 Euro pet fee which I thought reasonable (despite the fact that she is actually a service animal and therefore, charges are usually waived). However, upon checking out, I was very surprised to find that it was 25 Euro/night which for 6 nights, adds up to quite a bit (and honestly, does not seem reasonable especially considering she is VERY clean re: wears shoes and is wiped coming in and we didn't ask to have the room cleaned for the entire stay so we were very low maintenance hotel guests). After some back-and-forth with the hotel and a promise to produce a policy which I searched for and could not find, I have not received any further responses to my inquiry after leaving the hotel which feels like very poor customer service.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Amazing
text:
We stayed at the hotel for 4 nights and it was the best hotel experience we’ve had. It smells so nice, the staff are really friendly (especially Maxin). After coming from England he made it a lot less stressful of a process, he is a legend. The pool is amazing, the room was incredible, the bed is super comfy and the pillows omg wow.
Will likely come back again. Love you Maxin.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Very good
text: Beautiful hotel near Bastille place. Point of strengths sauna and a little swimming pool. Rooms quiet silent and clean. Breakfast very good. Tube allows you to reach the real city center in minutes. Service quite good not so responsive but good.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: NICE
text: There are 2 subway stations very close to the hotel. the neighborhood is calm, the hotel staff is friendly, in special Maxime and Sandra. They were very commited and helpfull, amazing!! I think that the closet in the room is small and there is too noisy from the aisle [other doors closing].
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Lovely hotel and an enjoyable stay
text: The room was very comfortable and the staff were brilliant. They speak English, Spanish, Italian and of course French which is practical and impressive! The breakfast was diverse and very nice. The spa and fitness centre are high quality and were often quite quiet which was perfect for the end of a day exploring. Overall, an incredibly clean hotel in a practical area - surrounded by stations and restaurants too.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Enjoyable stay
text: The room was very clean and comfortable, with everything we needed. The staff were very friendly and made us feel welcome, plus served a brilliant breakfast buffet. Worth every penny and would definitely return if I visited again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great neighbourhood, Comfortable stay.
text:
I can't get enough of this beautiful 5-star hotel conveniently located within walking distance to so many metros, eateries, supermarkets and more! It's a charming neighborhood to say the least, and the staff cannot be more warm, attentive and friendly - particular Maxim who helped with not only providing recommendations on food and travel around the area but also by noticing little details for us.

My mom and I booked the superior twin room and it was spacious and comfortable enough for us. The bathroom is more than enough space for us and I j'adore the strong water pressure! You can even change the water stream should you wish for a lower water pressure.

Housekeeping staff is a rockstar too for keeping our rooms clean for the 6 nights we stayed there.

The industrial architecture is interesting with a spiral staircase that's to die for. 

All in all, we would definitely stay there again given the chance. Thank you Maxim and everyone on staff for making our stay fuss free from check-in to check-out. We hope to see you soon. Merci beaucoup!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Best Paris Hotel!
text: Had an amazing 4 night stay at the hotel. It is well situated on a quiet but bustling street with lots of amenities and lovely eateries around. You are well located with two metro stations nearby, one just at the end of the street. Upon arrival we had a free room upgrade which was extremely generous! The staff were polite friendly and helped us when we had accidentally broken our air conditioning. They made the stay perfect for us. The room was very clean stylish and much more spacious than any other hotel, with lovely shower/ baths and great water pressure. The rooms are really quiet as there is good insulation and not too much street noise in the night. The spa is a great bonus with a relaxing sauna and hammam. It is clean and elegant with a reasonably sized pool.We enjoyed relaxing there in the evenings, it is open until 10pm. The breakfasts in the morning are good with a nice selection of food however maybe slightly limited in variety and quality when compared to others but not massively so. The food and beverage staff were great and even made us a breakfast box when we had to leave on our final day early in the morning. Overall had a great trip cannot fault much at all!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Hammam of my dreams
text: 5 star service and beautiful hammam! I had the most wonderful stay here during a business/pleasure trip this past spring. I love the area around the hotel, and the second you step inside it is beautiful and calming. There are many good cafes and restaurants in the area.. my favorite part  is the beautiful pool and sauna. Also, an amazing breakfast is available every day.  The room was beautiful, clean, and modern. I had lots of space in the room and I cannot say how amazing the staff was. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: perfect location and a lovely hotel
text: had a long weekend with lots of exploring Paris.  Found it very easy to get to the metro and the district was perfect, as was Pairs.  The hotel is a perfect Parisian boutique hotel which we got in a good deal via eurostar, so was very happy.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Lovely hotel in a quiet part of Paris
text: This industrial chic hotel is set within a quiet non tourist area of Paris. The streets surrounding have some lovely gourmet food outlets and restaurants. Excellent pool. Underground parking, although large SUVs have difficulties because of the steep, twisting and narrow descent. Our large SUV was unscathed during descent and ascent, but careful steering is required. Friendly staff, especially Patrick.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Beats every other 5-star hotel in its class
text:
What's not to love? Friendly helpful staff with "the customer is always right" mentality (so unlike the rest of France, right?). The largest room of its kind for a five-star hotel for the price. The most comfortable bed I have ever slept in.  A refrigerator large enough to put some of your own things in it. Airconditioning that works and keeps you as cool as you want. An abundance of towels. A walking oversized shower. A really nice neighborhood with a short 2-block walk to the Metro/subway. 

If PRICE matters, and QUALITY matters, this hotel beats every other 5-star hotel in its class. Don't look any further.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great Property / Inept Customer Service
text: A really nice hotel in a great neighborhood.    We booked two suites as a family and enjoyed the rooms, especially the terrace area.  The pool also was a great touch after a long day exploring Paris.  Where this hotel really suffers is the customer service.  The staff are nice and enjoyable but they just don't have the training to work at a five star property.  Their inability to help with the most basic items, such as directions, restaurant reservations, finding a wine bottle opener, making a drink at that bar,  getting change, etc. was comical.   Watching the bar tender literally reading ingredients from a notebook without any idea of what he was doing was par for the course.  The staff are young and inexperienced and clearly the hotel management is not helping them; in fact, I didn't see a manager or senior level person during our entire weeks visit.   Would not recommend.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Super location, room disappointing
text: The location of this hotel is outstanding--this quartier is one of the coolest in Paris--and the staff were friendly and amenities good (Nespresso, bathrobes, comfy slippers!). Unfortunately my room had a really bad gaseous smell, evidently coming from the air conditioning. Although the staff covered it with perfume my first night and said they would address it the next day, the odor returned and persisted. It would have been intolerable for a longer stay. Windows above the line of sight are a feature of the building, but combined with a bathroom door that slams and can't be held or propped open the room had an institutional and somewhat depressing feel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: One of the best stays in Paris!
text: My friend and I stayed around three nights at the Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet. And we loved it! The room was very large, especially for Paris. The air conditioning worked like the dream, and the bathroom is amazing - with a rainfall shower head. Everything in the room worked, and the staff were always very friendly. In fact, my luggage broke the day of my arrival to the hotel and they kindly offered to try their best to fix it. The glue did not end up holding but I really appreciated the effort. And the staff were also very knowledgeable about the ways of Paris transportation and even helped us navigate the city. The hotel is located in a quiet neighborhood near the Marais and is around an 8 minute walk to two different metro stations. The spa in the hotel is incredible as well, and worth the experience.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A disappointment in our favourite city.
text:
We arrived mid week for a three night stay. 
The check in was delayed and not completed correctly not being shown all the amenities. The room we were given was not adequate but we were moved for which we were grateful. Issues with storage, wi-fi, towels, being called by reception after midnight, disruptive neighbours all contributed to a poor stay not reflective of the star rating of the hotel nor the price paid. 
In an attempt to complain we felt ignored and the main issues raised were brushed under the carpet. 
Overall a disappointing stay that we won’t repeat.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Amazing Hotel and Staff!!
text:
My husband and I just came back from our 25th wedding anniversary in Paris. We stayed 4 nights at Boutet Hotel and we loved it. Special thank you to Mavea and  Erick for a wonderful surprise in our room. Staff was super friendly and attentive, they made our anniversary EXTRA  Special!!! 
Will definitely recommend the hotel and return!
Thank you again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Just truly awful so far - 1st night in.
text:
This place is just terrible. Awful experience so far. But just 1st night in so let’s see. Arrived at 2pm to try and check in. I have a 4 and 5 year old with me. Normal check in is 3 pm but I’m told very directly ‘we are fully booked and you have NO chance to check in’. I ask to ensure that we have adjoining rooms (I’m paying 381 Euros a night) and am reassured that is done. When we get back at 8pm we find that rooms are not adjoining and quite far from each other. We ask to change. Again - sorry we are fully booked. Then the receptionist tries to argue that a ‘family room’ doesn’t need to be adjoining. Mmmmmm.  Thanks for that. Oh and the hammam is not working. 

So I try for room service. I ask how long it will take for risotto. Am told -‘everything is frozen so we have to wait to heat it up’. 5 star dining???

So I have to go out to get food for the family. Now 10pm. Get to the room (noisy on the main road - inadequate glazing). Decide to wash my hands and the sink is completely blocked with all sorts of quite unspeakable and disgusting things regurgitating out of the plug hole. Including phlegm. Covid safe they proudly display. 

Eventually someone comes to sort it. Does a partial job and tells me he wants to go home so can’t finish it. Excellent. 

Now midnight and two exhausted children. I get an apology from the nice lady at the front desk who is trying her best. 

Let’s see what happens tomorrow.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great
text:
Plus:
- beautiful heated indoor swimming pool with hamman and sauna: wonderful 
- large room with nice view
- great cocktail
- friendly staff
- interesting location
- confortable bed
- nice bathroom
- good breakfast
- quiet

Could have been better:
- more drawers would have been nice
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Good choice in paris depending on the rate you get
text:
Location, 2 min walk from subway, which will bring you fast to the center. Close to the famous pere lachaise.
Rooms are spatious.
Very good bedcomfort. Noise insulation is vey good. Small desk, too small to work on.
Bad room very small sink. Enough space, great shower. Toilet in the bathroom.
Airco is ok. Wifi on times bad connections in my room.
Breakfast, very classical and a bit disappointing for a 5 star hotel. The small croissants, pains au chocolat were the same as they serve in every ibis… bit better quality here would be appreciated. Small platters with meat and cheese that were emptied quickly, so i had to go a couple of times before replenishment.
Staff is very friendly and helpfull.
Small Welness complex in the hotel with sauna swimming pool & hamman. Found it overcrowded too really enjoy (probably bad timing). Also small children are allowed in the area… which isn t really ok for a spa pool.
Depending on the price you have to pay this can be a good choice, but i wouldn t pay high season prices of over 300 euro for a night here.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Comfort & convenience, in the 11th arrondisemont.
text:
Medium-sized hotel, away from the busy tourist area of Central Paris, but perfect for us nonetheless. The staff were very helpful, and our daily rate included the generous breakfast buffet. The adjacent neighborhood has lots of good restaurants,  just 5 minutes away,  and a Metro station close by, at Faidherbe-Chaligny.
 After a busy day seeing the sites, returning to Hotel Bastille was very comforting, especially because of the nearby restaurant selection. The hotel is in a pleasant residential area of Paris, so our experience here felt  authentic.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Nice to hotel for this area
text:
Very nice Hotel !! Good service good bed
MS. janas (work at bar on apr14,22)and others staffs are willing to help our needed 👍🏻

I will come again next time, love the location and atmosphere here

Very nice Hotel !! Good service good bed
MS. janas (work at bar on apr14,22)and others staffs are willing to help our needed 👍🏻

I will come again next time, love the location and atmosphere here
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Simply the best!!!! 5⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
Let’s start with my accreditation’s, I have worked in several high end 5 star resorts and have over 20 years experience with hospitality.

Check in

100% smooth and welcomed with a lovely smile and very informative and the style of reception and entrance bar is absolutely stunning.

The room (302) 

This room is on the side which has views over the street and a local art school( maybe??).
The room you couldn’t ask for anything else. Room has fantastic air con comfy bed. Quality lining. Space to move about. Toilet separate to the luxury bathroom. The shower is out of the world. No expense spared in the room. 

Hotel amenities 

The hall ways, stairs and style of the hotel is unbelievable, quality every where you look and all kept to a high standard.

Spa

Having been involved in running spas I understand standards, on our last day I treated the wife to a spa and she has said one of the best she has ever had. The facilities, you can use without having a spa are fantastic. 
Pool, sauna, steam room again high class well maintained and an added bonus to a hotel in Paris. 
The staff are fantastic in the spa. Caring and knowledgeable.

Breakfast

The breakfast is unbelievable , we don’t ever usually have bed and breakfast but it was included in our deal.

It again was great, light french styled breakfast with approx 30 to 40 different items you can have. Buffet style. 

Staff again very helpful and attentive. 

Staff in general

Having read previous reviews moaning about staff/ managements attitude I can tell you within 15 minutes of being in the hotel 4 different staff ask us if we are ok? Or do we want a hand?
When ever we entered a room for breakfast or reception a smile came onto the staffs face and a genuine want to help. 
All the staff are a credit, room staff did a fantastic job cleaning and presenting the rooms and all other staff just did their jobs to a level I haven’t seen before. 

Having travelled the world and stopped in some unbelievable hotels, this by far is the best. The quality and the staff stand out. 

I would give this a solid 9.5 out of 10.

2 very minor negatives 

One being proper English tea bags at breakfast ( PG OR TETLEY). 
Second one is location, if this was 20 minutes closer to 
Centre it would make it perfect. We didn’t mind it as we enjoyed the aspect of walking about, and a taxi to a more central position wouldn’t cost a lot, less than €10.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Very disappointing
text: Unfortunately we had a very bad experience with the hotel management for not being accommodating with our family emergency situation and early check out - while every airline , every other hotels are waiving their change fees due to Covid emergencies, helping people in difficult times, this hotel is only after money ! The most disturbing part was that the receptionist agreed to waive the fees but asked us to call the third party reservation company without having any knowledge of the process. We won’t be going back to this hotel and I don’t recommend it - just in case something happens to your travel plans - which it very well can like ours - they will not be helpful ! These are the situations which prove how well or bad the hotel manages their customers issues . Just be very aware of it .
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Perfect Hotel, Perfect Anniversary!
text:
My husband and I recently completed a second stay at this wonderful Five Star property the beginning of December for our anniversary.  It is a beautiful boutique property in a fantastic location!  

The hotel is a fairly short walk to the Bastille and they you can quickly be in the heart of Paris.

The staff was complimentary and just amazing.

Our room was on the top floor with a gorgeous balcony overlooking the city.  While we couldn't see the Eiffel Tower, you could see the lights at night.  The bed was super comfortable and I loved the towel warmer.  The bathrobes and slippers were a great addition that we used every night after walking ten miles a day.

Highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Little Gem
text: We stayed two nights and found the room was very good.  Breakfast was a little over priced if not included but food was good.  Staff very helpful.  Building is really nicely renovated but location is not as central as others.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Lovely hotel: some improvements needed in customer service
text:
A well situated hotel on a quiet street. Well-appointed,modern room with two windows and so lots of light. A good size too for Paris. Wonderful bathroom with jacuzzi tub. Reception staff were exceptional: extremely professional and customer friendly - offering directly to reconfirm a restaurant booking for us. 
There were some issues where customer service could have been better. We received two complementary macaroons (as we are platinum members) but the person leaving them in the room didn’t think to replace the two used coffee cups. The second day, the coffee and water weren’t replaced and only one bath towel was left instead of two. 
The breakfast buffet was surprisingly poor, not at all the level of a Sofitel. It was more similar to the standard and range of an Ibis or Novotel. Certainly not with €28. There are similar breakfast offers at cafes down the street for less than €10. 
All in all a nice stay but some changes in the service and breakfast are needed.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A lovely place very well located run by caring people
text:
We stayed at Hotel Bastille Boutet for one night.
We were delighted to be there, warmly welcomed by the team who was fully supportive in providing us the best possible experience during our stay.

We had to book the swimming pool because of Covid limitation. Finally it was great because we enjoyed a moment alone in the Spa.

The location of the hotel is very pleasant with close public transportation, many bars, restaurants and theatres closeby.

Thank you !!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great place to stay
text:
We stayed here for a 3 nights. For what I have payed it was an absolute great place to stay (bought the whole trip through wowcher, so was A LOT cheaper) Room and bathroom was of a decent size. The best feature here is obviously included in the price was sauna, turkish hammam, pool and gym. Used the saunas and pool every morning and evening as the weather wasn’t great, so was good to warm up after a days walking in the city. Breakfast was of a good selection. Unfortunately there weren’t many options for plant based (vegan or vegetarian) food. Every morning I had only pancakes and sweet pastries 😁 No vegan sausages etc. However all was delicious so can’t complain. Also I think it’s France itself who’s not into the plant based food yet, so can’t blame hotel, as we were struggling to find a place to eat to have at least few options of vegan meals.
Hotel is in a great location. Metro station is about 5min slow walk, there are restaurants around. Can feel that Parisian lifestyle as very few tourists around.
Overall it’s a nice, definitely posh hotel and would stay here again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Nice, but not quite 5 stars.
text:
We stayed here for four nights on a vacation. Overall, we really enjoyed our trip, but the hotel was not quite as advertised. For an advertised 5-star hotel, it was not quite up to par. 

Overall: 
+ The value for the room was good, possibly due to it being a bit further removed from the city 
+ The location was great! It was a short walk from the Feidherbe / Cheligny station which took only ~15 minutes to be in the center of the city. Plus there were lots of good restaurants around the area. 
+ Everyone in the hotel was very friendly. 
+ The room was quiet even though it faced the street, and the bed was a dream. 
+ The bathtub is like a spaceship, so if you take baths, get ready for an A+ experience. 

- The internet was really slow and inconsistent. If you are trying to work from the room, be careful. When we mentioned it to the front desk, they were of limited help in this area. 
- The rooms were clean, but we had issues with both our tub and our room sink. When we asked for them to be fixed, it took two days to get fixed. 
- The overall feel of the hotel was not a 5-star experience in my view; more like a 3.5 or 4-star experience. Everything from the check in, to lack of concierge, to lack of unique touches (e.g. turn down service) makes this feel short of 5 star experience. 

Overall, this was a completely fine place to stay. However, I think the billing as a 5-star place is probably a bit oversold.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Poor customer service, extra payment and delayed checkin
text: The front office staff lacks empathy for the customer. They charged us for the breakfast even after telling that it is optional. We had not taken breakfast but had to pay 30 euros for the breakfast. The front office staff had initially denied checkin saying that our booking cannot be found in the system. They made us make a new booking by paying 300 euros for stay and 30 euros for the breakfast. They delayed the checkin even after payment and told us that rooms are not available for next day. At checkout they again offered us rooms. The front office is a total mess. Only one emoployee at the front office was empathetic and allowed us to keep the luggage in the luggage room. If you want to mess us your holidays and experience a stay where every thing is about money, please book this hotel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: One of the most comfortable hotels I've been
text: The hotel impresses with the decoration details, all very elegant. Very comfortable room, spotless bathroom, impressive whirlpool and great service. Great location, lots of bars and things to do around the area
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Very nice hotel with great service in local neighborhood
text: Had a chance to stay for 5 nights here. The location is off the typical tourist track but that is one of its charm. Many cafes, bakeries, and restaurants within walking distance. Close to subway lines 1 and 9 for traveling around the city. I’ve received exemplary services here from the front desk to Morgan, who kindly helped arranged for a move to new room after heating issues with original room. Staff are all very professional and speaks fluent English.  A really pleasant stay!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Highly recommended
text: We stayed for 3 nights - the hotel is perfectly located for the Metro into the city. Staff are very friendly and very helpful. The room and all the facilities are first class. Plenty of bistros around the area - we would most definitely return
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great hotel in Paris
text:
Stayed at the Bastille Boutet in November 2019 for a business meeting.
Very quiet, clean rooms. Slept perfectly.
Nice restaurants around and close to subway.
Excellent staff. The breakfast is perfect.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Perfect location, hotel, staff, and rooms.
text:
I surprised my wife to a trip to Paris for our 15th year wedding anniversary and everyone at the Boutet went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. They were kind enough to make dinner recommendations and even call the restaurant to make our anniversary dinner reservations. Their spa center was perfect. My wife and I used it to relax and unwind before going back out for the evening. 

Keep in mind it is not located in the busy areas, it's off in the 11th district. When looking around at other 4-5 star hotels in the 6th and 7th district it was a lot more. I decided to go for a high-quality hotel a little further away. It was a great choice! To get anywhere I'd need to take the Métro, so staying in the 11th, 6th did not make a difference. There are great cafes, shops, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby too. We walked around daily to get some breakfast, pastries, bread, cheese, and wine.

I highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A Residential Neighborhood
text: We were a group of 24 American tourists.  My husband and I arrived arrived at the hotel before the rest of the group.  Our flight had been delayed by 2 hours and we missed the transfer bus at CDG airport.  As we checked in at the front desk, an incredibly rude young woman had trouble finding the reservation.  It was not under my name.  It was under my husband's name.  We were finally able to get our keys.  We were on our way to the room when our friends arrived on the transfer bus.  We were happy to greet everyone.  We were shown to our room by the porter.  It was at ground level beyond the kitchen area.  I wondered if the young lady had placed us there out of spite.  Nevertheless, I liked the room.  It was clean and neat.  There was a view of a garden.  Later, I found it very convenient to simply step outside my door for a coffee or juice at 6:30 a.m.  I could just give my order to the server and return to my room.  The only meal served was breakfast.  It was average not great.  I really liked my chamber maid, the porter and all of the staff.  The only unpleasant  encounter was the young woman at check in.  Fortunately, I never saw her again. The hotel has WiFi service and other amenities like a swimming pool.  I was too busy sightseeing with my friends and dining out to spend much time at the hotel.  I will say that there is a supermarket behind the hotel and an organic store across the street  There is a patisserie and chocolatier on the corner and a gourmet store too.  I loved walking around the residential neighborhood.  It was not a tourist trap.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Five Star Stay in an amazing hotel and dog friendly too !
text:
We stayed here with our small dog . I cannot praise the hotel enough . From the moment we walked into the hotel , we were made to feel very welcome . The reception staff were amazing- friendly, professional and really helpful . 
We stayed in the Suite Tech , with its roof terrace and it was stunning . The bed was extremely comfortable and the ‘tech’ aspects of the suite were a great addition . We loved the terrace and the two bathrooms. 
The hotel has a beautiful pool/spa area and the bar area in the reception is a great place to unwind in the evening - again the staff were great . 
There is an underground car park belonging to the hotel which is really useful , but it is rather difficult to get in and out of if your car is large , so ask for a staff member to guide you , as this then helps on the corners . 
The hotel is located within walking distance of lots of restaurants, bars and shops . We walked from the hotel to the Jardin de Plants ( 40 minute walk) and got on the Bateux Bus there , a great way to see all the Parisian landmarks. 
We will definitely stay again when next in Paris .
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Don’t believe the hype
text: Not sure why this is 5 stars.  The neighborhood, while I’m told is safe, seems a little dicey and not near the beauty of other parts of Paris.  It feels like a sleeper cell is about to pop out at any moment.  Bunch of creeps at night roaming around.   Hotel is basically clean but not to the level of a 5 star.  I’d rather be at a Hyatt.  I guess the extra 100 euros is worth it to be close to the nicer parts of Paris and have a nice hotel experience.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Five Star Stay In A Five Star Hotel!
text:
I cannot say enough great things about this hotel and the staff.  My husband and I recently spent our 20th Wedding Anniversary here and it was an extraordinary stay.
