From the moment we arrived from the airport, stupid and jetlagged,  the staff met us, checked us in, let us use the showers and facilities in the spa and treated us like royalty.  While our room wasn't ready, and I did not expect it to be because of the early hour, they held our luggage as we went on our way to explore the hotel.

Right out the door are two Metro lines.  The hotel is located in what I could only guess is a residential area which made for a very quiet stay even though our room overlooked a school.

When we returned to the hotel, not only was the room ready but the staff had already delivered our bags to the room and complied my request for a king bed.

The room was large, the bed a dream, and the spa robes and slippers were wonderful.  Loved the bathroom amenities.

The view from our very large window was spectacular.  We opened the window every night and enjoyed a bottle of champagne before bed.

Every single day, every single staff member we encountered were so lovely!  

I can't wait to come back and stay here again!

BTW, thank you for the lovely gift of chocolates and the book on Paris and thank you for making my anniversary so special!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Outstanding service and accommodations!!!
text: The staff was extremely helpful and diligent in their tasks. We booked the hotel thru Delta Vacations and got an excellent deal. The spa, pool, steam room, sauna, and massages were excellent as well; and we used them daily. The daily breakfast was great with super helpful staff. The neighborhood was full of great restaurants and was a nice walk to Bastille, full of shopping. The market at Bastille was also great. Great job! I couldn’t have asked for more.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great location
text:
Loved this neighborhood, walkable to everywhere and well-connected to several metro lines. So many great restaurants, bistrots, cafes, bars, markets and shops here.  I would highly recommend this location for an authentic Paris experience.  I was super excited to experience this hotel, check-in was fantastic, great service! My room, 108, was mediocre.  It had one small window, which seems to be above a smoking patio.  It is a handicap-accessible room so it has a huge bathroom but does not have the elegant glass steam shower I was anticipating.  Also the heavy bathroom door is weighted to remain closed, without ventilation, so you have to use various pieces of furniture to prop the bathroom door open for air.  The rest of the furnishing in the room are truly luxurious, lots of unexpected touches, high tech lighting, great minibar/coffee/tea, extremely well-equipped luxury room.  
One morning I tried the breakfast and it was fantastic, so many choices, very fresh and delicious.  
With a different room selection this would have been a magnificent stay.  I booked my room using Amex points which goes through Expedia so I didn’t want to complain about having the handicap-accessible room because I didn’t really pay for the room.  Overall I would recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Fantastic stay in a lovely boutique hotel
text:
We chose to stay in this hotel for its location as it was close to where our daughter lives in Paris and had secure parking as we had done a driving tour of Europe.
The hotel gave us an upgrade on arrival, which was excellent.The staff were very helpful as couldn't do enough for us. As the car park was narrow and my husbands car beefy, they actually walked in front of the car step by step helping him into the underground car park! The room was very clean and comfortable, with a seating area, lovely bathroom and super comfy bed. We used the spa one morning, which was super. Breakfast was very good. We had a very pleasant stay and would highly recommend.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A little disappointing
text:
The building and the staff were lovely but overall I was a little underwhelmed. We arrived late and certainly didn't get our usual welcome. Then we ordered a beer and a coke zero in our room. The porter brought the beer but forgot the coke zero. However, when he brought it he charged us another €4 room service charge. 

We tried to get a drink at the bar the following evening but it was like waiting for Christmas so gave up and went to one of the local bars instead. Probably better and less expensive. And I did think that €26 per person for a couple of croissants - and not even very nice bread was a little expensive. I know its a  5* hotel and you expect to pay for it but it wasn't 5* quality.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: very nice boutique hotel
text: This is a great boutique hotel nicely located. Very comfortable bed and great breakfast ! Certainly to recommend ! We already had the opportunity to go 2 times to this hotel and we will come back for sure !
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Pleasant Stay
text:
Has a 5 star rating on the front door but not a 5 star international rating.  Not quite the Soffitel standard.  The bed however, was the most comfortable I've slept in - can I take it home?
Very central location, Velib bikes outside and lots of eating places close by with cuisine and cost ranges.  All staff very friendly and helpful. Very enjoyable week in Paris.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Very well presented art boutique style hotel in Paris
text:
I decided to try this hotel out during my short break to Paris , the hotel is very well located in the heart of the bastille area and is very well surrounded by restaurants, cafes and bars should you fancy venturing out one evening. The hotel does provide a limited evening food menu , but you have to try out their house and specials cocktails and they have a very well stocked bar too.  
Very nice spacious and comfortable bedrooms and comfy beds that I could have been tempted to just sleep in all day :-))  good bathroom with a very powerful shower , nice modern furnishings , everything you need.  I always love it when they put in espresso coffee makers in the room , always a nice thing to have either in the morning or when your winding down in the evening.  
Breakfast area in the morning very well laid out again lots of choice of hot and cold items, meats, cheese, bread, cereals, pastries and fresh juices, should you come back from walking around the city sights later in the day a very welcoming swimming pool and spa area to make you feel refreshed.  
All of the staff are very welcoming and really make sure you have an enjoyable stay and should you need anything just ask and they will do their best to assist you.  Also thank you very much for my birthday goody bag which I was very touched to receive on my way back from my day.  Thank you to all of the team at mgallery boutet and I hope to see you at some point in the future.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A relaxing stay
text: We stayed here for three nights on a Eurostar deal. The hotel is perfect - a fabulous breakfast was included in our package, the rooms are sunny, quiet, with the most comfortable beds, and there’s a lovely little swimming pool in the basement. The service was friendly and it was very nice to be in a less touristy area. Apart from breakfast, food at the hotel is quite limited, but there are wonderful cafes, restaurants and delis nearby. We walked along the river to the Musée d’Orsay, enjoyed the pool, and were particularly excited to find a French branch of Habitat nearby! We definitely plan to stay here on our next trip to Paris.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Excellent stay
text: We stayed here for 3 days from June 30-July 3rd. The reception desk was so nice. They gave us a tour of the hotel so we knew where to find things. The room was quiet and the beds were so comfortable! There’s convenient Metro access a block from the hotel. Each night we came back to the room we had bottled water waiting for us.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Excellent hotel!!!
text: I have been to Paris several times and never stayed in this area and it was a great option for being a less touristic area and the hotel was perfect.  The check in was made by Cecilie, excellent employee who attended me very well.  The bedroom was very comfortable and clean.  Excellent breakfast with several options with products of the highest quality, the employees that works in the restaurant are very kind, educated and excellent professionals.  The location of the hotel is very good near several options of good bars and restaurants.  Although the hotel is not near any touristic point, there are two metro lines, 1 and 8, that allow you to reach quickly to any place that you want to. When I return to Paris I will stay at this hotel because I liked everything in the hotel.  The employees who work at the reception are super polite, every time we pass by then they say hello, it makes the guest feel better. I have stayed in other Accor hotels and this one without a doubt is the best. Thanks to the manager and to all employees that make my trip to Paris better. Highly recommended!!!!!! Ah! Obrigado Wagner (a Brazilian man that works at the hotel!!!)
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: A wonderful hotel, great location and friendly staff
text: Great location with many local shops, restaurants, cafes, etc. it is also close to the Metro for easy access to Paris attractions. Friendly staff at the front desk and exceptional helpful. I was arrived earlier and the staff tried their best to arrange a room and I was able to check in at noon, which was really helpful after a long trip.  We booked a Junior Suite that is spacious, clean, well maintained and very quiet with extremely comfortable beds. There is a Jacuzzi hot tub in the bathroom that made our stay quite enjoyable and their SPA services are also very nice and provide a discount between 9:30AM to 2PM. We would be happy to stay here again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great!
text: Great hotel with amazing breakfast, every things that you want can you eat! beautiful spa with very nice sauna. It’s located in a good position at est side of the city and near metro too (about 70 mt.). Top!!!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Stylish hotel
text: This gorgeous hotel is set in the best location away from the crazy inner city but close to everything. Staff were lovely, so helpful! Beds are so comfy and great showers! Loved our stay and would recommend a visit here.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Truly amazing
text: I end up in this hotel by complete hazard and I was truly impressed. First of all, the hotel is simply great. Recently and extremely well renovated. It feels from the moment you walk in a nice and relaxing experience. Rooms are reasonably sized for Paris, impeccably clean (and I have a very high standard) and feel fairly spacious. My room was exceptionally quiet, a must for business travelers. Bathroom was one of the best I have been in Paris, large, well designed, well stocked with spa products and with really nice bathrobes and towels. The hotel has a small but well done spa that has a nice pool and gym and offers spa treatments 24h (so rare nowadays). One of the things that impressed me the most was reception staff, warm, competent, and incredibly helpful. I can only congratulate this hotel's staff and management for being simply great.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great rooms and wonderful staff
text:
We will be back Staff organised restaurant and transport for a family birthday. They were brilliant.

Rooms were lovely. Location was good once we mastered the Metro.

We all loved it and look forward to returning
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Hôtel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery by Sofitel
text: My first visit to Paris, the hotel was great. I did not give it a 5 star because of the limited storage space. It has a very small closet but the shower stall was amazing, huge shower with multiply shower heads. The hotel was very clean and they where really nice. Plenty of restaurant and local bars to hang out. Great service everywhere we went. Close to the train station and a quite area, felt safe walking around late. Went to a few local bars, which was fun. Don't use the taxi service, they will take advantage of you, use UBER if you don't want to deal with the subway/train.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: lovely light filled room but limited storage
text: Reception and checkin was a great experience and the room is light and airy.  However the 1 drawback is that there are no drawers, about 30 cm of hanging space and nowhere to put the suitcases even had we been able to unpack them.  They did not fit under the bed.  Traffic noise is constant though this is typical of European cities.  There are plenty of good eating options nearby and the Metro is 1 minute walk.  Overall I recommend this hotel as the room was (deluxe) larger than average and it was clean and light filled.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great Honeymoon
text: Spent 7 night as part of our honeymoon. Hotel was exceptional from the time we checked in until we checked out. Service, breakfast and facility was one of the best I've had. Lived the area and am so happy we chose the location. Multiple metro stations that let us easily get wherever we wanted to go but still experience Paris outside of the touristy spots. The pool was a great way to relax after long days of touring. May have been the best service I have ever had at a hotel.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Fantastic
text:
First time in Paris. Loved this location in a neighborhood & not in a tourist area. We loved being able to eat with the locals.  Quick Uber ride to the city chaos. 
Hotel upgraded us on arrival to a suite with a private rooftop terrace. Probably b/c (AccorHotels premier member). Nightly turn down service. Exceptional clean. What was the best, was the staff who are just so warm and inviting.  I did  not get all their names but, Victoria went out of her way on several occasions and I appreciate it.  I can’t wait to come back to Paris and would  love to stay again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Generally nice but maintenance and service to improve
text:
The pros :
Nice historical building with some character and distinctive deco. Early access to the room granted after a red eye flight which is always nice. Relatively large room for Paris standards. 
The cons 
Shaving mirror in bathroom damaged (not remaining up) and jacuzzi function of bathtub not working. Self boiling machine is breakfast room not working properly (water not warm enough). 
When these issues were reported upon check out, all I got as answer was “sorry”
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: What a Fabulous Hotel!!  We will return!
text:
We chose this hotel for our fifth visit to Paris. This is the very best hotel we have experienced in Paris by far.  
LOCALITY
It is located near the Bastille.  It is close to a Metro station.  It is surrounded by restaurants, provision shops and a self-serve laundry.  The hotel is located in a nice, clean street which is quiet, safe and pleasant.
CHECK-IN
Check-in was a very pleasant experience.  The staff were very friendly and engaging, able to speak English. We felt welcome.
OUR ROOM
The room was bright and airy, very clean and modern.  It had large windows to let the sun in. Tea and coffee supplied (kettle and coffee pod machine) along with a modest minibar. Complimentary sparkling and still water supplied.  Chair and desk in the room.  Room size was good. Lighting was adequate.  The bed was a very comfortable queen size double. The air-conditioning heating/cooling was very efficient and super quiet. The TV was  large screen type.  The bathroom - wow! Ultra new. Shower with rain head  and hand wand. Bathroom very clean and functional.  Large hairdryer supplied (big tick!!).
STAFF
The concierge was very engaging and helpful on advice on where to eat locally and with other information.
Housekeeping was of a very high standard.
Swimming pool and gym were clean and very enjoyable to use - good supporting amenities. 
The hotel had breakfast and bar facilities, so one can stay without having to venture out if desired.
We will most definitely come back to this hotel when we visit Paris again.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Lovely in every way
text:
This hotel was wonderful.  Every staff member was kind, caring, and helpful (especially Victoria and Alexander), and the room was very comfortable.  We greatly appreciated the little touches that made it feel luxurious, such as the supply of Nespresso, the fine quality of the linens, and the large bathroom (especially for Europe!). We booked the junior suite with terrace and were very pleased with the size of the room, thought it didn't feel like a suite in the way we are used to, mainly because it was all just 1 room. But still, enough space and the terrace was so nice.  

The neighborhood was quaint and filled with local shops and restaurants (2 patisseries and a wine shop down the block, fromagerie around the corner!) - nothing was touristy - yet it was easy to get to the main attractions via subway. I will point out that the main areas near the big museums/gardens/etc is about 25 minutes away via train, so just plan that into your day and night so you know what to expect. We really liked spending a few long mornings and evenings just in this neighborhood to avoid tourist trap restaurants, but of course we wanted to see the sights so we used the metro a lot. Some great nearby restaurants are Pure Cafe and Les Funambules. Overall a wonderful Parisien hotel!
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great small hotel, in a convenient location for the metro
text:
We stayed in a Courtyard facing room. The room was very spacious and although didn't have a view, it was also very quiet. The room was well equipped with coffee machine and kettle as well as a fridge. The hotel is small, but had a nice pool and spa area. There is a small bar and breakfast room. We didn't eat at the hotel as we choose to have breakfasts in the neighbourhood, which was better value for money. Staff very friendly and helpful.
Really good location for the metro - and we found nice places to eat locally each evening.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Birthday trip ... leaving with a smile
text: We just left the hotel and we are full very good impressions! We stayed for two nights celebrating my husbands birthday in a deluxe room with a delightful balcony. Before arrival I asked the hotel to book two restaurants on our behalf and they were happy to do so. Also, upon arrival my husband received warm birthday wishes from check in staff, which is a nice touch and not obvious. The room was nice and large, the bathroom is well appointed, everything is super clean. There are not enough power sockets to charge all your stuff, clearly the room was designed by someone stuck in the past and not knowing much of modern customer’s expectations. The bed is extra comfortable and the room is quiet. There were some minor issues with our room: there is a problem with plumbing and sometimes when you come back to the room after a few hours it does not smell pleasant, the smell goes away if you open the window for a minute; there was turn down service on the first night, nothing happened on the second night, which makes the service rather patchy; the breakfast is very limited considering it is a 5 star hotel, don’t order cappuccino, it is made by a mediocre machine. The staff in the hotel is very nice and helpful when approached! When departing we received luggage from their luggage hold and the lovely lady failed to give us a bag with my husbands birthday plant and we forgot about it as we were tired. When you get your luggage from the hotel’s luggage hold do remember to count the pieces and remind them to go look for any missing items. It was too late for us to go back and as a result we left a piece of us in Bastille Boutet! All in all pleasant stay and we will most likely come back.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Neat  and Nice Small Hotel!
text:
We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights in April. It is a nice , small hotel at a great location. The street is away from the typical touristy areas yet very close to all the places of interest in Paris. 

The hotel is small but very well maintained and the staff is absolutely brilliant and I think that is what stands out. Right from the time we were checking in to the time we left the hotel, staff was extremely polite and very helpful. 

Special mention to Aleksander ( hope I have got the spelling right!) who was extremely helpful and guided us to various attractions.

 Thank you very much.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Absolutely   Perfect!
text: There are not enough great words to use to describe this wonderful boutique hotel.  From the first minute of arrival to our departure, everything was outstanding!  The front desk, especially Waginer, were gracious, friendly and above all else, helpful in every way.  Our room was on the top floor.  We had booked a queen bed bc at the tome of our booking through Orbits, a king was not offered.  Honestly- the bed was bigger than a queen and the most comfortable bed we’ve ever slept in.  The high quality bedding and pillows made it a pleasure to get into bed every night.  The electricity runs by your room key- very convenient and energy efficient.  The rooms are very quiet and we never heard any other guests.  The shower with its double shower heads were huge.  The closet lit up every time we open the door.  At first, I thought this room was small but it was just the right size for us.  Everything in the entire hotel is immaculately clean, and each day, the housekeeping staff were like ninjas- they were invisible, yet there was never a wet towel or unmade bed, and there were hand written notes and chocolates with turn down service.  The buffet breakfast was just enough to experience a European breakfast without being overdone.  Although its pricy when purchased through the hotel, we were lucky enough to book it with our package, which was much cheaper.  Pool, sauna and steam room were very clean, and the shower in the spa was not only clean but very high tech with a total body blow dryer!  Every member of the staff, from the bartender to the front desk to the housekeepers and the breakfast staff were friendly, helpful and non-intrusive.  And what a cute neighborhood!  You have access to 3 nearby metro stations and lots of many close, local eateries and bistros and bars.  Free WiFi, water and plush bathrobes and slippers just completed the package.  You couldn’t ask for a nicer place to stay!  Definitely would recommend the Boutet if you;’re looking for a special vacation.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Lovely hotel, great location
text: My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights and it was our first time staying in the 11th.  It's a great location as is close to the metro, but not in the tourist throng, so when you walk in the area, you are not bombarded with souvenir shops and tour groups!   The hotel is very lovely, we had a nice room with a balcony and the pool and haman are fantastic to have in the heart of Paris.   We didn't eat at the hotel - so I can't comment on breakfast.  We did have an issue, but it was professionally handled and so I would definitely return.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Nice Hotel
text: We had a good time at the Boutet. The staff was lovely especially Victoria at the front desk, the room was spacious and clean with great amenities. We enjoyed the pool and the steam room at the end of the day. The only thing that we did not enjoy was that our room was facing the street and on the 2nd floor, it is very very noisy at night. Request a room away from the street and you will have a great experience !
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Really classy place with fantastic staff - all of them were brilliant.
Pool, sauna and steam room all top spec and never too busy. Definitely stay again if we go to Paris again as close to Metro so easy to get about from here. Nice bars around the hotel for food and drink.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Affordable, comfortable & very friendly+helpful staff
text: I only spent 1 night at the hotel & didn't eat at the restaurant, but besides the hotel being affordable & comfortable, I found the hotel staff very friendly & helpful. In addition to allowing me to check-in a bit early, they also agreed to give me a bit more time to check-out the next day. And, since I had a night flight I was able to store my bags in luggage room, & use the pool + shower facilities after checking-out in order to shower before my flight, which was great. Strongly recommended.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Hotel with an Indoor swimming pool
text: On arrival I thought the reception/bar area looked smaller than on the photos but the staff were lovely and friendly although English not great.  Got to the room - bit small and I paid for a delux double room.  All in all our stay was comfortable and the room was clean - the main issue was the pool was closed and I wasn't informed - probably more to do with Jet2 not informing us but this was the main reason for booking the hotel.  We ordered room service quite a lot for coffee as the coffee and tea facilities weren't great for a 5 star hotel, the room service staff weren't great at English so most of the time the items were incorrect.  The mini Bar was poorly stocked and over priced.  The TV had 2 English channels but for some reason 1 of the channels that was supposed to be English had French programmes on so we ended up watching the Disney channel at night - not great for adults.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Good location but not sure if it’s up to the usual MGallery/Sofitel standards
text: The location here is great - a short walk from several metro options. It’s actually quiet easy to miss the hotel if you’re walking along the same side of the street as it’s quite an underwhelming entrance, but cross the road and you can see the unique Art Deco-type facade. Room was tiny - and apparently we received an upgrade due to Accor status - and the whole hotel just didn’t feel as luxurious/service driven as usual Sofitel and MGallery hotels do. We asked several members of the reception staff for restaurant recommendations but they couldnt really seem to come up with much to suggest.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Overall a most enjoyable stay
text: Although I arrived early the room was ready which was a relief.  The staff were very helpful with tips on  best use of the Metro and nearby good restaurants.  The room was well equipped with excellent shower and bed but it was rather small for it to qualify as very comfortable.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Great location
text: I stayed in this hotel for 4 nights on January, the rooms were good and the service was nice and quick especially guys at the breakfast. The whole team made my stay very good except one lady at the reception who was not helpful and rude at the check out (elsie i think but not sure) thanks god florianne was here to help... Otherwise i want to thank all the team and of course i recommand the hotel for your stays in Paris.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Laid back luxury
text: Definitely above our usual budget but a very nice stay. Staff always ready to help, room was wonderful with terrace with roof top views, breakfast and spa with indoor pool spotless. Also very nice surroundings, great location with Parisian atmosphere away from the tourist crowds.
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: a great place to stay
text: second time at the Sofitel Boutet : nice location in a vibrant 11eme arrondissement with easy access to public transportation, several nice restaurants. Comfortable room well equipped (Nespresso machine, a kettle to make tea, small fridge). Functional bathroom with a good shower. This time we had access to the swimming pool and the spa facilities (last time it was under maintenance). The breakfast was just fantastic like the first time we stayed at the hotel.The staff was helpful and friendly
name: Hotel Paris Bastille Boutet - MGallery Collection

title: Good choice
text:
Not cheap but enjoyable!
Comfortable bed and room, excellent internet, enjoyable fitness and piscine/ sauna facilities
Acceptance of dogs - another plus

title: Large rooms in real Parisian neighborhood
text: I arrived late at the hotel and the check in was smooth and quick. I was assisted with my luggages, given a little tour then was taken up to my room on the 6th floor. First impression was that the room was large as compared to Paris standards. The next day I woke up and finally got to see the beautiful view of the Parisian rooftops. I also had a terrace with sitting area which would is perfect in a really nice weather . Breakfast starts early at 6:30 am which was really great especially if I wanted to start the day early. The location was in a real Parisian neighborhood in the 11th arrondissement. It was 2 blocks away from 2 different Metro Station lines, very convenient. The area also had a lot of places to eat. Didn’t get to use the spa or pool but was able to see it and if only I had more time, I would have been able to try it out as it looked so inviting. Overall it was a great stay and will definitely recommend it to friends visiting Paris.

title: Great hotel close to everything!
text: My first, my friends second, trip to Paris and we found Le Derby Alma after searching for weeks. This quaint hotel has everything you need and is in the heart of the 7th Arrondissement. Blocks away from the Eiffel Tower, restaurants and gift shops abound, and high fashion within walking distance. The Louvre and the Catacombs are quick Ubers away, and you can walk to dinner cruises on the Seine easily. You can have French, Italian, Pakistani, and more, within a block, and much more in the surrounding area. The rooms are small, but that doesn’t matter because you’ll be exploring all day long and only need the great bedding at night for a terrific nights sleep to be ready for more exploring the next day. The staff were impeccable, and humored us as we practiced our French, and were very encouraging. They have a little bar in the lobby, and delicious breakfast if you can’t get to the boulangerie the next block over. If you need to do laundry, three blocks away is a great spot, across from an amazing Italian restaurant. The hotel was quiet, felt very safe and secure, as did the neighborhood. We will definitely return!

title: Beautiful boutique hotel.
text:
My friend and I took a girls trip to Pairs for 9 days and chose to stay here. 

As much of Europe the rooms are small. That's to be expected. If your going to Europe do not expect large rooms. 

The lobby is smaller yet beautiful. The staff at the desk were always friendly and helpful with everything we needed or asked about. 

The rooms are beautiful and decorated so chic. Very modern day fashionable. Beds were comfy, room was always cleaned. Downfall is they didn't always refill the fridge & the fridge is always luke warm. For whatever reason they only give you one regular coffee and multiple decafe. We made do, wasn't the worse thing that could happen. 

The bathroom was always cleaned & well kept. The hair dryer did not work or stay on the holder. One night I needed it the front desk couldn't get it to work and gave me a key to another room to use that hair dryer. It was a pain since it was midnight but whatever I needed my hair dried. The next day I asked if it was fixed only to be told their is a hair dryer in our closet. That would have been helpful at midnight instead of running around. Again not the end of the world just miscommunication. The tub is VERY high up. We are in our late 30s and it was a steep step in for us and a bit scary getting out since your all wet. 

Overall we enjoy our stay here. It was definitely over priced due to the location. You are about 6 minute walk to the Tour Eiffle and 8 minute walk to busses and metro. Location is great but that is why it is so expensive. Front desk held our luggage the first day since we traveled in early and our room wasn't ready. 

I would stay here again most definitely and recommend to others.

title: Exceeded expectations
text: Wonderful choice of hotel, stay here! Staff are so welcoming and friendly, best I've had in a hotel and surprised me with it being france which service can have a reputation as being more prudish, here they are very warm and accommodating. Location was perfect, very close to Eiffel Tower, can walk to cafes, restaurants, metro, all easily managed but its not in the noisy thick of things or touristy, very classy and for the price it's a gem. We recieved handwritten notes during the stay under the door welcoming us / asking for feedback, again a lovely touch. After booking I emailed direct flagging that I'm heavily pregnant, very swift and kind response and upon arrival I was warmly welcomed and got the Eiffel tower view room. Didnt reserve breakfast, hardly necessary when cafes everywhere with lovely pastries. Downside - no bathrobes. Thank you team for a lovely stay, big applaud to the staff for their wonderful service!

title: Average Hotel In An Excellent Neighborhood
text:
Eh.

Staff - Excellent. The guys at the bell desk are awesome! So friendly and polite. Check-in was a breeze. Everyone who I interacted with at this property are excellent. 

Room - Eh. I can't believe this room costs so much. Two twin beds and a couch. The bed is super comfortable with very soft fluffy pillows. The room was bigger than expected, which is welcomed, but it needs to be updated. The carpet has seen better days. The closet is really dark and the safe is stored at an odd angle (protip: use your phone's flashlight to check the closet and safe). We never figured out how to turn on the TV, so instructions would've helped. The electrical and USB outlets are a hit and miss. Some worked (even with a European plug), but most didn't. The hotel turns off the air conditioner during the winter (I stayed in early October), but the room had three doors that partially open. However, even with the sheer curtain we had mosquitos (and we were on the 3rd floor!... 4th floor if you're American).

Bathroom - Love the Clarins products! The bathroom is roomy. Big shower (no bathtub). Plenty of hot water with good water pressure. 

Neighborhood - Excellent! 7 minute walk to Champs Elysee. Hotel is not on a main street so it's quieter (more on that below) and there are lots of shops and restaurants closeby.

Protip #2 - The hotel (website nor front desk staff) failed to tell us about the construction on the building across the street. Work begins around 6am and ends around 4pm. Ask for a room that does NOT face the construction site.

title: Wonderful stay!
text: This is exactly what you expect when you know this was a mansion owned by John Jacob Astor.  I think they did a great job in converting this into the little gem that it is.  From the moment we arrived, the desk staff offered us bottled water since it was hot out that day, and they treated us truly like we were appreciated.  While the room was small, especially when you are gone for 21 days and have 2 large suitcases, it was quaint, quiet and cute!  There are no complaints about the room but the size is really what you would expect for Paris (and no different then our room in London later on in the trip).  Breakfast was really good, room service was as well.  The most amazing part of this hotel is their incredible concierge staff.  Whatever you need, want to see, go and do, reservations etc, they handle it for you and are kind and quick doing that for you.  I truly believe that their help made our trip what it was as they hooked us up with the most incredible private driver (yes, it cost a lot but was well worth it).  Thank you front desk staff, restaurant staff and concierges for making our stay amazing.

Overall, this is a very nice hotel, but we felt that we could have found a more satisfying hotel for our expectations.

title: Nice, centrally located hotel
text:
The hotel itself is beautiful, and very well located. Walking distance to a lot of sites, and very close to multiple public transportation spots. The rooms are small, as expected in Paris, but overall nice. Breakfast was also good, a nice spread (I wouldn't pay for it, but good for being included in my rate as a Hilton Honors member)
The couple "watch outs" - the shower and bathroom were not designed well at all. There is little to no counter space in the bathroom to put toiletries, etc. I was only there 2 nights and was travelling alone so made do, but this could have been very frustrating if there were more than 1 person in the room, or if i was there for longer. 
Second, and the most annoying, was the shower - the way it's designed, there's no shower curtain and the "door" only covers half the shower. So when the shower is on, it sprays EVERYWHERE in the bathroom. After one shower, the entire bathroom floor has water on it - I had to lay towels on the ground of almost the entire bathroom to mop it up. The shower drain also drained VERY slow, so towards the middle through end of my shower, i was standing over shin deep in shower water. 

Overall, great hotel but could use some upkeep

title: Disappointing and Not Hilton Quality
text:
We stayed here because we were interested in trying a new arrondissement and were interested in the Astors.  The Hilton brand also inspired us to believe that this just might be worth the money.  We were quite disappointed across several parameters.

At $650 a night, our slightly larger than normal room was not even close to a “Junior Suite.”  There was no couch or sitting area other than the bench at the front of the bed.  I knew this before I booked, so while there were other choices that offered us better space for our family stay and maybe even better value, I was expecting the experience – at the end of our two week trip – to be trouble-free and with superlative service.  It wasn’t.  It really, really wasn’t.

This is an older hotel and you stay here because you want to experience a bit of the Gilded Age.  It delivers to an extent.  But, like many properties in this class and style of hotel, there’s just a bit too much dust in the corners, cabinets and other places that you wish were a bit cleaner.  There is major construction going on across the street which ruined the vibe – which was the primary reason to stay here.

As we were in the middle of an extended trip, we had three large suitcases.  With a large room, I was expecting this wouldn’t be a problem and asked for two additional suitcase stands upon arrival.  The concierge called us after thirty minutes to say it wouldn’t be possible.  The next day, I complained to the front desk and they found us one extra stand – two just “wouldn’t be possible.”  Having offered them up to my wife and daughter, I appreciate nothing more than having to constantly bend down to the floor to dig through my suitcase at the end of the day to pull out the necessaries and pack for our departure.

Next, we pulled back the sheets and found that their laundry service was severely lacking, as there were two hairs in the bed.  This is always disappointing and shows a lack of attentiveness from both the laundry and housekeeping staff.  It got us off to a bad start and an uncomfortable first night sleep.  

The next morning, a manager arrived.  We sat and I politely informed her of our experience and the disappointment that they were quite far from delivering a Hilton standard deserving of the Curio or  Astor names.  I was really quite shocked that while she listened and apologized, made absolutely no effort whatsoever to make amends -- no flowers; no box of chocolates, no handwritten note – nothing.  This was the lowest level of service and attention that I have ever experienced at a hotel of this class. 

Breakfast was reasonable, but not a highlight.  Hot food was cold.  Cold food was room temperature warm.  Juices were not fresh.  Pastries weren’t as good as we experienced at “lesser hotels” in the regions.

I would NOT recommend staying here.  When you experience the low level of responsiveness from the staff, you can’t help but feeling ripped off by the Brand Names and Logo – because they just don’t deliver the treatment that you deserve at this price.

title: Chic boutique Maison with best staff in Paris!
text:
Love, love, love Maison Astor!  This hotel is perfection for us, with a location that scores 5* for walkability and access to monuments, shopping, restaurants, and Metro.

Rooms were spotless, cool (great AC!), quiet, and dark at night.  Son had classic room (perfect for one, with a beautiful tub/shower in bathroom), and husband and I booked Deluxe King (super comfy big bed, large walk-in shower, and enough space to comfortably hang out in room).  The boutique quality of the property offers narrow hallways and a small lift, and the Astor family portraits on the walls reflect its historic past. 

We opted for the daily buffet breakfast, which was outstanding.  Hubby is T1D and son is vegan and everyone was able to enjoy the wide variety of Parisian offerings.  The coffee machines provided the perfect cafe au lait, espresso, latte - whatever we desired.  We also dined at their intimate bar on Sunday evening, when all nearby dining options seem to have been closed.  Son had college friends with him that night, and six of us each found something wonderful on the menu.

Maison Astor's secret ingredient, however, is their magnificent staff.  Their warm hospitality and multi-lingual abilities exude inclusivity - we felt at home from the moment we arrived. Our less-than-perfect French-speaking was not a problem.  The concierge team went above-and-beyond in suggesting appropriate dining options for our dietary preferences.  They even drew maps for us!  The room attendants were invisible, and our rooms were always ready with fresh towels and often little treats in the evening.  The bar staff seemed to know us by Day 2 (weird and wonderful!), as we strolled in there for a drink in the evenings on our way up to bed.  

We booked 2 rooms for four days of the Tour de France finale weekend and were thrilled that we could walk to the Champs in minutes.  For us, Maison Astor's location was perfect.  La Madeline church was 5 minute walk, Printemps Haussmann (husband forgot to pack casual pants) was a 10 minute walk, Boulevard Malesherbes (around the corner) has every cafe/bistro, quick bite-to-go, pharmacy, mini-grocery, patisserie, and specialty clothing shop we could imagine, plus a Metro station.  It's location isn't specifically touristy, so you'll mingle with locals wherever you go! 

This was our second stay at Maison Astor and we look forward to returning.  Cheers to all who work there and to the manager for creating an environment where it appears no one on staff is ever having a bad day, even though we know that's impossible!  Our time there was magical.

title: Poor experience
text:
We stayed for 2 nights, on arrival staff weren’t welcoming at all and didn’t come across as if they cared even a manager avoided eye contact when we saw her.                                                           

The first room allocated had a significant maintenance issue so we went down to reception and instead of offering a room move straight away, the girl suggested to send someone to fix it, not a good idea after arriving from a long trip. Not a great first impression and zero follow up from the management. 

The second room was very small, the bedside tables were tiny like from a dolls house. No shower gel provided only shampoo. The space between the bed and desk was so small that it would prevent an easy scape in case of fire! 

Room Service menu was very limited no burger or Club sandwich available, very strange. 

A/C didn’t work properly and room was unbearably hot. 

The worst part of the stay was the breakfast. Impersonal service, self service from a dark room including powder coffee, processed cheeses, rusted coffee pot, cheapest frozen croissants and pastries (in Paris?), fruit bowl containing 6 limes and lemons. 

Overall the breakfast was very poor, no attention to detail, run by disengaged agency staff who were more interested in chatting amongst themselves than serving paying customers. 

I raised my concerns with the same girl who checked us in and she couldn’t care less. Hilton “Make it right” principle not in practice. 

This hotel is very dark, the busy furniture and lack of A/C made it worse.  

Concierge staff saw us passing by many times and were just looking at their screens rather that acknowledging our presence. 

It appears many people staying there were redeeming Hilton loyalty points, if you pay full price you would be very disappointed.

title: Quiet, cozy, good location and A FABULOUS CONCIERGE!
text:
This was our second time in this hotel. Last time we stayed here 12 years ago (!), after realizing that the hotel we originally booked was so noisy that we could not sleep! One of the problems that we see in Paris is that most of the luxury hotels with good location are on very noisy streets or squares. While I would not call Maison Astor a luxury hotel it is definitely very comfortable, well appointed and quiet hotel. It is located in a side street but only a short walk from the metro station and restaurants and key tourist attractions. I think that during those 12 years the hotel has changed the owner but continues to deliver quality service. The highlight of this stay, however, was the assistance of most fabulous concierge (unfortunately as I am very bad with names I don't remember his!!!!!!!). We were travelling with two sons, one of the on crutches (skiing accident!!!) so we needed a lot of assistance. The concierge not only recommended great, easily accessible, restaurants many of which we would not find ourselves, but also organized guides for the museums and when needed a wheelchair for our son! He also provided us with lots of local knowledge which we need even more now due our party's mobility restrictions. In a way he knew better than us what we would need and where we should go. I highly recommend the hotel even if the for the concierge alone!

title: An average hotel with a noisy construction site in front of it.
text:
We spent 2 nights at the hotel.

We Checked in at 19:30 and were allocated room 501 (which we chose online). This was a twin Deluxe room (and a Honors Diamond upgrade from the Premium room we originally booked).

The reception area and the lobby felt a bit cluttered, but the check in process was quick and courteous.

We squeezed into the TINY elevator and went up to our room (the luggage would not fit in so the receptionist sent it to our room).

The room felt large, if a bit empty (there should've been a sofa there).
It featured 2 narrow and soft beds, a connecting door, a TV, a minibar, a safe, tiny night stands and a window that opens just to a crack.
The room was not very cleaned (stepped on a needle next to the bed).

The bathroom was small and featured a narrow bath tub (combined with a shower with a good water pressure), toilets and a small sink (with almost no space for putting anything next to it).
There was no ventilation (nor window) in the bathroom, which made things a bit complicated... .
Furthermore, the ceiling of the bathroom was filled with mold, which was disgusting.
The bathroom toiletries were from Sothys and were nice.

The a/c in the room was ineffective on a warm March day and the room was too hot for comfort.

Our main disappointment from the hotel arrived at apx. 8:00 in the morning. There's a large parking lot across the street from the hotel, which is being demolished - manually, thus creating a CONSTANT drilling noise from the early morning until the late afternoon.
As the parking lot is apx. 15 meter away from the hotel's window (see photos), the noise is UNBARABLE!
If you're thinking about sleeping in, or getting back to sleep after breakfast - forget it!
To our amazement, there was no notice of the VERY noisy construction on the hotel's site. Had we known about this - we wouldn't have stayed here.

We had 2 breakfasts at the hotel, which were just OK and included a smallish buffet and drinks.
To our amazement (and other guests as well), nobody from the hotel's staff let us know that it was possible to order à la carte from a menu (which was never presented to us), instead of having just the ordinary (and cold!) scrambled eggs from the buffet.

To add insult to injury, upon reporting all those issues to the receptionist (and later on - to the hotel's staff via email), there was a complete and utter silence and disregard.

Bottom line - this is certainly not the lovely boutique hotel we were hoping for and Hilton should definitely rebrand it as a regular 3-star hotel, or better yet - get it out of its portfolio.
Definitely not recommended.

I loved this hotel and hope to return again someday!

title: Outstanding!
text:
Was here by myself for one night.  Everything from the greeting to the au revoir
was perfect....location outstanding, service exemplary, breakfast delicious and 
plentiful, rooms delightful and beyond expectation.  I was impressed and this hotel will become my Paris go-to!
