title: Hotel canceled our reservations
text:
I booked rooms at the Hotel Left Bank for my family one year ago for my planned July 2022 trip, booking directly with the hotel.  When I  sent an email in mid-June 2022 to update my credit card on file, I was told that my reservations had been cancelled due “dysfunction by our hotel system”.  

The hotel offered two solutions: I could book 2 rooms for my family in their lower-ranked sister hotel or I could have two lesser rooms in their hotel.  At no point in the email did they offer some kind of discount for this error.  

They never responded to my questions about the unacceptable options.  I was forced to find another hotel.  No apologies and no response from a hotel booked a year in advance?
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Best location on the Left Bank!
text:
We have stayed at the Left Bank many times and it is still our very favorite location in Paris.  The staff is helpful, and the rooms are clean and comfortable.  Walk outside and you are on and near the nicest streets on the Left Bank, Rue Buci, Blvd St. Germaine, etc. Many of the major tourist sites are within a relatively short walk (e..g., Luxembourg Gardens, Notre Dame, Lourve and Orsay museums).  Plus, within a few blocks you have an amazing numbers of cafes, restaurants, and brassieres.
We still strongly recommend the Hotel Left Bank!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect for my stay
text:
I had a great stay here (3 nights in a standard room). The room overlooked the street but was really quiet, the bed was really comfortable and the room had everything I needed. 
The breakfast was very good value, with lots of choice, delicious pastries and good coffee. The lady who oversaw breakfast was just lovely, remembering my coffee and juice order every day, and the reception staff were friendly and helpful.
The location is just perfect - 15 minutes walk to the Louvre, Notre Dame, the Pantheon - Odeon metro a minute away and lots of lovely restaurants and cafes within a few minutes. 
Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Ok hotel but dishonest
text: The hotel was ok but the most frustrating thing about staying here was the staff lied to us. We left a bag in the room and they claimed they didn't have it. We called them about 20 mins after we checked out and were 100% sure we left it in the room and they claimed they didn't have it. It was very frustrating because we checked out at around 8:30am and then called around 9am and there's no way the room had been cleaned yet but even if it was cleaned then the maid would have seen it. They claimed they didn't see it but where else would it have been.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Excellent one week Stay, Just as Advertised
text:
We spent 7 nights in a Superior room the last week of October.  It was pretty much just as expected with no unpleasant surprises.  We were on the 3rd floor with windows facing into the interior courtyard(really more like a built in skylight)  We used the tiny elevator to go up to the room and always the stairs to come down.  We booked direct w/ the hotel and took the 5euro pp breakfast option.  It was a great value, given that just a cup of coffee anywhere outside could be 3 euros.  The breakfast options were adequate and didn't change much but certainly enough and the fresh baguette bread and pastries were always welcome. 
We got a peak into some of the standard rooms & they looked quite small.  We were glad to have the superior room if only for the extra space it provided for our clothes etc.  There isn't a proper closet in the room, just an antique wardrobe so that was not nearly enough for a week's worth of cool weather clothing for 2. 
My only other negative would be the lighting, which was poorly positioned, so I had to prop a mirror by the window in the mornings to try & do my makeup.

For our first stay in Paris, I couldn't have been happier with the location.  We used the metro every day and the Odeon station is literally less than a block away.  But we also walked for miles and we could easily reach the Right Bank, the Louvre, the D'Orsay, and all of St. Germain by foot.  Within 3-4 blocks of the hotel there are 3 movie theatres, several bakeries, 100's of restaurants, pharmacies, grocery stores, wine boutiques, etc.  We had some great meals, some so-so and a couple of take- aways when we were hungry in the late afternoon( when most kitchens are closed)
The hotel staff was friendly and helpful when needed and everything was very tidy & clean.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Lovely Little Hotel
text: I liked everything about this hotel. The staff was friendly and helpful, the location ideal, and the room was cozy and comfortable. It was also a great value. There are so many wonderful shops and restaurants nearby and most of the major sites were within walking distance. I hope I am lucky enough to stay there again someday.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: ideal location for seeing Paris
text: First class hotel ,great location ,short walk from the RER  metro station,lots to see nearby  and other sites like the Louvre only a short walk,rooms clean and neat,good tv channel selection,great shower,staff friendly and helpful, good basic breakfast ,would stay here again when returning to Paris
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Very enjoyable stay
text: We recently stayed here for 7 days and thoroughly enjoyed our time. The Paris strikes made our stay a bit unhinged but the staff were so helpful and eased the stress. Our room was nice and the breakfast good value at 5 EUR which was part of the package offered.  Location was fantastic.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Only place we will stay in Paris
text:
Cannot say enough about Hotel Left Bank St. Germain - an old-world French hotel with a welcoming staff in a fabulous location. We spent 8 nights there on our honeymoon in November 2019 & found it absolutely charming.  The beautifully decorated 18th-century building still retains its original hand-hewn beams & woodwork. The bathrooms are thoroughly modern, with marble tub/showers, & the rooms are quiet, beautifully appointed & very comfortable. (We stayed here twice during our visit to France.)  We also received an unexpected upgrade to the luxurious top floor suite with incredible views of Notre Dame and the Eiffel Tower.  

Every member of the staff was wonderful - always friendly & helpful with advice on local restaurants, events & transit options. The location is perfect in the heart of the oldest part of Paris, its narrow streets full of beautiful architecture & interesting shops, sights & sounds.   It's a 5-minute walk to the Seine and 10-20 minutes to gardens, museums, etc.  Taxi stand around the corner & there is always Uber. 
 
Each morning, for only 5 euros, we enjoyed an in-house buffet of several cheeses (including Brie!), croissants & other pastries, baguettes, cold cuts, fresh fruit, yogurt, freshly-squeezed orange juice & delicious coffee.  The service was impeccable & the breakfast room lovely. Room service is also available.  

Staying at Hotel Left Bank St. Germain made our trip more fun (and romantic!).  Cannot imagine there is a better place to stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great location and comfortable room
text: A big thank you to Chris at the front desk, he was very helpful during our entire stay at the hotel. Hotel is a short walk to many sites in Paris. The Panthéon, Luxembourg Gardens, Notre Dame (under construction) Sainte-Chapelle, and not far from the  Marais district. Le Danton is a great place to get breakfast close to the hotel. Taxi stand is at the corner. Our hotel room was comfortable with a large bed. The shower is only partially enclosed so lay a towel on the floor before you shower. In the evenings the hotel's entrance door is locked so if you get back late at night you press the door button for staff to open the door. I recommend this hotel if you're visiting Paris. Many good restaurants nearby.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Cute and very Parisian
text:
Adorable little hotel ... stunning room .. clean.. staff SO. Helpful 
Very central and coffee making facilities and toiletries in room very good .. 3 ladies in one room for 2 nights and it was perfectly adequate... I’d 100% stay again
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Paris in Class
text: My daughter and I spent 2 nights at this hotel. The rooms were classy and comfortable and the service was good. Loved the cheeses and baguettes, and the many breakfast offerings. Location was central and accessible. Will be staying here again on my future trips to Paris.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: A charming hotel in a lovely area
text:
This hotel was everything we expected a Paris hotel to be - full of charm, comfortable and great location for getting around (close to 2 metro stops). We had the breakfast deal added and I'm glad we did as it was a nice way to start the day. The room itself was very pretty and the fixtures and furnishings were of a high standard. We stayed in the Delux Triple room and it was perfect for the 3 of us (2 adults and a child). We were there during a severe heat-wave but the room's air-conditioning coped without any problems at all and we remained cool and comfortable. The hotel was surrounded by eating options. 
Recommend.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great value, excellent location
text: This beautiful hotel is reasonably priced, has a great location and excellent staff. I enjoyed our stay and would stay there again. We had easy access to wonderful restaurants, shops and a taxi to assist us in getting around Paris.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Totally Happy With Our Five Day Stay
text:
This hotel was our base in Paris for 5 nights before getting on our river cuise. We wanted something safe, clean and  close to the Metro.The Left Bank was all of these
The rooms were spacious and the beds comforting after long days of touring. The breakfasts started our days off right with great coffee and items served on china dishes.The guys at the front desk shared wonderful places for dinner and made prearrival reservations for places we wanted to visit. this was a great choice. When we come back to Paris, this is where we will stay.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Gem with best location
text:
Friends recommended the Hotel Left Bank  and we are grateful they did. Location is amazing. 5 minute walk to the Metro and RER.  We only had 1 bag each, so the RER train was an easy ride to CDG. Easy walk to the highlights of the city such as Luxembourg Gardens, Musee D'orsay, Louvre. The area has restaurants from street food to high end. Just fun walking around. 
The breakfast was perfect for us: croissants, cheeses, meats, fruit, yogurt and fresh made eggs (at a small charge). Breakfast was served until 11am.
We initially had a small but adequate room but Fannie upgraded us to room 604 which was a real treat: spacious, beautiful views and comfort beyond our expectations. 
Fannie and Christophe went out of their way to provide information and advice.
We had a wonderful 6 days in Paris and the Hotel Left Bank added to the experience we are looking forward to our next visit.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Authentic Parisian Charm
text: Located in a great area where we could walk to everything. Street and cafe life just around the corner. Staff were very professional, friendly and helpful. Booked direct and were kindly given an upgrade to a deluxe twin which was huge room at the rear of the building overlooking an internal courtyard.This possibly made the WiFi patchy but quiet for a good nights sleep. This was a character filled room with french furnishings, fabrics and wooden beams. Marble bathroom and separate toilet. We took advantage of the 5 euro continental breakfast which was good value and set us up for our days of strolling through beautiful Paris
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great stay, value and personal attention with the front desk
text:
I stayed there for two days in the middle of October and it was a perfect stay. 

The hotel seems to be full so don’t count on checking in early, but they can hold your luggage and there are nice places to eat and see nearby. 

I was traveling alone and was “upgraded” to a deluxe room. It is on the lobby floor and I was skeptical that it would be loud, but I surprisingly didn’t hear much. I kept the window open so the air inside the room wasn’t so stuffy. I always sleep with a soft white noise sound and I never awoke to any loud sounds or people. 

The room was spacious with a king bed and a day bed. The bathroom had a separate shower and bath. The bed only had two pillows which I could foresee being a problem for other travelers but I bet it wouldn’t be a big deal to an extra pillow. It wasn’t a Westin bed, but it wasn’t uncomfortable either. 

The gentleman at the front desk (I am embarrassed that I don’t remember his name) during the day was always so helpful and pleasant. He helped me with so many little things since I speak terrible French. He also spent nearly 10 minutes trying to get the wifi to work on my phone. Really made me feel like I was the only one there. 

You can’t be the location and as long as the traditional decor doesn’t bother you I can’t imagine why this would be a great value for most people. I would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Stay there always for the 4 Time
text: Very helpful people, great location, walk too all the great tourist sites. Rooms clean, small not am America hotel. French Hotel. Breakfast in cheap and good. Steady here before and found it most convince.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great location and friendly staff.
text: This charming hotel is in the perfect location. We only stayed one night but staff were super friendly and helpful. Our Deluxe room was very large and the bathroom was huge! It was on the first floor and only had a window into an outside natural area which was kind of odd. This made the room very quiet and did let some fresh air in. I've already booked another stay for the spring!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Paris, Paris , I love you
text:
My name is Diana Meltzer and I am a Records owner I was so happy to back again to the same Hotel Left Bank, - Paris the personal that work there was amazing all the time Morning, Afternoon and night .
I will be there every day. I feel that is home.
Thank you so much for all your attention.
Love
Diana Meltzer
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Stunning hotel on the left bank
text: This was our last stay in Paris after 3 weeks in France. When we stepped into the hotel our breath was taken away. What a beautiful hotel with its period furiture. We booked the top floor suite #604. When we stepped in we were surprised by the size of it. Just perfect for our family including two kids. The views were amazing. The flowers behind the windows were a delight. We could see the Notre Dame and Eiffel tower and the rooftops of Paris. The a/c was perfect as all the other hotels we stayed in allowed the a/c to only go down to 20 degrees celcius. The breakfast was wonderful. Cannot go wrong with 5 euros per person. The food was fresh and the service was great. Anytime we needed help with any questions or tips was provided by the front desk. They helped getting a large van for our trip to the airport. I must say, this is the most wonderful hotel we have ever stayed in and we strongly recommend anyone to stay there. Book the top floor suite #604 if you can!!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Extremely charming with fantastic location
text: My family stayed in the top floor suite of the hotel and we couldn't have been more happy with our accommodations.  The room was very charming.  The furniture is fitting of the style of the hotel--not brand new but well loved and properly maintained.  The bathroom has been remodeled with updated fixtures and flooring.  The location was perfect.  Just steps from a metro station and taxi stand.  Less than a mile walk to the Louvre.  Many food options nearby.  We felt very safe in the neighborhood and enjoyed every bit of our stay.  I was beyond thrilled to be able to see the Eiffel Tower from one side of our room and Notre Dame (or what remains at this time) from the other side.  I would not hesitate to stay here again!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great stay
text:
Just got back and wanted to write a review. We were in Paris with my sister’s family. We stayed at this hotel while they stayed on the Champs Elysses at a $900 a night hotel. After visiting them at their hotel, all I could think of was how much I liked our hotel better! Their hotel felt cold and without character. 

Hotel Left Bank is in a super cute neighborhood. The rooms were quaint and felt Parisian. Having Eric Kayser across the street doesn’t hurt either. Metro was right down the street. I thought the location was awesome. Everything felt really close. 

There were 3 of us staying in Paris. Our room had one Queen size bed and a single bed. Both were very comfy. Bathroom was nice size and great layout. 

I’d totally stay there again and I was happy with the price.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: The good/excellent reviews must be all about the position!
text: We decided to stay here given the good reviews it has on TripAdvisor.  The location is outstanding and so if that is the key consideration then this hotel is for you. Otherwise the decor of the hotel is dated, our room had a stale smell to it, the breakfast very average and the service nothing notable.  One bonus is a wonder boulangerie across the road that is perfect for breakfast!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Location, location!
text: A friendly and very helpful staff at the front desk and in the breakfast rooms. Our room was great. We were travelling with an adult sized grandchild, and we three were comfortable in our superior room.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Lovely break in Paris
text: Had a very lovely stay at this hotel with a group of friends back in February. Hotel is centrally located very close to Oden metro. A fantastic little hub to relax and explore Paris. Staff were amazing, so friendly, helpful and were always on hand to answer questions and make recommendations. Decor is beautiful. Very clean. Great shower and room amenities. Give it a try!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Excellent vacation spot
text: This was a great hotel to stay.  Great location in the heart of Paris.   The rooms were Very clean accommodations.  The staff was Friendly and spoke English well.  The shower was roomy and clean.  You will enjoy this place.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect Room for 3 in a GREAT location
text: I took my two 12 year old granddaughters to Paris and chose the Hotel Left Bank for its ideal location and the possiblity of a "family" room.  I was pleasantly surprised by the Family Room I had booked, which was large enough for all 3 of us to feel at home and comfortable.  Hotel Left Bank has it all - effective air conditioning in a city where that is not always the case, comfortable beds,a  large and impeccably clean bathroom, a vintage French feel.  It is great value for the money and a lovely experience.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Beautiful
text:
An absolutely wonderful stay with every one of our needs met; every member of my family had an exceptional experience.

The food was perfect and the service could not be faulted.

We will return one day, most definitely.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Customer service in a city of scarcity
text: We did have the pleasure of staying at this hotel, as it is in a great location and beautiful. We were stranded without taxi service to the airport. I walked in and noted I was not a guest. Asked for help at a moment when the receptionist was in a flurry of calls. She took time and care to assist. Next time in Paris, definitely staying here.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Location, staff, rooms, all wonderful
text:
Perfect location. Steps to great cafes, bistros, boulangeries. Short walk to the Seine, Notre Dame, the Louvre. Convenient to all.
Staff are especially helpful with travel plans, reservations etc. the larger room was very spacious. The junior suite for 2 adults and2 young boys was large with views of the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame.
Do not hesitate to stay here, you won’t be disappointed. Reserve early since it is a small hotel.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Still the best location for exploring the Left Bank.
text: We’ve stayed here many times as we love the area.  Rooms are small, but adequate.  Beds could be improved, but again are adequate. Not the friendliest staff, but they are helpful when needed.  Overall, we still recommend the Left Bank for short stays in Paris.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great location and warm hospitality
text: Really enjoyed staying at this hotel.  The staff were all so nice and helpful. The location is amazing - social neighborhood with cafes and restaurants, walkable to the Seine and major attractions, less than 5 minutes to metro (which gets you anywhere).  The room was very nice and decor was traditional french. Very modern bathroom.  The rooms aren't huge, but we were upgraded to a slightly larger room which helped a lot. Lots of convenient outlets for charging phones, laptops, portable chargers, etc.  For a 3 star hotel in Paris, I found this to be a fantastic value. My only negative comment is that the wifi wasn't always reliable.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Location, Service and Comfort
text: From the moment we booked our large room in this hotel we were very happy with it's responsiveness to our questions. They ended up scheduling a great guided tour of Versailles and the gardens for us prior to arrival and while we were there directed us to great restaurants and cafes. The room was large and quite quiet. (hotel is on a side street) We booked the larger room with the sofabed included and had more than enough room. The room was clean, the bed comfortable and the bathroom larger than most. We stayed 4 nights and will definitely book again if returning to Paris. The price was very fair in May, 2019 for a city center boutique hotel. (about 30 rooms I think) The only improvement I could suggest was a speedier elevator. Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Charming Hotel with a great personal service from staff
text: Fantastic hotel!  The location was excellent - so much within walking distance, charming hotel, clean and comfortable rooms, great service from staff, lovely breakfast options and overall a delight.  Our stay was for 7 nights with a family of 5 (grandparents included.) Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect Location, Great Hotel!
text:
We stayed 4 nights at this hotel with my two children. The Location is great. We walked easily to the Louvre, Orsay, Saint Germain Des Prés, Saint Michel, Notre Dame. You can take a bus to the Eiffel just at the corner. You can find many restaurants around the hotel.
And the hotel was very clean, The staff was helpful. We stayed 2 nights in a room which has a small window to the small inside garden. After that we asked for a room which has a window to the outside, the Lady at the reception gave us a room at the top floor, which has two windows with a great view of the Tour Eiffel and the Notre-Dame! Thanks for everything. If we came back to Paris we would stay there again. The only thing was the Breakfast, it could have had more variety and warm croissant :)
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Lovely hotel, excellent location
text: Hotel was recommended to us by a family member who stayed here several times.  The hotel did not disappoint:  perfect location, lovely rooms, overall lovely decor, knowledgeable and efficient front desk staff, good breakfast room staff.  Very close to Odeon metro station.  We were a family of four and stayed in one large room. Sufficiently spacious room.  Would definitely recommend.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Wonderful small hotel, close to everything!
text: Close to everything, walking distance to river, lots of cafes, shopping, historic sites. Great, helpful staff. Can't wait to return. Clean rooms, spacious baths, charming decor. In the heart of the Left Bank, St. Germain.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Charming and Friendly Boutique Hotel in Great Location.
text: My husband and I had a lovely stay at the Hotel Left Bank. It has all the old world charm you hope to find in a Paris Boutique hotel. The staff is very friendly and accommodating and the location couldn’t be better. It is surrounded a great number of restaurants and wonderful alleys of small shops. The metro is a block away and the Seine and Luxembourg Palace a short walk away as well. The rooms are not large but very charming and come with a stocked refrigerator. You can pre-buy breakfast for 5€ and we were very glad we did. All in all a wonderful hotel and we plan to come back.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Very pleasant place
text:
Enjoyed three nights here.

Quaint hotel. Very small rooms but seen worse. Nicely decorated and importantly the bathrooms were sufficiently spacious and new.

Fantastic location less than 100m from Metro. Plenty of good local cafes (Rue Buci) and restaurants within easy walk. Also just a short walk to Louvre, d’Orsay, Notre Dame.

Great value given the location.

No real negatives.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Wonderful place!
text:
The Hotel Left Bank was just as I hoped it would be and more.  We had a suite since it was three of us.  It was a little tight but nothing i hadn’t figured on.  The people were very accommodating. We arrived at 6:00am so we couldn’t check in yet. They called us as soon as our room was ready. They were pleasant and very courteous.  

The hotel was in a great area, perfect for hopping on the train, wonderful cafes and amazing pastry shops!  A block away from the Seine River.  We couldn’t have picked anything better. Thank you Left Bank Hotel for a memorable stay.  Oh I didn’t mention how lovely the lobby/sitting area was?  We sat there in the late afternoon with our coffee and pastry’s before heading out for the evening. 
I would highly recommend The Left Bank St. Germaine.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: The best staff and location
text: We stayed here two nights in a double room. Very comfortable and clean. Great staff and great location.  We did not dine there but it looked good and beautiful decor. Would stay there again.   Metro stop very nearby and many restaurants as well.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Works for us in Paris!
text: Stayed again in this really pleasant hotel. It is not luxurious, but has charm to it and it’s clean... yes, it could use some updates but nothing major that would spoil the experience. Location is it’s biggest asset, right in the hard of Saint Germain... We stayed in the top floor suite (#604) and nothing could beat the view!!! Eiffel Tower on one side and Notre Dame and rooftops in other... We love this hotel, works for us
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Location Location Location...and a Great Staff As Well
text:
My wife and I loved the Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain.  First and foremost the Hotel Left Bank is in an amazingly great location.  We were a 10 minute walk from the Seine and no  more than a 15 minute walk from the Louvre, Notre Dame and several other major tourist highlights.  The hotel is about a 5 minute walk to the Metro (subway) which means all of Paris is very accessible.  Take the time to figure out the difference between their Metro and the RER.  There are numerous shops, cafe's, bistro's, restaurants immediately outside the hotel.  There is an excellent boulangerie right across the street and a small and very nice supermarket about 5 minutes from the hotel.  The staff was friendly, accommodating and helpful. The front desk staff, namely Chris and Fanny could not have been nicer.  We bought croissants from the boulangerie (across the street) and intended to make coffee in our room to have with the croissants.  Fanny saw us bringing in the pastries and insisted on giving us coffee from their breakfast kitchen.  She had us sit down in their small sitting room just off the front lobby, which we did. Fanny and Chris just made the whole experience better for us. Our room was attractive, old style and clean.  The only reason I did not give the 5th star (above) was that the room does not have the amenities of newer hotels (which is to be expected in an old style hotel).  The very small safe is bolted to the bottom of a wooden cabinet deep in the back of the cabinet.  To use the safe you literally must get down on all fours, stick your head pretty much on the floor and into the cabinet and  use your cell phone for light to see inside the safe.  Not easy to do when your knees creak (my knees creak).  The safe was very small, so not all of our valuables fit into the safe.  The bathroom was very nice all marble and glass.  There are no shelves or cabinets so all toiletries must be stored on the sink itself.  We managed very well in that regard.  
This was our second visit to Paris.  On our first visit we stayed in a hotel that was quite distant from the major attractions.  The Hotel Left Bank is walking distance to so many Paris attractions.  It made all the difference in the world to us.  If you're into American history, take the time to walk into the restaurant next door, namely the Procope, the oldest Cafe-Restaurant in Paris.  You will find many artifacts and ancedotes having to do with Thomas Jefferson, Ben Franklin, French writers Voltaire, Diderot and others. Jefferson and Franklin developed the precursor to America's Bill of Rights right there in the Procope.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Best hotel we've stayed at in Paris to date
text:
Hotel Left Bank was our choice mainly because it's located in the heart of busy St. Germain.  A few steps literally from rue de Buci, Blvd. St. Germain, and Odeon.  Loads of shops and restaurants too.  We have stayed in other hotels in the area for years, but I have to say that this personally was my favorite hotel to date.  

Perhaps I'm biased because I was fortunate enough to book the hotel's top floor suite that's exactly as pictured on their website. Suite was really spacious thus extremely comfortable for stretching out.  Has two TV's so that both of us could enjoy our own programs.  And the entire suite was spotless and tidy. Only thing missing is the view of half of the Eiffel Tower that is located on the other side of the suite.  And because we visited in low season end of February/beginning of March we were able to score a fantastic rate especially with the inexpensive breakfast special included if one booked online via the hotel's booking engine.  

Also I highly recommend booking the hotel's private transfer. While we typically would take the official taxis to & from CDG we decided to book the private van arranged by the hotel for very reasonable rates truly.  Honestly the last time we visited Paris seven years ago we were scammed by an unscrupulous taxi driver at CDG.  Never before occurred until then with any taxi driver, this one caught us unaware that we didn't remember to take a photo of him and his license; he played the 'you shortchanged me' game upon our arrival to our hotel who could care less about our plight.  This time with the flat taxi fare being 55 euro to the left bank we paid 15 euro more for the private van (a new, clean Mercedes 6 seater with tons of space for our luggage).  Driver was there waiting for us at arrivals, we walked a few steps to his van, and were delivered promptly to our hotel without any stupid scams pulled.  Same thing to return to CDG we were actually booked with the same vehicle and driver except fare was 10 euro less.  Again I highly recommend this service-well worth it IMO!!

I booked the 5 euro breakfast special with the room via the hotel's booking engine.  Five euro for either a Continental (which also includes choice of eggs and/or ham-alot of other hotels charge an exorbitant price for these items as extras) or buffet breakfast with choice of jams, cheese, eggs, ham, yogurt, cereal, and pastries including baguette, freshly squeezed orange juice, and choice of coffee, tea, milk is an excellent deal.  The only small negative IMO is that the pastries were bite sized & the croissants were not the best quality considering it's Paris.

I can't say enough about how excellent all of the staff were.  From before we left home I'd emailed them about different questions which were promptly replied to.  Upon arrival we were greeted by Christophe who was quite helpful in lending us an adapter saving us the trouble of going out and buying one.  The other reception staff were all great too as were the housekeeping staff who kept the suite spotless every day.  Want to also commend them on allowing us to sleep late each morning.  Other hotels sometimes do not respect the 'Do not disturb' sign on the doorknob and would knock to proceed with their cleaning schedule.  But here the staff truly respected the guests' wishes to leave the room when they chose even past 1pm as we did everyday.  Thank you for that!!

So all in all, both my son and I loved this hotel & would recommend it to anyone seeking a moderate cost for a lovely, well staffed hotel in the heart of the 6th.  And do try to book the suite!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great location!
text: Stayed here three nights in March. The room was cozy and convenient. The bathroom fresh and refurbished. The staff at the reception were nice. The elevator is tiny, and will make you intimate with complete strangers, but I found it charming. Most of all I loooved the location.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect for Visitors- Paris Perfection
text: I came back here for the 5th time and I really have to say its worth it. The location is a short walk to Notre Dame, Louvre, and Saint Germain shopping including the covered market. The Odeon metro stop is around the corner with access to the 4 and 10 line which will take you quickly to other areas. There is a Starbucks nearby for English speakers or early morning departures, a post office to mail stuff home if you bought too much, and a couple excellent pharmacies if you forgot things..You are also a short walk from great restaurants, bars, and high end shopping. The rooms are super charming and clean. Classic without being dated! The WiFi is great. The prices are very reasonable for what you get in the area. The staff and manager Fanni have always gone out of the way to assist with planning my visits, or answering any questions... If you want to feel like a local, with the benefits/amenities of a hotel then Left Bank is a perfect choice.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Amazing Location. Great Hotel
text:
The location was perfect for us. We love the restaurants and bars within walking distance. Many attractions withing walking distance as well. Hotel has very friendly 24 hour reception and is very clean. The only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 was the breakfast. You get a price discount for booking on their site, but even with the discount, I do not feel it was anything special. Basically, a pastry and coffee. For normally 12 or 13 euros, I would think eggs and several other options would be included. 
However, everything else was great and in the end, would stay there again.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Convenient and Lovely Stay
text:
The hotel is within a short walk from Odeon station. Look small from the outside but totally gorgeous internally. We had a quad room on ground level. Room was more spacious than we expected. Bathroom comes with double sink, bathtub and shower area. The furnishing was very classy and cozy. 

Many nice and affordable restaurant around the area. Easy walk to Louve and Notre Dame, The Seine.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: totally gorgeous
text:
Amazing little hotel.... ! met 3 members of reception staff during stay and they were simply the best ~ knowledge of area, transport advice and always with a smile, room clean & stunning ... the location was amazing... no more than a short walk to stunning sights, shops, restaurants and metro link.
The room was spotless and fully stocked and cleaned during our 3 day stay... the trip was myself and two friends we shared a room and didn't feel cramped at all. the décor was gorgeous, but if you want modern sleek its not for you.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Lovely stay !
text: This is a lovely hotel ! Location is fantastic . Walking distance to the Louvre , Notre Dame , The Seine . 1 min walk to nearest metro which is how we got to the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tower . Buffet breakfast is great value and enough to keep u going for a few hours ! All staff so welcoming and friendly .
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Very cute and authentic Parisian Hotel
text: Left Bank is a very cute boutique hotel in St. Germain. This was my first time staying there but my friend who I was travelling with had stayed there many times with his family and loves it. The hotel is in a great neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and shops within walking distance and is a quick walk to the Louvre. It is also near two metro stops so is very accessible to other parts of the city. The hotel staff are all friendly and helpful. Our room was very cute, clean, and quiet. Good price point. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend Left Bank to family and friends.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text: My colleague and I stayed at the Hotel Left Bank this past week.  The staff are wonderful - so welcoming  - giving us excellent advice on restaurants and arranging transport to the airport.   The location is perfect for any Paris activity as well as close to Metro and Train.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Excellent Location, Boutique Hotel
text: We just had our second stay at the Hotel left Bank our experience was wonderful.  The location is outstanding.  It is surrounded by excellent and affordable restaurants and cafes.  There is a bakery, a supermarket, a book store and lots of boutique clothing and shoe stores right on the doorstep.  It is within walking distance of the Louvre and Musee de Orsay and we even walked to a local antique Brocante market from here.  It has the ambience of a classic French boutique hotel.  The staff are delightful and were happy to arrange airport transfers etc. The Breakfast buffet is excellent and good value.  The bathrooms are modern and everything is sparkling clean. I would definitely stay here again and cannot recommend this Hotel highly enough.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Our favourite hotel in Paris
text:
Whether we go to Paris alone or together we like to stay at the Hotel Left Bank on the rue de l Ancienne Comedie.  The staff are welcoming, helpful and friendly. The rooms are clean and fairly quiet. The bathrooms are small but very clean.  The beds are comfortable and we always sleep well,

The lady who cleans the rooms is an absolute sweetheart!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Charming Hotel, Perfect Location
text: We stayed at the Hotel Left Bank on a family trip this past week, it was absolutely perfect! It's a charming hotel with beautiful eclectic decor, the staff was friendly and helpful and it is in the perfect location! There are dozens of great restaurants and cafe's right outside the door and it's within walking distance of almost all of Paris's major attractions. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Paris, I can't wait to be back!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Old style Parisian Hotel
text: Room and location exactly as described.  Restaurants, cafes and places to visit on doorstep.  Room not large but clean with everything one needed..  Helpful and welcoming staff. Lost item forwarded willingly.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Wonderful Hotel with charm!
text: Our family of five stayed in the suite. It was perfect with more room than I had thought we would have and very clean! Views of Notre Dame Cathedral out one side and the Eiffel Tower out the other. Great location, close to shopping, restaurants and the Metro. The front desk staff were so helpful with suggestions on lunch(loved La Citrouille) and getting a taxi for us. It was our first time to Paris and we will for sure stay here again when we return!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: A fantastic place to stay!
text:
The room was lovely and the staff were really helpful. The area has lots of restaurants, cafes and shops, and great place called Shakespeare and Company bookstore. Notre-Dame is very close, about 10 minutes walk, and the river Seine is a beautiful to walk along, especially at night. The Paris Catacombs are also about a half hours walk south. We only stayed for a night, so these places were the easiest to get to for a short stay. 

The only issue I had was that other loud customers were easy to hear through the walls. 

But I will definitely be staying here again!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great Location
text: This was the perfect hotel for our first time visit to Paris. Metro station near by plus plenty of options for shopping and dinning in the surrounding neighborhood. The hotel was just as it was pictured. The front desk was very helpful for two inexperience English only tourist. Hope we get a chance to stay there again.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Supremely comfortable hotel with a great location
text: We just returned from a quick weekend in Paris and highly recommend the Left Bank Saint Germain.  We had two deluxe rooms.  Have been to Paris many, many times and was more than pleasantly surprised at the large size of these very well decorated and comfortable rooms.  They faced the inner courtyard so they do not receive a lot of natural light but this was more than offset by the fact that these rooms are very quiet and very well lit.  Terrific staff!  Will return for sure.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect location, good service, and a lovely hotel
text: I've stayed here several times and it is always a pleasure. The front desk folks are helpful and the rest of the staff couldn't be more accommodating. The hotel is clean and has lovely decor. some rooms are larger than others but we found the Superior room to be perfect for my granddaughter and me.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Long weekend
text:
Good location and near to metro and other transportations,
Small room but this is common in France.
Room nice, clean and tidy.
Little concerned about the reception because we have a late check-in and the next morning our room key did not work anymore and when we asked the morning staff in the reception they informed that we was checked out.. All was sorted out and then good,
We also have the breakfast (when book directly from hotel website there is a discount which we did), well depending what you want for breakfast there could be some good and bad on this, we was little bit okay but there could be some improvements, overall good place!
Patric!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Relaxing atmosphere, helpful staff, great location.
text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel. The front desk staff was extremely pleasant and helpful. They made dinner reservations for us, and arranged out taxi back to the airport. The location is very  near the Odeon metro stop, convenient for all of Paris and wandering around St Germain de Pres.  Our room on the 5th floor was small but not cramped, with a nice geranium window box view. The room and breakfast area are clean and inviting.  The furniture is not new, but not old; the wall coverings and paintings are pleasant.

Breakfast was discounted while we were there, and the coffee made it worth the price for us.  Not the best croissants, but not horrible, and the fresh squeezed orange juice was appreciated.

My only complaint was that the bed was a little soft for me, and the duvet was so warm that it was hard to have a good sleeping temperature.  But these are small things.   The hotel was not full, and perhaps there would be more noise from other rooms if it was, but we found it very quiet.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Terrific in every way!!!
text: Definitely the hotel to stay in Paris.  Terrific front desk staff, delicious breakfast, great location, and super clean rooms.   Stayed here for 4 nights in October and can't say enough about the great stay at this hotel.   This was our last stop on a two week vacation in France.   The neighborhood has great restaurants too!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great hotel, excellent loaction, will definitely return
text:
First of all - great loation. Lots of restaurants and coffee shops nearby, a supermarket half a block from the hotel open till 23:30, the Odeon metro station also very close with lines that can get you pretty much everywhere in paris with only one connection.
The hotel was very comfortable & clean, will definitely return
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Vibrant Easy Stroll to all-parts Paris
text: We've always stayed on the perimeter of Paris but whilst w/ 40-somethings, indulged in staying in the heart of the Latin Quarter for 'atmosphere'. Would search harder next time for QUIETER LODGING, but were pleased with how easy it was to get EVERYWHERE in much less time as well as how nice it was to feel as if you were actually "there" when simply strolling around proximity of our hotel.  When along the river at night you can almost FEEL the ghosts/history!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great visit
text: All of the previous reviews have mentioned what we loved about this hotel. Amazing location, vibrant neighborhood and knowledgeable and friendly staff. We do, however, have a tip concerning transportation to the hotel. If you are arriving from either airports in the morning we advise taking the train, rather than a taxi or bus. The traffic in the morning is horrendous and at 7:30am it took 90 minutes to reach the hotel by taxi from CDG. Other than that we had a wonderful time and would certainly choose this hotel again
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Loved it!
text: It’s been ten years since I last stayed here but I have such fond memories of it!  The rooms are wonderfully cozy and one (I want to say #505) has a view of Notre Dame.  It was covered floor-to-ceiling in a rosy red toile that I absolutely loved.  I kept the window open most of the time just to look out at the city.  The room has a bathtub which was great after long days and many hours spent walking.  The breakfast was always tasty and served in the room or the dining area, according to your preference.  One of the best attributes of the hotel is its neighborhood and its proximity to a major-thoroughfare metro station, about two blocks away.  You are in a quaint and (possibly) still not completely-tourist-overrun area of Paris here, between the best of St. Germain and the Latin Quarter just out your door.   Head only a few blocks to the Seine, the Pont des Arts, the Ile de la Cité, the Louvre, and so on.  I’ve visited Paris many, many times, and some of my happiest memories are the ones spent in this sweet and charming little hotel!
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Great hotel
text: This hotel is located in one of the best and busiest area of central paris. It is an old hotel but well maintained. The room is small but cozy and the bed is very comfy. Breakfast is a buffet style, simple and not fancy. Staff are friendly and helpful. Walking distance from all major attractions, and it is surrounded by tons of bars and restaurants. Electric and regular bikes are all over, but the best is the new electric scooters woo woo.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Warm and friendly
text: I have stayed at this hotel many times. It is a warm boutique hotel with friendly and welcoming staff who are willing to assist in any way! Tiny lift, old fashioned rooms but very clean and comfortable
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Location, Location,Location!
text: We chose this 3 star hotel by the reviews and because it had a cheap breakfast if booked directly with the hotel only €5 per person which was a continental buffet breakfast but plenty of choice fresh fruit, toast, Croissants and pastries, French breads and Cheeses, Cereals, Pancakes, Yoghurts and tea and coffee. We filled up and didnt need lunch. A cooked breakfast was available at a further charge. We had a room overlooking the street.It was very clean and the bed was comfy. The bathroom had a great rain shower over the bath with instant hot water. Toiletries provided too. Wi fi was was a bit patchy dropping in and out so we used our data. I slept well but my husband found some noises from other guests disturbed him but he is a light sleeper. The hotel had great air conditioning and we needed it as it was 34 deg when we were there. We visited The Seine which was just 5 mins walk and The Louvre 10 min walk. Notre Dame and Muse D'Orsay was 15 mins walk. Toullieres Gardens and place de La Concorde 20 mins walk and Arc de Triomphe about 30 mins walk. The Eiffel Tower was the furthest at approx 40 mins walk but it was an easy walk along the Champs Elysee. There are tour brochures in the hotel and we got a boat tour and a 3 course meal in the oldest cafe in Paris La Procope (which is next door to this hotel) for just €39 each it was well worth it. The Luxemburg Gardens were also nearby about 15 mins walk away and so beautiful. Lots of restaurants and cafes close by for dinner and Rue St Germaine de Pres is at the end of the road to do lots of shopping. Staff were friendly, polite and helpful and spoke perfect English. They kept our bags after check out for us and organised a taxi too. The Gare de Nord was approx 15-20 mins drive away and the taxi costs about €20.00. If you book your stay in August it is cheaper per night than in July. A great month to go. I hope you enjoy your stay at Hotel Left Bank as much as we did.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: above expectations
text: This was a nice surprise. The property is clean well kept and very nice convenient location. The breakfast was excellent and the service was very friendly. It represents very good value and is definitely worth considering.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Wonderful
text:
I found the perfect spot with Hotel Left Bank. The neighborhood is filled with cafés and bookstores, and the hotel itself is on a quiet street close to everything but serene enough to get a restful night’s sleep. 
The day concierge, Christophe, is welcoming and helpful, the hotel is clean and charming, and they also are able to provide a shuttle to the airport with some advanced notice. 
I would absolutely stay here again, and I hope that I can someday.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Amazing location - good value for the money
text:
We stayed here recently in two rooms. First, the location is great! We were right in St Germaine and near Latin Quarter. Lots of restaurants and shopping and just nice walking around. We could walk to many attractions (Notre Dame, Luxembourg Gardens, Louvre) and very short cab rides to others. 

The hotel staff was very helpful and had good suggestions. The rooms were nice and had ambiance. First night we stayed in two adjoining rooms which were adequate, on the small side but clean. For the last few days of our trip we moved to the suite on the 6th floor. The views from the room were fantastic - Eiffel Tower from one end and Notre Dame the other. I would struggle to call it a suite though. While it says it sleeps 4 people, when you do put 4 people in it you lose any use of the couch (that is one of the beds) and they bring in a cot which takes up the rest of that living room area. So in the end, it's a tight space for 4 people with no real useful seating area. If we went back, I would get the two adjoining rooms for four people as that gives you a little more room and you have two bathrooms.

Overall a good stay and a very good value for the price, especially given the location.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Perfect
text: Everything we had heard about Paris style was embodied in this Hotel. Perfectly placed 50m from the Metro, in the middle of the best vibrant Cafe scene. We loved our stay at this Hotel, friendly staff, comfy bed and so reasonably priced. We will always stay here again when we return to Paris.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Brilliant family friendly hotel
text: This was a lovely little hotel, location was excellent with lots of attractions within walking distance and the Metro just round the corner. We were a family of 4 in one room and the room was huge, very clean and the beds comfy! The staff were also really helpful and great with restaurant recommendations! Would definitely stay again.
name: Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain

title: Downgraded experience
text:
This was our second time here (first was at 2018 - before Covid pandemic). 
As we had good memories from this place, it was disappointing to discover that the place does not hold to its past years good impression and experience.
The room was very minimalistic, not very clean, room door was very squeaky (all doors in the floor, not just ours), as well as the kitchen cabins and even the refrigerator’s door. It simply feels like no maintenance was kept. 

On the other hand - receptionist were very pleasant and kind. 
The location is a winning one - close to Rivoli street, the louvre, many restaurants around and less than a minute walk to the Metro station. 

If you’re looking for a simple, minimalistic place to stay - it’s pretty much ok. If you’re looking for something a bit fancy, I would skip staying here.

title: Great and not so great location
text:
We picked out this hotel due to high reviews from previous guests. Here are my personal review after staying for 9 nights last June 2022. 

Pros: we are a family of 4 and were assigned the highest floor with the largest family room. There was a bedroom with queen size bed and closet with shelves. Wonderful space! Full kitchen with washer/dryer. Fridge and living room with queen size sofa bed. There’s basic housecleaning every 3 days. The linens and towels and toiletries are all self service in the first floor and it’s scout’s honor to take as you need them. There’s AC in the room. Black out curtain. Bathroom with radiator to dry towels.  Just basically everything a simple home needs, it was provided. There’s a mini market right beside the hotel. Great location as far as walking distance to food and shopping and metro. Staff’s customer service were excellent! 

Cons: the Fontaine Des Innocents is right in front of the hotel and sadly, as iconic as this historical landmark is, it is also favorites among local “thugs” and homeless people to hang around. the presence of local folks who look  like they are ready to rob you anytime is a huge turn off. I felt unsafe. I believe the hotel staff are aware of this issue. There is a police presence constantly in the vicinity. My cousin who was vaping outside almost got mugged on 2 different occasions. It wasn’t a pleasant walk back to the hotel specially at night. 

Other than this issue, this hotel is perfect in every way. You make the judgment.

title: Take a pass on this one
text:
We have stayed at Citadines in London, Kowloon, Hong Kong and now Paris. The hotel is centrally located and a great spot for transit or walking. Unfortunately the rooms have seen better days and are rundown compared to their other properties. There isn’t even a tea bag or packet of instant coffee in the room and only a tiny French press.

The biggest negative however, is the NOISE! Four nights and no sleep yet due to the noise from outside the hotel (yelling, screaming and singing until 3 and 4 am) as well as the room above and the hallway until past 1 am and that’s with all windows and doors closed!

If you value sleep stay anywhere else, perhaps a freeway or fire station may be quieter!

text:
I have stayed in Citadines in several European cities and have always enjoyed a pleasant stay.  I find the aparthotels well managed with comfortable accommodations and a caring staff.  Citadines Les Halles was no exception.  As I was staying quite a while, I got a discount on my room and the staff put some snacks in my room as a treat--very welcome for a jet lagged traveler!  The staff also printed out my museum reservations and helped me find a place for the Covid test I needed to return home.
The location is first rate, and in my opinion cannot be beat unless you stay at the Novotel next door.  It's a straight shot on the RER no need to change to the metro.  The renovated shopping center Les Halles is right there, and you can find almost anything you need.  It also contains a huge transportation hub.  Despite this the area is largely pedestrianized and so very quiet and calm in contrast to other parts of Central Paris.
Because of the Pandemic I wanted to avoid taking the metro as much as possible and found I was able to walk most places I wanted to see.
Thanks, Citadines Les Halles, I had a great stay in Paris!

title: Our second stay at this hotel
text:
The hotel is located in a lively shopping area. The area is safe and well lit with a lot of people about well onto the evening.  The check in was easy and the staff were very friendly and spoke perfectly English.  
Our room was larger than a typical French hotel room and had a sink, microwave, and refrigerator.  The refrigerator worked well and was empty (not packed with expensive bait).  Everything in our room worked well.  The bed was comfortable and outside noise was barely audible.  
The bathroom was clean and we never ran out of hot water. 
The hotel’s wifi worked great and was free.  
There is a metro station very close to the hotel entry. 
Well worth the money.  This was our second stay in this hotel and we will visit it again

title: An excellent option for the self-directed traveler in Paris
text: If you read the hotel's description, then you already know all the many positives - location (central and within easy walking distance to so many Paris highlights - while having metro/train practically at your door), apartment/hotel concept (less servicing but that trade-off for the kitchen amenities is well worth it).  The room was modern, the bed was extremely comfortable, toiletries included, the mini-fridge had a freezer, the coffeemaker a permanent filter, the toaster, electric kettle, microwave, stove-top - all allowed you to eat in if desired (even a dishwasher).  While we were there, they were installing the key pass to get in the front door and on the elevators going up so safety was a given.  Cannot speak to AC    as didn't need it but the heating worked fine.  The double windows with balconet were extremely well insulated - noise from the street it opened but completely quiet when closed.  Coffee in lobby very nice extra.  The only negatives,  apparently, a standard Studio is possibly not modernized so the difference between the Studio and the Deluxe Studio is perhaps more than just a sofa and iPod docking station, the smallish bathroom has adequate storage and amenities but the tub construction/layout is a challenge if you are not reasonably agile - getting in and out required great care, for US travelers, who haven't mastered the language, the TV is pretty useless (put the WiFi was adequate).  Would definitely recommend, unless you want a "Pampered Experience" (that is what a traditional upmarket hotel provides).  We would stay here again.

title: Great value for money
text:
Amazing location within easy access to the metro lines, including the RER coming from the airport or Gare du Nord. Within easy walk to all of the sights.

Pros:
- location
- cost
- laundry room (although you'll pay €5 to wash and €4 to dry per load)
- there's a small gym
- spacious room
- good air con
- kitchenette with everything you need
- lots of closet space

- bathroom is pretty small even for one person
- needs renovating

I'd stay here again.

title: Well located serviced apartment at Les Halles, Paris
text: Citadines Les Halles offers decently sized serviced apartments - this means you get a kitchenette in the unit but will have limited housekeeping.  We were happy with the tradeoff, especially given the convenience of its location, right next to exit 1 from the Chatelet-Les Halles metro which makes the RER B connection to CDG extremely convenient.  Our unit was sparely furnished, and was showing signs of wear and tear, which is the only reason for our less than 5-star review.  The staff is very helpful and friendly.  The small fitness facility has a few treadmills and an exercise bike, and a set of dumbbells; the memory is vague as to whether they have an elliptical.  Shopping (Forums Les Halles is right next door) and dining is incredibly convenient.  There are numerous good restaurants, patisseries, boulangeries, and supermarkets in the area.  We skipped the offered breakfast and took advantage of the free coffee in the lobby and the wide selection of local pastry shops.

title: Excellent Well Located Apartment Style Hotel
text:
We stayed here as a family of 2 adults and 2 kids. We liked this hotel for many reasons including its excellent location.
We were in Paris in late Dec 2019 during the rail strikes but that didn't impact us as the hotel was walking distance to whereever we wanted to go including the Louvre, Pompodiou Centre and Notre Dame Catherdral (under repair at the time of our visit). It is also walking distance to the Chatelet-les-Halles Metro station and a major Westfield Shopping Centre. As this is more an apartment style hotel, rooms are not serviced daily which was fine as we were able to get fresh towels from the linen room on Level 1. The hotel has a good coffee machine downstairs which was a good compromise to not having one in the apartment. There is also a token operated laundry On Level 1 where about €5 of tokens purchased at the front desk was suffient to wash and dry our clothes. 
We will stay here again if we are in Paris.

title: Fantastic location and a great price.
text: Paris is expensive so to find a hotel in the middle of Paris for such a great price was awesome. It is so close to the metro ( 1 minute walk) which allows you to get to just about anywhere you want. I should mention that there is an indefinite rail strike which has shut down most of the train lines, so getting around is much more difficult than usual. There are almost 700 restaurants within 0.5 km of the hotel, so you have plenty of choice when it comes to dining. The rooms also have their own kitchenette, microwave and fridge. They don't have house keeping unless you want to pay extra for it. I think it is done once a week if you stay for 6 days or more. This is one reason they can keep their prices down so I don't mind saving on the room and missing out on house keeping. There is also a laundry at the hotel. For 9 Euros you can get a a load a washing done as well as getting it dried. The staff are very helpful and it appears they can all speak a fair amount of English. I can certainly recommend staying at this hotel.

title: Great location and nice to have the kitchenette
text:
First, the good.  This is adjacent to a huge mall and a metro/RER station from which it is easy to get ANYWHERE really quickly.  There is an amazing boulangerie a half block away (to the right as you step out of the hotel).  Good fast food off to the left, easy walking to several museums and a wander through the marais.  Easy walk to ile de la cite.  Food available at a Monoprix in the huge mall.  (Don't go on Saturday afternoon - anywhere shopping!)  Also, a nice quick mart next door that is open late.  Very friendly and helpful staff.

Small room with comfortable twin beds pushed together.  Great closet space (two closets, two drawers, three giant shelves.)  Great cookware available and good washing up soap, hand cloths, etc.  Towels were fine but no washcloths.  (I brought my own)

The room is pretty small but well arranged and wifi worked very well.

Brunch is available though I never even checked it out.  I was told it was pretty plain Jane for 16E so I passed.  With all the good food available in Paris and a stocked kitchen, why?  

The negative:  small room and instructions for use of appliances hard to understand or unavailable.  Hot water in shower could run hot and cold.  Sort of comparable to a  Day's Inn with half the sized room.  
 I went through Ascott central to leave information about arrival time and combination of reservations, and apparently the instructions either did not get through of were unread, complicating my arrival.  There is generally only one person at the desk who speaks good English but of course, it's great when that person is available.  This is petty but the toilet paper was more like copy paper.  Maid did not resupply TP when room was serviced and when I called and asked for some, I was sent to a supply room to get it.  Bring your own shampoo and conditioner!  There is just that old soap on the wall and a non-functional conditioner.  

In sum, rooms are expensive in Paris and this is a small self service apartment that has a microwave, french press, small refrigerator with freezer, stove top, and dishwasher.  Plenty of cookware and glasses for two - but two people would be really bumping into each other in this room.  It is serviced only once per week unless you pay extra.  The lighting is really poor.  There are lots of lights but each is quite dim.  If I knew what sort of light bulbs to buy I'd have brought some with me, but it wasn't worth the effort to learn it and then find a place to buy one.  I'd stay here again.

title: Okay hotel in excellent location
text:
We originally booked this hotel as it had a small kitchen, so great for our 3 and 5 year old fussy eaters. The first room they gave us was not great. The bedroom was poorly designed with a huge book shelf as you walk in. A big safety problem for my 3 year old who likes to climb and jump! I asked the staff if we could change it and they were kind enough to do so. Apparently when i opted for the quieter side of the hotel we got that room. The second bedroom felt much more spacious on the 6th floor, lovely views. Also the front of the hotel and not noisy. Could have done with having some safety features on the balcony doors. We just made sure they were closed at all times. The decor is really outdated, the walls all bobbly wallpaper, sofa bed was really noisy every time you turn over, not too bad to sleep on. Our fridge broke over night so all the food we purchased was binned. 
As for the location, perfect. You could walk to most of the well known tourist destinations! Metro outside the hotel directly takes you to Disney, quick 30min journey. Lots of lovely cafe/restaurants near the hotel. Westfield shopping centre 1min away. Even a small grocery shop next to the hotel. 
Staff were very friendly and helpful.
Food at the restaurant is fine for adults but not much for the kids. 
Overall i’d say, if you like luxurious rooms, this hotel isn’t for you. If you just need a place to sleep while exploring Paris, it’s great.

title: Visiting Paris after a 25 year break
text: We are experienced travellers in our mid-sixties, and by the time we reached Paris midway through our European tour we needed a serviced apartment with laundry facilities. This hotel fit the bill perfectly with very good self-serve laundry mat facilities with endless clean towels. We had a Studio Apartment that was a good size with facilities to have our own self-catered breakfast sourced from the small market just around the corner. There is a large metro station 50-meters from the front door that has a “manned” service desk open in the mornings if you need help. There are a large variety of restaurants and a Westfields centre within 10-minutes walk. The hotel is a very an easy 10-minute walk from the Louvre. I’d recommend the Musee D’orsay if you already seen the Louvre. Buy your timed entry tickets on line before leaving home and book for an early start as it a popular place. Great value! The hotel staff are very good. Location and laundry facilities are its greatest attributes; it’s a very good hotel and we’d stay again.

title: Excellent location
text:
Visited Paris for a week, stayed here this time.  
Location is excellent, neighborhood well lit and safe.  We walked to the nearby restaurants in the early morning: many young people still walking about. There was some street noise but not something irritating.  A lot of shopping in the immediate neighborhood.
Check in was easy, room was ready for us early.  Staff was friendly and spoke perfect English.  
Our room was clean and everything worked well.  It was small in the way you expect rooms to be in Paris.  The bed was comfortable and the bathroom never ran out of hot water.  There is a tv in the room but we didn’t use it.  If you visit Paris to watch tv you are a madman.
Our room had a small kitchenette with a refrigerator (it was empty: there were no prepacked, ridiculously priced items in it).  There is weekly maid service.  On the first floor there is a room where you can get new towel, toiletries and sheets.   
We didn’t eat in the restaurant downstairs.  
The view from our room was very nice.
There is a metro stop very nearby

title: Great location, comfortable space for 2 adults
text:
We booked a long weekend in a deluxe studio, although I'm not sure they were any different to studios, just higher floors.

It was well equipped, so easy to make breakfast and snacks, we even cooked dinner on a couple of evenings. The kitchen area has a microwave/ grill, 2 electric rings and a dishwasher. there's plenty of pots and pans and a good supply of everything like bin bags and toilet paper! I particularly liked the fact you could help yourself to clean towels. 

The room was fine, although i didn't see the point of the weird chaise longue. It was nice to open the windows and watch the comings and goings in the square below. But there was no noise (apart from one night with kids in the corridor outside) and the blackout curtains worked well.

I wasn't sure about the area when I booked (we've stayed in the Marais before) but its really easy to get around.  On arrival from London on Eurostar, its one stop on the RER and a very short walk to the hotel. There's a lot of shops around so getting bread etc is easy EXCEPT Sunday mornings - I had quite a walk to find fresh bread.

If you want a cozy (ie tiny room) boutique Paris hotel its not for you. But if you want some space and to have the option of self catering its great. Recommend Monoprix for basics and Bastille Sunday market for fish and treats.

title: Good location!
text: This hotel is very centrally located and has the train station nearby.  It is a 10 minute walk to the Louvre which made it convenient for some tours we had booked through Viator.com at the Paris city vision office which is right across the street from the Louvre.  We stayed 6 nights at this hotel in 2 different rooms since the number in our party changed.   We had a 1 bedroom apartment which was spacious and later stayed in a studio. The rooms were clean and a good size.  The bathrooms do need some upgrading as they are showing wear. We had issues one morning when the fuse went out and we lost electricity but the staff did fix it the same day and when we came back from the tour all was fine.   There is no room service during short stays so you do need to pick up after yourself.  There was one rude staff member- Geoffrey who made it a bit difficult when we wanted to reserve a taxi and had some other concerns.  The remaining staff was very accommodating and we had no other issues during our stay other than the one electrical outage.  The lobby was clean and has coffee and water.  You are able to get fresh towels daily if you choose and that was very nice.   This hotel was comfortable and in a good location if you want central Paris.  Being Central it does have lots of restaurants and cafes nearby as well as a small grocery store next door which we found convenient for quick snacks.   You are next to a train station and will encounter all kinds of people, it is is a busy area.   I gave this hotel a 3 rating because of the need for refurbishing and the rude attendant. It is not a 5 star property but neither is the price.  It was very affordable and clean.

title: Clean, central location, near train and mall
text:
Day 1 getting there was a bit confusing.  Car cannot drop you off in front of hotel as front entrance is not near the road.  Only an issue on day one and last day trying to get a taxi/Uber with rolling your stuff to street corner.  

Putting that aside, the condo was a great location for the sub-train, right outside the building, but once down there it’s a bit intimidating and can easily get lost on the way back.  Remember exit # that will get u back to right exit closest to condo.  

Mall is right there, so can get anything and everything there even groceries.  Same for the traditional restaurants with outdoor seating.  Walk a little further away form the hotels and I think will get better food vs. the 5 page menu joints.  

Back to hotel; if I had one or 2 issues it was the tub; got clogged very easily.   And would be nice to have more washer dryers.  Other than that, for a week stay did the job.  Felt secure once in the hotel, outside depending on time of day and direction could be sketchy.  

Knowing what I know now, Would I choose this place again, yes.

title: Disappointing - nothing like its promotional photos... not 4 stars!
text:
We booked a one bedroom apartment following extensive research into what area to stay in Paris and hotels in the area. We chose Citadines Les Halles based on the photos on the website and its rating... how wrong we’re we! 

The room was nothing like the light, bright modern kitchenette room shown on the website! It was old, dark and dingy! The sofa bed didn’t fold up property resulting in the top cushions sliding off if you tried to sit on it. 

The bed was a joke! Two small (in width and length) singles pushed together and made up as completely separate beds! We are a couple and we booked a double bed! The first night was horrendous as the mattress on my bed was so old it was basically a hollow with no support or comfort (which you can even see on the photo!). To their credit they did change it when we complained. The room itself, not much bigger than the bed which resulted in the person sleeping by the wall having to climb out the end of the bed or over the other person to get out!

The cabinetry in the kitchen and bathroom was like something out of the 60’s... with damaged edges from being kicked and opened and closed over the decades and handles that have lost their chrome finish.

The bathroom was tiny and so dark I couldn’t do my makeup in front of the mirror! I had to stand by the windows. The shower was moldy and the basin needed a good scrub... or the basin was just old with surface damage! It was hard to tell. The towels were old and thin, not what Hu would expect to find in a self proclaimed 4 star location!

While there were lots of power points, there were no USB charging points! Unheard of in this day and age. The room was so hot we ended up sleeping with the window open. There was what looked like an air conditioning control, which we had set to the coldest setting and on high fan, but nothing happened!

There are a couple of positives, the staff, always friendly and helpful, the ‘comfort room’ where you can help yourself to fresh towels, lined etc, and there were lots of proper coat hangers! 

Overall, we made it work but if you want a romantic, holiday to remember for all the right reasons in Paris, stay somewhere else!

title: It is what it is!
text: This place is all about the location and not much else. The rooms are very small and a bit tired, the cafe is crap but you get what you pay for. This place is about 350E $500nz a night, You get a very small room, 2 ring hobb, microwave and fridge. No tea, coffe, salt or pepper, oil or any of the basics. The rooms are not serviced you must do that yourself. The same sort of thing in at home in NZ would be 60E/$120 a night. But this is  the heart of paris. Give the in house cafe,Olivier Stehly a big miss. I had a very poor breakfast there. There are over 600 cafes within .3 of a mile. Eat out. The hotel in on a large square with a beautiful old fountain that does not work and judging by the dead pigions lying in the bottom, has not worked for some time. There is a lot going on and a lot to see and do. After dark rats everywhere and homeless people sleeping everywhere. Some in tents, some on the ground in there own, or someone elses urine. There are a couple living right under our window. Popular with thousaands of young people day and night. Very vibrant. I would not be out and about late. However lots of heaverly armed police in squads of 4 or five patrol often. Lots of strange people shouting, yelling and talking to themselves at all hours. As I said this place is all about the location. Right in the heart of paris. A very exciting location. We were here to experience the city not the hotel. For us it was just a place to sleep. Yes I would come and stay again.

title: Security and service in a good location
text: This hotel is conveniently located for the Chalet–Les Halles metro line, with elevator access right outside the front door – great if you're laden with luggage. The area is lively but felt relatively safe (exercising reasonable caution a given). As a woman travelling alone, this was important and I was pleased to see that the hotel has swipe access for security. I booked a 6-night stay in a studio room (with bath) which was well equipped with all the amenities you'd need. The price included one clean but clients have access to the 'comfort cupboard' on the first floor which ensures that you're never without clean towels, shampoo, etc. The room was fairly quiet with the only disturbing noise coming from the desk chairs in neighbouring rooms – easy to fix with felt pads or earplugs! The hotel offers computer/printer access in the foyer as well as a 24/7 coffee machine, vending machine, newspapers and tourist information. The hotel reception was well staffed and I found the service friendly and professional.
