title: Great Staff and location
text: We arrived early, and were allowed into our room. Very lucky. We  had a renovated room, and it was lovely. Big bathroom, comfy bed, great coffee machine. We did not use the honor bar, too expensive. The concierge Zuhair, helped us every day. He drew out our walking routes to  the museums we wanted to see, gave restaurant suggestions for each area we would be in, and gave  us exact train directions to  the Palace of Versaille. The lobby is beautiful, and the bar tender friendly.The doorman was always pleasant, and works hard to hail you a cab. It is very hard to hail a cab on Champs Elysees. Stay here, the location is perfect, you can walk to Eiffel Tower (15 minutes)  and the Louve (30 minutes).  All the shopping is right there too!

title: Not a 5 star hotel by a long shot
text:
I am a lifetime Marriott Gold member so generally like their hotels  My rating reflects the “value,” ie the experience relative to the cost and self assessment  Marriott Champs Elysees refers to themselves as a 5 star hotel and charges ~$800 a night  The location is obviously fine and the rooms spacious and clean, the lobby beautiful.  The defects were as follows;

1  The concierge service was among the worst i have come across  One man, Zuhair, spent 20 minutes arranging for me to buy a ticket to the Army Museum for $20 ( plus $5 tip) when in fact the museum was free on Saturday and Sunday  He generally was curt as well, providing little advice as to the quality of said museum vs others  Leandre would not provide receipt for refund for Museum, forcing me to call front desk manager to do it  He also reserved an awful restaurant for dinner, and would not tell me how hard it would be in the morning to grab a taxi or uber (since Sunday is no car day starting 11am)  They were unhelpful and rude

2  The gym is ill -equipped The only stair master did not work  There is one non Peloton bike and a treadmill, along with a crappy set of weights, and no universal The technician could not fix the stair master 

3  It is a bit awkward to navigate the place  To go to gym one must go on 1st floor, take bridge over and then go down to basement  There are two elevator banks to separate room blocs, with poor demarcation as to which rooms go where Furthermore the elevators are finicky in allowing the room cards to activate floor selection  Being on floor 2, i often could not get it to work fast enough, forcing me to go to a higher floor and then come down 

4  The bell captains are unethical, mercenary.  One would not get a taxi for me so  I was forced to hail one   After getting into car, the bell man ran out to my driver and said he had called for someone else, trying to kick me out!!  The taxi driver said this was untrue and that these bellman do this to get 15% of the fare and/or a large tip from rider  

So more like a 2-3 star experience
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Old and outdated
text:
I have rated this hotel 3 stars because it has great location and good service. Other than that, there is nothing good I can write about. My husband is a Bonvoy Platinum Elite member so we have been to our fair share of Bonvoy hotels. This one, given how pricey it was (whether paying cash or points) is extremely outdated and lacks major amenities. 

The rooms we were given had disgusting old carpets with big stains. The room hasn’t been renovated probably since the 80’s or something by the looks of wear and tear of the furniture and the decor. Our room door lock was broken and wouldn’t close properly without a lot of hassle so we finally had to ask them to change the lock. I’m surprised the housekeeping wouldn’t share this details with the maintenance and we had to. Speaking of housekeeping, it was unpredictable whether they will refresh some things in the room or not - IF they didn’t forget our room. They forgot to clean our room 2 separate days, and we had to remind them. We would leave our There seems to be renovation going on by the sounds  of drilling that began at around 8 am or so and lasted the whole day till 5-6pm. I hope they are planning to update the rooms too.

title: Exceptional Service
text: My husband, grandson, and I recently returned from Paris where we stayed 3 nights at this hotel. We reserved a parlor suite to insure privacy for our teenage grandson. Not only was the two room suite ample in size, it also included a 2nd full bathroom. We were more than pleased with the amount of room the suite provided.  However, the most exceptional part of our visit was the care provided by the staff. Upon our arrival from the airport, I discovered I had left my carry-on that contained meds, jewelry, etc in the luggage area of CDG. Zuhair, the concierge, immediately began trying to contact the airport. He also filled out a lost baggage claim for us online and and continued to try to reach American Airlines.  At this point, his associate, Anjana, volunteered to go to the airport with my husband, on her own time, to look for the missing bag. Her help was invaluable due to the language barrier. After Anajana spoke to several airport employees explaining the situation, my bag was located!  In all of our travels we have never received such personal service. And this extended to all the staff members with whom we came in contact. Truly exceptional!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Serving past its prime
text:

For some reason the room thermostat only has +/-  dial and not a readout; despite cranking over to max plus, still no warm air. Coincidentally when checking in, another guest was making front desk note the room didn’t warm up either. 

Still conveniently located but area is getting much more run down. 

Hotel staff is friendly and the lobby cafe has a limited menu but quite tasty. The restaurant serves breakfast but didn’t try on this trip. 

With Marriott having so many chains, will likely stay at another property in the next visit.

title: Perfect location
text:
I typically try to stay here for business trips to Paris given the location and service I usually get. 

The staff is very attentive, treat you well, acknowledge any status you carry with Marriott Bonvoy and acquiesce to any request you make in advance or at the time of arrival. 

Breakfast is one of my favourite things about this property as it sets me up nicely for a busy day in the Paris office. 

The rooms are clean, comfortable, and generally nice. There's typically a good ambiance in the hotel too.

Value for money is questionable since prices fluctuate immensely given the location and city [there's always something happening in Paris that drives up the cost].
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Meh
text:
This is out second stay at this hotel so we knew what to expect but I was more disappointed this time around.  We had a larger room with two double beds and the carpets were dirty and the wind literally whistled through the windows.  In addition,  the shower regularly flooded unless you turned the pressure way down.

The breakfast buffet was good and everyone was kind and helpful but this is not a great hotel.  The location is the perk so if you are going to be out of the room all day like we were, you can live with the issues.  I used points or I would have been more upset.  

I will choose a different location next time.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great location, ok hotel for business trips
text: I stay at the Marriot when visiting Paris for business as my office is very close. Not sure I would opt to stay here if travelling for personal reasons, but definitely a good business hotel. Gym is a little underequipped but is serviceable. Decent room service menu but not spectacular bar/lounge in the lobby.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Beautiful place
text: beautiful place. We had an amazing experience visited this beautiful place for few days. We will come again for sure next year with our family. The atmosphere and the people are so beautiful too. recommended
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Spacious room in an airy and light filled hotel
text: Their location on the Champs-Élysées can’t be beat, near the metro, multiple Michelin star restaurants, Louis Vuitton, and several pharmacies with rapid COVID testing.  The rooms are centered around a large atrium with skylight which bathes the entire hotel in the Parisian natural light.  My wife also loved the scent in the hallways and after they cleaned the room, and we felt comfortable that COVID protocols were adhered to consistently.  The hotel was an excellent homebase for our first post pandemic vacation (5 nights) in France.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Overpriced, thin walls, uncomfortable beds
text: If you like hotels with the title issues, this is the one for you.  Also not well cleaned.  We did an experiment and left a piece of debris in the shower.  It wasn't cleaned.  The staff did superficial cleaning and tidying and that was it.  We actually had what looked like a blood stain on the carpet.  Worst Marriott property we have ever stayed in.  The only going for it is the location.  I guess that's what's driving the price.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: A wonderful stay at Marriott Champs Elysee
text:
We came here to celebrate our 30 years anniversary and we had a few snafus to start but ultimately we were situated. Our room faces the Paris skyline with a balcony and we love our room, we sat outside to enjoy the weather and views.
It was a special trip as my husband has never been to Paris, we haven’t traveled abroad in over 2 years from covid and it was a nog anniversary. The staff was lovely and were accommodating and kind in many ways. We only stay at Marriott hotels and this stay just reinforced our Marriott loyalty.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Don't stay here.
text: Room rate was $600....carpet was dirty and bathroom shower was disgusting.  Not the 5 star (room is like a 3 star) Marriott quality we were expecting.  Very disappointing.  Is on Champs Elysees, but still, don't stay here. Marilene at  reception was very nice at check in.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: A grande dame on the Champs-Elysées
text:
The Paris Marriott Champs Elysées hotel is located right in the middle of the action, in one of the busiest intersections of the city, and yet once you walk through the gilded iron gates, it feels secluded. The lobby is an impressive atrium with a glass dome and features the reception and concierge desks, on the opposite side a bar for an afternoon aperitif before navigating the throngs of people out on the avenue!

The hotel enjoys a privileged location in a historic building which once housed the Louis Vuitton atelier and warehouse. For the curious ones, when you stand in front of the building and look up, you can still see the LV name on the building. 

The check-in process was quite efficient, we were in our room in just a few minutes. Our room was facing a courtyard on the side of the building, please note there are many room types here, some which feature views into the atrium where the lobby is. We chose a Deluxe King Room for our stay. The rooms are quite spacious for Paris city-center standards, and it features a cozy seating area, desk, King bed, plenty of closet space. The bathroom was also quite big with both bath and separate shower stall, and featured a vast array of L'Occitane bath products! 

It's no secret - this is a hotel that requires a bit of a revamp soon, you will definitely miss modern amenities like usb ports. But to be honest the condition of the room was quite good, spotless and the temperature could be controlled quite easily. As we were celebrating a wedding anniversary, we were welcomed by an amazing display of amenities in the room, courtesy of the Guest Experience team. We were so thankful for this! delicious macaroons, wine and fruit with a personalized message. 

The bed was on the firm side, but then again I do enjoy that. Just please note if you prefer otherwise I'm sure the hotel would be able to accommodate upon request. There were several complimentary bottles of Evian in the room. Due to Covid procedures, prior to arrival I was notified that housekeeping service would only happen on every third day of our stay, however I was pleasantly surprised to see that my room had been serviced every day. it was amazing to come back to a refreshed room every afternoon. 

I did not use the restaurants or bars of the hotel so sadly can't comment on those. However, what shines here is the people, the amazing team that is willing to help out with any questions, recommendations or directions. A special thank you to Mr. Fabien Villoteau (Front Office Manager) whose expertise and knowledge of the city were invaluable, and also to Ms. Anjana Perera, she takes pride in the hotel and what they do as a team, making sure memorable experiences are at the forefront. We were in very good hands and would recommend the hotel to anyone looking to stay in the heart of Paris.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: well situated, very professional and friendly staff, great breakfast experience
text: The entrance is quite discreet right there on the Champs Elysees, half way between the Franklin Roosevelt and the George V metro stations.  There are two sections, one older section overlooking the Champs Elysees, I believe it used to be the old Louis Vuitton factory, and a newer section in the back.  We had a nice "Junior Suite" that was actually on 3 levels between two floors, great view right on the Champs Elysees, nice minibar, coffee machine, amenities, air conditioning worked great, tv with many channels, lots of pressure and quick hot water in the shower, great internet, just a great room experience for us.  The breakfast was really more than adequate, with omelets or eggs cooked to order, smoked salmon, hams, fresh fruit, all sorts of breads, etc etc.  The best part of the stay however was the staff.  Not one unfriendly person in the entire hotel for three days, quite a feat in Paris (sorry !) !!  Highly recommended if you are looking to visit that area of Paris.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Dirty Carpet Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel
text: September 2021 - Was given a room with dirty, stained carpet.  Asked for a clean room and this carpet was dirtier and more stained than the last.  Waiting hours for them to find another room and the carpets were also stained but we couldn't wait any longer.  They said the hotel was supposed to be remodeled but cancelled this because of Covid.  This is an owner/management decision to steam clean the carpets.  The carpets were dirtier than a motel 6 or a 1 star hotel.  Shameful.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great Hotel!! Excellent Location!! Superb Customer Service!!!!
text: My Daughter and I arrived to this beautiful property were the Staff were AMAZING!!! everyone made you feel at home and went above and beyond the call all duty to assist with whatever was needed, wether was food, or reservation to see some attractions. The room was always clean and tidy. And the location was Excellent, very close to everything. I have stayed at this property before, and every time I come here I feel I belong in Paris. If this is your first time in Paris give this Hotel a chance, you will not be disappointed.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Dining is an issue.
text: This hotel has an excellent location. And rooms are comfortable and clean. However, I still can not recommend this hotel for a family holiday.   There is “at your service” button on the phone but it is always busy. There is no proper dining hall. They use the remote corner of the lobby as a restaurant for lunch and dinner. The tables are also very small lobby tables rather than proper dinner tables. It is hard to fit all the orders on one table. May be because it is too far away from the kitchen food comes very late. In order not to wait any longer at this squeezed tables we decided to have our deserts at our room. We ordered lava cakes from the room service it did not arrive in 1 hour then we had to cancel since children had to go to sleep.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great hotel, ideal location, wonderful staff!
text:
Excellent location convenient to get to all important touristy sites within a 10-15 euro taxi.  Very elegant foyer and bar open till 11 pm. Good sized rooms for the location. We got a very warm reception. The front desk staff are really outstanding. They all speak English. Great bellhop/ concierge. Very tight security. Wonderful breakfast buffet. Everyone here is nice, completely the opposite of our previous (pre pandemic) Parisian experience. They are bursting with happiness to have tourists back.

Some exceptionally standout associates who made our stay truly remarkable and made treasured memories for the family were: 

Sabrina W.: manager, wonderful and friendly: arranged and personalized everything 

Myra dasouza: wonderful lady at the front desk. She is  just the nicest, kindest and most helpful person you will meet in Paris! Helped us with room, advice and always met us with a smile!!

Fabrice and Ali the bellhops/ Concierges helped us and got our luggage to the room ASAP on the first day, got us taxis during the day and got our luggage into a taxi the last day: Great service!

Anna: simply outstanding  Maitre de in the restaurant greeted us with a big smile and made sure we were comfortably seated at breakfast every morning.

Pauline the hard working, sweet and smiling waitress. Thank you for your kind attention to all your guests, we noticed how hard you and all your fellow waiters were working!!

In short: amazing stay, cannot recommend highly enough, we will return!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Housekeeping service not up
text:
Arrived at the hotel at approximately 15:30 and was told the room was not ready but the cleaning team was in the room preparing it for us.  After nearly one hour, I spoke with reception and was told that a supervisor was inspecting the room and it would be ready shortly.  We thought “wow, this room is going to be impeccably clean” but were we ever wrong.  After a nearly 90 minute wait we received our keys and when we entered the room we found a dirty cloth on the furniture and a previous guest’s dirty clothing on the floor.  I firmly believe that we were lied to as the room was obviously not inspected and never have I seen a room take 90 minutes to clean.

I asked the concierge team to have a manager call us which they did quite promptly but the result was lackluster to say the least.  We have always enjoyed staying at Marriott properties but this time has been different.  The manager said he would speak with the housekeeping team to sort out the issue but that was the extend of the goodwill.  

As we used a significant amount of Marriott Bonvoy points plus cash to stay here, we were disappointed that no goodwill gesture was made by management to correct the shortcomings.  Additionally, I messaged the hotel personnel using the Marriott app and have not been responded to.  At this point we have determined that the hotel management is not bothered with customer satisfaction and we are going to enjoy our time in Paris despite the poor service.

On a positive note, the hotel is perfectly situated and within walking distance to many of Paris’ attractions.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Location vs. Rooms
text:
I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. The common areas are lovely, lobby, restaurants, etc. It's also in one of the most prime location in Paris. In the evening, you feel comfortable as there are doormen that let you in and out of the building. Further, staff are very, very nice and try to be as accommodating as possible. Oh, and the lobby bar is fantastic!

The only big issue is most of the rooms are in desperate need of a revamp. Our first room had stained carpet, walls, and window drapery. We pointed this out to the Front Desk immediately and housekeeping was sent. The housekeeper mentioned that there was not really much that could be done and that many rooms are in need of an upgrade/update. As a Bonvoy Gold Member, rooms like that would have never been up for sale here in the US. I am fine with 'worn,' but this was terrible. We were then moved to a Suite for a hefty upgrade charge. It was much nicer, but significantly more expensive. Room views at this hotel are drastically different, as well. One side of the hotel faces the front street, the other side faces the Paris skyline, and other rooms are 'interior' with limited views of the atrium.

Overall, I would suggest this hotel, but choose your room wisely.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: This isn’t a bad choice you can’t afford Four Seasons or
text: The hotel location is very convenient, it’s just on the Champs-Elysées, the hotel service is very good, the breakfast is also great, but very pricey. Love the toiletries in the room. They are all famous brands, the service is kind and you can come again. The general facilities of the hotel are old. Overall it’s still pretty good for business and family travellers.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Perfect Selection
text:
I was guessing which hotel to stay in Paris till I decided to stay at this hotel.
It is really fantastic. Starting from reception, the ladies were so amazing and tried to help as much as possible.

In addition, the roooms are very clean and the room service correspond fast.

Moreover, the hotel has best location; it is located in the nicest street and all attractions can be reached by walking.

Thanks a lot.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Convenient
text:
Close to the Eiffel tower and other tourist attractions. Restaurant was good.
Rooms were clean but not prestige. 
Service was great. 
Price was right !!!!!!!!!
I would go back there any time 
Watch out for cabs in front, they will try to overcharge you to take you places. 
Walk a block before getting into a cab.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Christmas in Paris
text: This was a very nice hotel in an amazing location in Paris just down from the Arch d’triumph and many other amazing sites and landmarks. We went during the riots but had no issues. We stayed a number of days and had two rooms. One was facing Champs Elysees which was nice but I decided it wasn’t preferable. The noise was to be expected but not too bad...didn’t keep us from sleeping. There was a strange upstairs area in this suite which was useless and some stairs down to the bathroom which I tripped down several times. After leaving for the weekend and returning, I enjoyed a regular, quiet, comfortable interior room much more. Very expensive hotel but that’s expected given the brand and location.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Spectacular Hotel
text: Honestly, I am reading some of these other reviews and wondering if they have the right hotel. First off, the location is bar-none. You are on the Champs Elysee. Second, we found the staff to be extremely helpful and friendly. After a long flight from the U.S. arriving around 9 am, they comped up breakfast and got us checked into our room, which was rather large by European standards, and nothing “outdated”/worn except for maybe the carpet in a few places.  We got free breakfast during our stay given my husband’s Titanium Platinum status and it was pretty amazing. All the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The entire experience was just great. So ignore the whiners.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Warm Welcome!
text:
I am a lifetime Bonvoy Titanium member obtaining regularly 100 nights per year at Bonvoy properties across the globe.  We arrived this morning at the Marriott Champs Elysees, and the front desk manager, Remy, gave us a very pleasant warm welcome.  Our room wasn’t ready yet, as we had arrived at 10:15 from the airport.  Remy made us feel right at home, and escorted us down to the breakfast room where we could relax and have coffee and a late breakfast (They serve until 11:00.).  His warm welcome really lifted our spirits after a long over night flight and a journey into the city.  During breakfast Remy came down to let us know that the room was ready.  He really took pride in having it ready for us in short order.  We were so impressed with how all the staff have been so welcoming to us.  
Our room is comfortable and spacious.  It is nice to come back after a long day of sightseeing to a perfect, central location. We are really looking forward to our next five days at the Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: A perfect location with great service
text: First off as a titanium status for Marriot group and lifetime Platinum member I really care about the details and service towards its members , 1st location , perfectly situated in the middle of the Champs Elysees , and close to RER A and Line 1, so extremely easy to get around Paris , 2 a very big thank to Remy and his team , from check in and to even some issues that I had , he was extremely helpful and quick to respond , the room he arranged and the little touches really made my stay feel special , the rooms are a Bit dated but very clean , the breakfast was great , their service truly made my stay feel special and appreciate everything from the team
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Location Location Location
text:
Located in the heart of the shopping belt, its a great spot for all luxury shopping needs. There's also a supermarket nearby for snacks.

The team is friendly and welcoming. Had a good chat with the front office team at check in and check out. 

It's a old building, and signs of aging can seen at room walkways and room. Room is spacious and comfortable, and great that shower amenties is l'occitane.

Would come back again if the rates are right!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Always a Pleasure to See the Marriott Doorman
text:
It was always a treat to see the Marriott doorman as you exit the hustle and bustle of the Chanps Elysees to an oasis of quiet. 

Service was very good. I really enjoyed the turndown treats, especially the brownies. Order the waffles at the breakfast buffet - outstanding. 

On the downside - the room needed to be inspected and touched up. The desk was missing a handle. Many pieces of furniture had noticeable scratches. Needed CNN channel.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Useless
text:
Twice now housekeeping didn’t clean or even remove dirty dishes and bins. No turndown service. Phone not working. Upgrade assured didn’t come through and room like a dog box. Air conditioning useless. Breakfast chef can’t speak English and stuffing up orders left right and centre. Raw fried eggs. LITERALLY! I’ve
had a great experience in the past. 

Never again!! Never.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Unauthorized Charges on my card
text:
I had two reservations made for the following:
- 27 Dec till 28 Dec for Parlor Suite
- 28 Dec till 31 Dec for Family Room

Upon checked in, I was offered to change the Parlor Suite to Family Room instead for easy staying so I don’t need to move my belongings on 28 Dec. I thought thag will be wonderful and therefore I agreed.

When entering the Family Room, it was not as my expectation, the carpet very smelly and the worst thing was the water pressure was very low so it was not pleasant at all to stay in that room.

Without even taking a bath, I asked to be moved to a higher room category. Unfortunately since they’re fully booked, so they don’t have other room available and even the Parlor Suite which was booked earlier was not available anymore. 

I appreciated the response from the Front Desk Team who did whatever they could to ensure I continued to stay that night. But since I was not comfortable anymore so I moved directly at 12am in the morning to Park Hyatt since they’re happened to have availability on their Diplomatic Suite.

Again, I appreciated the Front Desk staff at that time who said will waive the room charge for that night and will cancel the reservation with no extra charge. They appologize and helped me to move my belongings. I was very pleased.

However, few days after receiving my credit card bills, I just realized that they have took 2 deposits upon checked in, one at Euro 8,140 and second at Euro 3,650.

What was odd is for the 1st one, the room rate for family room is only Euro 799/night. Even if they took for the whole stay, it should be Euro 3,995 without incidental. How could they took Euro 8,140? 

Another worst thing is when checking my credit card bill, it was not a block as deposit but it’s being CHARGED. I called my bank, they said it has been collected by the hotel and now it being collected to me.

Dear Paris Marriott, how could you took 2 times deposit and now even you charge your guest which was never stayed in your hotel???

Now I can not use my card and even I have the credit bill to pay.

I have called the Front Desk, Global Marriott Team and waiting for your answer. And yes I am Marriott Bonvoy Elite member.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent personnel and locale, but REALLY BAD CONDITIONS AND FOOD
text:
We have been Marriott Bonvoy members for a long time, and use Marriott frequently in the US and overseas. We spent 4 nights there over New Years. Our room had not been adequately cleaned for a long time. There were/are dirt spots (at least 7) all over the carpet. The rug in the room where the front desk is situated was also multi-spotted. NOT an encouraging matter. Our son & daughter-in-laws room was NOT CLEANED ONCE while they were there. This is inexcusable; we will NOT STAY at this hotel again. The toilet in our bathroom had to be flushed MULTIPLE TIMES in order to get rid of materials and water in the bowl. NOT GOOD. Hotel needs a physical UPDATE to bring up to 2019/20 standards!

The staff were pleasant and articulate in both French & English. But apparently those responsible for keeping the place clean are less qualified.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: 5-Star Hotel on Ave des Champs Elysees (8th Arr)
text:
My husband and I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights on our honeymoon, and here is the review.

The staff was absolutely friendly and helpful. We checked in around 9:30AM, but there was no room available yet. Ms Anjana (I might have misspelled her name) at the Front Desk greeted me with Platinum member refreshments (2 bottles of water, towels and a little snacks), and told me to go eat breakfast at the restaurant. She said she would personally call me as soon S a room is available. We were able to settled down for 1-1/2 hours and then voila, a room was available around noon. It was so nice because we didn’t get much of sleep and was at the airport by 3am, so we definitely needed the rest.

The room was a lobby view room (no windows looking outside the building). We closed the curtains whenever we were in the room, so nobody from the lobby can look up right into our room (on 3rd floor, visible to the people in the lobby). It was spacious and had all the amenities one need - from hot water kettle to robes to nice L’Occitane bathroom amenities.

Breakfast was good. There were cold and hot food. The staff was super friendly and helpful too. There was also free coffee by the second set of elevators in the morning (diagonally across from the business center).

We went to The Concierge at 6PM Fri and he was able to book us a 1:30PM skip-the-line tickets @ the Louvre the next day. Amazing on a such short notice.

When we went it was Christmas time, so interior was very beautifully decorated with trees and lights.

Overall we loved this hotel. They made our honeymoon lodging a memorable one.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great location, rooms in line with expectation
text:
The location of the hotel is really great and the hall and common areas are of good quality. 
The room is in line with expectation for an hotel of this level, although they are not fancy or particularly sophisticated. 
The bathroom is probably not at the level I expected: no dedicated shower, but only one inside the bath, and with the pole holding the shower that was falling down when I touched it by mistake. 
Overall a good experience, but not the most modern hotel you can find around...
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great Location, Luxurious Accommodations
text: My husband and I stayed here for a night on our way from Toulouse to Miami. It’s a five star hotel. From the staff’s welcome, to the well appointed and comfortable room, to the steep prices, and excellent location, from the designer shopping, and the landmarks that are only a Metro ride away...this hotel has it all. I would stay here again and again.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Hospitable and well located Marriott
text: Stayed at the Marriott, Champs Elysees for 4 nights to attend to business meetings in Paris. Entrance to the hotel is visually shielded from the main road by the hotel's restaurant and is separated from the road by a bicycle path and a deep pedestrian side walk. However, we were spotted by the doorman who came out to assist with bags and direction. Entrance to the hotel's lobby required an escalator ride (up but not down); lobby is nicely furnished and visually pleasant (calming). Check-in required a short wait but I was processed efficiently and professionally. Staff throughout the premises were attentive, polite and helpful when tasked. Assigned room (on the top floor) looked into the lobby and across from other rooms; consequently, the curtains had to be drawn for much of my stay at the hotel. Room was of a good size (by Paris standards) and nicely furbished. However, it was a little dated and needing of an update. As the room's windows were sealed and the hotel had already switched to heating, the room's air was somewhat stale and arguably uncomfortable (for this client). Everything else worked but the wifi, which was down the entire 4 days of my stay (except for a few hours) - this is unacceptable and the hotel should work to either rectify or provide a discount due to the inconvenience. Restaurant (breakfast) at the back of the hotel was a buffet - the food was varied but simple fare (it could do with additional flavoring). Despite my negative experiences, I am still rating the hotel highly - mainly because of its location and staff. The above inconveniences are "fixable" and the Marriott should work to address as best they can.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Celebrating 50 birthday in Paris
text:
Thank you to the entire staff at the Marriott! The Concierge was amazing and started helpkng my over a month before my arrival and continued to help ensure that this was truly a special weekend..from the breakfast.wine or macaroons in my room THANK YOU!!!
I will be back soon!!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent Location
text:
This hotel was very comfortable and good for a mini family of 3 in a 2 double bed room.  Air conditioning worked well.  We had a room with opening windows which was great.  The location is 5 star, really the best ever for access to all the sites of Paris, shopping, convenience, metro access, walking, taxis, bikes and scooters, really good restaurants, etc... just the beat location ever!  

The hotel service was amazing.  Friendly staff go out of their way to make your stay as perfect as they can help.  We actually changed rooms twice till we were given the perfect room for 4 nights.

While the lobby was nice, the amenities were soso and the hotel was dated.  It could use room renos like in shower tiles and new carpeting.  The exercise room was not great for a 5 star hotel.  The air was too hot with no ability to fan or air condition, the equipment was dated, the room was too small for stretching Nd floor exercises.  The stretch mats were old and not very good.  Basically it needs a revamp and better air circulation.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: S.Leigh
text: The location was in a central tourist area near the Arc de Triomphe. The service was great, but our room was dated and the ceiling had a leak in the bathroom. When we asked for a new room, the staff graciously moved us.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great for first time visitors to Paris!
text: Good location - easy to get in and out - security is great - the lobby bar attendants are wonderful - great assortment of food and snacks in the lobby - hotel rooms are small, as all are in Europe - the hotel Is clean and the staff is very nice - the concierge is extremely accommodating.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Incredibly noisy
text: So disappointed. Staff was not particularly friendly. Woken up two nights in a row at 3:00 in the morning because of yelling outside by people who were leaving clubs. Noise carried on for three hours.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Simply superb!
text: Thank you Marriott Champs-Élysées for making our short trip extremely memorable. Every person we encountered was warm and helpful. The room itself was everything we expected. The housekeeping was on point. Especially enjoyed the little treats they left for us every evening after the daily turn down service. The location ofcourse is perfect. I am so glad we chose to stay at this property. Will definitely be recommending it to everyone who’s travelling to Paris!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Poor Facilities
text: For a 5 star hotel it has very poor facilities from the gym, to the breakfast restaurant, etc. Its. 7 star hotel in terms of location however the services and facilities will hardly make 3 stars. I believe its not worth the rating and the prices the hotel charges simply because of the location
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing
text:
We had a perfect stay there! Many thanks for front Office staff!!! Very helpful staff in all hotel and very clean and comfortable rooms! Very good location!
We had a room with a nice view and balcony.
Hope will be back soon!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Just OK
text: For a top rated hotel in a prime location, it's a little disappointing. The lounge area is lovely and open, but our experience wasn't top notch. Our room wasn't ready and I feel they forgot about us and gave us a room that was reserved for overnight staff or something. The room had stained carpet and matted down.  I will say the bathroom was quite large for European standards.  The location can't be beat, so if you want to be right in the heart of things, I'd definitely recommend.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Amazing stay at Marriott Champs Elysees!
text:
Stayed at Marriott Champs Elysees for two nights. The bedroom was very spacious and with amazing view- the terrace was lovely!

We were 2 adults. Beds are very comfortable, shower with plenty of amenities! 

Breakfast was very very good! 

The reason I decided to choose this Hotel was its location. It's in the centre with everything close to it. You can walk easily or get a metro. 

Louise from the communications department was lovely and always there if we needed something.

Really recommend this Hotel!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Missing valuables
text:
My family and I stayed at the this Marriott for our first trip to Paris. The hotel was terribly expensive for what we received, but I had expected this knowing we were in a large European city. However, our disappointment came in losing some cash and a pair of earrings from our room. Clearly, allowing this to happen was on us since the hotel had made a room safe available, and we had failed to use it. However, this is not an inexpensive hotel, and I would expect slightly better precautions taken in who the hotel hires for staff. I travel a lot for work and have Titanium Elite status. Not once have I had my possessions stolen in a Marriott hotel...until now. Possibly I've been lucky, or possibly this hotel is simply a 2 star hotel disguised as a high-end experience.
I should highlight that I reported the problem in Marriott's post visit survey, and received a note from someone at the hotel expressing concern, indicating that they would review the situation with their staff and offering their services if I should ever stay at this hotel in the future. In other words a faux sorry guaranteeing no follow-up.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Excellent Staff and Service in the Heart of Paris
text: Stayed 6 nights in this Marriott that is located on the Champs Elysees and believe that my wife and I could not have had a better hotel for our first visit to the City of Lights!  Located just a 10 minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe and within short travel distances to major Paris attraction, excellent restaurants and shopping the staff made us feel right at home from our arrival through the entire stay.  our room was well appointed for European standards, had numerous outlets to recharge our multiple digital phones. computers and other devices.  There is a lobby bar and Atrium eating area in addition to the M-Bistro restaurant for lunch, afternoon or evening snacks. Morning coffee is always ready by the lobby floor elevators by 6AM and breakfast in the restaurant is served until 10.  If there are any questions, the front staff or Concierge can address in multiple languages including English.  If you don't know your way around Paris, this hotel is a good place to start your visit.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Location, location
text: This hotel was just average, nothing to brag about. The location is great. It”s right smack in the middle of Champs Elysees. The air freshener running in the hallways/other areas all day were a bit much for my liking but I guess, the smell of the old building needed it. Exceptional staff. The staff makes this place great. Everyone on the staff was pleasant. I wish we remembered the young lady name who checked us in 2 different rooms because she deserves a gold star.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Too expensive for what you get
text: I have stayed in Paris in the 8th Arrondissement near the Champs Elysees many times before and I can honestly say this Marriott is not a good value for the price they charge.  Also, the hotel rooms are not great.  Very old school and run down compared to other similar category hotels.   The only positives with this hotel is the location.  Also, the hotel lobby is charming.  That's all.  Will not be going back.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Beautiful, Well Appointed hotel in the heart of it all!
text: Hotel was very nice, only steps from the Arc and less than a 5 minute Uber ride from the Eiffel Tower! In the heart of shopping, small convenience stores nearby, subway access. But the staff made the difference. They are welcoming and accommodating. The manager even stopped to introduce himself as he was leaving for the day. It made our brief stay in Paris very pleasant. Will definitely be back! (Photos are views from the front hotel entrance and street view of Arc from curb in front of hotel)
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Mixed bag
text:
Pluses

1) Absolutely excellent location - slap, bang in the middle of the Champs Élysées, if you like that sort of thing
2) Lobby floor is very charming
3) Staff are polite 

Minuses

1) The hotel has been neglected by its owners - water leaks from the ceiling, no warm water for the shower, fitness centre is far too inadequate. It’s not Marriott’s fault. 
2) Breakfast buffet is extraordinarily expensive and surprisingly limited
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: totally dissapointed
text: We've been this week three days, after our trip to London and I can't be more disappointed.Dirty room, we had to claim three times until they came to clean and very rude the cleaner. we expected more.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Don't stay here if you are expcting to escape rowdy kids
text:
To start, I do want to give a big shout-out to Jose who has been helping us from behind the bar and with dinner in the restaurant. If it weren't for him, this would be a giant one-star review. He has been the saving grace.

The night manager (I think) who helped us check in the first day and was extremely pleasant every time we saw him was great as well.

Moving on the the problem, this place is over-run by extremely rowdy, loud and obnoxious kids. And we were here for a week, and it was a problem EVERY SINGLE DAY.

Kids obnoxiously banging on the piano (apparently, it is allowed for kids to bang on the piano for 10-15 minutes before being asked to stop is the policy. If they have talent, they can play as long as they want, but "talent" is subjective) kids running around, yelling, and it echoing all through the lobby, kids watching videos on their ipads on full blast, kids running around to the point where you have no clue who the parents are, and this happens EVERY SINGLE DAY. Not exaggerating.

I usually blame it on the parents for not disciplining, hushing, and controlling their kids, but when it is as bad as it has been here, you have to blame management for not controlling the situation.

Other people who are paying $400/night do NOT want to listen to obnoxious kids every day. They are punishing the others by accommodating they few families whose kids make more noise than any 30 adults combined.

And, if you are a parent who travels with your kids, please be mindful of others who share public space with you, and ask your kids to sit down, be respectful, and not yell when there are others trying to enjoy their time. In every public space, especially high end places. Please. 

Completely unacceptable for a nice high end hotel. Management, time to step up.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Hotel is average, but location is great!
text:
Don't get me wrong, the hotel was nice and we are loyal Marriott members.  But we did expect a lot from this hotel being that it does have a very high ranking on the list of hotels in the immediate area. The room looked old, the carpet was worn badly, the handle on our balcony door was broken, there were red droplets of something on our sheets and the shower drain seemed to be clogged because the water didn't drain fast enough and overflowed on the floor.  We overlooked a lot of this because we were only in town for a 36 hour layover.  
There is a nicely decorated lobby.  The breakfast buffet seemed decent, but we really didn't get a chance to see many of the other amenities.
The location is why you stay at this hotel (and also is what makes it expensive).  It is on the Champs-Elysées, 1 km from the Arc de Triomphe and directly in the midst of shops restaurants and people watching.
I would have to say that it was not easy to find, so you really have to look for the street number.
The tour buses pass directly in front of the hotel, although the stop for them is near the Arc de Triomphe.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Good hotel well located for a solo business traveller
text:
I work in Paris a lot and have started staying here instead of another hotel owned by the same chain. 

I find the hotel less pretentious and feel safer as a solo traveller as it is located on the Main Street.

Some of the rooms have a great view and considering they are on the Main Street they are still quiet. Staff are friendly and breakfast is good.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel
text: When walking on the Champs-Elysées you might pass it by since the entrance isn’t that big but once you come in you will be flabbergasted by all what’s inside. A wonderful hotel calm and well appointed, very friendly staff and great room, at least ours is. Recommend to everyone. Love the Marriott beds.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Location with sacrifices
text: The location is awesome and I must say the women who checked us in was lovely. The hotel is old and in need of renovations. The water pressure is not great and the shower needs some TLC. The breakfast buffet is nice.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Tour de France fun!
text: We were surprised that the Tour ended right in front on our one night stopover. Other than walking 3 blocks from our taxi all inside was good. Friendly checkin and bellmen and a complete buffet breakfast. Yes the carpets should be replaced but the room and bath were nice and we would happily return.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Poor, not worth the price
text:
We only took this hotel because we wanted to see the 14th of July parade - so the location is right on the Chmaps Elysees. 
The hotel basically uses its location to make you pay an exorbitant price - while the rooms are old and and sadly decorated. The breakfast buffet is nothing interesting at honestly quite basic. 
And while we left our room the entire day - we came back to a bed that wasn’t made and an overflowing bin... but a piece of chocolate on the desk. So they saw the state of the room, and just decided to “carry on”. Service is slow and inattentive. 

Definitely won’t be coming back and the Champs Élysées are doesn’t have nice restaurants or great shopping anyway ... so even location wise, not interesting.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Warm, Friendly Hospitality
text: The staff at this hotel are some of the most helpful and friendly that I have ever encountered.  They are eager to do whatever they can to make your stay pleasant and memorable.  Everyone from the front desk to the restaurant hostess gives the impression that you and your family are valued customers.  This was our fourth stay, and each stay was better than the previous one!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Perfect Location
text: This hotel is exactly where you want to be.  Close to everything, and all the taxis know where it is.  The concierge does an excellent job on excursions and restaurant reservations.  We stayed here for the 100th Tour de France and return as often as we can.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Great Location - Wonderful Service
text:
The staff are very attentive and good English speakers.  The hotel is located a few blocks from L'Arc De Triomphe.  If you stand in front and look left - there it is!  The rooms are comfortable and there is a nice bar located on the Champs Elysees which is great for a glass of wine and people watching.

The hotel is expensive, but you are in Paris.   Easy walk to Metro and good access to cabs.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: The restaurant outside on the Champs-Elysées
text:
It is a great place to be even if you are not a customer if the hotel, service is perfect, food is good ans you really feel welcome. It is very clean, ans well located.
Take a break, enjoy the pleasure to be at une of the best location un Paris
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Never ever again
text:
This was a last minute booking 
All my regular places fully booked and I did not want to go to a three star place.
As I stayed in Marriotts in London over 50 times I thought to accept a rate of 1200 per night ( the first and last time ever) should give me a very very decent room.
What a mistake I made. The escalator to the reception on the first floor was out of order.
Everyone entering or leaving had to use the same staircase with a very dirty carpet. That was a warning ....
Checking in was troublesome - the girl asked my passport 3 tines and I responded three times I have my ID which is sufficient to fly with in Europe ...so surely enough to check in with.
She became a bit more friendly when she saw I was a Marriott regular.
The lobby area looked just ok - nothing chic or stylish whereas the atrium space is an eye catcher on its own.
There was too much going on in that space - bar- lounge-check in etc.
Than there was a second sign that i should have picked up....there was no Executive lounge in this hotel as the building was too old.... according to the receptionist.
Anyway up to the room......
When i walked in i was speechless But even more shocked. How on earth does a respected hotel chain dare to charge more than 1200 euro for a room like this... there is  a maximum amount you can charge not determined by the fact you sell the last available room in Paris but by the product you sell.
I travel for work for more than 30 years but never I experienced this.
The room was so small that there was no place for two bedside tables.... the carpet so dirty I would not allow my dog to sleep on it... the furniture so outdated that even a recycle shop would refuse it. Actually they should have binned it as the items were to big for the room.
At least the bed linen looked white but I had not the guts to lift the sheets to check the mattress.
The bathroom so small that you block the door when using the toilet.
This is steeling money from your guests - not charging them for an overnight stay.
I went down to talk to the duty manager to explain why I felt so maltreated .... all what came out was a deafening silence.
For sure a travel experience which will stick to my memory for a long time. ( for all the wrong reasons ) 
Never again .
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Still very good!
text: Back one year later... that must say something!  This location simply cannot be beaten, and we now had experience at this property so our expectations were totally in line.  We had a wonderful stay, given the same room as before - as we had requested, and enjoyed Happy Hour in the Atrium every evening after happy French Open days in Paris.  We would go back again!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Perfect Location
text:
The only adversity was getting to the hotel on a Sunday when the Champs is closed to vehicles.   Stopped by police and baggage opened and inspected on the street but that is our current world and doesn't reflect on the hotel. 

The location of the hotel is unbeatable for tourists.  The walks to the Eiffel Tower, River boats, Arc de Triumph etc are all short.  The hotel is central to many fine shops and restaurants although the good restaurants are off the busy Champs. 

The rooms are very and clean and housekeeping was very attentive.  The desk and restaurant staff were excellent and very helpful.  

Very nice property.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Location
text:
This one of nicest locations on the iconic Paris strip. 
Service at check in was excellent, service staff to get ice to your room was a bit slow, but always delivered with a smile. 
The location is central to all the things you want to do in Paris, the Arc, Louvre, Palaces, Napoleons tomb, are all just a short walk away. 
For longer trips, take the Metro, it’s right outside the door. 
Supermarket called Monoprix is a short walk away. 
Security and helpful desk and bag staff are excellent as well. 
Not sure why the front escalator is not fixed yet, but it is very central location for all your needs.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Mixed Emotions
text:
Great wait staff at the outdoor cafe!! Well done Eponine and Stephan!!!

Also very attentive bellmen. Nice job. 

As for the residential portion of the stay, there were way too many problems:
- Very dirty carpet in the room. Yuck. 
- Flat-out absence of maid service one day!!  They just didn’t clean the room... Really?
- Terrible room service... 1 hour wait, poor quality, high price!
- A friendly concierge, but one that simply did not follow through on his commitment to obtain transportation to CDG. (An easy one).
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Poor Breakfast & Unattentive Stadd
text:
Today we had our first breakfast and we came in at the restaurant at 9am. Nobody seem to want to refill the food anymore!!! When I ask one of the crew as to where the bacon is because the signage says so, the manager just simply said “no more bacon for today”.

I am like? Why? No more refill at that early? Are you like closing at 9:01 am!

Very poor breakfast! Very little choice of food given it is Marriott Hotel! I have been to a lot of Marriott Hotels in UAE but we have never seen this poor kind of breakfast serving!!!

We are seated already for more that 15 mins and nobody even offer coffee from the staff. They are very unattentive and nobody seems to care at all!!!

If i only knew this is how they do breakfast here, I should have just go outside and eat from one of the restaurants in Champ Elysees!

Room are clean and comfy but small!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Awesome Hotel in the heart of the action
text:
The title says it all.  Great rooms, great staff, great location!  Stayed here on rewards points with my wife and son.  The hotel is on the Champs Elysee, a short walk to the Arc de Tromphe, and the Hop-on-Hop-off bus tour stop.  

Omar, one of the staff at the front desk/concierge desk dished out great restaurant recommendations time after time.  The door staff and security also pointed us in the right direction when we were looking for a drug and grocery store.  

I would return to this hotel next time we're in Paris.
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Safe and secure location
text:
One of our favorite hotels in Paris but we were a bit concerned about security during the "yellow vest" protests. Entire length of Champs-Elysees was on alert following destructive protests the weekend before we arrived, especially hotels but also shops and restaurants. We arrived on a Thursday, early afternoon, and found that there was always at least 1 or more security personnel at the front door. Wonderful welcome at the front desk, even though room was not yet ready - Marriott Elite status certainly helps; wonderful breakfast buffet included for every day of our stay (menu price 44Euro/person). 

Not only had daily breakfast here but also enjoyed Happy Hour in the Atrium Bar (5-7PM daily) and had an early dinner in the bar on one evening that we were attending a nearby concert. The concierge made dinner reservations for us on another night, where we were treated to complimentary champagne as a courtesy to Marriott guests.

The hotel and the city of Paris was prepared on the Saturday of our stay - Champs-Elysees was shut down, police vans lined the street and police patrols with dogs were visible everywhere. No trouble at all, protestors moved to new location on the West Bank. But they were prepared.

Still a great place to stay - location, staff & service!
name: Paris Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel

title: Disappointing experience with no response
text:
Overall this hotel was disappointing and not a five star experience. Check-in went great and the staff was friendly and accommodating. As a titanium elite, I was hoping my suite night upgrades would clear, but they did not and we were not upgraded

We were assigned to a room with a king bed, with the shower/bathtub in the bedroom itself (less than 2 feet from the bed). There was also no curtain, which limits the rooms usage to any non-romantic guests. The shower itself had very high walls (over 2 feet) with no bars/handles to get in and out. On our first night, I slipped getting out of the bath due to the lack of non-slippery services and severely injured my leg. I messaged the hotel, they did not understand and told us they could Not switch our room. Understandable. I messaged again, saying I could no longer use the shower due to my leg and whether there was another room available. There was no response from them at all, even to indicate they were sold out. 

The room is standard size for Europe, but a shower with no curtain/walls IN the room itself is too far. While the breakfast was great, the lack of response or concern from the hotel was disappointing. While I’ll be seeking medical attention, I won’t be returning to this hotel and I wouldn’t advise any group of more than 1 person to.

title: Dissappointing
text:
We have just returned from a three night stay in this hotel. I had booked it months before and had emailed the hotel to inform them I was planning a proposal to my partner whilst in Paris and any upgrades or anything to make our stay extra special would be appreciated. They replied to say they would do their best subject to availability but would ensure I had a wonderful stay. I reflected and a week later I emailed to ask if there would be anything they could do to help assist me in a proposal eg decorate room etc…..I had no reply which to me is very poor service. 
However when we arrived at the room and discovered how tiny it was, there was no way I would propose in there. The room was very dissappointing and nothing like the photos. I know Parisian hotels can be small but I didn’t like the fact the toilet was in a cupboard of its own and the shower and sink in a different area. The bathroom was grubby, with a drippy tap and mould on the ceiling. The room was boiling and air con wasn’t working. Not what you would expect of a five star hotel. 

When we arrived at the hotel the check in was poor,no help or advice was given, and when asked if breakfast was included I was told no, I asked about coming to breakfast and the man on the desk said we would get a nice breakfast at a place down the road…..strange ( surely you would encourage guests to dine in the hotel) 
 
A few days in( and after proposing without the hotels help) I spoke to kahina on the front desk who was lovely, and helpful and gave us a map of the city and the best places to go, I informed her of our proposal and she was very kind. 
For a five star hotel I would have expected to return to the room to perhaps a congratulations slice of cake or glass of fizz or something to acknowledge such a life event….we returned to nothing. Having stayed in lower star hotels than this and being treated to complimentary bottles of fizz, the customer service this hotel is providing is extremely poor. 
The only bonus is the location is central for Eiffel Tower and main tube lines. I would avoid booking here.

title: Nice hotel in the 16th
text:
I stayed one night with my young son. This a pleasant small hotel on a quiet place just a few minutes from the Eiffel Tower. The staff are very professional and friendly, and all seemed to speak English quite well (I speak ok French, but sometimes need to fall back on English when discussing travel logistics, etc.) Our room (their least expensive, I think) was small but the beds were very comfortable, and there was even a little Parisian balcony.

I will say that the hotel, probably like most in Paris, seemed to just be getting back on its feet from Covid. They were a bit short-staffed at the front desk (but always very polite). The indoor pool was also in a bit of disarray thanks to ongoing repairs from some previous flooding. 

The neighborhood, in the 16th arrondissement, is lovely but very touristy. In the summer you will probably hear as much English as French on the streets. But it’s a fine jumping off point if you want to see Paris. The hotel also seemed well-equipped for business travelers (good WiFi, helpful staff, etc.)

title: Eiffel View Suite. Spectacular
text:
Stayed for three nights in the 3rd floor Eiffel View Suite. The room offfered a fantastic straightaway view of the Eiffel , which looked great all lit up in the evening. Since it was a suite, the room was a great size, with a separate living area. It was separated from the bedroom area by a movable wall which opened if you slide it . It was a very unique and good idea, and we kept it both opened and closed depending on if we wanted to see the view from bed, or from the couch. the shower and tub room was great and the toilet was in a little room off by itself near the room door. I actually thought this is a great idea, and wish more hotels had it. The complimentary breakfast was OK, but nothing special like other hotels in Europe offer.
The staff was friendly and attentive, although they did forget to reserve a restaurant for us one night , after being assured that they would. But luckily when we got to the restaurant, they were able to fit us in. 

All in all, I recommend staying there and would stay there again when back in Paris.

title: Great stay at Le Metropolitan
text: Stayed 4 nights from August 18-22. Booked a standard room with 2 single beds and had read many reviews before booking. Yes the room was quite small but it had all the amenities that one would expect from a nice boutique hotel. There was a mini fridge which I had them empty so I could use for our own snacks and drinks, a Nespresso maker which makes espresso sized coffee fyi (very good coffee, you better like it strong!), slippers, robes, shampoo/conditioner/shower gel/body lotion, hair dryer, safe.  As others have mentioned it was a bit odd to have the watercloset on the opposite side of the room from the sink and shower but it was fine. I would say if you are a larger person the bathroom may be an isssue for you. The shower stall size was large enough for sure, but the space outside the shower to get changed was very small and there is a giant window, well covered by a curtain, but seemed a little odd to have right there in the shower area. The room was very clean and comfortable. The phone is a mobile that you can use freely and even make phone calls back to Canada, the USA, anywhere in Europe for free! Mine unfortunately was in need of some updates they couldn't do onsite so although it was supposed to have free data to use around town mine didn't work. Not the end of the world, but probably the only disappointment I had with my stay. The front desk staff as others have mentioned were genuinely friendly and very helpful. They were all nice, but Sarah stood out to me as the most friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel was brilliant, about 5 minutes walking from the Trocadero stop on the metro. You could walk to the Eiffel Tower in about 10 minutes and the Arc de Triomphe in about 15-20. There were many restaurants within easy walking distance. There is a covered market just accross the street with 2 bakeries, a wine shop, a few take away restaurants and a Casino grocery store which I visited daily for snacks and drinks. Travelled with my 12 year old son and felt the neighbourhood was quite safe, we walked back from the metro in the dark a couple of times later at night and felt comfortable. I would definately stay here again and recommend this hotel.

title: COMPLETE DISAPPOINTMENT
text:
I'm not one to give a really bad review (check out my profile and you will see I don't) but this was not a good hotel.  I have Titanium status with Marriott which means I've stated at a lot of Marriotts and some of their Tribute hotels too.  We booked this on points almost a year ago because Marriott was going to raise the category to a 6 for this hotel and we wanted to stretch our points while it was still a category 5.  Really, Marriott?  This is not a category 5 and should have never been upgraded to a 6.

When we arrived the front desk person was quite pleased to inform us that we had been upgraded because of status.  Once we saw the room, we knew it couldn't possibly be an upgrade.  It is the smallest room we have ever had anywhere even by European standards.  There was no chair, no desk and nowhere to put luggage (and we travel light!)  We finally squeezed the suitcase in the armoire because there was no room elsewhere.  My husband and I are not big people but we had to walk sideways to get around the room.  There was only a small bench (about 10 inches wide) that had the coffee pot.

The room was done in black marble.  Might have sounded good on paper but made the room and bathroom seem even smaller.  There were no hooks in the room to hang anything.  We came back wet one day after being caught in the rain and had no place to hang wet clothes.  We couldn't hang them in the armoire because our suitcase was in there and the wet clothes would have dripped on the clean clothes.

There was also no mirror in the bedroom and the bathroom was so small, two people couldn't fit in there to get ready in the morning.  Every other place we stayed had a mirror in the bedroom so I could be putting on make-up and getting ready while my husband was showering.  The design was an attempt to make the hotel look artsy and more like a boutique property.  However, the rooms ended up not being user friendly.  If you are going to have rooms that small add a few touches to help the customer.

However, our biggest issue was cleanliness.  There was no top sheet on our bed; all we had to pull over us was a comforter that looked like it hadn't been cleaned in a while.  The bare floor was obviously dirty when the sun shined in the room.  I dropped a bar of soap in the shower and it left a white ring on the black marble.  The ring stayed there for two days which obviously told us the shower had not been wiped down.  Same with the bathroom sink; there were spots on the sink that we had to wipe down every day when we came back so obviously cleaning people were not wiping down the room properly.  

The public bathroom down by the restaurant also was not cleaned on a regular basis.  I stopped in there after breakfast the first morning rather than heading back to the room before we ventured out and I noticed that there were two open small bars of soap.  I went in again the third morning and the open soap was still there and both bars were quite dirty at that point as was the sink.  Who puts open bars of soap in a public bathroom?  I told the front desk it needed to be cleaned.

I confirmed prior to coming that we would get the breakfast because of status.  When we arrived, I was told I would have to give up the 1,000 point welcoming gift to get the continental breakfast.  it's never been an either, or situation with Marriott so was quite surprised at that.  We chose the breakfast since we were planning on it and wish we had kept the points instead.  The breakfast was the most pathetic breakfast we had on our entire trip.  It consisted of a small jar of yogurt and the same few pastry selections every day -- and they normally charge 25 euros for that!  I asked one day if I could get some fruit and the hostess was so put out by my request that I didn't ask again.  For anyone planning to stay there, don't waste your points or your money; simply go down the street to another place.

I gave it a 2 star rating only because the front desk staff, for the most part, were very good and location is great.  I simply would not recommend this hotel, even with the good location.  There are too many choices in Paris to settle for this one.

Marriott, if you are going to look for Tribute hotels to align with look at Greenmount House in Dingle, Ireland or Kilkenny Hiberian Hotel in Ireland.  Both are lovely boutique hotels that had every amentity.  But please don't try to convince me that Le Metropolitan should be a category 6.  I've stayed at Fairfields that were much cleaner and nicer than this property.

title: Location can't be beat...but be ready for super small rooms
text:
The location of Le Metropolitan is fantastic. The 16th district is one of the best in the city, and many wonderful cafes and shops are close by. And, the Eiffel Tower is literally a 5 min walk away- awesome!! The hotel is extremely clean, safe and modern. 

That being said, be warned that the rooms in this hotel are VERY small, unless you are able to get a Junior Suite. We had a classic room. We were traveling for 2 weeks so had large suitcases. There is no place to store them in a classic room. And I mean NO place. So, we had to stack them against one of the walls when not in use, but still ended up tripping over them or having to jump over them to cross from one side of the room to another. There is a closet, but it's teeny, with room to only hang a couple of items. It's odd too, b/c the rod to hang clothes is mid-way down in the closet, so longer items bunch up at the floor. The bathroom is also very small. You basically have to shimmy your way in and out sideways to get to the toilet. We were two people in the room and it was crammed. We constantly had to maneuver around each other and map out who was doing what on what side of the room when.  

Again, lovely hotel, just know what you're getting yourself into space-wise ahead of time. And DO NOT buy breakfast at the hotel. You'll pay over 30 euro for a basket of bread and coffee. Instead, hop right out of the front door and visit one of the many bakeries and coffee shops close by. Paul (bakery/coffee) was our favorite!!!

title: Great hotel in the Trocadero / Victor Hugo area
text: We based ourselves in this part of Paris, as we wanted to explore the not so touristy part of the city but at the same time wanting somewhere a little posh and close to Eiffel. We stayed here for 4 nights and had the Eiffel-view suite. Note that the top floor suite is called Eiffel suite and costs a little more. The hotel has a boutiquey feeling with extensive use of wood, marble stone and steel. We liked the Carita brand toiletries and found they are much better quality than the average ones you get. Bedding is superb, probably one of the best we had during our 3-week trip. We used the metro extensively and you have the choice of either Victor Hugo and Trocadero. Both about 10-mins stroll. We also enjoyed the amenities around and given it's in the suburbia, you also get easy access to supermarket, takeaway shops, cafes, boulengeire, restaurants, atms etc. Now, if you don't like noise, you may have to avoid this hotel as it's bordered by two streets and a roundabout in front of the hotel. It can get busy and noisy and we do notice it in the morning and occasionally at night (after 10pm). However, the plus side is you get a glimpse of Eiffel if you book any of suites (although somewhat blocked by the current construction from another hotel). Special mention to Efim who look after us with our special request during our stay.

title: Great Hotel, Desirable Location and close to the Metro
text:
My wife and I traveled to Paris for our first time and decided to stay at Le Metropolitan; it did not disappoint. 

The hotel is very well hidden amongst the residential buildings of the 8th ARR, which add a very local feeling to your stay. It's a small boutique hotel with English speaking staff that offers a small swimming pool in the basement, a steam room and spa services and an award winning restaurant that serves fantastic food at reasonable prices given food prices in Paris. 

Room sizes are typical European sizes with a separate toilet and shower area and two twin beds were pushed together to create a queen bed. We found with two carry on luggage's and 2 checked luggage's the space was a little tight, but it did not feel uncomfortable. 

Complimentary use of the in room Nespresso machine was a nice touch with refill pods provided daily. Additionally the complimentary cell phone provided by the hotel offers guests the ability to make local calls for free and and LTE data (which is helpful if you have the Paris Metro App), although we found it slow and opted for a tourist SIM card from Orange. The daily water bottles provided helped us when walking the street of Paris.

Guests can take comfort in knowing that there is a grocery store less than 2 mins walk (200M) from the hotel if they want to make food, buy water, or alcohol.

Trocadero Metro station is less than a 10 min walk from the hotel and is a great Metro station that has many direct lines to popular tourist destinations. 

Major tourist attractions like the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elyees, Palais de Tokyo are all largely with a 10-20 min walk from the hotel, most of which is downhill. 

The neighbor is safe and well lit with people walking around at all hours, we felt comfortable walking back to the hotel from late night drinks at 1230AM.

All in all, this is a great hotel within walking distance of many tourist attractions. Its proximity to the Metro make getting around Paris simple. We easily come back and stay at Le Metroplitan again.

text: We spent several days at the end of December and beginning of January 2019 at this beautiful and well-run hotel in the 16th arrondissement near the Eiffel Tower. title: Highly recommended!
text:
Our weeklong stay at Le Metropolitan during the Christmas holidays was absolutely wonderful! This property is perfect for those who prefer an intimate feel, a quiet yet convenient location, and a clean, well-appointed room. We had stayed at Le Metropolitan in summer 2017 before it became part of the Marriott chain, and I am pleased that it has not lost any of its charm.

This time, we stayed in a deluxe room. Though small, it had a nice sofa for lounging, and the bathroom was a good size with a rain shower. Last time, we had a junior suite which was amazing and well worth the extra cost. We’d book that again next time, and perhaps one day, a suite with the Eiffel Tower view! 

While the location is great (love the 16th Arrondissement!) and the rooms are lovely, it’s the service that makes this hotel stand out. Kahina, the concierge, made us feel welcome even before our arrival. She was warm, courteous, and efficient in handling our special requests via email and always greeted us by name during our stay. All the front-desk staff were terrific, and housekeeping did a great job as well. 

Service in the restaurant during breakfast is less even, but we didn’t mind as we just needed a quick bite before starting out our day. If you’re gluten intolerant, gluten-free bread and madeleines are available in lieu of the regular breads and pastries. Each room has an espresso maker which was great, but as a tea drinker, a water kettle would be nice to have (they may provide that on request). There’s also a few grocery stores and lots of wonderful food shops nearby for snacks, wine, cheese, chocolates, etc. 

Can’t wait for our next visit!

text:
Both the service and facilities at this hotel are outstanding.  In a great residential location in the 16th, the hotel is very small and offers superb personal service.  Kahina at the front desk is particularly helpful.
