title: Check before staying
text: We stayed in this hotel for four nights in mid-April.  It is a large hotel with 195 rooms over 9 storeys.  We did not experience any groups whilst we were there, mainly business people during the week.  Whilst to the south-east of Paris centre it is within easy reach of metro, bus and train stations.  We could be in the centre of Paris in 15 minutes. The hotel is situated on a side street opposite a shopping village and has charged-for car parking.  We were disappointed to find that the hotel was re-furbishing its ground floor reception, restaurant and bar.  As a result there was no public seating, everything was shoe-horned into the breakfast area which we found depressing and we had booked this hotel several months in advance with plenty of opportunity to be advised of on-going works.  The works are said to continue into the summer and noise from the activity permeates the hotel during the day.  Whilst partitions are in place to shield the on-going work it nevertheless feels like a building site.  Our room was on the 8th floor with views toward the Eiffel Tower.  There was some cross-room noise and some noise from the street.  Although the hotel uses the ibis two-door arrangement to shield the bedroom there was still noise from the corridor.  That said, the room - which is the latest generation ibis-style - was warm and comfortable and clean.  Air-conditioning was fine.  Wardrobe space was at a premium (don't pack a lot!).  Much maintenance had been overlooked and the room could have done with a spruce-up.  The bathroom was not the ibis pod and was acceptable but the shower was not generously sized. Wheelchair users might not gain access at present and we do not know if rooms have been adapted for any disabilities.  Anyone visiting before summer 2019 should check that the hotel will meet their requirements.  The hotel offered bar snacks but nothing else.  Breakfast was standard continental fare with only toast and boiled eggs as hot food, it was generous but there was not much choice.  Salvation for eating and drinking can be found across the road in the Bercy Village complex - several restaurants, a small supermarket and shops.  There is also a cinema.  Beyond the village complex is a delightful park.  Staff were professional, friendly and with good English.  Several went the extra mile to make our stay enjoyable.

title: Could be Better
text: We were on a Riviera trip to Paris and this was the hotel we stayed in. Unfortunately, the first room we were given wouldn't open so I had to go back to reception and get new keys. Then, when we did get into the room the place smelt of stale tobacco smoke, so I had to go back down to reception and get a new room. This room wasn't too bad, and the bed was comfortable, the TV was large and the bathroom was was very good. What was missing for an Englishman abroad was a kettle and tea making facilities. We had been told beforehand by Riviera that there was some work going on in reception, but it shouldn't interfere with our enjoyment. Sadly, the work encroached onto the restaurant area, so there were at times some serious bottlenecks as a mass of people shuffled and squeezed to get their breakfasts. Seating was limited, but the breakfast wasn't too bad, although the coffee machine had a tendency to run out of supplies all too frequently. However, the staff were very helpful and friendly, and with the hotel being situated so close to a fantastic array of bistros and restaurants, we were really spoilt for choice when it came to the evening meal. Also, there was a very nice park nearby which was a great place to go for an afternoon stroll or an evening sojourn. What's more, a nearby Metro station gives you access to the rest of the city and the cost of travelling on the Metro is incredibly cheap combined with a very efficient service. In case you get hungry during your stay, there is a fantastic boulangerie next door to the hotel which serves some of the best baguettes and brownies we've ever had!

title: Fantastic base for exploring Paris!
text:
We picked this hotel as we had wanted to go to Paris for years now, but we just couldn't justify the price of staying in central Paris.  This place was a fantastic compromise, great value but obviously requires travel to see the sights.  As it was this was so easy and simple to do that it was not an issue at all.  The metro is literally a matter of crossing the road, and once there everywhere is easily accessible. 
Another plus point is Bercy Village being so close by, there is a mini Carrefour & enough places to sit out and have a drink/something to eat that served us well after a long day out and about.
My only slight negative is that the rooms are small.  Obviously we didn't spend much time in the room, but the TV is easily knocked when walking around from the bed.  There is also very minimal storage.  Again, not a major issue for us on a long weekend, but any longer & I think you would struggle to unpack the contents of your suitcase.  Aside from that, the rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable & all the staff we encountered were polite & friendly.  If I were to come to Paris again I would genuinely not hesitate to stay here again!

title: Very Poor Hotel, Not recommended.
text:
When I booked this hotel for my family vacation, I relied on the rating that, for the first time, put me down.
The hotel by any means does not qualify for 3 stars.
The check-in was quick and friendly, however I had to pay for the full stay upon arrival.
As for the rooms (we got 2 connected), was very poor. They had no minibar, no toiletries, no wardrobe (to be honest, less than 50cm one), no kettle or coffee machine and of course no safe box to keep your stuff in.
The bathroom's door had no lock and the bathroom itself had only 2 shower towels (no face or hand towels) so you use the shower towel for everything. 
On the first night I asked for a tissue box, and surprisingly they replied: 
"we don't have sir, so you can use the toilet roll !!!"
On the second night, we asked for a water boiler and 2 cups, and the answer was again surprising "we don't have sir", so I asked for hot water and they told me "we can't send it to the room, you can come down to the bar and get it from there !!!" 
When my son went down to get them, they gave him 2 paper cups half filled !!!!
I have stayed before several times in accor chain hotels, but this is the worst experience ever with them.

The only thing I see positive is the location, it's around 15-20 minutes from the heart of paris, and few meters away the Bercy village have some great restaurants. The metro station is round the corner, so the accessibility is very good.

Still have 2 nights to go and hope I get no more surprises.

If you are thinking to come, you can cross the street to Pullman instead.

title: Just be aware - no A/C
text:
Stayed in a balcony studio for 18 nights. I'd checked all the amenities very carefully before we booked but it never crossed my mind to check for A/C which turned out to be a big mistake, although obviously my own mistake & not the hotels. A fan was provided in the room but at 35° it was much help.
Hotel is great otherwise. Spotlessly clean with very friendly & helpful staff. Avenue Rachel is quiet and we loved being next to the cemetery which we went to quite alot because it was cooler than our room! 
Would definitely stay here again outside the summer months.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location,Secure,Clean but needs some Air Con
text:
Apartments are located in a quiet area down next to cemetery in a No through road so good location. Up the stairs and turn right and around the corner is the lovely streets of Montmartre. Lovely cafes, quieter with quaint shops and a short walk to the Basilica. 
Go out of the hotel turn left and you are on the busy street with Moulin Rouge, cafes,souvenirs and plenty of restaurants /bars/train station. Nice places to eat and drink. Only a short train ride to the Eiffel Tower as well. 

Apartment is secure with cards to get in main door required. 
Apartment is okay in size, small kitchenette, quiet, clean, fridge,heating.
Shower over bath
Basic toiletries 
TV and good WiFi 

Only issue is it was very hot in Paris over 36 degrees and this complex has no airconditioning just a small portable fan supplied so it was very hot in the apartment even with windows open.

Didn’t have breakfast looked a basic spread of food, coffee machine in foyer with vending machines with drinks.
Mini mart directly opposite that sells alcohol /basic supplies/ snacks etc. 

A nice place to stay
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Decent Location with some niggles
text:
Great Location
Decent Facilities in the Hotel
Would stay again due to the location
Ideal for Moulin Rouge
Close to both bus and metro 
Hotel booked Fixed Price Taxi for us

Recommendations to improve
1) Put instructions for safe in the rooms
2) Put a laminated card in the room to know what TV channels there are.
3) For the phone in the room - maybe worth telling customers what number to press for reception
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Perfect location, really nice apartments and had everything we needed
text:
We stayed here as 5 girls so had 2 apartments, our apartment had a really big king size bed then a fold out sofa with 2 singles, the rooms were a good size with lots of cupboard space, had a bathroom and a separate toilets all with toiletries and fully equipped.

we had a kitchenette too which had a fridge and everything we needed.

Reception were really helpful with check in and keeping the luggage for us. The hotel is 2 min walk to the station and when you walk out the hotel there is a restaurant opposite and a Irish bar at the end of the road. 

Defo would stay again
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Pickpocket dilemma saved by hotel
text: I experienced excellent service at this hotel when I had my wallet stolen near the Eiffel Tower. I am from New Zealand and was in France for my childhood friend's wedding. As all my money had been taken, I had to find a way to get to the New Zealand embassy. Management at this hotel gifted me with some metro tickets so I could get to the embassy and the kind receptionist at the front desk gave me his most recent tips. I can't remember his name but he had blue eyes, brown hair, Spanish speaking and about 1.7 metres tall. Thank you for all your help.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great stay at Citadines Montmartre
text:
Great location, price, room and custoner services. 
Check in and out was fast. The staff were knowledge and helpful. 
Staff accommodated my request.
Had stayed at different Citadines locations and satisfied with the services. 
Would come back again.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Second home
text: A complete homely feeling with all facilities. Can carry items to cook during the stay. Had few issues with not having housekeeping staff cleaning the room on day to day basis . Overall the stay was wonderful with good experience
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Okay hotel close to Montmartre
text: Had a nice stay in this hotel. The location is excellent, close to the Metro and Montmartre. The room itself was so-so, with wc and shower/sink in separate rooms. The hotel might have a security issue, as the couple we traveled with got strangers in the room after bedtime (not thieves, probably other guests taking the wrong door. What was concering about this was that the door was opened with a key...)
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Close to Moulin Rouge
text:
Nice big and spacious rooms that easily accommodated our travelling party of 4. 

Kids have 2 single beds and the adults had foldout couch that transformed into a comfy double bed. 

Rooms are unserviced, however the hotel staff happy to provide you extra amenities if required. 

Being a basic apartment, there is kitchen utensils to make meals and a dishwasher to wash everything up. 

Wifi is very good. There is complimentary tea and coffee in the foyer. 

Front desk are very friendly and accommodating with help getting around the place.

You can buy tokens at the front desk for self service laundry in basement level. 

Eateries, cafes, pubs are close by and all within walking distance. Moulin Rouge is just a short walk up the road. 

A taxi from from the train station is approx €15 and to get to Orly airport is about €35-40. 

One point to mention... we only found out once we arrived the place is in the heart of Paris’s red light district. It is ok during the day, however we tended not to go out once the sun fully went down 😶
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Dirty room, but good location
text:
Located in Montmartre, it's easy to get around to the famous sights. The staff was polite.
The biggest issue was the room cleaning - we checked in on a Sunday, and they did not clean the room until Saturday (!). This was after I went to the reception and asked Friday.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: 4 day styay
text: I arrived in the mid afternoon. The initial booking in was fairly painless. My room was very nice. Unfortunately the rooms are not air-conditioned but they do have a fan. At this time of year Paris is hot. The receptionists were great. Language was not a barrier. The area is also very good as it has easy connections to other parts of Paris via either train or bus. On booking out i had to pay an extra tax which I am not sure was correct.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: average
text: The room is a bit on the smaller side, but besides that we had no other problems. The hotel should work on their sound isolation because everyting could be heard trough the walls on the second floor. Overall a nice service and room close to tge city center and a metro/bus station.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location
text:
We stayed here from Aug 22-25 in a one bedroom suite. The room had two balconies. One view was of the Montmartre cemetery. The other view was of the Sacre Coeur. Beautiful watching the sunrise over the Cathedral. 
The rooms were clean overall. The only annoying part was that the shower head wasn’t held firmly in the shower so whenever we turned it on the water would just spray everywhere. 
We only stayed for 3 nights so we didn’t have the advantage of daily room cleanings. 
Kitchenette was functional and it was nice to have a fridge to store milk for the kids, chill out wine and keep all our cheese. 
The hotel has a lovely rooftop patio for everyone to enjoy. 
The concierge/front desk was very helpful in giving us tips on how to get places (bus vs subways because the 6 line was closed due to maintenance). 
The hotel is close to the promotrain stop, moulin rouge, that Amelie restaurant and a while row of great Irish pubs 😀.  Also very close to the “red light district” which would have been fun to check out if we were not vacationing with the kids lol
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Nice family apartment with plenty of space.
text:
We spent a week in a family apartment in January 2019. The location was vibrant and a little edgy. There was a nice bistro across the street and a couple of food markets around the corner. The hop on hop off buss leaves from just around the corner as well.

The room was clean and comfortable. We enjoyed the balcony and funnily enough did enjoy walking through the historic cemetery. The breakfast was included and was more Paris than a full english which is to be expected. The coffee machine down stairs was brilliant. 

The staff were a little cold on occasion. We certainly would stay again.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Excellent Value and Location
text: The hotel staff was very nice and make check-in/out very easy. The hotel was in an excellent location, close to several public transportation stops and many restaurants,yet it was very quiet. The rooftop deck was nice but only open from 10am to 10pm-and no alcohol is allowed. If we visit Paris again, we'd stay here!
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Lovely/large room - great area
text: some people on this site have complained that it is across from a cemetery - you couldn't get any quieter neighbours than dead ones lol.  it is also a famous one to boot.  the rooms are large and well appointed.  they need to consider installing air conditioning.  the heat during the summer will only get worse with the climate change.  all in all, a great stay in a very good hotel.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Worst hospitality
text:
Booked two rooms for family for 10 days without searching much .
Let’s me start with cons which are in plenty /
Cons:
1. Rude n cold staff ad reception
2. No ac and no ventilation 
3. Cleaning only after 7 days 
4. Rude house keeping staff
5.  breakfast not worthy
6. Slow Checkout process. 
7. Room key got faulty many a times during my stay and for that , I had to see the same  rude staff at reception every time.
8. Bad hospitality 
9. Very Bad hospitality 
10, worst hospitality 

Pros:
1.Good location . Close to market n metro ( place d clichy, blanche) 
2. Decent room with comfy beds 
3. Nice terrace . The best thing I liked.

I would  prefer  to stay here . Won’t recommend either.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: 4 day visit to Montmartre
text: This hotel is situated pretty well. No frills and nothing fancy about this place. The room was quite comfortable and the staff was very accommodating. This is a good base for exploring Paris, with a few good bars and restaurants very close by.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: I do not recommend hosting
text:
I stayed at the Citadine Monmartre for 4 days in June. The cleanliness of the room and the hotel as a whole is very poor. As you can see from the photo I posted, you can see spider webs in the corridors. In the apartments, there is no daily cleaning; If you want daily cleaning there is extra charge. The breakfast is very expensive for the variety and quality of the products served. In the rooms there is no air conditioning, fans were provided. In the Europe summer it is a problem. The bed quality is good as well as the shower. 

The check in and check out process either is very time consuming and confusing. The restaurant attendant at breakfast does not speak English.

I do not recommend staying at this place.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: An average stay
text: I had a studio room and and the website says "1 Living & Dining Area & 1 Bed Area."  They are actually all the same area and it's tiny, smaller than many standard hotel rooms I have stayed in. Simply a bed with a desk and chair. No dining table or lounge. Little to no English TV channels besides news. It took 3 separate attempts over 2 days for them to unblock the drain in the bath / shower and the fan above the shower was disgusting, full of visible dust and mould. There is no garbage chute and the rooms are only serviced every 5 days or so, so some other guests were leaving their full garbage in the hallway instead of taking it down to reception - the hotel is not to blame for this bad behaviour but it shows a garbage chute is needed for every level. Lovely rooftop but other guests also kept drying their laundry by draping it over all the available chairs and leaving for the day. Room was quite hot. Great location though, very central to public transport.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Nice apartment
text:
Nice apartment with kitchen - all facilities, bathroom, lounge
1 bedroom twin beds with sofa twin beds in lounge area
24 hour helpful staff, self laundry facilities, facilities if required, rooms clean weekly other wise extra cost to daily service 

NO aircon really stuffy in rooms hotter inside than outside 

Near moulin Rouge & Place de Clichy metro line, we went to Palace of Versailles on Métro. It wasn’t too bad we just kept asking questions- very few conductor or platform 

No tours leave from here with exception of hop on hop off big bus, you need to go to centra Paris 
60 Euro to Paris Disney, 45 Euro Nord train station 

Lots of restaurants be prepared to use you translation app as most menus in French. Lots of Italian restaurant, multiple sexy lingerie shops???
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Mah
text:
So the location is decent and has good access to the Metro and a lot of local bars and restaurants. We were in Paris when it was 36 degrees and this hotel has no AC so although the small fan they gave helps it was still an uncomfortable few nights. 

Room is decent with a small kitchen, separate toilet and then a shower. There was mold in the bathroom which was not so pleasant but the beds were comfortable.

Some of the staff were nice, others were very rude.

People say on other reviews you get what you pay for but there were better options for the same price.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Nice location
text: We always stay here for our business trip and I am quite satisfied with this place regarding the location and service. It is clean and close to multiple subways. Cons would be no AC in the room so that summer time maybe difficult for some people.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Near Moulin Rouge
text: The view from room was nothing like the illustration. It looked out on a noisy, dirty street. The mediocre breakfast was equivalent of what you would get at a Best Western - minimal with few choices. The room not made up daily. The location was convenient location and parking was in the basement which was convenient.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Dirty rooms
text:
Great area.  But for what you pay for. There’s more options in the area.   Mind you the size of the room is good.  But dirty.   Very dirty.  Staff is horrible. Cleaning is once a week and they barely clean properly.   Fine. They don’t have to clean the whole room. But you need to have the floors washed. Vacuumed at least 3 times a week.  U have to get your own bedding and towels.   That’s insane for a hotel.  If it was half cheaper then most hotels fine. But you’re  paying  the same as other hotels that I’ve had in Paris. With daily cleaning. 
Free coffee in the lobby. And tea

But the rooms are filthy.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Paris
text: We didn’t realize the location was on the edge of the red light area of Paris. However by walking around the back of the cemetery next door we were opened up to some amazing shops, cafes and bistros of Montmartre. The rooms are studio apartments with everything you need including a dishwasher! The windows open fully so you can get a real sense of the weather and temperature before venturing outside.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Average but value for money!
text: An average hotel no cons  but at the same no pros as well, the place where the hotel is situated is great BUT  this apart hotel is a value for money option  comparing with other expensive prices for Paris. If you are looking for a good value for money then citadine Montmartre is a great choice!
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Our home from home in Paris
text: We visit Paris several times a year and have stayed in many hotels but after staying at the Citadines Montmartre we won't stay anywhere else. I nearly cancelled this hotel after reading some of the reviews but am so happy I didn't.  The apartment provided everything we needed and more - and on the few occasions we required assistance the staff responded quickly.  It may not be the prettiest hotel in Paris but the fantastic location, friendly staff and excellent facilities make it a winner for us - we can't wait to stay again! Thank you.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Perfect for us
text: We were very happy with our apartment. It was on a high floor and faced the cemetery, so was very quiet. It had a decent-sized balcony with a beautiful view. We travelled with our teenage son, so we were happy to have the separate bedroom plus pullout couch in the living room. Everything was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly enough. Location was great. I wished we could have stayed longer.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great Location
text:
We stayed here on our trip to Paris, we had 4 nights on our first leg and got a great apartment on the 8th floor. It was perfect we had two little balconies that we loved sitting out on. All rooms are equipped with a little kitchen which are well supplied, a separate bathroom some with toilet others have a seperate toilet. It is a great location you have everything you need in walking distance, supermarket, public transport bars restaurants etc. we found the rooms quiet. We returned back to the Citadines with 3 other families for 9 days (12ppl in total ) so upon leaving from our first leg we requested that if we could have the same room that would be great, as they stated they couldn’t promise anything, but would do there best.  We also asked if the 3 apartment rooms we had could be all on the same level as we are a large family group and it would be convenient for us. I was very disappointed on our return to find out that they didn’t have a enough apartments for all of us and we had to have two seperate rooms. As we were the ones with the eldest children we took that, as the rest of the party had little children and could not be seperated. They did give us two rooms side by side and complimentary breakfast. We weren’t on the same level as the rest of our family though. We had booked months in advanced so I don’t know how they had not enough rooms for us and had checked before we left on our first leg of the trip. 
Although very disappointed about this I would stay again for the location.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Meh
text: Kind of dated. Staff rude and will debate you when you have proof. Gave me the wrong room. Told me I was wrong. Showed him proof. Then he changed his tune but still refused to reaccompdate me until the next day. Followed his instructions for the next day. Went back to the desk he immediately tried to deny me a new room until I reminded him that I confirmed that morning with other desk guy. New room just as dated and worn. Great area. Kind of loud and crowded but I expected that and it didn’t bother me. But I wouldnt stay here again.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Not too pleased
text: While the room is efficient and spa Iappi’s compared to most. The staff was less than helpful considering they screwed up one of the two rooms I had booked. It only had one bed when I reserved two. He went on to tell me I was wrong and that I can’t possibly book two rooms with two beds. When I showed him the confirmation he then said that it’s too bad because they are fully booked and I can’t get another room. I asked for a roll away bed. He pretended to not know what I meant. Then suddenly remembered when he saw I wasn’t going away. Tomorrow I’m allegedly getting moved to the room I paid for with two beds. It’s also very loud and noises in here as the window won’t fully close. I wouldn’t stay here again. Which is a shame because the room is nice and so is the location.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Citadines Montmartre is a great place
text:
Clean, good location, good transportation, good personnel, good accessories
Its located in Montmartre close area. You can visit the Montmartre sacore by walking, have a good dinner or lunch in c good restaurants.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Everything you need for a short stay in Paris
text:
My boyfriend and I stayed here for two nights in April.

We choose this hotel as it came with a kitchen (which meant we had the flexibility of making meals if we needed to or just fancied a chilled glass of wine before we went out for the evening). 

I can't fault the apartment we had. It was clean, light and spacious. There was a toaster, iron and ironboard as well as the usual TV, safe and bath towels - as well as a bottle opener!

The Moulin Rouge is a few minutes walk away (my advice is to avoid that show at all costs! what a tourist trap!), there is a great cemetery behind the hotel  where you can wander around for hours and the Sacré-Cœur basilica is about a 10 minute walk away (what a view!).

If you want a fairly priced place to stay in Paris then I don't think that you can go wrong by staying here.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Spacious, bright and airy apartment
text: We were given a room on the top floor with a balcony overlooking the Main Street. The room was spacious with a kitchenette and and small dining table on the balcony. Service was pretty good and location is superb (only a few minutes from the Main Street and the metro)
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: good stay for city trip Paris
text: perfect located, near to trainstation east and north, only 30 min door to door, many, many restaurants within walking distance, nice rooms, near to metro, only 10/15 min by metro to Louvre,  Notre-Dame, etc., if you like  Croissant, perfect bakeries with in walking distance
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Tired - does NOT look like the pictures!
text: Our Air BnB cancelled on us at the last minute so we booked this hotel instead. BAD MOVE. It was SO tired on the inside and depressing, quite frankly. There are two very small lifts (like as in, they can literally fit 3 people in at the most with luggage) and one of them was broken, so it was a very long wait to get up and down from your room to the lobby. Oftentimes we would miss it because the cleaners were in it and there was simply no room. No air con (don't go in summer). The area is terribly touristy because it is right next to the Moulin Rouge (rookie mistake on our part). Wading through the masses to get home after a long day was less than enjoyable. Just look for somewhere else, there are better options in much nicer, chill parts of Paris.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location, great facilities
text: When we chose a studio apartment with a balcony for February we couldn’t have imagined we’d be in Paris for a mini-heatwave and be able to enjoy the lovely 8th-floor views over the cimetiere de Montmartre from our personal outdoor space at breakfast in the sunshine and at apero time with our Eifffel Tower glimpse sparkling in the twilight! But apart from that bonus, the studio itself was great - spacious enough for twin beds not to feel cramped; big, clean bathroom and well-equipped kitchen all ideal. It was nice to be able to fetch decent coffee from the lobby to enjoy with fresh croissants warmed in the microwave. The roof terrace offered us the Sacre-Coeur view our apartment didn’t have. Location was perfect, close to Montmartre and the Blanche metro station, and there’s a lovely little bistro just opposite. Would definitely recommend to friends, and will stay here again.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great place to stay!
text: This is a great apartment hotel in an excellent location. I recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and reasonably priced apartment hotel. It is in a central area of montmartre in Paris close to the metro.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Excellent location
text:
Studio appartments were clean and spacious.
Roof terrace was brilliant wonderful views.
Great location close to metro and of course The Moulin Rouge.
Breakfast was ok and at 13 euros reasoable.
Comfortable bed and very quiet so easy to sleep.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: a nice place to stay
text: When we spend a few days in Paris, we always try to book at Citadine, either Montmartre , either Marais, because those locations are very convenient to catch the subway . Both residences are comfortable and make you feel "at home" . You can choose to have your diner in a restaurant or to just buy some food and eat your diner in your room . Room are usually spacy and particularly quiet. Prices unfortunatly are somehow high, but we try to get advantage of special offers ... A nice place to stay !
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: lovely place, lovely staff
text:
I just returned from a 2 week stay at the Citadines Montmartre.
Previously I'd stayed a couple times at the Citadines Marais-Bastille, so I was apprehensive about staying in a different part of town.

No worries!
My deluxe studio with balcony was spacious and clean.
I was hoping for a higher floor with a view, but I was fine with this apt.

The location is wonderful.
There are two Metro stops close by, but don't discount the bus!
The bus stops are also close by, and will get you to Hotel de Ville in about the same time as the Metro.

The apartment was clean and nice.
And I really do appreciate that Citadines allows all guests to get coffee right off the lobby.

My compliments go mostly to the staff.

I tried to check in a couple hours early, even though the check-in time is 3:00pm.
Florian at the front desk checked me in and took my suitcase into storage so I could go out and have lunch and come back later.

There was a minor mixup with my check-in name, and it became kind of a joke between Florian and me whenever I saw him.

I just can't say enough great things about Florian.
So friendly, charming, helpful, and knowledgeable.
(and ladies: he is GORGEOUS!)

Attention Citadines: 
this young man is exactly the kind of person you want running your hotels. I've been to a lot of hotels, and this young man is the best of the best.
Give this guy a raise now and train him well! 
You won't be sorry.

I would also like to commend Baptiste at the front desk.
He checked me in and was very friendly and helpful.
He was also very helpful when I booked a shuttle to the airport.

Nice place, great staff, lovely location - what's not to like?

I'll probably book this place the next time I come to Paris.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: It's okay
text: For £100 I guess you can't expect stellar service, but I have definitely stayed in nicer places for less. Our room wasn't cleaned at all during our stay (3 nights), and the toilet smelt of cigarette smoke. Location is at the bottom of the Montmartre hill, though, so it's in a great location.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Exactly what it says on the tin!
text:
Excellent .. spotless . Perfect location. Comfortable beds. Everything we needed. Kettle, fridge, 2 ring electric hob. Microwave. Iron ! 
Hot drinks 24 hours in the lobby . And 2 balconies overlooking the beautiful, historic monmartre cemetry.. nice quiet neighbors!, 
One hundred percent will return
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Convenient, quiet location in bustling Montmartre/Pigalle.
text: Property is appropriate for vacationing family of four on an extended stay. Nearby grocery vendors and brasseries provide for convenience. Choose apartments at lower floor adjacent to garden for a better experience. Only two drawbacks: seedy self-service laudry facilities; complicated in-property parking if you have a large car.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great Location but Poor Service
text:
We came over from Citadines Trafalgar Square London, stayed here 4 nights before returning to Citadines Trafalgar Square. So the comparison is there

Location wise, this is really good. It is within walking distance to many many small streets around the area with very interesting food! The famous Moulin Rouge is also just round the corner. Two metro stations are also nearby. You can take them to many places. We took them to Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Arc de Triomphe etc

Spoiler: further past the Moulin Rouge, is the red light district with many sex shops. And the hotel is adjacent to a cemetery albeit a historical one. My room window actually faced it. We had the curtains drawn all the time. May be an issue for some. 

The biggest letdown is the service. The front desk staff do not greet or smile when you enter. After a few times trying to greet them with no proper answer back, I gave up. 

Even though we do not expect room cleaning every day, you would think they would at least bring clean towels to your room. No, you have to bring your dirty towels to the front desk, hand them over the desk and get new ones in exchange. Yup, in front of guests checking in/out. 

Oh, toilet paper and litter bin bags to be collected the same way. No tissue paper provided at all. 

If service standards do not improve, I think the place will be more like a hostel.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great staff
text: Great location that allowed for lots of activities within the city. The highlight was the staff being very helpful in helping with a sensitive situation. I would recommend this place. Many thanks to the staff (yes, it was that good).
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Good location
text: Good location a short walk away from metro stations. Many eateries and interesting shopping streets. Lowdown is that hotel staff are official and not too friendly. Room amenities are very basic - just towels and toilet rolls, don’t even supply tissues.  Not the cleanest- the toaster had lots of crumbs inside, leftover from previous occupants. And leftover hair too on floors.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Decent enough place
text:
I had a 2 room suite for a 3 week work trip.  Not terrible. 

Friendly staff, very spacious rooms, the breakfast was ok, I only had it one day.

Water damage is visible in the next room from the shower.  Someone killed some bugs and the staff have left them squished onto the ceiling.

Very close to tourist spots and the metro.  Good wifi to work at night.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Very nice apartment - great location
text: Central Paris - straight outside the apartments you have a wide variety of eateries / shops , theatres etc it’s very busy with a great vibe yet nice and quietly situated and very relaxing once your back in your room. Nice cosy breakfast room to the left of the main entrance- I stayed on the 5th floor and would absolutely recommend for a leisure / business trip.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great Stay
text: Great aparthotel, arrived really early and they were able to give me an early check in which was much appreciated. They also upgraded our room to an apartment. The room was very clean, free tea and coffee all day downstairs in a very nice and colourful sitting area. The kitchen had everything we needed. Plenty of room. There is no cleaning service for up to a week, but I didn't mind as I was there for 3 days. Couldnt fault it at all. Around the corner to the Moulin Rouge, loads of pubs and restaurants nearby, walking distance to famous landmarks.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Over booked, poorly organised, rooms are fine though!
text:
I have stayed in this area a number of times and I have even stayed in the Citadines before so I booked 8 rooms for 2 nights 12 months ahead due to a trade show in Paris.
The rooms were flex so the Friday before I reduced down the first night to 6 rooms and this was confirmed via Expedia with the Hotel, however when I arrived at the hotel I was informed they were fully booked and we could only have 4 out of the 6 rooms, and the other 2 rooms were available in 2 other citadines hotels both the other side of Paris. Whilst they offered taxis to get to the other Hotels they was completely inconvenient for the whole group, and in the end agreed they could find 2 other rooms.
I was assured that that extra 2 rooms were fine for the next night, but then the next day the Hotel phoned me to say they did not have have any spare rooms and again we would need to stay in another citadines Hotels!
We had another another lengthy conversation and in the end found the extra rooms in the hotel!
They then changed us for a room we had already paid for and it took 30 minutes to resolve the booking issues and still left without a receipt, and was promised they would send one by 10am the same day
After chasing via email it arrived 5 days later, and I now notice they have charged me for the extra rooms but with no notification.
The hotel organisation is a joke with the over bookings, no record of payment for the rooms and lack of receipts for the bookings, and this was after dealing with the Manager at the end.
However the rooms are fine and there of plenty of good places for breakfast in the local area.

Whilst the area is fine with plenty of good restaurants and excellent transport, the Citadines organisation is very poor and just plain greedy as they are soo over booked...
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Dirty Hotel,unfriendly Staff
text: Cleaningness is not the highlight of this Hotel.We found hair on the floor,in the bathtub and even on the walls...The rooms are spacious but need renovation and  CLEANING!The Staff is not not very friendly and helpful.When you enter the Hotel,they don’t even lift their head to welcome you!Breakfast has limited options and the lady in charge was always grumpy.Parking in the basement is narrow and costs 25€/night even for Hotel customers which I thing is expensive.The location is good,safe,the metro station is near and restaurants/pubs are easy to find.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: don't go
text: you book a room and when you get there, they don' t find the booking and don't help. Really no need to book here, just forget and go elsewhere.  I was so mad about the staff who is  unfriendly and unhelpful.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Honest Review
text: What I enjoyed about the hotel, The staff was very helpful. They usually helped me with any request I had. Its just a few blocks from the Moulin Rouge. What I did not like, The hotel is really in need of a renovation. There is no AC. The hotel is right next to a cemetery, if that's you thing cool, but at night it was really creepy. The neighborhood really isnt the best.Would I stay here again? Never.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Very convenient hotel
text:
This Apt/Hotel is ideally located... the Metro is literally 10 meters away, a major train station is across the street and lots of restaurants within very short walking distance.
There's a washer and dryer in the basement that comes in handy if required. The rooms are comfortable and and includes a kitchenette.The safe in the room was non functional.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Unhelpful staff
text:
Very very strong smell of stale urine comes from the toilet area and sticky floors, requested it to be re-cleaned which was told it would be the next day, that never happened and got the same excuse for the next three days. 
Very very hot room with no aircon and window that doesn’t stay open and fan that does nothing. 
Stayed 8 days here but never ever will again. Used to love the Citadines chain but this has just put me right off.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: A great place to stay.
text: This apartment/hotel is delightful. The staff is charming and the location fantastic. We w had one of the rooms with a balcony which was amazing. I loved spending time out there. This wonderful hotel is located in a bustling district on a very quiet avenue. So you have the opportunity to walk out on a quiet street walk a block or 2 away and you're right in the middle of everything. I highly recommend this hotel!
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Good hotel for the price
text: 4 of us stayed in an apartment with 2 twin beds and a pull out couch. Nice enough kitchen and bathroom.  We were there in the middle of a heatwave amd there was no ac - despite being told that all rooms had air conditioning.  Some friendly staff, some really rude. A lot of options at breakfast,  but it is not included with the price of the room.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location, comfortable, quiet and clean.
text:
Stayed first week of September 2018
Even though it is located in a very busy area, the hotel is surprisingly quiet.  It is at the end of a quiet, dead-end street with no through traffic.  The Moulin Rouge is within a couple of minutes walk just around the corner and the rooftop patio has an amazing view of the Sacre Coeur Basilica.  The subway stops are very close too.
Our room had a small kitchen with fridge, countertop stove, microwave and dishwasher.  There is a restaurant in the main lobby:  I cannot remember the cost of breakfast but we decided it was too expensive.  There are many cafes and restaurants in the area.
The place is spotlessly clean and the cleaning staff work diligently to keep it that way.
The staff is extremely helpful and polite.  They destroy the stereotype of rude Paris staff.  
There isn't much I didn't like about this hotel, however, some things need mentioning:
The room was very warm every day.  The hotel does not have air conditioning and we had to use the fan which the hotel provided.  We also had to leave the window open every night.  Remember, this is Europe.  They do not have screens on the windows as they do in North America so the first couple of nights I was apprehensive but we still got a good night's sleep every night.  Very comfortable beds.
One staff member told me that there are plans to install air conditioning before next summer
The rooms are a tad small.  Again, this is old Europe and so most rooms will be smaller than in NA.

I've read some people complain that it is situated beside a cemetery.  Actually, this is a historical cemetery and one of the more interesting places in Montmartre where a number of famous Parisians are buried (Offenbach, Delibes...). At the main gate they provide maps for visitors to locate the graves.  Very interesting place.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location
text: We were very happy with our stay, the apartment was a great size. The bed was comfortable and it was nice to have a kitchenette. The location was the best part, very close to the metro to get around in Paris. There are plenty of restaurants, bakery’s and bars around. I would definitely stay there again.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Location is good and very quiet
text: Metro and bus station are very near the hotel. And the hotel's place is very easy to know for guest,in front of tha montmartle cemetary where Dalida,Truffaut, Degas are sleep. So quiet in spite of the noisy street near the Moulin Rouge.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Lovely Long Weekend Away
text: This hotel was much more than what we expected. The room was huge and there was a kitchen included. We chose it as it was near the Moulin Rouge and we had tickets to see a show there. I'd definitely pick this hotel again if I came back to Paris. The only issue is the price is a bit high which didn't include breakfast.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Very nice stay
text: I highly recommand this place as being very well located, The staff was qualified. We were welcomed with smile and efficencyThe appartment.was very quiet, very well equipped and clean.The bedding was very good
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Propre, agréable, excellent accueil et bien situé au cœur de la vie nocturne de Paris
text: This is our home away from home in Paris. Perfectly quiet and yet right in the heart of Paris entertainment district. Close to other Paris interesting spots by bus or metro while staying in a very quiet place.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Not bad!
text: Good location, good breakfast, room comfortable but had a very noisy fan that was pretty rubbish. Little dissapointed with the roof terrace, the pics on the sites make it look really pretty, where as in reality it’s not used and has a bit of furniture up there. They should definitely utilise it more, I’d have loved to have had a bar In the hotel and been able to take a drink up to the terrace. It’s a wasted space. Staff very nice and professional. The area feels a little sleazy but you’re in walking distance of beautiful back streets with stunning buildings and pretty street lined bistros. Literally around the corner from the moulin Rouge (most amazing show) I wouldn’t have a problem recommending the citadine, it’s just pretty basic.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Recommend Oct - April
text:
Basically, the only con for me about the hotel was the lack of air conditioning.
The location is perfect, the staff are great.  If travelling in the cooler months this would not be an concern, but in the warmer months, air conditioning is needed.  Other than that, I would totally recommend this property to anyone.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great base, good location
text: We stayed as a family of four with two adults, 12-year-old and 16-year-old. The apartment was clean, had everything we needed for two nights. The single pull-out beds were a bonus for our son and daughter (no sharing!). The location is excellent, close to Montmartre, Moulin Rouge and lovely Les Abbesses. Monoprix supermarket is just a few minutes walk away and the metro too. And the rooftop terrace a bonus. Would recommend for families and couples - it's good value for money in an expensive city.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Will not disappoint but read on..
text:
Stayed 2 nights.. very helpful with lost luggage issue ... lent a universal charger etc so we at least had a phone! 
Room 506 - Very comfortable and simple. Nice with the toilet being separate from bathroom. Window opens wide for breeze - no air con.. it would be very warm in summer months but there is fan provided in the cupboard. Beds very comfortable.
Friendly and helpful staff. We had a nice view from window.. no cemetery in sight but we were expecting it so it would not have bothered us anyway. 
Unfortunately the rooftop was closed for renovations.. can’t be helped but would have liked to see the views.
We didn’t eat there but there is a breakfast option I believe.. and coffee. 
Location.. awesome. Close to metro and bus lines. Walk to Moulin Rouge, restaurants, take aways and souvenir shops. 2 metro stops from Sacre Couer.
Very happy with stay here 😄
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Good location
text:
I'm writing the review 2 days since checking out of Citadines Montmartre. We've stayed 5 nights, in a twin room. If I wrote this review on the first or even the second night of our stay, I would scream, tearing my hair out - all because we were in Paris during the heatwave and there was no air-conditioning in the hotel. Honestly, I didn't even check that before booking - I thought A/C was a standard in any hotel.
To be able to breathe, we kept the window wide open (1st floor) all night -  still, no air was coming in at all. There was a desk fan provided and was on all night too - so there was some air movement - and a constant buzz in the room.

There were no cleaning, changing towels, making up beds or any maid services included - all was self-service. 
Kitchenette: all basic stuff was there, the frying pan had the teflon coat badly scratched and the wine glasses were 2 different ones, but these are just details. There was a microwave and the hot plates, a kettle, a fridge with an ice box and a small dishwasher. There were 2 clean tea towels provided.
Bathroom: rather lacking ventilation and the drain must have been somehow clogged I guess, as the water was draining slowly. I liked the shower gel provided - nice, clean smell.

There was a coffee machine in the reception/breakfast room area for the guests, I have also seen a water dispenser opposite the lifts.

Because the weather had changed towards the end of our stay, we could breathe and sleep in the room better - so my review softens now;) 
I think the biggest drawback for this hotel is the lack of the A/C - everything else is OK. The location is really good, just by the Montmartre Cemetery, very close to Moulin Rouge.  I have asked the reception for a room without the cemetery view (my daughter not a fan) and we had a yard view, no problem. The guys at reception were friendly and helpful.
I think I would come back to this place, not in the summer though:)
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Everything is fine but the doors slam loudly
text: Great location near Moulin Rouge.  Clean.  Very friendly, knowledgeable staff.  Great view from the rooftop!  They offer breakfast but it wasn’t included in our booking so we didn’t eat here. Free coffee machine in lobby.  I would give this a higher rating if the room doors didn’t slam loudly every time they shut.  There is no AC but that is common in Europe. The rooms are good size for Europe.  There is a little kitchen in our room.  Nice place.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Well located, basic hotel in Montmartre
text:
This hotel is tucked away just off the main road with Moulin Rouge a little further down. Great location if that’s what’s important to you. 

For a video review of this room (and many others in Paris), head over to You.Tube and search for 'Tim and Matt's Travel Reviews'

Hotel was “ok”. Friendly staff at check-in, but felt a little tired in places. 

I was upgraded to an apartment-style room (small kitchen area, table and sofa), located on the ground floor. 

The room did have its own private external access via doors, opening onto a shared external space (behind which is the graveyard!). 

Personally, I would have preferred to keep a hotel room higher up!
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Great location. Helpful and friendly staff.
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights with a family of 4 in June.
Yes the hotel is a little outdated but for us we did not mind at all.
We had a 1 bedroom with a pull out sofa.
The staff were extremely helpful and accomodating. The hotel is clean and we had no problems. The funniest thing for us was when we opened our window and the view we had was of the cemetery. 
This place is in a quiet street central to Paris. There are restaurants and cafes around plus for the kids Kfc and Macca's down the road. Moulin Rouge is around the corner and the Euro Star was only a 5 min cab ride. (please do not get rip from them).
There are also a couple of mini marts around and walking distance to the train station which we used to get to disneyland.
Also only a 20min walk to the best view in Paris.
There is a terrace on the top with great views too.
Thank you for making our first time to Paris a wonderful stay.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: No air conditioning means a poor sleep
text: We were actually surprised that a place like this had no A/C. The temperature in our room was miserably hot which meant that we had terrible sleeps on the 3 nights we stayed here. We had to prop the deck door open for air, which is a safety issue. The location is good and the free coffee appreciated, but if you are planning to stay here in summer you would be advised to find a place that is more comfortable. Also while you may see nice pictures of the top floor viewing area, in reality no body has bothered to water the plants on it so they are all dead. This is a shame as it has the potential to be a nicer space.
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: just about ok
text:
The positives, great location near Montmartre and Pigalle, quiet area in a cul de sac, friendly reception staff, free coffee, glad to have booked a studio with a terrace therefore some extra space.  Negatives: very very hot in Summer only old table fan, cleaning only once during the stay and badly done at that.
In general would come back but not in Summer and would only stay a few days not 8 days as I did

title: Terrible Experience
text: We checked in and left our bags in our room on the first day, when we got back to the hotel our keys firstly wouldn't let us into the building and then wouldn't let us into our rooms, a woman there said that she was given our room key and walked into our room with all our stuff in it so she left...luckily she didn't steal anything! When we went down to the front desk the man just shrugged his shoulders and told us we hadn't been properly checked in...the second day we turned on the iron and it began to spark from the bottom and smoke everywhere, we went down to the front desk and they just laughed it off and once again shrugged when we told them how dangerous that was and that our room now smelt of smoke. When we got back that day, our keys did not work yet again. The next day our keys stopped working again and every time we went down to the front desk they just laughed. Dishwasher didn't work either. Not one "sorry" came from the mouths of the staff there. We will be telling our travel agents to NEVER recommend this hotel to anyone. Terrible service, do not stay here.

title: No A/C
text: $ 270 per night for a hotel with no A/C. Room felt outdated. The service is ok. I tried to change my reservation less then 24 hrs after making it and they charged 50 Euro cancellation fee. Even though i was staying with them. That won't happen again because i also had poor experience with Citadines London.

title: Great location

title: It was ok but not as good as I had hoped
text:
I really wanted to love this place, & in many ways it was a great find, but just didn't live up to my expectations. We stayed here as 4 adults, picking the Citadines over other places as the photos on their website seemed to show sliding doors closing the living space off from the kitchenette, which was wanted for privacy for the 2 people sleeping in there on the sofa beds; even if not, the location of the kitchen in the images seemed separate enough that it wouldn't be a problem. I don't know if some of the apartments do have the sliding doors, but ours didn't, and the kitchenette was on one wall of the living area, meaning the main thing we had wanted was absent - had I known, I wouldn't have booked here. Felt very cramped and the rooms were pretty small, & in our living area the TV was tiny - smaller than in the bedroom - and only 2 chairs for the little dining table, which was weird given that it was known there were 4 of us.

The apartment seemed clean, although infested with ants, which I was told by the desk staff is just a problem they have when the weather is hot (fair enough, probably unavoidable, but ruined a lot of our food!).

Otherwise, it is a good place to stay, well-connected to central Paris, easy access to the Gare du Nord, easy walk to main Montmartre, quiet street, lovely rooftop terrace. But I wouldn't recommend it at all for 4 adults, unless other apartments have a lot better set-up than ours. I don't think I would stay again though sadly, having been left with disappointment from my first stay. Also watch out for city tax - we booked direct with Citadines as it was the same price as booking.com & I prefer to give my business direct, but Citadines did not include the city tax in their price & booking.com did, which meant going direct cost us more. C'est la vie!
name: Citadines Montmartre Paris

title: Second stay as good as my first
text: I was back at the Citadines in Montmartre this May.  Once again the hotel met all my needs, but this time I could compare it with stays in 5 other properties around France.  The Citadines was the best hands down.  My room was spacious, the bed incredibly comfortable.  Best Wi-Fi signal I received the whole trip.  I would recommend to others and if I go back to Paris it would be high on list of places to stay.

title: A nice little Hotel close to l'Arc de Triomphe
text:
Now getting to the end of our quick trip to Paris, we still can't believe how lucky we were with the Hotel.

The Hotel is nice and clean and at a great location. There are actually two Métro stations at a similar distance just outside the Hotel. The Métro is line Nr. 1 and goes along famous places starting at the famous l'Arc de Triomphe, goes down Champs-Élysées, passes Place de la Concorde and also stops at Louvre.
Because the Métro is a great transportation system, it is worth taking it. We had a 3 days pass Zone 1 and it was worth every penny.

If you like shopping and you have money ;) the famous Champs-Élysées is just on the other side of the L'Arc de Triomphe as you see in the picture above.

Even that our room was located at the busy street , we had two windows with several glacing and therefore our room was quiet. The bathroom was spacious and also the room itself had enough space for all of us. I have been to Paris several times and usually the rooms are very small but this time was not too bad.
OH, I forgotten to mention, that the beds are very comfy. Of course, after a long day with a lot of walking, you are dead tired and could sleep nearly anywhere, but the beds were very comfortable and also the pillows, at least for us and we slept like angels.

Breakfast was something we enjoyed the most. It is a causy little corner of the Hotel with a few table and a lovely staff. The food offered was or is delicious and we always were looking forward to it, knowing that the french breakfast with it's baguette, croissants and pain au chololat is delicious.
The only thing they have to work on is the coffe. Was not the best but hey, what more do you want?

The Hotel is a little jewel and we did enjoy it a lot and can only recommend it.

Only negative was that we had to upgrade our room, as the room orignally was too small, but for a small fee the new room we had which I believe was a deluxe had amazing views and was much more spacious.

Would definitely recommend for a weekend break, and would stay again.

title: Very good with room for improvement
text:
The good: 
Good communication before arrival, they actually answer your emails clearly. Excellent location, 3 minutes walk from Champs Elysee but still away from the tourist hordes and very well connected by public transport as well as the airport bus. Comfortable bed and lovely bathroom. Quiet room overlooking courtyard, great sleep quality. Rachel and Sebastian from reception were very kind/helpful. The hotel is located on a main street that is very busy, so choose your room accordingly. 
Old school charm, they still use real keys for rooms. 
Good AC. 
good daily cleaning.
Very good supermarket right across the street.
phone/ipad chargers in lobby were nice touch.
tea-coffee kettle in room, replenished daily.
v good wifi

Need for improvement: 
Doesn't feel like a 4* hotel. The picture of the room is better than the reality. Room decor was a bit old. Mini bar needed cleaning on the inside. Weird setup for the safe, you need to use/carry a key (not very convenient). Would not fit a large laptop.
They don't tell you about complimentary food items offered every evening, we found out by accident. This should be explained at check-in. 
Rachel, the manager, was nice and efficient but the other ladies of reception were not consistently nice. 

Overall nice place with v good location with plenty to do around. Mostly pleasant stay.

title: Location, location, location....
text: Just returned from 3 nights in Paris and we were fortunate to stay at this little gem of a hotel!  We were in Paris to attend the Prix de L’Arc de Triomphe.  We only decided to go a couple of weeks ago so there was no availability at the recommended hotels near Longchamp race course.  After some research and discovering that shuttle buses ran between Longchamp and nearby Port Maillot I booked Hotel Montfleuri.  It turned out to be perfect for our needs - going racing and a spot of sightseeing.  We arrived around 11am Saturday 6th October, so well in advance of 3pm check in.  The friendly reception staff checked us in and we were able to leave our luggage safe and secure whilst we went out and about.  We returned around 6pm and got the key to our beautiful room.  Ignore the reviews saying there are few restaurants and bars nearby - there are loads of options.  Porte Maillot is only 5 mins walk and there is a wide variety of eating and drinking places that are more reasonably priced than the Champs Elysees in the other direction.  The hotel is spotless with a great team of staff.  And the buffet breakfast was a pleasant surprise - relatively basic but does the job perfectly - a great choice of pastries, cold meats and cheese, fruit juices and a couple of hot options.  We are already discussing our return in 2019 and will definitely stay here again.

title: Threatening guests to delete their reviews online!
text:
I had to delete my previous review because the team at Hotel Montfleuri was harassing me through phone and email, and even sent me an email threatening me to take legal actions against me if I didn’t delete it within the next 48 hours. 

It is unbelievable that they send this kind of emails just because they don’t like a review. They said I was incriminating one of their staff members which is not true, I simply wrote what I presenced and they decided to threaten me. A guest caused a riot in front of everyone while all the guests were having breakfast and the staff decided to have the discussion there for everyone to see and listen, instead of taking it elsewhere. They can’t blame their guests for leaving terrible reviews, they handle things at their hotel extremely unprofessionally.

The rooms look much much better in the pictures than how they truly are. Our room was miniature, very difficult to accommodate two large suitcases. We had to request a change of pillows on the first night because ours smelled terrible! The shower door didn't work well and every time we used it, there was water all over the bathroom floor. Their toilet didn't work correctly as well, we had to flush three to four times for it to go away. The room was not cleaned well, seems like they only make the beds and take out the trash, but no thorough cleaning. There was dust everywhere and you could even see all the fingerprints in the wooden bathroom door. This is definitely not a four-star hotel. 
There are A LOT of little kids in this hotel, trying to sleep and also to have a quiet breakfast seemed impossible. 
At the end of our stay, they wanted to charge us for the breakfast, even though when we first arrived they told us it was already included. At the and they didn't charge it but seems like all the reception staff has bad communication with each other. 

The only good thing about this hotel is the location. Other than that, I would never recommend it. Especially after receiving an email with a threat. What is their problem!? What a rude thing to do!

title: Is this really a four star hotel in Paris?
text:
We stayed in the hotel for 8 days.

Location: walking distance to Arch de Triomphe & Champs de Elysees, 2 Metro station nearby- CDG Etoile & Argentine, in the street with many motorcycles showrooms and cafes.

Room: the pictures in the web shows nicer version of the room. The Deluxe room is sufficient in term of size but the condition needs to be refurbished. The toilet bowl had problem, did not flush properly, we reported to the Front Office twice but not being repaired until we checked out. The cleaning is below standard for a four star hotel in the elite area 16th arrondisement of Paris- we had situation just changed pilow cover had smell of not properly drying fabric, the room is still dusty after being cleaned, the cleaning staff left a bag of duvet (we had to carry this big bag to the front office to return) and their note in the room. 

Breakfast: We had free breakfast for booking more than 3 days. Same menu through 8 days- below average standard croissant and burnt taste coffee.

Staff: Only 1 duty staff 7/ 8 pm onwards, seems overwhelmed with full occupancy situation in the hotel during summer holiday season. 
We were asked on our feedback during checked out, the front office staff seemed defensive on our feedback regarding cleaning and toilet bowl flush problem creating unpleasant  smell during our 8 day stay in the hotel- claiming that previous guest had no report on this toilet flush problem. She also mentioned that the hotel is fully occupied during summer peak season and the staff is hectic- really NOT the guest problem, we were paying higher room rate for the period- the hotel should find own solution.
The staff also works in poor coordination manner- have completed the check out process and while waiting for our cab, I found in my wallet the receipt of deposit fee that had not being refunded. I had to remind her to give me the refund- never experienced this in any other hotel.

In short, the good thing about the hotel is just the location. Not recommended, not at par with the room rate that we paid.

We moved to Relais du Louvre in arrondissement 1- lower room rate, beautiful room and superb Parisien experience.

title: A memorable experience..
text:
Hotel Montfleuri made our stay in Paris more memorable. I had booked the hotel for five nights through my travel agent. We wanted interconnected rooms for ourselves and our two daughters. However, my travel agent forgot to inform them about it. Mr Sebastian made relentless efforts to get us two rooms facing each other (despite full occupancy in the hotel) . He is a wonderful man, who treats everyone with utmost warmth, care and affection. The front desk staff was very friendly and always happy to provide any information at any point of time. We felt welcomed and at ease in a city far away from home.  
This hotel is located at a wonderful, quite and safe location. One can find a grocery store and a pharmacy on the same road.  Avenue des Champs-Élysées is just five minutes away. 
The rooms were also very clean and breakfast was good.
 I will definitely go there again each time I will be in Paris!

title: Great hotel for a weekend break
text:
We got a friendly welcome on arrival and throughout the staff were all pleasant and helpful. Location is excellent, the Arc de Triomphe is about 2 minutes away and a great sight to see whenever you leave the hotel. The Champs Elysees is definitely only about 5-10 mins walk, ignore anyone who says otherwise! Argentine metro station is a couple of minutes away and is a great way to get further down the Champs Elysees, to the Louvre and further east.

The hotel entrance and lobby are perhaps a little dated but there's nothing wrong with them, Rooms are well appointed, clean and ours was exceptionally quiet. We were able to get a cot for our baby without any issue (we requested via email beforehand). Rooms have a TV, minibar, en suite and air conditioning. Some rooms have a bath, others just a shower.

Breakfast was a good continental selection, including some hot food (sausages and scrambled egg) plus plenty cereals, yoghurts, bread, fruit, etc.

The location is the real key for this place. I would undoubtedly recommend the hotel and would stay here again.

title: Perfect fo a First Trip
text:
We stayed in the Hotel Montfleuri for three nights in March 2018. It was cold, very cold. To that point, it was hugely important that we had a hotel with a good location. We flew into Beauvais airport, and the shuttle bus drops you to Port Maillot in Paris - a 10 minute walk to the hotel. This was really handy for getting to and from the airport.

You're also a 2 minute walk from Arc De Triomphe, and a 5 minute walk from Champs Elysee. There's a Metro station right beside you too.

If I had to criticise anything, it might be the breakfast. Not the best quality, and a bit over priced. However, that's a small issue for an otherwise strong hotel in a great location. If yo're visiting Paris for the first time, it's where you'll want to stay.

title: What more can you expect
text:
My husband and I stayed at Montfleuri hotel for 8 nights. We booked a Courtyard view room with breakfast included. Before our trip I had emailed the hotel hopefully requesting for a complimentary upgrade to a room with the Arc de Triomph view as I had reviews that this has been done in the past. We arrived at the hotel at 10pm, and of course no upgrade was given. Courtyard view it is. Let me list the pros and cons of this hotel - 

Pros:
Excellent location (steps away from champs elysee, a little corner shop where you can buy all your needs, a bakery, lots of cafes and 2 train stations)
As clean as it get for a 4 star hotel. (Comfy bed, sheets were soft, towels refreshed daily)
Staff were pleasant. Not very friendly, but they were okay. I am hotelier myself and non of the staff even got to know our names, or asked how our stay was. All they said was Bonjour. Bonjour. Being a guest in the hotel for so long the could at least make an effort to know their guests.
The lady who works at breakfast is lovely and very hardworking.

Cons:
Lots of sticky and dirty carpet stains. I didn't dare walk on the carpet barefoot. (lucky they provide in room slippers)
Breakfast was very poor. They served the same things every single day. As we stayed for 8 nights eating the same thing every day was not satisfying. (Croissants, cold cuts, boiled egg, fruit salad, yogurt, cheese, scrambled egg, sausage) I recommend they do some sort of rotation with the food.
Coffee machine made the worst coffee i have ever tasted.
After returning to the hotel one day, our key could not open the door when we went to the front desk they said they had changed the lock and gave us a new key. I found this very inappropriate, if your going to change the locks of our room at least advise us before??

Overall, if your after an average hotel with good location then I recommend this hotel to you.

title: Location still great, hotel not as good as last visit
text: The best thing about the K+K is the location.  The neighborhood is upscale with wonderful shops and restaurants and it's within walking distance of many attractions.  The service has declined in the decade since I stayed there last.  I am not sure if it is hotel policy, but the desk staff is not nearly as friendly as they used to be, nor will they help you book tours or reservations (instead pointing guests to the computer for use in the business center).  There is no longer a bar or bistro, though you can buy wine and beer from 6 to 8pm.  The breakfast is still good, though they no longer include champagne.  There was also no welcome gift upon check in.  They seem to be skimping now on the little personalized touches that I enjoyed so much in 2012.  I did hear that the hotel is due for a renovation next year, maybe with some physical improvements they will regain some of their original welcoming attitude.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Very Disappointed of Hotel Housekeeping
text:
I stayed in hotel K+K Cayre Saint Germain des Pres in PARIS (4 Boulevard Raspail Paris, 75007) in May 2022 through TripAdvisor Plus booking. I accidentally left 60 Euros worth of brand new hair products in the bathroom when I checked out. The house keeping claimed they never found the products. Stay in this hotel at your own risk, never leave anything when checking out, as most likely, you will never see them again!

Here is the full story. I bought in store near the hotel 1 big bottle 500ml of Shampoo and 1 big bottle 200ml of conditioner, brand new Christophe Robin products which cost 60 Euros, on May 15, and brought them back to the hotel. I used it in my hotel bathroom for once.

When I checked out of the hotel the next morning, I browsed to make sure that I've taken everything with me, not realizing that I had left my brand new big bottle of Shampoo and Conditioner in the bathroom (it is not directly viewable from the bathroom door location as the items were placed at the far end of bathtub behind the shower curtain).

I quickly realized this situation after I left, and immediately called the hotel on May 17th evening. The evening shift personnel asked me to call back the next morning and talk to the front desk. I called on May 18th morning, and the front desk said they have checked with housekeeping and the cleaning person claimed that they have not seen the products. I called in the evening of May 18th again, and they asked me to email the hotel 	reservations.cayre@kkhotels.com instead. I emailed the address they gave me the same day with details, never heard a word back. 

I have now returned to my home in America and formally reported my incident to TripAdvisor Plus, where I had booked by reservation. I also forwarded the email that I sent to the hotel to Tripadvisor plus and they opened a case. But the hotel said that there was nothing they could do about this.

I am deeply disappointed that the items I left at my room were forever lost. Cleaning the bathroom before the next guest's arrival is a standard procedure for the cleaning staff. There is no way those big bottles of 500ml size shampoo and 200ml bottle of conditioner can be missed. They were huge! It is not acceptable for hotel housekeeping staff to not return the items that guests have forgotten in the room.

I will never stay in this property again, as I deeply worry about the character of their house keeping team, and the attitude of the hotel's customer service.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Amazing stay in Paris
text:
I traveled to Paris for the first time with my girlfriend last week. 
We decided to choose this hotel and had a wonderful stay. 

The location was perfect, it was really easy to get anywhere we wanted to and easy to get back to the hotel after long days of sightseeing and enjoying Paris.

Breakfast was delicious and there was plenty of food options to choose from.

The staff was great and very professional. 

I'd like to give a special shout-out to:
Karl, Benjamin, Enrico, Pamela, Hameed, and Ines 

for ensuring all our needs were met quickly and that we had everything we needed.

We felt very welcomed during our stay and we're happy to recommend this hotel to everyone.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Nice place to stay
text: We enjoyed the location of this hotel as it was super easy to get around having the metro across the street. The rooms are small, bathroom very small and I would highly recommend a balcony for fresh air and a small view of the Paris street below. The hotel breakfast is fantastic but a little pricey. Beds were a bit hard.  Overall a solid 3.5-4 star hotel. The neighbourhood is great with many cafes around.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great location/Great breakfast(extra)/Staff could be friendlier and more helpful…
text: This was our second stay at K&K and it is in a great location with excellent restaurant choices. Rooms were somewhat spacious and clean with maid service daily! The breakfast is extra but a definite plus! We were on 6th floor(611&612) with a balcony which was lovely. The staff could use more customer service training…Whenever asking for help they always seemed to be bothered by any inquiry. Dinner reservations always a problem/one night we were told the reservation was confirmed and upon arrival we were not on the list! Only other negative is the bar/don’t bother …selection weak and not open nightly. Two especially rude front desk employees were Enrico (rude and bothered by any question)and Ines(knew no English). Even the young girl who checked you in at breakfast was not friendly…May consider another hotel only due to staff…
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Wonderful
text: This hotel is perfect! It is in such a perfect location for walking to almost everywhere you’d want to go in Paris! The staff are friendly and most speak decent English so it’s easy to communicate your needs. Lovely shops and delicious food and coffee all within a block or two.  I will definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Nice conclusion to our trip to France
text: Hotel Cayre was a very comfortable hotel with a spacious room.   Great location in St. Germain and close to many excellent restaurants.  Walking distance to the Louvre and Champs Elysees among other sights.  The staff was extremely helpful - even with a 5:30 a.m. departure.  Would definitely recommend.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Not worthy of 4 Stars
text:
