We first checked into the hotel for 5 days and were given Room 712. It was incredibly TINY & the slanted ceiling just made it worse. The room had several broken fixtures & lacked many amenities; No clothes iron, empty mini bar, Water temperature was inconsistent & worse of all, AC didn’t work properly. However, The room had a wonderful view of Sacre-coeur, but that was possibly the only nice thing about the room. 

We then checked out & went on a two day trip & then checked back in when we came back. I would’ve much rather gone to a different hotel, but we already had our bookings done before hand. 

Upon re-checking in, we asked for a bigger room than the previous one & we were given room 105. It was MASSIVE. It overlooked a small side street, but Much better than the first room. However, once again, broken fixtures & outdated furniture. Our second experience was a lot better than the first, but overall, i think the hotel deserves 3* at best. You can probably find nicer hotels for the same pricing.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Disappointing 4 star hotel
text: The hotel is not what I would expect a 4 star hotel to represent. The room (710) is smaller than a premier Inn room, the bathroom was tiny and shower virtually unusable due to sloping roof, black out blinds are also ineffectual because of the sloping roof, trying to get some milk for your tea in your room felt like asking them to walk on water as we had to ask 3 different times and when it finally arrived they wanted to charge us for it!! The city view from our room was non existant unless you are happy viewing chimneys from adjacent buildings. The only reason I gave this 2 stars and not 1 is because Enrico on reception was pleasant and tried to be as helpful as possible. That being said when we checked out we spoke to 3 members of staff and not one of them asked if we enjoyed our stay!! My guess is there are probably better hotels to stay at where you dont pay 4 star prices for a 1or 2 star experience!!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Family room needs some TLC
text:
So, this hotel does have a lot of positives but our room needed some TLC.
Pros-
Great location, we were able to walk everywhere 
Friendly staff-most of the time
Cons- 
Our bathroom had a broken fixture with exposed glass. It did end up getting fixed on day 2 or 3
Two times we had the do not enter the room sign on the door and came back to find the maid had come into our room !
Small bathroom for a family room
Refrigerator leaking water
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Nice, quiet and well located hotel
text: Nice, quite and well functioning hotel in the Saint Germain district of Paris. Very friendly and helpful staff. The breakfast was good, but somewhat limited. The location is perfect for sight seeing and the subway is just next to the hotel. Seriously considering visiting again as this was well worth it.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Amazing stay…
text:
It has been a fab place to stay.. signature room with balcony is a must. 
Amazing views of Eiffel Tower. Everything you need in the room and a lovely breakfast, friendly staff and a fantastic central to all you want to visit. 
Great location for bars and restaurants.
We will definitely be back again soon.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Excellent concierge in bartender very accommodating
text: Hotel was wonderful got us in a great size room I know some rooms can be small there but we had a wonderful size room and they loaned me an outlet adapter which was very helpful on charging my phone. Always happy to call us a taxi and could speak English so communication was easy. Had cocktails in the bar with bartender Benjamin’s. Very cheerful
name: Hotel Cayre

title: My Gucci bag was stolen !
text:
I arrived the 25th and in the morning of 26 I went out and asked them to move my travel bag to put me in a better room, 
I had packed my bag and put all my belongings inside . When I came back in the after noon to move to the other room , they had already moved it and I looked for my Gucci bag that was placed in my travel bag , but no where to be found .
I immediately informed the receptionist, and they did nothing ! 
I kept asking them to search the house keeper and not let her out of hotel without searching her , but still they said she had already left . And there is nothing to be done ‘! 

I am really upset not only because I was stolen in a hotel room that is supposed to be safe , but of the treatment of negligence they gave me .
I am really dissatisfied and disappointed! 
I suggest you don’t go there !
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great stay
text:
Great Hotel with nice staff - especially blown away by Juan Carlos from Cuba who assisted me so well and nicely with my questions!
Super polite and obliging even tho he just started learning English he was a huge help to me!
Xx jana
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Excellent value for money
text: Great location. Very welcoming and helpful staff with special mention for Glen. Spacious family room. Very clean. Will go back again! Plenty of good restaurants and shops including high-end ones nearby.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Amazing hotel!!!!!
text:
Beautiful hotel with everything you need! Gorgeous room with lots of space. Our view was incredible, you could see the Sacre Couer from our balcony!!

The location is second to none. Right next to a Metro and 15min walk from the Louvre. 

Spoilt with choice when it comes to restaraunts and coffee shops right on the door stop. Noir coffee and Coya restaraunt were highlights. 

Only issue we had was the tiny pillows but these were swapped when we asked. My partner found the bed a little hard but this comes down to personal preference.

Breakfast had a simple selection but enough to get you going for the day. Hot food and pastries available. 

Would definitely return to this hotel any time I was in Paris!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Really pleasant experience
text:
I had a wonderful experience here thanks to the staff especially Glenn and Cedric. Who were nice to attend to our requests. They treated us with kindness and made sure everything about our stay was perfect. 
The hotel was so clean and well stocked room considering I made a booking an hour prior. It really needs it's 5 star status. 
Thank you for for making our stay in Paris perfect.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Near perfect location for a Paris stay
text: 2nd time to stay at K+K Hotel Cayre from January 12-22, 2022 and just like the last time (January 2020) - this hotel didn’t fail with our expectations! Location is just near perfect at Saint Germain area, a metro just right across the hotel, pharmacy and brasseries are all over the area!  Breakfast buffet always fresh and Deni very respectful and helpful for any breakfast inquiry we got for him☺️ Will definitely return when we visit Paris again!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Hotel Stay Incredible!
text: K&K located in St Germain area was perfect for our stay, metro so close, pharmacy, shopping the best cheese shop & many restaurants all within walking distance.   The hotel staff was extremely helpful with anything we asked and always smiling and willing.  Breakfast was fresh with a nice assortment to choose; Denny was the best!  Our room had a balcony and was very comfortable.  Highly recommend the K&K Cayre!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: 1st Time in Paris
text: High level of service delivered by their personnel.  Very convenient to many sights, restaurants, and, most importantly, the Paris subway.  Rooms were well-appointed and very clean.  Very good breakfast buffet.  Would highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Nice hotel but the USP: its location!
text: This is a nice hotel in the best part of Paris - near Rue de Bac. It is walkable to great shops, bistros and restaurants. The hotel itself is nothing special but the breakfasts were great and the staff friendly. Apparently there are rooms with nice views of the Eiffel Tower (but we looked out onto a courtyard). All in all, I would recommend this hotel just for its fantastic location!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Fooled by the photos and reviews
text:
PROS: The customer service and breakfast was great! The bed was comfy but that’s as good as it got.

CONS: We were fooled by the photos and reviews. I’m not sure if this was specifically our room only but I thought I did my due diligence of reading reviews, traveler photos and even checked their social media before I booked.

We booked the spacious family non-smoking room since there were 3 of us. 
The room reeked of smoke. We tried masking it with fragrance and poo-purri and it didn’t help at all. I could not stay in the room longer than 30 minutes because the smell was just so bad.
There were stains everywhere on the carpet and even a love stain on the chair in the room.
The bathtub looked rundown and someone did a terrible job of covering up the crack with plaster in the tub. 

We asked to be moved to a different room but they said we would have to wait until tomorrow since all the rooms were booked. We ended up sticking it out and just to never book here again.

*side note* there were these creepy photos on the wall through the hallway and in our room, we took them down during our stay because it just gave us weird vibes.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Wonderful, BUT…
text: We enjoyed a wonderful four nights at this hotel recently.   The room was clean and quiet with a nice view, very good breakfast, and the front desk was helpful with questions. Everything was great until I left a pair of shoes in the room by mistake when checking out. I contacted management immediately both by phone and email. The only thing I got back from management was a note that housekeeping found nothing in my room. This is not true!  There is a thief on staff, and if you stay here I urge you to be VERY careful with your things. Leave nothing behind and lock everything up of value when you aren’t there. So sad to have to deal with this!  My best advice is to stay somewhere else!!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Room with an Eiffel Tower view
text: I booked this hotel because it offers rooms with a view of the Eiffel Tower at a great price compared to other hotels offering the same thing. This hotel is located just outside the Saint Germain area which is a very well off neighborhood. The metro station Rue du Bac is right outside the front door to the hotel and is very convenient. We alternated taking the metro and walking because this hotel has such a great location. The hotel staff were friendly and everything was clean. Our room was great,  clean and big enough for me and my mother to  be comfortable for a week. The room was cleaned and replenished with towels and anything we needed. We booked the room with the hotel breakfast option and it was worth it. Breakfast is everyday from 7am—10am and offers a good selection of food. I recommend this hotel or anyone staying in Paris.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Fabulous location
text:
Just come back from a fabulous stay in the K & K Cayre. In a great location, central to all attractions. The room we had was lovely and comfy with plenty of room. A view of the tower made it even more special.
The measures for covid made me feel very safe, lots of sanitation stations all around the place, and cleaning was always going on. 
Breakfast had lots of choice and lots of room to be able to be distanced.
Tower was 30 mins walk, Louvre was 15 minutes walk, notre dame cathedral was only 10minutes away.  Restaurants and bars on the door step. Would highly recommend a stay here.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Perfect location and really nice hotel
text:
We just came back from a 4 day trip in Paris with my husband and 8 year old daughter. We stayed at the K+K hotel Cayre in their spacious room which was perfect for 3 persons and remarkably big for Paris. Our room gave on the courtyard and it was very quiet despite the very central location of the hotel.The personnel is very friendly (front desk and at breakfast). The breakfast buffet has all you need: pastries, jam/choco paste, yogurts (nature or with fruits), cereals and also scrambled egges/bacon etc for people who prefer a salty breakfast. 
The location is perfect, right by a metro station, a short walk to rue de Buci where you have many restaurants/bars, a short walk also to the Louvre. We only took the metro to go to the Sacre-Coeur or Versailles, we visited everything else (Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Notre Dame, Luxembourg gardens) on feet and it was just fine. 
We highly recommend this hotel for the friendliness of the staff and the location.
There is a parking just 500m from the hotel so very easy to leave your car there.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: PERFECTION IN PARIS
text:
Everything about this hotel is good .
Location- It is directly opposite the Rue Du Bac Metro ( but no noise or vibration penetrates ).
Across the way is a taxi rank .This is such an elegant part of the City with the famous cafes of St Germain De Pres  5 minutes walk away. Rue Du Bac which is around the corner is home to a famous ice cream shop, Conran and the astonishing Bon Marché Department Store . It has a brilliant food and  wine department as well as every serious fashion label that one could name.New to the street is a Courtyard that houses cafes and restaurants. Pierre Hermé does astonishing patisserie.
Accommodation- The building is classic yet the interior is modern . Spotless; every room has   air conditioning , a big benefit in a hot July , but is silent . Beds are covered in crisp linen . My marble floored bathroom had smart toiletries and plenty of towels . I had an unimpeded view of the Eiffel Tower , something that not every room offers .So much quality yet room rates are less , much less , than the big tourist chain hotels .
Staff - Nothing is a problem and they know good restaurants and bars to visit.Monsieur Cedric Joly looked after me and is a hotelier of the highest order .
This ticks all of the boxes and is where i will be staying for my birthday.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Love the breakfast and the location
text: Stay in Paris for two nights solo and enjoyed this hotel location. So close to so many things all walking distance. The staff is friendly and the breakfast is very good. I love the fact that they are using a lot of local / French products. The yogourt is out of this world with a bit of fresh honey. There are no disposal items, no plastic , all is reusable on the buffet and it is very fresh. Just « un petit bémol «  French expression ; the room for the urban solo is extremely small and looks a bit old. Some of the furniture should be replaced to give it a bit more modern feel.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Excellent hotel as a base to visit the city
text: Very well located and comfortable. Provides a perfect base for visiting the city by foot or metro. Regular rooms are a bit small as is the norm in Paris but the large family rooms have a good size. Staff Is cordial and helpful even though they are very few of them. The breakfast  buffet is fairly standard but good.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Fantastic for a trip to Paris
text: Excellent hotel located in one of the nicest neighbourhoods in Paris. The staff is extreme friendly. Rooms are clean and quite and equipped with everything you need. Nice entrance and good atmosphere. The hotel has a small but good fitness room and wellness area. Even in COVID times, our  stay was excellent.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Excellent hotel, top location and great staff !
text:
I arrived in a city deeply hurt by Covid-19 effects on tourism and income from it...not knowing what to expect as this was my first trip after a four month lockdown. The hotel I picked purely by location and by web impressions.

I was welcomed by warm and friendly FO staff -telling me good wishes as it was my birthday. I was upgraded to an Eiffel Tower view room, and as my train back was cancelled, I stayed one night longer in a room of one category less. Both room types were spacious, nicely appointed and equipped and offered a great sleep. 

Most important: spotlessly clean and well cleaned every day. The "Rituals" bathroom amenities were a nice touch (I took some with me from the shop next door).

Breakfast was ok, actually quite nice. It was not buffet style but served, the two waitresses clearly had little experience with one-on-one service and were at times a bit confused -they made it up with smiles and at the end brought every guest what they asked for (folks, give those people a break. not knowing if they will have a job sooner or later, all staff members of hotels are going through a hard time -as the entire world is...so I find it not important enough to get upset because they forget to bring you a croissant). Once you got the croissant, it was heavenly delicious !!!

The location of the hotel is superb. Can't get more central, you fall into the metro once you leave the door, and since Paris mayorship has stepped up alternative forms of transport (scooters, bike rentals and the like), you have it all in front of the door. Also plenty of dining and food options all over -it's St. Germain !

I highly appreciate the efforts of all Cayre staff members in these crazy times. They do their job graciously and friendly, not knowing what the future will bring. 

If you are looking for a hotel where you don't need to worry about transportation and cleanliness -try this one, it won't disappoint. I also found the prices good value.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Cool!!
text:
Great hotel in a great place. The metro is a few meters to the hotel. A Big parking with bikes  in Front of the entry. 

15 minutes by feet  to  the  Louvre  and to the Orsay Museum. Good choiche  of restaurant, shops and service nearest the hotel. We'll be' back  soon.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Home away from home
text: A great hotel with formidable staff. Mathieu and the team are there for you, under all circumstances. The hotel has a great location on the left Bank of Paris, with direct access across to the right bank.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Location Location Location
text: Loved our recent visit to the Hotel Cayre.  We had a room on the 6th floor with a stunning view of the Eiffel Tower.  Room was modern, roomy and comfortable with a good sized bathroom.  Good breakfast buffet, too.  For us, the location of the hotel was awesome.  The Metro stop (rue du Bac) was steps from the front door of the hotel and, for those who prefer walking, it is in easy walking distance of most of the sites that you will want to see in Paris.  It's our second experience with the K+K chain (we stayed in their Vienna hotel awhile back) and we have been happy both times.  We'll look for them when we travel to other cities.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Paris Must go location
text: This hotel was an excellent experience! The staff was attentive and helped me at all hours! The room was amazing and Made you believe you were in a luxury hotel. I will definitely come back to this establishment!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: 1st time in Paris
text: Even with a crazy public transportation strike we did well. The staff was always very helpful. The hotel public areas were always very clean. When it rained they gave us umbrellas to use for the day. Our room was cleaned well and we felt we had enough space for 2 adults. The breakfast which was incl was always delicious & well taken care of. No complaints. Would stay again.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: An example of plummeting from heights of excellence to appalling customer service
text:
I have been an avid and regular patron and advocate of this hotel for over 15 years.
It was staffed by people who really cared about their guests and would bend over backwards to rectify a problem on the rare occasion something occurred.
So why am I posting a negative review?
I made a reservation through the K&K Cayre website for a stay in March 2020. I made the reservation late at night. For some reason the date chosen reverted to default which was the same evening as I made the booking. I did not notice it as it was late and only discovered the error the following morning.
I called reservations at the hotel and spoke to a woman who claimed to be the Manager. I explained the situation and was brusquely told there was nothing she could do. When I explained what had happened she told me she did not have time to discuss it with me and to write in. I politely asked her fir her email address and she abruptly cut me off!
I wrote to a Mr Jolie  who is a Manager at the hotel and have received no response.
No one at the hotel could be bothered to respond or deal with my query.
All the old team have left and been replaced, it seems, with young people who do not have the same ethos or idea of what customer service is about.
I have tried to find a K&K hotels web site to inform HQ of the lack of courtesy and customer service to no avail. It seems they do not want to know unlike other quality hotel chains.
Like anybody else the only recourse open to me is to no longer spend my money and stay at this chains hotels.
I am now staying at another hotel and will in future avoid K&K.
I sincerely hope nobody else faces the same discourtesy and lack of help but felt potential patrons should be aware of the way they treat guests.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: KK Cayre Wonderful Paris Hotel
text: We recently stayed 5 nights at the KK Cayre in Paris.   We also have stayed her back in 2006.   This hotel is a wonderful small hotel located in a very nice area of Paris.    The staff are outstanding and will help you with anything you need to navigate the city and see any attractions.    It is a smaller hotel, but they have plenty of amenities.   There is a small workout area.   The breakfast each morning is well done.   The rooms, like many rooms in Paris, are smaller, but I think they are much larger than most properties.   We stayed in a Junior suite and had plenty of room to move around.   The hotel is located in the 7th district and is central to many attractions.    The Louvre is about a 10 min walk.   The Eiffel Tower, about 20 min.   There is a Metro station (Rue de Bac) right outside the hotel, but we only used it once.    We walked everything and most attractions are within a 20 min walk from the hotel.    The neighborhood around the hotel has plenty of cafe's, small markets, pastry shops and small grocery stores to get what you need.    If we return to Paris, I will certainly stay here again.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great location
text: We spent 12 nights at this hotel in Paris and found the location fantastic.  We were close to Louve, Orsay, Rodin, and many other places.  The staff was very good and kind!  I am not fluent in French and they were very helpful.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Perfect location, friendly staff!!!
text: We paid extra for the Eiffel Tower view- totally worth it at night!!! So cool to lay in bed and see it. The room was good, we had everything we needed- and the water pressure was terrific!! That’s usually a problem for me in Europe bc I have long hair. The staff was very friendly and accommodating and always spoke to us in English, even though I tried to speak with them in French. :) my husband ate breakfast there every day and enjoyed it- I loved the cafe au lait. we didn’t use the gym so can’t comment on it. I definitely recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Good service as always
text:
Our 3rd stay in 5 years & always a pleasure. However, economies have been made: room bar hardly any choice, used to be full to bursting, not that we are boozers! Sachets of milk & tea meagre for 2 people if you want a cuppa after checking in & later on not to forget early morning tea in bed! And no longer champagne at b'fast!
But on the happy side prices are stable if not down on previous stays - well done!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Dream visit
text: I took my wife for our "honeymoon" 25 years later.  Everyone at the K&K was amazing and helpful.  We will be back, but it will not take 25 years to return!  The location is perfect for walking to the nearby major attractions in Paris.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: A GREAT Hotel in a beautiful city!!!!
text: This is a great hotel in a fabulous location close to metro.  The staff was very helpful and the breakfast TOP NOTCH. There are many shops and restaurants nearby and most of Paris' great attractions are within a short walk.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great place to stay
text: This was a great place to stay. Convenient location. Easy access to major sights. Useful subway and bus stops a stones throw from the door. Helpful staff. Fast service when we needed assistance. Room bigger than expected. Really liked the little hall entrance within the room with a little mud-room like space to hang up coats on pegs with a bench and place for shoes with shelf on top for stuff -  in addition to large closet. Very comfortable beds. CLEAN! Great showers - constant hot water with good pressure - hand held as well as regular shower. All amenities including a fridge. We loved the breakfast included with our room's fee. Best croissants - better than those we got at various bakeries and restaurants during the trip. Perfectly cooked eggs - scrambled and sunny side up (or maybe poached?)  - fully cooked whites, but not dry - runny yolks, perfect for sopping up with one of the many bread choices. Good coffee - machine made many options well. Lots of other food choices - fruit, cereal, yogurt, juices, etc. etc.  Our thanks to the staff for a wonderful stay!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great attentive stuff and comfortable location .
text:
We stayed a weekend at K+K hotel in Paris . February is pretty cold month - was always warm in hotel + sauna downstairs was very helpful after long walks to relax and get some energy for dinner time and more walk ! Special big thanks to the attentive staff , especially Reseption team was kind attentive and helpful . Would love to mention Édouard / Reseption team / 
was attentive kind and helpful ! Thanks for all !
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Perfect!
text:
I can’t think of a single thing wrong with this hotel or our stay here. 

The location was amazing—central but not too touristy/busy. And the Rue du Bac metro station is literally right outside the door. The room was clean and surprisingly spacious. 

The service was very friendly and helpful but not overbearing. Right before check-out, I was struggling to understand our train tickets and a man from the front desk read the email and website in French, explained it to me, and then double checked with a colleague to make sure we wouldn’t be stuck at the station. 

The only thing I can’t review is the food. A breakfast buffet is included for those who booked directly through the hotel and is 19€ per person for those who didn’t (like us). There are so many amazing breakfast places of all price points nearby, though. 

I absolutely recommend the K+K Cayré for a stay in Paris!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Still a gem!
text: I last stayed at the K & K Cayre almost 3 years ago. It was wonderful.  So much so that I decide to return with my family.  With the exception of one little inconvenience, it still remains one of my top 3 hotels in Paris!!!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great vacation
text: The property was beautiful and well maintained. Our room was a nice size in comparison to some other properties in Paris. The neighborhood had some great shopping. We were able to walk down St Germain which is filled with resturants and shops.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great location
text: We recently had a family trip to Paris and booked a total of 3 rooms at K+K.  Overall it was a great hotel with a great location.  We did have an issue with the AC/heater in one room, blowing hot air continuously and being unbearably hot.  Every day we asked but it was not fixed during our 5 day stay.  They had maintenance look at it who said there was nothing wrong.  The front desk came up and set it and said it was fine, but the room remained unbearable.  Ended up putting extra people in the other two rooms and essentially not using that room for sleeping.  Every time we asked, we were told it was our fault, we must be leaving the window open, and we were doing something wrong despite not having any issues in the other two rooms.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great Staff
text: My wife and I have just returned from a six night stay. A very well located hotel offering easy access to all major attractions with metro station outside front door. Very clean and relatively quiet room which was larger than most hotel rooms in Paris. We were given a free upgrade, much appreciated. Breakfast is good with a large selection. The best aspect of this hotel is the friendly, welcome and extremely helpful staff. This is the second time we have stayed at the K+K and will be back.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: One night in Paris
text:
Great experience for my first stay at hotel Cayre .Perfectly located, only a few minutes from shops museum restaurants and transports Lovely friendly professionnel staff caring about the clients wellbeing. 
Clean comfortable room with balcony and street view upon my request Nice full breakfast Very satisfied with my stay, will definately come back
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Good location, comfortable & clean
text: Steps from Rue de Bac Metro station.  Good breakfast, nice neighborhood with plenty of good restaurants within walking distance.  Staff were friendly & helpful.    1 1/2 miles from Eiffel Tower. 1/2 mile from Muse de Orsey. I would stay again
name: Hotel Cayre

title: A nice small boutique hotel
text: Excellent location , attentive service and reasonable breakfast. Prices are rather high as compared to the room size. Rooms are clean and well equipped. Very convinient for a short stay of a single person.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: excelent hotel
text: the stay was very nice. The people from reception was very friendly and kind. The breakfast was delicious. The localization of this hotel was very interesting for us, with everything that we had needed inclusive Metro station, Restaurants, Pharmacy, Bakery etc.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: A pleasant stay
text:
Recrptionists were defenitely a plus for my stay: friendly and helpful all time. 
The room was clean, cozy and the bed super comfortable.
Central zone, really recommended, would definitely enitely come back.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: 50th Birthday trip
text: Hotel has an excellent location... excellent service. Breakfast is incredible. They treat you very professional and with a genuine smile. I would go back to Paris and would stay there. Front desk clerks are the best.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Fabulous hotel
text: Once again, K&K hotel did not disappoint us. We enjoy staying at this property because the staff are efficient and helpful, rooms are immaculate, location is best in the city. You can basically get anywhere in Paris within 30 minutes from this hotel. Subway and buses within one minute walk and restaurants close by and shopping within one minute walk. Everything is always perfect when we stay at this property.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great location
text: The hotel is in a great location to walk to many of the major sites in Paris. Loads of lovely restaurants nearby, great shopping. The hotel itself is modern, rooms are of a decent size given the central location. Great staffWe'll priced
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Bienvenue a Paris!
text: K+K Hotel Cayre is great. Centrally located in a great neighborhood and the staff is wonderful. The front desk, concierge, restaurant staff were terrific. I always stay here when I come to my favorite city in the world, besides home.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Perfect stay!
text: We stayed 2 nights in this nice hotel, second time, and again it was very pleasant! The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room is good and have nice bed and comfortable bathroom! The breakfast is a perfect start of the day. The hotel is very well located, the stores and luxury Bon Marche is around the corner, the entrance of the hotel near the metro station Rue de Bac winch is very central to travel everywhere you want to go in Paris. If you want to have a nice diner, then go to Cafe Saint-Germain where the best ober of Paris world, Kevin is the funniest en most friendly and the food is French cuisine. We recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great hotel staff
text:
My husband and I had the privilege to visit Paris for the 4th time over Christmas and New Year. We stayed at various hotels during our previous visits but our experience with K+K Hotel Cayre was something we won't forget. I won't rate the hotel itself 5 stars because the room is a bit on the small side (which is common in Europe in general) but the bed was very comfortable and the rain shower head was a plus. It won't be a problem if you pack light. Having a microwave would have been perfect. The hotel is centrally located in the Saint Germain area. Walking distance to most tourist attractions. If you need a quick snack, Carrefour is a block away. Monoprix is next door but it is mainly a department store and only carries sandwiches, bottled juice, salads, and soda. There are plenty of restaurants around the hotel. It is also close to the metro station, although we never used it as the metro employees were on strike and still on strike to this moment.

What made our experience with K+K wonderful was the friendliness and willingness of the staff to accommodate our needs. Special thanks to Deni and Nasir in the restaurant. Thank you guys for your great smile every morning during breakfast and remembering our room number. We enjoyed our small chats with Alam at the bar. Everyone at the front desk was always very patient and helpful with our inquiries. My husband is still currently staying in the hotel for business reasons. I felt like I left behind good friends when I departed Paris two weeks ago. Still to this day, when my husband is having breakfast in the restaurant, Deni sends his regards to me. Alam at the bar pops in when my husband and I have a video chat while having a couple of drinks. I hope I get another chance to see these wonderful people again. Cheers guys!!!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great Location But Average Rooms At High Cost
text: We stayed at the K+K Cayre in mid-January for a girls trip.  We have stayed at this hotel a number of times.  We had issues with our booking (requested a specific room but didn't get it and had to get them to change it once we were there).  The bathroom was also very run down with stains etc. and the drains kept backing up and not draining well.  For dual occupancy, the rate was very expensive for the size and quality of the room and hotel.  Bar staff and continental breakfast staff were great.  Location is fantastic.  It's the only real reason we keep going back. May have to look for another location though, because increasingly the quality is not worth the price.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Just paris
text: I love your hotel.Very comfortable and clean.It is convenient for not business but shopping. I like many shops such as chocolate ,cheese shops around your hotel.You should visit new passage” Beaupassage”.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: amazing
text: it was amazing experience when i stay i K+K HOTEL CAYRE the service was good food and staff as well as the ambiance and amenities.. Accessible in all access in the center of the city very friendly and helpful staff
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Good Location
text: Very good location and concierge front desk staff very helpful especially Glenn and Alan.  Housekeeping just needs to be on tip top shape as room's not being cleaned thoroughly as what is expected for a four star hotel.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: very comfortable.
text:
The room was clean and spacious, and the location was good to go anywhere and I was very satisfied.
The staff were also very kind.
However, I am glad if the price includes breakfast.Perfect with it.
I would definitely use it if I have the opportunity.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great Location!
text: K +K was a very centrally located hotel near all of the great shops and eateries within walking distance.  The hotel had a very amazing fragrance so much so that myself and other guest inquired about the scent to purchase for our own homes. The staff was both friendly and accommodating for our new years stay. I will definitely stay again.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great location and very comfortable rooms
text: I would recommend this hotel in Paris, the location was close to everything...close to Metro, shops, cafe and bars. Rooms very spacious and very well kept. The staff were very friendly. Maybe the bathroom was a little small.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great find for tourists..an excellent Parisian base
text: Fabulous location, upmarket and comfortable hotel.. great for families as informal and good for tourists using it as a base.. second visit and would stay there next time as it is good value and totally does the job
name: Hotel Cayre

title: 7 day stay
text:
It was a 7 day stay over the New Year 2019. The hotel is very conveniently located, the room ( junior suite) was big and nice. 
However, we had some ‘housekeeping problems’ - the room was cleaned only in the afternoon, minibar fridge stopped working. Fortunately it was repaired on the following day.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Nice location, great staff and fabulous breakfast buffet
text: Second time at the K&K -  nice location to walk around (food, stores, sites) and great staff (accommodating, professional [shout-out to Glenn]).  Last, and by no means least, the breakfast buffet is fab.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great Location
text: Hotel Cayre is centrally located in St. Germain and close to all the major destinations.  Our room was lovely and the neighborhood is beautiful.  We had the Deluxe room which was equivalent in size to an American standard room.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Delightful Accommodations
text: Our travel agent suggested this property for our vacation to Paris.  The hotel is centrally located just off Boulevard Saint-Germain and within walking distance of the major tourist attractions.  The room was clean, well appointed and comfortable.  We booked with breakfast included and were delighted with the well-maintained buffet.  Eggs made two ways, bacon, sausage, deli meats and cheeses, and fresh juices.  And don't even get me started on the croissants... to die for!  Cedric was incredibly helpful when we checked in and everyone else, regardless of where we encountered them, could not have been more accommodating.  We would stay with K+K again.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Outstanding!
text: I recently returned from a wonderful trip to Paris. I  stayed at the K&K Cayre for the second time in 3 years. The staff are fabulous, the rooms are clean and comfortable. The location is perfect. Walking distance to the Louve, Luxemburg gardens, Eiffel Tower and Musee de Orsay. Great shopping too.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Fabulous location, staff and comfortable
text: The hotel was clean, comfortable, good amenities and the location was fabulous. Can walk to Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame, etc.  Metro outside your door!  Many cafes, markets, and restaurants nearby.  Close to shopping. Staff is friendly, helpful and speak English.  Would stay again.
name: Hotel Cayre

title: First visit to Paris was excellent.
text: K & K was in a great location for our first visit to Paris. K & K is in an upscale beautiful area. My American family safely walked to many nearby big attractions & great restaurants! We were able to speak English our entire stay at the hotel & everywhere we went. That is a compliment to the friendly Parisians! There was a strike on so we used a Taxi $55. Euros to & from CDG airport Terminal 2-E. Uber's are available, but not as many as in the USA. Convert to EUROS before leaving USA. We would happily return to Paris & the K & K hotel whenever we return to this fabulous city!
name: Hotel Cayre

title: Great value for Paris
text: We just returned from Paris.  Initially we were a bit shocked at how small the room was but as we adjusted we were fine.  The hotel is extremely clean with great maid service.  The amenities (in-room safe, fridge, lovely toiletries and Dyson hair dryer and fan) were top notch.  And it is air-conditioned.  We were there during the heat wave and it was perfect.  The breakfast (included) was great too.  Everything you could want.  The area is rather quiet (which we loves) and within a short walking distance to a few Metro station.  Overall, we enjoyed it very much.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great hotel location
text:
Small room, but enough space. We stayed 3 nights. Good hotel, we lived on the second floor. Very good location. hotel just outside the Champs Elysées, very little to walk to.

Great dyson hair dryer. 

Did not like, that there was no free water in the room.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Fabulous little gem!
text: Stayed for one night on a short break to Paris. Room was spotless with various amenities. The Dyson fan and hairdryer were a good touch! Very central to all the Paris main attractions and polite staff on reception. I would definitely stay again if in Paris in future.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Good place to stay
text: Very warm welcome by staff and check in,friendly and helpful staff, excellent location ,walking distance from  all services ,restaurants, shopping and clean rooms,enjoyable stay, rates are competitive, rooms are comfortable,  recommended
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Worst Hotel Ever
text:
I stayed at this hotel from 3rd to 6th of December. I paid 499 euros for the stay through hotels.com. The hotel reception claimed if was a preauthorisation amount and only on hold. He then proceeded to charge me and my friend for the stay. 

I came back home only to find out the amount deducted through hotels.com was not a preauthorisation amount. It was debited from my account and they have applied for a refund. It has now been over 3 weeks and I have yet not recieved my refund. I have called up the hotel several times, spoke to Mamoun and manager Yousri, however they keep repeating the same thing over and over again without providing me help on why the refund is delayed. It has been a horrifying experience and I wouldn’t recommend this hotel to anyone.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Worst hotel ever; dirty stinky and unsafe
text:
I lived the worst nightmare at this hotel as I booked for a business trip for 4 nights. The sheets were dirty, the room was stinky and the radiator was making the room extremely hot and unbearable. When we called them to check it, they said we can't control it. This was not of the end of the terrible stay, someone got into the room in the night. I only got to know this in the morning when I found the door open. But that makes it even worse as I could now think of various dangerous possibilities. Just after one night, I decided to check out but the hotel didn't budge and without permission took the entire pre authorised money. Not just this, when we said we need to talk to the manager, he was not available at all despite saying we could wait.
My suggestion it's Paris you rather be safe then sorry and avoid this hotel. They are not nearly accountable and for once suggested me to open the doors to balcony and sleep. Worst mistake ever.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: I was cheated: Extremely unprofessional and unethical practices
text:
Linen was dirty, I asked for an extra sheet to put under the surety l quilt, in the whole hotel they didn’t have a single extra sheet ! the reception guy didn’t believe me that the linen could be dirty, finally he sent his colleague up to my room who then saw the linen and took pictures of it. They finally offered me a separate blanket.

They didn’t have toothpaste ! The excuse was they had ordered it but didn’t get a delivery because of the weekend! 

 They claim to have all non smoking rooms. I asked for a non smoking one. The room reeked of smoke . I kept calling them about it, they refused to believe me. At 10 pm I had to bring the reception guy to my room and then he acknowledged that a the previous guest must have smoked there but there was nothing they could do except move me to to a lower category room. After a 15 hour journey and 3 hours of explaining things to them, I had to take the option.

They disabled their air conditioning due to winter and have no way to lower the radiator heat. The rooms are the smallest you have ever seen and it was VERY SUFFOCATING! I was offered a solution of sleeping with my balcony door open !  This is a first floor room that opens out on the Haussmann Boulevard, not only was it very easy for anyone to climb into the balcony , one cannot sleep with the balcony door open given the noise from all the vehicles. As a woman travelling alone, I didn’t feel safe keeping the door open.

I somehow managed to spend that one night there and in the morning asked for my unused nights to be refunded as I was moving to another hotel. The receptionist flatly refused. She was polite but very unhelpful. I asked to speak to a manager, he was on leave and unavailable to talk to a disgruntled customer. There was no one else to escalate to.

I was charged for the entire 4 nights, despite checking out after the first one. When they moved me to a lower category room, they did not agree to charge me a lower rate, So I  basically ended up paying ~1150 Euro for one night !

Don’t go to this hotel, not only are they unprofessional but are also unethical !
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Terrible
text:
Arrived in Paris at the airport, collected our bags then went to find the transfer we had booked but no one was there, called the hotel and was asked to wait and they would call back. Waited 15mins then decided to get a taxi instead. Received a call back around 10mins I to the journey.

Checked in no problem and was apologized to for the transfer error. Paid then went up to the room to find there was no balcony (the main reason we choose this hotel). Immediately went back downstairs to get it corrected and was told that not all rooms have balcony’s but they are classed the same. We booked on hotels.com which clearly states room with a balcony.

Asked to be moved but was told there were no other rooms with balcony’s available so I asked for a refund. I was told as I had paid that I could not be refunded..... asked to speak to mange’s and was Loyd the manager left 2 mins ago (we were in the lobby by the entrance for 10 plus minuets at this point) and that he wouldn’t be back for 5 days and was unreachable....

Again asked for a refund or at least a discount as I could see the room available online now for £300 less than I paid for the same dates..... again unable to do anything.

Called my bank to cancel the payment and returned the key and suddenly a room with a balcony was available....

Still out of pocket as the room can be booked now for cheaper!

Their room descriptions are incorrect, they are stating rooms have a balcony regardless of whether they do or not.

Very disappointed as we canceled another (nicer) hotel to have a room with a balcony and thus far have had a very disappointing start to our trip.

Rooms are ok but not great considering the price, service is poor all in all poor value.

Recommendation: Do not visit
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: No, NO... it's unbelievable - the stranger entered our room (!) He had an electronic key.
text:
1. incompetent service at reception. Twice I was asked to pay for breakfast, which was included in the price.
2. The stranger entered the room who had an electronic key, but as he explained to another room !!!!!
3. Good breakfast
4.very small room
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Very nice hotel
text:
We had a great moment in this very nice hotel. Excellent location, very good service and nice rooms, small but with all the services and very clean. 
The owner was to nice and helpful, she help us with restaurants recommendations and she even give us a gift! I would definitely come back
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Perfect balcony,  great staff,
text: Great experience, they emailed a few days before the trip to ask for any special requests - all i wanted was a great balcony view and we recieved one! The staff was very professional and helpful, the bathroom hairdryer was great, very clean.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Overpriced with tiny rooms and poor service
text:
Room is the tiniest thing I have ever seen.  I could barely move around the bed. It's a very French rule based attitude. When I arrived in the morning I asked if any rooms were available that I could check into a bit early. They said check in is 2pm.  I came back around 1pm to ask again assuming that someone would have checked out by then.  Same answer. Literally 2pm on the dot they let me have my room. I don't think they made any effort at all to see if it was possible earlier. Very French. Rules are rules.
The room was not well serviced. Tissue box was empty. Moisturiser bottle was empty. Little things but it adds up.
On the plus side the location is excellent and they do cram all the things you need into the room, including ironing board, coffee maker and a desk.  Plus a pointless electronic toilet. Who wants that?? The young lady at reception was also very pleasant and friendly. And very beautiful.  
Breakfast was poor. Badly laid out so bowls are not next to cereal. Coffee never came with a little jug of milk. It seems they don't care about their non French guests. A shame. I won't return (except maybe to see the lovely receptionist)
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent hotel and location
text: We stayed at the Hotel Plaza Elysees in July 2019. We came from Australia and visited Paris with our baby and enjoyed this hotel stay very much. The room was beautiful, clean and had  traditional windows as well as air conditioning. The bed and baby cot were really comfortable and I especially enjoyed the luxury of the Dyson hairdryer! The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Paris with the Champs Élysées minutes away. With friendly staff I highly recommend this hotel and would stay again.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent Location & Service
text: Our Stay at Hotel Plaza Elysees was amazing! The hotel is located just 5 minutes from the Champs Elysees and a short walk from multiple metro lines. Truly one of the best locations I've stayed at in Paris because it is on a quieter street, but you get access to the major sites/streets. The Concierge was extremely helpful and knowledgable, and the bedrooms are extremely comfortable and clean. Bathrooms are also large for Paris and nice! We absolutely recommend this hotel and look forward to staying there next time we are in Paris!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Customer service needs to be improved!!!
text:
Booked a executive double room (the best one they had) via Hotels.com for 4 nights. When we arrived, the room wasn’t as described. On hotels.com, the room was supposed to have a balcony and a bathtub. Mine had neither and it was small. When we checked with the front desk, the person in charge was about to get off work and told us to wait for the next day before they could settle the issue. Might I highlight that we did not check in late. It was around 5-6 pm. Why couldn’t it be settled there and then?

The next day we were told that we had booked a superior double room (the cheaper one) and they had already given us a free upgrade. Excuse me? I literally paid for an executive double room. It felt like we had to ‘beg’ for a room change when I had already paid a high price for the better room. We managed to change rooms the next day. Very disappointing considering that I was spending my birthday at this hotel. 

Poor customer service aside, location is pretty good.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Nice little hotel
text: Spent 4 nights here. Location ok. Smallish 4star hotel. Room on the small side but manageable. Breakfasts ok - really good croissants. Reception staff were all friendly and helpful. Avoid Paris on Labour Day May 1st - virtually nothing is open.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Very nice
text: I enjoyed my stay. Nice location. New renovation. Friendly staff. Near Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, and all the restaurants and shopping. Quiet at night. Everything I needed for my weekend visit to Paris. Caution-lots of closures on Saturday due to expected protests. No worries.  Just limited access to some shops.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text:
Great location
Very comfortable room, even though it’s pretty small, it’s well organized. Loved the balcony as well :)
Very friendly staff
Definitely will stay again at this hotel!

Ps: Thank you for the birthday cake, it was very tasty :)
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent
text:
Everything was good.
It’s a very nice place to stay. Professional staff reception and helpful. The room was very clean and the bed is comfortable. It’s near to the metro station. I will recommend this hotel to my friends.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Fabulous Experience
text:
My husband and I loved every minute of our 3-night stay here - even through the protests of the gilet jaunes! The hotel staff kept us calm, and we were so impressed with the room and how close the hotel was to the Champs Elysées and public transport! 

I would highly recommend this for anyone planning to stay in Paris
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Lovely place
text: The staff were great, they were very welcoming and helpful. Breakfast was lovely and the room was very comfortable. The location is fantastic with plenty to do. Really enjoyed my stay and would come back if I'm visiting Paris again!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Not as advertised
text: My family and i found this hotel in Expedia.  The pictures were wonderful so we booked 3 rooms.  We arrived and it was quant.  We checked into our room and there was a dirty mop outside my door.  Our luggage did not fit in our room ... when you sat on the bed which felt like a bag of laundry by the way...the toilet and shower were all you could see.  Just not for us.  We went down to speak to the front desk and they charged us for one night then we found a fabulous hotel down the street for the same price and 5 stars!!!!!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great stay with very polite receptionist (Elena & Claire)
text:
My wife and I had a lovely stay in here and I would highly recommend. Clean and today despite we are hard to be pleased unless high standard. 

Professional service makes you feel special resulting in great experience. 

Thank you all.  

Will reuse when next in Paris
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: HOTEL PLAZA ELYSEES STAY in DECEMBER
text: The hotel is super convenient in terms of position as it is just a walk's distance from the Champs Elysees and there are plenty of restaurants/bistros around to choose from for meals. We had take away as well and it was very convenient as we could order food and have it delivered at the hotel. What is offered in terms of amenities is perfect as well as the services offered. The breakfast is really good in terms of food offered, and the fact there's a Nespresso machine for coffee (though you can get other types as well), made it perfect for me who's an espresso/coffee fanatic! The concierge and everyone working there: what can I say, they are super nice and very attentive to everything even my partner said before we left "please make sure they know we are coming back because they have been so nice!" (he doesn't speak French). And we definitely are coming back! :)
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: A good choice to stay when visiting Paris
text: Great hotel at a reasonable price given the location. Comfortable stay, very clean and very enjoyable. Very nice and friendly staff also, always smiling and professional. The breakfast buffet offers healthy selection of food and a great coffee. A place to go back for sure :)
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Visit de famille
text: Very good location. Nice to not depend in All the metro trafik All the time. Rooms were of a nice site. The food in and Sound the hotel Was og good quality. I would return at any time. Thank You for the hospitality.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent location,close to everything
text: The location of the hotel is perfect. Really enjoyed the easiness of moving around to any part of Paris, it is close to shopping area and restaurants .  Beautiful clean interior,very comfortable rooms and superb architecture to it. The staff is very friendly and attentive.Excellent guest service ,especially Elena from the front desk is very knowledgable and always on hand to help with all my requests.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Hello
text: A very clean and friendly hotel,the staff it’s very helpful giving the best indication to any touristic point from the city,we thank you specially to Elena from the reception You are the best!Good luck in the future.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Almost perfect
text: Lovely hotel in a great location quite close to the Arc d’ Triomphe and the Champs Elysees. The executive room in spacious by Paris standards, as far as my experience goes. The room also had a bath, and not just a shower. The great Dyson hairdryer in the room is a wonderful addition for someone who always struggles with hotel hairdryers. I would have liked the ability to make proper coffee in my room, but other than that the hotel was perfect. The staff were very friendly, and gave great assistance when required.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Beautiful, Parisian hotel near the Champs Elysees
text:
My friend and I stayed here in August. It was wonderful from start to finish. The staff were friendly and helpful, and our room had a balcony (which was a very happy surprise!).
Our decor was gorgeous - a pale blue, and having peaked into other rooms it seems they have different colours in each room.
It was a Parisian dream!
The bus was direct from Gare du Nord, and it took 5 minutes to walk to Champs Elysees or Arc de Triomphe. For me location is key in Paris so you can walk everywhere, and this hotel certainly delivered on everything we asked. We booked directly through the website as they have a price guarantee.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: A Great Find!!
text: Perfect boutique hotel -very clean, comfortable beds, staff were all very helpful. Location cannot be beat - just minutes to the Champs Elysees and the Arc de Triumphe. Little terrace facing the street was an added plus.  We totally enjoyed our 4 night stayand definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great Hotel!
text: A few minutes from champs elysee street and arc de trompe. Beds were comfy and all staff was very helpful and nice. From the arc de trompe,I took the big red bus tours and saw all of paris. I enjoyed the hotel. I would reccomend it.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great Location
text:
The hotel's location is amazing. It is located in the center of Paris and is walking distance from the Arc de Triumph and Champs Elysees. The advantage of this hotel is that is near everything but away enough that there is no outside noise. 
The staff is very friendly and helpful
The rooms are a bit on the small side but they were very clean and nicely decorated. It is also a bit loud within the hotel since you can hear hallway traffic from the rooms.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Lovely Staff
text: we absolutely loved our stay in Plaza Elysée. Friendly staff, excellent service in the breakfast area. The room was a bit small, we were 3 adults, but very comfortable and clean. Very well located, walking distance from Arc de Triomphe. We will gladly return if we have to go back to Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Lovely
text: We have had a lovely stay at Hotel Plaza Elysees! The rooms are clean and nicely decorated! The team at the front desk have been very helpful! Breakfast has only a small selection but it was delicious 😋! My 10year old and I have had a lovely stay x
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Cecilia
text:
This beautiful hotel is perfectly located. The very comfortable rooms are exactly as shown online and the staff were fantastic! Very helpful and polite

Extremely clean, comfortable and luxurious hotel. 

I would highly recommend this hotel and would love to return on our next visit to Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Top hotel
text: Business trip with 2 nights in this excellent hotel. The room was small,but really nice and clean. The breakfast with big offer. The service was greatfull. It is top hotel in the centre of Paris. I will recommend this hotel to my friends.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Nice - but a bit mad
text:
Stayed here for one night last week, whilst popping over to Paris to catch up with a mate who was passing through.

Address is a bit confusing (at least to a bear like me) as it is more on Avenue Friedland than Haussmann.  Nonetheless really well positioned to wander down to the Champs Elysees or to go to the whole slew of restaurants and similar slightly to the north.

Staff were incredibly friendly and outwardly helpful, but I really only had one issue, which was that the air conditioning had been set fixed at 23 degrees C, which is a little on the warm side in June.  Despite being pretty high end Japanese manufacture, the button to turn down the wick simply did not work.  My room overlooked the main road, so opening the window did not seem an option (though actually the road is far less busy than you would think at night), so I asked them to sort it out.  Behind the reception there is some sort of Bond Villain secret room in which such technological adjustments are possible, and so, after asking twice, I was able to set aircon down to 18 degrees and all was right with the world.  However, I do feel it is a bit naughty for a four star hotel to have done an override for every room at a temperature which is not really functional.  You can imagine a little maggot of a management consultant explaining just how much electricity, and hence cash, this little wheeze would have saved them each year, and unfortunately someone did not choose to turf him out into the road at that point.  Also unfair to leave the front desk staff having to deal with it (though they were brilliant).

Meanwhile room was spotlessly clean.  Toilet separate from bathroom (big plus).  Bath and shower both excellent with really hot water.  Bed moderate rather than excellent, but, all in all, pretty good, and when added to the relatively low price and the excellent location it delivers more than it misses.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Hidden Jewel in Paris
text: This cozy boutique hotel is filled with Parisian charm and warmth. Starting with a friendly and professional welcome from the front desk manager/ concierge, ElenaP. This lovely hotel has everything for travelers. Location: there is a city bus which literally stops at the entrance to the hotel. Bus 22 takes you to and back from the heart of shopping..Printemps and Galleries Lafayette. Around the corner of the hotel is Washington Street which takes you to the main street of the Champs-Elysees and the iconic Arc de Triumphe. Elena P. will help you navigate all these transportation questions and is very knowledgeable. Breakfast included: Breakfast is served in a beautiful dinning room and features a variety of yummies to satisfy your early morning hunger such as scrambled eggs, sausage, wonderful pastries baked on premises, cereal, breads, cold cuts and cheese and more. The Rooms: our room is small compared to American standards but regardless.. it was comfortable. The beds were excellent and the room was always attended to and cleaned. The shower has the BEST hot water and pressure!! The bath amenities are high quality too! I would highly recommend this hotel to singles and couples...it is truly a romantic stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Stunning Hotel
text:
Amazing hotel, great location and only a 10 minute walk to the Avenue des Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triomphe. Buses right outside the door to Les Grands Magasins on Boulevard Haussman and l'Opéra area, great shopping!
Staff were extremely friendly and attentive, rooms beautifully designed and comfortable. Champagne breakfast was on offer every morning. Would highly recommend and will stay again next time I visit.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: 3 nights stayed, good location, excellent service, noisy because its on the center
text:
The place was nice, clean and cozy.   The staff is great, and even we meet the owner and I was amazed about how helpful and nice they were.  They help you with everything and are available all the time.  We had breakfast there all the time and we love it. 
The reason why I'm not rating it excellent it's because it started getting really hot in Paris and we were staying in the upper floor, and they have a central AC that only they can control.  It was SO HOT at night that couldn't sleep at night, even if we open the windows, and it we do, the noise was too much.  My dad complain several times and they did nothing about.  For the price we paid, we would expect better sleeping conditions. 
Other than that, the place was great, and I like the location, central, easy to walk around, but if you like to avoid noise and crowded places, this is not for you.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Lovely hotel
text: Fabulous hotel with amazing central location-10 minute walk from Arc de triomphe and very close to metro station! Lovely helpful staff who speak great English! I will definetly be visiting again soon!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Sean king
text: Wow wonderful hotel in a beautiful city I hope to get back to Paris next year and will stay in this friendly hotel. Food was great, staff and services were great. They were very helpful and rooms were clean every day nothing was to much for them . Not to far to walk to the main shops and Charles de Gaulle. All I can say is THANK YOU Hotel Plaza Elysees hope to see Paris soon
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent location, excellent staff
text: We had a 5 night stay in this beautiful hotel. It was marvelous.clean rooms, Very near to metro and bus station and just 3 minutes walk to champs elysees. Helpful and friendly staff. I'll come again for sure.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Charming hotel with wonderful staff and excellent location
text:
The hotel is located in the heart of the city but doesn’t feel too overwhelmed by the business of such a central location.

The staff is wonderful - always friendly, helpful and accommodating.

The rooms are comfortable, beds cozy, bathroom has a great shower.

Breakfast has a little big of everything- hot items like eggs and fresh French pastries among others.

Overall a wonderful experience!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Lovely, friendly hotel in an excellent location.
text: I stayed for three nights with my daughter and felt extremely safe and relaxed.  Our room was beautiful, very clean and quiet considering the hotels central location. We found the transfer from the hotel very easy and the hotel is a 7 minute walk from RER A station. The station is next to the Arc de Triomphe which was a lovely surprise when we came up the escalator. Many thanks to all the friendly staff that made our stay so pleasurable.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Very nice, homey, boutique hotel
text:
First of all, I'd like to say thank you to all the staff at the Plaza Elysees, and especially to Elena from front desk who was extremely nice, friendly and helpful!
We enjoyed our stay here. The location is great, on Boulevard Haussman, right between  Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré and Rue Washington, and a few minutes' walk away from Champs Elysees and L'Arc de Triomphe. 
The room was rather small, but very nice and clean with comfy beds, and  with great amenities in the bathroom. There is a lot of closet space, where you will also find  an ironing table, which I found very useful. 
Also, even though the hotel's facade was in construction (like most old buildings in Paris), the noise didn't bother us at all; I guess the walls are soundproof or something.
Overall, I highly recommend this place!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Wonderful experience in Hotel Plaza Elyesses
text:
Stayed for four days and the overall service was professional and detailed.
Staffs showed willingness and took initiatives to give a helping hand.
The location was also easy accessible to the main Champ Elysees Av, bus stop very near, with lots of subway stations that leads to elsewhere. 
If have to mention one thing, and it has to be the construction going on with the building which blocks the view of the street and it would have been better if informed ahead.
But despite the construction going on, no serious noise was heard and because of their fine quality of service it made it acceptable.

Strongly recommend this hotel
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Feeling Homey in Paris
text:
To anyone looking for a reliable place to stay in when visiting the city of lights, make sure you check out this Hotel!
Hotel Plaza Elysees is perfectly situated in boulevard Haussmann - walking distance to everywhere in the city center.
We only stayed for one night. Anyone who has visited Paris before knows that it's a relatively expensive city with smaller than usual hotel rooms so please adjust your expectaitons before visiting. Hotel Plaza Elysees offers great accommodation with all the amenities one would hope for. 
Upon arriving we hadn't realised there would be construction work going on at the Hotel during our stay. The hotel staff apologized repeatedly and did more than make up for it. The building itself might not be the most beautiful or the most chic place out there but what counts is hospitality and cleanliness and this place is a 10/10 for both!
The staff went over and beyond to attend to our every need and we are not the easiest people to please. 
A big big big THANK YOU to Elena- the managing supervisor during our stay - who together with Claire and the other Elena actually put together an entire itinerary for us to follow (including a step-by-step visit to the most famous monuments, bus times, metro stops, coffee and meal breaks) They really listened and catered to our every whim :p 
Ladies you are real professionals. you make the place what it is. We really appreciate everything you did for us.
ps: the free n2 bus to the airport is located behind the arch on the right hand side. There was a lot of traffic but we did get to the airport on time in the end..
We will be visiting again as long as you all are there,
A Bientôt
Stef and Alex
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent
text: This hotel is excellent! Rooms are very clean, and the location is very close to Champs Elysees Av. Reception staff are very nice, helpful, supportive and friendly! Well done! I really had a great time there! A big thank you!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Excellent Hotel to stay in Paris
text: I found this hotel is excellent, room is very clean and location is very near to Champs Elysees AV. reception staff are very friendly and helpful.  I enjoyed the American breakfast and I hope to stay again on this Hotel during my next trip to Paris.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Best hotel in Paris with great location
text: I stayed at Hôtel Plaza Elysees for a few days during a business trip. Staff was welcoming, kind and helped me with everything I needed! Valerie is also an amazing host. She cares very much about her clients' experiences and knows how to make you feel right at home. The rooms are nicely decorated, clean and have all the necessary amenities you'll need. A tasty french breakfast is served every morning.The strategic location of the hotel makes it extremely convenient, for example: Arc de Triomphe, Champs Elysees, Eiffel Tower are a walking distance. If you're looking to stay in Paris without breaking the bank Hotel Plaza Elysees should be your go to.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Best hotel in Paris
text:
The hotel has the best strategic location to visit Paris. 
The room is very comfortable, spacious and new with a nice bathroom. 
Staff helped us very kindly in everything we were asking for and made our stay excellent! 
Strongly recommend!
Thanks a lot, we will be back soon!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: “Super well located small hotel in Paris!”
text:
Isabelle the owner & Valerie the General Manger of the hotel run a tight ship.
Excellent front desk with multilingual, helpful & polite service from all but especially Elena & Olivier.
The hotel is well run & very clean.
The rooms are petit, but have all amenities & are full of extra details;

-Wall chargers for your phones
-well stocked mini-bar
-Steamer for food
-jacket holder
-Weighing scale
-Flat screen TV
-Toiletries stand
-Etc...

A nice buffet style breakfast with good ingredients, friendly & efficient service from both Beata & Emerson.
However the outstanding & key point is the truly great location of the hotel.

Walking distance:

-Arc de Triomphe 5 mins
-Tour Eiffel 15 mins
-Café de Paris 4 Mins
-Boumboum discothèque 5 mins
-Restaurant Les 110 de Taillevent 10 mins
-Museums 5 to 20 mins
-Dominican Embassy 3 mins
-Etc...

Strong price quality ratio & I highly recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Annalisa Gray
text: Fabulous hotel friendly helpful staff would definitely stay again. I look forward to staying again soon would highly recommend.  Lovely fresh coffee and great choice with the buffet breakfast too. Great decor and very clean and tidy.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great hotel, great location
text:
Stayed 23-25\10, the hotel is tucked way but is n absolute gem. 

Great location and lovely decor.  It was only completed last year and considerable  thought went into the decoration

Staff could not do enough for you, very friendly 

Our room was spotless and had sound proof windows which worked very well.

We will definitely return to Paris and definitely will stay here again-it has everything we need and can only praise how it was

Highly recommended!!

Big thank to Director General Valerie Buttignol
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Good location, some helpful stuff
text:
Hotel location is very close to Champs Elysees. Rooms are small even executive rooms!

Stuff did'nt help about early check in even we had written a note and they accepted it. They even help about check in at 12:00-12:30. They said we could check in at 14:00.

Room temperature is not configurable. In Fall, there is no heating in the room even it cold in the room. Stuff was'nt helpful about heating. They only provide an blanket for us. :)

Stuff was helpful about suggesting a breakfast cafe and it was not bad at all.

Design of the bathroom should be better. When you took shower ground of the bathroom gets wet. Bed should be more comfortable, it's not an orthopedic bed i think. There should be more complimentary foods and drinks (like espresso machine in the lobby or room.) like other hotels in the same area.

I would try another hotel if i would go Paris again.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Highly Recommended !! "
text:
We arrived early, had no problem in booking in .Room was a good size and very stylist. 
Continental breakfast ,there was a great selection to chose from.
The staff was very helpful and friendly.
 Finally the location of the hotel was quite close to all the attractions.
            Thanks Alan .
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Easy to love
text:
Very nice little hotel, with friendly staff and nice rooms. Good choice if you want to be close to the big attractions and a bit local at the same time.
We had a twin room with a spacious bathroom. Loved champagne for breakfast.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: A Good hotel
text:
Second time already in this beautiful hotel and already plan whenever I come back in Paris to book it again and again. Good quality bed & linien  , very Clean, friendly staff, centrally located, quiet and close to Metro. Very good quality breakfast. What else! 
I am totally satisfied.
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Good one !!
text:
I stayed with the hotel for 3 nights and the room that I got was with an amazing view and a balcony.
So yaaaaay, it was lovely with the feeling in the morning to get up. 
- The beds were so comfy that I really didn't wanna get up.
- The variety of amenities in the room were good the quality was brilliant.
- The hotel from the entrance to the room even the restaurant was really stylish and cozy
- Great location, very convenient 
- Check out experience was way better then check in (2different staff from C/In - both ladies were very professional)

And you know It's Paris,
"A bad day in PARIS is still a good day"
But I will definitely recommend few thing for the place to better 
- Staff at check in all are confused and looks too much too handle 
- Across he team; A need to be TRAINED on Hospitality and customer service esp Check IN experience (old lady and the guy)
- Bathroom had a smell from 2nd. Day but I didn't report so it's my bad 
- Restaurant options in 3 breakfast ~ exactly SAME , could be more cyclic 
- Internet was ok, speed and connection not the best.
- It would nice to see some flexibility from the staff and management, too strict and stingy with rules 
- It doesn't speak well for the value of money

Overall a fabulous place to be for a stylish stay near the major happening location but YOU MISS THE A HOTEL BRAND VALUE and FACILITIES
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Not recommended
text:
I don't recommend this hotel at all especially for the people who are used on a high or even med standard hotels, it's said it's a 4 stars hotel but it's more like a motel we have booked a room for three adults lets start with the lobby it doesn't exist only a small disk and a long sofa, the room was so small we couldn't even move and the beds were sticking together the bath room small, old and the water gets every where when you shower,the towels not well cleaned, the window of the bath room not covered with curtains or anything else so in the morning when you are sleep the sun light gets through the bathroom door, we complained they told us this is the biggest room in the hotel so we stayed two nights they called us the third day to see another room and I was surprise that the room is bigger we moved to the room, the shower still have the same problem we couldn't even stand comfortably in the shower because the ceiling is low and the room was very warm the A/C doesn't work well, upon the arrival we arrived early and we have requested before an early check in they told us before if the room is available they will let us in, when we got there the lady told us if you want to check in early you have to pay 100 euro I showed her the email she told us in a rude way that's it you want to get there you have to pay, then the hotel manager came she was nice and tried to do her best during the stay but the problem is actually in the hotel, another thing to mention the hotel has no doorman or security..
The location of the hotel is good though close to the champs elysees..
We would have cancelled the whole stay but we did not have the option..
name: Hotel Plaza Elysees

title: Great Location, Nice rooms and Friendly Staff
text:
Upon check-in we were greeted by a very friendly and welcoming staff, plus Bella the cutest little rescue dog that sat behind the desk.

The decor of the hotel lobby is a beautiful art deco style, as are the rooms.
The hotel is in a great location as we were in walking distance to the Champs-Élysées and surrounded by cafe's and restaurants.

Their breakfast is a typical European breakfast with tasty mini pastries, eggs, meats and cheese.
