title: Excellent service
text: I booked this hotel for its proximity to Gare du Nord as I wanted to avoid to take public transportation to catch my TGV. This hotel doesn't look that great from the outside but it is a hidden treasure in the middle of that very busy and touristy area. First, the staff is just wonderful and will go the extra mile to help you out. As an example, I forgot my Iphone charger in another hotel and while they do not provide a replacement, the front desk (almost) walked me to a store where I could buy one!!!. Then the room is a typical Parisian size room (small for most American standards) but was very clean, and very cozy. It offered free filtered water, tea and coffee machines. It has air conditioning that you can fix yourself. The Wifi is very fast and reliable (very important for me since I was here for business), I could use for my online meetings, facetime and other online platform. The rooftop is also a wonderful place to work when the weather is nice (which I wasn't lucky with that). But do take a trip to the 9th floor and at least take pictures. I'm sure when the weather is nice, it must be a wonderful place to socialize and have a nice drink. Finally, you MUST have a meal at their restaurant and DO make a reservation. I made the mistake not to make one and I could not have dinner with them but did make a reservation or the following day for lunch and was able to eat there. Let me just say that their meals are very fine and the service is just at any higher standards that your average restaurant. I highly recommend it (again, be sure to make a reservation). They also have a nice downstairs (small) lounge) where you can actually work with comfortable chairs and a nice soothing music. In other words, this is a great place to stay, close to most tourist attraction with metro Pigalle or Anvers very close to you. Moulin Rouge is also walking distance and Montmartre is "just right there". Excellent service at all levels ... nothing bad to say about this place.

title: Style over substance
text:
Whilst boasting interior design that is stylish yet comfortable and supposedly  offering a unique “all inclusive” approach this hotel falls short on the basic fundamentals. Initial elation at finding a boutique non-corporate type hotel  near head office in Paris was quickly diminished by the lack of simple requirements such as hot room service food, a working air con, in room drinking water and with only very basic breakfast choices. Despite repeated requests for the air con and the room phone to be fixed there was zero response or action taken.To add insult to injury on the rainy morning of day 2 of my 3 day stay I was told a taxi would not come to take me to the office (15 min walk away) as the distance was too short - okay I understood this was not the hotels fault but when I asked if I could borrow an umbrella the answer was NO but we can sell you one for 30 euros - a large branded golfing size which is not suitable to take on the plane home!
So OKKO - you can keep your so called style and in the future I will stay at the Radisson Blu  - at least they know how to run a hotel and realise that their guests are their business.

title: A very good hotel
text:
In the last two weeks I was accommodated two times in this hotel. In two different floors and in different rooms. Overall the hotel is very good, expensive as all hotels during important events like exhibitions. The hotel in fact is located 10 minutes walking from Expo Paris. If you walk for about 10 minutes from the hotel you can find also a selection of different restaurants. The first time I went there, internet was not working but to fix my problem they gave me the access to the staff internet. In my last accommodation, the safe was not working and the hair dryer was working but you couldn't switch it off. You had to unplug it from the mains. Small  problems, I hope they will fix for next time. Overall service and cleaness were very good. 
The breakfast was good including also the food for those who have gluten intolerance. After 6.30pm there is a free buffet available. I recommend this hotel!

title: Fourth Stay this Year - Value can't be beat - couple of minute walk to metro
text: I discovered this Okko last February when the airbnb that I had booked turned out to be a disaster and I had to scramble to find a last minute hotel replacement. Would never have tried the hotel otherwise since its location is off the beaten path and in my 25+ previous times I have stayed in hotels in Paris  I've always have tried to stay in the center of Paris near classic tourist sites but, that night, this was the only hotel I could find that was <$400 a night. So glad I took the chance. Hotel is in a safe neighborhood, a couple of minutes walk to the metro (last stop on Balard line)  and via the metro easy (and inexpensive) to get anywhere in Paris (just a couple of stops to Eiffel Tower and then a couple more to Place de la Concorde). Also about a 10 minute walk to the Seine where you can walk  (or jog) along the River with great views of Paris. The hotel has a modern upscale Ikea feel with small but very efficiently laid out clean rooms and  front desk provides any complimentary toiletry you might need. Huge lounge that provides an incredible free self-serve breakfast  and free evening appetizers and drink.  But if you feel you must stay in an old fashioned Paris hotel and/or be in the midst of things the moment you step outside the hotel door this is not the place to stay. However, the $ saved by staying here each night provides you with a lot more pocket money to spend in Paris.

title: Few issues, Overall great hotel :)
text:
The hotel is situated in a good location, with close by access to Tram and bus routes.  The main centre of Paris is only a short train ride away. Close to the hotel are a number of great spots to grab a bite to eat, or to go for evening meals. Myself and my Fiancé found that the locals very friendly and always try hard to accommodate you, some even having english food menus for non french speakers. Our room was very clean and had everything we needed, including fresh clean towels. However, the main wall was made from open concrete and had holes in it, so wasn’t the prettiest thing to look at, but not a big issue. The room was quiet and I didn’t hear any noise from the nearby road or other hotel guests. 

The shower in the bathroom was extremely spacious and no issues with the water temperature. The only issue with the bathroom itself is that it’s situated in a glass dome of sorts? With plastic slabs. Which is very modern but the person you’re sharing a room with can watch you do your business, which isn’t what you want to think about on a romantic getaway to Paris. 

The selection of food and nibbles that was put out on a night was absolutely incredible, there was so much choice of fresh bread, meat, cheese, soup, etc. Overall it was just an absolutely amazing spread and such a good value for money. 
Same goes for the breakfast, a nice touch is that you can boil your own eggs, meaning they are just how you like. The main lobby and chill out area is clean, modern and super cosy. Fab to sit down with a glass of wine, or two. I think a really good feature of the hotel is that; there is a fridge situated in the main lobby, which is stocked with a huge selection of drinks e.g. fresh orange, coke, sprite, etc. and you can get a drink whenever you wish, for free. 

The hotel also had a good selection of wines, which you could ask a member of staff to get you a glass of. I had a glass which was absolutely delicious, but unfortunately, I only had one glass because there were no staff members available to actually get me another. We waited for about 40 minutes and even asked a member if drinks were still being served (which they were) but we still didn’t get any service. This was pretty disappointing as we were celebrating getting engaged that evening. 

So overall a few issues but a good stay nonetheless.

title: Hotel was nice but staff were rude
text:
The hotel was generally nice, modern and clean. Our room was fairly small but had everything we needed. The location was in the business district so very quiet at the weekend. 

The staff, however, were not so pleasant. When we checked in, we were explained the “concept” of the hotel was as an all-inclusive hotel with breakfast, food in the evening and drinks (aperitivo) provided. 

For both evenings we were there, we went down to have a glass of wine before we went out for dinner. Upon checkout we were told we had nothing additional to pay - but the hotel had automatically charged our card an additional €20 euros for wine. This was done without our consent and without any warning before we had even checked out. Staff were incredibly rude when dealing with the situation, and said that the “all-inclusive” description we got when we checked in was incorrect. This turned into an argument and the hotel staff were shouting at us. 

If I were to ever return to Paris, I would definitely avoid this hotel due to the rude and incompetent staff, and pick a hotel closer to the city centre where they actually value their hotel guests.

title: Substandard service and poor staff attitude
text: I booked this hotel for my husband and his friend for the Paris motor show for last weekend based on the overall good reviews. However, they were left very disappointed when they arrived on Friday night to no running water. They were unable to do basic things such as shower, brush teeth, wash face or use the toilet. When staff were confronted they just said we can’t do anything. This totally ruined the first night of the stay as both had flown straight after work and expected to at least have the basic amenity of running water! I have since contacted the manager via hotels.com who I booked through and have had the same attitude from the hotel manager. I’m appalled they have charged me a full night rate despite lack of running water. I’m not complaining about luxuries but a lack basic necessity and it appears this hotel will wash their hand off any such matter if you stay here. I appreciate work was being done locally but I PAID the hotel to stay there and it was their contractual obligation to provide what was promised. The only compensation I have had is being offered a lousy 50 euro and no direct apology by the hotel. Hotels.com customer services has been brilliant as usual at attempting to fight my corner. Will not be staying her again and would advice anyone who is thinking about booking to think again as you will certainly get no compensation if things go wrong at this hotel. Just staff shrugging their shoulder saying it’s not their fault or problem!!!

Other than these minor things, it is a very recommended hotel.

title: Amazing Hotel!!
text:
My fiance and I stayed at OKKO Hotels Paris Porte de Versailles from August 10 to August 21. We absolutely LOVED every minute of our stay! The staff were really nice and friendly, the rooms were always clean and the hotel offered a good selection of breakfast foods in the morning and a nice selection of appetizers at night. The hotel offered free wifi, drinks and free breakfast which was a HUGE bonus. Our room was stocked with water bottles every day which was really nice. We found out bed to be comfortable as well. My boyfriend and I found the location of the hotel to be in a nice and quiet, safe neighbourhood. We loved the fact that the hotel was a 5-minute walk to the subway station, which took us anywhere and everywhere (super convenient transportation) as well as we had the option to take the bus close to the hotel as well. I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel to anyone who is planning on visiting Paris! My fiance and I got engaged during our trip and the hotel went above and beyond to make sure we had a special engagement. They provided us with rose petals and a bottle of champagne in our room, which was so nice of them! Check in and Check out was very easy and quick. Other amenities available to guests include espresso makers, free bottled water, and hair dryers in the room. I would go back to this hotel any day!!

title: Another excellent Okko stay - Thoroughly Recommend
text: I really enjoy the Okko hotel concept and this one in Porte de Versailles is no exception.  Good location close to light rail and walkable to Metro station and local restaurants.  The rooms are smallish but don't let that put you off, as they lack for nothing - very comfortable large bed; great/large shower space; desk large enough for a laptop; nespresso machine. This is a fantastic concept.  Basically a large area with different kinds of seating (standard chairs and tables, high stools/tables, comfy lounges, etc), and you can grab a drink or light snack from the fridges...brilliant; plus they have a free drink and nibbles at 6pm every night.  And all this at reasonable rates.  Love the concept and absolutely recommend Okko hotels to anyone that asks.

title: 2-week stay first time in Paris
text:
My mom and I stayed at this hotel for 2 weeks back in May.  It was our first time in Paris so I went on TripAdvisor to read the comments about this hotel before deciding to book it.  It was a mixture of some positive and some negative reviews but I decided to take a chance on it and I am very happy that I did!
Like many other guests of this hotel who posted their reviews here, I had a very nice time staying there.  I had no problem with the simple, eco-friendly design of the hotel.    Some people mentioned the location of the hotel being farther away from the central part of Paris BUT do not let that prevent you from choosing it because the public transportation options are plenty and very easily accessible.
The main reason I chose this hotel was the included breakfast and the evening food offer was a nice bonus! I enjoyed the food selection very much--they are a good variety and of high quality.
The main stars of the hotel are its great staff! I'd like to say hi to Yoelle, Deborah, Jean-Philippe, Haider, and others that I did not get a chance to learn their names.  They were very professional, friendly, helpful, and spoke way more English than I spoke French! They all made our stay very pleasant. 
I highly recommend this hotel.

text:

Rooms are cleaned daily and left with refilled coffee pods and bottles of water and bathrooms are sparkling.
I would 1000% use this hotel (or the chain) again!! Overall a beautiful stay that made Paris even more special.

title: untrained staff, not included in the position of the guest
text: We arrived at the hotel late in the evening.  We were three people: two adults and a child.  for a child we were asked to pay 20 euros to get an extra bed.  we paid.  but the bed they brought us was broken.  in the end, it was decided to put the child on the floor, and we were promised a refund upon departure (20 euros for the first night).  the next day, we were moved to a triple room.  for which, too, was paid 20 euros.  upon check-out, the man at the reception with glasses (looks like a Spaniard) spoke in a raised voice, did not want to return 20 euros for the first night.  and that the child was forced to sleep on the floor.  also, did not want to discuss delicately the problem.  spoke in parallel on the phone with someone (obviously not on working moments).  When I started filming his behavior on my phone, I immediately got scared.  I left this conversation with tears in my eyes.  do not recommend, some staff are not trained to communicate with guests
name: Fred Hotel

title: Very good reception and valuable stay
text: The reception person's quite friendly and helpful, helped us to upgrade the room for free.  In a quiet neighborhood, the metro station is within walking distance. If you find hotels near the business district expensive, can try those located in the residential area like this one.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Bright, clean and modern in a good location
text:
We had 2 rooms for 5 nights at the Fred Hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were spotlessly clean and comfortable. The location was good, being only a short walk to the nearest Metro station.
We would definitely stay there again.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice boutique hotel in a quiet location close enough to main sites!
text: This is a nice small boutique hotel in a quiet location but conveniently located with the metro being only a few minutes walk away, the Eiffel Tower was about 10 mins by cab and other main sites are easily reachable by the metro within 15-20 mins. Hotel was very clean, the room was nice and spacious (we had a deluxe room on the top floor, the only downside was the transparent glass door to the bathroom). Friendly staff and very welcoming, highly recommend.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great hospitality in a quiet neighborhood
text: Stayed here last year in November and they’ve maintained the same level of hospitality and service. This time, we booked a classic room and requested an early check in. We waited at least an hour and was accommodated at 2pm with a bigger room and a patio. We felt safe around the neighborhood and being close to Plaisance, we can get access to almost everywhere in minutes via Metro.
name: Fred Hotel

title: June stay
text:
Stayed in the Fred hotel for 3 nights from the 10th June. We had 2 rooms booked- the superior double. We had originally booked the basic double but we were contacted by the hotel management to say that these rooms wouldn't be suitable for 2 people sharing and the superior double would be better for more space. 

We got to the hotel early and Tovo took our luggage and recommended places to go while we waited for the rooms to be ready. There is a big supermarket- Auchan just around the corner which was great! And the main plaicence metro station was a 2 minute walk which took us every where we needed to go! 
One of the rooms we got was lovely and big with a king bed and separate bathroom with bath/shower, the other room we were allocated was alot smaller with a sink in the middle of the room and a bad layout with only a double bed. The only downside was the room size and the fact that the shower water leaked everywhere in the bathroom and bedroom. Personally I think that the 2 rooms were very different and should not have been charged at the same price. 

The Air com system was brilliant and well needed as it was a very hot weekend when we stayed. The staff were friendly and attentive and we would definitely stay here again if visiting paris again.
name: Fred Hotel

title: A fine little hotel in a lovely neighborhood
text: While it is certainly not as fashionable a locale as some other parts of town, I love this quiet little area. Easy access to the Métro, a couple of markets, solid restaurants, and third wave coffee, just a few minutes from the Gare Montparnasse.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great Staff
text: We really enjoyed staying at the Fred Hotel. The location is great - near 2 subway stops and many restaurants and shops. The hotel is clean and the rooms are pleasant. The thing that made our stay special was the care and kindness of the staff.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Wonderful hotel, lovely area
text:
This hotel was everything I needed for a trade show visit. Good value, super clean and friendly. Rooms and especially beds very comfortable, felt homely but chic.

Area is lovely, not too busy and some wonderful shops, cafes and restaurants. Really chilled and seemed quite French and residential.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great little hotel, very comfortable and friendly
text: The hotel is in a good location, a couple of minutes walk from a metro station (Plaisance or Pernety) with good connections into central Paris. The staff were really friendly, and the room spacious and extremely comfortable - we felt immediately at home. It was relatively quiet at night. The breakfast was good, although the room was a little small for all the guests. Highly recommend!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Excellent Value for Money
text: The hotel is excellent value for money. Small and small rooms ( like all in Paris) but well decorated.The front desk clerk accommodated an early checkin in a smaller room and I later moved to the room I had originally booked.Everything is spotless new and clean,breakfast is very good. It has a small cozy waiting area with  a couch and magazine’s in the front part of the breakfast room. My only comment is that the shower does not retain the water on the floor ( ask for extra towels)I definitely recommend it and will go back when in Paris
name: Fred Hotel

title: good location, nice style
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights. Liked the room, not too large but contained everything you could need for a short stay. Very friendly people at reception, helpful and professional. 

Location is also very good, with lots of restaurant choices in walking distance, metro around the corner and not too much noise from traffic. 
Also luggage storage with a numbered ticket is a good practice you don't see often with hotels in this price class. 

Highly recommended.
name: Fred Hotel

title: August/September stay at the Fred Hotel
text: We just returned from Paris this week and stayed at the Fred Hotel.  While the accommodations were mediocre at best, the service (or lack thereof), at the front desk from Gerard was absolutely appalling.  He was completely rude and appeared to be somewhat racist with his disposition and approach with me and my family.  The original room that I was assigned, upon arriving at the hotel, was not the room that I had booked - a superior room - it was the basic room and the black tiles were loose and dirty in the shower.   Overall, the standard room to which I was originally assigned - room number 55, did not appear clean.  Gerard offered the superior room to me as if presenting an alternative as a concession after I complained, however, this was the room that I had booked in the first place!  Also, Gerard asked me to pay for my stay in advance at my arrival for the entire amount.  I am a very seasoned traveler and have never been asked to pay for my hotel stay in its entirety in advance at check-in.  Also, my first day there, Gerard had a verbal disagreement that devolved quickly and got quite nasty with a loyal hotel guest who had stayed there at least five times previously.  I was shocked at how rude he was to this guest who was an older woman who attempted to engage Gerard with only civility and respect.  All of the other employees, including the other people who worked at the front desk and the housekeepers, were very gracious and polite.   I have been to Paris numerous times - my father is French and I grew up part-time in France - and only booked here because I needed to be somewhat close to Orly Airport but still wanted to stay within the city limits (inside the périphérique ).  Also, my daughter and I stayed in room 51 and the lock on our room door was always jammed and we actually got locked in our room one morning - this was a major fire hazard and I needed to call from inside of our room to have someone come and let us out of the room. On our check-out day, this past Sunday, September 5th, I needed to print out our boarding passes and Covid test results prior to our flight and the printer was not working and unavailable. I think that the corporate office should review Gerard's employee record and performance. I would never book the Fred Hotel again and would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great Hotel, From Texas to Paris
text: Great hotel in a great location near very nice places to eat and shop, close to metro for getting around, wonderful professional and friendly staff, Rooms extremely clean and very up-to-date, nice breakfast in the morning with coffee, breads, meats, cheeses, cereals, fruits. Great hotel!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Cozy
text: Next to metro station, nice beds, AC. No fridge in rooms, small elevator. Nice French breakfast: baguettes and croissants. Lot of restaurants around. We stayed on the top floor, in some parts of the room the ceiling was tight, with beams, but still a nice room.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Really nice hotel and services
text:
A collegue and I were in Paris for work for several days. When we arrived, everything was ready and the hostess was really welcoming. We were agreably surprised by the practicity of the location : pretty closed from the metro and tramways.The rooms were perfect, nothing to add. Perhaps, just a thing about the shower, not entierly closed, which splah water all over the bathroom !
Breakfast and bar are served in a cozy and comfortable atmospehe, right next the chemney. good quality and origin products.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Friendly service and clean rooms
text:
Very friendly service personnel and nice rooms . 
I gotta say Fred Hotel excellence my experience. The service was very friendly and helpful . The breakfast was also fresh , lots of choices and quality items. I was pleased by their location which has good connections. 
I will be happily return on my next visit to Paris.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice find!
text:
Stayed for 3 nights as a group of four, booked two family rooms which worked well. Located at the end of the corridor on floor 4, we were able to close a door on the hallway and leave our bedroom doors open in order to make one huge apartment.

Walking distance to bakeries and restaurants this is a great find. Metro station near by that can take you to all the Parisian landmarks.

Staff were fantastic and couldn't do enough for us, very friendly, accomodating and knowledgeable.

For parking, we parked at the hospital in which the hotel can get you a discounted rate to park.

Highly recommended and will return. In the words of the great Arnie himself, 'I'll be back'
name: Fred Hotel

title: Okay hotel, perfect location
text: We arrived having booked a room for 3 adults, I think there had been some confusion as it took a long time to get a room, and when we did it was very small, we did get moved to a better sized room for the second & third night. The rooms are a bit tatty, bed side table coming away, glass rolled off and smashed. Showers don’t have a position which doesn’t soak the entire bathroom, but not your head :). But overall hotel was okay and location was perfect. Lovely shops & restaurants/ cafes and easy walking to various stations and metro stops, as well as into the city.
name: Fred Hotel

title: 3 Night stay
text: A small scale hotel, surrounded by many cafes, and restaurants about 5-10mins walking distance. The main floor lobby is very modernly designed. There is an option of buffet breakfast although this wasn’t included with my stay. The room was kept very clean each day. Free Nespresso coffee was provided in your room, as well as a free bottle of water per day. Staff was very friendly and courteous. You are required to pay a small city taxes fee per night. We stayed in a superior room and standard room, I would recommend a luxury room for more space.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Certainly worth a visit
text:
A lovely hotel a bit off the beaten path. Still easily accessible by metro. Small with about four rooms per floors. Very quiet. Good service from all the staff. Things to know: the rooms on the last floor have low cellings. No showers but this is well described on their website. The breakfast was ok. This was the main thing that was ok (versus excellent).

Bottom line : now on my short list when I go to Paris.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Safe, clean, convenient  little.
text: Impeccably decorated and super clean. It's conveniently located one small block from a subway station.The staff is friendly and efficient. If you are going to Paris and don't know your way around, know this: this place is a great choice. It's the little things though (no pun intended). The bed When they say it's a KING size bed, it's rather on the line of "little" king size bed. The breakfast situation is where it gets a little complicated. It's not about the quality of what is offered. Everything is there, everything is nice. Tables are tiny though. I find the "concept" toaster, coffee machine and egg boiler kind of difficult to get. Some instructions would be in order. For the life out of me I couldn't make that thing spit out coffee instead of hot water. But this would be totally irrelevant if only they had AN EXTRA PERSON on the floor clearing the tables and available for issues like this. THe only person they have would be gone for sometimes 20 minutes. I understand, there's probaly plenty to be done in the kitchen but that affects the breakfast experience in my opinion. The first day I honestly thought someone hadn't shown up for work, but on the second day it became clear that they were simply short staffed. That being said, the place is great. Youll have a peaceful. night's sleep in a safe, clean and pleasant place. Breakfast may be turbulent but you'll be fed. I would both recommend and go back there.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Over priced hotel
text:
ordered this hotel for ridiculous overpriced rate and got a tiny room with dirty blanket and broken sink and broken shower head. The location is very far from all of the known activities.
The room was a Deluxe Room with courtyard views, where we had to suffer from party noise until 2AM from one of the flats next to it. We could not sleep due to the loud music. 
The only advantage is the nice staff in the hotel. 
I was very disappointed, and this is not my first time in Paris.
name: Fred Hotel

title: esthetically and friendly
text: it was a very nice weekend in Fred Hotel. The service was very friendly and helpful and the Hotel esthetical and comfortable. The breakfast was also very nice. My girlfriend and me were pleased by this inspiring location.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Friendly staff, clean rooms, cozy atmosphere
text: I had a great experience at the Fred Hotel. Staff was very welcoming and friendly. The rooms were nicely made up and provided me with everything I needed. The location is great - it's just off a busy street so that it wasn't very crowded but close enough that I could walk to local cafes for breakfast.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Recommended hotel.
text:
A clean hotel with friendly staff. We stayed for 5 days while we toured around Paris. It's in a pretty good position for this. The nearest metro station is a few minutes walk away (Plaisance ) and only 20 mins ride  most of the main sites of interest; Champs Elyssee, Eiffel Tower Last louvre etc. The staff are all very helpful and friendly. All the reception guys speak good English. 
Breakfast is continental style self service. It can get a little crowded but all on all not bad. In the local area there are several bars, restaraunts, take aways, wine shops and a small supermarket so you can easily cater for any food needs nearby. A short cab ride into the centre of the Montparnasse area will put you in the way of many good Brasserie. 
Next time we are in Paris I will check the availability here first.
name: Fred Hotel

title: My experience
text:
the hotel is welcoming.
the room are modern with very good sleeping.
The service always available and people ready to help.
i really appreciate the location none far from transport, with restaurants and shops nearby.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Fred Hotel Paris France
text: Highly Recommended ! Very Comfortable and Clean Rooms backed by a very Professional and Friendly Staff at the Reception. Very close to the Metro and a variety of Restaurants in close proximity. Ideal stay for a business traveler or family.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Wonderful stay
text: The staff were very friendly and helpful. The hotel was very quiet, and a good size, so it never felt overcrowded. The breakfast was very nice, and the breakfast room was clean, organised and relaxed. Also, location is perfect, not on a busy ride, only a couple minute walk to the train station that takes you very close to the middle of Paris. And lovely restaurants in the area as well.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Quiet boutique hotel
text: Great value hotel located in a beautiful part of Paris. Quiet with good local shops and restaurants yet still easy to get to all the sights. Hotel with modern decor nice rooms and good value breakfast. Very friendly staff.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Lovely place
text: A cool little boutique hotel that is easily accessible to many parts of Paris. Friendly welcome and lovely staff. The place is clean and a good base of you are visiting Paris. The reception area also has a tv and seating area.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Charming and comfortable
text:
Choosing this hotel was strongly based on reviews, as we stayed only a regular weekend in Paris which tends to be over quite fast. 
I liked the style a lot, and I would also recommend this hotel to everyone else on a private trip as well! For sure during the summer days the hotel is probably very full and not as affordable as during our stay in early May, but totally worth a visit it if you have the chance.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Home in Paris
text: We are checking out now from Fred hotel. It feels like leaving home. We were a family of 5. The location is perfect the metro at a walking distance. The street full of bakeries and restaurants. These rooms are big small but very well equipped, clean and the bed is very confortable. The breakfast includes high quality products. But above all was the service. Everyone here was more then welcoming , helpful, extremely friendly. Was very good choice staying with u at Fred hotel. Highly recommended
name: Fred Hotel

title: Worst customer service - Tovo
text:
I really didn’t want to give Fred hotel any reviews esp a negative one as our stay there was mostly okay (convenient location etc.) but the way Mr. Tovo at the front desk handled our checkout was simply appalling. He claimed that we hadn’t paid for the stay (we were charged by the other nice gentleman when we checked in), when we pulled up our Amex transaction record to show him proof of payment (hotel name, address, DATE  and amount etc.) he dismissed us by saying ‘how do I know it was for this trip?’. Yup you read it right! He basically called us liars! Then he decided to ‘confirm’ with the other gentleman who had checked us in by calling him. All this time we were standing there like idiots for no fault of our own. After his ‘confirmation’ (because ofcourse Amex and the whole world apparently goes around lying!) he gave a ‘fake’ apology. This gentleman does not belong in hospitality industry.

The other gentleman who checked us in was the opposite and extremely nice but we will not be coming back.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Right Said Fred!
text: An small but excellent hotel tucked in one of the sidestreets of the 14th arrondisement, we were lucky to have stumbled upon it on the net. It is newly renovated, clean and well-maintained. The air-conditioned rooms were a definite plus during the heat wave that swept Paris during our stay. The staff was friendly, efficient and very helpful. I would stay here again, if ever I return to this city!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Good accomodation
text:
I only stayed for a couple of nights but I found the hotel very good. The room was comfortable and well equipped although as a preference I would chose tea over coffee in the room.
The staff were friendly and helful if needed.
A food quality accomodation for a reasonable price.
name: Fred Hotel

title: excellent service
text: our stay was short but the staff was really attentive.especially Ader (?) at the front desk.My wife was ill and his kindness, genuine concern was reassuring...little things were done to acommodate..i will definitively recommend this hotel to anyone : clean, well located with excellent people working there
name: Fred Hotel

title: Very nice
text: This was a good find. The concierge were very friendly and helpful. Especially Yusuf who made our interactions a delight. It's in a great location with a few good brasseries close by and multiple subway stations a short walk away. The room was very small though. Very small. But the trade off for a good hotel in the centre of Paris was worth it.
name: Fred Hotel

title: A 3 star hotel that-strives to be more but isn’t
text:
Spent 3 nights at Fred.  My review is mixed.  As a hotelier myself; I can forgive a lot as I know the drill but others require intervention by higher management.  The main requirement for me is friendly and welcoming staff which Fred certainly has.   Everyone was all smiles.  Sadly that where it ends 

I won’t complain of room not being ready for early check-in as that’s just a bonus.  I will complain of a faulty room and no follow up despite my daily complaints to front desk whom all said we will take care of it...... perhaps they did and couldn’t fix it so ignored it.  I’m not sure.   But as a hotel departmental manager, leaving your quest questioning or ignoring is the absolute worse thing you can do.   Sadly this is what happened at Fred.  I stopped complaining.    I was told they would fix my issue and if not complete a room move.      Issues wasn’t fixed. ......no complaint logged on my account.    No notes for room move. 

To be honest the issues were pretty mediocre and didn’t really affect me as I was hardly in my room ....... however if I was then I would’ve been escalated to the GM.  

Thanks Fred for the friendly smiles but sorry; won’t be back
name: Fred Hotel

title: Good Boutique Hotel
text: My husband and I stayed at the Fred Hotel for three nights in December. We were able to check in early which was wonderful, and we were brought to a room on the main level in the back garden area. Our room did not have any windows, but had a glass door/ entrance with a shade over it. The room itself was well appointed with an area for a desk, a nespresso machine and a small television. The bathroom was quite large for a paris hotel, however the door to the bathroom was a clouded glass. This was not my favorite, as it did not provide much privacy while using the toilet. We had a comfortable stay at the Fred hotel and it was very reasonably priced for Christmas time when other hotels were rather expensive. We did find that our room had been left unlocked after it was cleaned one day, and that was rather unsettling. The front desk was always very friendly and helpful. About a 10 minute walk to the local metro station.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Half term break
text:
Great little hotel in a nice quiet location. 

Rooms were clean and tidy with decent bathrooms.

Close to the metro but walkable to all of the big tourist sites.

Never used the breakfast offering as we preferred to find a cafe nearby. 

We would definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice small hotel in Paris
text: Stayed at the Fred Hotel for business and enjoyed the stylish Classic Room although it was rather small. The reception and breakfast area was beautiful but sometimes too cold due to the entrance and the very cold winter weather outside. Location was ok, Metro station close by. Staff was very kind. Thank you for having us.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Friendly hotel
text: Small but cute hotel. Stylish, quite, firm beds, smaal but clean rooms. Staff friendly, helpful and knowledgeable of local area and bilingual. Plenty of local eateries and shops to keep oneself amused for an evening or two.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Small but Cute
text:
Hotel was nice, just the lighting could have been a bit better. Room is small but is normal for being in Paris.
The only thing I didn’t like was that you have to leave your key at the desk whenever you’re leaving the hotel. But hey I guess you can never loose your key. Desk attendants were also very nice.
name: Fred Hotel

title: 2 year wedding anniversary in Paris
text:
The stay was amazing. Very nice, modern boutique hotel. The staff made our stay fantastic. Tovo checked us in and pretended not to speak English. Made us practice our French and made for a funny joke. He was awesome and helped with ANYTHING we needed. Helder was just as awesome. He gave us great recommendations and we spoke several times. These two were fantastic and really helped make our anniversary trip special. 

Thanks Fred Hotel
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great stay
text:
We recently stayed our 1 night in Paris at Fred Hotel. Cute and charming but the best part was the friendliness of the staff. As an American, you hear about the rude Parisians but they did not get the memo. They get Five stars from us. The breakfasts small but 
delicious with fresh bread replenish throughout the morning. Clean rooms and was very quiet. Bonus is how close they were to the metro. Thank you Tovo for your hospitality.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Charming hotel
text: Very charming hotel in nice safe area. Two metro lines are close by. The best thing in hotel are employs, very very friendly and willing to fulfill all requests we had. Check in and check out was easy and fast. Lobby is very nice, rooms could be a bit better. Breakfast was good, and worth the money, although area for breakfast was a bit small. I will definitely come back.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great location
text: T`was a great stay with Mom and Dad, On a quiet street,near to a Metro, Restaurants, Cafe, and a large grocery few steps from the hotel. Excellent and welcoming staff who were helpful about anything!  Overall a lovely botique hotel.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Perfect accommodation
text:
Very friendly and helpful staff, nice breakfast, the rooms were clean and comfortable
and I liked the fact that it is a non-smoking hotel
I liked the modern decoration!! Also the prices were affordable
I would totally recommend it!!!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Modern hotel with tiny rooms
text: Convenient hotel to the metro with great restaurants, especially for crepes! Modern hip room decor and big bed, but super tiny bathroom!  Moderate size elevator, nice back patio garden, and cool lobby.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Cozy, comfortable stay at Fred Hotel
text: My stay at Fred Hotel was very pleasant. The staff were friendly and helpful, the rooms were clean and cozy, and the breakfast was fresh and affordable. I recommend this hotel for couples looking for a nice local taste of Paris.
name: Fred Hotel

title: All you need.
text: The Fred hotel had very friendly hosts. They were welcoming and helpful from the first moment. There is a very small lift, 2 people max, and the room is quite small, but is really all you need. The AC was nice as it was a very hot weekend and it was nice to have coffee in the room too. We didn’t need anything else for our quick stay. The 13 line is right around the corner and also there is a great breakfast shop just near the entrance to the metro where we had the best breakfast all week!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Great hotel
text: Great hotel and amazing front desk staff. They made an effort to speak in English and I really appreciate that. I was extremely happy that my room and bathroom  was sparkling clean. I enjoyed my stay at Fred Hotel, thank you!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Family of four in two rooms
text:
First, I cannot say enough about how welcoming the staff was every time we returned.  Helder, the desk attendant, was so much fun to chat with! He put us at ease and recommended great food (very close).   
Our rooms were small but very clean with clean bathrooms.  Lovely windows with views of Paris rooftops.  Shops of all kinds are all around this hotel and the neighborhood is quiet.   We slept well, in spite of jet lag!
Showers/bath a bit odd in that they spray the water around the bathroom.   We did have problems with wi-fi and even when it worked it would frequently bump us off.  
All in all this hotel is so charming and comfortable.   Thanks, Fred Hotel and Helder!!!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel in Paris - stay here!
text: Read a lot of positive reviews of this hotel, so gave it a go for our 3 day Paris break. The hotel itself is tucked down a side street in the Montparnasse district (14th Arrondissement) which is a lovely area to walk around with cafe bars, delis, cheese shops, wine shops etc. It is close to the Metro for easy access to the city centre or a taxi to the main sites will be around 15 euro. The hotel is very well appointed, with lovely, compact rooms and a fabulous organic breakfast. Staff are very helpful and speak excellent English (our French is not up to much!). There is a lovely outside Terrace for guest use. We really enjoyed our stay - highly recommended!
name: Fred Hotel

title: First time in Paris.
text: The hotel was ok. A little out from the main tourist area of Paris, although only 2 blocks from the subway. Great French bakery around the corner. The room was small but that was expected for Paris. The bathroom sink kept clogging and the shower floor was kinda gross, work flip flops to shower. Probably wouldn't stay again....but was a pretty inexpensive.
name: Fred Hotel

title: 2 weeks in Paris
text: I was traveling for work from the US to Paris for two weeks with my girlfriend. I needed a place that was convenient to get into the city and close to public transportation but would break the bank during peak seasons. Fred Hotel fulfilled all my needs and was better than I imagined! First off the staff is top notch and speak English very well. This is a huge deal because there can be a language barrier in France. Second they are very close to the M13 line and a half hour travel from every major attraction. Third the room was a good size and the bed was big enough for two people. This hotel was a great find and I would recommended them to friends. Thanks Fred for a great stay and putting up with the late nights stumbling in.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice stay, service can be improved
text: We staid for work for 5 days and had a room with extra space (advice from other reviews). That was a good choice! The room was quiet(6th floor), spacious enough, clean, with all the amenities (hair drier, internet, a large desk, some hangers and space to open the luggage, air condition,safe). The bathroom was spacious enough. Breakfast was standard continental. The only small issue we had was that the service can be improved: 1) room service always forgot something small eg. shampoo was empty (refillable shampoo was appreciated though!) or towel missing, 2)one morning we head to miss breakfast because it was not ready on time, etc. Overall a nice stay in Paris and conveniently located close to transport possibilities!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Visiting family in France
text: Really enjoyed the Fred Hotel. Boutique style, in a 6 floor building, we were at the top in what must have been an artist's garret, a long time back. Very well appointed room with two beds, modern bathroom etc. Breakfast was served in the ground floor dining room by pleasant staff. Well located with Metro stations within walking distance. Would stay again.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Pleasant stay
text:
Greated by friendly staff, the Fred Hotel is a conveniently located , just few minutes walk to the metro stations . 
Room is well equipped with good ventilation. Quiet surroundings contributed to a good night of sleep. 
Value of stay in Paris !
name: Fred Hotel

title: Really Nice
text: My stay at this hotel was very pleasant, definitely recommend and will stay here again whenever I’m in Paris.  Really close to restaurants and cafes, two entries to the metro and the front desk is super helpful if you have any questions.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Small but very nice
text:
I had to stay in this district due to a friend that lives nearby. They suggested this hotel as it was close and very clean.
Upon late arrival I was checked in by the night staff. The rooms are nicely done but are very small. Overall, a very nice and pleasant stay!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Good experience
text: Decent location near Alesia and Pernety metro. Polite, friendly and helpful reception. Clean room with stylish furnishing. Would highly recommend for those on reasonable budget. Overall we had a good experience.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice and affordable
text: Hotel is very simple and has nice decor. In a very convenient area with 2 metros very close by. The staff are very friendly and helpful and the room is cleaned daily. Downside is that we got the smallest sized room for the weekend and the shower in the room is a wet room situation where the water basically floods the whole toilet. A bit of a hazard as I slipped quite a few times after the shower. The noise level within the hall is very loud and if unlucky you can hear loud individuals voices in their room. Fortunately we could only hear this once in a while and nothing during the night. Great stay for a short weekend.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Fred hotel was a memorable experience
text: As family we were lucky to stay at Fred hotel. The location is great and safe. The team at front desk were helpful and polite. The rooms were big and clean with comfy beds.metro was access able and close. The salon was very cozy making us feel at home with the fire place We recommend the hotel and to reserve as early as possible.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Always Nice Service for an excellent stay in Paris!
text: I stayed again at this modern hotel boutique last December 2017...this time for about a week...and again it was a very pleasant stay. The room is big enough and very comfortable for somebody that use it mostly for sleeping, since one is mostly roaming around the city visiting all kind of interesting places. The bed was very comfortable, very clean room, with nice toiletries. They have breakfast available with excellent quality products/food. The hotel is strategically located close to fresh food stores, restaurants, metro (subway), etc. in a very secured area, so one can go in and out any time day and night. The staff was very courteous and handled any request i had promptly and efficiently. Special thanks again to the managers Mr.Tissa and Mr. Syilvio for their excellent customer service!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Good hotel at low price
text: This hotel is located rather central in Paris, with good metro connections. The price is reasonable and the room was, even if it was at the smaller side, good. Beds were comfortable and everything was clean and tidy. The breakfast buffet was surprisingly good with a broad variety to almost all tastes. I do recommend this hotel.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Decent Boutique hotel with good places in walking distance
text:
Small boutique hotel not too far away from Montparnasse and a number of decent dining places. Very traditional.. rooms have still keys with heavy large keychain. On the other side a fairly modern hotel with a cozy lobby also for breakfast. Rooms are not really big. Sink is in the main room, shower and toilet in the bathroom. 
Hotel is clean and area not too noisy, So great place to stay.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Busy week in Paris
text: The hotel staff were hands down the friendliest and most welcoming staff!! Room and bathroom both a good size and exceptionally clean. Metro stop is a very short walk away even though it was a bit crazy trying to do the metro in a wheelchair. Monoprix at the end of the street so great for getting lunch and heading out for a day seeing the city. Hotel is in a quiet safe area. Great Korean restaurant a few streets away called Sodam. Would I stay again? Without a doubt!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Comfortable, quaint hotel for a great trip!
text: Staff were the highlight of this place. They were kind and considerate, always had time to talk and get us a taxi if we needed it. The room was clean and comfortable, brilliant size given we had asked for a superior suite. Even a nespresso machine which was a lovely touch! Gorgeous bathroom, lovely lounge, and we loved the Montparnasse neighbourhood. Very bohemian! Easy access to the metro, plenty of places to eat. We loved it. Would definitely go back!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice, clean and friendly boutique hotel
text: Staff is extremely accomodating, rooms are clean and nicely furnished. If you fear noise from the elevator do not take room 01. Room 11 has its own little deck. Good quality/ price ratio. Will definitely go back to this hotel
name: Fred Hotel

title: Nice cozy hotel well located and not too crowded neighbourhood
text: A hidden gem located at a well equipped neighbourhood with supermarket, pharmacy and nearby a few metro stops away from the one best croissant stalls in paris. Its not too far away from the effiel tower and also within a 20 min bus ride to the lourve. Kudos to the helpful staff at the hotel who are always ready to help. I am very appreciative of the service for me and my fiancee's stay at the hotel. The beds are comfortable and good tv system. A few points for feedback, for the bath tub maybe the glass panel could be slightly wider so that the water wont splatter over when one is using the shower and also have some instructions on how to set the tv to english audio will be helpful for tourist like me. Thank you and keep up the good work.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Quaint, Charming Parisan Hotel in a Great Neighborhood!
text: We arrived very late in the evening for our two night stay at the Fred Hotel. We were welcomed warmly. We loved our room on the top (6th) floor. The beds were very comfortable. The bathroom was clean. There was a store right around the corner. The neighborhood is delightful, full of little shops and cafes. The staff was very accommodating and kind. They even let us borrow an umbrella for a day when it was raining. They also loaned us plates and silverware so that we could eat our breakfasts in the room every morning from what we bought at the store around the corner. However, you can eat breakfast in their little dining area for a few euros. The metro is only 2 blocks away.  I would recommend this hotel and I would stay there again. Thank you Fred Hotel. You were fabulous!
name: Fred Hotel

title: Excellent location and service
text: Just returned from a 4 night stay at the  Fred Hotel.  Room was clean and tidy, small but adequate with everything you require for a city break.  Staff were fantastic and spoke English well.  They assisted us with our travel plans, bookings and recommendations for dining. Felt staff went over and above their duties to help us.  Would  definately recommend.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Made to feel Welcome
text: We picked Fred Hotel as it was in an area of Paris we had not stayed in before. From the pictures online we expected to like the modernity...We were not disappointed then when we arrived we were warmly welcomed.by the Reception staff...We met four individuals and all tried to make to feel "at home". For travellers the main issue is Bed/sleep quality "Excellent", next is bathroom facilities the double sized shower was a special item that worked wonders in our estimation. Full stocked with all appropriate items....far better than average ! Cleanliness was also first-class. So Great Value all round..There is a room by room renovation underway.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Cozy hotel with friendly staff
text:
Fred hotel is located in an exciting neighborhood in Paris 14th endorsement. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. The hotel is located close to the metro, going to the Eiffel or Louvre is just a small metro trip away.

Tasty and inexpensive meals are available in the surrounding area. I would recommend the Italian restaurant close to the hotel.

The staff and manager at Fred know the true value of customer service, they will help you with any issues you are encountering during your stay in Paris.

The property was modern, aesthetically pleasing and kept extremely clean. Front desk staff is very friendly and welcoming.  
The rooms are modern, open and have the amenities you would expect. The bed is comfortable. 

I recommend this hotel to everyone, who is looking for an enjoyable stay, great food, and excellent hospitality in Paris.
name: Fred Hotel

title: Beautiful hotel
text: The hotel is an awesome place, staff are very helpful n always willing to go above and beyond,and they all speak English so it's perfect for the people who can't speak French or just a little,  I stopped for a long weekend n it was brilliant perfect location and it's only a stones throw away from the metro, I'm booking for next year and would recommend it to anyone it's a perfect hotel n it's one off the best three star places I've ever stayed in
name: Fred Hotel

title: Just below Average
text:
So how much you like this hotel depends on which type of room you get.  The is basically small, medium, and large.  Frugal at first I went with the Small version and this was a mistake, at least for me.  I was here for 7 night stay and the room was barely large enough for the bed, 5 strides across and only 3 deep.  Understated to say it was small.  This is not my first trip to Europe so I was accustomed to quite small rooms and elevators, but this one fell within the lowest 10% I recall seeing. 

But the front desk folks there are very friendly and helpful and eventually got me the large version for €30 more. For the size, this was a much more workable size room.  The bed was firm and adequate even if not "enveloping" like some are.  Good night's sleep was had every night. 

Bathroom was sufficient sized although the arrangement of the shower head was a little screwy.   Breakfast was typical European, nothing really hot. 

One big concern is security and to that two points.  First, my Safe was locked when I checked in, went down to front, the guy pulled a box out of a desk drawer and had me open in under 2 minutes.   While I was grateful to get the safe open, this was just way toooo easy.   Second was basic room access.  Here these guys are still working in a 20th century mindset.  Mechanical keys are used and are tied to a large key ring with the number indicated on the end. Coming back after my first day back a new person was at the front desk, never had seen me, and all I needed to obtain the key was the room number, no ID, nothing.  I kept the key on my person the rest of my stay. 

So I'd likely not stay here again for the reasons cited.
name: Fred Hotel

title: A very tiny Pied à Terre in the City of Love
text:
Excellent location. Pleasant, helpful and courteous staff. 
Shockingly small rooms unless you book on the 6th floor. Elevator can only accommodate 2 people at once. Hallways are challenging for people with claustrophobia. 
Otherwise it was a kind, clean, friendly place to lay your head down at the end of a busy day.

title: Not worth the price
text: The location is the only reason to stay at this hotel. Otherwise, it is not at all as advertised. We booked a "Superior" room described as a "large room". I travel a lot for work and have stayed in Paris many times in the past so I knew that the room wouldn't be large but even by Paris standards the room was extremely small. We thought they must have given us the wrong room but the manager insisted we had the "Superior" room. Then a day later we were joined by a friend who booked the smaller room and ended up being given a larger room than ours. So obviously, the hotel was overbooked and we received whatever room was available when we arrived. Additionally, the bathtub wouldn't drain and the lifts only allow two people at a time and jerks significantly every time it stops on the bottom floor. We were told by the front desk staff that it breaks often. You have to leave your key at the front desk every time you leave the hotel but there isn't always someone at the desk when you return so you have to wait to go up to your room. The rooms were clean but very old. This is a two star hotel at best. The first red flag should have been that they make you pay in full upon arrival. Will not be staying again.

title: Very Very Clean but Basic
text:
The exterior of the building is in need of some attention but our room (64) was immaculate in every way . Bed linen was pristine and the towels fluffy.Curtains like new . Air conditioning was perfect and very quiet.
There was no fire extinguishers on the landing but there was one on the wall after the door to the fire escape , but you would not know it was there unless you opened the door.
64 is right beside the Lift Shaft and there is some noise as the elevator moves up and down and the doors open , however much quieter than a noisy neighbour , and did not cause us any concern.
The bathroom window opens onto the main street and on occassion I left it open Oops !!
Fantastic bath tub and excellent shower toiletries replaced daily.
So without question no complaints at all regarding the room .
The breakfast at €8.00 and the "Big Breakfast at €15.00 including an egg are in my opinion not good value and the actual breakfast room is uninspiring so we only had one on the last day.
The location is the main attraction as many other reviewers mention, and that's about all the hotel itself has going for it.Sadly the only staff member who smiled and engaged with us was the young cleaning lady , the other staff members did not inspire any feeling of welcome apart from ordering us a taxi to return to the airport we had no conversations. This little hotel is basic and I dislike vending machines in reception areas ,even if €2.00 gets you a coffee, there are no facilities for tea or coffee in the rooms.
Perhaps I am too "Picky" but I honestly believe that with a little extra effort , this little place could easily go to 3* . however if you just want value ,and cleanliness and a good bed with no frills then this little hotel is well worth a visit. One last point , regarding the front of house staff, we did not receive any information regarding the "Protests " on Saturday or any security information on where to avoid and this I think was very poor customer relations, 
Would I return ?  Maybe .

title: Fantastic location, very small room and pricey!!!
text:
We first stayed in this hotel 30 years ago when it was 'budget'. Now it's gone upmarket and for the size of the rooms it is pricey. 

The location is fantastic, next to Jardin du Luxembourg and in the heart of the Sorbonne. It a lovely area, packed with interesting sights and lively cafes and restaurants.

The room we had, a double, was very very small. I guess you expect this from a Parisian building of its age and history, but I did manage to knock our suitcase off its stand next to the bed with a knee it was that close.

In addition, the aircon was noisy with a strange buzzing. Opening the window as an alternative brought the early morning bin lorries into play and the odd student revellers singing in to the equation.

And the room was expensive. we stayed there for nostalgic reasons but really in terms of value for money its a big trade off between the location and comfort.

Staff were pleasant if a little disengaged. Roms was very clean and well equipped. Didn't try the breakfasts - too many delicious alternatives nearby.

title: A friendly 3-star hotel, convenient to the Luxembourg RER ‘B’ station for trains from Charles De Gaulle and Orly airport
text:
Hotel des 3 Colleges is tucked away on a quiet corner at 16 rue Cujas in the Latin Quarter, a short block off Boulevard St. Michel and a ten-minute walk from the Luxembourg RER ’B’ station.  Luxembourg Gardens, the Pantheon, and the Sorbonne are within a five-minute walk. 

The rooms are slightly small, the bathrooms are newly modern, and the hallways are narrow.  When making a reservation, request a room facing the street so you can wake (or awaken!) to the sights and sounds of Paris. 

WIFI is best in the lounge adjacent to the lobby. Continental breakfast is available for a few Euros more.  

The lobby and breakfast area are somewhat sparse, however there are a plethora of eateries nearby on Boulevard St. Michel.  Should you have a craving, there’s a clean, well-lighted McDonald’s 100 meters towards the Luxembourg station.   

For cash seekers there’s a Banque Postal ATM—which gives better exchange rates than commercial banks—half-a-block and slightly uphill on rue Cujas. Those with an excess of linge sale (soiled clothing) will find a clean, well-lighted place to do laundry at 223 rue St. Jacques, ten-minutes by foot. 

Walk fifteen-minutes to the Seine and you’ll arrive at Place St. Michel with its fountain and water spouting dragons. Across the river is Notre Dame Cathedral. On the way you’ll pass the Cluny Museum and 3rd century Gallo-Roman baths on your right. 

The 24-hour front desk staff can provide you with maps, directions, and bus schedules for every nook and cranny of Paris.  Put them to the test!

title: Great little gem on the left bank
text:
I love this little hotel and have been staying here for many years.  The rooms are very clean, the wifi is excellent, the front desk is terrific and they have a nice little breakfast room.

The he Chinese restaurant next door is good.  France is all about French movies and, if you speak French, there is a good little cinema for artsy movies just a few doors away.

The area is safe and you are right in the heart of Paris.  Take a short walk up,the street and you are in the Luxembourg gardens or walk down to the Seine in just a few minutes.

Marks and Spencer has recently moved into a store just down St Michele street and they have great take away food at good prices and even a micro wave and a little cafe area. It is even open on Sunday.   Monoprix also has a good food court.

This year I found a new Seine river cruise at 14€ that leaves right from the Pont Neuf.  It is a great way to,see Paris from the water.

The rooms are less expensive iif you book directly with the hotel.  They have a good webpage and th front desk is very helpful.

And it is easy to get to either airport from the hotel.  It is 10.30€ to get a ticket for the RER B that goes right to CDG in about 35 minutes.  It leaves right from the Cluny metro just a sho t all down the hill.

This is a great little hotel tucked behind the Sorbonne University on Rue Cujas.

title: Location Is Everything
text:
My fiancé and I enjoyed our short stay at this hotel. After our long flight from the states, we were happy to be able to arrive so easily via train from the airport. We had an amazing view of the Sorbonne, and although it's so close to a major street, we felt like we were away from the city chaos.

Our room was clean and snug, but that is expected in Paris. The bathroom was a lot roomier than I expected, and since we had a corner room, we had an amazing view out! My fiancé is over 6 feet tall and he was fine with the room size and managed well with the shower. 

The hotel is about a 15 minute walk to Notre Dame with a lot of dining options around. 

Overall, I would recommend if you're looking for a modestly priced hotel that's conveniently located near major attractions or close to a metro stop that will get you everywhere you need to go.

Oh, and the wifi connection in our room was excellent!

title: Small room, but clean and friendly.  Good breakfast too.
text: I stayed here for three days for a meeting with a local university.   My room (53) was very tight and the shower was almost too small for me to get inside.  That said, this is my 5-6th trip to Paris, so this was expected.   What I loved was the AC in the place that worked like a charm, you could freeze yourself if you so desired!  Just have to make sure the windows are closed as they have a sensor that prevents the AC from coming on if open (makes sense).  The room was very clean and the TV and internet worked fine.  Reception was always friendly and helpful.  Continental breakfast was good and fast.   I would stay here again, though with my wife and kids, it would require a larger room or multiple rooms.....

title: Unpretentious hotel in a good location
text: We always use this hotel when we visit Paris.  It's very conveniently located in the 5th arrondissement and close to the RER station for Luxembourg, enabling an easy airport transfer.  It's also very close to the Jardin du Luxembourg, Notre Dame and the Pantheon.  There are plenty of restaurants within a few minutes's walk. The rooms tend to be small but that's pretty standard for Paris.  It's clean, the beds are more comfortable than in many French hotels and the staff are always friendly and helpful.  There are two options on breakfast - the full "continental" comes with tinned fruit, yoghourt and slightly cardboard-tasting orange juice.  So personally I always stick with the coffee and croissant/bread roll "express" option.  Both are a bit expensive for what you are getting but hey, this is Paris, and you don't have to have either.  You can always go out for breakfast and just pay for the room.

title: Absolutely Love La Pavillon de la Reine
text:
Located in the very cosmopolitan district of Le Marais and within the Place des Vosges, this is a beautifully charming Parisian boutique hotel. 

The entrance to the hotel is what you envisage every Parisian hotel should look like. The hotel is tastefully decorated, with a stylish lounge that doubles as the breakfast and evening dining room, along with the library and outdoor terrace. It was so enjoyable to sit in the terrace as the sun sets for aperitifs or a digestive in the evening, or just to have breakfast or dinner.  

We had breakfast at the hotel on every morning of our stay, which was enjoyable. Breakfast consisted of a buffet selection, and cooked eggs were also on offer, and cooked to your liking (scrambled, omelette), along with freshly brewed tea and coffee which was brought to your table.

We booked a superior room, which was a reasonable size that overlooked a gorgeous courtyard garden, and the bathroom is off the bedroom, as is the separate toilet.  To access the shower in the bathroom you have to step into the deep bath which was a little awkward to step into, and the shower/bath had a privacy and shower curtain, which I don’t particularly like. 

The entrance between the bedroom, bathroom and toilet is also very narrow.

The bed and pillows were comfortable, the room had in-room air conditioning, safe and tea and coffee making facilities.  I thought the bedroom furniture was quite dark and looked tired, and not really the antique style or the French provincial style I was personally expecting in a boutique hotel. The hotel has a lift, although quite tiny, however that’s not unusual for European boutique hotels. 

The staff were friendly, engaging and very helpful and most spoke English (as a second language), which helped us immensely. 

The hotel is opposite the Place des Vosges and surrounded by cafes, restaurants, bars, boutique art galleries and several smaller museums, along with Victor Hugo's house which is only a 2-min walk from the hotel, all worth visiting. 

The streets in and around the hotel were a joy to meander in and there is so much history in the area to enjoy.  The hotel is a short walk to the Seine River and about a 20 minute taxi drive to the Eiffel Tower or the city centre of Paris.

Highly recommend Le Pavillon de la Reine

title: Not worth it!
text:
Although the hotel looks nice from the outside, the rooms are very dark and quite run down.
The service is nice although they refused us a table for lunch even though we were guests of the hotel.
The worst thing is the strong smell of urine everywhere outside the hotel. A smell that we could smell even when inside our room.
It's a pity that the city doesn't take better care of the cleanliness. You expect better than this when you pay 700 Eur per night. We'll not be back.
