title: Great location, nice hotel (review has info for disabled travellers)
text:
The hotel is tucked in a side-street that looks far from promising, but once you are at the entrance everything changes - the inside of the hotel is very nice, especially the glassed-over courtyard that forms the bar and breakfast area.

The location is great, in the fashionable Marais area. 5 mins walk to the Picasso museum, 10 mins to the Pompidou centre. Lots of great shops and galleries.

Our room (106) was small but the 1.6m wide bed was comfortable and the air conditioned room was quiet. The doorways are wide and access is good. The wet-room bathroom was large and well finished but would have benefited from another drop-down rail on the right of the toilet, and a pull bar on the back of the door.

The only problem - and the only reason for not awarding this otherwise excellent hotel 5 stars - is that the bathroom floor is very slippery when wet (poor choice of floor tiles), and the hotel couldn't find any non-slip mats. This is dangerous and the hotel needs to address this.

Breakfast was much better than we expect from a Paris hotel - good selection and quality.

We will definitely stay here again.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great stay
text: Great experience at this hotel. Two adults and a kid, had no trouble in a superior double room with an extra bed. High quality beds, very comfortable. The air conditioner is actually a lot better than expected. Very quiet rooms. The staff is friendly and helpful. The location is unbeatable. We did not try the breakfast or the gym. I will stay here again, I high-level recomand it. For coffee there are several speciality coffee shops in 5 min walking distance, and fresh croissants across the street. The room is larger than expected, considering Paris standards. All in all, this is a great place, we’ll worth the money.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Absolutlty no..
text: I arrived at the hotel with my three children for a 3-night stay. Two of my children are somewhat allergic to dust and mites, but nothing out of the ordinary. After two hours in the room, my children had a major allergy attack, they had to take medication. We went to the reception to explain that we could not stay due to the poor cleanliness of the hotel and the amount of dust. They did not help at all, on the contrary, they were not kind, not very cooperative and very arrogant. We left the hotel that same night. I don't know if the hotel has been closed during the COVID period and they have recently reopened, all the reviews are from before covid. Currently the hotel presents a very high state of neglect, dirt and unhygienic. In addition to the fact that the hotel rates are very expensive due to the conditions it presents. There are much better 4* hotel options. By tha way, did not receive any refund....
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Honey moon
text: The people were nice but theres no air conditioning tiny rooms no working fridge there were no working keys the first day. Just a really bad experience. Very uncomfortable sleep and really expensive for it
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Not a Hotel more of a Motel
text: Have to be honest, the room was small I can deal with, but the A/C did not work and the small refrigerator under the TV did not work either. I have someone bring extra towels, asked about the A/C and the small refrigerator and he told me tomorrow someone will be fixing the A/C, which was a lie. The days I stay there not once the A/C or refrigerator worked. On  my last night there, coming back from seeing Paris, me and my boyfriend got stuck in the elevator which the alarm button didn't work, lucky we was able to call the front desk with our cell phone to let them know we are stuck in there. It took about 17-mins before the elevator reset and started to move. Not once did anyone that work at the hotel mention or apologize for the inconvenience. The hotel needs to be renovated.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Beautiful hotel, lovely room, scary shower
text: Our Covid strategy was to walk to as much of what we wanted to see as possible, and avoid going into the Metro.  We split our nine night Paris visit, spent four nights here to see things in the Marais area.  Plan worked well.  This hotel is beautiful, our room was very comfortably furnished.  Probably a bit bigger than most of the rooms in Paris.  Bed was comfortable.  Breakfast was great, appreciated some scrambled eggs.  One complaint; the tub floor was a good bit higher than the bathroom floor, no grab rail.  The shower water barrier was a large piece of glass on a vertical hinge.  Seemed like a disaster waiting to happen.  Took us three of our four nights to figure out the faucet.  But, that does not keep us from recommending this hotel, or staying here again.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Poor hotel.
text:
It was very expensive. Not a four star standard.  Mattress was hard as a rock.  I had to complain to get it fixed.    The breakfast was cheap and cheerful w not enough wait staff. Dirty tables. Nowhere to sit.   Carpets in the room and stairs all stained.   The. So called fitness room.  Had a broken stepper.  They said could only get fixed on a Thursday !  I arrived on a Sunday.   The bike had broken pedals.   No air con.   
The positives.   Good location. Nice staff who did the best they could.    Quiet hotel 
Unless you get a bargain rate. Don’t stay here.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely and amazing location
text:
I hate to admit this, since I spent a bit more than I normally would spend on hotels, but this place was so great and I would stay there again!  It was in the PERFECT location!  So close to a number of metro lines.  And so close to fun shops and restaurants that are open late too.  Close to Place de Vosges.  Close to the Siene.  I walked here to most all of the places I wanted to see.  The staff did such a nice job of cleaning my room.  The toiletries were great - the conditioner and shampoo were great (I usually have to bring my own because the free hotel stuff doesn't do a good job, but theirs did).  I did the breakfast one morning because they comped me because of a snafu.  It was a really nice breakfast!  Fresh squeezed OJ and grapefruit juice, the best croissants, hot chocolate, meats, cheeses, etc.  But if you aren't going to be eating that much in the morning anyway, it wouldn't be worth the price.  But if you want a big breakfast each morning, than it definitely is.  Room size was great for me.  
One tip though, if you are wondering if you should have the hotel call for a taxi for you or get an Uber, GET AN UBER!  The taxi service they called for me was 20 euro more than an Uber would have been.  I wish I had realized that.  The hotel said they didn't know what the price would be.  They could have asked the taxi company, but they did not.  I was worried about getting to the airport on time so did it.  I'm passing along the info to the rest of you so that you can benefit from my experience.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Amazing!
text:
I've spent 3 nights at Villa Beaumarchais and it was great. The staff is very friendly and helpful, they gave me interesting recommendations for restaurants and places to visit. The room was clean and so quiet. The winter garden is amazing with a piano and a cosy bar.
Would definitely recommend!!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Good service and nice hotel
text: Good and clean hotel near metro. They gave me late checkout for free, so very happy about everything. Breakfast is good also. My room has a bathtub as bonus. A kettle, coffee and tea in room. Very quit, easy to sleep.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: ROOM SAFE ROBBERY LEFT US PENNILESS IN PARIS
text:
My wife and I were robbed of over $1,800 in cash, and a $2,000 camera lens from our hotel room safe.  

We stayed at the Villa Beaumarchais for four nights. Being seasoned travelers, we were careful to lock our valuables in our room safe each day.  On the second day, we came back to find that strangely we could not open the room safe with our combination.  We asked the manager at the desk to come up and open it.  She did so, but since my wife’s purse was still in the safe covering the other valuables, I simply relocked it, not checking it carefully it at the time.  The next evening, we opened the safe to pack as were leaving on a plane for Italy at 4:00 AM in the morning.  It was then we discovered we had been robbed!  Someone had taken all our cash in dollars, and the expensive camera lens, but had left our computer and ipads. Since there was no damage to the door or to the safe, it had to have been an “inside job”, done by someone working there or in league with a staff member. 

I asked the night manager to call the Hotel Manager, but he told us as it was 10:00 PM, and too late, and so I walked to the Police Department to file a report.  It took me over two and a half hours to do so, and after I got back to the hotel, I gave the night manager my contact information, and a copy of the police report. I demanded that he have the hotel manager call me as soon as possible.  After a week of waiting, I called the hotel manager back myself.  He told me that he could do nothing until the police came to question them.  I asked him, “What if the police never come?”  He simply told me it was out of his hands and abdicated all responsibility. 

Although this hotel is charming and in a great location, STAY HERE AT YOUR OWN RISK, as the persons who robbed us, could still be working there! Please do not repeat our mistake and end up completely penniless as we were, at the start of our dream vacation.  Better to stick with a reputable hotel chain that cares.  Obviously, the Villa Beaumarchais, which is owned by the Machefert Group does not!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Rooms in need of a makeover
text:
We stayed here for two nights at the end of October 2021 for a long weekend from London.

The hotel is nice but in need of a little TLC - rooms were really tired and in need of a makeover.  The staff were always polite.  Maybe it's due to Covid but the hotel had no atmosphere - no one in the bar or communal areas.  It's in a much quieter part of Marias than we have stayed in before.  I probably wouldn't stay again as have stayed in much nicer hotels in the area in much more preferable locations in Marias that suit us.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely hotel right near the Marais
text: Villa Beaumarchais is just off the busy boulevard Beaumarchais. Its location means it close to all kinds of things including restaurants and bars, but it's quite quiet. That means it's easy to sleep and when you enter the hotel it's like a little oasis.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Amazing stay in Paris!
text: My husband and I stayed at Villa Beaumarchais for 4 nights for his birthday and we had the best time ever! It was out first visit to Paris and we heard that Le Marais was a lovely area with lots of restaurants, bars, shops and art galleries but at the same time being a quiet and lovely area to stay which they were not wrong. The hotel was lovely, it was small and friendly in a great location, yet hidden off the main busy road. The staff were great and very helpful, rooms were comfortable and clean and the breakfast was great!! We are most definitely planning our next trip back very soon! Thank you for a perfect stay!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: This is an incredible find in the heart of the Marais district. It's a small hotel with incredible, thoughtful customer service. The rooms are clean, quiet and look into an inner courtyard. A respite from the busy streets of Paris. Restaurants, smaller museums, shopping, metro is all within a block of the charming entrance. We hope to be back soon!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Hidden gem!
text:
Tucked away in Le Marais, perfectly located for easy (under 5 and under 10 mins) walk to 2/3 metros, AND  surrounded by lots of lovely and walkable choices for restaurants and bars. Place des Vosges is a stone’s throw away. We took a cab to Canal Saint Martin one evening because it was freezing cold - easily taxiable- but you could probably walk to there too on a nice spring/summer evening (?maybe 25 mins?). 
Hotel is delightfully decorated, lots of painted wood and panelling. Our room was smallish but very pretty and had everything you could want. The conservatory bar area is lovely and upstairs are squishy leather sofas, a fire, bookshelves  and an honesty bar. Joy.  Staff are all helpful and friendly.  We loved it, basically!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: February business trip
text: This hotel has quaint rooms with complimentary shampoo, shower gel, sewing kit, vanity kit, shoe buff in each room. The hotel is on a side street so it is very quiet but very convenient to many small restaurants that are amazing. Located between two subway stops it was convenient to stay for business and explore Paris and the surrounding area. I will be back.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Couldn’t have wished for better
text:
My husband and I scrolled through many hotels on the Eurostar website but we felt this one had the most authentic french look that we wanted. 

We were greeted warmly upon arrival by the lovely lady at the desk and the atmosphere immediately made me feel as ease (I’m an anxious traveller and get nervous in new places to begin with). Our room (109) had beautiful decor and was plenty big enough for two. The bathroom was well equipped with toiletries, plenty of towels, toilet rolls and the shower was lovely. The mattress was a little hard for me but hubby said it was perfect for him, pillows were super comfy and temperature was good. 

I hadn’t seen much about the breakfast on here prior to my visit but it had a great selection. I asked if I could have some gluten free bread and they kindly arranged this for the next 2 days (and remembered to bring it out when they saw us come down - that is service for you!) If anyone with allergies are visiting, don’t be afraid to ask, they will certainly accommodate!!!

The location is a great walking distance (30 mins +) to many touristic sites and the closed metro stop is about 2-3 min walk. 

I would recommend this hotel to anyone, it was a great home from home and we would not hesitate to return. 

Thank you to all the staff for making us feel so welcome!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Really Good, Unsual Hotel. Loved It !
text: On the edge of the Marais district,mucked away from the buzz of the main road, this is not, perhaps,nor your first visit to Paris but it suited us totally,mhavng done all the sights over many years and having stayed at huge price luxury hotels where you pay for all the facilities and staff you never use. This hotel is an old villa,nwithentheninner courtyard made over with a glass roof and a quirky conservatory, very few staff around but really well done. Breakfast isn't the massive international buffet which some customers like, but is well more than adequate with an egg boiler, fabulous bread, meats, cheeses, jams etc. Our room was large, bathroom has a jacuzzi and was massive, a complimentary upgrade, Room 007. Bed and pillows,nand towels and bathroom goodies were all good,beta and coffee making only spoiled bvwooden sticksninstead of spoons - a strange misfit and puzzling. Do guests really steal the spoons ? Staff were helpful and were multi- tasking, not many often but that does not detract. Metro stations nearby, plus many decent eateries at reasonable prices.vwould go again and explore more, far away from "Tourist Rip-off Land
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Good value, great location
text: We enjoyed staying here for our first trip to Paris. The staff were polite and friendly, the downstairs reception/bar area were really lovely, and the value and location of the hotel itself made it a great home base for exploring Le Marais in particular--this was our main goal, as we had heard so much of the food/shopping/drinking! We did not love the beds (old, hard mattresses) and parts of the room could have used a new coat of paint (there were some scorch marks on the walls!) but it was all apart of the "Old Paris" charm.  There was an issue where we got an email saying a card (that did not belong to us) charged another €400 (!!) but the staff said it was an error and just sometimes happened? Seemed a bit weird, if it happens regularly surely there must be a plan to fix it.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely hotel
text: Really lovely, central hotel.  The room was incredibly clean and all the staff were pleasant.  Although small, the accommodations were very charming.  Would recommend, especially for someone looking to walk around the city.  Didn’t get a chance to be there much, but the lobby was beautiful.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Amazing Hotel!
text: Great hotel so accommodating and very central with lots of restaurants and the metro near by. The Louvre only a half hour walk away. Hotel itself is very clean and very pretty all the staff are very nice. Would definitely recommend!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Wonderful stay
text:
Got an upgrade to junior suite - large and very comfortable bed, lovely shower, big tv and a comfortable sofa. Coffee machine was great addition too. Blackout curtains were great too.

Also enjoyed breakfast, especially the potatoes.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely staff but not so much hotel
text: Very disappointing breakfast and it is really hyped up on the website. Smoked salmon is 11 euros extra!? The Mercure breakfast is far superior. Bedroom very comfortable but some things were broken in the bathroom and in spite of reporting them all, not all were repaired. One major comment. If I write a review on Tripadvisor and give the hotel 5/5, the hotel will enter my name into a draw to have my entire hotel stay paid for by the Machefert group. This is immoral and can one ever trust a review of this hotel?
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Fantastic hotel
text: We stayed here for 1 night and had a great stay. Very clean hotel with a great staff. The area around the hotel is great to walk around and find cute bars and restaurants. Very accessible to all of Paris.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: French Luxury Class
text: Am staying often in Paris and in Le Marais, discovered villa Beaumarchais lately and it's just perfect , quiet ,clean, comfortable and beautiful, price is actually lower than many hotels in the area which do not reach that comfort and quality, looking forward to go back.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Claudia Gutiérrez
text:
The hotel is super clean, personal at the hotel are so kind and helpful. 

Location very good for the fashion showrooms and so close to the metro.

Breakfast is good and the rooms have AC a natural lighting.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Excellent
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Villa Beaumarchais. It’s a quiet and comfortable hotel in a great location on the edge of the Marais near Place des Vosges. We had a slight hitch to start with - there seemed to be a leak from the bathroom of our room into the bedroom carpet - however this was dealt with very professionally by Dmitri and his colleagues - we were immediately upgraded to a larger room at no extra charge. Breakfast was excellent and is served until 11am daily - ideal if you want a lie-in!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely stay in Paris
text:
We chose to stay here for our two night stay in Paris.

Perfect location only a few minutes walk to the metro and easy to access the main attractions. The hotel had a very Parisian feel to it, which was lovely. Staff were friendly and polite, and room although a little small, suited us perfectly!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Average
text:
Pro's - Hotel is in a great location, approx 5 min walk to Chemin Vert station. Buidling felt very Parisian. Rooms are quaint.  However, since it's a very historic building, hallways and rooms are on the dark side, hallways are completely dark until motion sensors kick in, has a bit of  "The Shinning" feel.  
Staff was polite.

Con's - We booked 2 rooms with 2 double Beds in each room as we had 2 separte families, were given 2 rooms with one bed in each room upon arrival, then was told us we needed to pay extra to upgrade to a larger room for the extra bed.  Felt a bit mislead. 
Hotel security needs an update.  The hotel still uses a manual key for guest rooms with the room number attached, key needs to be dropped off at the front desk as you leave and picked up upon return.  The counter has a "key box" for drop off, however, it's nothing more than a hole on the counter top and key drops onto the bottom counter.  Key is not secured.  Since the front door is also not secured and no one is at the front desk at all times, it would be very easy to compromise room security.  The front desk also mistakenly gave our room key to another guest checking in.  They did not take the steps to ensure our room was properly secured after the discovering that error.  We walked into our unlocked room.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: A very charming hotel with very comfortable and super quiet rooms
text: The hotel has the old Paris flair and is located in the trendy Marais district, in walking distance to the shopping and sights. The rooms are perfectly designed, very quiet and very comfortable beds with tea and coffee and very nice shower products. It's certainly a 4-star experience and we would come back again!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great location, space, and service
text:
Stayed at Villa Beaumarchais with my boyfriend for an extended vacation and we loved our time. Heart of Le Marais without feeling touristy, fantastic restaurants and shops nearby, and conveniently near the metro. 

We were surprised by how large the space was for the money; got a closet and full size tub plus a massive bed. It’s definitely older school like most people say in reviews, but we found it endearing. Loved coming home to a fireplace in the lobby and frescos seen from the glass elevator.

Would recommend for a couple or for traveling.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Tranquil & comfortable base for a busy stay in Paris
text: We had a lovely stay at the Villa Beaumarchais for 3 nights.  The hotel is situated close to the no.8 metro line, and is also within walking distance of many good restaurants.  The quiet Rue des Arquebusiers is just off a main thoroughfare.  The rooms are very comfortable, clean and beautifully decorated.  You feel that you are in a well cared-for older property, with all the modern necessities.  We had everything we needed and the breakfast provided a good variety of options each morning in the tranquil bar/restaurant which boasted some very impressive tropical plants at its centre.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Amazing hotel. very nice and welcoming design. beautiful green garden at the patio of the dinning room. nice breakfast.
text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 nights. it is located in a great location. It is calm and relaxing hotel, near many places and museums I wanted to visit. the staff is very efficient and helpful. the atmosphere is really very warm and friendly. I enjoyed the good will and help of Mariana and Griselle at the reception desk. Rich breakfast, and a very nice Honesty Bar at the salon by the reception. My room shine of cleanness. I was happy to find a refrigerator with soft drinks, sneaks and wines, where I could keep some of the food I brought  from the market.  I also enjoyed the tea/coffee corner on the desk when I came back from my journeys to my room.   Fantastic hotel. very great value for the money.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Wonderful experience
text:
Wow what a hotel! I stayed here for 3 nights and must say I had an amazng time. Staff are very polite and very welcoming! The breakfast buffet which we had was splendid indeed with a vast range of fresh food, something for everyone to enjoy. I particularly found the bread and pain au chocolat and croissants delicious!!
My partner’s birthday was during our stay and I emailed the hotel admin to arrange something if possible and they responded brilliantly - during an evening jazz show from a jazz band, they played the happy birthday tune, and the staff member at the bar treated us to a glass of champagne each and 4 different flavoured macarons - We were very grateful for this.
Overall, such a cute, cosy hotel in a very good location, I would highly recommend!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Fantastic hotel
text:
This hotel is a very cute small hotel, perfect for couples or small families.
Breakfast had a huge range of different food and everything was delicious.
Hotel is very clean.
Staff are very friendly and polite. 
Rooms also are so lovely and comfortable.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: ❤️ It!
text:
Terrific location! Incredible breakfast! Very warm and hospitable staff! We are so grateful to Iman and the rest of the team members for enabling our Paris trip to be absolutely amazing!  Thank you! 
You can walk to pretty much all central Paris must-see places from here - including the Lourve, Norte Dame and the Pantheon.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Fantastic Stay
text: Everything about Villa Beaumarchais is wonderful. The fabulous staff, location, our room, food, decor, just everything. Getting around Paris ( even with the transport Strike) was easy from our location. We loved exploring Paris. Thank you all for an amazing 1st time in Paris. 💖
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Perfect!
text: Stayed five days in this quaint boutique hotel in the heart of the Marais district for our honeymoon.  From the moment we checked in the experience was perfect. The hotel is very centrally located, close to metro, shops and cafes. It is the best location to explore Paris. More importantly, the hotel staff is wonderful and very helpful. They recommended a restaurant, Les Enfant Rouges, to celebrate our honeymoon that was not only within walking distance but was extraordinary. Our stay was wonderful! Thank you Villa Beaumarchais!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Really lovely smaller hotel in good location
text: Hotel villa Beaumarchais is situated on a side street (quiet) but within 5 mins walk of two metro stations. This was not our preferred section of le Marais, but it worked.  Classic room very small (ok for one) but superior room was perfect for two. Nice/helpful staff, GREAT bfast (something for everyone) and very accommodating service hours (7-11a). So, for the amount of time we actually spend in hotel on vacation, this worked well. Very quiet, comfy beds.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Very efficient
text:
Room 303 was very good and neat. In Paris you expect small rooms but this was still very good and the service at the hotel was excellent with an excellent staff especially at the front desk and I would like to make a special mention of Arthur and Dimitry who went out of their way to help and provide us with all information and help we required.

I would definitely recommend this hotel for the location and excellent service.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great hotel in a jewel location
text:
Had a three night stay at the hotel. Generally, the hotel is very ‘homish’, cozy and welcoming. The staff is friendly, assists with any question you might have, and took very good care of the rooms. 
Rooms are nice, bed very comfortable, the only thing is the bathtub shower which is a bit small. Other than that no problems.
Main thing is definitely location, which is just great, with amazing restaurants in the area, museums are minutes away, and generally it’s just such a beautiful surrounding. 
Thanks for the stay!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Quaint Marais gem with nostalgic old world charm
text: We spent a cosy six days tucked away in this quiet corner of the haut Marais. The hotel itself is very well located close to the Metro and all the prime local destinations worth visiting are well within walking distance. Each room overlooks a central courtyard with romantic vines winding past the windows under a pastel blue patch of sky, and though the hotel could use a bit of touching up here and there, the staff are stellar. Each visit to reception was greeted with a smile and no ask was too big. They really made a difference to our stay here and enhanced it considerably. There were a few niggles; I could hear the man in the room next to me snoring contentedly at full pitch, the pillows only come in extra soft, and there is a constant smell of smoke pervading the atmosphere (though this could be said for all of Paris, malheureusement). The bathrooms however are brand new and fully accessible and the internal night garden which doubles as the breakfast room hinted at the Art Deco decadence of old. It was even hosting a jazz concert on the night we checked out, full of warm candlelight as the drummer set up his kit. As we left we walked past a tour group learning that it used to be an armoury, of all things. Amazing. All in all I would recommend a stay here, it felt secret and demure, cosy and très charmant and un petit peut parfait for it. Exactly as you’d hope a romantic sojourn in Paris would be.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Excellent!
text: This is a nice hotel perfectly located in the Marais area. The hotel is close to most things, still located on a silent and calm street. Comfortable beds and clean rooms. The hotel has climbed up to my number one choice in Paris.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: excellent stay
text: good place to stay very near to all tourist spots, rooms are comfortable and calm, staff are very sympathique and helpful, will keep coming back for sure, keep it up and will recommend it for sure, abientot
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great hotel experience in Paris
text:
I spent two nights at Villa Beaumarchais on a business trip  On arrival I was upgraded to a suite which was very nice and appreciated 
A special touch is the Yamaha Piano in the atrium which i was allow to play ) i am a professional musician ) 
its in a great location and I highly recommend
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Rude service; don’t care about their customers
text: I stayed here for work for 3 nights. First they gave me a room next to the lobby which was fine but a bit noisy. I asked for a different room since I was in town for work and they just said no not possible. Then I found a dirty cleaning rag on top of my clothes when I got back the second evening. Then the last night I stayed someone was obviously smoking in the hotel near my room somewhere to the point it made all my clothes smell and made me ill. Reception did not answer the phone so went out to find someone at midnight because it was so strong. Her initial reaction was that she didn’t believe me because the fire alarm would have gone off. I asked her to come and smell the room and the hallway. She just said “no nobody’s smoking don’t ask me again” in a very cross and rude way. Incredibly unprofessional and unhelpful and the starting point was that she didn’t even believe me. The hotel itself is tired and worn out - the least they can do is have decent service and not treat their customers like they wish they weren’t there. Will never stay here again.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: W.end escape at cosy hotel
text: Very nice and charming hotel. Close to the tourist attractions and public transportations. There are plenty of choices for breakfast buffet.  The reception teams were very friendly and helpful during our stay. We will comeback definitely..:)
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Hello
text: Our stay here was amazing! The place is elegant and clean. And the hotel is near at the famous places in Paris. The staffs are so nice and generous. We really enjoyed our stay in this hotel. Nice services and delicious foods!👌🏻 Thank you!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Bonjour
text: We had a great time on staying at this hotel. The place is very beautiful and relaxing. The receptionist over there is very helpful and kind. The place is safe. I recommend this to everyone. And we'll probably go back at this hotel on our next stay in Paris.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great service and amazing staff!
text:
Was here for 3 nights and the staff was amazing! Kept assisting me with every request and made my business trip much easier.
I thank you very much for all the things you assisted me with and hope to return as quickly as possible.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Excellent Location, Warm Service
text: This cozy little corner in Paris was exactly what we were looking for. My wife and I stayed here for her birthday and found it to be very welcoming. The front desk agents were always smiling and greeting us in and out of the hotel. The breakfast options were amazing! We took the train to Switzerland for a few days and decided to come back to Villa Beaumarchais when we returned to Paris because they treated us so well there. Thank you to all the staff who made our trip so memorable!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Skip!
text: Unmaintained and dirty. Worst 4 star hotel I’ve stayed in. Not replenishing shampoo and other things. Rude staff and one of them doesn’t even speak French ... we stayed in the suite and it was tiny! I come to Paris often so I’m comparing to other Paris hotels. The elevator was blocked with an empty bottle of wine so we had to take the stairs, see picture. It looked like a murder mystery
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Nothing special
text: Hotel room bathroom smelled like public urinal, and bathroom window would not open and there was no fan.  Twice I asked them to clean it to take away the smell, but they didn't seem to use a strong enough cleaning product and the smell was there for my entire stay (a full week).  Beds reasonably comfortable.  Nicest touch was refilled large water bottle each day.  For this hotel to be a four star requires a bit of work and possibly renovation - I think it should be rated a 3 star.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely friendly hotel
text: I stayed here for a work trip and the hotel staff were helpful and friendly. The rooms were clean and surprisingly normal sized for a reasonably priced hotel in central Paris. I’d certainly recommend it to a friend.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Visiting the Marais section of Paris
text: Nice little  hotel tucked away in a quiet corner of The Marais, within walking distance of the Picasso Museum and close to lots of restaurants.  Recommend going to Chez Janou Bistrot, very close by, for a very French meal.  Be sure to make a reservation.  Arthur, at the front desk of the hotel was most helpful with suggestions and making reservations and was a real delight no matter how many questions we threw at him!  Hotel was very clean and the breakfast was good and plentiful.  All together a very good place to stay in Paris.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Orangerie
text: Nice quiet location in old style. Room well equipped and warm. The dining area was a bit cold now in November. WiFi sometimes gappy for telcos. All amenities provided, great for lightweight travels. Nice breakfast options.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Friendly hotel in a good location
text: This is a cozy hotel in a very good location, on the eastern edge of The Marais. There is a beautiful open sapce with a handsome glass roof in which to have an excellent breakfast. Standard double rooms are relatively small, but the hotel is quiet. Service is friendly & welcoming.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Villa Beaumarchais
text: As a honeymoon couple, we enjoyed and appreciated our stay. Staff was helpful and smiling all the time. Rooms were clean, breakfast was very good and broad. They also upgraded our room and it was so surprising. Thank you guys all! We will definetly come back!:)
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Good hotel in great district
text: A good hotel with the Marais on your door step.  Near to bars, restaurants, museums and Place des Voges. Good sized bedroom, comfortable bed, clean bathroom and helpful staff. A good place to stay in a great district.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Highly recommended
text:
Highly recommended for the price. The comfort of the bed is one of the best I sleep in paris. Will definitely come back.
The bathroom is also very nice. I take a bath for 1 hour.
The quarter is very secure
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Beautiful villa beaumarchais
text: This property is quietly tucked in a very active stretch of Paris.. lots of bars cafes and restaurants around in the neighbourhood. Rooms were nice and clean and staff super helpful. Would highly reccomend this hotel to other fellow travellers and I will definitely stay here again in my next visit. Best. Anish.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Family Break to Paris
text: Had a lovely stay at villa Beaumarchais- family site seeing and shopping trip (2 teenagers). Great location near to Metro and plenty of restaurants etc but not to far in centre. Room not large but comfortable. Staff very friendly and helpful.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: A little gem
text:
Can’t praise this little hotel in the Marais enough. I think we discovered it via The Guardian. We had had a major change in travel plans, and found ourselves with an extra 5 days in Paris.

If you are looking for a quiet tucked away little treasure, close to the Picasso museum- this is it.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Wonderful experience
text: Our recent visit to Paris for a family weekend was made perfect by our stay at the Villa Beaumarchais. From the moment we checked in the staff were attentive and so polite. As there were three of us they explained that we had been put in a junior suite to make sure we had enough room. The room was spacious and exceptionally clean. Likewise the bathroom had a bath and shower and was very clean with a great supply of toiletries. Breakfast was great and as much as you could eat. Great experience and would definitely stay here again.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Awesome stay
text: We had a great stay there. The hotel is very centrally located and with close proximity to two metro stations, Chemin Vert (line 8) and Bastille (line 1). The neighborhood is pretty safe even past midnight and offers a plenty of very vibrant restaurants, cafe and boulangeries. Arthur by the reception is a very welcoming and helpful guy. He helped us a lot with recommendations. Overall, we had a very pleasant stay at the facility. Highly recommend it.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Lovely hotel really peacful location but near all the main attractions with plenty of resturants near by and good transp
text: Spacious clean room with lovely staff, good location to walk to main attractions and metro close by. Good local shops and resturants including bakery with lovely pastries. Nice and peaceful and feel like you are not part of the tourist crowd as surrounding shops and resturants full of locals
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great location
text: This hotel was recommended by our friends who had stayed there over the summer.  Nestled on a one-way street, the hotel is extremely well located in Le Marais.   Lovely breakfast area.  The service personnel were accommodating and superb.   Well located to the Picasso museum, the Place Des Voges, the  Carnevalet, nearby metro, and great restaurants and boutiques. Room was charming but in need of a bit of refurbishing. Bathroom was well appointed and modern but not functional-shower area too narrow, no grab bar, half glass wall that allowed water on the floor, and a commode in a too-tight space.   If you stay here make sure to ask for a room with a larger bathroom   Otherwise I would have no hesitation to return
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Brilliant
text: It was a lovely stay in the villa. We had a lovely clean room with a large bathroom. Great breakfast and service. What made it even better was the location. It was very close to the metro and cheap places to eat. Would definitely recommend.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: A gem of a hotel with exceptional staff
text: This hotel is a wonderful find. We have been to Paris on many occasions and this is certainly the best hotel we have stayed in for many years. The staff were extremely friendly and knowledgeable and made us feel at ease. The rooms were kept very clean and the bedding was crisp. There were many restaurants round about and the Marais is close to the more popular attractions of Paris but less congested. Nonetheless there is a vibrancy and energy both during the day and at night time.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Great Stay!
text: This was our first time in Paris and we really enjoyed our stay here! Staff was very nice and helpful. We hope to be back soon! The hotel was very quiet at night because it is tucked away which gave for a great night of sleep after a long day!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Very French hotel in a good location!
text: This gem of a hotel is tucked 1/2 a block back from Boulevarde Beaumarchais. It retains a stylish French decor, not the modern look of so many hotels, yet offers modern conveniences. We stayed in suite 301, a quiet, roomy space with couch, coffee table, and desk besides the generous bed with side tables. The bathroom offered a sink, tub, and separate small shower, with the toilet in a space of its own with a door. The bed was quite comfortable. Our view was to the interior courtyard with ivy turning red as autumn progressed. We ate breakfast at the hotel twice, a nice spread with many choices, including eggs, bacon, and potatoes, as well as fruits, cereals, and breads. We also had one room service dinner of Spring Stew, a just-right mix of lamb and peas.The staff was pleasant and helpful. We walked to the nearby Metro and to cafe's serving delicious meals. We were very happy with Villa Beaumarchais!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Excellent Hotel in Marais District
text: We spent 6 great nights at Villa Beaumarchais. The junior suite was roomy and had great decor-very French. The breakfast each morning was delicious and filling. We recommend adding breakfast each day of your stay. Also close to several different Metro stops. I definitely recommend this Villa.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Charming hotel in terrific location
text: In Paris, Boulevard Beaumarchais is one if my favorites...great restaurants and shopping and central to the most fun neighborhoods. The hotel is tucked onto a quiet street just off the Boulevard! Full service and delightful staff.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Stay at Villa Beaumarchais
text: The hotel is very conveniently located, within walking distance to most of the highlights in the Marais.  Also just round the corner from Maison Plisson, a wonderful place for breakfast and lunch! It is also close to 3 metro stations.  The rooms are quiet and the bathroom is a good size with modern updated facilities.  Will definitely stay there again.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Wonderful stay in Le Marais, friendly staff, great room!
text: My wife and I had an excellent experience at this hotel at the end of September 2019. We stayed in a deluxe double room which was very spacious, nearly the size of a US hotel suite.  The bed was very comfortable and the shower had great hot water and the water pressure was very good.  The staff was friendly, welcoming and extremely helpful. The breakfast buffet was delightful as well.  Very convenient by Metro or by car. I would highly recommend this place to anyone that wants to stay in the Le Marais neighborhood.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Very comfortable accommodations
text: Highly recommend this hotel has the room and beds we're very comfortable, the staff always went beyond to accommodate,  The breakfast was always well prepared  with especially the bread is to die for. Decent location little Tucktaway but accessible to the metro and many restaurants in area to choose.  Spent nine days there and couldn't ask for a better accommodations.   Only drawback was it was not  centrally  located to tourist attractions but easy enough to get to.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Partisan style and great staff
text: Stayed here for a mid-week break through a Eurostar package. Rooms are clean and comfortable, breakfast is a mix of continental and a small hot selection (mini garlic potatoes just lovely). Location is close to a couple of metro lines and just off the main road so no road noise but with plenty of decent bars/restaurants very close by. Staff were excellent and always spoke to you and made you feel welcome and were helpful with advice when asked. Went for wife’s 50th and they surprised us with a nice champagne surprise when we returned to our room after a day out, which was lovely, thank you! On the Friday (only!) breakfast was the busiest we’d seen and there were some delays with breakfast supplies being replenished after they ran out, otherwise would have been 5 star. Bar prices in the hotel were reasonable for Paris. Overall a lovely hotel with great service and you should have a great stay in a nice location.
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Beauté au Marais
text: Delightful room (junior suite) with plenty of space and great comfort. The location is outstanding. Reception staff all speak good English. The service is good, although there is no food or drink after breakfast and there is no one to help carry the bags upstairs. The staff who make up the rooms are excellent. Thanks!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: My 50th Birthday Surprise
text:
The hotel is set down a quiet street off a main thoroughfare with plenty of restaurants and bars. Close to the Metro also. 

The staff couldn’t do enough for us. The room was very Parisian and lovely toiletries. On the night of my birthday we came back to a tray with champagne and snacks and a ‘happy birthday’. It was a lovely touch. 

Iman on reception helped us with directions, taxis and a warm welcome was always on hand. Breakfast was fantastic with hot and continental choices of excellent quality. 

A birthday to remember indeed!
name: Villa Beaumarchais

title: Amastan is amazing!!
text: This hotel is amazing and will be my “go to” for any future visits to Paris. The location is on a nice quiet street, within walking distance to many of the key attractions. My friend and I spent a couple of nights at the Amastan on our way to Bordeaux. We shared a modern room with a nice bathroom and quality accoutrements. We had two twin beds and there was plenty of space for us to spread out with our luggage, etc. The included breakfast is top notch from the cafe latte, fresh squeezed orange juice, yummy croissants, and the eggs Benny was amazing! The bar serves some delicious cocktails and a yummy house-made bar mix snack. But the real shining star of this hotel was the service! From the moment we arrived, Kristina was incredibly welcoming, warm, friendly and could not do enough to help me when I unfortunately lost my cell phone in a taxi. With her help  (and “Find my iphone”) in coordinating with other taxi drivers (I don’t speak French) we were able to track the phone down and retrieve it from the cab I dropped it in!! She was genuinely more concerned about me getting my phone back than I was ;)  Kristina is a true gem - I’m forever grateful for her help and our lovely chats 🥰 Will always have fond memories of staying at the Amastan!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Wonderful stay!
text: Really enjoyed my stay at Amastan Paris. Arrived on an overnight flight and luckily for me, my room was ready early. It's Paris, the hotel rooms tend to be small, but it was beautifully decorated, with a nice bathroom and comfortable bed. And I had some room to do some exercises and post-run stretching. Staff was nice and helpful. The breakfast was yummy. Would stay there again.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Poor quality
text: Unfortunately our stay was not good at Amastan.  Both my parents and our room was tiny and both looked on to another building at the back (very different to any advertised photos), ours was not cleaned and had a beer bottle in it. Even when cleaned the room was very shabby. Have stayed at many other better hotels in France for the same cost.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Quiet, Well equipped boutique hotel....
text: Small boutique hotel in a central location.  Lovely property, friendly staff, and generally quiet - except for the large construction project behind the building, which if you're in the room during the day is quite loud. But rooms are lovely with robes, coffee, nice products, good space to work. No fridge or gym, but everything else you might need.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great hotel!
text: The Amastan was a great place to stay on my recent trip. The room and hotel lobby is hip and sleek - great colors and look. Bed and a/c made the room comfy. The team was so helpful with cars to and from the airport, too. Would stay again here anytime!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Hidden gem next to the champs Élysée
text:
Wonderful small hotel with lots of style. Nice bar for the evening with lovely small garden.
Nice room, very Parisian size however confortable and charming. Personalized breakfast with quality products and tasteful service. Great experience will come back.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Gorgeous small boutique hotel! Very Recommended!
text:
I highly recommend this hotel, the rooms are small but super clean with gorgeous light.
The room service is perfect, the team is really nice and welcoming, they speak perfect english and everyone was really lovely! 
If you are looking for an easy, clean quiet hotel you should definitely go to Amastan!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Amazing!
text: The hotel is in an incredible area in Paris. Such a friendly staff who cared for us the second we walked into the hotel. Wallid, was super welcoming and made sure that everything was great during our stay. I highly highly recommend!!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Beautiful unique little boutique hotel
text: Very small room but all the amenities are available and I got a room with a balcony which even in winter was nice to sit out. Staff very friendly and helpful and they go out of their way to help with all requests.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Refreshing and comfortable
text: The staff here are lovely and welcoming, Walid in particular is often on the night shift and a great welcomer and friendly greeter at the end of a long day. The rooms and amenities are clean, modern and fresh, and the small bar well stocked. Breakfast is simple but satisfying, and the personalised menus are a lovely touch. Some rooms face the street, but they are still very quiet, and the beds very comfortable. As a frequent visitor, I know I can reliably get a good nights sleep here. The hotel is very handy to the Champs Elysee, and several metro stations, and is a good base for both work and pleasure.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Excellent experience!
text: I have stayed at Hotel Amastan twice and had wonderful experiences each time. Walid and the rest of the staff are gracious and always happy to provide a restaurant recommendation. Additionally, the location can’t be beat!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Amazing place to enjoy a cocktail
text: I've been in the bar of this hotel yesterday night with some friends. The location is wonderful, it is a quite place and there is a fantastic garden in which you can share beautiful moments with your friends in front of a drink. The staff was amazing, Mehdi (the barman) was really friendly and professional, as all the rest of the team. I will come back without any doubt and I highly recommend to go. Thank you!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Very Disappointed
text:
My wife and I stayed here for 6 nights as part of our dream honeymoon.

Positives
* The staff are very nice and welcoming. Particularly the girl at the front desk and the duty manager.
* There was a coffee machine in the room
* we received 2 complimentary waters a day.
* The decor was modern and stylish.

Negatives 
* The room was quite small with limited space (We booked this room knowing it was small so it is our own fault) - Just make sure you book the larger room. 
* There is no full length mirror.
* There is no bar fridge or mini bar so you can't buy cold groceries and keep them. 
* There was no welcome signage or any pamphlet that gives us any information about the hotel whatsoever (Room service? Phone number for reception? Nothing..). 
* The bathroom and bedroom were separated by a glass door which meant there was NO privacy when using the toilet - My wife and I have been together for 10 years but this made going to the toilet an awkward experience (The rooms are so small you are basically watching eachother's every move). 
* The shower would leak all over the bathroom floor when used due to its poor design.
* They don't have readily available irons. We asked for an iron on the first night as we were going out to dinner but there was none available at the time so I had to go out in unironed clothes.
* On the first night the aircon was intermittently making a crackling noise which kept waking us up. The next morning we asked to change rooms so they moved us. The new room seemed OK, more or less the same, or so I thought. We soon realised that the aircon was even worse as there was an intermittent, foul, sewerage smell being emitted. The smell was horrendous and we ended up sleeping without aircon on the 2nd night and because of this we couldn't sleep due to the heat. The next morning I asked for a fan so we could use it instead of aircon but they didn't have any. We therefore asked to change rooms again so they moved us back to the original one as it was the lesser of 2 evils. I was wondering why they couldn't find us a new room but I figured that a small hotel like this with 24 rooms was probably fully booked. This is fine but good service to me would be the hotel staff going the extra mile to keep us happy as a result but all we got was a "Ok you can change rooms back very sorry". I would expect some form of compensation at this point, even a drink at the bar probably would have kept us happy.

Also a couple of relatively minor issues but those which should be noted so that the staff can be trained to improve their service in the future.

* We asked for a bottle opener and the guy at reception said he would bring it right up. I waited 30 mins and ended up going down to get it myself, to which he said "Oh sorry I forgot".
* We asked for batteries for the remote as they ran out. The guy at reception brought us the wrong size batteries and when I told him, he said he couldn't find the correct size batteries. I have to laugh at this point because that was the end of our conversation - No reassurance that he would put any further effort into finding batteries whatsoever.

In summary, there are 3 key problems with this hotel. 
1. Some of the staff don't appear to be well trained in customer service and lack the understanding of what it means to ensure customers stay happy during their stay.
2. The hotel lacks the resources to enable the staff to provide good service to the customer.
3. Rooms lack some of the basic amentities and have been designed in a way that they are impractical.

This hotel should be listed as 3 stars at best.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great location, friendly staff, poor admin
text:
Central location, lovely smart hotel with good food (but they do charge an extra 2 EUR for granola on your fresh fruit for breakfast - unbelievable!). Checking in and out was a mess - wrong address, wrong company name all advised on check in, but was still wrong on invoice when checking out the following morning. Nice touch having a personalised breakfast menu, but they called me 'Mrs' rather than 'Mr'! 
Room was nice, but small. Shower control impossible to operate with wet hands, so had to use a towel to turn it off - choosing design over function never really works!
At the price, too many mistakes, so will probably not use again.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Art - Culture - Amastan!
text:
My stay at the Amastan will be favorably remembered for a lifetime.  Across from the hotel are a few art museums.  It was really fun, to open the window and see the art across the street.  It was satisfying.  Unlike American hotels where it is mostly not permitted to open a window, this feature seemed to be a connection from my room, to the larger room of community outside.

The staff were so nice, helpful, and interesting. They to provide a bridge for connection from the outside of Paris, and it's attractions to the inner connection to others. Great recommendations to attractions to see, room service, enjoyable conversation, and ability to put up with the curious demands that I had.

Thank you - Amastan
