name: Amastan Paris

title: Great Location, Average Hotel
text:
They have done a nice job on their website with this hotel.  Unfortunately, it doesn't look nearly as good in person.  Staff was great...very friendly and helpful.  I booked this room several months in advance and requested two separate beds (traveling with my sister).  They notified me at check-in that that would not be possible...frustrating (although they did upgrade the room to a larger bathroom).  

If I would have known this would have been an issue, I would have booked another hotel.  I suggested a roll-away bed...which they were able to provide.  They set up the bed, didn't put a comforter on the bed.  Eventually, all was fine.  The windows don't block much noise, you can hear the street noise as if the window was open.  The bathroom was spacious.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Incredibly stay at Amastan!!
text: The hotel exceeded all of my expectations! The staff was incredibly helpful and kind. They went above and beyond to help us with whatever we needed. The hotel was clean and very stylish. It was in a great area.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Highly recommend this chic hotel.
text: Beautiful hotel located in 8th arrondisment. Lovely staff. Close to lots of shopping and shops. Only complaints were that bed is a little hard and shower is quite tight. Cute lounge area at entrance. Would stay again.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Overall experience excellent
text: Great hotel, outstanding service from a great team who really look after their guests.  The cocktail bar is great fun in the evenings and a fantastic wind down after a hectic day.  The room quality was great and spotlessly clean.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great stay at Amastan Paris
text: Spacious and clean room, comfortable beddings, and good toiletries.  Location is very convenient, accessible to metro and just a short walk to Avenue des Champs Elysees. Staff service was good especially the lady in charge of breakfast/bar-Kristina.  Good breakfast as well.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Beautiful hotel in Paris
text: For a great location that still offers quiet rooms, consider this hotel. We had a room on a high floor, which was light and airy. The hotel was almost empty when we were there (mid August), but it seems the rooms are always pretty quiet. Very friendly and nice staff! -- Highly recommended!!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Quiet Paris location
text: This hotel was recommended. I must say it is pleasant hotel! They speak good English! It is a small room! Room was spotless! There is mold on shower curtain which is upsetting! Breakfast was ok 👍🏻. Yes it is a great location! Would also recommend amastan hotel to others  this street must have 20 different restaurants on it.
name: Amastan Paris

title: nice stay for 2 nights
text:
Room on 5th floor with balcony. Small but not tiny! Nice washing products, towels and dressing gown. Nespresso in room. They have channel4 and film4 but no BBC (for UK residents info!). 

Breakfast was included and is delicious. 

Staff and lovely and very helpful.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Cutest place in the 8th!
text:
My husband and I had the pleasure of staying at The Amastan Paris for 10 days, and to be honest some days it was hard to leave. From the moment you walk into the huge glass doors you’re surrounded by thoughtful design and decor, and at the end of the hall greeted by a smiling staff member. (Shout out Soufian!!) I immediately felt relaxed, welcomed, and at home. We ended up eating breakfast here most of the days because it was SOOO good!! And ending our nights in the garden sipping on aperol spritz, nibbling on the amazing charcuterie board on the menu and Shazaming most of the songs on the speakers (seriously the music in the bar is relaxing, upbeat and fun all rolled into one). 

Our room was nice and clean with great amenities including a cozy robe, AMAZING shampoo and conditioner anddddd iPhone USB ports so we didn’t have to use our converters. The staff spent so much time giving us recommendations and places to visit, it made our time in Paris so unique, special and more than just the tourist spots. Speaking of tourist traps, I mean spots, the Amastan is located in the heart of it all. This is the perfect location to easily catch the metro, rent a bike or scooter or simply walk to your destination like we mostly did. 

I could seriously go on and on about this amazing boutique, but I’ll end it with saying this is the only place we will stay and recommend friends to stay with in Paris. Thank you guys again for making our trip so comfortable and memorable 💕
name: Amastan Paris

title: Amastan is a home away from home in Paris
text: Our short time in Paris was made so special by the incredibly warm and welcoming staff at Amastan. From the moment we walked in, we felt that no request was too large, no question was met with without attention and care. The bar and courtyard  are like havens in the busy city filled with greenery, comfortable seating and great music  -- we couldn't wait to start each morning with delicious pastries and coffee and come back each evening  for amazing cocktails and snacks, always greeted with a smile. The room was a comfortable size and very clean, with stylish amenities, great bedding and a lovely balcony overlooking the courtyard.  We will definitely come back to stay at Amastan next time we visit Paris!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great sleep, pleasant staff & lots of light
text: Stayed twice at the Amastan - great location, everything is walkable & next to excellent places to eat. The beds are very comfortable, the hotel is clean & the staff is extremely helpful. Most of the staff speaks great english and will provide recommendations on where to eat & will book your uber to go back to the airport. Had a great experience. Only drawback, the food is okay - egg had too much cream & the creme brulee was not good at all. The cocktails were okay, the wait time to get the cocktail is something to be desired. But you don't eat at your hotel when there are SO many great places to eat within only a block. Highly recommend!!!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Boutique Hotel in Paris
text:
We HIGHLY recommend this hotel to couples staying in Paris. The atmosphere is chic, modern and luxurious without being stuffy. The Room was well kept and with all the items and gadgets you can ask for. The staff are incredibly helpful - always willing to help and chat! 

Definitely stay and include breakfast, this was a mistake we won’t make again. All the food we had was delicious and well executed. Not to mention their bar and cocktail menu, something you must not miss!!

Location was safe and near two metro stops, perfect for traveling in the city and especially easy to travel to Versailles. Couldn’t be happier with this gem and most certainly will be back - hopefully soon!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Excellent hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
Small rooms but well designed so it was comfortable. Nice little touches like umbrella and Sachajuan amenities as well as bathrobes. The balcony is nice after long day of sightseeing and shopping.

Reception was very helpful during check-in and checkout.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Wonderful stay with a wonderful team
text:
It is rare to find an hotel where the staff just can’t do enough to make your stay perfect !
There is a small boutique hotel with a family feel. Directions, extra pillows, dinner recommandations, reservations, taxis, early check in,it was all taken care of personally by whom ever we asked with never any issues. We will definitely stay here again !
name: Amastan Paris

title: I wouldn’t if I were you...
text:
I wanted to leave the minute I got there but it was booked via work and non-refundable. I was so upset by this. Worse 2+ weeks I’ve ever spent in Paris. 

The good:

1. Location is fantastic if you need to be in the 8th. Far enough away from the Champs not to be too noisy and not many clubs close by

2. Very polite front desk staff who try their best

3. Free Evian in the room (I’m being polite and trying to find more goods here!)

The not so good:

1. Very, VERY small and tight rooms. My first so called room was shocking. I had neither the space to open my suitcase properly or indeed a cupboard!!! 😟 

2. Even when they ‘upgraded’ me I had a tiny cupboard and just about enough space on the floor beside the window to open my case but nowhere to keep it without tripping over it!

3. They don’t clean your sheets everyday, or even every other day! NO I’M NOT JOKING. I spilt some food on the sheets. Why was I eating in bed? Simple, because there’s NOWHERE ELSE YOU CAN EAT! 😨 The stain stayed there until I left, which was a week later. 

4. There’s no room service in the hotel. If you wanna eat in, you’ll need to order from Uber Eats or the like. But I suppose it’s nice of them to put it on a tray for you. 😕

There are MANY hotel options in the 8th, including one about two doors down from the Amastan. Do yourselves a favour and pick any hotel but this one...unless perhaps they slash their prices by 50% which would be more reflective of the experience you would expect for the price!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Staff doesn't care if you like the hotel or not, they won't do anything
text:
Booked this hotel for a weekend in Paris, payed extra 50 euro for a room with balcony. When I arrived the balcony door was broken and wouldn't open. I asked the reception lady to solve the issue. When I came back to the hotel room late in the evening, the balcony door was still broken. The staff of the hotel said: "We called the technician but he still hasn't come/ Why do you want to use the balcony so badly, the weather is so cold". I was really angry with them but didn't want to spoil the vacation by arguing more. I asked if they could give us a different room, they showed me one which was much smaller. While we were talking about the balcony problem, and old French lady came up to the reception and said her bathroom didn't have hot water. Speaking of bathrooms - our bathroom and toilet had a glass door =) which is a bit funny and the shower curtain was too short to close it. The soundproofing was terrible as well. If you have a room facing the street, be prepared for lots of noise, especially during the night and early morning. The room does have a coffee machine but doesn't have an electric kettle. So if you want to have some hot water or tea - you cannot have it.
In the end - the balcony door remained broken and the balcony closed during my entire stay. I didn't have any refund from the hotel for this inconvenience. I would never stay in this hotel again and would strongly recommend you avoid them too.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Amstan amazing
text:
While been there for a few times . This small boutique hotel near the Champs Elysées  is a true jewel.
All the details in the room and the unusual breakfast are great. 
Also the products in the room from Sacha Juan was a real discovery
name: Amastan Paris

title: Wonderful Staff & Accommodations!
text: The location is superb, centrally located and easily walkable to all the usual tourist spots and a host of excellent dining opportunities, but what really stands out about Amastan is the hotel staff. They are extremely welcoming, attentive and helpful with any questions we had. They recommended places for us to eat. They made reservations for us. They even went so far as to reach out to health care practitioners for me when I needed, setting up appointments whilst we were wandering the city. The rooms, although on the smaller side, are impeccably clean. We stayed on the fifth floor and had access to a small balcony overlooking the street. There is also a great little courtyard that soon became our starting point each morning with coffee, and again for wine before heading out for the evening. This is a small, artsy hotel that you can tell puts a lot of effort into pleasing their clientele. We will definitely stay with them again the next time we are in Paris. Highly recommend!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Dazzling start of 2019
text: Truly memorable stay at the Amastan Paris. Went there to celebrate NYE as it was a lifelong dream to spend NYE in Paris. Max was so welcoming upon arrival and made sure we knew just where to go (dining options) during our stay. Rooms were rather small but hey, we were staying in Paris after all. Thank you Roman for booking the Disneyland passes for us in advance. We will definitely be coming back in the near future!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Thank you Amastan for an amazing weekend!
text: I have never slept better in a hotel room - the bed is so cosy an comfortable! The products in the bathroom are amazing and the room has very good facilities allover. The hotel is very clean and it smells so good everywhere. I love the bar and the delicious breakfast - and also to see my name on the breakfast menu :)! The staff is so attentive and everyone I met in the hotel was so friendly and always ready for a little chat - which I love. The location of the hotel is really fabulous - we reached so many things by foot and in a couple of minutes. Everything at AMASTAN felt so warm and joyful and I will definitely come back and recommend this hotel to everyone!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Very enjoyable stay
text: Stayed here for a week, had a great time. Courteous staff, room was cleaned promptly and thoroughly each day, excellent bar with friendly bartender (Mehdi), fantastic central location, yummy breakfast options in the very comfortable communal dining area. My one minor complaint is that there's nowhere in the room to hang clothes. A couple of well placed hooks could solve that.
name: Amastan Paris

title: my perfect honeymoon stay
text: while planning my honeymoon journey, i was worried about my stay in Paris but thank god and thank to tripadvisor, we chose AMASTAN hotel. we were amazed by everything in this hotel. the location which is close to the tourist places in addition to the safety of the district.the hotel is very clean and the rooms perfect . the personnel are very nice and helpful. the atmosphere was warm and  joyful. we really appreciated each minute we did spend there. we felt home. we stayed there for two weeks and it felt quick and fast. we miss Amastan already.  we will advice anybody going to Paris to try Amastan  because it is the perfect choice for people looking for the perfect stay. Thank you Amastan
name: Amastan Paris

title: Best hotel in Paris - great location & amazing staff!
text: I searched for many hotels in Paris, always trying to find the perfect one. This is the best boutique hotel in Paris. The location is a stones throw away from the Champs-èleysees. You can walk to so many tourist spots plus there are 4 different metro lines nearby that connect you to all the main areas. The hotel decor is fresh, chic and modern. The hotel is very clean. The rooms are perfect with good facilities. The bed is the so comfortable and you will have the BEST EVER SLEEP of your life. I have visited this hotel many times and look forward to this the most. The staff are so lovely, always happy to help and so friendly. This makes us want to return time and time again. The breakfast selection is good too. The standard of ingredients meet the standards you would expect from a high end boutique hotel. The local bar two mins away from the hotel perfect for drinks before you head out or a night cap on your way home. Lots of eateries near by and a supermarket in case you have forgotten to pack something.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Perfection
text:
I've been meaning to write a review for this place for ages but it slipped my mind for a while. 

We had a great time at this hotel and I can't fault it in any way. Great service from start to finish, very good location, and clean rooms. 99% of the time I'm up for trying new things but this was so good that if and when I do re-visit Paris, this is where I'll be staying :)
name: Amastan Paris

title: Wonderful experience
text: My husband and I loved this hotel.  We will stay there again and recommend it to all of our friends. Our room was on the 5th floor with two giant windows opening onto the street in the front, and the surrounding neighborhood from our bathroom in the back.  We slept well, neighborhood was quiet.  Room was spacious, light and airy, hardwood floors, white tile in the bath, very clean and pleasing to the eye.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  Lobby area small, but pleasant.  Nice library area and bar.  There was a small garden courtyard, a great place for a delicious breakfast. Located near the Canadian Embassy.  Very nice neighborhood with cafes, bakeries, restaurants.  It's within walking distance to all the sights in Paris, but of course, we love to walk!
name: Amastan Paris

title: My husband and I had a wonderful stay at the hotel Amastan!
text: The hotel is quaint, charming, very clean and beautifully decorated. The staff is also extremely friendly, welcoming and helpful. We stayed in one of the smaller rooms and really enjoyed the little deck. There's also a beautiful garden area in the hotel where you can sit for breakfast or to have drinks in the evening.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Excellent hotel and service.
text: Well appointed, small room (suit 1-2 adults) with modern decor and all amenities. Level 5 room. Quaint parisian view onto quiet street. Lift always worked and never any wait. Desk staff present and helpful any time of day. Close walk to Champs-Elysee and FDR metro (line 1). Four stops to Palais des congrès de Paris. Many eateries close by. Street felt safe to walk alone.
name: Amastan Paris

title: excellent choice
text: very comfortable bed, very good idea to provide water and coffee in the room, a relatively quiet area, very close to main historical atractions of Paris, close to metro lines, the staff ready to help anytime.
name: Amastan Paris

title: fantastic hotel in great location
text:
it was convenient to my evening venue.. very well located and the bedroom was thoughtfully laid out. Everything was design-led and gorgeous but practical and easy to use too. The bed and pillow were very comfy and the light was perfect around the bed. I was quite upset that I only got to sleep for three hours..

There were a few things to improve in the bathroom though.. 
There was no grip on the knobs on the sink, so I could not turn the knob with my soapy hands.  And the light was too far from the mirror that I could not see very well. I am quite small but even for me the shower curtains were too close to me.. It was very clean but still I prefer not to touch it..
name: Amastan Paris

title: Pleasant hotel with good location and friendly atmosphere
text:
We stayed here for a 5 nights and we were very satisfied. Very good location, about 5 minutes from Champs-Elyseé, very welcoming stuff, mainly girls from restaurant were very friendly and helpful.
Room was clean, bed was very comfortable and considering the size of the rooms and the prices in other hotels in Paris, was quite large.
Bathroom was also quite large and very clean. We hadn't any problems or negative experiences.
Just only one little thing, which slightly bothered us, was a night bar near hotel, which was quite noisy , but it isn't fault of hotel.
Nevertheless we were very enchanted and contented from Amastan and hotel's services and we definitely visit Amastan in our next visit of Paris.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Elegant, chic, and welcoming
text: Amastan is a true gem in the City of Light. It has the best, most welcoming staff, an excellent location, and a very high-end yet comfortable ambience.  We stayed for a 10-year anniversary get-away, and the team did everything at the highest level: arranged for transport, decorated the room, provided champagne. The breakfast was excellent, with fresh Parisian food every morning. Evening and late-night cocktails were excellent. The room was spacious and light, with brand-new fixtures and style. The location is fabulous, close to everything, but away from the crowds of the main streets.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Fantastic boutique hotel in champs elysees!
text: My husband and I stayed here for four nights and we loved it! Everyone was friendly and able to speak English. Our room was clean and styled in a unique way! Definitely stay here it’s reasonable and located around all the shops.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Excellent boutique hotel!
text: Very nice hotel near ChampsEllyse. Perfect decoration, nice staff. The breakfast is okey, not the best but is good. The room with balcony is perfect the size, may be if we booked the normal it would be too small. Definitely I will recommend to friends!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Home away from home
text: Lovely, chique, artsy Parisian style hotel. Great location and staff. Clean and big rooms (even the standard room) with nice amenities and of quality. Loved the stay and I would definitely recommend it and go back.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Just, PERFECT!
text: When in Paris for a few days you usually need a great location and enough comfort to feel at ease. So here you go: Amastan! you wont regret it. Not pretentious, very simple and easy yet with a great design, not kidding when I say I felt at home
name: Amastan Paris

title: Delightful stay in Paris
text: I stayed at Amastan for one month while I was in Paris for work. The staff was incredibly nice and eager to help in any way. My room was clean, comfortable, and a great size. I loved the location right next to Champs-Elysees. The bar offers a cool vibe and was a fun spot to hang out at night.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Stylish and unexpected oasis in Champs Elysées
text: Lovely hotel in Champs Elysées with bright rooms, some with balconies. We ordered breakfast to our room which came on time and was very delicious. The staff is very helpful and speaks English. The hotel has a terrace, a nice bar and is very stylish.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great stay in a nice location
text:
Nicely located in the 8ieme, this relatively new small hotel is very cosy and convenient. The staff is friendly and the work atmosphere seems to be good. The bar with inner courtyard is a nice place to relax in the evening. Staff is very young so you have to accept some lack of experience. 
Rooms are well equipped (also with free water and nespresso) but rather small with almost no space to open a large suitcase. The bed is good but not so long. Try to avoid a room on the street side because early morning there is some noise. 
Breakfast is tasty but they give relatively small amounts of bread. You can ask extra though. We had tea with our breakfast and at the end asked a coffee as well. This coffee was to be paid though ... a bit disappointing.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Home Away From Home in Paris
text: Extremely charming, sleek but quiet oasis sandwiched between Champs and Fauborg d'Honore - the room is perfect, and the staff exceeded every expectation. Ofek in the bar is the best mixologist a Paris!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Amazing stay
text: Second time we stay here; beautifully designed, all aspects are top quality. The key is natural and attentive service, makes it feel like a home away from home. looking forward to going back, definitely recommend
name: Amastan Paris

title: Stylish boutique hotel in Paris
text: The beauty is in the attention to detail! Staff was excellent, even accommodating my daughter’s middle of the night quest for chocolate. Central location for walking to many Parisian highlights. Will definitely return to this well-appointed hotel.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Consistently great!!
text: This is the second time I stayed at Amastan but this time I felt compelled to share my experience because everything was once again so on point. Staff was adorable and attentive to everything about my stay. The restaurant reservations they had prepared following my requests in my online check-in (great little feature they added since my last stay) were so quaint and non-touristy, you can tell they really care about how you experience their city. And last but not least, the bar was very cool, a chilled vibe, great cocktails and awesome music. Everything feels so genuine at this hotel, it’s almost like your best friends owns a big house in the heart of Paris and you get to enjoy it for the weekend. Highly recommend it!
name: Amastan Paris

title: 1 night
text: Friendly and helpful staff at check-in but the bartender at night is a bit different - unfriendly when I politely informed him I broke a glass in my room and got all cleaned up, his facial expression embarrassed me.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Great Stay
text: I had such a wonderful stay and wished I could have stayed longer.  I was greeted by friendly staff who were able to accommodate all of my requests. The room was spacious and beautifully designed. I loved the bathroom, it was a nice touch to have the vanity mirror. There was lots of storage space which is rare nowadays in hotels. I will recommend to all of my friends an coworkers who visit Paris to stay here. It is located conveniently to many great attractions.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Lovely place
text:
This boutique hotel located next to the champs Elizee, did not disappoint. Reviews are spot on. We had a lovely room at the 5th floor & faced the street. Location was perfect.
Wonderful breakfast.
Lovely and really helpful staff!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Top Notch in All its Detail!

Super cute hotel with lots of natural light in the rooms which I LOVE! Try out their Avocado toast for breakfast in their little terrace. Best Toast Ever. OH! And their Spicy Roger cocktail!
Everything is Top quality is this place! Truly a home away from home!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Everyone must stay at least twice at the Amastan
text:
I love this hotel, is cozy and with cutting edge design. The staff is so friendly and will go beyond to help you and make you feel welcome. 
The rooms are so comfortable and they have every amenity needed.
The location is superb!
name: Amastan Paris

Unfortunately upon my arrival there was no one at the front desk and no sign indicating that they would be back soon.  I waited 15 minutes before someone showed up.

In the bathroom a little trap door type thing fell open making lots of noise and wasn't fixed even though I asked housekeeping.

Breakfast was ok 👍🏻. Yes it is a great location! Would also recommend amastan hotel to others  this street must have 20 different restaurants on it.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Boutique Hotel
text: Small hotel on a side street between 2 most important streets in Paris. Excellent location! Nothing over the top here, bathrooms are modern and simple, rooms are uncluttered and fresh. A bit small , but thats Paris. Very good value over all .
name: Amastan Paris

title: Very Pleasant!
text: Great position in the very center of the town, but extremely silent. Professional and very courteous staff. Small hotel but good sizing for the rooms. Accurate in style and all needed details you are expecting from  a good hotel. Free water and coffe in the room, only weakness no frigobar in the room, but my stay was so pleasant that I noticed it only after a couple of days.....
name: Amastan Paris

title: 8€ le café Nespresso
text:
I was there for a week . The room was very cozy but if you like a buffet for breakfast Amastan is not the place to be. There are 3 formulas if you don't have a breakfast included and it is quiet expensive. My assistant came for a coffee and PAID 8 EURO FOR A NESPRESSO COFFEE. Shame on them.
For the rest the service was ok . 
If you like baths ... pitty... only showers with great soap Of Sacha Juan
name: Amastan Paris

title: Modern & comfortable. Fantastic location. Price is a steal!
text:
Money well spent. Great 4-night experience. 

Location is unbeatable. Cute side street off of Champs Elysee with lots to do in immediate neighborhood & central to other major destinations. 

Details in the room were well thought out - nice solutions for common travel nuisances (e.g. abundance of USB outlets in the wall to avoid need for adapters. Super fast wifi with no annoying password / login situation. Etc.) Bed was extremely comfortable. Natural light on both sides of the room was very nice (one of which was terrace). Pleasant design features overall! 

Staff was considerate and professional - respectful of my privacy but always friendly and eager to help when needed  - especially important for me as solo traveler.

I have not found anything of this quality in the same price range...Well done, Amastan. I'll be back!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Little gem with AMAZING staff!
text: Our stay at the Amastan was wonderful! Tucked away on a quiet street just off the Champs-Élysées, the hotel is a stone's throw from several attractions while maintaining a tranquil and intimate vibe. Though the rooms are small (to be expected in Paris), they are very tastefully appointed and no detail has been forgotten. The staff at the Amastan are also remarkable - everyone we encountered was extremely friendly, accommodating and eager to improve our stay however they could - they even went as far as upgrading both rooms we had booked free of charge upon arrival! Couldn't be more happy with our stay and would highly recommend! Merci beaucoup Amastan!
name: Amastan Paris

title: recommendable place to stay, lovely staff
text:
From all the times that I’ve been to Paris this is the first time that I feel the need to leave a comment. I am travelling frequently to NYC, London and Paris for work and this was the only time that I felt as comfortable in such a young and cool spot. I stayed at room 32 and the small size of the room has all you need (including very nice materials!). There was also an open bathroom in my room which reminded me of trendy boutique hotels in NYC. 
The staff is very friendly and very willing to help; you can literally ask for anything you want. Whether it was for booking the 1000 restaurants I had planned to go to or getting me some medicine from the pharmacy they always did it with a genuine smile.  Having been to Paris many times, it is very rare to feel such a pleasant atmosphere.  
Having my breakfast in the hotel’s garden was a perfect start to the day; sitting in a little private garden in the middle of Paris felt very homey. Already looking forward to being back!!
name: Amastan Paris

title: A lesser known gem
text:
We stayed for five nights at this recently opened hotel across two different room types (balcony room for a few nights, followed by a deluxe non-balcony room). 

First of all, the reception to the hotel was stunning. A very impressive, modern entrance and a comfortable, classy sitting area. The courtyard and bar (Anouk) were fantastic and we enjoyed sitting down here for breakfast, or a glass of champagne in the evening.

The staff were all very helpful, and the check-in process was easy and efficient. 

The room itself was very well appointed and decorated in a very contemporary, luxe style - both rooms could easily have featured in a design magazine. While the both rooms were small, they were average by Paris standards. There was enough room to move around. The bed was so comfy and I had a fantastic sleep every night. 

All in all, a beautiful hotel that ticks EVERY box. I will surely choose this hotel again for my next stay in Paris. Merci beaucoup to all the staff for a very pleasant and memorable stay.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Disgusting treatment
text: I arrived with my wife to Amastan at 02:00 am after a long travel. We don't like to plan our trips so we like to use last-minute app to reserve the hotel and obtain the best deals in good hotels. We found a good rate in Amastan Paris, including complimentary breakfast and the location of the Hotel is amazing so we decided to booked it. The receptionist made the check-in for us and i asked for the breakfast included on my reservation. She said she couldn't confirm if breakfast was included because we had payed a really low rate, it was the first time she had seen this kind of rate so low, and she had to confirm with the hotel manager in the morning. After that she said we are in a superior room, and she remarked the price of that room was really higher that we had payed on the App, and she couldn't believed when she saw the reservation. It was a disgusting comment, the treatment was different just because we had made a reservation with and last-minute app, that things can't happen in a fancy hotel like Amastan. In the morning i ask again for breakfast and the receptionist try to charge it, i had to show my reservation and explain to her. It was an uncomfortable situation and we don't recommend the hotel, worst treatment i have ever had in a four star hotel!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Perfect Little Parisian Gem!
text:
My boyfriend and I had an amazing time (6 nights) at this property! It was our first time in Paris, but we found it easy to navigate our way around here to the Champs-Élysées
and the many cafes that were down the road. The rooms were small but were very well appointed. My boyfriend is super claustrophobic, but even he found the rooms spacious which is a mega thumbs up! The decor was super modern in blue and white with a crisp white marble bathroom. The balcony was our haven where we were able to sit and enjoy our baguettes watching our favourite TV shows. The staff were incredibly nice (which is amazing compared to most of Paris). We LOVED the Thai house keeping lady who was SO friendly and made us feel so warm and welcoming everyday that we bumped into her. We will definitely return upon our return to Paris... THANK YOU xxx
name: Amastan Paris

title: Boutique at its Best
text: We stayed 2 nights recently in a balcony room and loved this property! The design is brilliant...modern and hip with incredible attention to detail. We had breakfast included and this is not a boring standard breakfast buffet... it was cooked to order with the best eggs and salmon. We also enjoyed the location in the 8th..many restaurants and art galleries nearby. It was only a 15 minute walk to Place de Concord and the Rue Fauborg shopping. We couldn't believe this property was rated #951 on TripAdvisor. We stayed at another hotel in Paris that was rated #3 and the Amastan blew it out of the water!! If you like a small intimate boutique hotel that is brilliantly designed and staffed I highly rcommmend.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel in Perfect Paris Location!
text: I stayed at Amastan for a week with my daughter in June.  We were in town for Roland Garros.  The entire staff was excellent.  Before we arrived, I booked car service and restaurants with the hotel staff.  They were extremely efficient and gave excellent recommendations.  The hotel is beautifully done with attention to every detail.  I definitely recommend a room with a balcony.  The location is excellent--very close to Champs Elysees.  My daughter and I truly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend Amastan!
name: Amastan Paris

title: Fantastic short stay for honeymoon
text:
Stayed here with my wife for 2 days during our honeymoon and had a wonderful time. We checked in late at night and staff had prepared food for us (which was excellent) knowing we were arriving late. The entire staff from the receptionists, to bartenders and managers were incredibly friendly and helpful. Rooms, lobby, bar and decor are well-appointed with strong attention to detail. And Breakfast included is always a plus!
The hotel is located in a great neighborhood. 
All in all, would recommend to anyone looking for 5 star quality at a great price.
We look forward to returning.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Cute hotel in a great location
text:
Amastan is a good hotel in a great location.Its a small hotel of 24 rooms and almost all the rooms are of the same size.It is best to book a room with a balcony.The rooms are done in white colour and so do are the bathrooms.The hotel is very near to most attractions in Paris . You can reach almost all main attractions in the minimum Uber fare. This works out great even if you are just a couple because for Euro 6 which is the base Uber fare you can save time and the complications of navigating a metro.

The Hotel does not have a buffet breakfast . Instead you have  to order and then the breakfast is brought to your table.

There is bar in the hotel and the barman does work up some pretty good cocktails. I remember the Moscow Mule which was pretty great.

The staff are very friendly and the overall experience of staying in the hotel was very satisfying.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Lovely little hotel
text:
Stayed here for one evening on a business trip to Paris in May 2017
This is a lovely modern little hotel. The food was not quite what I would usually have (yes I probably was expecting a bit much wanting and English breakfast in France!) however the Continental breakfast was great. This is a fabulous little place for a drink, very modern inside, decent bar. The rooms are very small but comfortable. Only thing that put me off was the clear bathroom door giving a view to anyone you are staying with when you use the bathroom! I was thankfully travelling alone.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Holiday
text:
Was charged €50 extra after chk out on a baseless allegation by hotel that I took its Bluetooth speaker from room which I never saw in the room & also on its site it doesn't mention that it provides Bluetooth speakers in room wen I wrote mail asking y I was charged extra without informing me also. 
Also they say rooms are with a/c but during our stay 6-10th April a/c not working in rooms. Extremely stuffy in the rooms had to sleep with windows open all night traffic sound impossible to sleep well.
Advice guests to be very careful of being labeled as thieves as I have been called one by the hotel. 
Best to avoid this hotel
name: Amastan Paris

title: A very nice charming boutique hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
I stayed one night in Amastan and it was wonderful I was very surprised by the quality of every material and finition used to design this hotel. If you like Scandinavian design this is your place. The bed is one of the best in its kind. The hotel is located just behind the most popular luxurious avenue in Paris (Champs Élysée). Breakfast is very healthy with some fresh fruits and French croissants everything you need to start a good day.

The staff is very lovely and helpful.

I have some remarks for a better improvements:
- the température of the room can't be set from inside the room (a call to the reception is required)
- I would really appreciate to have a clock inside the room either digital or classic (maybe some Menu Marble clock can fits the Scandinavian design of the hotel)
- Maybe another alternative for milk such as soya or almond.

I will definitely choose and recommend this hotel for my future stays in Paris.
name: Amastan Paris

title: Lou’s service 😀
text: Ate at the restaurant on top floor and had great service from Lou. 3 of us for dinner, I had a pizza and it was great, diavola which was a little spicy but loved it. Lou was great making sure we were happy at all times and checking on us regularly. Our drinks were a little slow in coming but she went and got them for us. Thanks again
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Fab!
text:
Went on a Eurostar city break to this Hotel.  Was amazing! Beautiful roof terrace with great views.  Beds soft and comfy with quality linen.  Complimentary toiletries of high quality.  
Food in rooftop restaurant was very pricey and lukewarm which was a shame. Aside from this we loved this funky energy filled hotel.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Far enough for quite streets yet fairly close to the city attractions
text:
I love the atmosphere, the wide street in front of the hotel followed by a park. The nearby Supermarket makes you feel like a local. 

The breakfast is big and lots of home made bread varieties. I did not mind paying Euro 19 for the breakfast. Sitting and facing the street is a joy with the ceiling to floor windows.

The rooftop atmosphere is also nice but did not spend much time there.

Nearby is the exposition where I can go for a coffee or a light breakfast at Paul. 

I used Uber mostly for transport because the cost I saved in hotel rooms. I walked to the Eiffel Tower and the Champs it is a little more than an hour walk but there are so much shops and things to see along the wall.

With kids you need laundry and with washing& drying machines in the hotel no stress for finding a laundromat. 

The only issue is that shower and toilet are separate, also once you step out of the shower, you are in the room.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Good Meal, average price
text:
We went to Mama Shelter at 11pm. Every place was closed but not Mama. The meal was nice. We ate Chicken with frites. Taste nice!! 
The price was a little expensive, just like Paris at all… not a surprised though. 
Thank you Eva !!
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: nice view and good atmosphere; food and drinks could be better…
text: Rooftop @mamashelterpariswest has a nice view and good atmosphere. However food and drinks could be better… We started with our drinks “Sangria La Rossa” and “Papi Chulo” 👎 with fries calamari (Very good 👍), then we had beef carpaccio, spaguettone al pomodoro and pizzas, all the 4 dishes had a lot of pepper and for sure they all could be better. For example, pizzas were so thin that they got all watery. For dessert we had ice cream 👍 (kids menu), prosecco gourmand  👍 and “riz au lait” 👎 (milk rice) not good at all, to the point that it was not charged to our bill. And jus to finish we chose the kid’s menu (1 MAIN COURSE + 1 DESERT + 1 DRINK + 1 MAMA DRAWING KIT = 19€) because of the drawing kit, however we didn’t receive it! the one on the 9th photo was a welcome kit (apparently different to the one on the menu), at least it is what the waitress said!
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Super place
text: Excellent environment, fantastic food & sweets, super service from Marvin. Smiley and very pleasant!Strongly recommended. The food arrived in the right time. People working there where very polite, happy and helpful. Atmospheric environment, modern and clean
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Don’t visit the restaurant if you don’t speak French
text:
Planned to meet friends at the rooftop bar. The friendly personnel at the hotel reception informed me that the bar was open and for drinks only no booking was needed. 

Luckily, I made a reconnaissance visit before the evening, only to find out the bar was closed that day. At the downstairs restaurant, I was told its terrace bar was open, free seating, no bookings accepted. When I later arrived with my friends, a few tables were free, but I was informed that they were booked. 

We were referred to the indoors bar. First, I was told all tables were booked, but when I said I stayed at the hotel and we also wanted to ear dinner later, I could get a table and was told a waiter would come soon. We never saw a waiter at our table. 

At the bar disk, a busy bartender completely ignored my order in English, although I stood right in front of him, and took orders from many French guests that arrived after me. When I told him that I had waited for a long time and wondered when he would take my order, he referred me in French to a colleague who was busy serving other guests. Frustrated we left the restaurant. 

Reading previous positive reviews, we were surprised to find this rude behaviour at the Mama Shelter.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Nice as usual !
text:
I particularly appreciate the service : nice and quiet people, really adjustable for our family.
The matress was as comfortable as at home, the same for the pillow.
The breakfast was as good as in 3 stars hotel : large choice to eat, sweet and salty and to drink.
Thank you !
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Stunning hotel in Paris
text:
We stayed in this hotel for few days and we really enjoyed it. Room super clean with a really comfortable bed, drinks and breakfast amazing and the staff is incredibly kind and friendly. 
We definitely recommend this hotel to everyone especially for couples.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Mama shelter loves you, we love manager Sandra
text: We had a miscommunication about our reservation. It was till the next morning that we could speak about it with the manager. Sandra helped us in such a friendly and accurate way. Thank you Sandra and thank you mama Shelter. We had a wonderful stay! Sylvia van der Westen
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Awesome design centric hotel
text:
Brilliant hotel with bags of personality and surprise design features around every corner. I wish the rooms were a little warmer but that’s the only minor issue I have. Otherwise the restaurants and bars are brilliant fun, the staff are probably the best and most fun in Paris, the food is amazing, the price of champagne is too low to stop drinking it ;) 

Absolutely love Mama!
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Hipster hotel for younger fellows
text: Was there on a business trip, ssh i picked it as it was close to the trade centre. Reception needs improvement, very slow and not very quick in understanding simple logistics. Rooms was decent, functional bathroom, you could not hear a thing from the busy street. Breakfast was tasty and costs 18 Euro per person. Dinner was also fine but a little bit too expensive for what you get (54 Euros for a plate with meat and a coctail)
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Fabulous food, beautiful venue and an easy hop into central Paris on the metro
text: Although this hotel has 'adult' options! (the sex package add on when booking online was a surprise!) Its actually a really great venue for a family. Staff were amazingly helpful, the rooms were quiet and clean. We also had a family room with 2 separate rooms for the beds - the living room has been turned into a bedroom for the kids - which is much better than the usual cot bed down the sides of the parent double bed.  The breakfast was also fabulous as was the lunch we had in the rooftop restaurant. We'll def stay here again.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: original
text:
The service and products were great, the staff was very helpful and so caring ! and I think it's not easy regarding the context, 
We stayed fat the Mama Paris West for the PSG&ALL because the family is fan, so the idea was excellent for us ! we enjoyed all the program and the service with the very good food !
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Great modern hotel with very helpful team, functional & with great food & beverage outlets .
text:
I rarely write review on T/A – but I thought I would write one on my recent stay at the Mama Shelter West … I was there a couple of weeks ago .. the Hotel is brand new, opened late December, then closed 4 months later because of the Covid situation, and then reopened again 3 months later; not such an easy task to do when you are in the hotel business, I know…. It seems that - and despite all the turmoil experienced during all that time – they really got their act together! Great staff all around who generates a great atmosphere all throughout the hotel… Special thanks to Pauline and the 2 very helpful ladies at the reception who really went out of their way to help me in getting appointment, documents that were necessary to get myself back home…
The hotel might not in the best location but it is only a 15/ 20 minutes taxi ride from Montparnasse train station and to a walking distance to Rue de Vaugirard where you will find anything you need including nice small bistrots …But the hotel has also 2 F&B outlets that are worse the visits, before thinking to get out! – One is a roof top restaurant & bar, great for sundowners – (Eiffel tower on the horizon! & where they also serve a great breakfast (top notch crispy croissants and chocolatines); the other one on the ground floor, is rather vibrant venue where they propose great bistrot type food under the guidance of a 3 *** Michelin chef! I was there for 2 full days …Despite the hotel running at low occupancy (due to the covid situation) both restaurants at lunch and diner were packed with house guests but also with a lot of patrons from the outside! Highly recommended to book….though the front staff is pretty switched on as they will always propose to book for you. Finally, very comfortable rooms with all the latest modern facilities. Had a great time & will be back!
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Really bad price/quality for brunch
text:
For 44 euros per person, you can go to really amazing places in Paris. This is sadly not one of them. The food IS good, but we had to stand in line for 10 minutes at each station to get the food. There were only 2 options for juice (orange and grapefruit), which is not diverse enough when you’re charging 44 euros...
While the staff are super friendly and welcoming, the service was slow, and no one came to clean the plates when we were done. Again, usually we wouldn’t mind too much, but in this case for the price we’re paying it’s not acceptable.
Finally the toilettes were really not clean at all. There were paper towels spread across the floor, and sanitary pads lying on top of the bin (so not regularly cleaned we assume).
We really love mama shelter usually, which is why this experience was so disappointing :(
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Very chic & modern
text:
Very cool hotel, easy to find from the Metro. The rooms are chic and functional, had a huge walk in rain shower. Beds were comfy, no complaints.

Breakfast was nice, although a little inattentive - was not given an cutlery!

But super good experience.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Great hotel for event in Paris Expo
text:
Stayed for 4 nights as working at trade show at Paris Expo. Literally around corner.

New hotel. Fab helpful staff.

Great bedroom. Free wifi and films.

Plenty of choice for breakfast.

Good restaurant, funky vibe and dj!
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Good clean hotel
text: Good clean hotel very well located for exhibitors at the nearby show center. A little disappointing that there isn’t a kettle or coffee in the room. One would expect this in such a hotel . Very comfortable beds.
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Perfect experience
text: Love this hotel. Everything is nice, location, rooms, decoration, price, will definitely stay next time again. Breakfast was overwhelming, especially the granolas blew my mind. Nice personal with right attitude
name: Mama Shelter Paris West

title: Great hotel, just be aware of street noise throughout the night.
text: The room was nice and the staff was exceptionally helpful.  Centrally located it is so easy to walk the city from here.  We had a room that overlooked the street, and that may have been our mistake.  The three nights we were there were sleepless ones due to the noise throughout the night. People partying without much thought to the people sleeping in the apartments and hotels in the area.  One group at 3am until 5.  As far as the hotel it was a nice room and exceptional, warm service. If you can sleep through anything, worth every penny.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location and very clean
text: Our family of 3 stayed for a week. The rooms were clean, the staff was incredibly helpful and the location was fantastic. Several metro stops are within a 5 minute walk and there are many wonderful restaurants in the immediate area. We also enjoyed the daily breakfast offerings.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: I absolutely recommend to everyone!
text:
I stayed here with my grandmother a couple of months ago and don't want to stay anywhere else in Paris! The location is perfect --  in the 6th, fabulous restaurants everywhere you walk. It's a quick walk across the Seine to the Louvre and other sights. 
The rooms are not large (it's Paris!), but they are beautifully decorated. The continental breakfast is plentiful and good.  The staff is both helpful and friendly.  It is a hotel I would recommend for everyone!  -- from Neila
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Mouse in the room and didn't compensate for one night. Unbelievable :/
text: We had clients stay here, and on the third night of their stay with two rooms booked for a family of four, the two daughters saw a mouse in their room.  They went to their parent's room because they were scared and called the front desk.  While the clerk on duty tried his best, he couldn't remove it.  So the dad and he went back in with a broom and discovered it behind their suitcase.  It scurried down the hall and into the elevator shaft.  While this could occur anywhere, sadly enough the hotel management didn't think it necessary to compensate that family for one night for one room.  That is the least they could do...There were no other rooms available to move them.  They refunded 20% or 54 euros.  Up until that point, the family had enjoyed their stay and said the location was great, staff was friendly and it was clean.  We tried contacting the hotel on their website, but to no avail as there was no response to our request to compensate them for the one night.  So disappointed in the lack of professionalism and "good business" sense.  A MOUSE IN THE ROOM--really?  Still flabbergasted for not taking better care of your clients.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location and breakfast, but just a little claustrophobic.
text:
Our large family of 10 had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Le Regent just recently. Ultimately, its a place we would return!,   The location is fantastic - a very short walk to river, parks, restaurants, Notre Dame, The Louvre, and also subway/metro stations - which provides easy access to the more distant areas of Paris.  
All in our party loved the breakfast - it is superb mix of croissants, jelly's, etc. 

Rooms are a bit small, but not out of norm in our opinion.  The Elevator, stairs, etc. can be a bit claustrophobic, and takes a lot of patience to navigate - as the room stairs to various levels of the hotel are carpeted, steep and narrow/curved, and the elevator takes quite a while to move. 

The hotel was perfect for us, though - and we'd definitely stay again in the future!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Very good location
text:
This hotel has the best location ever!! Few steps from Pont Neuf you can walk to Louvre, Notre Dame, St Gemain de Pres, Saint Chapelle , lot of metro station around(closest is line 4 Odeon) , just 100mts away. Staff are amazing gentle and polite. Always there for help. Breakfast is fair, orange juice, yogurt, baguette and 2 croissants.
I highly recomend.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Would stay here again!
text: My daughter and I spent a week at this establishment and couldn’t have been happier with the location.  The cafes, shops, boulangeries, and just general atmosphere were so fun!  We were in Room 11 on the second floor (European first floor) which I believe was a superior deluxe.  The bed was so very comfy and the bathroom was very large (by European standards) and modern large shower with great water pressure.  We faced the street and there was some street noise but it died down during the night and just didn’t bother me much at all.  Our room had very adequate closet space which was greatly appreciated by two women!  The staff was friendly and Sandrene at the front desk was especially helpful during our stay. Overall I would certainly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Some quite dated rooms
text:
Average is possibly too low. The location for me is the main thing that stands out positively. 6eme Arrondissement is where I want to be based. 

Some of the rooms are a bit dated. The bathrooms have been recently redone and are nice enough. Hopefully the rooms are getting an makeover soon as well. 

You will find newer places at lower price, but not in this location. 

Service was friendly throughout. I would come back for a short stay. I would likely go for a CitizenM option if I was staying longer.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Second Visit was wonderful ... like the first!
text: Our recent second stay at Hotel Le Regent was very good. We absolutely love the uniquely designed rooms and the location. We are walkers so we are out all day, and it is always a treat to return to this lovely little hotel in the most picturesque part of Paris.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great little hotel
text: We have stayed at this hotel twice now and it is a real find. Small and compact rooms in an amazing central location with helpful staff and a good breakfast. You can walk to many of the Parisian attractions from here.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great stay
text: The room was small (but if you're looking to stay in Paris that's inevitable) but still definitely workable with two adults and two suitcases. We had the accessible room on the first floor by chance and had a good sizable bathroom. Hotel was cute and decorated for the upcoming holiday. Great location, not a long walk from the Notre Dame metro station and lots of eating/shopping nearby. As two women traveling we felt safe in the area. Hotel staff was nice and helpful.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A Nice Experience
text:
If you want a true Parisian hotel experience and avoid the cookie-cutter approach, this may be the hotel for you. Warmly greeted by an English speaking receptionist, we were able to securely store our baggage until the room was ready, thus enabling us to hit the pavement and start touring right away.

We booked a deluxe superior room that was clean, comfortable, and with enough elbow room to move around in.  We did have some street noise, but our ear plugs remedied any significant problems.  Most importantly: everything worked, including robust a/c.

Do not expect a large, ornate lobby, large breakfast area, or average sized elevator.  All are quite small.  In fact, you can have breakfast delivered to you room at no extra charge, I suspect, due to the small size of the breakfast room. Speaking of breakfast, you can have eggs to order, a side meat, coffee, juice, and delicious breads that only the French know how to make.

The location was perfect for us.  Several sights were in walking distance and with the Odeon metro a few minutes away, all of Paris was at our footstep.  Additionally, dozens of restaurants were within a few blocks.

Should we return to Paris anytime soon, we will happily stay at the Le Regent.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Location, Breakfast, A++ Service, D
text:
Location of course is fantastic and this hotel offers a free breakfast that was a great way to start each day. Unfortunately after a night out with my husband on our first night, the evening clerk stopped us at the front desk on our way in and scolded us for taking our room key with us. We had not been told it was custom to leave the key and instead of telling us to please leave the key next time he got into an argument with us and continued to yell at us saying “if you lost the key what would we do, we have no way to replace it.” 

I posted a review that evening expressing how I felt, and how disappointed I was that my first night in Paris ended by the clerks bad attitude. The next day, a different receptionist stopped me to say that she had read my review and wanted more details on the situation which I gave her. She said it wasn’t a big problem to leave the keys or not which is why we weren’t told to do so and that they had problems with this evening clerk previously. Still, no apology for his behavior or anyone asking how they can make it right.

On top of this, that next night on our way out of the hotel for the evening, we were stopped by the same evening clerk again who had clearly heard of our bad review. He harassed us as we were leaving the hotel and I felt so extremely uncomfortable leaving him our room key, we almost didn’t leave the hotel that night. We spent the rest of the night saying we didn’t want to go back and deal with him. Worried by what he might do or say. 

This hotel was nice, but unfortunately this is the SERVICE industry and we are the clients paying per night. To treat your guests in this way is simply uncalled for. Finally, when we checked out, a different receptionist apologized for everything and sent us on our way. We were glad to be leaving this hotel, not Paris of course. There are many many hotels around the area. Read a few more reviews which I also noticed a few had written about poor service and front desk employees being rude, and make your own judgment. Unfortunately for us, service means a lot to us and can sometimes make or break the experience. We will not be staying here again nor will our friends and family.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Location plus
text: Loved the location of this hotel and the decor. Stayed on the first floor just up the spiral staircase with a window over the internal courtyard that we could open for fresh air. Room was compact but expected that for Paris. The staff were very helpful and friendly and could stay here again if I were in Paris.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Depending on which room you get, this is either a 1 star or 5 star hotel
text: This hotel is situated in the heart of Saint Germain and it is one of my favorite quarters.  When you go out there are plenty of good restaurants and bars, stores and lots of people. We had a room number 25 that was horrible!  Extremely small had to walk over my suitcase in order to go from one side to the other.  One window and a horrible bed.  The bathroom was decent size though.  My friends on the other hand, who paid the same amount, had a beautiful room number 42.  Twice the size of ours, 4 windows with lots of light coming in because it was on the top floor.  completely different experiences for us.  Their bed was even comfortable.  Thank goodness we were only there for 2 nights.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Rude manager, tiny rooms, disappointment overall
text:
We stayed at the hotel for four nights. First night was unexpected and the hotel had us with our two young kids on the same floor but separated by a number of rooms. That was fine. 

But, for the three following nights, we were supposed to have adjacent rooms as reserved by our travel agent months earlier. However, that never quite happened. The second night, we were put in a small room with no working air-conditioning. When we asked the front desk, they seem surprised it wasn’t working. However, we noted there was a fan in there. The next morning, it became clear they knew there was no working air-conditioning in that room - hence the pre-existing fan. We complained that not only about the lack of air conditioning but also that both small rooms overlooked “poubelle” (french word for garbage). See pictures. The next morning, the manager came out and got incredibly defensive. Accused me of calling her hotel garbage. I assured her I would never use such a term but she aggressively persisted.
