name: Hotel Le Regent

title: PERFECT location and staff
text: My niece and I stayed here and it is within 5 mins to Notre Dame and Rivoli street which has tons of great shopping.  It is near hundreds of stores and cafes. It is close to the hop on hop off bus lines, which we took to see the city at our leisure.  I can't say enough good things about this hotel.  The rooms was cute, the AC  was cold,  the breakfast was fantastic.  Everyone spoke English and was very nice. They arranged a car to pick us up from the airport which was $75 but worth it. Its near a pharmacy, bakery, etc.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Suits your Parisian needs
text:
Location (5/5) is superb. It is a 3 minute walk to Odeon, Metro 4 which takes you to Gard du Nord or Gard l'Est. A 3.5 minute walk to Metro 10 which, with the C RER being closed, will connect you to Javel RER (C) and take you to Versailles. Certainly walking distance to the River Seine, St Germaine, Luxembourg Gardens and the Latin Quarter. 
Hospitality (5/5): very friendly and easy going reception staff. Very helpful.
Room (3/5): this is my 4th visit to Paris and this is the smallest room I've ever had so could only give it a 3. In saying that, it is Paris and was there to sleep and have a rest after walking for miles. The room was both quiet and comfortable. 
Breakfast (3/5): they do provide breakfast but it is only a croissant, baguette, a pan au chocolat and yogurt which is fine but when you're staying there for 3+ nights it would have been nice to provide some variety, perhaps some charcuterie.

Little tip, I urge you to book directly to the hotel because you will get a complementary hot/cold drink and a snack at the famous cafe blessed by different artists and novelists, Les Duex Magots.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: average experience
text:
This was my first time in Paris, so I write this not knowing what all there is to offer in this charming city, but our room was tiny and in need of refreshing.  

We were happy to have A/C during the July heat, but we were also thankful to only be in our rooms for sleeping and showering—as they were extremely tiny.  If my mattress moved at all from its original position, I could not open the door.  As well, my suitcase (while admittedly large), barely fit in the room.  I had to put the chair in the bathroom just to make room for my carry-on and a small walking path from the far side of the room to the bath.  There was a dispenser of dual-purpose soap/shampoo in the shower, but nothing else was provided (lotion, conditioner, etc).  While there was a hair dryer, it was one of those hose dryers that makes a lot of noise, but doesn’t dry a lot of hair.  WiFi is spotty.  Breakfast is adequate--lots of bread (which is very French). I wore sandals in the room (because I didn't want to go barefooted). Again, my experience in Paris is limited, but Le Regent is best described as just barely meeting our needs while traveling.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Well located and very friendlu
text: In the middle of the most charming streets of paris filled with bistrots, restaurants, boutiques, iconic cafes and places. Metro around the corner, good connection to airport. Famous backeries all around. Beds are very good. I was very pleased with them.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Good
text:
I feel it’s about 3 1/2 stars really. 

The pros:  affordable, clean, and comfortable beds.  

The not as good is that it’s located in a very busy intersection in the heart of the left bank. Our room which was bright and airy was also very noisy at night with a lot of street noise and street musicians until midnight (even later on Friday). 

This is a very basic hotel with no clothes iron in the room, an out of date bathroom and weak WiFi.  There is a small refrigerator, though which we appreciated. 

The decor is a bit over the top so be prepared for a very busy looking room. 

The staff is pleasant but it’s not full service;  they’ll point you to an elevator when you check in that is the size of a postage stamp. 

The breakfast is enough to get you started for the day—coffee, bread, croissants, one plain yogurt each and a glass of orange juice. 

Overall, though, it is a good value.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location in Paris
text:
Hotel Le Regent is exactly what I was looking for in my most recent trip to Paris.  It is located centrally within walking distance to many of the best sights, dining, and nightlife in Paris.  There are also a couple of metro stations within a very short walk.  This makes it a great home base for exploring Paris.

We had a room on the first floor with a balcony overlooking the moderately busy, mostly pedestrian, street below.  There was very little noise with the window closed and the in-room air conditioning made it very comfortable.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Gem in Paris
text: My daughter and I just came back from a fantantsic hotel in the heart of Paris. I was impressed with all levels of this great find. We were there during the extreme heat wave and the air conditioning was amazing. Wonderful breakfast, helpful and kind staff. Will definitely be coming back. The location couldn’t be beat.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Good option in a great part of Paris
text:
The Hotel Le Regent was a good option in a great neighborhood. My wife and I traveled with my parents, and our rooms were both good, but in different ways.

We stayed in Room 22, which overlooked Rue Dauphine and had a larger bathroom. It was still small by American standards but fairly typical for Paris. It had a comfortable bed and a good shower. Meanwhile, my parents stayed in Room 61, which was smaller, particularly the bathroom. However, it had a balcony with an amazing view of the neighborhood. For my mother, that alone was worth the stay.

Breakfast can either be taken in your room or in the breakfast area downstairs. We had a continental breakfast included, which had a basket of croissants and baguette slices, yogurt and coffee or tea. The croissants were outstanding.

Couple of things to note: 1) The elevator is a little claustrophobic. No, it's a lot claustrophobic. Since we were on the second floor, I often just took the stairs. 2) We paid about $300 USD a night for the room. Now in the center of Paris, you're going to pay more for rooms than you would in other parts of town. Still, that seemed a little high.

But it was a special trip, and we enjoyed staying there, so in the end, I would recommend it.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Perfect Paris Weekend!
text: Absolutely perfect hotel in the ideal setting.  We could easily walk to cafes and dinner and shopping, Could get to many of the best sights on foot.  Room was comfortable, service very good and the breakfast brought to our room every morning.  Eating croissants and drinking coffee in a robe looking out at the streets of Paris waking up.  Simply magical!  Definitely will return to this hotel.  No doubt!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Excellent location, charming Hotel and nice service
text: The location in a charming area, close to Notre Dame and walking distance to many places you wish to see when visiting Paris. The Hotel is charming in a very old building. Not luxurious but definitely very nice.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Needs updating
text:
This hotel is lovely with its fabric walls & matching curtains, bed not so comfortable (dips in the middle) room is small & bathroom desperately needs updating 

Overall it’s clean & staff are helpful!!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Fabulous Stay
text: What a fabulous, centrally located ,quaint  boutique hotel on the left bank. Angelique was incredibly helpful in arranging transportation and offering insights on tours and events. Located near an intersection of streets with cafes and restaurants and a pedestrian only street. Near a terrific selection of restaurants multiple cuisines. Hotel has a very good continental breakfast included, optional cooked breakfast. Clean rooms, lovely linens, deep tub. Room on the second floor, window opening to street scene, lovely in the sun for a cup of tea. Merci ! We will be back
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Perfect Paris Locale
text: Located in St Germaine district, we were right in the middle of the great bistros and restaurants.  Our room overlooked all of the action down below.  We even had a two hour jazz concert out on the street in our room.  The rooms are adequate, actually quite large for Parisien hotels.  Comfortable bed.  Very helpful staff.  View of Notre Dame from the back windows (Unfortunately we were there the day after the fire-so sad)
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Steve and Mary
text: The hotel and all of the staff were absolutely wonderful.  One sort of negative was the high step into the tub/shower.  We had to be extremely careful getting in and out of the tub,. But everything else as absolutely terrific.  We will certainly recommend the hotel to family and friends and of course if we ever go back to Paris for vacation would stay at your wonderful hotel
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Charming, Great Location, & Friendly
text: I stayed at this hotel with 2 friends.  We shared 1 room & it was very spacious.  The room had great street views & a charming interior decor.  Hotel staff is very friendly and accommodating.  The continental breakfast was wonderful as well!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Le Regent is a wonderful find!
text:
This hotel was a wonderful find!  We have travelled to Paris many times and wished to find a hotel that had a more “traditional” feeling and situated in a neighborhood setting. Hotel Le Regent fit the bill!

The room was large by Paris standards.  The bed was comfortable, and the sheets were of good quality and without blemish.  The entire room was clean, well appointed, and well maintained.  There was adequate storage in the built-in closet along with a built in safe.  The bathroom was also well appointed with a large tub/shower with nice water pressure and seemingly unlimited hot water.  Two bathrobes were included.
The room was quiet with well insulated glass that minimized external sounds. The heating and cooling system worked very well.  

The key to the room itself is a huge brass key with a beautiful decorative fob; you always return the key to the front desk whenever you leave the hotel and then get it back when you return.  Even though the staff changed, they somehow always remembered our room number when we went back to the hotel.  (Apparently, this type of key return/request is common in boutique hotels in Paris.)

The staff was multilingual, always outgoing and courteous, and knowledgeable about the city, neighborhood, and restaurants.  Our request for a wine opener and additional towels were promptly and cheerfully fulfilled.  Breakfast, which is served in the cellar, was tasty and included croissants, baguette and one other pastry, coffee and juice (a typical Continental breakfast).

The location of the hotel is excellent only requiring a short walk to the heart of the city, restaurants, and the Paris Metro. The actual street upon which the hotel is located is pretty and rather busy. We always felt very safe walking all around the area.

North Americans need to be aware that like most European hotels, Hotel Le Regent has a small elevator that does not go to the breakfast room in the cellar.  In addition, the stairs are steep, and in some places, they are circular. The shower/tub combination has a high side.  Again, this is typical for European hotels and is not meant as a negative comment.   

Would we stay here again and recommend this hotel?  Yes!  I would recommend requesting a room on a high floor.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A great find!
text: This hotel is in a central location and, although not cheap, is good value for money. The small rooms are decorated in a typical Parisian style and several have views across the city. All the facilities were excellent: bathrooms, breakfast etc and staff very helpful and friendly.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A very good value hotel
text: This 3 stars hotel is a typical Parisian hotel: rooms are small, the breakfast room is at the cellar level but ... this hotel is also more than a normal 3 stars hotel. The staff is very friendly, the location could not be better in Saint-Germain, rooms are very clean and the ones not on the street are very calm. Highly recommandable.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Parisian charm
text:
My teenage daughter & I stayed at the Le Regent at the end of November. I had booked this hotel because the location seemed to be good and the pictures of the rooms promised what I believed to be a real Parisian style Boutique hotel, with their flowery wallpaper, bed linen and curtains. What can I say, I wasn't disappointed! The location is great, with two metro stations close by and the banks of the Seine at the end of the street. The lobby is small but very elegant and like in the photos, our room was beautifully decorated. We had booked a standard double room and after reading some of the other reviews, I had expected it to be tiny, but it was actually not too bad, especially because the en suite bathroom was surprisingly spacious. It was located downstairs (room 1 I believe) and therefore you could hear everything that was going on in the lobby, plus a lot of the street noise from outside - this noisiness, sometimes very early in the morning or very late at night,  is the only negative I can think of. 
The staff was very helpful and except for the breakfast attendant all spoke very good English. We had a continental breakfast in the cozy, cave like breakfast room every day and it was delicious with fresh baguette & chroissants, jam, yoghurt, juice and coffee. Would definitely stay there again!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A Gem
text: Have been to Paris multiple times but this was my first stay at this hidden gem. From the ease of reservations, arranging of airport shuttle, and continental breakfast selections, all were perfect. Loved the wallpaper and drapes in my charming room and the windows certainly keep the liveliness of Rue Dauphine at bay. Will return to the friendliness and courtesy of Hotel Le Regent’s staff. Merci Beaucoup!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great old but well-done hotel.
text: Le Regent is an old but elegant hotel in a great location, near the river, Notre Dame, the Louvre, etc., all within a 10+ minute walk.  It is surrounded by all sorts of great sidewalk cafes and easy access to busses, etc.  Rooms are nicely decorated, breakfast is typically French (croissants, coffee, etc.).   Staff is Very friendly and helpful; speaks very good English and put up with our questions.  Comfortable beds, a/c worked well.  Highly recommend the hotel.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Location and staff
text: Excellent location - near some famous restaurants and some of the main attractions in St. Germain & Latin Quarters. Public transport stations (metro, train) easy to find and access. Very friendly staff. [Breakfast/coffee room was a bit small, but sufficient.]
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Location, location, location and great staff!
text:
If you want to stay in a charming hotel in the middle of the lively 6th arr cafe culture stay here! We could walk everywhere from this locale and enjoyed so many nearby cafes and restaurants. The staff were excellent, so friendly and helpful.

The room, however, was minuscule. Which we do expect in Paris but this was the tiniest bathroom we have ever had. You had to sit sideways to use the toilet and the shower was equally as difficult to manuever, but we managed. That being said, we would stay in this hotel again, just not in a standard double on the courtyard. Get a superior room on the street for more space and avoid room 24.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: First visit to Paris!!
text: Just returned from a week's stay at Le Regent, and so happy to have chosen the perfect place to stay. I was looking for a small, Parisian hotel with plenty of charm, and in a great location, and this was both! Right outside, plenty of street cafes and shops, and a few minutes walk from the Seine. We walked to Notre Dame, the Louvre, even the Eiffel Tower.  Room and bath were small, which was expected, but clean and quiet. Front desk all very friendly. Wonderful visit!  I would go back tomorrow if I could!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Pleasant Hotel in Central Paris
text:
I was only in Paris for one night this time and wanted to make sure I was staying near the center of the city for easy access.

This hotel offers quite a bit of classical Parisian charm and is within walking distance of many of the great sights.

The staff was nice and the room was very clean.

I would consider staying again if in Paris again in the future.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Worst hotel
text: Checked in to a supposedly paid for  street view room , instead got a 150 square foot tiny box room. No  soap in dispenser, 2 thread bare towels , shower that barely had water coming out, wallpaper peeling pretty disgusting and ridiculous for $300 a night .  When complained seems like no one cared.  We checked in at 11:am and got such a terrible room at 4:00 pm. Couldn’t even unpack as room was way too small.  What an utterly disappointing hotel.  Never coming to this hotel again....
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: those were the days
text:
I stayed here in January-February, 1978. I paid $7.40 a night for a pretty large room. The
shower was down the hall. The room was dark, and the window looked out on an area
cluttered with random maintenance items. I had limited interaction with the staff. They
had a scary-looking German shepherd. I did not see many other guests, although I did hear a woman in a room below enthusiastically enjoying her stay. The location was great. The price was, too. My visit was among the most fun times in my life.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: True Paris
text: Lovely hotel surrounded by cafes and restaurants. Very clean with courteous and helpful staff. Quite loud at night (not an issue for me) recommend ear plugs if you're a light sleeper. Will definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Very nice!
text: We were 3 nights at Hotel Le Regent and enjoyed our stay.  The room was very small, but we've had similar rooms in other European hotels - and it worked out fine.  The continental breakfast was good quality, pretty much the same each morning.The staff was friendly and helpful with directions, restaurant recommendations, etc... We really enjoyed the area, many restaurants to choose from very close by.  And so much within an easy walk (Notre Dame, The Louvre, Luxembourg gardens, etc...).  I would definitely stay in that area again, and would certainly consider the Le Regent.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Lovely quaint hotel
text: My aunt and my uncle have been staying at this hotel annually for close to 30 years.  The location is excellent, the staff at the front desk is most helpful and nice - Angelique and Sandrine, both lovely. The rooms are small, but comfortable.  I will definitely come back.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Location Pretty Good - The Rest Just OK
text:
This hotel is in a good location to access a lot of the sites on foot. That is pretty much where the good ends.

Our room was smaller than expected, but a private bathroom which is not always the case in Europe. The biggest issue was this is meant to be a non smoking hotel. We are non smokers and furthermore have allergies. We constantly smell smoke in our room from other rooms. When we asked the front desk about this, they didn’t care and would not address the guest. My eyes are burning and it is very uncomfortable. The front desk staff, of which there have been at least 5 in the last 3 days, did not investigate and instead assumed the guest was on the terrace. News flash smoke travels.

Europe has a big health problem when it comes to smoking, go figure.

So decent location, no hotel bar, tiny and expensive breakfast that is not included, and smoking permitted in a “non-smoking” hotel.

My advice, keep looking!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Ideal gem in the perfect arrondisment
text:
We had a delightful stay here in the summer of 2018 right after Bastille Day and the World Cup win and celebration. 

I think some of the poor reviews I read recently are due to provincial Americans who expect to find the exact hotels they know from home when they travel. 

The rooms are smaller and the floor plans are more unique than the standard room in America.  Also, AC is still a luxury in Europe and the devices like hair dryers may look different. They also boast of bidets and towel warmers. 

Travel to learn about your destination and don't expect to find home when you are abroad.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Wonderful hotel and service in the ideal place
text: This smaller hotel could not have been a better place to serve as our home base on our first trip to Paris. It is located within walking distance to the Louvre, Notre Dame, Musee d'Orsay and many wonderful restaurants and shops.  The room was spacious by European standards and beautifully decorated.  The service was excellent, with a warm "bonjour!' each time you arrive into the lobby of the 18th century building. A free breakfast is served in the morning as well.  At night, it is just a few steps to lively Rue de Buci which is lined with several great cafes. I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough.  It was perfect.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location, mini mini hotel
text:
Le Regent is located on a side street Rue Dauphine between Boulevard St. Germain and Pont  Neuf in Latin Quarter. Great vantage point to Notre Dame, Louvre, Luxembourg Gardens,... Could not recommend the location enough - plenty of restaurants, shopping, Brasserie and Patisseries as you step out of the hotel.
On the other hand however, pack lightly should you decide to stay there. Starting from a relatively small lobby, to a miniature elevator (2 people, or 1 person and a larger suitcase capacity,...), mini breakfast area in the basement, narrow and steep stairs and equally small rooms. TV in our room was a the size of a computer monitor...literally. A/C was blowing right on our heads when we were sleeping and we couldn't do anything about it to divert the flow, so we had it turned off overnight.
We stayed there in the summer, spent more than 12 hours outside the hotel exploring Paris and didn't really mind the small room all that much (except when we unpacked and packed our bags, hugely lacking space, ha ha). 
Hotel was clean, reception staff was mostly bland and not really helpful, the room was clean. We did not have breakfast there as there are plenty options right outside the hotel.
Hotel would be a recommendation from my side, with a cliff note warning about the smallness of it all. If you are claustrophobic, you definitely don't want to stay there.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Charming hotel, friendly staff
text:
Great location, we could walk to so many places. 
The hotel has managed to keep an old time feel and yet provide modern conveniences.
Breakfast was included and was a pleasant start to the day with crossant, pain au chocolat, and baguette. Tea and coffee and juice were also provided. 
The rooms were a reasonable size and the AC worked well. It was noisy to sleep the weekend France won the World Cup, but it settled down after that!
You’d have to see the elevator to believe it, but it works well. 
The staff was friendly and helpful and informative.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Shockingly disrespectful customer service. Ideal location.
text:
We arrived for 5 nights and chose this hotel based solely on Trip Advisor reviews. 

The location is perfect, close to wonderful restaurants, shops, the metro and sights.

On our second night upon leaving the hotel to go for dinner we were told to leave our keys. Not being familiar with this hotel requirement we said that we would prefer to keep our keys with us. The manager, Ilyas [--], proceeded to start yelling at us very aggressively and almost physically. He yelled that it would cost him so much to replace the key and the locks should we lose it. We tried to explain that we were not told of this when we checked in and hadn’t been asked by any other employees during our comings and goings over the past few days. He said it was because they are lazy and don’t know how to do their jobs. Ilyas [--] even came out from behind the reception desk to continue to insult us. We agreed to leave our key and then he threw it back at us and yelled for us to keep it. We ended up leaving our key anyway for fear that he would further his threats towards us. Throughout the rest of our stay whenever he was working at the front desk he was rude and extremely disrespectful. When I asked him to call for a taxi for us one morning he acted like I was really inconveniencing him and spoke very aggressively towards me. 

The hotel itself isn’t good; the rooms are tiny, the showers don’t drain well, the hair dryer looks like a vacuum cleaner, and don’t even consider eating breakfast at the restaurant as it is in the basement. 

We will not be returning to this hotel.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Magnificent Charmer
text: I can’t begin to describe how wonderful the Hotel Le Regent is! We had one of the two terrace rooms which had a view of the top of the Eiffel Tower. Every morning we enjoyed breakfast on our terrace and in the evening we opened a bottle of wine, listened to the street performers and took in the sunset. The room was very comfy, authentic French decor and clean. The whole building is charming including the real room key which you leave with the front desk when you leave so you don’t have to worry about carrying it. The location is great, lots of great shopping and places to eat all around. Also the metro is just a couple blocks away. We often just enjoyed walking to the Louvre and Notre Dame areas though both are only a 10-15 minute walk. We already want to book another stay at the Hotel Le Regent! Merci Beaucoup!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Second visit as good as the first..
text:
My friend and I stayed at this hotel about 10 years ago.. in the intervening years I have since been to Paris about 5 or 6 more times.. and stayed at other hotels.. all nice enough.. but this trip my friend and I chose to try the Regent again. 

What a lovely hotel.. the desk staff are all very pleasant and helpful .. the rooms are clean,I like  the bathrooms especially as they have space to put your stuff down.. and the tub is nice and deep and the shower works well. 

We had a deluxe twin on the 5th floor.. facing the street. Noise was a non issue.. the windows kept our room quiet.. The air conditioning was EXCELLENT and that is a rarity in Paris . 

The beds were comfy and had nice duvets and nice linens.. nothing overly fancy.. but comfy and clean. 
Room has everything you need, mini fridge, safe, coffee service.. but the hair dryer is the downfall.. its one of those wired in the bathroom ones that barely blow air.. its really time to get proper hair dryers. 

Breakfast was included in our rate.. just continental.. but it was good enough for us.. a croissant, a pain au chocolate, some bread, a plain yogurt, orange juice and a hot drink of your choice. For an extra charge you can have cereal or an egg. I personally wouldnt bother.. A very nice touch was you can have breakfast delivered to your room .. !!! 

Stars are the desk staff.. my purse was stolen and we had to ask them to print off many things that I had in my purse.. and they were always very prompt and kind in doing so.. a younger man.. and a lady I believe may be the manager or owner.. 

The location is fab.. cafes, stores, buses, metros.. all within in walking distance.. as well as many sights.. and I loved having the bank machine right next door.. would withdraw money and put in hotel safe before going out for the day . Good thing I had my passport and a bit of money in safe !

Would stay there again in a minute.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location, lovely room
text: We spent a week at Hotel Le Regent.  The location is wonderful, with restaurants and boutique shops just outside the door.  We had a Deluxe Superior room and really appreciated the extra space and seating area.  The room was attractive, although it did not appear to be a recent renovation.  It was very nice to have an elevator.  The staff was helpful.  Breakfast was convenient.  We felt this was a very good value for the money and will definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Nice hotel at a great location
text:
We (patents with a teenager) spent a week at the exclusive and large green room. 
The hotel is very well located. Many attractions are at a walking distance and public transportation is very close. 
The hotel is located in a lively area with many restaurants, cafe’s, music and people on the street. 
The hotel itself is very convenient, clean and friendly. 
Elevator is very small and slow so we usually used the stairs. The included breakfast is standard continental - quite basic with croissants as the main serving.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Fantastic Location
text: My wife and I have stayed many times at this perfectly located boutique hotel in the very exciting 6th arrondissement. The staff, Sandrine, Angelique & Vinciane are most accommodating and cheerfully helpful with any request. The location is in the heart of a marvelous area filled with bistros, art galleries, restraunts, bakeries and boutiques. Fantastic people watching area. Great selection of food choices. Live jazz at club 2 blocks away.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Lovely and perfect stay for a first visit to Paris. Can't wait to return.
text:
I read a number of three star reviews here before booking with Hotel Le Regent. While this is indeed a three-star hotel, I am reviewing it based on my expectations of that price-point and size, which is what the star rating is meant to provide.
 
Our family of four had two very pretty rooms in this hotel in May and we loved everything about it. 

The staff was always available, friendly and were very kind about our imperfect attempts to greet and respond to them in French. All of them spoke English very well.
 
The included breakfast, which we had served in our room at no extra charge, was unbelievably delicious. The pastry was so flaky that it looked like a croissant bomb went off on our tray each morning. The portions are also very large so don't be put off by what North Americans refer to as a Continental Breakfast. We were absolutely stuffed full of baguette and pastries and butter and jams and delicious coffee with hot milk every morning.

This is not a recently renovated hotel. The rooms are small but charming and the beds were more comfortable than they were at a five star hotel we stayed at in London on this same trip.

The location is beautiful, close to everything and exactly what you would hope for in this chic and lively neighbourhood.

I can't imagine staying anywhere else and we are already planning another visit.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A little left bank gem
text: This small but lovely hotel is located on the left bank and within walking distance of many sites, e.g Jardin de Luxembourg, Isle de la Cite, Sorbonne etc. Small but lovely rooms, great breakfast and many interesting restaurants and bistrots within minutes of walking. Very helpful and attentive staff, fantastic value for money. We'll stay there again during our next visit to Paris.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location, charming hotel
text: Hotel Le Regent is a great hotel very centrally located in the 6th arrondisement of Paris.  Within 15 minutes, you can walk to wonderful landmarks such as Notre Dame and the Louvre.  There are numerous cafes, restaurants, boulangeries, and patisseries within the 2-3 blocks surrounding the hotel.  The hotel itself is quite charming! Our room faced Rue Dauphin with floor to ceiling windows that were both beautiful and really brightened the room.  The noise level at night, especially on weekends, can be loud given the numerous cafes and restaurants surrounding the hotel.  However, the windows are very well insulated and very effectively block the noise so it is not a problem.  All the staff spoke English and were very helpful and welcoming.  The beds were very comfortable and the rooms were clean.  The morning breakfast was more than ample and quite good with yogurt, bread and croissants, coffee and juice.  The only reason I am not giving this hotel a full 5-stars is that the wifi was not very strong in our room (it is an older building so it is to be expected) and there were no bathroom amenities such a bars of soap or lotion provided.  Instead, there was only a wall-mounted pump dispenser of shampoo/body wash.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: In the heart of the sixth
text: The staff is very attentive. They serve a delicious breakfast. You leave the hotel and you can walk around the sixth arrondisement and easily go to Notre Dame or a 10 minute walk to Musee D'Orsay. I would recommend this hotel as a perfect place to stay at a good price.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Perfect
text: Perfect location--near everything on the left bank and just one block from the Metro system.  And the restaurants in the area are fab.  French, Italian, Sushi, Greek, Indian--all right there. Perfect--rooms. All very charming (we stayed in two) BUT you want to be facing the street.  The rooms are larger (and with the windows closed not noisy).  The first room we had, while it looked great, just a little two small for big old people.  Perfect staff--They couldn't have been more friendly and helpful.  Perfect breakfast--Great breads and croissants. Paris is a walking city.  And this area is a short walk to Norte Dame, Isle St Louis, The Seine, and across the river to The Louver.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Once again at this great hotel
text: This was our third visit to Paris within a years time.  We stayed at the Le Regent, of course, and everything was perfect.  The croissants are the best in Paris.  The staff is outstanding and always there to help you.  This is a great location and we just love it here. We always look forward to our return.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A lovely place to stay
text: We stayed three nights at the hotel, and we enjoyed our stay. The location in St Germain is close to many “attractions,” restaurants, shops and galleries. The hotel staff was very friendly and answered our questions. They also arranged our transport to the airport which went smoothly. The rooms are on the small side, but that is to be expected in Paris and in no way reflects negatively on the hotel. The decor and setting just add to your experience staying on the Left Bank in Paris. We will definitely consider Hotel Le Regent for our next stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Hotel review
text: Great place to stay.  Staff very helpful & friendly.  Seems to be a hotel where many English speaking people stay, which was helpful with our limited ability to speak French.  Within walking distance for the main sites of Paris. Our room was a bit small, but others in the group had generous size rooms.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Hotel in Busy Saint Germain
text:
This was my second trip to Paris after spending time in the Dordogne Valley area.  The first time some friends and I rented a flat that was located closer to the 7th arrondissement. The Saint Germain area is very touristy with a lot of cafes catering to tourists. Hotel Le Regent is in this area and close to a lot of cafes and snacking shops. The rooms are very small but nicely decorated and clean. There is a T.V. and small refrigerator in the room and the wifi is secure and free. The hotel provides a hair/shampoo pump gel in the shower. The room key is a large metal key that is left at the front desk when you leave the hotel and picked up when you return. You can purchase breakfast in the morning by filling out a door hanger and leaving it outside on your doorknob the night before. Even though we didn't realize we had to do this we were still able to order breakfast although the woman at the front desk had to go out and purchase more croissants and baguettes for the Americans who didn't read the door hanger.

The hotel staff are very helpful and pleasant. I am used to having tea at night and relaxing in my room before going to bed.  Although there isn't a coffeepot in the room the man at the front desk provided me with a carafe of hot water.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Wonderful Staff
text:
Staff was fantastic.  I can't say enough of how welcoming they were and want to give Elias a specific thank you for recommending two excellent dining experiences and making our stay more enjoyable!

Room was small, as expected, but very functional. Definitely attempt to get one of the terrace rooms as they have lovely views.  Stayed in a suite in Saint Germain with all the bells and whistles prior to migrating down the street to the Le Regent and had a much better experience at Le Regent.

Thanks again to everyone at the hotel, everyone was great. I will certainly recommend to friends and family. Stayed here for the second leg of Paris because of a recommendation from a family member.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Return visit
text: We just returned from Paris and once again we stayed at Hotel Le Regent.  This was our third time staying a this great hotel.  The staff has never changed and they are just as wonderful as ever.  You can stay at a chain hotel when you are at home, but in Paris immerse yourself in the French culture by staying at Hotel Le Regent. You will love everything!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: My Paris Hotel
text: Le Regent has everything I need.  All is clean.  Wifi  and cable TV work.  Bed is comfortable.  Breakfast is filling.  Staff is helpful and friendly.  Location is perfect.  Suggestion: Would be nice to have more legroom at writing table.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Le Regent Rules!
text:
From the moment I made reservation inquiries until my final departure, Le Regent responded in the highest professional manner possible. Sandrine, with whom I corresponded by email was prompt and so responsive in the process of finding just the right room for me for the three nights I would be in Paris prior to a Normandy river cruise.

Sandrine arranged for a car to pick me up at CDG and that same company for transport to Conflans an hour outside of Paris to meet the ship. This, at a very reasonable rate and with great service.

I loved the cozy colorful oh-so-French decor of my quiet top sixth floor room with its little balcony I was able to sit out on. The mini fridge kept cool the necessary bottled water and cheese for snacking. The bed was very comfortable, bathroom small but adequate. A nice touch was the heated towel rack and adjustable makeup mirror. When I mentioned the tube style wall mounted hair dryer wasn't working for me, Sandrine offered up a hand held hair dryer for my use - much better!

Sandrine and her associate Vinciane were on hand at the front desk each morning with their smiles and gracious offers to help in any way they could with directions, confirming restaurant reservations, calling taxis, etc., and I really appreciated their excellent English speaking abilities. Vinciane's sweet hand made lavender sachets displayed in a basket on the reception counter were irresistible, two of those came home with me I'm pleased to say.

Breakfast was included in my room rate in the lower level grotto, the usual continental of orange juice, tea or coffee, a baguette, chocolate and plain croissant. I prefer breakfast in the hotel to get me up and going but I noted a Paul's just down the street for those who like to be out and about first thing. This neighborhood is teeming with choices of restaurants and shops.

Hotel Le Regent on rue Dauphine is in the very heart of St. Germain, a perfect location restaurant-wise for Le Deaux Magots, Little Breizh Cafe, Relais de L'Entrecote and Le Petit St. Benoit, all just a short stroll away, my choices for sitting with a glass of wine or a meal during my shopping and walking in the neighborhood during the three days. Also close by is a Monoprix and Citi Pharma which were on my destination list. The Patrick Roger shop is just down Blvd. St. Germain, the best chocolate in the world according to my son-in-law. The "made in France" shop Gab & Jo on rue Jacob is a real treasure trove for browsing and finding just the right take home gifts, a ten minute walk from Le Regent up rue Bonaparte.

This, my 10th Paris visit, was to be a laid back three days to recover from jet lag before the river cruise, do a bit of shopping, have a few good meals and location was pivotal.
Hotel Le Regent enabled me to be in the best possible spot for my needs. Can't wait to return!

Thank you Sandrine and Vinciane for a very memorable three days!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Love this hotel
text: This is the second time we stayed at Hotel Le Regent.  We will stay here again!  The rooms are lovely (yes, on the typical Parisian smaller side), clean, well maintained, and managed.  The smallest rooms are SMALL - so maybe only good for a single person or a couple for one or two nights.  The next level up is perfect for a couple - we stayed a full week.  The elevator is quite small, so if you can't climb stairs, don't come if you are claustrophobic - and I don't think it would work too well for someone with a wheelchair - overall the space is not very accessible.  The breakfast was delicious and we had it delivered to our room, the staff are ALL, every one of them, so helpful, nice, eager to make it a pleasurable stay.  The location is great, centrally located. We walked from the Hotel to every tourist site, but you can also easily get to the metro.  My only hesitation in putting out such a great review is that it might be too booked for me to get a reservation next time!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great location - nice little hotel.
text:
My husband and I had a room on the third floor which was so small we could hardly move.  The bed was a double and I won't even mention the size of the bathroom!   I understand that small hotel rooms are the norm in Europe but this was almost claustrophobic. 
Having said that, the room was attractive and clean and the staff friendly and helpful.
Because we had booked through a booking service we were not eligible for the free breakfast which we didn't know about until we got there.
The location is great with lots of good restaurants and shops nearby
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Paris Gem
text: I have stayed at this hotel twice in the last year.  It is located in a great area, close to nice restaurants, bars, and shops.  The staff is wonderful and they are very helpful.  The coffee area is very quaint and the crossiants are great!  I can't wait to return.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Fabulous , fabulous fabulous - A Paris Home away from Home
text: Our stay was delightful - the location was incredible.  Music drifted up from the street corner as if we were in a movie.  The location is convenient to everything.  Your staff was very attentive, friendly and made us feel welcome.  We will definitely return on our future trips.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Very well located near transport and restaurants and bars and train station nearby
text:
Room was good, with comfortable beds and nice bathroom. The space was small for 2 pax but that's expected for Europe. There was a small elevator from ground floor up but not to the basement and so not too friendly for people with disabilities. 

Excellent location near many good restaurants and shops. Room had a window which opened to the atrium and had welcome fresh air.

The breakfast was charged even though the room was booked with breakfast. 

The charges should be made clear as they were charging per piece of bread, juice etc. This was not made clear in the dining room and so we were surprised with this as we checked out.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Very nice stay
text: Our family of five stayed at this hotel for a week during our kids' spring break vacation.  It was recommended to my by my father and my brother -- both of whom had stayed here before.  We were very happy with our choice.  The location is very central and it is in a vibrant neighborhood.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  I would love to go back!
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great little hotel
text: Your get off the Metro from the airport and pop up at Notre Dame, it's 12 minutes walking distance from the Louvre. The staff is nice, our room was a bit cozy, but for location it's great! Elias the night man is SUPER PATIENT with in and outs. Bathroom are modern and cute, hot water works great. A bit high for continental breakfast so walk out side and choose from like the 100's of cafés.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Chic boutique hotel
text: This was my 2nd stay here it is a very chic French hotel the decor is beautiful and spotlessly clean.  They serve you breakfast in bed for no extra cost and this consists of fresh orange juice, coffee or tea croissants and fresh bread roll with a selection of honey and jams.  It is the perfect place for a couple to stay as it's quite romantic.  The location is excellent there are two metro stations only a few minutes walk away and from here a ten minute stroll takes you to notre dame and other tourist attractions. I would highly recommend it.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: A good honest clean tidy friendly hotel with a great smile.
text:
It's in the best of locations for a great fun time.
Location is everything and here is great. Plenty of jazz clubs just down the road. Lots of art and fine restaurants in the area..
It's very close to the action and is great for late breakfasts and a friendly smile no matter how late back.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Fab Hotel in brilliant location
text: Best Hotel in Paris for a weekend away break. Location, staff and rooms were fab. All around the hotel were great cafes, great bars and fantastic restaurants. Metro is only minutes away as is the Notre Dame Cathedral which has to be seen to be believed. This hotel made our 3 days in Paris.
name: Hotel Le Regent

title: Great summer day in Paris! 🇫🇷
text:
Great location, friendly staff, clean, comfortable and good bed and pillows. Spacious bathroom consideren Paris bathroom standards at city center 😅 good shower with good pressure. There is no parking however there is a parking 5 min distance. We paid more or less 30 euro, nevertheless there is free parking depending on the days and hours, but that needs to be confirmed with someone local.
We had a good experience.

title: Love, love, love this hotel!
text:
On a quiet side street, Hotel Magda Champs-Elysees  is steps from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees. Its central location is perfect for those who enjoy exploring the city on foot. The Charles de Gaulle Etoile metro station is less than a minute's walk from the hotel, making any part of the city easily accessible. 

The rooms are beautifully decorated and immaculately clean. We were upgraded to a junior suite, which was huge, with minibar, sink, fridge, microwave, coffeemaker, large bathroom with tub and hairdryer, large closet with terrycloth bathrobe and slippers, safe, couch/table, desk/chair and strong WiFi/fast Internet. The bath towels are large and plush and the bed super comfy with cozy duvet. One nice touch is the clothesline you can pull across the bathtub. 

The (optional) breakfast is very good, with eggs and other hot offerings, meats, cheeses, croissants, breads, cereals, yogurt, fruit, coffee, juices, etc. 

On top of all this, the staff is fabulous. Warm and gracious, always helpful. Special thanks to Michael, Jean-Frederic, Solenne, and Esperance who were so kind and made us feel so welcome!

title: Ideal for a Paris mini-break
text:
Stayed at this hotel for a Paris mini-break and it was ideal for a short stay in this beautiful city. I had requested early check-in by e-mail for 11am and it was arranged as requested. Check in was very friendly. Booked a superior room. It was compact but modern, bright, and flawlessly clean.  Very comfortable bed and bedding for a good night's sleep.

Our deal did not include breakfast but with so many cafes nearby it was not a problem.  

The hotel is ideally located and only  2 minutes from the metro / RER. (To/from CDG Airport is just 2 RER stops with a change in Chatelet).    

Overall, Hotel Magda was reasonably priced and good value for the location.  Would stay here again.

title: Great location, small but very clean and very helpful
text:
Really and truly right around the corner from the Champs Elysees. Excellent location near a landmark of course, but also near several metro entrances. There's a burger king and a mcdonald's at the end of the street if you're looking for a late night snack. 

Once you enter to your right will be the dining area for breakfast and to the left will be the check-in counter. There are two gentlemen who man the desk, but only one at a time. The night gentleman is more personable and chatty but both are incredibly nice and helpful. I bothered them a lot because my baggage had been delayed and they were very gracious and helpful. 

After checking in, directly across from the main entrance is a lovely winding staircase. To the left of the staircase is a small elevator. I wouldn't think the elevator could fit more than 2 people, and definitely not if you have significant luggage. I felt very roomy since I had just a carry-on and myself but if you're a two or more person party I would take turns going up the elevator. It's not a very quick or grandiose one but it does the job and is very clean. The staircase is a little squeaky and if you're on the top floor like I was you'll get a workout but the winding aspect does make it very fun. 

I had one of the smallest rooms I believe with just a single bed - it was wider I feel than a regular twin bed, but of course not as wide as a full or a queen. Once you walk in there's a bathroom to your right, the bed further ahead and to your right. On the left wall there's a small desk area. Directly ahead there is a window which can be opened with the classic iron railing and you can look up and down the street if you poke your head out - there aren't any landmarks or anything visible but personally I felt it was a lovely view since all the architecture was different from what I'm used to. 

The bedding was pristine and very comfortable and the receptionist gave me extra blankets as requested free of charge. When you're laying on the bed, to the left is a little cubby cut into a closet where there is a phone and a place to charge your phone. The closet is maybe 2 feet wide and has a safe in it which is very easy to set up. Under the safe is also a small refrigerator with assorted drinks. 

On the small table are various snacks but most importantly a portable wifi hotspot which would have been very useful had I not already purchased data w/ my carrier. 

The bathroom is also very small - you're getting the idea, everything is small. But everything is also very clean! Once you enter the bathroom to the right is the sink, and to the front right is the standing shower and front left is the toilet. To your left on the wall is a hook for hanging your towels and to the right on the wall is a hair dryer. The toiletries were strange, there was body wash and solid soap and body lotion but no conditioner or shampoo. The doors to the shower stall are double sided and open up in a v-shaped fashion. You can change the water to come from above or from a hand-held which was nice. There didn't seem to be any limits on how long the hot water lasted. There isn't a lot of space to put all the toiletries you've brought w/ you.

title: new management, bad customer service...
text:
My extended family had planned a first time vacation to Paris. We were going to and from different places. Orignally, I had booked a different, lower cost hotel with comparable amenities. However, the other hotel did not provide shuttle services to/from the airport.

At the suggestion of my family, I booked Hotel Magda since their website stated they will help arrange for shuttle service and we had already booked Hotel Magda for a return to Paris later in the week. 

I had booked reservations for 3 deluxe suites and 1 junior suite. The cost of the 4 rooms was double that of my previous hotel reservation elsewhere. This was, after all, the first time we had been in Paris and not having to worry about transportation to the hotel was one less thing to worry about. So we booked this hotel...

I had emailed back and forth with the hotel regarding the shuttle service. I was informed a week before we arrived, that service was prepared for us.

Upon arrival at Charles de Gaulle Airport, there was no shuttle to be found. I contacted the hotel and was told that shuttle service was supposed to meet us there. I called again and was asked for confirmation numbers that I was not given in my email correspondences with the hotel. After an hour of waiting and calling the hotel back and forth, my family ended up taking Ubers to get to the hotel.

When we got to the hotel, the staff was very apologetic... however, when it came time to check in, they didn't have the rooms I reserved. They had 2 deluxe suites and 2 junior suites. I asked the front desk staff to check my reservation and they admitted there was an error on the hotel's side. The hotel was already fully booked and they could not give us all the rooms we reserved. I was disappointed to say the least. But we took what we could because we did not have another option.

When we checked out, I asked that the charges be adjusted for the lesser room. Unfortnately, that did not happen. I was charged for the 3 deluxe and 1 junior suite. I said that it needed to be corrected and that the hotel manager should contact me. I left my email and phone number. I did not get any call back nor an email.

Later in the week, my family returned to Paris and since we already had prior reservations here, it was too late to change the reservation and find another hotel...

Upon our arrival, I expressed my displeasure that the hotel management did not contact me regarding the erroneous charges. I was asked to email the hotel regarding their error. I do not think it is my responsibility to email the hotel to start correcting their charges. I informed the front desk staff and they in turn informed management. That should have been enough.

When we arrived, our rooms were actually ready. However, the room I was given did not have a working bathroom light. We went to the front desk and the British woman at the desk said she couldn't get someone to fix the light until 2 days later. This was unacceptable, she wanted us to stay in a room without a working bathroom light! We asked for another room and after another staff member took over, we received the same room we had stayed in earlier in the week. However, it smelled like cigarettes... we expressed our concern and I was asked again to email the management...

Other than the British woman at the front desk, the hotel staff we interacted with were very nice. I hope I spell their names correctly, but Ziana, Bobakar and Elwin (Elwin was the best) were very good to us. They understood our frustrations and tried to make things right. Elwin especially went out of his way to help us get what we needed.

From what I understand, this hotel was bought out after we made our reservations and the owner and staff were not the ones who we had initial contact with via email. I would give a little leeway for the change in staff. However, management should have gotten back to me to correct the charges. Instead, I am now dealing with my credit card company to investigate the incorrect charges...

This hotel is close to some good shopping but other hotels are close to other city attractions. also, there are other hotels out there that charge less for the same or better rooms. 

As of this review, I have not heard from the hotel management regarding the incorrect charges...

I wonder if my experience would have been better with the previous owner and staff. They got good reviews...

title: Excellent location.
text:
This hotel is a little hidden gem. Literally a 1 minute walk from the arc de triomphe and Champs-Elysées. When we arrived we had a quick check in and went off to our room. Our room was one of the larger rooms. It had a small kitchenette (without a stove) which was handy, it also came equipped with a nespresso coffee machine. The rooms were very spacious and each had a tv. We had a lot of luggage with us and didn’t struggle to store it. The bathroom had a bathtub and shower and was also very spacious and most importantly the rooms and bathroom was very clean. The staff here and very polite, courteous, friendly and the most helpful. We arrived to the same afternoon the rioters destroyed the Champs-Elysées, so were advised by the staff not to leave the hotel as we had children and there was gas/pepper spray in the air. One member of staff kindly escorted my husband somewhere local where he could purchase hot food for us to eat back at the hotel. The hotel has a seating area in lobby where you can drink tea and coffee for free, there is also a little self service bar which comes at a charge. 
As well as the hotel being in a great location, at the end of the street there are plenty of French cafes, various restaurants (French, Thai, Chinese), a Mac Donald’s and Starbucks. 
I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to others. The only reason I haven’t given 5 stars is because of the lack of food services and what was on offer for breakfast was very limited.

title: Amazing hotel
text:

-Michael P. and Elizabeth S.
name: 1K Paris

title: Visit to 1K Paris
text: My boyfriend and I visited 1K Paris for a few days and had a great visit! The woman at check in kindly greeted us with great care. Any request we had was swiftly accommodated without hesitation. The restaurants and bars on the premises offer such great Peruvian and Mexican food options. The ambiance was clean, warm and unique and we will definitely be back again next time in Paris!
name: 1K Paris

title: Lovely hotel, thoughtful staff, FANTASTIC location!
text: The hotel absolutely exceeded our expectations. The staff was lovely and so helpful at every turn! The rooms are HUGE, which is always a welcome surprise. And the Taco stand downstairs serves wonderful drinks. We loved our stay and will be back!
name: 1K Paris

title: Exceptional boutique hotel with lots of great amenities.
text:
I'm staying at the 1K Paris Hotel this week.  Prior to booking I did a fair amount of research on what others have said about this property.  Rarely am I totally pleased when I book a hotel.  However, in this instance I have zero doubt I booked the best property for my needs.

Let me be specific about what went right.

1.  Check-in experience.  I was checked in by a cheerful, upbeat and most kind individual.  Absolutely flawless check-in experience.
2.  I got an inexpensive room.  Despite this I have plenty of space.  Lots of closet space, hangers, drawers and room for my toiletries in the bathroom.
3.  Bed is very comfortable.
4.  Bathroom is wonderful.  Large heated towel rack, oversized bathrobe and big towels.  Lovely bath amenities.  
5.  Quiet room.
6.  Comfortable temperature.
7.  Fridge with interesting mini-bar options.
8.  Easy to use safe.
9.  Cool lighting.
10.  Amazing location.  Access to Le Marais, Franprix market across street, Metro on the corner.  Does not get much better.

I could get critical and make a few suggestions to improve this place.  They could better position the shower head.  Had to be careful I did not spray the floor at times.  But I could easily deal with it as it is.  A couple of minor lightbulbs were burnt out - no big deal.

Understand I am not paying 300 Euros a night.  I'm paying less than 150 Euros each night with the deal I snagged through hotel2nite.com.  For what I am paying it would be impossible to do better.

I will definitely be returning to this fun hotel.
name: 1K Paris

title: Couple review
text:
Very nice hotel, very friendly staff. 
The hotel is very close to transportation. 
The room is bigger than all other hotels that we looked in Paris. 
We will sure come back to this hotel next time we’ll visit paris. 
Overall we really enjoyed our stay at 1k paris. 
excludes the breakfast that wasn’t so rich.
name: 1K Paris

title: Pleasant stay in Le Marais
text:
Good, clean hotel with an excellent location. Plenty of nice restaurants, bars, cafes and shops around the area on Le Marais. 

Very friendly receptionist staff who all spoke fluent (some native?) English.
Good and fast check-in/check out experience.

Room is simple but clean and quite big for Paris standards. Comfortable beds.

Hotel has a Peruvian restaurant (we didn't have a chance to try it) and a very cool Mezcal bar which we loved.

Overall we really enjoyed our stay. Only 'negative' thing I would mention would be that street noise can be heard a little. This didn't bother us at all, but if you're a light sleeper you might need to request a room not facing the street.
name: 1K Paris

title: Excellent Boutique Hotel in the Heart of the Marais
text: Lovely, small boutique hotel in an exceptional location in the Marais - the very best neighborhood to stay in Paris. Kind, attentive staff, comfortable beds and a reasonable amount of space make this hotel an excellent choice. The hotel also features a truly excellent Peruvian restaurant, a good Mexican restaurant next door - and many other great dining choices within a block or two. Within walking distance of many key attractions.
name: 1K Paris

title: Great hotel, lovely people, wonderful location
text: My sister and I stayed at 1K Paris for a girls trip to Paris. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Rooms were nice and clean- I loved how the windows opened and I could just relax and watch the folks walking below. It is in the perfect location- Le Marais is an awesome area of Paris with tons of shops and restaurants. Not a far walk to Notre Dame and the trendy St. Germain de Pres and Latin Quarter. There was also a subway station a half a block from the hotel. The staff was so friendly and helpful. They gave us perfect directions on how to get to Sacre Coeur using the subway, and then also printed them out for us so that we didn't get lost. They even left us a welcome package when we arrived- one of their mezcal drinks in a cute bottle on ice and 2 pastries. We would definitely come back again if we decide to visit Paris again.
name: 1K Paris

title: Well located, comfortable, good people!
text: The room was very stylish! It was spacious at 25 sq mts. The split bathrooms (one for washbasins, the other for bathing/loo) were spacious and premium. The people at the reception were friendly, always helping!
name: 1K Paris

title: Teuta
text: What an amazing stay at 1K hotel! The location was so great, metro was so near, loads of trendy cafes and it felt very safe. The staff were very friendly  and accomodating. Rooms were very clean, lovely view from the window, bed comfy, huge bath tub and many amenities in the room. Would definitely stay here again at this hotel! Merci 1K team
name: 1K Paris

title: What a fabulous hotel!
text: I recently stayed at 1K Paris. Nothing  was too much trouble from moving rooms as i don’t like perfume and first room though lovely smelt a lot of perfume from cleaning to organizing me a massage they were so good. the room was clean spacious and bright. check in and check out easy and you can communicate with reception via what’s app. v well located for marais and central paris and nice area easy to find taxis etc. i would definitely return. thank you
name: 1K Paris

title: Linda
text:

title: Amazing stay!

Rooms were very clean, lovely view from the window, bed comfy, huge bath tub and many amenities in the room. Would definitely stay here again!
name: 1K Paris

title: Good hotel

title: Style over substance
text:
Nice looking hotel, great location and friendly staff. However, that's kind of where the good stuff stops.

Unfortunately the room (on the 5th floor) was very warm and there was no Aircon etc. This was in spring so in summer I think it would be unbearable (and I've previously lived in SE Asia).

There are signs up to enjoy happy hour around the hotel bar but we were told it wasn't actually a bar so we were sent to the secret mescal bar where you choose drinks based on your BDSM preferences apparently (who knew toe sucking could be so tasty?).

Overall, it wasn't a bad place, it just wasn't great either.
name: 1K Paris

title: Amazing South American vibes in the heart of Paris
text: My fiancée and I literally loved the hotel. The location is just perfect, few steps from the Marais (one of my fave area in Paris!). We had the chance to have a dinner at the restaurant of the hotel, the InKa, perfect Peruvian food. Definitely gonna recommend this place. Room was super clean.
name: 1K Paris

title: In the heart of Paris
text: The hotel was perfectly located and also the area around is full of life. The room was super clean and the stuff really friendly. I would definitely visited it again. The restaurant was exceptional and a new culinary experience. Totally recommend.
name: 1K Paris

text: I have come back often for business trips at this hotel. The decoration is original, tacos served by the restaurant are delicious and bed is amazing. Very nice staff and clean place. I will keep coming back :)
name: 1K Paris

title: Big rooms, lovely breakfast and central location
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights between 12 - 15 January 2021. Gabriela was the first person I met there and she was nice and sorted out my booking quite fast. I got room 414 on the fourth floor, the room has a double bed, private bathroom, TV, air con and mini bar. Everything was clean and in order. 

The breakfast is delivered to your room during the pandemic and it's deliciously cooked. The staff is accommodating of your needs, I requested double portions one morning and they were more than happy to do so.

There is a gym in the basement with cardio machines and weights. I trained there twice and it is pleasant and quiet. There is a TV that you can use to start music. The gym is air conditioned. 

The hotel is in Republique, the area is a busy central with many shops and restaurants. Metro station is like 3 mins walk. 

One downside is I couldn't catch the reception 4 out of 5 times when calling from my room. I had to go downstairs to talk to them about my query. Nothing major though.

Overall, great hotel and would book here whenever I come to Paris. Highly recommend.
name: 1K Paris

title: Fantastic stay, friendly staff, even during Covid :)
text: I needed a last minute hotel for 2 nights, this was a great choice!  Super friendly staff, comfortable bed, nice hot shower, great lighting (you can change the color of light by your bed, love that :)  Covid means the restaurants and bar are closed, but they look like they would be wonderful when open. Mini-bar with snacks in room, but no coffee / tea (which I didn't mind).  Generally a great stay, I would come back for sure. Thanks!
name: 1K Paris

title: Great Place in Paris
text: Wonderful experience in great location. People are 5 stars. They made my stay special. Boutique hotel with large modern room between place de la Bastide and République. Metro super close. Maybe if it wouldn't have been covid time I woukd have given 5 stars.
name: 1K Paris

title: A peaceful bubble in Paris
text:
I stayed for 7night for work when Paris was a red zone with alerts for Covid-19. Paris was bizarre and empty. 
The staffs are very warm and available, ready to reply you with smile. It was a sort of a bubble with full of piece and this made me feel very relaxed and safe from all the things going around from the city. 
The rooms has many lights and bright- bathroom is essential but clean. The best part of my staying was the beds. Linens are very crispy & well ironed and the mattress is just too comfortable. Amenities is In decent quality. I didn’t try breakfast / room service but I can tell that will be also well cared. 
The only uncomfortable thing is the position of power socket. If you want to use phone while charging, a normal length cable could be little uncomfortable. But the rest is good. 
Highly recommended, very good compromise between price-quality 👍
name: 1K Paris

title: Well-located Standard Accommodations
text:
We actually live nearby but checked in to the hotel during a terrible heatwave this summer. The hotel Air Conditioning does the job and we had a comfortable stay. Good rates and helpful staff.

The hotel is in a very good location. Walking distance from countless restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and attractions.
name: 1K Paris

title: Email Spam
text: NEVER send an email to all people that stayed in your hotel without hiding their emails by putting them in the BCC field. Such negligence with personal data is worrisome for a place that keeps a copy of your ID and credit card.
name: 1K Paris

title: Great experience - even with a toddler
text: Nice, big rooms and very comfy bed. Lots of space for us and our toddler, who really enjoyed the bathtub, the huge tv. Great area close to nice restaurant and drinks.  Helpfull personel at the entrance.
name: 1K Paris

title: Great Stay - (Big, Modern Rooms in the Heart of Paris)
text: Amazing weekend at 1k hotel! I’ve stayed in a range of hotels in Paris and 1k has by far the biggest, most up to date, and comfortable rooms (including bathrooms!). The air conditioning kept our room cool when we emerged from walking around all day in the summer Parisian heat. The staff was accommodating, offering water bowls or our dog, and also spoke great English. The restaurant attached provided the perfect venue for happy hour drinks (highly recommend the mezcal slushies). Finally the location allowed us to meander down the streets of the Marais, then take the Metro right back to the hotel where a stop is located. Traveling during a pandemic can be stressful, but the professionalism of the staff put any worries at ease. Can’t wait for another weekend at 1k.
name: 1K Paris

title: Centrally located in the Marais and Bastille
text: I stayed at the 1K several times since last year and never been disappointed  - good value for money, centrally located , quiet rooms and nice staff ! and very import = large rooms which is quite rare in Paris !
name: 1K Paris

title: Ok hotel, little far from hotspots

name: 1K Paris

title: Very chic
text: A great hotel to stay in. Clean, friendly, modern and well-located. Just a heads up, our room and en suite were open plan so no privacy if you’re sharing with friends (check ahead if this would bother you). Highly recommend this hotel!
name: 1K Paris

title: Excellent hotel

Excellent in-house Peruvian restaurant and great piscos. Very clean. Helpful staff. Located off a big street so if you are looking for a typical Parisian street view, this is not it. Would stay here again.
name: 1K Paris

title: Ok boutique hôtel but not a 4 stars as advertised

WiFi was poor, room was poorly cleaned with, amenities not replaced, coffee cups not cleaned. Despite COVID 19 the breakfast buffet was maintained. Poor limited choice. Greasy dirty tables at the restaurant. Some staff are friendly others just ignore customers. I never felt I was in a 4 stars hotel. Just an average expensive boutique hotel located in central paris. Very noisy bar on the ground floor.
name: 1K Paris

title: Great hotel on a great location !
text:
Great boutique 4 star hotel in the nice (local) part of Le Marais. Rooms are modern and very clean. Staff is  helpfull and pleasant. Nice restaurant which serves great food. Rooms are quiet and boost a modern atmosphere.
Highly recomended
name: 1K Paris

title: The swimming pool suite was ideal for a photo set

name: 1K Paris

title: Great Place, Great attention.

Our visit to this hotel couldn't have been any better.  As one of the very few hotels still working in Paris, our stay was very accomodating and the staff was more than helpful. The food in the restaurant was one of the best that I had on my trip; I highly recommend the ceviche.
We are planning to return in December, and we will be staying here again.
name: 1K Paris

title: Wonderful hotel
text: Very well located, this hotel is a real 4 stars with wonderful rooms and large bathrooms. Since my arrival till my departure, the staff was very helpful. The breakfast is rich, and the hotel have a very nice restaurant and a wonderful hidden club. Recommended, will go back there as soon as possible.
name: 1K Paris

title: Fantastic and friendly.

name: 1K Paris

title: Super Hotel
text:
Good Location and very good service. Great rooms.Breakfast also very good. Gym looked good but no time to use as only short stay.
Staff also very helpful and a free drink at the bar as first stay was a bonus.
name: 1K Paris

title: Fabulous!
text: I have stayed here on several occasions and it is one of my favourite hotels in Paris. The location is fantastic and easily accessible from the airport. The rooms are bright and airy and the staff are incredibly kind and helpful. I would highly recommend it.
name: 1K Paris

title: The perfect pAris get away
text: We stayed at 1K for almost 7 days and our stay was wonderful. Location is perfect if you are interested in exploring a fun and young area of Paris. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. The staff was welcoming, kind, and attended to all of our needs.
name: 1K Paris

title: Spacious, comfortable, good vibes!
text: Our room was incredibly spacious, especially compared to other Parisian hotels. We had a standard King room, which came with two sinks and a large closet space. We were instantly comfortable. The bed was comfy as well as the shower and bathroom amenities. The hotel provided complimentary water too, which was nice. The location was very central and easy to access two major metro stations.
name: 1K Paris

title: Scrumbled Scrambled!
text: This was my second stay at this hotel and I had liked the first time very much. Which is why I had booked again. Paris being Paris, hotels remain on the pricey side even after one year of social unrest and two months of strikes ;-) For over $1,000 for 4 nights, one can expect a decent breakfast and friendly staff. I had none of these. The room I was in was comfortable except for the shower head. The water pressure was a bit low and the tub was not convenient as should you want to draw a bath, you had to use the shower head to fill the tub. But other than that and paper maché walls, the room was nice. The reception staff is kinda friendly not over friendly but kinda. As for the breakfast staff, one of the girls (dark haired) needs to be trained as to how to deal with customers. The blonde lady was very nice and welcoming. I had to beg for ketchup every day, and every day they’d bring back a couple sachets they would leave by the eggs. Just a couple! So every day I had to ask. I stopped asking today and as there was none I will never know if they had finally run out... But the cherry on the cake was today. After waiting for 10 mn for them to refill the eggs, they brought the weirdest looking scrambled eggs I had ever seen in my entire life. I know scrambled eggs can be weird in non English speaking countries but I had had them the three first days and they were ok. Today, they were so yellow that they looked barely cooked (photo attached). When I made the attendant (dark haired one) aware of the situation she lifted the lid with a stiff upper lip and said, “no they’re ok.” I went to the reception to complain and the guy came over and said they looked ok but went to the kitchen to enquire. When you see the pic you will understand. Their chef is “Mexican American” so he knows how to make them! Well, I’m not Mexican but French American and I do know how to make them as well. The receptionist was much nicer than the dark haired girl working the buffet and offered to cook them more. At least he cared. I have lived abroad for the last  20 years and have been living in Bogotá, Colombia for the last 3 years traveling through Latin America on a weekly basis and some of the staff on this hotel lack the basics in hospitality.
name: 1K Paris

title: Cozy atmosphere in a great location

Amazing food, the breakfast was the best!
Also we’ve been very surprised to find a speak easy bar on the back of the kitchen that served mezcal cocktails. 
Definitely recommend!
name: 1K Paris

title: Nice rooms, food and decent TV!
text:
Opted to stay here for a work trip and was pleased I picked this place. 
Staff are nice and helpful on check-in, very helpful recommending restaurants, although they did say the Peruvian one on site is particularly good. I took their advice on this and really enjoyed the meal too.
Gym was ok, nothing special but has everything you’d need.
I’d stay again for sure
name: 1K Paris

title: Great hotel in great location
text:
Hotel was in a great location. Near a Metro station, although workers were on strike and not working. Lots of galleries, restaurants and shops within a short walk.

Our room on 5th floor, on the back side, over looking a courtyard,  room 511. It was well appointed, quite spacious. Bathroom and marvelous deep tub. 

Would highly recommend staying here. The only glitch was check in. We arrived from a flight from San Francisco around 11:00 a.m. They told us to leave our bags and come back at 3:00. We arrived at 3:30, the room wasn't ready. Told us 5 more minutes.  At 4:00 they said it's ready, only to go upstairs to find the maid just starting to clean the room. Could have been handled much better.
name: 1K Paris

title: Great staff, location and room!
text: This is a well located hotel, with very spacious and modern rooms.  All staff were most helpful staff throughout stay. We were also visiting at the time of the metro strikes and staff gave us the best tips for getting around.  The hotel was also well located as we could walk to the majority of tourist sites. Definitely would stay here again and recommend it to anyone wanting to visit Paris - we stayed here for 4 nights..
name: 1K Paris

title: Highly recommend
text: We had a great stay, it was perfectly clean, warm and dry, which was very much appreciated in the cold weather! Very quiet also as double glazing and thick curtains completely blocked out the noise and light from the street below. Great location too and staff were really helpful. I’d definitely go back and recommend to family and friends.
name: 1K Paris

title: very nice place
