I arrived, checked in at 8 pm. At check in it seemed quite clear that everything was fine. My file/paperwork was right there, found within under 20 seconds, for processing me into a room. Put things in room and went out to have dinner.

Three hours later I came back to be told of that my reservation had been for the previous night (turned out my wife accidently booked wrong night) and that I might (MIGHT!) be charged for the room again but that the person in the evening couldn't do anything about it and seemed totally unsure about it, and that as a courtesy to make his life easier he changed my room.
In the morning, not only was I charged full fare pricing-- but charged for that upgraded room that I had not asked for.  
The morning I was hit with a full rate bill -- including about Euro 60 (US$80) to pay for the upgraded room that I didn't request.
All I needed was 'a bed' for the night ... within blocks were suitable ones at less than half the price. If Felicein's staff had been upfront (at 8 pm)  that I didn't actually have a reservation (having been booked for the previous night) and  how heavily they would hit me financially, I would have made the effort to change hotels.
Yes, upfront, our error but Felicien took advantage of it to fleece me.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Couldn't ask for a better hotel
text:
Having had this hotel and trip to Paris as a wedding Anniversary surprise I was a little apprehensive during the flight, but as soon as we arrived at reception any reservations I had soon disappeared, the staff at the hotel were very welcoming, helpful and professional.
I'm gluten intolerant and my husband had no time beforehand to alert staff so  he had packed my own rolls, however the staff at reception offered to buy in anything I needed, but the breakfasts catered to everyone's needs as far as I was concerned so I didn't need anything.
We had a pearl room on the 5th floor and it was lovely.
Spacious wardrobe space  with a mini fridge and safe and the decor was very tasteful and calming.
Bed was comfortable too.

Shower was lovely and hot, room clean. 
We did have a problem with sink draining as there seemed to be a problem with the operating system 
but was not really a problem so  we didn't think to let reception know as everything else was so lovely.

The hotel was quite near to the seine river, was only about 20 min walk to Eiffel Tower which we found better as every trip we wanted to go on we wanted to start off with a walk after a lovely breakfast, 
My husband had thought of booking something in the heart of Paris but had done his research very well as the description of the hotel and decor was exactly as described,
Everything was pleasing to the eye, very modern and very well designed
so he was glad to have booked here.
 
Hotel was lovely and quiet, all staff were very helpful and friendly and a credit to the hotel.
The spa was fab, we only had to ask for robes and they were delivered up to the room along with flip flops, we were lucky to have it all to ourselves so we used the sauna steam room and jacuzzi pool, which after a very busy day sightseeing was a welcome bit of relaxation.
Very happy that during a trip to such a wonderful city staying at the Felicien was the icing on the cake.
Thanks to all the staff and would loved to have stayed longer than 3 nights.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Comfortable hotel
text: I spent two nights in this hotel during a business trip for an event in Roland Garros. The hotel is well located to visit the southwest parts of Paris. To visit other precincts, suburban train lines (RER C, 'Javel' stop) and tube lines (Mirabeau, line 10), which are close to the hotel, will enable you to reach the very centre of Paris. The staff at the reception turned out to be very friendly and helpful.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Great funky hotel... something different plus indoor swimming pool
text:
Booked this hotel as it was something different that the usual chain hotels.
each floor has its own theme and rooms are different.

we had recently married and they spread petals over the room, a bit cheesy but nice touch.
the hotel has wife which is a must now.

we didnt have the breakfast there as there are lots of cafes and markets nearby.
location is a bit out of town, but gives you a chance to explore paris and there are lots of shops, takeaways and restaurant a walk away.

staff really friendly and they also kept our luggage after checking out as our flight was later in the day.

There is also a spa and an indoor swimming pool which is a great bonus.  it has waterfall and jets etc very nice.
luckily for us when we went to use it there was noone else there as it is quite small and intimate.  But you can book it for private session for a feww.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Nice, clean, perfect hotel in very good location in Paris
text:
Excellent location, very close to Sena left bank, near to Boulogne -Auteuil, Rolland Garros, and Grennel, Tour Eiffel over the Sena.
Very clean, newly renovated and equipped, SPA and Gym.
Good Metro and bus connections on some 200-300 m.  
Good restaurants, grocery shops nearby.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Very very nice
text: Really nice hotel with excellent staff and would recommend anyone thinking about it to definitely come here. Also Paula was very helpful with her customer service. Pool was also very nice and the room we stayed was very clean.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Comfortable But Small Room; Not Particularly Convenient Location
text: The hotel is near Pont Mirabeau in the 16th arrondisement. It is outside of tourist zone: no major sights within walking distance. I was here for meetings at the OECD, and that was a 25-minute walk away. Each floor has a color theme, and I was on the Ruby floor, and had a very red room (which I find cheapish looking). The room was small, but the shower was a comfortable size. There are reading lights by the bed, and back lighting behind the bed and in the bathroom that served as nice night lights. My sink was not draining well, but as soon as I told the front desk, it was promptly fixed. There is a refrigerator in the room, and 2-3 supermarkets within 5-minute walk. If you bring back a bottle of wine from outside, the friendly bartender would happily open it for you. Not many good restaurants within easy walking distance though. The closest metro is about 10-minute walk away.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Friendly & Cosy
text: A hotel enjoyable to stay while in Paris. Pleasant stay, with friendly staff and a nice breakfast. Close to major landmarks and tourist spots to visit. A city worth visiting with great sceneries, landmarks, restaurants etc.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Brilliant
text: Me and my boyfriend recently stayed here for a romantic city break and I can't recommend this hotel enough. The decor and interior was beautiful- very modern and stylish. There was also a plunge pool/jacuzzi with a steam room and sauna (we were the only two people in there which was an added bonus). I had requested a room high up with a balcony and we were given just that. The room size was good for European standards and the hotel was small but cosy (I find most hotels in Paris are more "boutique" style hotels which adds to the chic-ness!). The area was also good- a few restaurants nearby and the Eiffel Tower was about a 25 minute walk which was a pleasant, scenic route along the river Seine. The staff were friendly, helpful and lovely. The temperature of the plunge pool/jacuzzi was a little bit on the cold side, would have been even better if it was slightly warmer, although again, this may not bother the majority of people, but from a personal point this was literally the only ever so slight complaint I had. Thank you for a fabulous stay. I would definitely recommend this hotel and return again.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Not perfect but still 5* at the price we paid
text:
The hotel has exceptionally friendly staff which are the reason I give it five stars despite not being perfect on other ways. I hope the staff are paid a little more to reflect this. They helped us by printing station names so we could try the metro and also did eventually sort better firmer cushions for us- so they did everything they possibly could.

We were warned that French staff in hotels and restaurants would be rude (we are English)but literally none were rude - far from it. 

As for people marking down for the location - wow, really? Did you book blind or not do your own research beforehand? That’s your issue and reflects your ignorance ... nothing else - trip advisor should remove those. 

The hotel has comfy compact rooms. A bath would be nice but we had an awesome big raindrop shower. Yes some water leaked but nothing a towel couldn’t handle. 

The hotel has a good feel, a nice layout and top quality furniture and fixings - yes they are starting to show their age and water marks etc in shower so it’s due an update but for our price perfectly acceptable and still clean.

One big negative is that the swimming pool is tiny making it very awkward if just one couple is in there. Also not obvious how to change there if you can? Very awkward using lifts in bathrobes but we did see some couples brave it... if you’re confident there’s a swimming pool but if you’re not then really it’s unusable. This was a reason we chose the hotel so it was very disappointing.

Also the spa seemed to be closed a lot and on Saturday they’d obviously rented out the small bar/ lounge area to an event - so we couldn’t use it. It was really heaving with a fashion event? I suggest the hotel compares that income with the negative impact on the hotel customers.

The location: you get what you pay for- it’s quiet. Perfect for us because we don’t need lots of local bars cafes etc.  We also feel like we found more authentic restaurants full of locals due to this - tripadvisor still brings up plenty of walkable options. But for a livelier romantic get away going to bars every evening we recommend you look to another region of Paris - lots of guides online. Do not mark the hotel down because you’re too ignorant to research this yourself!
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Nice but not 4 star
text:
Hotel was nice but not for 4 stars 
They have issues with de design or with the furniture because it was looking old and used .
The Hotel has a good position for city centrum  .  For 2 night was good tks
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Not a good value for money
text: Holidays, the wifi in the hotel is very slow, they do not change the towels, this is a motel not a hotel, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, this is literally apartments converted to a hotel👎🏽
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Decent rooms, friendly staff, lovely whirlpool
text:
Convenient to shopping and sightseeing. The room was a decent size by Parisian standards, but the sheets were dirty. 

Breakfast was a step up from other four-star properties. There was a wide selection, including fresh fruit.

There is a fantastic whirlpool and hammam in the basement. Unfortunately, these were often occupied by couples, so it was easy to feel that you one was intruding.

The staff were all cheerful.

I wouldn’t hesitate to go back, but competition is fierce in Paris. There are a lot of good choices. Although competitive, I’m not sure that the Félicien has the best value for money.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Good but be better
text:
Stayed in the hotel in early December 

If you like walking it's a great location - 5 minutes from the rive seine - on a map look for the statue de la liberte - from where you can get s boat down the river - we walked to all the main tourist points from the hotel and returned very tired - the hotel is set in a mainly residential area so at night there is only a couple of bars and restaurants - we were the only tourists which was evidenced by the waiters asking where we were from etc - but that made it special - it felt abroad ! And with the added benefit of drinks half price of the more tourist areas - I can't really comment on price as you need to keep it in perspective - we had a room, a sitting area and hot tub with access to the spa - I imagine 15 minutes closer to the centre this would be out of our price range

We didn't order breakfast which was a good result as was a lovely bakery on the corner where a coffee and croissant was €3 - great result 

Staff were lovely and their English was very good and far better than my French 

Bath robes were also great 

Negatives for me

The shower ! I'd read other reports about the room flooding as the shower is broken and won't stay in place - yep we also soaked everything 

The main one was I ordered flowers for my arrival for my wife - I was charged €60 for about 15 roses that were just left on the bed - looking very much like supermarket flowers - even had to put them in the glass from the room as no other way to put them in water - irony is there is a beautiful florist about 50m from the hotel and great bouquets for €20 

So yes a god hotel in a residential area but I wouldn't pay for flowers or breakfast
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Very poor not worth price at all
text: Very poor hotel not with the price staff rude useless! Spa crap dirty rooms dirty! Noisy! Things to do nothing round there breakfast 18pound per person nothing there cleaning of room they obviously do t know how to use a hover! As I went out and something on he floor that I knew was there was still there after cleaning was meant to of been carried out hotel small bar dirty would not recommend this hotel at all to anybody would rather stayed in caravan.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Very disappointed
text:
I was very disappointed by this hotel at all levels: staff, service and cleanliness (the toilet hadn't been properly cleaned!). Neither the hammam nor the sauna were working. I told reception that the stay was terrible value for money upon checkout and was offered an hour of privatisation of the spa. I told them I wasn't interested in this as I wasn't planning on coming back and they didn't offer anything else.

I honestly would not recommend this hotel and will not go back. There are much better places to stay in Paris for that price.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Almost 5*'s
text:
Stayed at Hotel Felicien for a weekend work trip to Paris and brought my partner along with me. I thought this hotel would be perfect as it looked very different and quirky.

The location wasn't bad, luckily we like to walk and explore but there wasn't many restaurants in the area which is something us foodies struggled with. 

RESTAURANT RECOMMENDATION- L'Ogre - 5 minute walk from the hotel - steak restaurant and A LOT of wine choices. Friendly staff. Local restaurant. Book in advance they managed to squeeze us in on a Saturday night because we were so lost for food!

Breakfast at hotel - not much choice but still very good... fruit, yoghurts, meats, cheeses, pancakes, egg, bacon, baguette, pastries, cereals.

Rooms - try and request anything but the pearl room. Its very out dated...we asked to change and got moved to the Ruby floor which is LOVELY! Cute balcony which was nice, bathroom is elegant along with the room. Shower did leak but no problem that a towel can't sort out... Beds comfy so much space, can't really fault.

Spa was out of service so we had access to the Jacuzzi which was so relaxing at night after a long day of 25,000 steps around the city! 

Staff - I think this was the part that made this hotel stay PERFECT! The 2 reception staff we met (Lady from Romania and young Gentleman) - So friendly and helpful, gave recommendations, allowed longer stay in Jacuzzi, overall perfect... and they deserve a pay rise ;)

I would like to try and stay more in the centre of paris if I come again but this hotel was perfect for what we needed for a weekend stay!
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Great Hotel!
text:
The Hotel is quite small and cosy, also has a SPA that was closed due to
maintenance, but it did not matter for us since we got access to the outdoor jacuzzi on the top floor.

The staff working is truely 5 star, they were always kind and helped out with every request with a smile. 

Our room on the fifth floor had a really nice bed, a small balcony and a Nice bathroom.

We will for sure stay here again when visiting Paris.

title: Fab Beds!!
text:

The hotel is tucked away off the Main Street but trust me this is a super benefit very quiet at night.

The room was smaller than we like however perfectly suitable for a short trip. ( We just slept and showered in it) The hotel is modern in style and has everything you need including a must for most travellers these days WiFi!
The location is fab, just a short walk to the main attractions and a pretty good shopping centre, and Javel station.
Have to point out the beds, they were just fantastic slept well in the comfy beds with crisp white bed linen changed everyday!!!
Would defo stay here again if we are doing Paris again!!!!

title: Disappointing
text: Would not recommend this hotel at all. Rated 4-star more like a 2 star. Too far away from main attractions. Not many nice restaurants and cafes in the area. Shower curtain which was mouldy and stank the entire bathroom out. Water from the shower leaked all over the bathroom floor.

title: Great hotel in a great area
text:

The facility is new. Great restaurants in the area. Everything feels local and homey.
It’s not close to main attractions but it’s the exactly the point.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Second Stay and over the moon again!
text: This was our second stay at the hotel in as many years and we were completely over the moon with it. I contacted the hotel prior to arriving to see if they would be able to provide a surprise romantic gesture as I proposed to my better half that morning. They were quick to reply and filled the room with rose petals. They offered to have a bottle of champagne on ice in the room and even went out to look for a specific champagne at my request. The girls on reception were always helpful! The room was a good size and the hotel in a great location for walking to the Eiffel Tower! We tried to spa late at night and were upset we hadn’t tried it last time! A small pool, sauna and steam room! A truly welcome break after the days walking! We will be returning to Paris in the future and this is the only hotel we will ever stay at! Thanks again!!

title: False 4 star
text: The decoration, done by the son of the designer Ted Lapidus, is very attractive. However the standard functionalities of the hotel (bathroom too small, bad isolation of the shower, bad expresso at the breakfast) are mediocre. They do not justify a price of 240€ / night !!!

title: Amazing stay at the Felicien Hotel ❤️
text: Beautiful fresh and modern decoration by a french designer with various ambiances.The staff is smiley and knows really well the city. When arriving we had flowers on the bed 💕 We had breakfast in the room with good coffee and fresh juices ! good quality good price. Lovely hotel we recommand !
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Great helpful staff
text: We had reservations for 5 days. My husband had a medical issue and we arrived in Paris a day later. Although we purchased a non refundable ticket, they refunded our night (we presented medical documentation) and although we arrived about an hour after breakfast the staff brought my husband a tray full of cheese, cold cuts and breads with a bottle of water free of charge. The staff was very helpful and showed genuine concern for my husband's health. The hotel is totally rennovated, very modern and designed by Lapidus, a French designer. It is located 15 minutes from the bateaux bus which function as a hop on hop off boat along the seine. A bit far from the center. A great find.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Hidden extras
text:
Hotel was nice and modern. Felt like we were a local because we weren't near the tourist hotels. We stayed on the black floor which was nice, rooms average, with lovely matresses, brilliant night sleep. 
Wellness centre was lovely, plunge pool nice when not busy, sauna/stream room would fit 3/4 people. 
Receptionist spoke goof english was helpful. Metro 5/10 walk. 

Had to put down a €50 deposit for the mini bar if we used it and breakfast was something ridicious like €20 pp. I think they charged us over €200 for 6 mornings. The breakfast was typical continental breakfast, was nice but way way over priced. Also there is a tourist tax of like €2/4 a day. 

Would I return? Possibly not no
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Very good service and very friendly Employees
text:
It was wonderful. It is one of the design hotels I would like to recommend at any time.
The staff were friendly. The staff in general was very attentive.
The location was great. In 2-5 minutes to the RER or Metro. Great restaurants nearby.

Thanks for the nice time.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Unreasonable price & closed spa.
text:
We went to spend our honeymoon in Paris and stayed in this hotel noting that it is our honeymoon but they didn't care (unlike the hotel we stayed next gave us champagne). The room was painted black and very dark. The terrace chairs had no waterproof covers so were soaked through from rain on the first night making the terrace un-useable. Multiple times bath robes and towels were not provided and had to ring front desk several times to get some delivered (after an hour!). No sitting area and table so restricted to bed area. Spa facilities were closed which was the main reason for booking this particular hotel. No bath tub in the bathroom. Price was very expensive for what you get. 
On the positive note, the swimming pool is warm although it's small, good shower experiences and the cleanliness of the room is excellent.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Couples weekend away
text:
After proposing to my partner (with her thankfully saying yes) we flew to Paris. Having a not so great reputation with hotel bookings, I don't think she was holding out much hope.
The hotel was incredible. It was quirky and comfortable with the staff willing to bend over backwards to help. The room did not have a bath plug and they offer free breakfast for two for the inconvenience or a change of room. My partner was happy to escape the intensity of the RED room and our bags were moved. We would have been happy for a bath plug!
On check out day they provide a changing space if you want to change before your flight.
Staff could not have been more helpful.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Terrible service
text: This hotel is horrible. The receptionist did not speak English... What is not acceptable in a 4 star hotel in paris. After She was trying to explain that I needed to do a pre authorization of 100€ in case that i use the minibar. I was not expecting that because they don't say that when I book the room. After some minutes I was able to understand what she was saying and I paid. At 4pm she gave me the room and when I went there,  the toilet lid was broken. I called the receptionist and she change me the room but in that room was missing some items on the mini bar and towels, so I called again the receptionist saying that was missing some items on the mini bar and towels and the receptionist said it was okay because they didn't check the minibar before. In second day I went to the hotel at night and the housekeeping only put one bath towel and it was 2 people in the room. When I did check out I said again to receptionist (this time a different one) that was missing some items on the minibar and she said it was okay because she know it before because I call when I arrive. Now after 3 days they were supposed to give me back the money when I realised that they charged 12€ from my account when I didn't use nothing from the minibar. This hotel is so disorganised and the costumer service is terrible.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Average
text: I visit this place not long ago happy for me just for one night. I stay in many 4* and 5* hotel but this is for sure non of them  i just give this place 3* only for location and no more , for me it is just 3* hotel . When I arrive at 12 non to Hotel after long trip I find out check in is at 4 pm.... after wait for my room i find out in my bathroom wet bath rob with no even strap which was disgusting! New one have also no strap and look very old.. I chose this hotel mainly for rooftop pool. Later i find out that Pool on roof top is only for suit apartment not for everyone what I find out asking in reception, don't see any information before to inform about that , it was huge disappointing. Pool in "spa" was available for rest guest , without towels and bath sleepers . I get information check in pool is open till late evening , but later on i see information in the lift that pool is close for privet event.  In very morning next day wake me up some contraction work room next to my, nobody inform me about possible noise that early in the morning. For sure i will not stay there again.

title: Third time here but standards are slipping
text:
My son and I enjoy this hotel and have been here three times. It isn't the cheapest hotel and so the standards of what they provide have to be high. 

The hotel has many good points - the beds are the most comfortable beds I've slept on, the rooms are very clean, the breakfast is brilliant and the staff are always friendly. 

However, sadly may of their standards are slipping. The spa wasn't working properly and there was no apology for this - it is a very small pool, which we enjoy, but when it's key feature doesn't work, that's a shame. I was also given a very dirty towel for my room, with little apology. And the honesty bar continues to charge €6 for a cup of tea and the wine and beer prices are eye watering - laughable when you have to make it yourself. 

Final point - they allow the spa to be bought for private use by hotel customers for €140 per hour, which means that all the other guests are not allowed to use it during that time. As a paying guest, I think this is a poor policy as they hour may be the only time we can use 

We'll be back I'm sure, but the management needs to raise its game again.
name: Hotel Felicien by Elegancia

title: Saved our trip
text:
My boyfriend and I were stuck when our AirBnB turned out to be a dirty hovel on the Saturday night we arrived and were worried we'd be stuck. After a quick panicked Google, we found Villa Brunel and managed to book immediately for our two night trip, and were surprised at how affordable it was given the location and last minute booking (£166 for a long weekend in Central Paris)
 
The hotel itself was pure luxury from what we came from and we found it to be so clean and comfortable. The staff knew who we were the second we arrived and were so friendly and polite - Even the late night security when we came in a little worse for wear! We booked a double room which was small, but enough space for two for a weekend and the en-suite was clean and modern with a rain-fall shower head and detachable head as well. The standard hotel amenities were also provided, with others being available at the front desk - Including plug adapters.
 
It's set in a very quiet and beautiful location with some amazing restaurants nearby - Try Il Grano for delicious pasta and it's literally 3 minutes from the hotel! Plus, it was a 12 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees which is ideal. 
 
This place is great for those wanting to be close to the action but want a peaceful nights sleep after a safe walk home, can't recommend enough! Thanks for saving our first weekend away as a couple :)

We're accustomed to lots of drawer space, which we didn't have here, but the closet was big and had a shelf with plenty of room. For a 3-night stay, we didn't have to unpack much.

Breakfast at the hotel was worth the price. It was filling and tasty with fruit, cold cuts, cheeses, breads and hot foods. The coffee, tea, and juices were delicious, too. Our breakfast table also had a view of the street outside where we could see neighborhood residents walking to work and school.

One of the most wonderful aspects of this hotel is the view of the neighborhood. My wife and I enjoyed looking out the windows at the French architecture and watching the people pass by on the street. The light-blocking curtains helped when we slept in! We would definitely stay here again.

title: A definite thumbs up
text:
Myself and my boyfriend chose to stay here for my 30th birthday in Paris. I always use tripadvisor to look at hotels first and this one had great reviews. 
We stayed for 3 nights. We flew in to CDG airport. Took train B to Chalet. And then line 1 to Argentine. The journey was about 40mins. 

The hotel is a 5 minute walk from Argentine metro stop too. I couldn't quite believe how well located it was until we went for a walk around that first evening we got there and stumbled across the Arc de triomphe 10 mins from the hotel. 
We were welcomed nicely and the lady on the desk marked on the map some good bars as we wanted to go out that evening. 

The lift is very small. And was a squeeze with just the two of us and our bags. But being on the 6th floor at the very top I didn't fancy the stairs. The room was small but had everything you needed. But all rooms in Paris are small from what I gathered from reading other hotel reviews on tripadvisor before we came. 

The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was very nice and had a shower aswell as a bath too. You can tell it has been refurbished as the room was fresh and well maintained. Being on the top floor our ceiling was slanted due to the roof so just had to be careful not to bang our heads. There was hardly any noise at night from inside the hotel from other customers and you couldn't hear any noise from outside. We had black out blinds and curtains so had a great nights sleep. 

Breakfast is available but we ate out so can't comment on that. Rooms were cleaned everyday and towels replaced too. The room was lovely and warm and so was the bathroom due to the heated towel rack which gave out a lot of heat. 

The hotel as I have said is very central and you can walk to the Champs de llyses. The metro and trains get you all over Paris. We went as far out to Disneyland on train A. The neighbourhood is safe and full of pleasant locals. Not full of tourists and noise which was good when you come back after a long day sight seeing. There was also a Carrefour supermarket a 3min walk away in the local square up the road. 

Overall Paris was a beautiful city and if I were to come again I would definitely stay here and have recommended it to my friends too. 

Also take public transport as it is reliable, cheap and really easy to navigate. We got a €10 one way ticket the evening we got there to get to the hotel. Then got a weekly pass which starts mon-sun for €27 (I think) even though we were only in Paris til Wednesday it works out cheaper as you can use it on the train, metros and buses. 

Thank you Villa Brunel for a lovely stay.

title: A gem
text:
I am an elderly experienced world traveler, picky but not overly so, who does much research on accommodations before I travel, and am therefore usually pleased with where I end up. Clean, quiet, comfortable, convenient, friendly are my criteria, but I am a big fan of “olde worlde charme”.
This is a boutique hotel and overall I HIGHLY recommend it.
The Location was perfect, in a safe neighborhood, in the posh 17th, very quiet peaceful area with no street noise, near to the Porte Malliot or the Argentine Metro stops on the best (#1) east-west main line.  You can walk from the Argentine metro stop all the way downhill to the Rond Point of the Champs Elysses.  Very nice way to star the day.
Staff, universally English speaking, were OK, but especially the lady at the desk, she was much more friendly and very helpful with all my questions. As I am often a solo traveler, I like to chat with the desk personnel at these boutique hotels to have some local contact and sociability.
Cleanliness was perfect in my room, bathroom, and public areas.  The maid service was fine.
The Bathroom size was large
The Breakfast buffet, not included, was very ordinary, and not well served, you would be better off going up to the Place Maillot and eating at the Congress (pricier but so worth it !!)
The Restaurants in the area are terrific, ask the lady at the front desk for suggestions.  My favorite is the Auberge Dab.
The Lobby was OK and the front desk open all hours.
There was an elevator to my room.
The Room was big enough and more like a 4 star hotel. The bed was comfortable, there was a TV which I never watched.  The room was quiet - NO barking dogs, no loud late strollers in the street, no trash collectors in the early am.
The View from my room was of the street.  Very interesting to look into the adjacent apartments at night.
The all important WIFI worked OK in the room but I usually do that in the lobby as it is always better there.
The Value for the money was acceptable

title: Paris over Bastille week
text:
Family of 3, we really enjoyed this hotel. We'd a family room over looking the canal. Others have mentionned the lively area but its not as if they roll on until the wee hours, except the night before Bastille day where the fire brigade stations party until the morning near enough. We've been to Paris many times but must have missed this tradition.

Continental breakfast every morning, and as others have mentionned the hot breakfast wasn't always on, which must be down to local circumstances. 

Clean, good sized, air conditioned room, something we were very glad of in 36º heat on some days.

Staff were always friendly and helped us with some queries.

Car parking at the hotel itself is expensive, try the Interparking at Rue Riquet and only 4 minutes walk away. 

There are alot of restaurants in the local area for dinner, we ordered pizza one night and had sushi from the place directly across from the hotel, the Bento boxes were great. La Villette basin is part of the Quai de la Seine whereby those areas are turned into a 'beach' vibe, with boats, kida areas and large open air seating to eat and drink, in this case provided by two of the bistros across and just a 100 yards from the hotel.

Travel into Paris is fastest by Metro, Riquet station line 7, although Crimee´is an alternative. Allow 20-30 min goin in as after you are just inside the Peripherique in the 19th eme.

i would recommend the hotel and happily go back again.

text:

Breakfast did not have the biggest choice but was adequate. 
The staff were very helpful and the hotel cleaners worked constantly to keep it clean. 
We walked from the Gare Du Nord which took about 20 minutes.
Recommend a coffee in the top floor resturant at pretemps, (who sponsor the free city map available in reception) but its not cheap.
When we were returning home the hotel stored our cases for us, while we had an extra day site seeing.

The hotel is clean and functional, which is a definite positive. The breakfast they offer is perfect to fill your belly before going to exploring the city. My favorite item they offered was toast and nutella. There is a bar next to the check-in desk but that was not utilized by many guest. The area was more used for guest to have meetings.
The Area:
The hotel location was next to a youth hostel and an American Bar. Making this  area a fan for the younger age crowd. We found places to eat every evening within a few blocks of the hotel. One night we had Pho and another night we had McDonald's. There is plenty of options. The hotel is about 3 to 4 blocks from a metro station that will bring you to the heart of paris. 
If we go back, I would stay at this location again.

Overall, the hotel was very clean. The breakfast was very good. The hotel is within easy reach of restaurants, bars, and cafes. 

An excellent stay, all in all...

Thank you,
Lee from Gravesend Kent England.

title: Paris In The Sunshine
text:
I last visited Paris 10 years ago and mainly did the tourist bus. I swore then i would go back and one day and explore Paris properly....by foot.

First choice i made was this hotel, what an amazing hotel. It delivered everything it promised and more.

We were given a room on the 5th floor facing the canal, how pretty, the best view in the hotel. I had asked for good working air conditioning, as this can be hit and miss in Europe in my experience. This hotel had great air conditioning. 

The beds.....so comfortable, we slept soundly every night and woke up just in time to catch breakfast.

The breakfast was delicious, scrambled eggs done to perfection, delicious sausages and bacon, fresn baguettes, yoghurts, fruit, cereals, a cold selection of meats and toast. Really everything was catered for.

The hotel and rooms were spotlessly clean and cleaned thoroughly every day. I really do not have a bad word to say about this hotel.

The metro is really close and we used this for most of our 3 day stay but unfortunately twice we were nearly pickpocketed. First two men tried to pickpocket my husband at Gare Du Nord station unsuccessfully. And then when i was going up the stairs at Palais Royal a group of 4 young girls of about 14 years old got quite close to me. Even though my bag was zipped up i felt a slight tug and caught one of them with their hand in my bag. Both attempts were unsuccessful but to be honest this would put me off using the metro in Paris again. From then onwards we used Uber which was really easy and cheap. So bear this in mind if you ever visit Paris, ive never known crime quite like this in any other city ive visited. So thats a real shame.

However that said me and my husband had a grest time in Paris, with a very comfortable stay at this hotel. I was so pleased with my choice and if i ever return i will most definitely come back to this hotel.

title: good location, nice area.
text:
We stayed here from May 25th to June 1st, 2019.  The area where the hotel is located is a nice canal with close proximity to both the Riquet and Stalingrad metro lines.  In travelling the world, one thing we appreciate are rooms with safes in it.  For some reason this is an amenity that's left out in the rooms of this hotel. We also ran into a situation that needed us to call Canada to deal with (pickpocketed on the metro).  There was no in room instructions on how to make a long distance call, and when we went to the front desk, no one there seemed to know at the time how to make a call to Canada.  Very frustrating. I wound up contacting who I needed to via facebook messenger.  

The included breakfast was ok..  Once they offered apple turnovers but once that one batch was gone... they were gone.  If you're travelling to Paris for tourism and pleasure, you won't be spending much time in the room.  There's lots of restuarants, brasseries and other amenities within walking distance.  The Riquet metro line takes you directly to the Louvre museum.  

I've stayed at a few Holiday Inn expresses in North American and the UK, and given the fact this was Paris, I just found it average overall.  Location was great for seeing Paris and access to the Metro and transit. But the lack of an in room safe was really off putting to me, which led to me carrying stuff around with me around Paris I normally wouldn't have.

title: Much better than the rating I've given it
text:
I have stayed at this hotel 4 or 5 times now and have always thought it to be a hidden gem. The rooms are large by Paris standards and well priced and it's on the side of the Saint-Martin Canal at the Bassin de la Villette.

The hotel is well maintained and offers a really good breakfast with quality items and a wide variety of choice. Staff are generally friendly and efficient and speak many languages - English being the main one after French.

Usually, I would give the hotel a 5-star rating, but it's much less as I feel their professionalism left a lot to be desired on my last visit.

After checking out I asked for a taxi only to be told that they were on strike. This was the first I knew of this as no signs had been posted in the elevators or foyer. When I asked the woman at the desk what we could do she said to take the Metro. This to a person with 2 suitcases of around 25 kgs each and a handicapped wife who can't walk too far. 

After I pressed her for a solution she said she'd see what her manager had to say and went into the office behind the desk. The manager had such high concern for our situation that he didn't even bother to come out to us. When the clerk returned she said she would try and get a taxi and used the computer to make a booking. I asked how long the taxi might be and she said she didn't know. All through our conversation, she showed little if any empathy for our plight.

Thank goodness for phone apps as I was able to get a car from Kapten which got us to the airport in good time for our plane.

As I said this is a good hotel. But I have given it a poor rating because of the low level of professionalism and customer service when it was needed most. Also, because I received an email with a half-apology from the manager saying that staff would be counseled, but that there were signs in the lift - there were not. And that another client had got a taxi earlier after waiting 45 minutes and it took 2 hours to the airport. What relevance this has to our situation escapes me, but I find it passing strange that the manager knows how long a cab took to get to the airport. I actually believe he's not telling the truth, but who cares?

A professional manager would have arranged for signs to be in elevators, all foyers, and the breakfast room. They would also arrange some form of bookable transport to be available. They would talk with their customers and not hide in their office.

So stay at this great hotel by all means, but be mindful that when you may need it most their customer service might evaporate.

title: Some nice. Some not so nice.
text:
Location- loved it. Off the beaten path for first time Paris visitors but nice to walk around in a more residential area. Lots of little restaurants and bars and very close to subway line.
Room- I wish we had asked to be moved on first day of our 7 day trip. Had a top floor room. Size was nice with one large bed and a sofabed. Two major problems- Worst stained carpet I've seen and odors (two totally different types). When we walked in room and saw stains on carpet I thought they had just shampooed since it was very discolored in most places. I never thought a Holiday Inn would put someone in a room with that carpeting. Also since it was raining out I thought maybe the previous guest or housekeeper tracked water in from the balcony. We unpacked and went out for the day. The next morning it was evident that this was just a terribly stained carpet. If this room was acceptable to them then the others were probably the same I thought.
The room also had either a VERY strong cleaning smell or on the last 2-3 days was a terrible sewer smell from the bathroom. We had to keep bathroom door shut so we could tolerate it in the bedroom. Neighbors had the same odor issue.
The restaurant breakfast was decent. No changes throughout our 7 days but didn't bother us too much.
Front desk nice enough. Never said hello or any acknowledgment when we walked by the desk a few times a day. It would have been nice.
Will we return? Probably not. I expect better quality of the room.

title: Great stay at Piaia
text: Very good and clean hotel. Breakfast was very good and free coffee all day and night. Excellent staff and very helpful. Cliose to metro, station and restaurants nearby.  Could not have stayed in a netter hotel. Would highly recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very fine hotel
text: The room was clean and comfortable, the staff was very friendly and helpful. The breakfast was good. The hotel was closely related to public transport facilities making it a good place to make trips to the city.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: When in paris…
text: It’s a very nice place where to stay in paris! The rooms are very nice  especially the DELUXE ONE.. the staff are very helpful and nice also!Will stay again when we will had a chance to comeback.. MERCI!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: wonderful French people
text: This hotel is perfectly located away from hustle and bustle but next to 2 metro stations minutes walk away to get you quickly to anywhere in Paris. The staff are the nicest people you can meet. Rooms are not big but on a budget a bargain, I went on trip advisor found cheapest rate went to Expedia as member and a discount was applied. This hotel is 50 yards away from a pub with good food and they all speak better English than us Geordies. My only  downside was the flight with Vueling airline. We arrived at ORLY for flight to  find it cancelled. We expected they would put us in hotel and arrange flight to Newcastle, They left us stranded my wife 74 Yrs old with memory problems and me 71 yrs old today deaf and with heart problem. We had to get to other airport book a hotel book flights with AIRFRANCE for next day. Absolute nightmare. After 10 emails they gave us 148euro. The flight I had to book was 500 euros, Please do not our experience with Vueling put you off. Go with a good airline. We would like to thank people who helped my wife when she fell over. All the French we met especially the young people were fantastic,
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Clean, comfortable and friendly hotel
text: The hotel was recently renovated, so everything is in top condition. Air conditioning also works well, which was a big plus, as the summer weather reached 40 degrees. The staff was friendly and welcoming. And the location near the metro station was super handy. I would choose this hotel again.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Decent but incredibly small
text:
The Piapia hotel is a decent place but incredibly small, to the point that you can move around in the bathroom (or in the room) without hitting a wall. Breakfast is ok, wifi is good, sound isolation between room is not great.

Overall it’s a decent stay but nothing above average.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Excellent value-for-price in Paris
text: The stay in the city of Paris with the family in Pia Pia was excellent. The perfect short distance to the Metro made us explore the city easily. The hotel is stylish, clean and really comfortable for a three-star hotel. We would recommend it for any family stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Perfect location, cute & clean hotel with comfy bed!
text:
This hotel is in a perfect location, out of the hustle and bustle but right next to bus stops and metros that take you anywhere you want to go in around 30 mins. The reception staff were always friendly and helpful when we told them our fridge didn’t work (they replaced it!) and got us an extra pillow. 
Breakfast was definitely worth the extra small amount we added on booking - a great selection and really fresh. 
The bed was super comfy and our room (deluxe) was spacious, with big windows, a tv, and really nice double sink in the bathroom. 
I would definitely go back there!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Excellent hotel
text: I would highly recommend Hotel Piapia. The staff at reception were always very welcoming and helpful. The hotel was very clean and the bed was so comfortable! The location felt very safe and had great transportation links. Would recommend to friends and family!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: ok hotel but not great
text: Room i got was really to small even by paris standards. Can not put down luggage or even toilet bag in the bathroom. Als decoration feels bit like mercure hotel so not very premium. Bathroom itself is nice but to small to do anything. No waste basket in room so improvements can be made.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: AMAZING hotel
text: Beautifully modern, wonderful decor and absolutely charming. Excellent staff. Clean and spotless throughout. Showers amazing and rooms small but comfortable.  Location good - close to the Porte de Vincennes Metro and some good bar/brasseries.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Excellent Staff and a  Good Location
text: The hotel and the staff were just fabulous! As soon as we arrived, the staff at the front desk were warm and friendly. They very kindly upgraded our room. They were polite, funny and friendly - and this was just on arrival. The hotel itself is modern with a nice ambiance. Staff around the hotel would greet us with morning / bonjour and were smiling - all were very genuine. We had forgotten some things in the hotel and they have very kindly offered to post these goods to us - the communication is constant. We were so happy with our stay and will definitely go back! Thank you to all
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very nice, cozy, clean hotel in a pleasant district
text:
Very nice, cozy, clean hotel in a pleasant district. Quiet street, area is calm, a bit away from the centre, but very well connected and easy to move around. 
The simplest room is rather small (9m2) but it's ok for a few days stay for the offered price and there's working area downstairs.
On my second stay I got a free upgrade to a bigger room and it was very pleasant.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Confortable hotel and nice staff
text:
I strongly recommend hotel Piapia and its nice staff. 
It is a quiet place with high quality sleeping accommodation. 
The only black spot is the absence of parking lot, but this is usual in Paris.
Good deal
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Fabulous new hotel!
text: I really enjoyed my stay at PiaPia. It was very clean, brilliant decor, the staff were so professional and free tea/coffee on tap. The location was fine I didn’t have much time to explore the immediate area so I give it 3 just because I travelled 30 minutes to most places but everything else totally fab. The only downside is that the rooms are not totally soundproof and I could hear movement plus some construction works going on next door. That being said I would definitely stay here and certainly at another hotel by the same company. Brilliant!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Perfect, merci. Stay here during roland garros 2019
text:
Stay here for 9 nights. Got 2 super receptionist both are woman who wear glasses. Both perform top class. They treat us like we stay at 5 star hotel. The first receptionist one who were taller was very helpful and even give us a map to help us navigate around city. Second receptionist was super warm and smile for us everyday. I even remember how she stand and smile and waited for us to depart out of the hotel during our last day in Paris. Because of this hotel, sometimes i feel Parisian actually was more polite than Japanese. For 140usd++/night in Paris, you have quite lot of hotels selection, but if you want to stay in quote neighborhood, got lot of cheap food, close to 2 main line train, top class receptionist and staff, then hotel Comete was the best. Definitely stay here again for the next roland garros or rolex paris master.

Pros:

-got carefour and lot of boulagerie
-both of your receptionist (women who wear glasses) are all perform like 5 star hotel!!!
-got 2 main line train (porte de vincennes can take you to louvre etc) and (mareichers can take you directly to roland garros and eiffel tower via iena)
-bonus cookies was amazing
-very good smell inside hotel
-super clean
-modern boutique hotel

Minus:
-honestly i dont know
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice cosy little hotel at a good location
text:
We had a nice stay at this charming and nicely decorated hotel. We loved the vintage vibe! 
The lady at the reception was very friendly and welcoming. The room was good; very tidy and clean. Only the airco didn’t work properly. 
Breakfast buffet was perfect! 
Metro / bus stops to all different areas in Paris are only a short walk away. Ideal for a weekend trip to Paris!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very nice small hotel on the outskirts of Paris
text: Couldn't complain about anything really except that although  advertised the air conditioning was turned off. Clean, comfortable and spacious room. Excellent breakfast for a small Parisien hotel. Would stay again.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great hotel
text: Fantastic hotel, easy to get to on the metro if a little far out of the centre. Wooden floors mean you can hear people walking about. Great staff and good service. Breakfast was nice and simple but plenty of choice.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice place
text:
Nicely decorated small hotel. Close to metro. Clean modern room. Good beds. Area itself is not bad still paris feeling

Downside: coffee machine in room broken, no real emergency exit (only one staircase going down), wifi slow
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great value & access to Metro
text:
Great location for the Metro meant that whilst not near any tourist attractions. You could get to all of them within 25-50 mins depending on where you going. 

Also easy to get to & from Gare Du Nord (28 mins) by Metro Good choice at breakfast, comfortable beds, our superior room was a good size. I had to remind staff we were supposed to have macaroons. Which we promptly received with a smile. 

Only ‘moan’ is there was no full length mirror. Just the mirror in the bathroom above the sink. When out & about in a stylish city like Paris. It’s nice to check on your appearance before heading out on the town! Lol 

Last but by no means least, the staff were hospitable, attentive and friendly. Merci beaucoup to the young man who was on breakfast duties. Also the staff who dealt with my special requests for the welcome notes to be left in our rooms :-) 

Overall would recommend and definitely stay again. Although as I like to explore and experience new things. If like with this booking (Secret Escapes) a good deal is available. I may try somewhere else when next in Paris.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Disappointing stay
text:
I booked this hotel stay and was looking forward to it given the pictures and the reviews.
Good-the hotel looked like the pictures and was in a good location, breakfast was good and the rooms were nice
Bad- we booked superior rooms and when we got to the hotel they told us that we were in classic rooms- when I showed the staff our booking they said that they had changed the names of the rooms since we booked, even though the website still has superior rooms on. This was not a good start.
2 days before we arrived I called to ensure we had twin rooms and were told that was no problem (the website also says this is fine if in a superior room). When we arrived we were told this was not possible and that there was no record of this on our booking. When I showed the record of the call on my phone they still insisted nothing could be done even though they had previously said this was fine.
The website also says you get water and macaroons in the room which we never saw as the hotel said they had run out.

Overall this was a very disappointing stay and I would not recommend given the hotel did nothing to try and make amends. This meant we had to have a 12 year old child sleeping in a room alone and meant someone had to stay with him until he fell asleep and someone had to come early in the morning to ensure he was not scared.
This does not make for a relaxing holiday.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Refreshing hotel in the middle of the heat weather
text: Well designed room, comfortable, quiet and clean. Very quiet location, near a Tube stop, a bit far from the city centre, in a quiet quarter. Staff very polite and friendly, stunning air conditioning in the middle of the last heat weather episode.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Trip To Paris To Celebrate Wedding Anniversary
text: This hotel is something of a find. The deluxe room we had was large with an enormous double (and extremely comfortable) bed. It was also quiet (on the fifth of six floors). The bathroom catered for two at once and the safe was big enough to take all of our valuables as well as a large laptop. Our son had his own single room which, although smaller than ours, had a double bed big enough to generously accommodate his lanky frame. He was particularly pleased with the free wifi which he deemed to be appropriately fast. We went during the recent heatwave and were grateful for the quiet but efficient air-conditioning. Housekeeping was exceptional (towels and bedding were immaculate) as was front of house. There were a few changes of staff at the front desk during our stay, but thankfully they all spoke excellent English (my schoolboy French would only have confused them otherwise). One lady - I'm ashamed to say I never asked her name, but she said that she was originally from Romania - took the time to recommend a few supermarkets (wine and croissants!) and restaurants in the area. In fact the location - although a little out of town - was well served with eateries, and, if you like Italian food, we recommend Il Santo on the Avenue du Dr Arnold Netter just across the main road. On the subject of location - the Metro station is a few minutes walk from the hotel and it's at the end of Line 1 so it'll take you quickly to pretty much anywhere you might want to visit as a tourist. We found the RATP smartphone app invaluable, and made it from Gare du Nord to the hotel in about thirty minutes with only one change of line. Hotel Comete is highly recommended and when we revisit Paris (soon!) we do not intend to stay anywhere else.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Good little hotel
text: Nice, clean and comfortable modern hotel with lovely big bathrooms. Staff friendly and helpful. Location is just round the corner from the metro line 1,which means you can get around Paris very easily though the hotel is quite far out of the centre. Breakfast was ok and you could get free water and fruit at any time, though sometimes there was no fruit. My only criticism is there is no mirror in the bedroom! Very difficult to dry your hair etc with no mirror. I don’t think you would be disappointed with this hotel.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Went here for my 33rd birthday
text: This place is awesome!! It's a small quiet hotel. The staff is extremely nice and their breakfast in the morning is great. One of the biggest things for me when I travel is that they have good air conditioning and this place has an amazing air system. The location is right next to the metro which takes you everywhere. loved it will come back
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Good hotel
text: Good place to stay for few days but it’s a little bit far away from the Eiffel Tower 25-30 minutes drive it’s in a quiet location but I thought the room was a little bit on the small side and the bathroom has a pocket door:)
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Holiday in Paris, April 2019
text:
I've been at the Hotel Comete on holiday with my daughter, end of April. We spent there five days and I must say I really liked my staying. The hotel is clean (rooms, bathroom, breakfast room...). Our room was small but cosy and comfortable: they cleaned it every day, leaving a bottle of water for every guest. In the room there was also the espresso machine Nescafè if you want to enjoy Italian coffee. The bathroom was small (but who cares? You just need the hotel for the night!) but fully equipped. No noisy people, no traffic noise, but a still and quiet place. Breakfast is great: plenty of different kinds of food and beverages, clerks of the hotel very friendly and helpful.
The hotel is near the underground station which takes you everywhere in minutes but if you want to walk it's not far from centre. There is also a wide choice of restaurants nearby, as well as a supermarket.
Definitely, I had a gret holiday!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Small Hotel with good Metro Connection
text:
A small and clean Hotel. the Rooms are not very large too, but clean and the bathroom has a fantastic schower. Good Relaxing shower after a Long walk through Paris. 
The room for breakfast is small too and the tables and chairs are very low. Interessting to sit there. But the buffet is very fine. I enjoyed to eat there.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Lovely Hotel in a Quiet Area of Paris
text: Enjoyed my stay here at Hotel Comete.  Very very clean room.  Comfortable bed.  A/C worked great.  Love the shower! This hotel is a bit from the “major sites” but for that exchange you get a quiet safe surrounding.  UBer rides to any major site about $15-20 USD; if your traveling solo or would rather save a few Euros there is a metro spot at the end of the street.  Breakfast is nice - great coffee machine.  Good selection of cheeses, sliced meat, breads, scrambled eggs, bacon, croissants, neat machine for making poached eggs and fresh squeezed orange juice.  Day staff was very friendly- especially Erna who was very accommodating and helpful - Thanks Erna!!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Absolutely fantastic in every way
text:
My friend and I got a great deal for this hotel via secret escapes and I cannot fault any part of it. It’s a very small boutique hotel and every member of staff was friendly and helpful. It was stylish, very clean, and the breakfast was delicious. Honestly the best scrambled eggs I think I’ve ever had - I need to know the secret!! 

Thank you for a wonderful stay and I’d definitely stay here again and recommend to others.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Lovely
text: This hotel is a small boutique type hotel. It’s very new inside, spotlessly clean. Good self service breakfast and a good location to access central Paris on the adjacent Metro Line. We thought the price was very reasonable for such a good base to explore Paris.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Easter break
text: We travelled as a family of 5. After an exhausting but highly enjoyable 3 days in Disneyland we commuted up to this boutique hotel. Check in at 2pm but our rooms were available on arrival after mid day. Fabulous reception staff who welcomed us by name as they were expecting us! 2 rooms were adjacent and although separate were on a secluded corridor with one door so when locked opened up our stay into a fantastic suite. Only 4 rooms per floor (6) so each floor had similar suites throughout. The beds were fabulous, clean linen and soft pillows and quilts. Air con, water, fridge, Nespresso machine, hairdrier (excellent), toiletries, bath in one room and shower in other. Large plasma tv in each room, free WiFi and proper single bed added for extra child. Fresh towels, water and housekeeping each day. Trouser press and iron and irojing board. Breakfast fresh and substantial. 10 min walk to tour eiffel line and course de vincennes metro at top of street (1min). Lots of restaurants, supermarkets, take aways within a few minutes. Staff very friendly with great English. Bar on site. Unfortunately we couldn't stay longer. Jam packed schedule for us from.morning until nite. Kids wanting to go home at every opportunity ie hotel comete as they loved it. All in all fabulous and I would hope to return and I am not easily pleased lol!!!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: One of the best
text:
I am so glad I found this hotel. It is honestly one of the best hotels I've stayed in regardless of size. Lovely decor. Clean and modern decor. All the little touches of a much higher star hotel i.e. slippers, bottle of water refreshed everyday. 

The staff were friendly and helpful but they weren't too intense which I've found with some smaller hotels. The hotel entrance is 24/7 and reception is always manned. The breakfast is amazing and the cappuccino even though it's from a machine is incredible. I would go back here or  recommend to friends in a heartbeat. 

The hotel is situated on the edge of zone 1 but right on the metro for porte de Vincennes, meaning it took us 15 mins into central Paris, 40 to the airport and about the same to Disneyland. It was perfect for us.

All for a great price? If you're stuck on deciding - go!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Good location and lovely staff
text: My partner and I stayed at Hotel Comete for a weekend break in October. Our room was a reasonable size for a weekend break and the finish was stylish and practical. At breakfast there was a lot of choice and despite being late comers the food buffet had been replenished and was fresh. The staff were very welcoming and informative. The area surrounding the hotel has a secondary school and feels safer to walk around. Would definitely return to stay at Hotel Comete.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: This really does deserve an extra star
text:
I stayed for 3 nights to do a tourism “blitz” on Paris and, as has been noted by others, although it is not in a central district, it’s proximity to the Metro makes it an ideal, and very good value, base.

My room was clean and quiet, the bathroom, with an excellent shower, was very modern and well equipped. 

Again as been noted by others, the staff go out of their way to be pleasant and helpful. The breakfast is extremely good and varied and the nearby streets offer a wide selection of different restaurants.

A really ideal base
name: Hotel Piapia

title: A gem
text: This is a real gem.  Although it isn't in the center of Paris, it is a block from the subway that will get you there in 17 minutes.  It's in a quiet neighborhood -- by Paris standards -- with plenty of restaurants nearby.  The rooms are large -- by Paris standards.  Best of all is the staff.  They actually care whether you enjoy your stay in their hotel and in Paris.  There is no question that I'd stay here again.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Better than better
text: I have been very comfortable in Comete Hotel. Very nice and tidy rooms. And the staff very helpful. My daughter and me needed a break and we could not choose better. Amazing the silence and respect to intimacy. Breakfast: seemed home made. Thanks for making us happy.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice Hotel and Location
text: The staff is very friendly and helpful. Although the elevator broke down two times during my eight day stay, the location is very convenient and accessible to the Metro. I would recommend this hotel to other people staying in Paris.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Perfections
text: It’s a rare thing to find such a low-cost hotel in Paris. Such amazing and spacious rooms. Clean and tidy. Staff was super helpful and welcoming, and helped me a lot organizing a surprise for my bf. They gave us a better room, because of the occasion we had. Strongly recommending!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Perfect location, excellent comfort level, easy access to central Paris, great price! What else could anyone want?
text: We stayed three nights. Staff was courteous and helpful. The rooms on both occasions were clean, comfortable, quiet and had good bathrooms.  The breakfasts were great. Most of all we took advantage of the hotel's proximity to the metro which made our Paris visit so easy!  We will come back to this hotel when we return to Paris.  Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Lovely stay
text:
Stayed for 2 nights and the hotel and staff were lovely!
The room was lovely comfy bed and good amenities such as a good hairdryer, ness press machine and fridge. The bathroom was gorgeous such a nice shower.
The hotel itself is a fair distance from the airport a taxi cost about €40. However it is about a 5 min walk from The metro and from that you can get anywhere. I got a 2 day ticket for zones 1-3 but would only need a zone 1 if I returned as all major sights are in zone 1 as well as the hotel. Little tip is to download the Paris metro map app on to your phone great for getting around and knowing which line and what direction of metro you need to get on. Our 2 day pass was around €20 each so a single zone ticket would be less. 
The breakfast at the hotel was lovely cannot fault however I’d say get there early as some things can run out other than that the breakfast is lovely lots of choice and the dining area is suberbly decorated. 
The area around the hotel is nice lots of restaurants I went to a sushi restaurant and it was relatively cheap €20 for all you can eat. A couple of supermarkets for snacks and drinks and trams close by. 
Overall the stay was amazing would completely return again!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great Hotel with a Wonderful Staff
text: I was really impressed with this hotel. The staff went out of their way to be helpful. The room was extremely comfortable and the breakfast was great. I highly recommend the hotel and will hopefully stay there again in the future.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Love this hotel!!!!
text: We only stayed one night but honestly wish we spent more time here. The hotel is conveniently located a block away from the metro. The woman at the front desk was so nice and showed us all the tourist attractions on a map with restaurant recommendations. She went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable. We’d definitely go back here and recommend others to go as well!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great value, clean and welcoming atmosphere
text: This hotel is off the center of Pariss, but close enough to take Metro 1 toward La Defense and you are getting to all the Paris attractions. Also, there is a nearby term that can take you to other areas of town. The staff is very nice and helpful, especially Angelique that assist us by giving us instructions on how to get around and find the local scene. The area is very ethnic and on Saturday there is a local market.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Fabulously nice and friendly staff
text:
We have been to Paris several times, at different hotels over the years.  While we did not encounter any rudeness in our previous visit, we can’t remember a more obliging staff than those I encountered at Hotel Comete.  We arrived few hours prior to check-in time and when we explained to Tamar that we needed to attend a family function, she was able to request a speedy room clean up.  We were able to access to our room two hours prior to the standard check-in time. Later, Angelique took time out to explain the touristy spots that were easy access from the hotel on the metro line 1 (the metro line closest to the hotel).  
Beside the fabulously friendly staff, not just Tamar and Angelique, but everyone else we dealt with, the hotel has a boulangerie/patisserie a stone throw away (around 300 m away).  We spend many happy mornings exploring its croissants and patisseries offerings.  The super market Franprix is also conveniently close to create a pick-nick basket of your liking without breaking the bank. 
We also like our room, which is of decent size for two persons.  Actually, we just came back from Kyoto so the room was quite large compared to what we were used to in Japan.  
The only minus, and this is very personal, was the daily free water bottles we received from the hotel.  We would have preferred that the hotel provides a refill fountain for our water bottles and thus, decreases the amount of throw away plastic.  
Overall, we love this hotel.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great value for money and friendly atmosphere
text: We stayed at Comete for our short break in Paris as a family of four and we could not have made a better choice. Friendly and helpful staff, great attention to details, yummy breakfast, convenient location close to the metro station - great value for money.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Excellent stay at very nice hotel!
text: We enjoyed our recent stay at the Hotel Comete. The location was was very close to the Porte de Vincennes Metro Station on Line 1 - which made getting to all the major tourist spots very easy! The staff were welcoming and friendly. We had a room for 3 people and had a good amount of space. The bathroom area was quite large with 2 sinks a nice shower. The only thing we would change about the room is that we wish there was a full-length mirror. Every day the hotel provided free bottles of water in our room, which was a nice touch!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very good hotel at the 20th Arrondissement
text: Our stay at Hotel Comete Paris was perfect. Good location with easy access to the public transport, nicely decorated interior, good breakfast and very friendly and professional staff. Highly recommended
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Highly Recommend
text: We spent a week in Paris and stayed at the Hotel Comete.  The rooms were very nice and the breakfast was so delicious!  The staff were particularly helpful and attentive.  The location is good--near a Metro station.  I highly recommend this hotel!!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: One of my two favourite hotels
text: This was my third stay at the Hotel Comete, and it's just as good as ever, if not better. Having stayed in many hotels over the years, I can say that this is one of my two favourites (it's a close call as to which is best) and easily the best value hotel in a major city. Why? Firstly, the staff go out of their way to make sure everything about your stay is perfect. Secondly, the rooms which, while compact, are tastefully furnished, spotlessly clean and equipped with everything you might need, including a safe. Third, the modern bathrooms with rain shower. Fourth, added bonuses such as the espresso machines in every room, free bottles of water, and fresh macaroons on the first night. Fifth, the excellent breakfast with fresh croissants, breads, beautiful scrambled eggs, cheeses, fruit, apple tart, yoghurts, and more. Sixth, the location, in a nice area, just a minute from the metro line 1 and tram lines 3. And finally, the room rates which represent amazing value for money. Superb!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great family location
text: Was worried on arrival about location but it is a very well appointed hotel and only 200 meters walk from the main line to central Paris and main sights. We travelled using the underground to get around and found it hassle free for a family of 5. Enjoyable breakfast and the lovely lady attending the area was more than helpful in offering gluten free alternatives for our daughter. Great stay, thankyou.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice place to stay
text:
Excellent orange juice and breakfast. Yogurt, scrambled eggs, hams, cheese are really good. 
Bathroom shower needs better design, water splash out a lot. 
Very convenient to local cell phone stores and markets. 
2 blocks to subway station short walking distance. Close after 11pm. 30 mins subway to Champ Elysées. It’s a direct line, no need to transfer. Daily pass €3 unlimited within Paris center. 
The manager and the girls are really nice. Other guys not so much. 
In room WiFi weak.
Safe neighborhood quiet street. 
I would stay there again and recommend this hotel to anyone.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very pleased
text:
We booked this hotel based on TripAdvisor recommendations and the fact that it had parking available. The parking was a bit deceiving, even though they do have 4 spots in a garage nearby, the daily fee of €25 wasn't mentioned anywhere, so be aware of that when you're travelling by car. The rooms were clean and modern, albeit a bit small. The breakfast buffet was very good, and there were free bottles of water available 24h, handy for when you're going out for a day in the city. The hotel is situated at the outside of the city, but the yellow metro line stop is right around the corner and takes you to the heart of the city in 20min. 

Overall very pleased here, will bookmark it for a future Paris trip.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great choice ! Cozy, clean and friendly (at great price)
text: Our room was clean, comfortable and the staff was friendly. Located in a quiet zone (not much touristy) but i think is safe and close to metro by walk. The room has a nespresso machine, great beds, modern bathroom, well decorated and big windows. Please try the breakfast was plenty of options and delicious!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Good place but not sure of the neighbourhood
text:
OK, so I booked this place for just one night and the amenities in the place were just fine. The room was clean and the service was good. The coffee machine though was complicated. I'd have really preferred a simple kettle. The macaroons on the bed was a nice touch though....
Breakfast was delicious. And the coffee there was great
The only problem I had was the neighbourhood. I had chosen this place because it was right in the middle of my trajectory in terms of where I was coming from and where I wanted to go, however I didn't realise that it was close to a public square where they chose to have a demonstration. The metro to the stations were disrupted and I took a taxi to be on the safer side. A little warning would've been nice... 
Apart from that really nice place to stay
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Lovely Hotel
text: This is a lovely little hotel. The staff are friendly, rooms are a good size, well decorated and comfortable. It's in a good location, not right in the centre so it's quiet but is only a minutes walk to the metro and you can get into the main tourist area within 15 minutes. The only thing I could fault is that there wasn't much variety of drinks behind the bar, but that made no impact on our stay whatsoever. Breakfast was also delicious and had loads of variety! Would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: beautiful atmosphere
text: it is probably one of the coziest hotels i've stayed in. it was clean, nicely decorated. the patio was like sitting on the porch of you own home , with two line on which huge light bulbs hanging above you. the staff were great . breakfast was minimal however enough to leave you very satisfied. it is also very conveniently located close to the metro. i would recommend this hotel for couples on a budget.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: As good as it gets for the money
text:
I have certain criteria when selecting an hotel. Must have a minimum 4.0 from TripAdvisor, be close to transport links and, if possible of the main road. Hotel Comete meets all of them.

It is 100m from metro line 1, tram line 3 and bus stops. It is a 10 minute walk to Place de la Nation station which gives more metro lines to choose from. The hotel will look after your bags if you arrive early so take the train from the airport to Chatelet and take metro 1.

The hotel staff are helpful and speak good English. The room was spotless with daily maid service. Small bottles of water were provided free of charge and the room had a Nespresso machine with free capsules. Safe, TV and aircon also in the room.

There is a supermarket a couple of streets away and bars and restaurants nearby.

Would I stay there again? Absolutely.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Perfect atmosphere
text: Great en cosy place and yet very suitable dor business and leisure alike. Interior inspiratie is the sixties. Very tastfull. Breakfast excellent. And service very correct and friendly. Relaxed place. Clean and for Paris city not too small rooms either.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nicely decorated hotel
text: I enjoyed my stay in Comète Hotel. I had a Warm welcome including typical French delicacies and water. The room was Clean, nicely decorated and it included a Nespress. The neighborhood is quiet but close to public transport and easily accessible from périphérique.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Clean quiet room within walking distance to metro line 1 station
text: Stayed there from 6/24 to 6/27. Clean room, well insulated wall (better than US chain hotels such as HI, Hilton, etc.) Helpful staff. Visited 3 restaurants in the area to soak in the local atmosphere. Metro line1 nearby. Only downside is the room size, but it's still decent for Paris. Highly recommended.
