name: Hotel Piapia

title: amazing small hotel
text:
very nice hotel, great breakfast, quick arrive to city center with metro line 1 (metro station 2 min walk), decoration and design in the bathroom is very classy!
the receptionist at nights not very nice... started shouting at us in French beacuse we wanted to host friends in our room...
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Friendly and flexible
text: Very good place.  Also I had booked via booking,com lowest rate non refundable. I had to change the date. Booking,com replied "NO, Not possible". After contacting the hotel directly they have changed the date without extra cost. 5 star service!!!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice Hotel outside of the city center
text: Hotel had incredible rooms.  Bathrooms were nicely appointed, and breakfast was great.  The immediate area surrounding the hotel is a little plain, but only a few blocks away are some good restaurants and shopping.  Water pressure was great, elevator was big enough, and front desk staff was very helpful!!!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: One of the best hotels (in this price class) I have been in Paris.
text: Almost brand new 3 star elegant hotel in east of Paris. 300mtr. from metro. Room (Deluxe Room) very nicely decorated (but not over designed) with separate bath room anex toilet. Everything in room was rather new so that was nice. Room cleaning was accurate. Most positive thing however I found was the breakfast witch was exellent for a 3 star hotel and only 13 euro. Didn't expierence any inconvience of other guest rooms or outside stuff like noise. Personal settings possible for airco/heater, room did still smell a little like new. Nice flat screen tv with lots of HD channels. Neighbourhood rather calm (although some schools at nearby). Staff rather friendly and professional. So in my opinean a very good Hotel.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Business travel - excellent hotel
text:
Excellent value! Modern, clean and very quiet. 
Hotel staff very friendly and helpfull and the hotel is really close to the tube. 
This will be my hotel for all my business travel in Paris. 
I highly recommand this hotel.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Exceptional hotel
text:
The best hotel in every thing, comfortable, clean, quiet, free wifi, close to all means of public transportation and the best staff i had ever met.
This will be of course my destination every time i go to paris.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Vacation
text:
Brilliant hotel close to the metro line.
The hotel was very clean and very relaxing.
The hotel Staff are very friendly and helpful and speak good languages.
Breakfast was good.
Room was clean and well presented.
Only bad point was there was not a good selection of wines.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: "Great value hotel, clean and comfortable"
text: This is a newly renovated hotel where we stayed for three nights and had a very positive experience. The room and shower were nice and clean; the staff is friendly and accommodating. We didn't eat any meals in the hotel so no comments food-wise; the neighbourhood is not anything spectacular, but the hotel location is very accessible via Metro line 1 to/from Central Paris. We will stay in this hotel again on our next visit to Paris around this time of the year and recommend it to everyone who wishes to opt for a three star hotel with a very good quality of service.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: The best smaller hotel experience in Paris
text:
The Hotel is clean. The staff is friendly. The styling is done properly and was well executed. Everything you want to have for a business trip is there. Very clean room, good bed, super shower, good TV, COFFEE MACHINE, free bottle of water, AND SLIPPERS.

If you need a clean good nice comfortable hotel, go here!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Lovely place to stay in Paris
text: I stayed with my family for 3 days & 2 nights. The place was lovely with very nice & accomodating staff. I loved the several choices of food during breakfast. The place is near metro train stations. I will definitely recommend to friends.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Second stay as great as the first
text: I have already reviewed this totally renovated hotel situated conveniently on the number 1 line of the metro system (the line that takes you to all the must-see places like the Louvre, the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe). In a side street off of a main avenue, the rooms are very quiet, especially on the courtyard side that overlooks a school playground. The rooms are big by Parisian standards, nice queen-sized bed, big bathroom with roomy shower. The staff is courteous and helpful in every way, someone is at the front desk 24/7 so you can check-in at any time. I cannot say enough good things about it, I now stay there every time I visit Paris. Breakfast is a bit pricey but very good with lots of variety so don't pass it by just based on the cost.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great place to stay!
text: We stayed here for 5 nights and loved it. We were traveling with our infant son and the hotel was very accommodating. They made sure to have a baby cot set up for us and a baby chair every time we came down to breakfast. It is super close to a metro stop so it is easy to get anywhere you want to go in the city. We also really enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. I thought the room was a good size compared to other Paris hotels I've been in. The only downside I would have is that the wifi could be spotty in our room but it was free so I can't complain much!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Great nice hotel
text:
We found this nice hotel online. 
It's well located near metro stop so it's very easy to visit the city. 
Staff is very friendly and helpful and the room are nice, clean and comfy. 
We will stay there again when we visit Paris!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Amazing find......would stay again!
text:
Quite simply - I loved this little hotel. It looks great, fab interior design. The rooms are lovely, not too small with everything you need. The bed is one of the comfiest I've ever slept in, I'm normally a bad sleeper but slept like a baby in their beds. We did have breakfast, it does seem is a bit steep in price, but there is loads of choice. By the time we finished breakfast we weren't hungry again until the evening. So it did save money in the long run.
The hotel is on the Metro 1 line (get off at Porte de Vincennes). When you come up from the Metro, look for L'Europe bar / café lit up in red in the square, the hotel is down the little street next to it.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: A great little hotel with personal service
text: This was a great little place to stay and fairly quiet. The hotel owner sent a survey in advance to address any special requirements we had. We did request early check-in for around 9am which we didn't think would even be possible but we decided to indicate it on the survey anyway. To our surprise and delight, a room was made available for us even at such an early hour. Also, instead of housekeeping knocking on our door, they actually phoned the room! That was a pleasant difference from other hotels, and much appreciated.
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Very modern, nice stay
text:
The good: 
Room was very nice, modern, and clean
Staff were very helpful

The bad: 
Hotel was not on a good tram line so slightly out from where we wanted to be and longer travel 
When checking out they tried to charge us extra for buying drinks however this was incorrect. We never got charged. 

Overall was a very nice stay, toilets very modern and hotel room immaculate
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Nice boutique hotel
text: Nice design hotel with excellent location which bring you to the city center by subway conveniently. The front desk service is very heart warming and able to provide any help for your trip in Paris. Thanks and will be coming again!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Hidden gem!
text: Had a wonderful stay at this boutique hotel. Found a really good deal online and was not disappointed. Easily accessed by the metro, fabulous breakfast and lovely staff. Rooms are small but perfectly formed, very comfy bed. Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Piapia

title: Ideal location
text:
Fab location- so near the Champs Elysee and great places to eat.
Staff lovely, not a room with a view unluckily but couldn’t fault anything else.
You do have to pay a deposit for the mini bar on check in €75 which we didn’t realise but you get it back a week after check out
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great place to stay!
text: We stayed here for two nights. Very clean and the stay was helpful. The breakfast was also quite nice. Rooms are a good size but not huge. Very nice neighborhood near the the Arc d’Triumph and the Eiffel Tower. Nice restaurants within close walking distance.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great, short stay at the Elysées Union, Paris
text: We’ve just come back from Paris having stayed in the Elysées Union. Our room was a little dated but it was spacious, very clean and tidy. Staff were welcoming and friendly. The location of the hotel is great - you can walk to the Arc de Triomphe in around 10 mins, the Trocadero in around 15 mins and the Eiffel Tower in about half an hour. The view of the Tower from the hotel is very impressive. There were lots of cafes and bars on the doorstep which gave us plenty of stopping points both when going out and when retiring later in the day. It’s definitely a hotel I’d recommend if you are visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Mother & Daughter trip, great location! Fab staff.
text:
Honestly loved this hotel, the staff were excellent, extremely friendly & helpful. I had requested a room so that we could open the windows & see the Eiffel Tower and they gave us just that. 
It was a reasonably sized room & the bed was super comfy.  Bathroom was adequate, nothing fancy but everything worked! 
Trip was for my daughter to celebrate her birthday and we just had the best time. 
The location was great, within walking distance of the Arc de triomphe /Champs elysees and in the other direction the Eiffel Tower. 
I cannot comment on breakfast as we did room only but the breakfast room looked really nice. 
If you’re looking for good value in a nice location, close to metro stops you’ll not be disappointed.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Superb location, fantastic accommodation and wonderful staff/service
text:
Stayed for four nights in August 2022 as part of a trip around France. Easy to find, just a minute's walk from the Boissiere Metro station. Wonderful welcome received from reception staff who remained friendly and informative throughout our stay and would politely field any questions asked.
Our room, on the third floor, was a large family room with great air conditioning, excellent wi-fi connection and a view of the Eiffel Tower from the French door balcony. The room included 4 beds, ample storage for a family with 2 late teenage children, complimentary tea and coffee and a good size fridge. There is a Carrefour mini market 3 minutes walk away. 
Breakfast was continental style with fresh baguettes, a good pastries selection, hams, eggs, cheeses, yoghurt, cereal, fresh fruit, toast, coffee, juices etc. It was very good and the staff extremely welcoming and polite. 
The location, in a quiet side street is perfect with the Metro a minute's walk away and the Arc de Triomphe just a 10 minute walk.  There are lots of varied restaurants, bars and shops in the surrounding neighbourhood. 
All in all a wonderful experience at an excellent price and I would thoroughly recommend.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: First time in Paris
text:
Stayed here with my boyfriend for the first time in Paris, location was ideal, staff were friendly. Only downside for me was the breakfast. Wish there was a hot option. 

The towels we requested to not be clean to help with the environment but came back each day to what we thought were clean towels, but the odd one was dirty. So don't know if they just made them look tidier in the room. 

Would still recommend to family and friends and would come back again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: May 2022.. Third time staying here, doesn’t disappoint
text:
This was our third time staying at this hotel in May 2022,  It is still clean, friendly and the location is superb.
The breakfast is reasonable , self service and lots of options. The metro is less than a 5 minute walk. 
If you don’t mind a compact but clean room and good value then this is the hotel for you.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Family Trip
text:
Myself & my family (2 kids, husband & my parents) stayed here in 2 separate rooms. My parents stayed in a double room with the most beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower and we decided to opt for one of the apartments, both were spotless with comfortable beds and air con, the apartment was ideal with a little kitchen for cooking and a supermarket about a 3min walk away which was perfect to top up the fridge with snacks for the kids. The hotel itself was in a perfect location with popular sites only a short stroll away, the metro is also very close. There's a lot of restaurants close by so something to suit every taste is within reach. 
All the staff we met there were all very friendly, welcoming and helpful. 

We were sad to leave and are already planning our return trip.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Short stay
text:
Very impressed with this hotel, ideally situated only 3 min walk from arc de triumph and 10 mins walk from Eiffel Tower , staff were great and so friendly , nothing was a trouble. 

Nice continental breakfast which was available till 1100 which allowed a lie in. Rooms are on the small side but adequate  and spotlessly clean, we were given a room upgrade for the first night to a deluxe double which has a small balcony with unbelievable view of the Eiffel Tower , thanks to the hotel for doing that my daughter really loved it . 

One thing if your are going as the hotel have difficulty with ordering taxis and you really need Uber if you intend to use taxis in Paris , no fault of the hotel but just a tip.

Very reasonably priced given the location.

Thanks to the staff for a great stay 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Fab Hotel, Great Location
text:
Chose to stay in this hotel as it was an area of Paris we hadn't visited or stayed in on previous trips.  What a great choice!
We had Room 611 on the top floor and we overlooked the street.  On opening the window and looking to the left the Eiffel Tower was in plain sight!  What a view!  We'd obviously spotted the tower on arrival from the front entrance but really didn't expect to be able to view it from our room when we hadn't booked a balcony.
Yes, the rooms are quite small.  But really what do you expect from an old Parisian building?  The bed was super large, very comfy with luxurious bedding which was changed regularly during our 4 night stay.  The bathroom was a good size with a powerful shower and plenty of towels (changed daily) and toiletries.
Breakfast was good with lots of choice from a super coffee machine (strong coffee),  fruit juices, pastries, ham, salami, cheeses, breads (incl gluten free option), fresh fruit and yoghurts from the fridge, oh and cereals.  The coffee machine had several options including hot chocolate.  Enough to keep you sightseeing for a good few hours.
All the staff we encountered were friendly, helpful and efficient.  Our French is pretty rusty but we tried (with the odd English word thrown in) and the staff really appreciated our shoddy efforts.
Located just over Ave Kleber there are loads of places to eat and drink nearby. The Trocadero area is only about a 10 min walk as is the Arc de Triomphe.  All in all a brilliant location with a metro station and bus stops on Ave Kleber so not too far to walk to get onto public transport.
Highly recommend.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Paris trip
text:
Nice hotel, clean and cozy.  Arch of Triumph and Eiffel tower are in walking distance
High quality of good value of money
For us best surprise was balcony and specially view from there- directly to Eiffel tower. 
You must visit the hotel, to see this... and be ready for something special about 11 pm ;)
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Perfect hotel in Paris
text:
Our first time in Paris and this was a perfect hotel for us.
The location is fabulous for the effiel tower you can see it from outside the hotel and the Arc de Triomphe which is just up the road.

Staff are all really lovely and friendly, breakfast was brilliant no cooked but you really don’t need it so much choice.

Lots of restaurants around the hotel to choice from.

Rooms have all you need - let’s face it if your in Paris you only need a room to crash in at the end of a busy day.

Loved our stay and would definitely come back
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Good location
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice hotel, great location, lovely staff
text:
We’ve previously booked hotels where we’ve discovered that the publicity photographs bear little resemblance to reality. The Elysee Union isn’t one of them. Arriving late on a beautiful Parisienne evening, what we had seen on their website was exactly what we got……The Eiffel Tower appearing to touch the sky at the end of the street. Minutes later the iconic structure lit up the night with its after dark light show. Score one to the Elysee Union!! 
Hotel staff could not have been nicer or kinder and remained that way throughout or four night stay. Our room was clean, comfortable and well appointed and the staff who looked after the room did a wonderful job. 
On our first morning we decided to have breakfast at a nearby establishment that enjoyed very good reviews. It was a lovely place but the food didn’t live up to the hype. The rest of our stay we took breakfast in the hotel and the choice and quality of the buffet put the more expensive restaurant to shame. 
Location wise the hotel sits between two world famous landmarks. Step out the front door, turn left and a short stroll away is the Eiffel Tower. Out the door, turn right and another short stroll away is the Arc de Triomphe.  The street that the hotel is situated in is quiet. The surrounding area has a good selection of bars, cafes and restaurants. All in all we felt the location was ideal. 
Given the fabulous location, the kindness and helpfulness of the staff, the standard of the room and the breakfast, I’d have no hesitation in recommending the Elysee Union to anyone heading to Paris for a break, it’s certainly a hotel that we’ll stay at again. 
We had a late flight home and to help us make the most of our last day in Paris, the hotel took care of our baggage.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice and responsible for Paris
text: Great friendly staff, Brice, Francesca, and all the front desk staff were great. Very helpful with all my needs. Nice location and quiet. I you like walking a bit to the metropolitan as it is a little distance but it is still cheaper than being in the heart .
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Amazing location, Great view from hotel room.
text: Stayed here with my daughter, the check in was welcoming. Upon arrival we was told we had been given a room upgrade with a balcony and a view of the Eiffel tower (amazing). A cot was in the room as requested. We had breakfast in the morning where there was plenty of fresh food to eat and a highchair was there for my little girl. Perfect stay! Thank you
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Friendly hotel with great views and location
text: Spent four nights in this lovely hotel. The staff are helpful, the breakfast was great and the location was perfect for my needs. Having seen the views on the website I had requested a room with a view if possible - when I arrived they said unfortunately they didn't have a room with a view that night but would move me the next day. So helpful. Next day I came back to a room right up on the 6th floor where I could look out of my window and see the Eiffel Tower. Amazing! Thank you for a great stay.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: One of the best city trips
text: The hotel was fab, the room was clean and staff were very nice, located in a brilliant area that is easy to get to, the hotel is just as you would picture a boutique Parisian hotel, well stocked bar and fabulous outdoor seating area,as a a solo traveller I felt just at home
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great Location and Service
text: A small group of us stayed at the Hotel Elysees Union in August.  The rooms were small, which is consistent with many European hotels, but the hotel was great.  The hotel was very conveniently located; we walked to the Eiffel Tower, Champs Elysees and various restaurants in minutes.  One minute out the door were great cafes.  It was less than a 10 minute casual walk to the Eiffel Tower or Champs d'Elysees.  The breakfast was adjusted for the Covid-19 environment, but it was plentiful and very well done.  The staff was very professional and helpful from check-in to check-out.  When you can see the Eiffel Tower from your hotel window or stand in front of the hotel and get a close-up view of the Tower when it is beautifully  lit at night -- it is fabulous.  I would gladly stay her again!  No major complaints and we had a great vacation.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: beautiful view
text: Beautiful charming hotel, I had a good stay, ideally located for my business meetings, I loved this hotel for its beautiful view of the Parisian monuments, the staff were also charming, the check in was fast, very good restaurants in the neighborhood, I will come back with my family soon
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great location
text: Hotel is in a great location and lots of local bars and cafes nearby, quiet location but also close to the most important parts of the city. Staff were welcoming and very helpful. They should be recognized for this.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Perfect for a couple of days
text:
Right in the heart of it all. 
5 min walk to Trocadero, 15 min to the Eiffel tower and 10 minutes to the Arc de Triomphe.

The price was right, the location excellent and the room clean, small, super quiet but the AC didn't work properly.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Hotel Elysee Review (4/6 Septembrie 2020)
text:
Perfect location for easy access.
3 *  small rooms. Double bed room and single bed in the same room. (you need to push the single bed to be able to open the window.)
Breakfast very limited. And I mean very limited. (coffee machine, tea) 1 type off cereals,  boild egg, 1 small plate 2 slices off salmi and 2 slices off bacon)
Orange juice and apple juice.
Each table 1 bascket with few pastries products.
AND the Big Suprise.
The request 100 euro deposit to be paid after you pay for booking.
This 100 euro it is a deposit because in the room you have a mini fridge. (6 items)
When you book before 12.00 they will send sombody to check the room and make the transfer back to you account.
😂😂😂😂😂.
Sometimes you need 2 week's to take the money back. Depending off what banck you are using.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Perfect location
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights, in July 2020 .the location Is perfect for getting around and sight seeing, also for restaurants and supermarket ( Carre four). ..
We stayed in a triple room, myself,partner & son, whilst it was a small room it was perfect for our 3 nights - any longer though & I think we would have struggled for space.
The staff are exceptional, everyone really friendly & helpful - their English leaves me ashamed of my Standard GCSE French ....
The breakfast is enough to get you started on your day, the bed was very comfy and we all slept well .
We would recommend and definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: We never got there, but...
text: I was due to celebrate my 40th birthday at this property in March 2020. Unfortunately, part-way through our European trip, border closures and self-isolation rules became enforced. So, our long-awaited visit to Paris came to an end before we even got to France. I called the property to see what options were available for us - not expecting much... but they refunded our pre-paid booking. They were also really compassionate over the phone despite the fact that they themselves were impacted by what was happening. Thank you Hotel Élysées Union - we will be back when things return to normal!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Disgraceful Treatment
text:
We have a planned trip for our 13 year old daughters birthday in April, a few days in Paris taking in the sights. I have tried effortlessly to contact the hotel as our 10 year old son is chronic asthmatic and with COVID-19 and the UK in lockdown as well as Paris, Spain etc this disgraceful institute of a hotel are still encouraging my family to travel even though they know about the worldwide pandemic. I have asked several times for a refund but been refused point blank. Money grabbing at a new low. I’m unable to change my trip to any other time due to annual holiday leave, if they had shown more empathy to the world wide pandemic and a genuine care for their customers I would have gladly rebooked with them once the world is back to normal. I WOULD STRONGLY ADVISE NOT TO STAY IN THIS HOTEL as they have zero care for customers and their wellbeing. 
France has the 3rd highest death % compared to confirmed cases only Italy and Spain are higher, and we have a company showing ZERO care or compassion and almost forcing people to travel and go against ALL government advise for their own self gain. Appalling level of service you should be a shamed.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Location
text: The room was not that big but it was clean, fine and quiet, what I love was the location ,Eiffel Tower and Arc the Triomphe are just a few meters away,the place is also sorrounded by good restaurants.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Paris vacation
text: Nice small hotel, you can walk to the Arc of Triumphe and Champs Elysees from here, also if you are taking the Big Bus is a stop right at the Arc of Triumphe witch is very convenient. Rooms  are clean and they have a small variety breakfast in the morning but good enough to start the day and go to explore the city, They don’t have a restaurant so you have to go out for your meals but there are restaurant around. You have a view of the Eiffel Tower witch is nice if is your first time in Paris. Elevator is very small you may have to take two trips to bring your luggage up to the room. We got there early in the morning so they storage our suitcases in a room so we were able to star our adventure. Helpful staff and they have shuttles to the airport.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Little Gem
text:
We stayed in this hotel as a family of 4 in a quadruple room. The room was located at the front of the hotel so we could see the famous tower from our window - amazing! I had requested a room at the front and was really pleased that the lovely reception staff honoured this. 

The best thing about this hotel is the wonderful location. You really feel like you are staying the ‘Chelsea’ of Paris. Beautiful architecture and so close to Champs Elysee, Arc De Triomphe - 10 minutes walk - and metro system. 

Breakfast was plentiful and more than ample. Staff were really welcoming and lovely to our girls (who loved the sweet bowl on the reception desk!). 

I would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel and would love to stay again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Ideal Location
text:
We spent a couple of nights at this hotel and were not disappointed. The location is ideal - lots of main attractions within walking distance including Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées, Louvre. Also very close to Charles de Gaulle rail station which took us straight to Euro Disney. Subway line close by too for those who prefer not to walk everywhere. 
The hotel itself is small and friendly. We are a family of four - kids are 13 and 11 - room was comfortable enough with a double bed and 2 single camp beds. Kids said they were comfy enough. Room wasn’t huge but bigger than we’d expected after reading the reviews. Hotel staff were very helpful and gave us lots of good advice about trains and best walking routes etc. 
Taxi from the airport to hotel was a fixed price of 50 euros - cheaper than transfer bus for 4 of us. Think that’s about 18 euros per person. 
I’d definitely recommend this hotel for people who like to be central and like walking to the sights.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Good location!
text: This is an average hotel in a very good location. It is located between the arc de triomphe/ Champ elysee and Trocadero where you can view the Eiffel tower. It also near a pharmacy and couple of restaurants and in between 2 stops of Big Bus tour.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Family of Five - 2 bed apartment
text: A good choice in central Paris. Only 600m to the Arc de Triomphe. Worth knowing that the Charles de Etoille metro stop by the Arc de Triomphe will also give you good access across Paris and also the RER A Line train service out to Marne le Vallée (Disney). The hotel receptionists speak good English, the breakfasts were substantial - with nice continental options (Crosisant, Pain au Chocolat, Baguette, Cheese, Ham, Salami etc but also a range of yogurts and cereals. The rooms are clean, functional, well maintained, if perhaps a little dated in style. The two bedroom apartment we stayed in had a double bed in one room plus en-suite and flat screen TV, two single beds in the other room and large central lounge which had a good sofa bed. The apartment had a seperate small kitchenette off the lounge and also another bathroom with toilet and shower. Recommended.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: fantastic weekend
text:
Last minute weekend birthday  break with my daughter..absolutely fantastic from beginning to end
Paris amazing this hotel so well located spotlessly clean lovely and warm and the reception staff are all fantastic
Best wishes
Steff and Savannah x
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Beautiful boutique hotel 💃🏼
text:
Walking down the street to a view of the Eiffel Tower was amazing! The hotel room was gorgeous, great location to Champs-Élysées and of course the Eiffel Tower, I was part of a hen party and staff got us all checked in and sorted very quickly. Breakfast was fine as well. I’d say this hotel is well above 3 stars! 

Highly recommended and would return again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice cosy spot in central spot.
text: It was hard to judge this one properly as the train strike in Paris really took a lot away from the trip. We were lucky that from here we could easily walk to Champs Elysees and Eiffel Tower. The hotel was quite old and dated, however the amenities were good for the price. We had the 2 bedroom apartment which had two bathrooms and an old kitchen with a washing machine which was handy. The breakfast wasn't too bad either. Thete was some noise from works going on that woke us 2 mornings but they were next door. Would stay again if we had the family or on a budget. If I was just with my wife, would likely go a little more up market.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Hidden gem in the heart of it all ❤️
text:
We have had the most amazing stay here over Christmas.  
A charming boutique typically Parisian hotel right in the heart of it all.
I have travelled with my daughter who is in an electric wheelchair and we had equiptment delivered to the hotel.
I knew this was a typical Parisian hotel, that's what I wanted. 
Via phone calls and emails, Victor and Suzan who were were so efficient, they arranged everything perfectly, even a taxi to collect us.  Customer service at its finest. We even had a room with a balcony that looked onto the Eiffel tower. So beautiful to wake up to and watch lit up and sparkling on in the evening.
15 mins walk away to the Tower and the Arc de triomphe. Perfect destination. Surrounded by restaurants, bars and supermarkets.
The room was typically Parisian but a fair size. Comfortable beds, mini bar stocked with treats if needed.
Such a clean hotel with polite, friendly, helpful and courteous staff.
Breakfast was your typical continental.  Be warned, the smell of fresh baking croissants will wake you, so lovely ❤️ 

We have thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, we would DEFINITELY return.  If you are reading this now wondering whether to book, then you must.

Suzan, thank you for being amaxing. Victor too. 
All the staff here went above and beyond.  I can't recommend this hidden treasure enough. 

Thank you so much for making Christmas so memorable for both of us 🥰🎄
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Exceptional staff with great location
text: First trip to Paris for family and gradmother.  Staff at front desk is wonderful.  Extremely friendly and personable. We stayed in a family apartment.  The extra room was great for 2 kids.  Beds are low to the floor. Americans - hotel does not supply was cloths. Bring your own if you prefer.   Breakfast was included in our rate.  Great way to start our day and ful range of choices.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Amazing option for a 3 night stay in Paris!
text: W were greetd by the very friendly staff upon our arrival. The flight from Dubai landed at 9 am and our check-in time was not until 2pm meaning our room was not ready. Howeever the friendly staff let us put our big luggage bags in a secure and locked room behind the check in desk which was amazing. We then had the option to walk around the Champs Elysees for a bit. The location of his hotel is amazing. It is walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de triomphe and is located next to amazing hotels and restaurants. There is also a convenient bus stop down the road. The hotel breakfast is not free at the time of our stay but was amazing. The options were not exactly huge like you would experience at a Hilton or Marriot but they tasted amazing. Featured all types of cold cuts, crepes, bakery times, yoghurt, juices, fruits etc. The rooms were not that big but they were nonetheless clean and modern. Overall this was an excellent option for a 3 night stay and i will for sure return here. The best thing about this hotel was the excellent location and the friendly staff/
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great little place!
text: Lovely hotel with views of the Eiffel Tower from many rooms and the street. Located perfectly between Trocadéro and the Eiffel Tower. Very walkable. Rooms are clean and was surprised by the storage in a European hotel. My daughter and I had plenty of space! Staff is very friendly!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: A quaint hotel near everything in Paris
text: Continuing our firt Foray to Europe, we hoped on a train leaving Amsterdam & we head to Paris for a 2nd leg. We stayed at this nice quaint hotel in the Brasserie area a stone throw away from the Arc & chomps elysees. It was a small hotel, rooms small also. But service was very good. Staff vert helpful very friendly contrary to popular belief french people are arrogant & impolite. Hotels location top notched, very near the Metro trains making your planned site visits easy. I recommend this hotel if you plan to visit Paris.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Not Impressed
text:
The location is the only good thing going for this hotel.  I understand that hotel rooms in Europe are small, however this was beyond small. We could not believe how small this room and the bathroom was.  The window opened up to a dark tunnel of ugly concrete walls of other buildings.
We had just checked in after a long flight from the USA and were in the room about 20 minutes when a staff member just walked right in on us.  No knock at the door, nothing.  When I asked why, she said she was just checking in on us. Weird.
We could not get the safe to work and all of the staff that we came across at the front desk were rude and unhelpful as far as recommendations or directions go.
Without a doubt, we would not stay here again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Lovely hotel, good location for Eiffel Tower
text: Stayed here for 3 nights with my best friend and her family for a girls holiday. Location is good for the Eiffel Tower and Arc De Triomphe. We had an apartment within the hotel which slept 6, there were 5 of us and it was spacious with 2 bathrooms, lovely kitchen with tea and coffee facilities. The room was quite hot at times but we opened the window and this was fine. Staff were friendly! Couldn’t fault the room. As we left there were charges for water on our bill which we had not had, these were removed straight away without argument. A very enjoyable stay!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Good location, Average hotel
text:
The overall experience was no more than average at best. We have both done a fair amount of international travel, so we are familiar and totally fine with smaller hotel rooms from time to time. That being said, this room was very small (bathroom as well). The location is good as you can walk to many locations you would want to see in Paris and walking out of the hotel to see the Eiffel Tower is definitely a plus. 

That being said, the red flag for us was coming back to a room door that was left open by the cleaning crew. The room door must have not shut all the way as they left the room (innocent mistake), however obviously many of our belongings were in the room all day and this could’ve been a bad situation for us. When we brought this to the attention of hotel staff, the response was less apologetic and more “well good thing nothing happened”. 

Overall it served it’s purpose as a place to sleep but don’t expect much else.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great hotel wonderful location
text: We recently stayed here. Wonderful hotel,clean rooms,friendly and helpful staff. Great location in the city. Close to the Effiel Tower and other attractions. Great resturants right down the street. Close to lovely cafes for the great people watching.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Clean, modest.
text: This hotel is in an amazing location, walking distance to all of the major tourist spots. The staff is very friendly. My only complaint is there was a sign, that said if you hang your towels the hotel will not wash your towels as a means of saving water. We hung up our towels each day, but were still given new towels daily. We are extremely eco conscious, and wanted to reuse our towels. Please do not urge visitors to save water, if the house keeping isn't going to take it seriously. There were environmental protests during our stay, so its ironic the hotel wasn't helping to instill good environmental habits.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great staff... great location
text: We stayed for four nights. The staff were very friendly, offering great tips and recommendations, and helping me practice my French.  We loved the location - It was an enjoyable walk to Arc de Triomphe, Trocadero and Eiffel Tower.  It had  great restaurants close by and easy access to metro stations.  Whilst the room was small, it was clean and the bed was comfortable.  The main draw of this hotel is its staff and its location.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great Location
text: We stayed here as part of our honeymoon and were not disappointed. So conveniently located to the Eiffel Tower and the Arc De Triompe (which is also where all of the hop on hop off buses stop, bonus). Staff were friendly and helpful, breakfast was good but we ended up going to a restaurant just around the corner (Cafe Belloy) which had more of a selection. Room was clean and comfortable and they have a luggage room for storage. Definitely would recommend and we will stay again when we come back to Europe next year.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Good value near Arc De Triomphe
text: The Hotel is convient to the Eiffel Tower, the Arc De Triomphe as well a near by metro station.  The room was a little cramped but clean.  Good shower.  The breakfast was good.  The desk service 24 hours and helpful.  Have bagage hold area.  Generally quiet.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great hotel and location
text: Came for the weekend with friends, hotel is in a great location and good value for money. Staff on reception were very friendly and helpful. Short walk to the Eiffel Tower and lots of nice restaurants nearby. Will stay again
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great Location
text: My husband and I just got back from a Viking Cruise but we stayed one night in this hotel. It is so convenient to all the sites in Paris.  A descent quality breakfast was had the next morning. Despite the size of the rooms, they were quite comfy and cozy.  They gave great directions for us in the morning.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Good location for exploring the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe and The Louvre
text: Comfortable, clean room and quiet location. Good breakfast. Air conditioning in room a little weak but ok as weather was cool during my stay. Easy to reach the Eiffel Tower and Arc on foot. A short run on the Metro to The Louvre. Numerous places to eat nearby. Travelled by Eurostar and would recommend getting a taxi from the station as it was quite a walk!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great Hotel!!!
text: Was there over the weekend and our stay was amazing!!   Great location and the staff was amazing.   Suzana at the front desk was exceptional remembering our names every time we walked through and made us feel so at home.   The location was great - you could see the Eiffel Tower as soon as you walked at and there were so my cafes right there to choose from.    Definitely would stay again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Excellent Service!!!!
text: Our visit to Paris, booked  hotel and the stay here was fabulous. The hotel is lovely, with comfortable accommodations. Great location- we could see Eiffel Tower from hotel entrance. Also able to walk to Arc de Triumphe.The staff is very friendly and helpful. Loved breakfast as well. Great hotel!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Simple hotel in a great location
text: The hotel is clean and simple. It is in a great location. It was very easy to walk to the Eiffel Tower and the arc de triomphe. The room had plenty of space for our family of four (young kids). The front desk staff was very helpful.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: quick stay with my son
text: This hotel is a perfect location.  Room is clean and a good size. The receptionist lady was so helpful and could not do enough for us.  I bought a children's french book for my son and she even translated it for him into English. nothing was too much.  Perhaps the best receptionist staff I have ever come across.  They could not accommodate a lower floor for us but helped us with local restaurants, sights to see, times to visit sites, supermarkets, bakeries etc.  My son said it was perfect and he wants to stay there again.  Thats good enough for me to rebook.  lovely.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Charming hotel in a great location!
text:
This hotel was exactly what we were looking for in Paris. It is about a 15 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe, a 20 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower, and a short walk to many nearby restaurants. We had a great view of the Eiffel Tower nighttime light show from right outside the lobby. The lobby was a very attractive and inviting area with a nice sitting area on one side and a comfortable little bar on the other. Past the reception desk was a very pleasant outdoor courtyard with tables and chairs.
The staff was welcoming, friendly, and helpful. Our room was very clean, quiet, and comfortable with a nice view overlooking the courtyard. There was a large closet and a beautiful bathroom.
Complimentary breakfast, served in a spacious dining area downstairs from the lobby, was delicious and had multiple items from which to choose. A perfect way to start the day.
We loved this charming Parisian hotel and will stay there again next time we're in Paris. We HIGHLY recommend it.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: 40th anniversary
text: Hotel in perfect location the staff very helpful room clean and compact but very comfortable. The reception helped to book us a dinner cruise for the thursday night which was a great help as they know all the best deals. Only 800 metres away from the arc de triomphe, about a 20min stroll from the Eiffel tower and metro very close as well. If your flying in would recommend the le-bus direct airpot to arc de triomphe in 45mins then a short walk to hotel.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great location
text: Friendly apartment hotel very centrally located. Half way between the Arc de Triomph and the Trocadéro/ Eiffel Tower. We had a two bedroom apartment with a kitchenette and most importantly a washer/drier. Apartments are clean and nicely decorated but not luxurious. Everything worked. Had a king bed, twin beds in second bedroom and a single sofa bed in lounge. It’s a complex building with some rooms requiring the use of lifts and stairs, so if you can’t handle stairs, let the hotel know in advance. Handy for Metro too. Would be happy to stay here again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Family's First Trip to Paris
text:
Great hotel, great location - we had a family suite which gave us two bathrooms (one ensuite) and a kitchen which was big plus as there is a supermarket round the corner and helped keep food costs down with 3 big kids in tow.

Great location to see Eiffel at night just pop downstairs and on to the street, with arc round the other corner fab location. (also near a metro spot)

would definitely recommend and return to stay again
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel and great location. Stayed with my husband and 3 kids in one of the family apartments. Very clean and convenient. The kitchen was a big plus for us because our son has a food allergy so we cooked breakfast everyday. A great supermarket a couple of blocks away. Go there and stock up on water bottles...you'll save soooo much money. Room was very clean and housekeeping was fantastic. The location was awesome. Blocks from the Champs Elysees, Arc de Triumph and the Eiffel Tower. Restaurants in the area were great and very accommodating (Cafe Belloy and Le Compernc were our favorite. Staff was very helpful and arranged transportation and helped us around town. Highly recommend!!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Amazing location and staff.
text: Rooms were cleaned to a high standard and staff was EXTREMELY helpful with everything. Location was perfect and walking distance from Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triumph. We went during a heatwave and the aircon was not strong enough to handle it.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Best Location
text:
Just 1. 4 kms by walk away from the Eiffel Tower, makes this hotels location prime.
Easy access to metro. 
Good family rooms. Friendly staff. 
Very near to arc de triumph and champs Élysées. 
Take the family room which is on the 4th floor. 
Breakfast is good . They allow late check out upon request.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great hotel for a large family
text: The hotels location is vey near many attractions and metro stops. We are a family of five with three kids. We enjoyed one of the apartments in the hotel and found it nicely furnished and perfect for our needs. The beds were a bit on the hard side as my personal preference goes. The staff was very friendly and helpful with any questions or assistance needed. The daily breakfast was good and a great start to our days.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice Hotel-Fantastic Service
text: This is a very nice, clean, boutique hotel located within walking distance from the Arc de Triomphe, the Champs-Elysees and the Eiffel Tower in the 16th arrondissement of Paris. The woman who checked us in (I didn't get her name) was fantastic as she was high energy, enthusiastic, service-oriented and had a wonderful sense of humor.  She should work for the Paris Chamber of Commerce as she was a true ambassador for the city and made us feel incredibly welcomed the moment we stepped into the hotel. The room was clean and very functional and enjoyed had a nice view of the Eiffel Tower.  They serve a nice breakfast of French pastries, fresh fruit, juice and coffee.  The entire staff is friendly, hard working and engaging.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Amazing breakfast - nice hotel
text:
This hotel has a great location (let alone view from outside) 10 minute walk in either direction to either effiel tower or Arc de Triumph . Hotel is clean and spacious. Breakfast was awesome - could not fault !
2 adults and 2 young children. Bathroom smalll but perfectly useable and clean. I would definatly stay here again and would 100% recommend staying here
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Comfortable Quatro Room
text:
Comfortable and clean. You may have a headache since the building and interiors are old while the rooms are well appointed. 
Satisfactory breakfast spread. No hot dishes or omellettes served. 
Top marks for proximity to prime landmarks of Paris. 
Many Eating joints close by.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Quaint Hotel
text:
We enjoyed this hotel as the second stop on our European trip. The Hotel is conveniently located. We could see the Eiffel Tower from our hotel window. 

The staff was kind and accommodating. The breakfast was included and gave us a nice start to the day. The restaurants in the area are extremely tasty. 

I would highly recommend this hotel location.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Whistle stop tour Paris
text: This hotel is excellently located for Eiffel Tower and Arc du triumph. Both around 10 minutes walk away. It is a boutique hotel with quirky rooms. Very clean. Excellent choice for breakfast. Staff could not do enough to help and Suzanne at reception stands out for exceptional service. Good choice if reasonable priced restaurants close by.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great location and service. Highly recommended.
text: Personnel is very friendly and helpful. They speak several languages and are always willing to help with any need. Hotel itself is what you would expect from an old building, with small rooms and bathrooms. But what it lacks in comfort, it makes up with great service. Excellent location close to many attractions and restaurants and shops. We chose the rooms that were on the street side, and we could see the Eiffel tower from the windows, but I would not say it is a must. Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Wonderful location, freindly reception staff
text:
We stayed 6 nights in an apartment. The hotel is in a great part of Paris and walking distance to so much that Paris has to offer. Reception staff were very friendly and spoke a range of languages which was very helpful considering my French is very limited.
The only negative comment I would have is the apartment was advertised as 2 bedroom / 2 bathroom, however in the apartment we had, there was a full en-suite attached to the main bedroom, but only a toilet (WC) off the lounge - therefore our 2 teenage boys had to come through the main bedroom to access a bathroom. However, overall a wonderful hotel in an exceptional location.
When we return to Paris for our next vacation, we will definitely stay here.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Fall visit with my mother in law
text: Wonderful people at the hotel, cozy accommodations and within walking distance of the Tower and many other areas.  The breakfast buffet was wonderful with the aroma of baking croissants wafting throughout the hotel first thing in the morning.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Lovely Hotel - Breakfast disappointing
text:
We’ve just got back from a 3 night stay at this hotel. It’s in a brilliant location for exploring Paris and also posses a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower. The Arc de Triomphe is also a short walk away as well as the Champ Elysees. 

We too were informed that the city tax had increased upon check in, until I showed the email confirmation which showed the price of the booking (This included city tax at the point of booking) The additional price was then wavered. 

Breakfast was somewhat disappointing. I had read reviews previously that there was a good selection of food available. Obviously this depends on what you expect. However having paid an extra £15 per person - per day, I would have thought there would be more on offer. It’s perfect if you like cornflakes, chocolate cornflakes, fruit, yoghurt, pastries (croissants, pan au chocolat etc) but that appeared to be all that was available. Bread was also available but no where to “toast”. I personally didn’t feel it was worth the additional money for a bowl of cornflakes, a croissant and a little bit of fruit each morning was good value - especially when you’ve a full day of exploring to do! **tip** head to breakfast before 08:30, as it gets VERY busy with no where to sit. The breakfast room is very small and with many people trying to grab food from the serving counter, it can get a little frustrating when people are pushing/shoving you about. We observed many people being sent away and told to come back as there were no tables available. 

Generally, we were out at 9am and didn’t return until 8pm the last 2 days we were there (we learnt to get the breakfast early) so we only needed a bed to sleep in. It was clean & tidy and the hotel staff were friendly and welcoming. 

Our room had a kettle with coffee sachets and a fridge. The hair dryer in the bathroom was not worth using as there was hardly no power in it. I’d recommend bringing your own hairdryer if you need to dry your hair quickly! The view from our room was somewhat disappointing but again, we wasn’t in the room enough to appreciate a better view.

Apart from the above, we would stay at the hotel again but not pay for breakfast. There are plenty of restaurants around the area where you can buy breakfast, which would be more fulfilling and cheaper. 

Paris is a beautiful city and we loved every minute of exploring it. (We’ve now come home for a rest! :-).   )

Can’t wait to return again - Merci Paris
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great location but disappointing room
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed at this hotel for 3 nights, the location is amazing, about a 20 minute walk to the effiel tower and not far from the arc. Was abit disappointed with the room as we had high expectations but were given a ground floor disabled room, neither me or my boyfriend are disabled. Also the key was very old fashioned (it was an actual key) and had trouble opening the door multiple times which I can only assume to be a result of the old lock? It was disappointing as we had requested a room with a view as it was our anniversary but I understand most people will want a view and it is hard to supply everyone. Also we noticed on arrival that we, as british people, had to pay more city tax than the spanish people who were checking in before us? i’m unfamiliar with the law so that might be legitimate but we was quite confused. However the man on reception was very friendly and extremely bilingual, he switched to your language whenever you came into contact. A very beautiful hotel and will likely stay again, just a disappointing room application but we was hardly in it so we still had an amazing holiday!!!!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Beautiful hotel in a great spot!
text: Such a nice hotel in a fantastic spot. So close to the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe and some fantastic restaurants so close to the hotel. We had a family room and it was great and staff were very friendly. It’s a little gem and will gladly stay there again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice hotel in a great location
text: The hotel took a day or so to get used too for certain things. We are a family of 3 and the room was a bit small but with so much to do around it wasn’t that big of a deal.  The front desk staff bent over backwards to help with anything they could, we even happened to be there on the day they swapped out all the mattresses in the hotel and they even did everything they could to make sure we weren’t bothered by it. The location can’t be beat. It’s a quick walk to the Eiffel Tower and the Arc is at the end of the street. Restaurants and grocery stores (we needed to get some bottles of water) are all over.  Overall a really good experience staying there.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: First visit to Paris, great base
text:
My husband and I stayed here during our first visit to Paris.
It's a lovely wee hotel, close to Eiffel Tower and handy for various Metro stations.  Our room was clean and well equipped.  
Staff friendly, nice hotel and well situated for sightseeing.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Nice hotel with great view of Eiffel tower
text:
Hotel, the lobby, the outdoor courtyard was quite nice.  We got a room overlooking the courtyard even tho I requested a Eiffel Tower view. I booked a room for 4 and did 
not realize one of the two beds would be a luncomfortable pull out sofa. We did sleep fine tho so really cannot complain. Very convenient location with great cafes, short walk to metro, short walk to Eiffel Tower or arc de triumph. Breakfast was ok, good pastries, cereals, lunch meat, cheese, oj, coffee; definitely not an American type breakfast. Pharmacy very close. Overall I would stay here again.
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Paradise in Paris
text: Have you ever been awakened by the lovely smell of freshly baked French bread and croissants in the morning? in a hotel bed? Well, I had never experienced such pleasure; not at least until March of this year when I stayed at the Hotel Élysée Union! Well located, safe and with impeccable service, the hotel and its staff assured me the return of every euro invested in my trip to Paris. Worth it!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Fantastic, friendly Hotel
text:
I don't usually leave reviews but after a 2 night stay in this hotel I just had to write and tell you all how fantastic this hotel is! We were a group of 5 staying in 2 rooms celebrating my sister's 40th and everything about our stay was just fantastic. Rooms are basic but spotlessly clean. We requested a room with view of the tower, we got one, we requested the two rooms were close to each other, again no problem. The location of the hotel was brilliant. Walking distance to both the tower and Arc Di Triomphe. The subway was 4 mins away which we used frequently. Neighbourhood was safe and there was lovely bistro's just 2 mins walk away from the hotel. 

Breakfast was lovely and plenty of choice. But it was the staff who really are the 5 stars of this hotel. Suzanne and Victor could not have been more friendly and welcoming!!! They make you feel totally at ease from the moment you arrive and treated us like friends rather than total strangers or simply 'guests'. 

Suzanne organised a very last minute dinner cruise for us and even arranged the cruise company to play happy birthday to my sister and present her with candles on her dessert. She was just so funny and friendly only sad we didn't get to thank her personally before leaving. 

They jumped into action to help my sister when she hurt her ankle just hours before leaving for the airport. I would highly recommend this lovely hotel and hope you all experience the kindness and warmth that we did. 
Bravo to all the staff. Keep up the fantastic work!
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: Great stay!
text: We just had a 2 night stay with a 2 children under 4. The hotel itself was in a great location. The metro, tourist attractions, and restaurants just steps away. The room was just want we needed after a longs day of touring  the room was spacious and so was the bathroom. The staff was incredibly helpful, especially Suzanne! She made our stay that much more enjoyable guiding us to children friendly Paris. We would definitely come back! Merci 😃
name: Hotel Elysees Union

title: near transportation hub and cafes
text:
Good-location, breakfast, recently updated, small table and 2 chairs in room
Not good-weird shower that meant you always soaked the bathroom floor and into the hall, King-size bed was 2 twins that couldn't be pushed together
    Kind of an edgy Modern feel, but we found the front desk staff helpful.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: True budget hotel
text: Within walking distance of several Asian restaurants and one sex toy shop. No concierge, no electrical outlet in bathroom, no glasses in rooms only paper cups, room not vacuumed daily, trash not removed daily, water not replaced daily, no top sheet on bed, not within walking distance of major Paris attractions. Staff not very friendly. Only reason I would stay there again would be to economize on accommodations.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Enjoyed the visit
text: Cute boutique hotel in the middle of a number of bars and restaurants - also some adult entertainment places!  Nice friendly staff but our tour was running late on arrival due to Eurostar train backup and we had only a few minutes to throw our stuff in the room and meet back in the lobby for dinner.  This is one of those hotels where you have to put a room key in the spot by the door to have electricity.  So with lights on we discovered the room hadn’t been cleaned since last guest with used towels on the bathroom floor, an unmade bed and an empty coffee cup.  Got another room right across the hall right away and they did give us both a free drink that night for our trouble when hubby suggested it.  Unique light fixtures and such.  Awkward tub/shower because you can only get in from the opposite end from the shower head and it’s a big step up to do so.  The temperature and water flow are tricky to figure out and I was already in the tub since you can’t reach the controls otherwise and I got blasted with cold water!  However, the water pressure in the sink and shower are terrific, even too good in the sink as you can spray yourself due to rushing water! Temps in mid 70s and sunny made it warm with no a/c on, only a window and noisy from street even in 4th floor.  Interestingly the ground floor is floor 0.  Meeting rooms and parking are on -1 and -2. Breakfast ok not great.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Room for improvement
text:
As a whole the hotel was OK, however the clerk at the front desk called Alexandro gave us shocking service. He was extremely obnoxious and unwilling to help on all accounts.

He should not be dealing with paying customers at all.

The breakfast in the morning was the same thing everyday for 5 days straight.

Not a bad hotel but not great.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Very knowledgeable and friendly staff.
text: The hotel is set near the #13 metro which could get you anywhere. From the Orsey to the Louvé it’s within walking distance, the metro made it closer still. The room was immaculate and cozy with a nice view of an aspiring garden and chickens say hello if you open the window. The Breakfast room was a delight meeting any dietary requirement or need. From a rice pudding to French pastries, fresh fruit, eggs, meats, cheese, it was available. I can’t say enough about the staff. My room was always tidy and comfortable, and the reception area was as well. I had no problem communicating in English along with my very little French vocabulary.  I never felt so welcomed and relaxed. Thank you for opening your doors to our traveling tour group. Especially for myself since I had been traveling alone. The suggested Urbs app available for easy download and navigation was appreciated. I never once had a problem with the internet or entertainment. Did I mention the bed was the most comfortable and restful sleep I had?
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Good stay
text:
Wanted to give 4 out of 5 but could not. This is a clean, comfortable hotel, well run, nice service. Good room size for Paris hotel, worth noting this point. Breakfast ok, cooked food options very limited. Lobby area used extensively for  business travellers working, good vibe to the place.

Why 3 out of 5? Hotel is not a proper 4 star in my opinion. Every aspect of the rooms are designed and fitted to suit the hotel not the customer. Bathroom layout not good, toilet is boxed in on 3 sides, shower tray decent size but shower head offset to one side, irritating to use, towelling is poorly quality and undersized. Bedroom furniture might look ‘trendy’ but pretty basic. No trouser press, hair dryer…..

There is a safe and a small fridge in the room. Good size TV on the wall - all positive points.

You will not have a bad stay in this hotel, you will sleep well and eat ok. Hotel is in a good position for local restaurants and quick access into the city.

An experienced traveller using 4 stars hotels in Europe would pick up on these points. As a base for exploring Paris for a few days as a tourist you will not go wrong.

There is a 4 star boutique hotel next door to this hotel that is also worth considering.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Good location- not a 4 star hotel
text: The hotel looked pretty good online. The location is quote good also in real life but the hotel is not really a 4 star hotel. Horrible sleeping couch and quite bad attended bathroom.  Would not recomend.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Clean comfortable hotel in the heart of Montparnasse
text: Clean comfortable hotel in the heart of Montparnasse. Rooms are small but you will not get a bigger room in Paris unless you break the bank. The room was clean, shower was hot and hard, and the bed was a dream. It is in the vibey area of Montparnasse and there are bars and restaurants directly below you. Despite this the hotel room was really quiet and I did not hear a thing (I am a very light sleeper). I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this hotel. Check in was super quick and best of all the hotel has parking (you need to prebook and pay but this is a relief to know your car is safe under you). I would stay here again.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Good Hotel
text: Nice place, good staff and confortable bedroom. The parking entrance is too narrow ! It is not easy to turn and skills are needed to go down and up ! Otherwise, everything is fine and safety in the hotel is good regarding COVID.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Great Location and Stay
text:
I had a wonderful time staying at this hotel while in Paris. It was a little bit of a walk from the train station we got off at, but nothing crazy and there is a closer metro station to the hotel, it just didn't connect well with the train from the airport. The hotel has a very hipster feel when you walk in. The staff were always very nice, friendly and helpful. Our room was relatively large for Paris with a lovely balcony that we used every night. The road below was very busy and often quite noisy but I believe if we would have had the door closed it would not have been a problem. The only complaint I had was that the air conditioning was not very strong, but I think that is less a problem of the hotel and more a problem with my expectation since I live in the Southern US. 

I would absolutely stay at this hotel again and would recommend it to others.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Very good hotel.
text: Very clean hotel, friendly staff at reception, very helpful and ready to give advice on where to eat in the area. The room was spacious enough for two adults and a child, breakfast was good, would stay again should I need to travel from Montparnasse.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Last stay
text:
I have used this hotel many times over the last few years as the location is pretty spot on for the train station. However there is noticeable decline in standards in the last few months. 
During my most recent stay I could not have access to the iron, despite asking for it several of times. The hotel had an issue and had closed the ironing room, hence the 1-2 irons were lost in guests rooms, with no solution or contingency being offered. In addition the lifts (common occurrence) were not working properly and the final nail in the coffin was the fact the invoice took 1 wk and several calls and mails to be send out. Not acceptable for a hotel of that caliber. Real shame
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Lovely base for out City getaway
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights, with  my Mother and daughter,
The staff were all very friendly and helpful, the location ofthe hotel is great, close by to 3 metro lines, walking distance to many shops,bars,bakeries and restaurants I would definitely return.

The room we had was very spacious for the 3 of us.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Great but still to improve
text:
I love this hotel and stay there often. This said there are few important things to improve to make it great: Second elevator is “in maintenance” since too long and never really worked well. From time to time (rarely but still happening) some room can have a funny smell.
For the rest I can only have positive words about the place which is greatly located and very cozy. Prices should be a little lower some times but I understand the hotel is strong enough to not care about this Last point :)
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Good hotel
text:
A good hotel, friendly welcome at reception and a comfortable stay. Great location close to Montparnasse station. The bar/restaurant area was decent, though service could have been quicker. 

The lift is extremely slow to arrive, it was often much quicker to get the stairs. 

Highly recommended hotel.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Nice rooms, helpful staff
text: Right around the corner from Gare Montparnasse and catacombs - great location. Helped me out with early check-in really easily and helped in finding a bakery. Clean and neat rooms with a comfortable bed.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Worst Mercure I ever stayed in - NOT a 4 star hotel at all!
text:
Zero for customer service 
After waiting 4h for my room still got a room with one bed missing. 
Asked for a pillow for my kids (they had one but it was very low) and was told the pillows finished for today!  Although hotel is not full...most bizarre answer ever. 
This is definitely NOT 4 star hotel.  
Bathroom - only hand soap and refillable bottle of soap/shampoo in one (attached to the shower).  No other bathroom amenities provided. 
Rooms look very cheap. Generral feel of IKEA. You can have modern hotel with a style - this one is definitely NOT one of them.  
Coffee and tea at breakfast is a self service from a machine...I think that says it all :) 

This hotel should be under the Ibis umbrella - that's where it belongs.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: What wasn’t wrong?
text:
First they did not give my family and me a room until 4 pm and had us waiting in the lobby for over 2 hours. When they did give us a room they only had 1 ready not the 2nd one which we paid for. We traveled for over 24 hours to get to Paris and the lack of hospitality and punctuality was the last thing we wanted to deal with. To make it worse they did not offer any compensation for the inconvenience. Furthermore, The sheets are scratchy, the bed is thinner than my college dorm mattress. If we did not have a deposit down we would not be staying in this hotel. The only nice thing I have to say is that it’s clean. 

As a family we travel often and have stayed in great hotels and lower tear hotels. For a 4 star rating they are quite below average, I would put them closer to  2-3 stars.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Metro Morparnasse is a nightmare to navigate
text:
We were on our way from Scotland to Italy by rail and were passing through Paris and stayed in this hotel between connections at Gare du Nord and Gare du Lyon. 

Because of this we had to navigate the metro station at Gare Montparnasse, which is a rabbit warren full of miles and miles of tunnels, which is a nightmare whether you are tired or not.

 Gare Montparnasse is the closest metro stattion to this hotel.

It may be that a local knows a short cut through this metro station but we followed the signs.

The metro station changed our experience of this hotel

About the hotel:
o The lifts broke down in the morning just before we left. This was consideraby inconvenient with heavy bags
o other than that hotel was Ok ..
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Great location, great breakfast, great budget hotel
text:
This is quite a long review so a short version; great location, I'll definitely stay here again, details below :)

Location:
When staying in a city like Paris location is essential and this hotel is absolutely perfectly located for using as a base to explore from. 
The hotel is a 5 minute walk from Edgar Quinet, Gaite and 8-10 minute walk to Montparnasse Bienvenue metro stops which connects you with most of the city. There are a couple of supermarkets (including quite a large Monoprix) nearby which are perfect for picking up supplies like wine and snacks, there's a fairly decent bakery up by Gaite that does a nice ham baguette and some cakes.
Being situated on a vibrant and bustling Paris street there's a good choice on little restaurants nearby which seem to do quite a brisk trade with locals. There was pretty good sound-proofing in the street facing room we had but it didn't drown out some of the more 'determined' and vocal late-night revellers. 

Hotel facilities
Hotel reception sets the tone for this hotel, there is no formal reception desk to check-in. The casual feel is nice, the friendly staff quickly picked up on the slightly bewildered look on my face and check-in was completed at the bar. I like the slightly esoteric and 'random' feel to the decor, it feels less corporate and part of a chain, it gives the communal areas a more independent hotel feel.
The lifts in the building were a little sluggish, and took a while to respond to calls, so much so, that if possible it was frequently quicker to take the stairs. During our stay one of the lifts seemed to spend quite a bit of time out of service which really compounded the issue.
My only other criticism of this hotel was the peculiar 'drainage' smell that was present on the 3rd floor corridor. This was persistent but thankfully didn't permeate into the room so whilst it didn't cause any problems with the stay.
There is a secure luggage storage service in the basement, this is self-service and chargeable, it's not expensive (1 Euro for a few hours) but I was surprised I had to pay.
Breakfast is simply fabulous. Continuing the casual ethos, you find a space and eat there, this encourages a communal approach similar to that of hostels, if you want a table to yourself, that may be a little off putting but it works well, you don't have to speak if you don't want to! The choice is not exhaustive but it is enough and what is on offer is simply brilliant. The orange juice is dispensed from a machine which squeezes the juice from oranges on demand. There is a juicer and veggies also available. The bread is fresh and warm (courtesy of the oven). The cheeses are perfectly ripe. The fruit is also fresh not tinned. There was also sausage and bacon available as well as the most gorgeous scrambled eggs. The coffee is from one of those bean to cup machines and is only average compared to the rest of the fare on offer!

Room
Our room was spacious, clean and nicely decorated. The bed was comfortable and there were additional pillows available in the closet. The air-conditioning was handy at night as we had to keep the window closed to block out the noise from the street below. There were plenty of towels for the 3 of us and the complimentary toiletries (soap and shower gel) were of reasonable quality.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Good location, nicely furnished, friendly staff
text: Although it belongs to a chain, this hotel tries to stand out with some quirky furnishing and a casual breakfast room with country house touches.  Some of this is slightly annoying, such as breakfast cutlery being in a drawer of a cupboard across the room from the buffet!  However, this avoids the sterility of most chain hotels.  The room was clean, bright and of a reasonable size, but it was missing a proper work desk.  The location is good, with the Gare Montparnasse 10 minutes walk away, and numerous restaurants along the way.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: good time in Paris
text:
i love to be rue de la Gaite,the hotel is a perfect location for the theater and fine dining restaurant.
The staff is kind and professional.the room very quiet and comfortable.You need just to improve the quality of the key access to the room,i need to go to the front desk to reboot the key four time during my stay!
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Fun location near Gare Montparnasse !
text: This is my first time staying here; but I doubt that it is my last! The location is wonderful! Near the train station, and lots of théâtres, restaurant and bars! The room was quiet, clean, and large; and I had a bathtub! A plus for me!
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Big rooms
text: The rooms are huge for Paris standards. It was clean and maintained well. There were a lot of restaurants near the hotel so there’s no problem grabbing meals. The location is lovely too and it’s nice walking around just soaking the Parisian vibe in.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Leaves a bit to be desired
text: Stayed here for 3 nights had a fall over in reception and cut leg quite badly, the reception staff could not find a first aid kit and when they located it they couldn’t find the keys for the room it was in, 15 minutes later we got the kit there were no plasters only some gauze and some antiseptic spray. Disgraceful. Then yesterday we waited at the bar for about 10 mites trying to get a drink and no one took any notice of us so we left without. Would not return here
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Lost shoes
text:
As 4 star hotels go, this is a nice boutique hotel, next to gare montparnesse. It has a nice location and is close to many metro stations. The hote does not have a bussiness centre so is not good for travelers for bussiness and has a modest breakfast. Upon entrance, check in was not the greatest because the receptionist was not polite and said it was impossible to get our rooms as they were not ready till 2 pm . I had to call to her attention that i have booked the previous night in advance so my rooms would be ready, and magically they were. 
I am giving them the high rating however for their honesty, and integrity I had list my shoes in my room upon check out ( new and quite expensive). I called and asked and despite having to call again ( international) someone did respond and they had found my shoes. They also managed to ship them to me and have arrived safely to my home. High ethics and such behavior are what give a hotel a good name and the people who work in it respect. So thanks for finding my lost items and thanks for sending them back.
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Amazing experience in Montparnasse
text:
Stayed in Mercure Gaite for two nights. The bedroom was quiet and the decor matches with cool Montparnasse area!

We were 2 adults. Beds are very comfortable, shower with plenty of amenities (Nuxe). 

Breakfast was very very good! 

You need also to enjoy Jardin Luxembourg as its near to the hotel! 

Emilie, from the communications team was lovely and super nice! Always there if we needed something. 

Really recommend this Hotel!
name: Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse

title: Excellent hotel
text:
