title: Couple of nights
text: Nothing more can be said other than excellent ! The staff were exceptional and we loved every minute. The food is very fresh and really high quality. The suite we stayed in was perfect and from the moment we arrived until we left we felt very special. Thank you.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Home away from home!
text:
This was our first stay at the Splendide Royal and we were sorry that we had not discovered it before. From the warm welcome by the friendly staff who made us feel at home to the great service of a delicious breakfast, the staff was caring, knowledgeable  and helpful. 

The Junior Suite Saint-Honore' was spacious, comfortable and peaceful. The lighting, the air-conditioning and other features were well thought-out and simple to use. 

We will defiantly stay at the Spendide whenever we are in Paris.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Thankful
text: An amazing boutique hotel, located at the heart of Paris, in a quite and very convenient area to main attractions and nice restaurants. Excellent personnel. They all made their best to make us feel at home. Everything was scheduled for us well in advance. Special thanks and congrats to Benoit and all the team. Will go back for sure. Recommend to all couples that want to feel Parisian chic atmosphere, away from crowded, big hotels.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Gem
text: Fantastic location, staff & space.  The rooms were spacious & well-appointed.  Our family suite, which connected a suite with a jr. suite, included 2.5 baths, a mini-fridge and microwave.  Very friendly staff, who welcomed even our rambunctious young kids.  Splendide is in a quieter part of town, surrounded by art galleries & the president's residence (so if you're hoping to be near lots of restaurants & nightlife, this may not be a good choice).
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Wonderful Stay in Paris
text:
Just returned from a truly wonderful week at the Splendide Royal. Great staff and service ; we were on a first name basis with the staff within two days. Location was great; centrally located in the 8th arr within easy walking distance to the Louvre, Orsay, Champs Elysee, and the shops on Rue Honore; room was beautiful with a great shower and view of the Eiffel Tower from the balcony.; breakfast offered eggs in addition to great selection of fresh baked pastries; had two wonderful meals at Tosca, soon to be Michelin-starred!
If your looking for a 5 star experience and service in a small, boutique environment this is the place. And when our original flight home was postponed a day they easily accommodated us for an extra night and sent us to the airport with fresh coffee and croissants to go! We’ll done!!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: A high-class stay in a 5-star hotel in the heart of Paris
text: A fantastic 5-star hotel in the heart of Paris. This luxurious hotel is situated in a perfect location, allowing to visit the highlights of the city within walking distance. The Paris-style atmosphere is everywhere in the hotel combined with absolute luxury. Our room (suite) was extremely clean, spacious with all the amentities provided. The breakfast was served (our will) in our room and was very tasty everyday. All the staff was more than kind, aiming to help us in every aspect (restaurants, booking of tickets etc). And of course, i have to highlight the fantastic Michelin-star rated restaurant of the hotel (Tosca restaurant) which offers unique italian tastes. We will be back to this fantastic place soon. Thank you for everything.!!!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Can’t wait to return!
text: A beautiful property in one of Paris’ most elegant neighborhoods,  my stay at The Splendide Royale was one of the highlights of my recent trip.  My room was ready when I checked it at 9:30am (unheard of!) and my bags were brought to my room along with fresh croissants and coffee. My room was both beautiful and comfortable, housekeeping did a great job all week. The staff was both very friendly and extremely helpful. I loved eating at their restaurant, Tosca, as well. I’ve been recommending The Splendide Royale to all my friends in NYC since returning home from Paris a few days ago. You won’t be disappointed!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Excellent stay
text:
Lovely hotel rooms, friendly staff and perfect location for our purpose. Though the breakfast menu was limited with very little hot option for vegetarian. The cleanliness of the hotel was 10
Out of 10 and the house keeping team managed  the room every day to a level
Where we did not have to ask for any thing that was not done to our liking.I have travelled to May places and different hotels but the house keeping team at Splendide have been the best!!! This really make the stay even more pleasant and stress free
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Above & Beyond!
text: With only 12 suites, this small, luxurious hotel is everything and more in what we were looking for in our combination anniversary/birthday trip to Paris! Tucked on a small side street off of Rue Saint-Honore, it's a great locale to walk and explore with terrific shopping and restaurants nearby. We were on the second floor with three large floor to ceiling windows and a wee balcony. I was a little bit concerned about street noise but there was none! We slept so well in our seven nights there; it was so quiet, the bed was just the right amount of firm and comfort and the linens were to die for.  I can't say enough about the staff; they anticipated our needs and didn't hesitate to accommodate us with anything we desired. Our room was immaculate whenever we returned from the day's adventure and it was so relaxing to return to home away from home. We've been to Paris several times and stayed in great properties including La Meurice and La Reserve but Hotel Splendide Royal Paris is where we'll return again and again.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Relais &chateaux at its very best.
text:
One of the smallest luxury hotels in Paris, but a hotel with  extremely heigh standard of personal service and a tasteful decor in a  family inspired environment.
We enjoyed our  two night stay in one of the hotels junior suites and  also the very helpful and friendly staff..
The Hotel’s restaurant Tosca  served us Italian food at its best.
We will look forward to return.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Outstanding!!!
text:
This hotel really made our stay in Paris unforgettable. Excellent experience!!! Fantastic and unbeatable service!! 
Everything is absolutely beyond perfect. 
The district where this hotel is located is the best, we walked to all places because it’s very central. We felt very safe in this area, actually it’s the safest in whole Paris and very chic.
The hotel interior is beautiful and the small lobby and reception area is warm, cozy and very inviting.
We had a beautiful room on the top floor with a view on the Eiffel Tower. I wanted a room with a bathtub and they changed us to the lower floor with a bathtub, I was so happy that they made it possible to meet my wish. 
Talking about wishes the staff will do everything to make your stay amazing. They are all so kind and honestly nowadays it is hard to find a place that provides service of this level. 
We had 2 nights dinner at the restaurant Tosca. The food is really good, it is fine dining and the cuisine is the best. 
Final words: we fell in love with this small hotel with 12 rooms, and we would choose it over and over again visiting Paris,without a doubt.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: FABULOUS!
text: We would highly recommend this hotel for a stay in Paris.  It was perfect.  The location was amazing; the suite was beautiful, clean and spacious and the breakfast was fantastic.   The cleaning staff did a great job and as noted by other reviewers everything was immaculate.  Jeremy, the manager, was so helpful in assisting us with all our needs (Covid testing, restaurant reservations, etc.)  We cannot wait to go back with extended family!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Lovely Stay at Splendide Royal Paris
text:
There are just too many great highlights about with this fabulous boutique hotel, I almost don’t want to share because I will never get a reservation with just only 12 rooms!! 
Location, well you are a short walk from all the shops at Rue St Honoré and right next to the residence of the president of France. 24 hour armed security included at no additional cost! 
The staffs here are all amazing! Upon arrival they immediately greet you and welcome you into their luxuries establishment.
We were in a wonderful and spacious room facing Rue du Cirque. The room was elegant, clean and even had a double sink!! 
Breakfast was delicious and the staff was very attentive!!
Benoit, manager of the property is a wonderful host. He stops by during breakfast every morning to greet every guest by name and spend time getting to know his guests. He really cares about his guests and even our little dog – Kelly Grace.
Unfortunately we did not have the opportunity to meet Pierre the restaurant manager but I heard he really took care of our friends who stayed a few days longer than we did.
Now I have another reason to visit Paris, to stay and be pampered by the warm smiles of the Splendide staff!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Impeccable service - definitely left a good impression
text:
Our first stay at a Relais & Chateaux property, easily the best city hotel stay for me personally, and a departure from large global chain hotels that over-delivered and impressed upon me how small hotels can deliver incredibly personal service and punch above their weight. 

The staff were all eager to help and super professional, including the wait staff in the onsite restaurant. I made a mental note of their names to put on this review, unfortunately I returned home to a very busy year and am embarrassed I no longer recall. We stayed there in Sep 2019 (the date dropdown goes back only 12 months it seems). 

Looking at the pictures on the website now, we got a Parisienne Suite and it was very chic and classily done up. I wouldn’t describe the rates as affordable, but by day two I no longer had misgivings about whether I overspent - the space, luxury and attentive service (and no language barrier) was well worth it. 

We mostly walked to the mainstream shopping and dining locations we wanted to visit, and used Uber to explore the farther parts of the city.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Highly recommend - EXCELLENT STAY
text: We had an EXCELLENT stay at the Hotel Splendide.  The hotel feels boutique in that there are only 12 rooms - but the suite we stayed in was HUGE (and not just by Euro standards - by ALL hotel standards). Huge shower, separate bathtub, 2 sinks, tons of closet and drawer space.  Everything was immaculate, the staff was wonderful and warm and helpful. The neighborhood is quiet but very close to everything you'd want in the city so it was perfect. A++ will 100% return.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Paris mini-break
text: The hotel is beautiful with only 2 hotel suites per floor this hotel is a true 5* hotel jewel, the staff were brilliant at arranging any desired service quickly / professionally and of the highest quality. We can not recommend this hotel enough.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Your pocket palace in Paris
text: My husband and I so enjoyed the Hotel Splendide Royal in Lugano, Switzerland, where we've stayed twice, that when I discovered that its owner Roberto Naldi had renovated a former residence of Pierre Cardin and changed it into a discreet, twelve-suite hotel located between the Grand Palais off the Champs Elysee and Rue Faubourg St. Honore, I knew it would be perfect for us. And it was. Have you ever heard of a hotel where the staff are trained to be kind? Kind and competent with excellent concierge assistance and Ristorante Tosca adjoining, in keeping with the Italian owners. The view from the balcony of our suite 501 of the Tour Eiffel was charming and the decor in keeping with quiet luxury. Not a place for those who love bling. This is refined elegance.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Unforgettable
text: The experience at the Hotel was extraordinary.  Beautiful room.  Outstanding restaurant.  Mr Benoit, the Director, and his staff took care of every detail to make our stay unforgettable. We hope come back !
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Superb Service & Hotel
text:
Thank you very much to all Splendide Royal Paris team for the superb service. The hotel is top top located, very beautiful and with amazing rooms. Thank so much for the service and experience provided.
All the best to all team!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Boutique hotel in amazing location with fabulous service
text: My friend and I stayed in a Junior Suite during a trip to Paris and couldn't have been happier with the choice. It is a small, boutique hotel (14 rooms), a few blocks walk from the Champes de Elysees. Although you are so close to restaurants, shopping, etc. it is on a very quiet street so you feel worlds away, which was a nice break. Breakfast is included and was delicious (menu with many choices); they will also bring breakfast to your room if you arrange in advance. The room was very roomy, especially by European standards and gorgeously decorated. The service was fabulous- an attendant on 24 hours and always welcoming, asking about our day, and eager to help with suggestions, securing a ride, etc. Couldn't have been happier with the stay.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Excellent place, location, staff
text:
Title says it all.

Beautiful rooms, very good amenities/toiletries, centrally located near from many great monuments and shopping areas (petit/grand palais, boulevard haussmann, blvrd churchill and roosevelt, opera garner...). Amazing view at night from the room balcony.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Bucket List for Hotel Experience At Least Once in a Lifetime
text:
It was a divinely splendid couple experience in Hotel Splendide Royal Paris.
Great spacious room, great services, great intimate cosy breakfasts, great location, tip top cleanliness and above all great staffs that make it the perfect formula for a perfect stay.
Keep it up with lots of thanks
Dr Shirley Lee
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: If Carlsberg did hotels.....
text: We recently stayed for two nights at the Hotel Splendide Royal Palace. We have stayed in some fabulous hotels over the years but what sets this apart was the staff. From check in where we were given a coffee and given suggestions for sightseeing, to the management to the staff at breakfast we were made to feel incredibly welcome. The room was wonderful with a deep bath with  it’s own tv , a sensational bed and every amenity you could think of. The location is superb being within easy walking distance to all of the major attractions of Paris. Thoroughly recommended.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Luxury Boutique Hotel in Paris
text: We recently celebrated our 20th wedding anniversary in Paris and stayed at the Hotel Splendid Royal Paris.  From our well appointed suite to the excellent restaurant on-site, Hotel Splendide Royal Paris offers a wonderful boutique experience you’d expect from a Paris luxe hotel.  The central location made it easy to walk to many museums and sites.  The Hotel is very charming and the Staff is really professional and helpful. This was the perfect place for our stay in Paris and we plan on staying there again on our next visit to Paris.  Highly recommend.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Great hotel but lacks certain services proper of a 5 star property
text: I would give the hotel a rating of 3.8/5 on account of my extended stay and some issues the hotel has. For short term stays, or stays without kids, the hotel could be given rates between 4.5 or 5. The hotel is very well located. The staff (concierge specially) is extraordinarily attentive and genuinely helpful (not common). The rooms are also well decorated and confy. I paid for two adjoining rooms. The problem is room service. Any 5 star hotel should guarantee 24 hour room service and a decent menu of international options. The Splendide does not. We came in August and they told us the restaurant was closed and they did not have any evening food offering. That we  could order from a food app and they can help deliver the food to the room (we did and with some UBER issues). Other thing: breakfast menu quite limited and they would charge separately for things like omelette. Gym. No offer inside. In the webpage they offer they can arrange nearby. I inquired and the price was €55 per HOUR!!! No exercise then. Also TV rooms are set so as to prevent you from watching streaming TV. Other recent hotels I stayed in even offer now Apple Tv s for free (the case of Four Seasons); others offer DVDrs with connection to Netflix and other streaming services or Tv preloaded with the application. It is really a thing of the past to not let your guests use any kind of connectivity (I tried several of my appliances and they not work given the blocking devices attached to the TV.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Hidden Gem
text: We have been to Paris many times and have stayed at the “big name” 5-Star hotels. I found the Royale Splendide on a web search and am glad I did. Everything about this hotel is fabulous. From the minute you enter the small, intimate lobby, to the personal service, to the suites. All 5-Star+++.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Exquisite First Trip to Paris
text: WOW is all I need to say.  You MUST stay here. It started with planning - the concierge staff was very responsive to my various email inquiries.  Upon arrival at CDG, our driver (as recommended by hotel) whisked us to his luxury car.  It was clean, comfortable with fresh water and the WSJ.  Arrival at hotel we were met and our luggage taken.  The hotel is sooo beautiful and tasteful.  It is very intimate. The staff was waiting for us.  They introduced themselves and after formality of checking in, showed us to our room.  We were given the most beautiful room we have ever stayed in.  (we often stay in suites at luxury properties)  The details of the room were endless:  spacious, comfortable sitting area; wet bar with Nespresso, tea and microwave; a half bath; a balcony with view of the Eiffel Tower.  The bed was so comfortable and bathroom more than spacious.  Closet and drawer space were ample for our 9-day stay.  There was also a separate vanity area.  The room had every necessity imaginable.  Very large by Paris standards. Evening turn-down service was a welcome touch as we tiredly returned for the night. The restaurant for breakfast was sumptuous.  Breakfast in-room was an option as well.  The restaurant staff was professional, courteous and knowledgeable.  Not to miss is dinner at TOSCA.  The concierge team always went above and beyond to insure we had everything we needed.  They made additional reservations for us, purchased museum tickets and recommended restaurants and additional sights.  They chatted with us each morning before our Paris adventures and again as we returned to hear about our day.  They did everything they could to insure we had the most wonderful Paris experience.  Thanks to the entire staff for making our first Paris visit so very special.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Most wonderful stay in Paris
text:
This hotel is honestly amazing. The staff were so lovely & helpful - from reception to breakfast staff. 
The room was beautiful, large, with all the luxuries! The sheets were so soft & the bed was large & comfortable. The location is great, right near Champs-Elysées but in a quiet street which doesn’t feel touristy at all. 
The complementary snacks & wine at evening time was such a lovely touch & breakfast in our room was divine! It’s a small hotel which we loved, kept it intimate & quiet.
We will definitely be coming back to this amazing hotel.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: City Break
text:
Wow, wow, wow....what a truly wonderful place this is. From the moment you arrive the staff cannot be more helpful. Then you get to your room...wowsers, we stayed in room 502 (A junior suite) and it was wonderful. Cannot stress enough how lovely the room was but sat on the balcony at 11 pm with a view of the Eiffel Tower all lit up was just so so beautiful and having this place as a base was amazing.
Its a great location too, we like walking so for us...perfect, the Champs de Elysse was 5 mins away, the louvre was a 20 min walk through the park, The river just a 10 min walk...so so cool.
Even if you want to go further afield, the metro is so good (And safe) in Paris you can get around in no time. 
We walked to most places but also used the metro to get to MontMartre for the day and also the moulin rouge at night. So easy and the hotel staff are super helpful when explaining how to get around it made life so much easier for us.
The breakfast was lovely, all you need and more really (pastries, fruit bowls, scrambles egg and bacon with toast, bread, juice...list goes on)
The area around the hotel is super safe (That said we loved every part of Paris we went too and never ever felt remotely threatened)
Summing up - iff you want a perfect base for a city break to Paris you would be hard pushed to find a better hotel, superb service, superb location and beautiful rooms. 5 star from me :)
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Excellent service and beautiful suite
text:
What a fabulous time we had at the Splendide Royal.  The suite was spacious and well appointed.  The service, excellent and friendly.  I would definitely come back there at our next visit to Paris.  
Thank you for your hospitality and personalized service.

M. Park
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Perfection!
text: We stayed at this hotel for four nights after a long three weeks of traveling. It was the perfect way to end our trip. The suite was large, immaculate, comfortably furnished, and felt more like an apartment than a hotel room. The location was centrally located with much within walking distance. There are the road blocks on Saturdays and police to consider since the property is near the Presidents home but it also made us feel very safe, especially at night since we walked to dinner a few times. It was very quiet at night. Every single staff member was the most friendly and helpful we have ever met. It was as if I had asked them to hang the moon in my room they would have figured out how to do so. The restaurant Tosca was wonderful for breakfast and a lovely spot for dinner with very good food. This was an exceptional experience and we felt like we were leaving family when we came home. We highly recommend the Hotel Splendide Royal and this fantastic group of people helmed by Mr. Benoit Saudemont who was just as charming and welcoming as his team.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Truly splendid!  Only wish I could have stayed longer to really enjoy it.
text: We only stayed one night here on our way out of town, after a vacation in Bordeaux.  We will definitely be back.  Quite expensive but you get what you pay for in all respects.  High quality, very large room.  Great location.  Great service.  Splendid indeed!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Wow
text:
We loved this place.  It was the nicest hotel room I have ever stayed in!  We generally choose the Four Seasons when we travel but this was better. The room had two bathrooms, a large sitting room and a separate bedroom.  The bathtub was huge and they left you bath salts and chocolates each night.  They were so personable and helped us with every reservation to anywhere we wanted to go.  We would simply go downstairs and they would get us tickets, dinners, transportation, ect.  We had breakfast brought to our room each morning.

I would suggest to bring “dress clothes” because we were limited on where we could eat and go because my husband needed a suit coat and dress pants.  Paris is very proper.  We ate at a restaurant a the Le Bristol and it was the best meal I have even eaten.  The food in Paris is so good everywhere even the cafes on the corners.  

We walked everywhere from the hotel.  The shopping is very high end everywhere but the Main Street is just around the corner. We were shopping for a LV handbag and we walked to 5 different LV stores.  The LV handbags were much less expensive than in the US and you can get the tax refunded to you at the airport. I was amazed at the availability of luxury items.  

Go on the river ride at night, its beautiful. Get a skip the line ticket for Palace of Versailles (the upgraded one). Skip the Big Bus Tour it was a waste of time.  This was our first time in Paris and we loved it!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: A Gem!  Hotel, staff & restaurant!
text:
We chose this hotel for a 4-night stay based upon prior TripAdvisor reviews - we were not disappointed!

We arrived early in the day from the US, and our room was ready and waiting (luck).  Benoit, the hotel manager, met us and oversaw our check-in and helped us to get settled.

Our room was a junior suite on the fifth floor.  We had a small balcony from which we could see the top of the Eiffel Tower.  We were celebrating a major wedding anniversary, and they treated us to a bottle of champagne and sweets.

All modern amenities (exc. no US-style outlets), good Wi-Fi, and the room refresh every day was very good.  There are only 12 rooms, and the staff greeted us by name.  The desk staff was very helpful with sightseeing recommendations, negotiating the bus & metro systems from our locations, and making reservations for us.

Breakfast each morning in their restaurant, Tosca, was wonderful.  (As was dinner - we ate their one evening.)

The hotel is close to the presidential palace, and consequently there is lots of security in the area.  Within a kilometer or two, you can walk to the Louvre, Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame.

Hotel Bristol is within two blocks, and they have both 1-star and 3-star Michelin-rated restaurants.  We ate at Epicure to make the visit special.

Would definitely stay here again.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Amazing place
text:
My husband and I just spend the weeked at this wonderful place in Paris. It is a very small hotel, exact what we like with a excellent service! The suites are very comfortable! It has a great, huge bathroom! The view from the room is very nice - with a view on eifeltower! 
The restaurant Tosca is great! We have had a great lunch with homemade pasta!
Thanks to all employees for making our stay unforgettable!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: “Amazing Hotel And Staff That Was Memorable “
text:
To the wonderful Hotel Splendide Royal

With an abundance of gratitude we would like to thank everyone for our stay. It felt like our home in Paris. The Hotel exceeded our expectations. Special thanks to Ambra and Axelle for answering every question we asked, getting us tickets, drawing maps and easing our doubts. Ilaria, in the dinning service, was a joy and provided us with all the coffee we needed along with a smile and extra care. All of the staff were gracious and kind.

The location was perfect, we were able to walk to many places we wanted to see.

You made the trip of our dreams, in a place of history and beauty, a reality. 

Thank you all. With much fondness,
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Great !
text:
Thank you guys ! Everything was wonderful 
You make our stay in Paris just perfect ! 
The Room spacious .. restaurant just delicious  and staff very friendly  and profesional .. we can’t ask for more during our stay 
We hope come back soon !
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Feel like Royalty
text: Want to feel like royalty? Then stay here. We had a fabulous stay at this wonderful hotel. The rooms are incredibly big with a huge bathroom, walk in closet, living/bedroom. But best of all is the service, since the hotel is so small you soon know the staff and they know you. You feel like part of a large family which is a wonderful feeling to return to after a day of shopping/sightseeing. We have stayed in the best hotels in Paris in the past but this is now our home in Paris. We could find absolutely no fault with this property.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Paris’s best kept secret!
text: Have just left Hotel Splendide having spent the weekend in Paris with friends. What an amazing hotel! Right in the heart of Paris, a stones throw from the Champs Elysees but so private! The rooms are beautiful, very quiet and very comfortable.  The hotel is run by an amazing team where nothing is too much trouble. Will never use another hotel when staying in Paris! Would recommend this hotel to everyone! Loved it.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Splendide, Indeed!
text:
This immediately became not only my favorite hotel is Paris (and I have stayed at many of the palace hotels) but one of my favorite city hotels in the world. The intimate little palace of just a dozen suites is like having a pied-a-terre in the heart of the city, around the corner from the Elysee Palace and up the street from the Champs-Elysees. 

Our junior suite was exquisitely designed and decorated, in soothing tones of cream and white, making maximum use of its already generous size, including a walk-in closet, a compact but fully fitted area to prepare tea and raid the mini-fridge, an extremely comfortable bed, ample work space and a vast marble-clad bathroom.

At every turn there were extra touches that went above and beyond, from champagne served at check-in, to breakfast included (virtually unheard of in Paris) and one evening a sample of hors d’oeuvres passed in the intimate salon that makes up the hotel’s public space and has the refined ambience of a private club.

But for all of this, it is the amazing staff, led by the most charming Benoit Saudemont, that puts this hotel in a rarified league of its own. We felt truly welcome from the moment we set foot in the door the first time until we left, all too early one morning, for our flight back to the U.S. Going above and beyond at every turn, the staff outdid itself by taking great pains to rush tea and breakfast pastries to our room as soon as they arrived at an ungodly early hour that final morning and still had take-away breakfast bags ready and packed for our drive back to the airport.
  
I do not know what magic it took to create this special little gem but that is exactly what this is, our new home-away-from-home in Paris.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Lovely, well-located, charming hotel
text: The Hotel Splendide Royale in Paris is located next to the Presidential residence, Sant Honoré, and other prime areas.  It is small - just 12 suites.  The staff is incredibly thoughtful and kind, very friendly and helpful.  There is also a cute Italian restaurant, Tosca, in the hotel.  The included breakfasts are basic but very pleasant, including a great caprese.  The staff gave a lot of great suggestions and will attend to your every need, even those you don't express- they just know you!  We would definitely stay there again.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Small in size, big in luxury
text:
We were looking for a central hotel that could fit a family of 3 and provides a good amount of comfort and amenities. Boy, did we score right.

While small in size (public areas include a welcome desk, small sitting room and an adjacent restaurant), this hotel is huge on luxury.

The suites are big, include 2 rooms, a kitchenette, 1.5 bathrooms, floor to ceiling windows and the 5th floor one also has a nice balcony with an Eiffel Tower view.

Decked to the nines with classic furniture and huge, 5-piece all-marble bathrooms, this is the perfect way to start and end your day in Paris. Breakfasts are sublime and filling.

The location is perfect. Being smack in the middle of the city’s wealthiest neighborhoods and right next to the presidential palace means full security, I mean it- 24/7 security!

Last but not least- the staff. Whatever you need, whenever you need it. Our trip fell right on Paris’ weekend protests, the guys went out of their way to keep us safe and find a way to help us work around the local unrest. Amazing job!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Top Hotel the heart of Paris
text:
We stayed in this hotel thanks to a Relais & Chateaux gift box.
You have to choose that hotel !
We had a Junior Suite which is big enough and very luxurious.
In the evening we decided to eat the Gastronomous menu in the restaurant Tosca attached to the hotel. It was delicious.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Great stay in Paris
text: We had a quick three day trip to Paris for a conference and choose the Splendide Royal quickly online with little research, just based on location. How lucky we were! This is an elegant yet not stuffy oasis in the heart of Paris. The suite was beautiful, the service friendly and professional. Guillaume and Axel were top notch professionals who recommended restaurants, arranged transportation and in general provided great conversation. Thank you for a terrific stay.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Sumptuous and Perfect!
text: We just returned from a short trip to Paris, staying at the Hotel Splendide Royal for three nights. It is a small, intimate hotel perfectly located off the Champs Elysee near the best shopping in Paris. It is a short walk to many of the sites that would likely be on a visitor's list and is also located close to the President's residence, so you can be assured that it is a very safe area. If you enjoy excellence in service, beautifully appointed rooms and fine dining, then this hotel should be at the top of your list. It more than deserves it's five star Relais and Chateau rating. This is a property that we will visit again, without hesitation. As many other reviews have gone into greater detail than this review, I need not repeat what they have said. Rest assured, they are accurate in their assessment, and you will not be disappointed. Assuredly one of the best stays we have ever had, anywhere.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Will definitely return
text: Exceptional hotel and customer service. Very boutique hotel with I believe a total of 12 suites and virtually no amenities. But this lack of amenities is not necessary as the exceptional class of the hotel, suites and great service more than make up for this. My only complaint was the A/C in the room that never functioned. I had to open the window in order to let cool air into the room, though I did not mind since the weather was very cool outside and there was no traffic outside of my window to disturb me while asleep. But this will not deter me from returning, though I will address this with the hotel before my return to this hotel in the near future.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Incredible boutique hotel with an exceptional staff!
text:
We chose this hotel because it already had rave reviews. Our expectations were already high, but they were all exceeded after we arrived! The lobby, room, and on-site restaurant were all fantastic, but what really set this hotel apart were its outstanding staff, who went out of their way to make our stay truly exceptional. We arrived to Paris very early in the morning, getting to the hotel before 7:00 AM, but knew check-in was not until 3:00 PM. We walked around the city for a few hours, then came back to rest in the lobby. We were brought tea and bread from the restaurant and they were able to get us into our room before noon, which was greatly appreciated! 

When it came time to check-out, local protests had caused the surrounding streets to close, preventing our per-arranged airport transfer from getting to the property. The receptionists personally accompanied us out to find our driver, using their own phones to contact the company, staying with us until we were in the car.

There are admittedly many fine hotels like the Spendide Royal in a city like Paris, but we believe that one would be hard pressed to find a place with staff as exceptional as theirs. From beginning to end, they consistently went above and beyond to make our stay special and as smooth as possible. We could not have asked for anything more! We would certainly go back to the Hotel Spendide Royal Paris again on our next trip (and can't wait to do so)!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Splendid
text:
The Splendide Royal is simply splendid. 
Super service, friendly staff, perfect location, Greta restaurant (the Tosca). Small and intimate. 
Definitely one of the best hotels I’ve ever visited. 
Can strongly recommend.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: 10/10 AMAZING
text: This was one of the best hotels we have stayed in , The room was amazing , the service was excellent anything you wanted they would make a effort to get it for you. The room was amazing , checking was quick and friendly ( even offered tea & coffee )
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: WOW What an Experience
text:
From the time of ordinal booking throughout the whole stay, everything was wonderful.
I made a couple of changes that were handled exactly the way I wanted.
On arrival Axelle the receptionist was great. We were given an upgrade to the largest suite on the 6th floor. The room is very large, close to 600 square feet. Actually is two rooms, a bedroom and living room. There is one full bathroom with a tub and a walk in shower and a separate toilet room.
In the living area there is a second toilet 
They had a bottle of Champagne awaiting us. There were some chocolate covered strawberries and a delicious fruit tart. The fruit tart was on a cake type crust that was scrumptious. Bottled water was provided at no charge.
Axelle is very thoughtful and focusses well on doing and getting done your needs. 
I have been waiting to get to Paris to buy some liqueur from Province because it is not available in the US. She worked diligently to arrange for the shipment to arrive at the hotel we will be staying at in London.
She also booked restaurants and an exposition for us. She has been a busy young lady. Smiling throughout every process.
Breakfast is included. We did not find it at all a problem but the back page of the breakfast menu showed the items that are an extra charge.
The hotel is attached to a wonderful Italian restaurant called Tosca. Tosca makes the breakfast and serves it in their dining room. There is a doorway that leads you directly in without needing to go outside.
You do have the option for the same menu to be brought to your room. 
The staff without exception are amazing. Each one makes you feel like you have your own personal butler.
Benoit the General Manager went above and beyond to help with a number of things. I was writing a review about a restaurant in Milan and needed a key board so I could type it more effectively. He loaned me his, brought it to my room and set it up for me. I am not a computer whiz.
Guillaume has been wonderful, putting up with my crazy needs and wants. He set up a masseuse to come to our room. He tried to fix our shower control so we could get control of the hot water. He even offered to let us use another room for a shower suggesting that when we finish he would have housekeeping come and clean after us. We ended up not needing it but that is way above normal service.
The servers at breakfast are very nice and efficient.
Of course they arranged for taxis each time that we needed one.
Talk about being spoiled and indulged.
All this in the heart of Paris known for small and old rooms.
The location could not be more central.
Security here is not an issue. It is one block from the Prime Ministers building. The police presence was of course visible but reassuring.
I cannot think of anything that they have not done for us.
It feels like they all work just for us.
This is the place to stay when in Paris. Thank you everyone for your part in how happy we are.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: week at the Royal Splendide!
text: My family recently spent a week in August at the Hotel Royal Splendide. We stayed in a family suite and it was enormous, with 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a living room. The breakfasts that were included with our rate were delicious, and we usually chose to have them delivered to our suite as we prepared for busy days in the city. The hotel is small so there is no bar or gym, but the rooms are among the best we have ever experienced. We also found the staff to be very helpful and professional, and the Michelin starred Italian restaurant (Tosca) next door made our breakfasts as well as one of our favorite dinners of the entire week. The hotel is right across from President Macron's house so expect to see guards with rifles on the corners, but as a result it certainly felt safe! The neighborhood is near to very high end shopping, not so much in the way of cafes, but Paris is very walkable and it is very easy to walk to things like the Louvre and the Eiffel Tower and the Champs de Elysese is 2 blocks away. Overall, we were very pleased with this stay and recommend this hotel without hesitation.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: 5 nights Aug 2018
text:
A boutique hotel with only 12 rooms. We were with our daughter and stayed in a 45m2 room and the daughter stayed in a 35m2 room. Both rooms were just fantastic, the only real difference being our room had a bath as well as the shower. My wife loved the fact that the bath had a second TV at the end and she could really relax.

A continental breakfast was included which also included pancakes and/or eggs sunny side up or scrambled with bacon. A bit strange was that eggs over easy were an extra 10 euros.

On arrival both rooms included a bottle of French champagne and chocolate strawberries. Bottled water was replenished daily. The staff were all excellent, friendly and helpful. Location was central for most things, but, of course Paris is a big city and you cannot walk to everything. We saw a couple of shows, the Louvre and the Notre Dame by foot, and caught the train to Montmartre and the east bank.

Highly recommend this hotel as long as you are happy with a small hotel.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: A Gem of a boutique hotel!
text: What can we say, we absolutely LOVED this little luxurious hotel From the minute you walk in, they cannot do enough for you! The suite was just perfect, spacious and just well designed in every aspect, in room fridge/coffee machine, microwave! A well stocked wine/champagne fridge!! Nothing was too much for the staff! Super friendly and great service always!! Tosca restaurant is cozy and serves delicious food at night and the breakfast(included) is on point. I asked the first day if they served brown bread which they didn't but the second day there it was! Max and his team are fabulous in the restaurant, have to mention Victoria she is a super energetic/helpful and was a joy to be served by her! We also would like to thank Daphnee in helping us with all our restaurant reservations! This is a truly a 5 star luxurious small hotel worth staying in! We will definitely be back! Thank you to all the staff, which unfortunately cannot recall all their names for making it a memorable experience!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: What a pleasant stay!
text: It was such a treat to stay at this hotel.  If you're looking for a spacious room and a king bed in Europe look no further.  Our room was stunning.  The service here is excellent!  Beautiful snacks and bottled water set out for us on arrival made fresh from the restaurant downstairs.  Requested an ice bucket to chill a bottle of champagne on our third night and the staff brought an ice bucket, glasses and another tray of snacks to enjoy with our bottle.  All made fresh from the Michelin rated restaurant downstairs.  Breakfast was offered downstairs or in room at no extra charge.  The first day we ordered in room.  Wow!  They even brought us extra speciality's from the restaurant they thought we might like to try.  The room by European standards was HUGE.  The most comfortable bed in all of our travels through France and Italy.  The bathroom was beautiful as well and the hotel staff always helpful.  A couple of suggestions:  If your room is too warm for sleeping ask at the front desk and they will happily override the computer system to make the room cooler for you in the evening.  The hotel is close to government offices and Wednesdays are busy traffic days for this area and it can be hard to get a cab so plan accordingly.  They have Uber in Paris which we found out later and had great luck that.  Also, the hotel is very small so when rooms are open book.  LOOK NO FURTHER... you have arrived!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Great Hotel!
text: We loved everything about this hotel. The room was spacious, well designed, super clean and beautifully decorated. The king size bed is huge and the mattress and linens were the best we have ever experienced and we only stay in premium hotels. The staff were amazing and accomdated every request with a special shout out to Christopher who made us American coffee at a super early hour before our flight home. The location of the hotel is very central and very secure. You won’t be disappointed. One of our most favourite hotels ever
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Perfection.
text:
This hotel and it's staff have ruined us for every other hotel!
Yes, the location is perfect! The suites are spacious and luxuries, the pillows fluffy and soft.
But, what sets this hotel in a totally different category, is the service!
Max and his team, are a step above the service that every other luxury hotel offers, they have the ability to know what a guest wants, before they know themselves, you feel drawn in, into a family ambiance, as if we have all know each other for years.
Max, spent hours researching restaurants and places of interest for our onward journey, and Max, we have tried to see and do most things on your list, and for that  we say "mercy".
Until our next trip to Paris....
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Small Hotel that Delivers in a Big Way!
text: From the moment we arrived to find our spacious suite romantically decorated with rose petals in celebration of our 25th anniversary, to having travel meals prepared for our early departure, our experience at Hotel Splendide was beyond expectation.  Hotel and restaurant staff could not have been more personable or professional.  Great restaurant, well situated on a quiet street and with the most up to date amenities and décor all assisted in making our stay a wonderful life time memory.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Perfect Small Luxury Hotel in Paris
text:
We very rarely write reviews but our recent stay at the Hotel Splendide Royal in Paris (18, Rue du Cirque, Paris, 8th Arrondissement) was such an all around positive and perfect experience that we felt we had to make an exception. The Splendide is a “small luxury hotel”. In practice that means no gym, no hotel bar, no spa and no doormen with bowler hats but a small dedicated and ever alert staff headed by GM Max Michel Grand, lovely, spacious rooms with modern luxurious bathrooms, room service that showed up when we had barely put down the phone, a delicious (included) breakfast at the attached restaurant Tosca and a location in (to us) the best part of Paris - around the corner from the Elysee Palace, close to great shopping, the Tuileries and the Seine (great jogging!).
The Splendide is across the street from the hotel Bristol - and the room rate is approximately half. It is by no means cheap (we paid around Euro 620 a night) but it was for us truly a delightful home away from home with staff that went out of their way to make our stay a wonderful experience. Highly recommended for those who want a (true) five star hotel in the heart of Paris but are happy to trade some of the big hotel amenities for a much more attractive room rate and a highly personalized experience. We will certainly go back next time we are in Paris.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Excellent Location, Perfect Hospitality
text:
Recently realized that I had not reviewed Hotel Splendide Royale Paris after our trip to Paris in September 2017.

From the moment we arrived to the last second of our stay the entire experience was superb.  

On arriving from CDG early (0800) an extraordinary effort was made to ready our room - which was accomplished in record time so we could relax after our flight.  The room, a Suite Parisienne, was magnificent in size and décor.  It was the most comfortable hotel room we have ever encountered.  The living area was beautiful, the bedroom was blissful, and the bath was world class.  We could have stayed in the room for entire visit (except that we were in Paris!)

The entire staff, including the General Manager, were constant in their efforts to make us comfortable and enhance our stay at the hotel and in Paris.  

Any future visit to Paris will include a stay at Hotel Splendide Royale Paris! Thanks for a perfect stay.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Perfect Boutique Hotel in Paris
text: Small (12 rooms), beautiful hotel well situated just off the Champs Elysees on a quiet street.  The hotel staff was lovely, welcoming, and helpful.  Our room was well appointed, bathroom was large and very well lit (much appreciated by my wife) and each night a little food goody of some sort was waiting for us.  Great neighborhood.  If you are looking for a small hotel where you are made to feel like part of the family, this is your place.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Five-Star, start to finish
text:
This is our second visit to Hotel Splendide Royal Paris, the last being one year ago. Once again, we found the hotel wonderful in every regard, from staff to facility.  One does not feel like a stranger in this lovely oasis. From the moment you enter, you are treated as a special visitor.

The addition of the very fine, Michelin-listed restaurant Tosca has added another wonderful facet to this charming destination.

I cannot say enough about this wonderful hotel.  We will always consider it our Paris home.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: 5 stars without any doubt
text: We really enjoyed our stay. From reservation team to the General Manager, the team has been very helpful and went beyond our wish. Lovely restaurant from team to the food. We will be back and spread the word around us. I would say that the place is made for people willing to escape the so fake atmosphere you can find in some palaces of Paris. À bientôt!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: AHHH-MAZING STAY
text:
My 2 girlfriends and I decided to stay here for our 40th birthday weeklong celebration. We could not have picked a better place to stay. The things that make my stay memorable are: Staff, service, rooms, bedding, location. 
Staff/ Service: 5 Stars. My luggage was lost for 3 days. They were on it, calling the airport and the airline for me several times a day. Natalie, their front desk receptionist , was exceptional. Their entire staff was SO attentive to us at every moment, making reservations for us, making calls to change dinner plans for us etc.
Room: 5 Star. We booked the junior suite and WOW what a Parisian treat. The decor was beautiful. The room was clean and we had a beautiful balcony. The toiletries smelled amazing. We had 2 toilets, 3 closet areas  and a separate vanity area for makeup besides the sinks. 
The bedding was soft , plush and comfortable.
Location: 5 Star. Can’t beat it. Minutes from ChampsElysee. Around all of the high end boutiques and restaurants. This hotel is located around the corner from the Presidents Mansion. VERY SAFE.
-they bring breakfast to your room so you don’t have to go down for it
-they have extra converters
-they greeted us with Champagne in our room and chocolates 
Overall AMAZING experience!!!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Outstanding Hotel & People
text:
Hotel Splendide Royal Paris is a Jewel that shines as bright as the City of Light itself! 

The luxurious room was just excellent with outstanding finishing and attention to details in every aspect, Just beautiful. 

The location is just right at the good heart of Paris, a few meters of Rue Saint Honoré. My wife loved shopping there. Just very convinient!

Tosca, its Italian restaurant, prepares everything with the very best italian products and ingredients. Just deliciuous!

But the best thing about this Hotel, above all good things, is the people that work there. They made our stay very special. Just the best!

Many thanks to Axelle, Nathalie, Giorgi, Andrea, Amir, Marcelo, and the other personel that the names I do not recall now (what a team!). I would like to express my gratitude to Max-Michel for leading the team so well. Just outstanding!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Exceeded all our expectations! A gem of a hotel!
text: Just home from 5 nights with my young family and one of the best hotels we’ve stayed in (lucky to be well travelled and I’m super fussy!). The staff go out of their way to accommodate every need. The even organised shipping for my shopping! The family suites are so spacious - amazing for a truly central Parisienne hotel. Amenities fabulous. Wonderful breakfasts. Location just couldn’t be better - short stroll to Place de la Concorde. I’ll be recommending this hotel to friends and we will most certainly be back. ALL staff without exception were beyond helpful and super friendly and the Manager Max runs a fine hotel - a wonderful, warm gentleman. Book it - you won’t regret it. Can’t think of anything that could be improved, genuinely. Thanks sincerely for having us. The Parker Family, London x
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: The most spectacular hotel
text: This hotel was just incredible - you felt like you were in a private house (this was Pierre Cardin’s home) with all of the world class amenities of a 5 star hotel. The rooms are chic and comfortable. The staff is incredibly helpful. It is truly a special place! A gem!
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Could not be more pleased
text:
Excellent boutique hotel tucked away. We stayed 3 days and it was the highlight of our accommodations for our European trip. The suites are exceedingly comfortable and bright. The staff could not be more friendly and helpful. Manager Max-Michel Grand was excellent as well as Elise and the others, whose names I cannot recall, were all the best.
Looking forward to returning.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Perfect  !
text:
We stayed here for 3 days while visiting Paris and really enjoyed it.

They have put a lot of effort into providing high calibre accommodation and it shows in all the right places.  

As usual, some people have dismissed all the effort that has gone into the hotel and left churlish reviews on Tripadvisor.  Discount them.  Hotels of this standing are few and far between.

Polyglot Daphnee was very helpful at reception before booking and the Manager, Max-Michel Grand was courteous and informative.
name: Hôtel Splendide Royal Paris

title: Great Hotel
text: Stayed here for a few days and would recommend. Very friendly and helpful staff. The location of the hotel is great and you can walk to the major attractions in Paris. We only ate breakfast at the hotel and each breakfast was very good.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Paris
text: Very good location with affordable price compared to neighborhood, staff is very well trained to be friendly with guests in a professional way, rooms are comfortable, breakfast area is charming , i advise this hotel to most of my friends
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Recommendations
text:
Good location and easy reach to shops and popular landmarks. Staffs were very nice and helpful.
Some improvements needed in the room, larger cups and additional towel hooks in the bathroom. Treadmill in the fitness room not working.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Mrs . M Alsaqer
text: The stay was wonderful. The location was perfect for our activities. The hotel restaurant was pleasant. We especially appreciate the very friendly staff; Ms. Esther and Mr. Gazou from the reception were extremely helpful.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent hotel
text: I spent a week with my family at Hotel de Sers in Paris. It as a wonderful stay. Everyone was kind and paying attention to details. The check in process was smooth and easy, with welcome surprises for my daughters. The rooms are nice and fresh. The restaurant offers high quality food. The location is one of the very best in Paris.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Disappointing,  ugly experience. Stay away
text:
We stayed for 1 night at this hotel during the fashion week. I didn’t expect anywhere in the world,  last place Paris , to have such a disappointing, ugly experience as at this hotel. Staring from spoiled food, moldy smell at the bathroom and finishing with not friendly stuff. 
Thank you to this hotel our anniversary in Paris was completely ruined. 
If you want to have a nice experience in Paris, I don’t recommend anybody choosing this place
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great Hotel and Location with Wonderful view from Eiffel Suite
text: My wife and I stayed at Hotel de Sers in July 2022 for 5 nights. Great hotel located nearby Champs Elysées and a short walk to the Seine River. The hotel staff was beyond accommodating upon our early morning arrival when our room wasn't ready since we arrived 4 hours before check-in. They allowed us to clean up and shower in their spa facilities and that was much needed after our overnight flight from Chicago. That top notch service didn't change throughout the entire stay. Once we were able to check in to our room we were very pleased with our room and the view was amazing. Our reservation included breakfast and the offerings were perfect to start the day. We booked the Eiffel Suite, when booking this room be aware that there is apparently more than one of these suites and while we stayed in room 75 and it was a lovely room, the Eiffel Suite we stayed in isn't the one pictured as the Eiffel Suite on the website and all other advertising platforms. The terrace, views and room were outstanding simply not the comfortable patio furniture pictured for the Eiffel Suite so this portion of our stay wasn't what we were anticipating, we are guessing the website photos must be of 8th floor Eiffel Suite? That said we stayed during the week of Bastille Day and the view of the Eiffel Tower fireworks was unbelievable. Room was quiet and we couldn't hear any street noise at night. Bed was comfortable, shower was great. It was hot in mid-July and the air conditioning worked well and our room remained cool throughout our stay. Room had a small mini bar fridge. The room and the hotel were very clean. Staff was always helpful and made good dining recommendations. As for location this hotel is a short 5 to 10 minute walk to the GeorgeV Metro Station which provides easy access to all of Paris. Overall we enjoyed our stay and recommend staying at Hotel de Sers.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Nice hotel in the center of Paris
text:
A very nice hotel near a location (Champs Elysées).
In the bedroom you don't hear the noise of the street.
Good rooms and we sleep very well.
The hotel personnel are always prepared to help you.
So really myadvice to go to year.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Best Hotel I've ever stayed in!
text: The hotel was in the most amazing location and super clean. The staff was beyond accommodating and friendly. We felt at home and did not want to leave. The breakfast was perfect. Our room was gorgeous. They prepared multiple surprises for my birthday and made the day extremely memorable. My entire family enjoyed our stay and cannot wait to go back there again! Highly, highly recommend. Loved it! Thank you so much for an unbelievable experience.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Service quality of a three star hotel
text:
We spend three nights over Pentecost. On the check in nobody was aware of our credit of 720 € although it was confirmed by email. I had to fight to get the credit.
On the second day, the reception was not able to call a Taxi. The employee explained, that their system does not allow it !
The toilet flushing didn't work anymore from the second day.
The balcony windows are ancient and not noise proof.
Something was always missing at breakfast.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Michael chapman
text: Our stay at hotel de sers was wonderful. The hotel is charming and beautiful, but what made it extra special was the super helpful and personable staff. They helped with reservations, which were all great, taxis and everything in between. The rooms were just as stunning as the pictures showed online with marble finishes and chic furniture. To top it off the bed was comfortable and i slept great every night. The hotel is also in prime location with world class shopping in walking distance, and many world renowned museums a quick taxi ride away. I would definitely come back to this hotel next time in in paris!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Amazing Hotel
text:
I very much enjoyed this Hotel. Its situation is second to none and 
I  found it very welcoming indeed. The room was well appointed and luxurious. 
I found the staff very attentive. They looked after us from the moment we checked in and left nothing to chance.
The breakfast to our room was superb offering a host of delicious and healthy options. 
At dinner at the restaurant I knew we were in Paris! Gourmet food accompanied by quality French wines.

I would like to thank the staff at the Hotel de Sers for looking after us so wonderfully.
This is a special hotel!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Style & Luxury & Incredible staff in the Heart of Paris
text:
Best Location - Top Hotel - Stayed here for 4 nights in February and found the Hotel de Sers extremely welcoming. The hotel is modern & stylish and has a boutique feel to it. The staff greeted us with Top champagne and smiles. 

The room was lovely and overlooked the street below / overlooking Avenue George V & the Eiffel Tower (top Floor) . The location is second to none but it's easy to stay close to the hotel as it's so nice.

The service was fantastic and many thanks to the front of house, the bar & restaurant people & Bob who did room service  - for makaing the stay a wonderful time.

We really look forward to returning soon.  Couldn't recommend it highly enough.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: disappointing service
text:
The beds were comfortable. They had a Shattaf (water hose) at the toilet which was a big plus for us. The balcony was tiny and not as per what is shown on the webpage. The wifi was good, the staff was extremely friendly. The location is great.

This is not a 5-star hotel. The cleaning was disappointing, the cleaning lady was barraged one time when my wife and I were still in the room, she didn't give a second for me to answer the door, I found this rude. She did not speak any English. They need to sort out the breakfast option with booking.com, I do not want to get involved with booking.com and the hotel's agreement. The cleaning crew did not clean the room properly, nor the bathroom, and also have not restocked the room's drinks and water.
Water that was supposed to be provided for us was charged on my bill, it seems that the staff was not trained to handle a 5 star, I would expect a better organization when it comes to how much I paid. The telephone in the room did not work. The door handle on the balcony keeps coming off. 
If you want a more consistent service, try the four seasons next door.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: My wife and I love this Hotel!
text: This Hotel is exceptional. The location is great and service is the best. It’s close to great places to eat or have a glass of wine, the best shopping is a 3 block walk. I highly recommend staying here when you’re in Paris. Husbands, the Louis Vuitton store is a 7 minute walk!!!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Service could be improved
text: After a tortuous booking process, check in was uneventful. As I was working in my room, another guest opens my room door...apparently he was checked-in and provided a key to my room. The concierge came immediately to apologise so the matter was laid to rest. Later in the evening, before leaving for Dinner, I left my laptop for safe keeping at reception. Upon my return, the laptop was not found. After the manager on duty and the said concierge had an argument for a few minutes, I was escorted to my room by the concierge to check whether my laptop magically made its appearance there. And there was my laptop, sitting in plain view on the room table. The concierge tried to be smart and I had no choice but to lodge an official complain with the duty manager (he admitted he was exasperated himself). He promissed to report to the manager but I never heard from anyone. Otherise, the hotel is in a great location
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Wonderful hotel
text: A lovely hotel all round.  The location is excellent, rooms and decor elegant and tasteful and the staff are unfailingly warm and thoughtful.  I stay here whenever I'm in Paris and am always happy I did.  Highly recommended.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Very kind service
text: Audrey and Alexandre have taken such great care of us during our business trip! Very kind service in a cute boutique hotel, ideally located in the heart of Paris! Recommend it for both business and leisure !
name: Hotel de Sers

title: UNBELIEVABLE !!
text: I went to hotel de sers for a 2 weeks trip and it was amazing. Staff people are very welcoming and nice, rooms are charming in a very nice area, the lounge is perfect to have business meetings !! I had a blast and I recommend for sure !! Quentin
name: Hotel de Sers

title: 4 night stay - 10/10
text: Beautiful 4 night Luxury stay at hotel de Sers with complimentary breakfast and amazing customer service from all of the hotel staff. The view was unbelievable and location was absolutely perfect for tourists visiting Paris as it was directly off the Champs-Élysées, immersed in with many beautiful restaurants and shops
name: Hotel de Sers

title: A wonderful stay in Paris!
text: This chic boutique hotel in the heart of Champs-Elysees, next door to the Four Seasons is a gem! My daughter and I stayed in a Suite in November. The historical paintings combined with the contemporary decor tells a story of the history of the building.  Our room was lovely, a beautiful suite with impressive round carrera tub, and twin vanity sinks on either side of bath, including shower and commode. The colors and fabrics of the bedroom and living area were bold and sophisticated, just what you would expect in Paris! I'd like to thank the staff for their detailed attention! We are looking forward to another magical visit where we can spend time at this lovely hotel.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great place for relaxation while working in Paris
text: For work I spend almost 4 weeks in this Hotel. I picked this one as I wanted to have a proper Hotel, with great service and facilities. Also, it is near the Av. des Champs-Elysees and near bars and restaurants. Everything was arranged perfectly, the staff was very kind and the breakfast and diners were just awesome. I tried definitely to come back once I can continue the work in Paris.

text:
Your hotel is completely over sold, and by no means a 5 star. Ignorant rude unhelpful staff. Awful rooms for the price. Terrible breakfast. 
This hotel is well overdue an inspection.

title: Great location and staff
