Walking distance to all landmarks 
The room size is perfect for 2 people 
Also, the WC has shataf ! We as middle eastern we loved it
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Amazing
text:
I was with my wife staying at Hotel de Sers for few days, the location is excellent as you are really in the middle of everything.
The concierge Cedric was very helpful and could manage for us all reservations for restaurants.
Rooms were very clean and staff very pleasant
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great night in Paris
text: Recommend this hotel, fantastic location and within easy walk of the major landmarks. Great value for money. Friendly and professional staff. Rooms are well appointed and very clean. Did not have the breakfast and can not comment.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent city Centre hotel
text: We stayed 3 nights in January. The room was large compared to other Paris hotels, the location is excellent for shopping, sightseeing and restaurants. Alexis was particularly helpful to us- he is a credit to your hotel.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Super hôtel dans un emplacement parfait!
text: Really wonderful hotel with excellent staff. The location is perfect, beds are comfortable, and food was delicious. There is really nothing negative to say about this hotel, you get your monies worth.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great staff and superb location
text: The staff is helpful and friendly. Cedric, the Concierge, is very attentive and made us feel like home. Clean and comfortable rooms.  Recommended for those who appreciate small and cozy boutique hotels.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Centrally located for most major Paris attractions
text: My wife and I came from Los Angeles and spent New Years in Paris. The location was perfect and the service was phenomenal. English was spoken clearly and staff was friendly all around, especially Emily.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: The quality of the hotel has declined
text: ive stayed at this hotel 6 times throughout the last 5 years and i can tell you that their quality has dropped for sure. not sure if it was the strike in france or just a coincidence but the room was not as rennovated and clean as it should be and the quality of both the breakfast and room service were awful to say the least and the overall sense of the staff seemed to be clueless and inexperienced
name: Hotel de Sers

title: A perfect hotel experience in Paris!
text:
Together with my wife we spent a couple of days over New Years Eve at the Hotel de Sers. For this special occasion we booked suite Nr. 77 - spacious with sleeping & living room, a separate dining area, large bathroom and 2 toilets. All is tastefully furnished, comfortable and charming and certainly not main stream. The beautiful terrace a highlight for warmer days, facing even the very tip of the Eiffel Tower. 
The service of the reception and concierge team was impeccable! We did not feel at all the negative consequences of the strikes. The airport transfers were efficiently organized, also the transportation to our friends house at New Years Eve and restaurant reservations as well! All in all an excellent experience and value for money. We can only recommend this sophisticated and charming small hotel in the heart of Paris, to which we came back now for the 10th time!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent place, we'll come back
text:
We stayed 3 nights with our 2y.o daughter and enjoyed every second of it. Friendly and efficient staff, amazing hotel & location. The bed was fantastic, spotless room, bar was peaceful and music was a nice kind of lounge chill. Perfect short break after a busy year at work.
Thank you
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Superb location
text: Loved the hotel and staff were on the ball with every need! Will definitely stay here again. The location is perfect for shopping and sightseeing. Enjoyed it very much a thank you. 24 hr room service ordered a cuppa tea at 2am. Needed it! Breakfast was delightful with super fresh juice
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent
text: Our overall experience at Hotel De Sers was excellent and I have no hesitation in recommending it. The staff were exemplary and were very helpful throughout our stay. The location is very central and the accommodation is perfect if you wish a relaxing visit to Paris.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Business Trip STAY
text: Only good thing was it was close to my place of work. Room service was not complete when i checked in, break fast service is terribly slow. Room is average size. Even they took time to resupply water to the room on daily basis. Basic things should be given more attention by the team.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Not one of the best in Paris
text: The hotel is located right in the center of Paris. Rooms are spacious. Check in and check out was extremely smooth. Did not had a good experience during breakfast. When I shared with the staff that I am pure vegetarian and I follow certain diet pattern, they refuse to cook anything out of the menu unless I agree to pay extra for the same. I also tried speaking to the manager but he was extremely rude. Normally any good 5 star hotel would ensure that their guests eat well and leave the restaurant with a smiling face. They go out of the way to bring that smile on your face. I did not find that attitude in staff including the duty manager on that day. (Marcolivier dovonou) Because of his rude behaviour and impolite attitude, I could only eat couple of toasts and a glass of juice for my breakfast.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Really decent!!!
text: The sauna is hot...small aandd hot. They seem to keep the saunas hotter in France. The hallways seems outdated, but surprisingly the rooms are comfy and easy to navigate when with more than one in tow. The porter kept everything from our car to our hideous amount of bags from shopping. It's a bit more per night compared to other options, but you can get everything done in a night there and be complete for the next day. No swimming pool and gym is small.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Joyous
text: We loved our stay at Hotel de Sers. The facilities are comfortable, clean and aesthetically pleasing. The breakfast was abundant, our room spacious. Best of all was the lovely staff. Sophie and especially Cedric helped us with every itinerary detail, even before we arrived. They had great suggestions and purchased our tickets for us. Made our vacation easy and delightful. We will return and we thank all the staff for our great time.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Room was great, front desk and no hot water... NOT GREAT.
text:
Upon checking in, I asked the front desk woman about the daily breakfast and $100 Food and Beverage credit that my travel agent informed me that I would be getting. The front desk woman seemed a little annoyed with me asking and a manager stepped in with a smile to save the day.  My wife was a little turned off by it but because of the quick work of the manager, we were not about to let it bother us.

The real issue came on the last night of our stay.  After a late dinner and night out in Paris, my wife tried to take a shower but the water never turned hot.  Eager to get to bed, we decided to go to bed and try again before taking off for Marrakech in the morning. Upon waking up, we found that the water was still not hot so we called the front desk and they simply apologized and said that they couldn't do anything about it. We were pretty upset that we couldn't shower before getting on a flight to Marrakech and the front desk manager didn't offer to make it up to us in any way.  

I never expect any kind of credit but it would've been nice if it was offered.  I've received credits for much less in the past without having to ask.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Nice hotel but terribly understaffed !
text:
The location and the hotel itself is good, however our stay was disappointing.
They were terribly understaffed one day they even forgot to clean our room, even though we called them up several times. There was a plumbing issue as well and they had no plumbers on call or even maintenance staff.

The Managements attitude was also very defensive and denied anything was wrong.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: 30 th wedding anniversary
text:
Friendly staff, helpful in every aspect of our stay.  Checking in was easy and they spoiled us with champagne and flowers! We called the hotel once while shopping to get our passport number and they took care of us!
Clean beautiful room!
Close to everything!
Wonderful experience without complaints!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: ABSOLUTELY FABULOUS!
text:
this hotel is phenomenal! We were in Paris for the first time to celebrate my Fiance's birthday, and our recent engagement, as well as a few work projects. We ended up needing to add on a day to our stay, and Francine was super responsive and accommodating over email. She took care of everything for us and even surprised us with cheesecake and champagne in our room upon arrival! Sophie was down to earth and so helpful with any questions or assistance we needed. And there was 1 more special person who helped us out tremendously while we were there and I would totally mess up her name if I tried to type it here, so many apologies!! but she has dark hair, slim, and tall about 5'9 or 5'10. she gave us a tour of our room and showed us the lay of the land at the hotel. everyone was genuinely nice, and down to earth. 

We stayed in the Eiffel Tower Suite, and I literally almost teared up when we walked in. breathtaking terrace, with views of the Eiffel Tower and a beautiful Cathedral. You can have breakfast on the terrace with your own private bistro table and chairs or sofa loungers. Your money is well spent here. this is truly a 5 star property. there are so many hotels in Paris that claim a 4-4.5 star rating but are in NO way even close to what we would consider as an American standard. De Sers would be a 7 compared to Paris' 4 star hotels.

So many hotel reviews in Paris complain about the AC not working properly and it ruining their sleep and overall stay.
 
literally everything little detail was taken care off. they treat every guest like they are the single most important persons staying at their hotel. We will absolutely be back, and look forward to staying at other B signature hotel s & resorts across the world. 

The online photos are TRUE to reality! there entire staff pays attention to ALL the details!! no pretentious vibes here.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: The perfect Hotel
text: The first impression of the hotel was more than excellent. The employees were very helpful and friendly. Also the rooms are beautiful and have a high quality interior. I would recommend this hotel to everyone who wants to stay at a great hotel in Paris.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Highly Recommended
text: Hotel de Sers is situated in a great location. The staff were very friendly and helpful and the room was amazing with views over Paris. We will most definitely book the hotel again the next time we go to Paris and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend the hotel to friends and family.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Wonderful De Sers Hotel
text:
Fabulous gem of a hotel.  Lovely rooms and bathrooms, very nice bath amenities. Lovely breakfast room and friendly staff.
Loved the color scheme in the room and all the public rooms.
I like that it is a relatively small boutique hotel and I do not have to walk very far from elevator to my room.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: First time in Paris
text: It was my first visit in Paris and I was lucky to stay at this nice hotel. Nice, clean room with very comfortable bed and very good designed bathroom. The restaurant had small but interesting menu. I had dinner there almost every night. I tried the degustation menu which was really good option and showed me the side of the french kitchen. I recommend this nice hotel.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Cmfortable
text: Interior of the hotel is impressive The suite we stayed in was comfortable and the coffee offered there excellent The overall service was good Breakfast might have been better Also the concierge service
name: Hotel de Sers

title: A Paris Gem
text:
After a decade, the Hotel de Sers is an automatic choice for an annual Paris trip. Starting with a desirable location, the hotel features an staff renowned for personal, attentive and exceptional service. Never has a request gone unanswered. Never does a guest pass a staff member without being greeted by name with a smile.
Your day begins with a strong breakfast service in a cozy garden setting. And the concierge will handle any request for day or night, from museums to restaurants.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Very disappointed by their night management and staff that humiliated and verbally abused me and my friend.
text: Very disappointed by their night management and staff that humiliated and verbally abused me and my friend.  Didn’t feel secure at all. Unbelievable! Never again. And will not recommend it to any one!!!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great Hotel / Great location
text:
Boutique hotel with a contemporary charming decor, excellent money value and very close to the Champs Élysees and avenue Montaigne.
Many rooms with balcony and Eiffeil Tower view. Nice restaurant.Nespresso machine and nice fitness.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Relaxing environment 💕
text:
I enjoyed my stay at the hotel, the staff were very nice especially Nancy she was at the reception and she was super nice and helpful.
The location of the hotel is perfect, the only thing that I didn’t like is the price it was very high
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent
text:
I probably have made more than 50 trips to Paris and have stayed at different hotels, mostly near the Opera. This time I chose to stay near the Champs Elysees and found the Hotel de Sers at around $ 400/per night incl breakfast.
Its location is impressive, exactly around the corner from the Hotel Georges V, 10 minutes walking to the Champs Elysees.
The room was very nice and clean. Breakfast very French and delicious.
Staff very pleasant and helpful.
The only reason that I took a Star off is that the three times that we asked for a Cafe Latte in the lobby cafe, it took close to 30 minutes to get our drinks.
Most likely we will come back to the Hotel de Sers next time
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great Place to stay
text: It was all just wonderful and a great place to stay.  It was an incredible bargain. The service was superb and the location is the best.   Highly recommend this hotel to anyone. My travel agent did a wonderful job here.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great Location of Champs
text: Great location near Four Seasons in a smaller boutique hotel. Very friendly multilingual staff. They are helpful but the place needs a full time concierge which apparently at our stay was mostly not available.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great hotel with even better staff
text: We have been located at this hotel for 2 weeks for a work event. The hotel was comfortable and clean and the chef is amazing. Most appreciated was the management and staff, who went out of their way constantly to be of service. Besides that they are simply very lovely people. We would come back for sure!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: "It's OK"
text:
It's an OK hotel. Higher expectations through their marketing/pictures/website. Doesn't match what you get into. 
Design of lobby: Excellent
Rooms: They suck! Not up to the value. 
Service: One friendly staff (guy who welcomes you at the door) and a great manager; however, some of the staff (overnight shift) can be VERY rude and lazy.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent location but not five stars breakfast!
text: Very good location in the center of Paris and close to major points and attractions.Sufficient rooms and services but very small breakfast options. Be aware that they are using a preauth policy charging an extra amount per day additional to the booking.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful staff. And room where just amazing. Read about this hotel in a magazine and thought it wouldn’t maybe be as good as I read but yes. It was. The breakfast is also amazing. Good location if you’re heading of for the champs-elysees
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Double Celebration
text: Fantastic hotel, brilliant location, super clean and comfortable. However it's best asset is it's staff. They were all wonderful. Cedric ensured we were looked after and nothing was too much trouble. The restaurant is amazing too. Can't fault it
name: Hotel de Sers

title: a good experience
text: We enjoyed the good atmosphere with a staff always there to accommodate with a smile. Pleasant reception and cosy reading/ meeting area.  You feel that the staff wants you to be satisfied, keeping distance but available at anytime. Modern furnished, decorated with old paintings, elegant.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: incrediblehotel in the centre of everything.
text:
this place was absolutely amazing from when you first arrive at checking to the rooms amazing. 
it's centrally located walling distance to all famous attractions so no need to worry about Ubers, metros or anything like that.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Lovely hotel, very poor service.
text: rooms and location are very nice at Hotel de Sers.   Everything was clean and orderly.   You can’t beat the location.   The service at every turn was terrible.   The restaurant staff is mostly indifferent to your needs.  Two mornings in a row we were seated for breakfast, which is included, and the staff never came back to give us a menu to order from.   We were seated and they just never came back.  Both times when we finally asked for and received a menu they either never came to take our order or we had to get up from the table to flag someone down to take our order 25 minutes after being seated.   The restaurant was not busy at all, yet twice our od theee days we ended up not eating because we ran out of time.  Service upon checkout was also poor.   The process took 10 minutes and I was the only one there.  The gentleman that checked me out did not appear to have been trained.  He kept asking the other staff person at the deal questions and was unable to complete a simple check out procedure with the credit card on file in under 10 minutes.  It’s unfortunately as the hotel itself is lovely and ideally situated.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Stay elsewhere.
text: Our travel agent highly recommended this hotel, run by his dear friend, who would "take great care of us."  Our parents, us and our 10 year old were very disappointed upon arrival as basic amenities weren't even met.  Flooding in the bathroom, broken bathroom door, and just overall run down decor and furniture was surprising. GM and staff kept saying all the right things, but never delivered.  No action was taken to remedy any situation. Very disappointing.  My tip is to stay elsewhere.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Perfect experience!
text: My experience was lovely! Extremely clean and beautiful hotel, perfect location, incredibly helpful and professional staff! I would absolutely recommend it to anyone and will defiantly be staying there again!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Mostly polite staff - great location and spacious rooms
text: Great location, my room service arrive an hour late one morning so i did not get to eat it as i was leaving for work when it arrived. For the most part the staff were very friendly however. Bring your own toiletries as they are not good quality in the rooms and only 1 english speaking TV station [cnbc].
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Nice rooms but bad hotel restaurant service
text: Very surprise that a hotel of this category can have restaurant staff that is so disorganised.It took 15 minutes to allocate a table even though there were many free tables.30 minutes to bring the menu20 minutes to take my order30 minutes to bring the food but forgot the glass of wine I ordered with the foodasked whether I would get the wine I orderedNevertheless, my glass of wine came after I had finished my food
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Wonderful
text: Very friendly and helpful staff! Location is perfect- on a quiet street yet still close to the Metro. Good selection of local restaurants nearby, and shopping is also a short stroll away. Definitely recommended!
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Poor experience
text:
Expected luxury, professionalism, cleanliness and to be amazed by this hotel that promises so much and charges appropriately to match that promise.
Unfortunately we were disappointed on every aspect.
The room was small, had a view of a brick wall (not the promised road view), spa was lacking for a hotel of this calibre, restaurant recommendations were extremely poor, breakfast was unsatisfactory and overall left very disappointed with this hotel.
The only good thing is the location but with so many other hotels in the area I’d suggest trying somewhere else.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Avoid
text: Limited guest communication especially when asked prior to the trip about the Paris riots and whether it is safe to travel - didn’t/wouldn’t answer ! No information or care to keep guests safe - would advise strongly not to visit whilst the french are rioting which they have been every weekend for the last four weeks. Nothing is open - no transport links taxis, buses, boats all cancelled  everywhere near this hotel is locked down.  Eventually after at least a 2 mile walk to get back to the hotel around 8:30pm - dirty coffee cups from the morning still in our room no replacement cups or coffee.  Staff have no care or interest for guest safety or the fact they are spending a lot of money for no experiemce. Clearly just want to take your money knowing it’s not safe.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great Location, friendly staff, quiet room
text: Stayed at the hotel for 4 nights and loved the experience.  The hotel is a short walk from champ de elysees.  The location was perfect to walk around and come back to relax.  Its around the corner from the four seasons hotel.  Even though our room felt small, it was nicely done and had all the essentials.  There were plenty of cars when one was needed.  Our room was nice and quiet so we got restful sleep after long walking tours of the city. They have a lovely courtyard open for breakfast and meals.  We had breakfast and lunch at  the hotel.  Breakfast was pastries, juice, and coffee.  Lunch menu was good.  Staff are super nice and accommodating.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Great experience on Avenue George V
text: Great location in Paris, with excellent accommodations and service. Quiet street. Easy walking distance to the best restaurants, shopping, sites, and entertainment in the city. Meets all requirements of its class.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Good place for visiting Paris
text: Friendly staff, clean and comfortable room. It was really a superb place to stay.  Location is great - about 3 minutes  to Cham ps-Elysee's and Gorge Five metro station.Brekfast in 5 stars hotel should be better.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Good experience
text:
I can definitely say that I have liked this hotel. It has a great location, and regardless that it is in quite middle of the hassle, it is a very and very calm space. Staff is very friendly and helpful to everybody. Rooms and the hotel itself are cleaned and smell fresh. I really liked shampoos over there:)
After walking around for breakfast in different places, I would say that this hotel is the best to eat in the morning.
The only drawback I can provide with is the fact that they have A/Cs right in front of the bed. Which were switching on at night, therefore I have got cold...

Overall, I'd definitely recommend this hotel, nice and sweet place to go.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: excellent
text: the hotel had an amazing location and has a really modern interior.The staff was really helpful and friendly. I was really satisfied with the room we stayed in. The room was spacious and enjoyed the balcony which had an amazing view of Paris.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: experience oh high class
text: High class atmosphere with maximum of privacy. Elegance mixed with courtesy and high care reserved to all guests. A quite and elegant ambient in the heart of Paris. A perfect place for those looking for true elegance that makes the difference.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Personalized Touch
text: The location is convenient and the staff was phenomenal. Victor the bartender was a blast to get to know and he is an expert mixologist. Loved the personalized touch with some baked goods, watter and a card with my name on it. It was odd that the there were no shower curtains considering that the base boards in the bathroom showed decay and some rust. All in all I recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Excellent
text:
Excellent position in Paris - within 15 minutes walk of the metro, Seine, Champs-Elysées and much more.

Excellent room - spacious, good bed and bathroom with shower and bath.

Excellent staff - friendly and helpful. Everyone of them!

Excellent choice at breakfast. Your choice of a light breakfast (included) or a more hearty meal.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Expected more
text:
We are checking out today having spent 2 nights in the hotel. Firstly the hotel is situated in a good location to the designer shops, walking distance to Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triompe. Staff are friendly and very helpful. 
On booking it clearly states breakfast is included but what it isn’t clear about is that it is only a continental breakfast, if you wanted a cooked breakfast it’s very expensive. 
There are no tea/coffee making facilities in the room. I find this odd for a £300 a night 5 star hotel. Also be prepared for only 1 English tv channel ... good old bbc world news !
In all honestly I think you can find much better for this amount but still we had a pleasant stay.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: Nice hotel but..
text:
The location of the hotel is nice, maybe 5-7 mins to the Champs Elysée. The room we had was spacious, clean, the service was good.
Really disappointed about the breakfast, when you pays 600 something €, you expect a rich breakfast buffet. 
Not to mention that the gym is not really a gym. With only 3 machines, only 2 were working during my entire stay at the hotel, there's not event weights..
Overall we had a good experience, but not sure if I'll be back.
name: Hotel de Sers

title: A gem of a hotel in the 8th!
text: We have loved our stay at this beautiful hotel that was once a Parisian mansion. The decor is elegant, the staff lovely, the location terrific (a quiet street but right in the heart of everything) and the rooms well appointed. Definitely splurge for a terrace room (ours had a balcony as well as floor to ceiling window with lots of sky, and make sure you get the breakfast package- both the food and the dining room and terrace where it is served are lovely. Could not recommend the Hotel Alfred highly enough.
name: Hotel Alfred Sommier
description: Just 100 metres from the Madeleine, in a quiet area, the Hôtel Alfred Sommier offers an authentic setting in the heart of Paris. From the entrance porch, you enter the family intimacy of a large 19th century mansion with courtyard and garden. The marble fireplaces, gilded mirrors and oak parquet floors harmonise with the paintings and contemporary furniture created for the hotel. The Alfred Sommier Hotel is located in the heart of the central business district of Paris, halfway on foot between the boutiques of the Rue du Faubourg Saint Honoré and the Printemps and Galeries Lafayette department stores. The Opéra Garnier, the Champs Elysées and several theatres are also within walking distance. The restaurant "Les Caryatides" owes its name to the two monumental statues at its entrance. It occupies the large dining room and the glass roof of the mansion. During the summer months, meals are also served in the garden, the main courtyard and on our terraces. The Chef's menu changes according to the fresh seasonal produce.

title: Avoid room #10-14
text:
We just stayed two nights at Hotel Alfred Sommier from Friday April 29th to May 1st, 2022. We had very high expectations seeing pictures online of impressive hallways and we were hoping to get an experience of living in an amazing former residence. Before our arrival we got a message asking if we would like to request anything regarding our room. I thought that at a 5 star hotel all rooms would deliver the same experience, and that I didn’t have to make a special request, but unfortunately I was completely wrong.

We were extremely disappointed when we were guided to our room, which was room #10. The room was located in a separate building than the pictures you see online. Instead of getting an experience of living in an incredible house we got the experience of staying at a regular Airbnb. The hallway was narrow, the carpet dirty and there was no light in the hall leading to the room. When you come in from the street and have to turn left to go to your room - you look to your right and you know you are missing out on a great experience, but you still have to pay the same. title: Stunning property in the heart of Paris!
text:
Stayed two nights at this gorgeous mansion/hotel in September.  Welcomed warmly by David, who made sure our room was to our liking.  We chose the Golden Suite, which had incredible ceilings dating back from when it was a home.  Bedding super comfy, bath products luxurious. Mini bar was stocked daily with complimentary soda and water.  We were on the third floor and could have taken the elevator, but chose to wind down the amazing marble steps that wound down to the lobby. The stair railings still have the initials of Alfred Sommier in the wrought iron.
Breakfast was a buffet, which was amazing and  plentiful (everything kept covered and very sanitary).  Could either eat inside or out in the very private garden area.  Service was attentive no matter where you sat.  Even though we were in the heart of Paris, we chose to have drinks and dinner in the hotel's restaurant as well.  Very professional waiter (who also made a mean martini) and the menu selections were both perfect and well priced.
After we checked in and asked about restaurants in the area, David helped us choose one to our style and tried to call the restaurant to make a reservation, to no avail. As we were wandering in the area, we ran into David on the street.  He had actually left the hotel to go to the bistro in person to make our reservation.  Now THAT is customer service that I have never experienced before.  
We will be back to our new favorite place in Paris as soon as we can!

title: Fabulous stay; beautiful boutifque hotel, great service and perfect loctation
text:
We just had a wonderful one week stay at Hotel Alfred Sommier and having stayed at many hotels in Paris highly recommend this as our first choice.  

The hotel is in a beautiful original mansion with very high ceilings, original gold moldings and fabulous herring bone wood floors.  The hotel also has a lovely garden to have drinks or dine in which is truly rare in Paris.  

The staff also really make the stay a special experience.  David and Cyrille at the front desk are welcoming, friendly, helpful and knowledgeable about Paris.  The elegant French owner, Richard, is often at the property and greets his guests personally and makes you feel as if you're staying at a friends home.  Service overall truly outstanding.

The location is perfect for shopping on Rue Du Faubourg St Honore, walking distance to the Louvre, Seine, Opera House and the Champs Elysees.  Right next to Place Madeleine which also has lovely gourmet food shops.

If you're looking for a luxury stay at a very reasonable price in a great location this is it!

title: It's a very nice hotel with some very disappointing details
text:
With travel experience I can say that we usually evaluate the place itself and what feeling it gives us. So Alfred Sommier has left mixed feelings about it.

1st of all I would say that if not some inconveniences while staying there, and if we judge just the building, I would really give the hotel at least 4 points out of 5. It is really a beautiful place with a history and charm and good location and these things we really loved about the hotel.

To sum up good and bad I would mention these points:

Positive:

- We really liked historical interior (except maybe some small details but it's personal anyway).
- Bed is really comfortable.
- Rooms are really beautiful (I did ask to visit several of them). 
- Guerlain amenities is a beautiful touch.

Negative:

- The biggest issue we've met- was the noise made by the A/C. It's really loud and woke us up during the night. It's not constant, appearing just from time to time but really loud when it's there. And we were staying at the suite by the way.

- When we've told about the A/C noise at the reception -we didn't like how it was handled. 
	- The lady at the reception to whom we told the issue, 1st said that she will speak with technician. After 10-15min she told that she has spoken to the technician and there is absolutely nothing to do. She also told us that she worked at the hotel for 1,5 years and she hears this complain for the 1st time (although during conversation she said also that the owner is aware of that problem). She also assured us that this noise is present in each and every room of the hotel and, if we wish, she can change our suite but the noise would be exactly the same.
	- On the day of our departure the attitude of another lady at the reception was totally different- simple and human which we've really appreciated. She told us that the issue is not new and simply some people don't hear it while sleeping others do. She apologised and we also learned that it is not in all the rooms that it is present this noise. As someone who used to work with clients I can say that in many cases clients are able to understand things when they are explained and they themselves prefer to find solutions rather than to stay in negative impression and spoiling their travel experience.

- 1st evening of our stay nobody came to prepare our room for the night. At the beginning we thought it's due to the Covid but the rest of the nights there was always someone passing by to do it. It's just a detail  but, for example there was a small problem with our curtain and we couldn't close it as we didn't want to bother ourselves that night we just left it. Next day we've asked and it was fixed. 

- So would say the service is not constantly maintained.

At the end what we've said to ourselves about Alfred Sommier that it's one of those hotels where not everything it's perfect (if we'd consider 5*) but we've still felt somehow good there. Most probably we would come back to the hotel maybe just choosing another room, without noise this time.

title: Worst hotel I’ve stayed at
text:
We stayed at this hotel last year with friends and numerous things went wrong. We arrived very late and I was asked to pay £400 for any fees that might occur which is normal , my card was declined 3 times as I had a limit put on my card while abroad , I’ve asked to do this in the morning as clearly I needed to contact my bank, my request was refused . I’ve paid £2k for my hotel stay, do you think I won’t be able to pay £400? No empathy was shown that it was midnight and no apologies. My room was tiny even for Paris standards and there was nothing luxurious about it compared to other hotels I’ve stayed at. The key cards never worked for me or my friends so we had to make trips to reception constantly, all reception did was say that we should keep them in a separate pocked but we never even mixed them with anything else as we do understand how they work. I’ve also ordered flowers to be delivered to my friends room , hotel wasn’t able to locate the flowers after florist delivered them.. the phone in bedroom did not work and it was impossible to reach the reception unless going downstairs which took more than 5 min from my room. When I asked for the phone to be repaired it never happened. Breakfast room was very small with very little option for vegetarians. But at this point I didn’t even expect anything from this hotel anymore. I’ve also had breakfast included but I was charged for it on the first day , when I pointed that out the waitress was unhappy that she will need to adjust the bill, maybe because she likes doing nothing like the rest of the staff in the hotel. She never apologised for charging me breakfast when it was included. On Saturday evening me and friends alone were having drinks and we were aware that it’s late , an hour after receptionist comes in to stay that we have to go because they are expecting a large group of people, why choose to lie instead telling us that you simply want to close the bar? On Sunday evening room service knocked to ask if I need them to clean the room I’ve said no, half an hour after I was getting out of the shower while a man walks in without knocking , thank god I had a towel on me , he was embarrassed but please it’s a luxury hotel , can’t you see how bad your service is?! I’ve never had a hotel failing this bad ! 
To add to this I’ve email the manager to complain and he tried to justify every single point I made in an arrogant , angry manner also promised me to investigate but never came back to me , it’s been months. My suggestion is to be less arrogant and actually try to work for once and like and serve  your guests instead of being useless overcharged hotel

title: New star rating at France misleading. This No way a 5 star. 4 star at most
text:
It has been 2 1/2 years since the last time I visited France and something weird happened with the hotel stars categorization the ministry in charge does every 5 years. I have read in recent reviews many are complaining about the same, and with good reason. This time I found that several hotels that used to be 4 stars now are ranked 5 stars and 3 stars upgraded to 4, apparently because of a lowering of the bar (check the reviews of Castile Paris and Napoleon, two hotels I considered for this stay. Several reviewers complaining in that regard). Now I am joining the rankings of guest mislead by that strange event.

I have rated this  hotel 3 points because of QP ratio (for the same or almost the same rate I could have stayed at other better places but I didn’t because this was supposed to be 5 star hotel), because it is not a 5 star as indeed is categorized by the public entity in charge, and because of several issues I experienced:

1. Tiny restrooms and very basic materials used in them, definitely more the type of restrooms to be found at 3 or 4 star properties. On top of that inconveniently designed, they don’t have doors in the shower space, so all the floor is soaked when the shower is finished. I booked a deluxe room which is the second tier of their offerings, not the most basic room offered, so don’t tell me that to get a normal restroom I should have booked a suite . At least in a 5 star hotel it doesn’t work like that
2. Air conditioning almost nonexistent. Even with the winter temperatures, inside the room it was at 21-20 so had to sleep without blanket. And I kept all the time the thermostat set to 16 centigrades and in cool mode, which I never got in 5 days
3. A ludicrous one but that for me represented several nights of bad sleeping: they don’t have regular pillows! They use a small - square design more appropriate for cushions. I asked two different times for a normal pillow different than the ones furnished in the beds and what they sent to me was a small version of a regular rectangular pillow, made of foam and not the fluffy material of the pillows supplied with the bed. For me that’s a problem as several times when I turned while sleeping, my head was at the border of the pillow furnished with the bed and I didn’t get a good sleep 
4. I get the idea that the charm of hotel is that the rooms belong to the original property of the 19 century, and carpeting is limited so the original parquet is visible; but in that case if they want to be a 5 star hotel the carpeting in the room should be a kilim or persian style rug and not the generic carpet that they put around and below the beds, it looks cheap and damages the effect of the vintage room

Now the good things:
1. Good location
2. Attentive personnel, always with good attitude and trying to be helpful. In fact, I believe the only 5 star aspect of the hotel is their staff
3. Nice touches like the toiletries, the fireplace lit at night everyday; and the premises which are vintage - charming

I can see this place can appeal to certain kind of travelers, the ones that like luxury bed and breakfasts experiences and country manors, but this is not a 5 star hotel and if it weren’t for the charming house and the attentive personnel it would be more like a good 3 star.

I am sorry for the owner to be so blunt,  I know he is in the place almost all days and  strives to make the property and the experience amenable, but it s hard to change the facts with just the desire to please the guests.

title: So graceful ...
text:
This is truly a rare find in Paris:  A magnificent family home still belonging to the same family, superbly and luxuriously transformed into a hotel with all of the modern conveniences while retaining the many graceful architectural details of a 19th century hotel particulier.  The photographs on the website are very accurate.  Having had the sad experience of staying in some incredibly claustrophobic rooms in otherwise very stylish hotels in Paris, we especially appreciated our spacious Junior Suite filled with light, the floor-to-ceiling French windows, a view of the garden (and of Miro prints!) from/in the breakfast room, and the inviting public spaces.  Like other reviewers have pointed out, seeing the owner on-site explains that sense of pride and attentiveness at Hotel Alfred Sommier:  We feel like we are guests at someone’s private home, and we were treated accordingly with that very personal and gracious hospitality.  Turning from the street rue de l'Arcade into that courtyard to enter the hotel just accentuates that feeling of privacy.

We look forward very much to our future stays at this lovely hotel!

title: Feels a bit understaffed, rooms a bit small, small details missing
text:
The place best point is it’s location. If you have something to do in the city center this place is great, everything is almost walkable or a short taxi ride away. It has a discreet entrance,  it doesn’t very grand feeling but that’s fine by me. Guys at the door are awesome and have great presentation.
The breakfast room felt a bit desolated. The rooms are rather small even by Parisian standard. Some small things I noticed, one towel had some dark coloring, the head of the bed color had some stains, the rooms doors and windows didn’t have much noise proof work done, you can hear everything on what’s happening outside. High floor but you can your upper neighbor every foot mouvements. Heat control a bit weak. Bed is comfortable. Bathroom door doesn’t close so you May splash lots of water while showering. Not much noble materials are used on the bathroom, it has a bit of a cheap feeling with these anti humidity rubber used. Room service food was just not good , choices are very sparse that you might as well install Deliveroo... Basically it’s just pizza and pasta, and a smoked salmon and cheese plate. No real proteins just carbs carbs carbs. It’s not hard to bake a fish or sthing. I ordered a four cheese pizza and it was quite awful. I finished it anyway as I had a busy day and didn’t have anything the whole day .however the tiramisu dessert was excellent.
As I had a busy day int have the chance to explore more the property but it’s rather small anyway. The garden and dining room have a grand feeling. 
Lastly I thought it was a non smoking property so I was careful not smoking but then I saw a guy casually smoking on the hotel garden.maybe I should have asked.
Mixed feeling but for this location and price range, I’d say it’s rather competitive. If I compare to other five star properties worldwide, then it’s not really matching.

It was a perfect balance of historic charm with modern amenities. It’s a former Parisian mansion converted to a hotel. So everything is new. The best part of our stay was the hotel staff. Every day they made sure we were taken care of... they left madeleines and macarons every day, came to turn down the bed, and were incredibly polite. Christopher was amazing ready to offer us with restaurant suggestions or to give us advice on the best way to get somewhere. They treated us like family. We would definitely come back to stay again. This was by far the best hotel experience that I’ve had... EVER.

text:
My husband and I stayed at Hotel Alfred Sommier for one night on Monday 12th August as a treat visit to a more high-end accommodation for our wedding anniversary.

title: The best location but poor food
text:
First we must say that the hotel staff was very friendly, warm and professional. The location was near anything important in Paris and hotel was also located in a very good neighborhood.

Cleaning staff took care of our (small) room three times a day and the small mini bar without alcohol were also included for the cost of the stay.

Having said that the restaurant unfortunately did not had food that matches the hotel’s 5 star rating. We once visited the restaurant to eat something. Before that we only had glasses of champagne in the bar. Our stay did not include breakfast.

I ordered Caesar salad which had pieces of fish in it (cost was 20 euros) and my wife had toast which had a weird thick layer on top of that toast. Toast also included salad which had missed it’s expiry date. We also asked for two glasses of rose Moet Chandon champagne but for some unknown reason we were never brought the rose version of that champagne. Instead we got the normal version of the champagne. 

The owner of the hotel lingers in the halls and eats at the restaurant. We chose not to meet the owner because we where there to see Paris and the the hotel nor the owner.  The hotel also holds a deposit of 100 € per night which will be given back at the check out. That is a weird procedure since it’s a five star hotel. If we brake something we certainly can afford to cover the damages. There is no need to hold up a deposit on my credit card. It seems the hotel does not trust it’s guests and certainly makes me wonder as to why such a procedure is in place. No other five star hotel in the world does this.

title: A truly beautiful, relaxing stay!
text:
My fiancé booked this exquisite, wonderful hotel for my surprise birthday weekend in Paris and from the minute we arrived, we were drowned in exquisite luxury!
Everything in this hotel is wonderful - the rooms, the service ... everything!

It was the little touches that made this hotel outshine any other I have ever visited; the receptionist taking us personally to our room and offering to show us around the hotel, the cold selection of drinks that are restocked free of charge every day, the robe and slippers and the guerlain products! But above all, the fact that someone comes early evening to prepare your room for bedtime - amazing!

The hotel staff have really thought through everything here and offer such an exquisite, relaxing stay. And the fact that it is in a busy location but you can’t hear a thing from your room is just wonderful.

We had such a wonderful stay here, we really would not hesitate to go back and experience the luxury. It is like staying in a 5 star hotel but with a personal, homely feel ... truly amazing!

title: A superb hotel--my current Paris favorite--and a great value, with a great history
text:
I rarely, rarely give five stars (go check), but in the case of the Hotel Alfred Sommier, it is clearly a warranted rating.  Family-owned and run by 5th generation scion,  Richard de Warren (who is quite present, overseeing things), it only opened last year after an extensive renovation, and is now fully up-to-date, but that is only part of the story.

This hotel is unusual in one way--the hotel part only occupies one half of the building overall.  The other half is occupied by business tenants, which is a good thing since they are not only quiet, but they tend to pay their bills on time and reduce the volatility of the revenue stream that supports the hotel.  This bodes well for the future stability.

The hotel is on a very quiet side street that is filled with other small-to-medium-sized  boutique hotels.  The locations is near perfect--a couple blocks from the Opera, a couple blocks from the Madeleine, a couple blocks from Boulevard Haussmann, but very privately tucked away.  Taxis are called by the concierge, and arrive quickly, normally within 5 minutes.

The Sommier has about 80 rooms, so not precisely boutique, but it feels that way.  It is extremely quiet--no traffic noise, really no noise at all (except the occasional maid's cart outside your room with squeaky wheels and a heavy-walking maid pushing it who does not wear sneakers!), so generally very restful.  You enter down a long passageway (where the concierge is), having been greeted by one of the most positive, friendly doormen/valets you will ever see in France.  The reception area is quite modest in size, but perfectly adequate, and again, staffed by very friendly (but not obsequious) staff.  All the staff are well scrubbed, attractive, friendly, and helpful--just what you want, but seldom see.  There is little they won't do for you.  The elevator is a capacious, 10-person, well-functioning Otis--none of this usual midgets-only stuff found in other older hotels.  

The rooms are very well appointed. The floors are a mix of hardwood and carpet, but everything is very clean.  The bathrooms are all virtually new, with new fixtures, and everything works well.  The bed is extremely comfortable with good lighting, good pillows--very restful.  There is a small desk (the rooms are not large), but the Internet is excellent--25 MB/second both upload and download speeds.  There is a coffee maker, a safe, plenty of welcome treats like Madeleines (surprise!), fruit, macarons, etc--no stinting here, and all tasty.  My room even had a fireplace (not functional given the season of course)

A special feature of the hotel is the bar/back garden area.  The first courtyard you see when you walk down the entrance passageway has a twin courtyard in the back of the hotel that is really a garden where you can sit outdoors on couches and have your food or drink.  It is especially wonderful, and restful.  The bar adjoins this garden, so service is excellent.  

I did not try the restaurant, nor take breakfast in the hotel, so I cannot comment on that.  

So let's see, what are the complaints, if any?  

First, the rooms need better shades.  The current curtains are attractive, but hard to maneuver since they hang from rings that slide on a high bar, and which are difficult to move.  Even when moved into position, they do not block the light well enough.  Blackout shades would be an improvement.  

Second, the safety of the bath.  The shower is the typical Euro thing where the tub has the shower head overhead, with a half-width glass barrier to keep the shower spray from going all over the floor.  So far, so good.  But, the bottom of the tub is slick, and there are no provided rubber bath mats as one would normally see at a top-flight hotel.  Moreover, there are no hand-holds as one often sees that are there for the disabled to get into and out of the bath.  This creates an extremely dangerous situation where slipping and falling (keep in mind that the bathroom floors are polished, not honed, marble as well?) is a near certainty.  I fear that this hotel will be hit with a successful lawsuit once someone falls and cracks their head over this very avoidable danger.   That said, once recognized for the danger that it is, the bathroom works well, and the amenities (shampoo, conditioner, etc.) are first rate.

I will certainly return to this hotel.  For my $412 per night, I think it is a bargain, especially when compared to places like the Vendome ($1500 per night) or the Peninsula ($3500 per night), which were doing the usual air-show-week gouging of customers.  Plus the added advantage of a clientele that does not insist on showing off their Lamborghinis is extremely welcome.

title: Wonderful recently-restored 5-star hotel with great location and staff
text:
Terrific, recently restored hotel with well-appointed, comfortable and clean rooms and a very helpful and friendly staff all around (from check-in to arranging transport for departure on check-out).  The hotel is nested down a quiet street, but close enough to many of the areas we like to walk to (museums, shopping, etc.). The owner Richard greeted us on check-in, and even offered to have a drink and chat at the bar one evening which we sadly were not able to schedule for this trip, but surely will for the next one!

The room was relatively spacious and very comfortable, and housekeeping was attentive and ensured all amenities were replenished. The minibar was restocked with waters, sodas, coffee, tea etc. each day (complimentary) which was nice to be able to have on hand (the Nespresso machine being a start-of-day lifesaver!).  Even a couple of madeleine cookies provided each day as a treat, apropos to the locale of the hotel.

And, for those who cannot fully unplug and/or need to combine work with pleasure (or just traveling for business), the TV had plenty of international multi-lingual stations, and the wi-fi was included and very speedy and reliable (all fringe benefits of the hotel being recently restored no doubt, but nonetheless the hotel retained a very classical feel to it with respect to the decor and ambience).

title: Stuck in the elevator for over an hour
text:
A girlfriend, and I with our daughters in tow visited 5 countries in 17 days. We toured through Europe with our last stop being Paris. 
The hotel was nice, comfortable, clean and the front desk staff was friendly overall. Then comes the elevator, or 'lift'. The first day we get there, we are tired from travelling. the elevator is very small, so my 15 year old daughter goes up with a bag to our room on the 3rd floor. She comes back down, and the elevator door will not open. She is panicking, as it is very hot and small. The front staff tell us the maintenance guy is close, and he will get her out shortly. 20 min later, he comes, and its fixed. We called her to calm her down.
The front desk staff tell us we have to wait for a click or the door gets stuck. We ask why they didn't tell us this sooner?

We avoid the elevator for the rest of our stay.
The day comes when we are to leave. We go for breakfast and bring two suitcases down to make bringing luggage down easier. Our transfer to the airport is waiting outside. We have heavy bags, and the spiral staircase would have been hard to manage with our luggage.
We go up in the lift to get the last of our bags. The elevator gets stuck between floors 2 and 3 for over an hour. No one even noticed the alarm for at least 10 minutes. A front desk woman comes on the intercom and says the maintenance guy is 30 minutes away.  by the time he gets there, we are in there for over an hour. Sweating, crying, phoning Air Canada... Maintenance guy arrives, and the door is pulled open, still between floors.
We were pulled out between floors by our wrists and told that cabs had been called to get us not the airport as we had sent our transfer away. At this point, we were 90 min behind schedule. We begged the airport staff to let us through the line so we could make our plane.
We were never offered an apology, a free night, anything. In fact, we felt like they blamed us for taking 'too many bags' when it was just two people in the elevator when it got stuck. Terrible end to my amazing trip, and a black mark on Best Western as a whole in my opinion.

title: Fantastic property a short walk from the Eiffel Tower!
text:
We loved our stay at the Best Western Trocadero La Tour (do note there are two BW properties close to the Eiffel Tower - make sure to confirm your address!). We stayed in a Family Room with my wife and I and our two daughters and the room was plenty big for the 4 of us. Note that you’re getting European size rooms which get even smaller in somewhere as pricey as Paris but we were able to fit comfortably for our 4 night stay. 

This room had the queen(?) bed along with two rollaways for our girls that they said were very comfortable. We were on the 6th floor and fortunately there was an elevator (it’s tiny - 3 people or 1 with all the bags was a squeeze) but our girls loved using the spiral staircase. 

The bathroom was bigger than expected with two sinks and mirrors and a shower tub. The tub only had glass covering the first half so use caution when showering as it’s easy to soak the floor if you aren’t paying attention to where water is spraying!

The location is awesome - off a side street from the very cool Rue de Passy (we loved the Passy district!) so nice and quiet at night. Passy has tons of shopping and restaurants all within an easy walk from the hotel as well as two metro options (one with the RER) also close by. The Eiffel Tower is also a short walk down Rue de Passy which was a really nice surprise. 

All of the staff we met were fantastic and had great recommendations for restaurants or any other questions we had. We did not get the breakfast so can’t comment on that. We would definitely consider staying here again on our next trip to Paris!

title: Some pros and cons, but overall disappointing
text:

title: Phenomenal Hotel!
text:
My wife and I stayed here for 8 days on our honeymoon and I'm so happy we did! Here are just a few things we loved the most:
First, the location was PERFECT for what we were looking for. The hotel is tucked away on a quiet little side street from the Rue de Passy, so you don't get any kind of loud traffic noise. But once you're outside and you walk the 100 feet to the Passy, you have everything your heart desires: patisseries, shops, restaurants, a relatively close metro stop. If you turn left and start walking, you'll be in front of the Eiffel Tower in 10 minutes. It was fantastic!
Second, this was one of the cleanest hotels - not just European hotels - that I've ever stayed in. My wife is a total clean freak and she was very impressed. There was no cigarette smell and great air conditioning, which were both HUGE pluses for us. The bathroom was small by American standards but it was well arranged, clean, and did the job. I've read several people's reviews that complain about the small elevator. I'm just thankful the hotel has an elevator as we stayed on the 7th floor. Being able to send our luggage up with my wife was a lifesaver. 
Last but not least, the staff were great to work with and very friendly. Our safe ran out of battery and the manager came up and was super helpful and friendly. When we asked the front desk for any recommendations for dinner or directions to attractions, they were more than accommodating. 
I cannot recommend this hotel enough - seriously, unless you want to hear car horns and traffic all night, I don't think you could get a better hotel closer to any major Paris attraction.

title: Cute hotel, fabulous location, and honest, caring, outstanding staff
text:
We absolutely loved our stay at the Hotel Des Deux-Iles.  From before we even arrived, to after we left, everything exceeded our expectations.  Prior to our arrival, we worked directly with hotel staff to arrange cab service from CDG on our arrival day and to Orly on our departure day.  Both cab rides were great, and it was so nice not to have to figure it out ourselves.  We arrived at the hotel in the morning, far earlier than check-in time, and the wonderful Garance stored our luggage for us and made us feel welcome.  She recommended a dinner restaurant and made reservations for us.  After check-in that evening, we asked Garance about the honesty bar, and she insisted upon serving us our wine.  Each evening there was a wonderful little snack in the very welcoming and comfortable lobby area.  Every question was answered with a smile, and the kind staff made dinner reservations for us for our last night when we asked for yet another recommendation.  Our hotel stay was superb.  The location of the hotel on Ile Saint Louis is exceptional - we walked everywhere from there.  There are at least five wonderful, charming, and unique restaurants within two blocks of the hotel.  And shops!  We will definitely stay here on our next visit.  

But the best part of the visit happened after we checked out.   This is a wonderful above-and-beyond story.  About two hours later, I received an email from Gaspar to let me know I'd left a small wallet in the hotel safe.  Unfortunately we were at Orly airport, just about to board a flight to Corsica, and we couldn't come back to get it.  Gaspar sent a link to a packing and shipping company so that I could set up the delivery of my wallet home.  Because this online process was mostly in French, despite my translation efforts, I had to contact Gaspar multiple times.  Each time he responded with courtesy and respect.  I was able to finish the online request and  emailed the information to Gaspar, who then had to take the time and effort actually package my wallet for shipping and make sure to get it to the delivery service.  I was absolutely delighted, two days later, to get a text from my daughter-in-law with photos - one with a very sturdy packing box she'd had to open with a knife, and another of my wallet.  My wallet contained my credit card, my ATM card, and $74 cash.  The honesty, helpfulness, and professionality of Gaspar and the entire staff at Hotel Des Deux-Iles was awesome, and so appreciated.  I will recommend to anyone who asks about a hotel in Paris to stay there.  Thank you, Hotel Des Dex-Iles.

title: Perfect
text:
Just left Paris after a wonderful stay in this hotel on the Island Sainte Louis. It was perfectly located for my 8yr old child and two 18 year olds. We arrived during the sweltering heatwave and were very grateful for the cold air conditioning with outside temps going above 38 Celsius throughout our 3 days. It was wonderful to return to our cool rooms each afternoon! 

The hotel is located just across the road from an organic bakery and next to it, an organic fruit and veg store. There’s also an exquisite cheese shop a few doors down. A small convenience supermarket is also just down the road. Plus some excellent ice cream shops alongside. Together these were perfect for our picnics on the banks of the River Seine and we loved joining everybody else along the river each evening as there was a great festive ambience.  There are plenty of cafes and restaurants close by the hotel too which we enjoyed. Together with the easy walk to the Notre Dame, Sainte Chappel, Marais district, Louvre and Latin Quarter we loved the location of this small hotel. 

The staff were all friendly. So sweet with my children. We appreciated their English skills and local knowledge. Everyone on reception was lovely and welcoming. 

Breakfast was perfect. Fresh baguettes, croissants and good coffee were our favourites but lots of other choices and all fresh. 

Our room was located on the first floor and, contrary to some reviews here, we found it to be quiet with noise from the laneways barely perceptible with the windows closed. Great blackout curtains kept the early summer light out and allowed us to take afternoon naps when the outside temperatures got too hot. Our bed was comfortable and the room, while a little on the small side, is exactly what we expected for Paris. 

This was my 5th visit to Paris and the first time I left thinking I would happily return to the same hotel on my next visit. I look forward to returning to the Hotel des Deux Iles!

text: My fiance and I stayed with the Hotel des Deux Iles for three nights in May 2019. It was glorious. the hotel is beautiful, built in the 1600s. The room and hotel in general was immaculate. the breakfast was very tasty and the room in which it is held is very pleasant. The hotel owner and staff are a joy. So friendly, so welcoming, so well-informed about the neighborhood and Paris in general. They got us excellent taxis when we needed them, and gave great advice. They even had a bottle of champagne waiting for us in our room, because they ascertained that we were about to be engaged, on top of the Eiffel Tower! The Ile Saint Louis was the absolute perfect place to stay in Paris. I have stayed in Paris many many times before, starting in 1984 when I was in college living in Tours, France. This hotel, and the island itself, are glorious. So quiet, so peaceful, like a little private paradise in the middle of the grand European center that Paris is. There are only three main streets, with gourmet shops and restaurants, but everything is very tasteful and quiet. You are smack dab in the very center of Paris, yet there is absolutely no din. Stay ANYWHERE else in Paris, and you will find great noise. This hotel, like I said, and the island itself, are like a hidden secret. You will be VERY LUCKY if you can find space in this hotel. Believe me. I speak from experience. I have a Ph.D. and travel widely in the world. I have never, ever, stayed in such a special, charming, welcoming, unique hotel, and I have stayed at Ritz Carltons before, and other three and four star hotels. Bravo to you if you are fortunate to find availability in the Hotel des Deux Iles.

title: Making us feel at home.
text:
The warm welcome, friendly staff, amazing location and cozy accommodations made for a trip that my mom and I will never forget. From the moment I booked, I was made to feel as if we were the only guests that mattered. 

Because of the early arrival of our flight, I arranged for a shuttle pick up with the concierge Pamela, the hotel’s perfect ambassador. My mother and I were greeted by the driver with a welcoming smile, clean and well appointed van; he knew his way around this jewel box of a city. I would definitely recommend this for anyone who has an early flight.

We were thrilled that early check-in was available (I asked prior to arrival) so that we could settle in, unpack and unwind. The location was so perfect that we were able to grab a nosh at the truly French bistro St. Regis and then head around the corner to Notre-Dame. Because I did not want my mom (or me) to wait in the long lines to enter Paris’ most iconic museums, I purchased our four-day museum passes in advance and had them delivered to the hotel. So easy and well worth the extra euro. 

The staff always asked about our day and what they could do to enhance our stay. The room was cozy,  quiet and provided us with  small amenities like a mini-fridge to keep our bottle of rose nice and chilled.

title: Always reliable and a perfect location.
text: This was my second stay. By US standards, the lobby, the rooms and bathrooms are small, but the windows are tall and look out to a classic Parisian street view.  There's an organic grocery across the street, bakeries nearby, restaurants on the corner.  A bridge nearby is closed to cars, so the atmosphere is very pedestrian friendly.  Notre Dame cathedral is a 5 minute walk away.  This hotel is great value.  Who wouldn't want to island hop in one of the world's most beautiful and romantic cities?  I hope to stay there again in the future.

title: TRY THE BREAKFAST.
text:
Location, Value and Staff have all been given comprehensive reviews. However, for ease of use, the breakfast arrangements need explanation.

4) the orange juice is delightful and absolutely fresh.
5) a small selection of quality meats, cheese and cereals is provided.
6) all ingredients are of a high standard.
7) whilst an "urn" is provided for boiling eggs (difficult to use) staff will cook eggs to your preferred style. Although that can be hit and miss!
 8) a pot of tea or coffee is brought to your table with re-fills available. A Nespro machine is also available.
9) consider that the local cafes are charging Euro 10 for simple coffee, crossiant and preserved orange juice.

RECOMMENDATION :-
Have your first breakfast at the Hotel as on a comparative basis it offers a quality product at a reasonable price

title: Great location, touch on the expensive side
text:
This is among the more expensive hostels in Paris and in hindsight, I would have booked a cheaper one given that I am a budget traveller.

That said if you are traveler who likes to party, you will like this place. The location is excellent, 2 minutes from Metro and tons of great places to eat and drink. There is a bar adjacent to the hostel where you can party and meet locals and have a good time.

Some of the staff is good and others go about their job. I got a room on the ground floor and the sleeping bed was comfortable. The rooms are clean. Only issue was that it was just adjacent to the bar and hence got really noisy while trying to sleep.

So if you wish to sleep early, request if you can get the top floor which is likely to be less noisier. The breakfast was very good by hostel standards

title: Good value for money stay
text: My daughter and I shared a two bedroom private ensuite room here. We looked at other properties in Paris and the pricing at 3-Ducks was very competititve.  The room is very small and the beds are utilitarian and creaky. However the bedding was perfectly adequate, the water pressure and hot water were excellent, and we had our own aircon to control for the heat. The door to the room faces the courtyard and as others have said, we could hear the party noise late until the evening. However it never went past midnight and we got used to it. Sometimes the smoky smell was a little bothersome.  We found all the staff to be very friendly - from the recepitonist to the cleaning staff to the woman who arranged breakfast. And the breakfast was more than I've had at some hotels in France. It included choice of Coffee/tea/hot chocolate, milk, juices, cereals, yogurt, bread and croissant. Plus the kitchen area, while small, is adequate and has a refrigerator you can use. We really liked the neighborhood and enjoyed the walk towards the tourist areas. We stayed for a week and when we come back to PAris, we will be happy to stay here again.

title: Decent hostel
text:
This was my least favorite hostel in my travels.  The hostel itself is decent, and Im sure adequate for most. The room I had was directly above the outside of the outdoor patio and in the evenings I could hear the "party" like it was right inside the room.  I suppose its the echo off the building.  The next night I realized the window was broke and not close all the way.  With some creativity, I was able to secure the window closed and the sound was muffled a bit better the following nights.

The bunk beds are not very nice.  If your bunk mate moves, you move too. cheap chinsy metal frames, crappy mattresses.  not a nice sleep.  Positives, the bathrooms was ensuite and clean. water pressure in the shower is nice.  location is great. quiet, safe and clean neighborhood and easily walk from the subway line.  I wouldn't stay here just for the proximity to the Eiffel Tower.  Its still quite a walk...I don't think this is an advantage as there are other places to stay closer or you can take the subway from anywhere just as quickly.  
...and don't show up a minute sooner than check in. They will make you wait in the lobby (regardless if your room is ready).  Also, don't look your deposit slip or you won't get your deposit on towels refunded.  In this day and age, its absurd you have to keep a slip of paper to receive a refund.  Possibly use the computer to keep track?

title: Cozy Hostel in Quaint Paris Location
text:
Cozy Hostel in Quaint Paris Location

I loved this hostel. I was in an 8 bed ensuite dorm and stayed for 3 nights. Everything was very clean. There is no laundry service inside the hostel but there are laundromats nearby. There was a heated rack in the shower in my dorm so I could leave towels there to dry. The lockers are combination safes that are big enough for a day bag but too small for my 26L backpack. The edison outlets (2 each if I remember correctly?) were a little way above the bed itself so it might be good to bring longer cables unless you want to leave things dangling in the air. Wifi was all right as well, it reached the rooms so that was great. Sometimes had trouble connecting my laptop, but not really a big deal. 

The front desk attendants / bartenders are all very friendly, attractive, eager to ask about how you're doing, and create a very social atmosphere. I had a little mix up with my reservation (my fault) but they took care of it efficiently and with a smile. The bar is well equipped and people are drinking from the afternoon. It is also quite popular with locals so I had the opportunity to chat with a few who speak English—according to them, it is the best bar in the area! The patio area is the most lively but you can also just sit down quietly with a beer and book if that's you're thing. Not sure about other rooms but in mine, the sound from the chatter and music was never a problem, even late at night. The bar closes down at around 1am I think? I can’t remember. 

The people staying at this hostel were definitely personable. Not as obnoxious as the young and drunk crowd of the blatant party hostels, although the guys that I talked to were there to have a good time. 

There is free breakfast in the morning (7:30-) which was fantastic. Obviously the selection is quite simple but given that it was free, it was more than enough. Bread, cereal, coffee, juice, that kinda stuff.

Location wise, it was absolutely lovely. The area is generally quiet and is full of delightful little shops that are fun to pop into. It’s also convenient because most necessities are a quick walk away. The eiffel tower is about a 30 minute walk away and the walk there itself is pleasurable as well. 

You can probably find slightly cheaper hostels in Paris but I think you get great value here.

title: Literally the best place to stay in Paris
text: I stayed in this hostel for about a week from late May to early June. Not only are the staff friendly, they go above and beyond to make sure you’re having a good time. By the end of my trip I was hugging everyone I’ve met: staff and fellow travelers. This is the best place to meet a combination of travelers and locals as the bar located on the first floor is the local hangout. People have complained about it being too loud but I slept in a room both on the ground floor where the outdoor sitting for the bar is and on the second floor and I never once had an issue with noise. As far as security goes the hostel is in a neighborhood meaning that me as a 20 something year old 5 ft girl felt perfectly at ease walking around. Security in the room includes a lock box where you can store valuables. The rooms and bathroom area are clean. Finally, the metro and grocery store are literally less than a 5 min walk from the hostel. I loved Paris so much and I can definitely say that accommodations do make or break your travel experience. Would reccomend this hostel to anyone

title: Smelly and rude receptionists
text:
!!!DONT BOOK THIS HOSTEL!!!    We payed alot and read good reviews. When we arrived we got welcomed by a room that stinked so bad and by hairs on our bed. The receptionist (guy with glasses) was also super rude because we wanted to see the room before paying (he was repeating three times : "are you sure " ... "this is the first time somebody asked me " like its weird to see the room before sleeping there... ) 

The rooms were horrible. They smelled (the floor), sheets were stained and hairs on the bed. At least there were no bed bugs. Furthermore, the rooms were cold and the showers were very dirty (dust and hairs everywhere).

The breakfast was shaming. It ended every day at 9:30 and then you had to leave. The food selection was very very limited. On Easter day, it was the same and nothing extra was offered. 

The last day when checking out, the receptionists were talking about us us (in French), gossiping. Very rude. 

There was nowhere to chill - no space in the room to sit and chat and the only common place is noisy overcrowded bar. 

Location was bad for going out people. One evening were were walking outside on the street with the bottle and the receptionists run after us (outside) to check whether it was alcohol in the bottle!?!?!?!? That was very weird and unpolite. 

Conclusion, dont book this hostel, except if you want to have a bad hostel experience.

title: Great - most of the time
text:
It's a nice hostel filled with lovely people. I only have two "negative" things to say about it, and that's if you want to sleep, you should bring earplugs, because the bar plays loud music + you risk living with loud people. The other thing is, that you have to be down for the breakfast at least half an hour before it ends, otherwise you risk they are out of the good stuff (and one of the staff is a bit grumpy) - other than that, it was a great stay. The toilets are great, with really good showers, and the breakfast was really good as well (if you are vegan, you should consider buying some milk or yoghurt yourself, which you can then eat with the müsli they have at the hostel - which is really great!). You also get access to a nice and small kitchen - there is not a lot of space for storage, but if you just want to cut some vegetables from the shop next door and heat up some beans/ cook pasta it's great! 
It's placed close to the Eiffel tower and to two different metro lines - alas, quite nice.

title: Nice Hostel, Rude Staff
text: As a Travel Agent I have booked this Hostel as per research with the intention of staying closed by my VIP Clients in Paris. I have arrived 1 day before in Paris due to Irma Hurricane. I went to the Hostel to request a lower bed because I have a health condition in my back. The receptionist was very welcoming saying that would leave a note. The next day arriving at 9pm at the check-in the new receptionist named Juan was totally different them the previous one. Rude, arrogant, making faces that ~I dont care~, when I reported my back problem. He didnt care at all. Did not offered me a towel as well. The Hostel is good, good location, nice rooms, very small showers with no place to display not even a towel, the bed was ok with lot of metal noise. When I reported to the receptionist that I would like him to inquire the next day for a lower bed he didnt care. Anyway, on the second night I have decided to book a Hotel because of the request not been accepted and the fact that this gentleman was absolutely rude again to me making a ~I dont care~face! This is was ridiculous and I would never even come back to a place that accept such a horrible Host. As I am Brazilian and he is Argentian I have my thoughts that he has prejudice of my nationality and I love Argentina, visiting each year 20 times there. I have reported to the Manager all experience that I had and he seemed to protect more his staff instead of apologizing and looking at my bad experience with a health condition. So, please I want to state here this horrible experience with a Human person who treated me very bad and honestly as per my reviews I am always polite, professional and courteous, but in 19 years in Hospitality bussiness I have never seem such a horrible receptionist like Mr. Juan at 3 Ducks Hostel.
