title: Definitely coming back
text: I stayed at this hostel for 4 nights and I highly recommend it. Great neighborhood, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, very well connected (subway station right in the corner), clean, comfortable, breakfast included and has a bar which is an amazing place to meet new people. At 12am they close the indoor patio so you can sleep with no noice. If you are sensitive to this I suggest ear plugs (at any hostel). I'm reading other comments complaining  about the drink's price -welcome to Paris! Be prepared to spend some big bucks. Regarding the staff, they were nothing but helpful and super friendly. I'll definitely stay here next time!

title: Alright / Fine / probably wouldn't go back
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights at the beginning of the month at the start of our interrailing trip. It was fine. Bathroom was nice and clean. Beds weren't comfy but it is a hostel. We had a room that went straight on to the courtyard which was always dead busy at night which again was fine. 

You should be aware that the walls are paper thin and you can literally hear everything going on in the courtyard. There wasn't really any points during the night where the place fell quiet and this was not necessarily down to people drinking in the courtyard until the early hours (I think they may people go into bar after 11pm) but it seems you can hear someone whisper from the bar in the ground floor rooms. I say this for people looking at booking private rooms and people wanting to hold conversation in the courtyard after 11pm because we literally heard all of the inner workings of your anatomy guy from Boston! 

Another thing that perhaps was annoying was the fact there was no do not disturb sign as we had a private room instead of a dorm. As we were out a lot a night we weren't getting ready until 9/10am in the morning but we were constantly walked in on by cleaners / maids who were apologetic but could've been avoided if we had a do not disturb sign.

Again this is a hostel and by hostel standards was fine but don't come here if you're looking for a good nights sleep.

title: Would recommend
text: Haven't stayed in a hostel for a few years but decided to in Paris as I was travelling solo and thought I could meet other travellers. Was in a 6 bed female dorm on first floor. No noise issues up here and couldn't hear between rooms either. Happy with aircon as it was so hot when I stayed. Separate shower room and toilet both with own hand basins. Clean and comfy rooms with individual lockers. Had my own towel but think you can hire if you don't. Happy with the breakfast each morning too. Loved the location, tube stops nearby and is situated in a lovely neighbourhood with plenty of choice for restaurants, grocery stores, fashion, ice cream and more! Perfect little park to laze about in the sun.

title: Decent Hostel
text:
The hostel is located within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower which I guess is its main selling point. There are two metro stops in walking distance which makes getting around fairly easy. The hostel itself is clean, with a fantastic high pressure shower and air conditioning. 

We had a room located at the front of the building which meant it was incredibly loud, from the metro running underneath the property and general street noise. Also note that access to the rooms is through the courtyard of the bar which seems very popular with locals - I imagine the ground floor rooms with direct access from the courtyard would be incredibly noisy.

title: Girls Weekend
text:
We have recently come back from the 3 ducks Hostel. Five friends all stayed in the same room and was perfect for us. The room was spacious for us and was just what we needed for 2 nights. A couple of improvements points would be washing your hair in the shower is rather annoying due to the shower head not being hooked night up and the room could of done with a draw of some sort so you don't have to live out of a rucksack. Otherwise perfect. The location isn't 10 minute walk from the Eiffel Tower it is more 20 minute walk however was still great for us. The surrounding area was beautiful and the location was just perfect. 
I would highly recommend staying here again and as a first experience in a Hostel I was very impressed.

title: Nice little hostel close to the Eiffel Tower.
text:
My friends and I stayed in a private 4 person room for two nights. Our room was on the second floor facing the courtyard, everything was clean and the interior was modern. Having an en-suite bathroom is an extra plus. As mentioned in the other reviews the bar area is a locals hangout spot, so it might not be easiest place to be social or meet other travelers. There was some noise at night from the bar as well as the metro running underground but nothing major, so perhaps only if you're very sensitive to noise it might be a problem for you. The free breakfast was nice, but there's no meat or eggs so it wasn't the most filling. 

The staff was friendly. My friends arrived before me since they were on a different flight, and while they waited for me to arrive from the airport to check us in they were given a free round of beers. Furthermore, one of my friends got some very bad sunburn in Barcelona and one of the staff was nice enough to give him some of her lotion.

title: Amazing hostel!
text:
I stayed here for 5 nights in march and was so impressed. 

Pros:
-free breakfast (croissants, cereal, yogurt)
-bar in hostel
-fun atmosphere (great place to meet people)
-good price
-comfortable beds
-2 usb ports and personal lights with each bed
-1 minute walk to the metro
-great shopping (3 minute walk to cafes, shops, grocery stores, and bars)
-luggage room to store your things so you can explore before your room is ready
-multilingual and very helpful staff

Cons
-must take stairs to your floor, no elevator
-music can be loud in the bar area, so not a great place to have intimate chats

Overall it was a great first hostel experience. I loved the modern vibe and met a lot of great people from all over the world! 10/10 would recommend and visit again!

title: Very good
text: I stayed in a 6-bed deluxe female dorm. The room had two en-suite bathrooms; one with a toilet, and a separate one with a shower. Lockers were very small, only large enough to hold your valuables but not a full size backpack. Courtyard is loud at night so any rooms facing it with have considerable noise. Very close to two metro stations so you get to downtown very quickly and easily. Plenty of little restaurants around and a grocery store right across the street. One day I decided to wonder around from the Eiffel Tower and next thing I know I recognized where I was as the neighborhood of the hostel so walking to and from the Eiffel Tower is doable. Breakfast was pretty good with cereal, juice, coffee, and croissants. A little expensive but everywhere to stay in Paris was expensive.

title: Very Clean Rooms and Friendly Staff
text:
The staff here was incredibly friendly and helpful with tips of places to check out.  The room was very clean and modern.  The safe is digital, so you don't need to worry about carrying a lock with you, which is an added perk.  I stayed in an all girls room, with 6 beds.  It worked out fine, but I do think if I were to return, I would pay extra for a room with 4 beds, simply to make the bathroom situation better.
This hostel is also a bar.  Keep that in mind if you are going during summer or warmer nights, and if you are a light sleeper.  I packed ear plugs and a face mask and was fine.  However, if I handn't had those, I would have certainly struggled to sleep as the shared court yard outside of the bar, is right outside the bedroom doors.
The only reason I took off a star is the WIFI is terrible in the room.  None of the girls I was there with at anytime could access the WIFI from the room and the only time it worked was in the bar.  That is very frustrating when trying to contact friends and family.  Also, the distance from the Eiffel Tower is more like 15-20 mins, not 10.  So I also considered that when removing a star, as it is not what the website states.
All in all, it was a wonderful stay, very budget friendly and very clean.  I would absolutely stay here again if I found myself back in Paris.

text:

title: Great location / very comfortable
text:
I had a wonderful stay at 9confidential Hotel. The location in Le Marais is wonderfully central to a lot of good shopping and not far from many excellent restaurants in the 11th. A metro station nearby gives you easy access to other parts of the city. 

I asked for a room in the courtyard to avoid any noise from the activities down below at night. It was a good decision. I slept soundly every night - the bed being very comfortable - and the insulation from other rooms being very good. 

The room size is fine for central Paris. There are several pleasant accessories in the room. The lobby is small but has a nice bar and very comfortable chairs with magazines in French and English. 

Best of all was the service. Noraliza welcomed us when we checked in and always had a pleasant smile for us - and some good advice - when we came in or stepped out.  I had a little problem with a misplaced credit card at a store close to the hotel. She helped me resolve the matter without any fuss. 

I would definitely stay at 9C again. It gives you everything you hope of a city center hotel and then a little bit more. 

Also - do head for Peleton Cafe (a short walk away) for excellent coffee.

The furniture and decor are modern comfortable with an extra touch of luxury. Rooms are big for 2 people, the bath is huge, the shower is great, the toilet is fun (it is the Japanese type that will clean your bottom but without the blow drying function).

Lots of hanging spaces (no wardrobe), good sofa and big chair, a big writing desk behind the bed where you can place your luggage on the floor, windows are all double glazed and the curtains are very thick to keep the light out and warmth within, very quiet and sleep very well at night.

But.......

The internet is totally unusable, the TV reception went blank every 2 minutes, spoke to Emilie the Manager and it has been like this for a while and no date is given when it will be fixed, so we have to watch the news several times to get the whole picture for the whole 9 nights there.  

On one day, our room was not cleaned and the excuse was that the hotel had too many check outs and check ins on the same day and therefore our room was not cleaned!

Only 1 bottle water is allocated for free for each stay, we drink the tap water anyway, seems a bit mean to save money this way. Cleaner will not take the empty bottle away, left it on the floor, wondering why, or reminding us the free one is consumed!

Asked for ironing board and iron, and only the ironing board is brought to our room, why no one will think the reason for getting an ironing board in the first place.

The water pressure of the bath is very low for both suites, it is like a trickling stream, so if you want to have a bath , plan it at least half an hour ahead.

Notified the Manager of all the above issues, we got an offer to have 2 glasses of champagne at the Bar downstairs, we didn't take it.

On the last day of the first stay, we brought up especially the internet and TV issues to Emilie and she offered to upgrade us to Aurore for the second stay, she went away for holiday the day after and when we checked in for the second stay, no one was aware of the offer and there was no Manager for the whole second stay when we were there, front desk staff were overworked, they were not supposed to make decisions such as TV or internet repairs and we were promised that Alexi (another Manager) will come to follow up with us and it never happened, we tried to email their corporate email addresses and no one replies.

Also, the lobster sculpture on the top floor outside Aurore has all the right limbs broken, it is not a good look, it should be repaired or replaced.  I can see scuff marks and wear tears on carpets and walls, the conditions should be better considering this is a relatively new 'luxury' hotel.

In a word, enjoy the stay and don't expect any offer of help if the Manager is not onsite.

The 3 stars I gave are mainly for the comfortable bed and spacious suite.

title: Boutique Jewel Box in Trendy Marais
text:
Upon arrival, we were a little put off by the unused wooden "cafe" structure blocking the street entry to the hotel.  We sat there a couple of times during our stay, but it's a bit neglected, looks a little like a corral, and never mentioned by staff.  A courtyard would have been really lovely.  

Once you enter 9Confidentiel, though, you see what a gem it is.  So tastefully designed in a modern-meets-Art Deco style with dusty pinks, brass, and mirrors - we enjoyed the small lobby several times during our stay.  There were four staff members in reception throughout our stay and each one was attentive, helpful, unobtrusive, pleasant, and efficient.  While my friend and I never ate in the restaurant, our husbands liked it enough to have breakfast there twice.  The elevator was a bit of a joke - very, very tiny! - though it was always working (slowly).  The stairwells were very clean and well-lit, so we used those occasionally.  

We stayed in the "Renee" on the 5th floor (loved how the rooms were named for alluring women in framed, hazy, b&w photos) and our friends were in the "Jeanne" on the 6th.  They were the same 'basic' class of room but were a little different.  Ours was in the front of the hotel and had a bay window with a long sofa underneath, which was a great place to sit and put your things.  There was a tiny table and one chair, as well as a corner stool.  The light and airy yellow room was a little marred by a massive flatscreen on the wall.  Definitely affected the vibe of the decor and was just not proportional (tiny room/giant tv).  

The windows let in so much light, especially on the 5th floor - I wouldn't have wanted to be any lower for that reason, in addition to the major street noise from the restaurants, especially on Friday/Saturday.  The windows did a really good job of blocking it out, but I'm not sure that would be possible on the 2nd or 3rd floor.  Our friends' room on the 6th floor faced the back of the hotel, so it was completely quiet and had a really charming rooftop view.  Ours faced apartments across the rue du Roi de Secile, but the window coverings in our room were incredible.  They were blackout, heavy, but a natural texture you didn't mind touching (lol) and the best part - fully automated via a little retro-James Bond switch next to the bed!  Genius.  Besides the low, comfortable beds and the great water pressure, these motorized curtains were the best feature of the room!  

The bedding was so soft and the duvet just the right weight - it all made for lovely sleeping from night one.  I will say that that Housekeeping was supposed to change sheets after the third night, but ours did not do it until the fourth.  The lamp lighting was also perfect in the room - no bright overheads, which I despise in hotel rooms - but also included the coolest bedside reading lights operated by just moving them up and down.   It just felt very Sean Connery-era Bond for some reason.  So many wonderful details make 9Confidentiel feel very special.  

Our room was completely covered in mirrors (not so the 6th floor room, which did not have a bay window or a couch) but were a bit fogged...mirrors, mirrors everywhere, but not one you can do your makeup with.  Our closet/bathroom area was in form of a very short hall when you walk in - the closet wasn't much more than some hooks, hangers, and a curtain.  The minibar was decent, but when it wasn't replenished, the bar downstairs bent over backwards to deliver a replacement.  

I'm pretty sure I've never reviewed a hotel toilet before, but this one glowed!  I was the perfect light to, um, leave on at night.  The shower 'room' is the one major design flaw.  There is no slant or trough in the flooring to direct the water to the drain.  As a result, it's like a guaranteed minor room flood the first time you use it.  Pro tip:  roll up a towel and place it inside the shower door (it's a big heavy door, not glass - kind of like showering in a closet).  It will be soaked, but Housekeeping is used to it and they'll replace them daily.  The shower itself is luxurious - a rain shower head and two others, each with constant hot temperatures and fantastic water pressure.  The hotel is inexplicably stingy on the shower amenities - no lotion, no conditioner, just lots of shower gel and the occasional tiny bottle of shampoo.  I'm sure they would have given us more if asked.  The towels might be the only huge thing at 9Confidentiel (well, except for the tv) - they were soft, bright white, and fluffy.  Delish.  

A unique feature of the room was a sliding wall that closed off the bed area!  Fantastic.  We used this several times when my husband had to get up early for a trip to Normandy or an early breakfast.  The room on the 6th floor didn't have one of these, although it did have a slightly bigger entry hall with a proper closet.  The bathroom and shower room were in another small hallway at the foot of the bed, so it made it seem a little more separated from the sleeping area, which was nice, though a bit dark as it was windowless. It did have a sweet little vanity at the end, though.

Overall, this is a small gem of a hotel with lots of fantastic design details and a few minor flaws.  The location is superb for key Paris destinations - and if you are looking for a lively, trendy, crowded area with loads of restaurants, bars, glace, macaron, and chocolat shops, clothing boutiques, this is the place.  There's really nothing else quite like it in the city that we've found.  

Our favorite spots were Le Boulangerie du Marais right on the corner, across the street.  Sonam was so friendly and kind - and they had the best yogurt, croissants, tea, and pain chocolat.  The pharmacy further up the street was incredibly efficient for Covid tests if you need one to return to your home country.  We also liked the Portuguese cafe (Comme a Lisbon) and Pozzetto Gelato directly across from the hotel and our friends enjoyed the Cafe Suzette nearby when they couldn't get into the popular Breizh.  In fact, I wish we'd explored more of the restaurants nearby - so many of every description, you probably can't go wrong.  

I hadn't stayed in the Marais in 30 years and it's changed so dramatically from an old, quiet, cobblestoned charming area into a super lively, hip, trendy area filled with endless shops and restaurants.  It's family-friendly, gay-friendly, and filled with people.  You can see why it's become a destination area for tourists (in addition to its proximity to the Louvre, Notre Dame, Hotel de Ville, the d'Orsay, Pont Neuf, etc.)  and locals on weekends.  It can also make it really congested - if you don't like crowds, I mean major, spilling-into-the-streets, knock-you-off-the-sidewalk, squeeze-by-you crowds, you might want to stay elsewhere.  I think the younger you are, the more you'd really love it.  And we did thoroughly enjoy our stay at 9Confidentiel, as did our friends, but next time my husband and I might consider another area of the city for that reason and make a day of the Marais instead.

title: Not Quite 5-Star, But Good Aspects
text: First, let me start by saying I searched Trip Advisor for a highly rated Parisian hotel in the 4th Arr with a Fitness Center. This hotel came up in my search and the reviews were outstanding. However, upon arrival I learned that there was NO Fitness Center on-site and you had to walk about 10 minutes to reach one and pay 25€ per visit. This was very disappointing and Trip Advisor should adjust their settings to say they Do Not have a fitness center. I cannot say enough good things about Paul, the concierge. He was outstanding! He was very friendly and extremely helpful from booking a tour to dining recommendations. He was the highlight of the hotel. The rooms are small and well appointed, but missing a few basic items like lotion. The front desk staff was very kind, but they made several mistakes ranging from putting a deposit/ hold on my credit card and then losing it, to ordering the taxi to take me to the airport at the wrong time, despite an extended discussion. Thankfully, Sandra, the morning desk assistant, was able to sort it all out and order me another taxi that arrived in 15 minutes. Overall, the small staff is very kind and strive hard to make your stay comfortable. Their location in the Marais district can’t be beat. The neighborhood is very vibrant with lots of restaurants and shopping, although the old feel of years passed is changing due to the increasingly high rents, forcing out the independently owned small cafes and stores. It is a very easy walk to most places. You can get to most of the major tourist attractions in less than 40 minutes walking, or take the Metro. Just don’t stay here if you are seeking a fitness center on-site. And be sure to ask Paul for recommendations!

title: Good location, comfortable rooms.
text:
I stayed here for 3 nights with work. The room was a good price. Reception staff were welcoming. Room was clean and comfortable and the shower was good. Huge bed and good pillows. Lovely L'Occitane products in the shower-room. Good transport links with RER and Metro lines at the end of the road. 15 walk to the Arc de Triomphe. Umbrella's lent to us by the hotel one night we wanted to go out in the pouring rain - 15 Euro deposit applied to the room but removed upon their safe return.
Breakfast is pricey at 22 Euros - we walked to L'Hortensia at the end of the street for hot chocolate, fresh juice and a croissant for 8.5 Euro instead.
I highly recommend a local restaurant "Le Petit Villiers - Chez Fred" just up the street.
I would stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

title: Lack luster customer service but great location
text:
Stayed September 12-15.

Great location but the customer services even by European standards was subpar. 

Requested two wake up calls for our second day and only received one. Requested two calls for the day of our flight and received neither! We set our phone alarms but with 7 hour time difference from home it was extremely hard to rely on this. 

We rushed to leave and as we waited on our Uber to get to the airport and speak to the manager the price changed by 20 euro. The receptionist hesitated to get the manager even though I told her we overslept and were running late for our flight. When the manager finally arrived they spent the 10 minutes we had waiting on our ride trying to figure out who took our wake up call request not trying to rectify the problem for us. 

As our Uber arrived, the manager offered us coffee. How disrespectful. 

Pros: location and clean rooms
Cons: customer service, have to make special requests multiple times, only one working elevator and no wake up calls

title: Perfect Stay, Perfect Location - A Paris Charm
text:
As soon as I walked into the inviting airy lobby (white marble floors & trendy design)    I felt the charm of Paris and immediately warmly welcomed by the front desk staff!  Even though arrived early, appreciated room was available to check-in.   Throughout my stay the desk staff was friendly, offered directions, tips and nice bonus was speaking English too.  As I stepped into the Elevator complimentary daily newspapers (French & NY Times) were stacked nearby. Restaurant offers breakfasts and dining plus a nice lobby bar and enjoyed nice chat with the bartender-English quite good.  Room service available too.  Fast & speedy wifi.  

Perfect location, rather upscale pretty Parisian neighborhood -17th  (similar to the trendy Marais & St.Germaine neighborhoods).  Certainly a charming area to stroll about and short 15 min walk to the iconic Arc de Triomphe.  For super convenience, the metro stop (Preirie-Line 3) is directly across the street and can easily get around Paris.  Surrounded by restaurants and cafes. Couple doors down from the hotel is a nice wine shop.  Monoprix grocery store is one block over.  

Fresh, super clean, contemporary and modern appointed room!! Very impressed. Room is decent sized compared to other Paris hotels.  Stayed at a very pricey historical 5 star Westin, by the Louvre and my room was even smaller, barely got around the bed).  The Hotel Ampere room truly looks just like the website photos.  Bed comfortable crisply made, white quality linens and nice pillows.  I had a garden room view that overlooked a garden courtyard, very quiet room (I understand can upgrade to a room with view of Eiffel Tower). Room stocked with coffee and tea, water kettle, safe, flat screen TV (includes CNN), small wet bar, refrigerator and good air conditioning.  Modern design carries through into the immaculate bathroom with a large, sunflower showerhead, high end bathroom toiletries- L’Occitane, blow dryer and fresh oversized fluffy soft towels and robes.  Plus the glass shower wall & mirror sink had a pretty etched design and backlit with the wall switch with a pleasant apple green light illumination-kinda night light feature- first time I’ve ever seen this type of attractive feature.  Quality Villeroy-Boch sink and Hans Grohe faucets. Wi-Fi very good, speedy. Phone and offers wake-up calls. Daily maid service top notch. 

I’ve been traveling to Paris for years and stayed in 5 star hotels in Paris (Intercontinental Le Grand, Westin Vendome, Sofitel +) This trip was on a tighter budget and for the price point of this hotel very good value –a 5 star stay in my book! I enjoyed the experience and will definitely book here on my next return to Paris.  – Highly Recommend!!

title: Comfortable, friendly hotel in great location of Paris.
text: We recently visited Paris and booked the Ampere for a 3 night stay. It was a good choice the hotel is well located close to Periere Circle, and only an easy 15-20 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe and Champ Elysees. The main lobby is large and inviting and the front desk staff are more than happy to assist you in any way they can. We booked and stayed in the Terrace suite, which is a large room with a large exterior terrace on the top (8th) floor of the hotel. From the terrace you have a view of the eiffel tower and arc de triomphe, which makes for a spectacular picture int he evening. The room was modern and comfortable, queen size bed, separate WC, bathroom with walk in shower and tub and small sitting area. Maid service was impeccable. The hotel offers a daily buffet breakfast served from 7-10 am. It is very well stocked and laid out, with the food hot and tasty, with lots of options for every type of diner. the main room is a little small so if you are visiting int he late fall or winter there may be a small wait to be seated. If you visit in the spring or summer they have an exterior patio in the middle of their garden that extends the size of the area. They also have a nice bar area just off the lobby on way to restaurant (which does not offer any meals other than breakfast). The bar tender is a very nice young man who is more than attentive and friendly. It was a pleasure t o stop and have an early evening drink before heading out to dinner, which there are many restaurants within 5 minutes of door. The hotel does offer interior parking. If you are visiting Paris and like to have a stroll in the morning and evening, (or only 10 Euro cab ride from Arc de triomphe) this the place for you. Highly recommended hotel.

title: The fire alarm works!
text:
Loved this hotel and would highly recommend.  As other guests have stated, friendly staff and clean, nice rooms.
  
Room: I didn't notice that my room was small as others have stated.  When you walk in, there is the toilet "closet" to the right off the entry way with the shower "room" (no bathtub) next to it on the right.  On the left is the closet with iron/ironing board directly across from the shower room. Then another door into the bedroom.  I liked the set up.  You can shut the door to the bedroom at night to be certain noises from the main hallway don't wake you.  The window in the bedroom opened and there was no screen.  I haven't been able to open a window at a hotel in years, much less not have a screen over it.
   
Smoke Alarm: Someone had the bright idea to smoke in their room while we were there.  The smoke alarm SCREECHES.  I've never heard anything so loud in my life.  So that's a good thing!  I took the stairs down (we were on the 2nd floor) and ended up outside in an unfamiliar place with no reentry into the hotel.  That was somewhat confusing at first but I managed!  

Location:  The location is great.  Just a short walk to a grocery store and many restaurants. I had a drink at the bar at the hotel when we first got there and the bartender was very nice and answered all my touristy questions. There were a couple of shops in the area that I wish I had time to explore.      

Breakfast: The breakfast was delicious and I loved that the breakfast room opened to the outside where you could sit and enjoy the sun and morning air while you ate if you wanted.  

The BEDS - So comfortable.  That's the most important thing other than being clean is the bed and pillows!  Very restful, comfortable sleep each night.

text: Great location, walking distance to many attractions. Fantastic, friendly and professional reception  staff. Very good breakfast with plenty of options. Rooms are clean but compact, some are facing light shaft, check with the hotel when booking if you would like look out at the street instead.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent location
text: The location of this hotel is superb. I wish I could say the same about the reception team. Concierge was helpful in arranging a couple of restaurant bookings. Overall, I would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to stay somewhere near the Champs-Élysées.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Ideal hotel for a Paris citytrip
text: We stayed in the hotel for 3 nights during our citytrip to Paris. The hotel is clean and the rooms are quiet, with good beds. We saw all the sights by walking through the city, the location of the hotel is ideal for that. Around the corner is a Pret-a-Manger for a nice and healthy breakfast (breakfast in hotel is quite expensive). Parking garage in the street is expensive (but that is to be expected in the heart of Paris). Would of sure return here on a Paris citytrip!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great location, very tasty breakfast
text: Our stay in general was pleasant. The only problem we had was, the housekeeping being extremely noisy especially very early in the mornings. Our room was next door to the service room, and there was a lot of door banging, loud conversations which interrupted our rest. We politely warned the staff, but didnt make a difference. I suggest not to book the rooms close to the service rooms.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent
text:
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Paris, and this hotel was the ideal base to explore the 8th Arr. and wider area. 5 min walk to George V (Line 1), 15-20 mins to Pont De L'alma (for RER C).
Junior Suite was excellent, spacious, and perfect for our needs. Very large and comfortable bed, and the air-con kept the room nice and cool.
My only niggle was that the shower was a bath with showerhead (not great pressure) rather than a walk in, but each to their own.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Disappointed
text:
Unfortunately, I am person who I travel a lot and stayed in many hotel.
Before my trip to paris, I tested positive, I contacted the hotel and showed them my PCR, Unfortunately Rudolf and Sabine from the hotel they were replying to my msg as nothing happen and all what they care about that the charges, I didn’t ask for refund, I just ask nicely for credit note that I can use it in my next trip but as I am talking with no one, same answer they didn’t care.
I highly advise people to not book directly, better through partnership Chanel since for sure they will be treated better in emergency case.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: 35th Wedding Anniversary
text: Overall, a great stay, Hotel has a central location for the main Attractions, pretty much all within walking distance. No where is cheap, but you have to expect that in a capital city anywhere in Europe, especially the premium locations. We spent 4 days in Paris and that covered pretty much all the reasons why we wanted to go, I would recommend this hotel, staff all very  friendly and accommodating. We had room only which worked for us as we wanted to get our early and experience the Parisian lifestyle, .We also opted to get Taxi's rather than the hop on hop off buses and from our point of view it worked out probably a little cheaper with the advantage of not having to navigate tp the bus stop locations. Would recommend the boat trip as well, very informative.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Don't stay here
text:
The hotel is in a good location, the rooms are standard
But the hotel staff are not friendly at all, here is a list of what we endured at the hotel.
1. We pre-booked our rooms including a junior suit for 3 adults, it was on bed and breakfast basis, upon arrival the hotel canceled breakfast and their explanation was the rate changed as of 1 june, we booked and paid in January
2. Every day we had to inform the housekeeping that we are 3 adults in the room to put enough towels and toiletries but they never did.
3. Ask for anything from the hotel, the answer is always not possible.
4. To top it all upon check out they tried to rechage us for the room and we told its prepaid, showed the recete but they denied and after lots of arguments and shouting they miraculously found the prepayment, they were trying to double charge us.
Here is a copy from the bill the hotel tried to make us repay

My advice, avoid this place
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Anniversary @Chateau Frontenac and Quebec City🥂❤️
text: My husband said I had to see Quebec City so we went for our 30th anniversary. Loved  loved the hotel - old meets new as an old CP Hotel. Bars and restaurants were so lovely and had courteous staff in English as well as my high school French. Our room overlooked the boardwalk and was huge and quiet. Comfy bed and the separate bathroom with double doors was very elegant. Would stay again in a heart beat.❤️ Also close to the shops and the fonicular and other historical sites
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: This is a great location.
text: The rooms are nice.  The concierge were not friendly-however—-they were not helpful to us for trying to find any dinner reservations.  They seemed like they were put off when we asked to recommend anything.  Good location.  Also, had a private party the  one night and would not allow hotel guest any drinks from the bar——weird.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Everything was perfect
text: We had a great stay at Chateau Frontenac for March break vacation.  Location is perfect! Reception and concierge were helpful and reliable. They even turned on the AC during our stay eventhough it is still winter/spring season. The junior suite is huge and clean. We’ll stay here again…soon! Highly recommended!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: LOVELY STAY IN PARIS
text: It was really comfortable stay and feel so relax . I recommend you Chateu Frontenac always. Location is perfect , staff is frendly. Rooms are comfortable cleaning is ok. They renewed the rooms . Go and stay
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Amazing! ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text: 20th Wedding Anniversary weekend - faultless! We had the most amazing stay, the hotel staff were so polite and helpful, the room was immaculate with a Juliette balcony opening up an amazing view over the streets of Paris and the location was perfect. Comte wait to go back!!!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent base for a few days enjoying Paris
text:
The hotel has a great location allowing you to walk to many attractions enjoying Paris as you stroll. 
We stayed in a small suite that was very ample for three family members traveling together and had enough space to have a drink whilst freshening up. The hotel bar was also very pleasant and not overpriced given location and service. 
We did not eat in the hotel preferring to get a quick breakfast in the Pret just round the corner. 
Very pleased to have stayed here.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Nice stay at Paris
text: Easy and cozy stay in the Carl V area for a weekend in Paris. Clean hotel and nice staff. Room not big but nice and well organized. From the location of the hotel, you can move around the center of Paris on foot.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great location, view and service !
text: Excellent location, unbeatable view, service was friendly, kind and helpful. Also, the view of the Eiffel Tower is so absolutely stunning. If you want to “splurge” without breaking the bank, stay in the front facing tower rooms, especially the fifth floor if available. It will make you catch your breath each time you look out the window. And of course, the pictures!!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Bonjour, merci et à bientôt!
text: We wanted a nice, clean hotel with proximity to amenities, shops and restaurants of our preference. We were not disappointed. On the contrary, we have thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Staff is excellent and the room was fabulous. A generous breakfast buffet offered a nice start of the day. All in all, we had a memorable stay and recommend Hotel Chateau Frontenac with sincerity. À bientôt!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great experience
text:
Apart of parking difficulties I was a great experience staff was great and helpful room is clean and good sized of course never regret such location 
Unfortunately room service was not available after 12
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Unforgettable
text: We had an exceptional stay. Rooms, staff, location - everything was perfect. Although a business trip, we had the opportunity to relax completely. And the view from our room to the Eiffel Tower - just unforgettable!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Two days in Paris with family
text: We enjoyed our stay in Paris with our 5 year old daughter. Hotel is perfectly located . Staff is nice especially concierge . Room was large and comfortable. However loud music at night coming from bar downstairs until late.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Nice hotel, nice staff, room was so-so
text: This was our first trip to Paris.  We selected this hotel due to its proximity to the main attractions and the location didn't disappoint.  The staff was very helpful (it rained when we were there and they gave us complimentary umbrellas).  I don't have any real knocks on this place other than the temperature control in the room, or lack thereof.  The room was very warm upon check-in.  We tried turning on the cooling, but the cooling system wasn't set up yet, so we had to leave the bathroom window cracked open to let in cooler, fresher air.   Rooms are small per Euro standards, but this is good location.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great Location... Terribly Noisy
text: We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights. The hotel has a great location, it is renewed, personal is really good.... but it is really noisy. We could hear EVERYTHING of the floor above, opening door, foot steps, closing door.  So if you want to have a pleasant rest, this is not your best option.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Exceptional Hotel
text: The hotel and location is exceptional. Great experience with one exception of the attached restaurant. The restaurant prices were extreme and the food was not worth the cost or very appetizing. The location is only a few blocks from champs elysees if interested in shopping.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Amazing hotel and location
text: Just amazing! Loved the location, service, very clear, good breakfast, just in the corner of many restaurants and Champs-Elysées, metro station, spacious room, comfortable, and I Will come back for sure
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Well spent NYE
text: Me and my family came here for the new year eve and we didn't regret it. The hotel is centrally located at few steps from the famous Avenue des champs elysees where the NYE in paris takes place. Our room was at the 6th floor, large, renovated and well equipped. The breakfast included was good and varied. The staff at the hotel is lovely, we arrived 6 hours earlier at the hotel and they checked us in without any problem , they are very helpful and professional, and on our last day our taxi didn't come so the very friendly concierge (maybe named david)reserved us the hotel's transportion since it was very hard to find another taxi on the 1st of jan. The only problem with the Hotel is the very poor internet connection :( . However would definitely come back  !
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Hotel Chateau Frontenac
text: Excellent hotel in the centre of Paris. We have stayed there a few times, and we are very pleased indeed. Eifel tower, designer shops, excellent restaurants are all very near. We strongly recommend it.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: One of the best hotels in Paris
text: Best welcoming team, best location in the middle of Champs-Élysées , best quality of service, great rooms , totally renewed, excellent breakfast and food , a very charming hotel like our home in Paris .
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: perfect hotel in paris
text: perfect location, comfort and breakfast.Warm and helpfull hospitalty. shopping and restaurant options are all around. easy access to the river seightseing tours. I definetly recommed this hotel and hope to come again. thanks
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: You have to stay here!
text: A fantastic hotel in a fantastic location, only a few minutes walk to a great choice of restaurants on the Champs-Élysées. Staff are all very welcoming and more than happy to help you in any way they can. A definite must for your visit to Paris!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Disrespectful Staff
text:
The hotel has a great location in the center of Paris but .......
However when I made a reservation for a privilege room , they gave me a lower category and when I told the person in charge at the reception that I don't like the room he told me that I am impolite and hanged up the line !!
Cannot imagine such a disrespectul behaviour from the hotel staff member .
I believe that this hotel is not any more competing with the high level hotels at the corner because of its staff bad attitude .
You can find many other hotels in the same area which respect and care more about their clients and same price level but larger rooms and more respect.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent hotel in an excellent location.
text:
Hotel in an excellent location for sightseeing and restaurants. Staff very accommodating and friendly and nothing too much trouble. 

Rooms very clean, nicely furnished and very comfortable.

Reasonably priced (for Paris anyway!)
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Recommended !
text:
Very pleasant stay with very nice staff in a wonderful location . I have  been staying a few times already. Tis time I was meeting some family members.
I would definitely recommend Chateau Frontenac to my friends.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Good location
text:
Very good location, very clean hotel and good staff. I would recommend to everyone.
Easy to access with transports. Staff are very helpful and smiling. 
Did not use the restaurant but it seems very elegant and clean.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: a gem
text:
friendly staff, perfect location, spacious rooms on ground floor
concierge people were beyond helpful. I had to run to a shop and check out time was near. the person even packed my bags in the room as they were not fully closed
they also honor your room requests if you call ahead
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great hotel close to Champs Elysees
text:
Perfect hotel for visiting Paris, with a lot of charm.
Excellent breakfast and very good service.
Confortable bed
Lots of nice restaurants in the neighbourhood of the hotel.
Some rooms are small in size.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: First trip to Paris
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Did not eat in the restaurant, but had a cocktail in the bar, which was very pleasant. Location very convenient, walking distance to many sites.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent location, great room (Upgrade to a balcony if you can) and wonderful Breakfast
text:
We arrived late into Paris after a long trip and what a beautiful finish to a long day!

I highly recommend This beautiful boutique establishment just off the Champs Elysee in a vibrant part of Paris.

Service was excellent, the breakfast was excellent (with a wide availability of timing). They really helped make our stay in Paris special.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Lovely hotel, great location, wonderful breakfast, helpful staff
text: I stayed at this hotel with my tour group.  It was a wonderful place to finish the tour.  The rooms are lovely, the front desk staff is very friendly and helpful, the breakfast is excellent, and the location is perfect.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Boring and unfriendly
text: Extremely small rooms, the staff is not very service minded, barely say hello and never smiles. The rooms are clean but that’s it, super small and the beds are not comfortable. The neighborhood is good for shopping and restaurants
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Champs Elysee location. Elevator. Close to 2 Metros. Attentive staff.
text: Large rooms for Paris and the Golden Triangle.  Just renovated in 2019 and lovely. Easy to have breakfast across the street and watch the world go by. Plenty of dining places within walking distance.  Stayed here 8 times.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: In love with my Eiffel Tower view room!!
text:
This hotel is centrally located in the 8th district. 30 mins walk to the Louvre, 20 mins to the Eiffel Tower, 2 mins to the Champs Elysees, and 15 mins to the Arc de Triumph. 
The room and bathroom was spotless and modern. The breakfast was ample, generous and delicious. WiFi was reliable and powerful.
We had an Eiffel Tower view room with a balcony, table & chairs that was amazing!! We sat out there morning noon and night staring at her beauty.
The only sad part was when I left behind a headband in the bathroom upon checkout, and called the next day looking for it... But they were unable to locate it.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Central charme of the old Paris
text:
The hotel is in a great location in the centre of the touristic Paris. Arc de trionfe, al luxury brands in walking distance.

I found the staff very friendly and helpful. Might be a à result of earlier reviews.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Almost work
text: Coming to Paris, specially for me, is not a job. Besides of course, the activities related with my tasks, having time for walking or running for Paris, is no words found them for the description. This time Chateau Frontenac gave me the chance in visiting again Paris almost not wishing for leaving it. Very kind, flavored, shiny rooms, amenities, everything for a pleasant stay
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Anniversary
text: lovely hotel in an excellent location close to all the major landmarks in Paris, staff very obliging and helpful with the bar manager a stand out character,chambermaids were very friendly and did a superb job
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Save your money
text:
Pictures lie! My closet at home is bigger than the room they gave us . Can hear my neighbor whisper!  
Tv has one English speaking channel, which is CNN international . Over all not worth the money they charge. I’m so sorry my pre birthday celebration is ruined by this bull. Yes, I take the room I stay in seriously . 
This hotel DOES NOT KNOW RHE MEANING OF LUXURY! Unfortunately, we have to stay because we can’t find another hotel! Do not book here unless you like sleeping in a closet!

title: Central location, helpful staff and good service!
text: Stayed in this hotel for 5 nights, it has been newly renovated, the rooms are nice. The staff are helpful, the location is central in a high end area just a 2 min walk to the Champs-Élysées and 10 Min walk to the Arc de Triomphe, easy access to the metro stations. There is a close by market and pharmacy. The hotel offers a good breakfast that has a wide variety of items. My only issue was that the hotel was highly occupied, at night it got noisy from kids running and doors being slammed. The room was in a very good condition, comfortable bed, nice bathroom with all amenities needed.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Excellent and lovely hotel
text:
Excellent and lovely hotel

The hotel is very clean and the staff are very friendly and helpful.

The location is close to all tourist places, markets and restaurants

Thank you very much all staff and manager  and  hotel.
Mubarak

title: Just OK! But I’ll never comeback!
text:
Great location two minuets walk to Champs-Elysées, clean rooms and ok staff. However, needs few important things to make me comfortable; breakfast we had it once but never to do it again! Poor selections and those very sad faces staff with expressionless faces! Housekeeping doing their job early morning with lots of noise while I don’t want to wake up early at 8 on my holiday! Also I can hear all sounds come from around rooms! 
For once, we needed an Electric plug so the front desk charged me for €25 as insurance! Until I brought it back to them while checking out!
No iron at the room, thus we had to ask for it every morning and housekeeping take it back everyday for three days!
We were having a car and didnt know where to park? Concierge were not useful at all, we dont speak French and all parking machines with French instructions I just needed someone to let me know how to pay for the daily tickets, unfortunately they were not able to help!

title: Excellent
text:
Perfect stay !

Rooms are spacious and clean
Breakfast is great
Location is unbeatable in the “Gold triangle”
Staff is friendly especially Pablo and Anthony

Tout est parfait !

This is the place to be if you are visiting Paris
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: 5 Days in Paris
text: Stayed at this place which was a gem. Beautiful inside and out, spacious suite with high ceiling and the view from our room added to the atmosphere. Service standard high with helpful and friendly staff, breakfast was wonderful and available till lunch. Was pleasantly surprised by this place and location is great if you want to be close to Champs-elysées and Eiffel tower.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Fantastic Breakfast Buffet, Helpful Staff
text: With our tour group, my wife and I spent three nights at this hotel. We found the location near the Champs Elysees very convenient. In our journals, she and I both commented about the breakfast buffet. I called it fantastic; my wife called it fabulous. The first morning I reported getting a roll, tomato juice (the only hotel on the trip that had this), cut fruit, stewed prunes, dried apricots, a date, granola with several toppings (walnuts, hazel nuts, etc.), and a taste of the sweet roll my wife got. The next day I reported having crusty bread and fish in addition to much of the stuff I had gotten the previous day. We also had several helpful interactions with various members of the hotel staff. As an example, I had a very painful fall walking away from the Eiffel Tower. When we got to the hotel, my wife asked the bartender if it was possible to get some ice to put on my various swellings, and he quickly supplied a bucket of ice. The furnishings were art deco. Our room's bathroom had a lot of space to put things. Overall pleasant experience.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: This hotel is outstanding!!!  Privilege room 518 with Eiffel Tower view was perfect!!!  Great view of the Bastille Day fly-overs and Eiffel Tower fireworks. fireworks.  The staff were all very friendly and very quick to respond to all requests...and with a smile.  The location is walking or biking distance to the Sienne, Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Musee de Orsay.... I cannot say enough great things about this hotel!!!!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great hotel in Paris
text: Just the perfect hotel needed to enjoy Paris .A few blocks from Champs Elysees this hotel offers nice rooms and a great late breakfast buffet . Concierge is really helpful as well as well trained  staff ready to serve at any time ! thanks Chateau Frontenac Paris for the perfect stay.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great Location and Excellent Service
text: We stayed here for 2 nights in May and it was excellent. The location is perfect - right off the Champs Elysee and near many restaurants and shops. Also an easy walk down to the Seine to get a boat ride. The room was great - comfortable bed, nice bathroom, all amenities needed. Included a safe and TV. The front desk was helpful and friendly each time we asked questions. Gave lots of help on where to find places. Breakfast was very enjoyable - lots of options to satisfy everyone.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Our stay in Paris at Chateau Frontenac
text: We enjoyed our stay at Chateau Frontenac very much.  The staff was always helpful, friendly, and professional.  The breakfast service was particularly wonderful because of the large selection offered and the extended opening time.  It is a pleasure to have a late breakfast if you are out late the night before!  The location of the hotel is fantastic.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Eiffel Tour view
text:
What’s better than wake up at sunrise and watch Eiffel Tour from your room? This is what you can do at Hotel Chateau Frontenac. 
Our room was very bright, and we found all we could need (like bathroom facilities and so on). The bathtub was big and the bed so comfy.
Couldn’t imagine a better place to stay in Paris.

title: 4 day Paris Trip
text: Great choice of Hotel, Waling distance to some of the hot spots as well as public transportation. Breakfast buffet is really great for all tastes….Very helpful staff and rooms were spotless...Taxi ride from airport is a little expensive
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Average hotel

name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: BEST experience in our life!!!
text:
One of the best experiences of our life! We spent 4 nights at this beautiful hotel and we are super happy. The location is perfect, just a stone's throw from the Champs Elisee and very close to the main metro and bus stops. Furthermore we arrived in a few minutes at the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower! The breakfast is fantastic and complete with everything you want and above all the fabulous croissants we have so much enjoyed. The staff (waiters, receptionists ...) are very polite and have met all our requests. The room was extraordinary and really clean and we suggest you ask for room number 519 because it has a balcony on the fifth floor with AMAZING view on the Eiffel Tower, very very romantic!!! When we return to the Ville Lumiere we will definitely come back to this hotel!

Domi & Frida

title: Family trip
text: I always stayed at this Hotel when ever I came to Paris in the past 10 years. The location is the best. Their breakfast is good. The rooms are fine too.. The front desk are usually helpful. Paris is always amazing!
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Great Boutique Hotel!
text: Really wonderful stay last week at the Hotel Chateau Frontenac.  The hotel is in a very good location between the Champs Elysses and the Seine and close to the George V or the Pont d'Alma Metro stops.  This area is in the high rent district with much higher priced hotels and shops like Hermes, Ellie Saab, Maje, Loius Vuitton etc all within a few blocks.  The hotel has a very comfortable lounge and bar area which we used for an early evening cocktail and snack or a nightcap.  We had the all inclusive breakfast one day, which is very good if you like to have a big breakfast before you start your day.   Nice cafe across the street for morning coffee and croissants or a casual dinner.  Our room had 2 twin beds, which we requested as it was just my daughter and I and they were really quite comfortable.  Contrary to another's review, we found the AC to be working in April.  The weather turned quite warm during our stay and we did need to turn it on for our last two nights.  I also requested a balcony, which was small, but with large French doors that opened fully and which was perfect to step outside and enjoy the view.  We found all of the staff to be exceptionally helpful.  I especially have to praise the honesty and integrity of the housekeeping and front desk staff.  In rushing to meet friends on our last day, I left US$ and credit cards in the room safe.  I didn't realize it until we were at the airport much later that evening.  I frantically called the hotel, only to find that they had all of my cash and credit cards at the front desk.  Luckily our friends were still in Paris and were able to pick everything up late that evening.  If this is the area you are looking for in Paris, I would highly recommend the Hotel Frontenac.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Quick trip to Paris
text: The hotel location is great and its newly renovated but the rooms are small and also the beds . The room was too hot during the day but the told me they don't on the Ac till the beginning of may . The staff is very friendly. The hotel very clean and elegant.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Fantastic hotel!  Best location
text:
This hotel really delivers!  Location is a short walk to everything. The rooms are recently remodeled and very comfortable and well appointed. The breakfast is amazing. Food was excellent and the staff was lovely.  The desk crew and management were friendly and gave us excellent service.  

We were in Paris to run the marathon and the location was perfect.   We will stay here again if we come back to Paris. 

Book your room now.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Very good experience
text:
I have stayed in Chateau Frontenac for 5 nights. Hotel is very clean, team are helpful and my room was very calm.
Just a small comment, bathtub is really high so i recommend to change it to walkin shower.
My experience was Excellent and i rate it 5/5.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: This hotel never disappoints!
text: This was our second stay at the Chateau Frontenac, and it was every bit as pleasant as our first stay. The hotel has finished their remodeling and the rooms are lovely and sun-filled. The locations is just a block or so from the Champs Elysees for quick access to shopping and restaurants. It makes it so easy for access to the metro. We had a wonderful experience and will stay here again.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Delightful Hotel Experience
text: This hotel exceeded our expectations.  The rooms are quite charming and very clean.  The location is fantastic.  You are a half block for a bus stop and a block and a half from a metro entrance. The staff is friendly and very helpful.  Especially  helpful was a young concierge  named Emanuel.  The cost for a room is very reasonable, considering everything you get and that it's Paris.  We would definitely stay at this hotel again on a return visit.  Thanks to everyone at the Hotel Chateau Frontenac for helping to make our vacation in Paris so wonderful.

title: Great place to stay
