Great location within moderate walking distance of most attractions.
Excellent selections of local restaurants.
Concierge service friendly and helpful.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Faultless. Lovely, charming hotel.
text: Stayed for 2 nights, thoroughly enjoyed this hotel,  it appears to be very recently refurbished as it is immaculate throughout, we had what was described as a ‘double superior room’ which was beautiful, with twin balconies overlooking the front of the building on the 6th floor. Staff were professional, discreet and attentive,  our stay was an absolute pleasure, what more could you ask? We would love to stay again - I recommend without hesitation.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Beautiful hotel
text: We loved our two days at Hotel Château Frontenac. The staff were friendly and welcoming and couldn’t do enough for us. Quiet, comfy room and right in the heart of Paris so easy to get everywhere and just a ten minute walk from the banks of the Seine.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: An awesome vacation
text: We were part of a huge group.  We had a wonderful time in Paris during our one week stay.  Our wonderful vacation was topped with our stay at Chateau Frontenac.  Beautiful and a very comfortable boutique hotel.  Great staff and wonderful breakfast. Our special thanks to to Garik, who accommodated all our needs during our stay in the hotel.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Stay in Chateau Frontenac in Paris
text: It was a fantastic few days in Paris - sunny and lovely and the stay in Chateau Frontenac was lovely: charming service, cosy room and excellent breakfast - all you need to spend a great time in the city of lights.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Chateau treatment in Paris City center
text: Great location and superb service are the main ingredients of this recently renovated hotel. Rooms are top standard and breakfast buffet offers excellent choices to fit your diet. I stayed during a recent business trip but the location close to the Champs Elysées makes it perfect for a holiday break as well.
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: Unprofessional
text:
One morning I was shocked bec out of nowhere 2 workers were lifted to my balcony without notice /warning... I was scared bec I was asleep & still in bed!!!! Told the receptionist who said will tell the manager .,
Nothing happened 
I paid a lot of money for 3 nights they should’ve handled it much better
name: Hôtel Chateau Frontenac

title: So cosy
text: Not really a hotel - more like visiting a friend, with the comforts of a hotel. The service was great in general. The second day the breakfast personel was somewhat unwelcomig, but the kindness from the rest of the staff made up for it.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Amazing
text: We were in this hotel ( two couples) in November 2019, its an amazing hotel, clean, warm, feels at home, the atmosphere is just perfect.  Excellent breakfast, exemplary cleanliness, recommend to everyone and we will be back again next year.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Paris with friends
text: Very nice little hotel, a good location with a lot of restaurants and bars nearby. Many details in the hotel that were really thoughtful. Friendly staff and a good breakfast. We really enjoyed our stay.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: First Class Experience!
text: Sopi is like being at home outside of it. The spaces are very nice and quiet; the location is strategic and the service is really top notch! I will definitely come back on my next trip to Paris. Don’t be concerned about the location close to the Pigalle
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Your home in Paris!
text: Not a hotel and Not an Airbnb, more like a guest house where you get breakfast made for you and your room cleaned. Very comfortable. Quiet and well appointed. We really enjoyed the experience. Your immersed into a neighborhood immediately! Yea
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: We habe found our perfect spot for a stay!
text: Simply the best for our needs. Very centrally located, everything we were looking for in Paris at very easy reach. Very comfortable rooms and Juliette and Serge indeed lovely hosts. Don’t be concerned about the location close to the Pigalle - it is indeed very quiet (especially to the back). We will certainly be guests again soon!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Super SoPi
text: This was my 5th stay and having not visited Paris for 3 years SoPi provided  a home from home. Chic, clean, always excellent service and a great location. I look forward to returning soon. Thank you Serge and Juliette!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Pretty boutique hotel in great neighbourhood
text:
Beautiful decor, friendly hospitality, great location and perfect breakfast.
A great place to stay if you want to be close to the main sights but not too loud or touristy. An easy walk from Gare du Nord too
Juillette is very accommodating and flexible on check in and out as well
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Perfect for Couples!
text: Perfect neighborhood for killer nights out, scenic days in hipster Pigalle/SoPi/Montmartre, and/or a relaxing getaway.  If you've been to Paris before, but you based your trip on the Eiffel tower/Louvre/regular tourist hot spots, this is the perfect way to see the city through fresh eyes!  Clean, great breakfast, easy access, and perfect location.  Easy Uber from any train station and easy metro access.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: perfect stay
text:
Our stay in 1er Etage SoPi was in one word perfect! The owners gave us a free upgrade to the room with kingsize bed! A very quiet environment, especially with the room at the backside of the building. The street itself is also without big traffic, no vibration of the underground whatsoever.

The room was perfectly clean, with exta items such as bad slippers, very nice smelling soaps and cream, a booklet with info about Paris, good wifi, ...

And the breakfast also great! Very friendly staff as well!

We will come back!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Beyond our expectations !!
text:
the moto Comme un Parisien expresses precisely the feelings we had during our staying at the Etage Sopi. Everything was so perfect that we felt like to be at home . The personel is very helpful & polite, the breakfast includes everything, the hotel is near by to the most important places in Paris!
Thank you !
We will be back for sure!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Home style hotel, so lovely!
text: This is our first visit to Paris and very special experience from Christmas to New Year Day! So nice to stay at Le 1er Etage SoPi, very clean, warm and comfortable, especially our room has a big bathtub, Everyday after a long day's walk, it's so relax and recovering in the hot water. And every morning, there is delicious breakfast prepared with fresh fruits, breads, meats, cheeses, cereal, milk, juice, coffee and yogurt by friendly lady. The room decorated very nice boutique. It's so clean and quiet. A unforgettable trip!!! Strongly recommend.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Fabulous Stay!
text: We had a wonderful stay at your chic boutique hotel. It was our first visit to Paris and we could not have been happier with our stay. Very clean and pleasant! The breakfasts were just so wonderful - fresh fruit, meats, cheeses, cereal, juice, coffee and tea. Even after I had made a booking error and needed to extend our booking by one day, the staff was so accommodating and helpful. When you walk around the Louvre and the Lafayette Gallery the crowds are intense, loud and there is a lot of traffic noise. The beauty of this location is that it is close enough to walk to those areas to visit them or to take the Metro, but it is quiet at night without the traffic noise/sirens that you find in the more busy parts of town. We will absolutely stay here again - thank you again for such beautiful accommodations!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Excellent hotel which felt like home
text: A great experience at Le 1ere etage SoPi.  The kitchen and lounge areas are very welcoming and relaxing.  The bedrooms are beautiful and kept to a very high standard.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Super Helpful and Kind
text: I stayed in this very pleasant B&B and found the owners very helpful and kind.  Through their suggestions I was able to see a special art expo in Paris that I would otherwise not have known was on.  Breakfast was delicious and the room was very comfortable and well appointed.  I will definitely stay there again.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: One of the Best Boutique Hotel
text: I was here some week ago for my business travel... all was perfect and incredible! I love the design of this Hotel, the room was very comfortable, clean and elegant. I think I come back very soon! Thanks for all.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Hidden gem in Paris
text: It's my 2nd time staying in this hotel and they never got me down. I had a strong feeling when i returned back this time that i'm returning back home. Yes,  this hotel makes you feel home in a fancy way. The owners are looking after every small detail in interior design in this old building built in 18th century as you can smell histor once you step in. All the staff are so friendly and welcoming and doing all their best to accomodate any request from you. The hotel is located in the heart of amazing  Pegalle destrict,  about 6 minutes on foot from Montmartre and about 12 minutes walking to Opera Garnier. There are tens of groceries around in 1 or 2 minutes of walking and several resturants, coffe shops and pubs in the area. In addition there are three metro stations between 3 to 7 minutes walking from/ to the hotel. moreover, the hotel has an application, you will receive its password  once your booking is confirmed. There're massive information and recommendations on the best shopping , places tio visit, schedule of events,...and too many details to make your trip to Paris the most memorable one. The breakfast every day was so delicious with many homemade stuff like the fruit salad with special yummy homemade syrup and fantastic granola. I doi highly recommend this hotel for everyone looking for a unique authentic Parisian experience. Certainly i will return back again to the same hotel in my coming visits to Paris
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Wonderful 4th Visit
text: This was the 4th time we have stayed at this establishment and it is just perfect in every way. The owners and their staff make you feel right at home and the value for what you get keeps us coming back. Wonderful breakfast, beautifully updated rooms and on a quiet street yet close to everything. We will definitely continue to stay here as it is the best value we have found in Paris and we have been coming for many years. Bravo Serge and Juliette.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Highly recommend!
text: My husband and I stayed here for five days. We wanted something quaint and away from the tourists. We learned the area quickly and used the Pigalle metro station frequently and felt like true Parisians toward the end of our trip. The breakfast was fabulous and the women who served us our breakfast were very friendly. We had no issues entering the building or our room. We were pleased with the accommodations, but were a little disappointed that we didn't have a safe in our room.  The only other thing I wish I knew ahead of time was the lack of an elevator. We were on the top floor, and my husband has some mobility issues, so I wish I had  requested a room on the ground floor.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: A perfect stay for the Paris trip
text: For the tourists visiting Paris, this place is not only convenient, within quiet and nice community, but also it provides the unique experience of being private, stylish, friendly, feel-at-home, providing all-you-need. Everything are cautiously thought about, the deco, the food, the enviroment, the intro to Paris etc. It is definitely a pleasant and cozy place for staying while travelling in such a huge and fatastic city of Paris. I am very grateful to the staff there for their being so friendly and kind.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Paris Wedding
text: When looking for a hotel, I wanted something away from the crowds and somewhat unique—this B&B is the PERFECT place! The rooms are quite spacious, impeccably clean, and well-designed, with large bathrooms (for Europe). The rain shower head, breakfast with fresh fruit, and 24hr kitchen access are the best parts. Shinn was a helpful host with great suggestions. Close to the metro & the neighborhood had wonderful bars and restaurants! I suggest Cyprien, Baton Rouge, 21 Martorell, La Compagnie, and Polpette! C’est delicieux. Merci beaucoup!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: 5 ***** stay!
text: A hybrid between a small boutique hotel and a B&B.  Small, quiet and nestled amongst Parisian apartments this B& B is a perfect place to stay.  Close to the Pigalle Metro stop and excellent restaurants. Staff is helpful and breakfast was 👍!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Excellent find!
text: This hotel/airbnb is so originally and beautifully decorated, and perfectly located in an interesting and walkable neighbourhood which also has many options for transportation nearby. Not only are the rooms charming, they are comfortable and spacious. A true gem in Paris!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Hidden gem in the crowded city
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the property. It was tucked away in a charming neighborhood close to Montmarte with some good local restaurants just down the street. Our room faced an inner courtyard so it was so quiet, which was exactly what we needed after long days walking around the city. The morning breakfast was just perfect - fresh fruit, yogurt, croissants, meats and cheeses - just enough to get you out the door without weighing you down. And the staff are great!!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Lovely little hotel
text: Good sized room with modern and clean bathroom in interesting old building.  Good fresh breakfast, friendly and helpful staff.  Can't fault it, would definitely stay here again.  Much more character than a chain.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Wonderful!!
text: Situated near the Moulin Rouge. We loved this quaint B&B. The staff was very attentive. The rooms were clean and lovely. The breakfast was complete and plentiful and absolutely delicious! Thank you for all of your care.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Best place I've ever been in Paris
text:
Great location, intimate and quiet place with a lovely lounge.
Rooms are nice, breakfast is very good and the staff is very kind.
I've spent many days in hotels in Paris but this one it's the best ever.
You feel at home!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Lovely
text: Lovely residential location in Pigalle - very quiet, safe and clean with a lovely breakfast. The little kitchenette was a bonus and perfect for making hot drinks whenever needed. Took my 16 year old daughter for a long weekend in Paris and it was perfect - you could walk everywhere although the Metro was only a 10 minute walk away if you needed it.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: excellent
text: Warm atmosphere, nice people. They always have good advice concerning travel places. Breakfast was very nice. The location is very close to the center, and also to the St. Lazare train station. Will definitely return.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Best night's sleep on their mattress!
text:
I stayed in the first room to the right upon entering the hotel. Super cute room, painted with a dark interior, with a cute wallpaper background with green leaves of some sort behind the bed. This bed was AWESOME. I slept incredibly well in it because of it's firmness. Also, the room got super dark, like pitch black when you turned out the lights. Perfection! 

I do wish the room provided more light during the day though. I literally just wish there was an extra light source inside the room. I also had a problem with getting hot water from the shower, but once we brought it to the hotel's attention, she took me to the unit above mine and I showered there. 

The staff was super friendly and the place was super clean. I'd definitely recommend this place if you're in the area!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Lovely stay
text: The room was large enough for two people, and it was very stylish. Breakfast was nice, people were friendly and helpful. Many restaurants, shops, museums, Metro stations in easy walking distance. We stayed for a week and would do it again.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Amazing stay, friendly staff!
text: This is a really nice gem and perfectly located in the city. Very nice and comfortable stay. It feels like we have a HOME in a foreign country rather another generic hotel. The staff was very friendly and welcoming.  We will definitely go back again. ~Sara
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Cute property - Great service
text: Great location - only a block from Galeries Lafayette but on a relatively quiet street. Cute place. Room was very nicely decorated with plenty of details. Loved the system of codes for getting into place and room. Continental breakfast was perfect. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Everything you need for a stay in Paris to visit the city. Only minor complaint was a loud garbage truck in the middle of the night that woke us up on two different nights. Not sure if this was isolated but the truck was making a lot of noise for at least 15m. Other than that, perfect experience!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Great concept and experience
text:
The concept to experience living in Paris vs staying at a hotel comes to life here. The rooms are great and quiet, living room and share spaces are fantastic and service is outstanding. Location is at the core of the city and access to local restaurants and bars are around the corner. 
Thanks Sergei for your warm hospitality.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: GREAT ACCOMMODATIONS, LOCATION, SERVICE, STAFF!
text:
Loved the 1er Etage B&B / Hotel Room hybrid model. EP Breakfast was fresh, flavorful, and served at a table - croissants and baguettes, pastries, jams, honey, yogurt, fresh fruit, granola, cheeses, ham, butters, coffee / tea, OJ, etc.
Room was perfect size, comfortable and in room amenities were perfect, wifi strong. The ONLY negative was the TV signal (probably dish provided), which was sporadic. But, as we were in Paris, it didn't really seem to matter!
Location was in the SiPi - or South Pigalle district, mostly in the 9th / 18th Arrondissements I believe. A short walk to Moulin Rouge / adult area of Paris, or to Galleries Lafayette / L'Opera, A bit further walk to Sacre Couer and, opposite, the Louvre, with many. many entertainment and dining options all around us.
Staff was young, energetic, helpful, attentive and professional.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Wonderful B&B for Paris Christmas
text: Spent 5 nights here over Christmas 2018. Absolutely amazing stay. Very tourist friendly. If you're new to Paris, enter from the Trinité metro station, not Pigalle (slightly less tourist friendly neighborhood). We stayed in rooms 2 and 5 which were both beautiful. Lots of hot water for showers in the evening, more lukewarm in the morning. Breakfast was served every morning and was really good. Bread, yogurt, fruit, meat, cheese, and pastry. We even received complimentary macarons on our last night. Beautiful, amazing place. One note is it is not handicap accessible, lots of stairs. It is very centrally located to 3 metro stations, and a shuttle was organized by the hotel to the airport when we left.  Next time in Paris I will definitely be returning here.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Staying at 1er Etage
text:
Location is exceptional, not too crowd and many bars and restaurants.
The atmosphere and service are amazing. 
And the most important the hotel owner's - amazing people that will help you and recommend great secret sports of Paris
5 from 5
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Perfect ;)
text: We came to Paris for a concert of a beloved band and to spend time at the “city of love”. As many tourists we planned to visit in some of the recommended places, but we also were loking for something authentic and didn’t wanted a standart touristic trip. Juliet upgraded this visit with her advice on where to go and what places to avoid. It suited us perfectly. And her love and understanding of food, brought our gormandizer experience to new heights. We received of her recommendations for the best restaurants and chefs in town. We definitely recommend the hotel and especially Juliet as hostess. Thank you. Alexander&Dina(Jullette for one day)
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Staying at 1er Etage SoPi
text: We loved the atmosphere and the service as well as the delicious breakfast every morning at the hotel. It was a wonderful base to launch our explorations of Paris. The street is quiet and the area is safe and very close to Moulin Rouge. Best way to get to a from the hotel is taxi as it is difficult to find at night by walking. Our room although smaller than the US standards, was comfortable, warm and cozy. We loved the shower and high ceilings and all the expresso you want.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Intimite hotel
text: The hotel is in an excellent location, easy access to public transportation, lots of shops bars and restaurants. Staff is helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. Breakfast is simple, tasty and healthy. The hotel has brochures by the entrance. There were city maps and transportation maps.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Simply top notch
text: Just back after three nights. Previously in the Georges Cinq - for me this was so more to my taste.  Beautifully appointed, charming staff, best shower room I have experienced. Delightful salon/kitchenette/breakfast room with unique paintings. I think it is 17th century and has been lovingly brought to contemporary relevance with a lot of care. More complementaries than I've seen before and charming staff. Excellent location and very personal communication. Thank you
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Number 1 place to stay!
text: We are in love with the entire experience. The communication with the management and staff is flawless. The accommodations are top notch. The environment is completely Parisian. The service is incomparable. Every time we go back to Paris, we will stay here.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Super Quite Place
text:
Exellent B&B  situated in heart of Paris  in three floors,  some rooms in grand floor,  also in first and second floor. Location is great, 4 minutes to place Blanche,  same to place Pigalle,  a little more to Monmartre, 15 minutes walk to opera. 
 No reception like hotels, but always someone there in morning till noon. Access via codes that emailed to me in advance, and finding the place and  using  the codes was so easy. 
 The most thing I enjoyed,  super quite room in a really busy place, around Clichy and Monmartre.  In room, curtains was well to block the light.  Exellent  bed mattress  for someone like me with backache.  Room was big compare to European stile, has shower, toilet, two washbin and safe. Shower and toilet were separate from each other. 
  In a small fridge in common area,  there were water and orange juice, also could make coffee /tea with some biscuits / cookies , 24 hours.
 Breakfast was very good , with tea/coffee, orange juice,  fruit salad, cheese, butter,  homemade jams and honey, some bacons , flakes , also croissants and other pastries.9/10 rate  for breakfast which serve between 7:30 to 10 . 
 The property owners and workers did the best for their  guests.  I requested  earlier check in and they let me have my room 2 hours sooner. I saw Serge and Camille, both was so helpful  , I asked many questions about the places and the best ways to access and the kindly search and answered me . They provided maps, also we received a small book with many things to do and places to walk and go, restaurants. ... 
 I am really appreciate for their hospitality,  Surely come back  to your place Juliette and Serge.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Fantastic Stay - Highly Recommend for First Time in Paris!
text: Service from Juliette, Maria & Serge was excellent. 5 night stay for us. Rooms were cleaned each day, beds were very comfortable (and big - I’m 6’5”), and lighting/amenities were very accommodating. Also felt very safe protected off street with two door security codes to gain access. SoPi was also able to accommodate us with champagne and cheese/fruit plates to our room upon request! Walking distance from Moulin Rouge and Theater District, as well as numerous close-by restaurants, bars and coffee shops. Our continental breakfasts each morning consisted of coffee, croissants, meats, cheeses, yogurts and cereal. Water and OJ available 24/7 in fridge. Great way to wake up each day and start off right! Big thanks to 1er Etage SoPi for making it such a memorable stay!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Great concept, great creation
text: This place was fantastic. Modern, clean room with good shower and toilet. Comfortable bed and curtains which kept the light out effectively. Located in a vibey area with nice restaurants and bars. I was initially uncertain if the keypad system with no typical front desk would work - turns out it works brilliantly. I would return in a heartbeat, super place.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Loved our stay!
text: Really enjoyed our stay, the location was convienient to restaurants, shops and hop on/off bus. Staff were lovely and friendly, not to mention the yummy breakfast each day. The rooms are a great size and basic but handy items are available all the time in the kitchen. After staying at a few other hotels on our trip, the use of the kitchen is a fantastic bonus here. The check in was easy using the directed method we received via email and we had no problems getting in to the building and room. We used the laundrette across the road which was cheap enough to wash/dry clothing. Thank you for everything!!!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Really Unique and Enjoyable Stay *****
text:
My girlfriend and I booked the 1er Etage Sopi Pigalle for a 2 night stay in September 2018 for her 30th birthday , and having read all the good reviews before booking we were not disappointed. 
We arrived about 11.30am on the Thursday (arrived via Beauvais airport , got a bus to Port de Maillot then caught a metro from there to Pigalle station , the accommodation is 5 min walk from the station)

Our room wasn’t ready til 3 so we were aloud leave our bags in a waiting room , the girl who greeted us was really friendly and said we could help ourselves to complimentary Coffee Juices Bottled Water , which was a nice gesture. 

We only had 2 and half days in Paris so we wanted to get as much in as possible , we headed off for the day and done all our exploring , we didn’t get back til after 9.30/10 and our bags were still where we left them safe and sound ... 

The next morning we had a lovely breakfast which was included (mixed fruit salad , yoghurt , croissants, bread and jam and cup of coffee , there was also cold meats and cheese but we didn’t have those. 

We went out exploring again we had bought a 2 day ticket for hop on hop off open bus tour €78 euro (€39 each )
There is 4 routes that cover the whole city we would highly recommend it. Also the red line drops you off 5/7 min walk away from the 1er Etage Sopi (get off near the moulin rouge) so it’s handy to get back home after your day of exploring!!! We also done the RIVER SEINE CHAMPAGNE NIGHT CRUISE FOLLOWED BY A TRIP UP TO LEVEL 2 EIFFEL TOWER €100 per person bit expensive but would highly recommend it , nearly 3 hours long total.

Our second night we wanted to have a few drinks , we had cocktails in Dirty Dicks which was a funky bar prices of cocktails ranged from €10-€18 we then went to a place called B9s which is very close to the accommodation, they do food and drinks happy hour til 10 €5 euro a cocktail and then happy lounge from 10-2am €6 for cocktails , we got a nice pizza between us for €14 and good few cocktails , the place is like a diner but they were playing Rap/RNB music , really good atmosphere there. And prices like that on Friday night you cannot argue with it. 

We checked out 11am on the Sat and our flight wasn’t til 5.10pm so we left our bags in the same room as the first day without any problem
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Fun weekend in Paris
text: What a great boutique hotel. Loved it. So much character. Excellent position to bars and restaurants. Felt very safe and secure. Serge, Maree and Camille looked after us so well, booked restaurants made us cappuccinos and sorted our room after many hours of traveling. They were all so welcoming. Will definitely be staying there next time I visit Paris.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Extraordinarily good!
text:
We had a very relaxing time here. Serg and staff were very welcoming and helpful.

This was my first visit to Paris but my wife has visited on two previous occasions. We have both been to other parts of France and have travelled extensively to other parts of the world.

Our room was spacious and cool (good a/c in hot weather). Our bed was blissful and we both slept so well. This is an important factor that is not fully understood by other accommodation providers. 

The breakfast was very good with ample chopped fruit, cereal, bread and coffee. Of particular note is that the dining area is available 24/7 for guests to access coffee, cold bottled water (so much needed after a hot and long day walking). Little snacks were also available. 

There is so much attention to detail that I could go on and on but suffice it to say that this is all in the interests of a whole and wonderful experience for guests. It really works and well done to the flair and style of the owners.

We had such a great time in Paris and this accommodation made our trip very memorable - thank you!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Exquisite example of Paris Life
text: Have come to understand Paris as the Maximum exponent of refinement, balance and courtesy. 1er Etage was gorgeous and a great experience. Will visit again for sure. Breakfast was great as well as location. We rode velib bicycles that were a block away from hotel. Great breakfast food and hospitality. Please come !
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Nice and cozy
text:
Breakfast is great, though it's always the same. Room is small, but clean and nice.

One important thing - there is no reception! You need to have an email with two codes before you come here. One is to get to the building, another one - to the hotel door and your room.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Highly recommend
text: Large room, greate stuff, extremely clean, cozy bed, waterfall shower. Located very well, in a quiet street close to Pigalle, Glery Lafayette, Opera ets, all in a walking distance. Highly recommend!!!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Weekend in Paris
text: Spent the weekend in Paris and this was part of the reason our stay was unforgettable. Beautifully decorated and exceptionally clean room, delicious breakfast, friendly staff. Close to the Opera House, Louvre and Sacre-Coeur. Paris East Train station is a 30 min walk. Great concept—will definitely be back.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Lovely accommodations in the 9th
text: My girlfriend and I just returned from a very pleasant 9 day stay at this property and I would definitely re- book for my future Paris travels. Our superior room was cozy but spacious, by Parisienne standards; the bathroom was large and equipped with a rain shower head which was a dream.   The interior of this boutique hotel has been carefully curated with art and other objects.  1er is conveniently located in a nice neighbourhood and within steps of all services.  Serge or Juliette are available in the mornings to assist, if necessary.   If you are looking for pleasant, refreshing, cozy accommodations, 1er will fit your needs!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Wonderful attention to detail
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our three day visit and would definitely stay here again if we return to Paris.  Breakfast was tasty, the room was spacious, clean and comfortable.  The location is great with many nice restaurants, wine and pastry shops nearby.  Owners were helpful and courteous.  Highly recommend this lovely property!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Tourist visit
text: Given the location, price, extremely clean, nearly perfect room, I would highly recommend it to anyone..  just no heavy bags.. lol. Breakfast is great,  people are superbly helpful and accomodating. Owners were charming and delightful
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Absolutely perfect!
text: We stayed here for 3 nights over a weekend & absolutely loved it! The location is perfect, the rooms are beautiful & we were looked after so well. Nothing was too much trouble & a lovely alternative breakfast was provided to suit my dietary requirements (lactose & gluten intolerant vegetarian!) I can’t recommend this place enough & wouldn’t consider staying anywhere else in Paris now. Highly recommend!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Love all the little extras
text:
We stayed here for a weekend and absolutely loved it!

We arrived at around 6pm and were given codes for the front and inner doors - it feels like something out of a spy film - loved the hands off approach - no queuing for a receptionist - just let yourself in! It’s the future.

Great location just 5 minutes from Saint-George Metro or Pigalle and just a short walk up to the Sacré-Cœur. Relatively quiet area and our room was really peaceful.

There is a kitchenette downstairs where you have breakfast with free water, orange juice and big sweetie tubs of chocolate, nougat and little cakes! There’s another one on the top floor which also has a coffee machine for espresso and a kettle for tea - plus more free water and OJ.

Our room was a little small (room 6) but really comfy with a great shower - there is very little in the way of privacy though! You can see into the shower from the bed so this room is only suitable for couples- the bed is very comfy - we both slept soundly.

The breakfast is yummy - fruit salad, pastries, yoghurt, cereals, bread, ham and cheese with tea, coffee and OJ in a lovely little room with French music playing.

Oh you also get a free tote bag and booklet with the owners recommendations for places to eat, see and kiss at! Very sweet idea. The toiletries in the room are also great but girls you’ll need to bring your own conditioner.

Top tip if you arrive hungry I recommend Le Chaptal restaurant at the end of the road - the steak is incredible and the owner is really friendly.

Overall we loved this place and would definitely stay here again!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Must stay
text: Great location. Can easily walk to Paris’s many attractions and subway stops.  Wonderful rooms with shower to look forward to. Very clean. Comfortable beds. Very nice breakfast of fresh fruit, bread with jam, yoghurt and cheeses and meat selection. Oh and coffee.  Friendly and very helpful staff.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Great location, high quality room, charming hosts
text: A great location in a reasonably quiet street yet within walking distance of so much that one wants to see, high quality room fittings and furnishings, professional and friendly hosts, charming lounge, fresh fruit and quality breads for breakfast. Will be staying here in future. Concierge is not full time (one uses a code to enter the hotel much in the evenings) and price is not the cheapest but I don't see the point of taking a risk in order to save a few Euros. You'll be comfortable here, and you'll sleep well.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: The best stay in Paris one could wish for!
text: The bed was super comfy - such wonderful sleep. Breakfast was prepared fresh before us every morning. The room was beautiful with large full height window. Large waterfall shower with his and hers sinks. Decor was very nice and the staff were superb! Would love to visit again.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: A Wonderful Place!
text: We didn't really know much about Paris other than the obvious.  But staying here was a great decision.  It was a great location, walking up the hill to montmartre in the morning and then multiple choices for metro nearby.  The staff was very helpful recommending dinner spots and things to see.  The morning breakfast was delicious and perfect.  We stayed in room 1 and loved the cozy Parisian feel.  The wifi was free and fast, not like the normal wifi at hotels.  Getting into and out of the hotel and our room with just keycodes was awesome.  Because sometimes carrying a keycard around is just one extra thing.  We would love to come back at stay again!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: More than a hotel
text: We stayed at 1er Etage Sopi for 5 days and it was simply a perfect experience. We loved the consept of 1er Etage which is a perfect combination of a cozy and homey parisian apartment and a bourique hotel. The style of the place is sophisticated and functional.The location is very good, moving around is easy by metro or by walking. 1er Etage Sopi was very peaceful and we had all we needed in our queen size room (except full size mirror). Everything was clean and the service was just perfect and frendly. Now we have found our place in Paris, next time maybe 1er Etage Marais😊
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text:
1er Etage is the perfect hotel for you if you're an independent traveler who wants to feel more like they are living like a Parisian than a tourist on vacation. We stayed in Room 7, one of the classic rooms for a week and it was perfect. The bed is really comfortable, the towels are soft, and the shower has instant hot water with a rain shower head. The room was small but we still had plenty of room to unpack out clothes and make ourselves at home. Our room also faced a courtyard, we slept with the window open each night and it was very quiet and peaceful. The room was also spotlessly clean.
The breakfast is amazing. Fresh fruit, preserves, bread, pastries, cheese, and charcuterie everyday. Plus fresh brewed coffee. The breakfast room/kitchen area is beautiful and stylish. 
The kitchenette was very convenient, we used to to eat our dinner a couple of nights after picking up food at a local market. The kitchen is well stocked with utensils, plates, glasses, and all the basics. If you stay in room 6 or 7 on the top floor there is an additional little sitting room with kitchenette that is comfortable and private. 
Juliette and Serge are there if you need them to answer your questions or make recommendations about things to do. 
The location is very good, it's close to metro stops and lots of restaurants and bars. A few places we enjoyed were Aloha Cafe, Le Depanneur Pigalle, Ito Izakaya, Hmm Donuts, and Boulangerie Cyprien. The Montmartre cementery is also really close and we enjoyed spending a morning strolling through the beautiful cemetery. 
Thank you Juliette and Serge for a wonderful stay in Paris, we can't wait to return!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: amazing experience
text: if you would like to try different hotel experiece you should stay this hotel. Every room decoration is very unique and different and also you dont see any stuff at the hotel during your accommodation. you have the pin codes that open the door of the rooms.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: The most amazingly beautiful place, with excellent personal service
text: I have just returned from staying at Le 1er Etage SoPi this weekend. I went with a group of 7 people and we booked it last October. From my initial enquiry to the end of our trip, the owner Serge went out of his way to accommodate us all. One of the group was 88 years old, and Serge made sure all of our needs were met, and that our trip was easy and straight forward. What I loved about this place was the 'home from home' feeling and personal touches throughout. It is like staying in your own beautiful Parisian apartment. The decor is gorgeous and his wife Juliette has added her own flair and personal touches throughout. Camille and the rest of the staff were polite and very helpful. From booking us dinner in a nearby restaurant on the night we arrived, to organising taxis for us, nothing was too much trouble. The beds and rooms exceeded our expectations in comfort, cleanliness and style. The breakfast was fresh and delicious. The location is perfect and is very central. I honestly can say that Serge and Juliette deserve more than 5 stars. I will definitely be back here next time I am in Paris. Thank you again to you all.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Amazing way to feel Paris atmosphere
text: 1er Etage is an amazing place to stay, the atmosphere and decoration is charming. The rooms are very confortable, and Deluxe room have plenty of space, as well as a huge bathroom. In between guesthouse and luxury hotel, the experience is very great. The best way of visiting Paris and having a good rest in a cosy place.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Unique, charming and memorable stay
text: One of the most charming and lovely hotels we have stayed in! We visited Paris for my fiancé’s 30th birthday and this hotel really made our trip. We got the euro star to gare du nord and walked to the hotel, which took us around 30 minutes. On arrival, access to the building was simple with the codes provided previously by email and the building felt safe due to the two separate doors to enter. The lounge area, where you are free to make tea and coffee was so stylish and relaxed - we loved the decor! Breakfast was also served here, which was delicious - fresh fruit, bread, yoghurt, granola, cheeses, meats and more. We stayed in the jungle room, which was gorgeous. We especially loved the large bath at the end of a long day on our feet. Juliette and Serge were so helpful with reservations over email before we arrived and suggested and booked les canailles for us, which I would highly recommend. They also printed Disney tickets off for us which was really helpful. Another friendly touch was a Valentine’s gift bag left on the bed with a balloon, face mask, chocolates and more in it - so sweet and thoughtful. The location was great and overall an amazing stay in a quiet but central area of Paris!!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Cute little hotel in a convenient location
text:
The title says it's all: This is a cute little hotel in a convenient location!

Self-check in was fast and easy. Great breakfast. Nice location near many interesting attractions. Short walking distance to Moulin Rouge. No elevator, so keep this in mind if you're traveling with heavy luggage! (We weren't so it was ok ;))
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: An elegant and thoughtfully-prepared establishment in a wonderful location
text:
Everything you could need - a compact room but with every convenience.  Large TV, comfortable bed, spacious shower and vanity area, separate WC, plenty of storage.  Elegant decor with bottles of water, room fragrance and toiletries.  Free coffee and tea etc. provided in common areas.  Our room (number 6) overlooked the courtyard below and had a Juliet balcony.  Serge and Juliette were quick to reply to any questions.  Interesting city guide and access to tourist app provided.  A full-length mirror on the back of the door (for instance) would be a fabulous addition.  

This place is quirky, well-run and unique.  We met our host, Serge, before we left and after our excellent breakfast - he was a knowledgeable, affable and charming host.  This place is wonderfully located within the more sophisticated streets of Pigalle and stones' throw of the more touristy areas (shopping in Galleries Lafayette and later to Place de la Concorde).  Overall - fabulous.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Friendly and absolutely classy boutique hotel
text: If you´re looking to save money in a big size hotel with buffet meals and centric location simply don´t come here. On the contrary, if you´re looking for exquisitely decorated and meticulously cleaned rooms, the authenticity of becoming part of a really calm and trendy Rive Droit neighbourhood (SoPi) just a few squares from two Metro Stations (Saint Georges and Liege) and the animated areas of Galleries Lafayette and Montmartre with many restaurants around, real personalization and absolute quality of service, fabulous breakfasts listening calmly to Carla Bruni or Charles Aznavour, please don´t miss the superb experience of Le 1er Etage Sopi. On your bed you'll find a booklet wich states "Feeling like a Parisian", so simple to say, so hard to find; needless to say that behind curtains there´s hard work from both owners and staff. We stayed here for ten days so the Parisian promise really came true.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Excellent place to stay
text:
Le 1er Etage Sopi is an excellent place to stay in Paris. It's my forth time this year that i stayed there. Good situation, near Opera and metro station, but at the same time, quiet zone to get a good rest. Rooms are quiet and completely new with a cool equipment, nice mattress and linens, excellent bathroom, nice television, and coffee machine.
Breakfast is good, served nicely in the comfortable dinning room. 
Resuming, excellent place to stay and enjoy Paris.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Lovely hotel, fantastic staff
text:
My wife and I stayed here for 2 nights as part of our honeymoon. Juliette and Serge were in touch beforehand with comprehensive details to help us find and access the hotel. They gave recommendations for local attractions and restaurants and could not have been more helpful.

The room was perfect, very tastefully furnished and exactly what we needed for a short break to Paris.

Breakfast was fantastic and access to lounge areas for water/tea/coffee was a great touch. I would definitely stay there again.

One point to note, but certainly no fault of the hotel, is that there is no lift access to the rooms which are spread over 3 floors. So bear that in mind if you are planning on carrying heavy cases around!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Luxury boutique hotel in a great location
text: Booked this hotel with a friend as we were going on a girls shopping trip to Paris. From the moment we walked in, our room was spotless and beautiful. It was larger than most European rooms I've stayed in. The shower was fantastic and the beds were extremely comfortable. Breakfast was included and it is worth waking up early for! Overall it was a fantastic experience. The location of this hotel is near a lot of delicious restaurants that are not touristy at all, as well as a number of fun bars. It's close to the metro but I would recommend walking as the shops are not too far. An amazing hotel and I would certainly stay here again on my next trip to Paris.
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Top Concept
text:
Three words: T O P ...
Clean rooms, great breakfast, superb location near metro and a taxi stop, parking for cars is very close, delicious restaurants in the neighborhood and a personal approach by Serge!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Cozy
text:
Hotel 1er Étage Sopi is installed in an 19th century mansion with seven unique rooms. It is an innovative hospitality concept that combines the boutique hotel and the authentic charm of an elegant Paris apartment. This new hotel concept let you try different styles of accommodation. The vintage decorations of the 50 years in the rooms certainly give you a feeling of home. You can completely adopting and feel comfortable in your "home" in Paris or rather your room. What else can you want in Paris? This is very important. 

It is located in a very central place which is also a quiet and calm neighborhood. Thanks to the comfortable living-room and kitchen you can enjoy your French breakfast and chill after a long day. Of course the kind and helpful attitudes of the owners of the hotel Juliette and Serge is one of the reasons that make your stay a pleasant one.

At the same time, Hotel 1er Étage Sopi is very close to Abbesses which has a lot of theatres, joyous cafes and restaurants. You simply must experience that fun and colorful ambiance! The hotel also close to Montmartre, Pigalle, Opera Garnier and department stores such like Printemps and the Galeries Lafayette. If you are planning a bohemian trip to Paris you should stay at Hotel 1er Étage Sopi and get to enjoy this area! 

Enjoy your trip!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Clean, quiet and very comfortable
text:
The breakfast was very good and the room was really clean. The hotel is in a quiet area, but close to the metro and shops. It only takes about 10 minutes to walk to the Sacre Coeur. 
Everyone was helpful and we enjoyed our stay here!
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Great stay, totally recommend it
text: We really enjoyed our 2 nights stay in this apartment.  From room size and decor of the apartment to breakfast which was delicious and served in the lovely dining room of this house. I loved retro decor of our room, every item lovingly sourced from the markets , I found this information from the little booklet you are given by the owners.  Tote bag gift is lovely touch as well. Great area to stay, multitude of bars and restaurants and walking distance to Moulin Rouge, Opera, La Lafayette shopping house etc.   Also it is close to Gar Du Nord by taxi which cost about 10 euro . Lovely ladies both at the reception and serving breakfast!    There is also free water, juice and sweets in dining area provided for the guest. No negatives at all.  I would return !
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: Beutiful hotel with a top location
text: Quiet little hotel. Very comfortable bed. Clean room. Beautifully decorated. Nice breakfast. Friendly, smiling and helpfull staff. Great location near moulin rouge and different metros. We will definitely come again :)
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

title: The best hotel!
text: Beautiful, quite, really nice stuff and placed near all the metro station you need and a few minutes from gallery lafayettea and from great pubs and restaurants. We will be back! If you are in paris, don't miss this great hotel
name: Le 1er Etage SoPi

Hotel Magellan is an amazing hotel, extremely clean, I would even say spotless! We loved the breakfast in the morning, always fresh and we were happy with the variety of food. We loved the fact we could sit outside and enjoy our breakfast on the terrace. The service was excellent!!!! Once again we were blown away with the cleanliness! 
Location is also great! 
Hotel staff was always helpful and very nice ! 
We would highly recommend this hotel! 
We we were beyond happy with our choice !

title: Lovely Hotel in a Quiet Residential Area
text: Thank you to the Hotel Magellan for upgrading our room to a courtyard view during our 12-night stay in Paris. Our room was absolutely immaculate with a big window that opened up to the courtyard. The bed was so comfortable and the air conditioning was amazing. Breakfast was pretty good and we were able to enjoy it outside in the courtyard most mornings. Although the breakfast was a buffet, the breakfast room had wonderful staff that attended to our every need such as bringing us fresh coffee, orange juice, etc. The rooms in the hotel do not have fridges, which we found very challenging during the hot summer days. We weren’t able to bring any food to our room and had to drink warm drinks most of the time. Luckily there was a supermarket around the corner where we were able to buy cold drinks. The hotel had a little bar downstairs but the price of drinks was expensive compared to the supermarket. The hotel is located in a quiet residential area and a little far from the major tourist attractions (the closest attraction was the Arc de Triomphe at 1.2 km away). At first, we were a little upset for booking a hotel so far away but once we learned the metro and bus system, which didn’t take us long and is super easy, we were just a ride away from everything. The biggest plus is that after a busy day of sightseeing in Paris amongst thousands upon thousands of tourists and noisy traffic, we were so happy to come back to our peaceful area. The only drawback to staying in a residential area was that there was nothing to do at night - no shopping, no nightlife, restaurants were so-so and closed early.

title: Very clean and comfortable, lovely staff and amazing breakfast.
text:
We stayed at Hotel Le Magellan recently; for 7 nights, 8 days (transfer to airport included with Air Transat). It's a tad remote from the "middle", but we wanted to walk Paris, you see so much more. LM is in the 14e Arrondissement I beleive. The subway or RER is a few minutes away from your destination in Paris (and very accessible). If I was too tired to walk back, I would look for the stairs down, and hop you go. 

Le Magellan was fully renovated in 2017 (I believe) with modern decor and accessories. If you plan to walk all day, you want to start with a decent breakfast; Le Magellan had an excellent full-breakfast, lovely really. Check the photos...it's for real. They do have a fresh orange juice press. Quite the treat, fresh everything and delicious. I found the service and food to be excellent in Paris (forget the prices, it's expensive, you're in Paris). Lovely to have that part (breakie) of your day included. I would go back to the Magellan...not sure how it works with kids. They might have junior suites. We often bought snacks in one of the neighbourhood grocery stores, lovely again, I don't have to tell you about the cheese aisle do I? And a good bottle of Bordeaux is 7 or 8 Euros. It's nice to have a glass before going out, although Le Magellan has a lovely small bar next to the reception area. The staff was very kind, we had a great time there. Felt like we were home. We saw all the important venues in Paris, and as I mentioned, going back to the Hotel was very easy. Amazing time, thank you LM and Paris! Bisous de Vankleek Hill (Ontario).

title: Parfait
text:
Loved this hotel. I was surprised to see it was only 3 star! Immaculately kept and clean, with friendly staff. (There’s even a shoe shine by the lift!)
Room was small but had a little balcony, air con, safe, tea & coffee making facilities, toiletries, iron & ironing board without having to request from reception. 
I loved it.
Definitely worth adding full breakfast in advance. There is a fresh orange juice machine (the oranges are literally squeezed before your eyes & are delicious). There are hot fresh thin pancakes, a boiling pot for eggs and a toaster. Cold wise there is yoghurt, small pastures, cereal & dried fruits, cheese etc. Tea/coffee is offered and you can ask for more. The hotel has a little peaceful garden which you can eat breakfast in if you choose to.
Location wise there is a gorgeous Italian nearby & mini carrefour less than 5 mins walk away. Uber to arc de triomphe (which you can climb, who knew?!) was approx 10-15 euros depending on time.
Would definitely stay again.

title: Excellent base in Paris
text:
I stayed with a few friends for a training course in Paris and this hotel was an excellent place to stay. 
It was clean, comfortable and the rooms were big by Paris standards. I had toiletries, a hairdryer, iron & ironing board, tea-making facilities, safe in the room and aircon- so everything I needed. 
The metro station is nearby but it isn’t far to walk to L’Arc de Triomphe and between a few of us, Uber’s were cheap enough to get everywhere. 
The staff were very nice too and the wine at the bar was cheaper than in most nearby restaurants. 
Breakfast was varied and decent (I didn’t get breakfast but sat with my friends one morning whilst they did and it looked pretty good!)
The only teeny downside was that the blind in the room still let a bit of light in so the room wasn’t dark enough for me. 
All in all a great place to stay and I’d definitely go back.

title: Charming
text:
We booked this hotel last minute in a package deal as we like to try and visit Paris every year. What a fantastic little hotel. Firstly, this hotel is not a three star hotel, I have stayed in worse five star hotels! The room was lovely, amazingly comfortable bed! We struggled getting up in the morning! Great en-suite. The breakfast was great, substantial continental - with croissants, pastries, cheese and meats. Fruits, cereals, freshly squeezed orange juice and some hot eggs and bacon, or beans and sausage. 
People have said the location is out of the center but I would disagree. It is 5 mins to Pereire metro station, from here you can get to Opera and change to line 7, which will take you to Palais Royal or Chatelet. 15 minutes and you're in the centre of Paris. We walked to the Arc De Triomphe in approximately 20-25 minutes and we were sauntering. I would say it is a lovely area with gardens just outside the hotel  and some great bars and restaurants nearby. The real bonus for us was the outside garden area, somewhere to relax in the fresh air after a day of walking and sip a beer or wine! A brilliant hotel and we will be returning soon!

title: Lovely hotel
text:
My husband and I stayed the weekend here while visiting Paris on a sight seeing break.
On arrival (8pm) the hotel staff were very welcoming and spoke very good English. 
Our room was compact, functional and very clean. We had clean linen and towels everyday and the room contained tea/coffee making facilities. There is also a hairdryer in the room which was handy. Our room was in the seperate house overlooking the courtyard which had a nice view however, as we were on the ground floor you could hear people outside coming and going and eating breakfast so not good if you were a light sleeper. Unfortunately we could not get the air con to work in our room so spent the weekend sleeping in a warm room which wasn't ideal. Personally I found the bed and pillows a little hard for my liking so I didn't sleep too well. I'm now leaving to go home quite tired. 
The breakfast was nice (continental) and the breakfast staff were friendly and welcoming. We were impressed with the professionalism of all the staff members. 
The hotel is a 5/10 min walk from the metro. I would recommend asking the receptionist for a map of the metro system as we felt the local taxi drivers ripped us off and were disgustingly extortionate in their prices. But they also drove like crazy people! Im surprised they don't have more accidents on their roads.

title: Excellent!
text: My adult daughter and I spent three nights at the Magellan sharing a twin room on the fifth floor. A very good job had been done all round - lovely welcoming reception area, well laid out breakfast room, and tastefully decorated bedroom. There is a supermarket quite close by if you want to buy a snack to eat in the room.  There are also loads of different restaurants to choose from.  The hotel is about 15 minutes' walk away from L'Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees.  I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely go back!

text: My 2nd time in Paris, my 2nd time at the Magellan.   This is a lovely hotel, a little off the beaten track, but very close to 2 Metro stations and about a 15 min walk to the Arc de Triomphe.   A great buffet breakfast each morning (love the orange presse), nice courtyard, rooms are comfy, theres an elevator. Only negative would be at check out, we asked for a cab to be called (to take us to the train station for the Eurostar) and the front desk staff wasn't too accommodating, after about 1/2 hour they told us just to walk to the taxi stand a few blocks away (bit of stress there, as we almost missed our train).   But, I won't let that deter me from leaving a great review, and I would stay here again.

title: 4 star appearance - 2 star staff
text:
Visited here mid Dec '18. The hotel is easily accessible from either Gare du Nord Station(eurostar) or central Paris. The nearest metro station (Pereire) is a 6 min walk past a nice little park.

The neighbourhood is quiet, pretty and safe even at night (we are 2 young females and came back at 2am). There are a couple of newsagent shops within 2 mins for snacks and drinks.

The reception area is beautiful - the entire complex has the appearance of a high 4 star hotel. Everything is very clean, neat and new looking, including the guest toilet available for use when your room is not yet ready. There is a seating area with sofas, away from the reception desk, where you can relax or wait. 

The room was on the small side, but quite spacious compared to the average Parisien hotel room. 
There was a decent sized wardrobe with adequate hangers, ironing board and shelf space. The table was a good size. The TV was a mid sized flat screen which we didn't use so cannot comment on channel availability. 
There are plug sockets next the each bed side, small bedside tables and a hook for coats. There is also a full length mirror on the wall.
The curtains are lightweight voile but there is a button to put the blackout shutters down at night if you need it. Slippers at eprovided but we were only given one pair (?!).
Two pillows were provided and there is a warm large fleece blanket in the wardrobe for the cold season. 

The bathroom is small but very clean and new. The lighting and mirrors are very handy, and towels, hand towels and a bath mat are provided, as well as a hairdryer under the sink.
The shower has a waterfall shower head as well as a handheld one if you do not want to get your hair wet. Water pressure and temperature were great - no fluctuations and nice and hot/powerful. The bathroom door is a sliding wooden door that can be locked.

There is a vending machine on the ground floor by the lift, as well as a shoe shining machine. The lift is a decent size and is very fast.

We did not eat breakfast there or go out into the courtyard so cannot comment on these. 

Cons:
The pillows and the bathroom has a few short hairs on them - however I think this is from the cleaner and not a previous guest, as everything else was spotless, and the same hairs were found again the next day after the cleaner had been. It was only a few but this put me off slightly as I am a germaphobe.

The reception staff were not the friendliest - they were not rude, but weren't friendly either, apart from the one female receptionist we had on checkout. The male receptionists were either apathetic or slightly short/blunt. We had an evening when we ordered food via ubereats, and the receptionist hung up on me after shouting "What room are you?!". I rang back and the same receptionist told me rudely that we need to come down and collect our food. I asked if someone could send it up, and he said "You did not tell me your room number!". I calmly gave it to him again, and the ubereats driver himself appeared at our door with our food.
I understand there may have been a slight language barrier, combined with frustration and maybe upset that we ordered food in (is this not allowed? The hotel doesn't have any lunch or dinner facilities!) and so I would not say this would stop me from staying here again, however I didn't appreciate being shouted at.

Everything else was fine with the hotel, and as the trip itself was so great, these issues did not ruin the trip. I would rate the hotel itself as 4 stars, it is very new and clean. But the staff I would rate 3 stars.

title: AMAZING!!!
text:
I have no idea how anyone could have something bad to say about this hotel. My husband and I went to Le Magellan last week for our first anniversary and first experience and Paris, and we don't have a single complaint!
We were greeted and checked in very quickly, and were welcomed with kind staff. We have been told that the rooms are quite small generally in Paris, but we did not find that! We found our room quite spacious. The AC was incredible, the shower was perfect and we LOVED the blackout windows! Every day we enjoyed the breakfast, and loved the croissants and fresh orange juice. The gardens were well-maintained a beautiful area to sit.
This is a reminder that last week, we were there for both Bastille Day and when France won the world cup, if there was any time for staff to be 'too busy' or there to be craziness, it would have been then. The staff put the game on for everyone to watch and watched along with us (when there weren't customers obviously).
One day, my husband and I got back so late from our bike tour, we couldn't find a restaurant open. The one staff member actually looked online and found a pizza place, placed our order for us, and called us when it was delivered. I literally can't say enough about how warm, welcoming and excellent our stay was in Paris. If anyone has any doubts, I would be happy to share more of my experience because we truly couldn't have asked for a better one.
Also, it was maybe a 10 minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe.... close enough to the action but far enough away for some peace and quiet!

title: an ideal place to stay with essentials but without frills
text: What a gem!  I was so pleasantly surprised.  I booked knowing nothing except the price and stars, bt for one night that was enough.  I expected little but was so pleased when I arrived.  It's in a quiet street -- but a convenient location fro Porte Maillot. The staff were super friendly.  It was clean, modern and comfortable.  It's not 5* and all bells and whistles, but the room was large enough (especially large for Paris), it was clean, comfortable, adequately stocked with what travellers expect. The bathroom was large enough and well appointed. Free wifi, tea and coffee.  There was everything I needed and at a reasonable price with friendly staff.  What's not to like?! OK, there's no restaurant for fine dining, and the bar is the reception desk, but if you want to entertain you'd choose another hotel.  As a nice place to sleep this is  definitely one to go back to.

title: Wonderful Stay, Lovely hotel and lovely staff!
text: The hotel exceeded our expectations I had booked two double rooms for a 3 night stay one for my parents and one for me and the deal included breakfast which was a really nice continental breakfast buffet with delicious coffee and fresh orange juice. The hotel is in a quiet residential area with metro a 5-10minute walk and convenient base for exploring the city centre of Paris without the tourist crown and noise. The staff were really friendly and helpful; we felt very welcomed to hotel and comfortable. My parents who were elderly really enjoyed their stay. The double rooms we booked queen bed were very clean modern and sufficient the beds are a bit small but thats only one niggle. The bedrooms were also cleaned every day which I thought was professional. The hotel has a lovely outdoor garden which we didn't get to experience due to the rain however I would not hesitate to stay here again it was perfect! I was told the hotel will be undergoing refurbishment for a 6 months from the end of March to make it even better so looking forward to stay here after the refurb. Thank you again Hotel Le Magellan for a wonderful stay.

title: No frills comfort
text: It's hard to rate hotels in Paris; the rooms always seem to be the size of closets and a bit antiquated. With that said, this hotel might deserve a 4 star rating with respect to other establishments in Paris. The rooms are small but clean and comfortable. I found a distinct lack of electrical outlets; there was one for charging my phone, but then I had to unplug the hot water kettle to charge my laptop. The wifi wasn't very fast; I could get my email but it didn't support teleconferencing. The shower was also adequate but tiny (keep those elbows tight to the body). Although the room is showing it's age, I understand from some of the other comments that renovations are planned soon. The hotel location is in a quiet area that is also close to restaurants (lots of Japanese possibilities) and different metro options are a short walk. In short, it's great if you're just going to clean up and sleep without spending too much time in the room itself.

title: Not a 5 star experience
text: This is a quaint hotel. It is clean.  That's as far as I can compliment.  We had a family room with 2 bedrooms reserved, thinking it was like a suite of sorts, for the price. .
