Also the location may be good for a business traveller, but for a tourist, I would suggest another area.  This was too far off the path.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great concierge but grumpy receptionists and small room for the price
text:
We stayed here for two nights. On the plus side, the beds were comfortable and the shower was good. However, the toilet was crammed into such a small space that anyone taller than five foot five would have been unable to sit there. Breakfast was good. The concierge was excellent. Good location. 

The gym was ill-equipped with no bench or mats. The two female receptionists were unhelpful and unfriendly. Overall very expensive for what it was.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Our 25th wedding anniversary
text: Me & my husband spent a week at Juliana Hotel from Sep 1-8, 2022! We were in Paris to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary, and the staff of this beautiful hotel truly made our special trip, lovely and unforgettable! They are very friendly, very professional, super helpful, & will always be there for you, whatever you might need. The rooms are very clean, the service is exquisite! The location of this hotel is amazing, you can walk to Eiffel tower, Champs-Elysees, and so many nice restaurants/cafes around you. We couldn't possibly ask for anything more you might need at your stay in a hotel! Highly recommend this hotel!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great place in Paris
text:
So many positives! AC was strong, rain shower or handle shower also strong. The location is very good, very close to a metro stop, cafes and restaurants. 

The best thing about this hotel was the staff. Everyone we encountered was very polite and patient and extremely helpful! 

The decor in the lobby and the rooms was very chic. 

Loved this hotel!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Lovely Boutique hotel - great staff & location.
text: We had a lovely stay at the Hotel Juliana in Paris. It’s a boutique hotel in a great location, on a quiet street but close to all the sites. When we arrived we were greeted by the hotel manager Mohammad. He was professional and spoke good English. We felt very welcomed as Mohammad and the other staff member were both very upbeat and friendly. Lots of smiles! We arrived early before our room was ready so he made us a delicious coffee, checked us in and stored our bags so we could walk around until the room was ready. Check in is 3pm. I wanted to find a nice place to eat or grocery store and Mohammad took the time to orient me on a map and even walked with me to the corner of the street to give me directions. What a nice guy! All of the staff were top tier! Our room was clean and large and the whole hotel is very well maintained. Upon leaving to go back home I thought I lost my headphones. I called the hotel from the airport and Mohammad was quick to help. Fortunately I found my earbuds deep in my bag later on. Lol. Overall our experience at the Juliana was lovely and I would recommend.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Incredible staff and a relaxing enjoyable stay!
text: We came to Paris for the first time and were recommended Juliana by a friend. It did not disappoint! Staff was incredibly helpful and made our stay that much better. We will definitely stay again the next time we go back to Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Lovely hotel but lacks staff
text:
I emailed the hotel twice prior to our arrival to request an earlier check in (which I mentioned we were happy to pay for) my emails were unanswered. I submitted a chat request which was finally answered at 11:30am on our day of arrival… 

Our arrival was actually delayed by several hours due to transport issues but when we arrived the check-in process was very slow. We were asked to pre-authorise the full stay plus some extra on our credit cards, quite happy to do that but the process took ages and resulted in one of our cards being charged twice. 

The junior suites we had booked were very spacious and comfortable. 5 stars for that. 

When we tried to buy drinks at the bar, the whole process seemed like such an effort for the member of staff on duty. 

Breakfasts were good with plenty of choice.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful and unique ❤️
text: I have nothing to compare this hotel to because I have never stayed in Paris before but I really like the Juliana!!!! It's such a good location too! Walking distance to the 2 largest museums, biggest mall, and eiffel tower! I will check out the spa while I'm here. Our bathroom tub is amazing with great waterfall pressure, heated towel rack, and bidet toilet! No complaints everything is nice so far. And Roy our concierge is so helpful! And plenty of USB charger plugs.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Fabulous little gem
text: Fantastic hotel in a fantastic location. Everything you need is within walking distance. The area near Rue Cler and Rue Saint Dominique is especially cool and feels very local. The hotel staff are great. Rooms are really nice and well equipped.  Family room worked really well.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Sightseeing Paris
text:
The hotel itself was in a great location but the service can only be described as the Faulty Towers of Paris. We were only there a few nights but struggled to get shower wash, toilet paper, an iron etc etc. For toilet paper we were told the concierge didnt have a key to get us any??? Even on checkout they couldnt provide an account. 
You just had to laugh about it as the staff seemed to try but literally couldnt do anything.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Beautil hotel, lovely staff
text:
My husband and I stayed here early June, after flights were cancelled last minute we called ahead to check we could park (at 3am, in a panic), the staff were super helpful and friendly on the phone, promising us a parking space.
We arrived after a 9 hour drive and were met by the loveliest concierge, they were so welcoming and accommodating. We had our car sorted as promised, cold champagne handed over and then shown to our room. The room was spacious, clean and modern with a massive comfy bed. Gorgeous bathroom with robes, towels etc.
Every day we chatted to the concierge, they gave us recommendations for places to eat/walk/buy local snacks and flowers. The hotel itself is absolutely stunning but the staff really did make our stay extra special. We'd like to personally thank Rui who went above and beyond for us!
Thank you everyone, hope we can visit again
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Wonderful Stay
text:
My wife and I stayed for a week to celebrate our anniversary. The hotel staff was so friendly and helpful!  Emannuel, Roy and the entire team were so kind.  Even the night auditor and the gentlemen vacuuming the halls were so nice!

The hotel was very clean and in a great location for walking around the city.

Highly recommended!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful hotel close to Paris attractions
text: This hotel was perfect ! Very clean & comfortable rooms . The property was small & very beautiful. It was in a great location to walk to the Eiffel Tower and many other landmarks . We found it’s location to be a quite street that was very clean & within close walking distance to many restaurants & bar . The staff was very friendly & always helpful ! We stayed here on a recommendation & we highly recommend this hotel if your traveling to Paris !
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: First visit to Paris.
text: Myself and my wife decided to take a short break and visit Paris. We wanted a hotel close to the Eiffel Tower and this hotel did not disappoint! Great service start to finish… special thanks to Rui (concierge) who provided a high standard of customer service and offered recommendations for restaurants and places to visit. The hotel also offered a service where we could relax after a long day of walking/shopping via their in-house steam and sauna room where you could also book a massage experience. A place we would recommend and stay again!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Loved our stay!
text: We spent a fabulous week in Paris and loved every minute of our stay at the Juliana Hotel. The staff was exceptional—especially Roy, who went out of his way to help make our stay pleasant. We loved the quiet street and the quick walk to cafes and the Eiffel Tower. I highly recommend staying here.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Nice hotel but small details make it average
text: So I will try to be balanced in this review. I liked the boutique style of the hotel, decor is amazing, breakfast is plentiful and tasteful and the staff is super super nice!! Now the bad - my bathroom had ants which was disgusting (I had to kill them and they stopped coming). And on my final night of the stay I arrive late at night only to find that my room was not cleaned the night before. They also don’t give free water in the room. TV service is full of european languages and there is no entertainment. I would NOT recommend staying here.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Stolen jacket
text: We stayed at this hotel last weekend and we left a jacket on the couch in the room by mistake. I rang the hotel the next morning to ask them to kindly ship it for us and they said the jacket wasn’t left behind. I know the jacket was left in the room because I purposely left it out the case on the couch and said we will carry it in the car so it isn’t creased in the suitcase as it was expensive, so I asked to ask all staff because we didn’t take it to the car I know it was left on the couch in the room. They rang me back and said no it wasn’t their! It was definitely their
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great location and service
text:
Great service and location! Although they had shortage of staff, we’ve been assisted and taken card of. A special thank you to Terri who has been super amazing go us! 

The location is excellent, we stayed in a room category called Junior Suite (its not a suite) the room is spacious with a little sofa. It was great due to our luggage if you’re not with plenty of luggage the deluxe room is also amazing.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Five stars doesn't do this hotel justice
text: We have just returned from the most amazing stay in Paris and the hotel made the experience perfect for us! I have stayed in a few 5 star hotels but the service from the staff in this one was amazing they couldn't do enough for you, We got engaged and they even gave us a free bottle of Moet and wrote a lovely note for us. Location is amazing 10 minute walk from Eiffel tower the rooms are beautifully designed and spacious. We had that much of a good time we are booking again for December 2022. Be sure to check out the Christmas markets too they are lovely! Thanks again hotel Juliana you made a special time of our lives that bit more perfect.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Not a 5 stars!
text:
Location is convenient, but… furniture with an kitsch style, a mix and match of wood, design, furs, velvets, fake fireplace… and dark lights: too much!
Rooms are well-equipped but incredibly dark and the choice of furnishings doesn't help: I've bumped into the ton-sur-ton bedside bench with the floor and bed runner (yes, they use the runner!) several times. 
It lacks a mirror and decent center light to properly illuminate rooms. 
In the bathroom, the amenities are not up to 5 stars!
And not up to 5 stars the bar service as well as the breakfast ones.
At the bar, as an aperitif, I asked for a Pastis / Ricard (on the list) and the waitress didn't know what it is (in Paris!), while the barman served it in a whiskey glass.
At 10 in the evening, I asked something to eat and they said no: just a toast.
But the maximum was during breakfast: there were no lactose-free and gluten-free products. I just had a coffee. Is it a 5 stars? I don’t think so.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Juliana Hotel Paris
text:
We stayed in this hotel for 5 nights in mid-November 2021. The hotel is located in a quiet residential area but walking distance to almost all the sights and many restaurants. We have nothing but praises for the front desk and breakfast staff.  They are very professional,  friendly, and extra helpful, going above and beyond to make sure we had a memorable stay in Paris.
Thank you to Rui, Terri, Karl, and most especially to Taner who patiently pointed out and marked in the map all the places we needed to see Paris in such a  short period of time. We truly had a wonderful time! Merci beaucoup!    

The NY/NJ, USA group (Adele & Napoleon, Marilyn, and Lucille)

title: Great venue - average staff - could be brilliant with a few tweaks
text:
So this is a really hard one, the building is gorgeous, the location is amazing and within a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel tour and all of the brilliant things to see in Paris.

It was good if not great value for money and the room was lovely and bed so comfy.

Now the downside. The customer service, it was ok, but not 5 star, long wait on check in,  never anyone on the bar, no one took the time to tell us about any of the spa facilities etc (we found these on our own but not till the last night). It just seemed like we were a hindrance or that we weren’t high roller enough, you only got spoken to if you were carrying Louis Vuitton bags! it’s a real shame as it was our wedding anniversary and we chose the venue as it had such good reviews.

What a fabulous convenient  location, very helpful staff to provide recommendations and make reservations, and an amazing roof-top deck to enjoy the lights of the Eiffel Tower just a few blocks away.   Thank you to all who make Hotel Juliana a wonderful part of Paris!

title: Great hotel
text: We had a very pleasant stay . The staff was very friendly . Our rooms were modern, clean and quiet . Breakfast was fresh with very pleasant service . Hotel is located in a great location . I would def stay there again without any hesitation.

It's also very close to the River Seine and all the boat companies that take you down the river.  Highly recommend for families.

text: I love the atmosphere of this hotel. It’s very modern and clean. Their gym and sauna is nice. The day we arrived on feb. 12. A gentleman that morning was very helpful. Speak really good English and he made us feel very comfortable and easy vacation. He went out of his ways to help us booked activities. I think his name is Oliver. He’s a very light skin brunette hair guy. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: BEST SERVICE AND QUALITY

The breakfast was amazing! The thing I liked the most, is that it had nothing of the old hotels tired and money saving look/ attitude

text: Wonderful hotel in the 7th.  Close to everything.  From the moment we arrived, entire staff could not have been more friendly, inviting and helpful. Great recommendations for restaurants, local area bakeries and shops, and general places to go - whether as tourists or otherwise.

title: Trip to Paris
text: We stayed at Hotel Juliana and met with the most amazing staff. We were having a not so great time in Paris before we arrived with the “demonstration “ in the streets and were not happy we made the trip but after meeting Terry at the front desk we had an amazing experience. He was very polite and went out of his way to make sure we were accommodated and happy! I would absolutely refer this place to anyone because of him! He made our trip great!!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great little hotel
text: Great location, helpful, positive staff.  Small but well designed.  Juliana Suite was ideal for 3 adults, 1 child.  Breakfast was good with a very friendly, welcoming team. Would recommend for a short stay in Paris

title: Just OK, Proverbial “Get What You Pay For”
text:
Booked a last minute trip to Europe including 3 nights in Paris. As such, room inventory was low and prices were high. Noticed the Juliana on Expedia and the attractive rates and decided to give them a try. 

Reading the TA reviews, two points I felt were worthy discussing before providing my review:

Seems to be confusion on the 5 star rating leading to misalignment on hotel expectations. France uses a standardized hotel rating system based upon factors such as: room size, valet parking, lobby staffing, etc. The Juliana is indeed and bills itself as a 5 Star property. However compared to properties in the States, more like an average 3-4 star hotel. 

Reading my title, when seeing a “5 star” hotel in Paris for deep discounts compared to competition, please be cognizant. This is not the Ritz nor other luxury properties (see my glowing Hotel Nolinski review). 

The Juliana is an adequate option for those seeking central/serviceable lodging and not a destination nor experience.

My other point is Hotel Management’s thorough and often aggressive defense to TA comments and reviews. As such felt need to provide an honest and balanced review for the community and the hotel. TA users should have the ability to educate travelers without fear of a nasty rebuke.

Pros
Location - Juliana is centrally located a block from the Seine on a quiet, residential street. No more than a 1.5 mile walk to most of the major attractions. Saw a review stating the area is dangerous, this is 100% false. 

Quiet/Solitude - Hotel is exceptionally quiet with minimal noise or interactions with the staff and other guests. Combined with the fantastic blackout curtains felt it was a nice break from the city chaos.

Room - For Paris, the room and bathroom were large, clean and were serviceable for the short stay.  Bed was comfortable and relaxing.

Cons 
Early Checkin - This seems to be a sore spot for many reviewers. Coming from States, early checkin is highly coveted. From my direct experience and others, seems this request is often not available. 

Not sure if this is because of policy or practicality. The lobby was literally strewn with weary travelers waiting to check in. Might be opportunity to offer this as a paid service, would have gladly paid $50 - $100 extra fee to access room earlier.

Overall Service - Apart from initial check in, who was very helpful, overall was unimpressed with the level of staff interactions and attentiveness. Example, was hard pressed to get a drink at bar and check out process was tortuous. 

Perhaps most represenative, there was literally dog waste in front of hotel for 2 straight days (refer to image). Take pride in your property, this is the first impression with travelers.

Common Areas - the Juliana is a small hotel and as such is lacking some full service amenities like a restaurant or a lively lobby atmosphere. 

The Minor Details - For most part, hotels are nearly the same and it is the little details that make a hotel stand apart. The Juliana is lacking in this category. For example, we had washcloths only on 1 day, the toiletries were hapharzardly replaced, there was not water to buy, nor was my partners birthday acknowledged (when I specifically emailed). Although these are minor, they add up.

Overall, Juliana is OK for short trip with minimal time intended in hotel would not stay again would up the budget and stay at a more luxurious property.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great hotel
text:
The hotel was fantastic, great location and the staff were superb, especially one gentleman called Terry (I assume he must be the manager) who was just fantastic with his service and help.

We will definitely be staying here again.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: WORST HOTEL I HAVE EVER BEEN TO! NEEDS KNOCKING DOWN TO 2*
text:
First of all we arrived to only be greeted by someone who didn’t seem to have much clue about the check in process. This was done on a laptop that looks like a personal laptop not something you would accept in a “5* hotel”. We then got taken to our room carrying our own luggage. The room was so small you can barely walk round the bed. Numerous things broken in the room - shower, sink, USB ports. The tv constantly turned on through the night waking us up several times to which I had to unplug it! Condensation and mould on the windows and windowsill - worse in the bedroom than the bathroom. 

We visited for NYE 2019/2020. We missed the display for New Year’s Eve as we requested a iron and an ironing board to be delivered to our room which I had to ring up for on a second occasion to then it got delivered - minus the ironing board. The street that the hotel is situated on is so rough! The houses are boarded up. There is gangs of men at the end of the street with balaclava‘s on. This hotel is not 5*. I am a very frequent traveller and this is not a 5* experience. Nothing was 5* about this hotel. Needs some serious maintenance and the staff need to get rid of their rude/arrogant mannerism with guests. We paid nearly £400 for the room for 1 night. If I compare this to any other city hotel I have been to it’s the most expensive I have chosen and the worst! I am currently in process trying to get a full refund!!! 

DO NOT GO!!!!!! 
I have been Paris before and this is not a typical Paris experience.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Hotel Juliana
text: Hotel Juliana is very central, within walking distance to major Paris attractions. It boasts comfortable rooms, small but adequate gym, and first rate service. Highly recommended for those wanting a calm but central location.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great location and staff
text:
My family and I stayed here for about a week. It’s a really good location and just a short walk away from the on and off bus we took. It’s on a semi quiet street. The lobby was decorated beautifully at Christmas time and the staff downstairs was very friendly and helpful. The hotel was clean and always smelled really good when we would walk in from outside. Easy to get uber, although we did notice they cancelled more often than expected (not sure if this was due to the strike) but we managed. The hotel had free breakfast downstairs with a pretty good variety. It was mostly the same everyday, however they would cook fresh eggs upon request. Again, the staff was very nice in the breakfast area as well. 

The only thing I didn’t like about the room and why I knocked off a star was because it was SO dark! As a woman who applies makeup it was kinda difficult to do so. Even looking for clothes in my suitcase became difficult at times. I would drag one of the standing lamps over so I could see. But overall a good experience and I would recommend especially since it’s such a good location and easy walking distance to almost everything.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful boutique hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
Wonderful quiet hotel on a
 residential street very close the Eiffel tower and within walking distance to much more.  Great staff who provided assistance whenever needed.  Would stay there again if I get back to Paris!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great location! Wow!
text:
The staff was kind and courteous. When we got there they offered us a map of the city and sat down with us to point out special locations like the Christmas market where we could get hot wine. They weren't able to get us into a room early but they took our bags and allowed us to see the city until a room was ready for us! They were always so eager to help and eventually set us up with a driver who was just as kind and courteous.
We stayed on the second floor and were so thankful for the elevator. The Junior Suite was spacious and beautiful with a comfortable bed. Housekeeping kept the room clean and never disturbed us. The bathroom was stunning and we loved having both a shower and a very deep large bathtub. Having fast WiFi was good at the end of the day so that we could share all of our photos.
The breakfast buffet was SO delicious with so much food to chose from. The staff in the kitchen was attentive and served the best coffee. The dining room was large and clean. We looked forward to heading down every morning - though we did have breakfast brought to the room just once. It was as fresh and as delicious as expected!
I really can't say enough good about the beautiful hotel and its genuine staff. We had the time of our lives and would definitely encourage others to book a room here. It's so close to everything that you might ever want to experience.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Juliana for our anniversary trip. Hotel was well situated near many things but on quiet street. It was lovely and beautiful and artsy and sophisticated at the same time. Bed was sooooo comfortable and room was immaculate. Everything we were looking for in a 5 star hotel. Concierge was super helpful and arranged dinner for us every night in restaurants that did not disappoint. In room breakfast was Devine. The bathroom was luxurious and spacious. We just loved every minute in this hotel and would stay here again. Don’t miss this jewel of a hotel.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Wow!
text: Tucked away but at the same time in the heart of Paris. Ideal for Seine cruises and Tour Eiffel.  Attentive staff, spotless room. Well worth a trip up to the rooftop on the 7th floor for a photo shoot with such a beautiful backdrop!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Very nice hotel with a great location
text: A very nice modern boutique hotel.  We had a deluxe room that was very spacious.  The hotel staff were really helpful and the location, train and metro are all nearby. Breakfast was very nicely layed out with lot of option
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Small but very hight standard hotel
text: We stayed one night in this resort. Amazing service,this Hotel is modern, new condition and perfect details in rooms archiecture. Location is in a very quiet place. This hotel is small but definitely facing with the big one's in terms of standards.  This place is must be for families and couples
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Nice and very well attended hotel in a quiet and central area
text:
The hotel is very nice and well appointed. The  staff very helpful and polite.
The area, in the left bank of the river, quiet and elegant, has a lot of wonderful shops and restaurants.
Our room was fantastic with all the commodities.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Fantastic location, Great staff and terrific rooms
text: You couldn't ask for a better location. On a quiet side street, only a block from the Seine and only a few blocks to the Eiffel Tower. Service was efficient and very friendly and helpful. The room was a good size and with good ammenities. There are lots of places to find something to eat nearby and the Montparnasse train station is walking distance. They do have a small outside terrace with a view of the tower, but it is so close that you only need to step out of the hotel to see it. There is a fairly popular bar in the lobby. I highly recommend this hotel without hesitation.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Beautiful hotel!  Great service!
text: We ended up having a canceled flight and flew in to Paris for the night so that we could catch a flight the following morning stayed at this hotel just at the spur of the moment great service friendly staff Terry is the bomb he made us feel so welcome we couldn’t of asked for better service. He took the time to get to know us as we got to know him.  All the amenities you could ask for and more for a hotel that you can go up on the rooftop and see the Eiffel Tower.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Sisters’ Trip
text:
My sister and I stayed at Hotel Juliana during the last week of October. We found the boutique hotel to be very charming and full of interesting art and decor. Everyone we encountered was pleasant and seemed to go out of their way to strike up a conversation with us or offer recommendations for things we should do. 

The location is ideal- set on a quite street, but extremely near to most of the major tourist sights as well as local shops and restaurants. We used Hotel Juliana as our jumping off point every morning, after enjoying the delicious breakfast, and as a nice place to return to, and grab a drink at the bar, at night. 

Our room was very clean upon check-in and the king bed was heavenly after a long day of walking in the city of lights. 

I would absolutely recommend this hotel for its location, ambiance, and especially service. I hope to return to Hotel Juliana again during my future visits to Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Mr. Hijji
text: Elegant, quiet, clean with friendly staff. Very nice location, near to all attraction, however with no direct view. The price is a bit on the high side. But overall is a very nice place to stay.  Recommend
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Weekend to visit Paris
text:
Good:localization of hotel; room and space; check-in and check-out.
Bad: service for clean the Room and breakfast.The team forgot to clean our room and repouse shampoo and shower gel.
Because of the service we can not consider this a 5 stars hotel.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Nice Hotel
text: This was a good hotel in a good location, staff were friendly and the breakfast was nice too. Small points but important, check in took too long nd the mini bar was not full. Generally a good hotel but maybe a bit expensive for what you got.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Lovely stay
text:
We stayed for two nights last week.
Very central location with a walk from all major attractions.
The check in was a little harder than it has to be with the hotel using laptops although very friendly and welcoming with a free glass of champagne.
Small lifts take you up to your room. Our room was 604 which was very small and compact.
Lovely comfy bed and nice bathroom
Really comfortable stay and would recommend!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Nice hotel
text:
We ordered familyroom, it was a little small, but OK. It was two rooms with connecting doors. At check-in they where more eager about talking in the telephone than serving us. He answered and made 6 telephone calls while we where waiting to be checked in. Very rude, and not proper for a five star hotel.
The luggage was sent to the room, but it took forever to arrive. We sat on the room five minutes waiting for the luggage, it would have been easier to bring it ourselves.
We had ordered one doublebed and two single beds. At arrival we had two double beds. They had to split one bed.
Check-in was bad service, waiting and not what we expected.
The rooms where good quality. Bed was great. The bathroom was spacious with large shower. One room had large bathtub. The toillet was placed so close to the wall it was not possible to sit normal on it. This was on both bathrooms. Even the kids complained about the toilets.
The rooms where clean. It had all the normal perks you expect from a five star hotel.
Breakfast was on the lower floor, or you could order to the room. We went downstairs to eat. Breakfast was good quality and a fair amount of food to choose from. Both hot and cold food was available. It was OK.
The hotel has a terrasse on the roof. OK view, and you can see the upper half of the Eiffeltower. No lights there when dark though.
The hotel is placed close to the Eiffeltower and Invalides. Quiet area. Close to train, bus and metro. Very good location, especially for families and people that require a safe and quit environment.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great hotel, service & location
text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hotel Juliana.

The location is great, close to the Eiffel Tower and in a quiet and safe neighbourhood, with good cafes, restaurants, bars and shops nearby. 

Our hotel room was clean, with an incredibly comfortable bed and pillows - it was like sleeping in a cloud.

We enjoyed the breakfast buffet included with our booking. The service personnel were lovely, they even prepared tuna bruschetta for me, because I said I loved fish! I regret not getting the gentleman’s name. 

The concierge was also fantastic, assisting with arranging our transfers, tickets for the Moulin Rouge (with fab seats).

I can’t recommend this hotel enough. We would definitely stay here again.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: What a gem in the middle of Paris!
text: Near the Eiffel Tower and many busy little restaurants and cafes. Although it’s super close to all those attractions , its street is super quiet and the hotel just wonderful. Great bed, huge bathroom and perfect breakfast. Great baguette, croissants, fresh juice, jams, delicious coffee. Very nice polite staff.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Luxury boutique hotel in Paris
text: I have stayed at the Juliana several times and believe it to be one of the finest hotels in Paris. I especially enjoy their personal service. The hotel itself is first rate and it is located on a quiet street near the Eiffel Tower and Pont de L’Alma.  I look forward to my next visit.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Paris trip 2019
text: Superb location and very helpful staff.  Could not have asked for a better experience!  We particularly enjoyed the comfortable suite and complimentary breakfast.  The roof deck was a nice surprise -- the weather wasn't really ideal for fully utilizing it -- but I'd happily spend more time on it on my next visit!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Last stop Paris
text:
After a month away we spent t our last 4 days in Paris at this beautiful hotel 
From the staff to the location everything was on point 
Walking distance to pretty much everything if you like to walk around & explore 
Bed was comfortable, room was lovely & clean & we had free bottles of water daily 
The only thing was our room didn’t have a shower as such it had a hand held shower rose in a bath - easy to make do with but a little awkward when it’s not what your used to 
Would highly recommend staying here
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Good service Good people Good hotel
text: Very nice hotel. Very helpful staff. They made my stay pleasant. Especially the Concierge Rui. They make an effort to make your Paris visit easier and enjoyable. That's a big deal for me. Thank you very much.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Six ladies in Paris
text: Excellent location. Close to transportation and shopping. Very comfortable beds and quiet neighborhood. The staff was very helpful in making arrangements for our group and attentive to all our needs. The breakfast was top notch and a good value.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Fantastic hotel with helpful staff
text: Our room here was absolutely gorgeous (and massive).  The staff was extremely helpful and helped in booking restaurants as well as tours and anything else you needed.  The location is a short walk to the Eiffel Tower amongst other sites and is close to public transportation as well.  Perfect place to stay when visiting Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Hotel Juliana Paris
text:
Our stay at Hotel Juliana was exquisite!  The decor is beautiful and our room was very comfortable and spacious for Paris. 
The location was perfect. We easily walked to key sites,  restaurants and markets. 
Thank you to Terry for outstanding service and great conversations!
We will definitely stay here on our next trip to Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Lovely hotel, friendly and helpful staff, great location - highly recommend!
text: My husband and I spent 8 nights here and highly recommend it.  The staff was friendly and helpful, the rooms luxurious, and the location perfect - close to the Seine, Eiffel Tower and all the restaurants on Rue St. Dominique.  I would especially like to mention the deputy manager Mohamed Bendari who was always eager to help, pleasant to talk to, and full of great information.  If I have one criticism, it is the check in process.  We notified the hotel weeks in advance that we would arrive very early in the morning.  We arrived at the hotel before 10 a.m. and were told our room was not ready.  So we left our luggage and went walking. Around 1 p.m. exhausted, we decided to just camp out in the lobby until the room was ready.  I heard another couple, quite rudely I think, badger the front desk manager for their room to be ready or to be compensated in some way.  Interestingly enough, they got their room before we did.  Rudeness wins over politeness,  I guess.  Our room was finally ready at 2:45, 15 minutes before normal check in.  I understand we couldn't expect an earlier check in, but it could have been handled better.  An offer to call us as soon as it was ready?  An offer for a glass of wine while we waited?  Or a restaurant suggestion?  Something?   Sorry - have probably gone on about this too long.  All in all, we will definitely return to this hotel for our next time in Paris.  And I do recommend it - just don't expect to get into your room earlier than 3.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: A Paris
text:
We had a lovely stay at the hotel Juliana. Rooms were nice, beds were comfy and washrooms were spacious and well appointed. Checkin staff and reception desk were helpful and pleasant. 

If I had one criticism it is use of the roof top patio.  On our last night is Paris, we chose to indulge in the traditional baguette, cheeses, deli meats and wine (of course) that we had picked up in our daily travels. Roof top was staffed, but never once offered to get us some much needed cutlery, napkins or plates. I would have thought that such a hotel would try to be more accommodating and “try” to please their guests at a nightly rate of $500-700 cdn per night.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Not a 5 star hotel - dusappointed
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights for my husband’s conference. I chose it because of the good reviews and the location. But I was sorely disappointed.
To be fair there was a lot going for this hotel. The location is perfect being right next to the Seine and many public transport options. The staff is polite and warm. They upgraded us to a junior suite on arrival which was a nice gesture. The bathroom is one of the most sumptuous I have encountered.
However there are lots of annoying cliches that should not happen in a 5 star hotel. The suite turned out to have the sitting room bit outside your room and you share it with another room. The first I have come across so we didn’t used it. The aircon was pathetic and just about ok even when u turned it right down. We were lucky that the nights were cool. We were repeatedly locked out of our room as the card mysteriously stopped working overnight. As we were on the sixth floor, my husband got very crossed with them the third time it happened. No one answered the housekeeping phone so why have it on the dial? There should be BBC world news on the TV but there wasn’t. In the blurb they said they accept Union pay card except they don’t. We left 15 minutes to check out and there was a queue at the desk with only one person checking guests out. The result was that we had to queue barge in front of another couple because our transfer arrived which was embarrassing. The process at this place just doesn’t work like a 5 star should.
And lastly at over 400 euros a night they really should give you breakfast rather than charging guests 29 euro a head! 
As they say in school reports: really should do better! Can not recommend at this price.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Fantastic hotel, few things missing
text:
The hotel itself in terms of the rooms, location and absolutely fantastic breakfast gets 5/5 stars.
We stayed in the Juliana suite for a family of 4 and it was very nice. Perfect for our needs, And as mentioned so close to Eiffel tower and heaps of cafes, even Concorde and the louvre are not far to walk too. The staff are all friendly and try to help. The breakfast was the biggest highlight! So many yummy things to eat, especially the little quiches, cakes, croissants and fresh juices.
However a couple of things really let the experience down. Firstly I arranged a hotel transfer to find no one waiting, I had to call the hotel and got an excuse about my reply was 5am in the morning and it was missed. It seems missed messages are the theme though as there is a hotel app which I downloaded and tried to ask questions but was ignored. I received auto messages asking about my experience and I asked further questions that went ignored. The website states petit prince bathrooms sets for kids that were not in the room and had to be asked for. The website also states an evening room service but we were told room service is only for breakfast now. The hotel is listed as a member of World hotels and I have a frequent flyer card with a member airline that is part of this but no one knew anything about it. I needed a bottle opener to open beer we brought in local supermarket but was told someone had taken their only bottle opener and was given a broken plastic one. We went and bought our own one then next day in the end but as a 5 star hotel I would have expected something better here. 

I would stay here again for sure but hope the overall service level is improved.

Thank you
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: An exceptional boutique 5-star hotel
text: Based only on reviews we selected the Hotel Juliana for our 1-week visit to Paris.  Not only are the facilities terrific, but every member of the staff was really great.  We strongly recommend this hotel
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great 5 star stay and service
text: We are a family of four stayed in this hotel.  They gave us 2 rooms for the four of us which was quite comfortable.  Everything from the decor to the breakfast was superb!  If I get a chance to go to Paris again, I would definitely stay at Hotel Juliana!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Daughters 16th birthday visit
text:
We have just spent three wonderful days at this hotel. We organised our own airport transfer with prestige transfers and arrived at the hotel. A member of staff swiftly arrived down the stairs to assist us with baggage. A great start. A polite member of staff checked us in at around 11.30 and we were told our room would be available at 3pm. We left our bags and went to explore Paris. We returned to the hotel at 3 where our luggage had already been taken to the room on the third floor. Same staff member escorted us to the room and it was WOW. We booked a family room which was essentially two rooms adjoining, one with a super king bed and the other with twin beds together for our son and daughter. Both had toiletries, slippers and bathrobes and a bathroom each which was important for us - it was really beautiful and had a view to the front of the hotel. Location is perfect to everything we wished to visit and we walked everywhere. Eiffel Tower approx a seven minute walk and we took some gorgeous photos that first day we explored - see photos. A very quick walk to the Seine allows easy access to most sights if you preferred to use the batobus. Breakfast in the room in lower ground was plentiful and a great start to the day. If there is anything that could have been better it was simply an iron in the room as it’s the first four or five star hotel which didn’t have one. I called to housekeeping and one was brought to me immediately so this was fine . 
Thank you for having us ! Cannot what to return - I highly recommend this hotel
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Birthday weekend
text:
1:Love the hotel
The Decor international vintage modern Ethnic 🌹
The Room & Bathroom Fabulous stylish. comfort
2:staff very helpful and Cool
 all the staff are by bilingual 
IE:location for Restaurants shops 
We didn’t get a chance to use the Sauna & steam , but next time we will. 
3: location for birthday celebration spot on💥💥👍🏼
We will visit again
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: This hotel and staff is great. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone.They went Well beyond there duties to make
text: This hotel and staff is great. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone.They went Well beyond there duties to make sure my Family and I were treated with 5 Diamond experience. We're grateful and Thankful. I wished this kind of service were offer in the USA. Thanks ya'll for everything.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great location, friendly staff
text: Great location staff and was excellent!  We had everything we needed for our stay.  We could walk to many of the places we wanted to visit and we took the river boat to the others.  We would stay here again and recommend it to others looking for a wonderful hotel in Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Thank you Hotel Juliana Staff
text:
This is a small boutique 5* establishment, so the infrastructure isn’t quite up to that of a larger hotel. The lifts take a bit of figuring because you have to swap about a bit. The lift to the restaurant below street level is a different one to the one to the rooms. On the subject of (buffet) breakfast, there are only a ten tables serviced by one waitress serving tea or coffee, and a waiter who will go and get you eggs from the kitchen if you ask him to. The coffee or tea may or may not arrive - it depends upon whether the waitress remembers or not. Likewise, order your eggs 20 minutes before you go to the buffet if you want to eat it at the same time. I might be being a bit unfair because the food was excellent, it’s just that I prefer dynamic rather than lethargic staff when on the go. Rooms were great, showers and bath first class (except our loo roll holder had been fixed upside down so paper kept sliding off and unravelling on the bathroom floor). Didn’t like the pillows, huge hard things meaning your head was 90 degrees to the rest of you. I threw mine off in favour of a rolled up towel. 
Enough moaning. The Reception staff and management were brilliant. We had our wallets and passports stolen in an organised bag-snatch. The hotel team helped us enormously and apologised profusely about the crime levels in Paris which are currently orbital. Apparently this is due to organised East European gangs and they are at a loss for a solution. 
Would we go back despite eggs and pillows? Absolutely, but the issue is not the hotel, it is Paris. Through no fault of their own, they are located in a city under attack in more ways than one. Forget visiting the Eiffel Tower for instance, they have built a 4metre razor topped glass screen around the whole structure. 
So if you are determined to go to Paris, stay in the Juliana, they will help you when it goes wrong.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Wonderful hotel with character and location
text:
My family of four recently spent a weekend in Paris and we stayed at the Juliana Hotel in a family room booking (two adjoining superior rooms). The hotel has a contemporary feel and, unlike older European hotels, the rooms are relatively large with large bathrooms with large showers. The staff was very helpful and made us feel at home. The concierge was excellent and had great recommendations for activities, and he made us a dinner reservation on short notice at a wonderful cafe/restaurant (Le Petit Cler) nearby. The sink and faucet in the bathroom are a bit odd, which other reviewers have noted as well. But if you are aware of it, you will know to slowly turn on the water to avoid it splashing on you. 

The location is perfect: within walking distance to central Paris but away from the touristy crowded locations. The rooftop lounge area is fantastic as well. I would definitely stay at the Juliana again on a return visit to Paris.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Luxurious and comfortable; Front desk happy to help and direct
text: We loved our stay at Hotel Juliana. The front desk gave me metro directions, called taxis, made restaurant reservations, hand-delivered our laundry, and otherwise was available at all times to help. Breakfast was delicious and had good variety, and this is the best bed and bedding I've had the pleasure of sleeping on. 10-minute walk from the metro, and about 8 minutes to a Velib bike-share station where you can get on and ride to most major Paris attractions, such as Louvre, Musee D'Orsay, Ile de la Cite, etc. I highly recommend this property. Oh, and they have the best air conditioning in Paris!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Great boutique hotel located in a great neighborhood of Paris
text:
My wife and I have stayed here 3 times over the past 3 years because we love the location in the 7th arrondissement.  But location is not everything, sure it is awesome to us, but we so much love the experience that we have had every time at this great boutique hotel, from the decorations and the cleanliness of the rooms to the friendly staff that we have met over the years that always make you feel welcomed.  When we have any questions about where to eat or where to visit we have had some great recommendations and Taner and Terry were always so helpful.
Our most recent visit did not disappoint...it was a quick trip with a late check-in and the same consistent amenities and friendly staff there, willing to help as always!  We usually go out for breakfast so we don't do breakfast but we walked through for coffee and it looked very good. On our final evening, we had an early dinner and came back for a glass of wine to sit on the rooftop and look out with a view of the Eifel Tower and reminisce about our stay.  With an early departure, Terry was so helpful with not only the wine (and such friendly conversation) and with getting us a Taxi and check out the next morning making it so easy and efficient.  We always tell our friends back home that if they get to Paris, we have a great place where they should stay!
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Quiet, Nice, Great Location, Great Staff
text:
Very nice boutique hotel located close to the Eiffel Tower, shopping, water, restaurants, etc.

Staff was very accommodating and nice. Helped us with booking restaurants and anything else we needed.

Boutique hotel is very quiet despite being centrally located.

Rooms were very clear, fresh, and felt new.
name: Juliana Hotel Paris

title: Customer care needs a little work.
text:
Arrived in Paris at around 6 AM on Thursday, and got to the hotel at about 8 AM.
Understandably we were told that check in is at 3 PM, and the very nice gentleman helped to sort everything out, from paying the deposit to scanning our passports, and taking in our luggage while we stroll around until our room becomes available. When the process had been done we were the first people to arrive at the hotel. 

After a few hours of walking around the area, we got back at the hotel at around 1:30 PM, and we decided just to check if our room was ready, but were told by the lady at the reception to take a seat, and that we would be informed as soon as our room was available. At this given time the gentleman who checked us in was not on site anymore.

During the time we waited at the reception many other visitors came, checked in, and were told to wait as well. As the time went on every single guest was taken to their room, and by 3:30 we were the only customers left in the reception. 

When asked the people at the reception seemed as though they had completely forgotten about us, and we were told that they were looking for a room for us. At some point during this encounter they took us into the elevator to lead us to our room, just to be taken back out by another receptionist, because they wanted to give the room to others who had checked in after us. They were going to redo everything we had done previously in the morning when we got there. 

By the time we got to our room it was well passed 4 PM. Given the fact that we had planned to be in Paris for just a couple of days, we ended up wasting almost a whole day trying to get our room, thanks to the staff's mismanagement, and their lack of professional conduct.

Not only did we get the wrong type of room, as we had asked for two single beds instead of a double, but also the toiletries were incomplete and had thing missing (ie. the Shampoo, Conditioner, etc.). This became apparent when the room service had refreshed with all the missing items the next morning.

To top it all off, the treatment and the behavior of the staff after our multiple complaints, made our experience at this supposedly five star hotel into a horrible memory that we were not planning to invest in while on holiday.

title: A vous Cognacq Jay!
text:
Ended up here because Hotel St Dominique was full and....do not regret it one sec.  Such a nice boutique hotel. Felt like a little place of my own in a very pretty street of Paris. 

Rooms are cosy and well appointed.  Breakfast is plentiful and caters for European and American clients more than the middle eater and Asian from a food selection. 

It is a rather small hotel (at least it feels like it) and it has a special interior decoration with unique items scattered here and there.  The terrace is very nice (but was not really in use when we were here).

Note that there is a gym and a spa (but small as well).  

The place does not do dinner or lunch (except through room service). But you are in the 7th and there are plenty of options available around anyhow.  

Last note:  our Paris’ break was marked with many Parisian style encounters - rude taxis, unhelpful people, and terrible service.  Not here : service is too notch!!!  This was a wonderful break from what remains an otherwise terribly unfriendly (but beautiful) city!

title: Pleasant Weeklong Stay in a Studio in Paris

title: The worst hotel experience I've ever had
text:
The absolute worst hotel experience I've ever had.  I arrived early after a long flight at around 11 am.  Even though I was early, I was told my room would be ready by noon.   It was not, then I was told that technically the reservation starts at 3 pm and to come back then. Returned at 3 pm and the room still isn't clean. I also overheard another man with his family yelling "menteurs!" (Liars) at another receptionist. So right away I'm thinking I'm not alone in having issues.

I wasnt told anything about how the hotel works like getting new towels throwing out trash, etc. Since there was no room service; in the middle of the night I had to go to the receptionist to ask for toilet paper.  

When I get into my room, oh boy...The entire room smells of mold and was absolutely crawling with spiders and insects.  Then there's the bed, it's like sleeping on cement. I woke up in pain almost every morning.  

I go into the coffee/breakfast room one night to grab coffee and there are flies everywhere and I'm told by staff they usually close the room at night and that "it's summer so there's lots of insects that come in". I'm sorry, but not in a properly managed hotel there aren't.

Finally was able to switch hotels to a wonderful boutique hotel near Montmartre that was the same price!

Avoid this place like the plague!

title: Convenient dated serviced apartments with weak air conditioning
text:
Stayed here for a couple consecutive nights on 2 separate pre-paid bookings, booked direct and it was merely a mediocre experience.

Found out the hard way, during the heatwave, that only certain hotels in Paris are air-conditioned, even within a same brand... The best part about the stay was that the property is air conditioned, although somewhat dated and needing some refurbishment...

Check-in was slightly bumpy, initially being offered a room with a broken A/C, before being upgraded to a Deluxe Studio, featuring a balcony, supposedly due to having status with ASR.

The studio itself is dated, and in need of either some deep cleaning and/or remodeling. The first studio had a weak A/C unit and the 2nd studio had a strong A/C. 

Water pressure in the shower was excellent, although the drain was a touch finnicky. Towels were on the thinner side.

The mattress was on the firmer side and provided a great nights rest. My studio ended up with 2 twins (instead of a double or queen), which was fine, which meant more space for my carry on!

The kitchen was extremely dated, although well-equipped, including a dishwasher, hood, crockery, fridge, and microwave. A kitchenette is a phenomenal way to get additional square footage, in an otherwise tight hotel room!

There was a complimentary espresso maker in the lobby along with a laundry room that can be operated by the WeWash app.

Breakfast was available for a fee. There are numerous bakeries and grocery stores within walking distance to get breakfast!

The Metro is also merely a few minutes away by foot!

Hotel's front desk staff was most helpful and pleasant.

The location is  also excellent -  about 15 min  by bus  or Metro on the corner to  Louvre - Notre Dame areas ( or 30-40 min beatiful walk).  10 min walk to Picasso museum.
The area around is residential with lots of stores,  restaurants, cafes and patisseries  that locals use . The hotel is situated on a boulevard, with a playground and park.  I believe they have airport transfer, and  it's 5 metro stops from euro rail.

title: So much more than a hotel room. We were so satisfied with our choice.
text:
Our book club stayed for 5 nights in four rooms. Our rooms at the back all had  balconies, one large enough for all of us to gather for coffee and wine. The rooms were all different but all were comfortable and clean with lots of storage and big bathrooms with storage and shelves. The kitchenettes are well supplied. We shopped at the Casino market just across the Boulevard so we could have breakfast in the mornings. We made a meal one night.
This is a great location near several metro lines. We took RER B and metro to Richard Lenior stop from CDG. Easy and fast.
Coffee machine with many choices always available in the breakfast room.
We never requested our room to be cleaned. We were not messy. It was fine. Trash and recycling room located by elevators. 
The staff at the front desk were very efficient, friendly and helpful. We all felt they went out of their way to make our stay pleasant, including changing some double rooms with one bed to double with twin beds. Be sure to request what you prefer when you book.  
This is not a luxury hotel. It is basic but with great extras for a longer stay. 
Bastille Marais is a great location for walking and taking metro or bus. 
I recommend Citadines when you are staying for more than one night. They provide so much more than a room.

title: Huge room, good location, poor service (plus, BEWARE! clearing fees not included in the price)
text: The hotel is located in a quiet neighborhood conveniently located close to Bastille. On the positive side, the room that we got (the standard one) was huge for the Paris standards. We had a small dining table, and a full-equipped kitchenette. This is very convenient, if you plan to stay several nights but do not want to dine out every day. The cons are the following ones. First, our room was old (particularly, the bathroom). On top of that, they do not clean it during your stay, unless you pay 17 euros extra per day. This is not good. We also found the service to be inefficient. We ordered new towels (yes, you need to call the reception to get new towels!), and a couple of times they forgot to bring them to us. Also, the day we arrived the room was not ready and, therefore, left our luggage in the hotel. The person in the front desk provided us with tags to identify our luggage and show us the way to the luggage room. That person ordered us to write down our name on the tags (three of them), cut them, and to put our luggage in the luggage room: first time I do this in my life, with absolutely ZERO help from the person in the front desk (which, by the way, seemed to have nothing else to do, as there were no other customers there). These small details make me doubt whether I will consider this hotel again in future trips to Paris.

title: Perfect for a short city break
text:
Chose the Citadines as we wanted to have some kitchen facilities during our stay. Decided on this one as it is a little cheaper than some of the others around the city and the location is great for getting about. 

Booked directly on the Citadines website as it was cheaper than going through Booking.com, Trivago etc.

We had a Studio Deluxe room which had twin beds, a kitchenette (including kettle, toaster, fridge, induction hob and dishwasher) and a large balcony.  The room was comfortable and well-maintained. The only fault was the air-con which didn’t seem to be working, meaning the room was warm during the heat wave.

The location is great, in between 2 metro stops and within 5 minutes of 2 supermarkets. We mainly used the Casino supermarket which opens at 8.30 and has fresh bread, croissants etc. 

Staff are friendly and helpful. 

We’d definitely stay here again.

title: Very Convenient
text:
A good apartment hotel near Bastille. Two metro stations nearby make access into the city and other areas easy. The hotel itself is made up of self catering units. The room had a two burner stovetop, microwave, dishwasher and fridge. Very clean. Plenty of cooking utensils and cutlery, but don’t expect even a teabag. You must provide everything. But a good supermarket is about a 4 minute walk. 
Downside - rock hard beds and a lot of noise if you get a street view. Ask for “garden view” if noise bothers you, and the laundry token is five euros for just a small wash, no dry.

title: Highly recommended - Happy with Location, Service and Room
text:
The hotel is between the metro stations Richard Lenoir and Bréguet Sabin (the latter is closer to the hotel), connecting directly to the Gare de l’Est and Gare de Lyon. And you are in the heart of Marais within a five minutes’ walk.  
Boulvard Richard Lenoir is quiet, but if you want to be sure to have a quiet night, ask for a room facing the rear. The bed was comfortable, though the matrass was too hard for me.
The kitchen equipment is OK, though I missed a dishrag and an oven (to be fair, there was a microwave). The crockery is limited, but for a quick meal, there is everything you need. 
The bathroom has a decent size (for Paris ;-) and was clean, there just a few stains in and around the bathtub.

title: Comme Ci Comme Ca
text:
This hotel was a recommendation from a co-worker, who happened to be visiting Paris at the same time (and also booked a stay here).  I had several questions before arriving (eg. laundry, luggage storage) and was able to get those answered via email prior to our stay.  The communications were great and at arrival, the front desk was genuine and friendly.  The rooms were not ready so we left the luggage in storage and returned around 3pm.  The check-in process was painful and such a long wait - we were required to sign forms for the police department and I felt it could have gone much smoother with passport in hand.  

The room was clean and spacious. There is no daily room service, but we were able to request a fresh set of towels or cleaning if need.  We purchased some sanitized wipes for the bathrooms, but clearly needed new bath linens and more bath tissue after 3 days, which were provided.  After room service, my cousin noticed her money was missing.  It was reported to the front desk, but nothing came of it.  There are safes in the hotel, but she didn't think anyone would go sorting through her bags and fish out 8 euro of coins and paper.

It was difficult to figure out how to unfold the sofa-bed on the first night, it would have been nice to have some instruction.  Overall, the beds were comfortable, the evenings were quiet, and we got a good night's rest.  The metro was less than a 2 minute walk away, and a variety of restaurants were about a 10 minute walk.  The location was good but there are better locations (provided you don't mind paying more).

title: Safe, convenient, and family friendly!
text:
Love this apartment hotel! It is in a pretty safe neighborhood. About 5 min walk to the nearby metro, which takes us to all the touristy spots. It’s usually 15-25 mins to get to the key places to see in Paris. We stayed on the 7th floor, 2 twin beds, one full size pull out sofas for a family of 3 adults with plenty of space. Outside the window I can see Notre-Dame, Eiffel Tower, and Sacre Coeur. All are walkable but not recommended in the winter,  just take the metro lol. 

On Thursday and Sundays, the Bastille Market is right outside the hotel for delicious food to bring back and cook in the kitchenette. There’s are also a couple super makers super close, and a bakery we really like. 

If you walk down the street to the Bastille station, it’s a bunch busier street with lots of stores for food, restaurants, and shopping. 

Every night when we get back from touring Paris, we get a free cup of coffee/ hot chocolate / hot milk from the lobby before going back to our room. 

Another perk is there is a laundry area on the first floor, $9 Euro to wash and dry (detergent is included) and we brought our own bead fabric softener and dryer sheets though. 

Word of advice, booking through the hotels official site seems to be the most expensive option, I think I overpaid by at least $70 euros a night. I’m glad I did get this room, next time I might need to try booking though other sites.

title: A very good stay and worth a return
text:
There are many things to recommend about this hotel. It is easy to get to via train and subway from CDG (one transfer at Gare Du Nord to Richard Lenoir). Secure access to the building, in room safe, well stocked kitchen with a cook top and microwave. I would highly recommend taking advantage of your kitchen and the Sunday market outside the hotel to live like a Parisian and make dinner from some of the wonderful produce and seafood available. If you like oysters pack your oyster knife. Many non-touristy local restaurants nearby as well. 
  We arrived in the morning after a trans-Atlantic flight. Our double bed room was not available - fair enough we were well before check in. But we were told if we would take two twins we could check in or pay for an upgrade. We declined and checked our bags. When we returned 15 minutes before check in we were told the same thing - no double rooms available but we could have a twin or upgrade for an additional 50 per night. We declined again and said we would wait in the lobby until our room was ready and guess what it suddenly was ready. Something to watch for when checking in. There is no need to book the hotel breakfast was there are two grocery stores nearby to pick up breakfast foods.

Even though it was November our room was incredibly hot and was uncomfortable without a window open. Not the most environmentally friendly situation.

title: Good option for longer stay
text:
We stayed here for 18 nights and found the 1-bedroom apartment comfortable and quiet. At first I was skeptical because the hotel is on a busy street and the lobby is fairly plain. Recommend this hotel for those staying longer.

title: Family of 4 Vacation 10 nights.
text:
We stayed at the Citadines Bastille Marais Paris for 10 nights in July 2018 for a family vacation. Two adults and two children ages 12 and 14. I would recommend it to families. It it not luxurious by any means and it is limited in its amenities, but it worked for us and the front desk staff were helpful and friendly. 

We had a one bedroom on the 3rd floor. The room was comfortable, albeit modest. The pull out couch was actually two separate twin mattresses which was perfect for our family. The beds and pillows comfortable. The kitchen area as well stocked with the appropriate cooking utensils and appliances including a mini dishwasher.  The room was clean and the Air Conditioning worked well for us! We were there in a middle of a blistering hot heat wave. Other reviewers said they couldn't control their AC but we could and it stayed cool. Our room was welcome cool relief at the end of a long hot day of sight seeing. We looked at Airbnb before booking here and most apartments did not have AC unless you wanted to pay considerably more. In our opinion, this hotel was a good value for that reason. And it was large enough for our family of 4 to be in one room. 

There is a supermarket directly across the street and a couple of convenience stores close by. Many many restaurants within close walking distance, and considerably less expensive in this neighborhood than the heart of the tourist areas. The Metro station is across the street and the main line #1 at Bastille is about a 10 minute walk and takes you directly to the main tourist areas. The area felt safe for us.    

As for the front desk, everyone was very friendly and there were absolutely no language issues. We attempted some basic French but everyone spoke English. One morning staff person (I think her name was Silvia) was particularly friendly and helpful with all of our needs. 

This is NOT a full service hotel. The breakfast was modest but certainly not overpriced. We utilized it some mornings but mostly ate breakfast in our room. People complaining about housekeeping should have understood this before booking. We had no issue putting our trash/recycling out, or asking for extra towels or toilet paper etc. We did our laundry 2x during our stay and that was very convenient to have on the premises. There is modest soap and shampoo in the room and a hairdryer on the wall. It is not "high powered", but typical for Europe. There is a safe in the room for passports and such. 

My biggest complaint was that the lobby was very tired. The furniture was even stained. Not a great first impression. The hallways are also tired and in some cases the carpet looked dirty.  From reading older posts it seems that a renovation of rooms may have happened in the past year or so. Our room did not look exactly like the photos on here but close enough. We did not have a balcony. 

Overall we were happy with our stay.

title: Beware of Thieves.
text:
I stayed at this hotel May 7-14. During my stay, I informed Staff that the safety box was not working, this was verified by a guest with me at the hotel. Feeling concerned about my safety on the streets, I hid my jewellery within luggage that only a very in-depth search would have located it. I then departed on the 14th onward to Spain. Upon my arrival in Spain, I realised the jewellery was missing. 
Upon contacting the hotel, they informed me that no jewellery had been ‘found ‘ further investigation proved that only myself & cleaning staff had entered the room. Key card access is only available to the rooms. But elevator can be accessed by anyone. It is my very strong belief that I was targeted and hotel staff along with others, allowed unknown persons to access the room. I have had correspondence with the hotel, and Citadines/ Ascot corporate offices, who have declined to accept responsibility for duty & care to their guests. This hotel is well known for repeated incidents regarding theft. One can only check with the relevant Police Department, and by other reviews here & other sites. I only chose this Citadines property as a colleague suggested it.
The hotel imply that my jewellery was stolen while traveling to Spain, which is totally incorrect as the bag in question was with me the whole time. I am a frequent traveler for business and fully aware to watch my belongings as they go thru airport security checks. 
The significant loss of my jewellery will never be compensated for, the loss of my diamond ring that was a gift from my late husband will never be replaced. If I can advise potential guests then my job is done. 
If you have suffered any issue with regard to theft at this Citadines/ Ascot or related properties  please let me know, a collective approach is far more effective. 
So my advice .... read the reviews and make your choice wisely. 
Avoid this Citadines and all other Citadines /Ascot properties.

title: Unexpected Pleasures
text:
I have now stayed in several Citadines hotels in France, and I generally find them quite nice. This hotel did not disappoint, and in fact had some exceptional features. First, for the price (c 160 euro per night in early april 2018) it was a bargain, located as it was right on the border of the Marais District, which is very hip. Second, some of the rooms have lovely views. I lucked out with an end Studio on the top floor that overlooked Paris rooftops and featured windows on three sides. In one window I saw Montparnasse Tower;in another I saw the Eiffel Tower; and in the third I saw Sacre-coeur. Some days I had trouble leaving the room because I just sat on the bed  with the windows open and gaped  at the beauty of Paris.
The studio was compact but not cramped, and the furnishings were modern and of a quality kind of like higher-end Ikea products . Kitchen well-stocked . Bathroom spacious and well laid out, oh I did need to call down for more towels a few times in 8 days. Rooms like mine on the Courtyard are very quiet, despite being on the major thoroughfare called Boulevard Richard Lenoir. The  Paris Metro and a number of buses  were within a 5-minute walk , so I could get anywhere in the city  very easily. 
The most outstanding feature, however, was the staff. They were so friendly and accommodating and very patient with my bad French. There was a woman named Karen I especially liked and a manager named Guillaume, both of whom should receive kudos. I stayed 8 days and pouted that I had to leave. We will be back.

title: Perfect location and a great place to stay
text:
The Citadines Marais is perfectly located just outside the city center across the street from the metro for easy access to anywhere you want or need to go.  We had four people and it perfectly accommodated us comfortably.  Having four people it was nice to have the toilet separate from the bathroom/shower area which is unusual for most other hotels.  It was a great base as we spent most days wandering the city.  There is a grocery a few minutes walk across the street and a huge outdoor market on Sundays and Thursdays just down the street.  Having the kitchenette was great as we were able to take advantage of both the grocery and market to buy fresh eggs, croissants cheese etc. to make our breakfast every morning and snacks for the end of the day.  

The area around Citadines is full of shops and cafes and very lively.  The room was well kept if not in need of a little updating.  Since we spent very few waking hours in the room it was not a big concern.  The area is safe and clean and quiet at night with a park directly across the street if you have little ones.  The staff were very friendly and although we did not pay for a breakfast we were able to get coffee and water everyday and any leftover pastries they had from breakfast.  We stayed for five nights and would stay again.

title: Good practical base for exploration
text: We have stayed at Citidines Munich before, so knew what to expect. The Citidines brand is standardised, but practical. Our room had a small separate kitchen so we could make our own breakfast or dinner if we chose. It's not tidied daily, or sheets/ towels changed daily either, so if you are messy, be warned! Location is great - close to Republique, restaurants, bars etc. And there is a street market a block or two further down twice a week. It's reasonably priced by Paris standards, close to the Metro and the staff are affable and multilingual. If you are looking for quaint Parisian charm, it's not your best bet. But good for convenience, location, getting around. Oh, and it has a useful guest laundry - do it yourself cheaply, not an expensive laundry service.

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Classy, well-designed, and well-maintained hotel.

Pros:
1. On a quiet street, yet 100 yards from supermarkets, boulangeries, patisseries, and many restaurants.  It’s in a very nice classic Parisian neighborhood in the 14th arrondissement.
2. Just around the corner from a metro stop.
3. Rooms have a small refrigerator and a safe.
4. The most outstanding feature of the hotel is the staff.  Front desk staff and breakfast wait staff were professional, competent, friendly, and very helpful.  Special thanks to Benoit, who was exceptionally pleasant and helpful, and also to Brice and Waly at the front desk for their help and advice.
5. Breakfast quality is excellent.  Wide variety of high quality food with some interesting dishes not always found on a buffet.
6. Very quiet hotel.  If you ask for a room on the back side you will hear nothing from the street.
7. Full shower glass wall and door in the bathroom is a plus.  Not the typical European half enclosure.

Cons:
1. Rooms are functional but small.  About average size for a European hotel, but more than one person cannot really stay in one of the queen-bedded rooms.  There just isn’t the space.
2. Bed pillows are far too soft and make it difficult to find adequate head support.
3. Lighting in the rooms is inadequate.  More lights and brighter lights need to be installed.
4. Unfortunately, on the last few days of our stay the breakfast was moved out into the restaurant to accommodate what appeared to be a private party in the breakfast area.  The breakfast dishes were not covered in the new location and were available for people to breathe on and drop bodily fluids into if they were careless.  Before Covid this would have been unacceptable, but now it’s simply irresponsible.  Subtract ½ point to 4½ due to this unprofessional and unappetizing presentation of the food.

title: Friendly and Convenient Place for Touring Paris
text:
I stayed twice during our trip to France at this hotel. It was very clean, the staff was very friendly and the included breakfast was filling and of high quality.

My young adult children had their own rooms near ours. The rooms were equivalent in size to a New York City hotel room; not much more room beyond the bed. It was not cramped but do not expect large rooms. The rooms were modern with lights which were easy to use as they were preprogrammed. Bathroom was efficient, with a reasonable shower size.

This location is an easy walk (maybe two blocks) to the Pernety Metro stop on the 13 line which is makes getting to the big landmarks of the city easy for those willing to take the Metro.

Breakfast was included in our stay and the crepes were good but the whole family enjoyed the waffles. Good variety with cheeses, meats, eggs, bacon and sausage every day.

The staff was very friendly, and helpful. They held some of our luggage for several days while we toured the Normandy region. 

We walked from the hotel to our catacomb tour which was a kilometer away, passing many shops and restaurants. The city was celebrating summer with concerts across the city and many bars had live music which made the night more enjoyable.  

If looking to be a tourist and you want a safe, clean, friendly place to stay I highly recommend this hotel.
