title: Really nice hotel in a great area
text:
We booked this hotel with Hilton Honors points based both on price and access to major Paris attractions. It is in the Montparnasse neighborhood, near the Paris catacombs, so it's a bit far to walk to places like the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, etc., but there is a metro stop literally right around the corner from the hotel, so it was very easy to get around.

When we checked in, we were immediately greeted by outstanding customer service from Tenzin at the front desk, who upgraded us to a junior suite, which was a very nice room with a small sitting area and a beautiful, spacious bathroom.  The room was clean, modern, and well appointed.

The hotel has a very nice restaurant on the ground floor, where we ate a delicious buffet breakfast every morning. The fresh French bread, croissants, brioche, eggs, meats, cheeses, and yogurt were top notch. I especially enjoyed the fresh squeezed orange juice every day.

As I said, the hotel is in the Montparnasse area, and we went to a couple of amazing restaurants just a few blocks from the hotel. This whole area really has the quintessential French "vibe," with everyone sitting outside the cafes and restaurants in the evening, eating and socializing on the sidewalks.

The only reason I'm not giving the hotel five stars is that they had a persistent problem with the air conditioning which was never resolved during our stay, so our room was quite warm every evening. If they can get this fixed, it would be an amazing place to stay and I would definitely return.

title: Beautiful and relaxing!
text:
Wow. We had an amazing stay. In Paris we usually opt for an Airbnb and this time chose a hotel as the price was more reasonable. This hotel is lovely and just out of the centre of Paris. The most beautiful decor and rooms at such a reasonable price. The rooms are cleaned so well daily, the terrace is very peaceful and relaxing. Staff are so happy to help and rooms are lovely and private. 2 minutes from the metro and 5 minutes to get into the centre of you can walk in a reasonable timeframe.

This is now my go to when going to Paris to stay.

title: Look no further for a personable and helpful experience
text: What can I say? We were welcomed warmly and upgraded to the executive suite as we had booked a twin room and landed in a queen room which wasn’t suitable for 2 sisters especially when one snores..! The executive suite was roomy, with a bath, small balcony (not one you could walk out on though which was disappointing) and you could link your phone apps such as Spotify and Netflix to one of the 2 TVs on the wall. The rooms were cleaned daily with fresh towels and if you didn’t want it cleaned the staff would leave you a note. The reception team were amazing..! Soooo knowledgeable and would go above and beyond to help in any way possible. We asked lots of questions and followed their advice on many occasions so we had a wonderful week in Paris..! Breakfast was served with big smiles and a mixture of hot and cold foods were available. Continental. The team were so down to earth and we really got to know them. Our thanks especially to Cristina, Laurie, Sophie, Noamie, Ingrid and Melissa..! We miss you already..! You are all stars..! Your managers must be proud as without you the hotel would not be the same..! You made our stay the best..!
name: Le Belleval

title: Great location, excellent service
text: Great location, with a broad public transportation in vicinity to the hotel. A warm welcoming and excellent service. The Bathroom is a little bit small, but I really like the design of the room. Clean. Great value for money.
name: Le Belleval

title: Amazing hotel!
text: We stayed at Le Belleval for 4 nights and couldn’t be happier with the hotel, as well as the kind staff, especially George. The room was spacious, clean and well decorated. The location was very close to a Metro station, which we used daily as we visited all the sights in Paris. Great experience, highly recommend Le Belleval!
name: Le Belleval

title: Might be the best hotel in Paris
text:
My mother and I stayed in this hotel a year ago, in 2021, when there was a break in the covid pandemic. I totally forgot to write a review. Le Belleval is a fantastic hotel at a wonderful location in Paris. I think it might actually be the best hotel you can book! Our room was lovely, big for Paris standards and very clean. The atmosphere of the hotel is simply amazing. You can walk right into Paris city center and public transport is close by as well. 
Breakfast was simple but lovely and the view from our hotel room doesn't get more Paris than that! The staff is very friendly and we felt very welcome. I wouldn't hesitate to stay at Le Belleval again for my next trip to Paris!
name: Le Belleval

title: Nice boutique hotel with decent sized rooms
text:
The hotel location is pretty good - near the Saint-Lazare train station/ mall with good access to the shopping district.  The location also felt reasonably safe. 

The hotel staff were friendly and service was good. 

The rooms were decently sized and there was a Nespresso machine in my room.

title: Excellent
text: Room is pretty and quiet. The location is close to the shopping center. Highly recommend. The staff is really nice, and they provide me many useful advice of Paris. The bed is comfortable and I rested well. The room is clean and tidy with a cute welcome hand written card.

title: Physically threatened by hotel staff
text: This is a property run by unprofessional youngsters on top of a bar/restaurant. I have never felt physically unsafe at a hotel. Guests are requested to ask for refilled bottles of water in the name of being 'environmentally friendly. Upon arriving back to the property at 11 pm, I asked the man at the front desk, Georges, to give us a bottle of water. He very rudely dismissed us saying he is already off his shift and to wait for his colleague to help us. When his colleague didn't appear for some time, I asked him again. He then raised his voice at my husband and me, waiving the cash that he was counting and telling us he was very busy. We were shocked at his behavior but did not want to escalate the situation as Georges was increasingly aggressive and unstable so we went up to our room. I went downstairs again as I wanted to get his name. He at first ignored me and refused to give me his name. Then, he threw his passport at me telling me to take a photo of his passport. I told him I do not want to see his passport, merely, I wished to have his name. He then shouted out his name to me. I quickly went to the elevator to go up to my room. He had the gall to chase after me, press the elevator door open to continue shouting at me, telling me to check the reviews of the hotel as no one has ever complained about him. He only relented when I told him I will call the police if he continues. This is more than an issue of bad service. This is about being physically threatened by hotel staff.
name: Le Belleval

title: Superbe !
text: Superbe ! Exceptionally warm and helpful welcome by Georges. All the staff were friendly and helpful. They patiently spoke with us in French so we could practice, and switched to excellent English if we didn't understand something. The room and the entire hotel was clean and looked like it was newly renovated. The bed was very comfortable. We were too busy to use the sauna, but it looked very nice. The breakfast was very good with a wide variety of items to choose from. The only negative was the loud volume of the music during breakfast. One night we bought some food at the nearby supermarket and ate it the very quiet courtyard; the staff cheerfully provided us with plates, utensils, and napkins. The location is excellent; just a few blocks from Metro St. Lazare and close to restaurants, shopping, museums, but on a quieter street without much traffic. Merci beaucoup !
name: Le Belleval

title: Fine small hotel in central Paris
text:
Hotel Le Belleval is based in a good , fairly central, location, a few minutes walk from two different metro stations.  The staff were very helpful.  Our (superior double) room was all we needed, and by Paris standards, not too small.  Good breakfast.  I would recommend it.      
                                                                 .
name: Le Belleval

title: Highly recommended!
text: We absolutely loved staying at the Hotel Belleval. Clean, confortable room, delicious healthy breakfast every morning, great location, polite, friendly, and helpful staff (Georges is amazing!). Highly recommended!
name: Le Belleval

title: Very Quiet and Clean
text: Pretty and clean room, nice balcony view. Super quiet room AND hotel lobby. I did not find the staff very friendly but they did answer questions if I asked for help. Possibly it was different staff for Easter.
name: Le Belleval

title: Fantastic hotel!
text: We loved everything about our stay at Le Belleval--the location, the friendly and helpful staff, and of course, the gorgeous and clean room. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Paris!
name: Le Belleval

title: Comfort design hotel
text: Belleval's room was comfortable and clean, the bed was excellent and the breakfast small but good and with fresh products. I will be happy to be back soon and I definitively recommend it for business solo travelers.
name: Le Belleval

title: Perfect hotel for city trip
text: Hotel Le Belleval was in an ideal location: 2 metro stations just a few minutes away restaurants/cafes nearby. Room was immaculate, true to pictures and spacious. Thank you to the friendly staff for having us!
name: Le Belleval

title: Great staff and extremely clean and safe
text: Our room was very clean, spacious and comfortable.  The bathroom was large and everything was above our expectations.  The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and help us find anything in the city.  The location of Le Belleval is right next to the city lines and regional train station which was very convenient.  The hotel is in a very safe location for both day and night excursions.  I cannot recommend Le Belleval enough.
name: Le Belleval

title: Stop looking! Stay here!!
text: This beautiful hotel is perfectly located and staff is tremendously helpful and friendly! They even upgraded me and my friend to the junior suite, I requested and at no additional cost!! Loved the bottled water in the mini-fridge and the in room Nespresso machine was a life saver!! If you’re looking for a site-seeing trip to Paris, book this place!
name: Le Belleval

title: Nice stay in Paris for business.
text:
Amazing position and amazing staff. The hotel is super nice and the room is very clean and comfortable. Strongly suggested, I will come back for sure. 
The fitness centre is really nice and clean and also the sauna.
name: Le Belleval

title: Best hotel in Paris with the greatest price-value-proportion.
text:
We loved everything. 
The room was cleaned every day without asking and the breakfast had good quality. You definitely find something you like. You can also eat lunch here, no dinner. But there are plenty of restaurants nearby. 
The staff was super kind, always asked if everything was good and greated us every time we walked by. We also got a cute note for Valentine’s Day with chocolate on our room table. 
The location is perfect. There are many bus and metro stops nearby that connect you to literally anywhere. Plus you can walk to the Galerie Lafayette in 10 minutes, 20 minutes to the Louvre and 35 minutes to the Eiffel Tower. 
All in all we didn’t expect such a great hotel in Paris as the Internet is warning everyone to not expect a high standard. We will definitely come back here again.
name: Le Belleval

title: An Amazing Parisian Hotel!
text: One of the best hotels I’ve stayed at! The staff were so friendly, the room was super clean and nicely decorated while also offering such a good view of the city! The sauna facilities were great to use. Overall, a really nice hotel that I would recommend to anyone and everyone!
name: Le Belleval

title: Good but not great. And not a “brand new” hotel.
text:
Good location but needs attention from management in various areas. The bathroom shower stall had black mould so this was an issue for cleanliness and safety. The elevator is a challenge as it is tiny and serves 50+ rooms on 8 floors. It you have any physical challenge at all the charming signs that say to take the stairs to “get your summer body” can be offensive.
Date of stay: December 2021
name: Le Belleval

title: Perfect Paris Hideaway
text: Le Belleval was perfect for our short Paris visit. It is located closely to some Paris sights and to one of the main shopping streets. Couldn't wish for a better place. Stylish yet familiar and friendly.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great place to stay!!
text: Loved every single bit of my stay and have absolutely no complaints! Staff were amazing. Rooms were bigger than I expected. The location was central. I could walk to most places and other key areas were a short Uber ride (around €12). Loved it!!
name: Le Belleval

title: Boutique hotel with generous and comfortable rooms
text: Recently stayed 4 nights with my wife and in a Deluxe room. The room was generously sized, with a sitting area and a cool balcony. Being on the 6th floor, the skylight in the bathroom was a nice touch. The room was well furnished and had all the amenities you'd expect in a modern top-end hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful. Great location, with easy access to metro, and walking distance to major attractions. A very comfortable stay and we would return again
name: Le Belleval

title: Our stay was wonderful!
text:
We stayed with 4 other couples
We had room 702, with a small balcony and a view of the Eiffel Tower. The staff all spoke English, and were very friendly, professional and efficient!
Thank you for a wonderful stay!
name: Le Belleval

title: Lovely and modern, friendly staff, cute boutique hotel!
text: Cute boutique hotel with a very nice staff! Good location - close to the subway and all the famous sights. We asked to change rooms to 108 because our original was a bit small for two people - the staff was very nice about it. Housekeeping was super attentive every day - the shampoo and soap are luxurious. The courtyard-facing rooms are quieter than the street. Decorations and renovations are new and modern.  Breakfast is good (can get quite busy). I unfortunately left my purse in my chair for one minute while getting up to get breakfast. A thief saw it in the window, walked in off the street, grabbed it and walked out. I shouldn’t have left it unattended, so keep an eye on your things at all times (in general, as a tourist in Paris!). The staff was very helpful and supportive, and at the end of the day, my boyfriend proposed to me at sunset on the Seine River in front of the Eiffel Tower, so the day ended well. Overall a nice hotel and good value!
name: Le Belleval

title: Amazing stay, great location and the staff was very welcom
text: I recommend this hotel as it has great location, very clean, cool design and amazing services. It was a great stay and I would choose it again! Thanks to all the staff for making the stay great and accomodating different asks!
name: Le Belleval

title: This hotel gave me a comfortable time.
text:
We were very pleased with this stay.
The only problem was that I had a hard time to park my car because they didn't have a parking space.  This hotel is very close to Saint-Lazare train station, so it is convenient to go by train. 
The hotel staff helped us very well. 
Breakfast was very good.
name: Le Belleval

title: Comfortable and comfy boutique hotel very well located
text:
Stayed in this hotel during a business trip. 

Just a stone away from gare saint lazare and many transportation options, the hotel is pretty, well maintained.

Service is good and the room very pretty and comfortable.

The common areas are well decorated and relaxing.

Good experience, highly recommended.
name: Le Belleval

title: Quintessential Parisian Charm
text: The rooms are much larger than the average Paris hotel which for me was a selling point. After arriving we realized the entire hotel was a selling point. The hotel offers luxury at an affordable price! The attention to detail is so evident even in the towel rack of the bathroom. The breakfast is delicious and a perfect way to start the day. The staff are helpful and speak english in case you are like us and are still learning french. I have nothing negative to say. We have already booked our next trip and of course chosen the same hotel.
name: Le Belleval

title: Perfect Hotel in Paris
text:
It was our first family trip after the changes COVID has brought into our lives. We were very please we got to choose the Le Belleval. Let me first start that the whole positive feeling began long before our trip. They assisted us with all our enquiries and restaurant reservations. Upon arrival we checked in and although there was a small error on the room provided they immediately assisted us by offering us an upgrade. What a room and what a view!! The staff were extremely helpful. Melissa, beautiful lovely girl on the breakfast area. How beautiful the little gift to our young daughter. The gesture really touched me.  Thank you Georges for the remarkable help you gave us. Sadly we came across to a not so nice hostesses in one of the restaurants we booked who made an error with our reservation. He immediately tried to solve the issue and we honor his help taking into consideration that on that moment he was not at work. Ramona, lovely Front Office Manager thank you for the chat and for making our stay wonderful. For us customer service has always been a plus into our stays and let me say that this Hotel should feel proud for its people. 

All in all the Hotel is located very centrally with so many shops restaurants and bars near the area. Try Drinks and co very close to the Hotel. Very easy to reach close to all the Parissien monuments and luxury brands. The rooms are modernly decorated , daily cleaning and large size in comparison to most rooms in Paris. 

We have already rebooked for March 2022 and can not wait to return.

Sending all our love to the wonderful team from Cyprus.
name: Le Belleval

title: Staff went above and beyond
text:
When we arrived in Paris, jet-lagged and not having received a response from the French government regarding our application for a "pass sanitaire" proving that we had been vaccinated, the staff here were so helpful.  They let us check in early, gave us a cup of espresso, and the clerk personally walked us to a nearby pharmacy that could help us get the pass (necessary for entrance to restaurants, hotels and museums).   
The room was very comfortable and modern, and we found the breakfast fresh, delicious and satisfied.  I would gladly stay there again.  This is centrally located and near a Metro stop and good restaurants.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great hotel in Paris
text: Very nice hotel centrally located in Paris.  The rooms are modern and clean.  Looks very newly made.  The breakfast area is open to the sky and very pretty.  The team working at the hotel were very friendly and helpful. We will definitely stay here again!
name: Le Belleval

title: Excellent Stay in Paris
text: We would come back and stay here!  Great staff, clean, beautiful hotel.  The continental breakfast was delicious and the presentation was outstanding.  We were amazed at the level of service and the quality of the facilities.  They definitely made our trip an unforgettable one.  Love it!
name: Le Belleval

title: Super nice staff and a lot of value for money!
text: We just had a lovely stay at Belleval. The staff was super nice and efficient in problem solving, eg. getting a taxi with baby seat immediately to the hotel. It was also a very nice room and very central so we could walk to most places within 15-20 minutes! A lot of value for money!!
name: Le Belleval

title: Gem in Paris
text: Absolutely loved the Belleval. The attention to detail throughout every aspect of the hotel truly made this hotel standout. The rooms were modern and immaculate with many fun touches. Staff was very helpful and friendly, always greeting us with a smile and went above and beyond to accommodate requests. The common spaces were cozy chic. Everything worked well from fast wifi to a wonderful rain shower. Location was perfect, next to many shops and cafes and a short walk to two major metro stations with th area feeling safe and vibrant. Highly recommend staying here!
name: Le Belleval

title: Hotel Belleval is great Hotel to stay in Paris
text:
It was my first time in the Hotel Belleval and I must say it was a great surprise. The staff is super friendly and the location is very central. 
I was searching  for a great hotel in Paris since I travel regularly to Paris and the last few Hotel I stayed where disappointing in terms of prise value.
name: Le Belleval

title: Le Belleval
text: The Team at Le Belleval hosted my family under very special circumstances; and made us feel very special indeed. The location is extremely convenient, from transport to shopping and sightseeing. The bar is friendly, amenities aplenty, the beds are ultra comfortable and the value for money is excellent.
name: Le Belleval

title: Fantastic location and great hotel
text:
We have stayed over a week at Le Belleval and we enjoyed every moment we spent there. It is walking distance from the Louvre, the Opera and the Madeleine. Despite the Covid-19 restrictions that forced their restaurant to close, we felt at home with their fantastic staff. We could order food from many of the surrounding restaurants and we end up having a great time in Paris despite the particular circumstances.

The hotel seems to have undergone a full renovation very recently and the rooms and the terrasse were fantastic!

Highly recommended to any one looking for a great hotel at the heart of Paris!
name: Le Belleval

title: VG
text: I highly recommend this hotel. My wife and I stayed for 4 nights. The staff were so welcoming and helpful. The room was perfect, clean and comfortable. The breakfast had good choices and was good value. Belleval is very centrally located and within walking distance of many sights. We will return.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great hotel in central locatiln
text:
Our stay here was perfect for our honeymoon! The staff gave wonderful recommendations for restaurants in the neighbourhood. 

Our room was great, the bed was comfortable and clean. 

The hotel was walking distance to many Paris must see locations.
name: Le Belleval

title: Highly recommend!
text:
Good location, welcoming and friendly staff, and the room was very clean & comfortable.
Everything was perfect!
I and my family had a great time with Le Belleval.
If my friend says she(or he) plan to visit to Paris, I would recommend this hotel!
name: Le Belleval

title: perfect stay
text: beautiful hotel in a very good location with perfect service ' the room is quiet big with a very nice sitting area and big windows the employs were so friendly and gave us very good hospitality the breakfast was very good need to improve the variety of the product
name: Le Belleval

title: Lovely hotel,
text:
We had a great stay at Le Belleval. Were made to feel very welcome by the staff, appreciated their assistance with a number of local recommendations and translating for us with a transfer provider. 
Hotel rooms are lovely and very comfortable. Was an easy walk around town to a number of Paris’ biggest attractions. 
Would happily stay again next time.
name: Le Belleval

title: Beyond Expectations!
text: New, modern hotel in the perfect location and the room was everything we wanted it to be & more! Our room had a partial view of the Eiffel Tower! The staff was very friendly and there to help with all needs. The restaurant is delicious and great for any meal of the day. We were a close walk to many fun activities.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great location but the hotel needs improvement
text: Excellent location and nice design.  Need to improve facility.  Water leaks from below the sink and wet all my things placed underneath.  Very little water pressure for the shower, so very difficult to shower.  The heater was too strong, but the temperature didn't work, so it was too hot in the room.Staff did not tell me all the possible ways to get to the airport, which I later found out from my Parisian friend.  She was also not correct on how much the taxi cost to go to the airport.
name: Le Belleval

title: Excellent hotel
text: Great hotel with a super location, wonderful decor and friendly, helpful staff. The location is perfect with relation to the main train stations and suitable for business as well as tourism. This is the third time I stayed here and "I'll be back"
name: Le Belleval

title: A beautiful view from the window
text: This hotel is so Frenchie. Our room was very cozy and comfy. There were big windows with a beautiful view. Breakfast was very tasty. Metro is nearby and the district is really good. I recommend this place. When I checked in, I got a voucher for hot drinks at the bar, while I was waiting, it was nice.
name: Le Belleval

title: Very nice and clean room, good location
text: I stay at the Le Belleval regularly mainly due to its great location a few steps from Saint Lazard station. The hotel has style and the rooms are very nicely decorated and maintained. Check in can be slow since they have only one check in desk. I would definitely recommend the hotel
name: Le Belleval

title: First trip to Paris, France
text: Loved Paris. This 4 star hotel was exactly like the photos on their website. Staff was great. Room was great. Steps to restaurants and cafes. We were close to the Metro line. “Gare Saint Lazare”or “Gare Saint Augustin....the metro takes you everywhere in Paris. From the Bastille to Versailles. Note...take advantage of their weekly metro passes tourist can purchase. Unlimited trips from Sunday to Sunday. Google “Navigo- Decouverte” J’aime Paris.....it is the city of Love.
name: Le Belleval

title: Friendly staff and good hotel
text: My stay at the hotel was really great! The hotel also the room were new, clean and well-designed. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The only thing I thought could be improved was the flow in my bathroom was a little low. Totally, I can't wait to be back to Paris and stay here again!
name: Le Belleval

title: Little time in Paris
text:
It was a lovely hotel, near all the kinds of transportation. For us the easy way was with the bus. The staff was very kind and allways trying to help you in case you need it. I Hardly Recomend it.
We will be back.
name: Le Belleval

title: We had a lovely stay!
text: Our stay at The hotel was wonderful. The room was clean 24/7. The staff were kind and helping and our view from the terrace in our room was beautiful. The location was Very good. Can wait to stay there again.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great little hotel with good common courtyard and bar area.
text: Rooms are good size. Bathrooms are clean and new. Hotel has been renovated and tastefully completed. Front bar and lounge area are quite and accessible. Rear courtyard is great for afternoon drink etc.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great boutique hotel
text:
We stayed at Le Belleval for 1 week. Travelling with my daughter, and booked a twin room.
Le Belleval provided everything we needed, modern room, walk in shower, comfy beds, air con room and a small fridge. 
The location was fine, close to main train station and local grocery stores. A leserly walk to all attractions.
We enjoyed our stay emensley, the staff were very friendly and helpful & spoke good English.
Overall a 10 out of 10 for this boutique hotel.
name: Le Belleval

title: Couldn't ask for more
text: Wow! great staff, great location, very nice rooms, nice breakfast  - i think that is what you need when you travel, right? this place did meet and beat all those requirements. its like a 5 min walk from St. Lazare train station and like mile away from Arch De Triumphe. Lot of (nice) shopping around the area. After a long day if you want to come sit in and have a drink in their restaurant, cool, do it. If you are wanting to book this place for your next stay, do not hesitate.
name: Le Belleval

title: Really pleased with our choice! Loved the hotel!
text: Everything was perfect! Clean hotel, fantastic location, spacious rooms with very comfortable beds and great view! Also the breakfast was delicious! Every day we had fresh fruits and pastries! The staff was excellent! They were courteous, genuinely pleasant and always with a smile! We definitely recommend the hotel to our friends and stay here again! Thank you for everything belleval team! You made our honeymoon magical!!
name: Le Belleval

title: Hotel le Belleval is the top!
text: Wonderful location, very good staff! To be recommended!!!! every time is a perfect booking and excellent treatment. If you decide to go to Paris....click on the Le Belleval webpage. we come back for sure!!!!
name: Le Belleval

title: Amazing Hotel, Awesome Staff, Fantastic location
text:
Everything was perfect. Clean hotel, fantastic location, spacious rooms (by Paris Standards)

However the most outstanding thing was the staff they were out of this world. Everyone we interacted with was great. The gentleman and the two ladies at the reception where fantastic. They really made an effort to accommodate us (a big group of 7) we had a last minute booking and they managed to get us connecting rooms and a third room on the same floor. They were so courteous always smiling and genuinely pleasant. I cant tell you how happy we were. Would DEFINITELY recommend the hotel to our friends and stay here again. Definitely. 

Only comment would be shelf space in the room (the one small cabinet is not enough) also perhaps some improvement in the lighting in the rooms. 

Thank you to all the team.
name: Le Belleval

title: Very nice boutique hotel !
text:
I stayed here 6 nights, in July. Very clean hotel in a good position, just close to Saint Lazare station. The personnel was very polite and helpfull. They responded to all our request.The breakfast is very good and can be taken in a very nice restaurant.
I recommand the hotel, especially for the position and for the personnel.
name: Le Belleval

title: Relaxing Stay
text: I just returned from a trip to Paris and stayed at Le Belleval. The property was excellent and I enjoyed this boutique hotel. The staff were friendly and welcoming anytime I returned to the hotel. The staff was also helpful in setting up a few tours for me. The bedroom and bathroom were clean and modern. I had the room to myself and there was enough space for me. The bed was extremely comfortable. The location was good. The train is within walking distance or you can uber or catch the subway to most of the sites. Walking may take 20-40 minute but you will pass some great sites.  It seems as if things in this area close early. If you get hungry for a midnight snack or drink you will be out of luck. There was only one elevator that I noticed. I left the hotel early and returned late so I didn’t experience a wait. There was very little closet/storage space but I worked with what I had.  Overall I would return to this hotel.
name: Le Belleval

title: Nice stay
text: Overall nice hotel for the price especially in comparison to others this time of year.  Few minor glitches such as issues with the AC but it was a very hot week and something the area is not used to. The lift wasn’t functioning upon checkout so toting the luggage down the stairs was an issue. Due to these “glitches” wouldn’t give it a 5 rating but overall very clean, newly remodeled, nice location and excellent staff that were always accommodating and helpful. Breakfast is great and the limited experience with the restaurant was great as well.  I would recommend and return.
name: Le Belleval

title: Excellent
text: This hotel is adorable, very clean, friendly staff and close to the train station and metro stops. Breakfast was very good. Rooms and bathrooms were large for Paris hotels. We had two rooms that connected with a small foyer. It was perfect for us traveling with teen daughters.
name: Le Belleval

title: 舒適愉快的旅程
text:
房間乾淨 地點很好
工作人員態度良好 也很安靜
值得推薦

Nice hotel
Clean room and location is also good. The bed is big and quiet at night. I sleep very well in this hotel. 
The staff are polite and nice. 
I certainly will come back again.
name: Le Belleval

title: Very good hotel
text: Very good hotel. Newly renovated, modern design, room and bathroom very big for Paris standards. Staff very friendly and helpful. Pleasant courtyard where you can have a drink or dinner. My only remark is very little storage in room. I would definitely recommend this hotel
name: Le Belleval

title: Great hotel!
text: We stayed in a family room (two adjoining rooms with a shared entrance) and it was just perfect for the 4 of us!  The kids loved the fast WiFi and we loved the courtyard which was perfect for enjoying a bottle of wine in the afternoon after a day of sightseeing. Very close to the train and lots of restaurant options within walking distance. The rooms are well appointed and the air conditioning was appreciated since we were there in the middle of a heat wave!!  I would definitely recommend this place and stay here again!
name: Le Belleval

title: Great location, staff helpful room just ok
text: Staff were lovely at the hotel just some issues with the room, TV didn't work initially so someone had to come up and then had to go off and reset it. Following day couldn't get into room, went down to reception twice and was let in my member of staff, then issue resolved. Coffee maker didn't work, brought it to staff attention, it got resolved. Kettle was terrible, didn't bother bringing that up, lid kept falling into kettle. Lighting and clothes storage in room poor. Other than that was ok, ate once in hotel and it was nice.
name: Le Belleval

title: Beautifull week-end
text: It was a beautifull week-end on Paris. This hotel is very clean, localised is a beautifull part of this gorgeous town. This hotel is perfect for a week-end or holidays. Equipments are very good. Beds are very comfortable.
name: Le Belleval

title: Beautiful & designed Hotel
text:
The hotel deserve 5 points ...but

We had a quick stay at Le Belleval. The quality of product of this boutique hotel is basically above standards especially when it comes to the size of the room, the modern and cozy decoration (in the room or the lobby ) as well as the bathroom amenities, good pillows..

The only negative point is that neither the room maid nor the housekeeping supervisor paid attention to the little stain in the middle of the bed duvet which can't pass by without seeing it...

So overall it was nice hotel with a reasonable cost and a great location, I would definitely come again...
name: Le Belleval

title: Our perfect stay!
text: I could not wish for a nicer hotel! Rooms were very nice, breakfast was ideal (few and good options!), hotel situated in a perfect location! I definitely recommend it! The only thing I would change is that the rooms should have a closet! Staff was friendly and polite!
name: Le Belleval

title: best stay in paris
text:
sightseeing as pedestrian is best from here. metro is also very near.
very clean room, very clean bathroom. Both rooms are big! 
next time in paris we will go to this hotel again.  
thanks to all the stuff.
name: Le Belleval

title: Beautiful hotel
text: Beautifully decorated hotel, with very friendly and professional staff. Clean rooms, bathrooms and public areas, and a good location for the main attractions in Paris. A lovely breakfast, and nice restaurant for lunch.
name: Le Belleval

title: Amazing Hotel
text: Staff is so nice and this hotel is perfectly located in Paris.Room was confortable and quiet. We appreciated the modern design and the quality of the breakfast. Thank you very much for this great moment
name: Le Belleval

title: Great hotel!
text: Location, clean rooms, beautiful breakfast, great and fast room services and welcoming staff for really comfortable price. Fitness and wellness area at the hotel. I highly recommend this hotel for leisure stay, especially if it’s your first time in Paris.
name: Le Belleval

title: Nice hotel with clueless reception
text: Nice and centrally located hotel that is not worth the money. Modern design. The room was tiny but clean and new. Breakfast ok. Unfortunately the personnel at the reception (we interacted with three different people during our stay) was completely clueless, and not even able to answer the simplest question or provide minimum assistance. They were a mix of foreign trainees who have never been in Paris before and Erasmus students just trying to earn some pocket money with a student job. Given the price for the hotel and the 4 stars, you would expect something more. A suggestion for the manager/wonders: invest in some professional receptionists and/or concierge, this would improve the experience of the guests a great deal.
name: Le Belleval

title: As described in customer's review
text:
The check-in was done during my flight to Paris. I already knew the room number and fulfilled all the passport details. So I just picked up the key at reception and asked about the lift to my floor. 
The room was exactly as shown on the pictures with a comfortable bed which is very important for business travellers and tired tourists after an exciting day.
I had two nights and had wonderful dinners at the restaurant downstairs. 
The improvement area that I see for the hotel is breakfast.
name: Le Belleval

title: Great hotel, great location!
text:
Our stay at Le Belleval was such a pleasure. The check in was seamless and our executive suite was ready upon arrival. The suite was good for the 3 of us.  Bed was extremely comfortable and the balcony view was amazing. I loved the showerhead in the beautiful bathroom as well. 
During our 3 night stay, we had clean towels everyday. That's so refreshing to come back after a long day out and see that housekeeping did a great job. 
The hotel is within walking distance of many attractions and shopping areas. The metro is right around the corner and Gare Saint Lazare is one block away. We also found the staff to be friendly and helpful.  Special thanks to Angelina at the front desk for being kind, friendly and always helpful during our stay. 
There is also a restaurant in the hotel that serves breakfast, but we didn't get a chance to check it out. Will definitely try on our next visit. 
All in all, great and clean hotel with everything you need available to you. Highly recommend.
name: Le Belleval

title: Beautiful hotel
text:
Stayed for 1 night at the end of March. It's a lovely small boutique hotel in the heart of Paris.
We had a family room which was basically 2 rooms behind the 1 door. 
The rooms are set up and decorated lovely, really nice bathrooms with all the facilities you would expect of a 4 star hotel.
Lovely little balcony as well.
Really liked the courtyard behind reception to relax, and they even supply blankets if you are a little cold!
Has a sauna and gym which didn't use.
The breakfast was a nice continental selection, lovely smoked salmon.
It's in a good location to explore the whole of Paris.
Quite pricey, but worth it for the quality.
name: Le Belleval

title: It has a/c but don’t trust it will be operating. Plus after hour club across the street. Lots of club and street noise.
text: Fair hotel.  Booked because it had a/c.  Mgr had a/c cut because some guests were cold at night.  Guests could have turned off a/c.  Other guests including me had rooms with west facing rooms and was hot in room. Plus lots of noise car & club across st

title: Good Value Hotel in Great Location
text:
I give this hotel three stars because that is what it is - a three star hotel.  It advertises itself as three stars at the entrance, and when you compare Les Tournelles to the Four Seasons George V for example, it's a three star hotel.

That being said, and having stayed at plenty of luxury hotels in my lifetime, this was a very nice place to stay if you're trying to save some money and also be in a great neighborhood.  We had two rooms on the 5th floor, which is a flight of steps up from the top elevator floor, the 4th floor.  There are three rooms on that floor - two singles and a double.

The rooms we found to be tiny.  Not much room to do anything except sleep and bathe.  We were in room 53 and our son in room 51.  Hardly any closet space so if you got a lot of stuff or big luggage, beware.  Less than three feet on either side of bed, maybe 6-7 feet from foot of bed to doorway.  Only accessible plug was by tiny desk by doorway - we had to dig around for other plus for chargers etc.  

Our son's room had a small Juliet balcony and faced the street in a SW direction and was actually quite lovely.  Nice sunset views and quite airy with window open.  His bathroom was bigger than ours.  If you're on your own, I'd recommend that single.

Bed was comfortable, bedding decent quality.  Bathroom had small shower with decent water pressure.  Towels were pretty thin. Our bathroom was tiny, and not good ventilation.    

Breakfast was extra - 14 Euro.  Just a simple continental offering, wait staff spoke little to no English.  

Front desk manager was helpful when we needed him to print out some travel docs and booking taxis.  Lobby sitting room quite a nice place to relax as there was no sitting space in our room as mentioned above. 

Again, location is important and that the hotel gets five stars for.  Marais is hip, buzzing, young, with tons of shopping and dining options within a stone's throw.  

I'd stay here again.

title: Another perfect stay
text:
This was our 4th stay here. When we go to Paris, we always try to book this hotel since location is great, rooms are in good shape, the hotel has a nice ambiance and breakfast is good. Here some more details : 
- location : very close to the Marais, which is one of the most charming neighborhoods in Paris. Lots of boutiques, bars and restaurants.... 
- rooms : true, rooms are rather 'compact' (around 1§ to 18 sqm?) but this is the norm in Paris. You have enough space though to move around the bed and to organize your stuff. Bathroom is in perfect shape, with a nice good working shower. 
- ambiance : very boutique - we especially like the comfortable 'salon' (lounge) where you can coffee, tea, water for free. Also wine, gin, port etc on offer for a reasonable price. 
- breakfast : served in a charming basement by a very friendly lady. You will get a basket of different breads (croissant, 'pain au chocolat', baguette etc) all tasting yummy, a fruit salad, a yoghurt, orange juice, tea or coffee to your liking and marmelades and honey. All good quality. This time, we observed that there was no cheese and ham anymore (please, guys, we really missed this !). All in all, to Parisian standards, a very high quality and freindly breakfast. 
So, for us, no doubt on our minds we will always try to return to Les Tournelles when going Paris.

Cheers!

title: Dated, dirty, misleading, bad management attitude!
text:
On the website it has air conditioning listed as one of their facilities, what they don't tell you that it's not individually controlled. The control switch is at front desk, and it's either heating or AC mode. And they (the hotel) decides what mode to have it on. The receptionist Anwar when I raised about the heating and room being too warm, he said I don't need AC it's cold outside....... Yes maybe OUTSIDE but I'm not sleeping outside am I??!? My point is no where on the website states AC will not be available during months of winter etc etc. And this is my argument! For 2 nights we had to sleep with windows open facing a wall! There's a compressor outside and can hear it kick starting and it's noisy! 

The hotel pictures were probably taken when it just finished redecorated, there's paper peeling off wall, can't get all channels on TV, dust everywhere and furnishing proper dated! Think Les Tournelles should update their photos as it's misleading, there are reviews here about the state of the hotel and another review about the AC. Don't bother booking with them, for the price can find somewhere else with better facilities and probably attitude.

title: At 240€ this hotel is extremely overpriced
text:
The photos made it look like much more than it is. They always do, but here much more than usual.
1.) Understaffed: On arrival, at 2pm, there was nobody in the reception area. We had to wait a good 5 minutes until the receptionist arrived. With only 1 staff I understand that the person has to sometimes leave his post. But at 240€ you expect a backup.
2. )Extremely cramped: We could not access our room as the housekeeping service trolley was standing in the tiny corridor. You could not pass the trolley. No staff to be found. We had to wheel the trolley out of the corridor to squeeze by.
3. ) Room was cheaply furnished. There was a concrete wall 50 cm from our window (room 41). So it’s the equivalent of a windowless room. The room, as the rest of the hotel was showing signs of wear and tear. Chipped furniture. Marks on the walls etc. Beds where comfortable and the location, if you like the Maree is very good.

Overall this would have been a 3 star rating at 100€ - 150€. At 240€ it’s a 1.

title: A brilliant little hotel
text:
Stayed 2 nights and love it, this hotel makes a mockery of the hotel * ratings, it is classed as 3* but I have stayed in 5* that are far worst in every aspect, in terms of quality the hotel is 5* make no doubt.

It is decorated to the highest standard and was clean and immaculate, like most hotels in Paris the rooms are small but I found the aircon great, the quality of the beds and decoration in the rooms is really high class, pretty much one of the best quality hotel I've stayed in.  If I was to make one comment, the towels are a let down, they are small, thin and poor quality, they really do not match the quality of everything else in the hotel.

The front desk staff were the nicest and friendliest people I think I have met in hotels, so helpful and friendly, the same goes for the lady at breakfast.

The breakfast room in the cellar is lovely, vaulted ceilings and continental breakfast was very good, perhaps could be improved with fresh fruit, but I was happy with it.

The room was very expensive, this is Paris after all, but I would say the quality was 5*, it was also a very quiet hotel with no noise.

title: Pleasant
text:
﻿
﻿
So, the Hotel Odeon. It’s in a great location with a metro with two lines just a few steps away, as are several decent cafes. The hotel is sort of old French elegance meets kind of chic. Our room, 51, with a king bed, which was really closer to an American queen, was a bit cramped, even by European standards. The bed was hard, but that was okay for us. Pillows were skimpy. The bathroom was spacious, but the shower was a mess. A partial glass partition meant you couldn’t run the water hard without getting water all over the floor. The rain shower barely dribbled, but also wouldn’t completely turn off, so you could have a hot shower with cold water dribbling on you overhead. Towels were skimpy and rough. No washcloths. Wi-Fi was pretty speedy and consistent, and two ports by each side of the bed was a big plus. Air conditioning worked well, but couldn’t say about heat. Rooms seem to be soundproofed pretty well as we couldn’t hear anything from adjoining rooms. Nespresso machine in the room, but you only get two pods, if you’re lucky. Sometimes just one and you have to go hunt one down. Otherwise, there was instant coffee and herbal teas. Breakfast was not bad, though rather spare, and oddly, no cut fruit and essentially no pastries. English at the front desk depends on who’s there at the time, so if you have questions, or needs, you may have some difficulty.

text:
We arrived early and our room wasn't ready, but they stored our luggage until we came back. We got a standard room so it was a bit small (as expected with most hotels in Paris). We decided to stick with the room because we did not want to lug our stuff to another room and were planning to be gone most of the time (only here 2 days). I forgot to tell the staff on the way out.  Asides from the issue with the floor in our room (which I'm sure if I would have said something to them, they would have taken care of it), we really enjoyed our stay here. The entire staff was always so helpful and kind. We would definitely stay here again when we come back.
