title: Very helpful staff
text: Very close to the Raspail metro station, this hotel is located close to restaurants and bakeries. The desk people were extemely helpful, the receptionist taking the time to explain and draw directions to the sites in Paris that we wanted to see. The upper floors on the cemetery side have great views. The rooms are a bit small but clean and organized with free drinks, coffee and snacks. Wine is available to purchase. The room was hot at night. This was the only negative for us. It is 20 - 30 minute walk to sites like the Eiffel tower, Notre Dame, the Seinne, Ste. Chappel and a 10 minute walk to the catacombs.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Aiglon never disappoints
text: Every time I visit Paris I stay at Hotel Aiglon. I love the location. The metro/subway is just across the street. There are very nice restaurants that are only a block or two away from the hotel.   The breakfast is delicious. Super nice staff; very clean rooms.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: An excellent Paris base
text: Very well run hotel by an engaged and dedicated staff. Personal, friendly service and a very clean and well cared for property. Great neighbourhood, steps from the metro. Great selection of restaurants on the doorstep.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Better than expected.  Good hotel
text:
The hotel is clean and room is spacious. Good AC, clean room and supplies are good too.  We love this hotel. It is close to metro. 

We did not find big grocery market nearby, this is the only thing we can complain about.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent choice, we booked an apartment with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms for our family. The apartment was very clean and spacious. The hotel is near the metro station. It’s the perfect choice to visit Paris.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Favorite in Paris
text: Location, comfort, style, quality and staff are amazing. We have been three times in this hotel and ist always felt like Home. Plenty of delicious Restaurant, Bistros and Bars in close walking distance.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Brilliant hotel
text: This was a fabulous hotel. Very stylish and really helpful staff. Lovely big room and very close to the Metro and lots of restaurants but was in a peaceful location itself. Very close to the catacombs .
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Eccellent breakfast, good value!
text: 3 lovely days in Paris with the family :) For us, it was really worth checking the hotel's website for special offers and packages, far more convenient than booking.com rates. The breakfast room is very beautiful and sunny, perfect to begin a beautiful day in Paris with a really excellent breakfast, so think of including breakfast, it's really worth it!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great hotel in a great area
text: We stayed at this very nice hotel in June 2022. It a great location in Montparnasse. Close to great restaurants and bars and at the same time in a quiet area. Great service upon arrival and we got a very nice and clean room. We can highly recommend the hotel!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: I am a fan of Hotel Aiglon
text: Great location (close to Raspail-Vavin), nice decoration (I love the bathroom tiles), very helpful staff (for restaurant recommendations, for luggage...! I am really a fan. I come for both work and leisure, alone and with family.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Good hotel choice
text: Great hotel, well located, just 10 min walking from Montparnasse train station. The underground is just crossing the street. Many restaurants in the area. The room, ours was the suite, it was really good., recently renewed. The staff very friendly. We will definitely come back.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: COZY ROOM
text: The Aiglon Hotel is a.nice option when in Paris. Room is nice and clean. Breakfast is great. Staff are nice and well prepared. Subdivision is nice. Metro is next door. I highly recommend this hotel in Paris.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Very comfort hotel in the center of Paris
text: On this trip we have stayed in few hotels in Paris and this hotel was most comfortable, the room was the most spacious, the breakfast was the best. I was pleasantly surprised by the value for money. Thank you <3
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Very clean, good location, well priced
text: We took a family room that has a bedroom with double bed and a room with a double fold out sofa. The two kids on the sofa found it too springy and woke each other up when they turned over in the night. But otherwise the hotel is great. Rooms are very clean and air conditioned. Staff is extremely helpful. They allowed us a late checkout on Sunday that gave us the entire day for only a very small fee. EAsy access everywhere from Raspail Metro and nearby great food options on rue de la Gaite.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Wonderful Experience at Hotel Aiglon
text:
We stayed for a couple of days. Our room was clean, large, and quiet. We were on a corner, which allowed for a nice open view. Perfect location for sightseeing, shopping, close to nice restaurants and bars, and right near the metro station.
Everyone from the hotel was nice, welcoming, and professional.
Lovely breakfast in tastefully decorated room.
Highly recommend!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Lovely hotel with very friendly personnel!
text: Lovely hotel, in nice area, with very kind personnel. People were very helpful. If available, there is the option of private parking. The interior design of the hotel was lovely at the entrance and nice in the room.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: You have found the hotel
text: Great rooms, large and comfortable.  The staff is nice and very accommodating.  The air conditioning and housekeeping are great features of the hotel.  Location, location, location, it is walkable and very close to public transportation.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Amazing breakfast
text: Cute little hotel. Quiet rooms. I have stayed there 4 or 5 times. Great location as it is close to everything. My favourites things: the "mosaïque" decoration in the bathroom and their amazing breakfast. Nice staff at reception.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Could have been charming
text: On the positive side, this hotel is extremely conveniently  located , close to the metro and with many restaurants on either side of the street. You can practically walk anywhere  from the hotel. On the negative side, everything is very small, which is to be expected in Paris , but the hotel rooms are in need of renovation, it gives you a feeling of not being entirely clean. The hotel staff is attentive but not overly friendly. if you are not very demanding, then it is the hotel to stay.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Charming and chic!
text:
I stayed at this little boutique hotel for 3 nights. Everything was mostly on point! It was extremely clean - the cleanest hotel I've come across in a while. The room was very comfortable, exactly what I needed. There was a glitch with heating in my room half way through my stay, but this was promptly rectified - a very good electric heater was provided.

Check-in was fairly straightforward, staff were pleasant. Two reception gentlemen were particularly warm & friendly - one who provided me with a heater, & another who helped store/retrieve my luggage - I unfortunately didnt get their names. The rest of the staff could be warmer/more welcoming.

Location wise - the hotel is perfectly located in the 14th arrondisiment, on one of Paris's wide boulevards, & is 2mins walk from Raspail metro (line 4 & 6 I think).

Highly recommended! I will definitely return again.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: I wish we could have stayed longer
text:
We decided to stay in this hotel for our last night in Paris. We wanted to stay in the Montparnasse area due to the easy accessibility to Orly airport. I did not want to deal with the headache of Paris traffic in the morning.

I wish could have stayed in this hotel longer.  The room was a great size and we had ample closet space.  We especially loved how the windows opened up to a nice little balcony.  We had a king size bed it was quite comfortable. 

When you walk into the main lobby, it smells clean and relaxed me immediately. The front desk staff was very courteous and patient. There were daily newspapers and chilled water upon our arrival. 

It was a lovely hotel to wrap up an excellent trip.  Our last night in Paris was a great experience and I am glad we stayed here.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Absolutely Wonderful!!!!!
text:
I planned a family trip to Paris and saw this hotel on Trip Advisor with positive reviews. The rate was competitive (with prepayment), so I booked it. We LOVED it. My wife is a hotel snob and she fell in love with this hotel. The trip was for her birthday, so I knew things had to be just right. It was purrrr-fect!

The staff are so friendly. And if you’re not fluent in French, no worries. As advertised, the hotel staff are fluent in English (and other languages as well) and will kindly converse with you as need be.

We booked a room with a separate bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room. This worked perfectly for our family (we were traveling with one kid). I was a bit confused by the online description of the bathrooms. The description referred to a bathroom with “separate toilets.”  There were actually two bathrooms. One was a full tub and shower with a double-vanity (no toilet). The other was a toilet and single-vanity. I’ve not seen this set-up in the US, but it worked perfectly. None of our family was ever waiting to use the bathrooms. 

The hotel is super-clean, no smoky smells or anything. Just great. Also, My wife is like a bloodhound, and she never smelled anything but good scents. 

The appointment of our room and throughout the hotel was very up to date and attractive. The Mosaic tile was the most beautiful I’ve seen. The room was also very sizeable. It was clear there are lots of older hotels in Paris. There are also over-priced chains. This one gave the best combination of classy beauty and updated features at a very reasonable price.  

In terms of location, I don’t know how it could have been better. We were one  block from the metro train station. And the bus stop. Lots and lots of restaurants on our block and surrounding area. If you are interested in seeing the Louvre and Eiffel Tower and Champs Elysee and Notre Dame (which was closed for repairs while we were there), this was a perfect location, less than 10 minutes by train from these attractions. As an FYI, you probably don’t want a hotel that is right near to these attractions. Those areas are  crowded and loud. But our hotel was in a very quiet neighborhood that felt less touristy while still in close proximity. 

I honestly can’t think of anything negative to say about our experience at Hotel Aiglon. It was perfect. Even the prepaid breakfast was a bargain for our family—it was an an extra €20 per day. It was not the best food, but it was good enough given we were staying one week and didn’t want to overspend to eat every day.  We just rolled out of bed, took the elevator down to the breakfast room (la salon de petit-dejeunier), and enjoyed great cafe-au-lait with eggs, croissants, eggs, pastries, cheese, cereals, juices, milk, etc. 

I will definitely stay at this same hotel on my next Paris trip. It was luxurious, affordable, professional, super-clean, and fabulous all-around. Wonderful!!!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Charming, Comfy, and Convenient
text:
My fiance and I had been to Paris once before so we knew which neighborhood we wanted to stay in. I love Montparnasse because it's a little removed from the hustle and bustle but there's still tons of good food around. Hotel Aiglon was in the perfect location because there were two train lines just across the street, and it was very easy to transfer to other lines. Our room was very comfy and everyone on the staff was kind and helpful and just generally great people.

My only complaint is that the breakfast seemed to be a bit overpriced. We didn't have that included in the room price and we only ate at the hotel once (not necessarily because of the price, though. We have our own breakfast spot a short walk from the hotel.)

We had a great time and I'd definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Hotel at Montparnasse
text: It was a very pleasant stay. The hotel has charm, it has very comfortable and also quiet rooms. It serves a very good and fresh breakfast. This area of Paris is very interesting, e.g. Saint Sulpice and the Montparnasse graveyard. The location can be easliy accessed via Gare Montparnasse and Gard du Nord via the M4.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great Location, Lovely Room
text:
We stayed for a week, and would have loved to stay longer!  The rooms are comfortable, the beds soft, the bathrooms stylish.  We appreciated the option to add their breakfast buffet to our stay (do so - they serve until 11 AM and it has plenty to fill you up before exploring the city).  Our only critique with the hotel is the wifi.  Compared to other places we've stayed in Europe, it was annoyingly slow.  But, of all the issues to have, it was the least of our worries.

The hotel in across the street from a METRO station that serves 2 of the busiest lines.  From there you can take it directly to most of the big-ticket attractions in Paris (Eiffel, Louvre, Musee d'Orsay, Arc de Triomphe, Luxembourg Garden, etc.)  

In the same building as the hotel (but not affiliated) is Maison Edgar - a nice little restaurant to go to.  If you cross the street and go down 1 block, you will find Boulangerie Guilloton, a fantastic little bakery & cafe where we ate most of the time.  Big sandwiches and quiche and all sorts of pastry - almost all of which is less than €4.

Hotel Aiglon is a great place to stay for your Paris vacation.  The prices are reasonable, the location impeccable, and the rooms are comfy.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Very good hotel, great location and very well managed.
text: The hotel was located in the 14th arr.,, very near the metro (Raspail)  and many busses.  We stayed there for ten nights and ate  every night not more than a five minute walk away at a variety of wonderful French and seafood restaurants.  The hotel itself was very clean and the staff was very accommodating.  I recommend this hotel for a couples visit to Paris.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great hotel
text: My familiy (2children + 2adults) stayed for four nights. Spacious room with balcony, clean and nice. Lovely breakfast and nice staff. Situated next to metrostation, also walking distance to a lot of restaurants. We recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Nice but noisy
text:
A small hotel with friendly staff. The rooms are spacious and clean, with airco. There was a lot of noise from other rooms, especially their shower. Breakfast was nice but the choices offered are not up to the level we are used to at four star hotels.
A suggestion for improvement: guests are required to leave their keycard at the reception and to pick it up when they return. This is cumbersome for guests and requires unnessery work by the hotel staff. Moreover, it does not show confidence in the hotel guests.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: An excellent and stylish hotel in the Montparnesse Area of Paris
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Aiglon for 4 nights and we were impressed by it's stylish and modern appearance. The staff on arrival were particularly friendly and obliging nothing seems too much trouble to them. This was the theme throughout our stay from reception to the breakfast room.
Breakfasts were good with a variety of fruit, cereals, cheeses and cold meats together with traditional French breads and patries.
The room we stayed in was well equipped, with high quality linen,  drapes and furnishings. Everything was of high quality,  style and impressive for the cost of the room.
The location is near to the Paris Metro Line M6 with ease of connection to CDG Airport on the RER B  line which can easily be walked ro Port Royal or change at Metro M6 at Raspail. 
Lots of nice restaurants and bistros nearby.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Aiglon and would return again at the first opportunity. Thank you to the Management & staff of Hotel Aiglon.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Truly special - in many ways
text:
This small, high-quality hotel is a real treasure centrally located in Paris. Our family of four were warmly welcomed by the super friendly staff, received a very convenient, spacious family room that was lovely decorated. Breakfast great. Even car park available. Several tube lines within walking distance as are the famous catacombes de Paris.
Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great find!
text: I came across this hotel based on on line recommendations and could not have been more pleased. So pleased that I'm almost hoping it doesn't become so popular I won't be able to get a room in the future. Where to start? The location is just right - close enough to the center of town to allow easy access to all primary sights, while also retaining a more relaxed neighborhood atmosphere. An excellent supply of restaurants is available. The front desk personnel are cheerful and helpful. Finally, but quite importantly, the rooms are excellent: well appointed, plenty of space, clean, modern. I was in a comfort class room which had a king sized bed, shower and bath and a balcony overlooking rue Raspail. As  I think you will detect, I'm a big fan.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Hotel Aiglon
text:
Great hotel.... Great Staff at check in and Check out.
Though some rooms may be small for the unknowing travelers to Paris. The room we had was excellent. I would totally recommend this hotel. One of the best showers in Paris
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel with Outstanding Customer Service
text: During my recent trip to Paris, I left a jacket on the train from Avignon to Paris and was unable to retrieve it before my flight back to the States. One of the hotel's staff, Ms. Soha Abbas, took the initiative to write a letter on my behalf giving her authorization to pick it up, then subsequently traveled to Gare Lyon and mailed my jacket at her own expense. I received it just a few days ago and I was happy to reimburse her for her time and trouble. This level of customer service and kindness  is extraordinary. The hotel's management did not ask her to do this, rather, she did this out of the goodness of her heart to help a distressed traveler. I will never forget her kindness and if my future travels include Paris, I will always stay at the Hotel Aiglon. And I absolutely agree with other travelers who have rated the hotel highly -- the location is convenient with short walks to the metro and restaurants, the rooms are beautifully appointed, and the staff made it feel like my " home away from home".
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Cute little hotel
text: Perfectly sized hotel on a quiet street but close enough to nice restaurants and bus stops etc.  Beds are extremely comfortable.  Bedding top quality.  Spotlessly clean.  Beautiful, fresh, tasty breakfast served in a small, quiet dining room which made breakfast a delight as opposed to large hotels where it's a noisy bun fight.  We couldn't wait to get down for breakfast in the morning!! Lovely breakfast staff.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Fantastic hotel with friendly staff
text: The hotel was very close to public transport links and several nice restaurants. The staff were friendly and very accommodating. Our room was lovely, very large and spacious, nicely decorated and clean, with a balcony.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Charming, Comfortable, quiet hotel
text:
Hotel Aiglon was perfect for our quick stay in Paris. The hotel is located in a great neighborhood, with many good restaurants nearby. It is also within walking distance of the Gare Montparnasse train station, which is why I booked it as we had an early train. 

The room was very comfortable, clean, and stylishly decorated. With the exception of an occasional siren, it was also very quiet. 

The hotel staff were all very kind and helpful, and answered our questions about the area. The breakfast buffet was simple, but very good. 

Highly recommend!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Best place to stay in Paris
text:
It is our second time in this hotel and we really love it. The staff is very kind and attentive. The room has a good space compared to the pattern in Paris. It has a very comfortable bed with wonderful pillows. The shower and bathtube are also very good. In the summer, the silent air conditining guarantee a good sleep, and in the winter the heating system keep you warmed. It is close to the Luxembourg Garden, and there are 2 subway stations just in the corner. 
We feel very welcome here and we strongly recommend Aiglon Hotel.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Unusually nice Paris hotel
text: I've stayed in multiple hotels in Paris, but the Hotel Aiglon is by far the best in every way. I must admit that I've mostly stayed in 3 star hotels travelling alone, so it might be a bit unfair to compare those to the 4 star Hotel Aiglon, but the few 4 star hotels I've tried can't match the Aiglon in any way. The staff is polite, cheerful and helpful, especially the staff in the breakfast room. The breakfast is a wide selection of French pastries, cereals, bread, fruits, yoghurt, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, bacon, etc., and high quality juices, coffee and hot chocolate. When booking the room we asked for a room high up with a view of the Montparnasse cemetery, and we got a room on the 5th floor with said view. The surprisingly spacious family suite consisted of one living room with a sleeping couch for our two kids, and one bedroom with a 180 cm wide double bed for the grownups. There was a minibar, a safe, and a very efficient AC that handled the 33ºC heat outside without any problems. The only minor issue I had with this hotel was that the mattress was a bit too firm, it could definitely needed an over mattress. Highly recommended!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Good for a quick overnight
text: I found this hotel to be fine for a quick night’s stay. The room was comfortable and clean, but the location wasn’t my favorite. Luckily it is near a train and metro stop. We had a rate that included breakfast, but had to leave before it started  so they packed us a to go breakfast that was completely bizarre. For the price it was fine, but for a longer stay in Paris I would probably choose a different are.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Nice hotel, in a great little neighborhood
text: Stayed here for three nights, in the Montparnasse district (14th) - nice, local-type neighborhood; great cafes, lots of locals, was not a pretentious tourist trap neighborhood. Close to Montparnasse tower (awesome!), and the catacombs (fascinating). This hotel seems to be a part of the Esprit de France chain, and I would like to see one of their other hotels as well. This one was beautiful, very nice staff, and the room was great for a family of four! Bigger than I anticipated. Very clean, very classy.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Perfect Hotel in Paris
text: My mom and I stayed here for 5 nights. It's less than a block from a well situated metro station and surrounded by tons of restaurants. It is calm and quiet and a nice break from the more touristy parts of Paris. The hotel staff is quite helpful and the small bar underneath the hotel was a perfect place to have a drink each night. The rooms are very comfortable and the AC saved us during the heat wave!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Spacious, great location and super friendly staff!
text:
We were a family of five and stayed in the 2-bedroom suite. It was very spacious, clean with lots of natural light. The rooms had tea/coffee/hot chocolate with biscuits, while the bathrooms had very good toiletries.

The staff were very friendly and helpful. They helped us book our online tickets on the Louvre website as we were not familiar with the language.

Location wise it’s at a corner block, opposite to Raspail Metro Station and a 5 mins walk to Edgar Quinet Metro (direct train to Eiffel Tower), a further 10 mins to a great shopping area.

There’s a couple of very good cafe/restaurant next door too!

We would love to come back!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Business and leisure with quality
text: Overall, hotel above average than other similar ones that I stayed in Paris. Size of room is large and there are several options for families or individuals. We stayed in 3 people and had it all in separate spaces: bedroom, sanitary, shower + sink, coffee + minibar. Very good quality of linens, bed, towels. Location is great, close to Blvd Montparnasse, and in front of Lines 4/6, Metro Raspail. I recommend and I would say there again.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Excellent hotel in a really good location
text:
Very happy with our stay here - right next to Raspail metro station, only 10 minutes walk from Port Royal (RER stop from Charles de Gaulle airport, or you can change and get off at Raspail), plenty of bars and cafes and gardens nearby.
Staff were really friendly, breakfast excellent, hotel is beautifully designed. Soundproofing is good - we didn't hear anything from other rooms and minimal noise from the street. Would definitely return.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: AMAZING HOTEL, FRIENDLY TO TRAVELERS
text: You simply can't go wrong here!  Charming, friendly hotel with sumptuous bedding, robes, and towels.  I booked way in advance through the hotel's website and got free breakfast an incredible pricing.  We stayed in the apartment and even the sofa bed was VERY comfortable for adults.  (I've never said that about a sofa bed!)  The staff was incredibly nice and accommodating.  We stayed in many hotels throughout our 2.5 week trip and this one was the absolute best!  The breakfast was so nice and the waitstaff in the breakfast room was fantastic too.  The apartment had an iron and ironing board in the room as well as a hairdryer.  The only complaint is I couldn't figure out how to make the hairdryer stay on without holding the button down the whole time.  That's a pain with long thick hair that takes 20+ minutes to dry.  So...bring a hairdryer if that would bother you.  Otherwise, this place is just THE BEST!!!  Taxis, ubers, and the bus stop are directly outside the hotel.   One minute to walk to the metro.  Quiet location in Montparnasse.  VERY friendly to travelers and all hotel staff spoke perfect English too...so no worry if you have a language barrier.  You won't be disappointed choosing Hotel Aiglon!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Charming, small hotel
text: We throughly enjoyed our stay at this charming hotel.  The room was a very pleasant change from chain hotels.  We hope to return soon. And would recommend this hotel to friends who are traveling to Paris.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Weekend in Paris
text: perfect Location of the Hotel, Very friendly staff,  easy to reach From Airport CDG, by train.   very  good beds for  a relaxing  sleep. good restaurants  for a  good value in the neighbourhood.   will come back to the  same  hotel and recommend it to friends
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great Hotel
text: Well Maintained. Very close to the Raspail Metro Station which made getting to and from all the sites quite easy. Easy to get to and from the airport using the RER B train from CDG to Denfert-Rochereau Train station (only 1km south of the hotel). The room was nicely sized. Although the hotel is on the longest boulevard in Paris, the rooms were quite soundproof from street noise. The breakfast buffet was delicious, but not included in our room price. (That’s more of a cultural issue rather than an oversight.) I would recommend without reservation for a visit to Paris if you don’t mind riding the Metro.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Wonderful city trip
text:
A very nice hotel directly opposite a metro station. Jardin du Luxembourg and Montparnasse are within walking distance.
Generally I recommend to explore the districts like Marais, St.Germain, Montmartre on foot. It's just fun.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Stylish, friendly & comfortable
text: The hotel is at convenient location, metro line 4/6 is within 2 minutes walk.  Hands full restaurants around the street.  Hotel itself provides good breakfast at reasonable prices and the staff are very friendly
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Excellent rooms
text: We are 5 members family and stayed in two rooms since the family rooms were all booked. The provided us with adjacent rooms which was perfect. The rooms were very well furnished the toilet had everything and they were very clean. Beds were comfortable.  They left us a welcome msg with candies for the kids which was really nice. The only negative point is that there was no variety of the breakfast items same items were served every day. The food was good though.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Comfort and class
text:
Hotel Aiglon is a very nice hotel with a wonderful staff. The location is perfect for Shopping, dining, and as a base for seeing Paris. You have Metro, bus stop and trainstation near by. All the rooms in the are nice, clean, and quiet. The breakfast is very good and its a good start for a long day in Paris.
We have stayed at Hotel Aiglon in the Spring for many years, and will always return to our Hotel no 1.
Hotel Aiglon is highly Recommended.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: nice and spacious family room
text: The place is very clean and comfortable. the hotel is near metro station. The hotel reception people are very nice. I do not recommend to take the breakfast, the breakfast should be from 8 to 11:00, but if you come ~ 10:00 the hotel guy is already cleaning the place and not much is left. Over all it was very good experience.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Excellence and Comfort in Paris
text:
My family is getting bigger now so we need more space when we travel and Paris is notorious for cramped spaces acting as hotel rooms. Unless you can afford to splash out on a huge suite you are going to struggle but this location was excellent, because it was right by a cemetery, so quiet neighbours, but a pretty short walk and you are close to food and drink and the metro - 3 different metro stations. 

We had a family suite and it was lovely and very spacious for Paris. The quality of furnishings, art work and fabrics/sheets was really pleasing as well as the walk-in closet! The bed was a tad hard and our “King” was made up of 2 beds pushed together, so there was a definite gap in the middle which could be bothersome as the beds would separate pretty easily. 

The staff here were very helpful and kind we had no issues being English and American here since all staff were comfortable speaking English. I would definitely like to come back to this place.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Pleasant stay for two nights
text: The location of the hotel was very good. In the heart of Montparnasse, lively atmosphere and full of cafes and brasseries. Easy access to metro station and hop on - hop off buses. No disturbing street noise at night. The staff is polite and attentive. I would stay at this hotel again.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Everything to love here
text: Aiglon has a Great location, 15 minute walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and 10 min walk (wheeling suitcases) from Montparnasse station. The staff were friendly and helpful, the breakfasts amazing, and the rooms comfortable and clean - I could not ask for more!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: A WONDERFUL HOTEL IN THE HEART OF PARIS
text:
A spacious and very clean room, excellently located next to a metro station. The room has 2 bathroom sinks , a shower and a bath. Very convenient for a couple.
Very warm and helpfull staff.
We were sorry to leave!!!!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great location, stylish decor, friendly staff, attached parking
text: This hotel was much better than I expected - we are a family of 4, and stayed in room 449, which has 2 attached rooms (with 1 large king-sized bed + 2 twin beds) along with a bathroom in the middle. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful; the entire hotel is stylishly decorated and 2km walking distance to Notre Dame, Louvre, Luxembourg gardens, Latin Quarters
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Best Hotel in Paris
text: Would highly recommend this hotel. We had 3 adults in the family room. Breakfast and servers were WONDERFUL!! Loved everything about our stay. Check In to check out was flawless!! Room was very clean and bathroom great size. Noteworthy- Water pressure = Outstanding
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Excellent - I recommend
text: Professional, helpful and polite staff. Breakfast good but not outstanding. Superior room was excellent - nicely decorated with plenty of space. We would be happy to stay here again. Vavun station is nearer the action (Montparnasse in the evenings was buzzing), but Raspail metro is 50m from the hotel. Good walk down to Saint Michel through the Jardin Du Luxembourg and L'Odéon.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: An excellent place to stay
text:
We travelled to Paris recently, with our 2 adult children. One thing that I found difficult when searching for accommodation in France, including Paris, is actually finding somewhere that can accommodate us all. Sure, plenty of apartments and hotels will accommodate 4 adults, but this is usually assumed to be 2 couples and usually with a sofa bed - not really appropriate for adult daughter and son. I did find a few places, but in the end, settled with the Hotel Aiglon. We stayed here for 2 weeks.

We could not have been happier with our choice. We were given an apartment suite with 2 bedrooms, the second with 2 single beds, and 2 bathrooms.The suite was tastefully decorated and well maintained - obviously a sign of somewhere that takes this business seriously. Additionally, it is very spacious, a bonus for Paris.

Each morning we were graced with a simple but delicious breakfast of juices, yogurt, pastries, charcuterie, bacon & eggs and coffee. We were given a warm welcome each morning.

The staff were attentive and friendly at all times. Cheerio to Loic, who greeted us on arrival and assisted me to print some tickets to an event we attended.

At first glance, it may be argued that the Aiglon is not centrally located in Paris. In actual fact, this is not a problem and one should not be deterred by this. The hotel is about a 20 minute (or less) stroll to St. Germain-des-Pres, St. Michel, Luxembourg Gardens etc, a 5 minute walk to the lively Vavin and Gaite areas of Montparnasse - both which offer plentiful cafes & restaurants and shopping (including a Galleries Lafayette). Entry to the Metro is literally across the road, on Line 4, which will take you to St Germain (up-market shopping, cafes), St Michel (Notre Dame, St Chappelle, Shakespeare & Co), Les Halles (shopping, Pompidou Centre) and Montmartre (Sacre Coeur) without changing lines, and Line 6, which will take you directly to the Eiffel Tower.

I would definitely recommend the Hotel Aiglon to anyone visiting Paris.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Perfect family accommodation in Montparnasse, Paris
text: We stayed at this beautiful boutique hotel for 4nights with my children, 11 and 13 years old. A friend of us highly recommended it and we are very pleased that we followed her advice. It is a boutique hotel in the Montparnasse, 50 m from the metro station. Very spacious and clean room with a big window facing the street and two smaller ones on the bathroom. We all had shower and there were no humidity in the air. The room was just as shown on the hotel's website, even better. Really clean and soundproof with all the necessary facilities. The best part of our stay was definitely the breakfast. Excellent homemade pastries and jams, fresh juices and cheese, everything was delicious. All the staff were very polite and helpful. We will definitely stay again on our next visit to Paris. We recommend it, especially for families.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Weekend in Paris
text: Lovely hotel, comfy bed with quality bedding. Tourist attractions within walking distance if you don’t mind walking,if not hotel is very close to train links. I didn’t eat at the hotel but breakfast looked good.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Very Good Stay
text: My third stay at this boutique chain and so far I am 3 for 3 in terms of being happy w this hotel and value for price.  Room was updated and tastefully furnished.  Bed very comfortable.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Breakfast was delightful, everything you could want in a very nice room w big bright windows.  The neighborhood seemed kind of residential, which I personally liked, but someone visiting for the first time might prefer to be somewhere where there is more nightlife.  I also peeked into some of the rooms when they were doing housecleaning and the rooms did actually look like the pictures.  Definitely recommend.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Cozy hotel close to Raspail Metro station
text: This is a nice little hotel. It's just a few meters to the Raspail Metro Station. We used it a lot! The only problem was we did have to use the metro a lot because it is fairly far from all the main attractions. Next time we go I would rather stay closer to the Latin Quarter. But the hotel is very nice. The elevator is extremely small and slow. Breakfast was wonderful. Very nice staff. Spoke English fluently. Little tip: no air conditioning. We went for Christmas and opened the doors to the balcony because it was rather warm inside. We traveled throughout Europe and none of the hotels had AC which was fine because it was winter. Not sure what it's like in the Summer but just something to think about.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Room with a View
text: Small room but very nice hotel.  The breakfast is awesome....a bit pricey but worth it. The bathroom is super small, yet sitting in room looking at the street I felt the jest of Paris. The hotel is right across from a subway.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Great hotel
text: Very nice hotel. Bra location near to everything and the metro 100 meter from the hotel. Nice breakfast, lovely and helpful staff. Very clean room and cost beds. Easy to go to the airports with the train
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: A friendly hotel
text: Couldn't fault this lovely little hotel on Boulevard Raspail.  Staff very polite and friendly. Breakfast was delicious and the children especially enjoyed their hot chocolates.  The bathroom facilities were spacious.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: 6 night stay
text: Our family stayed here for 6 nights in the apartment. It was superb. Our adult daughters had their own section and bathroom. Tea coffee etc is also provided. We added breakfast to our booking and it is good value. The location is perfect and 2 minute walk to Raspail metro. We would definitely stay again. Heaps of restaurant choices within a 10 minute walk in several directions.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: New Year's weekend
text: Nice and very good hotel in a quiet and pleasant area of Paris with convenient access to the Metro, but it is situated a little off the shopping areas and main sights. Good restaurants are available on Blvd Raspail and Blvd Montparnasse and within walkiong distance. We spent the New Years weekend there and enjoyed our stay. We may come back another time.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Very comfortable stay is promosed
text: Quite comfortable stay!! In such cold winter in Paris, electric kettle for tea, bath tab and spacious room were so helpful  for my long stay. Will come back to this hotel when visiting Paris next time!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Nice, clean hotel but had some issues
text: The room was tidy and neat (other than a bug that first greeted us in the room - but, not sure how much they could have prevented that). The bathroom was especially nice - it had clearly been recently updated and was very clean. We interacted with 4 different staff members, and 3 of them were very kind and helpful (provided restaurant recommendations and directions). I called down to the front desk on the first night to ask about the radiators; the gentleman (the fourth employee we interacted with) who answered the phone talked to someone else about guns for a solid minute before greeting me. It was incredibly uncomfortable. Additionally, the alarm went off at 12:30am on our final night...everyone in the hotel rushed down to the lobby only to find out that nothing was wrong and went off by mistake. The location of the hotel is not super central to Paris, but is located close to a Metro station.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Cosy Hotel au coeur de Montparnasse
text: Mon hotel préferé a Paris :I like staying in Aiglon due to its location but also thanks to the very nice stuff.Always feeling at home independent if I come for business or leisure purposes. Merci et a bientot!
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Good location: good value.
text:
Spent 3 nights here.

We took a suite on the 4th floor, room 45. The room was beautifully presented, clean and comfortable. Bar fridge was well stocked and, for Paris, reasonably priced.

The breakfast was pretty standard - fruit, breads, scrambled eggs, ham, jams, yogurt etc for €18 each. A continental breakfast is available for €10 each.

The staff, from reception to cleaners, were polite and helpful.

There are a number of bistros locally which vary in quality. A Metro station is virtually at the door.

A very fine seafood restaurant, Le Duc, considered one of the best of its type in Paris, is also only a very short walk away. The food was absolutely outstanding.

Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Totally mediocre hotel
text:
How is this hotel considered a four star hotel?  I just moved from a different four star hotel in Paris to the Aiglon and the difference is huge.  I can’t believe that are both in the same category.

Firstly, let’s talk about the positives:
- we booked a suite and it was huge.  Best value for money in Paris.  Two bathrooms and a living room.  
- breakfast was delicious and included in our room rate.
- overall front house staff seemed nice with the exception of a rather surly older gentleman in the evenings.

However - there were definitely some negatives:
- there was a bug that looked like a beetle in the elevator.
- there was a spider in my bedroom
- on one day the cleaning staff left the door to my room open after they finished.  Anyone could have gone into my room and stolen my belongings.  This was probable my biggest grievance.  
- not the most central location in Paris if you like to walk to the major tourist sights.  

I’m not sure I would return to this hotel.  Which is a shame because I had wanted to like it so much based on other reviews.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Cozy and stylish hotel, convenient location
text: It was an overall excellent stay. The room was spacious and stylish, everything was clean and the staff was friendly and very helpful (they booked restaurants and museum tickets for us). The hotel is just across a metro station, which was super convenient. There are many bistros and cafes in the neighborhood (we had some really delicious crepes in a small creperie at Rue du Montparnasse), but we would recommend a nice 15 minute walk towards the Saint Germain area, for more elegant and not so touristic restaurants. We would definitely stay here again.
name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Nice Petit Hotel
text: Great cost-benefit hotel in the Montparnasse quartier, lots of restaurants, cafés, boulangeries, street markets and supermarkets all around. Raspail metro station is right across the street. The Luxembourg gardens at a quick walking distance. Room itself is very cozy, renovated, bathroom with bathtub and shower, and yet a little veranda (our was the classical room, pretty spacious for Paris standards). Small staff, but all nice and attentive. All I can say is 'merci beaucoup'.

title: Un Bon  Quartier

name: Hotel Aiglon

title: Best quality

title: Very good

title: Beautiful gem!
text:
My husband, our 11 year old son and I stayed at the Grand Powers for 3 nights in September.  The hotel is in a great location near the Champs Elysees.  Hotel lobby is small but cozy and warm.  We were immediately greeted by everyone in the lobby when we walked in.  

I splurged and chose a balcony room with Eiffel tower view.  We were in room 508 and it did NOT disappoint.  It was very spacious and the balcony large (compared to other room balconies).  There was ample space for the pull out sofa which was very comfortable.  The rooms are nicely decorated.  Bathroom is spacious and shower was good size and great water pressure.  Turn down service nightly.  

There is some street noise but nothing too bad.  We opened our window and balcony a few nights and it was refreshing and the noise on street was not sleep prohibitive.

We had breakfast included and it was good.  A nice selection of fruit, cheeses, meats, breads and pastries. You could order eggs as well.  Staff at the Cafe were so lovely to interact with.  They noticed my son did not eat much of the scrambled eggs he requested and they asked what was wrong with them and said they would fix that for the following day.  It is the little things!

Best part of the Grand Powers is the staff.  I never saw one person with a frown on their face. They were all lovely to interact with and very helpful.  I felt like they truly enjoyed their jobs and working at the Grand Powers.  Pierre, one of the concierge's actually recommended a pop up boutique shop nearby for me to take a look in.  It had just opened the day I arrived and open only 6 months. A great recommendation. 
 All the concierge's I spoke with with were pleasant and very helpful.

I highly recommend the Grand Powers hotel and have no hesitation to stay there again.  Great location, FANTASTIC staff, beautiful rooms, BOUTIQUE.

title: It All Makes Sense
text: My wife and I stayed at this property along with some friends from 04/23/2022 - 04/26/2022.  When I booked this property several months in advance (when they were still working Hyatt) I had a very good feeling about it,  based on the reviews and the very high Trip Advisor ranking.  Simply put, we were not disappointed.  All of the staff were super nice and friendly.  It's clear, that the expectation of quality guest service has been ingrained within the staff.  Our Superior Room on the second floor was DEFINITELY larger than the majority of hotel rooms in Europe; and although you could tell that multiple smaller mattresses made up the bed, it was basically a king sized bed with room to spare.  Our room also had a small balcony with a bistro set if you wished to spend sometime out there eating or people watching.  The bathroom is fantastic and arguably the best part of the room.  Marble everywhere.  If I had to provide one minor bit of feedback it would be the bathroom faucet itself.  Basically, it sticks way too far out.  If you're washing your face, you need to be careful when bending down and potentially slamming your head into the thing.  It needs to be shortened.  You will understand this when you see it, and you'll realize that I'm not nitpicking.  This is the ONLY drawback I found.  Outlets are everywhere.  Water pressure is strong.  The in room temperature unit works like a charm.  There's a small desk to sit and work if needed.  You can connect your device to the tv via bluetooth to play in the room speakers and there's a switch inside the bathroom that will turn on speakers in the bathroom also.  We had breakfast at the property during one of the mornings there.  It was decent and the staff was very attentive.  Grand Powers is located right off the Champs-Elysees in a very very nice neighborhood.  A 10 minute walk will have you in the thick of things.  This is a pricey property, but something tells me that the folks who stay here normally don't really worry about  that sort of stuff.  All in all, this is an excellent excellent property.  I would stay here again in a heartbeat.  Don't even give it a second thought.  Do it.

title: Phenomenal hotel for families
text:
Our family of 5 (kids age 13, 8, 7) just spent an incredible week with the Grand Powers family.  We got off to a great start when we arrived 14 hours after leaving our house in the US and the staff greeted my wife and me with espresso and the kids with pastries and juice.  Our rooms weren't ready, but they gave us a small room to shower and change in and recommended a nearby bistro (Chez Andre) for a delicious, casual lunch.

The location is perfect: easily walkable to the Arc de Triomphe, Trocadero, Eiffel Tour, Champs Elysees, Seine, and Tuilleries.  The finest retailers and brands are within blocks.  We took the subway all over using nearby stations on the 1, 9, and C lines.

The rooms were ready when we got back from lunch and the staff had already moved all of our luggage into them for us.  The rooms (204 & 205) were perfect.  They shared an external door and then had separate doors to each room after that external door.  They were spacious, beautifully decorated, and both had balconies with a small bistro table and two chairs.  We could even see the top of the Eiffel Tour from the edge of the 205 balcony.  My wife and I would have a glass of wine and some sweets on our balcony after the kids went to sleep.  Only rooms on a couple floors have balconies, so we got lucky!  204 also has a nice tub.

The facilities are perfect.  We enjoyed breakfast every morning, had a delicious dinner one night, and had coffee outside one afternoon.  The hot tub was a welcome relief after walking 6-8 miles a day and the kids had fun splashing around in it.

But the real gems of the Grand Powers are its staff.  Everyone is exceptionally friendly, helpful, and engaging and they went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable and enjoying our stay.  The front desk staff was always smiling and ready to meet every need.  The concierges' restaurant and shopping recommendations were spot on.  They took a couple Polaroids of our family that we'll put into our photo album from the trip and they have other amenities for families (like action figures) that we didn't use but that might appeal to other families.  But, what sticks with me is how much they all seem to love their jobs and welcoming guests into the hotel.  They were always happy to chat about Paris sights, food, culture, sports, etc.  We felt like friends by the end of the trip -- the benefit of staying at a high-end boutique hotel where every guest is valued.

There is a lot of world to see, but we may have to go back to Paris soon just to stay at the Grand Powers!
