title: disney
text: we booked this hotel because it was not far from station for taking the train to Disney. Afterwards we found out this was a perfect location to travel around in Paris, taking the metro not far from the hotel.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Good one
text: Hotel is just a 3 min Walk from the Metro station with line directly to arc triomphe, Champs-Elysées, La Défense, jardin tulleries and Louvre.  the room was clean and tidy and had a good size for a short stay. Only the arpet seemed a bit old and dirty, a new one wood be great here. Also the bath room was modern and clean. The room service made the bedsheets every day, but didn’t bring out the garbage. Didn’t have breakfast but 14€ seemed a bit to much for us. We had a good stay. Hotel is highly recommended.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Good hotel, sketchy neighborhood, excellent late-night pizza
text: Hotel nice and clean, staff friendly. It's not a particularly good neighbourhood, but it's within easy walking distance of an all-night pizza place that is brilliant value for money. For budget accommodation in Paris it's a good choice.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Great location
text: A very decent little hotel. Great location next to little shops and very close to Metro and tram lines. The room was clean and tidy and each morning there was a good buffet breakfast. The reception staff were helpful.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Superb hotel
text: Really really loved this hotel. The ONLY single problem was parking as none was available at or near the hotel. I know the hotel are not responsible for this but guidance as to local car parks would be a good idea. I would certainly stay here again. In fact, the family has decided to go back again. Soon
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Great stay
text: The rooms are extremely smaller than what we were used to!! We only booked one room for myself, my husband and two kids under three. We had to get two rooms just to accommodate us. The fro t desk attendant was very accommodating. He went out of his way to find us rooms near each other for a fair price. He actually made our stay enjoyable. I wish I could remember his name but thank you for great service at check in. Nice full breakfast buffet and great location near public transportation, shops and a park. Quiet area too!! The room is functional yet comfortable.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: good hôtel
text: Hall of the hotel is nice, rooms are with good space and decoration nice, not so far the subway station, good price, calm location in a little street, a few good restaurants at 5 to 10 mn walk. However, the breakfast room is too small so on morning it can be difficult.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: clean and tiny
text: Service is good enough but it has a smallbreakfast buffet. Room is quite clean and small and its amenities are complete. Staffs are polite and helpful. location is not in the city center but near to two main line of metro and train with easy access to Charle De Goule and Orly airport.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Recommandable
text:
Nice, quiet and good service. Very close to all public transportation, This place is pecfect place for people who need a good one but can't afford staying in High standard's hotels.
Nice staff at the reception and good manager's initiative.
 I had my free Beaujolais, though..! lol!!!
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: pleasant stay
text: Nice and pleasant stay. It's a comfortable and clean hotel, in a residential area, just a few minutes from the nearest subway station, and close to cafes, restaurants and supermarkets. Staff was very friendly and the price was very fair.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Review about Best Western Hotel
text: It's a good hotel to stay in Paris. I've stayed for 2 days with my wife to know the city. The rooms are comfortable and clean. The attendants are polite and solicitous. There is a subway station near to the hotel to get around the city.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Very charmy, modern and well-located hotel in the heart of Paris
text: The rooms have been recently refurbished and offer a modern, luxury and nice atmosphere. Very quiet rooms, as well as very friendly and cooperative personnel. The hotel is very close to the Nation metro station, to be reached by feet. I can only recommend this hotel to families who want to visit Paris.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Good Value
text: Spent 3 nights here on business. Perfectly placed for me to get out to the east but easy to get into the centre of Paris on Line 1. The hotel is on a quiet back street, very warm welcome from the desk staff every time I passed by. I didn’t have the breakfast but it seemed a little pricey. My room was extremely clean, with a comfortable bed, nice and warm and well equipped including a fridge. The free bottle of water was a nice touch. My only minor gripe I’ve got is that in an attempt to fill the room space available, the wardrobe is half size, by that I mean you can’t hang trousers full length and a long shirt touches the top of the fridge/safe. The area is really nice, good restaurants and cafes with tram metro and RER all minutes away.  I’ll definitely stay here again.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Good value for money
text: We spent here 3 nights during a business trip. Our bedroom was small but clean (there were 2 twin beds) and there was not enough space if 2 people have to stand up at the same time. We used the room service for breakfast one of the 3 days and the food variety was good. Overall a good experience.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Clean hotel, great location
text: This hotel is perfect for a short stay in Paris. The metro is a two minute walk from the hotel and it is only a 20 minute metro journey to attractions such as the Louvre. The location itself is ideal, somewhat quieter than tourist locations but still very busy with a typically French patisserie just a short walk down the road and a McDonald's across the road. Though the rooms are quite small (and the lift not suitable for more than 2 people), they are very clean and comfortable. The shower is powerful and the beds very comfortable. We were pleasantly surprised to also find a high quality docking station/alarm in our room, suited to an iPhone 4 or older iPhone model. Staff members were helpful and offered to take care of our luggage after check out. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would definitely visit again.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Small and cozy
text:
We stayed here for three nights for a long weekend in Paris. We were greeted by a really nice man at the front desk who was really helpfull and serviceminded. 
The room was small, but OK. The bathroom was nice and clean, and the shower was huge. We ate breakfast at the hotel two days, and it was a nice basic breakfast. Worth the price! 
The location of the hotel is right around the corner of a metro stop, so getting everywhere is easy. 

All in all we had a good stay!
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Great experience
text: The moment you enter , you see Paul at the front desk. A real jolly , friendly and helping guy. Hotel is minutes away from metro. Rooms are cozy , comfy and good service . There is also a great food area few minutes walk with a lot of Turkish restaurants . Pharmacy is just opposite to the hotel . Overall , great . 5/5
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Allows the Pais of people not just Tourists &Crowds
text:
Set round the corner from the Metro and a cross linking Tram  with a Mickey Ds  round the corner should  budget or kids demand.  Breakfast most days has a good selection  but  self service and with cooling precooked items  if your eating after 10. Items available for our first two days were not on offer on Tuesday which had a limited choice still available for us when arriving 30 minutes before Breakfast closes. There is only self service but enough to survive  even when less available.
Our 4th floor room , 405. had the basic needs and despite being near the tiny lift had no noise problem and we had restful sleep. Would stay again  but eat in Nation or before leaving the Centre of Paris as the local offering can be hit or Miss and that miss could be by Miles .
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Average hotel
text:
I stayed in this hotel during my visit to Paris. The hotel is small but that's the case with most hotels in Paris. The bed was comfortable and I would recommend the hotel if you are staying for a short trip. It is far from the top attractions but the train station is very close by. 
I did not like the fact that I had to pay a deposit for the mini bar, which was quite steep. For some odd reason the machine initially refused to accept my credit card and I had to pay cash, which was quite annoying. There are few eating areas close by.
name: Best Western Plus 61 Paris Nation Hotel

title: Great staff and location in Paris.
text:
The staff at this very well located hotel makes all the difference. Excellent group of people at the front desk and at breakfast. 
Conveniently located close to restaurants, metro, bars, bakeries, cheese shops, wine stores etc. Great value.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Hôtel les matins
text:
Couple trip
I was not totally satisfied with the proposed services 
Too many morning noises . 
Personal services is ok 
They did not respect prepaid services 
Localisation of the hôtel is ok 
Breakfast is ok and various
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Best bed ever
text: What a fantastic stay. The hotel is close to the metro (Saint-georges)  shops and restaurants. We found the room a little small but we booked the cheapest room so there may be some bigger. The bed however, makes up for this. It was the comfiest bed we have ever slept in-great after a day of exploring Paris. We will be back.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Excellent
text: We had a lovely stay at this small hotel. Friendly staff, really clean, wonderful beds and it smelled really nice. A few minutes walk to the metro station and lots of nice restaurants around the corner. We can really recommend the ice cream store around the corner: with a macaron filled with ice cream on top of your ice cream :)
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: A wonderful hotel
text:
Everything was perfect, the room had a terrace that was lovely to sit and relax and the bath room Juliet terrace faced the Effie’s tower. Breakfast was delicious and hotel staff was great, friendly and helped with anything they could. I would go back anytime I go to Paris.
I have one complaint we are going back to Paris and hotel was booked, smart people.
Larry and Sandi cohen
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Nice city hotel with a very good location
text: Really nice small hotel with a good location between Opèra and Montmartre. The Metro is nearby and in the evening you have lots of nice restaurants, Brasseries and bars in the neighborhood. Breakfast is with self-service but there is everything you need. The rooms are very nice and modern.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great value for the price
text:
Overall my stay was quite pleasant. The location was excellent, it’s in a very quaint neighborhood and it’s easy enough to get around. As for the hotel itself, it’s very clean and updated. I had a spectacular view from my hotel room. My room was very very small though.  If I was traveling with a companion, they wouldn’t fit their luggage in the room with mine. I wish I knew that before booking, I would have upgraded to a bigger room.

My one issue was with privacy. I had staff walk in on me in my room multiple times. They would knock and instantly walk in without giving much of a warning. Also, the headboard was against the wall to the hallway, so in the middle of the night when people returned to their rooms, their doors would slam and my bed would shake. I recommend moving the beds on the opposite wall of the hallway. 

I still enjoyed my stay regardless.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Amazing, friendly and beautiful little hotel
text: We couldn’t recommend this hotel highly enough. Friendly, welcoming, accommodating and helpful from the moment we arrived. Spotlessly clean, lovely decor and great location. We could not fault it! Thanks
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Fantastic hotel!
text: Stayed for 3 nights, wonderful hotel, we stayed in a classic room which had everything we needed and more, including robes and slippers. The staff were very friendly and the breakfast was delicious. The location is fantastic, lots of little cafes and bars and a short walk to Montmarte. There are numerous metro stations to choose from nearby. I would definitely stay here again!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great location, quiet
text: The hotel is nice and clean.  Front of house staff very helpful.  It is very easy to walk to all the main shopping areas and Louvre.  However the room was depressing.  Clean but the colours used to decorate it drab grey with little natural light make it not a place you want to be in more than necessary.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect stay
text:
A truly fantastic experience right from the moment we arrived,  very friendly people at reception, day and night , lovely room, and the comfiest bed imaginable. 
Excellent location , metro just  couple of minutes away , easy connections to all areas of Paris.
Plenty local bars and restaurants or if you prefer room service it's available 24 hours a day.
Will definitely  be back and would recommend without hesitation.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Quaint and comfortable
text: I really liked my stay at this hotel. It was cute and quaint. It’s smaller than the hotels I usually stay at but I think that’s the secret. I noticed that boutique hotels have a more personal touch and they’re more willing to help you. Bigger chain hotels sometimes lose the customer service experience where here it’s very personalized and much warmer. I had a last-minute delay in my flight and the hotel handled my pick up to the airport without any problems. They rescheduled me and I was so grateful. My bed was comfortable and the room was extremely clean even the bathroom. The only little issue that I feel might need improving is the closet space. It’s a little too small for my liking. But other than that honestly I would definitely come back here. The area is perfect it’s within minutes from the metro. And if there are days that you don’t wanna travel into the city center there are plenty of restaurants and patisseries and shopping in this area. Perfect even for some last-minute souvenirs. On my next trip to Paris this hotel will definitely be back on my list.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: A beautiful hotel in a great location.
text:
Beautiful hotel, spotlessly clean. Great location for bars and shops. Walking distance to Montmartre. 
The hotel treated us to a few gifts as we were on honeymoon.
Our room was compact but spotlessly clean and modern. Our room even had a view of the Eiffel Tower!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Ideal Pigalle location
text:
Apart from some issues with equipment functionality in my room, the property, staff and location were all good reasons to stay at this property.

title: Delighted with everything about this hotel
text: Absolutely perfect for a valentines getaway, really happy we went for the room with a terrace and spa access. Perfectly placed right in the middle of the tourist attractions, so much so we walked everywhere and saw all the sights.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: The best stay ever!
text: It was the best stay ever! The staff attended to all my requests and provided me with excellent recommendations that made me enjoy Paris much more. I will definitely be gone back to this hotel again soon
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect stay
text:
We visit Paris for a short tourist trip just to relax.
We stayed in Hotel Les Matins de Paris and we really enjoy our stay.
All the staff was excellent, rooms was nice, breakfast good etc. etc.
Actually I cut my hand and need some assistance from a Doctor and the girl in reception was an excellent help before I visit the doctor and when we returned to the Hotel.
So I can only give our best recommendation and we will defiantly come back :-)
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect Stay
text:
This is the perfect hotel to experience a Parisian neighborhood and yet be close enough to walk or bus to touristic areas. The hotel is just off the Rue de Martyrs which is a foodie heaven. The staff was super nice and welcoming the beds were incredibly comfy.  
I didn’t have breakfast there, but the dining area looked cozy, nicer and bigger than other places I’ve seen/stayed.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: The perfect place to unwind after a busy day exploring Paris
text: The bed was one of the comfiest I have ever stayed in. The staff were warm, welcoming and very accommodating. I love the area in general with ample cafes on your doorstep. I would definitely stay again
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Definitely recommend
text: We stayed at Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa for 4 nights, location of the hotel is really good with several cafes and bakeries nearby. Staff was very courteous and supportive throughout our stay and the rooms were comfortable

title: Pleasant stay
text: We stayed at Les Matins for one night. The room was little bit too small (but it is unfortunately normal in Paris), but it was clean and prepared as in my wish. The staff is very helpful. It is definitely worth to stay at Les Matins in Paris.

title: I’ll rebook one dy
text: I was due to arrive this month but sadly due to covid I was unable to travel. The customer service I received, from the initial enquiry of my booking to the unfortunate cancellation, has been great. Always a quick and professional response. I am devastated I had to cancel as I was so excited about my visit. Thank you for your wonderful customer service. I WILL stay one day and tell everyone I know to do the same when in Paris. Stay well.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Amazing hotel, great location.
text:
My boyfriend and I stayed for three nights and it was the most amazing hotel. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful and couldn't do enough for us. The decor is beautiful and the bed was incredibly comfortable. We had 45 minutes of free spa time included with the room which was one of the highlights of our trip. 
The location was perfect for exploring and sightseeing, not too close to the centre but still in the hustle and bustle with loads of great shops, cafes and restaurants close by. Overall a fantastic stay, thank you so much!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Friendly and great location.
text: Friendly and welcoming staff. Communal areas of the hotel were great and very well presented and the location was perfect. The addition of the spa was a real bonus. The only negative was the room service we ordered, it was very disappointing and over priced €6 for a fruit salad that consisted of a few sloppy slices of orange and grapefruit! And the pasta was simply gross. But apart from that we loved the hotel and would definitely visit again ( we just wouldn’t order room service)
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

The hotel was absolutely horrible was not close to anything that we wanted to see tourist hop on hop off bus and it was all supposed to be with in walking distance, we had to take a cab over to the train station to get over to the Eiffel Tower and Catch hop on hop off buses. Now for the cleaning ladies they were way out of control and unacceptable, two times the head cleaning ladies use the master key did not knock or nothing else just open the door & ask if we wanted tea the 1st. & 2nd. time ask if we want water. The second day we put the do not disturb sign on the door and we get back and we have a cleaning lady coming out of our room, we asked her what she was doing and she thought you were cleaning. OK The bed was not made & the shower was the same dirty towels on the floor. I will never never again stay active hotel.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Lovely
text: Beyond beautiful, romantic and exactly what we were looking for, Paris wouldn’t be the same without it. We will stay here again for sure. Paris is lovely anytime of year but especially Xmas time. France is our favorite
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect Night Destination
text: Excellent location. The room was small, but it was very clean and comfort. Very friendly and  helpful staff. Breakfast was not very rich but it was very good quality and free coffee. The bar was small but pleasant for a glass of wine. Ονerall a pleasant stay.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Very friendly hotel!
text:
Only stayed one night for our short city break but would have loved to have stayed here longer!
As our train got in at 1030 we got to the hotel well before the usual check in at 1600. I only intended to leave one of our rucksacks in storage at reception so we could explore the city more comfortably but the staff were so kind as to let us have our room around 4 hours early! In the room we found that they had left a lovely little package for my 8 Yr old comprising of toiletries, a little pair of slippers and a teddy bear! He was over the moon! They had also left a lovely bottle of wine on ice.
As there is a spa on the lower floor, gorgeous fluffy dressing gowns and slippers were provided too.
The room was a lovely size with a small balcony which was great to look out over the district. (we were on floor 5 though!)
Anything you might need was supplied and we were told more than once, anything else we might need, call them.
Breakfast was great, lots of options and more than enough. Don't expect a full English, but there are eggs, streaky bacon and little sausages. Plenty of breads, pastries, meats, cheeses, yogurts and fruit.
We had 45 minutes in the spa and you reserve it. It is probably because the area is quite small but it is lovely, and clean. The steam room was relaxing and my son liked the pool.
The location of this hotel is great. Easy walk to and from gare du nord. Nearest metro is Saint George's, less than 5 mins walk away. You can walk straight into some great areas from the hotel. Nice street nearby with little shops and eateries.
Above all, the staff make this hotel. So friendly and welcoming, nothing seems too much trouble. They are a credit to the place and I hope they are recognised as such.
Highly recommend staying here, location great, staff fab and hotel itself clean, comfortable and well equipped!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: A lovely hotel
text:
We stayed here for three nights to celebrate a special birthday. We had an upgraded room 601 which was modern, clean and very comfortable. The only negative about the room was that it was located near the lift which you could hear every time it was used which became annoying if you couldn’t get to sleep and was the only noise you could hear as otherwise it was extremely quiet. The small swimming pool is very relaxing after a day sightseeing.
The hotel is situated in a lovely spot with easy access to a variety of shops , cafes and restaurants and within walking distance of many of the iconic Parisian sites. 
The staff at the hotel were superb. They were extremely helpful and courteous. On the second day my wife hurt her ankle as a result of a fall and had to use crutches. Claire, the manager, Julia and Raoul provided us with very much appreciated help and support and even helped me celebrate my birthday with champagne and cake. 
We plan to visit Paris again next Spring and we will certainly stay here again. We cannot recommend it highly enough
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Good find
text: Great hotel in a fab location. Staff were most welcoming throughout the trip. Rooms were smaller than expected but cosy with very comfortable beds.  The only negative was clothes storage - hooks on wall could have helped to improve this.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Weekend in Paris
text:
This is a comfortable hotel with excellent staff with easy links to many attractions.
When  we next come to Paris we will  stay here again.
the rooms are comfortable and the breakfast was excellent. spa looks good but we did not have time to use it.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great location, clean cosy rooms
text: This small hotel has a wonderfull location in the center of old Paris, only 5 minutes away from 3 different metro stations and within 10 minutes walking to Moulin Rouge and 20 minutes walking to Montmartre. I stayed for 5 nights. Although the rooms are pretty small (no place for a big troley), they were cleaned every day and the personnel was very nice. A very good place for business travelers, especially if not accompanied.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: recommended
text: very clean hotel in a good location and very friendly staff.  Coffees, tea and water in the bar are free all day and the hotel has a honesty policy for the alcohol consumed by guests.  You just write down what you have consumed.  There are good restaurants and bars within walking distance.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Lovely, small hotel; very helpful staff
text:
Located in the 9th arrondissement, this little gem is near so many charming streets and shops, and perhaps a 15-minute walk to Pigalle. It is clean and crisp, and the front desk staff is particularly helpful and many are very friendly, aiming at customer satisfaction. They bent over to make my stay comfortable.
The breakfast is very nice, with many fresh choices.
I am not sure whether this is a hotel for nudists/naturalists! The armoire holds a few items on hangers and there are no drawers, no chests. Prepare to live out of your luggage! And there is little space in the bathroom to store any toiletries. My partner said therefore it was for men!
The lack of storage is why I did not rate the hotel five stars; it was my one objection.
Also, the pool is private and a nice, relaxing break. For some reason, there are no towels there.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Pleasant hotel in a lovely area of Paris
text:
Arrived in Paris for a 4 day visit with my family to this very pleasant hotel.
Nicely decorated in a modern, quirky style. It was very clean and tidy throughout looking like it may well have been refurbished recently?
Our rooms (we booked 2) were bijoux but very adequate for a city break. We didn't have a view in either room but that was not a problem for us as we were out all day. Everything in the room worked ie. Shower/air conditioning well. 
The staff were all extremely pleasant and spoke excellent english too, apart from one young lady on reception with untidy hair who was not and came across as a little condescending - not what we expected but it did not spoil what was otherwise a good hotel experience.
We didn't use the spa, so can't comment on it.
We didn't have the breakfast, as so many wonderful places to eat out just outside the hotel. Lots of other people did use the breakfast facilities though.
Most of the reception staff were lovely and helpful, and very knowledgeable about the local area and city sightseeing. They gave us a map and looked after our luggage on our last day.
Some very minor things that could be improved; provide a soap dish next to the room basin so the cleaner does not throw the soap away if you just leave it on the side; replenish the room tea/coffee/sugar etc adequately each day.
The local area outside the hotel is lovely and well worth an explore. Some great boutique shopping, excellent bakeries and patisseries, some very good café's and restaurants literally yards from the hotel. It feels very safe and appears to be popular with both families and young people too. There were a few tramps hanging around but this seems the norm for most cities now.
All in all would recommend.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Classy hotel in a great little corner of Paris
text: Excellent location - especially if you like Montmartre and you want to walk straight to your hotel from the Gare du Nord. The service was exceptionally friendly and informative. There is an honesty box for drinks at the bar, and there are some excellent cafes, brasseries, boulangeries and restaurants right out on the nearby Rue des Martyrs. Little tip too: if you're going to Giverny, it's only a 10 minute walk from the Gare St Lazare.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Wonderfully nice hotel with beautiful interior decoration, very friendly and helpful staff and perfect location!
text: First, you get welcomed with an offer to drink some water or coffee, and you instantly feel at home! Nice rooms, ours had a balcony! Room service included, you can have your delicious, french pain-au-chocolat-and-more breakfast delivered to your room! The spa has to be reserved on arrival which at first seemed a little strange (because I had hoped to be able to use it anytime), but this has turned out to be perfect! You have the whole Spa and Hammam for private use, and you get a fresh, ice cold tea and fresh fruit included. The location is unique: just a footwalk away from Sacré-Coer, a whole lot of nice restaurants and bakeries around, and near the next Metro station where you can e.g. go directly with line 7 to the Louvre. Beautiful!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Fantastic Hotel!!
text: Fantastic hotel, friendly and helpful staff. The rooms are well presented and the beds super comfy. Breakfast was superb! In a lovely district of Paris with some fantastic shops and restaurants close by. Would recommend a stay there.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Ticks all the Boxes!
text:
This is a gem of a hotel. Ideal location: central, safe and never far from nice patisserie store, creperie or restaurant. The hotel is spotlessly clean and very modern (albeit the upstairs would benefit from a little brightening). The rooms are nicely furnished and the bed is extremely comfortable. It is worth mentioning that the rooms are compact, and the shower in our room was over a bath with a high step, which may be an issue for some. 

We particularly liked the coffee and tea-making facilities which were accessible and complimentary at all times. Breakfast was very fresh. The spa facilities (pool and steam room) are a real asset to the hotel; ensure you book your 45 minute slot in advance. A perfect way to unwind after a long day of sightseeing. 

The staff could not have been more helpful, particularly Claire and Victor. Claire helped us to plan our days and gave us tips for the best way of visiting a particular place. (The metro is extremely efficient. Montmartre, within walking distance from the hotel, is worth a visit in the evening)

A more than enjoyable stay and it goes without saying that we highly recommend.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Fantastic as always
text:
The facilities are great, the location is superb with 2 metro lines within a 5 minute walk and a good selection of restaurants, bars and cafes within 2 minutes. 
The rooms and bathrooms are clean and very well equipped. 
Above all, the staff are courteous and attentive with nothing being too much trouble. 
Highly recommended.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Amazing boutique hotel in a wonderful neighborhood!
text: Our family of 4 all loved Hotel Les Matins!   The staff was all so wonderful, giving us recommendations for nearby restaurants among other helpful tips..  Our teens were thrilled to have their own room and bathroom, and the neighborhood was very quiet and safe....we would have felt totally comfortable letting our kids walk around without us to explore all the bakeries, shops, and various boutiques.   The breakfast was extremely convenient for a busy day trying to run out the door, and the honor bar was perfect for relaxing before dinner after a full day of sightseeing or enjoying a nightcap!    Spa was also great with a eucalyptus steam room.     Would have loved to have bought some of their bath/both products, so I need to look them up on Amazon!    Definitely recommend this hotel to anyone - family or couples - coming to Paris.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
We were lucky enough to stay in one of the deluxe rooms in this hotel, and it was more than big enough for two of us. The room was clean with a big comfy bed and a large clean bathroom with shower. We also had a cosy balcony with wonderful views of Parisien rooftops and the Sacre Coeur. Breakfast was ample including tea, coffee, juice and a varied continental selection of food. Make sure to book the spa, it's worth it since you get exclusive use and the wonderful staff bring you some iced tea if you'd like it.
The hotel is in a brilliant location, a 15 minute walk from Montmatre and Sacre Coeur, there are a few metro stations within a ten minute walk, and there are loads of lovely shops and eateries in the vicinity. It's also about a 10-15 minute walk from Boulevard Haussmann for Paris shopping.
The staff were so friendly and helpful, nothing was too much trouble for them, and you were always greeted with a friendly face upon returning. We had a wonderful stay.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: LOVELY HOTEL IN FAB LOCATION
text: We have just returned from a 4 day stay at this lovely hotel.  We booked a superior room, and like other reviewers, found it a little on the small side, though adequate for our needs.  It would have been nice to have had a set of drawers in the room to unpack properly but it wasn't a huge issue.  The little pool and steam room were a real bonus and it was so nice to have exclusive use.  It is advisable to book ahead before your stay to ensure availability.  Breakfast was more than ample and  available for 4 hours each day.  There was a wide selection of meats, cheeses, eggs, breads, salad and pastries, along with juices and hot drinks.  We found the staff to be extremely helpful and courteous and nothing was too much trouble.  The only reason I have not given 5 out of 5 is that on checking out we were delayed somewhat as the concierge stated we had booked on a room only basis without breakfast and he wanted to charge us for breakfast each day.  I had booked a rate including breakfast but he was adamant this was not the case.  It was only when I found my confirmation email (after some time as I thought it had been deleted) that he agreed to take the breakfasts off the bill.  We were then late leaving for the airport and I was a little flustered to say the lease.  If I had not found the email we would have had another 144 euros added.  It was a rather stressful end to an otherwise very pleasant stay.   Message to self:  always print of a hard copy of confirmation email before leaving home in future.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Shine On!
text: If you have read any of the reviews for Hotel les Matins, then you already know this place is special for lots of reasons.  The friendly staff, the clean rooms, breakfast, honor bar, spa, central location in a great neighborhood, and all the rest.  But it is always when you need things that you don’t really think about when you travel that the place you have chosen to stay either shines or falls flat on it’s face.  We needed medical help for a sinus infection...antibiotics.  The staff found a doctor, made the appointment and the visit was quick, easy and successful.  We had to make and unravel some plans.  Again, the staff did everything they could to make these things possible and successful.  And there were always smiles.  Welcoming smiles and time for conversations about the day and how you were feeling and what you were enjoying.  We got exactly what we needed at Hotel Les Matins and I bet you will too.  Thanks to the whole staff!  Shine on!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Beautiful,  great location, perfect for solo traveller
text:
This is a beautifully presented hotel in a great location. It suited me as a single traveler as it was a safe quiet location in the 9th. lovely 2.5km walk to the Arc de triumph. 
the rooms are beautifully presented and very clean.  even though my room was next to the lift I heard no noise the whole time I was there. the staff also spoke English.   
I would highly recommend  this hotel.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: A Paris to remember ❤️
text:
I was so happy to find a hotel that offered a family room!  Traveling with 4 kids is a challenge in so many ways....😉
But at the Matins they where so friendly and solution oriented!!  We had 2 rooms that could be closed of in the halleway, creating our own suite!  Lovely, friendly staff, simple but good breakfast and a good location to explore the Montmarte neighborhood!  Our best stay i Paris so far ❤️. Would absoulutly come back here again!  
The small spa in the basement was lovely after a long walk in Paris, just remember to book in the looby or on line!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Excellent well placed Boutique Hotel
text: Just arrived home after spending three nights at this hotel.  First impressions the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly - what a great reception!  Thank you Julia and the team !  (We were concerned as on one website it stated that there was no manned reception - absolutely not true it is manned 24 hours).  Our room was immaculate although to be fair a little compact, the bed very comfortable and having all the usual amenities.   Now this is a great idea -  for 45 mins you can book the small pool plus steam room in the basement all to yourself  - the pool is not really big enough for a swim workout but wonderful after a hard day sightseeing before you head out for dinner. The hotel is also excellently placed for the metro - 3 different lines within max 6 mins walk - Saint George’s, Pigalle, and Le Peletier.  (Buy tickets in bulk much easier) The surrounding area is great for restaurants and cafes - just ask reception for recommendations if you need to.   We would certainly stay here again.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Beautiful and boutique
text: Easy reach to public transport. Friendly staff, knowledgeable reception. Unique spa facilities. Very personal and stylish. Lots of places to eat and drink within walking distance. Loved our stay in Paris.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Gem of a hotel A Must Say
text:
Well we are flying home today after 5 nights at this amazing hotel.  The hotel is situated in a fab location with easy access to the Metro, great bars and wonderful restaurants.  Decor is modern but very well designed.  Breakfast is delightful the  choice is good and plentiful.  The coffee is very good and the lady at breakfast cannot do enough for you, she even timed my husbands boiled eggs with her mobile.  Our room was beautiful, very comfortable beds, great shower and lots of home comforts.  Vincent who took our original booking and then checked us in on arrival is charming and so helpful.  He really goes the extra mile and has a real can do attitude.  He will assist with directions, restaurant suggestions, booking excursions and always with a smile.
All the staff here are very friendly  and most welcoming. We are sad to be leaving but will return again and will no doubt return to this wonderful hotel.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great Personalized Service!
text: My husband and found this hotel through Tripmasters, and we're so glad we did! The location was perfect, in a very walkable neighborhood with great restaurants and bakeries nearby. What made out visit to the hoel so special was the friendly service, and attenton to detail provided by Julia in guest services, and her manager, Claire. They treated us like family, and Julia helped put together flowers and a cheese and fruit platter which my husband surprised me with for our 30th wedding anniversary. Julia epitomizes what great cusotmer service should be.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Good location and spa was a nice touch
text: This quaint hotel was good for our needs. Close to where we needed to be - tons of little bakeries just down the road and the spa was a nice addition to the stay. We had trouble with our safe which was not fixed unfortunately but the daily breakfast was also a nice touch.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Fantastic hotel, Fantastic location!
text:
I was so pleased with this hotel and the location was fabulous!  Just a short walk to the metro (Saint-Georges) and within easy walking distance to explore Montmartre and the beautiful Sacre-Coeur.  It's located in an area that doesn't feel touristy and there are lots of restaurants and pateserries a stones throw away.

All hotel staff were friendly and welcoming and I was very impressed with the hotel itself.  Our room was well appointed and I thought it was a great touch that they had left out mini slippers and kids toiletries for my 7 year old.  We had a standard room which was perfect for us...the space around the bed was a little snug but we were hardly in the room so it wasn't a problem.  I was very impressed with the en suite shower room.  

There was an ample selection at breakfast time and my daughter loved the waffles and pancakes! 

The spa was a fantastic way to end a day of sight seeing and again, it was well appointed and spotless.  

I booked via a third agent but I should have booked directly with the hotel as this would have provided me with the lowest rates.

I'd highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be booking again!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Brilliant hotel in a brilliant area
text:
This is a great little hotel in a great area of Paris - without a doubt the best part of our weekend break. 

The rooms are great, the breakfast is just fantastic, and like others say the staff make the difference - everyone was helpful, friendly and attentive. 

The area is perfect as well - a short (uphill) walk to Moulin Rouge and Sacré Coeur, and a slightly longer (but downhill!) walk to the Louvre and the Seine. 

Strongly recommend you pre-book the Spa for an hour as well - perfect for relaxing or working off a hangover...
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great location
text: A lovely hotel in a great location, A short walk to Gare du Nord and Sacre Couer. Surrounded by nice bars, cafes and shops. Staff very helpful and friendly. Really nice laid back atmosphere, room and bar/ breakfast area. We all really enjoyed our stay and would come back.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Very friendly and helpful staff
text:
The staff couldn't have been more friendly and helpful both before and during our stay. Our room was a little small but decorated to a high standard and spotlessly clean. The breakfast was fine. nothing fancy but there was lots of it and went late into the morning, which was nice. The spa area was a nice cherry on top for this hotel - the pool is small but lovely to relax in after a long day in the city. The Montmatre area has a lot of small restaurants and bistros nearby so I would recommend it for couples on a city break. 

My only critique is that the room was very hot at night and turning the air conditioning down as low as it would go (16 C was the lowest it could be set at_) didn't have much effect on cooling the room. There was no top sheet on the bed, only a heavy duvet, so we essentially just slept on the empty bed as it was too hot with the duvet.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

text:
-Great location, close to Gare de l’Est, restaurants, bars, supermarket, metro lines
-Two big windows in room
-Comfortable bed
-Quiet
-Free coffee and tea, both in the room and in the breakfast/restaurant
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa
text: Fantastic hotel, Great value, Really helpful & polite happy staff. There are no bad points at all & would definitely stay there again. Small hotel with a family feel, Lovely spa room area with a pool & Steam room, Could do with a clock on the wall in the pool area.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Great Boutique Hotel in Paris
text:
We are annual visitors to Paris, we have now stayed at this great boutique Hotel in Paris a couple of times and cannot recommend it enough.

Great location close to major shops, transport.  Stay & live like a local.

Generous rooms, spotlessly clean, very friendly staff.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Birthday Bliss!
text:
I wanted something special where I could celebrate my 40th birthday in style, every year I said I want to go Paris for my birthday... this time I actually did. 

The hotel was 10 minutes by taxi from Eurostar Gare du Nord station, and there were several stations near the hotel which was great for exploring the city.

Checking in was great the staff were so nice and when they found out it was my  birthday they upgraded me to a superior suite! 

The room was modern & clean the bathroom was a decent size... but what really won me over was the cute balcony looking over the other streets, it was so quaint.  

The staff there gave me great tips on getting the best out of exploring the city, they really were so helpful. 

I will be going back the next chance I get!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice hotel in convenient location. Rooms were small but assuming might be comparable to nearby hotels. Only disappointment, I didn't realize ahead of time a reservation was needed for the pool and it was all booked the times we were available.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Most amazing boutique hotel
text:
We stayed here in November 2018 for our anniversary. Even though where it is, it is still easy to access all over Paris.

We did the hop on hop off bus and was about a 15 minute walk to the stop which was nice as we past all the french cafes and shops. From there we got all around Paris and at the end of the day wasn’t a big hike to get back to the hotel.

The room was immaculate and so stylish, not anything we ever imagined. The room even had a bath so we took advantage of that! The view from the room was a little disappointing as it faced a courtyard but if we every returned we would book for a view of the Eiffel Tower.

We ordered room service one night which came within half an house and was GORGEOUS lasagne! We even spent a night chilling in bed and watching tv just to take in the room and our stay. 

The staff was a huge help especially with recommending restaurants and directing us the best way to the station and bus stops.

The is also a pool although we didn’t go to it, it looks nice and clean perfect for a morning swim.

All in all, I would definitely stay here again the location is great within 1 minute you have at least 10 shops restaurants, seafood shops and shops that sell wine for €3 which we could get enough of! My partner proposed to me whilst we was in Paris (at the Eiffel Tower) so this hotel holds very special memories for us! 

Perfect for couples looking for a romantic getaway! 

Thank you so much Les matins!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Beautiful and romantic!
text: Honestly, this was a surprise holiday for my boyfriend and he loved it, the room was perfect and very clean with a very faint view of the Eiffel tower from the toilet.The staff were lovely and the swimming pool was very quiet but it meant we really felt like it was just us two in the hotel which i loved! the only thing i would say is that the room smelt of weed a bit but i'm not sure if it was the room or someone who was smoking on another balcony but the smell stayed for the four nights. I didn't have breakfast there but simply because the road it's next two has 5 bakeries that are cheap and delicious cannot recommend them enough! Also the opening hours are very convenient as we went to Disneyland one day and got back at 1am and they still let us in which i found surprising.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect
text: Absolutely amazing clean modern hotel. Perfect location within walking distance of great food and a metro station. Nice to have the option of the pool to yourself. Staff were very friendly & helpfull, can’t wait till next time
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Lovely stay in Paris
text: My husband and I have just returned from our stay in Paris. I booked this hotel direct with them getting a good deal which included breakfast. It’s in a great location walking distance to attractions.We arrived in the evening the staff on duty that greeted us what helpful and welcoming and even sorted out a query I had with a trip I’d booked. The room was on the smaller side but was well presented, clean and adequate for our needs. There was a nice selection at breakfast. One thing that made this stay for me was the helpful friendly staff attitude , all of them were so happy to help. The pool is small but is lovely to have to yourself for an hour if you book it we  managed to get two time slots booking on arrival and were very happy with that, Thankyou for a lovely stay on our first trip to Paris.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Wonderful
text: Great small hotel in a perfect location . Close to many restaurants and shops , within walking distance to moulin rouge . Rooms are small but i guess everything is in paris .Rooms are kind of cold , even with heat turned all the way up. Sheets were not changed daily. We know because we had the same chocolate  stain on our sheets the entire stay . Staff friendly . Reception speaks good English . Have to make reservation for a 45 min time slot to use the pool .good wifi in rooms.One water bottle provided in room but you cant keep the bottle because they reuse it which is kind of odd so we didn’t drink anything from the hotel.  Pool room and water  was very warm which i loved . We had the pool all to our selves . Check in and check out was a breeze . Reception provided an adapter for the outlets . Over all I would stay here again
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Superb stay
text: Perfect hotel in a beautiful location. The staff in the hotel are extremely helpful. The rooms are clean,smart and modern. The pool is lovely along with the steam room. It really is a lovely little sanctuary which you can have to your selves. Quite enjoyed coming back from walking around all day and sitting in the lobby enjoying a nice coffee and relaxing. The area is really nice with lots of small shops, cafes and restaurants and sacre Coeur is only a 10-15 minute walk away which is a must see. Nearest metro is 5/10 minutes walk away. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this hotel and would highly recommend it.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Beautiful hotel, amazing first time to Paris
text:
A beautiful hotel in a perfect area of Paris, with easy access to Metro stations. the surrounding streets are filled with bakeries, restaurants & patisseries. 

The staff were incredible, knowledgable and helpful. We felt welcomed from the moment we walked through the doors.

Unfortunately, we didn't get to use the spa facilities as we were so busy, but they looked beautiful.

Genuinely, could not recommend this place enough
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Very nice
text: this is my second time in this hotel. the first time we had some issues with the receptionist but the hotel manager did everything to solve the problem. i can say that you reacted corretly and at the end, you were very fer to me. i respect that and that is the reason why i will return to your hotel.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Poor stay.
text: Paid a lot of money for this hotel to use all facilities. No spa, double bed room to find two singles pushed togther. Utterly disgraceful stay. They leave drinks and snacks in your room but if you use them to have to pay. Rude staff and ignorant, would not recommend.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: A wonderful hotel and stay in Paris
text: This was our second stay at this hotel and once again, it was great! I cannot recommend it highly enough. Good room, spa, breakfast area, location is great (we walked everywhere) and very friendly and efficient staff. It was my birthday during our stay, which was made even more special by a delivery of macaroons and champagne when in the spa!! (a first for me!) Thank you so much for allowing that, and for helping to make my birthday so special xx
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Pleased
text: This hotel was very clean. I enjoyed my time spent here staff was extremely pleasant and more than willing to help with required needs.I would gladly return to this hotel when revisiting this city, I found it very close to the subways to get us too any landmarks we wanted to visit.We was surround by many cafes restaurants so food was never a problem.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: 30th Birthday 4 day trip
text:
Booked through last minute.com and wasnt disappointed. From arrival the staff were extremely helpful. Very polite considering my french was minimal an very poor. 
The hotel smelt amazing as soon as we walked in. Even with such a late check in we were shown everything and even booked our spa/pool time for the next day. They have an honesty bar that worked brilliantly, they also have unlimited free hot drinks anyway. 
Room was spacious with a balcony and very clean. 
Usually dont pay extra for hotel breakfasts as they always seem pricey. This was well worth €15 and would definitly recommend
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect Boutique Hotel in Paris
text: I cannot recommend this hotel more. The room, we were in 404, which was front facing with a balcony was a good size, very large comfy bed, clean and quiet at night. The location, just off Rue des Martyrs which is full of bars, restaurants and food shops, short walk from Monmarte and the Sacre Cour but also easy walk into the centre. It is also a 15 minute walk from Gare Du Nord, which is a big bonus if coming from London. The staff were friendly and welcoming and the check in and check out process seamless. I will certainly not look anywhere else next time I am in Paris.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Regular and great stay
text: After many Air bnb stays and different hotel stays, we found this hotel. The rooms, spa, breakfast and service are TOP. This is now our company main address when we stay in Paris. The location is great, next to Mont Martre, Moulin Rouge, Galerie La Fayette, next to Gare du Nord,... I recommend this hotel for business or pleasure. The service is always great, we love to stay at Les Matins !
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect!
text: Stayed for 3 nights in this hotel and it was perfect. Such a pretty and clean hotel, lovely staff and close to loads of cafes, shops and restaurants. The hotel was quiet and had a lovely balcony. Very close to metro station so could get to everywhere we wanted. Walking distance to the Sacre Course which has a gorgeous veiw of the city. Also walking distance to moulin rouge which is a fun area! Great food around, so much to choose from. Highly recommended this hotel. I would definitely go back!
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Highly recommend!
text: This hotel is amazing! The rooms are very clean and the staff couldn’t help us enough. This hotel is in a lovely location right by supermarkets and lots of shops, bars and restaurants! It is also in walking distance of the moulin rouge (10 minutes max). It is a while away from the Eiffel Tower but the subway is a 5 minute walk away and as soon as you get off the Arc de Triumph is facing you and the Eiffel Tower is about a 20 minute walk from there. It was an amazing city break and I would definitely return to Paris and stay at this hotel.
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Hidden gem
text: Stayed at this hotel for me and my husband anniversary I picked it after reading great reviews and pleased to say are right what a lovely hotel great location for everything shopping site seeing restaurants cafes and cake shops and the staff are very welcoming the hotel has a lovely atmosphere and spotless clean throughout room was perfect had a wonderful time in Paris
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Amazing stay
text: Great hotel, friendly staff and fantastic experience. We got an upgrade as it was my birthday which was much appreciated and I can’t thank the staff and management enough for a great trip to Paris. Would recommend this hotel without doubt  thanks
name: Hotel Les Matins de Paris & Spa

title: Perfect Stay in Paris' 7th District
text: Couldn't be happier with this hotel selection. Nice room size, walking distance to many key sights. There is a market at your doorstep that is outstanding. They have bike rentals. Restaurants are nearby, and their breakfast is among the best we've ever encountered

text:

From start to finish we were made to feel at home and even though we arrived at the hotel 3.5 hours before our check-in time, we was told our room was ready for us which was a great surprise after being very tired from the flight and the taxi ride.

The location of this hotel is unreal, you turn the corner of the street and the Eiffel Tower is literally right in front of you (with a bit of a walk to get right to it but it’s right there) and you have numerous French restaurants and supermarkets close by too. 

We didn’t have breakfast during our stay but it looked and smelt delicious, we chose to eat out for breakfast at the authentic parisien cafe’s. 

Everything from the start of our stay to the end was delightful and I’m so happy we chose to stay at the Hotel Villa Saxe Eiffel.

title: Great Location/ Proximity to Eiffel Tower!
text:
This was my first trip to Paris, so I have nothing to benchmark here. However, this hotel met all of my needs. When entering the street of the hotel, there’s a beautiful head-on view of the Eiffel Tower. There’s a great local market on the same street on Saturdays, which was fun to explore. It’s about a 20 minute walk to Eiffel Tower, and another 15 or so to arc de Triomphe. Walkable to lots of restaurants, cafes and shopping. They also have electric bikes that you can rent, which came in hand to get around and explore. 

The room itself was clean. They are small, which was fine since I didn’t plan on spending much time in the room. There was a great little outdoor patio which helped in getting some fresh air into the room (you don’t always have the option for fresh air in hotel rooms!). The bed was sufficient in comfort, and the rooms were quiet, so I got decent sleep. 

The included breakfast was convenient, though fairly basic offerings (a wide variety including eggs, sausage, bacon, pancakes, crepes, croissants, yogurt, cereal, fruit, juice, coffee). Sufficient for sure!

There is no refrigerator in the room. 

I didn’t use the gym or other accommodations, so I’m unable to comment. Though the hotel did mention needing to reserve the gym (likely due to space/ capacity).

Overall I really enjoyed the stay and the location, and would recommend!

title: Okay for some people
text: Hotel is in a quiet street off the beaten path.  Next to the Ukrainian embassy so saw people with suitcases and police everyday.  Anyway, staff is very friendly and gave us a room upgrade to a Deluxe.  Room is spacious by European standards, not great decoration, and safe was not working so that was annoying.  It’s a boutique hotel so you won’t get the bells and whistles, but it’s very clean.  My biggest complaint is the location.  It’s in a residential area close to the Eiffel Tower (yes, they do exist) and it’s very quiet, especially in August when all the locals are on vacation.  How quiet? Not a soul for blocks.  Metro is a good 10 min walk so coming back at night is interesting.  Neighborhood is upscale but for someone who grew up in a city, it felt weird.  Some people like the quiet, but if you want to be next to the sights, metro, shopping, dining this is not your place.

title: Lovely hotel in great location.
text: We enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Villa Saxe Eiffel. We arrived early and our room was ready so we were allowed an early check-in at no cost. We were thrilled to have a good-sized balcony. The room was very small so the balcony helped although there was very little storage space - no drawers and a tiny closet. The front desk staff members were all wonderful. We requested an iron and ironing board, and ice several times, and the staff promptly addressed our requests. The king-sized bed was very comfortable, and the shower was great. One odd thing was the mini-bar fridge was not actually a fridge. It was not kept cold and there was no way to change the temperature so we weren't sure what its purpose was. And the safe did not fit our MacBook air even though advertised as laptop size. But these were minor issues. All in all, it is a wonderful hotel and we hope to return the next time we are in Paris!

title: A charming place I'd return to
text:
Well... A fantastic place with fantastic location. 
Something I really got used to is the amazing location of the hotel. The alley you pop up at right after you leave the hotel is a view I am greatly missing as a ritual when you leave or come back at the hotel - a long green paradise with a charming view of the Eiffel tower in the middle. 
Great view from the balcony (although I do realize that probably for lower floors this may not be so obvious). To put it in a joke - I could see the Eiffel tower even from the small window in the toilet. :) And from the windows on the other side of the room - the Montparnasse Tower. It was a trully a moment of joy to drink your coffee on the balcony there.

People in the hotel were wonderful - always calm, smiling and helpful. I especially remember the skillful man that was orchestrating the breakfast for us every morning. He was litterally everywhere all the time - managing to pay attention to everyone and to every request. My admiration goes to that person - unfortunately, I did not remember his name, but whoever from the hotel is reading this - pass my regards to him.

Also clean place, with great service and housekeeping. Perfect bathroom - spacious, with separate bathtube, shower cabin, two sinks and separate toilet.
Room comfort was excellent - had everything one can need. Even wireless phone charging from the multi funcional radio/alarm clock, with Bluetooth connectivity and lintegrated Spotify. All the small things you probably won't need, but would be happy to find available exactly when you need them.
Something else to note - everyone knows the annoying noises from the entry door of the room - people talking loudly, slamming doors, etc. Soundproofing  was well thought of by adding one more door as a barrier and this way having a small hall just between the exit door and the room. And also even (!) between the bathroom/toilet areas and the room itself.
I'd only mention the speed of the internet as something to improve. 
Anyway - I could continue giving all the good examples I've come across, but believe this is enough to express my satisfaction from this place.

title: Nice, but could have been a little better
text:
On arrival, the hotel is down a private road, taxi could not go down the road, so he just dropped us off at the side, which was fine. Immediately felt like it was a safe hotel. Police were also stationed right near the hotel, so was a safe neighbourhood. 

Was checked in smoothly, although the woman on check-in could have spoken better English! It was a little difficult to understand what she was saying. 

Room was nice, I guess could have been bigger! But it was okay.. the bed was large though and comfortable. The room was very dark though! Literally had to get out the torch on my phone to see the inside of the cupboard. Fridge was also not working! 

Breakfast was nice, and had some good options, but was the same everyday. The breakfast area also doubled up as the lounge/lobby area which I found strange which was on a different floor to the reception. The hotel didn’t really feel very homely or welcoming. 

The lobby area also had a coffee machine etc, and they expect you to pay for using the machine! 

One of the reasons I chose this hotel was because the reviews said the staff were exceptional, but I didn’t find this was the case at all! I informed the hotel before I arrived that I was celebrating a big birthday. I would have expected them to go the extra mile and provide a little something extra in my room like a bottle of alcohol or chocolates, but I did not receive anything. I also told them again when I was in the hotel hoping they’d at least wish me a happy birthday, but I got nothing! 

The staff offered no suggestions at all for Paris, and they didn’t offer us Bikes either. I read other reviews saying they were offered bike excursions, but I heard nothing! Did not get a warm welcome really. 

Overall, the hotel was in a semi-good location. It’s a 20 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. To get to the other attractions, you would really need to get the metro. I got a 2 day metro pass for 20 euros which was useful because we used it a lot! 

The hotel has some restaurants nearby, but it’s in quiet location, not in the hustle and bustle, which was quite good, because less noise surrounding the hotel! 

Overall, I’d say this hotel was nice, but I would not give it 5* rating. The service could have been better and the room details such a fridge not working and dark room issue could be improved! Just install some lights! 

Merci!

Be ready to walk a lot back to the hotel at night.

STAFF ::
Everyone speaks good english 
Kind, helpful and professional

HOTEL ::

The amenities around the hotel are not 4-star.
Wifi does not work - I had to resort to roaming just to check google things or for using maps.
Lounge is bare minimum, with seating for 15-20 people. Coffee is good and complimentary.
No microwave in rooms or lounge.
Gym is nonexistent, sauna is decent.

ROOM ::

They gave us the Access room for some reason which they said is bigger than a "classic". Barely.
Bed, carpet, shower, toilet were not clean.
There was hair everywhere on the bed.
The desk was sticky all over.
Mini fridge was not working at all. 
No microwave in the room, nor in the lounge.
We asked for toothpaste as we got to the hotel around midnight, and we got a 2oz off-brand tube with travel brush

title: Don’t take your regulars for granted
text: I’ve been coming to this little hotel for several decades - well before it was bought by Melia. It is classed as a 4-star and maybe by the strict tick-box approach of the Ministry of Tourism it is. But it isn't. It needs to smarten itself up. And take a more client-orientated approach. Some rooms are tired. Ours 607 has a shower bath which is frankly perilous unless you're an acrobat. The coffee on offer in the room is bog standard Nescafe. A Magimix coffee maker? And then there's the water issue. It should supply two free bottles a day. It's mini-bar water is €4.50!!. For 275ml. So - in order to earn its 4 stars it needs to improve. Staff as always helpful.

text: We recently stayed four nights at this very mediocre hotel. The only positive was its location to the subway and to the Champs Elysees. However, I would never recommend this hotel. The one morning I did pay for breakfast (20 euro), I was very disappointed in the quality and the selection. Our room was very tiny. It was also very hot so we had to sleep with both windows open. The bed was very hard, as were the pillows, so I barely slept. The furniture was old and beaten up. The coffeemaker didn't work properly and had instant coffee. The bathroom was cramped with no air flow. Not even the toiletries smelled good. The hotel seemed neglected. I had a miserable stay.

title: UPDATE
text: My family and I got 3 rooms (5 of us ). We checked in early and one room was not ready . We all got the same type (premium) and paid the same amount. title: Needs maintenance
text:
Spent 2 nights here and first impression was that the front of house staff were attentive and accomodating. The room was comfortable and had shutters on the outside to keep the light out and double glazing making it dark and quiet at night.
Unfortunately it was downhill from here.

Maintenance came and said nothing could be done until a weekday as no one works on weekends. (No suggestion of room change)

Maintenance called again, told to only use hairdryer on lowest speed (same advice for aircon that didn’t help either device). Comfy king bed but 2 joined singles which is fine but one corner didn’t sit flat so when you sat on it, it clunked to the ground.

Very very small lift, large or unusually shaped items of luggage may not fit in it.

Overall, pleasant enough stay in a good location but requires some maintenance and hospitality attention.

title: Weekends: Could do better
text:
We are loyal Melia customers. We normally go to the premium Gran Melia beach resorts. This was our first trip to a city Melia hotel. 

Impressions on arrival were very good. We were upgraded to a suite on the 8th Floor with great views over the city. The hotels location is great - located close to the West Bank sites such as the Eiffel Tower. 

Air conditioning was great, particularly on a very hot weekend. 

Breakfast on the Saturday morning was satisfactory, but we had high expectations based on stays in Gran Melia hotels. Scrambled eggs were cold and fried eggs burned. Breakfast was somewhat better on the Sunday morning. On Monday it was good. The food selection is very good. 

Throughout our stay one of the lifts was broken down. We returned exhausted after a day sightseeing to find the second lift broken too. Spoke to Reception to get an embarrassed sorry, but no idea when it would be fixed. We fought our way up eight floors to get to our room. We found this very annoying. 

Later on the Sunday the second lift was fixed. But still going painfully slow and feeling like it would break down again.

Housekeeping can be a bit hit and miss. We had to ask one day, as they had missed us. The evening turn down happened once. 

On balance, we had an enjoyable stay, and the room upgrade was appreciated . But the hotel needs to attend to customer service and breakfasts at weekends, and get their lifts serviced.

I paid for the breakfast included and it was fresh, limited, great donuts and croissants. Breakfast staff was great!!

Front desk staff - Andrea and manager Rodrigo were superb!! Another desk associate gave us misinformation on our first night about getting to our Liore Valley trip the next morning which  resulted in us missing our tour bus and causing us MUCH stress and loss of over $200 dollars. Andrea and Rodrigo tried VERY hard to help us out that morning!! Later that day the employee that gave us the wrong information didn't handle himself well when confronted by us and Rodrigo. I won't mention employee name because I don't think its necessary. Rodrigo and hotel management sent us champagne and macaroons the next night and paid for half the price for re-booking the Liore Valley trip!! Rodrigo really went out of his way to help us with anything we needed including giving us great train directions for getting to Palace of Versailles! Rodrigo and Andrea really helped make our trip a success!!
I would stay here again because of location if I were to ever visit Paris again!

title: Great Location but very tired
text: The staff on check in were great, although the hotel is very old and tired with a musty smell through the building, but it does the job, the location is great an easy walk to shops, restaurants and in a nice safe area. Although we wouldn’t stay there again, if you can get it on a good price and the smell doesn’t concern you then go for it, just be aware this is not a 4 Star experience it’s a 3 at best.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Wonderful stay
text: Couldn’t have asked for a better stay in Paris. This is our 4th time to visit Paris and by far the best accommodation we’ve had. Location is excellent for everything and our studio was superb. New and clean and great kitchen. Thanks to Diego at check in, ensuring we had a quiet room, he was so helpful with suggestions and making us feel so welcome. We will definitely be back to stay her again.  Thank you for your hospitality
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location but lack of attention to detail
text:
I am always reluctant to review places where expectations were not met. I usually stay silent on social media and report directly to management but we spent so much money on 10 days here and we tried to provide some constructive feedback privately but we were dismissed. 
Positives: Location was 10/10, right on the Seine, close to Saint Michel (Metro) and Mabilion (Metro), walking distance to Louvre, Notre Dame, D’Orsay. Great bistros, cafes, galleries and walks nearby.

Room size was pretty good for Paris and kitchenette was well appointed for such a small space. During the week all public areas were clean. Laundry facilities ($) available in house. 

The downside was the poor service and lack of attention to detail. This is our fourth visit to Paris and by far the poorest service. Despite trying to speak in French and being very polite it was difficult to get any advice or help. Front counter staff knew little about local attractions (can you recommend a dinner cruise, how do I use the laundry, how would I get a bus to x?) and dismissed us quickly. When we reported a plumbing issue requiring a small amount of maintenance we were simply dismissed as it was a Saturday and no one available. But no one attended to it during the week following either. 

Another issue was an disturbing noise which I assume was plumbing related - a screaming sound in the walls followed by thumping that actually vibrated the bed. Fortunately this was only intermittent (this made it hard to report) and maybe only related to certain rooms in our area so not necessarily a problem for all travellers. 
The place was unkempt during the weekend. It is a large hotel and a lot of through traffic and activity. 
Room for improvement - next time I’d sacrifice the view for service if possible.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Good value and convenient
text:
Excellent convenient location, safe to access even at night. The studios are large (twice the size at least of a normal Parisian double room), the staff friendly and efficient, there is coffee and tea on tap, the wifi is good.
Yes the carpet in the corridors are rather worn, the water pressure in the shower is not great and yes some of the appliances such as the fridges are in need of an update but overall, for the price, it is more than acceptable as they are in working order. 

One thing to bear in mind is that the street noises from revellers can get pretty intense, the flip side of not being tucked away in a back alley, so having the windows open at night is not a great idea depending on whether you are on the Seine side or facing towards the (quiet) back street. However there is good aircon and the sound insulation between rooms is good. 
I will certainly consider coming back, the convenience, security and ability to move freely around the room being such a rarity in Paris.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent
text:
This hotel is excellent in everyway. We stayed with 2 children (aged 7 and 10) for 4 nights in a 1 bed-roomed appartement.

Check in was easy and the staff very friendly and helpful. Our rooms were huge, and the beds (including the pull out sofa beds) very comfortable. The room had everything we needed for a few days in Paris and the location is great.

The room was very clean, and we were able to get replacement towels whenever we needed them from the closet downstairs.

Free coffee and hot chocolate in the lobby is a great addition.

All areas of the hotel were clean and well kept.

I would highly recommend this hotel and would stay again.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Appalling hotel
text:
I checked into this hotel today great location very nice staff but as for the room and surrounds its dreadful.
Stains on the carpets, mould in the bathroom shower, lights not working couldnt turn a light off  so my husband took the bulbs out!!
The bed is a flip up so on metal egs on a stand.At least the sheets and mattress are nice as the towels are terrible thin.
2 TV channels in English no sky, movies or netflix...thatcdoent really bother me but they say they are 4and half stars....I would just scrap up a 3!
I tried to change the room but the alternative was worse!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Just Satisfactory
text: When we booked our two-week Paris trip, we chose this hotel because the location was outstanding, the rooms have mini kitchens, and there are laundry services on the premises. All of these amenities met our expectations. This hotel is fine, but by no means luxurious. The room we were assigned was showing its age, but it was clean, quite spacious by Paris standards, and had plenty of storage space and a safe. The TV was pretty small and difficult to see detail from the bed. There was one arm chair and one desk chair. The bathroom was adequate. Our room was serviced by housekeeping twice during our stay. But the one negative was the bed. Although it was quite large, it was the most uncomfortable bed we've ever slept on. It was so hard, it was like sleeping on the sidewalk! Maybe okay for one or two nights, but we were aching by the end of our stay.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Safe, secure, adequate and great location.
text: Clean, safe and ideally located. We stayed for 3 nights to explore Paris, mostly the Louvre. The location is perfect, just a 3 minute walk from Pont Neuf and that clearly drives up the cost. The room was entirely adequate, nothing special. The bed and pillows comfortable. We had a room looking into the courtyard, sadly several nights we had to close the window due to the waft of cigarette smoke.  No linen service (I assume still due to COVID), but they did have plenty of towels available. The entrance is card controlled (safe) and there was parking under the hotel with direct hotel access (it was pricey as well). The staff was super friendly and very helpful and spoke great English – with no attitude – which is a real plus. It is super convenient to that part of Paris and well within walking distance of everything we wanted to see in Paris.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Bad stay
text: The manager of the hotel , Rebecca was being so rude to us .. when we checked in we had a fight with her and we were bargaining.. The next day , she was feeling better and showed us to the tram stop .. next time we come to the same place please don’t be mean and bargain with us .. we have had enough
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Citadines stay while going to French Open
text:
