The people who worked at the desk were of little help when ask where attractions were located, information regarding restaurants, transportation info, metro, etc. or anything else we ask. And some of the staff were rude and when we were checking in we were being helped by a staff person then he began helping someone else. When we did go to the desk to ask a question, it was a 10-20 minute wait.

. The room had old furniture and stained carpet. And it was not clean. The shower didn’t drain so we had to turn the water flow to a trickle and wait several minutes while the the water drained.  The lobby had sofas that were stained and very worn. 

On our second day at Citadines we needed towels because there were only two towels in the room. I ask at the desk for more towels. I was told they didn’t have any and they would arrive later in the day. I went back later on and was pointed to a closet to get towels. The towels were of poor quality. We ran out of toilet paper and the tissue box only had a few in it. I ask for bathroom tissue and tissues. The staff reluctantly gave me a roll of bathroom tissue and a tiny box of tissues. Both were of the poorest quality. 

There was a coffee bar but it  didn’t work a lot of the time. And there were no cups. The desk staff told us we had to use the coffee cups from our room. Toward the end of our weeks stay, I told the staff our coffee cups we’re getting dirty and ask could I have a paper coffee cup. They told me I should wash them in the dishwasher. I told them there wasn’t any dishwasher detergent. They reluctantly gave me one paper coffee cup. 

I would never stay in this hotel again. This was a wonderful trip except for this hotel experience.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: false advertising, not clean
text:
Be warned - the hotel is falsely advertised and rather disgusting.  It is NOT an upscale hotel as listed.  The rooms are outdated and are shockingly dirty and unsanitary (meaning that there are 'fluid stains' on multiple surfaces.). See photos: The ceiling was damaged and water stained.  The carpet was full of stains and the room smelled moldy.  Bedroom: The curtains had multiple white and black stains on them, the mattress was very old and had stains on it, with other's hairs on the sheets.  The light switch was taped to the walls and dirty.  Bathroom:  walls were old and stained with drips and what looked like dry blood, walls had suffered past water damage, dead bugs were visible in the ceiling light.  The bathroom mirror was rusty and the room was poorly lit.  The tub had dirty anti-skid stickers in the bottom and was not suitable for bathing.  The hotel furniture's plastic veneer was peeling off in places and the coffee table was dirty with sticky spots on it.  
Upon checking in, we were informed there is NO room service and we would have to get our own towels from a custodial closet.  The ice machine was broken. The AC would not cool the room, regardless of how low the temperature was set.  Accomodations for more than two guests is an moldy couch that folds out.  The pillow cases had dried blood on them.  
The following day, the power was out and there was no air condition as temps in Paris were over one hundred degrees during a three day heat wave.
We were told none were available and if we cancelled, there would be a five hundred dollar fee to do so.  
The only thing good about the hotel is its location.  But, there are many other hotels nearby and without having seen any of them, I can assure you - they are better than this one and won't require a dose of antibiotics afterwards.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Convenient stay and great area with good food around. Friendly staff.
text: We were glad to choose Citadines Saint Germain as our stay in Paris. About 5-7mins walk from the RER station - Saint-Michel Notre-Dame allowed us direct access to the Apart-Hotel. It’s also walking distance to major attraction in the city.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Badly in need of updating
text:
We stayed for a week at the Citadines hotel. My wife wanted to give the hotel a 4 star rating and I wanted 3½ stars, so I gave them 3 stars, mainly because of the following. 1. The furniture is Salvation Army. 2. The place is run down and is badly in need of updating. The carpeting in the hallways is all stained. The chair arm was broken 3. There were some annoying details in the room, like the fact that the wall was slanted by the corner of the king bed, so I had to climb over the mattress to go to the bathroom in the middle of the night. d, so I called the front desk. I was told that they would put a foam liner on the bed and go out and buy me a feather pillow. And they did exactly that, much to the their credit. The foam liner and the feather pillow made a big difference.

The location is right on the Seine, in the 6th arrondisement, one of the nicest in my opinion. It's centrally located to most everything.

We had an apartment with doors, so our grandson had his own room. The room has a kitchen, which is good if you want to eat in the room, which we didn't.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent accommodation in Saint Germain area
text: Stayed 7 nights at a studio on the 6th floor. View of city roofs with Montparnasse Tower, Eglise Saint-Sulpice and the Eiffel Tower on the horizon. Good size room, very comfortable double bed, good size bathroom, small kitchen (we used only for breakfast, would be too small for cooking larger meals). Excellent location, walking distance to main museums, major attractions, and numerous restaurants for all tastes. The staff were very kind and efficient. Overall - highly recommended.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Dirty, rude and unbelievable rip off.
text:
Unfortunately I booked a 2.5 week stay at this property. Do NOT book. There are other MUCH better hotels at similar price where you get clean rooms with maid service. This hotel is NOT a deal. 
        Upon checking in, I was given a room with ripped curtains, extremely stained carpeting and mold in the shower. Even the lights were flickering like a horror movie. They did change my room to a ground floor with wooden floors that had a "recent" paint job. For over 200 euros a night... I would have rather paid a little extra to stay in a normal hotel. Since maid service was once a week I would go to the front desk for toilet paper they would ration it and be rude to only give me one roll because of supply.... I have never experienced this in my life.
        I ended up leaving 4 days early because I couldn't handle it anymore. When I went to the front desk to talk about the bill, they were very rude. I originally booked on Expedia and they told me I could use that credit towards different dates when my travel plans changed.... I checked in and was asked to pay over 600 euros more.... only to find out that they CHARGED ME THE EXPEDIA COMMISSION THEY PAID ORIGINALLY. When I asked them to go over the bill they laughed at me. 
        I will never be staying at a Citadines property again. This is criminal that they can even post the photos they do. I didn't end up emailing the manager because of how mean they were. I just left. An absolutely disgusting experience.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Centrally located
text: Very welcoming staffs. Fantastic customer service from the duty manager (he is from Vietnam, can't remember his name). Excellent location in Latin Quarter. Complimentary hot drinks in foyer is a nice gesture. Apartment is clean, very spacious, perfect for a family, has everything we needed for a four-day stay. We were quite happy with the proximity to shopping, museums and transportation. Louvre is 10  min walk, Notre Dame 5 min, Musée d'Orsay 6 min, Luxembourg Gardens 5 min, Pantheon 20 min
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great aparthotel in a lovely location
text: We recently stayed here for three nights and found it difficult to find fault.  As mentioned in some reviews...it looks a little tired in places but you really have to be looking hard for faults. Our room was generous in size with good facilities, the staff were friendly & helpful and the area was great (central, safe, lively but not noisy). We thought it was excellent value for money
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: 18 nights in the Heart of Paris
text:
We have booked this hotel as we wanted a Medium apartment with kitchen and living room, and in the middle of Paris where i can reach everywhere i need to be by foot if needed as metros were at the time all out or order but line 1.
we were upgraded right away to the 6th floor, with extra-ordinary view ( not the Seine river view), the apartment was spacious.
We had a small issue with the door of the bathroom as it was stuck, they offered us to change the room, but still they fixed the door in 1 hour, which is quite amazing to do in Paris.
the breathtaking views from the balcony are the biggest highlights of this stay.
The kitchen had all needed items for cooking a good hot meal, and refrigerator, and dish washer ( that didn't work).
The rooms are quite warm so we had to keep the windows open.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Stolen Items and Misleading Advertising
text:
The location is good. The hotel lobby is acceptable, but our room was not in good condition and neither was the communal walkway. It did not look anything like what was advertised.
During our short stay someone entered our room and stole expensive items of clothing in addition to other small goods.
Based on this experience I would highly recommend staying in an internationally branded hotel in Paris.
The staff were of no help when this was reported.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location and very spacious room!
text: This is a perfectly situated hotel - walking distance to so many shops, restaurants and attractions. The rooms were spacious -  size exceeded our expectations for a hotel in Paris. We felt safe and would recommend this hotel. Only thing that was strange was toilet was on the other side of the apartment so you had to cross the apartment to wash your hands - a little odd. Loved the kitchenette and would definitely recommend this hotel. Staff was lovely.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Location!
text: Excellent location for long weekend in Paris, within walking distance from all the main attractions. Convenient parking directly underneath the building, fast and efficient service. Comfortable accommodation.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Fair offering, enjoyable stay
text:
Booked twice in November 2021 - once in studio Seine view, and another in a normal studio. The normal studio booking was eventually upgraded to a Studio Deluxe with a lot more space for packing before the end of the trip - this was a nice touch. 

Property is generally kept clean and common areas are nice to lounge around. Appreciated the complimentary coffee dispensing machines. 

I frequent the Citadines Melbourne on Bouke and the Citadines Shinjuku Tokyo almost yearly. Compared to these other 2 properties, this Citadines feels a bit dated. The furniture and room design seems to look a bit old and due for a refresh, which hopefully takes place soon. 

Given that I have stayed in Citadines many times before, I knew what to expect of the Citadines brand. Dont expect The Ritz Carlton here. Furniture provided is usually of the IKEA-type, functional and working. 

Prices paid for this property seemed generally higher than the Tokyo and Melbourne ones, although this seems to be more of a Parisian issue rather than a property-specific one. 

Location was very good for this Citadines St Germain property - many restaurants, bistros and high-end shopping within a 5 to 15minute walk. 

All things considered, will book here again.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Very disappointed
text: We booked a « suite » with a view of the Seine. View was great but the room was very disappointing. Extremely cheap furniture, hospital like; no table or chairs to have a simple meal; large spot on cheap sofa bed; worn out carpet; stopper in bathtub did not work. In short, not worth over $400/night.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: employees made it a bad experience
text: We booked 6 nights (22/11/21 to 28/11/21) WITH BREAKFAST in the name of my husband, Mr Rafael Cabrera Corrêa, through the Brazilian website decolar.com. At check-in, we showed the voucher and the employee requested that an email be sent to stgermain@citadines.com and informed us that everything was fine. To our surprise, at the time of ckeck out (28/11/21 at 7AM) breakfast was charged again, the amount of 128 euros. I showed the voucher to employees who simply said they didn't speak Portuguese (we were speaking in english) and couldn't solve it, forcing us to pay the amount. Despite the excellent location and a good hosting experience, the employees' neglect to solve the problem meant that I never stay at a hotel citadines again.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: The Cleaners left the fridge open and ruined all my food and the hotel is not doing anything
text:
Super horrible experience with the hotel. I am staying for a few weeks as I am on a business trip and am currently in the 2nd week of my stay here. 

1st week of the housekeeping service - cleaning crew used the dishwasher to clean the cups and it was still dirty. I called reception at 8am to ask them to get them to clean it by end of the day. When I got back at 11pm, still dirty, no one bothered.

I called reception 3 times to fix it, and nothing. I ended up bringing the dirty cups to reception to ask them replace it. Never got replaced. 

2nd week of cleaning service (today). The cleaners left my fridge open and everything in my fridge is ruined. I called reception and they told me to replace the food and give them the invoice. I just ended a long day of work and she is asking me to go out to replace the food, when I just did a round of groceries for the week. Seriously horrible service.

Seriously, please just give me a refund. This is such a horrible hotel and I really do not want to stay here anymore.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great Place If It Meets Your Needs
text:
I am writing as I sit in our room. We picked this apartment/hotel because my wife loves getting up  in the morning and brewing her own tea. Therefore, this hotel met our needs perfectly. It is kind of a hotel alternative to an Air BNB. We prefer the benefits that a hotel provides. 
The positives:
-The hotel was great as we had to cancel, then re=book, then modify our "non-cancelable res (our choice). They  gave us a credit, and then changed the res, and changed it again; no problem.
-Our accommodations were just about what we expected. We booked one of the more expensive rooms overlooking the Seine. Bedroom; fine. Kitchenette; everything you need including dishes, cutlery. Bathroom; fine, with big soaking tub for bathtub-lovers. Sitting room fine; work area, couch, chairs. There is one glaring omission however, which really surprised us. There is no small dining table. Given the fact that people stay here ostensibly to be able to have light food in the room, we thought this omission a strategic miss for the hotel. We were forced to have our coffee and  baguette sitting on the couch; big miss.
There is a 24 hour coffee/tea bar in the lobby with excellent coffee.
If you are a traveler who likes well-decorated rooms, this may not be the hotel for you. Everything is clean, but everything is also Ikea functional, but we kind of knew that going in. For us, the hotel was near perfect, but for the missing cafe table that would have made the stay perfect.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Outstanding hotel!
text: We just came back from a 4 night stay in the Citadines in Paris. Just a great situation, and a lovely friendly hotel, with excellent service and amenities. Particularly nice was the foyer, where you could have free tea, coffee, hot chocolate at any time, and a comfortable place to chat with friends.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Very Good Apt. Hotel with Nagging Isues
text:
I in the hotel 16 nights this August. I'm 80 year old American male from New York City, traveling solo.  If in Paris again should I book my stay in this hotel? Absolutely yes!. But that doesn't mean the the place is free of major faults (according to me alone..)
The location of the Left Bank is extra perfect, on the Siene in the 6th Arrd.  You are in a walking distance to the most important tourist sites in Paris; Notre Dame (closed now after the fire), Luxemburg Gardens, Pantheon, Louvre museum, Museum d'Orsay, Pompidou center , Boulevard St. Germain and many more. Two closed by Metro stations. My room has a view of the city more or less west. My room 1616 on the sixth floor has plenty of light. The black curtains help much,
The room is adequate in size. However the bad is situated very tight between two walls (see picture), without night stands. Who is genius that placed the full length mirror on one these walls?  
There is flat screen TV and very comfortable working space for two people.  There are one hard chair and one soft chair, and a folding one in the main closet. There is a mini "dinning table" as well. WI-FI  is free. I measured  the Wi-FI's speed:  6.00 mbps, looks slow but it's  streamable.  The closet storage is good for the solo traveler. You  will find there 10 hangers, an iron and an iron board. You should ask some couples about their opinion. 
The kitchen in great, almost on overkill. Fridge, micro, kettle,  hot top, sink,  toaster and mini dish washer! Plenty of china and utensils.  
The bed is comfortable with high quality linen. However the blanket is not heavy enough.  I couldn't understand  to operate the climate control. Very bed for a retired computer programmer.
The bathroom is large with plenty of storage. The showerhead is adjustable. To prevent slipping in the bathtub there a great ant-slippery mat.  
Please be aware that they don't supply a toilet brush, which is nothing but a sanitary felony!!!! Don't forget there is  only one housekeeping a WEEK. They ask for 17 euros if you need more.
 The towels feel cheap and flimsy. The toilet paper is horrible! (I can't say more). 
The staff is very accommodating and friendly, however not all my requests were met. A wakeup call,  extra blanket  and a fatly phone - I'm still waiting. If you ask for something from the front desk, they write the request  on a piece of paper. Not always there is a follow up. The hotel has no concierge, and the nice people in front desk are not trained to do this task. One time I needed to get in a harry to the Versailles Palace, just south of Paris. Instead of sending me to the Montparnasse Train Station they told me to take the RER, a trip that took over an hour and half instead of 20 minutes.   Google!
Free coffee and tea in the lobby, a lot of  supplies (towels etc.) are always available in a special room in the lobby, They sell a 7 euros breakfast in a shopping bag. Didn't entice me.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Good location in the center, price/quality good choice
text: We stayed 3 nights in the apart hotel. A parking lot is available in the basement (pay per night), friendly staff (reception desk and cleaning staff), the rooms are very clean and offer all that you need (mini kitchenette), beds are a bit hard, good pillows.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location and everything else
text:
Stayed Aug 9-14 2021.  This is an apartment with a kitchen, 1 BR, and pullout sofa.  Good amount of space.  Clean.  Felt secure.  Staff:  professional, welcoming, very helpful.  Spoke English.  Location is the best:  Walk out the door-- here is the Seine.  Within 10 minute walk from Pont Neuf, St. Michel, and Chatelet Metro stations.  Turned out we were in walking distance of restaurants we had chosen.
Wi-Fi:  Strong.
Would stay here again-- definitely.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Good apartment in Senna side
text:
Our booking was transfer from Citadines Les Halles to Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris without any notice from our booking system or hotel itself. As soon as we arrived they inform that Les Halles was closed and no transfer offered from their mistake (maybe our booking agent but it was not clear).

Property is located in Senna River in a wonderful area next to shopping and dining area. Citadines are not classic hotels more in a mix between a hotel and apartment. Despite of previous incident we did check in fast and reliable. Hotel lobby is basic but functional with amenities for water, coffee and tea. No proper breakfast available but you could order a petit dejuneur for 7 € that will handle to your room.

Apartment was clean and with good size, good bed area and full kitchen available (furniture, fridge and rest of items well kept). Maybe room seems a little bit dated but not in bad way, functional and simple but clean and sunny. Bathroom area it is ok. Our views are not to Senna River but seems ok.

Front desk people are efficient and well trained. Good for a week in Paris, closed to main attractions and not a bad choice in city centre but it is not a classic hotel therefore no cleaning service every day.  We didn’t remove any star by booking incident due to maybe it is not an issue of hotel itself.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great place and location
text:
We had a great experience for a 5 night Paris stay. Our group had 4 rooms. The smaller rooms were very small but the apartments had just the right amount of amenities. The room was clean and even though some items needed some upgrades everything was functional and clean. 
We loved having the espresso/ cafe station in the lobby. Perfect to enjoy while we waited for our party or to warm up after an afternoon out or on the way out. 
The location was excellent walking distance to the metro station, many excellent restaurants and tourist attractions- Musée de Orsey, Lourve, River Cruises. 
Would stay there again and recommend to friends.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Unprofessional, rude, and unaccommodating - worst customer service I’ve ever experienced. *Discrimination against Asians
text:
My family and I have been traveling all day from Chicago. We knew that check-in is at 3pm so we decided to just check our bags since we arrived at noon. The front desk told us that our room wouldn’t be ready until 3 but there are smaller rooms available now. We said we’ll wait for the bigger room that we have booked. (Why would we stay at a smaller room when we paid for the big room???) We left to explore and returned at 2 to nap in the lobby since we have been awake for 24 hours. 

Right at 3pm, one of the ladies informs us that our room wouldn’t be ready for an additional 45-60 mins. A smaller room was available, but she suggested to just wait since our original room is much bigger. It’s 4:15 and they haven’t checked in on us so I asked what was going on. I stated my valid complaints and this other lady was so unapologetic and unaccommodating. She couldn’t care less that we weren’t being taken cared for. She said the room was going to take another 30 mins... I kept asking why and they accused us that it was because we wanted a bigger room.

No. You guys are wrong. We just wanted the room we booked. We have been awake for 24 hours adjusting from Chicago to Paris time, so all we want to do is sleep in our room that was suppose to be ready at 3pm. We never asked for a change or upgrade. Stop blaming your customers for your incompetence. The room wasn’t ready when they should have been - this is your responsibility. What’s the point of having a check-in when the rooms aren’t ready? They literally said “just because we have a check in doesn’t mean the rooms are ready” - OK, so I guess customers can just check out whenever because they’re not “ready” right at check-out. 

I had to raise my voice at them in front of other visitors lecturing how this was wrong and unacceptable and they did not apologize. We demanded to speak to their manager and after a few minutes the lady comes back and said that our room was ready. (Wow, how convenient. How long were you guys keeping that room from us?) The manager didn’t even come out to apologize. We left the lobby and entered our room very angry. What a great welcoming by the entire staff. 

I’m not sure why this hotel has over 4 stars when their customer service is a joke and the staff is so unwelcoming. Is this how you treat all customers or just Asians? We are Korean-Americans and it felt as though we were being discriminated because they were friendly towards all the Caucasians. We were lied to about our room’s availability multiple times, the staff blamed us for their mistakes, they didn’t apologize or offer any discounts to make up for their poor hospitality. 

Later that day, they slipped an apology letter with a box of chocolate. They addressed us as mister... We’re all females! They can’t even apologize correctly or in person. Here’s an advice: get the suffix right and apologize to our face. 

To Citadines Saint-Germain-Des-Pres, do better. Much better. 

*Be advised:
Housekeeping is only once a week and if you need additional stuff like toilet paper and towels, they charge you extra! The hallways smells like rotten eggs so they have to use harsh chemicals to mask the smell.*
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great stay
text:
The location was top-notch! Close to metro/public transportation. Seine River view room was outstanding!!!! Close to lots of good food options.  Loved the coffee/latte machine and tea available in lobby.  Different elevators for different sections of hotel was inconvenient, and the room smelled like garlic for the first couple of days, but eventually aired out.
Staff was helpful and mostly friendly. Would definitely recommend to friends and would look to stay at Citadines in other cities.
Love the towel warmers!!!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Less than expected
text:
Having stayed at other Citadines in Paris i was confident when making the reservation that this one would too be very nice.  How disappointed i was.  The lobby furniture was worn, the hallways were worn, chipped paint, faded wallpaper, worn and stained carpet.
The room carpet was stained and worn.  Room phone did not work but was replaced while we were there. The ironing board was broken as well and the room safe did not lock.
I will have to say however that the staff was very friendly.
I would warn that just because one property is very good doesn't mean that they are all the same.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great Location Full Feature Apartments
text: Took the apartment with the view of the Seine and Point Neuf. Very large, lotsa space. Fully stocked with almost everything you may need away from home. Kitchen is great and you can make almost anything there (I tripped the smoke alarm, and saw the hotels fire response, I give them a Pass with distinction). View is great, could stare out the window for hours. Clean, practical and good value. A bit pricey, but considering the location, and the cost of rooms in Paris.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: greatest hospitality and service
text: location is very strategic, room is very clean, kids love the free chocolate ,we love the free coffee at lobby 24/7. sofa bed is very comfy compare w many hotels'sofa bed we stayed, i would like to give 6 stars rating for their manager and one asian lady on desk for helping us to solve the problem of stolen bag and passport at champ elysees during our trip, they were superd ! without their help, we were at lost and no idea how to go about.due to strike and no taxi , the manager personally walked out the hotel tried to get us a taxi as we were in hurry to settle this.day after we settled w the police and embassy, they personally came to us &offer us for further assistance. million thanks to the manager (an asian man with spectacle on duty during our stay ) and super polite and helpful Chinese lady customer service at desk that night (27/12/2019).She & the manager offered to make few phone calls for us, email and scan the documents to the embassy asap! we will highly recommend our frds and anyone in future! thanks again for great stay and we did have the best hospitality from your staff !
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Good location, clean apartment
text:
Family of 4.  One bedroom apartment. 

Positives
- Location, just across the river from the Louvre
- clean one bedroom apartment 
- coin laundry is available in the building
- good service
- within walking distance to shopping and restaurant. 
- coffee/hot choco/hot milk machine available 24 hours in the lobby. Very handy.  

Negatives
- breakfast is pretty standard.  Nothing to be excited about.  In our 6 nights of stay, we went down for breakfast only once
- the unit seems a bit dated.  The layout is weird with the toilet and bath separated.  But the unit is clean
- no bidet!!! this is applicable for all hotels in europe though.  Seriously someone should tell the europeans about bidet.  Especially the japanese version.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Christmas family stay
text: The staff here were so kind and had our room ready for an early check in following a long haul flight with our 6 month old. Location was perfect and we were able to walk to a lot of the attractions (public transport strike during our stay). The room was clean and warm (a bit too warm). Loved the small touches such as complimentary coffee machine in lobby and the stunning christmas decorations!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: We wouldn’t stay here again...
text:
Our room was noisy (we could hear everything from the room above and beside ours!!), needing a renovation (mouldy and broken equipment- main bedroom Aircon and hairdryer), and topped off with a fire alarm at 10:30pm.

Whilst the location is good and the free coffee in reception is a nice touch, it is overpriced and not at all able to provide a much needed night of restful sleep on any of our 3nights here so far!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Located close to the Louvre and Notre Dame Cathedral
text: Close To The Louvre and Cathedral, long walk to the Eiffel Tower at least 50 minutes. The trains were on strike whilst we were in Paris, which made getting around difficult, Taxi’s, Uber were expensive. Along the canal which made a pleasant walk, hop on hop off boat good. The hotel is close to bakeries and cafes, supermarket around the block. Staff were friendly and helpful, even though the language barrier was difficult at times. Free coffee and tea in the foyer every day. Laundry facility which is good when travelling. We had a studio apartment, which was a bit tired looking in my opinion, needs a fresh coat of paint and new carpet.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location. Needs a renovation
text:
We enjoyed our stay at the Citadines   Great location, by the river. 5 l-10 min walk to the Louvre. 5-10min to the heart of St Germain. Loads of restaurants nearby. Buses galore within a 5-10 min walk around the hotel. 
Rooms are ok. Some need minor repairs, but any problems and the hotel was quick to fix/repair. 
Friendly staff. 
Free coffee, tea and hot chocolate station for the duration of the trip.  
Would be great if the place received a renovation. However if you looking for good accommodation in a great location, then I would recommend the Citadines.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent hotel
text: Great location, clean, spacious and modern.  This is located directly across from the Louvre and one block behind the hotel is a vibrant area full of shopping and restaurants. The bathroom was roomy and had plenty of vanity and shelf space. Very clean and the staff was helpful.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: NICE HOTEL IN THE BEST LOCATION
text: Clean and nice hotel.  We have booked a studio with seine view. The view from the 6th floor that we were staying was incredible.  We could see the seine river , Pont neuf, Notre Dame , Samaritaine, Louvre and even Monmarte hill with Sacre Coeur. The room was very clean.  It had everything that we could need.  You could see the view from your bed too!  The hotel provides all day free coffee, beverages and water. I would definetely stay there again.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Super location, best value apart hotel.
text:
We stayed at CitadinesCitadines Saint-Germain-des-Prés for 5 nights in the first week of November 2019.
Never having stayed in a studio apartment ( we had 3 studios for 3 couples ), I was worried I might find the space too cramped & uncomfortable. Which is why I was pleasantly surprised to find the space just sufficient enough for a couple. The queen sized bed is placed a bit tight between the walls so although it was okay for us, if you’re big, you may have a difficult time squeezing against the wall to get into the bed. By the way, we were on 6th floor, facing Pantheon on the left in far distance and Sorbonne on the right in far distance. Later we discovered that these rooms were smaller than the ones on the 4th floor, as one of the couples traveling with us, got a studio on the 4th floor. The bed was king sized with a little more comfortable space between the walls and the bed. Other than that, it was slightly larger but also slightly older. However, these apartments ( Studio) are still much larger at 22 sq mtrs, than most similarly priced hotels in the same area, which have rooms of 15 to 17 sq.mtrs !

Back to our apartment on the 6th floor, the kitchen area was a very compact and extremely well designed part of the apartment ( about 3 x 4 ft ) which can be shut off from the sleeping area with a sliding door. It had all the basic utilities such as fridge, microwave, two burners for cooking, dishwasher and a toaster. Enough utensils such as 2 different sized pans with lids, a griddle, 2 different sized microwaveable bowls, sets of 3 in cutlery, soup bowls & plates. Apart from these, the thoughtfulness with which they provided items such as scissors, knives, chopping board, wine opener etc was impressive. Even the sink was fully stocked with a roll of garbage bags, scrubbers, dish washing soap, kitchen napkin and dishwasher tablets. Everything was clean and in working order too.
The bathroom is just like all the other hotels, functional and orderly. The usual
Supply of shampoo, conditioner & soap, extra toilet rolls and even a brush for washing the toilet.
The studio has a tv, music system & an ironing board too. For those who need to wash clothes, there's laundry facility on the ground floor. The lobby also has a children’s play area as well as a seating area for the guests. 
Now coming to one of the most appreciated and warmly welcoming features of the hotel, they have a small "help yourself" hot beverages facility next to the reception. This is a wonderful goodwill gesture, free of cost for the hotel guests, on the hotel's part. After a long day's sightseeing and walking miles, we would return to the hotel and make a beeline straight for the hot coffee or hot chocolate, grab our cups and sit in the lobby planning our next day or going over the day spent, just talking or chatting before retiring to our respective rooms.
A word of caution, if you step out of the hotel, make sure you don't forget to carry your key. You will need it at the entrance to enter the hotel. Worst case scenario, you will have to wait for one of the guests to come by and swipe their cards in order for you to scoot in after them.
Location wise, it is undoubtedly one of the best situated hotels. Rue de Bucy, Odeon, Cour du Commerce, St Sulpice Church, Rue de la Huchette, Place St Michael, Muse D'Orsay and of course, Notre Dame almost at your doorstep, all within walking distance and many more attractions, which i forget now.
All in all, a great apart-hotel, with fantastic location and very attentive and helpful staff. i would definitely stay here again and recommend it highly especially to all first time travellers, as staying in a centrally located property makes it so much more easier and enjoyable.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent Location!!!
text: Excellent location, clean but in need of repairs and some remodeling.  Appreciated needing to use your key card to get into the hotel - not just anyone can come in, must have a valid key card.  Room was decent size for 2 people, enjoyed having the mini-kitchen in the room.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great place to stay
text:
We booked this as part of a Eurostar deal and were very pleased that we’d chosen this hotel.  When we arrived the reception staff went out of their way to be helpful.
The room was fully equipped with a safe, a hob, microwave, fridge, dishwasher (& tabs) kettle, toaster, iron and all the basic kitchen equipment we needed. (as another reviewer said a roll of kitchen towel or a wiping down sponge would fave been useful too). 
We bought supplies from the nearby Carrefour supermarket and pretty much catered for ourselves in the room. Every time we came back to the hotel from one of our forays out we grabbed a free hot drink from the foyer.
The hotel is very central and we easily walked to the Louvre and the Musee d’Orsay. 
In the other direction we walked to Norte Dame and the amazing stained glass Sainte Chapelle.  The jump on/jump off batobus is worth doing from nearby St Michel quai.  
The hotel is very secure - you need the QR coded plastic key to get back into the hotel and to use the lift. 
My only criticism - and its a small one - is the constant feint hum of the air-con, which you can’t switch off even at night.
The bed was comfortable and slightly on the firm side.  The room, which faced the side so we did have a bit of a view of the river, was quiet with the window shut.
We would definitely recommend this hotel - they even brought some chocolates to the room for my husband’s birthday, which was a lovely touch.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great Location
text: The location of this hotel is PERFECT. Rooms are a good size by European standards, they are well appointed and clean. One of the downfalls is that you don't get your room serviced and if you want new towels you have to go downstairs to the foyer and get them whilst taking your dirty ones back! Our room had a small kitchenette which was handy and the bathroom is a good size with good amenities although our bathroom had a rubbish bin full of someone else's rubbish and the shampoo container in the shower bay was empty.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Wonderful hotel & great location
text:
My husband and I stayed here for a week in November. Our vacation started out pretty stressful because Air France lost our checked bag, which had most of our clothes/toiletries/shoes. Luckily when we arrived at the hotel, check in was pretty easy. We arrived early in the morning so we dropped off our carry-on with the staff and explored around the area. Overall, the hotel staff was very friendly and professional and our room was the perfect size for us. It was a little small compared to American standards but I think that's the normal size in France.

 

PROS: Shout out to the weekend manager (Mr.Tuong) who was very accommodating and also very helpful when it came to showing us how to navigate the city and which places to go. The hotel's location was perfect; right next to the Seine River, 15-20 min walk to the Louvre, and 15-20 min metro ride to the Eiffel Tower. Near St. Micheals statue (5 min walk from hotel), there are a lot of shops and restaurants to explore.

 

CONS: Whenever we had to print something (ex.boarding pass, tickets), the printer did not work so we had to bother the receptionist to print from their computer.

Depending on your stay, housekeeping only cleaned our room once during the week. This wasn't a big deal for us, just more of a surprise. However, they did have a room in the lobby for you to get new towels & toiletries if needed.

 

METRO HELPFUL HINT: It is so much easier and cheaper to take the metro/train than a taxi/uber/walking. Individual metro tickets were over 1 Euro going one way and a lot of times you had to change stations. If you plan to use the metro, train, or bus, definitely get the Navigo Decouverte Pass. It's about 30 Euros and includes the pass (good for 10 years) and 7 days worth of unlimited rides in 5 zones of Paris (this included Versailles, Disneyland, etc). You scan your card at each terminal and since this card is nontransferable (unlike the NYC metro cards), each person has to get a separate card. We got lost a couple times and since this was unlimited, we didn't have to worry about adding more money on.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Nice location
text: Our room was lovely attic room. Has good view by the river Seine, eazy transportation to all areas, center of the city, close to restaurants, shopping centers. Hotel was clean and secure. Our room has kitchen that nothing missed. We love it.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: An average hotel on a great location!
text:
Hotel is at a great location which is a huge plus and the two stars only for that. you can walk to Notre dame, St Augustine, Louvre and from Champs-Élysées to the Arc de Triomphe.
Negatives:
They dont clean your room on your entire stay. If you want it to be cleaned they will charge you around 20 euros. 
The rooms are pretty small and old for the price.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Wonderful Place to Stay
text: This apartment hotel was truly wonderful to stay at. The reception desk had excellent customer service, and tea, coffee, and hot chocolate available 24/7 in the lobby. My BF and I booked a one-bedroom apartment and couldn't be happier. It was spacious and roomy enough to enjoy the space provided by both rooms (living room and bedroom). It had a cute kitchenette, but we didn't use it, and had all the amenities you could need (hair dryer, iron, pots and pans in the kitchenette, etc.) The location was awesome! So lively and filled with cafes and restaurants nearby, and metro and bus stops just minutes away. I would definitely stay here again and recommend this location to anyone who might be considering it.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: My first time Stay in Apartment Hotel
text:
As I have heard that meal cost is very high and we can get very tasty deli easily in Paris, we chose apartment hotel at this time.
This Citadine hotel stay was more than our expectation. Good points are location, free coffee service, very clean room & kitchen, excellent stuff and bath tub.
シタディーン　サンジェルマンデュプレの良かった点、先ずロケーションが最高、ロビーの無料コーヒーサービス、キッチンや食器などが予想以上に清潔だった、スタッフも優秀で、パリでは有り難いバスタブがあった事。
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location!
text:
This hotel is well located near shops and restaurants just a 2-3 min walk. Nice and clean and offer kitchenette in the room which is a plus if you want to have a quick meal in the room (they do not offer room service or breakfast).
Free coffee and espresso is available in the lobby.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent .
text:
Very good to stay in family. The hotel has at guests disposal, coffee, hot chocolate and tea all day. The hotel is close to some tourist attractions, which can be done on foot.

We stayed in an apartment for four people, very spacious.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great Location and Hotel
text: Unfortunately we only stayed one night and wish we would have discovered this hotel sooner.  It's in a great location and had a great little kitchen that we never got a chance to use.  Many nice touches like slippers, shampoo, conditioner and great smelling soap.  Very clean little apartment with a comfortable bed.  We'd definitely go back again!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Good place to stay when visiting Paris
text: Very convenient location. Walking distance to many attractions. Very close to metro and RER stations. Lots of restaurants in the area. Grocery store is close and you can buy something and use the small kitchen. Friendly staff. Very clean.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Love the kitchen
text:
Very good size room. Modern renovation. Have a kitchen! Very hard to find in Paris center.
Great location for tourist. Walk to a few major attractions and along the river.
Don't try to park a full size car.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Wonderful hotel in a terrific part of Paris
text: I brought my fiancé here for a vacation.  I am so glad I picked this hotel.  It is located right along the river.  There were so many wonderful dining and entertainment options nearby.  The room itself was good and the staff was wonderful.  I would highly recommend.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Excellent
text:
Excellent cost and benefit. Great location and outstanding staff attendance!
Quick Check In and check out.  Poor breakfast,  which must be improved to match the hotel level.  I Will certainly return with my family.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Hotel has everything
text: The hotel was great.  Our room was spotless, had a full kitchen, queen bed, a quieter courtyard view, enclosed bathroom and a 24-hour receptionist. The location was only 2 blocks to the Saint-Michel Metro/RER-B train which services CDG Airport.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Apartment ok.
text:
Apartment ok...kitchen supplies can be improved... eg kitchen sponge,kitchen towels which are not available...
Toilet flushing can be stronger, toilet stucked 2 times in 2days. So we did not fully utiilised the toilet in those 2 days. We are so cautious that we decided to use the toilet at the lobby. Inconvenient.
Beds are good, very comfortable
Especially the sofa bed was more comfortable than we had expected.
Happy that we can have an extra bed in the bedroom.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Paris accomodation
text:
Stayed at Citedines St Germain Du Pres for six days.
Grocery store and an organic grocery store close by.
Toiletries provided were good quality and quantity.
Complimentary coffe, a variety of teas and hot chocolate avaiable in reception.
Minor maintenance required in room, the kick board on kitchen unit kept falling down, and no lids for saucepans.
Right on the Seine, close to Notre Dame...close to eveything you want to see!
Enjoyed our stay and would stay there again
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Location, location
text: Citadines was a safe, clean apartment hotel.  The breakfast buffet was very good and had gluten free options!  The staff was friendly and most spoke English.  But the location!!!  Turn left and it’s a half block  to Pont Neuf, and a short walk to the Louvre.  Turn right and it’s a few blocks to St. Michel and restaurants and shopping. A few more blocks to Notre Dame.  Oh, and a few blocks from where Picasso lived and painted Guernica....surrounded by galleries.  Wow!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text:
This Citadine is very well located, two stops on RER from Gare du Nord, with several metro stations and bus stops nearby.  Lots of restaurants.  And of course perfectly placed for walking over the Seine for major sights.
Our room was very quiet, facing an inner courtyard. We like Citadines because you can self-cater when necessary.
The staff are excellent, charming and very helpful.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Not 4 star property
text: First time staying at Citadines, based on recommendations of others & website.  This is a 3 star hotel with a 4 star location.  Our room definitely did not match photos on Citadine website; was very tired and only somewhat clean.  Rooms are only serviced weekly, which was a surprise to us (not a big problem but we weren't aware).  If desired, guests could replace towels themselves.  Bed not very comfortable.  For the price we paid, we could've (and would've) stayed somewhere much nicer.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Citadines Rocks!
text: While in Paris, we wanted to stay in a nice flat with a kitchen. But the apartment we had scheduled fell far, far short of our expectations and we refused to stay there. So, we scrambled online to find an alternative at the last minute, using "apartment hotel" as the search criteria. That's how we found Citadines - several in Paris - and in particular the Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres. The price was equivalent to the flat we had scheduled and it was located on the Seine a 5-minute walk to the Louvre, Notre Dame and lots of shopping and restaurants. The hotel was nicely appointed and the room was immaculate. We were on the 6th floor overlooking the Seine with a breathtaking view of the city. The room was spacious, the kitchen had two burners, a microwave, dishwasher and small fridge. And the staff were courteous, efficient and very helpful (we had a lot of questions, as this was our first trip to Paris). Having found this haven, we were free to enjoy our vacation with peace of mind.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Left Bank Paris Lication
text: My husband and I spent 6 days here recently. We loved this aparthotel.  It was our first time using this company and I recommend it highly.  The location is central to all things in Paris.  We saw the Eiffel Tower from our room.  The rooms are larger than typical Paris hotel rooms and having a small kitchen was a major plus.  The coffee machines in the lobby are wonderful and the comfort closet made it easy to swap out towels and pick up other amenities as needed.  Overall great aparthotel experience in Paris!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Disappointing room
text: While the hotel was itself great and in a fantastic location, the room was disappointing (1702). The sloping roof made the bathroom and bedroom very crowded. The room was very old and needed to be upgraded. It was not what we expected from the website- We made this known to staff who told us it was an old hotel- This was the only disappointing hotel out of the 7 we stayed in on our trip to Europe. My advice would be to confirm room quality before paying.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: A great location
text: We stayed for 5 nights and were really happy with the location of this apartment - across from the Seine so major Ing/evening walks were great; easy access to many attractions and subway; room (studio)  had everything we needed and the staff were very helpful. It is a little dated but we expected that.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Unsanitary hotel with unfortunately poor service
text: We have stayed at the Citadines in the past and would rate this hotel with reasonable marks.  This year, however, was sadly different.  There was a link from a bathroom that flooded the floor of the room and the hotel did nothing to address the problem.  For two days, we waded through the bathroom scum.  Finally, they put is in another room without fixing the problem.  The staff really doesn't care and if you do have a problem, I'm afraid you are without recourse.  Sad that the hotel cares so little about sanitation and the health and safety of its guests.  I never write poor reviews of hotels, ever.  But, I'm so sorry to say that I would warn everyone to stay away from Citadines Saint-Germain.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Very nice location
text: I recommend the appartements with river Seine's view. It's amazing! You can also see the Notre Dame Cathedral. The Saint Germain area is the best in Paris. This hotel has many qualities, it's quite expensive for what they offer, but Paris is a very expensive town anyway. It was a good experience.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great location friendly staff
text: First time in Paris and we found the location was perfect.  A couple minutes walk to Nôtre Dame and the metro.  Check in was quick and easy.  We were checked in by Hedi and he was very helpful showing were all the attractions are and how to get around.  I would stay here again the next time I am in Paris.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Our Parisian home away from home
text:
When we travel as a family- 14 & 11 yo, we stay here. This is our second time in Paris with the kids, and our first trip was a week, and this one was 10 nights.

We stayed in a 1BR apartment, and our room had ample space. The living room became the kids room as the couch became a pull out double bed. TV’s in lounge room and bedroom so allowed separate viewing.

Toilet was separate from bath/shower. The small kitchenette was brilliant as we could have breakfast each day.

Were you are is central Paris, in a lovely safe area. We wandered around in the morning to get breakfast in local patisserie’s, we ate out in the evening in wonderful restaurants, and ate fast food at the many Greek and Lebanese foodaries.

Our room was only serviced once during the stay, but it allowed us to relax and be a bit messy. If you needed towels etc, they were all available downstairs.

Downstairs is a laundry and coffee bar, and you can get breakfast if you do desire it. Staff are wonderful, and if you need to print Disney tickets ( we went for the first time this trip) they will print them for you if you email them to their address. They were great with this, and they didn’t charge us.

The hotel doesn’t have the French charm some people look for, but we stay here as a family. If you want French charm you need a different hotel.

The St Germain area is brilliant, and Citadines St Germain is brilliantly located. Notre-Dame is to the right, Pont neuf is to the left and you can easily see the Eiffel Tower from there.

Our Parisian home away from home.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: comfortable 9 nights stay
text:
great location, clean and well lay out apartment, very comfortable bed ,  management seems to know what travellers need and want. staff was friendly and accomodating,
extra bonus: coffee, tea and water station accessable 24/7
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Amazing stay
text: We recently visited for my wife’s birthday. We had a busy schedule as we tried to see all the major tourist locations. This hotel is within walking distance of the louvre, Norte Dame, many excellent restaurants, and minutes away by car from the Eiffel Tower. There is also access to the underground a couple of blocks away. That was one of the reasons we chose this hotel. When we arrived at the hotel, we were greeted by very friendly and eager front desk staff. They were very knowledgeable of the area and had spot on suggestions to make our trip even more efficient. The apartment was very spacious, clean and comfortable. The staff even had a lovely gift awaiting my wife when we returned to the rooms on her actual birthday. That made our stay extra special. I will definitely return every time we are in Paris.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Best property in Paris for location and value
text: We stayed 6 days recently while visiting Paris. The location of this property, is absolute perfection. The Citadines hotel sit's right across the Seine River from the Louvre and Notre-Dame The amenities were great, much more than we expected. Our room had a small kitchen, in its own room. The hotel also has a great water refilling station and very nice hot coffee/tea machines in the lobby, all free of charge. The staff is very pleasant and always helpful with any questions you may have. We loved everything about our stay.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Stay in Paris
text: This hotel located around the hottest region for tourists close to Note Dam and with public transports around it is easy to reach. Our apartment is clean and cozy, we do enjoy the stay a lot. It would be even better if you get the room facing the river, will be amazing!!
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Well equipped and comfortable
text: Great for our family of four. Well equipped and well located. Apartment option worked well. Housekeeping only after 6 nights but additional towels,paper etc all available self serve. Laundry facilities well maintained and easy to use. (Around $7AU for each wash)
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Great Position
text: Great position for attractions and Metro, room was adequate in size, kitchenette had everything to self cater. We felt the room was a little tired. For Paris we thought it was good value for money. Free coffee machine in the lobby was always welcome after a day sightseeing.
name: Citadines Saint-Germain-des-Pres Paris

title: Perfect in every way!
text: This hotel is a beautiful boutique hotel, with beautiful breakfast room, welcoming entry with fireplace, and rooms are decorated in beautiful rich fabrics and colors.  The staff is so accommodating and makes you feel well cared for during your stay.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect home base for a Paris Visit
text: The location is great and we were able to walk to the Louvre, tons of great shops and restaurants as well as the Eglise de Saint Germain des Pres. What made it more special was the actual history of the hotel coupled with the kind and smiling staff. The rooms are on the small side but so are most in Paris but they are clean and comfortable. Really happy with our stay.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Hotel da Vinci is the best!
text: My husband & I visited Paris for the first time and absolutely loved the Hotel Da Vinci. Honorene, Helen, and Christine are the most helpful and attentive staff we've ever experienced in hospitality.  We loved the romantic Romeo & Juliet balcony. We enjoyed tasting the different French wines in the hotel fridge. The location is close to the Louvre, D'Orsay & other tourist spots. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay as smooth and enjoyable as possible. We can't wait to return!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Fabulous hotel
text: A lovely hotel. Great location, 5 mins from La Louvre. Friendly helpful staff, a very warm welcome. Very clean, really comfy bed. Lovely room, great shower. The hotel has a quaint, Parisian feel, good breakfast. The spa is a real treat and special due to the fact your session is private. The air conditioning is very efficient. I stayed with my 18 year old daughter, we loved it! I would highly  recommend it.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent Hotel
text: excellent hotel, nice staff, great location, would definitely stay in DaVinci Hotel our next trip to Paris! Great breakfast; nice pool; clean room with a great view; overall very satisfied with our stay at Davinci Hotel.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent Romantic Stay
text:
This hotel is truly a beautiful boutique 4 star in a superb location, close to attractions, restaurants and also quiet too. 

Room was excellent and all the employees were splendid and helpful. 

This is a true find in the heart of Paris and you will be happy here. It is small and quaint.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Hotel DaVinci, Paris
text: Loved this hotel! So personal, great cafe - good breakfast, with a honesty bar at night… the staff couldn’t be more friendly and helpful! They even sent me a Welcome champagne! They took care of me when I didn’t feel well one morning (traveler issues) & brought me bottled water to my room… Each day,  I returned after lunch time,  for a much needed plung in the basement spa pool… so relaxing & calming! The first day, I got a massage after my flight!  GREAT LOCATION- within walking to many sights & museums & close to many Metro sights! Perfect! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent service
text: The staff is amazing, every single member of the staff went above and beyond our expectations. The room was spotless, breakfast was amazing, and the location is near everything we wanted to visit. The Louvre museum is within walking distance. In summary, we couldn’t ask for a better hotel to stay in the area
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Amazing Stay 10/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text: We stayed at this hotel for 2 nights and our stay was one of the best I’ve ever had, the rooms were beautiful and so well kept. The bed was super comfy and we had the best nights sleep. All the staff were so friendly and helped us out with anything we needed. It’s in the most perfect location as it’s a 5 minute walk to the Louvre and if you use the electric scooter and bikes close by you can see the Eiffel Tower in 10 minutes with a quick ride along the river! It was honestly the most perfect trip we could have asked for. This was our first holiday together as a couple and we felt the most comfortable and welcome. One of the best parts was having access to the spa which you book to have all to yourself. It’s such a beautiful space and so relaxing! Defiantly add to your booking when you visit. I can not recommend this hotel enough for a great stay in Paris. Thank you to everyone at the hotel for making us feel so welcome!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Beautiful gem in the city
text: We loved this boutique Hotel. The hotel has embraced its history, through out the hotel. The staff are friendly and helpful. The room we found was lovely and clean the bed was comfortable with nice linen. I particularly enjoyed the little balcony where we could eat out breakfast and enjoy the city. Location was great and made life easier to explore by foot. I would love to stay again one
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Great Hotel Perfect Location
text:
Love this Hotel. Great Staff, Great amenities.  Exceptionally located.
We picked this hotel online because it was near the Louvre and St Germain. On arrival we were met with a friendly and helpful staff. The breakfast was excellent and the evening drinks were a nice plus. The rooms were clean and neat and very spacious. We can't wait to visit again.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Business & Leisure stay in the heart of Paris
text: Very quaint hotel. Staff were very nice and courteous. Spa was fun and relaxing at the end of a hectic day. Breakfast was awesome! Location for getting around the city was perfect. Room and bathroom was on the smaller side.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect location, wonderful stay
text: The Hotel Da Vinci was perfect for our week long, first visit to Paris. The location was convenient and the room was comfortable. The rooms are very well soundproofed. The bathroom was clean and good sized and they provide really good soaps etc to use. The breakfast buffet was good and fresh and we loved having access to the espresso machine. The time in the private spa was relaxing after a long day of sightseeing. My only complaint about the whole experience was the spa water could have been hotter and the massage jets were difficult to turn on. Also, the closet space is small, but they provided a clothing steamer in the room which was a nice surprise. We really couldn't have asked for a better stay!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Great location, friendly staff…..service not so great.
text: The staff is friendly and the location is great.  That said, we had multiple issues with service.   My wife booked a facial but when the time came for the appointment the staff just took her to the private spa.  When she asked about the facial they said she had to have a ‘consultation’ first but didn’t explain what that was.  In any event, no facial.  We dropped off laundry to be cleaned but the person on duty put it in the lost and found.  It took them a few hours to find it but we were leaving that day so missed the opportunity to have it cleaned.  This is a small thing but there was only one cup and one coffee pod in the room the first day we arrived.  We inquired a couple of times about getting another one but never received one.  We finally were able to secure one of each from the restaurant.  Again, the staff is friendly and the location is awesome but the service was lacking enough to render a ‘Poor’ rating.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect
text: Excellent central location, very comfortable mattress! Rokms are compact, same as most hotels in Paris. Helpful and friendly staff. Private spa which you can reserve for an hour. Breakfast buffet is fresh. A hidden gem!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Small, but great!
text:
Very nice, helpful people running the place, especially Helen. Great location. Very clean. Smaller rooms so keep that in mind when selecting your type (standard, deluxe, etc.) We also had a view of the street which was nice, I guess some people had views of the inner courtyard 👎. 
Enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this hotel.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Room cancelled by the hotel as we discovered when we tried to check in
text: We had booked two rooms and arrived Sunday evening after confirming by phone the previous Thursday that everything was fine - even down to the individual we spoke to confirming the spa bookings had been made - only to discover that the booking for both rooms had been cancelled by the hotel the day of the call.  No email sent to tell us it had been cancelled, no explanation why, and no help to find alternative accommodation - which we did at a very nice hotel close by but at more than double the price as you might expect when booking at 6pm for that day.  We know the hotel is nice as some of the family had stayed there before but there are lots of nice hotels in the area, I just wouldn't take the risk that the room would be reserved for you given what happened to us.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent
text:
Great location, great staff. Nice spa.  
Only downside is that I paid extra to have a room with a balcony… however the balcony is in the middle of the building, rather like an elevator shaft. No view, just the wall opposite, and it made the room incredibly dark as there were no other windows. The room was nice but would recommend choosing a different room type.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: The best of Paris
text: Excellent location, beautiful interior, really good bed and the nicest breakfast. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Good advice and support from employees. The shop next door could offer the nicest selection of french delicatesses.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Myself and my husband had a fabulous time in the Hotel Da Vinci recently. We stayed in a standard room which was small but spotlessly clean and the shower was really good. The location is perfect close to the Louvre and a metro station with lots of cafes and restaurants nearby. The staff were very friendly, professional and helpful. Breakfast each morning was lovely also. We would absolutely stay in this hotel again.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A lovely hotel in a great location!
text:
A really lovely hotel and we had a great 3 nights here. It is the perfect hotel and location for a city break.

Positives: Perfect location, central to so many things and a 2 minute walk to the Seine. Restaurants and bars are close by too! Hotel is small but beautiful and the rooms are the same, small but beautifully decorated. Lovey products in the bathroom, plus a robe and slippers. Our breakfast was included and this was really good- a small selection of cooked food, but all the meats, cheese, yogurts, croissants, pain au chocolate etc that you could want. And a really friendly server (but I can’t remember her name). The spa is AMAZING. Definitely book your 45 minute slot if it’s included. We took a bottle of champagne down and it was so nice to have a private spa experience!

Negatives: It was a special weekend (birthday and engagement) and my partner had ordered champagne to be waiting in the room. This wasn’t there on arrival and he had to go and ask for it. They set it up when we were in there which isn’t quite the same. We were in a superior balcony room as I love balconies and a view (even a courtyard as it states), but there is a reason there are no pictures of the balcony view on any site… there isn’t one at all, it just leads to a very enclosed courtyard. This means the room was quite dark too. I would recommend booking the street view if you want to see a little bit more from your window.

Overall we would definitely recommend this hotel!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Wonderful Stay
text: My husband and I celebrated our 25th anniversary with a trip to Paris and stayed at the Hotel da Vinci. This boutique hotel was beautiful and in a great location. We were able to walk to museums, restaurants, and cafes. Staff were wonderful and upgraded us to a larger room since we were there five days. Breakfast each morning was delicious And had great options. I will definitely consider staying here again.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Beauty, service, Near museums and Galleries
text: The staff is very responsive. The private-use spa room by reservation with professional massage was relaxing. The hotel is charming, The living and dining space is very cozy ( and small). Hotel Di Vinci is a good place for a single woman traveling.  It is close to dozens of fabulous galleries and museums.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Unforgettable
text: A great hotel in a really convenient location. Team are excellent and very attentive, hotel is incredibly keen, quiet area. Upgrade to a balcony if you can. The spa is well worth using to unwind after sightseeing. Magic hotel, amazing team and great location, what’s not to like!.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: The perfect place in Paris
text: The perfect place for a romantic and relaxing stay in Paris. The location of the hotel is perfect, near to Museums (Louvre, Musee D'Orsay), bars, cafes and restaurants. The room is very comfortable and the bathroom was clean with a good shower. Breakfast was wonderful, especially the croissants and pain au chocolat - I definitely ate a few too many! We enjoyed our time at the spa, which gave a nice opportunity to relax after some long days of walking! We will definitely be back!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A secret history
text:
What a lovely stay in Paris. The Hotel Da Vince is a wonderfully charming small hotel with a little bit of history of its own (the name is not random). The hotel and the rooms are on the smaller side, but that does not take away from the enjoyment of the space or the staff. You will have everything you need. From a beautiful sitting area in the front lobby, to bedding that I am intent on finding for my own home. We had breakfast each day at the hotel to get us off to a pleasant start to the day. The staff was helpful on the occasions we had questions and the rooms and common space are beautifully done. It is perfectly situated for walking around and exploring Paris. D’Orsay, Notre Dame, and the Louvre are among the destinations which are an easy walk (well under a mile) and the neighborhood is just outside the bustling streets and cafes of the Latin Quarter.

Thank you for being such a terrific part of our most recent Paris adventures!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Desaster
text:
We booked the hotel for a weekend at secret escapes and we have been shocked. this hotel is one of the worsed hotels we ever have been. Dirty and ugly and staircase, only four rooms each floor and the lift-door. so you can hear everything during the night. The bed was dirty so have to change the room, the women at the reception was unfriendly - everything is so much tight. They offered a bottle of prosecco for free at booking, but we got nothing. The hotel is situated directly on a main-street.
Never ever!!!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: My Favorite Hotel in France. . .
text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful and it is in an amazing location, only a six minute walk to Les Deux Magots and and a 10 minute walk to the Musee d’Orsay.   The room is wonderful with a very comfortable bed and the decor is updated while beautiful old architectural features remain in place.  There is  plenty of lighting and the bathroom is small but nicely arranged and elegant.  I like to try new hotels but I will stay here each time I come to Paris going forward because it is such an ideal location and a pretty place and everyone has been very helpful.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Terrible service, horrific breakfast
text:
I don’t understand how this place has such a high rating. Perhaps it just got bad recently? To be fair, it’s a nice-looking place and in really good shape. Everything is clean and neatly refurbished. But the service is just awful. 
Check-in was cordial enough. No complaints. 
But we booked through a Staycation offer (based on an exaggerated savings) and they forgot to give us the bottle of champagne. Not a big deal, but off to a poor start. 
Then we get in the room and discover we can’t use the safe because the battery was dead. 
The standard room was incredibly minuscule. I realize Parisian hotels are small, but this room was insanely tiny. You can barely just walk around the bed. 
The biggest nightmare of our stay was the breakfast the next morning. In my entire life, I’ve never seen such an unorganized mess. When we showed up, not a single table was cleared. So we patiently waited for them to clear one off. When we finally got settled, our first surprise was the coffee machine was broken.  I honestly don’t understand why a hotel would rely so much on a machine like that without a single backup solution. I waited 25 minutes while they tried to fix it. I kept asking the staff, Why don’t you just pull out one of those manual machines like they have in the bedrooms? Or at least offer basic filtered coffee like most hotels do. Not everyone cares about an espresso. I would’ve been happy with just basic filter. That idea seemed beyond them. Finally, after the coffee machine was settled, I make my way over to the food. Everything of interest was empty. The pans for the eggs and bacon were totally empty. They said, we’ll get more. When they finally came back with the scrambled eggs, they were hot in some areas and ice-cold in others. By the way, this breakfast costs €18 per person. 
When we went to check out the next morning, I was hoping the clerk would ask how everything went. I would’ve politely and respectfully mentioned some of the issues. But he didn’t even ask. Didn’t seem to care.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Marvelous home away from home in Paris!
text: We all LOVED the Da Vinci Hotel. The staff and management was professional, patient, kind, knowledgeable, and made us feel at home. The rooms were comfortable and clean, and the location was perfect. We would recommend it highly to any family traveling to Paris!!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Very special stay
text: We stayed at Hotel Da Vinci in August of 2021. When we first got to the hotel, there was a mix up with our reservation, but the staff went above and beyond to make it right. The location of the hotel is PERFECT. It is on a beautiful, walkable street with many amazing restaurants within very close distance. The St. Germain area of Paris is to die for. The room we stayed in had a French balconette (?) overlooking the street. The view was perfect. The street is VERY quiet at night. Our room was very clean and had many special touches. The rooms are small, but this is Paris, after all! There is an elevator. The breakfast in the morning was perfect, and my husband could NOT get enough of the croissants. They were delicious! We were so sad to leave, and cannot wait to go again. We will definitely stay at Hotel Da Vinci.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Best location, elegant, clean and great rooms.
text:
We spent 5 nights at the lovely Hotel Da Vinci, and recommend it highly. It is a small, elegant hotel. Fabulous staff were welcoming and extremely helpful. The room was in the back, so there was no view but that did not matter to us. The room was small but not confining, with a beautiful and comfortable large king sized bed, dressed in white bedding with real down pillows and comforter. We appreciated that as we hate the polyester bedding so many hotels use. The room was nicely cool with a quiet indiscrete air conditioner. We loved the bathroom, and the shower is a dream, great pressure, a huge rainshower head and a large shower stall. There were two nice closets, and good lighting.
The spa in the basement is a real treat, very magical and beautiful, and great to swim or soak, with a fantastic overhead jet to massage neck or back. 
Best of all, the location is perfect, two blocks to the Seine, the Louvre is right across the river, and a short couple of blocks to the heart of Saint Germain. Easy walking location but not in an overrun tourist location.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A chic & gorgeous hotel close to the best of Paris
text: A charming and very cozy hotel in the heart of Paris. Extremely nice staff. Very well-decorated. It has an especial spa area and a delicious breakfast full of little details. We repeated hotel because we were delighted last year. 100% recommended
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: The best stay
text: My family came and stayed the hotel and had a wonderful time. The staff paid impeccable attention to detail to all our needs. We could walk everywhere from the Louvre to all attractions. We will be back!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Close to the seine
text: It is a beautiful hotel located in the beautiful districts of Paris, we liked to walk on the quays, we slept in a beautiful room with a beautiful decoration, excellent bedding, excellent breakfast, excellent value for money, the staff was professional and helpful , excellent memory
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A sanctuary away from Covid
text:
We loved this place. The hotel and all the staff are amazing. This is not just another hotel. It is full of charm and history. It has a soul. The staff are wonderful. 
The spa is not to be missed.  You get your own private session (55 mins) but book your slots early. 
Location is excellent. Short walk across the Seine to the Louvre. Get a 48 hour ticket for the Batobus (nearest stop at the Louvre) and this hop on/off boat ride takes you to a number of tourist spots along the Seine. Germain area with its fashionable shopping is also a short walk away.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent Staff, Family Friendly
text: Over all our stay was fantastic. The level of service was exceptional. Due to Covid19 their services and meals were limited but that didn't keep them from providing excellent service. We requested the Mona Lisa room but it was located on the first floor and small for 2 adults and 1 child. Also the private terrace is located next to the hotel cafe area only separated by a sheet of wooden lattice fencing. We asked for something larger and they gave us a larger room equally as nice at no additional charge on a higher floor.  The beds were a bit more firm than the average American mattress which made it hard to get comfortable. Very kid friendly the provided a small cot as well. It's also in a great location for shopping, cafe's macaroons and walking distance to the Louvre.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent
