text: First time in Paris and this hotel made traveling all over extremely easy. Great location next to the Lourve, center of a varity of cafe's, friendly staff, comfortable rooms, and clean. One of the best hotels I've stayed in.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect
text: Exceptionally Friendly and helpful, ideal location, staff were more than willing to spend time with you and offer advice, the tips on where to go were perfect and local knowledge added to our experience
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Honeymoon
text: Hotel is absolutely beautiful. Boutique hotel with fabulous service. Would definitely visit again. Rooms are gorgeous. Central stay and only 5 minute walk to the Louvre and 15 minute walk to Champs Elysees.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Nice stay in Paris
text:
Clean rooms, nice staff and quiet neighbourhood. Breakfast buffet was tasty and varied. 
There was a little misunderstanding regarding booking of the Spa. A friendly suggestion to the hotel: Providing a written confirmation of the Spa reservation would reduce the chances of getting the reservation wrong.
The Spa itself is in the basement, a little moist and a slight smell of mould, but overall a relaxing experience.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A gem
text: Best location! I walked everywhere. The staff is the nicest around. If you’ve any reservations regarding your stay in Paris- let them go- book a room here. Everything in Europe is small- but this room! It had stained glass windows opening to center of building over the bigger than I needed tub, French (!) door windows over the street, a glorious bed, staff understanding a variety of what ‘coffee’ means to you. Stay here. This neighborhood and the locals were my favorite. For the money, there’s no question- at hotel da Vinci- your trip will be amazing! D’orsey, the louvre only blocks. Eiffel Tower? A quick midnight walk. Art? Oh my! This is the area for small galleries. Stop looking and book it!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Absolute Gem!
text: What a wonderful hotel this is! The service was fantastic from the moment we arrived, just couldn’t ask for more. The room beautiful and clean with lovely smelling complimentary toiletries. We were on the top floor and had a lovely little balcony. The room was on the small side but this felt wonderfully French Boutique and cozy so was not an issue at all. To top off such a lovely place, private use of the spa can be booked each day too. It really was wonderfully romantic! Such a great treasure especially after lots of walking exploring the city. I cannot recommend this hotel enough; great location, helpful staff, beautiful rooms, spa - made our weekend trip to Paris just extra special! Will be sure to return :-)
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect location, brilliant staff
text: First, we found rumors of rude, unhelpful, Parisians to be totally untrue—once you leave CDG.  The team at Hotel Da Vinci is triply warm, welcoming and friendly in attempting to assist with every request.  A typically small space, every inch is used efficiently in a modern updated interior.  The breakfasts are excellent and include eggs, bacon and sausage in addition to the very fine continental selections.  They bring a great upgrade to the honor bar—a full bar is available off the lobby 5 pm to midnight.  A wonderful bottle of sparkling wine was provided, the incidentals are reasonable and the spa access is included.  Very good value!  The support and concern provided during an urgent medical issue was above and beyond.  Great experience—we’ll be back largely because of this great boutique hotel.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Wonderful - went out of their way to help us!
text:
Helene on reception accomodated us at a busy time when I had somehow due to website error on Booking com arrived one month early. There was no extra charge and no flat refusal to help as you would get in many hotels. 

The room was small but tastefully decorated  The Spa Jacuzzi was excellent, really powerful jets in an intimate setting. The location is perfect for St Germain  A lovely stylish boutiquehotel doing it's best for customers. What more can you ask?
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Combination of feelings
text: The history and the location of that hotel makes you to forget the small mistakes. The managers of the hotel must follow the history of that stay in order to worth the value. Even living in a very small room you can feel the story at least
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A real gem!
text: Perfect central location, extremely helpful and kind staff, lovely and quiet though small room but with a wonderful large soaking tub. We were there during a national strike severely impacting transit and the hotel always made sure we had transportation arranged for our many visits. The staff could not have been more accommodating.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: A recent stay in Germain-des-Prés via the Da Vinci
text:
In December a special event brought me to Paris with my husband. Three other couples accompanied us. We wanted a place to stay that would be cozy and inviting. Intimate and comfortable. We found it at the Da Vinci. The rooms are compact but comfortable, especially those with balconies. There is only a small lobby, but the staff is always anxious to make you feel welcome and will offer you a drink. The location is ideal for almost anything you are planning. For us, we were interested in seeing the Christmas Markets and I think the best ones were within walking distance of the hotel. Also, the walk to the first from there is charming, with so much great window shopping and galleries along the way. 
The staff at this hotel is what really sold me. They could not have been more pleasant or accommodating - and, it probably wasn't always so easy, with such a large group! Additionally, they provided good recommendations and helped us with transportation issues during the transit strike.
I found the Da Vinci a perfect spot for a quick getaway to Paris!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Character and comfort in a great location
text: Did a quick trip to Paris for our anniversary and wanted to find a place in one of our favorite neighborhoods…St. Germain. Hotel DaVinci was a perfect find.  The location is great within easy walking distance to any attraction we wanted to see. And the neighborhood itself is filled with great cafés, galleries and places to eat. Hotel was charming with lots of character and a great helpful and friendly staff. How room it’s self was small but beautiful with the balcony that contain small table and chairs for us to sit and sip champagne that was waiting for us in our room as a welcome gift. We never had a chance to use the spa but from everything we saw it looked beautiful.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Excellent customer service and a beautiful hotel
text:
We booked this hotel for my boyfriends birthday. This beautiful Renaissance inspired hotel is located in the heart of Paris. It was a big advantage for us as we visited during the strike.
The staff was very welcoming, friendly and helpful. Excellent management.
We booked their superior room with balcony and spa access. The room was very clean and our bed was very comfortable. But if we knew the history of this hotel before, we would have definitely booked the room 603.( When Mona Lisa was being stolen from the Louvre Museum in 1911 by Vincenzo Perrugia he booked the room 603 to hide it. He was hoping to escape from the roof in case something goes wrong.) I also got the chance to meet the gentleman who was staying at room at the elevator and he confirmed that it is beautiful room.
Their spa is small but beautiful and it needs to be  booked by the reception and you can only visit it on your time slot. 
Their bar is open until midnight and is also being used as the breakfast area.
Overall our experience in this Hotel was very good and we will definitely recommend.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Amazing place in a top location
text: Great overall experience. Croissants in the breakfast room were to die for! Location can’t be beat. Rooms were of a decent size. Absolutely no street level noise. Interesting spa in the basement although i did not use it.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Romantic Getaway
text: My wife and I just stayed at the Hotel Da Vinci this past weekend.  Our stay was absolutely fantastic!  The staff was friendly and helpful and the hotel was great!  We had an early arrival and our room was ready before noon.  Thanks for being so accommodating.  Looking forward to returning soon!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: FANTASTIC Hotel!
text: My husband and I stayed here, and we couldn’t have been happier with the outstanding service, location, and grotto pool that was private! All you had to do was request an hour, and you had the entire pool to yourself, for FREE! This was such a treat after a long day of walking. What other hotel can offer you a heated private pool?  The breakfast was wonderful, and the staff was nothing short of 5 star. If you are looking for a boutique hotel that offers high end service, this is your spot! We will be back! ❤️
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Charming Boutique Hotel; Super Helpful Staff
text: We stayed 4 nights in the Mona Lisa Room and our experience was excellent!  It started with the staff who were beyond friendly and were eager to help us find the right restaurants and make suggestions for our trip.  Special call out for Helene and Guillaume at the reception desk.  You are the best!!!  Our room was very comfortable and the rain shower in the bathroom was really nice. Everything was immaculately clean.  The neighborhood is great for walking to many of the tourist attractions in Paris.  It felt very safe to walk at night and was very close to lots of restaurants and nightclubs.  I would absolutely stay here again.  A great experience all around.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: So charming with best location!
text:
We stayed in this wonderful little hotel 3 nights in november! The service is excellent and the check-in is quick and effective.
The hotel is so charming and the historywhy it is called ’Da Vinci’ makes it even more interesting/ exciting.
The only negative thing about the hotel is the size of the room. You can barely put ONE suitcase in a suitable place and If you by accident have two it will be really difficult to move around in the Room.
There is only one small wardrobe. 
But the beds are great and it is very quiet during nighttime.
The Spa is a very nice experience, really relaxing. You can reserve this little Spa for up to 6 People. They have no gym, but we where not in Paris to work-out, so we didn’t miss that.When it comes to ’treatments’ the information that you need to  reserve this at least ”two hours ahead ” is not really true.This tas not possible; We tried to book this but it was totally fully booked at least one day ahead, so if you would like some massage make sure you book this well in advance!
The location of the hotel is excellent. It is in the middle of everything. It is close to Louvren, Musei d’Orsay and not far from other points of interest. You have a lot of great restaurants all around.
We did not have any breakfast in the hotel, so cannot say anything about that.
Anyway; I would absolutely come back and stay here again but this time I would definitely not bring 2 suitcases.... Otherwise I really recommend this charming hotel!!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Very friendly staff
text: Beautiful hotel. The room was really nice, with a balcony. Staff were very helpful. They have this pool/spa room which you can reserve for an hour at a time. Quite an interesting idea. Of course lots of good restaurants and cafes nearby.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Nice hotel but a couple things could have been better
text: We booked two rooms for this hotel — ‘Invention’ room and a superior room with a balcony. The check-in process at the hotel was a little bit unsatisfactory. We had just arrived in an Uber after coming to Paris on a 3 hour train ride from Geneva. The check-in process was slow — my main issue was that three other parties came in while I was in the middle of checking-in and the hostess immediately tended to their needs, interrupting getting us checked-in, while we just stood there, after several hours of traveling.  I was in need of using the washroom so did not appreciate that wait. They had complimentary water and bread available which was a nice perk. As previously mentioned, we had booked two rooms. The ‘nicer’ of the two rooms, which was also priced about €50/night higher than the invention room was OK but very small. The room advertised a balcony but there was absolutely no view. I was a little annoyed that this was a bit of a selling point when it was not a nice balcony. In fact we all found that the cheaper room was nicer, with a view out the window and a bit bigger. The hotel provided a complimentary bottle of champagne for each room which was very nice, and appreciated by the ladies in my party. Our rooms came with breakfast included. The breakfast was nice. Fruit, breads, egg, sausage. Nothing too over the top but it was good. The hotel has a very nice atmosphere. Definitely a boutique feeling. The location is very excellent and one of the reasons I chose the hotel. Close access to the Louvre, in particular. The staff was very friendly. They had complimentary umbrellas available for use which we did use as we experienced some rain on the trip.  They have a bar which they call an “honesty” bar meaning you can take what you’d like to take and you write down what you took and they bill it to the room invoice. I liked this service as it was always accessible. The ladies in my group did not understand the bar system at first and helped themselves to drinks without writing it down. I did make that right, however, by submitting a list of their drinks on the paper, to ensure we were billed. Overall a nice stay, aside from the slow check-in and the balcony room being small and with a bad view.  If anything, it’s my opinion that the hotel should really specify that the room has no view, even thought it has a balcony, and it should probably be the same price as the other rooms. Perhaps it would be advantageous to have the balcony if a cigarette smoker but as we don’t smoke it was not something nice to have. The WiFi connection was quite slow, and the worst connection out of the 4 hotels we stayed at in Europe this trip. I would probably stay at a different hotel on a future visit to Paris but there is a chance I might return. The staff at the hotel, including those working at the breakfast, were all very nice and friendly.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Beautiful bijou hotel on the left bank!
text: This was our third and wonderful stay at the Da Vinci hotel, and it was as good as always. It's a gorgeous bijou hotel in a townhouse on the left bank, each room decorated with Leonardo da Vinci replica paintings behind the bed. Aptly named because the Mona Lisa was once stolen and hidden in the attic before it became a hotel. It's in a brilliant location on the left bank, with views of The Louvre at the top of the street and the Boulevard St Germain down the other end, surrounded by lovely shops and restaurants in neighbouring streets. There's a welcoming cosy reception with open fire resembling a gentleman's living room or study, and a lovely little pool/spa in the basement with changing coloured lights in the water (you have to book time slot as it can only can take a couple at a time, and they have swimsuits if you forget your own). Breakfast is served opposite the reception in a quaint little parlour with white clothed tables for two and an honesty bar. We had rooms 303 and 301.The pretty standard rooms have rather small en-suite shower rooms, and overlook the quiet street with full sound insulation from double glazed french windows. Best for a single traveller or weekend couple, despite the two wardrobes and dressing table, there is no room for a big suitcase, but that is typical of Paris hotels. Luxury rooms are larger and face the inner courtyard with larger bathrooms and twin beds if required, some with small balcony. There is also a lift to all bedrooms. The staff couldn't be more helpful - from restaurant bookings or fixing light bulbs, they were so welcoming and always a friendly smile. Particular mention goes to Raffaela on front desk for all her suggestions and help each day. I stupidly left my valuables behind in the room safe, and she posted them straight away. Recommended for friendliness, style and location, a real gem.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Disappointing  & over priced
text:
My daughter took me away for 3 nights surprise stay 
She paid nearly £1500 which didn’t include breakfast. 
No tea or coffee facilities are in the room & you have to pay if you want a hot drink. Nothing is complementary 
The spa is a joke!  Literally a small pool in a room. The fountain not working. Only luke warm temperature   In the photos it looks big but it is so small.
If you request a massage this has to be done in a separate hotel room.  This is NOT a spa hotel,  they arrange for an outdoor therapist to come to the hotel. 
The room was very small with no where to put a second suitcase.  No room for bedside tables either.  Totally impractical.   We asked for a room with a street balcony which is very pretty but again little dolls house table & chairs. 
Reception & breakfast area tiny as well. No where to kick back & relax. 
The area is lovely & the staff where lovely   Such a shame the photographs online are deceiving.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Perfect stay at Hotel Da Vinci
text: We had the best stay at Hotel Da Vinci. The staff were amazing and so accommodating! The location and hotel was spectacular. We were celebrating our anniversary and it was a perfect way to spend the night! We will be back!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Amazing
text:
very elegant and shic 
hotel, with friendly staff. 
the location of the hotel is very good, you can walk to many tourist attractions.
a remark for the young Irish man to whom we thank for the beautiful Breakfast conversation
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: 5 days in Paris
text: Very friendly hotel in the best location in Paris.  Guiseppe in reception was fabulous, always happy to book a restaurant or give you directions.  L'epicurie next door is a great little place where you can delicious salads, food and drinks too.  Great area, short walk to Le Louvre, Musee D'Orsay, great shopping and places to eat. I would definitely book this hotel again.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text: Lovely small hotel in the BEST LOCATION close to the Seine and Saint Germain. It is a short walk to the Musse D'Orsay, Louvre, and Concorde via the river and Notre Dame via Saint Germain's winding streets. If you enjoy walking you can also go on foot to the Eiffel Tower. It is such a lovely area you could spend your whole trip here. The staff were very keen to help and it is worth enjoying your private daily slot at the Spa.The room was small but very well designed for optimum use, with lots of space in the wardrobe, room for cases and well designed bathroom.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Awesome Staff
text: My second time staying at this hotel.  The staff is what makes it! Helpful with recommendations, reservations and some special touches that make it really amazing The location is perfect for walking to many parts of Paris.  I love the room with the small balcony that face the street.  The rooms and bathrooms are immaculate but are starting to become a bit dated.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Spectacular
text: The hosts went beyond the call of duty to meet our needs and make us feel at hone. The room decor was a special treat. Breakfasts were superb. So glad that I took time to enjoy the pool! What a perfect location- it was accessible to  everywhere that we wanted to go.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Five days in Paris.
text: Location allows you to walk everywhere in the city. The hotel is clean and friendly, the spa is private, comfortable and relaxing. The staff provided us with information and great recommendations. Look forward to our next stay.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Birthday in Paris
text: We loved everything about our stay at Hotel Da Vinci.. The entire staff was wonderful and very helpful for everything we needed.. The rooms are very clean and beautiful. Breakfast every morning was delicious and Adam was always ready to get us anything we needed.. A big Thank you to Giuseppe our concierge for all his help...and all of the staff..I can’t remember everyone’s names...but we had a great stay..great location for seeing all of the sights...
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Highlight of our time in Paris
text:
I loved the decor, the friendly staff, the breakfast, and the private hour in the spa! My husband and I booked one of the smallest rooms, (103) which YES, it was basically a bed and attached bathroom the size of a closet, but we had no problems. (We also had two large suitcases, so yes, it can be done!) The bed was comfortable and the room clean and quiet. We were greeted with a happy 'bonjour' by any staff we encountered during our 3-night stay. When we booked an hour in the spa, it was gorgeous and sexy, and perfect for recovering our tired feet after a long day of walking the city. The location is fabulous too--only a five-minute walk to the Louve. 

For us, this was worth every penny!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Great Hotel
text: Room was very quiet and we had a nice balcony with a great view.  This hotel is well located to many different sights and is located in a wonderful district with lots of restaurants.  Air conditioning worked well and was greatly needed during the heat wave this past summer. We received a nice bottle of Prosecco as a welcome gift and breakfast was delicious and served in a very nice setting.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Great week-end in Paris
text: Great location, great staff, excellent breakfast! The spa was very pleasant as well. We really enjoyed our stay and definitely recommend this hotel. Rooms could be a bit bigger, but this is quite common in Paris.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: WOW! Don't miss this one!
text: I have travelled to Paris many times for both pleasure and business. This time I travelled to Paris with my two daughters and husband. This hotel is an absolute gem.  The staff is amazing, the rooms are beautifully decorated, and the breakfast is delicious. The rooms were small but to be expected, this is Paris. The spa could be reserved and we reserved it for an hour every day. It was a fantastic oasis in the center of Paris. Honestly the best part of this hotel was the staff. They took care of everything I needed and things I didn't even know I needed.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: The people are great.
text: We enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Da Vinci.  It wasn't what I'd hoped for a four-star and four hundred dollars at night, but the people were so helpful and kind, that maybe t balances out.  The rooms are small but clean, and the location is great.  It's not a full-service hotel and it felt overpriced even for the fabulous location.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Fantastic hotel - Perfect mini-break
text:
The hotel da Vinci is a fantastic boutique hotel in the romantic St. Germain area of Paris, only a 5 minute walk to the river and just a little further to the Louvre.
As well as being beautiful, comfortable and clean, it has an infamous and intriguing history which captivates the imagination.
Giuseppe and Helen were both incredibly helpful, kind and accommodating - Thank you both for helping to make my wife's birthday trip one which we will both always remember.
I cannot recommend the hotel da Vinci highly enough.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Vacation
text: Good Location, Friendly staff, Nice Property, Not a full service hotel, but made for an enjoyable stay. We had two rooms small but clean and well appointed. Interesting decor, I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: 2 nights in Paris
text: Great location for walking to the sites, warm staff, great breakfast. The rooms were small, but that's what you get for a boutique hotel down the street from the seine river and a 4 minute walk to the heart of St Germain. The hotel also has a cool history... 1911 when the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre, the thief and the painting spent the night in this location. Good thing she is back because we had an easy walk from the hotel to meet her.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Wonderful Gem in the best part of the city
text: We were here for 5 nights in August 2019, and it was absolutely charming. We were there for our 30th anniversary.  The rooms were updated, the bathrooms newly remodeled (or so it seemed), the rooms were quiet with high sleep quality, and the location is close to everything. The location was perfect, right between Notre Dame, the Louvre, and Musee D'Orsey. Breakfast was very good with a broad variety. And the staff was wonderful and helpful. I highly recommend the Hotel Da Vinci to anyone traveling to Paris who is looking for a charming, boutique clean, updated, and wonderful hotel.
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Beautiful hotel with accommodating staff!
text: The hotel is located perfectly, only a 10-20 minute walk from the Louvre and Boulevard Saint-Germain. The staff are welcoming and friendly and the hotel itself is gorgeous. The rooms are well stocked and air conditioned, ours had a lovely view of the Parisian streets beneath, and the facilities are wonderful. Try out the spa! We will definitely be returning again. Merci beaucoup!
name: Hotel Da Vinci

title: Amazing!

title: Great location, service and clean rooms including baby crib!

title: Perfect spot in St Germain

Would stay here again!

title: AMAZING LITTLE JEWEL IN PARIS
text: I'm thrilled that I found this hotel and I will forever now use this hotel for any future stays in Paris. Where do I begin? Location Location Location! The metro is one block away and it also has the RER. It's a very established and wealthy neighborhood, Ave. MacMahon. steps away from Arc De Triomphe. The neighborhood has a grocery store down the street, as well a laundry mat and an ATM. Plenty of local restaurants on Av. Mac Mahon. Go ahead and indulge in the breakfast for 15 euros its well worth lounging in your sweat pants  before your day starts in Paris. Breakfast features signature drinks such as Cafe Au Lait, a variety of juices, as well as hot and cold items on the buffet. Also, many pastries, yogurt, boiled eggs, etc.  Bathrooms come with the hairdryers and the shampoo and body lotions are all L'Occitane fragrances. Plenty of storage in the little closets. The staff was so friendly and helpful. One of the front desk employees helped me find a private chauffeur for the evening so he could drive us around in luxury for 3 hours at night. I love also that the lounge has a small bar and nespresso coffee for a pick me up. Bilingual staff makes it a great fit for those that don't speak the lanuage.

title: Amazing hotel & service added to the entire Paris trip
text:
My wife & I stayed here for 2 nights, mid January.
The photos do not do the location justice, a 2 minute walk from the Arc d Triomphe, le bus direct stop & the Metro station.
The welcome upon arrival was warm, sincere & friendly & no question in my faltering French was too much for them.
The room (53) is lovely. Some reviews say the rooms are small, this should not put you off. Well appointed, with all the amenities needed including a stool, dresser, great cupboards pace & a safety deposit box. The window to the balcony kept the street noise to a bare minimum ( its a city after all).
The bath room was airy, well lit & the shower over the corner bath a delight after 24km round Paris. The toiletries are beautiful, using Premier Inn for business I always pack some nice ones but could have left them at home, the L'Occitane ones available are gorgeous.
Breakfast in the small salon was fantastic, really great choice, kept topped up in small amounts & with care. The final day a family did clear the pastries that the lady put out & we had to wait while she ran off to get more from the local bakery then they had the nerve to nibble some & leave them! How rude not just for the guest but also the hotel, have some respect people.
A special message to the lovely lady who looked after us upon our return from long days of travelling, she was a delight & made my non French speaking wife feel welcome & comfortable.
The bar has a small selection of really good drinks, half the price of the local Beer station & artisanal not the usual Pression. 
The hotel also kept our luggage safe for 4 hours whilst we toured again before getting our bus to the airport & at no cost!

title: Lovely Hotel
text:
Myself and my fiancée stayed in this hotel in October 2017 for 4 days as it was fiancée's birthday. It is a lovely hotel and in a great location situated right next to the Arc De Triomphe. We had a nice room with a balcony looking on to the Arc which is nice to sit out on and watch the world go by. The room was a good size with everything that you need and there was very little noise from outside. The staff were so welcoming and friendly and spoke very good English. 
The only slight negative, and the reason that I never rated it a 5 out of 5, was the breakfast. There is a very small dining room downstairs with limited options to eat. There were things like ham, cheese, toast etc, but they did run out quite quick and the woman who was there wasn't very quick in refilling the trays. She also never explained about the hot food options and for 13 Euro's you can get better breakfasts in the cafes nearby the hotel.
However, don't let this put you off this hotel. It's a fabulous hotel for the price in a great location with very helpful reception staff. The biggest compliment I can give it is that if we come back to Paris I will definitely stay in this hotel again.
A little tip for you. You can get on the shuttle bus from CDG airport for 17 Euros per person and it takes you to the next street along from the Etoile Park Hotel. It is literally a 5 min walk away. This takes the hassle out of trying to work out how to get into the centre of Paris from the airport.

title: A QUIET LITTLE GEM IN PARIS
text: We recently stayed at this quaint little hotel which is close to everything Paris. We stayed in room 61 for 3 nights and returned a week later and had room 44. 61 was much nicer and larger so if you can, try to book it. We had a side view of the Arc from both rooms and cross the road to apartments and another hotel. The street is not too busy and very quiet at night and we slept well. The room had heavy curtains which made it dark and the beds were very comfortable. The rooms were very clean and fresh. We had breakfast included which was a continental but plenty for us. The breakfast room is rather small as is the elevator but I guess that is normal for Paris.  There are restaurants,bakeries and coffee shops close by and in the surrounding streets. The Metro is at the top of the street near the Arc which will get you to anywhere in Paris. Javier is a real asset to this hotel, not only is he very efficient but he has a genuine friendliness and charm and makes you feel like a long lost friend. He remembered our names after a day and went out of his way to make our stay comfortable. All the staff we encountered were friendly. I highly recommend this lovely little hotel if you dont like staying in large impersonal chain hotels. Very reasonably priced too. Will definately stay here again if we are fortunate enough to return to Paris.

title: A BIJOU HOTEL IN CENTRAL PARIS
text:
You would never expect this.  Right in the centre of Paris there is a small hotel that really can be called “bijou”.  Not only that, but it is real value for money considering it is near the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomph and Notre Dame.  It has all the qualities of a five-star hotel but is only rated and priced as a 3 star.  Why is this?  It is because of Ruth, from the Dominican Republic and her colleagues, Naceur ,Javier and Nadia (from Algeria).  I have never seen staff in the centre of any big city put themselves out so much to help and be so genuinely and enthusiastically friendly.
The Etoile Park on Avenue Mac Mahon is named after the star shape of the roadways which converge on the Arc de Triomphe which is only round the corner that leads into the Champs Elysee and the marvellous French shopping experience-if you have that sort of money.  The hotel really is a star because of its staff.  Ruth works 12 hour shifts on reception.  Naceur greets you in the evening and stays overnight.  Sometimes Javier takes over.  Next morning Nadia is hard at work as the housekeeper providing a standard of cleanliness and attention to detail that you don’t always find in larger hotels.  Nothing is too much trouble for them.  It is a small firm which owns the hotel which was refurbished about 2 years ago .
Ruth spent a lot of time trying to help me get back €12 which I’d been overcharged by taxi company.  I greatly appreciate that.
When you walk in, do not expect a spacious lounge, but do expect a designer effort to be different.  There are white hangings on the wall with large swirling black motifs that echo the ironwork on the balconies of nearby apartment blocks.  The furniture is comfortable and the overall effect of the carpet and cushions matching is pleasant.  The lounge looks larger than it is because of the massive mirror on one wall opposite a tiny bar and the entrance through to a well-kept toilet.
There is only one lift up to the bedrooms and the very narrow corridors.  As the building is not too tall and there is a good staircase everyone should feel secure.  One afternoon when I was there than the broke down but Ruth ensured that the maintenance company was there very quickly.
The bedrooms , which have laminated wood floors, can have quirky corners and odd shaped angles to the wall because every inch of space is used.  In our room there were lovely heavy curtains with Don Quixote pictures upon them.  There are no self-made drinks in the rooms-but tea and coffee are freely available down in the lounge.  The hotel does not provide a restaurant but well a order in any type of food from the many restaurants nearby.
We found the mattress to be comfortable and the room warm.  The shower and bathroom area and quality taps and everything worked.  There was not much of a view out of the window but most hotels of this character have been made from former tenement apartments, where the windows overlook each other.  Still, gauze curtains help!
If I ever go back to Paris, I would certainly stay here again and heartily recommend this hotel.

title: Great Parisian Hotel, with very happy service
text:
The location of this hotel- Incredible- 100mts from the Arc de Triomphe.
The rooms- fantastic- and spacious enough with a nice sized closet, TV, minibar. I had a rooftop room
The beds- great sleep quality
The bathroom- Ensuite. with a Shower and bathtub with a skylight above it. L'occitane products and the fluffiest, whitest towels (as also the bed linen). Only the space in the shower was a little tight and near the W/C as well
The housekeeping- very high standards and very efficient
The wifi- was great the first 2 days and then it slowed down so much that even my mails weren't getting loaded
The TV- only french channels- as with most french hotels
The breakfast- didn't have any- but the coffee smelt great
A bar in the lobby- served free tea and coffee
No complimentary water in the rooms
The service was so so helpful and friendly- specially all the front desk staff
There are plenty of great restaurants, cafes and bars nearby.
Champs Elysees is a stone throw away
I would stay here again

title: Great Location
text: Stayed here in April 2022 for 8 nights after a week in London at a very expensive hotel so our expectations were a little high.  The hotel is in a super location.  Walking distance to lots of really good restaurants, subway and many fun areas of the city.  It is very clean and the staff is very nice.  It is a pretty basic hotel.  I would say the room furnishings  are a little dated and the towels can use some fabric softer.  They were a little like sandpaper.  But for the price you cant beat it.    The elevator is extremely small.  One person and one suitcase is a tight squeeze.  Luckily we were only on the second floor.  Remember, in Paris they start counting at "0" floor.  Breakfast we ok.  We only did the hotel breakfast one day.  We so many bakeries near by we found it better to walk over to Eric Keyser every morning and get a fresh croissant/pastry and coffee.  I believe that is more of the real Paris experience.  Would stay here again now that i know what i am getting.  But if i was looking for a more luxury experience i would look for something else.  Also, just so you know, there is no air conditioning.  Coming from Central Florida where we keep our air on almost 365 days a year this was a little problematic.  Luckily it was not very hot while we were there but in the summer i would be a little concerned.

title: Nice small hotel in good location

Let me start by saying I have been to Paris many times and have stayed in a variety of Airbnbs and hotels.  We opted for a hotel this time because the last few times we have stayed at pretty bad Airbnbs.  

This hotel had clean rooms.  They weren't anything special but they were nice enough.  The bathroom was normal size for Paris and the shower worked well.  As far as rooms in Paris go, it was A-OK!  It was expectantly small, but no complaints. 

The location is on a quiet street, but very near the city center.  You can walk to the major sites around the river easily.  We also love the Monoprix grocery store a few blocks away.

Additionally, the daytime staff were super helpful.  We had a lost luggage situation and they went above and beyond to help us!  Thank you!! 

There is one significant thing that could improve this hotel that would take barely any effort on the staff's part.  They have a lovely breakfast room, but they close it after breakfast.  Because the hotel rooms are so small, they should allow guests to use this space.  It would give people a place to relax, caught up on work, write postcards, etc....you get the idea.  It's such a wasted amenity!!  If they feel they'd lose too much money on free coffee/tea, then they could charge customers and actually make some money...  A common room like this would also allow guests to mingle.  This addition would take this property from nice to epic!!

Overall, if you want an inexpensive and clean room in a good location, you will be happy here.

title: Robbed in the night
text: Be afraid...be very afraid of the Grand Hôtel Des Balcons. As the name suggests, the “balconies” of the hotel provided easy access for the robbers who came in the middle of the night, stealing a large chunk of Euros, our bank and credit cards and sunglasses etc. Very hot at the time, we stupidly left our window open after the shutters proved to be old and unlock-able. We woke at 7.30am to find my wife’s handbag gone. Frantically going down to reception, we asked to see lobby CCTV footage of us coming back the previous night, just to be sure my wife was wearing her bag. Hotel staff said we couldn’t look at footage until 2:30pm when the manager arrived. So not much urgency there! At 2:30pm CCTV footage showed my wife wearing her bag, thus confirming it had gone missing from the room. The manager was incredulous, dismissive and rude. The police at the local station, however, were not so incredulous and dismissive explaining this was a relatively common occurrence in Paris. Upon returning from filing the police report the manager did shift us up to a room higher than worry level as we were completely devastated that someone had sneaked into our room while we were sleeping. We were thankful that we hadn’t woken up because that could have only ended badly. So sure, it was our stupidity to open windows, but maybe the hotel should warn patrons of this possibility.

title: Great location- Would return
text:
We stayed here for two nights in July. The hotel is quaint and cozy. I liked our view, it was simply the building across the street, however, it is the enchanting wrought iron railings of the balconies that I had always pictured seeing In Paris. 

The hotel offers a breakfast at 12€ but we did my try it. There are many restaurants nearby. 

There is a hairdryer that was powerful. 

Many outlets nears the desk (not near the bed) 

Rooms are small but standard for Europe. 

The lift is tiny. We opted for the winding staircase (also small) 

The room and bathroom was very clean. Perhaps the cleanest of many of the hotels we stayed at in Europe. 

You will need to leave your key to your room at the front desk every time you leave. I did not think this was a hassle, I prefer it so that I did not have to carry the bigger key or fear losing it. 

There are stores nearby. 

The shower is open to the bathroom separated with a curtain. 

There is no A/C but they did provide a fan. 

Front desk staff were lovely. Arranged a taxi pickup for our trip back to the airport. 
City tax was very little. 

This was our first time visiting Paris. We took a taxi to the hotel as we had traveled 18 hours and felt that we perhaps did not have the right mindset to navigate metro with our luggage. I heard numerous times that the metro is easy and very close to the hotel, however, after the long travel we simply wanted an easy, worry free way to our hotel. From CDG it took us an hour with the traffic. You’ll get a real taste of the pace of the traffic and you remain all above ground to see the sites - we drive right by the Louvre and of course crossed the Seine. We walked many places from our hotel, despite it being very hot : Notre Dame is very close, Musée dOrsay, Seine (it’s nice to walk along this and cross the bridge), we walked to the Louvre and Tuileries as well. We opted for a bus tour the next day to hear some history and detail and get to the Arc de Triomphe, Trocadero & Eiffel Tower (reviews to come on these)

title: Clean, pleasant,would stay again
text: The hotel is located in a perfect spot for exploring this area of Paris near Notre Dame.  There Metro and RER stations close by.  We had two rooms- a double and a single.  The single had a little more floor space since the bed was smaller.  We found both rooms to be two warm but you can lower the powered shutter to the level of the balcony railing for security and then leave the windows open.  The double bed room had only a little bit of floor space.  There was small closet, a small folding stool in the closet, a safe, and a “wet room” shower / toilet combo with a shower curtain.  Some North Americans find the wet room a problem as North Americans don’t design bathrooms that way, but it is very common in Europe and is practical and economical.  The room was very clean, the bed was very comfortable and the room was quiet ( we were on the courtyard side).  As a courtesy to your fellow guest, please make an effort to close your room door quietly, especially in the hours when people may be sleeping as the doors tend to BANG shut.
